rows.translation: “有位农夫让我尝了尝。它们那么新鲜，又那么爽脆，简直像魔法一样。从那以后，我就知道自己想成为植物学家；让一个个世界遍布鲜花与可食用的作物。宇宙能给予我们的太多了，知道吗？我们每天都还在发现新东西。阳光雨露孕育出的组合与香料，都是我们绝不会想到要添加的东西。这就是我热爱植物学的原因。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“One of the farmers gave me a taste. They were so fresh and crisp. It felt like magic. From then, I knew I wanted to be a botanist; to fill worlds with flowers and edible foods. The universe has so much to offer, you know? Stuff we’re still finding every day. Combinations and spices, from the sun and the rain, things that we’d never think to add. That’s why I love botany.”"

rows.original: JimThermic
rows.raw: "JimThermic"

rows.original: You ask Aina what her birth-species is, and if she was born a centaur.
rows.translation: 你问艾娜天生是什么种族，以及她是否生来就是半人马。
rows.raw: "You ask Aina what her birth-species is, and if she was born a centaur."

rows.original: “Nope! I was born a human. This was very costly. My parents threw a fit when I told them I wanted to get gene-modded,” Aina winces, brushing back a blonde bang. “I think they wanted to make sure I wasn’t just going through a phase.”
rows.translation: “不是！我出生时是人类。这副身体非常昂贵。我告诉父母想接受基因改造时，他们大发雷霆，”艾娜皱着脸，拨开一缕金发刘海。“我觉得他们只是想确认这并非我的一时冲动。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nope! I was born a human. This was very costly. My parents threw a fit when I told them I wanted to get gene-modded,” Aina winces, brushing back a blonde bang. “I think they wanted to make sure I wasn’t just going through a phase.”"

rows.original: A phase? You ask why they’d think that. Aina smiles and gives a shrug.
rows.translation: 一个阶段？你问他们为什么会这么想。艾娜笑了笑，耸耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\nA phase? You ask why they’d think that. Aina smiles and gives a shrug."

rows.original: “I went to a fairly well-off school on Vaernes. Every so often, some kid would come to school with a gene-mod that their parents had forked out for, just so they could be a special snowflake. Of course, then all their friends want to follow suit. My parents wanted to make sure it wasn’t just some fad.”
rows.translation: “我在瓦尔尼斯一所相当富裕的学校读书。时不时就会有哪个孩子带着父母花大价钱做的基因改造来学校，好让自己显得独一无二。当然，接着他们的朋友全都想跟风。我父母只是想确认这不是一时兴起。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I went to a fairly well-off school on Vaernes. Every so often, some kid would come to school with a gene-mod that their parents had forked out for, just so they could be a special snowflake. Of course, then all their friends want to follow suit. My parents wanted to make sure it wasn’t just some fad.”"

rows.original: <i>“I understand it, though. Being a taur’s not an easy lifestyle.
rows.translation: <i>“不过我能理解。过半人马的生活并不轻松。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“I understand it, though. Being a taur’s not an easy lifestyle."

rows.original: I mean, you know, right?
rows.translation: 我的意思是，你应该明白吧？
rows.raw: " I mean, you know, right?"

rows.original: Most stuff is built for bipeds, with a little bit of afterthought given for everyone else. I mean, just sitting down in a shuttle is a hassle. There’s like, usually two taur seats and a ton for everyone else. You’ve pretty much got to get used to standing until your hooves sting.”
rows.translation: 大多数东西都是给双足生物设计的，其他人只能得到一点事后补救式的照顾。就连坐穿梭机都很麻烦，通常只有两个半人马座位，剩下的全是普通座位。你基本得习惯一直站到蹄子发痛。”
rows.raw: " Most stuff is built for bipeds, with a little bit of afterthought given for everyone else. I mean, just sitting down in a shuttle is a hassle. There’s like, usually two taur seats and a ton for everyone else. You’ve pretty much got to get used to standing until your hooves sting.”"

rows.original: So why bother becoming a taur, you ask?
rows.translation: 那为什么还要变成半人马呢？你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo why bother becoming a taur, you ask?"

rows.original: “It might sound a little silly, but I like to think I’ve always been a centaur, deep down. I’ve always loved natural things; plants, running, open spaces. A real problem when you live on a planet covered in giga-cities.”
rows.translation: “听起来也许有点傻，但我觉得自己内心深处一直都是半人马。我一直喜欢自然的东西，植物、奔跑、开阔空间。住在一颗遍布巨型城市的星球上，这可是个大问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It might sound a little silly, but I like to think I’ve always been a centaur, deep down. I’ve always loved natural things; plants, running, open spaces. A real problem when you live on a planet covered in giga-cities.”"

rows.original: “I first found out about centaurs when I was playing a fantasy game a friend lent me in high school. It had this beautiful centaur mare in it, and even though she was a bit character, I just found myself identifying so much with her and her species. I read up on the myths and fiction... I ended up visiting centaur extranet sites a lot.”
rows.translation: “我第一次知道半人马，是高中时玩朋友借给我的一款奇幻游戏。里面有一位漂亮的半人马母马，虽然她只是个小角色，我却发现自己非常认同她和她的种族。我去查了神话和小说... 后来还经常浏览半人马的星网网站。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I first found out about centaurs when I was playing a fantasy game a friend lent me in high school. It had this beautiful centaur mare in it, and even though she was a bit character, I just found myself identifying so much with her and her species. I read up on the myths and fiction... I ended up visiting centaur extranet sites a lot.”"

rows.original: “It got so bad that my parents caught me, um, masturbating to stallion porn...” Aina blushes, squirming on the spot. “...I-I was mortified. There I was, legs spread and fingers deep, touching myself to a life-size horseman holo. I was so grounded it wasn’t funny. It didn’t stop me. I ended up on virtual boards, talking to others who’d gone centaur and never looked back. They gave me the confidence to make the change.”
rows.translation: “事情变得太过火了，我父母甚至撞见我，呃，对着种马色情片自慰...” 艾娜红着脸，在原地不安地扭动。“...我、我当时羞死了。那时候我正张开双腿，把手指深深插进去，对着真人大小的马人全息影像抚慰自己。我被禁足得特别惨，一点也不好笑。但这也没能阻止我。后来我上了虚拟论坛，和那些变成半人马后从未后悔的人聊天。他们给了我做出改变的信心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It got so bad that my parents caught me, um, masturbating to stallion porn...” Aina blushes, squirming on the spot. “...I-I was mortified. There I was, legs spread and fingers deep, touching myself to a life-size horseman holo. I was so grounded it wasn’t funny. It didn’t stop me. I ended up on virtual boards, talking to others who’d gone centaur and never looked back. They gave me the confidence to make the change.”"

rows.original: “I walked in, told my parents it was happening one way or another, and that was that. There was shouting, but I stood my ground. They said they weren’t paying for it, so I got a part-time job at McChow Hut. It took me three years to save up the money. Sometimes I thought about just taking out a loan, but I was too scared of defaulting.”
rows.translation: “我走进去，告诉父母这件事无论如何都会发生，就这么定了。我们大吵了一架，但我坚持己见。他们说不会替我付钱，所以我去麦嚼小屋做兼职。我花了三年才攒够钱。有时我想干脆贷款，可我太害怕违约了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I walked in, told my parents it was happening one way or another, and that was that. There was shouting, but I stood my ground. They said they weren’t paying for it, so I got a part-time job at McChow Hut. It took me three years to save up the money. Sometimes I thought about just taking out a loan, but I was too scared of defaulting.”"

rows.original: “Anyway, that’s how I became a centaur - selling fast terrible cheeseburgers and watered down soft drinks. It gave me a new appreciation for home grown food, at least.”
rows.translation: “总之，我就是这样靠卖难吃的速制芝士汉堡和兑水软饮料变成了半人马。至少这让我更懂得珍惜自家种出来的食物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, that’s how I became a centaur - selling fast terrible cheeseburgers and watered down soft drinks. It gave me a new appreciation for home grown food, at least.”"

So long as I’m able to get off, I’m good to still do most things... though I find myself grinding against things a lot more often,” Aina blushes."

rows.raw: " “Though, you know, I’d prefer to be grinding up against, you know, you.”"

rows.raw: "JimThermic"

rows.original: You spot a shelf in Aina’s apartment cluttered with strangely random nick-knacks. There’s a little toy ausar soldier, an ancient-looking flint and steel lighter, a blue bandanna... it all seems completely out of place in her otherwise neat, stylish apartment.
rows.translation: 你看到艾娜公寓里有个架子，上面堆满了奇怪而杂乱的小物件。有一个奥萨尔士兵玩偶、一只看起来很古老的燧石打火机、一条蓝色头巾... 这些东西与她整洁时尚的公寓显得格格不入。
rows.raw: "You spot a shelf in Aina’s apartment cluttered with strangely random nick-knacks. There’s a little toy ausar soldier, an ancient-looking flint and steel lighter, a blue bandanna... it all seems completely out of place in her otherwise neat, stylish apartment."

rows.original: “Oh hey, what’s with those thingy-things over there?”
rows.translation: “嘿，那边那些小玩意儿是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh hey, what’s with those thingy-things over there?”"

rows.original: “Yo, babe. What’s with the crap on the shelf?”
rows.translation: “喂，宝贝。架子上那堆破烂是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yo, babe. What’s with the crap on the shelf?”"

rows.original: “That’s a strange bunch of stuff on that shelf. What’s with it?”
rows.translation: “架子上那堆东西真奇怪。它们是干什么的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s a strange bunch of stuff on that shelf. What’s with it?”"

rows.original: you ask, gesturing for emphasis.
rows.translation: 你一边问，一边特意比划了一下。
rows.raw: " you ask, gesturing for emphasis."

rows.original: The centauress looks over at the shelf, then turns back, golden eyes glinting excitedly. “Oh, you’re asking about my swag? I’ve collected it from all over the galaxy!”
rows.translation: 半人马姑娘看向架子，又转回头，金色双眼兴奋地闪着光。“哦，你是在问我的战利品？我从银河各地收集来的！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe centauress looks over at the shelf, then turns back, golden eyes glinting excitedly. “Oh, you’re asking about my swag? I’ve collected it from all over the galaxy!”"

rows.original: “Your... swag?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your... swag?”"

rows.original: “Yeah, my swag! It’s from Astrocaching. It’s a hobby of mine. Do you know it?”
rows.translation: “对，我的战利品！都是星际寻宝得来的。这是我的爱好。你知道这项活动吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, my swag! It’s from Astrocaching. It’s a hobby of mine. Do you know it?”"

rows.original: You shake your head. Aina pulls a small palm-size device and shows it to you. With a click, a three-dimensional representation of the station floats above the screen, with a green dot showing her position. There’s also a few smaller dots in blue. It’s a CPS - a cosmos positioning system.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头。艾娜拿出一个巴掌大的小装置给你看。她轻轻一点，空间站的三维图像便浮在屏幕上方，一个绿点标示着她的位置，旁边还有几个较小的蓝点。这是一台CPS，也就是宇宙定位系统。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head. Aina pulls a small palm-size device and shows it to you. With a click, a three-dimensional representation of the station floats above the screen, with a green dot showing her position. There’s also a few smaller dots in blue. It’s a CPS - a cosmos positioning system."

rows.original: “Astrocaching is a real-world, galactic treasure hunting game using CPS devices, dating back to Terra. It’s loads of fun. Basically, people leave astrocaches around the galaxy, then drop some coordinates on the extranet. People navigate there and attempt to find the cache nearby. It’s just like being a real treasure hunter!”
rows.translation: “星际寻宝是一种使用CPS设备进行的现实银河寻宝游戏，最早可以追溯到泰拉。特别好玩。基本上，人们会在银河各处留下星际宝藏，再把坐标放到星网上。其他人前往那里，尝试找出藏在附近的宝藏。感觉就像当真正的寻宝猎人！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Astrocaching is a real-world, galactic treasure hunting game using CPS devices, dating back to Terra. It’s loads of fun. Basically, people leave astrocaches around the galaxy, then drop some coordinates on the extranet. People navigate there and attempt to find the cache nearby. It’s just like being a real treasure hunter!”"

rows.original: “When you get there, there’s always a digital logbook inside, where you sign down your name. There’s also swag; things people have left behind in the cache. You can take anything you want, but you’ve got to leave something in its place of equal value. See, I found that stuff in the caches I opened and took them, but I left something small in trade for the next person to take.”
rows.translation: “到了以后，里面总会有一本电子记录簿，可以签下你的名字。还有战利品，也就是别人留在宝藏里的东西。你可以拿走任何想要的东西，但必须留下价值相当的物品作为交换。你看，我从打开的宝藏里拿走了那些东西，但也留下了一件小物品，供下一个人取走。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When you get there, there’s always a digital logbook inside, where you sign down your name. There’s also swag; things people have left behind in the cache. You can take anything you want, but you’ve got to leave something in its place of equal value. See, I found that stuff in the caches I opened and took them, but I left something small in trade for the next person to take.”"

rows.original: You ask her if the blue dots on Tavros are astrocache coordinates. The centauress nods and touches one. Suddenly a small screen pops up, with not only the general area the cache is hidden, but its type, size, and difficulty. This one appears to be three stars.
rows.translation: 你问塔夫罗斯站上的蓝点是不是星际宝藏坐标。半人马姑娘点点头，触碰其中一个。一个小窗口突然弹出，不仅显示宝藏隐藏的大致区域，还标明了类型、大小和难度。这个似乎是三星。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her if the blue dots on Tavros are astrocache coordinates. The centauress nods and touches one. Suddenly a small screen pops up, with not only the general area the cache is hidden, but its type, size, and difficulty. This one appears to be three stars."

rows.original: “Some are harder than others. I’ve only got as high as two stars. I hear you can find some neat swag in the bigger ones. There’s ones as small as a bottle, others large as a shipping container. You don’t really do it for the swag, though, but more for the adventure, you know? Sometimes it takes hours to find a cache, and you find someone’s hidden it as a fake log. Other times, there’s riddles to find caches, or ones that lead to other caches.”
rows.translation: “有些比其他的难。我最高只找过二星的。听说在更大的宝藏里能找到很棒的战利品。有些小得像瓶子，有些则大得像货运集装箱。不过玩这个并不真是为了战利品，更多是为了冒险，明白吗？有时要花好几个小时才能找到一处宝藏，结果发现有人把它伪装成假木头。有时则要解谜才能找到宝藏，还有些宝藏会引向其他宝藏。”

Sometimes it takes hours to find a cache, and you find someone’s hidden it as a fake log. Other times, there’s riddles to find caches, or ones that lead to other caches.”"

rows.original: “Have you ever been on a treasure hunt like that?”
rows.translation: “你参加过那样的寻宝吗？”

rows.original: “Well, yeah, you could sort of say that,” you cough.
rows.translation: “嗯，有吧，某种意义上也可以这么说。”你轻咳一声。

rows.original: You find yourself laughing out loud at her choice of words, and a confused Aina blinks vacantly as you hold your belly. When you finally catch your breath, you explain that the sex is actually not the problem – what’s making Amber unhappy is the fact that there isn’t much space left in her head for things that are not sex. As a result, she has a lot of trouble focusing and can’t really find the time to enjoy her life in any other way.
rows.translation: 她这套说法让你忍不住放声大笑。你捂着肚子，而困惑的艾娜则茫然地眨眼。好不容易喘过气后，你解释说性爱其实不是问题，真正让安珀不开心的是，她脑子里几乎没有空间留给非性爱的事情。因此她很难集中注意力，也几乎找不到时间以其他方式享受生活。

As a result, she has a lot of trouble focusing and can’t really find the time to enjoy her life in any other way."

rows.translation: 你甚至几乎没等她示意，就直冲那扇门！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou barely even wait for her to gesture: you dart for the door!"

rows.original: “Yes, yes! Ohhh yes, let’s. With my fingers all over you, touching your very soul,” swoons the breathy Akane, her hands bringing your head

rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, yes! Ohhh yes, let’s. With my fingers all over you, touching your very soul,” swoons the breathy Akane, her hands bringing your head "

rows.translation: 与她的头相抵。她将额头贴住你的额头，那双空洞漆黑的眼睛直直钻入你的[pc.eyes]。
rows.raw: "to meet hers. She presses your foreheads together, her black, blank eyes boring into your [pc.eyes]."

rows.original: “Efffffhhh, I’ve never wanted to rely or depend on others but I... ohh, I could never deny you, [pc.name],” she half-whispers, a sharp inhale trying to hide the palpable arousal texturing her words. “Now get to that bed before I... do something.”
rows.translation: “呃呃呃，我从没想过要依赖或仰仗别人，可我...噢，[pc.name]，我永远都无法拒绝你，”她半是耳语地说道，一次急促吸气试图掩盖话语中清晰可感的情欲。“现在，趁我还没...做出什么事，快到床上去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Efffffhhh, I’ve never wanted to rely or depend on others but I... ohh, I could never deny you, [pc.name],” she half-whispers, a sharp inhale trying to hide the palpable arousal texturing her words. “Now get to that bed before I... do something.”"

rows.original: She giggles at the thought, her thumbs circling against your cheeks as you give in to your reflexive smile. You can’t wait: you practically sprint to her door!
rows.translation: 想到这里，她咯咯笑了起来，拇指在你脸颊上打着圈；你也任由本能的微笑浮现。你已经等不及了：几乎是一路冲向她的门！
rows.raw: "\n\nShe giggles at the thought, her thumbs circling against your cheeks as you give in to your reflexive smile. You can’t wait: you practically sprint to her door!"

rows.original: You enter her chambers once again through the sliding door, the grayish-blue ambience sucking you into Akane’s personal world. Cheo stands with his hands behind his back, standing to attention with an immovable stance. As you approach the center of the room, he approaches you with his hands open, revealing some dark colored rope.
rows.translation: 你再次穿过滑门进入她的密室，灰蓝色的氛围将你吸入茜的私人世界。切奥双手背在身后，以纹丝不动的姿势立正站着。当你走近房间中央时，他摊开双手迎向你，露出一段深色的绳索。
rows.raw:
"

You enter her chambers once again through the sliding door, the grayish-blue ambience sucking you into Akane’s personal world. Cheo stands with his hands behind his back, standing to attention with an immovable stance. As you approach the center of the room, he approaches you with his hands open, revealing some dark colored rope.

"

rows.original: “Standard procedure,”
rows.translation: “标准流程，”
rows.raw: "“Standard procedure,”"

rows.original: “You know the rules,”
rows.translation: “规矩你都懂，”
rows.raw: "“You know the rules,”"

rows.original: he sniffs under his mask, the roboticized tone at odds with Akane’s assertive direction.
rows.translation: 他在面具下哼声说道，机械化的语调与茜坚定的指示格格不入。
rows.raw: " he sniffs under his mask, the roboticized tone at odds with Akane’s assertive direction."

rows.original: Yeah, yeah, rules is rules...
rows.translation: 是，是，规矩就是规矩...
rows.raw: "Yeah, yeah, rules is rules..."

rows.original: “All that off too,” he adds, pointing to your clothes. You turn around to undress properly, precision over haste.
rows.translation: “那些也全脱掉，”他又说道，指着你的衣服。你转过身，妥善地脱下衣物，将准确放在速度之前。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All that off too,” he adds, pointing to your clothes. You turn around to undress properly, precision over haste."

rows.original: You toss your [pc.gear] behind you with the more dangerous items placed on top of the pile. Apparently satisfied, he grips you by your shoulder with a vice-like paw. Not enough to hurt but there’s no way you could break that hold in this state...
rows.translation: 你把[pc.gear]丢到身后，将更危险的物品放在衣物堆顶端。他似乎满意了，用铁钳般的手掌抓住你的肩膀。力道还不足以弄疼你，但以你现在的状态，根本不可能挣脱...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou toss your [pc.gear] behind you with the more dangerous items placed on top of the pile. Apparently satisfied, he grips you by your shoulder with a vice-like paw. Not enough to hurt but there’s no way you could break that hold in this state..."

rows.original: The masked ausar turns you on the spot so that he faces your back. The click-clack of Akane’s heeled feet come closer from behind, the ausar manipulating and binding your arms and wrists while she inspects and observes.
rows.translation: 戴面具的奥萨尔将你原地转过身，让他面对你的后背。茜的高跟鞋发出咔嗒咔嗒声，从后方越来越近；奥萨尔摆弄着你的手臂和手腕，将它们捆住，而她则在一旁检查观察。
rows.raw: " The masked ausar turns you on the spot so that he faces your back. The click-clack of Akane’s heeled feet come closer from behind, the ausar manipulating and binding your arms and wrists while she inspects and observes. "

rows.original: “A little bit of slack, right there Cheo,” says the queen bee, her finger tapping on your wrist. You feel the rope lighten in tension, not enough to let you move your arms however. “Just like that. Good boy,” half-whispers Akane, stepping in front of you with a knowing smirk on her face. “He’ll be a master knot-tyer in no time.”
rows.translation: “这里稍微松一点，切奥，”女王蜂说道，手指在你的手腕上轻点。你感觉绳索的张力有所减轻，但还没松到能让你活动手臂。 “就这样。好孩子，”茜半是耳语地说道，走到你面前，脸上挂着心照不宣的坏笑。“用不了多久，他就会成为打结大师了。”
rows.raw: "“A little bit of slack, right there Cheo,” says the queen bee, her finger tapping on your wrist. You feel the rope lighten in tension, not enough to let you move your arms however.\n\n“Just like that. Good boy,” half-whispers Akane, stepping in front of you with a knowing smirk on her face. “He’ll be a master knot-tyer in no time.”"

rows.original: “Nearly perfect,” is what you hear from her, metallic digits trailing across the secure bind that ties your forearms and wrists. “Thank you, Akane,” replies the ausar, that digitized voice covering his notes of modesty. Akane has the galaxy’s most telling smirk as she steps out in front of you, a hand on her chin.
rows.translation: “近乎完美，”你听见她说道，金属手指划过牢牢捆住你前臂与手腕的绳结。 “谢谢你，茜，”奥萨尔答道，数字化的声音掩盖了他谦逊的语气。茜带着全银河最耐人寻味的坏笑走到你面前，一手托着下巴。
rows.raw: "“Nearly perfect,” is what you hear from her, metallic digits trailing across the secure bind that ties your forearms and wrists.\n\n“Thank you, Akane,” replies the ausar, that digitized voice covering his notes of modesty. Akane has the galaxy’s most telling smirk as she steps out in front of you, a hand on her chin."

rows.original: “Excellent work, Cheo. I wonder if working on our little playmate is having an effect on you?” jokes Akane, the solid metal of her fingers trailing across the taut and thorough binding. “Ahmm, I couldn’t say,” admits the ausar, clearing his throat. Akane giggles, her fingers creeping up your arm as she turns to face you.
rows.translation: “干得漂亮，切奥。我很好奇，在我们的小玩伴身上练手是不是也影响到你了？”茜打趣道，坚硬的金属手指划过绷紧而严密的束缚。 “呃，我也说不准，”奥萨尔清了清嗓子承认道。茜咯咯轻笑，转身面对你时，手指顺着你的手臂向上爬去。
rows.raw: "“Excellent work, Cheo. I wonder if working on our little playmate is having an effect on you?” jokes Akane, the solid metal of her fingers trailing across the taut and thorough binding.\n\n“Ahmm, I couldn’t say,” admits the ausar, clearing his throat. Akane giggles, her fingers creeping up your arm as she turns to face you."

rows.original: “All comfortable, [pc.name]?” she asks, eyeing your nude form up and down. You nod back, butterflies in your gut stopping you from verbalizing your response. She “hmmm’s”, trailing her fingertips across her pale cheeks.
rows.translation: “还舒服吗，[pc.name]？”她问道，上下打量着你赤裸的身体。你点头回应，腹中的紧张悸动让你无法把回答说出口。她“嗯——”了一声，指尖划过苍白的面颊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All comfortable, [pc.name]?” she asks, eyeing your nude form up and down. You nod back, butterflies in your gut stopping you from verbalizing your response. She “hmmm’s”, trailing her fingertips across her pale cheeks."

rows.original: “I’m surprised these binds are holding up with that squishy body of yours. Even I might have something to learn...” she mumbles, her pinky finger brushing against her ruby red lips.
rows.translation: “真没想到这些绳结居然能困住你那软乎乎的身体。看来就连我也还有东西要学...”她喃喃说道，小指擦过红宝石般的嘴唇。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m surprised these binds are holding up with that squishy body of yours. Even I might have something to learn...” she mumbles, her pinky finger brushing against her ruby red lips."

rows.original: “Even with all that [pc.skinColor] goop, there’s no way you could get out of this thing...” she half-whispers, apparently in awe of Cheo’s work.
rows.translation: “就算你浑身都是[pc.skinColor]黏液，也绝对不可能从这里挣脱出去...”她半是耳语地说道，似乎很佩服切奥的手艺。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Even with all that [pc.skinColor] goop, there’s no way you could get out of this thing...” she half-whispers, apparently in awe of Cheo’s work."

rows.original: “Follow,” she commands, grabbing your left shoulder. Cheo grabs you by the right, the two of them guiding you towards the end of the immaculately made bed.
rows.translation: “跟上，”她命令道，抓住你的左肩。切奥抓住你的右肩，两人引导你走向那张铺得一丝不苟的大床床尾。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Follow,” she commands, grabbing your left shoulder. Cheo grabs you by the right, the two of them guiding you towards the end of the immaculately made bed."

rows.original: Looking at that familiar spot, yet more bubbles and butterflies fill your insides: just to be so close to that wondrous world of... pain...
rows.translation: 看着那个熟悉的位置，更多泡沫与蝴蝶般的悸动涌入你的身体：只因你离那个痛苦的美妙世界如此之近...痛苦...
rows.raw: " Looking at that familiar spot, yet more bubbles and butterflies fill your insides: just to be so close to that wondrous world of... pain..."

rows.original: In short order, you’re placed in front of the edge of the bed. The two of them put pressure on your shoulders, an insistent prompt for you to get down on your [pc.knees]. You do so
rows.translation: 没过多久，你便被安置在床沿前。两人压住你的肩膀，以不容拒绝的动作催促你跪到[pc.knees]上。你
rows.raw: "\n\nIn short order, you’re placed in front of the edge of the bed. The two of them put pressure on your shoulders, an insistent prompt for you to get down on your [pc.knees]. You do so "

rows.translation: 迟疑着照做，约定的时刻越来越近。
rows.raw: "hesitantly, the appointed time drawing nearer."

rows.original: willfully, comfortable with what to expect.
rows.translation: 自愿照做，因为你已清楚会发生什么。
rows.raw: "willfully, comfortable with what to expect."

rows.original: eagerly, eternally wishing to feel Akane’s touch once again.
rows.translation: 迫不及待地照做，永远渴望再次感受茜的触碰。
rows.raw: "eagerly, eternally wishing to feel Akane’s touch once again."

rows.raw: "\n\nAkane herself sits on the edge, no more than a foot of space between the two of you. Your eyeline "

rows.translation: 与她的胸口齐平
rows.raw: "meets her chest"

rows.translation: ，很快便被她近乎疯狂的凝视所支配。
rows.raw: ", quickly becoming dominated by her near-psychotic gaze."

rows.original: Out of nowhere, she clasps your head in her metallic palms!
rows.translation: 她毫无征兆地用金属手掌扣住你的脑袋！
rows.raw: "\n\nOut of nowhere, she clasps your head in her metallic palms!"

rows.original: “Shhshh...” she says under her breath, her slender legs spreading open below. “I wonder...” Akane holds on both sides of your jaw, her hands slowly drawing you closer.
rows.translation: “嘘嘘...”她低声说道，修长的双腿在下方分开。“我想知道...”茜从两侧托住你的下颌，双手缓慢地将你拉近。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shhshh...” she says under her breath, her slender legs spreading open below. “I wonder...” Akane holds on both sides of your jaw, her hands slowly drawing you closer."

rows.original: Her lips part.
rows.translation: 她的双唇张开。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer lips part."

rows.original: You go through the routine, the same old ‘will she/won’t she’ that she always teases you with. Your eyes close and [pc.lips] open...
rows.translation: 你配合着那套固定戏码，还是她总爱拿来逗你的那一套‘她会吻还是不会吻’。你闭上眼睛，张开[pc.lips]...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou go through the routine, the same old ‘will she/won’t she’ that she always teases you with. Your eyes close and [pc.lips] open..."

rows.original: The gentle bump of your mouths touching catches you by surprise. Some part of you expected a rough tongue-fuck and then having your head crushed in between her palms but no... it’s soft, sensuous and slow. The purring mob boss takes her time with your mouth, her fingers gently gripping and releasing against your skull and [pc.hair]. With a gasp, Akane breaks away...
rows.translation: 双唇轻柔相碰，令你猝不及防。你心里有一部分本以为会迎来粗暴的舌吻，接着脑袋会被她两掌夹碎，可事实并非如此...这个吻轻柔、感性而缓慢。这位发出满足低吟的黑帮首领不慌不忙地品尝你的嘴，手指温柔地抓紧又放松你的头颅与[pc.hair]。伴着一声喘息，茜离开了你...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gentle bump of your mouths touching catches you by surprise. Some part of you expected a rough tongue-fuck and then having your head crushed in between her palms but no... it’s soft, sensuous and slow. The purring mob boss takes her time with your mouth, her fingers gently gripping and releasing against your skull and [pc.hair]. With a gasp, Akane breaks away..."

rows.original: “Fuh... ohhhho, now that’s the mouth I’m glad I saved. All for me, a perfect memory,” she says breathily, wiping a sliver of drool from your mouth and hers.
rows.translation: “呼...噢噢噢，我很庆幸救下的是这张嘴。全归我所有，一段完美的回忆，”她气喘吁吁地说道，擦去你与她嘴边的一丝唾液。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuh... ohhhho, now that’s the mouth I’m glad I saved. All for me, a perfect memory,” she says breathily, wiping a sliver of drool from your mouth and hers."

rows.original: You want yours to as well. Your eyes flutter to a close and your [pc.lips] slowly open but...
rows.translation: 你也希望自己的双唇能得到同样待遇。你的双眼颤动着闭上，[pc.lips]缓缓张开，可是...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou want yours to as well. Your eyes flutter to a close and your [pc.lips] slowly open but..."

rows.original: “Mmmmno, I don’t think so,” she says flatly, leaving you in place. “Perhaps when we’re ready.”
rows.translation: “嗯嗯，不，我可不这么想，”她冷淡地说道，把你留在原地。“等我们准备好时或许可以。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmmno, I don’t think so,” she says flatly, leaving you in place. “Perhaps when we’re ready.”"

rows.original: B-but...you’re ready now...!
rows.translation: 可、可是...你现在就准备好了...！
rows.raw: "\n\nB-but...you’re ready now...!"

rows.original: She leans backwards so that she now sits upright, legs still parted. Her hands remain attached to your head and you can feel the fingers locking into place.
rows.translation: 她向后倚去，挺直身体坐着，双腿依旧分开。双手仍贴在你的头上，你能感觉到她的手指锁定到位。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leans backwards so that she now sits upright, legs still parted. Her hands remain attached to your head and you can feel the fingers locking into place."

rows.original: <i>“Like
rows.translation: <i>“就像
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Like "

rows.translation: 之前

rows.translation: 上次，以及每一次
rows.raw: "last time, like every time"

rows.translation: 那样：说出我的名字。”
rows.raw: ": say my name.”\n\n"

rows.original: You hesitate at first, not knowing her game plan. You mouth the word before you say anything, a move to test the waters. “Ah... Akane,” you say slowly, a split second passing before her fingers twitch.
rows.translation: 起初你有些犹豫，不知道她打的什么主意。你无声地念出那个词，先试探一下情况。 “啊...茜，”你缓缓说道，过了不到一秒，她的手指便抽动了一下。
rows.raw: "You hesitate at first, not knowing her game plan. You mouth the word before you say anything, a move to test the waters.\n\n“Ah... Akane,” you say slowly, a split second passing before her fingers twitch."

rows.original: Knowing what to expect, you inhale and exhale through your nose with deep, slow breaths. Just a few seconds more... “Akane,” you say firmly, a sinking feeling playing about inside as her fingers twitch.
rows.translation: 你知道接下来会发生什么，于是用鼻子深深地、缓慢地吸气呼气。再过几秒... “茜，”你坚定地说道；她手指抽动时，一阵下沉感在你体内游移。
rows.raw: "Knowing what to expect, you inhale and exhale through your nose with deep, slow breaths. Just a few seconds more...\n\n“Akane,” you say firmly, a sinking feeling playing about inside as her fingers twitch."

rows.original: “Akane!” you blurt out, needy and eager for her loving touch. She giggles at your eagerness and at that moment, her fingers twitch.
rows.translation: “茜！”你脱口喊道，急切渴望着她充满爱意的触碰。 她因你的急切而咯咯轻笑，就在这时，她的手指抽动了一下。
rows.raw: "“Akane!” you blurt out, needy and eager for her loving touch.\n\nShe giggles at your eagerness and at that moment, her fingers twitch."

rows.original: “Akane,” you say immediately, fully prepared for what’s to come. She merely smiles back, a devilish smile that precedes the tell-tale twitch in her fingers.
rows.translation: “茜，”你立刻说道，对即将发生的一切做好了充分准备。 她只是对你微笑，那魔鬼般的笑容之后，手指果然抽动了一下。
rows.raw: "“Akane,” you say immediately, fully prepared for what’s to come.\n\nShe merely smiles back, a devilish smile that precedes the tell-tale twitch in her fingers."

rows.original: All at once, a heat that feels like molten metal burns into your skin! It starts from her palms, from your jaw to your temples and spreads all over the muscles of your upper body! Your throat locks up, your lungs freeze and every limb becomes paralyzed in place as the brutal energy of Akane makes its mark on your body yet again.
rows.translation: 刹那间，一股仿佛熔融金属般的热量灼入你的皮肤！它从她的掌心开始，自你的下颌蔓延至太阳穴，又席卷上半身的全部肌肉！你的喉咙紧锁、肺部冻结，每一条肢体都麻痹在原地，茜那狂暴的能量再次在你身上留下烙印。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll at once, a heat that feels like molten metal burns into your skin! It starts from her palms, from your jaw to your temples and spreads all over the muscles of your upper body! Your throat locks up, your lungs freeze and every limb becomes paralyzed in place as the brutal energy of Akane makes its mark on your body yet again."

rows.original: You want to scream. Oh how badly you and your body want to scream! Nerves burn and bristle with inorganic agony, the overwhelming force penetrating your senses just as deep. The blue lights of the room become difficult to look at, the rapid beating of your blood throbs in your ear and the faintest whiff of ozone fills your nose.
rows.translation: 你想要尖叫。噢，你和你的身体是多么渴望尖叫！神经在非自然的剧痛中灼烧竖起，那压倒性的力量同样深入贯穿你的感官。房间里的蓝色灯光变得刺眼，血液急速搏动的声音在耳中轰鸣，鼻端则萦绕着一丝微弱的臭氧味。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou want to scream. Oh how badly you and your body want to scream! Nerves burn and bristle with inorganic agony, the overwhelming force penetrating your senses just as deep. The blue lights of the room become difficult to look at, the rapid beating of your blood throbs in your ear and the faintest whiff of ozone fills your nose."

rows.original: Everything’s a blur. Your only possible focus through the subjugation is the wide-eyed, psychotic grin of Akane. In that moment, the current tearing through your senses numbs everything. The vision of her shakes, twists and- “Aghh!”
rows.translation: 一切都模糊不清。 在这场征服中，你唯一能聚焦的只有茜睁大双眼的疯狂笑容。那一刻，撕裂你感官的电流让一切都陷入麻木。她的身影震颤、扭曲，然后- “啊！”
rows.raw: " Everything’s a blur. Your only possible focus through the subjugation is the wide-eyed, psychotic grin of Akane. In that moment, the current tearing through your senses numbs everything. The vision of her shakes, twists and- “Aghh!”"

rows.original: You’ve endured worse: the roiling surges of euphoric agony that have taken control of you make your body feel so alive! You can feel it in every part of you, from head to [pc.feet].

rows.original: As Cheo hurries off to carry out his orders, you’re quietly preparing for what’s next. With a small prompt from Akane’s palm, she traces the outline of your [pc.hip]. “Remember the safewords?” she whispers. You nod in turn: “Breve” and “Tacet”.
rows.translation: 切奥匆匆离去执行命令时，你默默为接下来的事做准备。茜用掌心轻轻提示，勾勒出你[pc.hip]的轮廓。“还记得安全词吗？”她低声问道。你随即点头：“Breve”和“Tacet”。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs Cheo hurries off to carry out his orders, you’re quietly preparing for what’s next. With a small prompt from Akane’s palm, she traces the outline of your [pc.hip]. “Remember the safewords?” she whispers. You nod in turn: “Breve” and “Tacet”."

rows.original: “Strip.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Strip.”"

rows.original: Y-yeah...! You turn on the spot, eager to tap into her wavelength. You take a minute to undress from your [pc.gear]. The resulting pile ends up behind you, somewhere. Ahh well, you can worry about it later...
rows.translation: 好、好的...！你原地转身，迫不及待地想与她的节奏同步。你花了一分钟脱下[pc.gear]。最后形成的衣物堆落在你身后某处。啊，好吧，这事以后再操心...
rows.raw: "\n\nY-yeah...! You turn on the spot, eager to tap into her wavelength. You take a minute to undress from your [pc.gear]. The resulting pile ends up behind you, somewhere. Ahh well, you can worry about it later..."

rows.original: You raise your arms in the air to finish, anticipating what comes next.
rows.translation: 最后你将双臂举到空中，期待接下来会发生什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise your arms in the air to finish, anticipating what comes next."

rows.original: “Mmmhmm, I like a little eagerness in a new blood. Or are you such a sudden craven for a lashing that the mere suggestion gets you going?” mocks Akane, the sounds of servos coming from overhead. The two clamps lock around your hands with a jolt, securing you in place.
rows.translation: “嗯哼，我喜欢新人身上这点迫不及待。还是说，你突然渴求鞭打到了光听提议就会兴奋的地步？”茜嘲弄道，头顶传来伺服机的声响。两只夹具猛地扣住你的双手，将你固定在原地。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmhmm, I like a little eagerness in a new blood. Or are you such a sudden craven for a lashing that the mere suggestion gets you going?” mocks Akane, the sounds of servos coming from overhead. The two clamps lock around your hands with a jolt, securing you in place."

rows.original: Second time around, you’ve got used to the balance needed from your back legs.
rows.translation: 这是第二次了，你已经习惯了用后腿维持平衡所需的技巧。
rows.raw: " Second time around, you’ve got used to the balance needed from your back legs."

rows.original: “Please whip me, Akane,” you say with confidence, looking her dead in the face. “I... need it.”

rows.raw: "“Please whip me, Akane,” you say with confidence, looking her dead in the face. “I... need it.”"

rows.raw: ". “And I need it too.” She helps turn you on the spot, her husky breathing playing around your [pc.ears]."

rows.original: “So say it again,” she commands.
rows.translation: “所以，再说一次，”她命令道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So say it again,” she commands."

rows.original: “Please whip me, Akane!” you say automatically, louder than before.
rows.translation: “请鞭打我，茜！”你不假思索地说道，声音比之前更大。

rows.translation: “再说一遍！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Again!”"

rows.original: “Please whip me, Akane!!!” you yell, your cheeks flushing red. D-did you just...
rows.translation: “请鞭打我，茜！！！”你大喊道，双颊涨得通红。你、你刚才是不是...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please whip me, Akane!!!” you yell, your cheeks flushing red. D-did you just..."

rows.original: “Right... well, get ready then,” she says casually, releasing you from her playful fingers. Without another thought, you quickly get out of your [pc.gear] without much thought to where it ends up.
rows.translation: “好吧...那就准备好，”她随口说道，调皮的手指放开了你。你不再多想，迅速脱下[pc.gear]，也没怎么在意它们最后落在何处。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right... well, get ready then,” she says casually, releasing you from her playful fingers. Without another thought, you quickly get out of your [pc.gear] without much thought to where it ends up."

rows.original: As soon as you’re ready, you fling your arms up in the air. The servo-cuffs almost seem to shoot out of the ceiling, the mechanical gauntlets locking your wrists in place with a welcomed, relief-building TOONG TOONG.
rows.translation: 你一准备好，便猛地将双臂举到空中。伺服镣铐仿佛从天花板里射出，机械手套伴着令人欣然期待、如释重负的咚咚声将你的手腕锁在原地。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs soon as you’re ready, you fling your arms up in the air. The servo-cuffs almost seem to shoot out of the ceiling, the mechanical gauntlets locking your wrists in place with a welcomed, relief-building TOONG TOONG."

rows.original: You’ve never been more ready.
rows.translation: 你从未像现在这样准备充分。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve never been more ready."

rows.original: “Can you...whip me?” you blurt out, the desire for a lashing overpowering your self-control.
rows.translation: “你能...鞭打我吗？”你脱口而出，对鞭打的渴望压倒了自制力。
rows.raw: "“Can you...whip me?” you blurt out, the desire for a lashing overpowering your self-control."

rows.translation: 茜听到你的请求后挑起眉毛。近乎疯狂的笑容在她红宝石般的双唇上绽开，令你忍不住露出同样的表情。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane raises her brow at your request. A near-maniacal grin spreads across her ruby lips, one that you can’t help but imitate."

rows.original: “What was that? You’ll have to say it louder,” whispers the yakuza boss, her thumb pulling at your chin.
rows.translation: “你说什么？得再大声一点，”极道首领低声说道，拇指拉扯着你的下巴。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What was that? You’ll have to say it louder,” whispers the yakuza boss, her thumb pulling at your chin."

rows.original: “Whip me, Akane!” you blurt out again, closing your eyes in admittance.
rows.translation: “鞭打我，茜！”你再次脱口喊道，闭上眼睛承认自己的欲望。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whip me, Akane!” you blurt out again, closing your eyes in admittance."

rows.original: “Cheeeoooo, you know what to bring,” calls out Akane, her eyes never breaking their lock on you. Cheo hurries off at once, an audible huff coming through his mask. “And as for you, [pc.name], uh...”
rows.translation: “切奥奥奥奥，你知道该拿什么来，”茜喊道，目光始终锁定着你。切奥立刻匆匆离去，面具下传出一声清晰的哼气。“至于你，[pc.name]，呃...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cheeeoooo, you know what to bring,” calls out Akane, her eyes never breaking their lock on you. Cheo hurries off at once, an audible huff coming through his mask. “And as for you, [pc.name], uh...”"

rows.raw: " in a pile to the side, all that’s left to do iiiis: turn around, arms in the air, brace for impact..."

rows.original: The servos whirring above add to the building butterflies in your gut but it’s all part of the movement, part of the routine: when they clamp around your held up wrists, relief tickles your spine in the most pleasant way.
rows.translation: 头顶伺服机的嗡鸣加剧了你腹中不断累积的紧张悸动，但这都是动作和流程的一部分：当它们扣住你高举的手腕时，如释重负的感觉以最令人愉悦的方式挠过你的脊柱。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe servos whirring above add to the building butterflies in your gut but it’s all part of the movement, part of the routine: when they clamp around your held up wrists, relief tickles your spine in the most pleasant way."

rows.original: You’re ready.
rows.translation: 你准备好了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re ready."

rows.original: Now your view is the long chamber of artisan walls and rockpool springs.
rows.translation: 现在映入眼帘的是这间以工匠墙面与岩池温泉装点的狭长密室。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow your view is the long chamber of artisan walls and rockpool springs."

rows.original: Something rough and bundled gets dragged across your back. The sensation sends a discomforting chill up and down your spine, making you catch your breath.
rows.translation: 某种粗糙而卷成一束的东西从你背上拖过。那感觉令不适的寒意顺着脊柱上下窜动，使你屏住呼吸。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething rough and bundled gets dragged across your back. The sensation sends a discomforting chill up and down your spine, making you catch your breath."

rows.original: “B-but I’m not ready...I think?!” you blurt out.
rows.translation: “可、可我还没准备好...我觉得？！”你脱口说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“B-but I’m not ready...I think?!” you blurt out."

rows.original: “Don’t worry, precious. I would never give you more than you could handle, trust me... I’ll be with you every step of the way,” croons Akane, a free hand caressing a [pc.hip]. You hear her take some steps back behind you.
rows.translation: “别担心，宝贝。我绝不会给你无法承受的东西，相信我...我会全程陪在你身边，”茜柔声吟道，一只空闲的手爱抚着你的[pc.hip]。你听见她在身后退了几步。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t worry, precious. I would never give you more than you could handle, trust me... I’ll be with you every step of the way,” croons Akane, a free hand caressing a [pc.hip]. You hear her take some steps back behind you."

rows.original: You close your eyes.
rows.translation: 你闭上眼睛。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou close your eyes."

rows.original: “One... two... three...!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“One... two... three...!”"

rows.original: You brush it aside, shaking it off as novices nerves. You want it again, no matter how fresh the experience or wounds are.
rows.translation: 你将这念头甩开，把它当作新手的紧张。无论这次体验或伤口多么新鲜，你都想再来一次。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou brush it aside, shaking it off as novices nerves. You want it again, no matter how fresh the experience or wounds are."

rows.original: “You’re all ...comfortable, I take it? It’s all under control, I promise you,” whispers Akane, her voice trailing from some unseen, impossible position behind you. You nod as she talks, a sense of trust growing within you as the process continues. A few clink-clinks later and she’s in position.
rows.translation: “我猜你现在...还舒服吧？一切都在控制之中，我向你保证，”茜低声说道，声音从身后某个看不见也不可能存在的位置飘来。她说话时你点了点头，随着流程继续，心中逐渐生出信任感。又响了几声叮当之后，她已站好位置。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re all ...comfortable, I take it? It’s all under control, I promise you,” whispers Akane, her voice trailing from some unseen, impossible position behind you. You nod as she talks, a sense of trust growing within you as the process continues. A few clink-clinks later and she’s in position."

rows.original: You inhale, savoring the moment before it’s all let loose.
rows.translation: 你吸了口气，品味着一切彻底释放前的瞬间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou inhale, savoring the moment before it’s all let loose."

rows.original: “One.... two.... three!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“One.... two.... three!”"

You try to calm your heart with a few slow breaths with the cooling air adding some mild relief for your senses. But thenWuh-TSSCH!

rows.raw: "Fuck, that hurts!"

rows.original: “Holding up, precious?” says Akane from behind, loud and clear.
rows.translation: “还撑得住吗，宝贝？”茜的声音从身后清晰响亮地传来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Holding up, precious?” says Akane from behind, loud and clear."

rows.original: The mechanical gauntlets holding you up spring open and release you. You almost fall to the floor, the quick intervention of Akane and Cheo holding you on each side halting you midway. You whimper as your body calms down from the ordeal, the numbness and aching giving way to fatigue and delirium. Gotta... find somewhere... to...
rows.translation: 吊住你的机械手套弹开，将你释放。你几乎摔到地上，茜与切奥迅速从两侧扶住你，才让你半途停下。身体从这场折磨中逐渐平复时，你发出呜咽；麻木与酸痛渐渐让位于疲惫和恍惚。得...找个地方...去...

You whimper as your body calms down from the ordeal, the numbness and aching giving way to fatigue and delirium. Gotta... find somewhere... to..."

rows.original: Cheo bears the brunt of you on his shoulder, holding you up by himself as Akane quickly strides to the sliding door of her chambers.
rows.translation: 切奥用肩膀承受了你大部分重量，独自撑住你，而茜则快步走向密室的滑门。
rows.raw: "\n\nCheo bears the brunt of you on his shoulder, holding you up by himself as Akane quickly strides to the sliding door of her chambers."

rows.original: “Let’s get [pc.himHer] a place to cool down, Cheo,” she calls out, gesturing the two of you to follow.
rows.translation: “切奥，我们带[pc.himHer]去个能缓一缓的地方，”她喊道，示意你们两个跟上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s get [pc.himHer] a place to cool down, Cheo,” she calls out, gesturing the two of you to follow."

rows.original: You limp alongside the stocky ausar with timid steps. As you enter the chamber, the dim blue hue of the lights cools your mind somewhat, the physical pain seeming to numb as you approach her bed. Akane reclines on top, patting the space next to her for you alone. With Cheo’s guidance, you lay on top of the plush surface with a small grunt of discomfort. There’s little you can do but lay on your side.
rows.translation: 你迈着胆怯的步子，一瘸一拐地跟在矮壮的奥萨尔身旁。进入密室后，昏暗的蓝色灯光稍稍冷却了你的思绪；当你走近她的床铺时，身体的疼痛似乎也变得麻木。茜斜躺在床上，轻拍身旁只留给你的位置。在切奥的引导下，你伴着一声不适的轻哼躺上柔软表面。你几乎什么也做不了，只能侧身躺着。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou limp alongside the stocky ausar with timid steps. As you enter the chamber, the dim blue hue of the lights cools your mind somewhat, the physical pain seeming to numb as you approach her bed. Akane reclines on top, patting the space next to her for you alone. With Cheo’s guidance, you lay on top of the plush surface with a small grunt of discomfort. There’s little you can do but lay on your side."

rows.raw: "<i>“Tell me about you and who you are first. I know your name and... preferences but that’s it. What’s behind Akane’s mask...?"

rows.original: <i>“Talk about yourself again, I like it when you do that,
rows.translation: <i>“再聊聊你自己吧，我喜欢听你这么做，
rows.raw: "<i>“Talk about yourself again, I like it when you do that,"

rows.original: ” you say softly, a look of curiosity on your face.
rows.translation: ”你轻声说道，脸上带着好奇。
rows.raw: "” you say softly, a look of curiosity on your face. "

rows.original: She purses her lips as she tries to think.
rows.translation: 她抿起嘴唇，努力思考。
rows.raw: "She purses her lips as she tries to think."

rows.original: You see her mouth “Again?” with a slight furrow in her brow.
rows.translation: 你看到她眉头微蹙，无声念出“又来？”
rows.raw: "You see her mouth “Again?” with a slight furrow in her brow."

rows.original: “Hmmm... so obviously, I am Akane. It’s not just a name, more of a sign of respect. Almost a title, if you will. I wouldn’t want to say I’m that important to have one but it does have a nice ring to it. How I earned it is its own story,” she starts off by saying, casual and matter-of-fact.
rows.translation: “嗯...很显然，我就是茜。它不只是个名字，更像一种敬称。你也可以把它当作头衔。我不想说自己重要到了配得上头衔的地步，但它听起来确实不错。至于我是怎么赢得它的，那就是另一个故事了，”她以随意而实事求是的口吻开场说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmmm... so obviously, I am Akane. It’s not just a name, more of a sign of respect. Almost a title, if you will. I wouldn’t want to say I’m that important to have one but it does have a nice ring to it. How I earned it is its own story,” she starts off by saying, casual and matter-of-fact."

rows.original: “I am the ‘big boss’ of this little organization, as you’ve likely gathered. Been doing it a while, some would say for far longer than is supposedly healthy. Others still consider me a bit of a child in the criminal game. Less said on that for now, the better,” she smirks, rolling her eyes.
rows.translation: “想必你已经猜到了，我是这个小组织的‘大老板’。我干这行已有一段时间，有些人会说远远超过了所谓的健康时限。另一些人仍把我当成犯罪游戏中的小孩子。这个话题暂且还是少说为妙，”她翻着眼睛坏笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am the ‘big boss’ of this little organization, as you’ve likely gathered. Been doing it a while, some would say for far longer than is supposedly healthy. Others still consider me a bit of a child in the criminal game. Less said on that for now, the better,” she smirks, rolling her eyes."

rows.original: “Always irks me when that’s mentioned, as if I’m not already old enough or something. Although I do often forget in this routine. Is it 47 or 48, Cheo?”
rows.translation: “每次有人提起这点，我都会恼火，好像我的年纪还不够大似的。不过，我确实经常在这种日常工作中忘记年龄。切奥，是四十七还是四十八？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Always irks me when that’s mentioned, as if I’m not already old enough or something. Although I do often forget in this routine. Is it 47 or 48, Cheo?”"

rows.original: “Fairly sure it’s 47,” comes a low, distant voice from the door.
rows.translation: “我很确定是四十七，”门边传来低沉遥远的声音。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fairly sure it’s 47,” comes a low, distant voice from the door."

rows.original: “Mmm, not as bad as I thought. Time has a habit of leaving you in this line of work,” giggles Akane, brushing her hair from her face. “Almost feels motherly at times, having all these young agents around me and making sure they’re not jumping into frying pans on a daily basis. I wonder if real mothers have ‘that’ sort of feeling...?”
rows.translation: “嗯，没我想得那么糟。干我们这行，时间总有抛下你的习惯，”茜将头发从脸上拨开，咯咯笑道。“有时候几乎有种当母亲的感觉，身边围着这些年轻特工，每天都得确保他们不会往油锅里跳。我很好奇，真正的母亲是不是也有‘那种’感觉...？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm, not as bad as I thought. Time has a habit of leaving you in this line of work,” giggles Akane, brushing her hair from her face. “Almost feels motherly at times, having all these young agents around me and making sure they’re not jumping into frying pans on a daily basis. I wonder if real mothers have ‘that’ sort of feeling...?”"

rows.original: pregnancy/total births
rows.raw: "pregnancy/total births"

rows.original: Having been pregnant, you ask her to clarify what she means. “Ohh! Hm... that overwhelming sense of worry and pride that bubbles up when I think about them. You know the thing right?” You nod, although you’ve no way of knowing if that’s the same experience. “So young...” you hear her whisper.
rows.translation: 你曾经怀过孕，于是请她解释自己是什么意思。 “噢！嗯...每当我想到他们时，心里都会涌起压倒性的担忧和骄傲。你懂这种感觉，对吧？” 你点点头，尽管无从判断这是不是同一种体验。 “真年轻...”你听见她低声说道。
rows.raw: " Having been pregnant, you ask her to clarify what she means. “Ohh! Hm... that overwhelming sense of worry and pride that bubbles up when I think about them. You know the thing right?” You nod, although you’ve no way of knowing if that’s the same experience. “So young...” you hear her whisper."

rows.original: “Anyway,” she continues, brushing the thought aside. “I suppose there’s not really a lot to myself aside all this. It’s almost a 24 hour shift in a lot of ways, directing where things go and who faces the wrath of a fist. Even if I don’t have to do the dirty work, still...” - she yawns in between with her mouth covered - “still rather draining. I’m just blessed to have so many lovely boys and girls on the payroll.”
rows.translation: “总之，”她继续说道，将这个念头抛到一边。“我想除了这一切之外，我自己其实没多少可说的。从很多方面看，这几乎是每天二十四小时的班次，要指挥事情的发展方向，还要决定谁来承受拳头的怒火。即使脏活不需要我亲自做，还是...” - 她捂着嘴，在话间打了个哈欠 - “还是相当耗人。能有这么多可爱的男孩女孩领取我的薪水，是我的福气。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway,” she continues, brushing the thought aside. “I suppose there’s not really a lot to myself aside all this. It’s almost a 24 hour shift in a lot of ways, directing where things go and who faces the wrath of a fist. Even if I don’t have to do the dirty work, still...” - she yawns in between with her mouth covered - “still rather draining. I’m just blessed to have so many lovely boys and girls on the payroll.”"

rows.original: You ask her about her particular sexual tastes, considering the idea that they seem very personal to her.
rows.translation: 考虑到她的性癖似乎非常私人，你向她询问起具体偏好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her about her particular sexual tastes, considering the idea that they seem very personal to her."

rows.original: “Mhm... very personal subject. Let’s just say that I’ve never had a taste for being... controlled,” she says softly, a hint of menace in her ending word. You sense that it’d be a topic best left for later but...
rows.translation: “嗯哼...非常私人的话题。就这么说吧，我从来都不喜欢被...控制，”她轻声说道，最后一个词带着一丝威胁。你感觉这个话题最好留到以后再谈，但是...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mhm... very personal subject. Let’s just say that I’ve never had a taste for being... controlled,” she says softly, a hint of menace in her ending word. You sense that it’d be a topic best left for later but..."

rows.original: “But I think I can say that I’ve only ever worked with what I’ve been given. Oh and whoever was willing enough, mmhmm,” smiles Akane, gently squeezing your hand between her fingers.
rows.translation: “不过，我想我可以说，自己一直都只会利用手头已有的东西。噢，当然还有任何足够自愿的人，嗯哼，”茜微笑道，用手指轻轻握紧你的手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But I think I can say that I’ve only ever worked with what I’ve been given. Oh and whoever was willing enough, mmhmm,” smiles Akane, gently squeezing your hand between her fingers."

rows.original: TALKED_HER
rows.raw: "TALKED_HER"

rows.original: Her
rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "Her"

rows.original: Well so far, there’s a lot of answers needed for all... this. Start with the basics.
rows.translation: 到目前为止，这...一切仍有许多问题需要回答。先从基本情况开始。
rows.raw: "Well so far, there’s a lot of answers needed for all... this. Start with the basics."

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "You"

rows.original: “So what do you actually know about me...?” you ask plainly, the sneaking suspicion about her knowing of Steele Tech tickling bits of your curiosity. “
rows.translation: “那么你究竟知道多少关于我的事...？”你直截了当地问道；怀疑她掌握斯蒂尔科技相关信息的念头勾起了几分好奇。 “
rows.raw: "“So what do you actually know about me...?” you ask plainly, the sneaking suspicion about her knowing of Steele Tech tickling bits of your curiosity.\n\n“"

rows.original: No more than I’ve already said back to you.
rows.translation: 并不比我已经对你说过的更多。
rows.raw: "No more than I’ve already said back to you. "

rows.original: I know what you look like naked,” she giggles, brushing her hair to the side as it flops over her face. “And that you’re very receptive... very receptive indeed.”
rows.translation: 我知道你裸体是什么样子，”她咯咯笑道，将垂到脸上的头发拨向一旁。“还知道你非常容易接受...确实非常容易接受。”
rows.raw: "I know what you look like naked,” she giggles, brushing her hair to the side as it flops over her face. “And that you’re very receptive... very receptive indeed.”"

rows.original: In that small moment, her eyes turn from calm to predatory as if she was still in control of your physical body.
rows.translation: 就在那短短一刻，她的眼神从平静变得如捕食者般锐利，仿佛依然控制着你的身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn that small moment, her eyes turn from calm to predatory as if she was still in control of your physical body."

rows.original: <i>“But in terms of everything else... I know of your legacy, your family, career, age, sizes, most purchases made within the last solar year, your email contacts, important dates, ship, crew, uhh... what was the other thing? OHH right, also a deluge of half-baked theories and crushed dreams on some extranet forums.
rows.translation: <i>“但至于其他方面...我知道你的传承、家人、职业、年龄、尺寸、上一个太阳年里的大多数购物记录、邮件联系人、重要日期、飞船、船员，呃...另一件是什么来着？噢，对了，还有某些星网上论坛里铺天盖地的半吊子理论和破碎梦想。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“But in terms of everything else... I know of your legacy, your family, career, age, sizes, most purchases made within the last solar year, your email contacts, important dates, ship, crew, uhh... what was the other thing? OHH right, also a deluge of half-baked theories and crushed dreams on some extranet forums."

rows.original: I believe the biggest is called #tits_general.
rows.translation: 我记得最大的那个叫#tits_general。
rows.raw: " I believe the biggest is called #tits_general."

rows.original: ” You’re a little taken aback: on one hand, you’d expect her to know something at least but so much raw information...
rows.translation: ” 你有些吃惊：一方面，你本来就觉得她至少会知道一些，可这么多原始信息还是...
rows.raw: "”\n\nYou’re a little taken aback: on one hand, you’d expect her to know something at least but so much raw information..."

rows.original: “Oh don’t be so surprised, this is far from the dirty laundry we’d usually scope out for celebrity types. Although you’re not much of a celebrity in fairness, no offence,” she quips, tracing her fingers across your palm. “In fact, Steele Tech is something of less than low interest. An awful lot of slow gains with far too many barriers of entry for such a small group like ours. I think we have some form of contact in there however, isn’t that right Cheo?”
rows.translation: “噢，别这么惊讶，这离我们通常会为名人翻出的丑事还差得远呢。不过公平地说，你也算不上什么名人，无意冒犯，”她打趣道，用手指划过你的掌心。“事实上，斯蒂尔科技的利益价值连低都算不上。对我们这样的小团体来说，收益来得太慢，准入障碍又实在太多。不过，我想我们在那里确实有某种联系人，对吧，切奥？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh don’t be so surprised, this is far from the dirty laundry we’d usually scope out for celebrity types. Although you’re not much of a celebrity in fairness, no offence,” she quips, tracing her fingers across your palm. “In fact, Steele Tech is something of less than low interest. An awful lot of slow gains with far too many barriers of entry for such a small group like ours. I think we have some form of contact in there however, isn’t that right Cheo?”"

rows.original: “Operation Ran-Soh-Kah,” comes Cheo’s distant, low voice from the doorway.
rows.translation: “冉-索-卡行动，”门边传来切奥遥远而低沉的声音。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Operation Ran-Soh-Kah,” comes Cheo’s distant, low voice from the doorway."

rows.original: “Ahhh yes, yes. Less said on that the better,” winks Akane, a smug look forming across her face.
rows.translation: “啊啊，对，对。这个还是少说为妙，”茜眨了眨眼，脸上浮现得意神色。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahhh yes, yes. Less said on that the better,” winks Akane, a smug look forming across her face."

rows.original: Hang on, she... what... but...!
rows.raw: "\n\nHang on, she... what... but...!"

rows.original: “W-wait a sec-” you begin to say.
rows.translation: “等、等一下-”你开口说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-wait a sec-” you begin to say."

rows.original: <i>“Hushshsh, don’t worry. Consider it a mutually beneficial scenario.
rows.translation: <i>“嘘嘘，别担心。把它当作一个互惠互利的局面。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Hushshsh, don’t worry. Consider it a mutually beneficial scenario. "

rows.original: I’m fairly sure I told you about it anyway, right?
rows.translation: 我相当确定自己已经告诉过你了，对吧？
rows.raw: "I’m fairly sure I told you about it anyway, right? "

rows.original: Besides, you don’t even own the thing yet,” she interrupts, laughing it off.
rows.translation: 况且，你甚至还没拥有那东西呢，”她打断你，用笑声一带而过。
rows.raw: "Besides, you don’t even own the thing yet,” she interrupts, laughing it off."

rows.original: That’s... technically true. And in fairness, you don’t actually have power to stop her from doing it.
rows.translation: 严格来说...确实如此。公平地说，你实际上也没有能力阻止她这么做。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s... technically true. And in fairness, you don’t actually have power to stop her from doing it."

rows.original:
You push it out of your mind for the time being, she’s obviously not telling the whole story but you sense that she’s trying to be honest. You swiftly move on to your usual spiel of what your ultimate end goal is, the people you’ve met and the quests you’ve gone on.
She seems ever so slightly more curious whenever you mention pirates...
rows.translation:
你暂时将这件事抛到脑后。她显然没有讲出全部真相，但你感觉她正努力保持诚实。你迅速转而说起自己惯常的那套故事，包括最终目标、遇见的人和经历的任务。
每当你提到海盗时，她似乎都会稍微更好奇一些...
rows.raw:
"

You push it out of your mind for the time being, she’s obviously not telling the whole story but you sense that she’s trying to be honest. You swiftly move on to your usual spiel of what your ultimate end goal is, the people you’ve met and the quests you’ve gone on.
She seems ever so slightly more curious whenever you mention pirates..."

rows.original: TALKED_YOU
rows.raw: "TALKED_YOU"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "You"

rows.original: She knows some basic info on you but if it’s a fair exchange then she must want to know more...
rows.translation: 她知道你的一些基本资料，但既然要公平交换，她肯定还想知道更多...
rows.raw: "She knows some basic info on you but if it’s a fair exchange then she must want to know more..."

rows.original: History
rows.translation: 经历
rows.raw: "History"

rows.original: “Sooooo, I know a good bit about what you do but not as much as I want to about who you are,”
rows.translation: “所以——，我很了解你在做什么，却不太了解你究竟是谁，”
rows.raw: "“Sooooo, I know a good bit about what you do but not as much as I want to about who you are,”"

rows.original: “I know it was a little difficult before but I want to hear your story again if you’re comfortable,”
rows.translation: “我知道之前这有些困难，但如果你觉得没问题，我想再听一次你的故事，”
rows.raw: "“I know it was a little difficult before but I want to hear your story again if you’re comfortable,”"

rows.original: you ask coolly, hoping that you’re not prying into something too personal.
rows.translation: 你冷静地问道，希望自己没有刺探过于私人的事情。
rows.raw: " you ask coolly, hoping that you’re not prying into something too personal."

rows.original: “Huuuh... you’ve earned it, I suppose. No, you definitely have. Although I’m not sure why, there’s nothing that special there,”
rows.translation: “呼...我想你已经赢得了资格。不，你绝对赢得了。尽管我不确定这是为什么，那里并没有什么特别之处，”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huuuh... you’ve earned it, I suppose. No, you definitely have. Although I’m not sure why, there’s nothing that special there,”"

rows.original: “It’s alright, I don’t mind retelling. Just bear with me if I have a few ‘moments’,”
rows.translation: “没关系，我不介意再讲一遍。如果中间偶尔‘走神’，请多担待，”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s alright, I don’t mind retelling. Just bear with me if I have a few ‘moments’,”"

rows.original: she starts slowly, as if internalizing a confidence boost.
rows.translation: 她缓缓开始说道，仿佛在内心消化这股增强的信心。
rows.raw: " she starts slowly, as if internalizing a confidence boost."

rows.original: “Right, well...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right, well...”"

rows.original: She rubs her eyes with her index and thumb.
rows.translation: 她用食指和拇指揉了揉眼睛。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rubs her eyes with her index and thumb."

rows.original: “So as I’ve said, Akane is more of a title than my name. Something bigger than I am, something that’s just sort of ‘there’ and covers me. Got all sorts of rumours and stories in certain circles, for instance. Mysterious mafioso leader with an army of ghosts and demons, hmhm. Or some old witch from myth who won’t die a silent death. I believe its Old Earth meaning is more appropriate than all of that: it just means ‘angry child’,” she begins with a plain, casual tone.
rows.translation: “正如我说过的，茜更像头衔，而不是我的名字。它比我本人更加庞大，是某种就这样‘存在’并覆盖我的东西。比如说，某些圈子里流传着各种传闻和故事。率领幽灵恶魔大军的神秘黑帮首领，嗯哼。又或者是神话中不肯静静死去的老巫婆。不过我觉得它在旧地球语里的含义比那些说法都更合适：它只是‘愤怒的孩子’，”她以平淡随意的语气开场。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So as I’ve said, Akane is more of a title than my name. Something bigger than I am, something that’s just sort of ‘there’ and covers me. Got all sorts of rumours and stories in certain circles, for instance. Mysterious mafioso leader with an army of ghosts and demons, hmhm. Or some old witch from myth who won’t die a silent death. I believe its Old Earth meaning is more appropriate than all of that: it just means ‘angry child’,” she begins with a plain, casual tone."

rows.original: “As to how I was given it, well...”
rows.translation: “至于我是怎么得到它的，嗯...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As to how I was given it, well...”"

rows.original: She inhales slowly and closes her eyes for a few seconds as bracing herself for something.
rows.translation: 她缓缓吸气，闭上双眼几秒，仿佛在为某件事做好准备。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe inhales slowly and closes her eyes for a few seconds as bracing herself for something."

rows.original: “A condensed version of the whole thing, I think. There’s not a lot that I chose to remember. I believe I was 18, 19 maybe. Seems like a blur thinking back to that age. I was just a dancer, believe it or not. A sponsored performer for all kinds of acts. Me and a little group with some Terran agency. Very acrobatic, intense, demanding... loved every moment of it. So get this, we’re on a short tour as part of a modern opera. All this crazy showmanship, insane stunts. I was part of this big scene, the big twist before the final act. But you know, young performers on the road, we need our breaks,” she sighs, laughing half-heartedly.
rows.translation: “我想，把整件事说成浓缩版本吧。很多东西我选择了不去记住。那时我应该十八岁，或许十九岁。回想那个年纪，一切都很模糊。信不信由你，我只是一名舞者，为各种演出接受赞助的表演者。我和一个小团体隶属于某家泰伦机构。动作非常杂技化，强烈又严苛...我喜欢每一刻。事情是这样的，我们当时正在为一部现代歌剧进行短期巡演。全是疯狂的舞台效果和惊险特技。我参加了一场大戏，是最终幕之前的重要转折。但你知道，年轻演员在外奔波，总需要休息，”她叹息着，勉强笑了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A condensed version of the whole thing, I think. There’s not a lot that I chose to remember. I believe I was 18, 19 maybe. Seems like a blur thinking back to that age. I was just a dancer, believe it or not. A sponsored performer for all kinds of acts. Me and a little group with some Terran agency. Very acrobatic, intense, demanding... loved every moment of it. So get this, we’re on a short tour as part of a modern opera. All this crazy showmanship, insane stunts. I was part of this big scene, the big twist before the final act. But you know, young performers on the road, we need our breaks,” she sighs, laughing half-heartedly."

rows.original: “Just ended up in some bars the day before our third performance. Normal things, simple things. It somehow turned into a firefight, I don’t quite know... quite know what happened to everyone. Slavers, in droves. Raiding the waterfront. Or was it a... space station?”
rows.translation: “第三场演出前一天，我们只是去了几间酒吧。都是平常简单的事情。不知怎么就变成了交火，我不太清楚...不太清楚其他人发生了什么。成群结队的奴隶贩子袭击了海滨。还是说那是...一座空间站？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just ended up in some bars the day before our third performance. Normal things, simple things. It somehow turned into a firefight, I don’t quite know... quite know what happened to everyone. Slavers, in droves. Raiding the waterfront. Or was it a... space station?”"

rows.original: Her eyes glaze over and stop moving. If her hands had a pulse, you could probably feel it rise.
rows.translation: 她的双眼变得呆滞，不再移动。如果双手还有脉搏，你大概能感觉到它正在加速。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer eyes glaze over and stop moving. If her hands had a pulse, you could probably feel it rise."

rows.original: “Aaat this point, I don’t remember what happens. Memory blocks, or was it erasure? Aheh... uhhh. There’s a blank gap there,” she half-whispers, visible distress in her face.
rows.translation: “从这——里开始，我不记得发生了什么。记忆封锁，还是记忆抹除？啊哈...呃。这里有一段空白，”她半是耳语地说道，脸上显出清晰可见的痛苦。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aaat this point, I don’t remember what happens. Memory blocks, or was it erasure? Aheh... uhhh. There’s a blank gap there,” she half-whispers, visible distress in her face."

rows.original: “It’s okay, you don’t have to continue...” you whisper back, hoping she’ll not push herself.
rows.translation: “没关系，你不必继续...”你低声回答，希望她不要勉强自己。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s okay, you don’t have to continue...” you whisper back, hoping she’ll not push herself."

rows.original: “No no, it’s fine. I just need to focus... I remember lying on a bed. Some sort of medical bed. Seemed like it lasted forever. I could barely see what was happening around me, like my head was fixed to the spot. Always fading in and out of consciousness. And just... one day, I’m alert and ready. I’m scared but I’m alive. Trapped in the same bed with some old guy looking over me. And uh...”
rows.translation: “不，不，没事。我只需要集中精神...我记得自己躺在一张床上。某种医疗床。那段时间仿佛持续了永远。我几乎看不到周围发生了什么，就像头被固定在那里。意识总是时有时无。然后...有一天，我突然清醒并准备好了。我很害怕，但还活着。被困在同一张床上，一个老家伙俯视着我。还有，呃...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No no, it’s fine. I just need to focus... I remember lying on a bed. Some sort of medical bed. Seemed like it lasted forever. I could barely see what was happening around me, like my head was fixed to the spot. Always fading in and out of consciousness. And just... one day, I’m alert and ready. I’m scared but I’m alive. Trapped in the same bed with some old guy looking over me. And uh...”"

rows.original: She looks down to her hands, arms and knees.
rows.translation: 她低头望向自己的双手、双臂和膝盖。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks down to her hands, arms and knees."

rows.original: “...some new hardware sticking out of me. I could barely handle it at first, until I actually moved the things. It all felt surprisingly normal, just... numb. I’ve had 25 odd years to get used to it, but there’s still that slight numbness behind it all. Anyway, this old guy, he explains everything but I... don’t remember most of it. And then I’m just given a choice: get thrust back into the world like this, with no money, connections or sense of where I am or I can integrate with his little club... now my little club. In between that is a grueling, silent tale of rising up the foodchain and trying to impress this silly old man.”
rows.translation: “...一些新硬件从身体里伸了出来。起初我几乎无法承受，直到真正移动这些东西。一切感觉出奇地正常，只是...麻木。我花了大约二十五年适应它们，但一切背后仍有一丝麻木。总之，那个老家伙向我解释了全部，可我...大部分都不记得了。然后我只得到一个选择：以这副模样被扔回世界，既没有钱、人脉，也不知道身在何处，或者融入他的小团体...也就是现在我的小团体。其间还有一段艰苦沉默的故事，讲述我如何爬上食物链，并努力给这个愚蠢老头留下印象。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...some new hardware sticking out of me. I could barely handle it at first, until I actually moved the things. It all felt surprisingly normal, just... numb. I’ve had 25 odd years to get used to it, but there’s still that slight numbness behind it all. Anyway, this old guy, he explains everything but I... don’t remember most of it. And then I’m just given a choice: get thrust back into the world like this, with no money, connections or sense of where I am or I can integrate with his little club... now my little club. In between that is a grueling, silent tale of rising up the foodchain and trying to impress this silly old man.”"

rows.original: She blinks slowly and sighs, drawing a fingertip across your palm.
rows.translation: 她缓缓眨眼叹息，用一根指尖划过你的掌心。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe blinks slowly and sighs, drawing a fingertip across your palm."

rows.original: “His title was Bishamon. He lead this branch of the Shukuchi before it moved to Tavros station. All the faces have changed since I was new to it, save our business partners. Very taxing for younger folk, most burn out and retire by the time they’re in their mid 30’s. I only went further, outlasted them all. When Bishamon retired himself - probably 70 years old, I don’t even know - he only wanted me to lead. Said I knew the ‘pains of struggle’ on an instinctual level and it’s only in the last few years that I knew what he meant...”
rows.translation: “他的头衔是毗沙门。缩地迁往塔夫罗斯空间站以前，他负责领导这个分部。除了我们的商业伙伴，自我加入以来，所有面孔都已经换过了。这对年轻人来说非常劳神，大多数人到了三十五岁左右便会精疲力竭并退休。只有我继续前进，比所有人坚持得更久。毗沙门本人退休时 - 大概已经七十岁了，我也不清楚 - 他只想让我接掌。他说我在本能层面理解‘挣扎的痛苦’，而我直到最近几年才明白他的意思...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“His title was Bishamon. He lead this branch of the Shukuchi before it moved to Tavros station. All the faces have changed since I was new to it, save our business partners. Very taxing for younger folk, most burn out and retire by the time they’re in their mid 30’s. I only went further, outlasted them all. When Bishamon retired himself - probably 70 years old, I don’t even know - he only wanted me to lead. Said I knew the ‘pains of struggle’ on an instinctual level and it’s only in the last few years that I knew what he meant...”"

rows.original: Akane pauses, looking wistfully into your eyes.
rows.translation: 茜停顿下来，若有所思地望进你的双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane pauses, looking wistfully into your eyes."

rows.original: “Aaand with all that, I think that covers the story of ‘me’. I think so, anyway,” she finishes, glancing away from you with a look of discomfort on her face.
rows.translation: “加——上这些，我想‘我’的故事应该讲完了。应该吧，”她结束说道，脸上带着不适的神色，移开望向你的目光。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aaand with all that, I think that covers the story of ‘me’. I think so, anyway,” she finishes, glancing away from you with a look of discomfort on her face."

rows.original: You’re not sure what to say despite wishing you could say something. You instead clasp her fingers and squeeze the metal digits gently, the smallest hint of a smile playing at the corners of her mouth.
rows.translation: 尽管希望自己能说点什么，你却不知道该如何开口。你转而握住她的手指，轻轻捏了捏金属指节；她嘴角浮现出一丝最细微的笑意。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure what to say despite wishing you could say something. You instead clasp her fingers and squeeze the metal digits gently, the smallest hint of a smile playing at the corners of her mouth."

rows.original: “It’s okay, I just don’t make a habit of telling anybody this stuff. Maybe I realised I just need someone to... share secrets with,” she sniffs, her glassy eyes looking into yours.
rows.translation: “没关系，我只是不习惯把这些事情告诉任何人。或许我意识到，自己只是需要一个能...分享秘密的人，”她抽着鼻子说道，玻璃般的双眼望进你的眼中。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s okay, I just don’t make a habit of telling anybody this stuff. Maybe I realised I just need someone to... share secrets with,” she sniffs, her glassy eyes looking into yours."

rows.original: Something jumps and wriggles in your chest. Is she... saying...
rows.translation: 你胸口有什么东西猛然跃动扭动。她是不是...在说...
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething jumps and wriggles in your chest. Is she... saying..."

rows.original: “Ahh, oh dear, a bit of weakness on my part,” she blusters, wiping her face with the back of her hand. “Just stay with me for now, hm?”
rows.translation: “啊，天哪，是我有点软弱了，”她虚张声势地说道，用手背擦了擦脸。“现在只管陪着我，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahh, oh dear, a bit of weakness on my part,” she blusters, wiping her face with the back of her hand. “Just stay with me for now, hm?”"

rows.original: TALKED_HISTORY
rows.raw: "TALKED_HISTORY"

rows.original: History
rows.translation: 经历
rows.raw: "History"

rows.original: Well now you gotta know about her past, what with all her allusions...
rows.translation: 她已经做了这么多暗示，你现在非得了解她的过去不可...
rows.raw: "Well now you gotta know about her past, what with all her allusions..."

rows.original: History
rows.translation: 经历
rows.raw: "History"

rows.original: History
rows.translation: 经历
rows.raw: "History"

rows.original: You haven’t quite hit the right chord with her to ask this yet.
rows.translation: 你还没有真正触动她的心弦，现在还不能问这个。
rows.raw: "You haven’t quite hit the right chord with her to ask this yet."

rows.original: Her Mods
rows.translation: 她的改造体
rows.raw: "Her Mods"

rows.original: “So where’d you get the arms... and legs...?” you say coolly, a little inner voice scolding you for tactlessness.
rows.translation: “那么，你是在哪里得到这些手臂...还有腿的...？”你冷静地说道，内心有个小声音正责备你毫不委婉。
rows.raw: "“So where’d you get the arms... and legs...?” you say coolly, a little inner voice scolding you for tactlessness."

rows.original: Right on cue, Akane’s brow furrows and she makes a disapproving hum. Even so, she takes the time to scan her cybernetics with her eyes. The ultra-sleek, svelte design glints with the tame blue of the room the smallest detail in faux-muscle curve catching the light.
rows.translation: 果不其然，茜皱起眉头，不满地哼了一声。即便如此，她还是花时间用双眼扫视自己的义体。超流线而纤细的设计反射着房间温和的蓝光，仿制肌肉曲线最细微的部分也捕捉着光芒。
rows.raw: "\n\nRight on cue, Akane’s brow furrows and she makes a disapproving hum. Even so, she takes the time to scan her cybernetics with her eyes. The ultra-sleek, svelte design glints with the tame blue of the room the smallest detail in faux-muscle curve catching the light."

rows.original: “I suppose it would come up at some point, so very well. These, my dear, are the top of the line bionic replacements for those looking for or needing alternatives to organic regrowth. I had to have a lot of my skeleton replaced or upgraded to support them. Built from several types and arrangements of nanomaterials and constructed to my exact needs and specifications, they are... understandably, what enable me to live,” she begins in matter-of-fact tone. From the way she hesitates, maybe there’s even more to it than she’s letting on...
rows.translation: “我想这个问题迟早会出现，那就说吧。亲爱的，这些是顶级仿生替代品，提供给寻求或需要有机再生替代方案的人。我不得不替换或升级大部分骨骼来支撑它们。它们由数种纳米材料以不同排列方式制成，并完全按照我的需求与规格打造。可以理解，它们...让我得以活下去，”她以实事求是的语气开始说明。从她迟疑的方式看，事情也许远比她透露的更多...
rows.raw: "\n\n“I suppose it would come up at some point, so very well. These, my dear, are the top of the line bionic replacements for those looking for or needing alternatives to organic regrowth. I had to have a lot of my skeleton replaced or upgraded to support them. Built from several types and arrangements of nanomaterials and constructed to my exact needs and specifications, they are... understandably, what enable me to live,” she begins in matter-of-fact tone. From the way she hesitates, maybe there’s even more to it than she’s letting on..."

rows.original: With her right hand, she grips the seal on her bicep that connects her robotic left arm to her flesh and bone. There’s a slight shkk sound like several forms of lock disengaging in unison and the robo-limb twists in her palm. She pulls downwards and the whole thing comes with... leaving a metallic rim that’s melded seamlessly to what’s left of her arm.
rows.translation: 她用右手抓住肱二头肌处连接机械左臂与血肉的密封接口。伴着几种锁扣同时脱开的轻微咔嚓声，机械肢体在掌中转动。她向下一拉，整只手臂便随之脱落...只留下一圈与残臂无缝融合的金属边框。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith her right hand, she grips the seal on her bicep that connects her robotic left arm to her flesh and bone. There’s a slight shkk sound like several forms of lock disengaging in unison and the robo-limb twists in her palm. She pulls downwards and the whole thing comes with... leaving a metallic rim that’s melded seamlessly to what’s left of her arm."

rows.original: “As you can see, it’s not so difficult to disarm,” smiles Akane, winking to you. You’re a little too lost in the detachment process to appreciate her wordplay...
rows.translation: “如你所见，想让我缴械并不难，”茜微笑着对你眨眼。你太过专注于拆卸过程，没能欣赏她的双关语...
rows.raw: "\n\n“As you can see, it’s not so difficult to disarm,” smiles Akane, winking to you. You’re a little too lost in the detachment process to appreciate her wordplay..."

rows.original: “I think one day, I’ll be able to sleep soundly with all my cybernetics by the bedside...”
rows.translation: “我想总有一天，我能把所有义体放在床边，然后安然入睡...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think one day, I’ll be able to sleep soundly with all my cybernetics by the bedside...”"

rows.original: With a sigh, she reattaches her arm in short order, gaining full use after a couple of finger curls.
rows.translation: 她叹了口气，很快重新接上手臂；弯曲几下手指后，便恢复了全部功能。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a sigh, she reattaches her arm in short order, gaining full use after a couple of finger curls."

rows.original: “Back to specifications: the alloy is extremely durable and lightweight. I shed quite a few kilos from my original weight when I had them fully integrated. I merely need to have the will to move them and they move. Of course, you’re fully aware of a... particular feature,” she giggles, rubbing her thumb and index finger together. Between them, white sparks and tiny ropes of static fizzle and snap between her silvery fingertips.
rows.translation: “回到规格：这种合金极其耐用而轻盈。完成全面植入后，我比原来的体重轻了好几公斤。只要我有让它们移动的意念，它们便会移动。当然，你完全了解其中一项...特殊功能，”她咯咯笑着，将拇指与食指搓在一起。白色火花与静电细索在银色指尖之间滋滋迸裂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Back to specifications: the alloy is extremely durable and lightweight. I shed quite a few kilos from my original weight when I had them fully integrated. I merely need to have the will to move them and they move. Of course, you’re fully aware of a... particular feature,” she giggles, rubbing her thumb and index finger together. Between them, white sparks and tiny ropes of static fizzle and snap between her silvery fingertips."

rows.original: “Nothing damaging. I can send a neural signal through contact with any bit of flesh and the poor synapses have little else to do but accept it. When that happens, they go into overdrive and all I need is to think of how intense it should be. Barely even need to hold a weapon anymore if I need to get my hands dirty. You’d be surprised by how many scream for a quick death than live another minute more under my thumb...”
rows.translation: “不会造成伤害。我可以通过接触任何一块血肉传递神经信号，可怜的突触只能接受。那一刻，它们会超负荷运转，而我只需思考强度该有多大。即便需要亲自动手，我现在几乎也不必携带武器。你会惊讶于有多少人宁可哀求速死，也不愿在我拇指下多活一分钟...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nothing damaging. I can send a neural signal through contact with any bit of flesh and the poor synapses have little else to do but accept it. When that happens, they go into overdrive and all I need is to think of how intense it should be. Barely even need to hold a weapon anymore if I need to get my hands dirty. You’d be surprised by how many scream for a quick death than live another minute more under my thumb...”"

rows.original: Wow. Mood killer.
rows.translation: 哇。真扫兴。
rows.raw: "\n\nWow. Mood killer."

rows.original: Noticing your subtle wince, Akane merely laughs.
rows.translation: 茜注意到你细微的畏缩，只是笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nNoticing your subtle wince, Akane merely laughs."

rows.original: “Oh please, [pc.name]. Your screams are the best, the only ones I need. Don’t feel shame for it,” she smiles, stroking your chin.
rows.translation: “噢，拜托，[pc.name]。你的尖叫是最棒的，也是我唯一需要的。别为此感到羞耻，”她抚摸着你的下巴，微笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh please, [pc.name]. Your screams are the best, the only ones I need. Don’t feel shame for it,” she smiles, stroking your chin."

rows.original: You clear your throat as a telltale blush forms in your cheeks.
rows.translation: 你清了清嗓子，双颊浮现出明显的红晕。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou clear your throat as a telltale blush forms in your cheeks."

rows.original: “And what about the ear?” you say abruptly.
rows.translation: “那么耳朵呢？”你突然说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And what about the ear?” you say abruptly."

rows.original: “Ah, of course. Little bit of vanity on my part, disregarding the whole... scar business. I quite like both, truth be told.
