The ear mostly came about as a replacement for reasons you can probably discern. I liked the design, I still like the design, that’s pretty much it,” she shrugs, smiling again.
rows.translation: “啊，当然。是我有点虚荣，先不提整个...伤疤的问题。说实话，两者我都很喜欢。至于耳朵，你大概能看出它为什么需要替换。我喜欢这个设计，现在依然喜欢，差不多就是这样，”她耸耸肩，再次微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, of course. Little bit of vanity on my part, disregarding the whole... scar business. I quite like both, truth be told. The ear mostly came about as a replacement for reasons you can probably discern. I liked the design, I still like the design, that’s pretty much it,” she shrugs, smiling again."

rows.original: The next chat turns into a rather vague mess of what Akane would look like after taking
rows.translation: 接下来的谈话变得相当含糊混乱，主题是茜服用
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next chat turns into a rather vague mess of what Akane would look like after taking "

rows.original: Nepeta
rows.translation: 尼佩塔
rows.raw: "Nepeta"

rows.original: Pandaneen
rows.translation: 熊猫纳林丸
rows.raw: "Pandaneen"

rows.original: DracoGuard
rows.translation: 龙裔护卫丸
rows.raw: "DracoGuard"

rows.original: , much to her delight and curiosity.
rows.translation: 后会变成什么模样，令她无比欣喜好奇。
rows.raw: ", much to her delight and curiosity."

rows.original: TALKED_MODS
rows.raw: "TALKED_MODS"

rows.original: Her Mods
rows.translation: 她的改造体
rows.raw: "Her Mods"

rows.original: That’s some rather robust hardware she’s using and what’s with the ear?
rows.translation: 她使用的硬件相当强悍，那只耳朵又是怎么回事？
rows.raw: "That’s some rather robust hardware she’s using and what’s with the ear?"

rows.original: About Host
rows.translation: 关于缩地
rows.raw: "About Host"

rows.original: “So what is the Host, then?”
rows.translation: “那么，缩地究竟是什么？”
rows.raw: "“So what is the Host, then?”"

rows.original: “Tell me again about this organization, it’s fascinating,”
rows.translation: “再跟我说说这个组织吧，它很有意思，”
rows.raw: "“Tell me again about this organization, it’s fascinating,”"

rows.original: you ask generally, your tired gaze focusing on hers.
rows.translation: 你笼统地问道，疲惫的目光聚焦在她身上。
rows.raw: " you ask generally, your tired gaze focusing on hers."

rows.original: “I suppose it’s all a little vague. We’re a community, a family, a business group, a force for change. Sometimes a vigilante group, sometimes security, sometimes tax collectors. It’s a very old form of organization, dating back to ancient Terran traditions. Quite far from being the same thing, of course. Passage of time and all that. Even I don’t know that much about the origins and I run this thing, hmhmm. ‘Shukuchi’ is an old, old Terran word referring to silent, swift movement as if someone was able go from one point to another instantaneously. As such, we use it to describe our way of working. Bit on the nose but it works,” she begins, very quickly lost in thought as she relays the story.
rows.translation: “我想这一切都有点模糊。我们是一个社区、一个家庭、一个商业集团、一股改变的力量。有时是义警团体，有时是安保，有时是收税人。这是一种非常古老的组织形式，可以追溯到泰伦的古代传统。当然，它和当年的东西已经相去甚远。毕竟时间流逝，诸如此类。就连负责管理的我也不太了解起源，嗯哼。‘缩地’是一个极其古老的泰伦词汇，指寂静迅捷的移动，仿佛能让人瞬间从一点抵达另一点。因此，我们用它形容自己的工作方式。确实有点直白，但很合适，”她开始讲述，很快便在转述故事时陷入沉思。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I suppose it’s all a little vague. We’re a community, a family, a business group, a force for change. Sometimes a vigilante group, sometimes security, sometimes tax collectors. It’s a very old form of organization, dating back to ancient Terran traditions. Quite far from being the same thing, of course. Passage of time and all that. Even I don’t know that much about the origins and I run this thing, hmhmm. ‘Shukuchi’ is an old, old Terran word referring to silent, swift movement as if someone was able go from one point to another instantaneously. As such, we use it to describe our way of working. Bit on the nose but it works,” she begins, very quickly lost in thought as she relays the story."

rows.original: “U.G.C officially states that we’re a crime syndicate under their laws and I suppose I could agree. Barely anything we do is legal. What legal business we do have is often fronted behind something else. Oh we’re not all just operatives in the field by the way. Lawyers, businessmen both small and large scale, product manufacturers... could go on. It’s not a wide web but it’s a cohesive and efficient one. Our other interests include protection for smaller businesses, paid security, information brokering, sometimes private eye work and even lobbying,” continues Akane, reciting the list as if it were something constantly pressed into her mind.
rows.translation: “银河联合邦正式宣称，按照他们的法律，我们属于犯罪集团，我想自己可以同意。我们做的事情几乎没有一样合法。就连合法生意，也常常藏在其他门面之后。噢，顺便说一句，我们并不全是外勤特工。律师、大小商人、产品制造商...还能继续列下去。这张网算不上广阔，却紧密而高效。我们的其他业务包括保护小型企业、付费安保、信息中介，有时也做私家侦探，甚至参与游说，”茜继续说道，背诵这份清单的语气仿佛它始终牢牢压在脑中。
rows.raw: "\n\n“U.G.C officially states that we’re a crime syndicate under their laws and I suppose I could agree. Barely anything we do is legal. What legal business we do have is often fronted behind something else. Oh we’re not all just operatives in the field by the way. Lawyers, businessmen both small and large scale, product manufacturers... could go on. It’s not a wide web but it’s a cohesive and efficient one. Our other interests include protection for smaller businesses, paid security, information brokering, sometimes private eye work and even lobbying,” continues Akane, reciting the list as if it were something constantly pressed into her mind."

rows.original: “It’s diverse, mostly clean and highly sustainable. Of course, we’re not the only branch...”
rows.translation: “业务多样，大多干净，而且高度可持续。当然，我们并不是唯一的分部...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s diverse, mostly clean and highly sustainable. Of course, we’re not the only branch...”"

rows.original: Wait...
rows.translation: 等等...
rows.raw: "\n\nWait..."

rows.original: “So this isn’t exclusive to Tavros?” you ask cautiously, feeling some kind of imperceptible penny drop within.
rows.translation: “所以，这并不是塔夫罗斯独有的？”你谨慎地问道，感觉心中某个难以察觉的真相突然落地。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So this isn’t exclusive to Tavros?” you ask cautiously, feeling some kind of imperceptible penny drop within."

rows.original: “Oh by my sainted stars, of course not, dearest. As if we could pull all that off from just this station! Not that it wouldn’t be fun but it’s a quieter, less stressful environment we have in the Rusher front as odd as that sounds, just doing small time work to get a foothold. Plus more of everything slips under the cracks...”
rows.translation: “噢，我神圣的群星啊，当然不是，亲爱的。好像我们只凭这座空间站就能完成所有事情一样！那样或许也会很有趣，但说来奇怪，我们在拉舍尔的门面拥有更安静、压力更小的环境，只需做些小生意来站稳脚跟。而且更多东西都能从缝隙里溜过去...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh by my sainted stars, of course not, dearest. As if we could pull all that off from just this station! Not that it wouldn’t be fun but it’s a quieter, less stressful environment we have in the Rusher front as odd as that sounds, just doing small time work to get a foothold. Plus more of everything slips under the cracks...”"

rows.original: She sighs with a grin on her face, a palpable sense of pride radiating from her.
rows.translation: 她面带笑容地叹息，清晰可感的自豪从身上散发出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs with a grin on her face, a palpable sense of pride radiating from her."

rows.original: “Should go without saying that we’re not really fond of current society. It’s a chaotic web of traps and circumstance where everyone uses their bodies just to scrape money for food. Either that or get lucky enough to have work, only to indulge in body modding. Not a slight against you though, precious,” she opines, tapping her fingertip on your nose.
rows.translation: “不用说，我们并不真正喜欢当今社会。这是一张由陷阱和际遇编织的混乱网络，每个人都得出卖肉体，才能勉强挣到买食物的钱。要么足够幸运地找到工作，最后却沉迷肉体改造。不过这可不是在贬低你，宝贝，”她评论道，用指尖轻点你的鼻子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Should go without saying that we’re not really fond of current society. It’s a chaotic web of traps and circumstance where everyone uses their bodies just to scrape money for food. Either that or get lucky enough to have work, only to indulge in body modding. Not a slight against you though, precious,” she opines, tapping her fingertip on your nose."

rows.original: “Just against the system we’ve all been through. Count your lucky novas that you’re a semi-celebrity.”
rows.translation: “我针对的只是我们所有人经历过的制度。庆幸自己的幸运新星吧，你好歹算半个名人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just against the system we’ve all been through. Count your lucky novas that you’re a semi-celebrity.”"

rows.original: <i>“Not much else to say on that. I’m sure you understand why of course. I may sleep with you but I dare not let you into the family, you’d have to be to be able to know all this. I couldn’t do that to you, you’re far too... far too young with all this life ahead of you. No sense settling down this early on...”
rows.translation: <i>“关于这个没什么可再说的。当然，我相信你明白原因。我可以和你上床，却不敢让你加入这个家庭；只有家族成员才有资格知道这一切。我不能这么对你，你实在太...实在太年轻，还有整个人生摆在前面。没必要这么早就安定下来...”
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Not much else to say on that. I’m sure you understand why of course. I may sleep with you but I dare not let you into the family, you’d have to be to be able to know all this. I couldn’t do that to you, you’re far too... far too young with all this life ahead of you. No sense settling down this early on...”"

rows.original: She trails off into wordless thought, a glassy sheen forming over her darkened eyes.
rows.translation: 她渐渐陷入无言的沉思，深色双眼蒙上一层玻璃般的水光。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe trails off into wordless thought, a glassy sheen forming over her darkened eyes."

rows.original: “I... didn’t know you felt that way,” you half-whisper, taken aback by her admission.
rows.translation: “我...不知道你是这样想的，”你半是耳语地说道，被她的坦白惊到了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... didn’t know you felt that way,” you half-whisper, taken aback by her admission."

rows.original: “What, is it wrong for me to... only want the best? I just want to see you thrive, [pc.name]. That you kept coming back to me just... nevermind, I’m babbling, I’m babbling it all away,” she sniffs, wiping her face with her jacket sleeve.
rows.translation: “怎么，难道我...只想给你最好的东西也有错吗？我只是想看你茁壮成长，[pc.name]。你一次次回到我身边，这实在...算了，我在胡言乱语，我把一切都说漏了，”她抽着鼻子说道，用夹克袖子擦脸。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What, is it wrong for me to... only want the best? I just want to see you thrive, [pc.name]. That you kept coming back to me just... nevermind, I’m babbling, I’m babbling it all away,” she sniffs, wiping her face with her jacket sleeve."

rows.original: “Let’s just enjoy each other for a bit, hm?”
rows.translation: “我们只管享受彼此一会儿，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s just enjoy each other for a bit, hm?”"

rows.original: You nod, your face trying to hide the feeling of your chest filling with the soft flutter of butterflies.
rows.translation: 你点点头，试图在脸上隐藏胸口被蝴蝶般柔和悸动填满的感觉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, your face trying to hide the feeling of your chest filling with the soft flutter of butterflies."

rows.original: TALKED_HOST
rows.raw: "TALKED_HOST"

rows.original: About Host
rows.translation: 关于缩地
rows.raw: "About Host"

rows.original: It’s kind of fascinating that it remains this under the radar... you only found it because they let you, after all.
rows.translation: 它居然能一直这样避开注意，确实很有意思...毕竟，你能找到这里只是因为他们允许。
rows.raw: "It’s kind of fascinating that it remains this under the radar... you only found it because they let you, after all."

rows.original: Rivalries
rows.translation: 敌对关系
rows.raw: "Rivalries"

rows.original: “I got a question: do you guys ever get competition...? Outside of the law, I mean,”
rows.translation: “我有个问题：你们会遇到竞争吗...？我是说法律以外的竞争，”
rows.raw: "“I got a question: do you guys ever get competition...? Outside of the law, I mean,”"

rows.original: “Tell me again about the other crime groups, it’s a curious situation,”
rows.translation: “再跟我说说其他犯罪团伙吧，这种局面很有意思，”
rows.raw: "“Tell me again about the other crime groups, it’s a curious situation,”"

rows.original: you begin slowly, keeping the tone light in the post-sex glow you share.
rows.translation: 你缓缓开口，在你们共享的性爱余韵中保持轻松语气。
rows.raw: " you begin slowly, keeping the tone light in the post-sex glow you share.\n\n"

rows.original: “Oof, I’ll certainly try darling. What a web it is...”
rows.translation: “噢，我当然会试试看，亲爱的。真是一张复杂的网...”
rows.raw: "“Oof, I’ll certainly try darling. What a web it is...”"

rows.original: “Again? Hmm, just for you then, my little thrillseeker,”
rows.translation: “又来？嗯，那就只为你再讲一次，我的小冒险家，”
rows.raw: "“Again? Hmm, just for you then, my little thrillseeker,”"

rows.original: she giggles, her eyes looking into random corners of the room as she thinks of what to say.
rows.translation: 她咯咯笑着，思考该说什么时，双眼望向房间各个角落。
rows.raw: " she giggles, her eyes looking into random corners of the room as she thinks of what to say."

rows.original: “It’d be remiss of me to not mention the big guns: the Black Void. Mm, what an absolutely dashing, fantastical name,” she groans sarcastically, rolling her eyes.
rows.translation: “要是不提那门大炮，我就太失职了：黑色虚空。嗯，多么潇洒又奇幻的名字，”她讽刺地呻吟道，翻了个白眼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’d be remiss of me to not mention the big guns: the Black Void. Mm, what an absolutely dashing, fantastical name,” she groans sarcastically, rolling her eyes."

rows.original: “All dressed in red and black, how original. Anyway, petty quibbles aside, they’re not something that our group needs to worry about that much. Unpleasant to say the least but they’re merely just a grim mirror of the U.G.C at the dirtiest, darkest level. Same lack of mass cohesion as well,” she starts, her tone turning factual but lined with soft disdain.
rows.translation: “全都穿着红黑两色，真有创意。总之，先放下这些小抱怨，他们并不是我们团体太需要担心的东西。至少可以说他们令人不快，但他们不过是银河联合邦在最肮脏黑暗层面的一面阴森镜像。同样缺乏大规模凝聚力，”她开始说道，语气转为客观，却带着淡淡蔑视。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All dressed in red and black, how original. Anyway, petty quibbles aside, they’re not something that our group needs to worry about that much. Unpleasant to say the least but they’re merely just a grim mirror of the U.G.C at the dirtiest, darkest level. Same lack of mass cohesion as well,” she starts, her tone turning factual but lined with soft disdain."

rows.original: “Are they really that big?” you ask quickly, curiosity getting stronger.
rows.translation: “他们真的有那么庞大吗？”你迅速问道，好奇愈发强烈。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are they really that big?” you ask quickly, curiosity getting stronger."

rows.original: “Well not as big but big enough that you’d only need to dismantle the command structure and all semblance of terror melts away. Those ‘Dread Lords’, you know?” opines Akane.
rows.translation: “嗯，倒没有那么庞大，但也足够强大；只需瓦解指挥结构，所有恐怖假象就会消融。你知道那些‘恐惧领主’吧？”茜评论道。
rows.raw: " “Well not as big but big enough that you’d only need to dismantle the command structure and all semblance of terror melts away. Those ‘Dread Lords’, you know?” opines Akane. "

rows.original: FALL OF THE PHOENIX STATUS
rows.raw: "FALL OF THE PHOENIX STATUS"

rows.original: Yep you definitely know, having run into the Black Void before. You consider telling her about your experiences but...
rows.translation: 没错，你当然知道，毕竟以前就遇过黑色虚空。你考虑告诉她自己的经历，但是...
rows.raw: "Yep you definitely know, having run into the Black Void before. You consider telling her about your experiences but... "

rows.original: “Have you... met them?” you ask on the fly.
rows.translation: “你...见过他们吗？”你临时问道。
rows.raw: "“Have you... met them?” you ask on the fly."

rows.original: Her look of thought turns into a smile.
rows.translation: 她若有所思的神色化为微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer look of thought turns into a smile."

rows.original: “Under less-than-friendly terms, yes. A certain Dread Lord Bragga as it were. A brutish weirdo who doesn’t enjoy anything as far as I could say. Definitely did not think much of me at all. Her mistake,” she winks, tracing her fingers across your hand.
rows.translation: “是在不太友好的条件下，没错。也就是某位恐惧领主布拉加。一个野蛮的怪人，据我所知，她什么都不喜欢。她绝对没有把我放在眼里。这是她的错误，”她用手指划过你的手，对你眨了眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Under less-than-friendly terms, yes. A certain Dread Lord Bragga as it were. A brutish weirdo who doesn’t enjoy anything as far as I could say. Definitely did not think much of me at all. Her mistake,” she winks, tracing her fingers across your hand."

rows.original: “We’re not a powerful, space-borne army but on the ground outside of literal warzones, the Void come up short. During our little talks, I made it clear where our interests lie and the personal threat of a strike from a stealth field put her into a more reasonable state of mind. So without revealing too much, the Black Void leave us alone as long as we leave them alone. That is, until they start hosting their slavery parties around here...” she finishes, going quiet as she mentions ‘slavery.’
rows.translation: “我们并不是强大的太空军队，但在真正战区以外的地面上，虚空根本不够看。小小谈判期间，我明确说明了我们的利益所在，又亲自威胁要从隐形场中发动袭击，终于让她恢复了几分理智。所以在不透露太多的前提下，只要我们不去招惹黑色虚空，他们就不会来招惹我们。至少在他们开始于附近举办奴隶制派对以前...”她说完便沉默下来，因为自己提到了‘奴隶制’。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re not a powerful, space-borne army but on the ground outside of literal warzones, the Void come up short. During our little talks, I made it clear where our interests lie and the personal threat of a strike from a stealth field put her into a more reasonable state of mind. So without revealing too much, the Black Void leave us alone as long as we leave them alone. That is, until they start hosting their slavery parties around here...” she finishes, going quiet as she mentions ‘slavery.’"

rows.original: Hmm. A small part of you wishes she’d said more instead of cutting it short...
rows.translation: 嗯。你心里有一小部分希望她能多说一些，而不是就此打住...
rows.raw: "\n\nHmm. A small part of you wishes she’d said more instead of cutting it short..."

rows.original: “What about the other groups?” you say quickly, keeping her recollections fresh.
rows.translation: “那其他团体呢？”你快速说道，不让她的回忆冷却。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What about the other groups?” you say quickly, keeping her recollections fresh."

rows.original: “Hmm, in this part of space, there aren’t many big players. Void mostly just rubs its flaccid... thing all over the frontier and that’s enough to scare most small and large scale groups away. Not us though, different fields of business. But there are one or two exceptions. The biggest I’ve had the pleasure of dealing with is one Mr. Lysander Chow...”
rows.translation: “嗯，在这片太空里，大玩家并不多。虚空基本只会把它软趴趴的...东西在整片边疆上蹭来蹭去，这已经足够吓走大多数大小团体。当然吓不走我们，毕竟业务领域不同。不过确实存在一两个例外。我有幸打过交道的最大势力，是一位莱桑德·周先生...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm, in this part of space, there aren’t many big players. Void mostly just rubs its flaccid... thing all over the frontier and that’s enough to scare most small and large scale groups away. Not us though, different fields of business. But there are one or two exceptions. The biggest I’ve had the pleasure of dealing with is one Mr. Lysander Chow...”"

rows.original: Something about that name tickles a memory in the back of your mind but you can’t quite discern what it is...
rows.translation: 这个名字似乎勾起了脑海深处的一段记忆，但你无法分辨究竟是什么...
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething about that name tickles a memory in the back of your mind but you can’t quite discern what it is..."

rows.original: “Utter bastard by most accounts, even mine. Apparently he has a ‘thing’ for me personally but whether that’s a bounty or a series of delightful planned dates, I couldn’t say. Sometimes we come into conflict, other times we broker the same business deals. It’s all over the place with him, he’s quite the maverick. Grisly too. Still, we respect each other enough to cooperate on the rare occasion. I’m just never, ever going to be in the same room with freaky old man ever again,” she finishes bluntly, apparently rankled.
rows.translation: “从大多数人的说法看，包括我，他都是个彻头彻尾的混蛋。显然他对我本人有某种‘兴趣’，可那究竟是悬赏，还是一系列令人愉快的约会计划，我就说不准了。有时我们发生冲突，有时又为同一笔生意进行斡旋。他的一切都毫无规律，真是个特立独行的家伙。而且很残忍。即便如此，我们足够尊重彼此，偶尔也会合作。只是我再也、绝对不会和那个诡异老男人待在同一个房间里了，”她直截了当地结束说道，显然被激怒了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Utter bastard by most accounts, even mine. Apparently he has a ‘thing’ for me personally but whether that’s a bounty or a series of delightful planned dates, I couldn’t say. Sometimes we come into conflict, other times we broker the same business deals. It’s all over the place with him, he’s quite the maverick. Grisly too. Still, we respect each other enough to cooperate on the rare occasion. I’m just never, ever going to be in the same room with freaky old man ever again,” she finishes bluntly, apparently rankled."

rows.original: “Mmm, that was a bit brash... mind if we just cuddle...?” she says softly, her biting tone turning into a sweet calmness.
rows.translation: “嗯，刚才有点太冲动了...我们只抱一会儿，可以吗...？”她轻声说道，尖锐语气转为甜蜜平静。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm, that was a bit brash... mind if we just cuddle...?” she says softly, her biting tone turning into a sweet calmness."

rows.original: TALKED_RIVALS
rows.raw: "TALKED_RIVALS"

rows.original: Rivalries
rows.translation: 敌对关系
rows.raw: "Rivalries"

rows.original: Surely she must have run-ins with various other groups and syndicates...?
rows.translation: 她肯定会与其他各种团体和犯罪集团发生冲突吧...？
rows.raw: "Surely she must have run-ins with various other groups and syndicates...?"

rows.original: You’ve shared an awful lot with her, from her body to her experiences and to her most sensitive of secrets. You keep coming back for what she has and what she can give you. She even named your her special ‘painslut’ of all things...
rows.translation: 从身体、经历到最敏感的秘密，你们已经彼此分享了太多。你一次又一次回来，追求她拥有并能给予你的东西。她甚至在众多称呼中，专门将你命名为她的‘嗜痛荡妇’...
rows.raw: "You’ve shared an awful lot with her, from her body to her experiences and to her most sensitive of secrets. You keep coming back for what she has and what she can give you. She even named your her special ‘painslut’ of all things..."

rows.original: “Akane,” you begin tentatively, cupping her wrists in a loose grip. “Something’s been on my mind for a while and... I want to know how you see me? See us?”
rows.translation: “茜，”你试探着开口，松松握住她的手腕。“有件事在我心里萦绕了一段时间，而且...我想知道你怎么看我？怎么看我们？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Akane,” you begin tentatively, cupping her wrists in a loose grip. “Something’s been on my mind for a while and... I want to know how you see me? See us?”"

rows.original: “Ohh... oh,” mouths the stunned domme, blinking as if stunned by a bright light.
rows.translation: “噢...噢，”目瞪口呆的女支配者无声说道，眨眼的样子仿佛被强光晃到了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohh... oh,” mouths the stunned domme, blinking as if stunned by a bright light."

rows.original: “I want to talk about us again,” you say quickly, even before you’ve both settled down.
rows.translation: “我想再聊聊我们的事，”你迅速说道，甚至没等彼此安顿下来。
rows.raw: "“I want to talk about us again,” you say quickly, even before you’ve both settled down."

rows.original: “Ah... you’re still thinking about what you want then? We can talk about it more if you’d really like to, I... I have to know how you feel,” she says breathily, her chest heaving in anticipation yet... her expression is needy as all hell.
rows.translation: “啊...所以你还在考虑自己想要什么？如果你真的愿意，我们可以再多谈谈，我...我必须知道你的感受，”她气喘吁吁地说道，胸膛因期待剧烈起伏，可...她的表情简直饥渴到了极点。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah... you’re still thinking about what you want then? We can talk about it more if you’d really like to, I... I have to know how you feel,” she says breathily, her chest heaving in anticipation yet... her expression is needy as all hell."

rows.original: “We should talk, yeah,” you say, smiling to her to put her at ease.
rows.translation: “对，我们该谈谈，”你对她微笑，让她放心。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We should talk, yeah,” you say, smiling to her to put her at ease."

rows.original: “J-just let’s get the bearings first...” says Akane.
rows.translation: “先、先让我们理清头绪...”茜说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“J-just let’s get the bearings first...” says Akane."

rows.original: “From the top, then: as soon as you bought into our very obvious bait, willingly and with a clear head on your shoulders, I had to divert my attention to it. At the very least, you had to be... brave or mentally deranged. There’s procedures for both,” she begins, speaking slowly but with a slight waver in her voice.
rows.translation: “那就从头开始：你一看到我们明显得不能再明显的诱饵，便在头脑清醒的情况下自愿上钩，我不得不将注意力转过去。至少，你不是...勇敢，就是精神失常。两种情况都有对应流程，”她开始说道，语速缓慢，声音却有些颤抖。
rows.raw: "\n\n“From the top, then: as soon as you bought into our very obvious bait, willingly and with a clear head on your shoulders, I had to divert my attention to it. At the very least, you had to be... brave or mentally deranged. There’s procedures for both,” she begins, speaking slowly but with a slight waver in her voice."

rows.original: “You walk in, drop out, get prepared for interrogation... what can I say, I liked what I saw. I gave you the options and you tapped into my line of thinking. And that was our first time together, wasn’t it?” she giggles, tracing her fingers across your grinning cheeks and [pc.lipsChaste]. “And had I known you’d keep coming back time and time again...”
rows.translation: “你走进来，昏倒，做好接受审讯的准备...我能怎么说呢，我喜欢自己看到的东西。我给了你选择，而你接上了我的思路。那就是我们的第一次，对吧？”她咯咯笑着，用手指划过你咧开的笑脸与[pc.lipsChaste]。“要是我早知道你会一次又一次回来...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You walk in, drop out, get prepared for interrogation... what can I say, I liked what I saw. I gave you the options and you tapped into my line of thinking. And that was our first time together, wasn’t it?” she giggles, tracing her fingers across your grinning cheeks and [pc.lipsChaste]. “And had I known you’d keep coming back time and time again...”"

rows.original: A fresh blush rises in your cheeks as she says so. There’s a little bit of guilt and romance there, constantly returning to some gang’s hideout just to sleep with their sexy boss all the time... Akane merely chuckles, bopping your nose with her fingertips.
rows.translation: 她这么说时，你的双颊浮现出崭新红晕。这里既有一点内疚，也有几分浪漫——你总是回到某个帮派的藏身处，只为了和他们性感的首领上床...茜只是轻笑，用指尖轻点你的鼻子。
rows.raw: "\n\nA fresh blush rises in your cheeks as she says so. There’s a little bit of guilt and romance there, constantly returning to some gang’s hideout just to sleep with their sexy boss all the time... Akane merely chuckles, bopping your nose with her fingertips."

rows.original: “And each time you did, I knew you more and I wanted to know more. More of this... this Steele creature in front of me. Just had to crack the shell first, ahmmhmm. Now that I’ve done that I uh, I find myself wishing to know more...”
rows.translation: “而你每回来一次，我就会更了解你，也更想知道更多。更多关于这个...眼前这个斯蒂尔生物的事情。只是得先敲开外壳，啊嗯哼。现在我已经做到了，呃，我发现自己还想知道更多...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And each time you did, I knew you more and I wanted to know more. More of this... this Steele creature in front of me. Just had to crack the shell first, ahmmhmm. Now that I’ve done that I uh, I find myself wishing to know more...”"

rows.original: She shuffles closer on her side so that her face is within an inch of yours.
rows.translation: 她侧身挪近，让面容离你不到一英寸。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shuffles closer on her side so that her face is within an inch of yours."

rows.original: “But you’re so young. So young... I couldn’t take more than I have done from you. You’ve got all this life ahead of you and I’m just... something nice on the side. I-I can live with that, I can...”
rows.translation: “可你太年轻了。太年轻...我不能再从你身上夺走更多。你还有这一整段人生摆在面前，而我只是...身边一件美好的消遣。我、我能接受，我可以...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But you’re so young. So young... I couldn’t take more than I have done from you. You’ve got all this life ahead of you and I’m just... something nice on the side. I-I can live with that, I can...”"

rows.original: The wavering domme pushes her ruby lips to your [pc.lipsChaste], her kisses coming in slow and sensuous as she tries to keep herself steady. You can’t help but oblige with your [pc.tongue], using as much of to fill out her mouth as you can. For some long, blissful seconds, the two of you become enraptured in your own thoughtless, personal universe
rows.translation: 声音颤抖的女支配者将红宝石双唇贴上你的[pc.lipsChaste]，努力稳住自己，献上缓慢而感性的亲吻。你忍不住用[pc.tongue]回应，尽可能让它填满她的嘴。在漫长而幸福的几秒里，你们沉醉在专属于彼此、不含思绪的宇宙中
rows.raw: "\n\nThe wavering domme pushes her ruby lips to your [pc.lipsChaste], her kisses coming in slow and sensuous as she tries to keep herself steady. You can’t help but oblige with your [pc.tongue], using as much of to fill out her mouth as you can. For some long, blissful seconds, the two of you become enraptured in your own thoughtless, personal universe "

rows.original: MY PERSONAL UNIVERSE, CAN YOU HEAR ME
rows.translation: 我的私人宇宙，你能听见我吗
rows.raw: "MY PERSONAL UNIVERSE, CAN YOU HEAR ME "

rows.original: that never seems to end.
rows.translation: ，仿佛永远不会结束。
rows.raw: "that never seems to end."

rows.original: Akane breaks the kiss abruptly, leaving your [pc.lipsChaste] feeling cold.
rows.translation: 茜突然中断亲吻，让你的[pc.lipsChaste]感到一阵冰冷。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane breaks the kiss abruptly, leaving your [pc.lipsChaste] feeling cold."

rows.original: “A-alright alright, stop, stop,” she flusters, resting her forehead against yours.
rows.translation: “好、好了，停下，停下，”她慌乱地说道，将额头抵住你的额头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A-alright alright, stop, stop,” she flusters, resting her forehead against yours."

rows.original: “Why do we have to do this, just throw our little arrangement away? Let’s just be this, as a c-casual dominant and submissive relationship. You have so much ahead of you... if we kept going, if we became lost to this then that means you’d have to be here, with us... the higher ups wouldn’t allow it otherwise,” she sniffs, her fingers curling against your shoulder with a pained expression.
rows.translation: “我们为什么非得这么做，为什么要扔掉这段小小的安排？我们只需维持现状，保持随、随意的支配与臣服关系。你还有这么多未来...如果继续下去，如果我们沉溺其中，那就意味着你必须留在这里，和我们一起...否则高层不会允许，”她抽着鼻子说道，手指带着痛苦神色蜷曲在你肩上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why do we have to do this, just throw our little arrangement away? Let’s just be this, as a c-casual dominant and submissive relationship. You have so much ahead of you... if we kept going, if we became lost to this then that means you’d have to be here, with us... the higher ups wouldn’t allow it otherwise,” she sniffs, her fingers curling against your shoulder with a pained expression."

rows.original: “But why...?” you whisper.
rows.translation: “可是为什么...？”你低声问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But why...?” you whisper."

rows.original: “We can’t risk the secrecy... for anything. Either you’re here with me, knowing all we know or you’re not, knowing only me. I-I can’t make you choose but please, I just want what’s best for my young [pc.name]...”
rows.translation: “我们不能拿保密性冒险...不管是为了什么。你要么留在这里陪着我，知道我们所知道的一切，要么离开，只了解我。我、我不能逼你选择，可是求你了，我只想给年轻的[pc.name]最好的东西...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We can’t risk the secrecy... for anything. Either you’re here with me, knowing all we know or you’re not, knowing only me. I-I can’t make you choose but please, I just want what’s best for my young [pc.name]...”"

rows.original: “You know what it would mean if we kept going. You’d leave your spacer life behind and have to adapt to mine. It wouldn’t be yours anymore... and I want you. But I want you to thrive. Y-you don’t need me, our time together has been perfect at every point as is! I...”
rows.translation: “你知道继续下去意味着什么。你得抛下太空旅人的生活，适应我的生活。那不再是属于你的人生...而且我想要你。但我也想让你茁壮成长。你、你不需要我，我们共度的每一刻本来就已经完美！我...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know what it would mean if we kept going. You’d leave your spacer life behind and have to adapt to mine. It wouldn’t be yours anymore... and I want you. But I want you to thrive. Y-you don’t need me, our time together has been perfect at every point as is! I...”"

rows.original: She trails off before finishing her thought, her glassy eyes looking lost and fearful.
rows.translation: 她没有说完便沉默下来，玻璃般的双眼显得迷茫而恐惧。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe trails off before finishing her thought, her glassy eyes looking lost and fearful."

rows.original: “It’s alright, I want the same too. Existing as our own guilty pleasures,” you say to her, cupping her hand with the two of yours and bringing it up to your face.
rows.translation: “没关系，我也想要同样的东西。让我们继续做彼此罪恶的享受，”你对她说道，用双手托起她的手，带到自己脸旁。
rows.raw: "“It’s alright, I want the same too. Existing as our own guilty pleasures,” you say to her, cupping her hand with the two of yours and bringing it up to your face."

rows.original: With a heavy sigh, Akane’s fearful face turns into a smile of relief. Her forehead comes to rest against yours as her shoulders visible relax.
rows.translation: 茜重重叹息，恐惧的脸变成如释重负的笑容。她将额头贴上你的额头，肩膀明显放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a heavy sigh, Akane’s fearful face turns into a smile of relief. Her forehead comes to rest against yours as her shoulders visible relax."

rows.original: “Good, good... making the better choice for your future. Effhhhfuck, my head... I was so worried! Almost shaking...” she says slowly, half giggling as the moment of truth passes. “D-don’t scare me like that again, you... monster.”
rows.translation: “好，好...为自己的未来做出更好的选择。呃操，我的头...我太担心了！差点都发抖了...”她缓缓说道，真相揭晓的时刻过去后，半是咯咯笑了起来。“别、别再这样吓我了，你这个...怪物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good, good... making the better choice for your future. Effhhhfuck, my head... I was so worried! Almost shaking...” she says slowly, half giggling as the moment of truth passes. “D-don’t scare me like that again, you... monster.”"

rows.original: Akane nuzzles your nose to hers, the two of you then settling into a more relaxed mood...
rows.translation: 茜用鼻子与你厮磨，随后你们一同进入更加放松的情绪...
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane nuzzles your nose to hers, the two of you then settling into a more relaxed mood..."

rows.original: TALKED_US
rows.raw: "TALKED_US"

rows.original: One more year passes.
rows.translation: 又过了一年。
rows.raw: "One more year passes."

rows.original: You’ve both settled into your quiet resort in the middle of U.G.C space. With the Hosts blessing and Akane’s sizable monetary investments, you’ve several million in the bank to be comfortable with for a long time to come.
rows.translation: 你们已经在银河联合邦太空中央的静谧度假地安顿下来。得到缩地组织的祝福与茜大笔资金投入，你在银行里有数百万信用点，足以舒适生活很久。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve both settled into your quiet resort in the middle of U.G.C space. With the Hosts blessing and Akane’s sizable monetary investments, you’ve several million in the bank to be comfortable with for a long time to come."

rows.original: You spend most days together, experiencing peace and relaxation on a most indulgent and decadent level.
rows.translation: 你们大多数日子都相伴度过，以最放纵奢华的程度体验宁静与放松。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend most days together, experiencing peace and relaxation on a most indulgent and decadent level."

rows.original: Congratulations! You got the Good End!
rows.translation: 恭喜！你达成了美好结局！
rows.raw: "Congratulations! You got the Good End!"

rows.original: At this point, this story continues in its own vacuum... but maybe you’d rather begin your adventures again?
rows.translation: 到了这里，这个故事将在独立的世界中继续...不过，你或许更想重新开始自己的冒险？
rows.raw: "\n\nAt this point, this story continues in its own vacuum... but maybe you’d rather begin your adventures again?"

rows.original: Four years pass.
rows.translation: 四年过去。
rows.raw: "Four years pass."

rows.original: Eventually, you feel your zest for the rhythm of the Host to dull. Not in a negative way, more in a pure way. The actions become so well-versed and integral to you that you couldn’t even think back on what life you had before this all. Akane never ceases to provide the best of what you need... that overwhelming desire to be touched by her every night has never faded. Yet Akane herself has only grown more demanding of you while simultaneously letting herself become more lost to vice.
rows.translation: 最终，你感到自己对缩地生活节奏的热情渐渐变淡。这并不是消极的变化，反而相当纯粹。这些行动已经变得无比熟练，成为你不可分割的一部分，甚至让你想不起这一切开始前的生活。茜从未停止提供你需要的最佳事物...那种每晚都渴望她触碰的压倒性欲望从未消退。然而茜本人对你的要求越来越高，同时也任由自己愈发沉溺于恶习。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, you feel your zest for the rhythm of the Host to dull. Not in a negative way, more in a pure way. The actions become so well-versed and integral to you that you couldn’t even think back on what life you had before this all. Akane never ceases to provide the best of what you need... that overwhelming desire to be touched by her every night has never faded. Yet Akane herself has only grown more demanding of you while simultaneously letting herself become more lost to vice."

rows.original: Still very much in control and in top form amongst the Host, her sexual appetite grows more and more obscure as she tries to wring as much from your body as she can. Sometimes, it’s a public ‘shaming’ where you’re lashed in front of a parade of agents you’re friendly with. Other times, it’s sending you on missions strapped the nines in all manner of vibe-toys, stim-pads and potent aphrodisiacs. At the end of each day, you’re so worked up that you’re more than willing to accept her relief... and continue again the next day.
rows.translation: 她在缩地组织中依然牢牢掌权，保持最佳状态，但性欲变得越来越晦涩古怪，竭力想从你的身体里榨取尽可能多的东西。有时是在一群与你交好的特工面前鞭打你，进行公开‘羞辱’。另一些时候，则是让你全副装备各种震动玩具、刺激贴片与强效催情剂，前去执行任务。每一天结束时，你都会被撩拨到极点，心甘情愿接受她的释放...并在第二天重新开始。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill very much in control and in top form amongst the Host, her sexual appetite grows more and more obscure as she tries to wring as much from your body as she can. Sometimes, it’s a public ‘shaming’ where you’re lashed in front of a parade of agents you’re friendly with. Other times, it’s sending you on missions strapped the nines in all manner of vibe-toys, stim-pads and potent aphrodisiacs. At the end of each day, you’re so worked up that you’re more than willing to accept her relief... and continue again the next day."

rows.original: At some point, you’re snapped out of the routine.
rows.translation: 到了某个时刻，你突然从日常循环中惊醒。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt some point, you’re snapped out of the routine."

rows.original: The higher-ups in the command structure, impressed with your rapid rise in skill and accomplishment, send envoys to express their need for you in their more active fronts. You’re assured an intense and perk-heavy life well within U.G.C space as a mid-high level agent.
rows.translation: 指挥体系的高层对你迅速提升的技能与成就印象深刻，派出使者表示，他们需要你前往更活跃的战线。你得到保证，将作为中高层特工，在银河联合邦太空中过上紧张刺激且福利丰厚的生活。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe higher-ups in the command structure, impressed with your rapid rise in skill and accomplishment, send envoys to express their need for you in their more active fronts. You’re assured an intense and perk-heavy life well within U.G.C space as a mid-high level agent."

rows.original: Your immediate reaction is to refuse... and Akane agrees. The main reason you’re even a part of the organization is because of her, after all.
rows.translation: 你的第一反应是拒绝...茜也表示同意。毕竟，你会加入这个组织，最主要的原因就是她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour immediate reaction is to refuse... and Akane agrees. The main reason you’re even a part of the organization is because of her, after all."

rows.original: However, the higher-ups the lay down an ultimatum: agree to the order or face a forced retirement.
rows.translation: 然而，高层下达了最后通牒：接受命令，否则被迫退休。
rows.raw: "\n\nHowever, the higher-ups the lay down an ultimatum: agree to the order or face a forced retirement."

rows.original: Akane immediately voices her support for the latter. She explains her slowly unraveling behaviour as her getting more and more weary of the Host lifestyle. Now in her 50’s and with silvered streaks in her onyx hair, she tells you that she’s been feeling closer to just... whisking you away at some point to some pleasure planet. Now you have the chance to do so.
rows.translation: 茜立刻表示支持后者。她解释道，自己逐渐失控的行为源于对缩地生活越来越厌倦。如今她已五十多岁，乌黑头发中出现银色发丝，并告诉你，她越来越想在某个时候直接...将你带到某颗享乐星球。现在，你们得到了这样做的机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane immediately voices her support for the latter. She explains her slowly unraveling behaviour as her getting more and more weary of the Host lifestyle. Now in her 50’s and with silvered streaks in her onyx hair, she tells you that she’s been feeling closer to just... whisking you away at some point to some pleasure planet. Now you have the chance to do so."

rows.original: Aw...
Aw...
And then...
rows.translation: 然后...
rows.raw: "And then..."

rows.original: Although initially loathing the prospect of putting you in harm’s way once again, you play up your combat experience and your accomplishments during her slaver bust-up.
rows.translation: 尽管起初极其厌恶再次让你身陷危险的想法，你还是大力强调了自己的战斗经验，以及她打击奴隶贩子时立下的功绩。
rows.raw: "Although initially loathing the prospect of putting you in harm’s way once again, you play up your combat experience and your accomplishments during her slaver bust-up."

rows.original: After a few days of indecision, Akane relents and allows you to train with her other subordinates.
rows.translation: 经过几天犹豫不决，茜终于让步，允许你和她的其他下属一起训练。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few days of indecision, Akane relents and allows you to train with her other subordinates."

rows.original: The going is tough. While you’ve had your fair share of live fire situations, acrobatics and formal martial arts brings in a whole new set of skills. Skills that take some time to even get the basics right.
rows.translation: 过程十分艰苦。虽然你经历过不少实弹场面，但杂技和正规武术带来了一整套全新技能。就连掌握这些技能的基础，也需要不少时间。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe going is tough. While you’ve had your fair share of live fire situations, acrobatics and formal martial arts brings in a whole new set of skills. Skills that take some time to even get the basics right. "

rows.original:
It doesn’t help that your tauric body bars you from doing most things easily, forcing you to consider a drastic change to your body...
In the end, you’re able to requisition resources to purchasing specially made bi-pedal mods and taur-body mods in case this current route becomes too much.
rows.translation:
半人马身体让你难以轻松完成大多数事情，这也毫无帮助，迫使你考虑对身体进行剧烈改变...
最终，你得以征用资源，购买特别打造的双足改造剂与四足身体改造剂，以防当前路线变得过于艰难。
rows.raw: "It doesn’t help that your tauric body bars you from doing most things easily, forcing you to consider a drastic change to your body...\nIn the end, you’re able to requisition resources to purchasing specially made bi-pedal mods and taur-body mods in case this current route becomes too much."

rows.original: But weeks pass smoothly with the right training on hand, every night becoming a recovery session in which Akane massages, comforts and praises your personal progress. With all this bolstering, you can feel your body grow spiritually as well as physically. As a reflection of that, you’ve become more physically athletic and dedicated to improving your body’s strengths and limits. When you’re introduced to the specific combat routines used by the Host operatives, stealth field and all, you do surprisingly well. From then on, you only continue to improve...
rows.translation: 但在正确训练的帮助下，数周时间顺利过去；每个夜晚都变成恢复训练，茜会按摩、安慰并赞扬你的个人进步。在这一切鼓励下，你能感觉到身体在精神与物质层面同时成长。作为体现，你的体格变得更有运动能力，也更专注于提升身体的力量与极限。接触缩地特工使用的特定战斗流程时，包括隐形场在内，你都表现得出奇优秀。从那以后，你只会继续进步...
rows.raw: "\n\nBut weeks pass smoothly with the right training on hand, every night becoming a recovery session in which Akane massages, comforts and praises your personal progress. With all this bolstering, you can feel your body grow spiritually as well as physically. As a reflection of that, you’ve become more physically athletic and dedicated to improving your body’s strengths and limits. When you’re introduced to the specific combat routines used by the Host operatives, stealth field and all, you do surprisingly well. From then on, you only continue to improve..."

rows.original: A year passes, almost without you thinking of it. The routine of the Host Shukuchi becomes your rhythm. You’re often separated from Akane for most of the day, only to have her by your side at night. You both couldn’t be happier being together, a matured and intimate understanding having blossomed between the two of you. It comes to the point where Akane is able to live out her dream of sleeping without her cybernetics, her trust in you reaching a zenith. On nights like these, you find yourself taking on a spiritual protector role.
rows.translation: 一年在你几乎没有察觉的情况下过去。缩地组织的日常变成了你的节奏。白天大部分时候，你都与茜分离，只有夜晚她才会陪在身边。你们因相伴而无比幸福，成熟而亲密的理解在彼此之间绽放。最终，茜实现了卸下义体入睡的梦想，对你的信任达到顶峰。在这样的夜晚，你发现自己承担起精神守护者的角色。
rows.raw: "\n\nA year passes, almost without you thinking of it. The routine of the Host Shukuchi becomes your rhythm. You’re often separated from Akane for most of the day, only to have her by your side at night. You both couldn’t be happier being together, a matured and intimate understanding having blossomed between the two of you. It comes to the point where Akane is able to live out her dream of sleeping without her cybernetics, her trust in you reaching a zenith. On nights like these, you find yourself taking on a spiritual protector role."

rows.original: As she protects you during the day, you protect her during the night.
rows.translation: 正如白天她保护你，夜晚则由你保护她。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she protects you during the day, you protect her during the night."

rows.original: After a year of training and simple procedures - collection, security, some roughhousing for unscrupulous CEO’s - and some personally lucrative corporate work on the side, Akane deems you fit (and safe) enough to take part in clan warfare.
rows.translation: 经过一年训练和简单流程——收款、安保、替无良首席执行官粗暴办事——以及一些对个人而言收益丰厚的企业外快，茜认为你已经足够胜任，也足够安全，可以参与家族战争。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a year of training and simple procedures - collection, security, some roughhousing for unscrupulous CEO’s - and some personally lucrative corporate work on the side, Akane deems you fit (and safe) enough to take part in clan warfare."

rows.original: Your first raid is against a weapon smugglers crew, a low-level affair but with enough money and ammo in it that it’s treated seriously. With your own team of six agents, you sneak into the storehouse and incapacitate the few guards there with flashbangs, using stealth fields to bypass the unmanned security.
rows.translation: 你的第一次突袭针对一群武器走私犯；这是一次低级别行动，但涉及的资金与弹药足以让众人认真对待。你率领六人特工小队潜入仓库，用闪光弹制服少数守卫，再利用隐形场绕过无人安保系统。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour first raid is against a weapon smugglers crew, a low-level affair but with enough money and ammo in it that it’s treated seriously. With your own team of six agents, you sneak into the storehouse and incapacitate the few guards there with flashbangs, using stealth fields to bypass the unmanned security."

rows.original: It’s swift, smooth and lucrative. As a congratulation for your first successful mission, Akane presents you your official, personalized Shukuchi mask. Wearing it feels seamless, almost enlightening: the kind of tech that opens your eyes and awareness in the heat of combat.
rows.translation: 行动迅速、顺利而且收益丰厚。为了祝贺你首次成功执行任务，茜赠给你一副正式定制的缩地面具。戴上它的感觉无缝自然，几乎让人豁然开朗：这种技术能在激烈战斗中拓宽你的视野与意识。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s swift, smooth and lucrative. As a congratulation for your first successful mission, Akane presents you your official, personalized Shukuchi mask. Wearing it feels seamless, almost enlightening: the kind of tech that opens your eyes and awareness in the heat of combat."

rows.original: Another year passes.
rows.translation: 又过了一年。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother year passes."

rows.original: You’re now among the best agents at Akane’s behest. You’re afforded more respect and privilege than usual owing to your relationship with the boss. Although there’s not a complete lack of discontent among lower level agents, the arrangement doesn’t affect the Host. Now, your life has become a routine. Never a dull one, of course: every day, you’re given active duties to perform from shakedowns, reclamation, raiding or even protection and then every night, you return to the lover you never see enough of.
rows.translation: 在茜的指示下，你如今已跻身最佳特工之列。因为与首领的关系，你获得了超乎寻常的尊重与特权。虽然底层特工并非完全没有不满，但这项安排并未影响缩地组织。如今，你的生活已经形成规律。当然，这规律绝不乏味：每天都要执行敲诈、回收、突袭甚至保护等实际任务，每晚则回到那个永远相处不够的爱人身边。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re now among the best agents at Akane’s behest. You’re afforded more respect and privilege than usual owing to your relationship with the boss. Although there’s not a complete lack of discontent among lower level agents, the arrangement doesn’t affect the Host. Now, your life has become a routine. Never a dull one, of course: every day, you’re given active duties to perform from shakedowns, reclamation, raiding or even protection and then every night, you return to the lover you never see enough of."

rows.original: Over time, Akane’s style becomes more open and relaxed. Instead of body-hugging, short dresses and leather jackets, she opts for looser, ankle length robes that show off more of her skin. Her personal demands of you become more and more hedonistic, from subtle things like leaving the door open during painplay to having you pleasure her orally on her throne. You’re never left wanting for ways to please her, at least...
rows.translation: 随着时间推移，茜的风格变得更加开放放松。她不再选择紧贴身体的短裙和皮夹克，转而穿起更加宽松、长及脚踝的长袍，展露更多肌肤。她对你的个人要求变得越来越享乐主义，从痛觉游戏时把门敞开这种细微事情，到让你在王座上用嘴取悦她。至少，你永远不会缺少取悦她的方法...
rows.raw: "\n\nOver time, Akane’s style becomes more open and relaxed. Instead of body-hugging, short dresses and leather jackets, she opts for looser, ankle length robes that show off more of her skin. Her personal demands of you become more and more hedonistic, from subtle things like leaving the door open during painplay to having you pleasure her orally on her throne. You’re never left wanting for ways to please her, at least..."

rows.original: And Then?
rows.translation: 然后呢？
rows.raw: "And Then?"

rows.original: And Then...?
rows.raw: "And Then...?"

rows.original: Where’s this all going...?
rows.translation: 这一切会走向何方...？
rows.raw: "Where’s this all going...?"

rows.original: The next few weeks become something of a blur.
rows.translation: 接下来的几周变得有些模糊。
rows.raw: "The next few weeks become something of a blur."

rows.original: You’re quick to announce that you’re putting your dad’s quest to bed. The press surrounding Rusher space blow up in terms of speculation and it’s not so surprising to you. You know what the real answer is but... your new commitment means one final challenge. You give a tearful goodbye to your crew before selling your ship.
rows.translation: 你很快宣布，自己将终止父亲留下的任务。拉舍尔太空周围的媒体爆发出各种猜测，对你来说并不意外。你知道真正答案是什么，可...新的承诺意味着最后一道挑战。你含泪告别船员，随后卖掉飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re quick to announce that you’re putting your dad’s quest to bed. The press surrounding Rusher space blow up in terms of speculation and it’s not so surprising to you. You know what the real answer is but... your new commitment means one final challenge. You give a tearful goodbye to your crew before selling your ship."

rows.original: Anno is - at first - highly distraught but quickly comes to terms with the situation, hoping one day you’ll meet her again. You’re gonna miss that white-haired firebrand..
rows.translation: 安诺起初极其悲痛，却很快接受现实，希望有一天还能再次遇见你。你会想念那个白发火爆姑娘的..
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno is - at first - highly distraught but quickly comes to terms with the situation, hoping one day you’ll meet her again. You’re gonna miss that white-haired firebrand.."

rows.original: Although known for her thorny exterior, Sera seems genuinely lost in the wake of things. She even begs to take you with her given how you cost her the Chrysalis.
rows.translation: 塞拉虽然一向以尖锐外表闻名，却似乎真的在事变之后迷失了方向。考虑到你让她失去了蛹，她甚至恳求带你同行。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlthough known for her thorny exterior, Sera seems genuinely lost in the wake of things. She even begs to take you with her given how you cost her the Chrysalis. "

rows.original: However, with a few kind words and one last filthy railing for being such a good girl, she vows to use her new found freedom to become a mercantile giant in rusher space, delivering the most boutique of mods she can think of.
rows.translation: 然而，听了几句善意话语，又因做个好女孩而最后遭你狠狠操弄一次后，她发誓要利用新获得的自由，在拉舍尔太空成为商业巨头，供应自己能想到的最高档改造剂。
rows.raw: "However, with a few kind words and one last filthy railing for being such a good girl, she vows to use her new found freedom to become a mercantile giant in rusher space, delivering the most boutique of mods she can think of."

rows.original: Given how you’re unsure how she plans to survive with no guidance, money or friends to rely on... you gift her a sizable chunk of your savings with no expectation of returns. After some deliberation, she regains some of her zing and vows to rebuild a new shop from the ground up.
rows.translation: 你不知道她没有指导、金钱或朋友可以依赖，究竟打算如何生存...于是送给她相当大的一笔积蓄，不求回报。经过一番考虑，她恢复了些许活力，发誓从头建立一家新商店。
rows.raw: "Given how you’re unsure how she plans to survive with no guidance, money or friends to rely on... you gift her a sizable chunk of your savings with no expectation of returns. After some deliberation, she regains some of her zing and vows to rebuild a new shop from the ground up."

rows.original: Putting on a brave face, Kase can’t help but shed a tear as you break the news.
rows.translation: 当你说出消息时，凯斯虽然强装勇敢，仍忍不住流下一滴眼泪。
rows.raw: "\n\nPutting on a brave face, Kase can’t help but shed a tear as you break the news. "

rows.original: Still a part of Steele Tech, he promises to keep you and your legacy in mind while finding a suitable role for his talents. PR might be a good one...
rows.translation: 他仍是斯蒂尔科技的一员，答应在为自己的才能寻找合适职位时铭记你和你的传承。公共关系或许不错...
rows.raw: "Still a part of Steele Tech, he promises to keep you and your legacy in mind while finding a suitable role for his talents. PR might be a good one..."

rows.original: With his contract bought by you, he has little in the way of fallback but after some deliberation and a few spins of communication, he becomes convinced that he can get something in corporate PR.
rows.translation: 他的合同已被你买下，几乎没有退路；但经过一番考虑并打了几次电话后，他相信自己能在企业公关部门找到职位。
rows.raw: "With his contract bought by you, he has little in the way of fallback but after some deliberation and a few spins of communication, he becomes convinced that he can get something in corporate PR."

rows.original: Azra approaches it with a realists view, despite declaring her sadness and disappointment. The nagging thought of her work still keeps her grounded all the same. Still, she isn’t above embracing you for what is really longer than necessary, what with the towering suula pretty much crushing you into her chest before you leave her be.
rows.translation: 尽管表达了悲伤与失望，阿兹拉仍以现实主义视角看待这件事。对工作的牵挂始终让她脚踏实地。即便如此，她也不介意拥抱你，而且时间远超必要；这名高大的苏拉几乎将你压进胸口，随后才让你离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nAzra approaches it with a realists view, despite declaring her sadness and disappointment. The nagging thought of her work still keeps her grounded all the same. Still, she isn’t above embracing you for what is really longer than necessary, what with the towering suula pretty much crushing you into her chest before you leave her be."

rows.original: Nova, always a rather naive creature, isn’t sure what to make of your action. You’re able to explain it to her in very rough ways, only for her to make the snap judgement to go to Steele Tech as a ‘person of interest’. You’re not entirely sure what her intentions are but you figure it might be a long lost kinship with what remains of her goo-like body elsewhere.
rows.translation: 诺娃一直是个相当天真的生物，不知道该如何理解你的行动。你只能用非常粗略的方式向她解释，结果她当即决定以‘关注对象’身份前往斯蒂尔科技。你不太清楚她的意图，但觉得这或许源于一种失落已久的亲缘感，指向她散落别处的黏液身体残余。
rows.raw: "\n\nNova, always a rather naive creature, isn’t sure what to make of your action. You’re able to explain it to her in very rough ways, only for her to make the snap judgement to go to Steele Tech as a ‘person of interest’. You’re not entirely sure what her intentions are but you figure it might be a long lost kinship with what remains of her goo-like body elsewhere."

rows.original: Although having dealt with this sort of sadness before, a tearful Paige says she understands before giving you a loving hug. She emphasises how you’ve done more than enough for her in this lifetime after having regained her sight. Paige then begins steps to re-opening her yoga business.
rows.translation: 佩姬以前经历过这种悲伤；她含着泪说自己明白，随后给你一个充满爱意的拥抱。恢复视力之后，你已经为她做了远超此生所需的一切，她格外强调这一点。接着，佩姬开始采取措施，重新开办瑜伽生意。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlthough having dealt with this sort of sadness before, a tearful Paige says she understands before giving you a loving hug. She emphasises how you’ve done more than enough for her in this lifetime after having regained her sight. Paige then begins steps to re-opening her yoga business."

rows.original: Reaha can’t stop herself from crying, having been saved from legal sex-slavery only to be homeless once again.
rows.translation: 瑞娅控制不住哭泣；她才刚从合法性奴役中获救，如今又要无家可归。
rows.raw: "\n\nReaha can’t stop herself from crying, having been saved from legal sex-slavery only to be homeless once again. "

rows.original: However, with her renewed will to keep striving, she declares that she’ll put her new lease on life to good use. She hints heavily at opening a brand of milkshakes and icecreams, something affirmed with the wiggle of her ample, pendulous tits.
rows.translation: 然而，重新燃起的奋斗意志让她宣布，自己会充分利用这段新生。她强烈暗示要创立一个奶昔与冰淇淋品牌，还摇晃着丰满下垂的乳房加以确认。
rows.raw: "However, with her renewed will to keep striving, she declares that she’ll put her new lease on life to good use. She hints heavily at opening a brand of milkshakes and icecreams, something affirmed with the wiggle of her ample, pendulous tits."

rows.original: Knowing that she’d be very open to abuse and hardship with her addiction, you give her a list of contacts including Maki who could help, along with a sizable chunk of your savings to keep her stable.
rows.translation: 你知道她的成瘾问题会使她极易遭受虐待与苦难，于是给了她一份联系人名单，其中包括能够提供帮助的真希，还拿出相当大的一笔积蓄，让她维持稳定。
rows.raw: "Knowing that she’d be very open to abuse and hardship with her addiction, you give her a list of contacts including Maki who could help, along with a sizable chunk of your savings to keep her stable."

rows.original: Although not as broken up about it as you’d have thought, Celise instantly takes to the idea of going after
rows.translation: 赛利丝并没有像你以为的那样崩溃，反而立刻接受了去追寻
rows.raw: "\n\nAlthough not as broken up about it as you’d have thought, Celise instantly takes to the idea of going after "

joinAfter.expression:
void 0 !== flags.MET_ANNO
                                        ? "Anno"
                                        : "and old friend she grew apart from"

rows.original: Anno
rows.translation: 安诺
rows.raw: "Anno"

rows.original: and old friend she grew apart from
rows.translation: 一位已经疏远的老朋友
rows.raw: "and old friend she grew apart from"

rows.original: . Apparently being friendly with her from before turned into something else when you dropped the bombshell...
rows.translation: 的想法。显然，你丢下重磅消息后，她们以前的友谊变成了别的东西...
rows.raw: ". Apparently being friendly with her from before turned into something else when you dropped the bombshell..."

rows.original: Yammi is saddened but remains optimistic for you and for her. Having toured with spacers, she tells you that she has new ideas and plans in her head that are above and beyond what she could’ve dreamt of before.
rows.translation: 雅米感到悲伤，却依然对你和自己保持乐观。她曾与太空旅人共同旅行，并告诉你，脑中已经有了新的想法和计划，远远超出过去所能梦想的一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nYammi is saddened but remains optimistic for you and for her. Having toured with spacers, she tells you that she has new ideas and plans in her head that are above and beyond what she could’ve dreamt of before. "

rows.original: With her pexiga pet in tow, she already begins preparing for her newly minted business schemes.
rows.translation: 带着佩西加宠物，她已经开始为新鲜出炉的商业计划做准备。
rows.raw: "With her pexiga pet in tow, she already begins preparing for her newly minted business schemes."

rows.original: And that’s that. Despite having such love to go around, you know that your commitment to Akane now comes first. The spontaneity of it all, giving up your spacer life and all your friends, the promise of something new that you need... a pure, cathartic rush. A week after the declaration, you’re already at a shipyard with your
rows.translation: 事情就这样结束了。尽管你有如此多的爱可以分给众人，却知道对茜的承诺如今必须放在首位。这一切的自发冲动，放弃太空旅人生活与所有朋友，以及你需要的崭新事物之承诺...带来纯粹而宣泄畅快的冲击。宣布决定一周后，你已经来到造船厂，而自己的
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd that’s that. Despite having such love to go around, you know that your commitment to Akane now comes first. The spontaneity of it all, giving up your spacer life and all your friends, the promise of something new that you need... a pure, cathartic rush. A week after the declaration, you’re already at a shipyard with your "

rows.original: ancient Casstech
rows.translation: 古老卡斯科技飞船
rows.raw: "ancient Casstech"

rows.original: ship
rows.translation: 飞船
rows.raw: "ship"

rows.original: cleared of all personal belongings. It’s old enough and just about famous enough that it’s sequestered into an ‘artefacts’ category, presumably for some sort of Rushers museum. There’s an intense pang of guilt as you hand the command codes over... but by turning around, the guilt wafts away in a sea of new ideas and aspiration.
rows.translation: 已清空所有私人物品。它足够古老，也恰好足够知名，因此被归入‘文物’类别，大概会送进某座拉舍尔博物馆。交出指挥代码时，强烈的内疚刺入心间...可一转过身，内疚便消散在新想法与抱负的海洋中。
rows.raw: " cleared of all personal belongings. It’s old enough and just about famous enough that it’s sequestered into an ‘artefacts’ category, presumably for some sort of Rushers museum. There’s an intense pang of guilt as you hand the command codes over... but by turning around, the guilt wafts away in a sea of new ideas and aspiration."

rows.original: You spend the next week adjusting to life in the Host. Akane’s room becomes the most central part of your new home, something you get used to very quickly. The soft covers become the perfect balm for the nightly sessions you and her play out, and Akane is more than willing to wrap you up and tuck you in whenever there’s a particularly brutal one.
rows.translation: 接下来一周，你都在适应缩地组织的生活。茜的房间成为新家最核心的部分，而你很快就适应了。每晚你和她上演各种游戏，柔软被褥成为完美慰藉；只要某次游戏格外残酷，茜都会非常乐意裹住你，替你盖好被子。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend the next week adjusting to life in the Host. Akane’s room becomes the most central part of your new home, something you get used to very quickly. The soft covers become the perfect balm for the nightly sessions you and her play out, and Akane is more than willing to wrap you up and tuck you in whenever there’s a particularly brutal one."

rows.original: Every night feels like a new experience as she finds more intense and disturbing ways to bring you to your knees. During the day, you become familiar with the other inhabitants: the agents who have their own dorms and temporary sleeping places; training rooms and meditation spaces; comms rooms and actions rooms for planning and staging... with all your new free time, you dedicate yourself to knowing your surroundings in as complete a way as possible.
rows.translation: 每个夜晚都像全新体验，她会找到更加强烈、令人不安的方式，逼你跪倒在地。白天，你逐渐熟悉其他住民：拥有各自宿舍和临时睡处的特工，训练室与冥想空间，以及规划部署用的通信室与行动室...你有了大把空闲时间，便投入其中，尽可能全面地了解周围环境。
rows.raw: "\n\nEvery night feels like a new experience as she finds more intense and disturbing ways to bring you to your knees. During the day, you become familiar with the other inhabitants: the agents who have their own dorms and temporary sleeping places; training rooms and meditation spaces; comms rooms and actions rooms for planning and staging... with all your new free time, you dedicate yourself to knowing your surroundings in as complete a way as possible."

rows.original: Akane lets you roam free, letting you interact with the agents on their off hours. Despite their universally ‘professional’ attitudes, they lead surprisingly sane lives within the context of the Host. In turn, they all ask about how you plan to live in the organization, a question you leave open. Even if you don’t make friends immediately, you make good foundations.
rows.translation: 茜允许你自由活动，在特工休息时与他们交流。尽管他们全都保持‘专业’态度，却在缩地组织的背景下过着出奇正常的生活。他们也会问你打算如何在组织中生活，而你暂时没有回答。即使无法立刻交到朋友，你也打下了良好基础。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane lets you roam free, letting you interact with the agents on their off hours. Despite their universally ‘professional’ attitudes, they lead surprisingly sane lives within the context of the Host. In turn, they all ask about how you plan to live in the organization, a question you leave open. Even if you don’t make friends immediately, you make good foundations."

rows.original: A week turns into two, then into four.
rows.translation: 一周变成两周，又变成四周。
rows.raw: "\n\nA week turns into two, then into four."

rows.original: You’ve gotten used to the strange routines, procedures and quirks of the daily life of a Host Shukuchi member. Akane keeps to her own, even stricter routine that involves far more logistics and directive work than you would’ve considered before. You assist her at times, giving her emotional support on the long shifts... as well as servicing her during free time.
rows.translation: 你已经习惯缩地组织成员日常生活中奇怪的规律、流程与怪癖。茜保持着更加严格的个人日程，其中涉及的后勤与指挥工作远比你以前想象的更多。你有时会协助她，在漫长班次中提供精神支持...并在闲暇时服侍她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve gotten used to the strange routines, procedures and quirks of the daily life of a Host Shukuchi member. Akane keeps to her own, even stricter routine that involves far more logistics and directive work than you would’ve considered before. You assist her at times, giving her emotional support on the long shifts... as well as servicing her during free time."

rows.original: Yet you still haven’t quite found a true role in this walk of life.
rows.translation: 然而，你仍未在这种生活方式中找到真正的角色。
rows.raw: "\n\nYet you still haven’t quite found a true role in this walk of life."

rows.original: Some days pass and an opportunity arises when you’re able to figure out a solution to a complex business trade: managing business partners.
rows.translation: 几天过去，你找到了解决复杂商业交易的方案，于是机会出现了：管理商业伙伴。
rows.raw: "\n\nSome days pass and an opportunity arises when you’re able to figure out a solution to a complex business trade: managing business partners."

rows.original: Akane gives you the go ahead to be part of her business branch as a liaison of sorts. You work normal hours in a secure, Tavros-based office, several floors away from and two elevators behind the Merchants deck. It takes a good few days to get used to the routines, although the various lawyers, contacts and businessmen you have to manage are more than willing to help you with your first advances.
rows.translation: 茜允许你以某种联络人的身份加入商业分部。你按正常时间上班，办公室位于塔夫罗斯，安保严密，与商人甲板隔着几层楼和两部电梯。你花了好几天才习惯日常流程，不过需要管理的各位律师、联系人与商人都很愿意协助你踏出最初几步。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane gives you the go ahead to be part of her business branch as a liaison of sorts. You work normal hours in a secure, Tavros-based office, several floors away from and two elevators behind the Merchants deck. It takes a good few days to get used to the routines, although the various lawyers, contacts and businessmen you have to manage are more than willing to help you with your first advances."

rows.original: It’s slow but steady work at first, mostly ordering one lawyer in one direction and one portfolio into another to best fit the markets. It’s work that seems so far from your earlier beginnings as a [pc.startingCareer], the only things keeping you tied to that world are news reports of the odd new planet found, settled on and colonized in the space of weeks.
rows.translation: 起初工作缓慢却稳定，主要是指挥一名律师走向某个方向，又将一份投资组合调往另一个方向，以便最好地适应市场。这项工作似乎与早先作为[pc.startingCareer]的起点相去甚远，唯一让你与那个世界保持联系的，是新闻不时报道某颗新星球在几周内被发现、定居和殖民。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s slow but steady work at first, mostly ordering one lawyer in one direction and one portfolio into another to best fit the markets. It’s work that seems so far from your earlier beginnings as a [pc.startingCareer], the only things keeping you tied to that world are news reports of the odd new planet found, settled on and colonized in the space of weeks."

rows.original: Every night, you come back to a warm bed and a loving hand. Most days, the passions between you and your new partner last well into the night. Each new morning feels like the most well earned rest in the world. On the hard days, you spend more time together in a warm, silent embrace.
rows.translation: 每晚，你都会回到温暖床铺与充满爱意的手掌边。大多数日子里，你与新伴侣的激情会持续到深夜。每个清晨都像是全世界最值得的休息。艰难的日子里，你们会在温暖沉默的拥抱中相处更久。
rows.raw: "\n\nEvery night, you come back to a warm bed and a loving hand. Most days, the passions between you and your new partner last well into the night. Each new morning feels like the most well earned rest in the world. On the hard days, you spend more time together in a warm, silent embrace."

rows.original: Another week passes and you quickly find that the work of managing Shukuchi assets is certainly peaceful and smooth, it is far from the stimulation you were used to.
rows.translation: 又过了一周，你很快发现，管理缩地资产的工作固然平静顺利，却远远没有过去熟悉的刺激。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother week passes and you quickly find that the work of managing Shukuchi assets is certainly peaceful and smooth, it is far from the stimulation you were used to."

rows.original: You approach Akane for a change of course...
rows.translation: 你找到茜，希望改变方向...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou approach Akane for a change of course..."

rows.original: Oooo...?
rows.translation: 噢噢噢...？
rows.raw: "Oooo...?"

rows.original: Oooo...?
rows.translation: 噢噢噢...？
rows.raw: "Oooo...?"

rows.original: What could be next...?
rows.translation: 接下来会发生什么...？
rows.raw: "What could be next...?"

rows.original: “But that’s just it: I need you, Akane,” you whisper back to her, clasping her hand in both of yours. “I’m perfectly happy to live my life away from the Rush, outside of the messes going on in U.G.C. I can adapt here, I can help! I’ve already done so much already...”
rows.translation: “可这就是重点：我需要你，茜，”你握住她的手，贴在双掌之间，低声回答。“我完全愿意远离星球大开发，在银河联合邦的种种混乱之外度过一生。我可以适应这里，我也可以帮忙！我已经做过这么多事情了...”
rows.raw: "“But that’s just it: I need you, Akane,” you whisper back to her, clasping her hand in both of yours. “I’m perfectly happy to live my life away from the Rush, outside of the messes going on in U.G.C. I can adapt here, I can help! I’ve already done so much already...”"

rows.original: Akane’s eyes well up, a single tear running across each of her flushed cheeks.
rows.translation: 茜的双眼盈满泪水，一滴眼泪分别滑过潮红的双颊。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane’s eyes well up, a single tear running across each of her flushed cheeks."

rows.original: “[pc.name]... so does this mean you...?”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]...所以这意味着你...？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]... so does this mean you...?”"

rows.original: You lean in just a little closer so that you can whisper into her ear, the magic words of “I love you” passing from your lips. As you pull back, Akane’s fingers cover her mouth in disbelief. You can only smile as her reaction morphs into a tearful smile.
rows.translation: 你又靠近了一点，在她耳边低声说出“我爱你”这句魔法般的话。你退开时，茜难以置信地用手指捂住嘴巴。你只能微笑，看着她的反应化作含泪笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean in just a little closer so that you can whisper into her ear, the magic words of “I love you” passing from your lips. As you pull back, Akane’s fingers cover her mouth in disbelief. You can only smile as her reaction morphs into a tearful smile."

rows.original: You couldn’t help yourselves if you tried.
rows.translation: 即使想要克制，你们也做不到。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou couldn’t help yourselves if you tried."

rows.original: Knowing each other’s true feelings, you lose yourselves to a deep, loving kiss. Lips squish and pull against each other; tongues meeting then twisting together endlessly in between gasps and giggles.
rows.translation: 了解彼此真正的感情后，你们沉溺于深沉而充满爱意的亲吻。双唇互相挤压拉扯，舌头相遇，又在喘息与轻笑间无休止地纠缠。
rows.raw: "\n\nKnowing each other’s true feelings, you lose yourselves to a deep, loving kiss. Lips squish and pull against each other; tongues meeting then twisting together endlessly in between gasps and giggles."

rows.original: You’re pushed by your shoulder onto your back and Akane lays herself on top, the kissing kept to a constant and feral intensity. She directs the flow of things of course, pushing you into places that you can only react to.
rows.translation: 茜推着你的肩膀，让你仰躺下来，接着伏到身上，亲吻始终维持着原始而狂野的强度。当然，她主导着一切，将你推入只能被动反应的境地。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re pushed by your shoulder onto your back and Akane lays herself on top, the kissing kept to a constant and feral intensity. She directs the flow of things of course, pushing you into places that you can only react to."

rows.original: She continues to keep the pressure up at all times, the bristling sting of her fingertips becoming more frequent and invasive as her hands brush against, grip and squeeze your body all over. The more she does it, the more you bend to her manipulation under the near-orgasmic pain that flows through your nerves. With the way you wince and whine underneath, she seems keen on taking you down with her...
rows.translation: 她始终维持压力，指尖竖起的刺痛越来越频繁、更具侵入性，双手在你全身擦过、抓握、挤压。她做得越多，你就越会在流过神经、近乎高潮的痛楚下屈服于操纵。看着你在身下畏缩哀鸣，她似乎急切想拉着你一同沉沦...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe continues to keep the pressure up at all times, the bristling sting of her fingertips becoming more frequent and invasive as her hands brush against, grip and squeeze your body all over. The more she does it, the more you bend to her manipulation under the near-orgasmic pain that flows through your nerves. With the way you wince and whine underneath, she seems keen on taking you down with her..."

rows.original: Akane’s reactions go from maniacal giggles to feminine wails with every touch she makes adding to the blissful agony that bends you to her ministrations.
rows.translation: 茜的反应从疯狂轻笑变成柔媚哀号，每次触碰都会增加令人幸福的剧痛，让你屈服于她的摆弄。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane’s reactions go from maniacal giggles to feminine wails with every touch she makes adding to the blissful agony that bends you to her ministrations."

rows.original: Even after your previous sexcapade, that rising lust surging through your nerves burns twice as hard as before.
rows.translation: 即使已经经历过上一场性爱冒险，涌过神经、不断攀升的情欲仍比以前燃烧得猛烈一倍。
rows.raw: "\n\nEven after your previous sexcapade, that rising lust surging through your nerves burns twice as hard as before."

rows.translation: 茜用双掌扣住你的太阳穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane clasps your temples with her palms."

rows.original: The sheer strength of the current flowing into your body makes you want to scream. All the blood in your body seems to flood into your head, the deepest throbs turning into ungodly shivers down your spine.
rows.translation: 流入身体的电流强大到让你想要尖叫。全身血液仿佛都涌入头部，最深沉的悸动化作不似人间的震颤，沿脊柱向下冲去。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sheer strength of the current flowing into your body makes you want to scream. All the blood in your body seems to flood into your head, the deepest throbs turning into ungodly shivers down your spine."

rows.original: “S-say it! Say it” yells the quivering domme from above, her voice cutting through the sensory white noise.
rows.translation: “说、说出来！说出来”颤抖的女支配者从上方大喊，声音穿透感官白噪声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“S-say it! Say it” yells the quivering domme from above, her voice cutting through the sensory white noise."

rows.original: Her name...!
rows.translation: 她的名字...！
rows.raw: "\n\nHer name...!"

rows.original: “Ah...akane..!” you force out meekly, loud but incoherent.
rows.translation: “茜...茜..！”你温顺地勉强挤出声音，响亮却含混不清。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah...akane..!” you force out meekly, loud but incoherent."

rows.original: “Once more...!” she gasps, her slender body starting to quiver against you.
rows.translation: “再说一次...！”她喘息道，纤细身体开始在你身上颤抖。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Once more...!” she gasps, her slender body starting to quiver against you."

rows.original: “AKANE..!”

With that, her palms spring away from your head with a nasty czzrt of energy and the wailing domme slumps against you. On instinct, you wrap your arms around her as her jerking body succumbs to an orgasm. You take it upon you to whisper “I’m here” and “It’s ok” as Akane lies breathless on top of you.
rows.translation: 话音落下，她的双掌伴着能量发出的刺耳滋啦声弹离你的头，哀号的女支配者瘫倒在你身上。她抽动的身体屈服于高潮，你本能地用双臂将她环抱。茜气喘吁吁地趴在你身上时，你主动低声说着“我在这里”和“没事的”。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith that, her palms spring away from your head with a nasty czzrt of energy and the wailing domme slumps against you. On instinct, you wrap your arms around her as her jerking body succumbs to an orgasm. You take it upon you to whisper “I’m here” and “It’s ok” as Akane lies breathless on top of you."

rows.original:
With the two of you too tired to really do anything after this spiritual consummation, the thoughtless veil of sleep takes over. Your thoughts rest on what’s to come.
Here it starts: a new life. A life away from Steele Tech and all of those childish hopes and dreams...
rows.translation:
经过这场精神上的结合，你们都疲惫得无力再做任何事情，无思无虑的睡意薄幕随即将你笼罩。你的思绪停留在即将到来的未来。
一切从这里开始：崭新的生活。远离斯蒂尔科技，远离那些孩子气的希望与梦想...
rows.raw:
"

With the two of you too tired to really do anything after this spiritual consummation, the thoughtless veil of sleep takes over. Your thoughts rest on what’s to come.
Here it starts: a new life. A life away from Steele Tech and all of those childish hopes and dreams..."

rows.raw: "No one else can compare, you need her... and she wants you as much. All you gotta do is say it, baby. Point of No Return"

rows.original: She’s allowed you close, she’s shared how she values you and how much she wants you to thrive... but what does it all mean?
rows.translation: 她允许你靠近，与你分享她有多么珍视你，又多么希望你茁壮成长...但这一切究竟意味着什么？
rows.raw: "She’s allowed you close, she’s shared how she values you and how much she wants you to thrive... but what does it all mean?"

rows.translation: 枕边谈话
rows.raw: "Pillow Talk"

rows.original: Communicate, be healthy with your relationships. Might be a good time to uh, get to know her...
rows.translation: 沟通交流，保持健康关系。现在或许很适合，呃，了解她...
rows.raw: "Communicate, be healthy with your relationships. Might be a good time to uh, get to know her..."

rows.translation: 享受沉默
rows.raw: "Enjoy Silence"

rows.original: Having spent both of your energies, you and Akane simply gaze into each others eyes with mutually satisfied grins. With slow, tender movements, the breathy domme spends extra care in stroking and caressing your [pc.skinFurScales]. The smooth, warm fingertips delight your used and abused nerves to no end with gentle pulses of bio-energy.
rows.translation: 你们双方都耗尽了精力，只是带着彼此满足的笑容凝视对方双眼。气喘吁吁的女支配者以缓慢温柔的动作格外仔细地抚摸爱抚你的[pc.skinFurScales]。光滑温暖的指尖释放轻柔生物能量脉冲，令你遭受过度使用与虐待的神经享受不已。
rows.raw: "Having spent both of your energies, you and Akane simply gaze into each others eyes with mutually satisfied grins. With slow, tender movements, the breathy domme spends extra care in stroking and caressing your [pc.skinFurScales]. The smooth, warm fingertips delight your used and abused nerves to no end with gentle pulses of bio-energy."

rows.original: You lay for hours in the silence, completely at peace after the intense session. The afterglow wears off eventually, convincing Akane to wrap the two of you in the bed covers.
rows.translation: 激烈过程结束后，你们在寂静中躺了几个小时，内心完全平静。余韵最终消退，茜随即用被子将你们两人裹住。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lay for hours in the silence, completely at peace after the intense session. The afterglow wears off eventually, convincing Akane to wrap the two of you in the bed covers."

rows.original: You couldn’t be any more content in this moment.
rows.translation: 这一刻，你已经心满意足到了极点。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou couldn’t be any more content in this moment."

rows.original: Soon enough, you’re both feeling revitalized. Akane helps you up then helps you redress with what gear you have, fussing over the small details. You’re almost, almost tempted to say “thanks mom” or something to that effect but it didn’t seem... fitting.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你们都恢复了活力。茜扶你起身，又帮你重新穿好现有装备，仔细操心着各种小细节。你几乎，几乎忍不住要说“谢谢妈妈”之类的话，但那似乎...不太合适。
rows.raw: "\n\nSoon enough, you’re both feeling revitalized. Akane helps you up then helps you redress with what gear you have, fussing over the small details. You’re almost, almost tempted to say “thanks mom” or something to that effect but it didn’t seem... fitting."

rows.original: You give each a goodbye kiss, one interrupted by Cheo as he looms out of the shadows. Accepting that things have to move on, you follow him out of the room with a final view of Akane sprawled across the bed.
rows.translation: 你们以吻告别，却被从阴影中现身的切奥打断。你接受了事情必须继续的事实，跟着他走出房间，最后望了一眼四肢摊开躺在床上的茜。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give each a goodbye kiss, one interrupted by Cheo as he looms out of the shadows. Accepting that things have to move on, you follow him out of the room with a final view of Akane sprawled across the bed."

rows.original: Another attendant joins the two of you with a blindfold in his hands. Oh joy. With a sigh, you stand ready and close your eyes, the blindfold then comfortably tightening around your head. You get led back through the winding maze of doors, corridors and odd angles and then back out onto the Tavros merchants deck.
rows.translation: 另一名侍从手持眼罩加入你们。真是令人高兴。你叹了口气，做好准备，闭上双眼，随后眼罩舒适地收紧在头上。你被领着走回那片由门、走廊和奇怪拐角组成的蜿蜒迷宫，最后回到塔夫罗斯商人甲板。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother attendant joins the two of you with a blindfold in his hands. Oh joy. With a sigh, you stand ready and close your eyes, the blindfold then comfortably tightening around your head. You get led back through the winding maze of doors, corridors and odd angles and then back out onto the Tavros merchants deck."

rows.translation: 只凭本能享受彼此。
