rows.original: You spot a short male human in a very pristine suit standing behind an elaborate display of weapon models. While at first it seems to be a haphazard shop, it appears to merely be a stand for advertising wares: actual weapon selling would be a difficult thing to do on Tavros. There are two black-suited security guards milling around with unwavering, stern faces at odds with the salesman’s cheerful appearance.
rows.translation: 你看到一个矮小的人类男性穿着极其整洁的西装，站在一座精致武器模型展台后。起初那里看起来像间杂乱无章的商店，但似乎只是宣传商品的摊位：在塔夫罗斯实际贩卖武器会很困难。两名身穿黑色西装的安保人员在附近游走，坚定严厉的脸与推销员开朗的外表格格不入。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spot a short male human in a very pristine suit standing behind an elaborate display of weapon models. While at first it seems to be a haphazard shop, it appears to merely be a stand for advertising wares: actual weapon selling would be a difficult thing to do on Tavros. There are two black-suited security guards milling around with unwavering, stern faces at odds with the salesman’s cheerful appearance."

rows.raw: "madam"

rows.original: ? A brand such as ours works on reputation alone,” he replies, gesticulating in a rather delighted manner.
rows.translation: ？像我们这样的品牌完全依靠声誉经营，”他一边回答，一边兴高采烈地比划。
rows.raw: "? A brand such as ours works on reputation alone,” he replies, gesticulating in a rather delighted manner."

rows.original: “Host Shukuchi. They must need very advanced equipment for what they do, all that on-the-fly invisibility...” you say casually, palming a decommissioned display pistol. That namedrop should get his attention.
rows.translation: “缩地组织。他们做的事情一定需要非常先进的装备，比如那些随时开启的隐形能力...”你随口说道，手中摆弄着一把退役展示手枪。直接说出这个名字应该能引起他的注意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Host Shukuchi. They must need very advanced equipment for what they do, all that on-the-fly invisibility...” you say casually, palming a decommissioned display pistol. That namedrop should get his attention."

rows.original: <i>“Ahaaa, well in the interest of exclusivity, I do have... mock prototypes for consideration if the right clientele gain an interest, based on our previous clients specifications. May I say,
rows.translation: <i>“啊哈，嗯，为了维护专属性，我这里确实有一些...模拟原型可供考虑，它们根据我们以前客户的规格打造，前提是合适的客户产生兴趣。请容我说一句，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Ahaaa, well in the interest of exclusivity, I do have... mock prototypes for consideration if the right clientele gain an interest, based on our previous clients specifications. May I say, "

rows.original: sir
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "sir"

rows.original: madam
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "madam"

rows.original: , that you strike me as such a buyer! If you would... show me your loyalty card,” he continues, going from jovial to inquisitive.
rows.translation: ，您给我的感觉正是这样的买家！如果您愿意...请出示会员卡，”他继续说道，态度从愉快转为探究。
rows.raw: ", that you strike me as such a buyer! If you would... show me your loyalty card,” he continues, going from jovial to inquisitive."

rows.original: You tap away on your codex, a display screen showing the suspicious and seemingly useless card you received in the email. You show it to the rep, his hands still clasped together as if inspecting some sort of intriguing cake.
rows.translation: 你在智能终端上轻点几下，显示屏展示出邮件里收到的那张可疑而似乎毫无用处的卡片。你把它拿给代表看，他依旧双手交握，仿佛正在检查某种有趣的蛋糕。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tap away on your codex, a display screen showing the suspicious and seemingly useless card you received in the email. You show it to the rep, his hands still clasped together as if inspecting some sort of intriguing cake."

rows.original: <i>“Very good, very good,
rows.translation: <i>“非常好，非常好，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Very good, very good, "

rows.original: sir
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "sir"

rows.original: madam
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "madam"

rows.original: ! Our designers and researchers would love to have you on board, if you’d step this way,” says the rep, bowing slightly and lifting his arms to a large, brightly lit open door behind the display.
rows.translation: ！我们的设计师与研究员会非常欢迎您加入，请走这边，”代表说道，微微鞠躬，又抬起双臂，指向展台后那扇灯光明亮的敞开大门。
rows.raw: "! Our designers and researchers would love to have you on board, if you’d step this way,” says the rep, bowing slightly and lifting his arms to a large, brightly lit open door behind the display."

rows.original: You willingly walk over to this door with the smiling rep trailing behind, mindful of the artifice of this entire event. There hasn’t been another situation where you couldn’t win on your terms, you think: this Host Shukuchi is going to get a taste of Steele-branded justice!
rows.translation: 你自愿走向那扇门，微笑的代表跟在身后，同时提防着整场事件的虚假表象。你心想，以前从没遇到无法用自己的方式取胜的局面：这个缩地组织马上就要尝到斯蒂尔牌的正义！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou willingly walk over to this door with the smiling rep trailing behind, mindful of the artifice of this entire event. There hasn’t been another situation where you couldn’t win on your terms, you think: this Host Shukuchi is going to get a taste of Steele-branded justice! "

rows.original: Steele-branded and Steele-hard! So fucking hard, NNNGGGG.
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔牌，而且像斯蒂尔一样坚硬！硬得要命，嗯嗯嗯。
rows.raw: "Steele-branded and Steele-hard! So fucking hard, NNNGGGG. "

rows.original: You stare defiantly at your unnamed captor, having decided that this is the only solution for some reason: you would rather die than give her what she wants.
rows.translation: 你挑衅地瞪着没有透露姓名的俘虏者，因为某种原因认定这是唯一方案：你宁愿死，也不愿给她想要的东西。
rows.raw: "You stare defiantly at your unnamed captor, having decided that this is the only solution for some reason: you would rather die than give her what she wants."

rows.original: “And you’re quite serious, are you?” she asks, her brow furrowing as she tries to fathom whatever reasons you have for wanting this.
rows.translation: “你是认真的，对吗？”她问道，试图理解你渴望这种结果的理由，眉头皱了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And you’re quite serious, are you?” she asks, her brow furrowing as she tries to fathom whatever reasons you have for wanting this."

rows.original: You nod of course, having already made up your mind. 100%, this is exactly what you want. Yep.
rows.translation: 你当然点头，毕竟早已下定决心。百分之百，这正是你想要的。没错。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod of course, having already made up your mind. 100%, this is exactly what you want. Yep."

rows.original: No regrets.
rows.translation: 绝不后悔。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo regrets."

rows.original: “Fine. Cheo? Clean shot,” she commands, a rough hand gripping you by the back of the head.
rows.translation: “好吧。切奥？一枪干净利落，”她命令道，一只粗糙的手从后脑抓住你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine. Cheo? Clean shot,” she commands, a rough hand gripping you by the back of the head."

rows.original: With clenched teeth, you bear it all as the whine of a laser powering up clouds your ears.
rows.translation: 激光充能的尖啸遮蔽双耳，你咬紧牙关承受一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith clenched teeth, you bear it all as the whine of a laser powering up clouds your ears."

rows.original: You regret everything.
rows.translation: 你后悔了一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou regret everything."

rows.original: PHHHHIIIIII-
rows.raw: "\n\nPHHHHIIIIII-"

rows.original: (Bad end!)
rows.translation: （坏结局！）
rows.raw: "(Bad end!)"

rows.original: You’ve no interest in either of the other choices, preferring to get this over with as quickly as possible and to be done with it all. Although, now stripped of your codex, you’re not sure how you can do all this...
rows.translation: 你对另外两个选择都没有兴趣，只想尽快结束并彻底摆脱这一切。然而，智能终端如今已经被夺走，你不知道该如何完成这些事...
rows.raw: "You’ve no interest in either of the other choices, preferring to get this over with as quickly as possible and to be done with it all. Although, now stripped of your codex, you’re not sure how you can do all this..."

rows.original: You begin conveying this to the head honcho but she raises a hand to interrupt you.
rows.translation: 你开始向头目解释，但她抬手打断了你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou begin conveying this to the head honcho but she raises a hand to interrupt you."

rows.original: “Hold on, hold on. Cheo, bring [pc.hisHer] things, I’m sure we don’t need to waste words,” she says lazily.
rows.translation: “等等，等等。切奥，把[pc.hisHer]的东西拿来，我相信我们不必浪费口舌，”她懒洋洋地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hold on, hold on. Cheo, bring [pc.hisHer] things, I’m sure we don’t need to waste words,” she says lazily."

rows.original: One of the agents brushes against you, masked with black armor like all the others. You spot a tail of three-color fur: black, white and toffee brown... wait.
rows.translation: 一名特工从你身旁擦过，与其他人一样戴着面具，穿着黑色护甲。你发现一条生着三色毛发的尾巴：黑色、白色与太妃糖棕...等等。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the agents brushes against you, masked with black armor like all the others. You spot a tail of three-color fur: black, white and toffee brown... wait."

rows.original: Hopefully he doesn’t hold a grudge.
rows.translation: 希望他不会记仇。
rows.raw: "\n\nHopefully he doesn’t hold a grudge."

rows.original: You watch him disappear around some sort of sliding screen, his movements barely making a sound as he does. You jiggle around in place as the cool air starts becoming cold, the rope bindings feeling coarse against your [pc.skinFurScales].
rows.translation: 你看着他消失在某种滑动屏风后，动作几乎没有发出声响。清凉空气开始变冷，你原地扭动，绳索粗糙地摩擦着[pc.skinFurScales]。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou watch him disappear around some sort of sliding screen, his movements barely making a sound as he does. You jiggle around in place as the cool air starts becoming cold, the rope bindings feeling coarse against your [pc.skinFurScales]."

rows.original: “Ohhh of course. Yan, help [pc.himHer] out,” says the queen bee, flicking her mechanical fingers in your general direction.
rows.translation: “噢噢，当然。严，帮[pc.himHer]解开，”女王蜂说道，将机械手指朝你大致所在的方向轻弹。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohhh of course. Yan, help [pc.himHer] out,” says the queen bee, flicking her mechanical fingers in your general direction."

rows.original: You wince as the rope goes slack around you and the ache of the awkward pose recedes into a tingling burn in your muscles.
rows.translation: 周围的绳索松弛下来，别扭姿势造成的酸痛化为肌肉中灼热的酥麻，让你畏缩了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wince as the rope goes slack around you and the ache of the awkward pose recedes into a tingling burn in your muscles."

rows.original: As you shed the rope, you try standing up fully, a little bit on the wobbly side from your ‘time out’ in dreamland.
rows.translation: 你褪去绳索，试着完全站起；在梦乡里‘休息’过后，身体还有些摇晃不稳。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you shed the rope, you try standing up fully, a little bit on the wobbly side from your ‘time out’ in dreamland."

rows.original: “Hmhm...” murmurs the crime boss, a full view of your everything now on display. Her black irises scour your nude form, the mere act is an invasion against your already exposed body. You’re unfazed...
rows.translation: “嗯哼...”犯罪首领喃喃说道，如今你的一切都完全展露在她面前。漆黑虹膜扫遍赤裸身体，单是这个动作便侵犯了本就毫无遮掩的你。你毫不动摇...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmhm...” murmurs the crime boss, a full view of your everything now on display. Her black irises scour your nude form, the mere act is an invasion against your already exposed body. You’re unfazed... "

rows.original: on the outside.
rows.translation: 至少表面如此。
rows.raw: "on the outside."

rows.original: a weaker mind would recoil under that glare.
rows.translation: 意志更薄弱的人会在那道目光下畏缩。
rows.raw: "a weaker mind would recoil under that glare."

rows.original: The one called Cheo comes back in short order, a bundle of your gear in his arms. Your codex sits on top, looking more vulnerable than even you. The mob boss beckons over Cheo, scooping up the codex with a swivel of her wrist.
rows.translation: 那个名叫切奥的人很快回来，怀里抱着你的一捆装备。智能终端放在最上方，看起来甚至比你还要脆弱。黑帮首领招手叫切奥过来，转动手腕，将智能终端一把捞起。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe one called Cheo comes back in short order, a bundle of your gear in his arms. Your codex sits on top, looking more vulnerable than even you. The mob boss beckons over Cheo, scooping up the codex with a swivel of her wrist."

rows.original: “Mm, haven’t seen one of these in a while,” mumbles the fascinated femme, fingertips gliding across the surface of your device. Cheo holds your belongings in a haphazard lump. The jolting image of his blank mask lingers as you pick up and put back together all the things that were taken from you.
rows.translation: “嗯，我已经有段时间没见过这种东西了，”着迷的女人喃喃说道，指尖滑过你的设备表面。切奥杂乱地抱着你的物品。你捡起并重新整理所有被夺走的东西时，他那张空白面具造成的惊人印象依然挥之不去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mm, haven’t seen one of these in a while,” mumbles the fascinated femme, fingertips gliding across the surface of your device. Cheo holds your belongings in a haphazard lump. The jolting image of his blank mask lingers as you pick up and put back together all the things that were taken from you. "

rows.original: You’re no stranger to having your clothes off but given the relative hostility, you turn yourself around to get changed into your [pc.gear] instead of continuing to bare all.
rows.translation: 你对脱掉衣服并不陌生，但考虑到相对敌意的氛围，你转过身去穿回[pc.gear]，没有继续赤裸展示。
rows.raw: "You’re no stranger to having your clothes off but given the relative hostility, you turn yourself around to get changed into your [pc.gear] instead of continuing to bare all. "

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: KALAS.TAVROS.TAVROS HANGAR
rows.raw: "KALAS.TAVROS.TAVROS HANGAR"

rows.original: You jerk awake, finding yourself atop some generic crates and storage boxes. Right outside your ship...
rows.translation: 你猛然惊醒，发现自己正躺在一些普通板条箱与储物箱上。就在飞船外面...
rows.raw: "You jerk awake, finding yourself atop some generic crates and storage boxes. Right outside your ship..."

rows.original: ...How’d they even know where it was?
rows.translation: ...他们到底怎么知道飞船在哪里？
rows.raw: "\n\n...How’d they even know where it was?"

rows.original: Whatever, at least you’ve got everything. Mostly everything...
rows.translation: 随便吧，至少所有东西都还在。基本上都在...
rows.raw: "\n\nWhatever, at least you’ve got everything. Mostly everything..."

rows.original: With those cash stores a little bit lighter and whatever lessons learned firmly buried under a layer of despondence, you set your sights on furthering your adventures.
rows.translation: 现金储备稍微缩水，不管学到什么教训，都已被牢牢埋在一层沮丧之下；你将目光投向继续冒险。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith those cash stores a little bit lighter and whatever lessons learned firmly buried under a layer of despondence, you set your sights on furthering your adventures."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: “Quite a shoestring you live by, hm? Tech like this in the hands of someone so underfunded... not my place to judge,”
rows.translation: “你的日子过得真拮据，不是吗？这种技术竟掌握在资金如此不足的人手中...轮不到我评判，”
rows.raw: "“Quite a shoestring you live by, hm? Tech like this in the hands of someone so underfunded... not my place to judge,”"

rows.original: “Thank you for the donation, I’m sure that our most modest organization can put it to good use,”
rows.translation: “感谢你的捐款，我相信我们无比寒酸的组织能好好利用它，”
rows.raw: "“Thank you for the donation, I’m sure that our most modest organization can put it to good use,”"

rows.original: “My word, what a lovely donation. I can almost feel the goodwill leaping off of you,”
rows.translation: “天哪，多么可爱的捐款。我几乎能感觉到善意正从你身上跳出来，”
rows.raw: "“My word, what a lovely donation. I can almost feel the goodwill leaping off of you,”"

rows.original: “And now that I feel completely justified in accepting this sizable donation, it seems perfectly fine to let you go,”
rows.translation: “既然我现在觉得接受这笔巨额捐款完全正当，放你离开似乎也没有问题了，”
rows.raw: "“And now that I feel completely justified in accepting this sizable donation, it seems perfectly fine to let you go,”"

rows.original: she says plainly, tossing the device back to you.
rows.translation: 她平淡地说道，将设备扔回给你。
rows.raw: " she says plainly, tossing the device back to you."

rows.original: You clutch at it with shaky hands and after a frantic check, something sinks in your chest as you read your credit balance: all that hard-earned money...
rows.translation: 你用颤抖的双手紧握设备，慌忙检查后，读到信用点余额时，胸口有什么东西沉了下去：那些辛苦赚来的钱...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou clutch at it with shaky hands and after a frantic check, something sinks in your chest as you read your credit balance: all that hard-earned money..."

rows.original: “And now that’s out of the way, I’ll also add that... we’ll never cross paths again, I assure you. Goodbye now,” waves the mob boss, her eyes drifting off into some other direction.
rows.translation: “既然这件事已经解决，我还要补充一句...我保证，我们再也不会碰面。现在再见了，”黑帮首领挥手说道，目光飘向其他方向。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And now that’s out of the way, I’ll also add that... we’ll never cross paths again, I assure you. Goodbye now,” waves the mob boss, her eyes drifting off into some other direction."

rows.original: Bye? How do do you get back to the ship? How wi-
rows.translation: 再见？你要怎么回到飞船？该怎-
rows.raw: "\n\nBye? How do do you get back to the ship? How wi-"

rows.original: BNNKK
rows.raw: "\n\nBNNKK"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You’re all for secrecy and everything but getting knocked out each time is a bit much.
rows.translation: 你完全理解保密之类的事情，但每次都被打晕实在有些过分。
rows.raw: "You’re all for secrecy and everything but getting knocked out each time is a bit much."

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: The white light of the throne room stings your eyes again as you enter, making you wince a little. You trail a few steps behind Akane who proceeds to take her place on the chair, knees just a little bit closer together this time...
rows.translation: 你进入王座室时，白光再次刺痛双眼，令你微微畏缩。你落后茜几步；她走回椅子坐下，这一次双膝稍微靠得更近了...
rows.raw: "The white light of the throne room stings your eyes again as you enter, making you wince a little. You trail a few steps behind Akane who proceeds to take her place on the chair, knees just a little bit closer together this time..."

rows.original: You stop [pc.walking] when you spot her two adjutants approaching you, one with a bundle of... oh, right. The one carrying your gear appears to be the ausar from before, that tri-color fur tone giving it away. ‘Cheo’ wasn’t it...?
rows.translation: 你看到她的两名副官走近，于是停下[pc.walking]；其中一人抱着一捆...噢，对。拿着装备的似乎就是之前那个奥萨尔，三色毛发暴露了身份。是叫‘切奥’吧...？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stop [pc.walking] when you spot her two adjutants approaching you, one with a bundle of... oh, right. The one carrying your gear appears to be the ausar from before, that tri-color fur tone giving it away. ‘Cheo’ wasn’t it...?"

rows.original: With your naked body on full display, you give your [pc.chest] a
rows.translation: 赤裸身体一览无余，你让[pc.chest]
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your naked body on full display, you give your [pc.chest] a "

rows.original: rub and a flex so that he gets the point
rows.translation: 一边摩擦一边绷紧，好让他明白你的意思
rows.raw: "rub and a flex so that he gets the point"

rows.original: tempting fondle towards him and a little bit of tarty lip biting to top it off
rows.translation: 朝他诱人地揉弄，还咬了咬嘴唇，摆出十足的放荡姿态
rows.raw: "tempting fondle towards him and a little bit of tarty lip biting to top it off"

rows.original: . Just a little something for him to remember
rows.translation: 。只是给他留下一点纪念，让他记得
rows.raw: ". Just a little something for him to remember "

rows.original: who he lost to
rows.translation: 自己输给了谁
rows.raw: "who he lost to"

rows.original: what he missed out on when he beat you
rows.translation: 打败你时错过了什么
rows.raw: "what he missed out on when he beat you"

rows.original: ! Cheo pauses for a second and then merely sniffs, shrugging your display away...
rows.translation: ！切奥停顿了一秒，随后只是哼了一声，用耸肩无视你的展示...
rows.raw: "! Cheo pauses for a second and then merely sniffs, shrugging your display away..."

rows.original: With your nakedness on display to the large room, with who knows how many operatives present under their cloaks, you feel the urge to cover yourself with your hands.
rows.translation: 你赤裸站在宽阔房间里，不知道有多少特工正藏在斗篷下，让你产生用手遮住身体的冲动。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your nakedness on display to the large room, with who knows how many operatives present under their cloaks, you feel the urge to cover yourself with your hands."

rows.original: It’s a little bit difficult with the [pc.groin] that you have... but
rows.translation: 考虑到你的[pc.groin]，这么做有点困难...不过
rows.raw: " It’s a little bit difficult with the [pc.groin] that you have... but"

rows.original: Cheo continues unfazed, his arms stretching out to present you with your things.
rows.translation: 切奥依旧不为所动，伸出双臂将东西递给你。
rows.raw: " Cheo continues unfazed, his arms stretching out to present you with your things."

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: It couldn’t have been more than a few minutes but the strange and unknowable route you’re guided through seems to go on for miles.
rows.translation: 这一切不可能超过几分钟，但你被领着走过的诡异莫测路线似乎延伸了数英里。
rows.raw: "It couldn’t have been more than a few minutes but the strange and unknowable route you’re guided through seems to go on for miles."

rows.original: All of a sudden, as one final door opens with a schwiii sound, you’re pushed through into a loud, crowded area. You quickly remove the blindfold, twisting around to see where you came from, where those operatives... went...
rows.translation: 突然间，最后一扇门伴着咻——声打开，你被推入嘈杂拥挤的区域。你迅速摘下眼罩，转身寻找来时的方向，以及那些特工...去哪里了...
rows.raw: "\n\nAll of a sudden, as one final door opens with a schwiii sound, you’re pushed through into a loud, crowded area. You quickly remove the blindfold, twisting around to see where you came from, where those operatives... went..."

rows.original: Huh. The wall behind is just a wall. There’s nothing to the sides... where did they go? Where did you come from?
rows.translation: 嗯。身后只是一面墙。两侧什么都没有...他们去了哪里？你又是从哪里出来的？
rows.raw: "\n\nHuh. The wall behind is just a wall. There’s nothing to the sides... where did they go? Where did you come from?"

rows.original: With Akane’s open invitation in the back of your mind, you shake your head, clear out the questions and get back to your business.
rows.translation: 脑中仍记着茜的公开邀请，你摇摇头，清空疑问，重新处理自己的事情。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith Akane’s open invitation in the back of your mind, you shake your head, clear out the questions and get back to your business."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: He cautiously offers you your [pc.gear], eyeing you as you holster your [pc.weapon].
rows.translation: 他谨慎地递上[pc.gear]，看着你收起[pc.weapon]。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe cautiously offers you your [pc.gear], eyeing you as you holster your [pc.weapon]."

rows.original: “No funny business,” he growls through his mask, arms folded. You turn yourself away from the blank mask, proceeding to get dressed
rows.translation: “别耍花样，”他抱着双臂，在面具后低吼。你背对空白面具，开始穿衣，
rows.raw: "\n\n“No funny business,” he growls through his mask, arms folded. You turn yourself away from the blank mask, proceeding to get dressed "

rows.original: with the intent of putting on a show.
rows.translation: 打算好好表演一番。
rows.raw: "with the intent of putting on a show."

rows.original: quickly to avoid being out in the open.
rows.translation: 迅速穿好，避免继续暴露在外。
rows.raw: "quickly to avoid being out in the open."

rows.original: Once finished, Cheo and the other operative turn in unison and promptly take their places by Akane’s side. The queen bee beckons you to stand before the throne, wordlessly gesturing to the spot. Hiding a sneer, you take up the spot with folded arms.
rows.translation: 完成后，切奥与另一名特工一同转身，迅速回到茜身旁的位置。女王蜂招手示意你站到王座前，无声指向那个位置。你藏起冷笑，抱着双臂站了过去。
rows.raw:
"

Once finished, Cheo and the other operative turn in unison and promptly take their places by Akane’s side. The queen bee beckons you to stand before the throne, wordlessly gesturing to the spot. Hiding a sneer, you take up the spot with folded arms.

"

rows.original: This whole thing has to be some kind of [pc.race] rights violation.
rows.translation: 整件事肯定以某种方式侵犯了[pc.race]权利。
rows.raw: "This whole thing has to be some kind of [pc.race] rights violation."

rows.original: Didn’t even get you off, the bitch...
rows.translation: 那个婊子甚至没让你高潮...
rows.raw: "Didn’t even get you off, the bitch..."

rows.original: All you need is one more excuse to take her down.
rows.translation: 你只需要再找一个借口就能扳倒她。
rows.raw: "All you need is one more excuse to take her down."

rows.original: “Mmmmm and now business resumes,” begins Akane, getting comfortable in her seat.
rows.translation: “嗯——，现在继续谈正事，”茜开始说道，在座位上找了个舒适姿势。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmmm and now business resumes,” begins Akane, getting comfortable in her seat."

rows.original: <i>“Perhaps, as an... honored guest of our establishment,
rows.translation: <i>“或许，作为本机构...尊贵的客人，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Perhaps, as an... honored guest of our establishment, "

rows.original: Mister
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔先生
rows.raw: "Mister"

rows.original: Miss
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔小姐
rows.raw: "Miss"

rows.original: Steele would consider a deal?”
rows.translation: 愿意考虑一笔交易？”
rows.raw: " Steele would consider a deal?”"

rows.original: “Do I even have a choice?” you say back in a low tone.
rows.translation: “我真的有选择吗？”你低声回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do I even have a choice?” you say back in a low tone."

rows.original: “Well said,” she grins, tapping her fingertips against both armrests in arpeggiated patterns. “Did we um... did we ever find the relevant information, Cheo?”
rows.translation: “说得好，”她咧嘴笑道，指尖以琶音般的节奏轻敲两个扶手。“我们有没有，呃...我们到底找到相关资料了吗，切奥？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well said,” she grins, tapping her fingertips against both armrests in arpeggiated patterns. “Did we um... did we ever find the relevant information, Cheo?”"

rows.original: Cheo nods and produces a small datapad from his pocket, holding it in front of the mob boss. She lazily trails her fingers along its surface, talking out loud as she goes.
rows.translation: 切奥点点头，从口袋里拿出一块小型数据板，举到黑帮首领面前。她懒洋洋地用手指划过表面，同时大声念出内容。
rows.raw: "\n\nCheo nods and produces a small datapad from his pocket, holding it in front of the mob boss. She lazily trails her fingers along its surface, talking out loud as she goes."

rows.original: “Let’s see, Steele, Steele... Steele Tech, Victor, Maximilian, dead, blah blah, heir or heiress... oh,” she says at first, abruptly stopping and squinting when some detail catches her eye. “So young, [pc.name]. Oh my, I had no idea...” she exclaims, her grin gaining a devilish hint as she stares you down.
rows.translation: “让我看看，斯蒂尔，斯蒂尔...斯蒂尔科技，维克托，马克西米利安，已死，废话废话，继承人...噢，”她起初这样念道，某个细节引起注意后突然停下并眯起眼睛。“真年轻，[pc.name]。天哪，我完全不知道...”她惊叹道，盯着你看时，笑容多了一丝邪恶。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s see, Steele, Steele... Steele Tech, Victor, Maximilian, dead, blah blah, heir or heiress... oh,” she says at first, abruptly stopping and squinting when some detail catches her eye. “So young, [pc.name]. Oh my, I had no idea...” she exclaims, her grin gaining a devilish hint as she stares you down."

rows.original: You turn your head away, both to avoid her predatory stare and to hide the mild blush you feel welling in your cheeks. It’s not like she’s your mother, she can’t just... say that kind of thing... Akane simply laughs, holding her palm up to cover her mouth.
rows.translation: 你转过头，一方面避开她捕食者般的凝视，另一方面隐藏双颊涌起的淡淡红晕。她又不是你妈妈，不能随便...说这种话...茜只是笑着抬起手掌遮住嘴巴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn your head away, both to avoid her predatory stare and to hide the mild blush you feel welling in your cheeks. It’s not like she’s your mother, she can’t just... say that kind of thing... Akane simply laughs, holding her palm up to cover her mouth."

rows.original: “Look at you, all grown up and playing spacer. How about that, how about that indeed...” she says to you, her grin turning into a smile. She cocks her head to the left as if to examine you once more.
rows.translation: “看看你，都长大成人，开始扮演太空旅人了。真有意思，确实有意思...”她对你说道，咧开的笑容变得柔和。她将头向左歪去，仿佛要再检查你一次。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look at you, all grown up and playing spacer. How about that, how about that indeed...” she says to you, her grin turning into a smile. She cocks her head to the left as if to examine you once more."

rows.original: “As to the deal: consider it as something as informal as it could be. An open invitation, that’s all. An invitation for my audience in a very... intimate setting,” says Akane, tapping a knee with her fingers. “If you’ve a need for... pain, love, joy, or maybe to brighten a bored old woman’s day, just say so at our representative’s stall. You know the one. No knockouts this time, I promise.”
rows.translation: “至于交易：你可以把它当作尽可能非正式的东西。只是一份公开邀请，仅此而已。邀请你在非常...亲密的环境中接受我的接见，”茜一边说，一边用手指轻敲膝盖。“如果你需要...痛苦、爱、快乐，或许只是想照亮某个无聊老妇人的一天，只管到我们代表的摊位说一声。你知道是哪个。这次不会打晕你，我保证。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As to the deal: consider it as something as informal as it could be. An open invitation, that’s all. An invitation for my audience in a very... intimate setting,” says Akane, tapping a knee with her fingers. “If you’ve a need for... pain, love, joy, or maybe to brighten a bored old woman’s day, just say so at our representative’s stall. You know the one. No knockouts this time, I promise.”"

rows.original: Uh... hmm. Well, you’ve no reason to commit to anything, so you simply nod and consider what she means.
rows.translation: 呃...嗯。反正你没有理由承诺任何事情，于是只是点头，思考她话里的意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nUh... hmm. Well, you’ve no reason to commit to anything, so you simply nod and consider what she means."

rows.original: Wait, you spent who knows how long on finding this place, putting yourself in harms way at several points... only to have a mob boss solicit you? The galaxy these days.
rows.translation: 等等，你花了不知道多久寻找这个地方，好几次让自己身陷危险...结果只是被黑帮首领招揽上床？如今的银河还真奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nWait, you spent who knows how long on finding this place, putting yourself in harms way at several points... only to have a mob boss solicit you? The galaxy these days."

rows.original: “Yan, show [pc.himHer] out, if you please,” directs Akane, that bored tone of hers taking over once again as she turns her attention back to the dataslate.
rows.translation: “严，劳驾，送[pc.himHer]出去，”茜指示道，重新将注意力转回数据板时，那股无聊语气又一次占据了她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yan, show [pc.himHer] out, if you please,” directs Akane, that bored tone of hers taking over once again as she turns her attention back to the dataslate."

rows.original: The male agent to her right steps forward to your direction, reaching for something from a pocket. A weapon...? Oh wait. He produces a thin piece of black fabric: a blindfold.
rows.translation: 她右侧的男性特工朝你走来，从口袋中掏出某样东西。武器...？噢，等等。他拿出一片薄薄的黑色布料：眼罩。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe male agent to her right steps forward to your direction, reaching for something from a pocket. A weapon...? Oh wait. He produces a thin piece of black fabric: a blindfold."

rows.original: “Sorry, company policy,” he shrugs with a digitized voice, taking a spot behind you. Sighing, you straighten up as he reaches around and ties the blindfold over your eyes. You feel another set of hands guide you by the shoulder to somewhere else, the sounds of several kinds of doors opening as you’re moved along.
rows.translation: “抱歉，公司规定，”他用数字化声音说道，耸耸肩，随后站到你身后。你叹了口气，挺直身体，任由他从身后伸手，将眼罩系在眼前。你感觉另一双手扶着肩膀，将自己引向别处；前进期间，耳边传来好几种门开启的声音。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, company policy,” he shrugs with a digitized voice, taking a spot behind you. Sighing, you straighten up as he reaches around and ties the blindfold over your eyes. You feel another set of hands guide you by the shoulder to somewhere else, the sounds of several kinds of doors opening as you’re moved along."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The bright, chilled atmosphere of the throne room seems to turn to night as you go through the doorway, the hearty push from the agents is just enough to throw you off balance. With your arms still bound, you’ve nothing to grip on to!
rows.translation: 穿过门口时，王座室明亮冰冷的氛围仿佛转为黑夜，特工充满力道的一推恰好使你失去平衡。双臂仍被绑着，根本没有东西可抓！
rows.raw: "The bright, chilled atmosphere of the throne room seems to turn to night as you go through the doorway, the hearty push from the agents is just enough to throw you off balance. With your arms still bound, you’ve nothing to grip on to!"

rows.original: You stumble to the ground, your [pc.knees] stopping you from falling onto your [pc.face]. The light from the throne room casts your shadow across the darkwood floor, showing a kneeling, buckled silhouette of the real you.
rows.translation: 你踉跄倒地，[pc.knees]阻止你让[pc.face]撞向地面。王座室的灯光将影子投在深色木地板上，勾勒出真正的你跪地弯折的轮廓。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stumble to the ground, your [pc.knees] stopping you from falling onto your [pc.face]. The light from the throne room casts your shadow across the darkwood floor, showing a kneeling, buckled silhouette of the real you."

rows.original: The door slides to a sudden close, cutting off the light.
rows.translation: 门突然滑动关闭，切断了光线。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe door slides to a sudden close, cutting off the light."

rows.original: Your eyes scan the room around you.
rows.translation: 你的双眼扫视周围房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes scan the room around you."

rows.original: There’s an outline of a bed of sorts, a wall of what seems to be...weapons and weapon shafts, hooks lining the walls and ceiling. All this bathed in the pale blue light of a dimmed LED floor-lamp. The lamp swells before reaching its full intensity, the brightness not quite enough to deter you from looking away. It reveals things in slightly more detail but the room is still dark and eerie enough to put you on edge.
rows.translation: 那里有一张某种床的轮廓，一面墙上似乎挂着...武器和武器长柄，墙壁与天花板排列着挂钩。这一切都沐浴在调暗的LED落地灯所散发的苍白蓝光中。灯光逐渐增强至全部亮度，却仍没有亮到迫使你移开目光。它让各种东西稍微清晰了一些，可房间依旧阴暗诡异，足以令你紧张不安。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s an outline of a bed of sorts, a wall of what seems to be...weapons and weapon shafts, hooks lining the walls and ceiling. All this bathed in the pale blue light of a dimmed LED floor-lamp. The lamp swells before reaching its full intensity, the brightness not quite enough to deter you from looking away. It reveals things in slightly more detail but the room is still dark and eerie enough to put you on edge."

rows.original: What’s going to happen...?
rows.translation: 接下来会发生什么...？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat’s going to happen...?"

rows.original: Thinking about it, why rope of all things for restraints? You try to tug and pull at the bindings from behind, only running into the same problem from before: you’re far too restricted to do much aside from awkwardly [pc.walk] where you’re lead.
rows.translation: 仔细想想，为什么所有束缚物里偏偏选择绳索？你试着拉扯身后的绳结，却再次遇到之前的问题：身体受到太多限制，除了别扭地[pc.walk]向别人引导的方向，几乎什么也做不了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThinking about it, why rope of all things for restraints? You try to tug and pull at the bindings from behind, only running into the same problem from before: you’re far too restricted to do much aside from awkwardly [pc.walk] where you’re lead."

rows.original: Even with your tauric frame, your [pc.legs] are the only source of free movement.
rows.translation: 即使你有四足身体，[pc.legs]仍是唯一能够自由活动的部位。
rows.raw: " Even with your tauric frame, your [pc.legs] are the only source of free movement."

rows.original: As you glance over the hooks in the ground once more, a thought hits you: this has to be some sort of play dungeon.
rows.translation: 再次扫视地面的挂钩时，一个念头击中了你：这里肯定是某种调教地牢。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you glance over the hooks in the ground once more, a thought hits you: this has to be some sort of play dungeon."

rows.original: And you just agreed to be the toy.
rows.translation: 而你刚刚同意充当玩具。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd you just agreed to be the toy."

rows.original: Steeling
rows.translation: 你坚定
rows.raw: "\n\nSteeling "

rows.original: (lololololololololololol)
rows.translation: （哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈）
rows.raw: "(lololololololololololol) "

rows.original: yourself against the thought, you gingerly push yourself up with your [pc.feet] to full height, figuring that if you’re going to be used, the least you can do is make it a challenge.
rows.translation: 心神，抵抗这个念头，小心翼翼地用[pc.feet]撑起身体，站到最大高度。你觉得既然要被人使用，至少应该给对方制造点挑战。
rows.raw: "yourself against the thought, you gingerly push yourself up with your [pc.feet] to full height, figuring that if you’re going to be used, the least you can do is make it a challenge."

rows.original: You jerk around as the door slides open again, the white light stinging your eyes again. The slender, ultra-femme shadow of the mob boss hangs in the doorway.
rows.translation: 门再次滑开，白光再度刺痛双眼，你猛然转身。黑帮首领纤细而极具女性气质的影子停在门口。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou jerk around as the door slides open again, the white light stinging your eyes again. The slender, ultra-femme shadow of the mob boss hangs in the doorway."

rows.original: “What a feast for the eyes,” exclaims the shadowed figure as she prowls forward, the sliding door closing and floor lamp brightening in tandem. She walks with her fingers tapping her chin, the other robo-hand held behind her back.
rows.translation: “真是一场视觉盛宴，”阴影中的身影惊叹道，一边悄然走近；滑门关闭，落地灯同步变亮。她一只手的手指轻敲下巴，另一只机械手则藏在背后。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What a feast for the eyes,” exclaims the shadowed figure as she prowls forward, the sliding door closing and floor lamp brightening in tandem. She walks with her fingers tapping her chin, the other robo-hand held behind her back."

rows.original: You briefly consider retaliating with sarcasm, given her disturbingly playful approach to things. Right now though, you’re focused on what she might have planned for you. You keep your thoughts to yourself, [pc.eyes] focused on her as she slinks around and inspects her prize from a distance.
rows.translation: 她以令人不安的玩闹态度处理事情，让你短暂考虑用讽刺还击。不过此刻，你专注于她可能为你准备的计划。你把想法藏在心中，用[pc.eyes]锁定她，看着她悄然绕行，从远处检查自己的战利品。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou briefly consider retaliating with sarcasm, given her disturbingly playful approach to things. Right now though, you’re focused on what she might have planned for you. You keep your thoughts to yourself, [pc.eyes] focused on her as she slinks around and inspects her prize from a distance."

rows.original: “Name?” she asks, her left pinky finger tugging at her lower lip.
rows.translation: “名字？”她问道，左手小指拉扯着下唇。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Name?” she asks, her left pinky finger tugging at her lower lip."

rows.original: It’s only a name, after all.
rows.translation: 毕竟，这只是一个名字。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s only a name, after all."

rows.original: “[pc.name]. [pc.name] Steele,” you say slowly while keeping your head up, watching as the pinky finger sinks slowly into her mouth. Out of the corner of your eye, you notice her right knee rub against the other.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]。[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”你抬着头缓缓说道，看着她的小指慢慢探入口中。你从眼角注意到，她的右膝正摩擦另一边膝盖。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]. [pc.name] Steele,” you say slowly while keeping your head up, watching as the pinky finger sinks slowly into her mouth. Out of the corner of your eye, you notice her right knee rub against the other."

rows.original: Well jeez, if it’s that easy to get you aroused, lady, you can say more names if you want... like Grzegorz Brzęczyszczykiewicz.
rows.translation: 天哪，女士，如果这么容易就能让你兴奋，你想听的话，我还可以多说几个名字...比如格热戈日·布任琴什奇凯维奇。
rows.raw: " Well jeez, if it’s that easy to get you aroused, lady, you can say more names if you want... like Grzegorz Brzęczyszczykiewicz."

rows.original: She removes her finger from her mouth.
rows.translation: 她将手指从嘴里抽出。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe removes her finger from her mouth."

rows.original: “[pc.name]. I see... I wonder if I’ll remember it in the morning,” she sighs, bridging the distance between you while glancing over her own hands and fingers. You puff out your chest as she does so, instincts telling you to brace yourself.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]。我明白了...不知道明早还能不能记住，”她叹息道，一边扫视自己的双手与手指，一边缩短你们之间的距离。她这么做时，你挺起胸膛，本能告诉自己必须做好准备。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]. I see... I wonder if I’ll remember it in the morning,” she sighs, bridging the distance between you while glancing over her own hands and fingers. You puff out your chest as she does so, instincts telling you to brace yourself."

rows.original: You see her smirk at the inadvertent thrust of your [pc.chest] and [pc.nipples] towards her, your nose flaring as she reacts.
rows.translation: 她看到你不由自主地将[pc.chest]与[pc.nipples]朝她挺去，于是露出坏笑；她作出反应时，你的鼻孔随之张开。
rows.raw: " You see her smirk at the inadvertent thrust of your [pc.chest] and [pc.nipples] towards her, your nose flaring as she reacts."

rows.original: “Oh don’t be like that, [pc.name],” she coos, her hand darting for your shoulder!
rows.translation: “噢，别这样嘛，[pc.name]，”她柔声哄道，手掌猛然伸向你的肩膀！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh don’t be like that, [pc.name],” she coos, her hand darting for your shoulder!"

rows.original: You inhale sharply and tense up in response, expecting a harsh grab or grapple. Instead, she begins... stroking it, the smooth tips of her metallic fingers soothing the [pc.skin] on top and massaging the muscle underneath. It still takes a few seconds for you to relax, your heart rate jumping up just ever so slightly.
rows.translation: 你猛吸一口气，绷紧身体回应，预料会迎来粗暴的抓握或擒拿。可她反而开始...抚摸肩膀，光滑金属指尖舒缓上方的[pc.skin]，按摩下方肌肉。你仍花了几秒才放松下来，心率极其轻微地有所升高。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou inhale sharply and tense up in response, expecting a harsh grab or grapple. Instead, she begins... stroking it, the smooth tips of her metallic fingers soothing the [pc.skin] on top and massaging the muscle underneath. It still takes a few seconds for you to relax, your heart rate jumping up just ever so slightly."

rows.original: “See? I’m just a gentle old soul. You needn’t think of this as punishment, more of... an experience, shall we say,” she half-whispers, her voice breaking into a sultry husk as she holds your shoulder in place. You try to avoid eye contact, the need to focus becoming wordless and blurry in your mind.
rows.translation: “看见了吗？我只是个温柔的老灵魂。你不必把这当作惩罚，更像是...一种体验，可以这么说，”她半是耳语地说道，声音变成性感沙哑的低音，同时将你的肩膀固定在原地。你试图避免目光接触，保持专注的需求在脑中变得无言而模糊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“See? I’m just a gentle old soul. You needn’t think of this as punishment, more of... an experience, shall we say,” she half-whispers, her voice breaking into a sultry husk as she holds your shoulder in place. You try to avoid eye contact, the need to focus becoming wordless and blurry in your mind."

rows.original: Your [pc.skinFurScales] prickles as another set of smooth, cold fingers trails down your spine. The hand stops just short of your [pc.ass], instead coming to a very comfortable rest against your [pc.hip]. You stay firm, however, no matter how gently or calmly she teases your flesh.
rows.translation: 另一组光滑冰冷的手指沿脊柱向下划过，让你的[pc.skinFurScales]泛起战栗。那只手在[pc.ass]前停下，反而无比舒适地落在[pc.hip]上。但无论她多么温柔平静地挑逗你的肉体，你都坚定不移。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour [pc.skinFurScales] prickles as another set of smooth, cold fingers trails down your spine. The hand stops just short of your [pc.ass], instead coming to a very comfortable rest against your [pc.hip]. You stay firm, however, no matter how gently or calmly she teases your flesh."

rows.original: “Still not willing to play along? Fiiiine, fine, I suppose a tender caress isn’t everyone’s bag,” she concedes, her mild and playful tone giving way to a sigh as her hands let go of you. The cool metal feeling is replaced with ever-so-slightly warmer air, another tingle prickling through those groped areas.
rows.translation: “还是不肯配合？好——吧，好吧，我想并不是每个人都喜欢温柔爱抚，”她让步道，双手放开了你，温和调皮的语气化作叹息。清凉金属的感觉被稍微温暖一点的空气取代，那些遭受摸索的区域再次泛起阵阵酥麻。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Still not willing to play along? Fiiiine, fine, I suppose a tender caress isn’t everyone’s bag,” she concedes, her mild and playful tone giving way to a sigh as her hands let go of you. The cool metal feeling is replaced with ever-so-slightly warmer air, another tingle prickling through those groped areas."

rows.original: “Just get it over with, I’m ready,” you bite back at her, avoiding her eye contact as she slinks around to face you. Out of the corner of your eye, you see an open palm speed for your face-
rows.translation: “赶快结束吧，我准备好了，”你避开她的目光，尖锐地回应；她悄然绕到面前。你从眼角看见一只张开的手掌高速冲向脸部-
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just get it over with, I’m ready,” you bite back at her, avoiding her eye contact as she slinks around to face you. Out of the corner of your eye, you see an open palm speed for your face-"

rows.original: “Ah ah, hold it, hold it,” half whispers the mob boss, her entire right hand splayed and fitted to your [pc.face]. You almost recoil from the motion as the contact of her fingertips give you a cold, hard reason to pause.
rows.translation: “啊啊，停住，停住，”黑帮首领半是耳语地说道，整只右手张开，贴合你的[pc.face]。她的指尖接触带来冰冷坚硬的理由，让你停顿下来；你差点因这个动作向后缩去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah ah, hold it, hold it,” half whispers the mob boss, her entire right hand splayed and fitted to your [pc.face]. You almost recoil from the motion as the contact of her fingertips give you a cold, hard reason to pause."

rows.original: Yet there’s a genuine throb in your veins, as if hit by a static shock. That throb grows, your muscles stiffening and contracting even though you’re not using them! A primitive instinct begs you to look for the danger, the cause: your eyes stop wandering as they meet the dark, grinning glare of the mob boss.
rows.translation: 然而，静电冲击般的真实悸动在血管中泛起。那股悸动不断增强，即使没有主动发力，肌肉也会绷紧收缩！原始本能恳求你寻找危险与原因；游移的目光停了下来，与黑帮首领黑暗而咧嘴笑着的凝视相接。
rows.raw: "\n\nYet there’s a genuine throb in your veins, as if hit by a static shock. That throb grows, your muscles stiffening and contracting even though you’re not using them! A primitive instinct begs you to look for the danger, the cause: your eyes stop wandering as they meet the dark, grinning glare of the mob boss."

rows.original: “The name’s Akane. Say it back to me.”
rows.translation: “我的名字是茜。跟着我说一遍。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The name’s Akane. Say it back to me.”"

rows.original: At once, every part of you burns with an intense pain! Every muscle locks in place,
rows.translation: 刹那间，你身体的每个部分都燃起剧烈痛楚！每块肌肉锁在原地，
rows.raw: "\n\nAt once, every part of you burns with an intense pain! Every muscle locks in place, "

rows.original: every bit of [pc.skinColor] goo-flesh
rows.translation: 每一丝[pc.skinColor]黏液血肉
rows.raw: "every bit of [pc.skinColor] goo-flesh"

rows.original: every bone
rows.translation: 每根骨头
rows.raw: "every bone"

rows.original: and nerve fighting to tear themselves away from you as electric shocks wrack every conceivable part of you!
rows.translation: 和神经都竭力想从你身上撕脱；电击蹂躏着每个可以想象的部位！
rows.raw: " and nerve fighting to tear themselves away from you as electric shocks wrack every conceivable part of you!"

rows.original: The loss of control is immediate: you can’t even scream as paralysis takes over your throat and lungs!
rows.translation: 你立刻失去控制：瘫痪接管喉咙与肺部，甚至无法尖叫！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe loss of control is immediate: you can’t even scream as paralysis takes over your throat and lungs!"

rows.original: Your [pc.feet]
rows.translation: 你的[pc.feet]
rows.raw: "\n\nYour [pc.feet] "

rows.original: give
rows.translation: 失去
rows.raw: "give"

rows.original: gives
rows.translation: 失去
rows.raw: "gives"

rows.original: way and the physical connection of you and her are kept together as you fall to a kneel. Panic sets in: no arms to use, no lower body movement, a mechanized dominatrix bending and breaking you down... the only salvation is to scream her name!
rows.translation: 支撑，你跪倒在地，与她的身体接触令彼此始终相连。恐慌涌现：双臂无法使用，下半身无法移动，还有一名机械化女支配者正在弯折击溃你...唯一救赎就是尖叫她的名字！
rows.raw: " way and the physical connection of you and her are kept together as you fall to a kneel. Panic sets in: no arms to use, no lower body movement, a mechanized dominatrix bending and breaking you down... the only salvation is to scream her name!"

rows.original: “Ahkk..!” is what you try to shout, the syllables trying to force their way through you.
rows.translation: “茜..！”这是你试图大喊的声音，一个个音节竭力从体内挤出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahkk..!” is what you try to shout, the syllables trying to force their way through you."

rows.original: Akane pulls her hand back, the pain flowing around your system instantly dying out. Suddenly, your lungs kick into a frenzy, the need for sweet air becoming a savior’s balm to your freshly tortured nerves.
rows.translation: 茜收回手掌，流遍身体系统的疼痛瞬间消失。肺部突然疯狂运作，对甜美空气的需求化作救世主般的香膏，抚慰刚遭折磨的神经。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane pulls her hand back, the pain flowing around your system instantly dying out. Suddenly, your lungs kick into a frenzy, the need for sweet air becoming a savior’s balm to your freshly tortured nerves."

rows.original: “24 seconds. Didn’t even get one syllable out. We’ll try again” says Akane from on high, her fingers curling and uncurling as if she were just warming up. You can’t help but note her own breathlessness, her chest heaving under her other arm.
rows.translation: “二十四秒。连一个音节都没说出来。我们再试一次”茜居高临下地说道，手指不断蜷曲伸展，仿佛只是在热身。你忍不住注意到她同样气喘吁吁，胸膛在另一条手臂下剧烈起伏。
rows.raw: "\n\n“24 seconds. Didn’t even get one syllable out. We’ll try again” says Akane from on high, her fingers curling and uncurling as if she were just warming up. You can’t help but note her own breathlessness, her chest heaving under her other arm."

rows.original: “Akane. Say it back to me.”
rows.translation: “茜。跟着我说一遍。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Akane. Say it back to me.”"

rows.original: Her splayed fingers latch back onto your face, those charged fingertips making you wince and gasp as they make contact with your [pc.skinFurScales]. But... nothing. She merely holds it there.
rows.translation: 她张开的手指重新扣住你的脸，带电指尖接触[pc.skinFurScales]时，令你畏缩喘息。但是...什么也没有。她只是将手放在那里。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer splayed fingers latch back onto your face, those charged fingertips making you wince and gasp as they make contact with your [pc.skinFurScales]. But... nothing. She merely holds it there."

rows.original: “Say it,” she whispers, her thumb drawing circles across your cheek.
rows.translation: “说出来，”她低声说道，拇指在你脸颊上画圈。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Say it,” she whispers, her thumb drawing circles across your cheek."

rows.original: “Ah... akah... Akane,” you force out, clenching your eyes closed as your words seem to chime with submission...
rows.translation: “茜...茜...茜，”你紧闭双眼，勉强挤出声音，话语仿佛因臣服而鸣响...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah... akah... Akane,” you force out, clenching your eyes closed as your words seem to chime with submission..."

rows.original: Her fingers and thumb massage your [pc.face], the gentle motions belying the ghost pain your muscles tingle with.
rows.translation: 她的手指与拇指按摩着[pc.face]，温柔动作掩盖了肌肉中酥麻的幻痛。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer fingers and thumb massage your [pc.face], the gentle motions belying the ghost pain your muscles tingle with."

rows.original: “There, there, surely that’s not all you have? A young, strapping spacer with nerves of steel? Aheh... Steele...” she giggles, palming your head in her hand like an owner comforting their pet.
rows.translation: “好啦，好啦，你肯定不只有这点本事吧？年轻而健壮的太空旅人，拥有钢铁般的神经？啊哈...斯蒂尔...”她咯咯笑着，将你的头托在手中，如同主人安慰宠物。
rows.raw: "\n\n“There, there, surely that’s not all you have? A young, strapping spacer with nerves of steel? Aheh... Steele...” she giggles, palming your head in her hand like an owner comforting their pet."

rows.original: <i>“One more time now.
rows.translation: <i>“现在再来一次。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“One more time now. "

rows.original: WHO’S YOUR WAIFU?
rows.translation: 谁是你的二次元老婆？
rows.raw: "WHO’S YOUR WAIFU?"

rows.original: Say my name.
rows.translation: 说出我的名字。
rows.raw: "Say my name."

rows.original: Before you can think to even form the word, that warm current stings your skin again, rising in strength until your entire body is rapidly subjugated! You manage to gasp out, scream and inhale before your lungs seize up, the cycle continuing as constant pain keeps you locked to the floor and firmly within Akane’s hold.
rows.translation: 你甚至来不及思考如何说出那个词，那股温暖电流便再次刺痛皮肤，强度不断攀升，直到整具身体迅速遭到征服！肺部紧缩前，你勉强喘息、尖叫并吸气；循环不断持续，永恒的疼痛让你锁在地板上，牢牢困在茜的掌控中。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can think to even form the word, that warm current stings your skin again, rising in strength until your entire body is rapidly subjugated! You manage to gasp out, scream and inhale before your lungs seize up, the cycle continuing as constant pain keeps you locked to the floor and firmly within Akane’s hold."

rows.original: From below, your gaze is forced to focus on nothing but her, locked fingers giving you a shattered image of her wild-eyed grin. No, not a grin... a psychotic, lustful visage. A slight squeeze between her tips and you jerk in place, the intense pain that controls your body receding to your [pc.face].
rows.translation: 你被迫从下方只专注于她，锁定的手指将她双眼狂乱的笑容切割成破碎影像。不，那不是笑容...而是疯狂淫荡的面容。她的指尖稍稍收紧，你便原地抽动；控制身体的剧烈痛楚收缩到[pc.face]。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom below, your gaze is forced to focus on nothing but her, locked fingers giving you a shattered image of her wild-eyed grin. No, not a grin... a psychotic, lustful visage. A slight squeeze between her tips and you jerk in place, the intense pain that controls your body receding to your [pc.face]."

rows.original: “Say it!” she shouts, visibly gritting her teeth.
rows.translation: “说出来！”她大喊道，明显咬紧了牙关。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Say it!” she shouts, visibly gritting her teeth."

rows.original: Lungs free to move, you blurt out “Akane!!” with as much force as you can muster. As the last syllable leaves your [pc.lipsChaste], you’re both pushed away from each other: Akane staggers back, you fall onto your side! A visible crack of white light flashes between her palm and your head, one last jolt of agonizing energy from her to you!
rows.translation: 肺部恢复活动后，你竭尽全力脱口喊出“茜！！”。最后一个音节离开[pc.lipsChaste]时，你们同时被推离彼此：茜踉跄后退，你则侧身摔倒！一道清晰可见的白光裂纹在她掌心与你头部之间闪烁，那是她传给你的最后一道剧痛能量！
rows.raw: "\n\nLungs free to move, you blurt out “Akane!!” with as much force as you can muster. As the last syllable leaves your [pc.lipsChaste], you’re both pushed away from each other: Akane staggers back, you fall onto your side! A visible crack of white light flashes between her palm and your head, one last jolt of agonizing energy from her to you!"

rows.original: You cry out and whimper as you land on your shoulder, residual muscle spasms tugging and scraping at your tenderized nervous system.
rows.translation: 肩膀着地时，你哭喊哀鸣，残余的肌肉痉挛拉扯刮擦着已经变得柔嫩的神经系统。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cry out and whimper as you land on your shoulder, residual muscle spasms tugging and scraping at your tenderized nervous system."

rows.original: [pc.eachCock] flop
rows.translation: [pc.eachCock]
rows.raw: " [pc.eachCock] flop"

rows.original: s
rows.translation: 们

rows.original: around uselessly on the ground, the combined ‘shock tactics’ having forced
rows.translation: 无力地在地上甩动，复合‘电击战术’迫使
rows.raw: " around uselessly on the ground, the combined ‘shock tactics’ having forced "

rows.original: them to hardened yet unusable states.
rows.translation: 它们变得坚硬，却无法使用。
rows.raw: "them to hardened yet unusable states."

rows.original: it to a hardened yet unusable state.
rows.translation: 它变得坚硬，却无法使用。
rows.raw: "it to a hardened yet unusable state."

rows.original: The groggy dominatrix stumbles on her mechanical heels, the metallic plink-plinks erratic as she manages to stop herself from teetering over. You can see Akane hold herself up against the wall, her knees bent inward and all her limbs jittering with a palsy. Did she just...?
rows.translation: 昏昏沉沉的女支配者踩着机械鞋跟踉跄不稳，金属叮叮声毫无规律；她终于避免自己摇晃摔倒。你看到茜靠着墙支撑身体，双膝向内弯曲，四肢都因痉挛不断抽动。她刚才是不是...？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe groggy dominatrix stumbles on her mechanical heels, the metallic plink-plinks erratic as she manages to stop herself from teetering over. You can see Akane hold herself up against the wall, her knees bent inward and all her limbs jittering with a palsy. Did she just...?"

rows.original: “Nngggmmm... I haven’t heard someone say it like that in... ahehe, I don’t even know!” she pants, her voice dotted with feminine squeaks.
rows.translation: “嗯嗯嗯...我已经很久没听见有人这样说出它了...啊哈，我根本不知道有多久！”她气喘吁吁地说道，声音中夹杂着柔媚尖叫。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nngggmmm... I haven’t heard someone say it like that in... ahehe, I don’t even know!” she pants, her voice dotted with feminine squeaks."

rows.original: Even in your compromised state, you can see a glistening wetness seep out between her pale thighs. Oh, she definitely did...
rows.translation: 即使状态受损，你依旧能看到闪亮的湿润液体从她苍白大腿间渗出。噢，她绝对高潮了...
rows.raw: "\n\nEven in your compromised state, you can see a glistening wetness seep out between her pale thighs. Oh, she definitely did..."

rows.original: You try hauling yourself up but to no avail, the tight binding still a coarse reminder of your bondage. The slightest bit of extra effort cuts into your stamina and your [pc.skinNoun] is sore and far too sensitive to try again.
rows.translation: 你试图撑起身体，却毫无效果；紧实绳结依旧粗糙地提醒你正遭受束缚。稍微多用一点力气都会消耗体力，[pc.skinNoun]又酸痛又过于敏感，无法再次尝试。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try hauling yourself up but to no avail, the tight binding still a coarse reminder of your bondage. The slightest bit of extra effort cuts into your stamina and your [pc.skinNoun] is sore and far too sensitive to try again."

rows.original: Akane also slumps to her knees, her fingertips causing sparks to flare against the wall as she drags them down with her.
rows.translation: 茜同样瘫跪在地，指尖沿墙向下拖动，激起阵阵火花。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane also slumps to her knees, her fingertips causing sparks to flare against the wall as she drags them down with her."

rows.original: “Oh how glad I am that you agreed... oh how fucking glad,” she giggles, wiping her face with the backs of her wrists. Whatever thoughts you have to add fail to form in your mouth: the cool air filling your lungs is too good to pass up right now.
rows.translation: “噢，我真庆幸你同意了...真他妈庆幸，”她咯咯笑着，用手腕背面擦脸。你想补充的任何想法都无法在嘴里成形：此刻填满肺部的清凉空气实在太过美好，不容错过。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh how glad I am that you agreed... oh how fucking glad,” she giggles, wiping her face with the backs of her wrists. Whatever thoughts you have to add fail to form in your mouth: the cool air filling your lungs is too good to pass up right now."

rows.original: Your eyelids flutter to a close as that same air works its magic. Your lungs relax, your heart slows and your limbs loosen in short order, the comforting afterglow of expending so much energy making things numb and....sleepy...and....
rows.translation: 同样的空气发挥魔力，你的眼皮轻颤着闭上。肺部放松、心脏减速、肢体很快松弛，耗费如此多能量后的舒适余韵令一切变得麻木而....困倦...并且....
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyelids flutter to a close as that same air works its magic. Your lungs relax, your heart slows and your limbs loosen in short order, the comforting afterglow of expending so much energy making things numb and....sleepy...and...."

rows.original: “Ah ah, no no, nooo,” comes a voice from above, the exhausted voice of Akane leading you out of a microsleep. It couldn’t have been more than a minute. She’s got her hands all over you, the sneaky... wait...
rows.translation: “啊啊，不行不行，不——行，”上方传来一道声音，茜疲惫的话音将你从短暂睡眠中引出。时间不可能超过一分钟。她的双手正在你身上四处摸索，这个狡猾的...等等...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah ah, no no, nooo,” comes a voice from above, the exhausted voice of Akane leading you out of a microsleep. It couldn’t have been more than a minute. She’s got her hands all over you, the sneaky... wait..."

rows.original: You find your head to be resting snugly against her lap. Her hands seem busy with untying your bonds. But...why...
rows.translation: 你发现自己的头正舒适地枕在她腿上。她的双手似乎正忙着解开你的束缚。可是...为什么...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou find your head to be resting snugly against her lap. Her hands seem busy with untying your bonds. But...why..."

rows.original: The rope slackens and another burden falls free of you. You gasp as your joints gain fresh movement, the first they’ve had in hours. You’re still pretty sore and vulnerable: it wouldn’t be wise to try to escape the jaws of a tiger...
rows.translation: 绳索松开，另一项负担从身上脱落。关节几个小时来首次恢复自由活动，让你喘息出声。你依然相当酸痛脆弱：试图逃出老虎的血盆大口绝不明智...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe rope slackens and another burden falls free of you. You gasp as your joints gain fresh movement, the first they’ve had in hours. You’re still pretty sore and vulnerable: it wouldn’t be wise to try to escape the jaws of a tiger..."

rows.original: A shadow of five prongs looms out of the corner of your eye...! You wince, tense up and brace for more!
rows.translation: 五根尖刺般的影子从你眼角逼近...！你畏缩着绷紧身体，准备迎接更多痛苦！
rows.raw: "\n\nA shadow of five prongs looms out of the corner of your eye...! You wince, tense up and brace for more!"

rows.original: ...but instead, those same cold tips play lightly and gently across your temple. Instead of agony in its purest form, there’s a warmth and a fuzz from the metal digits. A flush of adrenaline overrides your fear as a tender caress plays about your head and [pc.face]. OOo, that feels nice....
rows.translation: ...可同样冰冷的尖端只是轻柔地在太阳穴旁嬉戏。金属指节带来的不是最纯粹的痛苦，而是暖意与模糊舒适。温柔爱抚在头部与[pc.face]周围游走，肾上腺素冲刷取代了恐惧。噢噢，这感觉真好....
rows.raw: "\n\n...but instead, those same cold tips play lightly and gently across your temple. Instead of agony in its purest form, there’s a warmth and a fuzz from the metal digits. A flush of adrenaline overrides your fear as a tender caress plays about your head and [pc.face]. OOo, that feels nice...."

rows.original: “Rather tame as punishments go, wouldn’t you say? Better than ripped out nails and a sliced tongue,” she half-whispers, her middle finger tracing along your [pc.lips]. A small part of you wants to hate her as she teases you, another part internally thanking her for the gentle balm of her touch. With you so tender in body as you as are, you can only go along with her statements.
rows.translation: “就惩罚而言，这算相当温和，不是吗？总好过拔掉指甲、割断舌头，”她半是耳语地说道，中指沿[pc.lips]划过。她挑逗你时，你心中一小部分想要憎恨她，另一部分却在内心感谢她的触碰所带来的温柔香膏。身体已经如此柔嫩，你只能顺着她的话。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Rather tame as punishments go, wouldn’t you say? Better than ripped out nails and a sliced tongue,” she half-whispers, her middle finger tracing along your [pc.lips]. A small part of you wants to hate her as she teases you, another part internally thanking her for the gentle balm of her touch. With you so tender in body as you as are, you can only go along with her statements."

rows.original: “Hmm, [pc.name], [pc.name]... I wonder,” she thinks out loud, running her thrumming thumb along the back of your neck. An intense, pleasurable throb follows the motion, forcing a shallow inhale out of you as it numbs your lungs with pleasant feelings.
rows.translation: “嗯，[pc.name]，[pc.name]...我很好奇，”她大声思考，让低鸣的拇指顺着你颈后划过。强烈而愉快的悸动追随着动作，舒适感令肺部麻木，迫使你浅浅吸气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm, [pc.name], [pc.name]... I wonder,” she thinks out loud, running her thrumming thumb along the back of your neck. An intense, pleasurable throb follows the motion, forcing a shallow inhale out of you as it numbs your lungs with pleasant feelings."

rows.original: Wonder what? You realize that your voice tickles your throat something fierce, as if you’d been shouting for hours into the starry void. Akane places a finger across your [pc.lipsChaste], signaling for you to stay silent.
rows.translation: 好奇什么？你意识到自己的声音猛烈挠弄着喉咙，仿佛已经对着群星璀璨的虚空尖叫了几个小时。茜将一根手指按在[pc.lipsChaste]上，示意你保持安静。
rows.raw: "\n\nWonder what? You realize that your voice tickles your throat something fierce, as if you’d been shouting for hours into the starry void. Akane places a finger across your [pc.lipsChaste], signaling for you to stay silent."

rows.original: “Shhh, shhh, rest easy for now. I’ll have your things brought and then we’ll have a few words. I’ve had my fill for today, ahum... hmhmm...” she giggles, holding your head up as she slips her knees out from underneath.
rows.translation: “嘘，嘘，现在安心休息。我会让人把你的东西拿来，然后我们再聊几句。今天我已经满足了，啊嗯...嗯哼...”她咯咯笑着，扶起你的头，将双膝从下方抽出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shhh, shhh, rest easy for now. I’ll have your things brought and then we’ll have a few words. I’ve had my fill for today, ahum... hmhmm...” she giggles, holding your head up as she slips her knees out from underneath."

rows.original: With your aching arms now free, you steadily bring yourself to a sitting position. The throb of your pulse pounds away against your skull, warms your chest and helps set your body at ease... but your nerves still seem tender as your [pc.feet]
rows.translation: 酸痛的双臂如今重获自由，你稳稳将自己撑成坐姿。脉搏在头颅中砰砰撞击，温暖胸膛，帮助身体放松...可神经似乎依然柔嫩，而你的[pc.feet]
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your aching arms now free, you steadily bring yourself to a sitting position. The throb of your pulse pounds away against your skull, warms your chest and helps set your body at ease... but your nerves still seem tender as your [pc.feet] "

rows.original: find their rightful places
rows.translation: 找回各自应在的位置
rows.raw: "find their rightful places"

rows.original: finds its rightful place
rows.translation: 找回它应在的位置
rows.raw: "finds its rightful place"

rows.original: against the ground. Akane is already at the dungeon’s entrance, the ‘session’ having added a subtle swagger to her walk and posture. She curls an index finger towards you, gesturing for you to follow her through the sliding door.
rows.translation: ，抵在地面上。茜已经来到地牢入口，这场‘调教’让她的步态与姿势多了一丝得意摇摆。她朝你勾起食指，示意跟随自己穿过滑门。
rows.raw: " against the ground. Akane is already at the dungeon’s entrance, the ‘session’ having added a subtle swagger to her walk and posture. She curls an index finger towards you, gesturing for you to follow her through the sliding door."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You’ve no interest in losing hard-earned gains and even less in dying for no reason. At least ‘allow use of’ couldn’t be anything crippling or along the lines of mutilation... right?
rows.translation: 你不想失去辛苦获得的成果，更不想毫无意义地死去。至少‘允许使用’应该不会造成残疾或身体残缺...对吧？
rows.raw: "You’ve no interest in losing hard-earned gains and even less in dying for no reason. At least ‘allow use of’ couldn’t be anything crippling or along the lines of mutilation... right?"

rows.original: Biting the bullet, you tell her that you’ll allow her to use your body.
rows.translation: 你硬着头皮告诉她，自己允许她使用你的身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nBiting the bullet, you tell her that you’ll allow her to use your body."

rows.original: “Really now...? Cheo, Yan, help [pc.himHer] to my room. Gently now,” she begins, her voice livening up a little in the process. “We’ve already given [pc.himHer] the warm welcome, after all...”
rows.translation: “真的吗...？切奥，严，扶[pc.himHer]去我的房间。动作温柔点，”她开始说道，声音在过程中稍微活跃了一些。“毕竟，我们已经热情欢迎过[pc.himHer]了...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really now...? Cheo, Yan, help [pc.himHer] to my room. Gently now,” she begins, her voice livening up a little in the process. “We’ve already given [pc.himHer] the warm welcome, after all...”"

rows.original: Two hands grasp your shoulders and another two the rope binding your arms and wrists. They prompt you to stand, which you have to do slowly as the ache in your [pc.legs] takes a few seconds to pass.
rows.translation: 两只手抓住你的肩膀，另外两只手抓住捆绑手臂与手腕的绳索。他们催促你起身；[pc.legs]中的酸痛过了几秒才消退，让你不得不缓慢动作。
rows.raw: "\n\nTwo hands grasp your shoulders and another two the rope binding your arms and wrists. They prompt you to stand, which you have to do slowly as the ache in your [pc.legs] takes a few seconds to pass."

rows.original: You quickly turn your head to the both of them: same black masks, outfits, yet judging from their sleeveless attire, one is a pale human and the other is an ausar. White, black and toffee brown fur... hang on.
rows.translation: 你迅速转头看向两人：同样的黑色面具与服装，可从无袖装束判断，一人是苍白人类，另一人是奥萨尔。白色、黑色和太妃糖棕色毛发...等等。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou quickly turn your head to the both of them: same black masks, outfits, yet judging from their sleeveless attire, one is a pale human and the other is an ausar. White, black and toffee brown fur... hang on."

rows.original: If he’s who you think he is,
rows.translation: 如果他真是你猜想的那个人，
rows.raw: "\n\nIf he’s who you think he is, "

rows.original: you can’t help but notice the irony of the situation, at least for a moment...
rows.translation: 你忍不住注意到眼前局面的讽刺意味，至少短暂如此...
rows.raw: "you can’t help but notice the irony of the situation, at least for a moment...\n\n"

rows.original: you’re sure that he couldn’t give you more of a beating than he already did, so nothing to fear, right...
rows.translation: 你很确定他无法比上次打得更狠，所以没什么好怕的，对吧...
rows.raw: "you’re sure that he couldn’t give you more of a beating than he already did, so nothing to fear, right...\n\n"

rows.original: You have to keep your head bowed low as you’re lead behind another screen: the overall size and space of this hideout seems set to be unfriendly to taller beings.
rows.translation: 你被领到另一扇屏风后时，不得不低下头：这处藏身地的整体尺寸与空间似乎对高大生物很不友好。
rows.raw: "You have to keep your head bowed low as you’re lead behind another screen: the overall size and space of this hideout seems set to be unfriendly to taller beings. "

rows.original: They push you forward by the shoulders, forcing you along the pathway before you.
rows.translation: 他们推着你的肩膀，迫使你沿前方通道行进。
rows.raw: "They push you forward by the shoulders, forcing you along the pathway before you."

rows.original: You haven’t even had time to take in your surroundings before. This ‘throne room’ is long and straight, a stone pathway from one end to the other. The walls are gray with wooden beams and pillars forming uniform patterns. On both sides of the path are two shallow rock pools in artisanal formations, crystal waters forming the ambience of the room.
rows.translation: 你以前甚至没有时间观察周围环境。这间‘王座室’狭长笔直，一条石质通道从一端延伸到另一端。墙壁呈灰色，木梁与立柱组成均匀图案。道路两旁各有一座以工匠风格布置的浅岩池，清澈水面构成房间的氛围。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou haven’t even had time to take in your surroundings before. This ‘throne room’ is long and straight, a stone pathway from one end to the other. The walls are gray with wooden beams and pillars forming uniform patterns. On both sides of the path are two shallow rock pools in artisanal formations, crystal waters forming the ambience of the room."

rows.original: The ‘throne’ sits on top of wooden steps, with little other decoration. To either side of the throne are two sliding doors, the pathway splitting off to a T to meet them. You’re guided towards the left door, which slides open on its own accord with a quick schwii sound. The room on the other side seems a little... dark...
rows.translation: ‘王座’位于木制台阶顶端，几乎没有其他装饰。王座两侧分别有一扇滑门，通道以丁字形分岔与之相接。你被领向左门，它伴着短促咻声自动滑开。另一侧的房间似乎有点...黑暗...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ‘throne’ sits on top of wooden steps, with little other decoration. To either side of the throne are two sliding doors, the pathway splitting off to a T to meet them. You’re guided towards the left door, which slides open on its own accord with a quick schwii sound. The room on the other side seems a little... dark..."

rows.original: “Go on in,” comes a voice from overhead. You turn around to see the mob boss rubbing her thumb against her cheek, grinning as she does.
rows.translation: “进去吧，”上方传来声音。你转身看见黑帮首领用拇指摩擦脸颊，同时咧嘴微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Go on in,” comes a voice from overhead. You turn around to see the mob boss rubbing her thumb against her cheek, grinning as she does."

rows.original: You watch her slink off of the seat, her faux-heels clack-clacking against the stone floor behind you.
rows.translation: 你看着她从座位上悄然起身，仿制鞋跟在身后石地板上发出咔嗒咔嗒声。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou watch her slink off of the seat, her faux-heels clack-clacking against the stone floor behind you."

rows.original: You get a forceful shove from both agents, one that makes you stagger forward into the room.
rows.translation: 两名特工同时用力推了你一把，让你踉跄着向前进入房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get a forceful shove from both agents, one that makes you stagger forward into the room."

rows.original: Fuh-!
rows.raw: "Fuh-!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: KALAS.TAVROS.TAVROS HANGAR
rows.raw: "KALAS.TAVROS.TAVROS HANGAR"

rows.original: Brutalized
rows.raw: "Brutalized"

rows.original:
You move in twice the time between tiles.
-10% to all resistances and damage.
rows.translation:
你在地格之间移动需要双倍时间。
所有抗性与伤害-10%。
rows.raw: "You move in twice the time between tiles.\n-10% to all resistances and damage."

rows.original: It takes a long while to come round.
rows.translation: 过了很久，你才恢复意识。
rows.raw: "It takes a long while to come round."

rows.original: When you awaken, you’re nestled on a chair of cargo crates and boxes in the Tavros docks.
rows.translation: 醒来时，你正窝在塔夫罗斯码头由货箱与盒子堆成的椅子上。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you awaken, you’re nestled on a chair of cargo crates and boxes in the Tavros docks."

rows.original: You scan your eyes over everything, hoping that nothing has been taken: nnnnnno. Your [pc.gear] all seem to be on your person.
rows.translation: 你用双眼扫视所有东西，希望没有物品被拿走：没——有。[pc.gear]似乎都穿戴在身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou scan your eyes over everything, hoping that nothing has been taken: nnnnnno. Your [pc.gear] all seem to be on your person."

rows.original: You move an arm to help yourself up, the- gaahhh!
rows.translation: 你移动一条手臂，准备撑起身体，可-嘎啊啊！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou move an arm to help yourself up, the- gaahhh!"

rows.original: Moving hurts.
rows.translation: 移动起来很疼。
rows.raw: "\n\nMoving hurts. "

rows.original: So does breathing, oh god life is pain kill me
rows.translation: 呼吸也一样，噢天哪，活着就是痛苦，杀了我吧
rows.raw: "So does breathing, oh god life is pain kill me"

rows.original: That anaesthetic must’ve worn off: all you can feel is debilitating aches and pains all over your limbs and joints. Guess you’ll have to see a doc!
rows.translation: 麻醉剂肯定已经失效：你只能感觉到四肢与关节各处令人虚弱的酸痛。看来必须去看医生了！
rows.raw: "\n\nThat anaesthetic must’ve worn off: all you can feel is debilitating aches and pains all over your limbs and joints. Guess you’ll have to see a doc!"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Not exactly thrilled with the other options and fancying yourself tougher than most, you tell her that you’ll submit to a physical punishment.
rows.translation: 其他选择并没有让你兴奋，而且你自认为比大多数人坚强，于是告诉她，自己会接受身体惩罚。
rows.raw: "Not exactly thrilled with the other options and fancying yourself tougher than most, you tell her that you’ll submit to a physical punishment."

rows.original: “Hmph, a brave one. What a waste of a good body. Well, you heard [pc.himHer]. Do be ample with the painkillers, okay Yan?” says the mob boss, turning her head to a masked assistant holding you in place. He in turn nods and lifts you up to your [pc.feet] while the other operative holding you works in perfect sync.
rows.translation: “哼，真勇敢。浪费了一副好身体。嗯，你们听见[pc.himHer]的话了。止痛药一定要足量，好吗，严？”黑帮首领说道，将头转向一名负责固定你的蒙面助手。他随即点头，将你扶到[pc.feet]站好，另一名控制你的特工与他配合得天衣无缝。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmph, a brave one. What a waste of a good body. Well, you heard [pc.himHer]. Do be ample with the painkillers, okay Yan?” says the mob boss, turning her head to a masked assistant holding you in place. He in turn nods and lifts you up to your [pc.feet] while the other operative holding you works in perfect sync."

rows.original: The one called Yan produces a small silver tube, a medipen of some sort by your guess. When he aims it for your arm, you consider resisting... only to remember that - in these bonds - you’ve no way to resist.
rows.translation: 那个名叫严的人拿出一根银色小管，依你猜测是某种医疗注射器。他将它对准你的手臂时，你考虑过反抗...但随即想起，在这些束缚中，你根本无从反抗。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe one called Yan produces a small silver tube, a medipen of some sort by your guess. When he aims it for your arm, you consider resisting... only to remember that - in these bonds - you’ve no way to resist."

rows.original: He quickly jabs the smooth surface against your [pc.skinFurScales] and presses down on the top of it. A mild hiss precedes a dull ache that swiftly spreads from your arm to almost everywhere in your body. You wince out of reflex but within seconds, the ache dissipates into a warm numbing sensation. You almost feel like smiling...
rows.translation: 他迅速将光滑表面刺向[pc.skinFurScales]，按下顶部。轻微嘶声过后，一阵钝痛从手臂迅速扩散到几乎全身。你本能地畏缩，可只过了几秒，酸痛便消散成温暖麻木的感觉。你几乎想要微笑...
rows.raw: "\n\nHe quickly jabs the smooth surface against your [pc.skinFurScales] and presses down on the top of it. A mild hiss precedes a dull ache that swiftly spreads from your arm to almost everywhere in your body. You wince out of reflex but within seconds, the ache dissipates into a warm numbing sensation. You almost feel like smiling..."

rows.original: Several agents then meld into reality before you; agents of all types and sizes, each holding a black baton.
rows.translation: 几名特工随即在你面前融入现实；他们身材与类型各异，每人手中都握着一根黑色棍棒。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral agents then meld into reality before you; agents of all types and sizes, each holding a black baton."

rows.original: Ah. Aahhh. Ah shit.
rows.translation: 啊。啊啊啊。啊，操。
rows.raw: "\n\nAh. Aahhh. Ah shit."

rows.original: The first in line takes a hefty swing at your [pc.hip]. The object hits but you feel... very little, actually. With a small yelp, you’re jolted slightly to the side. Instead of sudden pain, there’s an intense and discomforting heat. You shuffle your [pc.legs] a little: still functioning properly at any rate.
rows.translation: 排在第一的人朝你的[pc.hip]狠狠挥击。棍棒命中，可你实际上...几乎没什么感觉。你轻叫一声，身体被撞得稍微偏向一侧。那里没有突然出现疼痛，反而泛起强烈而令人不适的热意。你稍微挪动[pc.legs]：至少仍能正常运作。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe first in line takes a hefty swing at your [pc.hip]. The object hits but you feel... very little, actually. With a small yelp, you’re jolted slightly to the side. Instead of sudden pain, there’s an intense and discomforting heat. You shuffle your [pc.legs] a little: still functioning properly at any rate."

rows.original: While you’re assessing the ‘injury’, the second agent in line steps forward. Another swing, this time at your [pc.thigh]. The same shake from impact and the same intense heat... the same discomforting burn from each impact.
rows.translation: 你还在评估‘伤势’时，队列中的第二名特工走上前。又一次挥击，这次打在[pc.thigh]上。冲击造成同样的震动与强烈热意...每次命中都会带来同样令人不适的灼烧。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you’re assessing the ‘injury’, the second agent in line steps forward. Another swing, this time at your [pc.thigh]. The same shake from impact and the same intense heat... the same discomforting burn from each impact."

rows.original: You can’t quite tell how many ‘hits’ you take by the end of it. Each one dulls your focus and perception as your body is liberally covered in sickly, purplish blotches.
rows.translation: 结束时，你已经分不清自己挨了多少‘下’。每一击都会削弱专注与感知，病态的紫色斑块随意覆盖全身。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t quite tell how many ‘hits’ you take by the end of it. Each one dulls your focus and perception as your body is liberally covered in sickly, purplish blotches."

rows.original: Your eyes can’t... stay... open...
rows.translation: 你的双眼无...法保持...睁开...
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes can’t... stay... open..."

rows.original: Oo Here We Go
rows.translation: 噢，要来了
rows.raw: "Oo Here We Go"

rows.original: Oo Here We Go
rows.translation: 噢，要来了
rows.raw: "Oo Here We Go"

rows.original: Ooo Here We Go Again
rows.translation: 噢噢，又来了
rows.raw: "Ooo Here We Go Again"

rows.original: But what about intent to disarm and not kill?
rows.translation: 可是，让对方解除武装却不杀死的意图呢？
rows.raw: "But what about intent to disarm and not kill?"

rows.original: What about letting the operatives go?
rows.translation: 放走特工又算什么？
rows.raw: " What about letting the operatives go?"

rows.original: Ensuring their fox-morph ‘client’ was left well enough alone and safe?
rows.translation: 确保他们那位狐形态‘客户’不会再受打扰，并且安然无恙呢？
rows.raw: " Ensuring their fox-morph ‘client’ was left well enough alone and safe?"

rows.original: “And I’ve already thought of something,” interrupts the queen bee, cutting your questions off.
rows.translation: “而且我已经想到了办法，”女王蜂打断你，截断了所有问题。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And I’ve already thought of something,” interrupts the queen bee, cutting your questions off."

rows.original: “You can either pay your dues with a generous donation to our little group, submit to a physical punishment of equal value, allow me the use of your body or - if you truly do have a death wish - an honorable execution. The choice is yours,” she finishes almost as an afterthought, her ultimatum ringing about your head. Execution....?!?
rows.translation: “你可以向我们的小团体慷慨捐款，偿还欠下的债；也可以接受同等价值的身体惩罚；允许我使用你的身体；或者——如果你真的一心求死——接受体面的处决。选择权在你，”她几乎随口说完，最后通牒在你脑中不断回响。处决....？！?
rows.raw: "\n\n“You can either pay your dues with a generous donation to our little group, submit to a physical punishment of equal value, allow me the use of your body or - if you truly do have a death wish - an honorable execution. The choice is yours,” she finishes almost as an afterthought, her ultimatum ringing about your head. Execution....?!?"

rows.original: Shit... what do you choose?
rows.translation: 该死...你要怎么选？
rows.raw: "\n\nShit... what do you choose?"

rows.original: One of them makes you a tumblrite, the others make you a raging InCel.
rows.translation: 其中一个会让你变成汤不热党，其他的则会让你变成暴怒的非自愿独身男。
rows.raw: " One of them makes you a tumblrite, the others make you a raging InCel."

rows.original: Execution
rows.translation: 处决
rows.raw: "Execution"

rows.original: Execution
rows.translation: 处决
rows.raw: "Execution"

rows.original: This is exactly what it means. Serious. I dare you to press it, I dares ya.
rows.translation: 意思就是字面所说。很严肃。我赌你不敢按，我赌你不敢。
rows.raw: "This is exactly what it means. Serious. I dare you to press it, I dares ya."

rows.original: Donation
rows.translation: 捐款
rows.raw: "Donation"

rows.original: Donation
rows.translation: 捐款
rows.raw: "Donation"

rows.original: You’ll lose a lot of money in exchange for not dying, sounds good!
rows.translation: 用一大笔钱换自己不死，听起来不错！
rows.raw: "You’ll lose a lot of money in exchange for not dying, sounds good!"

rows.original: Allow Use
rows.translation: 允许使用
rows.raw: "Allow Use"

rows.original: Allow Use
rows.translation: 允许使用
rows.raw: "Allow Use"

rows.original: Although vague, this probably has something to do with your current outfit.
