rows.translation: 虽然含义模糊，但这大概与你现在的装束有关。
rows.raw: "Although vague, this probably has something to do with your current outfit."

rows.original: Punishment
rows.translation: 惩罚
rows.raw: "Punishment"

rows.original: Punishment
rows.translation: 惩罚
rows.raw: "Punishment"

rows.original: Perhaps the softest option judging by her tone... this most likely means you’re getting beaten black and blue.
rows.translation: 从她的语气判断，这或许是最温和的选择...但它很可能意味着你会被打得青一块紫一块。
rows.raw: "Perhaps the softest option judging by her tone... this most likely means you’re getting beaten black and blue."

rows.original: “Wake up.”
rows.raw: "“Wake up.”"

rows.original: You jerk and twist in shock as reality knocks you out of your sleepy daze. You can’t help but blink and wince as the ambient light bombards your senses. Even the light’s heat feels like an intangible, oppressive sensation against your [pc.face] and [pc.skinFurScales]. Just how long were you out to be this sensitive, fuck...
rows.translation: 现实将你从困倦恍惚中敲醒，你惊得扭动身体。环境光线轰击着感官，令你忍不住眨眼畏缩。就连光线的热度都像无形而压迫的感觉，抵着[pc.face]与[pc.skinFurScales]。你究竟昏迷了多久，才会变得如此敏感，操...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou jerk and twist in shock as reality knocks you out of your sleepy daze. You can’t help but blink and wince as the ambient light bombards your senses. Even the light’s heat feels like an intangible, oppressive sensation against your [pc.face] and [pc.skinFurScales]. Just how long were you out to be this sensitive, fuck..."

rows.original: As your eyes adjust, the first thing you’re aware of is pain. An ache in every limb joint, especially in your [pc.hips], hammered down with the sluggishness of waking up in such an odd way, some sort of tight, rough feeling covering your [pc.chest], abdomen and pelvis... are you naked?? The usual weight of your [pc.gear] is definitely gone, replaced with a motionless, cool air.
rows.translation: 双眼逐渐适应后，你首先意识到的是疼痛。每个肢体关节都在酸痛，尤其是[pc.hips]；以这种古怪方式苏醒的迟钝感进一步压住一切，某种紧实粗糙的感觉覆盖着[pc.chest]、腹部和骨盆...你赤身裸体？？平时[pc.gear]的重量肯定已经消失，取而代之的是静止清凉的空气。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs your eyes adjust, the first thing you’re aware of is pain. An ache in every limb joint, especially in your [pc.hips], hammered down with the sluggishness of waking up in such an odd way, some sort of tight, rough feeling covering your [pc.chest], abdomen and pelvis... are you naked?? The usual weight of your [pc.gear] is definitely gone, replaced with a motionless, cool air."

rows.original: You feel a shiver and a chill as the rest of your body comes to, the ambience of... wherever you are reminding you of a clinically controlled environment.
rows.translation: 身体其余部分逐渐恢复知觉，你一阵发抖发冷；这里...无论是什么地方，其氛围都让你想起临床控制的环境。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel a shiver and a chill as the rest of your body comes to, the ambience of... wherever you are reminding you of a clinically controlled environment."

rows.original: The fuzziness fades from your vision as you blink away the moisture.
rows.translation: 你眨去湿意，视野中的模糊逐渐消退。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe fuzziness fades from your vision as you blink away the moisture."

rows.original: You can see a ceiling that’s flat, red and wooden. You try to move your head around to get a better look but accch, something is catching you by the back of the head! Too tired to fight it, you swivel your eyes around instead: obscured white light that blooms in every corner, long shadows of humanoid figures static against gray and brown walls.
rows.translation: 你能看到平坦、红色而由木头制成的天花板。你试着转动头部看清更多东西，可啊呃，有什么从脑后将你牢牢钩住！你累得无法反抗，只好转动双眼：每个角落都有模糊白光绽放，类人身影的狭长影子静止投在灰褐色墙壁上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see a ceiling that’s flat, red and wooden. You try to move your head around to get a better look but accch, something is catching you by the back of the head! Too tired to fight it, you swivel your eyes around instead: obscured white light that blooms in every corner, long shadows of humanoid figures static against gray and brown walls."

rows.original: Sounds of water trickling across stones dance around your ears...
rows.translation: 流水掠过石头的声音在耳边舞动...
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds of water trickling across stones dance around your ears..."

rows.original: “Awake yet?” chimes a breathy, feminine voice. The malaise of unconsciousness melts away as a gravitas - a fear - weighs down on your mind.
rows.translation: “醒了吗？”一道气喘吁吁的女性声音轻快响起。昏迷造成的不适消融，一种凝重感——一种恐惧——沉沉压上你的意识。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awake yet?” chimes a breathy, feminine voice. The malaise of unconsciousness melts away as a gravitas - a fear - weighs down on your mind."

rows.original: “Aaanghh...” you mumble, realizing that your jaw is locked in place and your tongue held down by something solid: a gag...?
rows.translation: “啊嗯呃...”你喃喃出声，意识到下颌被锁在原地，舌头遭某种坚硬物体压住：口塞...？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aaanghh...” you mumble, realizing that your jaw is locked in place and your tongue held down by something solid: a gag...?"

rows.original: On instinct, you try moving your arms and [pc.legs], only to find that all of them are held in place too! You wriggle your arms and fingers, getting a feel for whatever’s holding them in place: joined at the elbows...
rows.translation: 你本能地试着移动双臂与[pc.legs]，却发现它们同样被固定在原地！你扭动手臂和手指，感受束缚它们的东西：双肘并在一起...
rows.raw: "\n\nOn instinct, you try moving your arms and [pc.legs], only to find that all of them are held in place too! You wriggle your arms and fingers, getting a feel for whatever’s holding them in place: joined at the elbows..."

rows.original: You pull timidly downwa-ach!
rows.translation: 你胆怯地向下拉-啊！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pull timidly downwa-ach!"

rows.original: ...and to your neck, it seems.
rows.translation: ...而且似乎还连着颈部。
rows.raw: "\n\n...and to your neck, it seems."

rows.original: “Cheo? Release,” says the voice, the sudden tension holding your head pushing it forward to face the mysterious speaker. Now you can see everything: the floor, your [pc.legs]
rows.translation: “切奥？放开，”那声音说道，固定你头部的张力突然将它推向前方，迫使你面对神秘发言者。现在你能看到一切：地面，你的[pc.legs]
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cheo? Release,” says the voice, the sudden tension holding your head pushing it forward to face the mysterious speaker. Now you can see everything: the floor, your [pc.legs] "

rows.original: coiled up in
rows.translation: 盘绕在
rows.raw: "coiled up in"

rows.original: spread apart underneath you and pinned down by
rows.translation: 分开在身体下方，并被压在
rows.raw: "spread apart underneath you and pinned down by"

rows.original: red rope, the stone floor you’re bound to. That rope forms a complex - looking bind, starting at your bare pelvis, stretched tightly across your [pc.belly] and then arrayed in a strange pattern across your [pc.chest].
rows.translation: 红绳中，还有束缚你的石质地板。绳索形成一道外观复杂的绑法，从赤裸骨盆开始，紧紧穿过[pc.belly]，再以奇怪图案排列在[pc.chest]上。
rows.raw: " red rope, the stone floor you’re bound to. That rope forms a complex - looking bind, starting at your bare pelvis, stretched tightly across your [pc.belly] and then arrayed in a strange pattern across your [pc.chest]."

rows.original: You’re fully bound and vulnerable.
rows.translation: 你被彻底束缚，毫无防备。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re fully bound and vulnerable."

rows.original: “Peek-a-boo, up here,” comes a melodious chide, your peripheral vision catching a hand gesturing for your attention. You follow the hand, some part of you hoping it will lead to where the voice is coming from.
rows.translation: “躲猫猫，看上面，”一道悦耳的责备声响起，你的周边视野捕捉到一只招手吸引注意的手掌。你顺着它望去，内心某个部分希望它会引向声音的来源。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Peek-a-boo, up here,” comes a melodious chide, your peripheral vision catching a hand gesturing for your attention. You follow the hand, some part of you hoping it will lead to where the voice is coming from."

rows.original: “Thaaaat’s it, eyes up,” says the voice, now given a form as your eyes lay upon your captor.
rows.translation: “就——是这样，抬起眼睛，”那个声音说道；你的双眼落在俘虏者身上，为它赋予了形体。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thaaaat’s it, eyes up,” says the voice, now given a form as your eyes lay upon your captor."

rows.original: She, whoever she is, sits on an archaic-looking chair made of wood and red silk. You’d be tempted to say ‘throne’ if it weren’t so oddly modest and small. The voice’s figure seems to ooze egoism and arrogance from her perch, however: a well-dressed and sophisticated femme fatale, perhaps in her 40’s, with long, black gloves and boots...
rows.translation: 她——无论她是谁——坐在一张外观古老、以木头和红绸制成的椅子上。如果它没有如此奇异地朴素小巧，你会想称其为‘王座’。然而，声音的主人坐在那里，似乎散发着自负与傲慢：一位穿着讲究、举止老练的蛇蝎美人，大概四十多岁，戴着黑色长手套与长靴...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe, whoever she is, sits on an archaic-looking chair made of wood and red silk. You’d be tempted to say ‘throne’ if it weren’t so oddly modest and small. The voice’s figure seems to ooze egoism and arrogance from her perch, however: a well-dressed and sophisticated femme fatale, perhaps in her 40’s, with long, black gloves and boots..."

rows.original: Wait no, cybernetics? You can make out the joints in her wrists, knuckles and ankles. Sleek and angular; instead of normal human feet, everything below the ankle turns into a stylized boot-shape with a pin-point heel.
rows.translation: 等等，不对，是义体？你能看清她手腕、指关节和脚踝处的关节。流线而棱角分明；脚踝以下并非普通人脚，而是化作带有针尖鞋跟的风格化靴子形状。
rows.raw: "\n\nWait no, cybernetics? You can make out the joints in her wrists, knuckles and ankles. Sleek and angular; instead of normal human feet, everything below the ankle turns into a stylized boot-shape with a pin-point heel."

rows.original: She taps her metallic fingers against her knee.
rows.translation: 她用金属手指轻敲膝盖。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe taps her metallic fingers against her knee."

rows.original: “Still with us? Let’s make things clear, then: your only danger is non-cooperation. I’ve a very willing cadre of throat-slitters on all sides of you; a few words is all they need. Don’t tempt them,” she states flatly, leaning her chin on her fist. “Just nod if you’re intending to play along.”
rows.translation: “还跟得上吗？那就说清楚：你唯一的危险是不肯合作。我在你四周布置了一群非常乐意割开喉咙的手下；他们只需要听到几个字。别诱惑他们，”她将下巴靠在拳头上，冷淡地说道。“如果打算配合，只需点头。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Still with us? Let’s make things clear, then: your only danger is non-cooperation. I’ve a very willing cadre of throat-slitters on all sides of you; a few words is all they need. Don’t tempt them,” she states flatly, leaning her chin on her fist. “Just nod if you’re intending to play along.”"

rows.original: You nod twice, your neck still stiff. You keep your eyes focused on the queen bee - her own gaze is an unwavering, deadpan stare right back at you.
rows.translation: 你的颈部仍然僵硬，却还是点了两次头。你始终注视着女王蜂——她也用坚定而面无表情的凝视回望你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod twice, your neck still stiff. You keep your eyes focused on the queen bee - her own gaze is an unwavering, deadpan stare right back at you."

rows.original: “Cheo? The gag,” she commands, unseen hands grappling some sort of lock on the back of your head. It slips easily out from your [pc.lipsChaste], a string of drool leaving in its wake. Fresh air hits your bone-dry throat and it makes you wince again.
rows.translation: “切奥？取下口塞，”她命令道，看不见的双手摆弄着你脑后某种锁扣。口塞轻易从[pc.lipsChaste]间滑出，身后拖着一串唾液。新鲜空气冲击干如枯骨的喉咙，让你再次畏缩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cheo? The gag,” she commands, unseen hands grappling some sort of lock on the back of your head. It slips easily out from your [pc.lipsChaste], a string of drool leaving in its wake. Fresh air hits your bone-dry throat and it makes you wince again."

rows.original: “Sooo, care to explain why you’ve been disrupting our business partners?” she enquires, an undercurrent of menace in her otherwise nonchalant tone.
rows.translation: “所——以，愿意解释为什么要干扰我们的商业伙伴吗？”她询问道，漫不经心的语气下暗藏威胁。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sooo, care to explain why you’ve been disrupting our business partners?” she enquires, an undercurrent of menace in her otherwise nonchalant tone."

rows.original: Business partners...? You only saw shady, illegal behaviour while hopping from hub to hub. By chance, you add. In all cases, it was civic duty.
rows.translation: 商业伙伴...？你从一个枢纽跳到另一个枢纽时，只看到可疑的非法行为。你补充说，自己只是碰巧遇见。所有情况都是出于公民义务。
rows.raw: "\n\nBusiness partners...? You only saw shady, illegal behaviour while hopping from hub to hub. By chance, you add. In all cases, it was civic duty."

rows.original: “Mm, ‘civic duty’ [pc.heShe] says,” chides the crime boss, idly playing with her jacket’s zipper. “Disrupting privately owned business is, at the very least, worthy of a stint in a white collar cell. And yet you chase our brothers through the streets of Tavros,
rows.translation: “嗯，‘公民义务’，[pc.heShe]是这么说的，”犯罪首领责备道，漫不经心地摆弄夹克拉链。“扰乱私人经营的生意，至少也值得进白领牢房待上一段时间。然而你却在塔夫罗斯街头追赶我们的兄弟，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mm, ‘civic duty’ [pc.heShe] says,” chides the crime boss, idly playing with her jacket’s zipper. “Disrupting privately owned business is, at the very least, worthy of a stint in a white collar cell. And yet you chase our brothers through the streets of Tavros, "

rows.original: beat another to the floor
rows.translation: 将另一人打倒在地
rows.raw: "beat another to the floor"

rows.original: challenged another to a fight
rows.translation: 向另一人发起挑战
rows.raw: "challenged another to a fight"

rows.original: and then
rows.translation: ，随后又
rows.raw: " and then "

rows.original: beat down two more operatives
rows.translation: 打倒两名特工
rows.raw: "beat down two more operatives"

rows.original: lost to two more operatives
rows.translation: 输给两名特工
rows.raw: "lost to two more operatives"

rows.original: later before willingly taking our open bait. Is this something along the lines of civic duty or the acts of a deranged lunatic? What were you thinking?” she asks, gently rubbing her forehead as she recounts every event.
rows.translation: ，最后还自愿踩进我们公开布置的诱饵。这算某种公民义务，还是疯狂恶人的行为？你到底在想什么？”她一边问，一边回忆每件事情，轻轻揉着额头。
rows.raw: " later before willingly taking our open bait. Is this something along the lines of civic duty or the acts of a deranged lunatic? What were you thinking?” she asks, gently rubbing her forehead as she recounts every event."

rows.original: Huh... there’s not really an answer to that.
rows.translation: 嗯...这个问题确实没有答案。
rows.raw: "\n\nHuh... there’s not really an answer to that. "

rows.original: You were just clicking buttons to see what would happen next!
rows.translation: 你当时只是在不停按按钮，想看看接下来会发生什么！
rows.raw: "You were just clicking buttons to see what would happen next!"

rows.original: You were following the threads and hoping to rely on yourself like always!
rows.translation: 你只是顺着线索走，还指望像往常一样全靠自己！
rows.raw: "You were following the threads and hoping to rely on yourself like always!"

rows.original: “Whatever answer you have doesn’t even matter, I have to decide on how to be rid of you,” she sighs, flicking her hair away from her face.
rows.translation: “不管你有什么答案都不重要，我得决定该怎么摆脱你，”她叹了口气，将头发从脸旁拨开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whatever answer you have doesn’t even matter, I have to decide on how to be rid of you,” she sighs, flicking her hair away from her face."

rows.original: Uhhh...
rows.raw: "Uhhh..."

rows.original: Uhhh...
rows.raw: "Uhhh..."

rows.original: Habeas corpus...?
rows.translation: 人身保护令...?
rows.raw: "Habeas corpus...?"

rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.translation: 醒醒醒醒.... 醒过来...!
rows.raw: "Waaaakkkke.... Uppppp...!"

rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.raw: "Waaaay....uhhhh...."

rows.translation: 那是啥...?
rows.raw: "Whatsat...?"

rows.translation: 那是啥...?
rows.raw: "Whatsat...?"

WHATCHU TALK BOU’ WILLIS
rows.translation: 你说啥呢，威利斯
rows.raw: " WHATCHU TALK BOU’ WILLIS"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: GAME OVER
rows.raw: "GAME OVER"

rows.original: Huh...?
Mmmhhh...
rows.translation: 嗯哼...
rows.raw: "Mmmhhh..."

rows.original: Hhhhuh...
rows.translation: 啊啊嗯...
rows.raw: "Hhhhuh..."

rows.original: Hhhhuh...
rows.translation: 啊啊嗯...
rows.raw: "Hhhhuh..."

rows.original: Mmmm...?
rows.raw: "Mmmm...?"

rows.original: Or at least a strong telling-off from the law...
rows.translation: 或者至少也该受法律一顿严厉训斥...
rows.raw: "Or at least a strong telling-off from the law..."

rows.original: As you approach the door, you wince as the bright lights of the connecting corridor seep into your eyes. You raise an arm to cover yourself, the image of the world around you seeming blurry and harsh...
rows.translation: 走近门口时，连接走廊里的强光刺入眼睛，让你不禁缩了缩。你抬起一条手臂挡住光线，周围的世界看起来模糊而刺眼...
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you approach the door, you wince as the bright lights of the connecting corridor seep into your eyes. You raise an arm to cover yourself, the image of the world around you seeming blurry and harsh..."

rows.original: There’s a swipp of air from behind thenBNNKKK
rows.translation: 身后的空气发出嗖的一声，接着砰咚
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a swipp of air from behind thenBNNKKK"

rows.original: Guhhh...
rows.translation: 呃啊...
rows.raw: "Guhhh..."

rows.original: Guhhh...
rows.translation: 呃啊...
rows.raw: "Guhhh..."

rows.original: Uuuunnhhh...
rows.translation: 呜嗯...
rows.raw: "Uuuunnhhh..."

rows.original: Investigate
rows.translation: 调查
rows.raw: "Investigate"

rows.original: You know, the last few times you did this, they all got away in the end. They might not be so elusive this time around. But you’re gonna do it anyway, right? Ya big ol’ space hero, you.
rows.translation: 你瞧，前几次这么做时，他们最后全逃掉了。这回他们或许没那么难抓。不过你无论如何都会去做，对吧？你这个了不起的太空大英雄。
rows.raw: "You know, the last few times you did this, they all got away in the end. They might not be so elusive this time around. But you’re gonna do it anyway, right? Ya big ol’ space hero, you."

rows.original: You spot a short male human in a very pristine suit standing behind an elaborate display of weapon models. While at first it seems to be a haphazard shop, it appears to merely be a stand for advertising wares: actual weapon selling would be a difficult thing to do on Tavros. The representative you remember is still there, smiling away as punters stop to look at catalogues and weapon models. He spots you and gives a friendly wave. You could visit Akane at any time if you speak to him, it looks like.
rows.translation: 你看到一名身材矮小的人类男子站在一座精致的武器模型展台后，身上穿着一套极其整洁的西装。这里乍看像是一间随意拼凑的商店，实际上似乎只是个商品宣传摊位：要在塔夫罗斯真正售卖武器可不容易。你记得的那名代表仍在那里，每当顾客停下来翻阅目录、查看武器模型时，他都会笑脸相迎。他发现你后友好地挥了挥手。看来只要找他交谈，你随时都能去见茜。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spot a short male human in a very pristine suit standing behind an elaborate display of weapon models. While at first it seems to be a haphazard shop, it appears to merely be a stand for advertising wares: actual weapon selling would be a difficult thing to do on Tavros. The representative you remember is still there, smiling away as punters stop to look at catalogues and weapon models. He spots you and gives a friendly wave. You could visit Akane at any time if you speak to him, it looks like."

rows.original: However, as you walk up to him, he raises his hand in a ‘stop’ sort of motion.
rows.translation: 然而，当你走到他面前时，他抬起一只手，做了个类似‘停下’的动作。
rows.raw: " However, as you walk up to him, he raises his hand in a ‘stop’ sort of motion."

rows.original: <i>“Ah, the boss is resting for today. You may return the next day,
rows.translation: <i>“啊，老板今天正在休息。您可以明天再来，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Ah, the boss is resting for today. You may return the next day, "

rows.original: Mister
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mister"

rows.original: Miss
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Miss"

rows.original: Steele,” he says in a flat voice, still wearing that smile.
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔，”他语气平淡地说道，脸上仍挂着那副笑容。
rows.raw: " Steele,” he says in a flat voice, still wearing that smile."

rows.original: Well shit, guess she tires out easily.
rows.translation: 真他妈的，看来她很容易累。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell shit, guess she tires out easily."

rows.original: To The Lair
rows.translation: 前往巢穴
rows.raw: "To The Lair"

rows.original: To The Lair
rows.translation: 前往巢穴
rows.raw: "To The Lair"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: As you walk to the stand, the rep meets you halfway, all smiles and clasped hands.
rows.translation: 你走向展台时，那名代表满面笑容、双手交握地迎了上来。
rows.raw: "As you walk to the stand, the rep meets you halfway, all smiles and clasped hands. "

rows.original: You feel your nose wrinkle as you anticipate going to the hideout again: all this secrecy...
rows.translation: 一想到又要前往藏身处，你的鼻子便不由得皱起：这整套保密措施...
rows.raw: "You feel your nose wrinkle as you anticipate going to the hideout again: all this secrecy..."

rows.original: You greet him with a small wave, less phased by the usual procedure of getting to and from Akane’s abode.
rows.translation: 你轻轻挥手向他问候，已经没那么在意往返茜住处的惯常流程。
rows.raw: "You greet him with a small wave, less phased by the usual procedure of getting to and from Akane’s abode."

rows.original: Akane is a human female, the boss of a crime syndicate in her early-to-mid 40’s at a guess. She stands at around 6' in height - give or take an inch - with a slender, well-toned gymnasts frame. Currently, she sits with folded legs and a watchful eye on a ‘throne’ of sorts, one with a simplistic and authentic design. It’s made of real, dark brown wood and perfectly straight in all observable proportions with the only decoration being a red backrest.
rows.translation: 茜是一名人类女性，也是一位犯罪集团的首领，看起来约莫四十出头到四十五岁。她身高大约六英尺，上下误差不超过一英寸，体态修长，拥有体操运动员般匀称结实的身材。此刻，她正双腿交叠坐在一张类似‘王座’的椅子上，警觉地观察着四周；那张椅子的设计简洁而古朴，由真正的深棕色木材制成，目之所及的每一处都笔直端正，唯一的装饰就是红色靠背。
rows.raw: "Akane is a human female, the boss of a crime syndicate in her early-to-mid 40’s at a guess. She stands at around 6' in height - give or take an inch - with a slender, well-toned gymnasts frame. Currently, she sits with folded legs and a watchful eye on a ‘throne’ of sorts, one with a simplistic and authentic design. It’s made of real, dark brown wood and perfectly straight in all observable proportions with the only decoration being a red backrest."

rows.original: Akane herself is anything but just an old piece of furniture, however.
rows.translation: 不过，茜本人绝不只是一件老家具。
rows.raw: "\n\nAkane herself is anything but just an old piece of furniture, however."

rows.original: Her face is structurally flat and perfectly symmetrical with high cheekbones and narrow eyes. Her skin is a gentle pale tone and only slightly affected by her age: some crow’s feet and the odd wrinkle. Old Terran definitions would have her placed as Eastern Asian, although such definitions are blurred in this day and age.
rows.translation: 她的脸部轮廓平坦而完美对称，颧骨高耸，双眼狭长。她的肤色柔和白皙，岁月只在上面留下些许痕迹：几道鱼尾纹，偶尔可见一两条皱纹。按照古代地球人的定义，她应当属于东亚人，不过到了如今这个时代，这类定义早已变得模糊。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer face is structurally flat and perfectly symmetrical with high cheekbones and narrow eyes. Her skin is a gentle pale tone and only slightly affected by her age: some crow’s feet and the odd wrinkle. Old Terran definitions would have her placed as Eastern Asian, although such definitions are blurred in this day and age."

rows.original: Her jet black hair is silky smooth, wavy and glossy and cut sharply to about chin length on her left side. Where you would expect hair follicles on the right side, there is a web of scar tissue consistent with cuts and lacerations going from her right ear down to her right collarbone. All of the healed-over marks are made of erratic, angular and deep looking patterns. Said ear seems surprisingly undamaged and appears to be modded into an elvish, pointed shape. Instead of one prong, there are three and they all have a slight upward flick towards the tips, making her right ear look ‘wing-like’.
rows.translation: 她乌黑的头发如丝般顺滑，带着波浪和光泽，左侧利落地剪至下巴附近。本该在右侧长有毛发的部位，却覆盖着一道道与刀割和撕裂伤相符的疤痕组织，从右耳一直延伸至右侧锁骨。所有愈合的痕迹都呈现出凌乱、棱角分明而且看起来很深的纹路。令人意外的是，那只耳朵似乎并未受损，还被改造成了精灵般的尖耳形状。耳尖并非一根尖角，而是分成三叉，每一叉末端都略微上翘，使她的右耳看起来犹如‘翅膀’。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer jet black hair is silky smooth, wavy and glossy and cut sharply to about chin length on her left side. Where you would expect hair follicles on the right side, there is a web of scar tissue consistent with cuts and lacerations going from her right ear down to her right collarbone. All of the healed-over marks are made of erratic, angular and deep looking patterns. Said ear seems surprisingly undamaged and appears to be modded into an elvish, pointed shape. Instead of one prong, there are three and they all have a slight upward flick towards the tips, making her right ear look ‘wing-like’."

rows.original: Her eyes dart around you from time to time, as if sizing you up every few minutes. They’re colored a plain shade of black and give little away.
rows.translation: 她的目光不时在你身上游移，仿佛每隔几分钟就要重新估量你一遍。那双眼睛是纯粹的黑色，几乎不透露任何情绪。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer eyes dart around you from time to time, as if sizing you up every few minutes. They’re colored a plain shade of black and give little away."

rows.original: Aside a light application of crimson lipstick, she wears no makeup.
rows.translation: 除了一层浅浅的绯红唇膏，她没有化任何妆。
rows.raw: "\n\nAside a light application of crimson lipstick, she wears no makeup."

rows.original: What draws your eyes more and more are her cybernetic augmentations. From elbow to fingertip and from knee to toe, sleek and seamless black replacements make up the rest of her limbs. They almost seem realistic, aside from the obvious joints and pivots. Instead of typical human feet and legs, her robo-limbs form pseudo-boots with angular arched heels about 4" high, giving her a stylish edge on top of pinpoint footing balance. When traversing, she moves with grace and precision; the added effect of the heels pushing her hips out with each step is just a small bonus.
rows.translation: 真正一再吸引你目光的，是她身上的义体强化装置。从手肘到指尖，从膝盖到脚趾，光滑无缝的黑色义肢构成了她四肢的其余部分。除了那些显眼的关节和转轴，它们几乎与真正的肢体无异。她的机械腿脚并非典型的人类形态，而是形成了一双仿靴结构，配有约四英寸高、棱角分明的弓形鞋跟，既为她增添时髦锋芒，也带来极其精准的立足平衡。行走时，她的动作优雅而精确；鞋跟令她每走一步都会将臀部向外摆动，不过只是附带的小小好处。
rows.raw: '\n\nWhat draws your eyes more and more are her cybernetic augmentations. From elbow to fingertip and from knee to toe, sleek and seamless black replacements make up the rest of her limbs. They almost seem realistic, aside from the obvious joints and pivots. Instead of typical human feet and legs, her robo-limbs form pseudo-boots with angular arched heels about 4" high, giving her a stylish edge on top of pinpoint footing balance. When traversing, she moves with grace and precision; the added effect of the heels pushing her hips out with each step is just a small bonus.'

rows.original: In terms of outfit, Akane wears a short, sleeveless dress much like an ancient qipao. It’s made of thin silver fabric and patterned with pink and red draconic designs. On top of that is a short, black leather jacket cut at the diaphragm, the sleeves only extending to her prosthetic elbows. The end effect would normally make one believe she was wearing long gloves.
rows.translation: 服装方面，茜穿着一件类似古代旗袍的无袖短裙。轻薄的银色布料上饰有粉红与红色的龙纹。外面又罩着一件下摆裁至横膈膜位置的黑色短皮夹克，袖子只延伸到她的义肢手肘。整体效果通常会让人以为她戴着一副长手套。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn terms of outfit, Akane wears a short, sleeveless dress much like an ancient qipao. It’s made of thin silver fabric and patterned with pink and red draconic designs. On top of that is a short, black leather jacket cut at the diaphragm, the sleeves only extending to her prosthetic elbows. The end effect would normally make one believe she was wearing long gloves."

rows.original: Underneath all this, her body is slender but not slim, detailed with muscle but built more like a gymnast or acrobat. A mild amount of ab detail shines through her thin dress, although little else does.
rows.translation: 在这一身装束之下，她身材纤长却不单薄，肌肉线条清晰，但体型更像体操运动员或杂技演员。薄薄的裙料间隐约透出些许腹肌轮廓，除此之外便几乎看不出什么了。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnderneath all this, her body is slender but not slim, detailed with muscle but built more like a gymnast or acrobat. A mild amount of ab detail shines through her thin dress, although little else does."

rows.original: Her chest barely seems to reach a B-cup and her jacket adds modesty. Although some natural curve exists on her, she is on the lanky side of things.
rows.translation: 她的胸部似乎勉强达到B罩杯，外套又令其显得颇为端庄。虽然她身上确实存在些许自然曲线，但整体还是偏瘦长。

rows.original: You have a glance over her folded legs, thinking about what feminine allurement lies in between... only to have her own gaze intercept yours with an unflinching and knowing stare.
rows.translation: 你瞥了一眼她交叠的双腿，思索着其中藏着怎样的女性魅力...可她的视线却正好截住了你的目光，毫不退缩地凝视着你，仿佛早已看穿一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have a glance over her folded legs, thinking about what feminine allurement lies in between... only to have her own gaze intercept yours with an unflinching and knowing stare."

rows.raw: "“Wait, you went through all that just to... say you don’t want to be here? Eugh... fine, Cheo, Yan, show [pc.himHer] out, I wonder if time away will open [pc.himHer] up,” she says curtly, apparently having lost interest in you already."

rows.original: Her two attendants approach you with that same old blindfold. With a sigh, you stand ready and close your eyes, the blindfold then comfortably tightening around your head.

rows.raw: "\n\nHer two attendants approach you with that same old blindfold. With a sigh, you stand ready and close your eyes, the blindfold then comfortably tightening around your head."

rows.translation: 他们领着你穿过那片由门扉、走廊与怪异转角组成的曲折迷宫，很快便将你送回塔夫罗斯站商业层。
rows.raw: "\n\nLed back through the winding maze of doors, corridors and odd angles, you’re quickly put out onto the Tavros merchants deck."

rows.raw: "As you’re walked through the doors, the same old sights of artisan rock pools and a view of the throne greet you."

rows.original: Instead of waiting for you to be lead to the center, you hear Akane’s telltale click-clacking heels approaching you.
rows.translation: 还没等你被带到中央，你便听见茜那标志性的鞋跟咔哒声向你靠近。
rows.raw: "\n\nInstead of waiting for you to be lead to the center, you hear Akane’s telltale click-clacking heels approaching you."

rows.original: “Hold it, let me see [pc.himHer],” she asserts, the sounds of much heavier feet moving away from you as hers come closer.
rows.translation: “停下，让我看看[pc.himHer]。”她不容置疑地说道。随着她逐渐靠近，一阵沉重得多的脚步声则从你身边离去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hold it, let me see [pc.himHer],” she asserts, the sounds of much heavier feet moving away from you as hers come closer."

rows.original: You wait patiently while she presumably eyes you over, adjusting your posture to allow her a better view. You hear her move from side to side then behind you, all the while ummming-and-arring with her own thoughts.
rows.translation: 你耐心等待着她大概是在打量你，同时调整姿势，好让她看得更清楚。你听见她从一侧走到另一侧，随后又绕到你身后，始终一边思考，一边发出犹疑不定的低吟。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wait patiently while she presumably eyes you over, adjusting your posture to allow her a better view. You hear her move from side to side then behind you, all the while ummming-and-arring with her own thoughts."

rows.original: Seemingly from nowhere, cold fingertips latch onto your [pc.face] and the sharp, overwhelming energy of Akane’s ‘touch’ sears itself into your nerves!
rows.translation: 仿佛凭空出现一般，冰冷的指尖扣住你的[pc.face]，茜的‘触碰’所带来的尖锐而压倒性的能量瞬间灼入你的神经！
rows.raw: "\n\nSeemingly from nowhere, cold fingertips latch onto your [pc.face] and the sharp, overwhelming energy of Akane’s ‘touch’ sears itself into your nerves!"

rows.original: Your body reacts before your mind does as everything seems to freeze in place. Instead of buckling in a pile, you stand firm and in place as the ephemeral current blazes through your [pc.skinFurScales].
rows.translation: 你的身体先于意识作出反应，一切仿佛都冻结在原处。你没有瘫倒成一团，而是牢牢站在原地，任由那道转瞬即逝的电流在你的[pc.skinFurScales]中熊熊穿行。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour body reacts before your mind does as everything seems to freeze in place. Instead of buckling in a pile, you stand firm and in place as the ephemeral current blazes through your [pc.skinFurScales]."

rows.original: In a flash, it ends. Akane’s warmed fingertips slip away from your head.
rows.translation: 一闪之间，一切便结束了。茜已经温热起来的指尖从你头上滑开。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn a flash, it ends. Akane’s warmed fingertips slip away from your head."

rows.original: You lean forward out of reflex, whining with orgiastic agony as that touch - that pure feeling - that Akane provides cuts you on the deepest level. You almost can’t tell where pain ends and pleasure begins...
rows.translation: 你本能地向前倾去，在高潮般的痛苦中呜咽。那种触感，那种纯粹的感觉，茜所给予的一切，都在最深处撕裂着你。你几乎分不清痛苦止于何处，快感又始于何处...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean forward out of reflex, whining with orgiastic agony as that touch - that pure feeling - that Akane provides cuts you on the deepest level. You almost can’t tell where pain ends and pleasure begins..."

rows.original: “Perfect...” comes her murmur from behind. You feel the cooling metal of fingers rest upon your shoulders, a gentle squeeze following. Your body almost shivers as she does, the anticipation for a loving shock forcing you to react to... nothing.
rows.translation: “完美...”她的呢喃从身后传来。你感到金属手指的凉意落在肩头，随后轻轻一捏。你的身体几乎随之颤抖，期待着那充满爱意的电击，结果迎来的却是...什么也没有。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perfect...” comes her murmur from behind. You feel the cooling metal of fingers rest upon your shoulders, a gentle squeeze following. Your body almost shivers as she does, the anticipation for a loving shock forcing you to react to... nothing."

rows.original: Just the soft squeeze of her fingers.
rows.translation: 只有她手指轻柔的挤压。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust the soft squeeze of her fingers."

rows.original: “There, there, I think that reaction speaks on its own, hm? That little shiver of expectation, the way your fingers curl...” whispers the domme into your ear, a knowing tone to her words.
rows.translation: “好了，好了，我想这个反应已经说明一切了，对吧？那因期待而起的小小颤抖，还有你蜷起手指的样子...”这位女主人在你耳边低语，语气中满是了然。
rows.raw: "\n\n“There, there, I think that reaction speaks on its own, hm? That little shiver of expectation, the way your fingers curl...” whispers the domme into your ear, a knowing tone to her words."

rows.original: Her fingertip lands on your right temple and slides against your [pc.skinFurScales]. Taken unawares, the intense, pinpoint pain that you remember returns and spreads throughout your mind.
rows.translation: 她的指尖落在你右侧太阳穴上，沿着你的[pc.skinFurScales]滑动。猝不及防之下，你记忆中那强烈而集中的痛苦再度袭来，并蔓延至整个意识。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer fingertip lands on your right temple and slides against your [pc.skinFurScales]. Taken unawares, the intense, pinpoint pain that you remember returns and spreads throughout your mind."

rows.original: And you want more.
rows.translation: 而你还想要更多。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd you want more."

Normally his room wouldn’t be too grand - which isn’t hard to believe with how shabby the board hall is - but in your drunken stupor it might as well be the biggest fucking mansion in the land. The bed is big enough for a king as far as you’re concerned, pulling free of Alex and collapsing into it."

rows.original: And passing out...
rows.translation: 然后昏睡过去...
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd passing out..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: BubbleLord
rows.raw: "BubbleLord"

rows.original: The humming buzz of an alarm eventually wakes you, propping yourself up quickly and looking around for Alex. All you find is a note alongside some of your equipment.
rows.translation: 闹钟的嗡鸣声终于将你唤醒。你迅速撑起身体，四下寻找亚历克斯，却只在自己的部分装备旁边发现一张纸条。
rows.raw: "The humming buzz of an alarm eventually wakes you, propping yourself up quickly and looking around for Alex. All you find is a note alongside some of your equipment."

rows.original: “Hey there. I went through some of your things so I could learn your name... my bad on that. I guess we drank a little too much, huh? Don’t worry, we didn’t do anything and I didn’t do anything to you. I’m heading down to the bar to catch a meal or a drink, maybe watch some funny videos. Anyway, catch you later. - A.”
rows.translation: “你好啊。我翻了翻你的东西，好弄清你的名字...这件事算我不对。我想我们都喝得有点太多了，对吧？别担心，我们什么都没做，我也没有对你做任何事。我正准备下楼去酒吧吃点东西或喝上一杯，也许再看看搞笑视频。 总之，回头见。亚。”
rows.raw: " “Hey there. I went through some of your things so I could learn your name... my bad on that. I guess we drank a little too much, huh? Don’t worry, we didn’t do anything and I didn’t do anything to you. I’m heading down to the bar to catch a meal or a drink, maybe watch some funny videos. Anyway, catch you later. - A.”"

rows.original: Well, that explains that. After sharing a drink with the guy it’s not like you’re random strangers at least. Making your way out his room - the door humming locked behind you - and down the stairs, you can see he’s definitely at his normal spot at the bar. He actually seems to be checking a small tablet-like device; maybe some version of your codex?
rows.translation: 好吧，这就解释得通了。你和这家伙一起喝过酒，至少不再是完全陌生的人。你走出他的房间，门在身后嗡鸣着锁上，随后下楼，看见他果然待在酒吧里的老位置。他似乎正在查看一台小型平板设备；也许是某种版本的个人终端？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that explains that. After sharing a drink with the guy it’s not like you’re random strangers at least. Making your way out his room - the door humming locked behind you - and down the stairs, you can see he’s definitely at his normal spot at the bar. He actually seems to be checking a small tablet-like device; maybe some version of your codex?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: His Place
rows.translation: 他的住处
rows.raw: "His Place"

rows.original: Well, if he’s offering a place to stay...
rows.translation: 嗯，既然他愿意提供住处...
rows.raw: "Well, if he’s offering a place to stay..."

rows.original: Stay w/ Sel
rows.translation: 与塞勒茜同住
rows.raw: "Stay w/ Sel"

rows.original: BubbleLord
rows.raw: "BubbleLord"

rows.original: That sounds really nice but you think you know a special gal who can take really good care of you. Sellesy eventually makes her way over and Alex quickly pays for the drinks before closing in and giving you a perhaps too obvious wink.
rows.translation: 听起来真的很不错，但你觉得自己认识一位特别的姑娘，能把你照顾得非常周到。塞勒茜终于走了过来，亚历克斯迅速付清酒钱，随后凑近你，冲你眨了个也许太过明显的眼。
rows.raw: "That sounds really nice but you think you know a special gal who can take really good care of you. Sellesy eventually makes her way over and Alex quickly pays for the drinks before closing in and giving you a perhaps too obvious wink."

rows.original: “Good luck - hic! - killer; make sure you - hic! - treat her right!”
rows.translation: “祝你好运，嗝！，高手；一定要，嗝！，好好对她！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good luck - hic! - killer; make sure you - hic! - treat her right!”"

rows.original: Oh, you’re gonna! You and her are going to have the bestest night!
rows.translation: 哦，你当然会！你和她将会度过最最棒的一晚！
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, you’re gonna! You and her are going to have the bestest night!"

rows.original: While Alex stumbles away, you sink into Sellesy with a pleased and needy nuzzling. The three-breasted waitress bites her lower lip and gently embraces you. She’s so warm and confident, radiating in the chance to hold you nice and close.
rows.translation: 亚历克斯踉跄离去时，你满怀愉悦与渴望地依偎进塞勒茜怀中。这位三乳女侍咬着下唇，温柔地拥抱你。她的身体如此温暖，神态如此自信，能够将你紧紧搂在怀里的机会令她容光焕发。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile Alex stumbles away, you sink into Sellesy with a pleased and needy nuzzling. The three-breasted waitress bites her lower lip and gently embraces you. She’s so warm and confident, radiating in the chance to hold you nice and close."

rows.original: “I’m glad you stuck around... maybe we can get you some more ‘drinks’ back up at my place... free of charge for such a good [pc.boyGirl], mm?”
rows.translation: “真高兴你留了下来...也许我们可以回我住的地方，再给你来几杯‘饮料’...像你这么乖的[pc.boyGirl]，当然免费，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m glad you stuck around... maybe we can get you some more ‘drinks’ back up at my place... free of charge for such a good [pc.boyGirl], mm?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Stay with Sellesy
rows.translation: 与塞勒茜同住
rows.raw: "Stay with Sellesy"

rows.original: You’ve got everything you need for now; Sellesy can take care of you.
rows.translation: 你目前需要的一切都已经有了；塞勒茜会照顾好你。
rows.raw: "You’ve got everything you need for now; Sellesy can take care of you."

rows.original: Head Home
rows.translation: 回家
rows.raw: "Head Home"

rows.original: BubbleLord
rows.raw: "BubbleLord"

rows.original: “Oh - hic! - alright! Swing by later, you... you uh... hic!.. uh... you.”
rows.raw: "“Oh - hic! - alright! Swing by later, you... you uh... hic!.. uh... you.”"

rows.original: Pft. Alex is drunk. But you’re both drinking buddies and probably not in too much better a state. Waiting for him to handle the payment and waving goodbye to your busty waitress, you stumble to your feet and set off. Hopefully you can make it back to your ship before you pass out!
rows.translation: 噗。亚历克斯喝醉了。不过你们已经是酒友，而且你的状态大概也好不到哪里去。等他付完账，又向丰满的女侍挥手道别后，你摇摇晃晃地站起来，踏上归途。希望你能在昏倒之前赶回自己的飞船！
rows.raw: "\n\nPft. Alex is drunk. But you’re both drinking buddies and probably not in too much better a state. Waiting for him to handle the payment and waving goodbye to your busty waitress, you stumble to your feet and set off. Hopefully you can make it back to your ship before you pass out!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Head Home
rows.translation: 回家
rows.raw: "Head Home"

rows.original: You’ve had a bit more to drink than you’d like to admit; you’re going to turn back in and call it a night on your ship.
rows.translation: 你喝下的酒比自己愿意承认的还要多一点；你准备返回飞船，今晚就此休息。
rows.raw: "You’ve had a bit more to drink than you’d like to admit; you’re going to turn back in and call it a night on your ship."

rows.original: BubbleLord
rows.raw: "BubbleLord"

rows.original: You wish you had the time but you’ll have to take a raincheck. He wants those drinks to be well-spent, right?
rows.translation: 你希望自己有时间赴约，但这次只能改日再说了。他也希望那些酒喝得值当，对吧？
rows.raw: "You wish you had the time but you’ll have to take a raincheck. He wants those drinks to be well-spent, right?"

rows.original: “Oh, I see!” Brushing his locks carefully out of his face and winking, he gives a dismissive tilt of his head toward the open floor. “Well, don’t forget you and me have a date... or at least a chance to get a little booze our systems, mmm?”
rows.translation: “哦，我明白了！”他小心地把发丝拨开，不让它们挡住脸，又冲你眨了眨眼，随后朝空旷的楼面漫不经心地偏了偏头。“嗯，别忘了你和我还有个约会...或者至少还有机会往肚子里灌点酒，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I see!” Brushing his locks carefully out of his face and winking, he gives a dismissive tilt of his head toward the open floor. “Well, don’t forget you and me have a date... or at least a chance to get a little booze our systems, mmm?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: BubbleLord
rows.raw: "BubbleLord"

rows.original: “Alright then,” he pauses and seems to contemplate ordering one of the waitresses over for a drink but instead waves his hand dismissively in front of his face. “Just don’t ask anything too boring, alright?”
rows.translation: “那好吧。”他停顿片刻，似乎在考虑叫一名女侍过来点杯酒，却只是满不在乎地在面前挥了挥手。“只要别问太无聊的问题就行，好吗？”
rows.raw: "“Alright then,” he pauses and seems to contemplate ordering one of the waitresses over for a drink but instead waves his hand dismissively in front of his face. “Just don’t ask anything too boring, alright?”"

rows.original: Him
rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "Him"

rows.original: BubbleLord
rows.raw: "BubbleLord"

rows.original: “About me, huh?”
rows.translation: “想问我的事，是吗？”
rows.raw: "“About me, huh?”"

rows.original: Alex’s eyes show his contemplation better than his body language does, his fingers curling in close before he settles his fist against the bottom of his chin and tucks the other arm beneath it to hold himself up.
rows.translation: 亚历克斯眼中的思索比肢体动作表现得更加明显。他的手指向内蜷曲，随后将拳头抵在下巴底部，另一条手臂则托在下面支撑身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlex’s eyes show his contemplation better than his body language does, his fingers curling in close before he settles his fist against the bottom of his chin and tucks the other arm beneath it to hold himself up."

rows.original: “Well... I’m a salesman first and foremost. They don’t just make smiles like mine without tons of practice, you know?” He flashes the very same smile your way to emphasize his point. “But more specifically, I was the best. Aegis picked me to take on the task of managing sales out here... until about my second day on the station anyway.”
rows.translation: “嗯...首先，我最主要的身份是推销员。你知道吗，不经过大量练习，可练不出我这样的笑容。”为了强调自己的观点，他对你露出了一模一样的笑容。“不过说得更具体些，我曾经是最棒的。神盾选中我负责这里的销售工作...至少在我登站后的第二天以前是这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well... I’m a salesman first and foremost. They don’t just make smiles like mine without tons of practice, you know?” He flashes the very same smile your way to emphasize his point. “But more specifically, I was the best. Aegis picked me to take on the task of managing sales out here... until about my second day on the station anyway.”"

rows.original: Alex lets his hand lower and instead turns his attention toward the counter and one of the waitresses.
rows.translation: 亚历克斯放下手，转而把注意力投向柜台和其中一名女侍。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlex lets his hand lower and instead turns his attention toward the counter and one of the waitresses."

rows.original: “The original manager decided they liked their desk job more and they picked the next best person. I can’t imagine how many of those egg heads were angry about hiring someone from the work floor but they’ll have to live with it. I always wanted to get out and explore though. That’s why I’ve been saving my money by living in a place like this.”
rows.translation: “原来的经理觉得自己更喜欢坐办公室，于是他们选了第二优秀的人接任。我都无法想象，那些书呆子会因为从一线员工里提拔了一个人而气成什么样，不过他们只能接受。我倒是一直想出去探索，所以才住在这种地方攒钱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The original manager decided they liked their desk job more and they picked the next best person. I can’t imagine how many of those egg heads were angry about hiring someone from the work floor but they’ll have to live with it. I always wanted to get out and explore though. That’s why I’ve been saving my money by living in a place like this.”"

rows.original: So he’s frugal and actually enjoys his job?
rows.translation: 所以他生活节俭，而且真的喜欢自己的工作？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo he’s frugal and actually enjoys his job?"

rows.original: “I never said that,” he snaps - almost bordering on anger - but hastily buries it with an instinctual flash of his stunning smile. “I just... well, who wouldn’t want to spend their best years travelling to hardly-explored space and meeting all sorts of interesting characters like you, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: “我可没这么说。”他厉声说道，几乎已经带上怒意，却又本能地露出那副迷人笑容，匆忙将怒气掩埋。“我只是...嗯，谁不想把最美好的年华花在前往鲜有人探索的太空旅行上，再结识像你这样形形色色的有趣人物呢，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I never said that,” he snaps - almost bordering on anger - but hastily buries it with an instinctual flash of his stunning smile. “I just... well, who wouldn’t want to spend their best years travelling to hardly-explored space and meeting all sorts of interesting characters like you, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: Alex reaches over and gently pats your shoulder.
rows.translation: 亚历克斯伸手轻轻拍了拍你的肩膀。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlex reaches over and gently pats your shoulder."

rows.original: “If I can meet a Steele then there really is no telling what sort of fun and sex I can have out here, yeah?”
rows.translation: “既然连斯蒂尔家的人都能遇见，那我在这里还能享受多少乐趣和性爱，实在谁也说不准，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If I can meet a Steele then there really is no telling what sort of fun and sex I can have out here, yeah?”"

rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "Him"

rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "Him"

rows.translation: 你最近才问过这件事。
rows.raw: "You just recently asked about this."

rows.original: Him
rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "Him"

rows.original: You want to know more about Alex.
rows.translation: 你想更深入地了解亚历克斯。
rows.raw: "You want to know more about Alex."

rows.original: Aegis
rows.translation: 神盾
rows.raw: "Aegis"

rows.original: BubbleLord
rows.raw: "BubbleLord"

rows.original: “Definitely not the sales pitch but... Aegis sells pretty much everything when you really get down to it. I actually really like that about it.”
rows.translation: “这肯定不算推销话术，不过...归根结底，神盾几乎什么都卖。其实我真的很喜欢这一点。”
rows.raw: "“Definitely not the sales pitch but... Aegis sells pretty much everything when you really get down to it. I actually really like that about it.”"

rows.original: Alex slips his hand back and gives himself a soft spank and winks at you.
rows.translation: 亚历克斯把手伸到身后，轻轻拍了一下自己的屁股，又冲你眨了眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlex slips his hand back and gives himself a soft spank and winks at you."

rows.original: “Enough to give myself this tattoo, at least.”
rows.translation: “至少喜欢到让我给自己纹了这个纹身。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Enough to give myself this tattoo, at least.”"

rows.original: Aegis sells a lot huh? You’ve heard they had a big catalog but that’s not very different from most companies and corporations. What makes Aegis so special to make them stand out and grow so much? Your questions need answers!
rows.translation: 神盾卖的东西很多，是吗？你听说他们的产品目录十分庞大，但这与大多数企业和公司似乎也没什么区别。神盾到底有什么特别之处，能让它脱颖而出并发展到如此规模？你的问题需要答案！
rows.raw: "\n\nAegis sells a lot huh? You’ve heard they had a big catalog but that’s not very different from most companies and corporations. What makes Aegis so special to make them stand out and grow so much? Your questions need answers!"

rows.original: “For starters, it’s mainly quality,” Alex raises a finger and then immediately a second. “Secondly, it’s service. Aegis might not make the toughest ships but we have a reputation for having some of the best service around and a high quality mark. Yachts and exploration ships are really popular... though the latter is more often sold to rich upstarts.”
rows.translation: “首先，主要原因是品质。”亚历克斯竖起一根手指，紧接着又竖起第二根。“其次是服务。神盾制造的飞船也许不是最坚固的，但我们的服务堪称一流，而且品质口碑也很出色。游艇和探索船都非常受欢迎...不过后者更多是卖给那些富有的新贵。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“For starters, it’s mainly quality,” Alex raises a finger and then immediately a second. “Secondly, it’s service. Aegis might not make the toughest ships but we have a reputation for having some of the best service around and a high quality mark. Yachts and exploration ships are really popular... though the latter is more often sold to rich upstarts.”"

rows.original: Grabbing his tablet and hefting it up, his smile fades in an act of unusually somberness from your drinking buddy.
rows.translation: 他拿起平板并将其举起，酒友脸上的笑容消失了，露出一种少见的严肃神情。
rows.raw: "\n\nGrabbing his tablet and hefting it up, his smile fades in an act of unusually somberness from your drinking buddy."

rows.original: “Of course, the things we package on our yachts are also just as popular; protection equipment for example. People love to joke that we use the armor meant for our ships on all of that stuff instead... but the truth is that it’s just easier to make things like our lightning dusters than a warship. And when you’re looking for a luxury ship, you’re definitely not looking for protection. Let one of the other lugs worry about all that.
rows.translation: “当然，我们为游艇配套的产品也同样受欢迎，比如防护装备。大家总喜欢开玩笑，说我们把原本要给飞船用的装甲全拿去做那些东西了...但事实是，闪电风衣这类产品本来就比军舰更容易制造。而且当你在选购豪华飞船时，你绝对不会把防护性能放在首位。那种事交给其他蠢货操心就好。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, the things we package on our yachts are also just as popular; protection equipment for example. People love to joke that we use the armor meant for our ships on all of that stuff instead... but the truth is that it’s just easier to make things like our lightning dusters than a warship. And when you’re looking for a luxury ship, you’re definitely not looking for protection. Let one of the other lugs worry about all that. "

rows.original: Aegis Shipyards can just give you some solid guns and armor to keep you safe when those nasty pirates board you to try and get the goods aboard your ship instead. Blowing you up isn’t really an option if they don’t get their loot, right?”
rows.translation: 神盾造船厂只需给你提供一些可靠的枪械和护甲，让那些讨厌的海盗登船抢夺货物时，你能保护自己就行。要是炸毁了你，他们也拿不到战利品，对吧？”
rows.raw: "Aegis Shipyards can just give you some solid guns and armor to keep you safe when those nasty pirates board you to try and get the goods aboard your ship instead. Blowing you up isn’t really an option if they don’t get their loot, right?”"

rows.translation: 无论是推销话术还是其他内容，亚历克斯能告诉你哪些关于神盾的事？
rows.raw: "What can Alex tell you about Aegis, sales pitch or otherwise?"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: BubbleLord
rows.raw: "BubbleLord"

rows.original: Five feet and eleven inches of androgyny, Alex is an ideal definition of a pretty boy. Smooth, creamy chocolate-colored skin and just enough muscle tone catches every bit of light just right to help accent the masculine touches of his body.
rows.translation: 亚历克斯身高五英尺十一英寸，一身中性气质，完美诠释了什么叫美少年。他拥有光滑细腻的巧克力色肌肤，恰到好处的肌肉线条也总能以最合适的方式承接每一缕光线，凸显出身体中的阳刚之处。
rows.raw: "Five feet and eleven inches of androgyny, Alex is an ideal definition of a pretty boy. Smooth, creamy chocolate-colored skin and just enough muscle tone catches every bit of light just right to help accent the masculine touches of his body."

rows.original: His attire isn’t anything too fancy though; a simple cropped top hugs his flat muscled chest and baggy pants hug his flared hips and narrow waist with just enough bagginess to let you see the top of his black pubic hair. His close-cropped hair hides a bit of his face but does little to diminish his near-flawless and trained smile whenever you look his way. He even has a pair of black slip-on sandals, ensuring he can transition to barefoot or vice versa in a moment’s notice.

Racks of lingerie cover the walls to the south and west, while numerous circular displays are set up on the floor itself. To the north is the check-out counter, as well as a set of changing rooms and a door to the back room.

rows.original: “Oh, that’s easy. You could probably find this on the extranet but whatever, I’m happy to talk about it. We were ‘discovered’ by the UGC a couple Planet Rushes ago. Back then our society was reasonably advanced. We were well into an industrial revolution, even had our own primitive version of the extranet. And boy were we curious. When the UGC showed up, we were actually planning missions to land on our own moons. So when a bunch of aliens land and say there’s actually a vast network of worlds and species, we jumped at the opportunity to join them.”
rows.translation: “哦，这很简单。你大概能在星际网络上找到这些资料，不过无所谓，我很乐意聊聊。大约两次行星开拓潮以前，我们被银河联合邦联‘发现’了。那时我们的社会已经相当先进，工业革命也已发展得很深入，甚至有自己较为原始的星际网络。而且我们有着强烈的好奇心。银河联合邦联到来时，我们其实正在策划登陆自己卫星的任务。所以，当一群外星人降落并告诉我们，外面其实存在由无数世界和物种构成的庞大网络时，我们立刻抓住机会加入了他们。”

When the UGC showed up, we were actually planning missions to land on our own moons. rows.original: “From what I understand, we fit pretty well into the universe as a whole. There wasn’t much of an awkward phase for us. We came in and adapted really well. My parents, and their parents, all grew up in mostly human settlements.”
rows.translation: “据我所知，我们相当顺利地融入了整个宇宙。几乎没经历什么尴尬的适应期。我们加入后适应得非常好。我的父母，还有他们的父母，基本都是在人类聚居地长大的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“From what I understand, we fit pretty well into the universe as a whole. There wasn’t much of an awkward phase for us. We came in and adapted really well. My parents, and their parents, all grew up in mostly human settlements.”"

rows.original: “Now, physiologically, we’re pretty different. For example, I’m a male,” she giggles, motioning down at her voluptuous, and most definitely feminine body shape. “We learn about it in school. Back in our early history, the more colorful you were, the better mates you could attract. It also worked as camouflage in some areas on our home planet. As for the tits, well, who doesn’t like tits? Our women most certainly did. The bigger your boobs, the better your chances of getting a girl. It was a sign of how healthy you were. A sign that you could easily feed yourself and others.”
rows.translation: “不过从生理上说，我们差别很大。比如，我是雄性，”她咯咯笑着，示意自己丰满而又无疑十分女性化的身形。“我们在学校里都学过这些。在我们的早期历史中，体色越鲜艳，就越容易吸引到优秀的伴侣。在母星的某些地区，这种体色还能充当保护色。至于胸部嘛，谁会不喜欢胸部呢？我们的雌性当然也喜欢。乳房越大，找到女孩的机会就越高。这代表你身体健康，也表示你很容易养活自己和别人。”

Back in our early history, the more colorful you were, the better mates you could attract. It also worked as camouflage in some areas on our home planet. As for the tits, well, who doesn’t like tits? rows.original: “Our females, on the other hand, are less colorful. They didn’t need the bright colors, or the large boobs, so they never developed them. Now, of course, there’s gene mods and all that, so you can’t always tell the gender of an ovir by their coloration, at least in human settlements and stations. Back home, and in primarily ovir colonies, tradition usually wins out.”
rows.translation: “另一方面，我们的雌性体色没那么鲜艳。她们不需要鲜艳的色彩，也不需要硕大的乳房，所以从未进化出这些特征。当然，如今有了基因模组之类的东西，所以至少在人类聚居地和空间站里，不能总靠体色判断奥维尔的性别。在故乡和以奥维尔为主的殖民地，传统通常还是占上风。”

Now, of course, there’s gene mods and all that, so you can’t always tell the gender of an ovir by their coloration, at least in human settlements and stations. Back home, and in primarily ovir colonies, tradition usually wins out.”"

rows.original: She perks up, her eyes suddenly sparkling. “Oh! That’s a good story. Now, I grew up in a mostly human colony. There were other ovir about, but mostly humans. The local clothing shops didn’t really ever have anything that fit me, not with this big old tail.” She lifts part of her bulky purple tail. “So I got into sewing my own clothing. It was a bit of a natural talent, really. I loved clothes, so I really got into making my own.”
rows.translation: 她顿时来了精神，双眼闪闪发亮。“哦！这故事很有意思。我是在一处以人类为主的殖民地长大的。那里也有其他奥维尔，但绝大多数居民都是人类。当地服装店从来没有真正适合我的衣服，毕竟我拖着这么一条大尾巴。”她抬起粗大的紫色尾巴的一部分。“所以我开始自己缝衣服。说实话，我在这方面颇有天分。我热爱服装，因此很快就沉迷于亲手制作衣服。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe perks up, her eyes suddenly sparkling. “Oh! That’s a good story. Now, I grew up in a mostly human colony. There were other ovir about, but mostly humans. The local clothing shops didn’t really ever have anything that fit me, not with this big old tail.” She lifts part of her bulky purple tail. “So I got into sewing my own clothing. It was a bit of a natural talent, really. I loved clothes, so I really got into making my own.”"

rows.original: “I had huge wardrobes filled with hand-sewn dresses, blouses, skirts, pants, and so on. And all the girls in my colony wanted some too! I had a bit of an eye for fashion, even back then. So, by the time I was 15 I had this nice little side business and was cleaning up pretty good. So I paid my own way through university, and when I graduated I bought this storefront! It started off pretty small, but after my business really picked up, I bought out the surrounding stores and expanded my showfloor.”
rows.translation: “我的大衣柜里塞满了手工缝制的连衣裙、衬衫、半身裙、长裤等等。殖民地里的女孩们也都想要！我当时就已经有点时尚眼光了。所以到15岁时，我经营着一门不错的小副业，赚得相当多。我靠自己支付了大学学费，毕业后便买下了这间店面！一开始规模很小，但生意真正红火起来后，我把周围的店铺都买了下来，扩建了展厅。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I had huge wardrobes filled with hand-sewn dresses, blouses, skirts, pants, and so on. And all the girls in my colony wanted some too! So I paid my own way through university, and when I graduated I bought this storefront! It started off pretty small, but after my business really picked up, I bought out the surrounding stores and expanded my showfloor.”"

rows.original: “And now with my new chameleon silk, business is really booming! I’ve got people coming from all over to pick up some of my lingerie. I’m even thinking of expanding to new locations.”

rows.original: Aliss pulls out a pair of panties from a nearby display and puts them on the counter. “It’s this new type of fabric I invented. It uses these multihued synthetic fibers. They normally look like little rainbow strands, but when you pulse electricity through them, they change to solid colors. So positioned around the panties,” she points at areas on the inside of the underwear. You can’t seem to see anything different. “There are these little nano machines that control the colors. I made it so that they can be linked up with a simple application on any wireless device to alter the color as you see fit.”

rows.original: Low, broad couches form a sort of pit in the living room, strewn with a wide array of pillows and blankets. In the center of the pit is an artificial fireplace, a holographic projection of flames coupled with a heater that bathes the room in light and warmth.
rows.translation: 低矮宽大的沙发在客厅中围成一个下沉区，上面散落着各式各样的枕头和毯子。下沉区中央是一座人造壁炉，由火焰的全息投影和加热器组成，让光亮与暖意洒满整个房间。

rows.original: More heat comes from the kitchen along the left wall, separated from the living room by a long, narrow table. Sounds and smells waft from the kitchen, its multitude of cookware and appliances seemingly alive with a perpetuity of things simmering, braising, or baking.
rows.translation: 左侧墙边的厨房也散发着热气，一张狭长桌子将它与客厅隔开。声响和香气从厨房飘来，众多炊具和电器仿佛活着一般，永远有食物在慢炖、焖煮或烘烤。

rows.original: In the far wall is a short hallway, presumably leading to Bhakar’s other rooms.
rows.translation: 远处墙上有一条短走廊，大概通往巴卡尔的其他房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn the far wall is a short hallway, presumably leading to Bhakar’s other rooms."

rows.original: The aroma of savory and spice fills the apartment, warming you from the inside as Bhakar sidles delicately behind you towards the kitchen.
rows.translation: 咸香与香料的气息充满公寓，从内部温暖着你；巴卡尔则轻巧地从你身后侧身走向厨房。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe aroma of savory and spice fills the apartment, warming you from the inside as Bhakar sidles delicately behind you towards the kitchen."

rows.original: “Please, make yourself comfortable, err, oh dear. I don’t think I had a proper name exchange with you earlier. Please forgive my manners - I just get so excited with guests,” he says, his four arms spread wide as he turns down several burners on his range, and lifts up the lid of a small, bubbling pot. A cloud of steam gathers around his head, and the smell of cardamom suffuses the air around you.
rows.translation: “请随意坐，呃，哎呀。我想我们之前还没正式交换姓名。请原谅我的失礼 - 有客人来时我总是太兴奋，”他说着，张开四条手臂，调低炉灶上几个火眼的温度，又掀开一口咕嘟作响的小锅盖。蒸汽在他头边聚成云团，豆蔻香气弥漫在你四周。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please, make yourself comfortable, err, oh dear. I don’t think I had a proper name exchange with you earlier. Please forgive my manners - I just get so excited with guests,” he says, his four arms spread wide as he turns down several burners on his range, and lifts up the lid of a small, bubbling pot. A cloud of steam gathers around his head, and the smell of cardamom suffuses the air around you."

rows.original: “As I mentioned before, I’m Kumbhakarna, but you are welcome to call me Bhakar, if it’s easier. May I ask your name, and would you taste this for me, please?” he asks, holding out a large wooden spoon.
rows.translation: “就像我之前提过的，我叫昆巴卡纳，不过如果更方便，你可以叫我巴卡尔。能告诉我你的名字吗？还有，请帮我尝尝这个好吗？”他递出一把大木勺问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“As I mentioned before, I’m Kumbhakarna, but you are welcome to call me Bhakar, if it’s easier. May I ask your name, and would you taste this for me, please?” he asks, holding out a large wooden spoon."

rows.original: You make your way towards Bhakar, introducing yourself before taking a cautious taste of the orange liquid in the spoon. You’re delighted to find that it tastes delicious: nutty and spicy with a hint of dill.
rows.translation: 你一边自我介绍，一边走向巴卡尔，小心尝了尝勺里的橙色液体。你欣喜地发现味道十分可口：坚果香浓、辛辣开胃，还带着一丝莳萝气息。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make your way towards Bhakar, introducing yourself before taking a cautious taste of the orange liquid in the spoon. You’re delighted to find that it tastes delicious: nutty and spicy with a hint of dill."

rows.original: Your response must have shown on your face because Bhakar immediately claps two of his free hands together, chuckling. “Excellent! This is my new recipe for adjika. It goes out tomorrow morning, and I’m delighted to have some positive feedback on it!”
rows.translation: 你的反应一定全写在了脸上，因为巴卡尔立刻拍响两只空着的手，呵呵笑了起来。“太好了！这是我为阿吉卡酱设计的新配方。明早它就会发布，能先收到一些好评，我真是太高兴了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour response must have shown on your face because Bhakar immediately claps two of his free hands together, chuckling. “Excellent! This is my new recipe for adjika. It goes out tomorrow morning, and I’m delighted to have some positive feedback on it!”"

rows.original: “If you’d like to sample a few more foods, I’m always in the middle of cooking,” he says, smiling broadly. “More than that, though, I’m just always happy for the company.”
rows.translation: “如果你愿意再品尝几种食物，我这里一直都有东西在做，”他咧嘴笑道。“不过更重要的是，有人陪伴总会让我很开心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you’d like to sample a few more foods, I’m always in the middle of cooking,” he says, smiling broadly. “More than that, though, I’m just always happy for the company.”"

rows.original: “Please, make yourself comfortable, [pc.name],” says Bhakar, gesturing towards the wealth of cushions and couches. “You are always welcome in my abode. Plus,” he adds with a smile, “it’s a blessing to have someone to try out my newest recipes.”
rows.translation: “请随意坐，[pc.name]，”巴卡尔说着，示意那些数量众多的靠垫和沙发。“我的住处永远欢迎你。而且，”他微笑着补充，“能有人试吃我的最新菜谱，也是一种福气。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please, make yourself comfortable, [pc.name],” says Bhakar, gesturing towards the wealth of cushions and couches. “You are always welcome in my abode. Plus,” he adds with a smile, “it’s a blessing to have someone to try out my newest recipes.”"

rows.raw: "You ask Bhakar about his job, and what he does that keeps him so busy all the time."

rows.original: “Ah, you see I’m a galactic chef!” he says expansively, spreading all four of his massive arms wide and booming out the last two words.
rows.translation: “啊，你看，我是一名银河厨师！”他豪迈地说，四条粗壮手臂全部展开，洪亮地喊出最后四个字。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, you see I’m a galactic chef!” he says expansively, spreading all four of his massive arms wide and booming out the last two words."

rows.original: He grins apologetically, bringing his arms back in, and returning to his slow bustle through the kitchen. “It actually sounds quite a bit more grandiose than it actually is,” he says. “While food synthesizers and processors can produce any number of foods, they still need to be programmed with specific input. Otherwise, it’s just nutrient paste day after day.”
rows.translation: 他歉意地笑了笑，收回手臂，又开始在厨房里慢悠悠地忙碌。“其实听起来比实际情况宏大得多，”他说。“食物合成器和加工机虽然能制作无数种食物，但仍需要输入具体程序。否则每天就只有营养糊。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe grins apologetically, bringing his arms back in, and returning to his slow bustle through the kitchen. “It actually sounds quite a bit more grandiose than it actually is,” he says. “While food synthesizers and processors can produce any number of foods, they still need to be programmed with specific input. Otherwise, it’s just nutrient paste day after day.”"

rows.original: He opens an oven, checking on a tray of round buns, perhaps inadvertently giving you a glimpse of his ample buns pushing out against his baggy trousers.

rows.raw: "\n\nHe opens an oven, checking on a tray of round buns, perhaps inadvertently giving you a glimpse of his ample buns pushing out against his baggy trousers."

rows.original: “And that’s what I do,” he says, straightening up. “I experiment and cook, providing different recipes and inputs for the databases to build from. It’s really a wonderful job,” he says with a beatific smile.
rows.translation: “而这就是我的工作，”他直起身说。“我做实验、烹饪，为数据库提供不同的菜谱和输入资料。这真的是一份很棒的工作，”他露出幸福的笑容说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that’s what I do,” he says, straightening up. “I experiment and cook, providing different recipes and inputs for the databases to build from. It’s really a wonderful job,” he says with a beatific smile."

rows.original: “Oh, have you not encountered a roravan before?” he asks. “That’s perhaps not surprising. There are not a great many of us left,” he says, nodding softly.
rows.translation: “哦，你以前没遇见过罗拉万人吗？”他问道。“那也许并不奇怪。我们已经所剩无几了，”他轻轻点头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, have you not encountered a roravan before?” he asks. “That’s perhaps not surprising. There are not a great many of us left,” he says, nodding softly."

rows.original: You inform him that he’s correct. The shaggy, four-armed bear-man is a unique encounter in your adventures. You ask him why there aren’t so many left.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，他说得没错。在你的冒险中，这个毛茸茸的四臂熊人确实是独一无二的遭遇。你问他为什么族人所剩不多。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou inform him that he’s correct. The shaggy, four-armed bear-man is a unique encounter in your adventures. You ask him why there aren’t so many left."

rows.original: “Justice happened,” he says, letting out a heavy, gusty sigh before slowly stirring a pot of bubbling stew. “Roravan saw themselves as a proud, warrior race, who sought galactic conquest through, well, through arms,” he says with a chuckle. “Blood begets blood, though, and bloodthirst and dogma will only carry you so far.”
rows.translation: “正义降临了，”他说，沉重地长叹一声，随后慢慢搅动一锅冒泡的炖菜。“罗拉万人自视为骄傲的战士种族，试图凭借，嗯，凭借武力征服银河，”他轻笑一声。“但鲜血只会招来鲜血，嗜血和教条能带你走的路终究有限。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Justice happened,” he says, letting out a heavy, gusty sigh before slowly stirring a pot of bubbling stew. “Roravan saw themselves as a proud, warrior race, who sought galactic conquest through, well, through arms,” he says with a chuckle. “Blood begets blood, though, and bloodthirst and dogma will only carry you so far.”"

rows.original: “We killed without thought and conquered without mercy, stopping only when it would be strategic to do so, to consolidate resources, to gather weapons,” he says, a distant look in his eyes. “Allies were few, and alliances short-lived. Woe to anyone who seeks alliance with a conqueror, for they are simply delaying the axe by a few more heads.”
rows.translation: “我们不假思索地杀戮，毫无怜悯地征服；只有在出于战略需要、必须整合资源和收集武器时才会停手，”他说，眼神变得遥远。“盟友寥寥无几，盟约也转瞬即逝。与征服者结盟的人必有灾祸，因为他们不过是让斧头多砍几颗脑袋以后才落到自己身上。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We killed without thought and conquered without mercy, stopping only when it would be strategic to do so, to consolidate resources, to gather weapons,” he says, a distant look in his eyes. “Allies were few, and alliances short-lived. Woe to anyone who seeks alliance with a conqueror, for they are simply delaying the axe by a few more heads.”"

rows.original: He pauses, turning off a burner and removing a massive pot from it, then sighs. “We fought the collected might of the UGC. The conclusion was forgone. How could it not be? It is insanity to wage war upon an entire universe. And roravan fight to their dying breath. It took the collapse and destruction of our homeworld to make us stop. Those few of us who found the clarity to finally lay down arms were imprisoned, then scattered throughout the galaxy.”
rows.translation: 他停下来，关掉一个炉头，将一口巨锅移开，随后叹了口气。“我们与银河联合邦联的全部力量交战。结局早已注定。怎么可能不是呢？向整个宇宙开战就是疯狂。而罗拉万人会战至最后一息。直到母星崩塌毁灭，我们才终于停手。少数终于清醒并放下武器的人先被关进监狱，后来又被分散到银河各地。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe pauses, turning off a burner and removing a massive pot from it, then sighs. “We fought the collected might of the UGC. The conclusion was forgone. How could it not be? It is insanity to wage war upon an entire universe. And roravan fight to their dying breath. It took the collapse and destruction of our homeworld to make us stop. Those few of us who found the clarity to finally lay down arms were imprisoned, then scattered throughout the galaxy.”"

rows.original: “It’s called Solitarius now,” says Bhakar. “Its old name was too heavy with blood to bear repeating. The UGC authorities had other reasons for renaming it, I’m sure. A world once of towers that reached up through the clouds, lush jungles and verdant mountains is now a ball of tectonic rubble-a cairn to idiocy.”
rows.translation: “现在那里叫索利塔里乌斯，”巴卡尔说。“旧名沾染了太多鲜血，不应再被提起。当然，我相信银河联合邦联当局给它改名还有其他原因。那个曾有高塔穿云、丛林繁茂、群山苍翠的世界，如今成了一团地壳碎块 - 一座纪念愚行的石冢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s called Solitarius now,” says Bhakar. “Its old name was too heavy with blood to bear repeating. The UGC authorities had other reasons for renaming it, I’m sure. A world once of towers that reached up through the clouds, lush jungles and verdant mountains is now a ball of tectonic rubble-a cairn to idiocy.”"

rows.original: “But memories are empty, are they not, [pc.name]?” he says, giving himself a shake and returning from his reverie. “A memory of food can’t sustain you, but real food can, yes?”
rows.translation: “但回忆都是空的，不是吗，[pc.name]？”他说着抖了抖身体，从沉思中回过神来。“食物的回忆养不活你，但真正的食物可以，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But memories are empty, are they not, [pc.name]?” he says, giving himself a shake and returning from his reverie. “A memory of food can’t sustain you, but real food can, yes?”"

rows.translation: “啊，谁会想听我这种老熊的故事呢？”他低沉地说道。

rows.original: “You were out like a light, [pc.name],” says Bhakar, tossing a few items from a pan onto a plate. “I think I was, too. I honestly don’t think I’ve slept that well in ages.”

rows.original: You pull up a chair next to the kitchen island as Bhakar hums, his musical baritone accompanied by the clatter of plates and silverware.

rows.original: What follows is a nonstop parade of amazing foods. Bhakar moves with a grace that you wouldn’t expect from his hulking frame, all four limbs reaching around him as he plates and serves dish after dish. You sample sauces, munch on roasts and stews, tear off steaming pieces off fresh breads, slurp soup, and crunch through pastries.
rows.translation: 接下来是接连不断的美食盛宴。巴卡尔以庞大体格难以想象的优雅动作起来，四条手臂伸向四周，将一道又一道菜装盘端上。你品尝酱汁，大嚼烤肉和炖菜，从新鲜面包上撕下冒着热气的面包块，啜饮汤汁，咔嚓咬碎酥点。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat follows is a nonstop parade of amazing foods. Bhakar moves with a grace that you wouldn’t expect from his hulking frame, all four limbs reaching around him as he plates and serves dish after dish. You sample sauces, munch on roasts and stews, tear off steaming pieces off fresh breads, slurp soup, and crunch through pastries."

rows.original: Your gustatory experience is accompanied by Bhakar’s jolly voice explaining the various items, noting their planets of origin, their ingredients and asking for your opinions. You do the best you can, telling him what you like and don’t like about the foods, your cheeks stuffed with Bhakar’s savory concoctions. He eats along with you, nodding in agreement and shaking his head at other times.
rows.translation: 巴卡尔欢快地讲解各种菜品，为你的味觉体验伴奏；他说明食物源自哪些星球、用了什么食材，并询问你的意见。你尽力作答，双颊塞满巴卡尔的咸香美食，告诉他自己喜欢和不喜欢的地方。他也陪你一起吃，有时点头赞同，有时又摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour gustatory experience is accompanied by Bhakar’s jolly voice explaining the various items, noting their planets of origin, their ingredients and asking for your opinions. You do the best you can, telling him what you like and don’t like about the foods, your cheeks stuffed with Bhakar’s savory concoctions. He eats along with you, nodding in agreement and shaking his head at other times."

rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you’re done, you feel too full to move."

rows.original: “Oops!” laughs Bhakar. “It looks like I got a bit too excited. Here, why don’t you relax for a bit before you try to move again?”
rows.translation: “哎呀！”巴卡尔笑道。“看来我有点太兴奋了。来，你先休息一会儿，再试着活动怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oops!” laughs Bhakar. “It looks like I got a bit too excited. Here, why don’t you relax for a bit before you try to move again?”"

rows.original: Before you can say anything, Bhakar scoops you up in his four arms. The shaggy warmth of his muscular arms makes you feel incredibly secure, especially in your overstuffed state. You can feel his burly body through his apron, well muscled, but with a bit of softness around the gut. Humming softly, Bhakar carries you to a spot on the sofa and sets you down in front of the synthesized fire.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及说话，巴卡尔便用四条手臂将你抱起。在吃得过饱的状态下，他肌肉发达的手臂毛茸茸又温暖，让你感到无比安全。隔着围裙，你能感觉到他粗壮的身体肌肉结实，腹部却略显柔软。巴卡尔轻声哼唱，把你抱到沙发的一处位置，放在合成炉火前。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can say anything, Bhakar scoops you up in his four arms. The shaggy warmth of his muscular arms makes you feel incredibly secure, especially in your overstuffed state. You can feel his burly body through his apron, well muscled, but with a bit of softness around the gut. Humming softly, Bhakar carries you to a spot on the sofa and sets you down in front of the synthesized fire."

rows.original: Artificial or not, the flickering of the fire is still comforting, and you find yourself drifting into a dreamy haze, leaning back and dozing. Behind you you can hear the rush of water and clatter of pans and Bhakar cleans dishes and prepares a few new creations for a stove.
rows.translation: 无论是否人造，跃动的火焰依然令人安心；你逐渐陷入梦幻迷雾，向后靠着打起瞌睡。身后传来水流和锅具碰撞的声音，巴卡尔正在清洗餐具，并为炉灶准备几道新作品。
rows.raw: "\n\nArtificial or not, the flickering of the fire is still comforting, and you find yourself drifting into a dreamy haze, leaning back and dozing. Behind you you can hear the rush of water and clatter of pans and Bhakar cleans dishes and prepares a few new creations for a stove."

rows.original: “Ah, are you the delivery [pc.boyGirl]?” he asks. His red-orange eyes peer at you as he looks you up and down. rows.translation: “啊，你是送货的[pc.boyGirl]吗？”他问道，红橙色双眼上下打量着你。尽管体格如怪物般庞大，这个生物的语气却近乎悦耳，而且十分礼貌。“我无意抱怨，不过我订购的加洛提亚人块茎已经迟到一天了，这感觉有点不专业。”

rows.original: “Hah!” he barks, his short laugh shaking the hallway. “One would think me some kind of a sorcerer with the number of people entranced by my cooking since I moved here to Tavros,” he chuckles. “I’m Kumbhakarna - though you can call me Bhakar if that’s too much of a mouthful - and if you’re hungry or curious, you’re welcome into my home. I’ll never turn away a hungry traveller,” he says, stepping back from the door and waving you in.
rows.translation: “哈！”他短促地笑了一声，震动整条走廊。“自从搬到塔夫罗斯以来，被我的厨艺迷住的人这么多，别人还会以为我是某种巫师，”他轻笑。“我叫昆巴卡纳 - 要是太拗口，叫我巴卡尔就好 - 如果你饿了或感到好奇，欢迎进我家。我永远不会拒绝饥饿的旅人，”他说着从门边退开，挥手示意你进来。

rows.original: “Why did you come out here?” you ask.
rows.translation: “你为什么来到这里？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“Why did you come out here?” you ask."

rows.original: “What, are you kidding?” she says, smiling. “The biggest event in centuries? Hundreds of untouched new planets and systems, opened up to everyone? This is the obvious place for a photographer to come! Oh, I was so excited. I was gonna visit Mhen’ga, try and get work with Ms Irson. I was gonna do shoots of all the celebrity explorers coming into Tavros like - like, well, you. Loads of the people I knew at Boney Station were coming out here, and I just kinda got swept up in the Rush.”
rows.translation: “什么，你在开玩笑吗？”她笑着说道。“这是几个世纪以来最重大的事件啊！数百颗从未开发的新星球和星系向所有人开放？这里显然是摄影师最该来的地方！哦，我当时兴奋极了。我打算去门伽，争取在厄森女士手下工作。我还打算给所有来到塔夫罗斯的明星探险家拍摄，比如 - 比如说，你。许多我在博尼空间站认识的人都要来这里，我就这样被卷进了大淘金。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What, are you kidding?” she says, smiling. “The biggest event in centuries? Hundreds of untouched new planets and systems, opened up to everyone? This is the obvious place for a photographer to come! Oh, I was so excited. I was gonna visit Mhen’ga, try and get work with Ms Irson. I was gonna do shoots of all the celebrity explorers coming into Tavros like - like, well, you. Loads of the people I knew at Boney Station were coming out here, and I just kinda got swept up in the Rush.”"

rows.original: She sighs, casting her marble eyes down.
rows.translation: 她叹了口气，垂下大理石般的双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs, casting her marble eyes down."

rows.original: “Didn’t work out the way I thought. Obviously. If there are thousands of camera crews taking in everything, and you’re just some green kid fresh out of college, you aren’t gonna find much work. Also I - I dunno if you’ve noticed, but I’m terrible at writing. Applications and ads and stuff, I can’t do them well. I thought - I thought maybe if I bought some gear, used my savings on that, people would take me a bit more seriously.” Her head sinks lower. “That was a dumb decision. And - and that’s pretty much where you came in, [pc.Mr] Steele.” She looks up at you, hero worship glowing in her eyes. “You saved me. I don’t know how I could ever have faced my family again if - if I hadn’t become some sort of success.”
rows.translation: “事情没有按我的设想发展。显然没有。这里有成千上万支摄影团队记录一切，而你只是个刚从学院毕业的愣头青，根本找不到多少工作。而且我 - 我不知道你有没有注意到，但我的文笔糟透了。申请书、广告之类的东西，我都写不好。我想着 - 我想着如果买些设备，把积蓄花在上面，或许人们就会更认真地看待我。”她的头垂得更低了。“那是个愚蠢的决定。然后 - 然后差不多就是你登场的时候了，[pc.Mr]·斯蒂尔。”她抬头看向你，眼中闪烁着英雄崇拜的光芒。“你救了我。要是 - 要是我没能取得一点成功，我根本不知道该怎么再面对家人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Didn’t work out the way I thought. Obviously. If there are thousands of camera crews taking in everything, and you’re just some green kid fresh out of college, you aren’t gonna find much work. Also I - I dunno if you’ve noticed, but I’m terrible at writing. Applications and ads and stuff, I can’t do them well. I thought - I thought maybe if I bought some gear, used my savings on that, people would take me a bit more seriously.” Her head sinks lower. “That was a dumb decision. And - and that’s pretty much where you came in, [pc.Mr] Steele.” She looks up at you, hero worship glowing in her eyes. “You saved me. I don’t know how I could ever have faced my family again if - if I hadn’t become some sort of success.”"

rows.original: Yeah, you’re a bona fide hero alright... or someone who took serial advantage of a vulnerable young catgirl. One of the two. You think playing up to the former - giving Bizzy a winning smile, a hug and telling her you stepped in because you could tell she had talent - is the way to go. She squeezes you back happily.
rows.translation: 没错，你确实是一位货真价实的英雄...或者只是个一再占这名脆弱年轻猫女便宜的家伙。两者必居其一。你觉得还是顺着前一种说法比较好 - 你朝比兹露出迷人的笑容，拥抱她，并告诉她，你之所以出手相助，是因为看得出她有才华。她开心地回抱住你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYeah, you’re a bona fide hero alright... or someone who took serial advantage of a vulnerable young catgirl. One of the two. You think playing up to the former - giving Bizzy a winning smile, a hug and telling her you stepped in because you could tell she had talent - is the way to go. She squeezes you back happily."

I’ve been fucking everything up my whole life.”
