Britannia moves to sit back down, but not before glancing at the door Fisianna went through and giving you a look of concern. You can choose to follow the feline to see what is wrong, or trust that she will come back to her friends once she is better.
rows.translation: 你还看到她似乎没有直接走向酒吧洗手间，而是朝紧急侧门去了。布里塔妮娅准备重新坐下，却先看了看菲希安娜离去的方向，眉头微皱。
rows.raw: "You also see that she doesn’t seem to be headed directly towards the bar’s bathroom, but rather an emergency side exit. Britannia moves to sit back down, but not before glancing at the door Fisianna went through and giving you a look of concern. You can choose to follow the feline to see what is wrong, or trust that she will come back to her friends once she is better."

rows.original: Follow
rows.translation: 跟上去
rows.raw: "Follow"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: Something about how things played out just then doesn’t sit well with you. The quick glimpse you caught of her face made her seem quite pained. You turn to the dragoness and offer to go after Fisianna to see if she is alright. Britannia wastes no time in giving you an approving nod and a slight smile.
rows.translation: 刚才事情的发展让你总觉得不对劲。匆匆瞥见她的脸时，她看起来相当痛苦。你转向龙女，提出自己去看看菲希安娜是否安好。
rows.raw: "Something about how things played out just then doesn’t sit well with you. The quick glimpse you caught of her face made her seem quite pained. You turn to the dragoness and offer to go after Fisianna to see if she is alright. Britannia wastes no time in giving you an approving nod and a slight smile."

rows.original: You excuse yourself to her and the other ladies and proceed to tail after Fisianna. She moves through the bar and to the emergency exit with you close behind. Upon opening the door, you take a look to your left down the alleyway and then your right, and find Fisianna knelt against the wall wiping off a few trailing tears from her face with her paws.
rows.translation: 你向她和其他女士告辞，随后跟在菲希安娜身后。她穿过酒吧，走向紧急出口，你紧随其后。门打开后，一股凉爽夜风扑面而来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou excuse yourself to her and the other ladies and proceed to tail after Fisianna. She moves through the bar and to the emergency exit with you close behind. Upon opening the door, you take a look to your left down the alleyway and then your right, and find Fisianna knelt against the wall wiping off a few trailing tears from her face with her paws. "

rows.original: Now that Fisianna isn’t crowded between the table and the girls, you can more clearly see the mod jobs she has done on her body. She has a cute pair of cat-like paws on her hands and feet, which are both left bare, and her two tails are quite long and luxurious. She’s also fairly petite in physique, but still has a distinctly feminine shape to her. Hugging her form is a black, fur-hooded sleeveless vest over a printed purple t-shirt, with blue bell-bottom jeans. She certainly isn’t dressed as racy as her companions are.
rows.translation: 如今菲希安娜不再被桌子和女孩们挤在中间，你能更清楚看到她对身体做过的改造。她的双手是一对可爱的猫爪，脚也一样；两条猫尾从身后伸出。她靠着外墙，双臂紧抱膝盖，肩膀微微颤抖。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that Fisianna isn’t crowded between the table and the girls, you can more clearly see the mod jobs she has done on her body. She has a cute pair of cat-like paws on her hands and feet, which are both left bare, and her two tails are quite long and luxurious. She’s also fairly petite in physique, but still has a distinctly feminine shape to her. Hugging her form is a black, fur-hooded sleeveless vest over a printed purple t-shirt, with blue bell-bottom jeans. She certainly isn’t dressed as racy as her companions are."

rows.original: You cross the threshold of the exit and make your way over to Fisianna before taking a seat next to her. She still seems oblivious to your arrival as she’s still wiping off tears and looking at the ground. You are not exactly sure how to break the ice, or in this case the iceberg, but you are willing to try to goad this catgirl to open up a little more.
rows.translation: 你跨过出口门槛，走到菲希安娜身旁坐下。她似乎仍没注意到你的到来，还在擦拭泪水、盯着地面。你不太确定该如何打破这层冰，或者说这座冰山，但仍愿意试着让猫娘多敞开心扉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cross the threshold of the exit and make your way over to Fisianna before taking a seat next to her. She still seems oblivious to your arrival as she’s still wiping off tears and looking at the ground. You are not exactly sure how to break the ice, or in this case the iceberg, but you are willing to try to goad this catgirl to open up a little more. "

rows.original: Perhaps you can even manage a smile out of her, or your name isn’t [pc.name] Steele!
rows.translation: 也许你甚至能让她露出笑容，否则你就不叫[pc.name]·斯蒂尔！
rows.raw: "Perhaps you can even manage a smile out of her, or your name isn’t [pc.name] Steele! "

rows.original: Perhaps you can even manage a smile out of her!
rows.translation: 也许你甚至能让她露出笑容！
rows.raw: "Perhaps you can even manage a smile out of her!"

rows.original: You decide to approach her in as gentle of a manner as you can, since she seems like a sensitive person. “Hey, Fisianna. Is everything ok? You didn’t seem like you were doing too well and I wanted to check up on you.”
rows.translation: 你决定尽可能温柔地接近她，因为她似乎是个敏感的人。“嘿，菲希安娜。你还好吗？刚才看起来不太舒服。”
rows.raw: "You decide to approach her in as gentle of a manner as you can, since she seems like a sensitive person. “Hey, Fisianna. Is everything ok? You didn’t seem like you were doing too well and I wanted to check up on you.” "

rows.original: You decide it might be a good idea to open with a lighthearted joke to soften Fisianna up. “Hey there! Didn’t figure you the type to be an alley cat! Can I paw-sibly do anything for you to help you feel better?”
rows.translation: 你觉得先讲个轻松笑话，也许能让菲希安娜放松。“嘿！没想到你还是只巷子猫！有什么我能伸出援爪帮忙的吗？”
rows.raw: "You decide it might be a good idea to open with a lighthearted joke to soften Fisianna up. “Hey there! Didn’t figure you the type to be an alley cat! Can I paw-sibly do anything for you to help you feel better?” "

rows.original: You struggle to come up with anything to tell Fisianna to comfort her, but before the silence grows awkward, you manage to say, “Hey. You doin alright there, uh... Kitten?”
rows.translation: 你一时想不到该说什么安慰菲希安娜，但在沉默变得尴尬前，终于开口：“嘿。你还好吗，那个...小猫咪？”
rows.raw: "You struggle to come up with anything to tell Fisianna to comfort her, but before the silence grows awkward, you manage to say, “Hey. You doin alright there, uh... Kitten?”"

rows.original: Fisianna in response starts to sit down fully against the wall and tuck her tails and her head between her knees, still not looking up. You can hear her groan faintly, which comes off in a sad, pitiful tone.
rows.translation: 菲希安娜作为回应，彻底贴着墙坐下，把尾巴和脑袋都缩到双膝之间，仍不肯抬头。你听见她轻轻呻吟，声音因膝盖遮挡而含糊不清。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna in response starts to sit down fully against the wall and tuck her tails and her head between her knees, still not looking up. You can hear her groan faintly, which comes off in a sad, pitiful tone."

rows.original: “It’s ok. It’s only me, there’s nothing to be afraid of. I won’t judge you for what happened or anything. Trust me.”
rows.translation: “没事的。这里只有我，没什么可怕的。我不会因为刚才发生的事评判你。相信我。”
rows.raw: "“It’s ok. It’s only me, there’s nothing to be afraid of. I won’t judge you for what happened or anything. Trust me.”"

rows.original: “Hey, I won’t bite! Lighten up a little bit! It’s only me here. You can tell me what’s t-ailing you.”
rows.translation: “嘿，我又不会咬你！放轻松点！这里只有我。你可以告诉我是什么让你尾屈了。”
rows.raw: "“Hey, I won’t bite! Lighten up a little bit! It’s only me here. You can tell me what’s t-ailing you.” "

rows.original: “Listen, it’s only me. C’mon. I’m not THAT bad of a person. Open up a little!”
rows.translation: “听着，这里只有我。来吧，我没那么糟糕。稍微敞开心扉吧！”
rows.raw: "“Listen, it’s only me. C’mon. I’m not THAT bad of a person. Open up a little!”"

rows.original: Fisianna hesitantly but slowly raises her head out from between her knees and looks your way with her golden, piercing, but dewy, tearstained eyes. “T-thanks. I’m sorry about that.” Sniffling, she straightens herself to more properly face you.
rows.translation: 菲希安娜犹豫着缓缓从双膝间抬起头，用那双锐利却水汪汪、沾满泪痕的金色眼睛看向你。“谢、谢谢。刚才那样很抱歉。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna hesitantly but slowly raises her head out from between her knees and looks your way with her golden, piercing, but dewy, tearstained eyes. “T-thanks. I’m sorry about that.” Sniffling, she straightens herself to more properly face you."

rows.original: “It’s ok, though I’m kind of curious what that was all about; that is if you don’t mind my asking?”
rows.translation: “没关系，不过我有点好奇刚才到底怎么回事——当然，前提是你不介意我问。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s ok, though I’m kind of curious what that was all about; that is if you don’t mind my asking?”"

rows.original: “I was just thinking of the last time we met each other here... and... I-I feel really bad. No no! Not at not being able to see you alone, but I feel bad for the way I acted. I might have made you feel bad about it. I-I’m not the strongest of people. I-I don’t know why I tried to run away again. I... I just...”
rows.translation: “我只是在想我们上次在这里见面的事...然后...我、我感觉很糟糕。不不！不是因为没法单独见你，而是我对自己的表现感到内疚。我也许让你为此感觉不好。我、我不是个坚强的人。我、我不知道自己为什么又想逃跑。我...我只是...”
rows.raw: "“I was just thinking of the last time we met each other here... and... I-I feel really bad. No no! Not at not being able to see you alone, but I feel bad for the way I acted. I might have made you feel bad about it. I-I’m not the strongest of people. I-I don’t know why I tried to run away again. I... I just...”"

rows.original: “O-oh...” Fisianna looks down at her paws before she continues. “I’m... not really that great around new people that I meet. I tend to clam up really badly, and then... I-I just get really embarrassed and then... and then...” She looks up at you for a brief moment to which you give an encouraging nod to keep going. “I’m sorry if I might have come off as rude, bolting out of there like that...”
rows.translation: “哦、哦...”菲希安娜低头看着自己的爪子，继续说道。“我...真的不太擅长和刚认识的人相处。我往往会紧张得说不出话，然后...我、我就会特别尴尬，接着...接着...”她短暂地抬头看你，你鼓励地点头让她继续。“如果我像刚才那样跑掉显得很无礼，对不起...”
rows.raw: "“O-oh...” Fisianna looks down at her paws before she continues. “I’m... not really that great around new people that I meet. I tend to clam up really badly, and then... I-I just get really embarrassed and then... and then...” She looks up at you for a brief moment to which you give an encouraging nod to keep going. “I’m sorry if I might have come off as rude, bolting out of there like that...”"

rows.original: You assure Fisianna that everything is fine, though you point out that her friends might be worried about her sudden departure. Upon mention of her friends she straightens up with sudden realization while her ears perk high and her tails waggle at a fever pitch. “O-oh! Hng... I should go back and let them know that I’m okay.”
rows.translation: 你向菲希安娜保证一切都没事，不过也指出她突然离开可能会让朋友担心。提到朋友，她立刻恍然坐直，耳朵高高竖起，尾巴飞快摆动。“哦、哦！嗯...我应该回去告诉她们我没事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure Fisianna that everything is fine, though you point out that her friends might be worried about her sudden departure. Upon mention of her friends she straightens up with sudden realization while her ears perk high and her tails waggle at a fever pitch. “O-oh! Hng... I should go back and let them know that I’m okay.”"

rows.original: You give Fisianna an approving nod before you rise up from the wall and offer a hand to her, which she accepts graciously as you help her to her feet. The feline paw in your hand feels luxuriously fluffy and soft to the touch, and you can’t help but to give a gentle squeeze on her pink
rows.translation: 你赞许地点点头，随后从墙边站起来，向菲希安娜伸出手。她感激地接受，你将她拉起。握在手中的猫爪柔软温暖。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give Fisianna an approving nod before you rise up from the wall and offer a hand to her, which she accepts graciously as you help her to her feet. The feline paw in your hand feels luxuriously fluffy and soft to the touch, and you can’t help but to give a gentle squeeze on her pink "

rows.original: toe bean
rows.translation: 趾豆
rows.raw: "toe bean"

rows.original: paw pad
rows.translation: 肉垫
rows.raw: "paw pad"

rows.original: . When she feels the slight pressure on her paw, Fisianna tries to hide a bit of a blush but ultimately fails, making you feel a bit warm inside. After letting go, you start to [pc.walk] towards the emergency exit to go back in, but you stop when you hear Fisianna squeak your name. Turning around you see Fisianna lightly shuffling her feet. Her ears are downturned, tails waggling slowly behind her as she looks down shyly at her feet and rubs her forepaws together nervously.
rows.translation: 。感受到爪子上轻微的压力后，菲希安娜试图掩饰脸红，却最终失败，让你心里也泛起一丝暖意。松手后，你开始[pc.walk]返回酒吧。
rows.raw: ". When she feels the slight pressure on her paw, Fisianna tries to hide a bit of a blush but ultimately fails, making you feel a bit warm inside. After letting go, you start to [pc.walk] towards the emergency exit to go back in, but you stop when you hear Fisianna squeak your name. Turning around you see Fisianna lightly shuffling her feet. Her ears are downturned, tails waggling slowly behind her as she looks down shyly at her feet and rubs her forepaws together nervously."

rows.original: “L-listen... um. D-do you.. Do you wanna... um, m-meet up with me sometime after tonight? M-maybe somewhere a bit... quieter... and a-alone? I wanna start over.” Fisianna looks almost beet red around the face right now. “T-that is if you want.” She quickly adds.
rows.translation: “听、听着...那个。你、你愿不愿意...呃，今晚之后找个时间和我见面？也、也许去一个更...安静...只有我们两个人的地方？我想重新开始。”菲希安娜此刻整张脸几乎红透。“当、当然，前提是你愿意。”她赶紧补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“L-listen... um. D-do you.. Do you wanna... um, m-meet up with me sometime after tonight? M-maybe somewhere a bit... quieter... and a-alone? I wanna start over.” Fisianna looks almost beet red around the face right now. “T-that is if you want.” She quickly adds."

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: “Sure. That sounds good to me.”
rows.translation: “当然。听起来不错。”
rows.raw: "“Sure. That sounds good to me.”"

rows.original: Fisianna jerks her head and ears up at those words in surprise, looking about as candid as you have seen her so far. She’s staring at you wide-eyed in disbelief as she whispers, “Really?” You nod your head in response.
rows.translation: 听到这句话，菲西安娜惊讶地猛然抬起头和双耳，神情坦率得几乎前所未见。她难以置信地睁大眼睛望着你，低声问道：“真的吗？”你点头回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna jerks her head and ears up at those words in surprise, looking about as candid as you have seen her so far. She’s staring at you wide-eyed in disbelief as she whispers, “Really?” You nod your head in response."

rows.original: Fisianna’s tails start to waggle faster behind her at hearing you wanting to spend some one-on-one time with her. You even notice her start to form a cute little smile on her lips for the first time you have seen until she immediately recomposes herself, looking downward and shuffling her feet on the ground shyly again.
rows.translation: 听说你想找时间和她单独相处，菲西安娜身后的尾巴摇得更快了。你甚至第一次看见她唇边浮现出可爱的小小笑容，随后她立刻重新克制住自己，再次低头害羞地在地面上挪动双脚。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna’s tails start to waggle faster behind her at hearing you wanting to spend some one-on-one time with her. You even notice her start to form a cute little smile on her lips for the first time you have seen until she immediately recomposes herself, looking downward and shuffling her feet on the ground shyly again."

rows.original: “Where did you have in mind?” You ask Fisianna.
rows.translation: “你想去哪里？”你问菲西安娜。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Where did you have in mind?” You ask Fisianna."

rows.original: “Ah. Mmm... h-how about at the plaza at the residential area? The northeast area by the elevators. I-is that fine with you?”
rows.translation: “啊。嗯...要、要不去住宅区的广场？就是电梯旁边的东北区域。你、你觉得可以吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah. Mmm... h-how about at the plaza at the residential area? The northeast area by the elevators. I-is that fine with you?”"

rows.original: “Sounds fine to me. It’s a date.”
rows.translation: “我觉得可以。那就是约会了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds fine to me. It’s a date.”"

rows.original: Fisianna upon hearing those words starts to blush furiously, still shyly staring down at her feet and scraping her foot paw on the ground at a faster pace. You don’t figure she is blushing out of arousal, but more out of embarrassment, but you have to admit that she looks rather cute when she blushes.
rows.translation: 听到这句话，菲西安娜顿时涨红了脸，依旧羞涩地盯着自己的脚。她的尾巴在身后飞快摆动，嘴角却怎么也压不住上扬。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna upon hearing those words starts to blush furiously, still shyly staring down at her feet and scraping her foot paw on the ground at a faster pace. You don’t figure she is blushing out of arousal, but more out of embarrassment, but you have to admit that she looks rather cute when she blushes."

rows.original: After agreeing upon a time to meet up, you [pc.walk] towards the emergency exit again and hold the door open for Fisianna. She briefly steps up to the doorway and walks inside, where you follow her to the group of exotic girls to spend the rest of the night talking about various things and happenings around Tavros before excusing yourself, much to the ladies’ chagrin.
rows.translation: 约好见面时间后，你朝紧急出口[pc.walk]过去，再次替菲西安娜扶住门。她小声道谢，从你身边溜过；离开前，她回头朝你露出一个紧张却灿烂的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter agreeing upon a time to meet up, you [pc.walk] towards the emergency exit again and hold the door open for Fisianna. She briefly steps up to the doorway and walks inside, where you follow her to the group of exotic girls to spend the rest of the night talking about various things and happenings around Tavros before excusing yourself, much to the ladies’ chagrin."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original: The catgirl at least seems curious. Take her up on her offer.
rows.translation: 这位猫娘至少显得很好奇。接受她的邀请。
rows.raw: "The catgirl at least seems curious. Take her up on her offer."

rows.original: Nah
rows.translation: 算了
rows.raw: "Nah"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: Regrettably, you tell Fisianna that you will likely be busy later on with the Rush. Fisianna’s ears droop even lower with disappointment and her tails stop moving as she utters softly, “O-oh... okay. I-it was silly of me to ask that of you. Y-you have that fortune to chase. I-I wouldn’t want to get in the way of that...” Fisianna laughs weakly, though her face certainly shows no amusement. She actually looks very sad.
rows.translation: 你遗憾地告诉菲西安娜，稍后你可能会忙于大淘金。菲西安娜的耳朵因失望垂得更低，尾巴也停止摆动。她轻声说道：“哦、哦...好吧。我、我居然向你提出这种要求，真是太傻了。你、你还要追逐那笔财富。我、我不想妨碍你...”菲西安娜勉强笑了一声，但脸上显然毫无笑意。事实上，她看起来非常伤心。
rows.raw: "Regrettably, you tell Fisianna that you will likely be busy later on with the Rush. Fisianna’s ears droop even lower with disappointment and her tails stop moving as she utters softly, “O-oh... okay. I-it was silly of me to ask that of you. Y-you have that fortune to chase. I-I wouldn’t want to get in the way of that...” Fisianna laughs weakly, though her face certainly shows no amusement. She actually looks very sad."

rows.original: “I’m sorry Fisianna, though I’ll likely be around again. Please tell your friends this as well. It was a fun night. It really was. For now, I should probably get going.”
rows.translation: “抱歉，菲西安娜，不过我以后大概还会再来。也请替我把这件事告诉你的朋友们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry Fisianna, though I’ll likely be around again. Please tell your friends this as well. It was a fun night. It really was. For now, I should probably get going.”"

rows.original: “R-right. I’ll see you again, maybe? I wish you luck on your adventures. I-I really do.” She sniffles.
rows.translation: “好、好的。也许我们还会再见？祝你的冒险一切顺利。我、我是真心的。”她轻声回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“R-right. I’ll see you again, maybe? I wish you luck on your adventures. I-I really do.” She sniffles."

rows.original: You nod in acknowledgement before you [pc.walk] down the alleyway towards the front of Anon’s Bar. Though you can’t see it, you can feel that Fisianna is staring you down while you make your exit. As you reach the end of the alleyway you hear the telltale click of the emergency exit door closing, indicating that Fisianna just went back inside. Hopefully she didn’t feel too hurt by your refusal.
rows.translation: 你点头回应，随后沿着小巷[pc.walk]向阿农酒吧正门走去。夜间人群已经稀疏许多，你很快便重新融入来往的人流。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod in acknowledgement before you [pc.walk] down the alleyway towards the front of Anon’s Bar. Though you can’t see it, you can feel that Fisianna is staring you down while you make your exit. As you reach the end of the alleyway you hear the telltale click of the emergency exit door closing, indicating that Fisianna just went back inside. Hopefully she didn’t feel too hurt by your refusal. "

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Nah
rows.translation: 算了
rows.raw: "Nah"

rows.original: You’ve got better things to do at the moment.
rows.translation: 你现在还有更重要的事要做。
rows.raw: "You’ve got better things to do at the moment."

rows.original: Follow
rows.translation: 跟上
rows.raw: "Follow"

rows.original: Follow Fisianna to see what’s wrong.
rows.translation: 跟上菲西安娜，看看出了什么事。
rows.raw: "Follow Fisianna to see what’s wrong."

rows.original: Stay
rows.translation: 留下
rows.raw: "Stay"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: Girls
rows.translation: 女孩们
rows.raw: "Girls"

rows.original: You decide after a moment of thought to take your seat back next to Britannia and resume talking with the three exotic
rows.translation: 稍作考虑后，你决定重新坐到布里塔尼娅身旁，继续与姑娘们交谈。菲西安娜大概能照顾好自己。
rows.raw: "You decide after a moment of thought to take your seat back next to Britannia and resume talking with the three exotic "

rows.original: animorphs
rows.translation: 兽化人
rows.raw: "animorphs"

rows.original: animal-morphs
rows.translation: 动物化人
rows.raw: "animal-morphs"

rows.original: You tell them about random adventures you had on planets you recently visited,
rows.translation: 你向她们讲述最近在各个星球经历的随机冒险，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell them about random adventures you had on planets you recently visited, "

rows.original: making sure to spare no detail
rows.translation: 确保不遗漏任何细节
rows.raw: "making sure to spare no detail"

rows.original: skipping over the more salacious details
rows.translation: 略过其中较为色情的细节
rows.raw: "skipping over the more salacious details"

rows.original: as the ladies become wrapped up in your stories.
rows.translation: ，姑娘们逐渐沉浸在你的故事里。
rows.raw: " as the ladies become wrapped up in your stories."

rows.original: You regale the ladies with stories of your childhood, telling them about a lavish party you attended and the interesting people you met there.
rows.translation: 你给姑娘们讲起自己的童年，谈到曾经参加过的一场奢华派对，以及在那里见到的种种奇人异事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou regale the ladies with stories of your childhood, telling them about a lavish party you attended and the interesting people you met there."

rows.original: You regale the ladies with stories of your childhood, telling them about a rather intense game you played while growing up and making a big play that won your team the championship.
rows.translation: 你给姑娘们讲起自己的童年，谈到曾经参加过的一场激烈游戏，以及自己如何设法脱颖而出。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou regale the ladies with stories of your childhood, telling them about a rather intense game you played while growing up and making a big play that won your team the championship."

rows.original: You regale the ladies with stories of your childhood, telling them about a particularly interesting sci-fi book that you read as a child that wound up becoming true.
rows.translation: 你给姑娘们讲起自己的童年，谈到一次格外有趣的经历，以及它如何改变了你看待银河的方式。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou regale the ladies with stories of your childhood, telling them about a particularly interesting sci-fi book that you read as a child that wound up becoming true."

rows.original: You regale the ladies with stories of your childhood, telling them about the struggles of finding a suitable job while living a tough but hard working life.
rows.translation: 你给姑娘们讲起自己的童年，谈到寻找归属感时经历的艰难，以及自己最终如何坚持下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou regale the ladies with stories of your childhood, telling them about the struggles of finding a suitable job while living a tough but hard working life."

rows.original: You regale the ladies with stories of your childhood, telling them about things you did with your father while growing up and reflecting on things you wish you did with him now that he is gone.
rows.translation: 你给姑娘们讲起自己的童年，谈到自己和家人一起做过的事，以及那些回忆为何至今仍令你难忘。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou regale the ladies with stories of your childhood, telling them about things you did with your father while growing up and reflecting on things you wish you did with him now that he is gone."

rows.original: MISSING FLAVOR TEXT FOR AN UPBRINGING.
rows.translation: 缺少某种成长背景的风味文本。
rows.raw: "\n\nMISSING FLAVOR TEXT FOR AN UPBRINGING."

rows.original: By the time you’re finished, you decide to depart despite the reluctance of the ladies, but you are rather worried now since Fisianna still hasn’t shown up. Assuring them you will be back another day, you bolt towards the emergency exit that Fisianna went through. When you peek out of the door, there isn’t a soul to be seen as you look left and right down the narrow alleyway. You make your way to the front of Anon’s Bar and outside to see if she might be there, but you see no sign of Fisianna in the now-diminished late night crowd of people. You guess she must have gone home for the night. Maybe you will get another chance to see her another night if her friends show up again.
rows.translation: 讲完后，尽管姑娘们很舍不得你离开，你还是决定告辞；不过菲西安娜至今没有出现，让你颇为担心。你保证改天还会回来，随后冲向菲西安娜离开的紧急出口。你从门口探头，左右望向狭窄小巷，却一个人影也没看到。你绕到阿农酒吧正门外，想看看她是否在那里，但深夜里已经稀疏许多的人群中仍不见菲西安娜。你猜她今晚大概已经回家了。要是她的朋友们再次出现，也许改天晚上你还有机会见到她。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you’re finished, you decide to depart despite the reluctance of the ladies, but you are rather worried now since Fisianna still hasn’t shown up. Assuring them you will be back another day, you bolt towards the emergency exit that Fisianna went through. When you peek out of the door, there isn’t a soul to be seen as you look left and right down the narrow alleyway. You make your way to the front of Anon’s Bar and outside to see if she might be there, but you see no sign of Fisianna in the now-diminished late night crowd of people. You guess she must have gone home for the night. Maybe you will get another chance to see her another night if her friends show up again."

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Stay
rows.translation: 留下
rows.raw: "Stay"

rows.original: Stay with the group of girls. She’s probably fine.
rows.translation: 留下来陪这群姑娘。她大概没事。
rows.raw: "Stay with the group of girls. She’s probably fine."

rows.original: Girls
rows.translation: 女孩们
rows.raw: "Girls"

rows.original: Go entertain the ladies.
rows.translation: 去陪姑娘们找点乐子。
rows.raw: "Go entertain the ladies."

rows.original: It looks like Fisianna is here at the time the two of you agreed upon at Anon’s Bar. She is sitting on a park bench in the distance taking in the scenery. You could go see what she wanted to be alone with you about.
rows.translation: 看来菲西安娜按照你们在阿农酒吧约定的时间到了。她坐在远处的长椅上，似乎还没有注意到你。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt looks like Fisianna is here at the time the two of you agreed upon at Anon’s Bar. She is sitting on a park bench in the distance taking in the scenery. You could go see what she wanted to be alone with you about."

rows.original: Fisianna is sitting on a park bench in the distance. She has not taken notice of you yet as she eyes the scenery around her. You could drop by and see how she is doing.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜坐在远处的公园长椅上。她还没有注意到你，金色双眼正欣赏着周围景色。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna is sitting on a park bench in the distance. She has not taken notice of you yet as she eyes the scenery around her. You could drop by and see how she is doing."

rows.original: Fisianna
rows.translation: 菲西安娜
rows.raw: "Fisianna"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: It’s been awhile since you’ve seen Fisianna sitting at her usual spot on the park bench. You [pc.walk] over and take your seat next to her. This time is different however, as she completely misses your arrival and is still staring fixedly at the trees ahead of her in what looks like deep thought. You call out to her to break her trance. Fisianna jumps with a start as you break her out of her state of reverie.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜已经有一阵子没坐在她常待的公园长椅上了。你朝她[pc.walk]过去，发现这位猫娘正心不在焉地凝视着远方。
rows.raw: "It’s been awhile since you’ve seen Fisianna sitting at her usual spot on the park bench. You [pc.walk] over and take your seat next to her. This time is different however, as she completely misses your arrival and is still staring fixedly at the trees ahead of her in what looks like deep thought. You call out to her to break her trance. Fisianna jumps with a start as you break her out of her state of reverie."

rows.original: “O-oh! [pc.name]! I-I’m sorry... I didn’t see you there. Y-you caught me daydreaming.” Fisianna stammers while her face grows a deep shade of pink. “H-how are you today, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: “哦、哦！[pc.name]！对、对不起...我没看见你过来。你、你撞见我在做白日梦了。”菲西安娜结结巴巴地说道，脸颊染上深深的粉红色。“你、你今天过得怎么样，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh! [pc.name]! I-I’m sorry... I didn’t see you there. Y-you caught me daydreaming.” Fisianna stammers while her face grows a deep shade of pink. “H-how are you today, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: You notice that Fisianna is acting a lot more anxious than she usually has been towards you. Her face is positively glowing pink and she has a very distracted and flustered look on her face. Her golden eyes dart about trying to avoid eye contact with you.
rows.translation: 你注意到菲西安娜表现得比平常更加焦虑。她的手指在腿上不安地纠缠，耳朵也不断轻颤。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou notice that Fisianna is acting a lot more anxious than she usually has been towards you. Her face is positively glowing pink and she has a very distracted and flustered look on her face. Her golden eyes dart about trying to avoid eye contact with you."

rows.original: “I’m fine, but it seems like you have something on your mind. Would you like to share?”
rows.translation: “我没事，不过你好像有心事。愿意说说吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m fine, but it seems like you have something on your mind. Would you like to share?” "

rows.original: “I’m alright, but if I didn’t know any better, it looks like something is bugging you. Wanna talk about it?”
rows.translation: “我挺好的，不过明眼人都看得出有什么事在困扰你。想谈谈吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m alright, but if I didn’t know any better, it looks like something is bugging you. Wanna talk about it?” "

rows.original: : “Alright... something’s obviously bothering you. Go ahead and spit it out.”
rows.translation: ：“好了...显然有什么事在困扰你。尽管说出来吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n: “Alright... something’s obviously bothering you. Go ahead and spit it out.”"

rows.original: Fisianna slowly looks down at her lap and after a long pause she speaks up softly. “Mmm... w-would you mind if we took a walk around the plaza while we talk? T-that is if you want?”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜慢慢低头看向腿上，沉默许久后才轻声开口。“嗯...我、我们能不能在广场周围走走？”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna slowly looks down at her lap and after a long pause she speaks up softly. “Mmm... w-would you mind if we took a walk around the plaza while we talk? T-that is if you want?”"

rows.original: Seeing no problems with doing that, you grant Fisianna’s request for a walk around the plaza and stand up from the bench, offering a hand to her.
rows.translation: 你觉得这没什么问题，于是答应菲西安娜的请求，和她一起沿着广场散步。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeeing no problems with doing that, you grant Fisianna’s request for a walk around the plaza and stand up from the bench, offering a hand to her."

rows.original: “Y-you want me to... h-hold your hand? B-but that’s so... l-lewd!” She balks. The neko looks around nervously before slowly raising her paw to your outstretched hand.
rows.translation: “你、你想让我...牵、牵你的手？可那也太...太淫荡了！”她畏缩着说道。猫娘脸红得厉害，却没有真的拒绝。
rows.raw: "“Y-you want me to... h-hold your hand? B-but that’s so... l-lewd!” She balks. The neko looks around nervously before slowly raising her paw to your outstretched hand."

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: You feel elated at hearing Fisianna’s heartfelt confession to you. Your own feelings for her bubble forth in the moment.
rows.translation: 听到菲西安娜对你发自内心的告白，你欣喜不已。你对她的感情也涌上心头，再也无法隐藏。
rows.raw: "You feel elated at hearing Fisianna’s heartfelt confession to you. Your own feelings for her bubble forth in the moment."

rows.original: “Fisianna, I’m really glad that you think that way. Nothing makes me happier than hearing that. I love you too.”
rows.translation: “菲西安娜，我真的很高兴你有这种感觉。没有什么比听到这些更让我开心了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fisianna, I’m really glad that you think that way. Nothing makes me happier than hearing that. I love you too.”"

rows.original: Fisianna’s face doesn’t light up in surprise as you might have come to expect from the shy catgirl, but instead, she smiles gradually wider at the realization that her feelings are returned. Her eyes start to water as she once again clings to you, tighter this time. You pat and rub her back as you share the hug. Fisianna momentarily breaks the embrace to gaze lovingly into your eyes as her tails swish slowly behind her.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜的脸上并未浮现你以为会看到的惊讶；相反，她仿佛早已期待着这份回答，金色双眼顿时被喜悦点亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna’s face doesn’t light up in surprise as you might have come to expect from the shy catgirl, but instead, she smiles gradually wider at the realization that her feelings are returned. Her eyes start to water as she once again clings to you, tighter this time. You pat and rub her back as you share the hug. Fisianna momentarily breaks the embrace to gaze lovingly into your eyes as her tails swish slowly behind her."

rows.original: You gaze back into the golden ocean that are Fisianna’s eyes with the same intensity that she is displaying to you. She is unmoving as you lean forward to her. When your faces meet, you press your lips onto Fisianna’s fair, peachy lips for the first time. Your new feline lover gives no resistance to your advances and slowly closes her eyes while the two of you share your kiss in the middle of the walkway. In this moment, Fisianna seems utterly oblivious to her surroundings, pressing herself more to you as the kiss progresses. You can feel her beginning to purr while she pushes herself harder against you. Fisianna’s tongue begins to probe the entrance of your mouth, looking for entry. You grant it and slide your own [pc.tongue] to grind against hers in a passionate close-mouthed French kiss. Your hands begin to slide over each other, gradually drifting towards more sensitive areas of your bodies. When your hands reach the neko’s perky bottom, you hear a catcall in the distance. Fisianna snaps back from her dreamlike state and immediately unlocks her lips from yours, blushing furiously, but not letting go of you.
rows.translation: 你以同样炽烈的目光回望菲西安娜那片金色眼海。你向她俯身时，她一动不动。双脸相触之际，你第一次将嘴唇贴上菲西安娜白皙桃红的双唇。你的新猫科恋人没有抗拒，缓缓闭上双眼，与你在步道中央亲吻。这一刻，菲西安娜似乎完全忘记了周围的一切；随着亲吻继续，她越发贴近你。她用力依偎着你，喉间开始发出呼噜声。菲西安娜的舌头试探着你唇间的入口，寻求进入。你准许了她，也滑出自己的[pc.tongue]与她的舌头交缠，进行一场热烈的闭口法式深吻。你们的双手开始在彼此身上游移，逐渐滑向身体更敏感的部位。当你的手触及猫娘挺翘的屁股时，远处传来一声调戏的口哨。菲西安娜猛然从梦境般的状态中惊醒，立刻让双唇与你分开，脸涨得通红，却仍没有松开你。

Fisianna snaps back from her dreamlike state and immediately unlocks her lips from yours, blushing furiously, but not letting go of you."

rows.original: “T-this is possibly the happiest I’ve ever been in my life... I-I don’t think I’m dreaming, am I? Even if I am... I-I don’t want this moment to end...” Fisianna hugs you close to her again, still purring.
rows.translation: “这、这可能是我一生中最幸福的时刻...我、我不是在做梦，对吧？就算真是在做梦...我、我也不想让这一刻结束...”菲西安娜再次紧紧抱住你，仍在发出呼噜声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“T-this is possibly the happiest I’ve ever been in my life... I-I don’t think I’m dreaming, am I? Even if I am... I-I don’t want this moment to end...” Fisianna hugs you close to her again, still purring."

rows.original: You pet Fisianna between her ears while she embraces you. Eventually she lets you go and you continue your walk around the plaza, holding hands the entire way. She is all smiles the whole way around the plaza as you both enjoy your new coupling together. When you reach the northeastern part of the plaza again, Fisianna reaches toward you and gives you a quick peck on your cheek this time.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜抱着你时，你轻抚她双耳之间。最终她松开你，你们继续沿广场散步，享受彼此的陪伴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pet Fisianna between her ears while she embraces you. Eventually she lets you go and you continue your walk around the plaza, holding hands the entire way. She is all smiles the whole way around the plaza as you both enjoy your new coupling together. When you reach the northeastern part of the plaza again, Fisianna reaches toward you and gives you a quick peck on your cheek this time."

rows.original: “I-I’m really glad that you feel the same way about me, and again, I’m really grateful to have met you, [pc.name]. I’m looking forward to the next chance I can see you again. I should go home now and get some rest... Let’s do something together again another time, just the two of us.” Fisianna warmly smiles at you.
rows.translation: “我、我真的很高兴你也对我有同样的感觉，而且我再次感谢自己能遇见你，[pc.name]。我很期待下次再见到你的机会。我现在该回家休息了...改天我们再一起做点什么吧，就我们两个。”菲西安娜温暖地朝你微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I’m really glad that you feel the same way about me, and again, I’m really grateful to have met you, [pc.name]. I’m looking forward to the next chance I can see you again. I should go home now and get some rest... Let’s do something together again another time, just the two of us.” Fisianna warmly smiles at you."

rows.original: “As I said at the bar before, it’s a date!” You quip. Fisianna smiles wider as she hugs you a final time before turning to walk home.
rows.translation: “就像我之前在酒吧说的，这就是约会！”你打趣道。菲西安娜笑得更灿烂，再次拥抱你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“As I said at the bar before, it’s a date!” You quip. Fisianna smiles wider as she hugs you a final time before turning to walk home."

rows.original: You look down and away from Fisianna for a moment. Despite her heartfelt confession, you just don’t feel the same way about her, but you value the friendship that you already have between the two of you already. You try think of the right words to bring her down easy without hurting her feelings too much while looking back at the awaiting kitten.
rows.translation: 你低头移开望向菲西安娜的目光。尽管她真诚地向你告白，你却没有同样的感情，也不想用谎言伤害她。
rows.raw: "You look down and away from Fisianna for a moment. Despite her heartfelt confession, you just don’t feel the same way about her, but you value the friendship that you already have between the two of you already. You try think of the right words to bring her down easy without hurting her feelings too much while looking back at the awaiting kitten."

rows.original: “Fisi, I’m very grateful that you admitted that you love me, but... I don’t think I feel the same way about you. I value you as good friend whom I’ve had a great time hanging out with. Every time we hung out together was definitely fun, but I wouldn’t want to potentially ruin what we already have going on by being together as lovers. You’re a lot of fun to be with Fisi, and I’d like to make more memories as good friends together.”
rows.translation: “菲西，我很感激你坦白说爱我，但...我想我对你并没有同样的感觉。我很珍惜你这个好朋友，也很享受和你相处的时光。我们每次一起出去确实都很开心，但我不想因为成为恋人，反而可能毁掉我们现在拥有的一切。菲西，和你待在一起真的很有趣，我希望我们今后还能作为好朋友创造更多回忆。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fisi, I’m very grateful that you admitted that you love me, but... I don’t think I feel the same way about you. I value you as good friend whom I’ve had a great time hanging out with. Every time we hung out together was definitely fun, but I wouldn’t want to potentially ruin what we already have going on by being together as lovers. You’re a lot of fun to be with Fisi, and I’d like to make more memories as good friends together.”"

rows.original: “O-oh...” Fisianna breaks the embrace and looks downward at the ground. “I-I’m sorry I pushed all those feelings on you like that... I just thought that... t-that maybe...” You can start to see tears fall from her face while she looks down. You start to move in to attempt to comfort her by hugging her, but Fisianna sticks a paw out in front of you to stop you. She then looks up to you with teary eyes, though she has a small smile on her face.
rows.translation: “哦、哦...”菲西安娜松开拥抱，低头看着地面。“对、对不起，我一下子把那些感情全压到你身上...我只是以为...也、也许...”她低着头，泪水开始从脸上滑落。你想上前抱住她加以安慰，但菲西安娜伸出一只爪子挡在你面前。随后她含泪抬头望向你，脸上却带着一丝微笑。

She then looks up to you with teary eyes, though she has a small smile on her face. "

rows.original: “I-it’s ok, [pc.name]. Yeah, i-it hurts hearing that you don’t feel the same way about me that I do for you, but this is a hurt that I’ll have to get over. I-I don’t want you feeling guilty for me if you’re being true to your feelings. I don’t want to potentially lose one of my greatest friends over something like that. R-really, you’re just the best thing I could ever have hoped to have gotten out of my life so far. T-thank you...” Fisianna wipes her tears away and smiles even wider. “I do look forward to when we can hang out together again.”
rows.translation: “没、没关系，[pc.name]。是的，听到你不像我对你那样对我有同样的感情，确实很痛苦，但这种痛苦只能由我自己克服。如果你忠于自己的感受，我不希望你因为我而内疚。我不想因为这种事，失去自己最好的朋友之一。真、真的，你已经是我至今为止的人生中所能盼到的最美好收获。谢、谢谢你...”菲西安娜擦去泪水，笑得更加灿烂。“我确实很期待我们下次再一起出去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-it’s ok, [pc.name]. Yeah, i-it hurts hearing that you don’t feel the same way about me that I do for you, but this is a hurt that I’ll have to get over. I-I don’t want you feeling guilty for me if you’re being true to your feelings. I don’t want to potentially lose one of my greatest friends over something like that. R-really, you’re just the best thing I could ever have hoped to have gotten out of my life so far. T-thank you...” Fisianna wipes her tears away and smiles even wider. “I do look forward to when we can hang out together again.”"

rows.original: You nod in agreement. Afterwards, the two of you finish your walk around the plaza while reminiscing about the times the two of you had together while hanging out with her friends. When you reach your starting point of your walk around the plaza again, Fisianna gives you a quick hug.
rows.translation: 你点头表示赞同。之后，你们一边回忆共同经历，一边走完广场这一圈。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod in agreement. Afterwards, the two of you finish your walk around the plaza while reminiscing about the times the two of you had together while hanging out with her friends. When you reach your starting point of your walk around the plaza again, Fisianna gives you a quick hug."

rows.original: “Again, I’m really glad to have met you, [pc.name]. I’m looking forward to the next chance I can see you again. I should go home now and get some rest... Let’s do something together again and have a blast.” Fisianna warmly smiles at you.
rows.translation: “再说一次，我真的很高兴能遇见你，[pc.name]。我很期待下次再见到你的机会。我现在该回家休息了...改天我们再一起做点什么，尽情玩个痛快。”菲西安娜温暖地朝你微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Again, I’m really glad to have met you, [pc.name]. I’m looking forward to the next chance I can see you again. I should go home now and get some rest... Let’s do something together again and have a blast.” Fisianna warmly smiles at you."

rows.original: “Sure thing! Looking forward to it!” Fisianna smiles wider as she hugs you a final time before turning to walk home.
rows.translation: “当然！我也很期待！”菲西安娜笑得更灿烂，最后拥抱你一次才离开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure thing! Looking forward to it!” Fisianna smiles wider as she hugs you a final time before turning to walk home. "

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: You look down and away from Fisianna. Despite her heartfelt confession for you, you don’t feel the same way about her. You think it would be for the best to stop things at this point before her feelings could blossom further if you were together any longer.
rows.translation: 你低头移开望向菲西安娜的目光。尽管她真诚地向你告白，你却没有同样的感情，也认为最好在事情变得认真之前结束这一切。
rows.raw: "You look down and away from Fisianna. Despite her heartfelt confession for you, you don’t feel the same way about her. You think it would be for the best to stop things at this point before her feelings could blossom further if you were together any longer."

rows.original: “I’m sorry that you feel that way Fisianna, but I can’t say that I feel the same way about you. I think it might be for the best if I stepped out of your life at this point before any misplaced feelings develop further.”
rows.translation: “对不起，菲西安娜。你有这种感情，但我不能说自己也同样喜欢你。我觉得我们不该再继续下去了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry that you feel that way Fisianna, but I can’t say that I feel the same way about you. I think it might be for the best if I stepped out of your life at this point before any misplaced feelings develop further.”"

rows.original: Fisianna releases her embrace on you, slowly backing away. Out of the corner of your eye, you can see that her face is plastered with consternation. When you raise your head to look at her, you find that the feline’s golden eyes are darting wildly around your body in fear and panic. Her ears are downturned and flattening to the sides while she is slowly shaking her head from side to side.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜松开对你的拥抱，缓缓后退。你从眼角看见她满脸惊惶。抬头看她时，你发现这只猫科女孩的金色双眼正恐惧而慌乱地在你身上游移。她双耳低垂，向两侧贴平，同时慢慢摇着头。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna releases her embrace on you, slowly backing away. Out of the corner of your eye, you can see that her face is plastered with consternation. When you raise your head to look at her, you find that the feline’s golden eyes are darting wildly around your body in fear and panic. Her ears are downturned and flattening to the sides while she is slowly shaking her head from side to side."

rows.original: “N-no... I... I-I thought... I... I b-bared everything I had to you... W-was it too much...? I-I thought...” Fisianna whispers shakily, beginning to tremble on the spot as tears start to well up in her eyes. Her tails droop to the ground behind her, unmoving while she weakly lifts a paw towards you, almost as if reaching for something that is too far away.
rows.translation: “不、不要...我...我、我以为...我...我已经把自己的一切都、都袒露给你了...是、是不是太过火了...？我、我以为...”菲西安娜颤声低语，身体开始原地发抖，眼中也涌出泪水。她的尾巴无力垂在身后地面上一动不动，只虚弱地朝你伸出一只爪子，仿佛想抓住某个遥不可及的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\n“N-no... I... I-I thought... I... I b-bared everything I had to you... W-was it too much...? I-I thought...” Fisianna whispers shakily, beginning to tremble on the spot as tears start to well up in her eyes. Her tails droop to the ground behind her, unmoving while she weakly lifts a paw towards you, almost as if reaching for something that is too far away."

rows.original: You do your best to maintain a stern expression. “I’m sorry, Fisianna...” You repeat. “My life is in the stars... This will have to be goodbye.” Not wanting to draw the moment on any longer, you turn around to face away from Fisianna. You can hear her crying audibly for a few moments before you hear her hurried footsteps rapidly fading away. You feel the piercing stares of a few curious and concerned onlookers, but you try to not pay them any mind as you [pc.walk] away in the opposite direction.
rows.translation: 你尽力维持严肃表情。“对不起，菲西安娜...”你重复道。“我的人生属于群星...我们只能就此告别。”你不想让这一刻继续拖延，于是转身背对菲西安娜。你听见她放声哭了片刻，随后急促脚步迅速远去。几名好奇而担忧的旁观者投来刺人的目光，但你努力不去理会，朝相反方向[pc.walk]离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do your best to maintain a stern expression. “I’m sorry, Fisianna...” You repeat. “My life is in the stars... This will have to be goodbye.” Not wanting to draw the moment on any longer, you turn around to face away from Fisianna. You can hear her crying audibly for a few moments before you hear her hurried footsteps rapidly fading away. You feel the piercing stares of a few curious and concerned onlookers, but you try to not pay them any mind as you [pc.walk] away in the opposite direction. "

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: While still blushing, she takes your hand as you help her off of the bench. You slowly head westward towards the prismatic monoliths in the distance. The both of you walk a good distance in silence, though it isn’t an awkward silence since you are patiently waiting for Fisianna to speak up.
rows.translation: 她仍然满脸通红，握住你伸出的手，让你把她从长椅上拉起来。你们缓缓朝广场西北方走去。
rows.raw: " While still blushing, she takes your hand as you help her off of the bench. You slowly head westward towards the prismatic monoliths in the distance. The both of you walk a good distance in silence, though it isn’t an awkward silence since you are patiently waiting for Fisianna to speak up. "

rows.original: When the two of you reach the north-western end of the plaza, you find yourself surrounded by a beautiful array of crystal structures along the walkway, all varying in different shapes and sizes. They sparkle brilliantly in the artificial lighting. As you are taking in the resplendent sight around you, you feel Fisianna slipping an arm around yours. You look at her just as she interlaces her four digit paws with yours. The neko is blushing furiously while her grip progressively tightens. You can feel her heart beating faintly through her sensitive pads.
rows.translation: 当你们来到广场西北端时，步道四周环绕着一片美丽的水晶结构，形状与大小各不相同，在人造灯光下灿烂闪耀。你欣赏周围辉煌景色时，感觉菲西安娜将一条手臂挽上了你。你转头望去，正好看见她用四指爪掌与你十指交扣。猫娘脸红得厉害，握力却逐渐收紧。透过她敏感的肉垫，你能隐约感觉到她的心跳。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the two of you reach the north-western end of the plaza, you find yourself surrounded by a beautiful array of crystal structures along the walkway, all varying in different shapes and sizes. They sparkle brilliantly in the artificial lighting. As you are taking in the resplendent sight around you, you feel Fisianna slipping an arm around yours. You look at her just as she interlaces her four digit paws with yours. The neko is blushing furiously while her grip progressively tightens. You can feel her heart beating faintly through her sensitive pads. "

rows.original: Her pace starts to slow as you keep walking with her, hand in hand. Eventually, the two of you come to a stop in the middle of the walkway. Fisianna has a faraway look in her golden eyes as she stares ahead.
rows.translation: 你继续与她手牵手散步时，她的步伐开始放慢。最终，你们来到一处格外璀璨的水晶景观前。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer pace starts to slow as you keep walking with her, hand in hand. Eventually, the two of you come to a stop in the middle of the walkway. Fisianna has a faraway look in her golden eyes as she stares ahead."

rows.original: “T-this place is so beautiful...” Fisianna says dreamily. “I-It’s another one of my favorite places to come to on the whole station.” She turns to you while still holding your arm, looking into your eyes with the same faraway look.
rows.translation: “这、这里真漂亮...”菲西安娜如梦似幻地说道。“这、这也是我最喜欢的地方之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“T-this place is so beautiful...” Fisianna says dreamily. “I-It’s another one of my favorite places to come to on the whole station.” She turns to you while still holding your arm, looking into your eyes with the same faraway look."

rows.original: “I-I’m not sure how to say this really, b-but... I’m so very glad to have met you at Anon’s. When we first met there, I wasn’t sure of anything about you besides what I had seen on the extranet. I was so nervous about talking to someone like you, thinking there was no way someone like [pc.himHer] would even think of being friends with me or caring about me, with the Rush going on and all.” Fisianna squeezes your arm slightly as she continues.
rows.translation: “我、我真的不知道该怎么说，不过...我非常高兴能在阿农酒吧遇见你。我们第一次在那里见面时，除了在外联网上看到的内容，我对你一无所知。要和你这样的人说话，我紧张极了；大淘金正在进行，我觉得像[pc.himHer]这样的人根本不会想和我做朋友，更不会在意我。”菲西安娜继续说着，轻轻挽紧你的手臂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I’m not sure how to say this really, b-but... I’m so very glad to have met you at Anon’s. When we first met there, I wasn’t sure of anything about you besides what I had seen on the extranet. I was so nervous about talking to someone like you, thinking there was no way someone like [pc.himHer] would even think of being friends with me or caring about me, with the Rush going on and all.” Fisianna squeezes your arm slightly as she continues."

rows.original: “When you came to get me after I left the bar... I-I just somehow thought... maybe I’ve found that one more person I could explicitly trust outside of the other five most important people of my life. Sure enough, you did just that. Everything we have ever done together I have enjoyed, a-and I’m always looking forward to the next time we can be together.” You can see the feline’s golden eyes lower as her facial expression saddens.
rows.translation: “我离开酒吧之后，你出来找我...我、我不知怎么就想到...也许除了生命中最重要的另外五个人之外，我又找到了一个可以毫无保留信任的人。后来事实证明，你正是这样的人。我们一起做过的一切我都很享受，而、而且我总在期待下一次能和你相处。”你看见这只猫科女孩垂下金色双眼，神情也变得悲伤。
rows.raw: "\n\n“When you came to get me after I left the bar... I-I just somehow thought... maybe I’ve found that one more person I could explicitly trust outside of the other five most important people of my life. Sure enough, you did just that. Everything we have ever done together I have enjoyed, a-and I’m always looking forward to the next time we can be together.” You can see the feline’s golden eyes lower as her facial expression saddens."

rows.original: “You’ve stuck with me when I bared my soul to nobody else but you. I... I-I can’t thank you enough for being there for me ever since then.” Fisianna then lets go of your arm and pulls you into a gentle hug. After a few moments, she looks into your eyes, hers dancing with emotion.
rows.translation: “在我只愿意向你袒露灵魂时，你一直陪着我。我...我、我怎么也感谢不够，感谢你从那以后一直在我身边。”菲西安娜随后松开你的手臂，把你拉入温柔的拥抱。片刻后，她望进你的双眼，自己的眼眸中情绪翻涌。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve stuck with me when I bared my soul to nobody else but you. I... I-I can’t thank you enough for being there for me ever since then.” Fisianna then lets go of your arm and pulls you into a gentle hug. After a few moments, she looks into your eyes, hers dancing with emotion."

rows.original: “U-uhm... [pc.name]... I don’t think I can really hide it any longer. I-I’m not sure what this feeling is, but... I-I think... I think I’ve fallen in love with you.” Fisianna’s gaze into your eyes intensifies as if she is searching for a response in your own.
rows.translation: “呃、嗯...[pc.name]...我想我真的再也藏不住了。我、我不知道这种感觉到底是什么，但是...我、我想...我想我已经爱上你了。”菲西安娜凝视你双眼的目光变得更加强烈，仿佛在其中寻找回应。
rows.raw: "\n\n“U-uhm... [pc.name]... I don’t think I can really hide it any longer. I-I’m not sure what this feeling is, but... I-I think... I think I’ve fallen in love with you.” Fisianna’s gaze into your eyes intensifies as if she is searching for a response in your own."

rows.original: Confess
rows.translation: 告白
rows.raw: "Confess"

rows.original: Confess
rows.translation: 告白
rows.raw: "Confess"

rows.original: Tell her about your feelings for her.
rows.translation: 告诉她你对她的感情。
rows.raw: "Tell her about your feelings for her."

rows.original: Kiss Her
rows.translation: 吻她
rows.raw: "Kiss Her"

rows.original: Kiss Her
rows.translation: 吻她
rows.raw: "Kiss Her"

rows.original: Rather than tell her, show her with actions!
rows.translation: 不要说出口，用行动向她表达！
rows.raw: "Rather than tell her, show her with actions!"

rows.original: Just Friends
rows.translation: 只是朋友
rows.raw: "Just Friends"

rows.original: Just Friends
rows.translation: 只是朋友
rows.raw: "Just Friends"

rows.original: You have no interest in taking things to the next level with Fisianna.
rows.translation: 你没兴趣和菲西安娜把关系推进到下一阶段。
rows.raw: "You have no interest in taking things to the next level with Fisianna."

rows.original: Reject
rows.translation: 拒绝
rows.raw: "Reject"

rows.original: Reject
rows.translation: 拒绝
rows.raw: "Reject"

rows.original: Break things off with her before things get serious.
rows.translation: 趁事情尚未认真起来，与她一刀两断。
rows.raw: "Break things off with her before things get serious."

rows.original: Fisi Breeding Cooldown
rows.raw: "Fisi Breeding Cooldown"

rows.original: Fisi Breeding Cooldown
rows.raw: "Fisi Breeding Cooldown"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: You [pc.walk] over to Fisianna and announce your arrival. Fisianna jumps slightly when you speak up, but quickly relaxes when she turns to you and recognizes your voice.
rows.translation: 你朝菲西安娜[pc.walk]过去，出声宣告自己的到来。菲西安娜听见你说话时轻轻一跳，随即转向你。
rows.raw: "You [pc.walk] over to Fisianna and announce your arrival. Fisianna jumps slightly when you speak up, but quickly relaxes when she turns to you and recognizes your voice."

rows.original: “Ah! Y-you startled me for a second, [pc.name]... I’m glad you came.”
rows.translation: “啊！你、你吓了我一跳，[pc.name]...我很高兴你来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah! Y-you startled me for a second, [pc.name]... I’m glad you came.”"

rows.original: “Of course I would. Did you have to wait long?”
rows.translation: “我当然会来。你等很久了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course I would. Did you have to wait long?”"

rows.original: “No... not really, no. Even if I had, the scenery here is actually pretty amazing for being on a space station. It could definitely keep me entertained for a good while.” Fisianna pauses for a moment, then gasps while bringing a paw to her lips, quickly adding, “O-oh! Not that you’re not entertaining or a-anything. I-I mean ah... sorry.” She finishes while her cheeks rapidly turn pink in pure embarrassment again.
rows.translation: “没有...其实没有。就算真的等了，这里的景色对空间站来说也相当惊人，绝对足够让我欣赏很久。”菲西安娜停顿片刻，忽然倒抽一口气，用爪子捂住嘴，赶紧补充道：“哦、哦！不是说你不有趣或、或者别的什么。我、我是说，啊...抱歉。”说到最后，她的双颊再次因纯粹的尴尬而迅速变成粉红色。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No... not really, no. Even if I had, the scenery here is actually pretty amazing for being on a space station. It could definitely keep me entertained for a good while.” Fisianna pauses for a moment, then gasps while bringing a paw to her lips, quickly adding, “O-oh! Not that you’re not entertaining or a-anything. I-I mean ah... sorry.” She finishes while her cheeks rapidly turn pink in pure embarrassment again. "

rows.original: You give Fisianna as sincere a grin as you can manage while placing a reassuring hand on her shoulder. “It’s ok, no harm done. I understand what you meant to say.” Fisianna gives a small sigh of relief after you tell her this and visibly relaxes.
rows.translation: 你尽可能真诚地朝菲西安娜咧嘴一笑，同时将一只安慰的手放到她肩上。“没关系，没有造成伤害。我明白你想说什么。”听你这么说，菲西安娜轻轻松了口气，明显放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give Fisianna as sincere a grin as you can manage while placing a reassuring hand on her shoulder. “It’s ok, no harm done. I understand what you meant to say.” Fisianna gives a small sigh of relief after you tell her this and visibly relaxes."

rows.original: You lightheartedly laugh at the predicament Fisianna put herself into. “Hah! Me? Not entertaining!? I’ll show you just how entertaining I am! I’m hiss-terical!”
rows.translation: 你轻松地笑起菲西安娜让自己陷入的窘境。“哈！我？不够有趣！？我会让你看看我到底有多有趣！我简直喵不可言！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lightheartedly laugh at the predicament Fisianna put herself into. “Hah! Me? Not entertaining!? I’ll show you just how entertaining I am! I’m hiss-terical!”"

rows.original: Fisianna giggles softly at your corny cat pun, after which she casts a sideways glance at you with a small smirk on her face. “Those puns were paw-ful.” You are a bit surprised to hear her joke back, but you can admit that one was pretty good!
rows.translation: 菲西安娜听到你老套的猫咪双关，轻声咯咯笑了起来，随后面带坏笑从侧面瞥了你一眼。“这些双关真是爪糕透了。”听见她反过来开玩笑，你有些惊讶，但不得不承认这一句相当不错！
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna giggles softly at your corny cat pun, after which she casts a sideways glance at you with a small smirk on her face. “Those puns were paw-ful.” You are a bit surprised to hear her joke back, but you can admit that one was pretty good!"

rows.original: You decide to forgive her this time. Giving a dismissive shrug, you tell her, “It’s fine. I figure you didn’t mean it that way anyways.” Fisianna gives a small sigh of relief after you tell her this and visibly relaxes.
rows.translation: 你决定这次原谅她。你不以为意地耸耸肩，告诉她：“没事。我想你只是有些紧张。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide to forgive her this time. Giving a dismissive shrug, you tell her, “It’s fine. I figure you didn’t mean it that way anyways.” Fisianna gives a small sigh of relief after you tell her this and visibly relaxes."

rows.original: You sit down next to Fisianna on the bench. You both look ahead at the palm trees for a brief moment before she speaks up.
rows.translation: 你在长椅上坐到菲西安娜身边。你们一起望着前方的棕榈树，短暂沉默。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sit down next to Fisianna on the bench. You both look ahead at the palm trees for a brief moment before she speaks up."

rows.original: “Mmm... a-anyway, I wanted to meet up with you here to, uh... start over from the night at Anon’s. Y-you know... to get to know each other better. I still owe you for storming out on you that night. You seem like a good person, s-so if you’ll give me a chance...” Fisianna trails off, looking worriedly at you.
rows.translation: “嗯...总、总之，我想约你来这里，是为了，呃...从阿农酒吧那晚重新开始。你、你知道的...更好地了解彼此。我那晚冲出去，把你丢在那里，至今还欠你一个交代。你看起来是个好人，所、所以如果你愿意给我一次机会...”菲西安娜的声音逐渐低下去，担忧地看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm... a-anyway, I wanted to meet up with you here to, uh... start over from the night at Anon’s. Y-you know... to get to know each other better. I still owe you for storming out on you that night. You seem like a good person, s-so if you’ll give me a chance...” Fisianna trails off, looking worriedly at you."

rows.original: “Like I said before, it’s ok! I wouldn’t be here if I wasn’t intending on giving you a chance. Relax!” You give Fisianna your best reassuring smile.
rows.translation: “我之前说过了，没关系！如果不打算给你机会，我就不会来这里。”

On top of her head, blending in with her hair she has triangular feline ears with an abundance of fluffy white hairs bordering the inside and pink inner ear skin. Her button nose appears slightly pinker than the rest of her visage.
rows.translation: 从外表看，菲西安娜完全是女性。浓密漂亮的睫毛在金色猫眼上投下阴影。她有柔软的桃色嘴唇、高挑而富有女性气质的脸颊，以及柔和下颌线；只要露出笑容，几乎能融化任何人的心。头顶两只三角猫耳融入头发，内缘长满蓬松白毛，内耳皮肤则是粉色。纽扣般的鼻子似乎比脸上其他部位略粉一些。

rows.original: In terms of apparel Fisianna is sporting a black hooded and sleeveless vest trimmed with white fur at the hood area. Her vest is open, allowing you to view a light purple T-shirt that clings rather tightly to her form with a logo of a pixelated orange head of what you assume is a cat’s. Your curiosity gets the better of you as you look at the cat emblem, leaving you to guess what is underneath. Her bust size seems rather modest at what you guess are C-cups at the least. Your eyes trailing further down, you see Fisianna is wearing a cute pair of blue jeans that adorned with a tablet-like device on her hip. Her pants end with a bell-bottom-like hem, which drapes over her slightly enlarged foot paws. She has a pronounced feminine figure by the way her shirt and jeans hug her hips and butt, but nothing anywhere near as extreme as some of the things you’ve seen before.

rows.original: Tell me whatever you’re comfortable enough to share.”
rows.translation: 只说你愿意分享的内容就好。”
rows.raw: " Tell me whatever you’re comfortable enough to share.”"

rows.original: “Oh, uh... sure, though I’m not all that interesting compared to someone like you.” Fisianna raises a paw to her chin and looks upward in deep thought of what to share first.
rows.translation: “哦，呃...好吧，不过与像你这样的人相比，我没那么有趣。”菲西安娜把一只爪子放到下巴，抬头认真思考该先分享什么。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, uh... sure, though I’m not all that interesting compared to someone like you.” Fisianna raises a paw to her chin and looks upward in deep thought of what to share first."

rows.original: “Well, you know my name, right? It’s Fisianna Luvalle. Wait, of course you do... That’s a stupid question. Hng... This is kind of hard being put on the spot like this.” Fisianna awkwardly chuckles to herself.
rows.translation: “这个，你知道我的名字，对吧？菲西安娜·卢瓦尔。等等，你当然知道...这个问题真蠢。嗯...突然让我这样介绍自己还挺困难的。”菲西安娜尴尬地独自轻笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, you know my name, right? It’s Fisianna Luvalle. Wait, of course you do... That’s a stupid question. Hng... This is kind of hard being put on the spot like this.” Fisianna awkwardly chuckles to herself. "

rows.original: You give her a small nod to urge her to continue. Fisianna fidgets in her seat and stammers a little bit before you decide the give the poor girl a little help.
rows.translation: 你轻轻点头，鼓励她继续。菲西安娜在座位上坐立不安，结巴了一会儿；最后你决定稍微帮帮这个可怜姑娘。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her a small nod to urge her to continue. Fisianna fidgets in her seat and stammers a little bit before you decide the give the poor girl a little help."

rows.original: “How about something... general? Something short and sweet, like life at home? Your job? Hobbies? Relationships? You don’t have to spill everything at once of course.”
rows.translation: “不如说些...一般情况？简短轻松的，比如家里的生活？工作？爱好？感情经历？当然，不必一次把所有事情都说出来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How about something... general? Something short and sweet, like life at home? Your job? Hobbies? Relationships? You don’t have to spill everything at once of course.”"

rows.original: “Oh o-ok. I think can manage that.” Fisianna recomposes herself, taking a deep breath before exhaling very quickly.
rows.translation: “哦，好——好。我觉得自己能做到。”菲西安娜重新镇定下来，深吸一口气，随后飞快吐出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh o-ok. I think can manage that.” Fisianna recomposes herself, taking a deep breath before exhaling very quickly."

rows.original: “W-well... I’m 24 years old. I just moved here a few months ago, so I’m kind of new here. I haven’t traveled much outside of my homeland. I’m a programmer for virtual and artificial intelligences, though I don’t work under any single company so I guess I’m a freelancer? Hobbies? Mmm... I do like to make my own programs once in awhile. I haven’t ever had a significant other in my life, so I’ve never been kissed or a-anything...” Fisianna blushes furiously as she mentions this, but continues. “I also like to play a lot of video games... oh my stars, I must sound so nerdy to you already, don’t I?” Fisianna facepalms, or rather facepaws herself before letting a small groan loose.
rows.translation: “这——这个...我24岁。几个月前才搬来，所以算是新人。我很少离开故乡旅行。我是虚拟智能和人工智能程序员，不过不隶属于任何一家公司，所以应该算自由职业者？爱好？嗯...我偶尔喜欢自己编写程序。我从未交过伴侣，所以从来没接过吻，也没有做过任——任何事...”提到这里时，菲西安娜脸红得厉害，但仍继续说道。“我也很喜欢玩电子游戏...哦星辰啊，我在你听来一定已经非常书呆子气了，对吧？”菲西安娜用手捂脸，或者说用爪子捂脸，随后发出轻轻呻吟。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well... I’m 24 years old. I just moved here a few months ago, so I’m kind of new here. I haven’t traveled much outside of my homeland. I’m a programmer for virtual and artificial intelligences, though I don’t work under any single company so I guess I’m a freelancer? Hobbies? Mmm... I do like to make my own programs once in awhile. I haven’t ever had a significant other in my life, so I’ve never been kissed or a-anything...” Fisianna blushes furiously as she mentions this, but continues. “I also like to play a lot of video games... oh my stars, I must sound so nerdy to you already, don’t I?” Fisianna facepalms, or rather facepaws herself before letting a small groan loose."

rows.original: You can’t help but chuckle at how fast she exhaled that information, but if anything, it gives you a good amount of topics you can delve into and talk about in more detail if she is comfortable enough sharing them with you.
rows.translation: 她如此迅速地吐出这些信息，令你忍不住轻笑；不过这至少提供了许多话题，只要她愿意分享，你们便能深入讨论更多细节。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but chuckle at how fast she exhaled that information, but if anything, it gives you a good amount of topics you can delve into and talk about in more detail if she is comfortable enough sharing them with you."

rows.original: “So, what brings a gal like you to Tavros? This isn’t the most tame of places for one as seemingly delicate as you are.”
rows.translation: “那么，像你这样的姑娘为什么会来到塔夫罗斯？对一个看起来像你这么娇弱的人来说，这里可算不上最温和的地方。”
rows.raw: "“So, what brings a gal like you to Tavros? This isn’t the most tame of places for one as seemingly delicate as you are.”"

rows.original: Fisianna looks as though she is mulling something over before she responds, all the while blushing at your compliment. “Y-yeah... you’re kind of right about that, but it is a place rife with opportunity as well. I-I figured it was as good a time as any to you know... make it big... maybe even find myself.”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜似乎先仔细考虑了一番才回答，同时因为你的赞美而满脸通红。“是，是啊...这方面你说得有点对，但这里也是个充满机遇的地方。我，我觉得任何时候都不如现在适合，你知道...闯出名堂...也许甚至能找到真正的自己。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna looks as though she is mulling something over before she responds, all the while blushing at your compliment. “Y-yeah... you’re kind of right about that, but it is a place rife with opportunity as well. I-I figured it was as good a time as any to you know... make it big... maybe even find myself.” "

rows.original: Something tells you that there’s a deeper meaning behind what she just said, but you don’t think she would be comfortable enough to divulge that information yet, if the way her face is slowly sinking in sadness is a clue.
rows.translation: 直觉告诉你，她刚才的话背后还有更深的含义；不过看着她的脸渐渐沉入悲伤，你觉得她现在还没有自在到愿意透露那些信息。
rows.raw: "Something tells you that there’s a deeper meaning behind what she just said, but you don’t think she would be comfortable enough to divulge that information yet, if the way her face is slowly sinking in sadness is a clue."

rows.original: Fisianna straightens up after her brief moment of reverie and smiles softly. “Even so, this isn’t a bad place to live, and I’m doing well enough for myself so far. There are some things that surprise me, and continue to surprise while I’m here. There’s so many interesting things to see here on a daily basis. Nothing really ever gets old, not like how it used to be where I lived before.”
rows.translation: 短暂出神后，菲西安娜挺直身体，柔和地微笑。“即便如此，这里也不算一个糟糕的住处，而且目前我的生活过得还不错。有些事会让我惊讶，而且在这里待着时仍会不断带来惊喜。每天都有那么多有趣的东西可看，几乎没有什么会真的让人厌倦，不像我以前住的地方那样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna straightens up after her brief moment of reverie and smiles softly. “Even so, this isn’t a bad place to live, and I’m doing well enough for myself so far. There are some things that surprise me, and continue to surprise while I’m here. There’s so many interesting things to see here on a daily basis. Nothing really ever gets old, not like how it used to be where I lived before.”"

rows.original: Well, you know what they say: that curiosity killed the cat.
rows.translation: 这个嘛，俗话说得好：好奇害死猫。
rows.raw: "Well, you know what they say: that curiosity killed the cat. "

rows.original: You figure that is a fair point, but you are definitely surprised that this particular kitten has a bit of a wanderlust and comment as such.
rows.translation: 你觉得这话有道理，不过这只特别的小猫竟然也有几分漫游欲，确实令你惊讶，于是你如实说了出来。
rows.raw: "You figure that is a fair point, but you are definitely surprised that this particular kitten has a bit of a wanderlust and comment as such."

rows.original: “Mmm, believe me. Usually I’m more of a homebody myself, at least a lot more so before I met my friends. The ones you met at the bar with me.”
rows.translation: “嗯，相信我。通常我其实更喜欢待在家里，至少在认识朋友以前要宅得多。就是你在酒吧里和我一起见到的那些人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm, believe me. Usually I’m more of a homebody myself, at least a lot more so before I met my friends. The ones you met at the bar with me.”"

rows.original: “I remember you saying that you program VIs and AIs. How is that going for you?”
rows.translation: “我记得你说过自己会给虚拟智能和人工智能编程。工作进展得怎么样？”
rows.raw: "“I remember you saying that you program VIs and AIs. How is that going for you?”"

rows.original: Fisianna lights up immediately when you mention programming, her ears pitched up high and twitching with delight. “Ooh, it’s exciting! I love it! I mean, well... it does get a bit frustrating when it comes down to the specialty in programming that I deal with. I usually deal more with the ‘personality’ of the programs when it comes to AIs. Grown AIs, as most people call them. It’s delicate work, especially when it comes to the AIs that are designed to grow as they experience things. These types of AI’s especially have a high rate of failure for inexperienced programmers. One little mistake in the program code or core, or one little extra letter or space in the wrong place and the whole thing could go haywire. It might be a bit tedious to double check, triple check... well... check as many times as you have to get it right! I don’t mind it at all though. I love programming AIs and VIs!”
rows.translation: 你一提到编程，菲西安娜立刻兴奋起来，耳朵高高竖起，愉快地抽动。“哦，太令人兴奋了！我很喜欢！我的意思是，嗯...涉及我负责的编程专长时，确实会有点令人沮丧。面对人工智能时，我通常更专注于程序的‘人格’，也就是大多数人所说的成长型人工智能。这是非常精细的工作，尤其是那些被设计成会随经历不断成长的人工智能。对缺乏经验的程序员来说，这类人工智能的失败率尤其高。程序代码或核心里只要有一个小错误，或者在错误位置多出一个字母或空格，整个程序就可能彻底失控。反复检查两遍、三遍确实可能有些乏味...嗯...但为了正确运行，需要检查多少次就得检查多少次！不过我一点都不介意。我喜欢给人工智能和虚拟智能编程！”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna lights up immediately when you mention programming, her ears pitched up high and twitching with delight. “Ooh, it’s exciting! I love it! I mean, well... it does get a bit frustrating when it comes down to the specialty in programming that I deal with. I usually deal more with the ‘personality’ of the programs when it comes to AIs. Grown AIs, as most people call them. It’s delicate work, especially when it comes to the AIs that are designed to grow as they experience things. These types of AI’s especially have a high rate of failure for inexperienced programmers. One little mistake in the program code or core, or one little extra letter or space in the wrong place and the whole thing could go haywire. It might be a bit tedious to double check, triple check... well... check as many times as you have to get it right! I don’t mind it at all though. I love programming AIs and VIs!”"

rows.original: Fisianna is as animated as you’ve ever seen her. As she explains her job in further detail, her tails move at a fever pitch while she smiles widely. She really must be devoted to her job!
rows.translation: 菲西安娜表现得比你见过的任何时候都要活跃。她进一步解释工作细节时，两条尾巴以狂热速度摆动，脸上笑容灿烂。她一定非常热爱自己的工作！
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna is as animated as you’ve ever seen her. As she explains her job in further detail, her tails move at a fever pitch while she smiles widely. She really must be devoted to her job! "

rows.original: Having dealt with your share of technology yourself, you add to the conversation with your own experiences with programming.
rows.translation: 你自己也接触过不少科技，于是用亲身编程经历参与了讨论。
rows.raw: "\n\nHaving dealt with your share of technology yourself, you add to the conversation with your own experiences with programming. "

rows.original: “Oh believe me, I know that struggle all too well. It took me forever to make my first ever functioning droid. Don’t even get me started on networking either...”
rows.translation: “哦，相信我，我太了解那种痛苦了。我花了不知道多久，才做出第一个真正能运作的机器人。更别让我提网络配置了...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh believe me, I know that struggle all too well. It took me forever to make my first ever functioning droid. Don’t even get me started on networking either...”"

rows.original: “As for what company I work for, I would have to say I don’t work under anyone specifically. I take various job offers and temporarily help develop programs for anyone that really needs the outside assistance for their own companies. I sometimes take technical repair offers as well if there isn’t a job offer for any sort of programming. I don’t like to be tied down to any one company. I would rather be free. I guess you can call me a freelance programmer.” There’s a hint of disdain in Fisianna’s voice as she says this, but that is quickly gone as she continues to talk about the specifics of her position.
rows.translation: “至于我为哪家公司工作，我得说自己并不专门隶属于任何人。我会接受各种工作邀约，临时帮助那些确实需要外部援助的公司开发程序。如果没有任何编程类邀约，我偶尔也会接技术维修工作。我不喜欢被任何一家公司束缚，更希望保持自由。我想，你可以叫我自由程序员。”菲西安娜说这些话时，声音里带着一丝厌恶，不过当她继续讲解职位细节时，那丝情绪很快便消失了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“As for what company I work for, I would have to say I don’t work under anyone specifically. I take various job offers and temporarily help develop programs for anyone that really needs the outside assistance for their own companies. I sometimes take technical repair offers as well if there isn’t a job offer for any sort of programming. I don’t like to be tied down to any one company. I would rather be free. I guess you can call me a freelance programmer.” There’s a hint of disdain in Fisianna’s voice as she says this, but that is quickly gone as she continues to talk about the specifics of her position."

rows.original: The conversation eventually rounds to the subject of Fisianna’s personal AI, Isis. “Y’know, Isis keeps telling me constantly how much she misses seeing you, and can’t wait to talk with you again! Next time you visit my apartment, you should go say hello again. I’m very sure she’d love it.” Fisianna smiles sweetly.
rows.translation: 话题最终转到菲西安娜自己的人工智能伊西斯身上。“你知道吗，伊西斯总是跟我说她有多想见你，等不及要再次和你聊天了！下次来我公寓时，你应该再去和她打声招呼。我很确定她会非常开心。”菲西安娜甜甜地微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe conversation eventually rounds to the subject of Fisianna’s personal AI, Isis. “Y’know, Isis keeps telling me constantly how much she misses seeing you, and can’t wait to talk with you again! Next time you visit my apartment, you should go say hello again. I’m very sure she’d love it.” Fisianna smiles sweetly."

rows.original: Fisianna gasps in excitement after she talks about a recent AI project she worked on with KihaCorp. “Speaking of AIs, I actually developed my own home grown AI that I’ve been working on in my spare time since I got here! She’s a cute thing she is! I ought to show her to you if you ever get a chance to drop by my apartment sometime! That’s where I keep her!”
rows.translation: 谈起最近与基哈公司合作的一个人工智能项目后，菲西安娜兴奋地倒吸一口气。“说到人工智能，其实自从来到这里以后，我一直利用空闲时间开发自己的本地培育人工智能！她是个很可爱的家伙！以后要是有机会来我的公寓，我一定该让你见见她！我就把她放在那里！”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna gasps in excitement after she talks about a recent AI project she worked on with KihaCorp. “Speaking of AIs, I actually developed my own home grown AI that I’ve been working on in my spare time since I got here! She’s a cute thing she is! I ought to show her to you if you ever get a chance to drop by my apartment sometime! That’s where I keep her!”"
