rows.original: You tell Fisianna that she mentioned she likes to play games as a hobby and ask what types of games she likes to play.
rows.translation: 你告诉菲西安娜，她曾提到自己喜欢把玩游戏当作爱好，然后问她喜欢什么类型的游戏。
rows.raw: "You tell Fisianna that she mentioned she likes to play games as a hobby and ask what types of games she likes to play."

rows.original: “O-oh, all sorts of games! Puzzles, strategy, shooters, you name it! I’m particularly fond of adventure simulators myself. They’re kind of like what planetary rushes are in some cases, but none of the imminent danger... at least not real danger anyways. I suppose I’m pretty good at the shooters myself, feline reflexes and all.” Fisianna adds jokingly with a giggle.
rows.translation: “哦，哦，各种各样的游戏！解谜、策略、射击，什么都有！我个人特别喜欢冒险模拟器。在某些情况下，它们有点像行星淘金热，只是没有迫在眉睫的危险...至少没有真正的危险。射击游戏我想自己也相当拿手，毕竟有猫科动物的反应速度。”菲西安娜咯咯笑着开玩笑补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh, all sorts of games! Puzzles, strategy, shooters, you name it! I’m particularly fond of adventure simulators myself. They’re kind of like what planetary rushes are in some cases, but none of the imminent danger... at least not real danger anyways. I suppose I’m pretty good at the shooters myself, feline reflexes and all.” Fisianna adds jokingly with a giggle."

rows.original: “I’m pretty sure they have some gaming stations set up around here that we can probably play together. I’d like to see what you can do sometime in a game of Call of Valor 8.” You suggest.
rows.translation: “我很确定这附近设有一些游戏站，我们大概可以一起玩。我想哪天看看你在《英勇召唤8》里能有什么表现。”你提议道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m pretty sure they have some gaming stations set up around here that we can probably play together. I’d like to see what you can do sometime in a game of Call of Valor 8.” You suggest."

rows.original: Fisianna’s smile starts to turn into something that looks uncharacteristically devilish as her ears rotate forwards. “Oh you’re ON! Just say when!” The feline giddily bounces in her seat with her tails waggling wildly for a little while before at the flip of a switch, she realizes her excitement and straightens herself out, lightly coughing and turning into her usual meek self. “T-that is, if you want.”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜的笑容开始变得反常地邪恶，两只耳朵向前转动。“哦，来就来！说个时间吧！”这只猫咪兴奋地在座位上蹦跳，两条尾巴狂乱摇摆；过了一会儿，她仿佛开关翻转般意识到自己太过兴奋，立刻坐直身体，轻咳一声，又变回平常那副腼腆模样。“我，我是说，如果你想的话。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna’s smile starts to turn into something that looks uncharacteristically devilish as her ears rotate forwards. “Oh you’re ON! Just say when!” The feline giddily bounces in her seat with her tails waggling wildly for a little while before at the flip of a switch, she realizes her excitement and straightens herself out, lightly coughing and turning into her usual meek self. “T-that is, if you want.”"

rows.original: You start to develop the distinct feeling that Fisianna and Syri could become the best of friends if they ever met each other. Either that or the worst of gaming enemies knowing how Syri can behave during a game of Call of Valor.
rows.translation: 你渐渐产生一种强烈感觉：要是菲西安娜和Syri有机会见面，她们可能会成为最好的朋友。又或者，考虑到Syri玩《英勇召唤》时的表现，她们也可能变成最糟糕的游戏宿敌。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou start to develop the distinct feeling that Fisianna and Syri could become the best of friends if they ever met each other. Either that or the worst of gaming enemies knowing how Syri can behave during a game of Call of Valor."

rows.original: “About your friends... they’re quite the colorful group of girls. I’m curious to know how you all met each other?” You ask Fisianna.
rows.translation: “说到你的朋友...她们真是一群个性鲜明的姑娘。我很好奇，你们是怎么认识的？”你问菲西安娜。
rows.raw: "“About your friends... they’re quite the colorful group of girls. I’m curious to know how you all met each other?” You ask Fisianna."

rows.original: “O-oh. We actually met each other on the extranet back when I was a human on Terra.” Fisianna absentmindedly rubs her paws together. “They’re really nice people. They’re actually the ones that convinced me to come here, and they helped me get started with my life on Tavros.”
rows.translation: “哦，哦。其实还是我在特拉当人类时，我们就在外联网上认识了。”菲西安娜心不在焉地搓着两只爪子。“她们人真的很好。其实正是她们说服我来到这里，还帮助我开始了在塔夫罗斯的生活。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh. We actually met each other on the extranet back when I was a human on Terra.” Fisianna absentmindedly rubs her paws together. “They’re really nice people. They’re actually the ones that convinced me to come here, and they helped me get started with my life on Tavros.” "

rows.original: “They sounded nice enough when I met them at the bar. They’re certainly entertaining at least.” You think back about the night at Anon’s when you met Fisianna and how different their personalities were to Fisianna’s and can’t help but point that out to her.
rows.translation: “我在酒吧见到她们时，她们听起来确实挺友善。至少肯定很有趣。”你回想起在阿农酒吧遇见菲西安娜的那个夜晚，以及她们的性格和菲西安娜有多么不同，忍不住把这一点说给她听。
rows.raw: "\n\n“They sounded nice enough when I met them at the bar. They’re certainly entertaining at least.” You think back about the night at Anon’s when you met Fisianna and how different their personalities were to Fisianna’s and can’t help but point that out to her."

rows.original: “Y-yeah... I know I’m not as outgoing as them. I-I kind of envy them for that.” Fisianna looks wistfully at the palm trees ahead, ears downturning and sighing deeply as she continues. “T-that night at Anon’s, that was one of their ideas to start to try to get me to open up. They know I’m as timid towards strangers as a tove is greedy for money. I didn’t want to do that at all, but they insisted. It wasn’t the first time they’ve tried something like that either. Each time a stranger would come up to us at anytime, I... I felt like I wanted to die. I’m just so awkward a lot of times... S-still...”
rows.translation: “是，是啊...我知道自己没她们那么外向。我，我有点羡慕她们这一点。”菲西安娜若有所思地望着前方棕榈树，双耳垂下，深深叹息着继续说道。“在阿农酒吧的那个晚上，就是她们想出的主意，想让我开始敞开心扉。她们知道我面对陌生人时的胆怯程度，就像托芙人贪财一样。我根本不想那么做，但她们坚持。那也不是她们第一次尝试这种事。每次有陌生人走近我们，无论什么时候，我...我都会觉得自己想死。很多时候我就是这么笨拙...但，但是...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Y-yeah... I know I’m not as outgoing as them. I-I kind of envy them for that.” Fisianna looks wistfully at the palm trees ahead, ears downturning and sighing deeply as she continues. “T-that night at Anon’s, that was one of their ideas to start to try to get me to open up. They know I’m as timid towards strangers as a tove is greedy for money. I didn’t want to do that at all, but they insisted. It wasn’t the first time they’ve tried something like that either. Each time a stranger would come up to us at anytime, I... I felt like I wanted to die. I’m just so awkward a lot of times... S-still...”"

rows.original: Fisianna turns towards you with a rather intense look in her eyes. She grabs your hand in her paw while she speaks. “I-I’m really glad to have met you out of this though. I have them to thank for this. You’ve been a great new friend to me, a-and I couldn’t ask for anything more out of them.”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜转向你，眼神相当强烈。说话时，她用爪子握住你的手。“不，不过我真的很庆幸因此遇见了你。这一点要感谢她们。你已经成了我非常棒的新朋友，而，而她们能带给我的，再没有什么比这更好了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna turns towards you with a rather intense look in her eyes. She grabs your hand in her paw while she speaks. “I-I’m really glad to have met you out of this though. I have them to thank for this. You’ve been a great new friend to me, a-and I couldn’t ask for anything more out of them.”"

rows.original: You thank Fisianna and give her paw a gentle squeeze. She blushes and lets go of your hand, looking back towards the palm trees with a contented look on her face.
rows.translation: 你向菲西安娜道谢，轻轻捏了捏她的爪子。她红着脸松开你的手，重新望向棕榈树，脸上带着满足的神情。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thank Fisianna and give her paw a gentle squeeze. She blushes and lets go of your hand, looking back towards the palm trees with a contented look on her face."

rows.original: “So you said you ‘were’ human. What brought on the decision to start modding yourself? Especially with such unique mods.” You point at one of Fisianna’s furred paws.
rows.translation: “所以你说自己‘曾经’是人类。是什么让你决定开始改造自己？尤其还是如此独特的改造。”你指了指菲西安娜一只覆着毛发的爪子。
rows.raw: "“So you said you ‘were’ human. What brought on the decision to start modding yourself? Especially with such unique mods.” You point at one of Fisianna’s furred paws."

rows.original: “Ah, that’s an easy one. I really like cats!” Fisianna giggles and starts to swing her legs under the bench. “Back on Terra when I was a teen, I actually used to own a cat. She was the cutest little tabby cat. Her name was Isis. I used to play with her all the time. One day... she... she passed away. It was one of the saddest days of my life...” Fisianna’s expression rapidly changes to that of solemn mourning after she says this.
rows.translation: “啊，这个很简单。我真的很喜欢猫！”菲西安娜咯咯笑着，开始在长椅下晃动双腿。“我十几岁还在地球时，其实养过一只猫。她是最可爱的小虎斑猫，名字叫伊西斯。我以前总和她一起玩。有一天...她...她去世了。那是我一生中最悲伤的日子之一...”说完这些，菲西安娜的表情迅速变成肃穆的哀伤。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, that’s an easy one. I really like cats!” Fisianna giggles and starts to swing her legs under the bench. “Back on Terra when I was a teen, I actually used to own a cat. She was the cutest little tabby cat. Her name was Isis. I used to play with her all the time. One day... she... she passed away. It was one of the saddest days of my life...” Fisianna’s expression rapidly changes to that of solemn mourning after she says this."

rows.original: “I’m sorry to hear...” You try to console her.
rows.translation: “听到这件事，我很难过...”你试着安慰她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry to hear...” You try to console her."

rows.original: “I-it’s ok, [pc.name]... I-it was just her time to go is all...” Despite her efforts to try to stay strong, you can see tears start to well up in her eyes.
rows.translation: “没、没关系，[pc.name]...只、只是她该走的时候到了...”尽管她努力保持坚强，你仍看见泪水开始在她眼中积聚。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-it’s ok, [pc.name]... I-it was just her time to go is all...” Despite her efforts to try to stay strong, you can see tears start to well up in her eyes."

rows.original: You decide to try to move the conversation on as quickly as possible. “So was Isis an inspiration for your mod changes then?”
rows.translation: 你决定尽快把话题转开。“那么，伊西斯就是你进行身体改造的灵感吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide to try to move the conversation on as quickly as possible. “So was Isis an inspiration for your mod changes then?”"

rows.original: Fisianna wipes an eye and sniffles slightly before answering, “Largely, yes. I wanted to do these changes in memory of her. Part of it was also mere curiosity, which I suppose comes with being cat-like. I was also interested in those ‘nekomata’ I read about in Japanese folklore. The main reason why I wanted to make the changes to myself was because... I wanted to differentiate myself from who I was. I just simply wasn’t very happy being a human and felt I needed to express how I really feel... on the outside.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜擦了擦眼睛，轻轻抽鼻子后回答：“很大程度上是的。我想以这些改变纪念她。部分原因也只是出于好奇，我想这和猫一样的性格很相称。我也对日本民间传说中读到的那些‘猫又’很感兴趣。我之所以想改变自己，主要是因为...我想与过去的自己区别开来。身为人类时，我就是不太快乐，觉得自己需要把真正的内心感受...表现在外面。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna wipes an eye and sniffles slightly before answering, “Largely, yes. I wanted to do these changes in memory of her. Part of it was also mere curiosity, which I suppose comes with being cat-like. I was also interested in those ‘nekomata’ I read about in Japanese folklore. The main reason why I wanted to make the changes to myself was because... I wanted to differentiate myself from who I was. I just simply wasn’t very happy being a human and felt I needed to express how I really feel... on the outside. "

rows.original: I can tell you my parents were NOT happy to hear that...” Fisianna’s face turns into a grimace after she says this.
rows.translation: 我可以告诉你，我的父母听到这些时可一点都不高兴...”说完后，菲西安娜的脸皱成了一团。
rows.raw: "I can tell you my parents were NOT happy to hear that...” Fisianna’s face turns into a grimace after she says this."

rows.original: You ask her why that might be, but Fisianna’s face starts to contort into something very unfitting for her. She looks to be both simultaneously pained and... angry?
rows.translation: 你问她为什么会这样，但菲西安娜的脸开始扭曲成一种非常不适合她的表情。她看起来既痛苦...又愤怒？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her why that might be, but Fisianna’s face starts to contort into something very unfitting for her. She looks to be both simultaneously pained and... angry?"

rows.original: “I-I’m sorry [pc.name]... This... isn’t something I’m the most comfortable talking about. Can we talk about it another time?” She looks down at her hands and fumbles with some of the orange hair around her paw.
rows.translation: “对、对不起，[pc.name]...这...不是我很愿意谈论的事。我们可以改天再说吗？”她低头看着双手，摆弄爪子周围的一些橙色毛发。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I’m sorry [pc.name]... This... isn’t something I’m the most comfortable talking about. Can we talk about it another time?” She looks down at her hands and fumbles with some of the orange hair around her paw."

rows.original: At that earlier expression on her face, you definitely think it best to leave the subject be for now. You put a reassuring hand on her shoulder without thinking about it. Fisianna jumps slightly at your touch, but she turns her head to give you a small smile.
rows.translation: 想到她刚才脸上的表情，你觉得现在最好不要继续这个话题。你下意识地将安抚的手搭在她肩上。菲西安娜被你的触碰惊得轻轻一跳，但她转过头来，朝你露出浅浅微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt that earlier expression on her face, you definitely think it best to leave the subject be for now. You put a reassuring hand on her shoulder without thinking about it. Fisianna jumps slightly at your touch, but she turns her head to give you a small smile."

rows.original: Fisianna sighs deeply. “I-I suppose I owe you an explanation about them now. I-I just need a moment... I hate bringing them up again...”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜深深叹了口气。“我、我想现在确实该向你解释他们的事了。我、我只需要一点时间...我讨厌再次提起他们...”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna sighs deeply. “I-I suppose I owe you an explanation about them now. I-I just need a moment... I hate bringing them up again...”"

rows.original: You wonder what Fisianna’s life was like on Terra.
rows.translation: 你想知道菲西安娜在地球上过着怎样的生活。
rows.raw: "You wonder what Fisianna’s life was like on Terra."

rows.original: Fisianna purses her lips thoughtfully while she tries to recall her former home. “Well... it wasn’t bad. I grew up on a small island on Earth, close to the mainland. Life was pretty quiet and uneventful for the most part there... almost boring sometimes. As you can probably guess, I was shy around others when I was a kid too. I used to get teased quite a bit for it too by the other kids there.” Fisianna frowns while explaining.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜若有所思地抿起嘴唇，努力回忆从前的家。“嗯...那里不算坏。我在地球上一座靠近大陆的小岛长大。大多数时候，生活都相当平静，没什么波澜...有时甚至近乎无聊。你大概也猜得到，我小时候在别人面前同样很害羞。那里的其他孩子也常因此取笑我。”菲西安娜解释时皱起了眉。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna purses her lips thoughtfully while she tries to recall her former home. “Well... it wasn’t bad. I grew up on a small island on Earth, close to the mainland. Life was pretty quiet and uneventful for the most part there... almost boring sometimes. As you can probably guess, I was shy around others when I was a kid too. I used to get teased quite a bit for it too by the other kids there.” Fisianna frowns while explaining."

rows.original: “Well that’s just mean. What would they know of this cool cat that I’m with now?” You say trying to encourage Fisianna, trying to keep her spirits up. Fisianna giggles lightly at this.
rows.translation: “那也太过分了。他们哪里懂得我现在身边这只酷猫咪？”你试图鼓励菲西安娜，让她振作起来。听到这话，菲西安娜轻声笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well that’s just mean. What would they know of this cool cat that I’m with now?” You say trying to encourage Fisianna, trying to keep her spirits up. Fisianna giggles lightly at this."

rows.original: “Thanks. Yeah, what would they know?” Fisianna smiles while continuing. “I grew up liking technology a lot. It was just so interesting to just know how things worked. I would pick apart anything I could get my hands on just to see how things function and put them back together again. Later on I even began to improve some things I took apart and they would be working better than they did before. I guess you could say I was kind of a tech genius, even at a young age.”
rows.translation: “谢谢。是啊，他们懂什么？”菲西安娜笑着继续说道。“我从小就很喜欢科技。单是弄懂各种东西如何运作，就非常有趣。我会拆开能弄到手的一切，只为了看看它们怎样运转，再重新组装起来。后来，我甚至开始改进拆开的东西，让它们比以前运作得更好。或许可以说，我年纪很小时就有点像科技天才了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks. Yeah, what would they know?” Fisianna smiles while continuing. “I grew up liking technology a lot. It was just so interesting to just know how things worked. I would pick apart anything I could get my hands on just to see how things function and put them back together again. Later on I even began to improve some things I took apart and they would be working better than they did before. I guess you could say I was kind of a tech genius, even at a young age.”"

rows.original: This is the first time you have seen Fisianna with some iota of pridefulness in her. You take a look at her and see she’s smiling widely.
rows.translation: 这是你第一次看到菲西安娜流露出哪怕一丝自豪。你看向她，发现她正灿烂地笑着。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis is the first time you have seen Fisianna with some iota of pridefulness in her. You take a look at her and see she’s smiling widely."

rows.original: “That’s great! I think I might know who to look to if there’s ever anything wrong with something on my ship.” You tell Fisianna, only partially jokingly.
rows.translation: “太棒了！看来以后我的船上有什么东西出问题，我知道该找谁了。”你半开玩笑地告诉菲西安娜。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s great! I think I might know who to look to if there’s ever anything wrong with something on my ship.” You tell Fisianna, only partially jokingly."

rows.original: Fisianna laughs, still adopting that wide smile. “Well, I wouldn’t go that big in scale, I mean not as far as mechanical functions on a ship, but hey, if you have a busted terminal or a computer that’s on the fritz, I’m your kitty!”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜仍挂着灿烂笑容，大笑起来。“这个嘛，我可不敢接那么大的活儿。我是说，飞船机械系统那种规模不行；不过如果有终端坏掉，或者电脑出了毛病，我就是你要找的猫咪！”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna laughs, still adopting that wide smile. “Well, I wouldn’t go that big in scale, I mean not as far as mechanical functions on a ship, but hey, if you have a busted terminal or a computer that’s on the fritz, I’m your kitty!”"

rows.original: You tell Fisianna that you will hold her to that offer if it comes to that. After the two of you settle down a bit, you inquire about her family.
rows.translation: 你告诉菲西安娜，真遇上这种情况时一定会让她兑现承诺。你们稍微平静下来后，你询问起她的家人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Fisianna that you will hold her to that offer if it comes to that. After the two of you settle down a bit, you inquire about her family."

rows.original: “Oh, I’m the baby of my family. I have one other brother and sister. Twins. They’re really nice. I think they work as scientists that develop medicines for JoyCo. They’re quite well-respected at their profession too. I keep in contact with them when I can to see how they’re doing.”
rows.translation: “哦，我是家里最小的孩子。还有一个哥哥和一个姐姐，是双胞胎。他们人都很好。我想他们是为欢乐公司研发药物的科学家，在自己的专业领域也很受尊敬。我有机会就会联系他们，看看他们过得怎么样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I’m the baby of my family. I have one other brother and sister. Twins. They’re really nice. I think they work as scientists that develop medicines for JoyCo. They’re quite well-respected at their profession too. I keep in contact with them when I can to see how they’re doing.”"

rows.original: You nod your head as you listen to Fisianna talk about her brother and sister. “They sound quite nice. I’d like to meet them one day if possible.”
rows.translation: 你一边听菲西安娜谈论哥哥姐姐，一边点头。“他们听起来人很好。如果有机会，我希望有一天能见见他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod your head as you listen to Fisianna talk about her brother and sister. “They sound quite nice. I’d like to meet them one day if possible.”"

rows.original: Fisianna frowns. “Mmm, often times they’re really busy, so I rarely get to talk to them much myself. Their field of work is way more demanding compared to mine anyways, especially with me being a freelancer.”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜皱起眉。“嗯，他们经常很忙，所以就连我也很少有机会和他们好好聊聊。毕竟他们的工作领域比我的要求高得多，尤其是我还只是个自由职业者。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna frowns. “Mmm, often times they’re really busy, so I rarely get to talk to them much myself. Their field of work is way more demanding compared to mine anyways, especially with me being a freelancer.”"

rows.original: “That’s too bad...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s too bad...” "

rows.original: After a momentary pause, you ask, “What about your parents? What were they like?”
rows.translation: 短暂停顿后，你问道：“那你的父母呢？他们是什么样的人？”
rows.raw: "After a momentary pause, you ask, “What about your parents? What were they like?”"

rows.original: Fisianna’s face suddenly darkens at the mention of her parents. “Mmm... c-can I tell you about them at another time? I promise I will, just... just not yet.”
rows.translation: 听到提及父母，菲西安娜的脸色突然阴沉下来。“嗯...可、可以改天再告诉你他们的事吗？我保证会说，只是...只是现在还不行。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna’s face suddenly darkens at the mention of her parents. “Mmm... c-can I tell you about them at another time? I promise I will, just... just not yet.”"

rows.original: You recall the conversation you had about Fisianna’s mods and how she reacted when she said her parents were not happy about her mods. You start to think it has something to do with that and that she may have had some sort of a dispute about it, but you choose not to press the issue. All you can do for now is apologise in earnest and lightly hug Fisianna to you to comfort her, patting her gently near her feline ears.
rows.translation: 你想起了曾与菲西安娜谈论身体改造的那次对话，以及她说父母不喜欢她的改造时表现出的反应。你开始认为，这件事或许与此有关，她可能因此和父母发生过某种争执；不过你没有继续追问。现在能做的，只有真诚地道歉，轻轻将菲西安娜抱进怀里安慰，并在她猫耳附近温柔地拍抚。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou recall the conversation you had about Fisianna’s mods and how she reacted when she said her parents were not happy about her mods. You start to think it has something to do with that and that she may have had some sort of a dispute about it, but you choose not to press the issue. All you can do for now is apologise in earnest and lightly hug Fisianna to you to comfort her, patting her gently near her feline ears."

rows.original: “T-thanks, [pc.name].” She lightly murmurs into your shoulder.
rows.translation: “谢、谢谢，[pc.name]。”她靠着你的肩膀轻声呢喃。
rows.raw: "\n\n“T-thanks, [pc.name].” She lightly murmurs into your shoulder."

rows.original: Fisianna sighs deeply as her expression grows somber. “A-alright, I think I can tell you about them now. I just need a moment to prepare... a good amount of drama happened between us...”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜深深叹气，神情变得忧郁。“好、好吧，我想现在可以告诉你他们的事了。我只是需要一点时间准备...我们之间发生过不少糟心事...”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna sighs deeply as her expression grows somber. “A-alright, I think I can tell you about them now. I just need a moment to prepare... a good amount of drama happened between us...”"

rows.original: “While I was in college, I took on some repair jobs here and there to earn my keep. I mostly kept to myself when it came to interacting with others though, as I was still reeling from the loss of Isis and the argument with my parents. I just wanted a way to sort of... honor my memory of when I had Isis, so I looked on the extranet and that’s around when I found out about exotic gene mods. I was of course wary of this, but I also met a nice support group on one of the sites as well. They were college girls like me that went through things similar to what I went through and were really happy with their mod changes. I-I know it’s kind of silly to just go off of something you see on the extranet, and I wasn’t in the best state of mind, but I started to consider... changing myself the more I talked to these girls. Yes, [pc.name], they’re the very same girls you met at Anon’s.”
rows.translation: “上大学时，我四处接过一些维修工作来维持生计。不过与别人交往时，我大多独来独往，因为伊西斯的离去以及和父母的争吵仍让我无法释怀。我只是想用某种方式...纪念和伊西斯相伴的那段回忆，于是便上外联网寻找资料，也就是在那时了解到了异种基因改造。我当然对此心存戒备，但也在其中一个网站上遇到了一群友善的互助小组成员。她们和我一样是大学女生，也经历过类似的事情，而且对改造后的变化非常满意。我、我知道，只凭外联网上看到的东西就采取行动有点傻，而且当时我的精神状态也不算好；不过随着和这些女孩谈得越来越多，我开始考虑...改变自己。没错，[pc.name]，她们就是你在阿农酒吧见过的那些女孩。”
rows.raw: "“While I was in college, I took on some repair jobs here and there to earn my keep. I mostly kept to myself when it came to interacting with others though, as I was still reeling from the loss of Isis and the argument with my parents. I just wanted a way to sort of... honor my memory of when I had Isis, so I looked on the extranet and that’s around when I found out about exotic gene mods. I was of course wary of this, but I also met a nice support group on one of the sites as well. They were college girls like me that went through things similar to what I went through and were really happy with their mod changes. I-I know it’s kind of silly to just go off of something you see on the extranet, and I wasn’t in the best state of mind, but I started to consider... changing myself the more I talked to these girls. Yes, [pc.name], they’re the very same girls you met at Anon’s.”"

rows.original: Well that certainly sheds a new light on why she is with such an exotic group of girls. “We talked a lot during my time in college. Funnily enough, besides my brother and sister, they were the only other people I’ve really interacted with much in my life.” Fisianna shakes her head violently from side to side as if to shake something off before she continues. “A-anyways, when I was almost done with college, I decided by then that I would get those transformative mods that could make me reminiscent of a nekomata. Of course it was as expensive as ever, but I saved up every

Funnily enough, besides my brother and sister, they were the only other people I’ve really interacted with much in my life.” Fisianna shakes her head violently from side to side as if to shake something off before she continues. “A-anyways, when I was almost done with college, I decided by then that I would get those transformative mods that could make me reminiscent of a nekomata. Of course it was as expensive as ever, but I saved up every "

rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.translation: 信用点

rows.original: from any job that I could get while working on all of my exams.”
rows.translation: 都省了下来。”
rows.raw: " from any job that I could get while working on all of my exams.”"

rows.original: Your mind is spinning with the thought of the sheer amount of work and time that must have taken for Fisianna to reach this point in her life. She is definitely one of the most hard-working people you believe you have come across so far. Shaking the thought out of your head, you encourage her to continue.
rows.translation: 想到菲西安娜为了走到人生这一步，必定投入了何等惊人的工作量与时间，你的思绪都在打转。她无疑是你迄今遇到的最勤奋的人之一。你把这些念头甩出脑海，鼓励她继续说下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour mind is spinning with the thought of the sheer amount of work and time that must have taken for Fisianna to reach this point in her life. She is definitely one of the most hard-working people you believe you have come across so far. Shaking the thought out of your head, you encourage her to continue."

rows.original: “When I graduated out of college and got my degree, about a week later I went and got my mods and transformed myself into what you see now. I felt it was an appropriate time as I conquered the hardest part of my life at that moment. My friends couldn’t be happier with me. My brother and sister were supportive of me all the way, transformation and all. When they suggested to me to try to get in contact with my parents again to tell them the good news, my heart froze... I hadn’t talked with them ever since I ran away. I trusted my brother and sister enough to at least give it a try though. It was the highest point in my life, despite it being against their wishes. I figured I could at least tell them I was successful walking my own path too. ...Worst decision of my life...”
rows.translation: “大学毕业拿到学位后，大约过了一周，我就去做了改造，把自己变成了你现在看到的样子。那时我已经攻克了人生中最困难的部分，觉得时机正合适。朋友们都替我高兴得不得了。哥哥姐姐也从始至终支持我，包括接受改造的一切。他们建议我再次联系父母，把好消息告诉他们时，我的心一下子凉了...离家出走后，我再也没有和他们说过话。不过我足够信任哥哥姐姐，所以至少愿意试一试。尽管这一切违背了父母的愿望，那仍是我人生的最高点。我想，至少可以告诉他们，我沿着自己的道路也取得了成功。...这是我一生中最糟糕的决定...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When I graduated out of college and got my degree, about a week later I went and got my mods and transformed myself into what you see now. I felt it was an appropriate time as I conquered the hardest part of my life at that moment. My friends couldn’t be happier with me. My brother and sister were supportive of me all the way, transformation and all. When they suggested to me to try to get in contact with my parents again to tell them the good news, my heart froze... I hadn’t talked with them ever since I ran away. I trusted my brother and sister enough to at least give it a try though. It was the highest point in my life, despite it being against their wishes. I figured I could at least tell them I was successful walking my own path too. ...Worst decision of my life...”"

rows.original: Uh-oh... Whatever Fisianna has to say next can’t be good at all from what you have heard about her parents so far. She looks to be on the verge of tears again, though you feel she will definitely be pushed over the edge this time and consider that she may make a scene in public if that does happen.
rows.translation: 糟了...根据目前听到的那些关于她父母的事，菲西安娜接下来要说的肯定不会是什么好事。她看起来又快哭了；不过你觉得这一次她肯定会彻底崩溃，还想到如果真是如此，她可能会在公共场合引起骚动。
rows.raw: "\n\nUh-oh... Whatever Fisianna has to say next can’t be good at all from what you have heard about her parents so far. She looks to be on the verge of tears again, though you feel she will definitely be pushed over the edge this time and consider that she may make a scene in public if that does happen."

rows.original: “We can stop here if you want, Fisianna. If the memory is getting too painful for you, we can always pick this up again another time.” You attempt to persuade her.
rows.translation: “你愿意的话，我们可以先说到这里，菲西安娜。如果回忆变得太痛苦，我们随时可以改天再继续。”你试着劝她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We can stop here if you want, Fisianna. If the memory is getting too painful for you, we can always pick this up again another time.” You attempt to persuade her."

rows.original: “...N-no... I-I want to keep going. I-I want to get this off my chest so... so badly.” Fisianna struggles greatly, but manages to hold on to her composure. “A-anyways, when I went to call them on a video feed, I felt sick to my stomach, but I eventually got through to them. When the call started... their look of utter confusion and disgust when they saw me I don’t think I’ll ever forget. Of course I explained that it was me, their daughter, and I quickly after told them about my college days after running away and my mods and the support group, as well as telling them that I successfully graduated tech school. I started to get that same happy feeling I got when I told them about the tablet. It felt... good, if only for a brief moment.”
rows.translation: “...不-不用...我-我想继续。我-我真的...真的很想把这件事说出来。”菲西安娜竭力挣扎，却还是勉强保持住镇定。“总-总之，我打视频电话给他们时，感觉胃里一阵恶心，不过最终还是接通了。通话开始时...他们看到我后，那种彻底困惑又厌恶的表情，我想自己永远也忘不了。我当然解释说这就是我，是他们的女儿；接着很快告诉他们，我离家出走后的大学生活、我的改造和互助小组，还告诉他们自己顺利从技术学校毕业了。我开始感到当初告诉他们平板电脑那件事时的同一种喜悦。那感觉...很好，哪怕只有短短一瞬。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...N-no... I-I want to keep going. I-I want to get this off my chest so... so badly.” Fisianna struggles greatly, but manages to hold on to her composure. “A-anyways, when I went to call them on a video feed, I felt sick to my stomach, but I eventually got through to them. When the call started... their look of utter confusion and disgust when they saw me I don’t think I’ll ever forget. Of course I explained that it was me, their daughter, and I quickly after told them about my college days after running away and my mods and the support group, as well as telling them that I successfully graduated tech school. I started to get that same happy feeling I got when I told them about the tablet. It felt... good, if only for a brief moment.”"

rows.original: Fisianna unexpectedly slams her paw against her thigh in anger, wearing an unbecoming grimace on her face as tears start to roll down her cheeks. “M-m-my parents... T-they... they just... completely disowned me. T-they told me they were just very disappointed in me a-and that I was a shame to the family name. That I s-should have just become a d-doctor like they w-wanted... and to never speak to them again u-until I became one.”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜出乎意料地愤怒挥爪拍在大腿上，脸上挂着与她极不相称的狰狞表情，眼泪开始沿双颊滚落。“我-我-我的父母...他-他们...他们就这样...彻底和我断绝了关系。他-他们说对我非常失望，说我是家族名声的耻辱。还说我-我就应该照他们希望的那样去当医-医生...在我成为医生以前，永-永远别再和他们说话。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna unexpectedly slams her paw against her thigh in anger, wearing an unbecoming grimace on her face as tears start to roll down her cheeks. “M-m-my parents... T-they... they just... completely disowned me. T-they told me they were just very disappointed in me a-and that I was a shame to the family name. That I s-should have just become a d-doctor like they w-wanted... and to never speak to them again u-until I became one.”"

rows.original: At this point Fisianna’s emotional floodgates are let fully open and she begins bawling. You quickly reach over, pulling her onto your lap, making sure she is comfortable while she sobs wetly into your shoulder. You pat her back and whisper reassuring words into her fluffy ear as she cries, telling her it is not her fault and that she made the right decision for herself and anything else you can think of to comfort her. Other passers-by occasionally look towards the two of you on the bench and give you mixed looks of concern and antipathy, though with the free arm you aren’t using to pat the neko’s back, you wave them away to not disturb the two of you.
rows.translation: 此刻，菲西安娜情绪的闸门完全打开，她开始嚎啕大哭。你迅速伸手把她拉到腿上，确保她坐得舒服；她抽泣着把你的肩膀哭得湿透。她哭泣时，你轻拍她的后背，在毛茸茸的耳边低声安慰，告诉她这不是她的错，她为自己做出了正确决定，还把能想到的一切安慰话都说给她听。偶尔有路人看向坐在长椅上的你们，露出或关切或反感的神情；你用没有轻拍猫娘后背的那只手把他们挥退，免得打扰你们。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt this point Fisianna’s emotional floodgates are let fully open and she begins bawling. You quickly reach over, pulling her onto your lap, making sure she is comfortable while she sobs wetly into your shoulder. You pat her back and whisper reassuring words into her fluffy ear as she cries, telling her it is not her fault and that she made the right decision for herself and anything else you can think of to comfort her. Other passers-by occasionally look towards the two of you on the bench and give you mixed looks of concern and antipathy, though with the free arm you aren’t using to pat the neko’s back, you wave them away to not disturb the two of you."

rows.original: After a seemingly long while, Fisianna stops sobbing into your now soaked shoulder. You take the opportunity to ask her if she is going to be okay.
rows.translation: 仿佛经过了很久，菲西安娜终于停止伏在你已经湿透的肩头抽泣。你趁机问她有没有好一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a seemingly long while, Fisianna stops sobbing into your now soaked shoulder. You take the opportunity to ask her if she is going to be okay."

rows.original: “Y-yeah... I think so...” Fisianna wipes a rogue tear away from her eye and tries to straighten to more properly face you while still sitting on your lap. “T-that... felt good to let out. Y-you’re the only person I’ve ever told this to outside of my brother and sister... e-even my other friends. T-thank you so much for putting up with me through that.” She wraps her paws around you in a tight hug and does not seem intent on letting go anytime soon. You wrap your arms around her in turn.
rows.translation: “嗯-嗯...我想好些了...”菲西安娜擦掉眼角一滴不听话的泪水，仍坐在你腿上，试图挺直身体，更好地面对你。“把-把这些说出来...感觉好多了。除哥哥姐姐以外，你-你是我唯一告诉过这件事的人...就-就连其他朋友也不知道。谢-谢谢你一直这样包容我。”她双爪环住你，紧紧抱住，看起来短时间内完全不打算松开。你也伸出双臂抱住她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Y-yeah... I think so...” Fisianna wipes a rogue tear away from her eye and tries to straighten to more properly face you while still sitting on your lap. “T-that... felt good to let out. Y-you’re the only person I’ve ever told this to outside of my brother and sister... e-even my other friends. T-thank you so much for putting up with me through that.” She wraps her paws around you in a tight hug and does not seem intent on letting go anytime soon. You wrap your arms around her in turn."

rows.original: “You’re welcome, Fisi. You went through a lot. Nobody should have to go through what you did.”
rows.translation: “不用谢，菲西。你经历了太多，没有任何人应该遭受你经历的那些事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re welcome, Fisi. You went through a lot. Nobody should have to go through what you did.”"

rows.original: “At least I met some great friends in the process... especially you...” Fisianna murmurs into your chest. You make yourself as comfortable as possible for her while the both of you rest in silence on the plaza bench.
rows.translation: “至少在这个过程中，我遇见了一些很棒的朋友...尤其是你...”菲西安娜贴着你的胸口喃喃道。你尽可能让她靠得舒服；你们静静倚在广场长椅上休息。
rows.raw: "\n\n“At least I met some great friends in the process... especially you...” Fisianna murmurs into your chest. You make yourself as comfortable as possible for her while the both of you rest in silence on the plaza bench. "

rows.original: You start to hear, and feel vibrations coming from Fisianna as time passes. It looks like she fell asleep sometime during your embrace and is snoring into your chest peacefully. To your surprise, and delight, the vibrations you feel aren’t from her snoring, but her whole body seems to be vibrating softly; she’s purring! You smile widely while you start to stroke the feline’s hair as she rests, making her purr more intensely.
rows.translation: 随着时间流逝，你开始听见、也感觉到菲西安娜身上传来震动。看来她在拥抱期间不知何时睡着了，正伏在你的胸口安稳打鼾。令你又惊又喜的是，你感觉到的震动并非鼾声，而是她全身都在轻柔震动；她在呼噜！你灿烂地笑起来，开始抚摸这只猫科女性熟睡时的头发，令她的呼噜声变得更加强烈。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou start to hear, and feel vibrations coming from Fisianna as time passes. It looks like she fell asleep sometime during your embrace and is snoring into your chest peacefully. To your surprise, and delight, the vibrations you feel aren’t from her snoring, but her whole body seems to be vibrating softly; she’s purring! You smile widely while you start to stroke the feline’s hair as she rests, making her purr more intensely."

rows.original: Fisianna wakes up after almost an hour of cuddling. She picks her head up from your chest, still dazed from her nap. When she realizes the position she’s in on your lap, she lets out a startled yelp and quickly takes her seat on the bench.
rows.translation: 依偎了将近一小时后，菲西安娜醒了过来。她从你的胸口抬起脑袋，仍因小睡而迷迷糊糊。意识到自己正坐在你腿上后，她惊叫一声，迅速回到长椅座位。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna wakes up after almost an hour of cuddling. She picks her head up from your chest, still dazed from her nap. When she realizes the position she’s in on your lap, she lets out a startled yelp and quickly takes her seat on the bench."

rows.original: “I-I-I’m SO sorry! I didn’t m-mean to fall asleep on you! H-honest! ...I-I just... felt really comfortable. I’m sorry!” Fisianna looks at you wide-eyed, desperately babbling apologies a mile a minute before you eventually calm her down. Afterwards you tell her jokingly that she was very comfortable to pet, just like a cat. The catgirl’s face turns absolutely beet red at that remark.
rows.translation: “我-我-我真的非常抱歉！我不是故-故意在你身上睡着的！真-真的！...我-我只是...感觉非常舒服。对不起！”菲西安娜瞪大双眼，语速飞快地拼命连声道歉，直到你终于让她冷静下来。随后你开玩笑地说，她摸起来非常舒服，就像一只猫。听见这句话，猫娘的脸彻底涨得通红。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I-I’m SO sorry! I didn’t m-mean to fall asleep on you! H-honest! ...I-I just... felt really comfortable. I’m sorry!” Fisianna looks at you wide-eyed, desperately babbling apologies a mile a minute before you eventually calm her down. Afterwards you tell her jokingly that she was very comfortable to pet, just like a cat. The catgirl’s face turns absolutely beet red at that remark."

rows.original: “I-I am not! [pc.name], don’t tease me like that! You know very well how s-sensitive I am to teasing like that...” Fisianna pouts.
rows.translation: “我-我才不是！[pc.name]，别这样逗我！你明明很清楚，我对这种捉弄有多-多么敏感...”菲西安娜噘嘴说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I am not! [pc.name], don’t tease me like that! You know very well how s-sensitive I am to teasing like that...” Fisianna pouts."

rows.original: “That’s the fun in it!” You exclaim to her.
rows.translation: “这样才好玩嘛！”你对她高声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s the fun in it!” You exclaim to her."

rows.original: Fisianna gives you a soft punch to your arm, nowhere close enough to hurting you.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜轻轻捶了你的手臂一下，那点力道完全不可能弄疼你。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna gives you a soft punch to your arm, nowhere close enough to hurting you. "

rows.original: “M-meanie...”
rows.raw: "“M-meanie...”"

rows.original: You stick out your tongue and laugh, after which Fisianna joins in, looking more relaxed than you have ever seen her.
rows.translation: 你吐出舌头笑起来，菲西安娜随后也加入笑声，看起来比你见过的任何时候都更加放松。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stick out your tongue and laugh, after which Fisianna joins in, looking more relaxed than you have ever seen her."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: From the past conversations you have had with Fisianna, it has become increasingly apparent whenever the subject was brought up that she has held some sort of angst against her parents. You have known each other for a good while, but you can see that whatever happened back then with her parents is still eating her up. After a brief moment of thought, you decide it would be best to try to relieve her of that pain and bring the subject to light. You place a hand on her shoulder and squeeze gently while giving her a serious look.
rows.translation: 从过去与菲西安娜的交谈中可以越来越明显地看出，每当话题涉及父母，她心中便怀有某种怨愤。你们相识已有很长一段时间，但你看得出来，当年她与父母之间发生的事仍在折磨她。短暂思考后，你认为最好设法帮她缓解痛苦，把这件事摊开来说。你把手放在她肩上，温柔捏了捏，同时认真地望着她。
rows.raw: "From the past conversations you have had with Fisianna, it has become increasingly apparent whenever the subject was brought up that she has held some sort of angst against her parents. You have known each other for a good while, but you can see that whatever happened back then with her parents is still eating her up. After a brief moment of thought, you decide it would be best to try to relieve her of that pain and bring the subject to light. You place a hand on her shoulder and squeeze gently while giving her a serious look."

rows.original: As tactfully as you can, you attempt to persuade Fisianna to open up. “Fisi, are you ready to talk about what happened with your parents? I know it might be a tough topic for you to bring up, but I don’t think you keeping it in is very healthy either, and frankly it’s unbecoming to see your face go sour at their mention. Please tell me what happened with them if you can. You can trust me as always. I won’t judge.”
rows.translation: 你尽可能委婉地劝菲西安娜敞开心扉。“菲西，你准备好谈谈和父母之间发生的事了吗？我知道这个话题对你来说可能很难开口，但我也不觉得一直憋在心里有益健康；而且坦白说，每次提到他们，你的脸色就阴沉下来，实在不像平时的你。如果可以，请告诉我你们之间发生了什么。你一如既往可以信任我，我不会评判你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs tactfully as you can, you attempt to persuade Fisianna to open up. “Fisi, are you ready to talk about what happened with your parents? I know it might be a tough topic for you to bring up, but I don’t think you keeping it in is very healthy either, and frankly it’s unbecoming to see your face go sour at their mention. Please tell me what happened with them if you can. You can trust me as always. I won’t judge.”"

rows.original: Fisianna fidgets nervously under your touch and looks away to the ground in front of her for a long moment. She turns to you afterwards with a pained frown on her face. “Mmm... O-ok, I think I can tell you... I-I still feel terrible for what happened then but... you’re right. I can’t keep it in forever.” Fisianna sighs the longest sigh you think you have ever heard her utter and looks down at her lap before she continues.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜在你的触碰下紧张地扭动身体，移开视线，久久望着面前的地面。随后她转向你，脸上露出痛苦的愁容。“嗯...好-好吧，我想自己可以告诉你...当时发生的事至今仍让我感觉糟透了，不过...你说得对。我不可能永远憋在心里。”菲西安娜发出一声你所听过她最漫长的叹息，低头看着自己的膝头，随后继续说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna fidgets nervously under your touch and looks away to the ground in front of her for a long moment. She turns to you afterwards with a pained frown on her face. “Mmm... O-ok, I think I can tell you... I-I still feel terrible for what happened then but... you’re right. I can’t keep it in forever.” Fisianna sighs the longest sigh you think you have ever heard her utter and looks down at her lap before she continues."

rows.original: “W-well... I suppose it started in my early teens, when I was first developing my interest in computer technology. Around then my brother and sister were both finishing college to get their degrees in medicine. Those two were at the top of their class. Job offers were already being thrown to them from anywhere you can imagine, even before they graduated. My parents... they were the happiest I’ve ever seen them. Rightfully so, too. Any parent would be really proud of their children in that situation.” Fisianna shifts her gaze towards the palm trees ahead.
rows.translation: “那-那个...我想，这一切始于十几岁出头，那时我刚刚开始对计算机技术产生兴趣。差不多就在那时，哥哥姐姐都快读完大学，取得医学学位了。他们两个都是班里的尖子生。甚至还没毕业，你能想到的任何地方便已经争相向他们发出工作邀请。我的父母...那是我见过他们最高兴的时候。当然，这也是理所应当。任何父母在那种情况下都会为自己的孩子感到非常骄傲。”菲西安娜将目光移向前方的棕榈树。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well... I suppose it started in my early teens, when I was first developing my interest in computer technology. Around then my brother and sister were both finishing college to get their degrees in medicine. Those two were at the top of their class. Job offers were already being thrown to them from anywhere you can imagine, even before they graduated. My parents... they were the happiest I’ve ever seen them. Rightfully so, too. Any parent would be really proud of their children in that situation.” Fisianna shifts her gaze towards the palm trees ahead."

rows.original: “I was happy for them too, of course. I still am! They’re some of the best at what they do... in fact, as far as I’ve known, in my family we all have been really successful when it came to practicing medicine, even past my great-great-great grandparents’ generation. So... yes, of course my parents also practiced medicine as well. Family tradition and all that.”
rows.translation: “我当然也替他们高兴，现在仍然如此！他们在自己的领域都是最优秀的人才...事实上，据我所知，我们家族在行医方面一直都非常成功，甚至可以追溯到高祖父母以前。所以...没错，我的父母当然也从事医疗工作。家族传统之类的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was happy for them too, of course. I still am! They’re some of the best at what they do... in fact, as far as I’ve known, in my family we all have been really successful when it came to practicing medicine, even past my great-great-great grandparents’ generation. So... yes, of course my parents also practiced medicine as well. Family tradition and all that.”"

rows.original: You start to piece two and two together from what she just explained, but Fisianna continues all the while staring ahead with a distant look in her golden eyes. “So, y-yeah... Of course my parents were trying to condition me to follow in their, and my siblings’, footsteps too. They would try to cram any medical book they could into me while growing up. They also got me any tutors they could get to try to raise my knowledge of medicine as fast as possible so that I could go to the most prestigious medical schools. I... I just didn’t share their passion when it came to medicine. I-I guess I should tell you when I exactly started getting interested in technology, huh?” Fisianna gives you a wan smile. You nod in response, listening intently.
rows.translation: 听完她刚才的解释，你开始把线索拼凑起来；菲西安娜始终遥望前方，金色眼眸中带着疏离神色，同时继续说道。“所-所以，是啊...我的父母当然也试图把我调教成追随他们和哥哥姐姐脚步的人。从小到大，他们会把能找到的医学书全都硬塞给我。他们还尽可能找来各种家庭教师，试图尽快提升我的医学知识，让我能够进入最负盛名的医学院。我...我只是不像他们那样对医学充满热情。我-我想，应该告诉你自己究竟是什么时候开始对技术感兴趣的，对吧？”菲西安娜勉强笑了笑。你点头回应，专心倾听。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou start to piece two and two together from what she just explained, but Fisianna continues all the while staring ahead with a distant look in her golden eyes. “So, y-yeah... Of course my parents were trying to condition me to follow in their, and my siblings’, footsteps too. They would try to cram any medical book they could into me while growing up. They also got me any tutors they could get to try to raise my knowledge of medicine as fast as possible so that I could go to the most prestigious medical schools. I... I just didn’t share their passion when it came to medicine. I-I guess I should tell you when I exactly started getting interested in technology, huh?” Fisianna gives you a wan smile. You nod in response, listening intently."

rows.original: “W-well... I suppose it started when I was at the end of one of my tutoring sessions. I had a tablet that I worked off of to study my notes. Well... right after the tutor left, I went to take it out of its casing since I heard something loose in it. I wound up dropping the thing clumsily and it fell apart on me. Parts were everywhere. I was so scared that if my parents found out I broke it, I would get in big trouble... So I tried to piece it back together myself.”
rows.translation: “那-那个...我想，是在一次辅导课快结束时开始的。我用一台平板电脑学习笔记。嗯...老师离开后，我听到里面有东西松了，于是想把它从外壳中取出来。结果我笨手笨脚地把它掉在地上，它当场散架，零件到处都是。我非常害怕，担心父母发现我弄坏平板后会狠狠惩罚我...所以我试着自己把它重新拼好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well... I suppose it started when I was at the end of one of my tutoring sessions. I had a tablet that I worked off of to study my notes. Well... right after the tutor left, I went to take it out of its casing since I heard something loose in it. I wound up dropping the thing clumsily and it fell apart on me. Parts were everywhere. I was so scared that if my parents found out I broke it, I would get in big trouble... So I tried to piece it back together myself.”"

rows.original: “And were you able to do so?” You ask in curiosity.
rows.translation: “那你成功了吗？”你好奇地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And were you able to do so?” You ask in curiosity."

rows.original: Fisianna’s expression brightens and she gives you a prideful smile. “You bet I did! Thankfully, the screen wasn’t broken so it made things a lot easier. Even better yet, the only tools I had available to me at the time were just a few medical supplies from an earlier lesson. Had to use just those tools to mend it. It was almost like... ‘mechanical surgery’. When I finished repairing it, the loose part was secure in place and my tablet was working faster than it ever did before! When I fixed it up I just knew that repairing and piecing together technology was for me. It was SO much fun!”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜神情一亮，骄傲地冲你微笑。“当然成功了！幸好屏幕没有摔坏，所以事情容易了许多。更厉害的是，当时我手边能用的工具只有之前课程留下的几件医疗用品。我只能用那些工具把它修好。那几乎就像...‘机械手术’一样。修理完毕后，松动的部件被牢牢固定，平板运行得甚至比以前任何时候都快！修好它时，我立刻明白，修理和组装技术设备正是适合我的事。实在太有趣了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna’s expression brightens and she gives you a prideful smile. “You bet I did! Thankfully, the screen wasn’t broken so it made things a lot easier. Even better yet, the only tools I had available to me at the time were just a few medical supplies from an earlier lesson. Had to use just those tools to mend it. It was almost like... ‘mechanical surgery’. When I finished repairing it, the loose part was secure in place and my tablet was working faster than it ever did before! When I fixed it up I just knew that repairing and piecing together technology was for me. It was SO much fun!”"

rows.original: Fisianna starts to giggle at what must be the shocked expression on your face. She wasn’t exaggerating when she said that she was considered a tech genius.
rows.translation: 看见你脸上想必十分震惊的表情，菲西安娜咯咯笑了起来。她说自己被视为技术天才时，果然一点也没有夸张。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna starts to giggle at what must be the shocked expression on your face. She wasn’t exaggerating when she said that she was considered a tech genius."

rows.original: “Yeah, I know it’s an impressive feat. I wanted to show my parents so badly what I just did. Sure enough, when I went to tell them what I did, I was expecting them to be just as impressed. Well... I-I was dead wrong.” Fisianna’s smile very rapidly deflates to a sad frown. “When I showed the tablet to my parents and told them what I did to it, guess what they did? They scolded me... They scolded me for using the medical supplies improperly, telling me they were expensive materials and that I needed to better respect the equipment that can save lives. They even punished me for a whole month for that. I... I felt so crushed. I already felt like the one thing I was really passionate for in my life was just... stomped out... and so casually... just like that.”
rows.translation: “对，我知道这是一项了不起的成就。我非常想让父母看看自己刚刚做成了什么。果然，我跑去告诉他们时，原以为他们也会同样佩服。结果...我-我完全想错了。”菲西安娜的笑容飞快消失，变成悲伤的愁容。“我把平板拿给父母看，告诉他们自己做了什么，你猜他们怎么回应？他们训斥了我...他们骂我不该乱用医疗用品，说那些材料很昂贵，我应该更加尊重能够挽救生命的设备。他们甚至因此惩罚了我整整一个月。我...我感觉整个人都被击垮了。我才刚刚觉得自己终于找到了人生中真正热爱的事物，结果它就这样...被踩灭了...而且那么随意...就这样没了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, I know it’s an impressive feat. I wanted to show my parents so badly what I just did. Sure enough, when I went to tell them what I did, I was expecting them to be just as impressed. Well... I-I was dead wrong.” Fisianna’s smile very rapidly deflates to a sad frown. “When I showed the tablet to my parents and told them what I did to it, guess what they did? They scolded me... They scolded me for using the medical supplies improperly, telling me they were expensive materials and that I needed to better respect the equipment that can save lives. They even punished me for a whole month for that. I... I felt so crushed. I already felt like the one thing I was really passionate for in my life was just... stomped out... and so casually... just like that.”"

rows.original: Fisianna’s face by this point is contorted with a mix of anger and sadness as tears start to well up in her eyes from the painful memory. “E-ever since then... my parents and I just grew very distant. I-I barely talked to anyone if at all. Meanwhile, my interest for technology continued to grow as I would try to find anything that was broken and fix it. I would steal my dad’s toolkit whenever I did find something. If I didn’t find anything that was broken, I would just fiddle with random computerized appliances, take them apart and piece them back together again, without my parents’ notice of course. My brother and sister noticed my change in behavior after a little while and I think they might have secretly convinced my parents to get me a cat to try to cheer me up. My parents were never really the type to keep pets, as they were strictly conservative, so the only other ones to have any sort of influence over them must have been my brother and sister.”
rows.translation: 此刻，菲西安娜的脸因愤怒与悲伤而扭曲；痛苦回忆令泪水开始在眼中聚集。“从-从那以后...我和父母就变得非常疏远。我-我几乎不和任何人说话。与此同时，我对技术的兴趣不断增长；我会努力寻找任何损坏的东西，把它修好。每当找到什么东西，我都会偷拿爸爸的工具箱。如果找不到坏掉的东西，我就随便摆弄各种电脑设备，把它们拆开再重新组装，当然不会让父母发现。过了一阵，哥哥姐姐注意到我的行为变化；我想，他们可能暗中说服父母给我养了一只猫，试图让我振作起来。我的父母严格保守，从来不是会养宠物的人，所以除了哥哥姐姐以外，不可能有其他人对他们产生这种影响。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna’s face by this point is contorted with a mix of anger and sadness as tears start to well up in her eyes from the painful memory. “E-ever since then... my parents and I just grew very distant. My parents were never really the type to keep pets, as they were strictly conservative, so the only other ones to have any sort of influence over them must have been my brother and sister.”"

rows.original: Fisianna looks down to her lap as she wipes a paw on her face to keep a tear from streaming down her face. “When I got Isis, I... I instantly fell in love with the little cat. She was just so cute. I momentarily forgot all about my past pains while I had her. We played together all the time, and for the time I had her, I was content. Well... that was until when I just about turned 18 and was almost done with basic schooling. Isis... she passed away around then. All that past pain just came back to me... a-and it hit me like a ton of bricks. I-I was an emotional wreck. By then, my parents had already picked out a college for me to go to continue my medical education, but I didn’t want to go. I was very opposed to it, and I told them as much. W-we... got into a huge fight after that. My brother and sister weren’t around by then to stick up for me. It’s a miracle I wasn’t kicked out of my house after that argument... v-very hateful things were said that I would rather not repeat... I did the only thing that I could think to do after that; which was to call my brother and sister. I told them about the argument and about my interest in tech. Thankfully, they were really understanding of the situation I was in. They also must have had a good amount of connections already because within a few days after telling them this, they got me an on-campus setup at one of the most prestigious tech schools on Terra. I took that offer within a heartbeat and... ran away from home shortly after.”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜低头望着膝盖，用爪子擦了擦脸，不让泪水沿面颊流下。“得到伊西斯后，我...我立刻爱上了那只小猫。她实在太可爱了。和她在一起时，我暂时忘记了过去所有痛苦。我们总是一起玩；拥有她的那段时间，我很满足。嗯...直到我快满十八岁、即将完成基础教育的时候。伊西斯...她差不多就在那时去世了。过去所有痛苦一下子全都回来了...而-而且像一吨砖头般狠狠砸中了我。我-我情绪彻底崩溃。那时父母已经替我选好大学，让我继续接受医学教育，但我不想去。我强烈反对，也把想法告诉了他们。我-我们...后来大吵了一架。当时哥哥姐姐不在身边，无法替我说话。争吵结束后，我居然没有被赶出家门，简直是个奇迹...双方都说了许-许多充满恨意的话，我宁愿不要复述...之后我做了唯一能想到的事；那就是联系哥哥姐姐。我告诉他们这场争吵，也告诉他们自己对技术的兴趣。幸好，他们非常理解我的处境。他们肯定也已经拥有相当广的人脉，因为我告诉他们以后，仅仅几天时间，他们便替我在地球最负盛名的技术学校之一安排好了校内生活。我毫不犹豫地接受了邀请...不久后便离家出走。”

rows.original: When your eyes flutter open again, the room is fairly brighter, indicating it is early to mid morning. You had a very comfortable time as Fisianna’s bed felt like sleeping on a cloud. Before you move however, you can feel the right side of your body vibrating. You raise your left arm over to the right side of your body and feel something soft and fuzzy on your torso. Whatever it is, it is vibrating more intensely than your body is. You also feel a faint warmness on your neck that comes and passes about every few seconds. You crane your neck down your body and find that Fisianna’s pawed arm is wrapped around your torso. You can also see parts of her animalistic right leg are wrapped over your [pc.legsNoun]. You turn your head right only to have your nose booped by a flicking feline ear. Fisianna’s head is nestled into your neck as she is snoring and purring peacefully. It seems in her sleep, she has taken to snuggling with you. You figure there is nothing else you can do to move without waking Fisianna up so you lie back and make yourself as comfortable as possible while enjoying the half body massage of her purring.

rows.original: “Unng... [pc.name]? W-what’s up?” Fisianna whispers sleepily. In her daze, she briefly surveys the position she is in, and it only takes a few moments after to realize that she is snuggled against you. When her tired eyes quickly snap open in shock and surprise, she quietly gasps. The distraught catgirl quickly releases you and shifts back to the other side of the bed, burying her head into the pillow. Through the pillow you can hear Fisianna shoot muffled apologies to you, but she is too afraid to show her face after her indelicate display. The best you can do is whisper back that everything is fine, that she doesn’t have to worry about it and that you won’t mention what happened to anyone. When you have convinced her enough, she raises her head out of her pillow to show you her beet red face. You give her your most sincere smile to ease her feelings of embarrassment. This seems to calm her down enough to lessen the color on her face, though she still looks uneasy.

rows.original: You lay in bed until the other girls stir. They take their turns using the guest bathroom to freshen up, greeting each other groggily as they pass each other. After the other girls are finished sprucing up in the bathroom, you climb out of bed and take your turn to prepare for the day. By the time you are done, everyone is in the living room, including Fisianna. She still seems affected by the earlier accidental snuggle, as she has a faraway look in her eyes. She snaps out of her thoughts when you arrive and blushes brightly before turning to Britannia.

rows.original: “Mmm... it’s getting pretty late, and that game took a while to settle. I think it would be a good time to start getting ready for bed.” Britannia yawns. You look at your codex for the time and are surprised to find how late it has gotten. The others mirror Britannia’s yawn as they nod in agreement. Everyone rises up from their seats to retrieve their belongings and head towards Fisianna’s bedroom.

rows.original: When Fisianna opens the door to her private bedroom, you find that her room is surprisingly spacious, but expectedly girly. The feline’s room is heavily themed orange and white just like her, and decorated with peach colored curtains. Her room has dark wooden drawers and desks bordering the walls with white carpeting. She is also sporting a queen sized bed near the center of the room big enough for two people. Surrounding it are multiple blow up sleeping mats complete with comfy looking feather pillows. You notice there are only three floor mats.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜打开私人卧室的门后，你发现房间出乎意料地宽敞，但也不出意料地充满少女气息。猫娘的房间和她一样，以橙白两色为主，还有桃色窗帘装饰。深色木制抽屉与书桌沿墙摆放，地面铺着白色地毯。房间中央附近还有一张足以睡两人的大号床。床周围摆着多张充气睡垫，配有看起来很舒服的羽毛枕。你注意到地上只有三张睡垫。

Bri volunteered to sleep on a mat so she wanted us to decide with that game. We figured it would be more fun that way! Since [pc.name] and I won, we get to sleep on the bed... t-together.” Fisianna whispers the last word. The realization of her sleeping with you suddenly dawns on her and her face starts to flush with color. The catgirl stands in a daze for a few seconds before you see a flash of white fly past you. Fisianna is whiplashed backwards onto the bed as she is struck in the face by the fluffy object. Tarariel howls triumphantly while she readies another white weapon to throw.

You hear her gulp nervously before she whispers to you in as hushed a tone as possible so that none of the other girls can overhear."

rows.original: “T-thanks, [pc.name]. Thank you for making this one of the most fun nights I’ve ever had in my life. I-I don’t know what I’d do if I didn’t meet you. I...” Fisianna trails off. You nod in response, believing she will be able to see you with her sharp feline eyes. She confirms this by patting your hand with her paw.
rows.translation: “谢、谢谢，[pc.name]。谢谢你让今晚成为我一生中最快乐的夜晚之一。我、我不知道如果没遇到你，自己会变成什么样。我...”菲西安娜没有继续说下去。你点头回应，相信凭她敏锐的猫眼能看见。她用爪子拍了拍你的手，证实确实如此。
rows.raw: "\n\n“T-thanks, [pc.name]. Thank you for making this one of the most fun nights I’ve ever had in my life. I-I don’t know what I’d do if I didn’t meet you. I...” Fisianna trails off. You nod in response, believing she will be able to see you with her sharp feline eyes. She confirms this by patting your hand with her paw."

rows.original: “Sleep tight, [pc.name].” Fisianna whispers before she turns around the opposite way on the bed. You lay on your back and start to doze off yourself, still feeling warm from her compliment.
rows.translation: “晚安，[pc.name]。”菲西安娜低声说道，随后在床上转向另一边。你仰面躺着，也开始昏昏欲睡，仍因她的赞美而心中温暖。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sleep tight, [pc.name].” Fisianna whispers before she turns around the opposite way on the bed. You lay on your back and start to doze off yourself, still feeling warm from her compliment."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: RESIDENTIAL DECK FISIS APARTMENT
rows.raw: "RESIDENTIAL DECK FISIS APARTMENT"

rows.original: When the time arrives for Fisianna’s sleepover, you gather your belongings and make your way off of your ship wearing the best pair of pajamas you could find. You head up the elevator and out to the residential deck. Heading northwards you come across a lot of plain looking apartments while looking for Fisianna’s place. Eventually you find apartment number 124 and ring the buzzer to let Fisianna know you are outside.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜的睡衣派对时间到来后，你收拾好随身物品，穿着能找到的最好睡衣离开飞船。你搭电梯来到住宅甲板，向北经过许多外观朴素的公寓，寻找菲西安娜的住所。最终，你找到124号公寓，按响门铃通知她自己到了。
rows.raw: "When the time arrives for Fisianna’s sleepover, you gather your belongings and make your way off of your ship wearing the best pair of pajamas you could find. You head up the elevator and out to the residential deck. Heading northwards you come across a lot of plain looking apartments while looking for Fisianna’s place. Eventually you find apartment number 124 and ring the buzzer to let Fisianna know you are outside."

rows.original: When the door opens, you are greeted by the smiling feline. “[pc.name]! I’m glad you’re here! Please come in!” Fisianna steps aside to let you into her apartment. When inside you notice that all of Fisianna’s friends are already here and setting up her home gaming rig. You notice that everyone are wearing different variations of form-hugging tank tops with knee length pajama bottoms, except for Fisi. The catgirl has on an oversized baby blue t-shirt with a black paw print embroidered on the front, with matching black baggy pajama bottoms. They all give you a short hello and wave before concentrating their attention back on the gaming rig.
rows.translation: 门打开时，迎接你的是面带笑容的猫娘。“[pc.name]！很高兴你来了！快请进！”菲西安娜退到一旁让你进入公寓。进去后，你发现她所有朋友都已到场，正在安装家用游戏设备。除了菲西安娜外，每个人都穿着不同款式的贴身背心与及膝睡裤。猫娘穿着宽大的淡蓝T恤，正面绣着黑色爪印，还配有同色的黑色宽松睡裤。众人简短地向你问好挥手，随后重新专注于游戏设备。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the door opens, you are greeted by the smiling feline. “[pc.name]! I’m glad you’re here! Please come in!” Fisianna steps aside to let you into her apartment. When inside you notice that all of Fisianna’s friends are already here and setting up her home gaming rig. You notice that everyone are wearing different variations of form-hugging tank tops with knee length pajama bottoms, except for Fisi. The catgirl has on an oversized baby blue t-shirt with a black paw print embroidered on the front, with matching black baggy pajama bottoms. They all give you a short hello and wave before concentrating their attention back on the gaming rig."

rows.original: You take a brief look around Fisianna’s apartment. It’s a fairly cosy space that looks like it receives a lot of love and care. There are a number of gadgets and gizmos that are neatly organized on various shelves in the living room area. At another end of the living room area are a few cleaning droids which you assume were just recently used. Fisianna has a rather comfortable home theater area set up in the middle of the room. It has a plush couch complete with glass tables opposite of a holoscreen. The gaming rig sits nearby the display, where her friends feverishly work to set it up and play. They seem to be having some trouble starting it up, however. You assume that her rig is still on the fritz.
rows.translation: 你简单打量菲西安娜的公寓。这里相当舒适，看得出受到精心爱护。客厅各处架子上整齐摆着许多小装置和机械玩意。另一端有几台清洁机器人，你猜它们刚刚用过。房间中央是一套十分舒服的家庭影院：柔软沙发和玻璃桌正对全息屏幕。游戏设备就在显示器旁，她的朋友们正忙着安装并尝试启动。然而看起来有些问题；你猜设备仍在闹故障。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a brief look around Fisianna’s apartment. It’s a fairly cosy space that looks like it receives a lot of love and care. There are a number of gadgets and gizmos that are neatly organized on various shelves in the living room area. At another end of the living room area are a few cleaning droids which you assume were just recently used. Fisianna has a rather comfortable home theater area set up in the middle of the room. It has a plush couch complete with glass tables opposite of a holoscreen. The gaming rig sits nearby the display, where her friends feverishly work to set it up and play. They seem to be having some trouble starting it up, however. You assume that her rig is still on the fritz."

rows.original: Her dining room area looks just as comfortable with assorted fruits decorating the middle of the table. A bar-like setup next to a wide indoor window borders the living room area and kitchen. From what you can make out through the opening, her kitchen looks very modern and clean. There is a small narrow hallway past the kitchen to what you assume lead to the lavatory and bedrooms.
rows.translation: 用餐区同样舒适，桌子中央摆着各种水果。客厅与厨房交界处、宽大的室内窗口旁有一处类似吧台的布置。透过开口看去，厨房十分现代而整洁。厨房后方有一条狭窄走廊，你猜通往卫生间和卧室。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer dining room area looks just as comfortable with assorted fruits decorating the middle of the table. A bar-like setup next to a wide indoor window borders the living room area and kitchen. From what you can make out through the opening, her kitchen looks very modern and clean. There is a small narrow hallway past the kitchen to what you assume lead to the lavatory and bedrooms."

rows.original: A cheer draws your attention back to the girls. It looks like they got Fisianna’s gaming rig fixed and set up. You already see the holoscreen displaying the title screen for CoV 8.
rows.translation: 一阵欢呼将你的注意力拉回女孩们身上。看来她们已经修好并设置好菲西安娜的游戏设备。全息屏幕上已经显示出《英勇召唤8》的标题画面。
rows.raw: "\n\nA cheer draws your attention back to the girls. It looks like they got Fisianna’s gaming rig fixed and set up. You already see the holoscreen displaying the title screen for CoV 8."

rows.original: “Fuck yes! I’ve been waitin’ for this all day! I hope you’re ready, Fisi! I’ll get my revenge tonight! I can feel it!” Tarariel exclaims while she grabs a harness and jumps into the couch to set it up.
rows.translation: “他妈的太好了！我一整天都在等这个！准备好了吗，菲希！今晚我一定要复仇！我有预感！”塔拉瑞尔一边叫喊，一边抓起一副设备跳上沙发进行设置。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck yes! I’ve been waitin’ for this all day! I hope you’re ready, Fisi! I’ll get my revenge tonight! I can feel it!” Tarariel exclaims while she grabs a harness and jumps into the couch to set it up. "

rows.original: “You wish, Tarariel...” Fisianna scoffs as you and the other girls shortly join the kitsune-morph on the couch and set up your own holo-harnesses. She sets up a free-for-all game for the five of you and you jump into it right after.
rows.translation: “做梦吧，塔拉瑞尔...”菲西安娜嗤笑。你和其他女孩很快加入沙发上的狐妖变形者，设置各自的全息背带。她为你们五人开了一局自由混战，你们随即进入游戏。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You wish, Tarariel...” Fisianna scoffs as you and the other girls shortly join the kitsune-morph on the couch and set up your own holo-harnesses. She sets up a free-for-all game for the five of you and you jump into it right after."

rows.original: The games go by fairly quickly since there is a big gap in skill between all five of you. Aya can’t seem to catch a break between getting caught in crossfire and flat out being in the wrong places at the wrong time. You, Tarariel and Fisianna keep a fairly even pace with each other, having a mostly equal amount of kills between the three of you, but Britannia comes out undeniably dominant over everyone. She barely ever dies during your games and racks up kills left and right. You would think that she would have military training if you didn’t know any better. Either that or she is secretly a professional gamer.
rows.translation: 由于你们五人的技术差距很大，游戏进行得相当快。阿雅不是卷入交叉火力，就是在错误时间出现在错误地点，始终无法喘息。你、塔拉瑞尔和菲西安娜势均力敌，击杀数大致相同，但布里塔妮娅毫无疑问地碾压所有人。她几乎从不阵亡，却不断收割击杀。若非你更了解她，简直会以为她接受过军事训练；要不然，她就是偷偷当过职业玩家。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe games go by fairly quickly since there is a big gap in skill between all five of you. Aya can’t seem to catch a break between getting caught in crossfire and flat out being in the wrong places at the wrong time. You, Tarariel and Fisianna keep a fairly even pace with each other, having a mostly equal amount of kills between the three of you, but Britannia comes out undeniably dominant over everyone. She barely ever dies during your games and racks up kills left and right. You would think that she would have military training if you didn’t know any better. Either that or she is secretly a professional gamer."

rows.original: After a few rounds, the four of you eventually give up on trying to beat Britannia and take off your holo-harnesses.
rows.translation: 几轮过后，你们四个终于放弃击败布里塔妮娅，摘下全息背带。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few rounds, the four of you eventually give up on trying to beat Britannia and take off your holo-harnesses."

rows.original: “Shit, Bri... You could go a bit easier on us, y’know! I can’t exactly take my revenge if you’re constantly killin’ us all mercilessly!” Tarariel sighs in exasperation. Afterwards she audibly whispers to Britannia, “Hey, can you give me some private lessons for CoV 8? I’m gonna need ‘em to beat Fisi!”
rows.translation: “妈的，布里...你就不能稍微让让我们吗！你一直毫不留情地杀光所有人，我还怎么复仇！”塔拉瑞尔恼火地叹息。随后她用大家都听得见的声音对布里塔妮娅耳语：“嘿，你能私下教我几招《英勇召唤8》吗？我需要这些才能打败菲希！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit, Bri... You could go a bit easier on us, y’know! I can’t exactly take my revenge if you’re constantly killin’ us all mercilessly!” Tarariel sighs in exasperation. Afterwards she audibly whispers to Britannia, “Hey, can you give me some private lessons for CoV 8? I’m gonna need ‘em to beat Fisi!”"

rows.original: “I can hear you, you know...” Fisianna pouts as her ears swivel adorably in emphasis. Tarariel sticks her tongue out at the sullen neko and blows a raspberry. Britannia giggles softly before rising up from her seat. She walks over to the pile of belongings that you and the girls created when you first entered the apartment. She reaches into her bag and pulls out a small holo projection unit and sets it down on the glass table in front of everyone.
rows.translation: “你知道我听得见...”菲西安娜噘起嘴，一双耳朵可爱地转动以加强语气。塔拉瑞尔朝闷闷不乐的猫娘吐舌头，发出噗声。布里塔妮娅轻声笑着从座位起身，走向你们刚进公寓时堆在一起的行李。她从包里取出一台小型全息投影器，放到众人面前的玻璃桌上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can hear you, you know...” Fisianna pouts as her ears swivel adorably in emphasis. Tarariel sticks her tongue out at the sullen neko and blows a raspberry. Britannia giggles softly before rising up from her seat. She walks over to the pile of belongings that you and the girls created when you first entered the apartment. She reaches into her bag and pulls out a small holo projection unit and sets it down on the glass table in front of everyone."

rows.original: “I brought this over from home and thought we could try playing it next. It’s a little holoboard game called Oligopoly.”
rows.translation: “我从家里带了这个，想接下来一起试试。这是一款叫作寡头争霸的小型全息棋盘游戏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I brought this over from home and thought we could try playing it next. It’s a little holoboard game called Oligopoly.”"

rows.original: Aya jumps in her seat in excitement. “Oh! I know this game! It’s that one board game where you try to oligopolize, or uhh... rather take over every company you can and try to run everyone else out of business, right?”
rows.translation: 阿雅兴奋地从座位上弹起来。“哦！我知道这个游戏！就是那个要垄断，或者，呃...应该说尽可能收购所有公司，再把其他人都挤到破产的棋盘游戏，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAya jumps in her seat in excitement. “Oh! I know this game! It’s that one board game where you try to oligopolize, or uhh... rather take over every company you can and try to run everyone else out of business, right?”"

rows.original: Britannia nods. “Mhm, you’re right on the money, Aya. I thought we could play a little game of this to simmer down, while still tickling our competitive fancies...” She adds the last part with a playful undertone towards Tarariel.
rows.translation: 布里塔妮娅点头。“嗯，完全正确，阿雅。我想我们可以玩一局冷静一下，同时仍能满足一下竞争欲...”最后几个字带着顽皮语调，明显是冲塔拉瑞尔说的。
rows.raw: "\n\nBritannia nods. “Mhm, you’re right on the money, Aya. I thought we could play a little game of this to simmer down, while still tickling our competitive fancies...” She adds the last part with a playful undertone towards Tarariel."

rows.original: Everyone else in the room seems to be interested except for Tarariel, who looks unsure. “Hm... it sounds interesting and all, though I have a feelin’ Steele’s gonna mop the floor with us, bein’ a business tycoon and all.”
rows.translation: 房间里其他人似乎都很感兴趣，只有塔拉瑞尔神色犹豫。“嗯...听起来确实有意思，不过我总觉得斯蒂尔身为商业大亨，会把我们打得落花流水。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEveryone else in the room seems to be interested except for Tarariel, who looks unsure. “Hm... it sounds interesting and all, though I have a feelin’ Steele’s gonna mop the floor with us, bein’ a business tycoon and all.”"

rows.original: “Hey, I don’t own Steele Tech... yet anyways. Besides, I doubt the game would be as complicated as real business is anyways.” You say in your defense.
rows.translation: “嘿，我还没拥有斯蒂尔科技...至少现在还没有。而且我怀疑游戏能像真实商业那么复杂。”你为自己辩解。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, I don’t own Steele Tech... yet anyways. Besides, I doubt the game would be as complicated as real business is anyways.” You say in your defense."

rows.original: Britannia clears her throat, catching the attention of everyone in the room again. “Alright, I will volunteer to be the banker. It’s up to you four on who you would like to team up with.”
rows.translation: 布里塔妮娅清清嗓子，再次吸引房中所有人的注意。“好吧，我自愿当银行。你们四个想和谁组队，由自己决定。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBritannia clears her throat, catching the attention of everyone in the room again. “Alright, I will volunteer to be the banker. It’s up to you four on who you would like to team up with.”"

rows.original: Before anyone has a chance to speak up, Fisianna squeaks. “I wanna team up with [pc.name]!”
rows.translation: 其他人还没来得及说话，菲西安娜便尖声说道：“我想和[pc.name]组队！”
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore anyone has a chance to speak up, Fisianna squeaks. “I wanna team up with [pc.name]!”"

rows.original: Tarariel groans in disdain, to which Aya shoots a dangerous narrow eyed leer at her. “Hey, I know about this game, and I’m pretty good at it! Let’s mop the floor with them and run ‘em out of town, Tara!” Aya encourages the fox-girl.
rows.translation: 塔拉瑞尔不满地呻吟，阿雅则危险地眯眼瞪她。“嘿，我了解这个游戏，而且玩得很不错！我们一起把他们打得落花流水、赶出城去吧，塔拉！”阿雅鼓励狐女。
rows.raw: "\n\nTarariel groans in disdain, to which Aya shoots a dangerous narrow eyed leer at her. “Hey, I know about this game, and I’m pretty good at it! Let’s mop the floor with them and run ‘em out of town, Tara!” Aya encourages the fox-girl."

rows.original: Tarariel nods and smiles in agreeance with Aya. She then turns and gives you and Fisianna an even more dangerous looking grin. Britannia boots up the holoboard and a square board pops up with little avatars for everyone’s tokens. You can see that almost each square holds names of all different types of companies that are still currently in business, from smaller chains to large mega corporations. You see lesser known corporations like J’ejune, to widely known ones like JoyCo, Reaper Armaments, and even your very own Steele Tech! Little indicators pop up telling how much each team has in credits. Afterwards a computerized six sided die pops up and transforms into a two-sided coin to decide which team moves first. It flips up and down on its display and lands on tails, indicating Tarariel and Aya would take the first turn.
rows.translation: 塔拉瑞尔点头微笑，赞同阿雅。随后她转向你和菲西安娜，露出更加危险的笑容。布里塔妮娅启动全息棋盘，一块方形棋盘弹出，上面有代表众人的小型化身。几乎每个格子都写着仍在经营的不同公司，从小型连锁店到巨型企业。既有杰琼这种不太知名的公司，也有JoyCo、收割者军械，甚至你自家的斯蒂尔科技！小指示器显示每支队伍拥有的信用点。随后电脑生成一颗六面骰，又变成双面硬币，决定哪队先行动。硬币在画面中上下翻转，最终落在反面，表示塔拉瑞尔和阿雅先走。
rows.raw: "\n\nTarariel nods and smiles in agreeance with Aya. She then turns and gives you and Fisianna an even more dangerous looking grin. Britannia boots up the holoboard and a square board pops up with little avatars for everyone’s tokens. You can see that almost each square holds names of all different types of companies that are still currently in business, from smaller chains to large mega corporations. You see lesser known corporations like J’ejune, to widely known ones like JoyCo, Reaper Armaments, and even your very own Steele Tech! Little indicators pop up telling how much each team has in credits. Afterwards a computerized six sided die pops up and transforms into a two-sided coin to decide which team moves first. It flips up and down on its display and lands on tails, indicating Tarariel and Aya would take the first turn."

rows.original: “Alright, may the best team win!” Britannia smiles as the game begins.
rows.translation: “好吧，愿最佳队伍获胜！”布里塔妮娅微笑着宣布游戏开始。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, may the best team win!” Britannia smiles as the game begins."

rows.original: The four of you take turns moving around the game board buying any company that your avatars land on. By the time just about all of the companies are bought out, both your team and Tarariel’s team have about an even amount of companies owned. At this point in the game, it is more of a competition of who can wrest more money from another as you circle the board, having to pay a tax for landing on an opponent’s company. Both of you also buy more stocks from Britannia, investing them on strategic places on the board in the hope that your opponents will be unfortunate enough to land on them for a heavier tax.
rows.translation: 你们四个轮流沿棋盘移动，购买化身落到的任何公司。几乎所有公司都被买下时，你们队与塔拉瑞尔队拥有的公司数量大致相同。此时游戏更像一场争夺，看谁能在绕棋盘时从对方手里榨出更多钱；落到对手公司就要缴税。双方还从布里塔妮娅那里购买更多股票，投资在棋盘上的战略位置，希望对手倒霉地落上去并缴纳更重税款。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe four of you take turns moving around the game board buying any company that your avatars land on. By the time just about all of the companies are bought out, both your team and Tarariel’s team have about an even amount of companies owned. At this point in the game, it is more of a competition of who can wrest more money from another as you circle the board, having to pay a tax for landing on an opponent’s company. Both of you also buy more stocks from Britannia, investing them on strategic places on the board in the hope that your opponents will be unfortunate enough to land on them for a heavier tax."

rows.original: About an hour passes after this stage and almost each company is maxed out in shares able to be bought. One wrong landing could be a game changer.
