On Fisianna’s turn, she very narrowly misses landing on Aya’s Xenogen Corp square as she passes over it and lands on her own KihaCorp square. On Aya’s turn, she lands on Fisianna’s owned JoyCo square, having to pay more credits than their team currently has. They are forced to sell stocks from other companies they own to pay the tax. It’s the game changer that your team needed!
rows.translation: 这个阶段持续约一小时后，几乎每家公司可购买的股份都已达到上限。一次错误落点便可能改变战局。菲西安娜的回合中，她险险越过阿雅的异种生物科技格，落在自己拥有的基哈公司格。轮到阿雅时，她落在菲西安娜拥有的JoyCo格上，必须支付超过队伍现有资金的信用点。她们被迫出售其他公司股份来缴税。这正是你们队需要的转折！
rows.raw: "\n\nAbout an hour passes after this stage and almost each company is maxed out in shares able to be bought. One wrong landing could be a game changer. On Fisianna’s turn, she very narrowly misses landing on Aya’s Xenogen Corp square as she passes over it and lands on her own KihaCorp square. On Aya’s turn, she lands on Fisianna’s owned JoyCo square, having to pay more credits than their team currently has. They are forced to sell stocks from other companies they own to pay the tax. It’s the game changer that your team needed! "

rows.original: On your turn, you land on square that gives you an event card. The card grants you and Fisianna a hefty reward for finding a rare mineral deposit on an offworld planet. You use the money earned to max out stocks on your Steele Tech owned square, which Tarariel can possibly land on during her next turn. If she lands on Steele Tech, there would be no way for her team to pay the insane tax for landing on that square.
rows.translation: 你的回合中，落到一格并获得事件卡。卡片因你和菲西安娜在外星行星发现稀有矿藏，给予丰厚奖励。你用赚到的钱买满自有斯蒂尔科技格的股票，而塔拉瑞尔下一回合可能落在那里。一旦她落到斯蒂尔科技，她们队绝无可能支付那笔疯狂税款。
rows.raw: "\n\nOn your turn, you land on square that gives you an event card. The card grants you and Fisianna a hefty reward for finding a rare mineral deposit on an offworld planet. You use the money earned to max out stocks on your Steele Tech owned square, which Tarariel can possibly land on during her next turn. If she lands on Steele Tech, there would be no way for her team to pay the insane tax for landing on that square. "

rows.original: It comes to Tarariel’s turn. She presses the button to roll the digital die and rolls a three, which is just the number you needed for her to land your now fully upgraded Steele Tech square! The kitsune-morph cries out in anguish as her avatar moves to your Steele Tech square, after which the game displays an “insufficient funds” message and declares bankruptcy for Aya and Tarariel.
rows.translation: 轮到塔拉瑞尔。她按下按钮投掷数字骰，结果是三点，正好足以让她落到你已经完全升级的斯蒂尔科技格！狐妖变形者痛苦地叫喊；她的化身移到斯蒂尔科技格后，游戏显示“资金不足”，并宣布阿雅与塔拉瑞尔破产。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt comes to Tarariel’s turn. She presses the button to roll the digital die and rolls a three, which is just the number you needed for her to land your now fully upgraded Steele Tech square! The kitsune-morph cries out in anguish as her avatar moves to your Steele Tech square, after which the game displays an “insufficient funds” message and declares bankruptcy for Aya and Tarariel."

rows.original: “Aaaargh, damn it! Steele, I hope this isn’t a preview of what you would really do if you took over Steele Tech...” Tarariel leans in towards you to whisper into your ear. “If it is, let me get a share of the cuts, yeah?” She gives you a playful grin as she sits back in her chair. You chuckle while Britannia picks up the holoboard cube and puts it away in her bag.
rows.translation: “啊啊啊，妈的！斯蒂尔，希望这不是你真正接管斯蒂尔科技后的预演...”塔拉瑞尔凑近，在你耳边低语。“要真是这样，分我一杯羹，行吗？”她顽皮地笑着坐回椅子。你轻声笑着，布里塔妮娅则拿起全息棋盘方块，收回包中。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aaaargh, damn it! Steele, I hope this isn’t a preview of what you would really do if you took over Steele Tech...” Tarariel leans in towards you to whisper into your ear. “If it is, let me get a share of the cuts, yeah?” She gives you a playful grin as she sits back in her chair. You chuckle while Britannia picks up the holoboard cube and puts it away in her bag."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: You rack your brain trying to think of something else for you to do with Fisianna. So far you’ve had fun playing at the arcade with her, as well as shopping and watching some movies. In the middle of thinking of what new thing the two of you could do together, you spot all three of Fisianna’s friends coming up the walkway towards the both you. Upon seeing you and Fisianna sitting on the park bench together, their walking pace starts to quicken, though you can see Tarariel among them making a running beeline at you.
rows.translation: 你绞尽脑汁，思考还能和菲西安娜一起做些什么。到目前为止，你们在酒吧玩得很开心，也一起度过了些私人时光。正当你们考虑时，熟悉的声音从不远处传来。
rows.raw: "You rack your brain trying to think of something else for you to do with Fisianna. So far you’ve had fun playing at the arcade with her, as well as shopping and watching some movies. In the middle of thinking of what new thing the two of you could do together, you spot all three of Fisianna’s friends coming up the walkway towards the both you. Upon seeing you and Fisianna sitting on the park bench together, their walking pace starts to quicken, though you can see Tarariel among them making a running beeline at you."

rows.original: “Heeeey! Fisiiii! Steeeeele!” She yells as she runs over to hug Fisianna, and then you. Aya and Britannia catch up shortly after and offer their greetings.
rows.translation: “嘿——！菲希——！斯蒂——尔！”她边喊边跑来拥抱菲西安娜，接着又抱住你。阿雅和布里塔妮娅在她身后赶上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heeeey! Fisiiii! Steeeeele!” She yells as she runs over to hug Fisianna, and then you. Aya and Britannia catch up shortly after and offer their greetings."

rows.original: “So what’cha both up to?” Aya asks while she absentmindedly sips a drink she has in her hand.
rows.translation: “你们两个在干什么呀？”阿雅一边漫不经心地啜饮手中的饮料，一边问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what’cha both up to?” Aya asks while she absentmindedly sips a drink she has in her hand."

rows.original: “O-oh, nothing. We were actually just trying to think of something to do ourselves. I-I guess since you’re all here we can all think up something to do together.” Fisianna proposes.
rows.translation: “哦、哦，没什么。我们其实正在想要做点什么。我、我想既然你们都来了，也许我们可以一起？”菲西安娜回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh, nothing. We were actually just trying to think of something to do ourselves. I-I guess since you’re all here we can all think up something to do together.” Fisianna proposes."

rows.original: “Actually, the three of us were thinking about doing something a little... different this time, that is, if you would be up for it.” Britannia says with a slight smile on her face. “You don’t have to do it if you wouldn’t want to, Kitten.”
rows.translation: “其实，我们三个这次想做点...不一样的事，当然，前提是你们愿意。”布里塔妮娅微笑着说道。“如果你不愿意，也不必勉强，小猫咪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Actually, the three of us were thinking about doing something a little... different this time, that is, if you would be up for it.” Britannia says with a slight smile on her face. “You don’t have to do it if you wouldn’t want to, Kitten.”"

rows.original: Fisianna looks at Britannia in curiosity as she wonders what she and the others were intending to suggest. The catgirl doesn’t have to wait long until Tarariel speaks up.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜好奇地望向布里塔妮娅，想知道她和另外两人打算提议什么。猫娘的双耳微微转动。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna looks at Britannia in curiosity as she wonders what she and the others were intending to suggest. The catgirl doesn’t have to wait long until Tarariel speaks up."

rows.original: “Fisi! We were thinkin’ of havin’ a little sleepover tonight. You can even come along if you wanna, Steele!”
rows.translation: “菲希！我们想今晚来场小小的睡衣派对。你想来也可以，斯蒂尔！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fisi! We were thinkin’ of havin’ a little sleepover tonight. You can even come along if you wanna, Steele!”"

rows.original: “A-a sleepover? Aren’t we a little... old to-” Fisianna starts to question before she is cut off by Tarariel.
rows.translation: “睡、睡衣派对？我们是不是有点...太大了，不适合——”菲西安娜刚提出疑问，就被塔拉瑞尔打断。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A-a sleepover? Aren’t we a little... old to-” Fisianna starts to question before she is cut off by Tarariel."

rows.original: “Yeah, yeah. We know, but it’s not like any of us had much of a childhood to enjoy to begin with anyways.” Tararial says with a small frown on her face. Her frown is gone just about as soon as it came when she continues. “Anyways, we thought it might be a good idea to just spend a night with each other, y’know? Play a few games, watch some shows, have a good ol’ pillow fight maybe. Stuff like that, yeah?”
rows.translation: “好啦，好啦。我们知道，但我们本来就没享受过多少童年。”塔拉瑞尔解释道。“所以偶尔补回来又有什么关系？我们可以玩游戏、吃零食、聊八卦，还能熬夜！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, yeah. We know, but it’s not like any of us had much of a childhood to enjoy to begin with anyways.” Tararial says with a small frown on her face. Her frown is gone just about as soon as it came when she continues. “Anyways, we thought it might be a good idea to just spend a night with each other, y’know? Play a few games, watch some shows, have a good ol’ pillow fight maybe. Stuff like that, yeah?”"

rows.original: “Sounds like a lot of fun when you put it that way, Tara!” Aya pitches in. “Though do you know who would be hosting said sleepover?”
rows.translation: “听你这么一说确实很好玩，塔拉！”阿雅插话。“不过你知道谁来当主人吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds like a lot of fun when you put it that way, Tara!” Aya pitches in. “Though do you know who would be hosting said sleepover?”"

rows.original: “Hm... I haven’t thought that far into it...” Tarariel laughs sheepishly. “Well, my place is messy beyond repair so I won’t be able to host it tonight...” She says with a shrug.
rows.translation: “嗯...我还真没想那么远...”塔拉瑞尔不好意思地笑道。“我家乱得没法收拾，所以今晚没法举办...”她耸肩说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm... I haven’t thought that far into it...” Tarariel laughs sheepishly. “Well, my place is messy beyond repair so I won’t be able to host it tonight...” She says with a shrug."

rows.original: “I’ve still got a bunch of feathers that need cleaning up from my last molt so... it’s a no-go for me.” Aya adds with a disappointed tone in her voice.
rows.translation: “我上次换羽后还有一堆羽毛没清理，所以...我家也不行。”阿雅补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve still got a bunch of feathers that need cleaning up from my last molt so... it’s a no-go for me.” Aya adds with a disappointed tone in her voice."

rows.original: “Mmm... my place is still being de-fumed as well... It smells too much of smoke. I wouldn’t want you all to deal with that.” Britannia says with a slight cough.
rows.translation: “嗯...我家也还在除味...烟味太重了。我不想让你们忍受那种气味。”布里塔妮娅说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm... my place is still being de-fumed as well... It smells too much of smoke. I wouldn’t want you all to deal with that.” Britannia says with a slight cough."

rows.original: “So... d-does that mean you want me to host the sleepover?” Fisianna asks quietly. “I-I mean I think my apartment is in a better shape than all of yours, so I suppose I could. I would still need to get it ready and all. This is coming rather suddenly.”
rows.translation: “所以...你、你们是想让我举办睡衣派对吗？”菲西安娜小声问道。“我、我是说，我觉得我的公寓比你们的状态都好，所以应该可以。我还是得先做好各种准备。这实在有点突然。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So... d-does that mean you want me to host the sleepover?” Fisianna asks quietly. “I-I mean I think my apartment is in a better shape than all of yours, so I suppose I could. I would still need to get it ready and all. This is coming rather suddenly.”"

rows.original: “So you’ll do it? Awesome! I’m gonna go get some sleepwear ready and bring a game or two with me! This is gonna be soooo great!” Tarariel jumps in the air excitedly and starts to run towards her home before she is cut off by Aya.
rows.translation: “所以你答应了？太棒了！我要回去准备睡衣，再带一两个游戏！今晚一定超好玩！”塔拉瑞尔兴奋地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you’ll do it? Awesome! I’m gonna go get some sleepwear ready and bring a game or two with me! This is gonna be soooo great!” Tarariel jumps in the air excitedly and starts to run towards her home before she is cut off by Aya."

rows.original: “Whoa there... hold on. Fisi didn’t even say yes yet! Calm down, girl!” Aya explains to Tarariel as she tries to hold her down from trying to run home.
rows.translation: “等等...先停一下。菲希还没答应呢！冷静点，姑娘！”阿雅一边解释，一边试图让塔拉瑞尔安静下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whoa there... hold on. Fisi didn’t even say yes yet! Calm down, girl!” Aya explains to Tarariel as she tries to hold her down from trying to run home."

rows.original: Britannia walks over to Fisianna and places a comforting hand on her shoulder. “Again, you don’t have to do it if you don’t want to. It’s up to you, Kitten.”
rows.translation: 布里塔妮娅走到菲西安娜身旁，把一只安慰的手放在她肩上。“还是那句话，如果你不愿意，就不必勉强。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBritannia walks over to Fisianna and places a comforting hand on her shoulder. “Again, you don’t have to do it if you don’t want to. It’s up to you, Kitten.”"

rows.original: After a brief moment of thought, Fisianna smiles up to Britannia. “Yeah, why not? I suppose I can host a sleepover at my apartment. It does sound like fun. [pc.name], of course you can come along as well if you’d like to?”
rows.translation: 思考片刻后，菲西安娜抬头向布里塔妮娅微笑。“好啊，为什么不呢？我想我可以在家里举办睡衣派对。只要[pc.name]也愿意来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a brief moment of thought, Fisianna smiles up to Britannia. “Yeah, why not? I suppose I can host a sleepover at my apartment. It does sound like fun. [pc.name], of course you can come along as well if you’d like to?”"

rows.original: “Sure, I don’t have a problem with that.” You tell Fisianna. The catgirl smiles widely at hearing this.
rows.translation: “当然，我没意见。”你告诉菲西安娜。猫娘听到后灿烂地笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, I don’t have a problem with that.” You tell Fisianna. The catgirl smiles widely at hearing this."

rows.original: “Great! Then it’s settled. Let’s meet at my house tonight then. I should go home and tidy up anything I need to and get things ready for the sleepover.”
rows.translation: “太好了！那就这么定了。今晚在我家见。我得先回去整理一下需要收拾的东西，再准备些零食。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Great! Then it’s settled. Let’s meet at my house tonight then. I should go home and tidy up anything I need to and get things ready for the sleepover.”"

rows.original: “Nice! I should go get ready then. Meet you all there!” Aya waves after she lets go of Tarariel, who continues running towards her home without another word. Aya tails after her, and you can faintly hear them arguing as they disappear out of sight.
rows.translation: “好耶！那我也得去准备了。大家到时候见！”阿雅放开仍兴奋不已的塔拉瑞尔后挥挥手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nice! I should go get ready then. Meet you all there!” Aya waves after she lets go of Tarariel, who continues running towards her home without another word. Aya tails after her, and you can faintly hear them arguing as they disappear out of sight."

rows.original: “Thank you Fisi for doing this for all of us. We’ll make it up to you someday.” Britannia smiles warmly while she gently squeezes Fisianna’s shoulder.
rows.translation: “谢谢你，菲希，愿意为大家这么做。我们以后会补偿你的。”布里塔妮娅一边温暖地微笑，一边轻抚她的肩膀。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you Fisi for doing this for all of us. We’ll make it up to you someday.” Britannia smiles warmly while she gently squeezes Fisianna’s shoulder."

rows.original: “Dont worry about it, Bri. I have a feeling this will be a great night for us. Ah, [pc.name]! I almost forgot to tell you, my apartment number is 124. It should be by the Northern walkway!” Fisianna shoots a parting smile at you before rising up from her seat to run home and prepare for the sleepover.
rows.translation: “别担心，布里。我有预感，今晚会很棒。啊，[pc.name]！我差点忘了告诉你地址。”菲西安娜说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dont worry about it, Bri. I have a feeling this will be a great night for us. Ah, [pc.name]! I almost forgot to tell you, my apartment number is 124. It should be by the Northern walkway!” Fisianna shoots a parting smile at you before rising up from her seat to run home and prepare for the sleepover."

rows.original: “I shall see you there, Steele. Let’s have some fun, shall we?” Britannia winks at you before she turns away and heads towards her own home to prepare. You have your own preparing to do, so you head back to your ship and pack whatever is necessary for your night out and keep yourself occupied until it is time to meet up at Fisianna’s apartment.
rows.translation: “到时候见，斯蒂尔。一起好好玩，怎么样？”布里塔妮娅向你眨眨眼，随后转身离去，另外两人也跟上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I shall see you there, Steele. Let’s have some fun, shall we?” Britannia winks at you before she turns away and heads towards her own home to prepare. You have your own preparing to do, so you head back to your ship and pack whatever is necessary for your night out and keep yourself occupied until it is time to meet up at Fisianna’s apartment."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You turn in your seat towards Fisianna to ask if she would like to go somewhere else and pass the time doing something together.
rows.translation: 你在座位上转向菲西安娜，问她是否愿意换个地方，一起做点别的事情打发时间。
rows.raw: "You turn in your seat towards Fisianna to ask if she would like to go somewhere else and pass the time doing something together."

rows.original: “Sure [pc.name]! Where did you have in mind?”
rows.translation: “当然，[pc.name]！你想去哪里？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure [pc.name]! Where did you have in mind?”"

rows.original: Arcade
rows.translation: 街机厅
rows.raw: "Arcade"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: MERCHANT'S THOROUGHFARE2
rows.raw: "MERCHANT'S THOROUGHFARE2"

rows.original: You ask Fisianna if she would like to spend some time at an arcade that recently opened up on the Merchant Deck. She enthusiastically agrees and jumps out of her seat, already walking ahead of you, causing you to have to rush to catch up with her. You laugh to yourself while you follow Fisianna to the elevator lifts.
rows.translation: 你问菲西安娜是否愿意去商业层最近新开的一家街机厅消磨时间。她兴奋地答应，跳下座位，已经走到了你前面，害得你不得不快步追赶。你暗自发笑，跟着菲西安娜前往升降梯。
rows.raw: "You ask Fisianna if she would like to spend some time at an arcade that recently opened up on the Merchant Deck. She enthusiastically agrees and jumps out of her seat, already walking ahead of you, causing you to have to rush to catch up with her. You laugh to yourself while you follow Fisianna to the elevator lifts."

rows.original: When the turbo-lift arrives at the Merchant Deck, Fisianna is already bolting out of the elevator door before it can fully open, nearly knocking over an ausar in the process. She quickly apologies to the ausar with a blush on her face before she is on her way again, with you struggling to catch up.
rows.translation: 高速电梯抵达商业层时，门还没有完全打开，菲西安娜就已经冲了出去，差点撞倒一名奥萨。她红着脸飞快向对方道歉，随后又继续赶路，让你辛苦追在后面。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the turbo-lift arrives at the Merchant Deck, Fisianna is already bolting out of the elevator door before it can fully open, nearly knocking over an ausar in the process. She quickly apologies to the ausar with a blush on her face before she is on her way again, with you struggling to catch up."

rows.original: About halfway to the arcade, you and Fisianna run into Aya, Fisianna’s harpy friend. Aya chirps a happy greeting to the both of you, after which you ask what she is up to.
rows.translation: 前往街机厅的半路上，你和菲西安娜遇见了她的鸟身女妖朋友阿雅。阿雅欢快地鸣叫着向你们问好，随后你问她在做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nAbout halfway to the arcade, you and Fisianna run into Aya, Fisianna’s harpy friend. Aya chirps a happy greeting to the both of you, after which you ask what she is up to."

rows.original: “Ah, nothing much really. Kinda bored after doing some window shopping. What about you two?”
rows.translation: “啊，其实没什么。逛橱窗逛得有点无聊了。你们两个呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, nothing much really. Kinda bored after doing some window shopping. What about you two?”"

rows.original: “We were just about to head to the arcade! Wanna come with?” Fisianna asks Aya, still giddy at the prospect of going to the arcade.
rows.translation: “我们正要去街机厅！想不想一起？”菲西安娜问阿雅，仍因即将去街机厅而兴奋不已。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We were just about to head to the arcade! Wanna come with?” Fisianna asks Aya, still giddy at the prospect of going to the arcade."

rows.original: “Sure, I’ve got some time to kill, besides, I still kinda owe ya after I messed up our co-op progress through the campaign of CoV 8...” Aya frowns.
rows.translation: “好啊，我正好有时间要打发。再说，上次我搞砸了咱们在《英勇召唤8》战役里的合作进度，多少还欠你一次...”阿雅皱起眉头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, I’ve got some time to kill, besides, I still kinda owe ya after I messed up our co-op progress through the campaign of CoV 8...” Aya frowns."

rows.original: “Nah, don’t worry about it. As long as we have fun. Besides, things might go better with a bit of extra help this time around.” Fisianna reassures Aya, and gives you a cute wink.
rows.translation: “没关系，别担心。玩得开心就好。况且，这次多一个人帮忙，说不定会更顺利。”菲西安娜安慰阿雅，又可爱地朝你眨了眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nah, don’t worry about it. As long as we have fun. Besides, things might go better with a bit of extra help this time around.” Fisianna reassures Aya, and gives you a cute wink."

rows.original: With Aya now in tow, the three of you arrive at the arcade after a fairly short walk. When inside, Fisianna rushes to the nearest open gaming station and starts to set up a game of CoV 8.
rows.translation: 阿雅也加入以后，你们三个步行没多久便抵达街机厅。一进门，菲西安娜就冲向最近的空闲游戏站，开始设置一局《英勇召唤8》。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith Aya now in tow, the three of you arrive at the arcade after a fairly short walk. When inside, Fisianna rushes to the nearest open gaming station and starts to set up a game of CoV 8."

rows.original: “How about a 3 player co-op campaign? Legendary difficulty. Think you can handle that [pc.name]?” Fisianna inquires.
rows.translation: “三人合作战役怎么样？传奇难度。你应付得了吗，[pc.name]？”菲西安娜问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How about a 3 player co-op campaign? Legendary difficulty. Think you can handle that [pc.name]?” Fisianna inquires."

rows.original: You tell Fisianna that you are game if everyone else is and look towards Aya to receive her opinion. She looks very nervous about taking such a challenge right off the bat, but concedes to try it with the two of you anyways.
rows.translation: 你告诉菲西安娜，只要其他人愿意，你就奉陪；随后看向阿雅，征求她的意见。她对一上来就接受这种挑战显得非常紧张，不过最终还是同意和你们一起尝试。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Fisianna that you are game if everyone else is and look towards Aya to receive her opinion. She looks very nervous about taking such a challenge right off the bat, but concedes to try it with the two of you anyways."

rows.original: The three of you strap on your holo-harnesses and play for the better part of an hour. Fisianna is leading the charge through hordes of enemies with you holding your own and providing support. Aya seems to be having trouble keeping up with the two of you while you play, as she more often misses her targets than hits them. You and Fisianna pick up her slack as best as you are both able to, but you have to admit that with the difficulty of play that you are on, any mistakes you make as a group are near fatal, and it is growing increasingly harder to hold your ground against the seemingly never-ending tide of enemies.
rows.translation: 你们三人穿好全息吊带，玩了将近一个小时。菲西安娜带头冲过敌人群，而你稳住阵脚，为她提供支援。阿雅似乎很难跟上你们的节奏，射失目标的次数远多于命中。你和菲西安娜尽力弥补她的失误，但你不得不承认，在当前难度下，团队犯下的任何错误都近乎致命；面对仿佛永无止境的敌潮，守住阵地也变得越来越艰难。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe three of you strap on your holo-harnesses and play for the better part of an hour. Fisianna is leading the charge through hordes of enemies with you holding your own and providing support. Aya seems to be having trouble keeping up with the two of you while you play, as she more often misses her targets than hits them. You and Fisianna pick up her slack as best as you are both able to, but you have to admit that with the difficulty of play that you are on, any mistakes you make as a group are near fatal, and it is growing increasingly harder to hold your ground against the seemingly never-ending tide of enemies. "

rows.original: Sure enough, when the three of you arrive at an enemy base, a virtual army is waiting for you, forcing the three of you retreat to cover for a long battle of attrition. When there is a momentary lapse of gunfire, Aya takes the chance to move ahead towards a different vantage point to take cover. Fisianna tries to warn her not to move out into sight yet, but it is a moment too late. The game abruptly finishes when Aya runs ahead of you, only to be blasted by a stray grenade that she failed to see. As the three of you unstrap your holo-harnesses, Aya’s feathers look slightly ruffled from the shock she received from the grenade shrapnel and the holo-harness.
rows.translation: 果然，当你们三人抵达敌军基地时，一支虚拟大军正在等待，迫使你们撤进掩体，展开漫长的消耗战。枪火短暂停歇时，阿雅抓住机会向前移动，准备去另一个制高点寻找掩护。菲西安娜试图警告她先别暴露在视野里，却还是晚了一瞬。阿雅跑到你们前面时，没看见一枚飞来的流弹手雷，被当场炸中，游戏也骤然结束。你们解开全息吊带时，阿雅的羽毛被手雷碎片与吊带反馈的冲击弄得微微凌乱。
rows.raw: "\n\nSure enough, when the three of you arrive at an enemy base, a virtual army is waiting for you, forcing the three of you retreat to cover for a long battle of attrition. When there is a momentary lapse of gunfire, Aya takes the chance to move ahead towards a different vantage point to take cover. Fisianna tries to warn her not to move out into sight yet, but it is a moment too late. The game abruptly finishes when Aya runs ahead of you, only to be blasted by a stray grenade that she failed to see. As the three of you unstrap your holo-harnesses, Aya’s feathers look slightly ruffled from the shock she received from the grenade shrapnel and the holo-harness."

rows.original: “Sorry about that guys... I’m not as good as you two. I’ll get better though! Promise!”
rows.translation: “抱歉，各位...我没你们两个厉害。不过我会进步的！我保证！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry about that guys... I’m not as good as you two. I’ll get better though! Promise!”"

rows.original: You and Fisianna reassure her that everything is fine and that you all still had a blast. After grabbing a few snacks from a nearby vending machine, the three of you decide to head your separate ways. Hopefully you’ll all progress further in the campaign next time.
rows.translation: 你和菲西安娜安慰她，说一切都没关系，大家仍旧玩得非常痛快。从附近自动贩卖机买了些零食后，你们三人决定各自离开。希望下次能在战役里推进得更远。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou and Fisianna reassure her that everything is fine and that you all still had a blast. After grabbing a few snacks from a nearby vending machine, the three of you decide to head your separate ways. Hopefully you’ll all progress further in the campaign next time."

rows.original: On the way to the arcade, you run into Tarariel, Fisianna’s kitsune-morph friend. Tarariel waves and bounds over to the two of you.
rows.translation: 前往街机厅途中，你们遇见了菲西安娜的狐妖变体朋友塔拉瑞尔。塔拉瑞尔挥着手，一蹦一跳地来到你们身边。
rows.raw: "\n\nOn the way to the arcade, you run into Tarariel, Fisianna’s kitsune-morph friend. Tarariel waves and bounds over to the two of you."

rows.original: “Heya! So, what’re you two lovebirds up to? Hopefully not gettin’ into trouble, are we?” Tarariel playfully nudges you.
rows.translation: “嘿！你们两个小情侣要去哪儿啊？希望不是准备惹麻烦吧？”塔拉瑞尔开玩笑地撞了你一下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heya! So, what’re you two lovebirds up to? Hopefully not gettin’ into trouble, are we?” Tarariel playfully nudges you."

rows.original: Fisianna blushes profusely and pouts. “Tara... I told you not to-”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜满脸通红，噘起嘴。“塔拉...我跟你说过不要，”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna blushes profusely and pouts. “Tara... I told you not to-”"

rows.original: Tarariel cuts Fisianna off and starts slapping her shoulder, giggling in mirth. “I’m just playin’ with ya, Fisi! Sheesh!”
rows.translation: 塔拉瑞尔打断菲西安娜，咯咯笑着连拍她的肩膀。“我只是跟你开玩笑，菲西！真是的！”
rows.raw: "\n\nTarariel cuts Fisianna off and starts slapping her shoulder, giggling in mirth. “I’m just playin’ with ya, Fisi! Sheesh!”"

rows.original: You speak up before Fisianna can be embarrassed further. “Speaking of playing around, we were just about to head over to the arcade.”
rows.translation: 你赶在菲西安娜更加难堪以前开口。“说到玩，我们正准备去街机厅。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou speak up before Fisianna can be embarrassed further. “Speaking of playing around, we were just about to head over to the arcade.”"

rows.original: “That’s great! Would you mind if I tagged along? I’m soooo boooored... Plus, I still owe Fisi an ass-kicking. Don’t think I forgot what you did to me last time on CoV 8.” Tarariel scowls.
rows.translation: “太好了！介意我一起去吗？我无——聊——死了...再说，我还欠菲西一顿教训。别以为我忘了上次你在《英勇召唤8》里怎么对付我的。”塔拉瑞尔皱眉道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s great! Would you mind if I tagged along? I’m soooo boooored... Plus, I still owe Fisi an ass-kicking. Don’t think I forgot what you did to me last time on CoV 8.” Tarariel scowls."

rows.original: You look towards Fisianna for her approval. Surprisingly, she has a rather smug look on her face. “Fine, Tara. You can come along, but I think I’ll be the one to kick you down on your nine tails again. Maybe [pc.name] here can even put one in for me too.”
rows.translation: 你看向菲西安娜，等待她同意。令人惊讶的是，她脸上竟带着相当得意的表情。“好吧，塔拉，你可以来，不过我觉得这次还是我会把你和九条尾巴一起打趴下。也许[pc.name]还能替我补上一击。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look towards Fisianna for her approval. Surprisingly, she has a rather smug look on her face. “Fine, Tara. You can come along, but I think I’ll be the one to kick you down on your nine tails again. Maybe [pc.name] here can even put one in for me too.”"

rows.original: Tarariel smiles devilishly at you. “If you aren’t even half as good as Fisi here, then you won’t stand a chance against me! Best bring your A-game, Steele.”
rows.translation: 塔拉瑞尔邪气十足地冲你一笑。“要是你的水平连这里的菲西一半都没有，就绝不可能赢我！拿出最佳状态来，斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTarariel smiles devilishly at you. “If you aren’t even half as good as Fisi here, then you won’t stand a chance against me! Best bring your A-game, Steele.”"

rows.original: Oh boy...
rows.translation: 哦，天啊...
rows.raw: "\n\nOh boy..."

rows.original: When the three of you arrive at the arcade, Fisianna and Tarariel are both already rushing over to the nearest open gaming station and setting up a game of CoV 8. Tarariel hurries you over to them and thrusts a holo-harness into your arms when you arrive.
rows.translation: 你们三人抵达街机厅时，菲西安娜和塔拉瑞尔已经一起冲向最近的空闲游戏站，开始设置《英勇召唤8》。你赶到以后，塔拉瑞尔催你快点，还把一副全息吊带塞进你怀里。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the three of you arrive at the arcade, Fisianna and Tarariel are both already rushing over to the nearest open gaming station and setting up a game of CoV 8. Tarariel hurries you over to them and thrusts a holo-harness into your arms when you arrive."

rows.original: “We’re playing adversary mode of course. Free-for-all and first to ten kills wins, so don’t you two even THINK of teamin’ up on me, even though you’ll probably need it against me!” Tarariel boasts.
rows.translation: “当然要玩对抗模式。自由混战，谁先拿到十次击杀谁就赢，所以你们两个连想都别想组队对付我，尽管你们面对我时大概确实需要联手！”塔拉瑞尔吹嘘道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re playing adversary mode of course. Free-for-all and first to ten kills wins, so don’t you two even THINK of teamin’ up on me, even though you’ll probably need it against me!” Tarariel boasts."

rows.original: Fisianna rolls her eyes before she puts on her holo-harness. “Please, Tara... we can both probably beat you one-on-one.”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜翻了个白眼，随后穿上全息吊带。“拜托，塔拉...我们两个大概都能单独打赢你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna rolls her eyes before she puts on her holo-harness. “Please, Tara... we can both probably beat you one-on-one.”"

rows.original: “We’ll soon see then.” Tarariel scoffs, putting on her own holo-harness.
rows.translation: “那我们很快就会知道了。”塔拉瑞尔嗤之以鼻，也穿上自己的全息吊带。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’ll soon see then.” Tarariel scoffs, putting on her own holo-harness."

rows.original: You strap your holo-harness on shortly after and jump into the thick of it straight away. The game seems to stretch on for a while. The three of you are neck and neck in your kill/death spreads and not giving an inch to each other. You take turns playing cautiously and aggressively as the three of you traverse the war-torn city to find and kill each other.
rows.translation: 你很快也穿好全息吊带，直接投入激战。游戏似乎持续了很久。你们三人的击杀死亡比不相上下，谁都不肯退让半步。你们轮流采取谨慎和激进的打法，穿行于战火摧残的城市，寻找并击杀彼此。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou strap your holo-harness on shortly after and jump into the thick of it straight away. The game seems to stretch on for a while. The three of you are neck and neck in your kill/death spreads and not giving an inch to each other. You take turns playing cautiously and aggressively as the three of you traverse the war-torn city to find and kill each other."

rows.original: After about an hour of time has passed, the three of you are each at nine kills; one more kill away from the game winning kill. You are all playing with extreme caution, checking each corner and investigating each foreign sound. It is tense. You decide to take the high ground in this situation and climb to the top of a dilapidated four story building to overlook the street.
rows.translation: 大约一小时过去，你们三人都拿到了九次击杀，只差最后一次就能赢得游戏。所有人都谨慎至极，检查每个转角，调查每道陌生声响。气氛十分紧张。你决定抢占高地，爬上一座破败四层建筑的楼顶，俯瞰街道。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter about an hour of time has passed, the three of you are each at nine kills; one more kill away from the game winning kill. You are all playing with extreme caution, checking each corner and investigating each foreign sound. It is tense. You decide to take the high ground in this situation and climb to the top of a dilapidated four story building to overlook the street. "

rows.original: After about five minutes of inaction, you’re about to move to change positions when you spot Fisianna’s avatar turning the corner into your line of sight. You adjust your rifle scope and align your sights to square up with Fisianna’s head. You’re about to take the game-winning shot when you notice movement behind her. Out of the corner of your scope you see Tarariel’s avatar sneaking up on Fisianna while toting an SMG. Seeing this you are momentarily distracted with thoughts of who you would rather score the game winning kill on. You see Tarariel’s face turn into a twisted grin while she starts to charge towards the unaware neko. Fisianna simultaneously notices the light reflection off of your rifle scope and raises her weapon to try to take you down before you can down her. You have to act FAST. Without thinking about it, you quickly aim your sight off of Fisianna and focus on Tarariel. You only have mere seconds to take the shot, though you are not properly aimed yet. Fisianna and Tarariel both simultaneously start opening fire at their intended targets. It is now or never. You fire your rifle and manage to strike home, hitting Tarariel’s neck. Her still firing SMG goes flying out of her hands. Fanfare goes off telling you that you won the game as the holo-harness shuts off.
rows.translation: 大约五分钟毫无动静。你正准备移动并更换位置，却看见菲西安娜的角色拐进你的视野。你调整步枪瞄准镜，让准星对准菲西安娜的脑袋。就在准备开出制胜一枪时，你注意到她身后有东西在动。瞄准镜边缘里，塔拉瑞尔的角色正端着冲锋枪，偷偷接近菲西安娜。看见这一幕，你一时分心，开始思考自己更愿意从谁身上拿到制胜击杀。你看见塔拉瑞尔脸上扭出狞笑，开始冲向毫无察觉的猫女。与此同时，菲西安娜注意到步枪瞄准镜反射的光芒，举起武器，试图在你击倒她以前先解决你。你必须立刻行动。你不假思索地飞快把准星从菲西安娜身上移开，瞄向塔拉瑞尔。你只有短短几秒可以开枪，然而准星还没完全对好。菲西安娜和塔拉瑞尔同时朝各自目标开火。成败在此一举。你扣动扳机，成功命中塔拉瑞尔的脖颈。她手中仍在射击的冲锋枪飞了出去。胜利号角响起，宣布你赢得游戏，全息吊带也随之关闭。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter about five minutes of inaction, you’re about to move to change positions when you spot Fisianna’s avatar turning the corner into your line of sight. You adjust your rifle scope and align your sights to square up with Fisianna’s head. You’re about to take the game-winning shot when you notice movement behind her. Out of the corner of your scope you see Tarariel’s avatar sneaking up on Fisianna while toting an SMG. Seeing this you are momentarily distracted with thoughts of who you would rather score the game winning kill on. You see Tarariel’s face turn into a twisted grin while she starts to charge towards the unaware neko. Fisianna simultaneously notices the light reflection off of your rifle scope and raises her weapon to try to take you down before you can down her. You have to act FAST. Without thinking about it, you quickly aim your sight off of Fisianna and focus on Tarariel. You only have mere seconds to take the shot, though you are not properly aimed yet. Fisianna and Tarariel both simultaneously start opening fire at their intended targets. It is now or never. You fire your rifle and manage to strike home, hitting Tarariel’s neck. Her still firing SMG goes flying out of her hands. Fanfare goes off telling you that you won the game as the holo-harness shuts off."

rows.original: When you take the holo-harness off of your head, you see that both Fisianna and Tarariel have their faces etched with rage.
rows.translation: 你从头上摘下全息吊带时，看见菲西安娜和塔拉瑞尔脸上都刻满怒火。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you take the holo-harness off of your head, you see that both Fisianna and Tarariel have their faces etched with rage."

rows.original: “What the fuck, Steele?! I had Fisi RIGHT where I wanted her, and you just HAD to pot-shot me! Damn it! I SO had that game won! I almost got my revenge!” Tarariel stamps a foot down and sulks.
rows.translation: “搞什么鬼，斯蒂尔？！我已经把菲西逼到正合适的位置，你却非得远远打我一枪！该死！那局我明明赢定了！我差点就成功复仇！”塔拉瑞尔跺脚生闷气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What the fuck, Steele?! I had Fisi RIGHT where I wanted her, and you just HAD to pot-shot me! Damn it! I SO had that game won! I almost got my revenge!” Tarariel stamps a foot down and sulks."

rows.original: “What are you talking about, Tara? I was moments away from getting [pc.name]! You trying to shoot me in the back made me ruin my shots!” Fisianna retorts.
rows.translation: “你在说什么，塔拉？我马上就要击中[pc.name]了！你想从背后射我，害得我的射击全打偏了！”菲西安娜反驳道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What are you talking about, Tara? I was moments away from getting [pc.name]! You trying to shoot me in the back made me ruin my shots!” Fisianna retorts."

rows.original: The two of them continue arguing for about five minutes before eventually settling down. Tarariel walks over to you and shakes your hand. “Hey, it was a good game and a fun time, but next time, both of your asses are mine!”
rows.translation: 两人又争吵了大约五分钟，最后才平静下来。塔拉瑞尔走到你面前，与你握手。“嘿，这局打得不错，也玩得很开心；不过下次，你们两个的屁股都归我！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of them continue arguing for about five minutes before eventually settling down. Tarariel walks over to you and shakes your hand. “Hey, it was a good game and a fun time, but next time, both of your asses are mine!”"

rows.original: “Looking forward to it.” You tell Tarariel as you squeeze her hand during the handshake. Afterwards Tarariel says her goodbyes to you and Fisianna before she leaves the arcade.
rows.translation: “我很期待。”你在握手时捏了捏塔拉瑞尔的手。之后，塔拉瑞尔向你和菲西安娜告别，离开街机厅。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Looking forward to it.” You tell Tarariel as you squeeze her hand during the handshake. Afterwards Tarariel says her goodbyes to you and Fisianna before she leaves the arcade. "

rows.original: Fisianna comes up to you and hugs you while giving you a kiss.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜走到你身边，抱住你并亲了一口。
rows.raw: "Fisianna comes up to you and hugs you while giving you a kiss."

rows.original: Fisianna comes up to you and quickly hugs your arm.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜走到你身边，飞快抱住你的手臂。
rows.raw: "Fisianna comes up to you and quickly hugs your arm."

rows.original: “By the way, thanks for saving me back there, even though you could have shot me. I didn’t want Tarariel lording it over me if she did manage to win. She still hasn’t been able to beat me yet, but that’s the closest she’s come to breaking my win streak over her, so thanks for also saving me from that too!” Fisianna gives you a wide smile and a giggle as she lets go of your arm.
rows.translation: “对了，谢谢你刚才救我，尽管你本可以直接射我。我可不想让塔拉瑞尔赢了以后一直对我耀武扬威。她到现在还没赢过我，不过这是她最接近终结我对她连胜纪录的一次，所以也谢谢你保住了这件事！”菲西安娜松开你的手臂，灿烂地笑着咯咯出声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“By the way, thanks for saving me back there, even though you could have shot me. I didn’t want Tarariel lording it over me if she did manage to win. She still hasn’t been able to beat me yet, but that’s the closest she’s come to breaking my win streak over her, so thanks for also saving me from that too!” Fisianna gives you a wide smile and a giggle as she lets go of your arm."

rows.original: You and Fisianna walk out of the arcade with smiles on both of your faces. It looks like the three of you had fun after all!
rows.translation: 你和菲西安娜带着满脸笑容走出街机厅。看来你们三个最后确实玩得很开心！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou and Fisianna walk out of the arcade with smiles on both of your faces. It looks like the three of you had fun after all!"

rows.original: When you arrive at the arcade, you find Britannia, Fisianna’s dragon-morph friend already standing outside of the entrance talking to an ovir. The dragoness and the ovir exchange what look like pieces of paper with each other before going their separate ways. Britannia notices the two of you shortly afterwards and walks over to greet you both.
rows.translation: 抵达街机厅时，你们发现菲西安娜的龙族变体朋友布里塔妮娅已经站在入口外，正和一名欧维尔交谈。龙女和欧维尔交换了看起来像纸片的东西，随后各自离开。没多久，布里塔妮娅注意到你们，走过来向两人问好。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you arrive at the arcade, you find Britannia, Fisianna’s dragon-morph friend already standing outside of the entrance talking to an ovir. The dragoness and the ovir exchange what look like pieces of paper with each other before going their separate ways. Britannia notices the two of you shortly afterwards and walks over to greet you both."

rows.original: “Hey, Kitten. Steele. Looks like you two are up to something, and judging by the look on the kitten’s face, it looks like you two are about to play some games together.”
rows.translation: “嘿，小猫。斯蒂尔。看来你们两个要去做点什么；看小猫脸上的表情，你们似乎准备一起玩游戏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, Kitten. Steele. Looks like you two are up to something, and judging by the look on the kitten’s face, it looks like you two are about to play some games together.”"

rows.original: You blink in amazement at Britannia’s perceptiveness, but before you can say anything about it, she laughs gently and swings her arms around you and Fisianna. “Hehe. Don’t mind that. If you are about to play some games, would the two of you mind if I joined? So far the gamers I’ve come across aren’t really... competent to be perfectly honest. It would be refreshing to have a bit of a challenge, especially from the two of you.”
rows.translation: 你惊讶于布里塔妮娅敏锐的观察力，不过还没来得及说什么，她便温和地笑起来，双臂同时搂住你和菲西安娜。“呵呵，别在意。要是你们真的准备玩游戏，介不介意让我也加入？老实说，目前遇到的玩家都不怎么...称职。能遇到一点挑战会很令人耳目一新，尤其是来自你们两个的挑战。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink in amazement at Britannia’s perceptiveness, but before you can say anything about it, she laughs gently and swings her arms around you and Fisianna. “Hehe. Don’t mind that. If you are about to play some games, would the two of you mind if I joined? So far the gamers I’ve come across aren’t really... competent to be perfectly honest. It would be refreshing to have a bit of a challenge, especially from the two of you.”"

rows.original: You turn your head towards Fisianna, who looks nervous. “S-sure, but knowing you, I’d probably get creamed again... How about we just play something where we can work together?”
rows.translation: 你转头看向显得很紧张的菲西安娜。“好，好啊，不过照你的水平，我大概又会被打得落花流水...不如我们玩点能够合作的游戏？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn your head towards Fisianna, who looks nervous. “S-sure, but knowing you, I’d probably get creamed again... How about we just play something where we can work together?”"

rows.original: “Mmm, sure. I can do that too. How about you, Steele?” Britannia asks.
rows.translation: “嗯，可以。我也能合作。那么你呢，斯蒂尔？”布里塔妮娅问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm, sure. I can do that too. How about you, Steele?” Britannia asks."

rows.original: You tell Britannia that you don’t have a problem with that idea and ask for any suggestions on what game you all should play together. Fisianna is the first to speak up.
rows.translation: 你告诉布里塔妮娅，自己不反对这个主意，又问大家一起玩什么游戏比较好。菲西安娜第一个开口。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Britannia that you don’t have a problem with that idea and ask for any suggestions on what game you all should play together. Fisianna is the first to speak up."

rows.original: “O-oh! I know of something that could be fun for the three of us! I’ve been following it for a while, it’s called Castle Mania. It’s a virtual reality game mostly based off of ancient terran mythology. Basically you can fight as warriors, mages, and archers that use holy artifacts to combat waves of demons and to fight the evil vampire terrorising the town. I-I know it sounds kinda cliche but game reviewers gave it good scores. I’d like to try it!”
rows.translation: “哦，哦！我知道一个可能很适合我们三个的游戏！我关注它有一阵子了，名字叫《城堡狂热》。这是一款虚拟现实游戏，主要以古代地球神话为基础。基本上，你可以扮演战士、法师和弓箭手，使用神圣神器对抗一波波恶魔，并与恐吓城镇的邪恶吸血鬼战斗。我，我知道这听起来有点老套，不过游戏评测给了它很高分。我想试试！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh! I know of something that could be fun for the three of us! I’ve been following it for a while, it’s called Castle Mania. It’s a virtual reality game mostly based off of ancient terran mythology. Basically you can fight as warriors, mages, and archers that use holy artifacts to combat waves of demons and to fight the evil vampire terrorising the town. I-I know it sounds kinda cliche but game reviewers gave it good scores. I’d like to try it!”"

rows.original: “Sounds fun. Let’s get to it then!” Britannia exclaims as she lets the two of you go and struts into the arcade.
rows.translation: “听起来很有趣。那就开始吧！”布里塔妮娅大声说道，松开你们两个，昂首走进街机厅。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds fun. Let’s get to it then!” Britannia exclaims as she lets the two of you go and struts into the arcade."

rows.original: You and Fisianna follow Britannia to the nearest open gaming station and set up Castle Mania to play on your holo-harnesses. You all pick your classes; Fisianna picking the holy mage, Britannia picking the holy archer, and you picking the holy warrior. The three of you are thrown into the action as soon as you put on your holo-harnesses.
rows.translation: 你和菲西安娜跟着布里塔妮娅来到最近的空闲游戏站，在全息吊带上设置《城堡狂热》。你们各自选择职业：菲西安娜选择神圣法师，布里塔妮娅选择神圣弓箭手，而你选择神圣战士。三人刚戴上全息吊带，就被直接投入行动。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou and Fisianna follow Britannia to the nearest open gaming station and set up Castle Mania to play on your holo-harnesses. You all pick your classes; Fisianna picking the holy mage, Britannia picking the holy archer, and you picking the holy warrior. The three of you are thrown into the action as soon as you put on your holo-harnesses."

rows.original: Arriving at a castle graveyard with Fisianna and Britannia, you find that you are girded with rather heavy looking armor, and equipped with a faintly glowing mace on a chain as a weapon; definitely a lot more primitive than you are used to. You also have a rather gaudy metal shield that glows as brightly as your weapon.
rows.translation: 你和菲西安娜、布里塔妮娅来到一片城堡墓园，发现自己穿着看起来相当沉重的铠甲，武器则是一柄泛着微光的链锤；这显然比你习惯的装备原始得多。你还拿着一面颇为花哨的金属盾牌，光芒与武器一样明亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nArriving at a castle graveyard with Fisianna and Britannia, you find that you are girded with rather heavy looking armor, and equipped with a faintly glowing mace on a chain as a weapon; definitely a lot more primitive than you are used to. You also have a rather gaudy metal shield that glows as brightly as your weapon. "

rows.original: You turn towards your two companions and see that Britannia has on tight but mobile leather clothing with various pieces of cloth flowing from whatever isn’t covering her body with leather. She has two glowing daggers ready at her hips. The dragoness is already taking test shots against grave headstones with her enchanted bow.
rows.translation: 你转向两位同伴，看见布里塔妮娅穿着紧身而便于行动的皮衣，身体没有被皮革包裹的部位垂下各式布料。她腰间已经备好两把发光匕首。龙女正用附魔弓箭朝墓碑试射。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn towards your two companions and see that Britannia has on tight but mobile leather clothing with various pieces of cloth flowing from whatever isn’t covering her body with leather. She has two glowing daggers ready at her hips. The dragoness is already taking test shots against grave headstones with her enchanted bow. "

rows.original: Fisianna has on very loose robes that make you wonder how she doesn’t trip over the hems constantly. She has a holy tome that floats nearby of its own volition. It glows brightly with magical energy as she channels a spell through it to illuminate the immediate area.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜穿着非常宽松的长袍，让你怀疑她怎么没有一直踩到下摆。一本神圣典籍凭自身意志飘浮在附近。她通过书本引导法术，照亮周围区域时，典籍迸发出明亮魔法光芒。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna has on very loose robes that make you wonder how she doesn’t trip over the hems constantly. She has a holy tome that floats nearby of its own volition. It glows brightly with magical energy as she channels a spell through it to illuminate the immediate area."

rows.original: The three of you take a few minutes to grow used to your weapons and roles before you decide to continue. When you make your way to the castle gateway, the door opens by itself with a loud creak to reveal a dark foyer. You lead the way inside with Fisianna and Britannia warily keeping watch for any dangers. The door behind the three of you suddenly shuts itself with a loud “BANG.” The foyer candlelights suddenly burst aflame, revealing a horde of zombies and ghouls that flood out of every crack and corner that you can see. You lead the charge as the three of you battle your way through the army of minions, bashing, shooting and zapping anything that impedes your progress. Your group trudges through several dungeons while you climb the castle heights, fighting many different, scary enemies. The teamwork the three of you display is phenomenal as none of you ever come to immediate danger at all, though things grow tougher as you reach the top.
rows.translation: 你们花了几分钟熟悉各自的武器和职责，随后决定继续前进。来到城堡大门时，门伴着刺耳嘎吱声自行打开，露出黑暗前厅。你率先走进去，菲西安娜和布里塔妮娅则警惕地注意危险。身后的门突然伴着响亮的“砰！”自行关闭。前厅烛灯骤然燃起，照出从每道裂缝和角落涌出的成群僵尸与食尸鬼。你率先冲锋，三人一路杀过仆从大军，砸击、射击并电击一切阻挡道路的敌人。你们穿过好几座地牢，向城堡高处攀登，与许多不同而恐怖的敌人战斗。三人展现的团队配合非常出色，没有任何人真正陷入迫切危险，不过随着接近顶层，局势也越来越艰难。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe three of you take a few minutes to grow used to your weapons and roles before you decide to continue. When you make your way to the castle gateway, the door opens by itself with a loud creak to reveal a dark foyer. You lead the way inside with Fisianna and Britannia warily keeping watch for any dangers. The door behind the three of you suddenly shuts itself with a loud “BANG.” The foyer candlelights suddenly burst aflame, revealing a horde of zombies and ghouls that flood out of every crack and corner that you can see. You lead the charge as the three of you battle your way through the army of minions, bashing, shooting and zapping anything that impedes your progress. Your group trudges through several dungeons while you climb the castle heights, fighting many different, scary enemies. The teamwork the three of you display is phenomenal as none of you ever come to immediate danger at all, though things grow tougher as you reach the top."

rows.original: After defeating a particularly troublesome demonic chimera, the three of you walk into a very ominous hallway lined with candles that seems to stretch forever. Fisianna gulps nervously as you make your way through the hallway with no more opposition springing forward to meet you. When you reach the antechamber at the other side of the long hallway, you come across a giant wooden door that is absolutely splattered with blood. You nod at Fisianna and Britannia, indicating you are ready to proceed to what looks like your final challenge. When they nod back at you, you proceed to open the oaken doors. Their hinges produce a deafeningly loud groaning noise from their long period of disuse. Well... it looks like you won’t be surprising whatever is on the other side.
rows.translation: 击败一头尤其难缠的恶魔奇美拉以后，你们走进一条不祥至极、两侧排满蜡烛，仿佛永远没有尽头的走廊。一路穿过长廊，再没有任何敌人跳出来迎战，菲西安娜紧张地咽了口唾沫。抵达另一端的前厅时，你们看见一扇溅满鲜血的巨大木门。你朝菲西安娜和布里塔妮娅点头，表示已经准备好迎接看起来像是最终考验的挑战。她们也点头回应，你便开始推开橡木门。铰链因长久未被使用而发出震耳欲聋的呻吟。好吧...看来门后面的东西绝不会被你们打个措手不及。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter defeating a particularly troublesome demonic chimera, the three of you walk into a very ominous hallway lined with candles that seems to stretch forever. Fisianna gulps nervously as you make your way through the hallway with no more opposition springing forward to meet you. When you reach the antechamber at the other side of the long hallway, you come across a giant wooden door that is absolutely splattered with blood. You nod at Fisianna and Britannia, indicating you are ready to proceed to what looks like your final challenge. When they nod back at you, you proceed to open the oaken doors. Their hinges produce a deafeningly loud groaning noise from their long period of disuse. Well... it looks like you won’t be surprising whatever is on the other side."

rows.original: The three of you step inside the throne room of the castle, where you are greeted by a handsome, but menacing, looking vampire. The door behind you slams shut as the vampire straightens up in his throne, swirling a wine glass filled with blood in his hand.
rows.translation: 你们三人踏进城堡王座厅，一名相貌英俊却气势险恶的吸血鬼迎接了你们。身后的门砰然关闭，吸血鬼在王座上挺直身体，手里摇晃着一杯装满鲜血的酒。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe three of you step inside the throne room of the castle, where you are greeted by a handsome, but menacing, looking vampire. The door behind you slams shut as the vampire straightens up in his throne, swirling a wine glass filled with blood in his hand."

rows.original: You step forward to the vampire. “Die, monster! You don’t belong in this world!”
rows.translation: 你向吸血鬼迈进一步。“去死吧，怪物！这个世界不属于你！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou step forward to the vampire. “Die, monster! You don’t belong in this world!”"

rows.original: “It was not by my hand that I’m once again given flesh. I was called here by humans who wish to pay me tribute.” The vampire retorts.
rows.translation: “我并非凭自身之手再度获得肉身。是那些希望向我献上贡品的人类召唤了我。”吸血鬼反驳道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was not by my hand that I’m once again given flesh. I was called here by humans who wish to pay me tribute.” The vampire retorts."

rows.original: “Tribute?! You steal men’s souls and make them your slaves!” You counter.
rows.translation: “贡品？！你窃取人类灵魂，把他们变成奴隶！”你回击道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tribute?! You steal men’s souls and make them your slaves!” You counter."

rows.original: “Perhaps the same could be said of all religions.” The vampire idly swirls the blood in his wine glass.
rows.translation: “也许所有宗教都可以这么说。”吸血鬼懒洋洋地摇晃酒杯里的鲜血。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perhaps the same could be said of all religions.” The vampire idly swirls the blood in his wine glass."

rows.original: “Your words are as empty as your soul! Mankind ill needs a savior such as you!” You raise your chained mace threateningly at the vampire.
rows.translation: “你的言语和灵魂一样空洞！人类根本不需要你这样的救世主！”你威胁般向吸血鬼举起链锤。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your words are as empty as your soul! Mankind ill needs a savior such as you!” You raise your chained mace threateningly at the vampire."

rows.original: “What is a man?” The vampire flings his wine glass aside. “A miserable little pile of secrets! But enough talk! Have at you!”
rows.translation: “人是什么？”吸血鬼把酒杯甩到一旁。“不过是一小堆可悲的秘密！废话说够了！来战吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What is a man?” The vampire flings his wine glass aside. “A miserable little pile of secrets! But enough talk! Have at you!”"

rows.original: The three of you raise your weapons toward the vampire, after which he rises from his throne and starts to unleash a plethora of spectral beings and unholy magics at you. You raise your shield to brace yourself against the coming miasma. Fisianna quickly channels a spell that enchants your shield to be able to protect the three of you in a wider area as long as you hold it up. From behind the enhanced shield, Britannia starts to release a volley of holy arrows at the vampire, which steadily, but surely, whittles it down.
rows.translation: 你们三人向吸血鬼举起武器，随后他从王座上站起，朝你们释放大量幽灵和邪恶魔法。你举盾抵御迎面而来的瘴气。菲西安娜迅速引导法术，为盾牌附魔；只要你一直举着它，就能在更大范围内保护三个人。布里塔妮娅从强化盾牌后朝吸血鬼射出一轮神圣箭雨，稳定而确实地削弱对方。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe three of you raise your weapons toward the vampire, after which he rises from his throne and starts to unleash a plethora of spectral beings and unholy magics at you. You raise your shield to brace yourself against the coming miasma. Fisianna quickly channels a spell that enchants your shield to be able to protect the three of you in a wider area as long as you hold it up. From behind the enhanced shield, Britannia starts to release a volley of holy arrows at the vampire, which steadily, but surely, whittles it down. "

rows.original: When the vampire becomes weak enough, it transforms into a shapeless aberration and launches even deadlier waves of attacks than before. The three of you hold strong while Fisianna magically heals any wounds you or Britannia sustain. The dragoness is still letting loose a steady stream of arrows while gracefully dodging any attacks that manage to slip past your shield. You do your job to protect Fisianna and Britannia as best as you can, beating back any attack that nears them.
rows.translation: 吸血鬼衰弱到一定程度后，便变成无形畸怪，发动比之前更加致命的攻击浪潮。你们三人顽强坚守，菲西安娜用魔法治愈你和布里塔妮娅受到的一切伤势。龙女继续稳定射出箭矢，同时优雅闪避任何越过盾牌的攻击。你尽最大努力保护菲西安娜和布里塔妮娅，击退所有靠近她们的攻势。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the vampire becomes weak enough, it transforms into a shapeless aberration and launches even deadlier waves of attacks than before. The three of you hold strong while Fisianna magically heals any wounds you or Britannia sustain. The dragoness is still letting loose a steady stream of arrows while gracefully dodging any attacks that manage to slip past your shield. You do your job to protect Fisianna and Britannia as best as you can, beating back any attack that nears them. "

rows.original: The demon falters after a long fought battle and the three of you move in to deliver the final blow. You raise your mace and crush it down on the aberration’s weakest spot just as Fisianna sends down a holy ray and Britannia looses a piercing arrow. The aberration writhes in defeat after each strike hits home and lies still. The three of you quickly exit the chamber while the castle starts to collapse. You dodge and weave past the falling debris as the three of you run to the entrance. Once outside you breathe a sigh of relief when the display fades to black.
rows.translation: 经过漫长战斗，恶魔终于踉跄失稳，三人上前发动最后一击。你举起链锤，砸中畸怪最脆弱的部位；与此同时，菲西安娜降下一道神圣光束，布里塔妮娅则射出一支贯穿箭。每次攻击都准确命中，畸怪在败亡中扭动，最终静止不动。城堡开始坍塌，你们迅速离开房间。三人朝入口奔跑，一路闪转腾挪，躲过坠落残骸。来到外面以后，画面淡为黑色，你才松了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe demon falters after a long fought battle and the three of you move in to deliver the final blow. You raise your mace and crush it down on the aberration’s weakest spot just as Fisianna sends down a holy ray and Britannia looses a piercing arrow. The aberration writhes in defeat after each strike hits home and lies still. The three of you quickly exit the chamber while the castle starts to collapse. You dodge and weave past the falling debris as the three of you run to the entrance. Once outside you breathe a sigh of relief when the display fades to black."

rows.original: Back to the real world at last, you take off your holo-harness to check on Fisianna and Britannia. They both look windswept as they take their harnesses off, but are both wearing incredibly large smiles.
rows.translation: 终于回到现实世界。你摘下全息吊带，查看菲西安娜和布里塔妮娅的情况。两人摘下吊带时都显得头发凌乱，却也露出无比灿烂的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nBack to the real world at last, you take off your holo-harness to check on Fisianna and Britannia. They both look windswept as they take their harnesses off, but are both wearing incredibly large smiles."

rows.original: “...That was-” Britannia starts, but is interrupted by Fisianna.
rows.translation: “...刚才真是，”布里塔妮娅刚开口，就被菲西安娜打断。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...That was-” Britannia starts, but is interrupted by Fisianna."

rows.original: “Awesome! We definitely need to play that again real soon!” Fisianna pumps her paws in the air excitedly while her tails flick about rapidly behind her.
rows.translation: “太棒了！我们绝对得赶快再玩一次！”菲西安娜兴奋地把两只爪子举到空中，身后的尾巴也飞快甩动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awesome! We definitely need to play that again real soon!” Fisianna pumps her paws in the air excitedly while her tails flick about rapidly behind her."

rows.original: “I’ll say. I wasn’t expecting that game to be such a treat. And you, Steele. You weren’t bad at all.” Britannia smiles warmly at you and slaps a scaled hand on your shoulder.
rows.translation: “确实。我没想到那款游戏会这么有趣。还有你，斯蒂尔，你玩得也一点都不差。”布里塔妮娅温暖地朝你微笑，把覆满鳞片的手拍在你肩上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll say. I wasn’t expecting that game to be such a treat. And you, Steele. You weren’t bad at all.” Britannia smiles warmly at you and slaps a scaled hand on your shoulder."

rows.original: You thank the dragoness for the compliment, the game, and the company. After buying a few snacks to re-energize yourselves, Britannia decides to go on her separate way, leaving you and Fisianna alone.
rows.translation: 你感谢龙女的称赞，也感谢这场游戏和她的陪伴。买了几份零食补充精力后，布里塔妮娅决定独自离开，留下你和菲西安娜。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thank the dragoness for the compliment, the game, and the company. After buying a few snacks to re-energize yourselves, Britannia decides to go on her separate way, leaving you and Fisianna alone."

rows.original: You turn to Fisianna and ask: “If you know of any other games like that, please let me know. That game is intense!”
rows.translation: 你转向菲西安娜问道：“如果你还知道其他类似游戏，请一定告诉我。这款游戏太刺激了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn to Fisianna and ask: “If you know of any other games like that, please let me know. That game is intense!”"

rows.original: Fisianna giggles. “Sure! I’ll keep a lookout to see what’s hot and tell you about it when I see something good.”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜咯咯一笑。“当然！我会留意当下热门的游戏，看见好东西就告诉你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna giggles. “Sure! I’ll keep a lookout to see what’s hot and tell you about it when I see something good.”"

rows.original: After reminiscing about a few key moments you shared in the Castle Mania game together, you both decide to head out of the arcade and go your separate ways after your goodbyes.
rows.translation: 你们一起回忆了《城堡狂热》里的几个重要时刻，随后都决定离开街机厅；互相告别后，各自离去。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter reminiscing about a few key moments you shared in the Castle Mania game together, you both decide to head out of the arcade and go your separate ways after your goodbyes."

rows.original: ERROR WITH RANDOM VALUE :(
rows.raw: "ERROR WITH RANDOM VALUE :("

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Arcade
rows.translation: 街机厅
rows.raw: "Arcade"

rows.original: Take a trip to the arcade with her.
rows.translation: 和她一起去街机厅。
rows.raw: "Take a trip to the arcade with her."

rows.original: Shopping
rows.translation: 购物
rows.raw: "Shopping"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: MERCHANT'S THOROUGHFARE2
rows.raw: "MERCHANT'S THOROUGHFARE2"

rows.original: You ask Fisianna if she would be up for exploring some shops in the less seedy areas of the Merchant Deck.
rows.translation: 你问菲西安娜愿不愿意一起探索商业层里那些没那么乌烟瘴气的商店。
rows.raw: "You ask Fisianna if she would be up for exploring some shops in the less seedy areas of the Merchant Deck."

rows.original: “Sure, I-I don’t mind doing a bit of shopping with you. Shall we?” Fisianna happily smiles as she rises up from the park bench. You stand up and follow Fisianna to the elevator shafts.
rows.translation: “当然，我，我不介意和你一起逛逛。走吧？”菲西安娜开心地笑着从公园长椅起身。你站起来，跟她走向升降梯。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, I-I don’t mind doing a bit of shopping with you. Shall we?” Fisianna happily smiles as she rises up from the park bench. You stand up and follow Fisianna to the elevator shafts."

rows.original: When your elevator arrives at the Merchant Deck, you and Fisianna walk down the crowded corridors wondering where to go first.
rows.translation: 电梯抵达商业层后，你和菲西安娜走在拥挤走廊里，思考该先去哪里。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen your elevator arrives at the Merchant Deck, you and Fisianna walk down the crowded corridors wondering where to go first."

rows.original: “So what did you have in mind, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: “所以你有什么打算，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what did you have in mind, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: After a brief moment of thought, you suggest that the two of you can do a bit of browsing for clothes.
rows.translation: 短暂思考后，你提议两个人可以去看看衣服。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a brief moment of thought, you suggest that the two of you can do a bit of browsing for clothes."

rows.original: “Sure! I’ve always been a bit curious about what other races like to wear. M-maybe I can find something new for myself to wear at home.” Fisianna giggles as she scans the storefronts for a good starting point for your clothes shopping spree, ears perked and golden eyes on the move. Eventually she spots a store with a garish frontal display that advertises a myriad of both cool and strange-looking clothes. “How about there, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: “好啊！我一直有点好奇其他种族喜欢穿什么。也，也许我能找到一些新衣服，买回家穿。”菲西安娜咯咯笑着扫视沿街店面，寻找适合作为服装购物之旅起点的地方。她的耳朵竖起，金色双眼不断转动。最后，她发现一家门面布置艳俗的商店，展示着无数既酷炫又外形古怪的服装。“那里怎么样，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure! I’ve always been a bit curious about what other races like to wear. M-maybe I can find something new for myself to wear at home.” Fisianna giggles as she scans the storefronts for a good starting point for your clothes shopping spree, ears perked and golden eyes on the move. Eventually she spots a store with a garish frontal display that advertises a myriad of both cool and strange-looking clothes. “How about there, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: You admit that you yourself are pretty curious about what could be inside if all of these unusual clothes are being displayed outside. You agree with Fisianna to start looking in this shop first before squeezing through the crowded entrance to the store.
rows.translation: 你承认，看见这些不同寻常的衣服全都摆在外面，自己也很好奇里面会有什么。你同意先和菲西安娜逛这家店，然后从拥挤的入口挤进去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou admit that you yourself are pretty curious about what could be inside if all of these unusual clothes are being displayed outside. You agree with Fisianna to start looking in this shop first before squeezing through the crowded entrance to the store."

rows.original: Once inside, you find that the store is almost as congested as the corridor was. There are a multitude of aliens and morphs alike doing their clothes shopping. The clothes themselves are aligned in an almost endless number of rows with glitzy sales tags dotting the aisles. When a rather flamboyant outfit catches your eye, you muse to yourself that it looks the type of apparel only a self-obsessed star would wear. At that moment, you hear a familiar voice behind you calling yours and Fisianna’s name. You turn around and see that Aya is making her way down the crowded aisle towards the two of you.
rows.translation: 进入店里后，你发现这里几乎和走廊一样拥挤。各种外星人和变体都在选购衣物。衣服排列成几乎无穷无尽的货架，过道间点缀着华丽促销标签。一套相当浮夸的服装吸引了你的目光，你暗自想着，那看起来像是只有自恋明星才会穿的款式。就在这时，身后传来一个熟悉声音，呼唤你和菲西安娜的名字。你转过身，看见阿雅正沿拥挤过道朝你们走来。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce inside, you find that the store is almost as congested as the corridor was. There are a multitude of aliens and morphs alike doing their clothes shopping. The clothes themselves are aligned in an almost endless number of rows with glitzy sales tags dotting the aisles. When a rather flamboyant outfit catches your eye, you muse to yourself that it looks the type of apparel only a self-obsessed star would wear. At that moment, you hear a familiar voice behind you calling yours and Fisianna’s name. You turn around and see that Aya is making her way down the crowded aisle towards the two of you."

rows.original: “Hey Fisianna! [pc.name]! Didn’t think I’d meet the two of you here! It’s crowded as all heck in here... It’s hard to get any room to stretch the wings, y’know? What’cha two up to in here anyways?” Aya asks while trying to make herself small enough to let a burly thraggen squeeze past her.
rows.translation: “嘿，菲西安娜！[pc.name]！没想到会在这里遇到你们两个！这里挤得要命...连展开翅膀的空间都很难找到，你懂吧？不过你们两个来这里干什么？”阿雅问道，同时努力缩起身体，好让一个壮硕的斯拉根从旁边挤过去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey Fisianna! [pc.name]! Didn’t think I’d meet the two of you here! It’s crowded as all heck in here... It’s hard to get any room to stretch the wings, y’know? What’cha two up to in here anyways?” Aya asks while trying to make herself small enough to let a burly thraggen squeeze past her."

rows.original: “[pc.name] and I just wanted to do some browsing for clothes... Although... I-I could do without the crowd. It’s kind of making me uneasy to be honest.” Fisianna states nervously.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]和我只是想看看衣服...不过...我，我实在不喜欢这么多人。老实说，这让我有点不安。”菲西安娜紧张地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] and I just wanted to do some browsing for clothes... Although... I-I could do without the crowd. It’s kind of making me uneasy to be honest.” Fisianna states nervously."

rows.original: “Yeah... it’s way too crowded to do anything really meaningful here. Let’s try to go towards the back of the store; should be less crowded there.” Aya suggests.
rows.translation: “是啊...这里太挤了，根本没法认真逛。咱们去商店后面吧，那里人应该少一些。”阿雅提议。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah... it’s way too crowded to do anything really meaningful here. Let’s try to go towards the back of the store; should be less crowded there.” Aya suggests."

rows.original: You and Fisianna agree to the idea and make your way to the rear of the shop, where there are fewer people crowding the aisles. As the three of you walk down the row of outfits, the selection of clothing seems to grow skimpier the further you go. You can see that Fisianna notices this as she starts to visibly blush. Aya abruptly stops you, squealing excitedly while she reaches towards a rack of panties and pulls out a pair of white lacy cat patterned underwear.
rows.translation: 你和菲西安娜同意这个主意，一起走向商店后方，那里挤在过道里的人确实更少。你们三人沿一排服装前行，越往里面，衣服款式似乎越暴露。菲西安娜显然也注意到了，脸颊开始泛红。阿雅突然叫住你们，兴奋地尖叫着伸向一排内裤，抽出一条白色蕾丝猫咪图案内衣。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou and Fisianna agree to the idea and make your way to the rear of the shop, where there are fewer people crowding the aisles. As the three of you walk down the row of outfits, the selection of clothing seems to grow skimpier the further you go. You can see that Fisianna notices this as she starts to visibly blush. Aya abruptly stops you, squealing excitedly while she reaches towards a rack of panties and pulls out a pair of white lacy cat patterned underwear."

rows.original: “Ah! Fisi, these would be perfect for you! How about you get these ones? They’re not very expensive either!” Aya offers the panties to Fisianna. The catgirl turns a deep shade of pink while she shakes her head and waves her paws in front of her.
rows.translation: “啊！菲西，这件最适合你了！要不要买它？也不是很贵！”阿雅把内裤递给菲西安娜。猫娘一边摇头，一边在身前挥舞爪子，脸颊变成深粉色。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah! Fisi, these would be perfect for you! How about you get these ones? They’re not very expensive either!” Aya offers the panties to Fisianna. The catgirl turns a deep shade of pink while she shakes her head and waves her paws in front of her."

rows.original: “N-no, thanks. They look really cute, b-but I already have some like it and-” Fisianna cuts herself off as she comes to a realization over what she just said. She gasps and claps her paws over her face, which is a deep red by now. “P-please tell me you didn’t hear that, [pc.name]...”
rows.translation: “不，不用了，谢谢。它看起来真的很可爱，但，但是我已经有类似的，而且，”菲西安娜突然意识到自己刚说了什么，戛然而止。她倒吸一口气，用两只爪子捂住已经通红的脸。“请，请告诉我你没听见，[pc.name]...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“N-no, thanks. They look really cute, b-but I already have some like it and-” Fisianna cuts herself off as she comes to a realization over what she just said. She gasps and claps her paws over her face, which is a deep red by now. “P-please tell me you didn’t hear that, [pc.name]...”"

rows.original: You tell Fisianna a white-lie that you didn’t hear a thing over the crowd of people. Fisianna looks visibly relieved after hearing that as she exhales deeply.
rows.translation: 你善意地撒了个小谎，告诉菲西安娜，人群太吵，自己什么都没听见。听到这话，她明显松了口气，深深呼出一口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Fisianna a white-lie that you didn’t hear a thing over the crowd of people. Fisianna looks visibly relieved after hearing that as she exhales deeply. "

rows.original: You tell Fisianna while doing your best to keep a straight face that you might have heard something, but it wasn’t very clear over the crowd of people. Fisianna looks visibly relieved after hearing that as she exhales deeply.
rows.translation: 你竭力板着脸，告诉菲西安娜自己可能听见了点什么，不过人群太吵，没听清楚。听到这话，她明显松了口气，深深呼出一口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Fisianna while doing your best to keep a straight face that you might have heard something, but it wasn’t very clear over the crowd of people. Fisianna looks visibly relieved after hearing that as she exhales deeply. "

rows.original: You tell Fisianna that you definitely heard her say something about panties, but you couldn’t hear clearly over the crowd of people. Fisianna still looks embarrassed after you tell her this, but relaxes a little once you don’t say anything else about the issue.
rows.translation: 你告诉菲西安娜，自己肯定听见她说了内裤什么的，不过人群太吵，没听清楚。听你这么说，她仍显得很难为情；但你没有继续追问以后，她稍稍放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Fisianna that you definitely heard her say something about panties, but you couldn’t hear clearly over the crowd of people. Fisianna still looks embarrassed after you tell her this, but relaxes a little once you don’t say anything else about the issue."

rows.original: After Aya places the cat print panties back on the rack, she walks further down the aisle before stopping to take out a pair of tight looking mini shorts. “Oooh! Let me go try these on! I might get these!” Aya exclaims giddily while she hurries over to the changing rooms. You and Fisianna browse the unmentionables for a little while longer before Aya comes out of the changing room with a grim look on her face.
rows.translation: 阿雅把猫咪图案内裤放回货架，继续沿过道前行，随后停下来拿出一条看起来很紧的迷你短裤。“哦哦！让我去试试！我可能会买下它！”阿雅兴奋地大叫着冲向更衣室。你和菲西安娜又浏览了一会儿贴身衣物，随后阿雅满脸阴沉地走出更衣室。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter Aya places the cat print panties back on the rack, she walks further down the aisle before stopping to take out a pair of tight looking mini shorts. “Oooh! Let me go try these on! I might get these!” Aya exclaims giddily while she hurries over to the changing rooms. You and Fisianna browse the unmentionables for a little while longer before Aya comes out of the changing room with a grim look on her face."

rows.original: “I... I accidentally ripped the pants. Darned talons got caught on the pant leg. I’ll have to pay for this thing.” Aya says glumly. Sure enough the pants she holds up have a rather large gash in front of one of the legs. If it were touched up a little, it could still look fashionable.
rows.translation: “我...我不小心把裤子撕破了。该死的利爪勾住了裤腿。我得赔这东西。”阿雅沮丧地说道。果然，她举起的裤子其中一条裤腿正面裂开一道相当大的口子。要是稍微修饰一下，或许仍能显得时髦。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... I accidentally ripped the pants. Darned talons got caught on the pant leg. I’ll have to pay for this thing.” Aya says glumly. Sure enough the pants she holds up have a rather large gash in front of one of the legs. If it were touched up a little, it could still look fashionable."

rows.original: “Aw... I’m sorry that had to happen, but I can try to fix them for you if hand them to me?” Fisianna offers.
rows.translation: “啊...真遗憾，不过如果你把它交给我，也许我可以试着帮你修好？”菲西安娜提议。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aw... I’m sorry that had to happen, but I can try to fix them for you if hand them to me?” Fisianna offers."

rows.original: Aya gives a light chuckle, “That’s ok, Fisi. I know you’re a genius at fixing computers, but I’m pretty sure I can get these pants looking good. This happens a bit too often for me... Thank you though!”
rows.translation: 阿雅轻轻一笑，“没事，菲西。我知道你是修电脑的天才，不过我很确定自己能让这条裤子变得好看。这种事在我身上发生得有点太频繁了...不过还是谢谢你！”
rows.raw: "\n\nAya gives a light chuckle, “That’s ok, Fisi. I know you’re a genius at fixing computers, but I’m pretty sure I can get these pants looking good. This happens a bit too often for me... Thank you though!”"

rows.original: The three of you make your way back through the crowded aisle to the checkout counters. It takes a while for it to be your turn to check out, but when the three of you arrive at the register, Aya shows the rip to the cashier and offers to pay for the pants. The cashier disinterestedly throws the garment into a bag and accepts Aya’s
rows.translation: 你们三人沿拥挤过道返回结账柜台。等到轮到你们结账花了不少时间，不过三人来到收银台时，阿雅向收银员展示裂口，并提出赔偿裤子。收银员漠不关心地把衣物扔进袋子，接过阿雅的
rows.raw: "\n\nThe three of you make your way back through the crowded aisle to the checkout counters. It takes a while for it to be your turn to check out, but when the three of you arrive at the register, Aya shows the rip to the cashier and offers to pay for the pants. The cashier disinterestedly throws the garment into a bag and accepts Aya’s "

rows.original: dogecoin
rows.translation: 狗狗币
rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.original: credit chit
rows.translation: 信用点凭条
rows.raw: "credit chit"

rows.original: , bidding you a farewell after the transaction.
rows.translation: ，交易完成后向你们道别。
rows.raw: ", bidding you a farewell after the transaction."

rows.original: When the three of you make it to the entrance of the store, Aya thanks you and Fisianna for the company before she goes home to repair her new pants. Fisianna also says her goodbyes to you when you arrive at the elevator lifts and thanks you for spending your time to shop with her.
rows.translation: 你们三人来到商店入口时，阿雅感谢你和菲西安娜的陪伴，随后回家修补新裤子。来到升降梯后，菲西安娜也向你告别，并感谢你花时间陪她购物。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the three of you make it to the entrance of the store, Aya thanks you and Fisianna for the company before she goes home to repair her new pants. Fisianna also says her goodbyes to you when you arrive at the elevator lifts and thanks you for spending your time to shop with her."

rows.original: After a brief moment of thought, you suggest that the two of you could check out the local food shops and grab a bite to eat.
rows.translation: 短暂思考后，你建议两人可以去当地食品店逛逛，顺便吃点东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a brief moment of thought, you suggest that the two of you could check out the local food shops and grab a bite to eat."

rows.original: “Sure, [pc.name]. To be honest, I was feeling a bit peckish. I wonder if they have some decent chicken wings here. Even a nice salmon would hit the spot.” Fisianna’s mouth begins to water at the thought having one of those delicacies while she licks her lips in a rather cute, cat-like manner. She notices you looking and blushes in embarrassment at her literal slip of the tongue.
rows.translation: “好啊，[pc.name]。说实话，我正好有点饿。不知道这里有没有不错的鸡翅。哪怕来一份美味鲑鱼也能满足我。”想到能享用这些美食之一，菲西安娜不禁口舌生津，以相当可爱的猫科方式舔了舔嘴唇。她注意到你的目光，意识到自己当真‘口误’后尴尬地脸红。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, [pc.name]. To be honest, I was feeling a bit peckish. I wonder if they have some decent chicken wings here. Even a nice salmon would hit the spot.” Fisianna’s mouth begins to water at the thought having one of those delicacies while she licks her lips in a rather cute, cat-like manner. She notices you looking and blushes in embarrassment at her literal slip of the tongue."

rows.original: The two of you browse the corridors of the Merchant’s Deck for a suitable food place to satisfy your palates. You eventually come across a homely-looking diner that looks like it just recently opened up. There are signs along the entryway advertising grand opening sales on special entrees. When you [pc.walk] through the doors, you immediately run into a familiar face: it’s Tarariel. She turns around when she hears the jingling of the doorbells and her face lights up before she hurries over to the both of you.
rows.translation: 你们在商业甲板的走廊间寻找合适餐馆，满足各自的味蕾。最终，你们发现一家温馨餐厅，看起来才刚开业不久。入口沿途的标牌宣传着盛大开业期间特色主菜促销。你[pc.walk]进门，立刻撞见一张熟悉面孔：塔拉瑞尔。听见门铃叮当作响，她转过身，脸庞顿时明亮，急忙朝你们跑来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you browse the corridors of the Merchant’s Deck for a suitable food place to satisfy your palates. You eventually come across a homely-looking diner that looks like it just recently opened up. There are signs along the entryway advertising grand opening sales on special entrees. When you [pc.walk] through the doors, you immediately run into a familiar face: it’s Tarariel. She turns around when she hears the jingling of the doorbells and her face lights up before she hurries over to the both of you."

rows.original: “Fisi! Steele! Great seein’ ya here! I assume ya’ll are here for a bite to eat? Yeah, me too! Let’s go! I’m starvin’!”
rows.translation: “菲茜！斯蒂尔！真高兴在这儿见到你们！你们肯定也是来吃东西的吧？没错，我也是！走吧！我快饿死了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fisi! Steele! Great seein’ ya here! I assume ya’ll are here for a bite to eat? Yeah, me too! Let’s go! I’m starvin’!”"

rows.original: “...Uhm.” Is all Fisianna can muster out of her mouth before Tarariel grabs her by the wrist and drags her to a nearby table. She looks at you helplessly while she takes a seat opposite to Tarariel at the table. You take your seat next to the hapless catgirl and subtly shrug back at her as Tarariel looks over a menu. You take a menu off of the table and browse at the selection. Eventually you come to the decision to order a steak with the trimmings, but before you can do anything else, Tarariel gasps aloud and calls to you to grab your attention.
rows.translation: “...呃。”菲西安娜只来得及挤出这一声，塔拉瑞尔便抓住手腕，把她拖向附近餐桌。她坐到塔拉瑞尔对面，无助地望着你。你在这个倒霉猫娘身旁坐下，趁塔拉瑞尔查看菜单时悄悄朝她耸肩。你从桌上拿起菜单浏览。最终，你决定点一份配齐佐菜的牛排；可还没做其他事情，塔拉瑞尔便大声惊呼，招呼你看过去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Uhm.” Is all Fisianna can muster out of her mouth before Tarariel grabs her by the wrist and drags her to a nearby table. She looks at you helplessly while she takes a seat opposite to Tarariel at the table. You take your seat next to the hapless catgirl and subtly shrug back at her as Tarariel looks over a menu. You take a menu off of the table and browse at the selection. Eventually you come to the decision to order a steak with the trimmings, but before you can do anything else, Tarariel gasps aloud and calls to you to grab your attention."
