rows.original: “Oh! Oh! Steele, look at this! They have the traditional 72 ounce steak challenge here! We oughta try it! Fisi, you too! It’s potentially free food if you can do it!” Tarariel is practically bouncing in her seat. Fisianna looks the polar opposite in emotions to the fox-girl, frowning at the prospect of eating a giant slab of prime beef.
rows.translation: “哦！哦！斯蒂尔，快看！这里有传统的72盎司牛排挑战！我们应该试试！菲茜，你也来！如果能吃完，可能就是免费食物！”塔拉瑞尔几乎在座位上蹦起来。菲西安娜对吃下一大块顶级牛肉的前景皱起眉头，情绪与狐女截然相反。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh! Oh! Steele, look at this! They have the traditional 72 ounce steak challenge here! We oughta try it! Fisi, you too! It’s potentially free food if you can do it!” Tarariel is practically bouncing in her seat. Fisianna looks the polar opposite in emotions to the fox-girl, frowning at the prospect of eating a giant slab of prime beef."

rows.original: “I-I’m ok Tara... I know for a fact that I wouldn’t be able to eat that much in such a short time.” Fisianna groans.
rows.translation: “我——我就不用了，塔拉...我很确定自己不可能在这么短的时间内吃下那么多。”菲西安娜呻吟道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I’m ok Tara... I know for a fact that I wouldn’t be able to eat that much in such a short time.” Fisianna groans."

rows.original: <i>“Fair enough, Fisi... What about you Steele? You
rows.translation: <i>“也行，菲茜...那你呢，斯蒂尔？你够不够
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Fair enough, Fisi... What about you Steele? You "

rows.original: man
rows.translation: 男人
rows.raw: "man"

rows.original: woman
rows.translation: 女人
rows.raw: "woman"

rows.original: enough for the challenge?”
rows.translation: ，敢接受挑战？”
rows.raw: " enough for the challenge?”"

rows.original: Against your better judgement, you consider taking the challenge yourself, if Tarariel’s taunting wasn’t enough of a reason. After a short moment of thought, you tell her that you’ll attempt to take the challenge as well.
rows.translation: 你不顾更明智的判断，考虑亲自接受挑战；如果塔拉瑞尔的挑衅还不够成为理由的话。短暂思考后，你告诉她自己也会尝试挑战。
rows.raw: "\n\nAgainst your better judgement, you consider taking the challenge yourself, if Tarariel’s taunting wasn’t enough of a reason. After a short moment of thought, you tell her that you’ll attempt to take the challenge as well."

rows.original: <i>“My kinda
rows.translation: <i>“这才是我喜欢的
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“My kinda "

rows.original: guy
rows.translation: 家伙
rows.raw: "guy"

rows.original: gal
rows.translation: 姑娘
rows.raw: "gal"

rows.original: ! You picked a good one, Fisi!” Tarariel unsubtly winks at Fisianna. The shy feline next to you blushes intensely and looks down at her menu, avoiding eye contact with you. The waitress arrives shortly after and takes each of your orders. At the mention the steak challenge, the waitress raises a knowing eyebrow at you and Tarariel. She smiles as she collects your menus and sashays back to the kitchen. After about fifteen minutes, she comes back with both steaks in hand, as well as Fisianna’s modest portion of grilled salmon.
rows.translation: ！菲茜，你挑了个好对象！”塔拉瑞尔毫不掩饰地朝菲西安娜眨眼。身旁害羞的猫科女子瞬间脸红，低头看菜单，避免与你对视。不久，女服务员到来，记下你们各自的订单。听见牛排挑战时，她了然地朝你和塔拉瑞尔挑眉。她微笑着收走菜单，摇曳着走回厨房。约十五分钟后，她双手端着两份牛排回来，还带来了菲西安娜份量适中的烤鲑鱼。
rows.raw: "! You picked a good one, Fisi!” Tarariel unsubtly winks at Fisianna. The shy feline next to you blushes intensely and looks down at her menu, avoiding eye contact with you. The waitress arrives shortly after and takes each of your orders. At the mention the steak challenge, the waitress raises a knowing eyebrow at you and Tarariel. She smiles as she collects your menus and sashays back to the kitchen. After about fifteen minutes, she comes back with both steaks in hand, as well as Fisianna’s modest portion of grilled salmon."

rows.original: “Dig in, and good luck!” She winks and presses a button that is set on the steak platters, which activates a holo-panel timer that sets to thirty minutes... Wait, only thirty minutes?!
rows.translation: “开吃吧，祝你们好运！”她眨眨眼，按下牛排托盘上的按钮，启动设为三十分钟的全息计时器...等等，只有三十分钟？！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dig in, and good luck!” She winks and presses a button that is set on the steak platters, which activates a holo-panel timer that sets to thirty minutes... Wait, only thirty minutes?!"

rows.original: “Oh, it’s mostly to account for those species that have especially fast metabolisms, so we halved the time limit. Wouldn’t want to make it too easy on ‘em, or else we’d be out of business pretty quick.” The waitress explains.
rows.translation: “哦，这主要是考虑到某些新陈代谢特别快的物种，所以我们把时限减半了。总不能让挑战对他们而言太容易，否则我们很快就会倒闭。”女服务员解释道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, it’s mostly to account for those species that have especially fast metabolisms, so we halved the time limit. Wouldn’t want to make it too easy on ‘em, or else we’d be out of business pretty quick.” The waitress explains."

rows.original: “Doesn’t bother me, ma’am! I love the extra challenge!” Tarariel excitedly exclaims, her mouth already watering at the succulent steak in front of her. You on the other hand are starting to feel differently about this. The waitress leaves you alone with your food and sashays over to a nearby table to serve them.
rows.translation: “我不介意，女士！我就喜欢额外挑战！”塔拉瑞尔兴奋地喊道，看着面前多汁牛排，口水已经快流下来。另一方面，你开始对这件事有不同看法。女服务员让你们独自面对食物，摇曳着走向附近餐桌提供服务。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Doesn’t bother me, ma’am! I love the extra challenge!” Tarariel excitedly exclaims, her mouth already watering at the succulent steak in front of her. You on the other hand are starting to feel differently about this. The waitress leaves you alone with your food and sashays over to a nearby table to serve them."

rows.original: “Hey! Hey, Steele! Let’s make it interesting! Let’s race to see who gets done first!” Tarariel giddily challenges you, all the while eyeing her steak like a fierce predator that is about to go in for the kill. Goodness, this fox-girl knows no bounds! You look nervously at Fisianna, who has a look of concern etched on her face as she looks at the steak, then at you. Before you can think about backing out, Tarariel snaps her fingers, bringing both Fisianna’s and your attention back to her.
rows.translation: “嘿！嘿，斯蒂尔！让它更有意思吧！我们比赛谁先吃完！”塔拉瑞尔兴高采烈地向你挑战，同时像即将扑杀猎物的凶猛捕食者般紧盯牛排。天哪，这个狐女真是毫无节制！你紧张地看向菲西安娜。她先看牛排，再看你，脸上写满担忧。你还没来得及考虑退出，塔拉瑞尔便打了个响指，把你和菲西安娜的注意力拉回她身上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey! Hey, Steele! Let’s make it interesting! Let’s race to see who gets done first!” Tarariel giddily challenges you, all the while eyeing her steak like a fierce predator that is about to go in for the kill. Goodness, this fox-girl knows no bounds! You look nervously at Fisianna, who has a look of concern etched on her face as she looks at the steak, then at you. Before you can think about backing out, Tarariel snaps her fingers, bringing both Fisianna’s and your attention back to her."

rows.original: “Hey, Fisi! Count us down! This is gonna be such an epic steak!” Tarariel says as she readies her knife and fork. You sigh since there doesn’t look to be any way to back out of this now. You ready your own utensils as Fisianna sheepishly counts the two of you down.
rows.translation: “嘿，菲茜！给我们倒数！这会是一场史诗般的牛排大战！”塔拉瑞尔一边说，一边准备好刀叉。看来已经无法退出，你叹了口气，也准备好餐具；菲西安娜则腼腆地为你们倒数。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, Fisi! Count us down! This is gonna be such an epic steak!” Tarariel says as she readies her knife and fork. You sigh since there doesn’t look to be any way to back out of this now. You ready your own utensils as Fisianna sheepishly counts the two of you down."

rows.original: “U-um... three... two... one... go.” On the word go, Tarariel is already savagely cutting off a big chunk of steak and chomping it down. You work on your own slab of beef, sawing off a piece and taking a bite. The meat tastes absolutely wonderful to you! It has just the right amount of tenderness and moistness as well as spices. You gulp down your first bite. It slides down your throat with relative ease. You’re beginning to think this won’t be so bad after all and quickly move on to your second bite.
rows.translation: “呃...三...二...一...开始。”‘开始’二字刚出口，塔拉瑞尔已经凶猛地切下一大块牛排，塞进嘴里。你也开始处理自己的牛肉，锯下一块，咬了一口。肉的味道绝妙！柔嫩、多汁与香料都恰到好处。你咽下第一口，它相当轻松地滑过喉咙。你开始觉得挑战也许没那么糟，很快吃起第二口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“U-um... three... two... one... go.” On the word go, Tarariel is already savagely cutting off a big chunk of steak and chomping it down. You work on your own slab of beef, sawing off a piece and taking a bite. The meat tastes absolutely wonderful to you! It has just the right amount of tenderness and moistness as well as spices. You gulp down your first bite. It slides down your throat with relative ease. You’re beginning to think this won’t be so bad after all and quickly move on to your second bite."

rows.original: About halfway through, you are starting to feel rather full, despite your carefully timed eating pace. Tarariel is about three-fourths done her steak and shows no signs of slowing down. You take a deep breath to gather your bearings and concentrate.
rows.translation: 吃到一半左右时，尽管你仔细控制进食节奏，仍开始觉得相当饱。塔拉瑞尔已经吃完约四分之三，而且丝毫没有减速迹象。你深吸一口气，恢复镇定、集中精神。
rows.raw: "\n\nAbout halfway through, you are starting to feel rather full, despite your carefully timed eating pace. Tarariel is about three-fourths done her steak and shows no signs of slowing down. You take a deep breath to gather your bearings and concentrate."

rows.original: “Not givin’ up now, are we, Steele?” Tarariel smiles smugly at you after finishing a bite. You shake your head as a burp nearly escapes your mouth, which you silence by passing it through your nose. Fisianna is already done her salmon and watching the two of you eat, with more worry for you than Tarariel.
rows.translation: “不会现在就要放弃吧，斯蒂尔？”塔拉瑞尔咽下一口后得意地朝你微笑。你摇头，差点打出一个嗝，又让它从鼻腔无声通过。菲西安娜已经吃完鲑鱼，正在观看你们比赛；她对你的担忧显然多过对塔拉瑞尔。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not givin’ up now, are we, Steele?” Tarariel smiles smugly at you after finishing a bite. You shake your head as a burp nearly escapes your mouth, which you silence by passing it through your nose. Fisianna is already done her salmon and watching the two of you eat, with more worry for you than Tarariel."

rows.original: When you arrive at the twenty-eight minute mark, Tarariel slams her knife and fork down as she finishes the last bite of her steak. She punctuates her triumph over the challenge with a loud belch that could likely be heard throughout the entire diner. You are on your last bits of meat, which you estimate is about two more bites left. You decide to save these for the last minute or so, since your stomach feels almost ready to burst from all of the food.
rows.translation: 计时来到二十八分钟时，塔拉瑞尔吃完最后一口，把刀叉重重拍下。她用一声响亮饱嗝庆祝挑战成功，整间餐厅大概都能听见。你只剩最后几块肉，估计还有两口。肚子已经被食物撑得几乎爆裂，你决定把它们留到最后一分钟左右。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you arrive at the twenty-eight minute mark, Tarariel slams her knife and fork down as she finishes the last bite of her steak. She punctuates her triumph over the challenge with a loud belch that could likely be heard throughout the entire diner. You are on your last bits of meat, which you estimate is about two more bites left. You decide to save these for the last minute or so, since your stomach feels almost ready to burst from all of the food."

rows.original: “Whew, that was great! I’m gonna need to work out for the next week straight to burn all this off. Looks like I win the race at least! C’mon, Steele! Only a couple bites left! You can do it!” Tarariel cheers you on. Fisianna on the other hand is gripping your arm tightly in anxiety. You nod to her in reassurance that you will be able to finish the steak.
rows.translation: “呼，真痛快！接下来一整个星期我都得锻炼，才能消耗掉这些东西。不过至少比赛是我赢了！加油，斯蒂尔！只剩几口了！你能做到！”塔拉瑞尔为你助威。菲西安娜却焦虑地紧紧抓住你的手臂。你朝她点头，保证自己可以吃完牛排。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whew, that was great! I’m gonna need to work out for the next week straight to burn all this off. Looks like I win the race at least! C’mon, Steele! Only a couple bites left! You can do it!” Tarariel cheers you on. Fisianna on the other hand is gripping your arm tightly in anxiety. You nod to her in reassurance that you will be able to finish the steak."

rows.original: When the timer hits twenty-nine minutes, you take one of the last two pieces of beef and slowly chew it, tenderizing it as much as possible before gulping it down. It’s not as easy going down as it was to start off, but you manage to swallow the bite of steak down.
rows.translation: 计时来到二十九分钟时，你拿起最后两块牛肉中的一块，缓慢咀嚼，尽可能嚼软后才吞下。它不像最开始那样容易下咽，不过你还是成功吞下了这口牛排。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the timer hits twenty-nine minutes, you take one of the last two pieces of beef and slowly chew it, tenderizing it as much as possible before gulping it down. It’s not as easy going down as it was to start off, but you manage to swallow the bite of steak down."

rows.original: Thirty seconds left on the timer. You pick the last piece up and shove it in your mouth, tenderizing the meat as much as possible before time is up. Ten seconds left. You swallow the steak in bit by bit, fighting to keep each morsel flowing down your throat. Five seconds. You down the last piece remaining and open your mouth to Tarariel to confirm you swallowed it. The timer stops with only a few seconds to spare, confirming you have eaten the whole steak. Your vision starts to swim. You can barely make out Tarariel cheering for you and in the very next moment you hear a worried gasp next to you as everything starts to fade to black...
rows.translation: 计时器还剩三十秒。你拿起最后一块塞进嘴里，在时间耗尽前尽可能嚼软。还剩十秒。你一点点吞下牛排，努力让每一小块继续滑过喉咙。五秒。你吞下最后残余，张嘴向塔拉瑞尔证明已经咽下。计时器在只剩几秒时停止，确认你吃完整块牛排。视野开始摇晃。你几乎看不清塔拉瑞尔正在为你欢呼；下一刻，身旁传来担忧的抽气声，一切逐渐陷入黑暗...
rows.raw: "\n\nThirty seconds left on the timer. You pick the last piece up and shove it in your mouth, tenderizing the meat as much as possible before time is up. Ten seconds left. You swallow the steak in bit by bit, fighting to keep each morsel flowing down your throat. Five seconds. You down the last piece remaining and open your mouth to Tarariel to confirm you swallowed it. The timer stops with only a few seconds to spare, confirming you have eaten the whole steak. Your vision starts to swim. You can barely make out Tarariel cheering for you and in the very next moment you hear a worried gasp next to you as everything starts to fade to black..."

rows.original: When you come to, you are greeted by a warm, fuzzy feeling going through your [pc.hair], as well as a gentle breeze blowing in your face. You open your eyes to see Fisianna’s visage looking back at you, etched with anxiety. She has your head rested on her lap as she gently pets you, occasionally running her paws through your [pc.hair]. One of her tails is rapidly waving back and forth over you while fanning air to your face with a menu.
rows.translation: 恢复意识时，你感到一股温暖毛绒的触感穿过[pc.hair]，还有轻风吹拂脸庞。你睁开眼，看见菲西安娜正满脸焦虑地回望。她让你的脑袋枕在腿上，一边温柔抚摸，偶尔用爪子梳过[pc.hair]。她的一条尾巴在你上方快速来回摆动，同时用菜单朝你脸上扇风。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you come to, you are greeted by a warm, fuzzy feeling going through your [pc.hair], as well as a gentle breeze blowing in your face. You open your eyes to see Fisianna’s visage looking back at you, etched with anxiety. She has your head rested on her lap as she gently pets you, occasionally running her paws through your [pc.hair]. One of her tails is rapidly waving back and forth over you while fanning air to your face with a menu. "

rows.original: It looks like you came down with a case of the ‘itis.
rows.translation: 看来你患上了典型的‘饭困症’。
rows.raw: "It looks like you came down with a case of the ‘itis. "

rows.original: It seems like you passed out after finishing the steak.
rows.translation: 看来你在吃完牛排后昏过去了。
rows.raw: "It seems like you passed out after finishing the steak."

rows.original: When you stir, Fisianna stops fanning you with her tail and eases you up to a sitting position. You are still in the diner from what you gather, but Tarariel is already long gone.
rows.translation: 你开始动弹后，菲西安娜停止用尾巴扇风，扶你坐起。从周围来看，你们仍在餐厅，不过塔拉瑞尔早已离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you stir, Fisianna stops fanning you with her tail and eases you up to a sitting position. You are still in the diner from what you gather, but Tarariel is already long gone."

rows.original: “I-I’m sorry for that, [pc.name]. Tara can tend to get on a competitive streak too much for anyone’s good. Y-you didn’t have to take her challenge...” Fisianna still looks at you with unease on her face.
rows.translation: “对——对不起，[pc.name]。塔拉有时竞争心太强，对任何人都没好处。你——你其实不必接受她的挑战...”菲西安娜仍满脸不安地望着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I’m sorry for that, [pc.name]. Tara can tend to get on a competitive streak too much for anyone’s good. Y-you didn’t have to take her challenge...” Fisianna still looks at you with unease on her face."

rows.original: To ease Fisianna’s worries you tell her lightheartedly that you are fine and that you got a free steak out of it regardless, so everything worked out well. She sighs in relief and visibly relaxes.
rows.translation: 为了缓解菲西安娜的担忧，你轻松地告诉她自己没事，而且无论如何都白吃了一份牛排，所以结果很好。她如释重负地叹息，明显放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nTo ease Fisianna’s worries you tell her lightheartedly that you are fine and that you got a free steak out of it regardless, so everything worked out well. She sighs in relief and visibly relaxes."

rows.original: “Still... remind me to not eat another steak for at least a week.” You request to the feline jokingly. Fisianna giggles at this.
rows.translation: “不过...记得提醒我，至少一星期内别再吃牛排。”你开玩笑地请求这个猫科女子。菲西安娜咯咯笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Still... remind me to not eat another steak for at least a week.” You request to the feline jokingly. Fisianna giggles at this."

rows.original: “Agreed.” After Fisianna swipes her
rows.translation: “同意。”菲西安娜用她的
rows.raw: "\n\n“Agreed.” After Fisianna swipes her "

rows.original: dogecoin
rows.translation: 狗狗币
rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.original: credit chit
rows.translation: 信用筹码
rows.raw: "credit chit"

rows.original: on the bill for her salmon, the two of you head out of the diner, thanking each other for the company and saying your goodbyes before going your separate ways.
rows.translation: 支付鲑鱼账单后，你们走出餐厅，感谢彼此陪伴，道别后各自离开。
rows.raw: " on the bill for her salmon, the two of you head out of the diner, thanking each other for the company and saying your goodbyes before going your separate ways."

rows.original: You try to think of something the two of you can shop for, but nothing immediately comes to mind. You shift the question back to Fisianna.
rows.translation: 你试图想出两人能购买什么，却没有立刻想到，于是把问题抛回菲西安娜。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to think of something the two of you can shop for, but nothing immediately comes to mind. You shift the question back to Fisianna."

rows.original: “O-oh... um... hm...” It seems like Fisianna wasn’t prepared to do any shopping for her own needs. She stands on the spot lost in thought for a while before she comes to a decision.
rows.translation: “哦...呃...嗯...”看来菲西安娜完全没有准备为自己购物。她站在原地沉思许久，最终做出决定。
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh... um... hm...” It seems like Fisianna wasn’t prepared to do any shopping for her own needs. She stands on the spot lost in thought for a while before she comes to a decision."

rows.original: “W-we could go to a hardware store or something. I kinda need more replacement parts for this droid that I’m building on the side. T-that is if you wanted to go too?” Fisianna looks at you expectantly.
rows.translation: “我——我们可以去五金店之类的地方。我正在业余制造一台机器人，需要更多替换零件。如——如果你也想一起去的话？”菲西安娜期待地望着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-we could go to a hardware store or something. I kinda need more replacement parts for this droid that I’m building on the side. T-that is if you wanted to go too?” Fisianna looks at you expectantly."

rows.original: You nod your head in agreement since you can’t think of anything else the two of you can do, plus it wouldn’t hurt to help her out as well. The two of you walk a little ways before reaching the nearest hardware store that you find. Once inside, she turns to you.
rows.translation: 你想不到其他能一起做的事情，而且帮助她也没有坏处，于是点头同意。你们走了一段路，来到找到的最近一家五金店。进门后，她转向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod your head in agreement since you can’t think of anything else the two of you can do, plus it wouldn’t hurt to help her out as well. The two of you walk a little ways before reaching the nearest hardware store that you find. Once inside, she turns to you."

rows.original: “Alright. What I need to get are parts for a new processing core, some spare coupling wires, a bit of silicone, and I need a new welding torch. Mine burned out just recently. They shouldn’t be too hard to find, I imagine anyways...” Fisianna perks her ears and does a quick visual scan of the shop. “Yeah, I’m confident we’ll find what we need here. Let’s split up and look then. It might make things a bit faster that way, yes?”
rows.translation: “好。我需要购买新处理核心的零件、一些备用耦合线、一点硅胶，还有一把新焊枪。我的焊枪最近烧坏了。我想这些应该不难找...”菲西安娜竖起耳朵，迅速目视扫过店铺。“对，我相信能在这里找到需要的东西。我们分头寻找吧。这样也许会更快，对吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright. What I need to get are parts for a new processing core, some spare coupling wires, a bit of silicone, and I need a new welding torch. Mine burned out just recently. They shouldn’t be too hard to find, I imagine anyways...” Fisianna perks her ears and does a quick visual scan of the shop. “Yeah, I’m confident we’ll find what we need here. Let’s split up and look then. It might make things a bit faster that way, yes?”"

rows.original: You agree to Fisianna’s plan and head towards one end of the store while Fisianna searches the other. Looking down the aisles of gadgets and gizmos, you are quite amazed at the wide selection this store has. There is everything from electrified repair tools to media devices. You try your best not to distract yourself too much from the wide array of electronics and look out for the things Fisianna mentioned that she needed. Eventually you find some coupling wires, a welding torch, and some processing core parts in nearly the same area of the store. Pleased with your luck, you head towards the other side of the store to search for Fisianna and show her your finds.
rows.translation: 你同意菲西安娜的计划，走向商店一端，她则搜索另一端。望着一排排小装置与机械玩意，你惊讶于这家店的商品种类如此丰富。从电动维修工具到媒体设备一应俱全。你尽量不让琳琅满目的电子产品分散注意力，寻找菲西安娜提到的物品。最终，你在店内几乎同一区域找到一些耦合线、一把焊枪和部分处理核心零件。你对自己的运气十分满意，走向商店另一侧寻找菲西安娜，准备展示成果。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou agree to Fisianna’s plan and head towards one end of the store while Fisianna searches the other. Looking down the aisles of gadgets and gizmos, you are quite amazed at the wide selection this store has. There is everything from electrified repair tools to media devices. You try your best not to distract yourself too much from the wide array of electronics and look out for the things Fisianna mentioned that she needed. Eventually you find some coupling wires, a welding torch, and some processing core parts in nearly the same area of the store. Pleased with your luck, you head towards the other side of the store to search for Fisianna and show her your finds."

rows.original: When you arrive at the aisle that is featuring silicone on sale, you [pc.walk] down the narrow lane of branded rubbery material and find Fisianna, though she isn’t alone. From what you witness, she is in the middle of a discussion with a younger looking male human and ausar, though she seems less than pleased with the company. Her ears are downturned and her twinned tails are clung tightly to her body as she is constantly shying away from them, but they won’t give her an inch. Thinking she is in trouble, you move quickly to the catgirl to intervene. When in earshot, you can hear the ausar asking rather lewd things to Fisianna and increase your pace. The human sees you approaching and gestures to the ausar, who backs off of Fisianna and turns their attention to you.
rows.translation: 来到硅胶促销货架时，你[pc.walk]过这条陈列各品牌橡胶材料的狭窄通道，发现了菲西安娜，不过她并非独自一人。你看到她正在和一名较年轻的人类男性与奥萨人交谈，但显然并不喜欢这两人的陪伴。她双耳低垂，两条尾巴紧贴身体，不断躲避他们，可对方却步步紧逼。你认为猫娘遇上麻烦，迅速上前干预。走进听力范围后，你听见奥萨人正向菲西安娜提出相当下流的问题，于是进一步加快脚步。人类看见你接近，向奥萨人示意；后者终于退离菲西安娜，把注意力转向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you arrive at the aisle that is featuring silicone on sale, you [pc.walk] down the narrow lane of branded rubbery material and find Fisianna, though she isn’t alone. From what you witness, she is in the middle of a discussion with a younger looking male human and ausar, though she seems less than pleased with the company. Her ears are downturned and her twinned tails are clung tightly to her body as she is constantly shying away from them, but they won’t give her an inch. Thinking she is in trouble, you move quickly to the catgirl to intervene. When in earshot, you can hear the ausar asking rather lewd things to Fisianna and increase your pace. The human sees you approaching and gestures to the ausar, who backs off of Fisianna and turns their attention to you."

rows.original: “Hey! What do you want? We’re talking science here! Ms. Kitty and I were just discussing about how we can make a little pleasure bot that can look just like her. She’s a perfect model for one! I was just asking how much silicone I’d need to capture her bust size!” The ausar sneers. Fisianna shrinks and moves to hide behind you, trembling as she clings to you.
rows.translation: “嘿！你想干什么？我们正在讨论科学！我和猫咪小姐刚刚在讨论，怎样制造一台外表和她完全一样的小型寻欢机器人。她就是完美模型！我只是在问，要还原她的胸围需要多少硅胶！”奥萨人冷笑道。菲西安娜畏缩着躲到你身后，紧紧抓住你，身体不断颤抖。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey! What do you want? We’re talking science here! Ms. Kitty and I were just discussing about how we can make a little pleasure bot that can look just like her. She’s a perfect model for one! I was just asking how much silicone I’d need to capture her bust size!” The ausar sneers. Fisianna shrinks and moves to hide behind you, trembling as she clings to you."

rows.original: “Where do you get the idea to go around asking a random person personal questions like that, especially if she’s clearly opposed to telling you?” You question the ausar. You are starting to become a little hot under the collar at their brazenness for harassing Fisianna like this.
rows.translation: “你凭什么觉得自己可以到处向陌生人询问这种私密问题，尤其是她明显不愿回答？”你质问奥萨人。对方如此明目张胆地骚扰菲西安娜，让你逐渐怒火上涌。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Where do you get the idea to go around asking a random person personal questions like that, especially if she’s clearly opposed to telling you?” You question the ausar. You are starting to become a little hot under the collar at their brazenness for harassing Fisianna like this."

rows.original: The human steps up to you so close that you can feel his hot breath on your face. “Yeah, well this isn’t any of your business, so if you ain’t gonna help, then let the little kitten answer.”
rows.translation: 人类上前逼近，近到你能感觉他的热气喷在脸上。“是啊，可这不关你的事。所以如果你不打算帮忙，就让小猫咪回答。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe human steps up to you so close that you can feel his hot breath on your face. “Yeah, well this isn’t any of your business, so if you ain’t gonna help, then let the little kitten answer.”"

rows.original: “You don’t mean my little kitten, do you?” A calm and familiar, but also faintly threatening feminine voice chimes in. You see a scaled finger tap the human on the shoulder before he whirls around and comes face to face with Britannia’s smiling visage. Where did she come from?!
rows.translation: “你说的不会是我的小猫咪吧？”一个平静熟悉，却隐含威胁的女性嗓音插话。你看见一根覆鳞手指轻拍人类肩膀；他猛然转身，与布里塔妮娅微笑的脸庞正面相对。她从哪里冒出来的？！
rows.raw: "\n\n“You don’t mean my little kitten, do you?” A calm and familiar, but also faintly threatening feminine voice chimes in. You see a scaled finger tap the human on the shoulder before he whirls around and comes face to face with Britannia’s smiling visage. Where did she come from?!"

rows.original: “W-who the hell are you?!” The human angrily snarls at Britannia. The dragoness doesn’t look fazed by him at all, since she is still wearing the same warm smile as when she first appeared. She does however step up closer to the man. Britannia then places her face so close to his that they are almost touching. The dragon-morph abruptly blows a puff a smoke through her nostrils that makes the human stagger back coughing. Her facial expression suddenly changes from that warm smile to an extremely, terrifyingly stern face.
rows.translation: “你——你他妈是谁？！”人类愤怒地朝布里塔妮娅咆哮。龙女丝毫没有被吓住，脸上仍保持初次出现时的温暖笑容。不过她确实进一步走近男人，随后把脸凑到几乎与他相贴。龙裔突然从鼻孔喷出一股烟雾，令男人踉跄后退、连连咳嗽。她的表情骤然从温暖微笑变成极其严厉、令人恐惧的面孔。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-who the hell are you?!” The human angrily snarls at Britannia. The dragoness doesn’t look fazed by him at all, since she is still wearing the same warm smile as when she first appeared. She does however step up closer to the man. Britannia then places her face so close to his that they are almost touching. The dragon-morph abruptly blows a puff a smoke through her nostrils that makes the human stagger back coughing. Her facial expression suddenly changes from that warm smile to an extremely, terrifyingly stern face."

rows.original: “The person that’s going to burn you to cinders if you don’t leave my friends alone.” Britannia huffs another cloud of smoke towards the ausar to accentuate her threat. It looks like it works! The human and ausar look on in terror at the imposing dragoness standing up to them.
rows.translation: “如果你们再不放过我的朋友，我就是那个会把你们烧成灰的人。”布里塔妮娅又朝奥萨人喷出一团烟雾，加强威胁。看来很有效！人类与奥萨人惊恐地看着挺身面对他们、气势逼人的龙女。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The person that’s going to burn you to cinders if you don’t leave my friends alone.” Britannia huffs another cloud of smoke towards the ausar to accentuate her threat. It looks like it works! The human and ausar look on in terror at the imposing dragoness standing up to them."

rows.original: “C’mon! This isn’t worth it, man!” The ausar yelps before both he and his compatriot scramble past you and Fisianna as fast as they can. Britannia giggles and waves as they run while tripping over each other. When they turn the corner out of sight, Fisianna relaxes and comes out from hiding behind you.
rows.translation: “走吧！这不值得，伙计！”奥萨人尖叫，随后与同伴一起，以最快速度从你和菲西安娜身旁逃窜。两人互相绊倒着跑开，布里塔妮娅则咯咯笑着挥手。等他们拐过转角、消失不见，菲西安娜才放松下来，从你身后走出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“C’mon! This isn’t worth it, man!” The ausar yelps before both he and his compatriot scramble past you and Fisianna as fast as they can. Britannia giggles and waves as they run while tripping over each other. When they turn the corner out of sight, Fisianna relaxes and comes out from hiding behind you."

rows.original: “T-thank you, [pc.name], a-and you as well Bri. Those two were unbearable...” Fisianna sighs in relief. Britannia smiles at the two of you.
rows.translation: “谢——谢谢你，[pc.name]，还——还有你，布里。那两个家伙实在令人受不了...”菲西安娜如释重负地叹息。布里塔妮娅朝你们微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“T-thank you, [pc.name], a-and you as well Bri. Those two were unbearable...” Fisianna sighs in relief. Britannia smiles at the two of you."

rows.original: “No worries, Kitten, though I imagine [pc.name] here could’ve handled it anyways. I just wanted to have a little bit of fun.” Britannia laughs gently.
rows.translation: “别担心，小猫。不过我想，[pc.name]自己也能处理。我只是想找点乐子。”布里塔妮娅温柔地笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No worries, Kitten, though I imagine [pc.name] here could’ve handled it anyways. I just wanted to have a little bit of fun.” Britannia laughs gently."

rows.original: You can’t help but wonder... “Britannia, can you really breathe fire?”
rows.translation: 你忍不住好奇...“布里塔妮娅，你真的能喷火吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but wonder... “Britannia, can you really breathe fire?”"

rows.original: Britannia covers her mouth and opens her eyes wide in mock-surprise. “Oh goodness, no! That would be incredibly dangerous, not to mention terribly expensive! I’m only modded to have some smoke sacs if I ever need to get the point across that I’m upset.” Britannia winks at you. You make a mental note not to get on Britannia’s bad side if she can pull off such a convincing act.
rows.translation: 布里塔妮娅捂住嘴，故作惊讶地睁大双眼。“哦天哪，当然不能！那会危险得难以置信，更别说代价极其昂贵！我只改造了几个烟囊，以便在需要时明确表达自己很生气。”布里塔妮娅朝你眨眼。她能演得如此逼真，你暗自记下，绝不能招惹她。
rows.raw: "\n\nBritannia covers her mouth and opens her eyes wide in mock-surprise. “Oh goodness, no! That would be incredibly dangerous, not to mention terribly expensive! I’m only modded to have some smoke sacs if I ever need to get the point across that I’m upset.” Britannia winks at you. You make a mental note not to get on Britannia’s bad side if she can pull off such a convincing act."

rows.original: “W-what are you doing here anyways, Bri? I-I didn’t expect you to be here of all places.” Fisianna asks.
rows.translation: “不——不过你为什么会在这里，布里？我——我完全没想到会在这种地方见到你。”菲西安娜问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-what are you doing here anyways, Bri? I-I didn’t expect you to be here of all places.” Fisianna asks."

rows.original: Britannia scratches the back of her head as she laughs sheepishly. “Well... I was actually looking for repair tools so I could fix something back home. Let’s just say I don’t know my own strength, so I’m going with the heavy duty stuff. From the looks of things, it looks like you’re doing your own fixing, Kitten?”
rows.translation: 布里塔妮娅不好意思地笑着挠了挠后脑。“这个...其实我在找维修工具，想修理家里的某件东西。只能说我不太清楚自己的力气，所以准备买重型工具。从你们的样子看，你也在修东西，小猫？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBritannia scratches the back of her head as she laughs sheepishly. “Well... I was actually looking for repair tools so I could fix something back home. Let’s just say I don’t know my own strength, so I’m going with the heavy duty stuff. From the looks of things, it looks like you’re doing your own fixing, Kitten?”"

rows.original: Fisianna nods her head. “Y-yeah, I’m just looking for parts so that I can finish fixing a droid I was working on.”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜点头。“对——对，我只是在找些零件，好完成正在维修的机器人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna nods her head. “Y-yeah, I’m just looking for parts so that I can finish fixing a droid I was working on.”"

rows.original: Speaking of which, this reminds you that you have yet give the parts that you found for her. You present the items to Fisianna and hand them over to her.
rows.translation: 说到这里，你想起自己还没有把找到的零件交给她。你向菲西安娜展示物品，递到她手里。
rows.raw: "\n\nSpeaking of which, this reminds you that you have yet give the parts that you found for her. You present the items to Fisianna and hand them over to her."

rows.original: “That’s great, [pc.name]! Now I can finish this project off!” Fisianna gives you a gentle hug and deposits the parts in a shopping bag that she is carrying. “I guess that’s everything. Thank you again for the rescue Bri and [pc.name]! I should be on my way and get to work!”
rows.translation: “太好了，[pc.name]！现在我能完成这个项目了！”菲西安娜温柔地拥抱你，把零件放进随身购物袋。“看来东西全齐了。再次谢谢布里和[pc.name]救了我！我该走了，回去工作！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s great, [pc.name]! Now I can finish this project off!” Fisianna gives you a gentle hug and deposits the parts in a shopping bag that she is carrying. “I guess that’s everything. Thank you again for the rescue Bri and [pc.name]! I should be on my way and get to work!”"

rows.original: Britannia nods and smiles. “Take care, and good luck with the droid! It was also nice seeing you again [pc.name]. Let’s all talk together again under not-as-hostile circumstances!”
rows.translation: 布里塔妮娅微笑点头。“保重，祝机器人项目顺利！也很高兴再次见到你，[pc.name]。下次我们再在没这么充满敌意的情况下聚一聚！”
rows.raw: "\n\nBritannia nods and smiles. “Take care, and good luck with the droid! It was also nice seeing you again [pc.name]. Let’s all talk together again under not-as-hostile circumstances!”"

rows.original: You decide to escort Fisianna to the checkout and out of the hardware store after you say your goodbyes to Britannia. Fisianna gives you another hug and bids you farewell before heading home.
rows.translation: 与布里塔妮娅道别后，你决定陪菲西安娜结账并走出五金店。菲西安娜再次拥抱你，道别后回家。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide to escort Fisianna to the checkout and out of the hardware store after you say your goodbyes to Britannia. Fisianna gives you another hug and bids you farewell before heading home."

rows.translation: 在商业甲板寻找可以购物的地方。
rows.raw: "Browse the merchant deck for a place to shop."

rows.original: Movies
rows.translation: 电影
rows.raw: "Movies"

rows.original: Lkynmbr24
rows.raw: "Lkynmbr24"

rows.original: MERCHANT'S THOROUGHFARE2
rows.raw: "MERCHANT'S THOROUGHFARE2"

rows.original: You ask Fisianna if she would be up for watching a movie at a theater that you passed by on the Merchant Deck.
rows.translation: 你问菲西安娜，是否愿意去商业甲板上经过的电影院看场电影。
rows.raw: "You ask Fisianna if she would be up for watching a movie at a theater that you passed by on the Merchant Deck."

rows.original: “Huh... I didn’t know a theater opened up there. On the Merchant’s Deck of all places too? That’s a weird place for a theater in my opinion, but sure! It sounds like it could be fun.”
rows.translation: “咦...我不知道那里开了电影院。而且偏偏在商业甲板？我觉得电影院开在那里很奇怪，不过好啊！听起来应该挺有趣。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh... I didn’t know a theater opened up there. On the Merchant’s Deck of all places too? That’s a weird place for a theater in my opinion, but sure! It sounds like it could be fun.” "

rows.original: “Sure, [pc.name]! It sounds like it could be fun.”
rows.translation: “好啊，[pc.name]！听起来应该挺有趣。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, [pc.name]! It sounds like it could be fun.” "

rows.original: Fisianna rises up from her seat after you do and the both of you head towards the elevator shafts.
rows.translation: 你站起来后，菲西安娜也离开座位，你们一起走向电梯井。
rows.raw: "Fisianna rises up from her seat after you do and the both of you head towards the elevator shafts."

rows.original: When you arrive on the Merchant’s Deck, the two of you make your way to the theater, discussing which movies you both have been wanting to see and talking about your favorite actors. You eventually arrive at the rather grandiose looking entryway of the theater. It is lined with holo-posters of popular movies, as well as schedules of when they air.
rows.translation: 来到商业甲板后，你们朝电影院走去，一路讨论彼此想看的影片和最喜欢的演员。最终，你们来到电影院颇为宏伟的入口。入口两侧排列着热门电影的全息海报，以及各自的放映时间表。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you arrive on the Merchant’s Deck, the two of you make your way to the theater, discussing which movies you both have been wanting to see and talking about your favorite actors. You eventually arrive at the rather grandiose looking entryway of the theater. It is lined with holo-posters of popular movies, as well as schedules of when they air."

rows.original: The two of you make your way inside. You are surprised to see that the theater lobby is heavily crowded. Numerous walkways lead into different screening rooms, giving you the impression that this theater is likely a multiplex. You can smell all of the delicious movie snacks being sold at the nearby stalls. As you look towards the different snack stalls, you spot a familiar flash of yellow and green feathers. Their owner turns towards you with an armful of popcorn, nachos, and soft drinks. Were they really intending on eating all of that by themselves? Upon taking notice of you, they hurry over to you, spilling a few popcorn kernels along the way. You come to realize that the feathered person is Aya, Fisianna’s harpy friend.
rows.translation: 你们走进影院。大厅里人山人海，令你吃了一惊。许多通道分别通向不同放映厅，让你觉得这里很可能是一家多厅影院。附近摊位销售的美味电影零食香气扑鼻。你看向不同零食摊，发现一道熟悉的黄绿羽毛身影。羽毛主人转向你，怀里抱满爆米花、玉米片和软饮料。她真的打算一个人吃掉这些吗？注意到你们后，她急忙走来，途中洒落几粒爆米花。你这才认出这个羽人是菲西安娜的鸟身女妖朋友阿雅。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you make your way inside. You are surprised to see that the theater lobby is heavily crowded. Numerous walkways lead into different screening rooms, giving you the impression that this theater is likely a multiplex. You can smell all of the delicious movie snacks being sold at the nearby stalls. As you look towards the different snack stalls, you spot a familiar flash of yellow and green feathers. Their owner turns towards you with an armful of popcorn, nachos, and soft drinks. Were they really intending on eating all of that by themselves? Upon taking notice of you, they hurry over to you, spilling a few popcorn kernels along the way. You come to realize that the feathered person is Aya, Fisianna’s harpy friend."

rows.original: “Heeeey! Fisi! [pc.name]! Great to see you both here!” Aya chirps gleefully.
rows.translation: “嗨——！菲茜！[pc.name]！真高兴在这里见到你们！”阿雅欢快地啁啾。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heeeey! Fisi! [pc.name]! Great to see you both here!” Aya chirps gleefully."

rows.original: “Hey Aya! I didn’t think we would see you here. Were you about to catch a movie yourself?” Fisianna asks Aya, all the while eyeing the snacks in the avian’s arms.
rows.translation: “嗨，阿雅！没想到会在这里见到你。你正准备自己看电影吗？”菲西安娜问阿雅，同时盯着这个鸟人怀里的零食。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey Aya! I didn’t think we would see you here. Were you about to catch a movie yourself?” Fisianna asks Aya, all the while eyeing the snacks in the avian’s arms."

rows.original: “Yeah, I was as a matter of fact! I was going to go see this great sci-fi comedy, ‘Blubber’. It’s about this scientist that’s too super busy with his experiments to pay attention to their loved ones, and they wind up modding this galotian to be super bouncy. Hey! If you two wanna, would you like to come watch it with me? I’ll share my snaaaacks!” Aya asks elatedly while attempting to wave the bag of popcorn in her arms enticingly, sending even more popcorn kernels falling to the floor.
rows.translation: “对，事实上正是如此！我准备去看一部非常棒的科幻喜剧，《肥胶》。故事讲的是一个科学家忙于实验，无暇关注爱人，最后改造了一个加洛提亚人，让她变得弹性十足。嘿！如果你们愿意，要不要和我一起看？我会分享零——食！”阿雅兴高采烈地问，同时试图诱人地挥动怀中爆米花袋，结果让更多爆米花落到地板上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, I was as a matter of fact! I was going to go see this great sci-fi comedy, ‘Blubber’. It’s about this scientist that’s too super busy with his experiments to pay attention to their loved ones, and they wind up modding this galotian to be super bouncy. Hey! If you two wanna, would you like to come watch it with me? I’ll share my snaaaacks!” Aya asks elatedly while attempting to wave the bag of popcorn in her arms enticingly, sending even more popcorn kernels falling to the floor."

rows.original: “Ooooh, I have always wanted to see that one! I’ve heard Jay Williams was hilarious in this movie!” Fisianna smiles excitedly. “I think I’m sold Aya! How about you, [pc.name]?” She asks while grabbing the box of nachos out of Aya’s arms, which unburdens her load by a little.
rows.translation: “哦——，我一直想看这部！听说杰伊·威廉姆斯在里面特别搞笑！”菲西安娜兴奋微笑。“我决定了，阿雅！你呢，[pc.name]？”她一边问，一边从阿雅怀里拿走玉米片盒，稍微减轻对方的负担。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooooh, I have always wanted to see that one! I’ve heard Jay Williams was hilarious in this movie!” Fisianna smiles excitedly. “I think I’m sold Aya! How about you, [pc.name]?” She asks while grabbing the box of nachos out of Aya’s arms, which unburdens her load by a little."

rows.original: Seeing as it would be two versus one on any adverse decision you would make anyways, you are inclined to agree with the two girls. You grab the popcorn out of Aya’s arms so she won’t spill anymore, leaving her with the soft drinks. The three of you walk over to the ticket vendor to pay for your movie tickets. Aya steps in front with her bundle of soft drinks and offers to pay for your tickets, which you and Fisianna gratefully thank her for. Afterwards, you head towards one of the screening rooms. Once inside, you observe that the room is already very crowded. It must be a very popular movie! The three of you manage find seats in the middle of the room despite this, and Aya passes her extra drinks to you and Fisianna once everyone settles down in their chairs. Your group sits through about ten minutes of previews for other movies before the main attraction starts.
rows.translation: 反正无论你做出什么反对决定，都会变成二比一，你倾向于同意两个姑娘。你从阿雅怀里拿走爆米花，避免她继续洒落，只留下软饮料。你们三人走向售票处购买电影票。阿雅抱着一堆软饮料走在前面，主动提出替你们付钱，你和菲西安娜感激地道谢。随后，你们前往一个放映厅。走进去后，你发现里面已经非常拥挤。这一定是部很受欢迎的电影！尽管如此，你们三人还是在房间中间找到座位。所有人坐稳后，阿雅把额外饮料递给你和菲西安娜。正片开始前，你们一起看了约十分钟其他电影预告。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeeing as it would be two versus one on any adverse decision you would make anyways, you are inclined to agree with the two girls. You grab the popcorn out of Aya’s arms so she won’t spill anymore, leaving her with the soft drinks. The three of you walk over to the ticket vendor to pay for your movie tickets. Aya steps in front with her bundle of soft drinks and offers to pay for your tickets, which you and Fisianna gratefully thank her for. Afterwards, you head towards one of the screening rooms. Once inside, you observe that the room is already very crowded. It must be a very popular movie! The three of you manage find seats in the middle of the room despite this, and Aya passes her extra drinks to you and Fisianna once everyone settles down in their chairs. Your group sits through about ten minutes of previews for other movies before the main attraction starts."

rows.original: Throughout the entirety of the movie, the room is bursting with laughter at the scientist’s shenanigans. At one particular point in the film, the scientist mods a graviball with part of the galotian’s “blubber-like” like cellular structure. They send it careening across a room, knocking an innocent passerby out cold. Aya laughs so hard at this that she accidentally squeezes the soft drink bottle in her hand and sends its contents flying backwards onto an unfortunate laquine behind her. She gasps and apologises profusely with the lagomorph. You turn a sideways glance towards Fisianna, who meets your gaze halfway with a knowing smile, after which the two of you do your best to muffle your laughter. The rest of the movie runs on uneventfully from then on. When the
rows.translation: 整部电影期间，放映厅都因科学家的滑稽举动爆发笑声。影片某个特别桥段中，科学家用加洛提亚人‘肥胶般’的细胞结构改造一颗重力球，让它在房间内高速乱飞，把无辜路人撞得昏死过去。阿雅笑得太厉害，无意间捏扁手里的软饮料瓶，把里面的液体向后喷到一个倒霉的拉奎因人身上。她倒抽一口气，不停向这个兔形人道歉。你侧眼看向菲西安娜，她在半途迎上目光，露出会意微笑；随后你们二人竭力压住笑声。从那以后，电影剩余部分顺利播放。等到

The rest of the movie runs on uneventfully from then on. When the "

rows.original: closing titles
rows.translation: 片尾字幕
rows.raw: "closing titles"

rows.original: ending credits
rows.translation: 结尾演职员表
rows.raw: "ending credits"

rows.original: roll, the three of you make your way out of the screening room and into the theater lobby.
rows.translation: 滚动时，你们三人走出放映厅，回到影院大厅。
rows.raw: " roll, the three of you make your way out of the screening room and into the theater lobby."

rows.original: “Ah... that movie was great! I think I’m gonna grow abs from laughing so hard!” Aya remarks as she wipes tears of mirth from her eyes.
rows.translation: “啊...这电影太棒了！我觉得自己笑得都快长出腹肌了！”阿雅一边评价，一边擦掉眼角笑出的泪水。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah... that movie was great! I think I’m gonna grow abs from laughing so hard!” Aya remarks as she wipes tears of mirth from her eyes."

rows.original: “Hehe, yeah! That movie was a lot better than I was expecting! I wonder if they’ll make a second?” Fisianna wonders while she throws her nacho box away into the nearby trash can.
rows.translation: “呵呵，对啊！这部电影比我预想中好看多了！不知道会不会拍第二部？”菲西安娜思索着，把玉米片盒扔进附近垃圾桶。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hehe, yeah! That movie was a lot better than I was expecting! I wonder if they’ll make a second?” Fisianna wonders while she throws her nacho box away into the nearby trash can."

rows.original: “Hopefully so! If they do come out with a sequel, you two will be the first people I invite to come see it with me!” Aya exclaims excitedly.
rows.translation: “希望会！如果真有续集，你们两个会是我最先邀请一起看的人！”阿雅兴奋地喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hopefully so! If they do come out with a sequel, you two will be the first people I invite to come see it with me!” Aya exclaims excitedly."

rows.original: The three of you stick around the lobby for a little while longer, talking about your favorite parts of the movie. After the conversation winds down, you all walk out of the theater, exchanging your goodbyes and going your separate ways.
rows.translation: 你们三人在大厅又待了一会儿，讨论电影中各自最喜欢的部分。话题逐渐结束后，你们一起走出影院，互相道别，各自离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe three of you stick around the lobby for a little while longer, talking about your favorite parts of the movie. After the conversation winds down, you all walk out of the theater, exchanging your goodbyes and going your separate ways."

rows.original: The two of you make your way inside. You are surprised to see that the theater lobby is heavily crowded. Numerous walkways lead into different screening rooms, giving you the impression that this theater is likely a multiplex. You can smell all of the delicious movie snacks being sold at the nearby stalls. As you near the ticket vendors, you spot a familiar fiery multi-tailed figure standing in line: it’s Tarariel. She looks backwards in the line of moviegoers and her face lights up in recognition, after which she breaks from the line and strides over to the both of you.
rows.translation: 你们走进影院。大厅里人山人海，令你吃了一惊。许多通道分别通向不同放映厅，让你觉得这里很可能是一家多厅影院。附近摊位销售的美味电影零食香气扑鼻。靠近售票处时，你发现一道熟悉、燃烧般的多尾身影正在排队：是塔拉瑞尔。她回头看向队伍后方，认出你们后顿时双眼放光，离开队列，大步朝你们走来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you make your way inside. You are surprised to see that the theater lobby is heavily crowded. Numerous walkways lead into different screening rooms, giving you the impression that this theater is likely a multiplex. You can smell all of the delicious movie snacks being sold at the nearby stalls. As you near the ticket vendors, you spot a familiar fiery multi-tailed figure standing in line: it’s Tarariel. She looks backwards in the line of moviegoers and her face lights up in recognition, after which she breaks from the line and strides over to the both of you."

rows.original: “Fisi! Steele! Nice seein’ ya two lovebirds here! How’re ya’ll?!” Tarariel claps the both of you on the shoulders once she reaches you.
rows.translation: “菲茜！斯蒂尔！真高兴在这里见到你们这对小情侣！你们怎么样？！”塔拉瑞尔走到面前，同时拍了拍你们的肩膀。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fisi! Steele! Nice seein’ ya two lovebirds here! How’re ya’ll?!” Tarariel claps the both of you on the shoulders once she reaches you."

rows.original: “T-Tara... please...” Fisianna groans while trying, and failing, to suppress a blush.
rows.translation: “塔——塔拉...求你了...”菲西安娜呻吟着，试图压住脸红，却以失败告终。
rows.raw: "\n\n“T-Tara... please...” Fisianna groans while trying, and failing, to suppress a blush."

rows.original: Tarariel giggles at length before continuing. “Anyways, I was actually JUST thinkin’ about you Fisi! I was about to go see this movie called ‘The Exterminator.’ It’s a pretty sweet sci-fi action movie about an android with a rogue AI from an evil company known as Airnet. They send the android to the past to kill the mother of the future leader of the rebellion against Airnet’s army of androids. I thought you might like to see it, bein’ an AI techie and all!”
rows.translation: 塔拉瑞尔咯咯笑了很久才继续说道。“总之，我刚才正好在想你，菲茜！我准备看一部叫《灭绝者》的电影。那是一部很酷的科幻动作片，讲述一个拥有失控人工智能的机器人，来自名为‘空网’的邪恶公司。他们把机器人送回过去，刺杀未来反抗军领袖的母亲；那支反抗军正与空网的机器人军队作战。我想你可能会喜欢，毕竟你是人工智能技术专家！”
rows.raw: "\n\nTarariel giggles at length before continuing. “Anyways, I was actually JUST thinkin’ about you Fisi! I was about to go see this movie called ‘The Exterminator.’ It’s a pretty sweet sci-fi action movie about an android with a rogue AI from an evil company known as Airnet. They send the android to the past to kill the mother of the future leader of the rebellion against Airnet’s army of androids. I thought you might like to see it, bein’ an AI techie and all!”"

rows.original: Fisianna looks both reluctant and interested at the same time while she considers if she wants to see this movie. Before she can decide however, Tarariel speaks up again. “C’mon! It’s not gonna hurt ya to see it. Who knows? Maybe it might broaden your horizons a bit! What about you, Steele?”
rows.translation: 菲西安娜考虑是否想看这部电影时，同时显得犹豫又感兴趣。不过她还没决定，塔拉瑞尔便再次开口。“来嘛！看一场又不会伤到你。谁知道呢？也许能稍微开阔视野！你觉得呢，斯蒂尔？”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna looks both reluctant and interested at the same time while she considers if she wants to see this movie. Before she can decide however, Tarariel speaks up again. “C’mon! It’s not gonna hurt ya to see it. Who knows? Maybe it might broaden your horizons a bit! What about you, Steele?”"

rows.original: You tell Tarariel that you are willing to see that movie if Fisianna is. The feline lowers her paw from her chin as she finishes contemplating the idea of seeing Tarariel’s movie of choice. “Mmm... Okay, I’ll give this movie a chance. It does sound pretty interesting.”
rows.translation: 你告诉塔拉瑞尔，只要菲西安娜愿意，自己也愿意看。猫科女子结束思考，爪子离开下巴。“嗯...好吧，我会给这部电影一次机会。听起来确实挺有意思。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Tarariel that you are willing to see that movie if Fisianna is. The feline lowers her paw from her chin as she finishes contemplating the idea of seeing Tarariel’s movie of choice. “Mmm... Okay, I’ll give this movie a chance. It does sound pretty interesting.”"

rows.original: “Great!” The kitsune-morph pumps her fist in the air. “Alright then, now that that’s settled, how about you two wait in line and buy us three tickets for the movie while I go get us some snacks? Figure I’d give you two some aloooone time!” Tarariel winks as she passes a

rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.translation: 信用筹码

rows.original: to you and saunters off towards the snack bars. Fisianna sighs while she avoids your gaze to suppress her blush again.
rows.translation: 递给你，随后大摇大摆走向零食吧。菲西安娜叹了口气，避开你的目光，努力再次压住脸红。
rows.raw: " to you and saunters off towards the snack bars. Fisianna sighs while she avoids your gaze to suppress her blush again."

rows.original: The two of you eventually make it to the front of the long line and purchase three tickets to see “The Exterminator.” Tarariel makes it over with the snacks at about the same time you and Fisianna finish buying the tickets. You feed your tickets into the receptacle near the entrance of the screening room and head inside. The room is already heavily crowded. It takes a while to find three open seats but you find some near the front of the room.
rows.translation: 你们终于排到长队前方，购买三张《灭绝者》的电影票。你和菲西安娜买完票时，塔拉瑞尔也恰好带着零食回来。你们把票投入放映厅入口附近的接收器，随后走进去。房间里已经非常拥挤。寻找三个空位花了一些时间，最终在前排附近找到。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you eventually make it to the front of the long line and purchase three tickets to see “The Exterminator.” Tarariel makes it over with the snacks at about the same time you and Fisianna finish buying the tickets. You feed your tickets into the receptacle near the entrance of the screening room and head inside. The room is already heavily crowded. It takes a while to find three open seats but you find some near the front of the room."

rows.original: The movie starts just about when the three of you settle down and Tarariel screams in glee. The three of you sit back with your snacks and watch the movie, surrounded by cheers, gasps, and applause at the climax of each action scene. Fisianna seems glued to the screen. She is barely touching her snacks which you and Tarariel take advantage of and occasionally sneak a little helping. The fox-girl cheers especially loud near the end of the movie when the protagonists are able to finally destroy the rampaging android. Several people in the immediate vicinity of her try to quiet her down but the kitsune-morph is completely oblivious to them.
rows.translation: 你们三人刚坐稳，电影便开始，塔拉瑞尔兴奋尖叫。你们拿着零食靠在座位上观看；每个动作场面的高潮都被周围的欢呼、惊呼与掌声包围。菲西安娜似乎彻底黏在屏幕上，几乎没碰零食，于是你和塔拉瑞尔趁机偶尔偷吃一些。电影接近结尾，主角们终于摧毁狂暴机器人时，狐女欢呼得格外响亮。附近几个人试图让她安静，可狐妖形态的女子完全没注意到。

The three of you sit back with your snacks and watch the movie, surrounded by cheers, gasps, and applause at the climax of each action scene. Fisianna seems glued to the screen. She is barely touching her snacks which you and Tarariel take advantage of and occasionally sneak a little helping. The fox-girl cheers especially loud near the end of the movie when the protagonists are able to finally destroy the rampaging android. Several people in the immediate vicinity of her try to quiet her down but the kitsune-morph is completely oblivious to them."

rows.original: Once the movie is over, the three of you head out into the still crowded lobby. Tarariel gives a big cheer as she raises her fist in the air. “That was awesome! You guys have to see the sequel with me! You’re gonna be the first people I think of comin’ with me when that happens!”
rows.translation: 电影结束后，你们三人走进仍然拥挤的大厅。塔拉瑞尔高举拳头，大声欢呼。“太棒了！你们必须和我一起看续集！到时候我第一个想到的观影伙伴就是你们！”
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce the movie is over, the three of you head out into the still crowded lobby. Tarariel gives a big cheer as she raises her fist in the air. “That was awesome! You guys have to see the sequel with me! You’re gonna be the first people I think of comin’ with me when that happens!”"

rows.original: Fisianna frowns slightly at Tarariel’s overexcitement. “Mmm... it was ok. I mean... I would have to question a few things about the movie. Like in the future, how did those rogue AIs even get through proper screenings without the UGC noticing the faulty and malicious coding? They didn’t go that far back into the past where regulations would have been changed all that much. Why didn’t the hero bring back any sort of fail-safe to deactivate the AI first, seeing as they were fighting them in the future? I bet it would have been pretty easy to at least code something to stop that specific AI. Also, what abo-” The rambling neko is stopped short when Tarariel firmly places a hand on her shoulder.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜对塔拉瑞尔过度兴奋的表现微微皱眉。“嗯...还可以。我是说...电影里有些地方让我很怀疑。比如在未来，那些失控人工智能究竟怎么通过正规审查，而UGC却没发现错误恶意代码？他们回到的过去又没有久远到监管规定发生巨大变化。既然英雄未来一直在和它们作战，为什么没有带任何故障保护程序回来，先让人工智能停机？至少为阻止那个特定人工智能编写某种代码应该很容易。另外，关于——”塔拉瑞尔坚定地把手按在肩上，打断这个喋喋不休的猫娘。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna frowns slightly at Tarariel’s overexcitement. “Mmm... it was ok. I mean... I would have to question a few things about the movie. Like in the future, how did those rogue AIs even get through proper screenings without the UGC noticing the faulty and malicious coding? They didn’t go that far back into the past where regulations would have been changed all that much. Why didn’t the hero bring back any sort of fail-safe to deactivate the AI first, seeing as they were fighting them in the future? I bet it would have been pretty easy to at least code something to stop that specific AI. Also, what abo-” The rambling neko is stopped short when Tarariel firmly places a hand on her shoulder."

rows.original: “Jeez, Fisi! Relax! It’s just a fictional movie! It’s nothin’ to get your panties in a bunch about. So what if there’s a few... inconsistencies that the movie has compared to what ya do for a livin’. Just have fun pretending from the point of view of someone who doesn’t know any better! Live a little, girl! Sheesh!” Tarariel sighs with an exasperated expression on her face. Fisianna blushes when she realizes that she might have taken her ranting a little too far.
rows.translation: “天哪，菲茜！放松！这只是虚构电影！没必要为它把内裤都拧成一团。就算电影和你的职业相比有些...不一致又怎么样。站在什么都不懂的普通人角度，开心地假装一下就好！好好享受生活，姑娘！真是的！”塔拉瑞尔满脸无奈地叹息。菲西安娜意识到自己的长篇大论可能有些过头，脸红起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Jeez, Fisi! Relax! It’s just a fictional movie! It’s nothin’ to get your panties in a bunch about. So what if there’s a few... inconsistencies that the movie has compared to what ya do for a livin’. Just have fun pretending from the point of view of someone who doesn’t know any better! Live a little, girl! Sheesh!” Tarariel sighs with an exasperated expression on her face. Fisianna blushes when she realizes that she might have taken her ranting a little too far."

rows.original: “O-oh... sorry. I kinda got carried away. My inner nerd was going crazy during that entire movie and just needed to come out. Heh...” Fisianna smiles sheepishly. “If it helps though, I did enjoy the action scenes, and it did help me broaden my horizons a bit when it comes to developing AIs, if only by a little.”
rows.translation: “哦——哦...抱歉。我有点得意忘形了。整部电影里，我内心的书呆子都快疯掉，非得发泄出来。呵...”菲西安娜羞涩微笑。“不过如果有帮助的话，我确实很喜欢那些动作场面；在开发人工智能方面，它也稍微帮我开阔了一点视野，哪怕只有一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh... sorry. I kinda got carried away. My inner nerd was going crazy during that entire movie and just needed to come out. Heh...” Fisianna smiles sheepishly. “If it helps though, I did enjoy the action scenes, and it did help me broaden my horizons a bit when it comes to developing AIs, if only by a little.”"

rows.original: Tarariel’s expression sinks to one of worry and anxiety, which is a rarity from what you’ve seen of her so far. “Say... I hope that doesn’t mean that you’re gonna start makin’ an army of killer robots to try to take over the galaxy, are ya?” Tarariel laughs nervously.
rows.translation: 塔拉瑞尔的表情变得担忧焦虑；根据你目前对她的了解，这非常罕见。“那个...希望这不意味着你准备制造一支杀手机器人大军，试图统治银河，对吧？”塔拉瑞尔紧张地笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\nTarariel’s expression sinks to one of worry and anxiety, which is a rarity from what you’ve seen of her so far. “Say... I hope that doesn’t mean that you’re gonna start makin’ an army of killer robots to try to take over the galaxy, are ya?” Tarariel laughs nervously."

rows.original: At first Fisianna’s eyes open wide in shock at that suggestion, but after noticing Tarariel’s rare show of unease, she forms a sly smile on her lips. “Mmm, maybe... After seeing this movie, I am definitely thinking of doing something like that, and you’ll be my first victim.” The neko subtly winks at you as Tarariel shrinks back in fear. The two of you laugh off the joke while fox-girl scolds Fisianna for scaring her. After Fisianna manages to calm her down, the three of you talk about possible advancements for AI programs before deciding to call it a day.
rows.translation: 起初，菲西安娜因这个猜测震惊地睁大双眼；可注意到塔拉瑞尔罕见的不安后，嘴角浮现狡黠微笑。“嗯，也许吧...看完这部电影后，我确实在考虑做些类似事情，而你会成为第一个受害者。”猫娘悄悄朝你眨眼，塔拉瑞尔则害怕地向后缩去。你们二人笑着揭过玩笑，狐女却责怪菲西安娜吓到自己。等菲西安娜成功让她平静下来，你们三人讨论了人工智能程序可能的发展，随后决定今天到此为止。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt first Fisianna’s eyes open wide in shock at that suggestion, but after noticing Tarariel’s rare show of unease, she forms a sly smile on her lips. “Mmm, maybe... After seeing this movie, I am definitely thinking of doing something like that, and you’ll be my first victim.” The neko subtly winks at you as Tarariel shrinks back in fear. The two of you laugh off the joke while fox-girl scolds Fisianna for scaring her. After Fisianna manages to calm her down, the three of you talk about possible advancements for AI programs before deciding to call it a day."

rows.original: The two of you make your way inside. You are surprised to see that the theater lobby is heavily crowded. Numerous walkways lead into different screening rooms, giving you the impression that this theater is likely a multiplex. You can smell all of the delicious movie snacks being sold at the nearby stalls. Among the crowd in the lobby, you spot a familiar ebony scaled dragoness: it’s Britannia! You and Fisianna make your way over to her while she breaks away from the small group of people she was previously conversing with.
rows.translation: 你们两人走了进去。影院大厅里人山人海，令你颇为惊讶。许多通道通往不同放映厅，让你觉得这家影院很可能是一座多厅影院。附近摊位出售的各种美味电影零食香气扑鼻。你在大厅人群中发现一位熟悉的乌黑鳞片龙女：是布里塔妮娅！你和菲西安娜朝她走去，而她也离开了先前与之交谈的一小群人。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you make your way inside. You are surprised to see that the theater lobby is heavily crowded. Numerous walkways lead into different screening rooms, giving you the impression that this theater is likely a multiplex. You can smell all of the delicious movie snacks being sold at the nearby stalls. Among the crowd in the lobby, you spot a familiar ebony scaled dragoness: it’s Britannia! You and Fisianna make your way over to her while she breaks away from the small group of people she was previously conversing with."

rows.original: “Hello, Kitten. Hello, Steele. Pleasure meeting the both of you here.” Britannia greets the both of you gently. “I assume that you’re here to see a movie and don’t know what to see yet?”
rows.translation: “你好，小猫。你好，斯蒂尔。很高兴在这里见到你们两位。”布里塔妮娅温和地向你们问候。“我猜你们是来看电影的，而且还没决定看什么，对吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello, Kitten. Hello, Steele. Pleasure meeting the both of you here.” Britannia greets the both of you gently. “I assume that you’re here to see a movie and don’t know what to see yet?”"

rows.original: Is this woman psionic or something?!
rows.translation: 这个女人难道有灵能还是什么吗？！
rows.raw: "\n\nIs this woman psionic or something?!"

rows.original: “W-wow, you’re right Bri!” Fisianna exclaims with a wide-eyed stare in disbelief at Britannia. The dragon-morph laughs gently in response to Fisianna’s expression.
rows.translation: “哇—哇，你说对了，布里！”菲西安娜瞪大双眼，难以置信地望着布里塔妮娅惊呼。看到她的神情，这位龙化人温柔地笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-wow, you’re right Bri!” Fisianna exclaims with a wide-eyed stare in disbelief at Britannia. The dragon-morph laughs gently in response to Fisianna’s expression."

rows.original: “Mmm, I thought so. Tell you what? Would the two of you like to see a movie with me perhaps? I was feeling in the mood for a romance movie this time around. I’ll even pay for the tickets for you as gratitude for the company. Snacks included.” Britannia smiles warmly as she waves a
rows.translation: “嗯，我就知道。这样如何？你们两位愿意和我一起看场电影吗？这次我正想看一部爱情片。为了感谢你们陪我，我甚至可以替你们买票，零食也算在内。”布里塔妮娅温暖地笑着，挥了挥一张
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm, I thought so. Tell you what? Would the two of you like to see a movie with me perhaps? I was feeling in the mood for a romance movie this time around. I’ll even pay for the tickets for you as gratitude for the company. Snacks included.” Britannia smiles warmly as she waves a "

rows.original: dogecoin
rows.translation: 狗狗币
rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.original: credit chit
rows.translation: 信用筹码
rows.raw: "credit chit"

rows.original: to emphasise her point. Who are you to pass that up?
rows.translation: ，以此强调自己的话。这样的好事，你有什么理由拒绝？
rows.raw: " to emphasise her point. Who are you to pass that up?"

rows.original: “A-a romance m-movie?”
rows.translation: “爱—爱情片？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A-a romance m-movie?” "

rows.original: You can see Fisianna visibly blushing while trying to hide a small smile.
rows.translation: 你看得出菲西安娜明显红了脸，同时试图藏起一抹浅笑。
rows.raw: "You can see Fisianna visibly blushing while trying to hide a small smile."

rows.original: You can see Fisianna visibly blushing as she tries to avoid eye contact with you.
rows.translation: 你看得出菲西安娜明显红了脸，同时试图避开与你对视。
rows.raw: "You can see Fisianna visibly blushing as she tries to avoid eye contact with you."

rows.original: “Erm... sure, I-I mean, since you’re offering.”
rows.translation: “呃...好—好吧，我是说，既然是你邀请。”
rows.raw: " “Erm... sure, I-I mean, since you’re offering.”"

rows.original: Britannia’s smile grows wider while she procures three tickets from her pocket and hands two of them out to you and Fisianna. “So she already brought these ahead of time? She really must be psionic...” You wonder aloud to yourself, but it looks like Britannia caught on to your external monologue.
rows.translation: 布里塔妮娅笑得更加灿烂；她从口袋里取出三张票，将其中两张分别递给你和菲西安娜。“所以她早就把票买好了？她真的一定有灵能...”你不自觉地把心中所想说出了口，看样子布里塔妮娅听见了你的自言自语。
rows.raw: "\n\nBritannia’s smile grows wider while she procures three tickets from her pocket and hands two of them out to you and Fisianna. “So she already brought these ahead of time? She really must be psionic...” You wonder aloud to yourself, but it looks like Britannia caught on to your external monologue."

rows.original: “No, not at all. I just bought too many tickets to start with.” Britannia giggles. “That’s why you saw me talking with that group of people before. I was wondering if they wanted to see it with me, but well... I think some people find me a little too... imposing to believe me to be interested in romance. Plus, I saw you two come in the theater so I thought it would be nice to treat two of my best friends, hm?”
rows.translation: “不，完全没有。我只是一开始买了太多票。”布里塔妮娅咯咯笑道。“所以你们刚才才会看到我和那群人交谈。我在问他们愿不愿意和我一起看，不过...我想有些人觉得我太过...威严，很难相信我会对爱情片感兴趣。再说，我看到你们两个走进影院，便觉得请两位最好的朋友看一场也不错，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, not at all. I just bought too many tickets to start with.” Britannia giggles. “That’s why you saw me talking with that group of people before. I was wondering if they wanted to see it with me, but well... I think some people find me a little too... imposing to believe me to be interested in romance. Plus, I saw you two come in the theater so I thought it would be nice to treat two of my best friends, hm?”"

rows.original: She brings up a fair point. A suspicious, but still fair point. Before you can ponder on which side to believe, Britannia motions over towards the snack bar. “I’ll go and buy us all some snacks to keep us entertained. You can go on in ahead of me and find us seats. I’ll be able to spot the both of you.”
rows.translation: 她说得有道理。虽然可疑，却仍然有道理。你还没来得及思考该相信哪一边，布里塔妮娅便指向零食吧。“我去给大家买些零食解闷。你们可以先进去找座位，我会找到你们的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe brings up a fair point. A suspicious, but still fair point. Before you can ponder on which side to believe, Britannia motions over towards the snack bar. “I’ll go and buy us all some snacks to keep us entertained. You can go on in ahead of me and find us seats. I’ll be able to spot the both of you.”"

rows.original: Fisianna nods in agreement and leads you over to the screening room where your movie is airing. Once inside, you notice the room isn’t terribly full like the lobby was. There are a lot of couples seated together as you would expect. Some of them are already engaged in make out sessions. Fisianna notices this as well and the blush on her face darkens even more.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜点头同意，带你走向播放那部电影的放映厅。进去后，你发现这里并不像大厅那样拥挤。当然，正如预料，确实有许多情侣坐在一起，其中一些已经开始热吻。菲西安娜也注意到了，脸上的红晕变得更深。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna nods in agreement and leads you over to the screening room where your movie is airing. Once inside, you notice the room isn’t terribly full like the lobby was. There are a lot of couples seated together as you would expect. Some of them are already engaged in make out sessions. Fisianna notices this as well and the blush on her face darkens even more."

rows.original: “L-let’s just find room for all three of us, yeah?” Fisianna asks sheepishly, trying to shake away the sight of the embracing couples in the screening room. The both of you make your way towards the first set of three seaters open near the entrance so it would be easier for Britannia to spot you when she comes back with the snacks. When the two of you sit down, you sit in
rows.translation: “我—我们找个能坐下三个人的位置，好吗？”菲西安娜羞怯地问道，努力把放映厅里相拥的情侣赶出脑海。你们走向入口附近第一组空着的三连座，这样布里塔妮娅带着零食回来时更容易发现你们。坐下后，你们陷入
rows.raw: "\n\n“L-let’s just find room for all three of us, yeah?” Fisianna asks sheepishly, trying to shake away the sight of the embracing couples in the screening room. The both of you make your way towards the first set of three seaters open near the entrance so it would be easier for Britannia to spot you when she comes back with the snacks. When the two of you sit down, you sit in "

rows.original: silence, holding hands
rows.translation: 沉默，牵着彼此的手
rows.raw: "silence, holding hands"

rows.original: awkward silence
rows.translation: 尴尬的沉默
rows.raw: "awkward silence"

rows.original: for the good part of a minute before Fisianna speaks up.
rows.translation: ，足足持续了将近一分钟，菲西安娜才开口。
rows.raw: " for the good part of a minute before Fisianna speaks up."

rows.original: “U-um, [pc.name]?” Is all she can manage to say before Britannia shows up with snacks in hand, and boy, she bought a lot of snacks!
rows.translation: “那—那个，[pc.name]？”她才勉强说出这几个字，布里塔妮娅便带着零食出现了；天哪，她买的零食也太多了！
rows.raw: "\n\n“U-um, [pc.name]?” Is all she can manage to say before Britannia shows up with snacks in hand, and boy, she bought a lot of snacks!"

rows.original: “Hehe, enjoy!” The generous dragoness giggles as she passes the snacks around to you and Fisianna. She finishes just as the movie starts up, prompting all the embracing couples in the room to pay attention to the screen.
rows.translation: “嘿嘿，请享用！”慷慨的龙女咯咯笑着，把零食分给你和菲西安娜。她刚好在电影开始时分完，放映厅里所有相拥的情侣也随之把注意力转向屏幕。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hehe, enjoy!” The generous dragoness giggles as she passes the snacks around to you and Fisianna. She finishes just as the movie starts up, prompting all the embracing couples in the room to pay attention to the screen."

rows.original: For the most part during the movie, nothing happens outside of the norm for typical romance flicks. When the main characters reunite after a lengthy separation from each other and share a passionate kiss, most of the couples in the theater join in their example as well, turning the screening room into a softcore orgy. While observing this, you catch a glance at Britannia, who is already shooting you a look with a knowing sideways smile on her face. Before you can confirm if she is leading you on, she winks and makes a subtle gesture with her head pointing towards Fisianna. Turning the opposite way, you just manage to see Fisianna leaning slightly towards you with an expectant look in her eyes. A split second later, she realizes what she is doing and her eyes widen before she turns around rapidly, covering her face with a wave of orange and white hair. Britannia giggles before she turns back to the screen and eats a bite of popcorn. The movie finishes shortly after the actors finish kissing and the three of you make your way back the lobby.
rows.translation: 电影大部分时间都没有发生任何超出典型爱情片套路的事。两位主角经历漫长分离后终于重逢，并深情拥吻；影院里的大多数情侣也纷纷效仿，让放映厅变成一场软色情群交。观察这一幕时，你瞥向布里塔妮娅，发现她正以心照不宣的侧目微笑望着你。还没等你确认她是否在暗示什么，她便眨了眨眼，脑袋微微指向菲西安娜。你转向另一侧，刚好看见菲西安娜略微朝你倾身，眼中满是期待。半秒之后，她意识到自己在做什么，双眼猛然睁大，迅速转过身，用一片橙白相间的头发遮住脸。布里塔妮娅咯咯一笑，转回屏幕，吃了一口爆米花。演员结束亲吻后不久，电影也落下帷幕；你们三人一起返回大厅。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor the most part during the movie, nothing happens outside of the norm for typical romance flicks. When the main characters reunite after a lengthy separation from each other and share a passionate kiss, most of the couples in the theater join in their example as well, turning the screening room into a softcore orgy. While observing this, you catch a glance at Britannia, who is already shooting you a look with a knowing sideways smile on her face. Before you can confirm if she is leading you on, she winks and makes a subtle gesture with her head pointing towards Fisianna. Turning the opposite way, you just manage to see Fisianna leaning slightly towards you with an expectant look in her eyes. A split second later, she realizes what she is doing and her eyes widen before she turns around rapidly, covering her face with a wave of orange and white hair. Britannia giggles before she turns back to the screen and eats a bite of popcorn. The movie finishes shortly after the actors finish kissing and the three of you make your way back the lobby."

rows.original: “Well, that was fun! Hopefully I can run into the two of you again to catch another movie. For now, I believe I’ll leave the two of you alone.” Britannia says with a wink to you. “I’m definitely going for another movie before I retire.” She adds while she walks towards the ticket booth again. You and Fisianna thank her for treating you to a free movie and turn towards each other. Fisianna still has the remains of a bright blush on her face from earlier. With you and your feline companion alone, you have to wonder.
rows.translation: “嗯，真有趣！希望以后还能碰到你们两个，再一起看场电影。现在，我想该让你们独处了。”布里塔妮娅冲你眨眼说道。“不过我回去休息前肯定还要再看一场。”她补充着，再次走向售票处。你和菲西安娜感谢她请你们免费看电影，随后转向彼此。菲西安娜脸上仍残留着先前的鲜明红晕。现在只剩你和猫科同伴，你不禁想知道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, that was fun! Hopefully I can run into the two of you again to catch another movie. For now, I believe I’ll leave the two of you alone.” Britannia says with a wink to you. “I’m definitely going for another movie before I retire.” She adds while she walks towards the ticket booth again. You and Fisianna thank her for treating you to a free movie and turn towards each other. Fisianna still has the remains of a bright blush on her face from earlier. With you and your feline companion alone, you have to wonder."

rows.original: “So, Fisi. What were you about to ask me when the movie was about to start?”
rows.translation: “所以，菲西。电影快开始时，你原本想问我什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, Fisi. What were you about to ask me when the movie was about to start?”"

rows.original: “O-oh... I was just going to ask if you if you wanted to kiss me.” Fisianna blushes even more profusely while fidgeting on the spot. You lightly chuckle at this and lean in to plant a gentle kiss on the shy kitten’s peachy lips. She takes your smooch in earnest, leaning in to your body to kiss you back just as passionately. After the two of you break the kiss, Fisianna smiles back at you warmly in gratitude.
rows.translation: “噢—哦...我只是想问你愿不愿意亲我。”菲西安娜在原地局促不安，脸也红得更加厉害。你轻笑一声，俯身在这只害羞小猫桃色的双唇上温柔一吻。她认真接受你的亲吻，身体贴近你，以同样的热情回吻。双唇分开后，菲西安娜感激地朝你露出温暖笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh... I was just going to ask if you if you wanted to kiss me.” Fisianna blushes even more profusely while fidgeting on the spot. You lightly chuckle at this and lean in to plant a gentle kiss on the shy kitten’s peachy lips. She takes your smooch in earnest, leaning in to your body to kiss you back just as passionately. After the two of you break the kiss, Fisianna smiles back at you warmly in gratitude."

rows.original: “Thank you so much for that sweet treat, [pc.name]. I had a fun time with you. I hope we can do this again. For now, I’m a little tired so I think I’ll go home and rest, okay?”
rows.translation: “非常感谢这份甜蜜招待，[pc.name]。和你一起很开心，希望以后还能再来。现在我有点累了，想回家休息，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you so much for that sweet treat, [pc.name]. I had a fun time with you. I hope we can do this again. For now, I’m a little tired so I think I’ll go home and rest, okay?”"

rows.original: You nod in acknowledgement, happy to have satisfied Fisianna’s request. You bid her farewell when the two of you make it back out of the theater and by the elevator shafts on the Merchant Deck.
rows.translation: 你点头表示明白，很高兴满足了菲西安娜的请求。你们走出影院，回到商业甲板的电梯井旁时，你向她道别。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod in acknowledgement, happy to have satisfied Fisianna’s request. You bid her farewell when the two of you make it back out of the theater and by the elevator shafts on the Merchant Deck."

rows.original: “O-oh! Uh... N-n-nothing!” Fisianna stammers nervously. You are about to press her when she backs away a step, almost running into a passerby. After profusely apologising to them, her blush deepens in embarrassment.
rows.translation: “噢—哦！呃...没—没什么！”菲西安娜紧张地结巴道。你正要追问，她却后退一步，差点撞上一名路人。她连声向对方道歉，随后因尴尬而脸红得更加厉害。
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh! Uh... N-n-nothing!” Fisianna stammers nervously. You are about to press her when she backs away a step, almost running into a passerby. After profusely apologising to them, her blush deepens in embarrassment. "

rows.original: “I-I had a fun time with you, [pc.name]. I hope we can do this again. For now, I’m a little tired so I think I’ll go home and rest, okay?”
rows.translation: “和—和你一起很开心，[pc.name]。希望以后还能再来。现在我有点累了，想回家休息，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I had a fun time with you, [pc.name]. I hope we can do this again. For now, I’m a little tired so I think I’ll go home and rest, okay?”"

rows.original: You nod in acknowledgement, deciding not to press her on the issue after all, since she seemed quite nervous about it. You bid her farewell when the two of you make it back out of the theater and by the elevator shafts on the Merchant Deck.
rows.translation: 你点头表示明白；见她似乎对此非常紧张，你最终决定不再追问。你们走出影院，回到商业甲板的电梯井旁时，你向她道别。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod in acknowledgement, deciding not to press her on the issue after all, since she seemed quite nervous about it. You bid her farewell when the two of you make it back out of the theater and by the elevator shafts on the Merchant Deck."

rows.original: You decide to change your mind about traveling somewhere with Fisianna.
rows.translation: 你改变主意，决定不和菲西安娜去别处了。
rows.raw: "You decide to change your mind about traveling somewhere with Fisianna."

rows.original: “O-oh, ok. I’m perfectly fine with staying here too. Just let me know whenever you do want to go somewhere. I’m up for anything else you might have planned.” Fisianna says expectantly.
rows.translation: “噢—哦，好吧。留在这里我也完全没问题。以后想去哪里时尽管告诉我，你可能还有其他安排的话，我也什么都愿意做。”菲西安娜满怀期待地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh, ok. I’m perfectly fine with staying here too. Just let me know whenever you do want to go somewhere. I’m up for anything else you might have planned.” Fisianna says expectantly."

rows.original: Hangout
rows.translation: 聚会
rows.raw: "Hangout"

rows.original: Go hangout someplace with Fisianna. You might bump into a friend of hers.
rows.translation: 和菲西安娜去某个地方逛逛。你们也许会碰上她的一位朋友。
rows.raw: "Go hangout someplace with Fisianna. You might bump into a friend of hers."

rows.translation: 你还不够了解她，不知道她可能喜欢去哪里消遣。
rows.raw: "You don’t know her well enough to know where she might like to hang out."

rows.original: It doesn’t look like she wants to take things further due to your formidable anatomy.
rows.translation: 鉴于你那令人望而生畏的身体结构，她似乎不愿把关系推进到更深入的程度。
rows.raw: "It doesn’t look like she wants to take things further due to your formidable anatomy."

rows.translation: 你的信用点不足，无法带她出去约会。
rows.raw: "You don’t have enough credits to taker her out on a date."
