rows.translation: 出问题了：未处理的约会编号
rows.raw: "SOMETHINGS FUCKED: UNHANDLED DATE NUMBER"

rows.original: MERCHANT'S THOROUGHFARE2
rows.raw: "MERCHANT'S THOROUGHFARE2"

rows.original: You ask Fisianna if she would like to go on a date with you, now that the two of you are a couple. Her ears perk up and her tails wiggle faster behind her when you raise the question of going out somewhere with her.
rows.translation: 既然你和菲西安娜已经成为情侣，你问她愿不愿意和你约会。你提起要和她一起出去逛逛时，她的耳朵顿时竖起，身后的尾巴也摇得更快。
rows.raw: "You ask Fisianna if she would like to go on a date with you, now that the two of you are a couple. Her ears perk up and her tails wiggle faster behind her when you raise the question of going out somewhere with her."

rows.original: “S-sure! I’d love to go with you! Was there anywhere you had in mind?” Fisianna asks sweetly.
rows.translation: “当、当然！我很想和你一起去！你有什么想去的地方吗？”菲西安娜甜甜地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“S-sure! I’d love to go with you! Was there anywhere you had in mind?” Fisianna asks sweetly."

rows.original: You try to think of what would be a good place to have your first date as a couple on. Nothing comes to mind immediately, though Fisianna speaks up before the silence extends for too long.
rows.translation: 你开始思考第一次以情侣身份约会，去什么地方会比较好。你一时没有想到，不过沉默尚未持续太久，菲西安娜便开口了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to think of what would be a good place to have your first date as a couple on. Nothing comes to mind immediately, though Fisianna speaks up before the silence extends for too long."

rows.original: “U-um... I was thinking... would you like to go to the arcade again? Just the two of us?”
rows.translation: “呃...我在想...你愿意再去一次街机厅吗？就我们两个？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“U-um... I was thinking... would you like to go to the arcade again? Just the two of us?”"

rows.original: You wonder why Fisianna would want to go to the arcade of all places first, since you both can go there together at any time to have fun.
rows.translation: 你有些疑惑，菲西安娜第一次约会为何偏偏想去街机厅，毕竟你们随时都可以一起去那里玩。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wonder why Fisianna would want to go to the arcade of all places first, since you both can go there together at any time to have fun."

rows.original: “W-well... it’s the place I feel most comfortable in at the moment, besides next to you of course. I-I thought we could start dating with something in more familiar territory. You don’t have to spoil me with fancy dinners or anything, though that wouldn’t be a bad idea either...” Fisianna adds the last part with a playful undertone to her voice. You pretend not to acknowledge the idea of a candlelit dinner, but keep it in mind just in case. You take up Fisianna’s offer for a date to the arcade and grab her paw in your hand as you both rise from the bench and head to the elevator shafts.
rows.translation: “嗯...目前除了待在你身边，那里就是最让我自在的地方。我、我想，我们可以从比较熟悉的环境开始约会。你不必用豪华晚餐之类的东西宠我，当然那也不是什么坏主意...”菲西安娜最后一句话带着俏皮的语气。你装作没注意到烛光晚餐的暗示，不过还是把这个主意记在心里，以备不时之需。你接受菲西安娜去街机厅约会的提议；你们从长椅起身走向电梯井时，你将她的爪子握在手中。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well... it’s the place I feel most comfortable in at the moment, besides next to you of course. I-I thought we could start dating with something in more familiar territory. You don’t have to spoil me with fancy dinners or anything, though that wouldn’t be a bad idea either...” Fisianna adds the last part with a playful undertone to her voice. You pretend not to acknowledge the idea of a candlelit dinner, but keep it in mind just in case. You take up Fisianna’s offer for a date to the arcade and grab her paw in your hand as you both rise from the bench and head to the elevator shafts."

rows.original: The two of you eventually arrive at the arcade without running into anyone familiar. Fisianna is already looking towards every gaming station in sight. Wrought with indecision, your playful date turns towards you with a thoughtful look on her face. “Mmm, what should we play first? We could play some CoV 8 if you wanted to, or Castle Mania, or anything else you have in mind. I’m up for anything!” Fisianna smiles gleefully at you.
rows.translation: 你们一路没有遇到熟人，最终抵达街机厅。菲西安娜已经开始环顾视野内的每一台游戏机。你这位活泼的约会对象难以取舍，于是转向你，露出若有所思的神情。“嗯，我们先玩什么？你愿意的话，可以玩《英勇召唤8》，或者《城堡狂热》，也可以玩你想到的其他游戏。什么都行！”菲西安娜兴高采烈地朝你微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you eventually arrive at the arcade without running into anyone familiar. Fisianna is already looking towards every gaming station in sight. Wrought with indecision, your playful date turns towards you with a thoughtful look on her face. “Mmm, what should we play first? We could play some CoV 8 if you wanted to, or Castle Mania, or anything else you have in mind. I’m up for anything!” Fisianna smiles gleefully at you."

rows.original: Since it is just the two of you at the arcade this time, you think it might be a good idea to do something different this time. In a corner of the arcade, you spot a number of games that look remarkably similar to games you would find at a terran carnival, complete with prizes. You point at the section with the carnival-like activities to Fisianna and ask if she would like to try her hand at playing those for now.
rows.translation: 这次街机厅里只有你们两人，你觉得尝试一些不同的活动或许不错。你在街机厅一角发现了几台游戏，看起来与地球游乐场里的项目非常相似，奖品也一应俱全。你向菲西安娜指出那片游乐场风格的游戏区，问她现在是否想试试身手。
rows.raw: "\n\nSince it is just the two of you at the arcade this time, you think it might be a good idea to do something different this time. In a corner of the arcade, you spot a number of games that look remarkably similar to games you would find at a terran carnival, complete with prizes. You point at the section with the carnival-like activities to Fisianna and ask if she would like to try her hand at playing those for now."

rows.original: “Oh sure! That looks like it could be some fun!” Fisianna places her paw into your hand as you make your over to the carnival-like games together.
rows.translation: “好啊！看起来会很有趣！”你们一同走向游乐场风格的游戏时，菲西安娜把爪子放进你的手中。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh sure! That looks like it could be some fun!” Fisianna places her paw into your hand as you make your over to the carnival-like games together."

rows.original: The first activity that catches Fisianna’s eye is a “Shoot the Target” game. It looks pretty standard from what you can see. There are several red targets moving along a track, which can be shot down with what looks like a light gun about the size of a small rifle. A side display shows the prizes that can be won for hitting a certain amount of targets. One of the prizes catches Fisianna’s eye and she smooshes her face on the glass panel to try to find a better view of the item she is fawning over. It looks like an oversized stuffed cat that is mostly white in color with splotches of brown and black all over it. Once she is done examining the stuffed toy, she runs over to you and grabs your hands, giving you a pleading look. “Please, please, please! Can you try to win me that cute stuffed cat? I’m not the best of shots and I’d love to have it back at my apartment!”
rows.translation: 第一个吸引菲西安娜注意的是名为“射击目标”的游戏。从你所见来看，它相当标准。几块红色标靶沿轨道移动，玩家可以用一把大小近似小型步枪的光线枪将其击倒。侧面的展示板列出了击中相应数量标靶可以赢得的奖品。其中一件奖品吸引了菲西安娜的目光；她把脸贴到玻璃板上，努力想看清自己迷上的东西。那似乎是一只超大号猫咪布偶，主体呈白色，浑身散布棕色和黑色斑块。看够布偶后，她跑到你身边抓住你的手，以恳求的眼神望着你。“求你了，求你了，求你了！你能不能帮我赢下那只可爱的猫咪布偶？我的枪法不太好，而且我特别想把它带回公寓！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe first activity that catches Fisianna’s eye is a “Shoot the Target” game. It looks pretty standard from what you can see. There are several red targets moving along a track, which can be shot down with what looks like a light gun about the size of a small rifle. A side display shows the prizes that can be won for hitting a certain amount of targets. One of the prizes catches Fisianna’s eye and she smooshes her face on the glass panel to try to find a better view of the item she is fawning over. It looks like an oversized stuffed cat that is mostly white in color with splotches of brown and black all over it. Once she is done examining the stuffed toy, she runs over to you and grabs your hands, giving you a pleading look. “Please, please, please! Can you try to win me that cute stuffed cat? I’m not the best of shots and I’d love to have it back at my apartment!”"

rows.original: Seeing no reason to refuse, you grant Fisianna’s request. You offer to pay for your tries at the targets, and once you swipe your
rows.translation: 你想不到拒绝的理由，于是答应了菲西安娜的请求。你主动付钱购买射击机会；当你将
rows.raw: "\n\nSeeing no reason to refuse, you grant Fisianna’s request. You offer to pay for your tries at the targets, and once you swipe your "

rows.original: dogecoin
rows.translation: 狗狗币
rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.original: credit chit
rows.translation: 信用芯片
rows.raw: "credit chit"

rows.original: past the receiver, the game springs to life. Three red targets move in a uniform line at a steady pace. You pick up a light gun, and a display shows that you have three chances to down the targets. You look towards the prize display to check how many shots you would need to win the cat. To your dismay, you find that will need to hit all three shots to be able to obtain that prize. Well... the pressure is on now!
rows.translation: 划过读取器后，游戏随即启动。三块红色标靶以稳定速度排成整齐一列移动。你拿起光线枪，显示屏提示你有三次机会击倒这些标靶。你望向奖品展示板，确认要击中多少次才能赢得那只猫。令你沮丧的是，必须三枪全部命中才能获得那件奖品。好吧...现在压力可大了！
rows.raw: " past the receiver, the game springs to life. Three red targets move in a uniform line at a steady pace. You pick up a light gun, and a display shows that you have three chances to down the targets. You look towards the prize display to check how many shots you would need to win the cat. To your dismay, you find that will need to hit all three shots to be able to obtain that prize. Well... the pressure is on now!"

rows.original: After shaking off some nerves, you line up your shot and track one of the targets on your light rifle’s scope. It takes a few moments of careful aiming and adjusting before you make the attempt. Your first shot hits home, striking the target dead on. It falls backwards and out of sight as the display indicators flicker in response to your successful try. Fisianna whispers a near silent, “yes!” She smiles and waits for you to align your second shot.
rows.translation: 你摆脱些许紧张感，将一块标靶套入光线步枪的瞄准镜里，跟随着它移动。你仔细瞄准、调整了片刻，随后尝试开枪。第一枪正中目标，准确命中标靶中心。标靶向后倒下，消失在视野中；显示器的指示灯闪烁起来，对你的成功作出反应。菲西安娜几乎无声地低语：“太好了！”她笑着等待你瞄准第二枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter shaking off some nerves, you line up your shot and track one of the targets on your light rifle’s scope. It takes a few moments of careful aiming and adjusting before you make the attempt. Your first shot hits home, striking the target dead on. It falls backwards and out of sight as the display indicators flicker in response to your successful try. Fisianna whispers a near silent, “yes!” She smiles and waits for you to align your second shot."

rows.original: As you line up your second shot, you are beginning to think that this won’t be so hard after all, when to your chagrin, the targets begin to accelerate progressively faster. You silently curse your luck for underestimating the game and readjust your timing to the now increased pace of the targets’ movements. Once you have the timing down, you take your chance to fire at a carefully predicted spot where the two targets meet each other. You manage to hit the side of one of the intercepting targets, which folds over out of sight. Fisianna nods her head in approval, though she looks very nervous for you as she watches you ready up your third shot with bated breath.
rows.translation: 瞄准第二枪时，你开始觉得这终究没那么困难；然而令你懊恼的是，标靶开始逐渐加速。你暗自咒骂自己运气太差、低估了游戏，并根据标靶如今加快的移动速度重新调整时机。掌握节奏后，你朝两块标靶相遇位置的一个精心预测点开枪。你成功击中其中一块交错标靶的侧面，它随即折下去，消失在视野里。菲西安娜赞许地点点头，不过她看起来也替你紧张得不得了；她屏住呼吸，看着你准备第三枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you line up your second shot, you are beginning to think that this won’t be so hard after all, when to your chagrin, the targets begin to accelerate progressively faster. You silently curse your luck for underestimating the game and readjust your timing to the now increased pace of the targets’ movements. Once you have the timing down, you take your chance to fire at a carefully predicted spot where the two targets meet each other. You manage to hit the side of one of the intercepting targets, which folds over out of sight. Fisianna nods her head in approval, though she looks very nervous for you as she watches you ready up your third shot with bated breath."

rows.original: You take your aim at the last remaining target, which is moving at the same fast pace as before. You opt not to take the shot yet to watch for any changes in movement. Sure enough, the target starts to fluctuate in speed now. It is moving in very irregular patterns; sometimes moving blisteringly fast, other times tantalizingly slow. It even stalls to a standstill on occasion. It looks almost impossible to predict any sort of set pattern to take an easier shot on the lone target. Sighing, you take a deep breath to relax and train your sight on the target as best as you can, waiting for the moment when it slows down to a crawl. You hold your breath just as the target finally slows down enough to take aim at it. Taking the opportunity, you fire at it as soon as your crosshairs have it dead center on sight. At the moment you fire, the target jerks back to full speed, making you wonder for a split second if you hit it before the target just as abruptly stops again. You see that the target has a mark at the very edge of it, indicating a confirmed hit. The target folds back behind the line and out of sight, after which the prize panel lights up with a bright fanfare, declaring your victory. Fisianna rushes over to you and gives you a surprisingly crushing hug for someone of her small stature.
rows.translation: 你瞄准最后一块标靶，它仍以刚才的高速移动。你决定暂时不开枪，先观察其运动是否会发生变化。果然，标靶的速度开始波动。它以极不规律的模式移动：有时快得惊人，有时又慢得诱人，偶尔甚至完全停住。它似乎根本没有固定规律可供预测，让你无法轻松射中这最后一块标靶。你叹了口气，深呼吸让自己放松，尽力将准星锁定标靶，等待它减速至缓慢爬行的时刻。标靶终于慢到足以瞄准时，你屏住呼吸。抓住机会，准星正正对准目标中心的瞬间，你扣动扳机。就在开枪时，标靶猛然恢复全速，令你有一刹那怀疑自己是否命中；然而它又同样突然地停住。你看到标靶最边缘留有一道痕迹，说明确实击中了。标靶折回轨道后方，消失在视野中；随后奖品面板伴着明亮欢快的音乐亮起，宣布你取得胜利。菲西安娜冲到你身边，以与她娇小身材完全不相称的力道紧紧抱住你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take your aim at the last remaining target, which is moving at the same fast pace as before. You opt not to take the shot yet to watch for any changes in movement. Sure enough, the target starts to fluctuate in speed now. It is moving in very irregular patterns; sometimes moving blisteringly fast, other times tantalizingly slow. It even stalls to a standstill on occasion. It looks almost impossible to predict any sort of set pattern to take an easier shot on the lone target. Sighing, you take a deep breath to relax and train your sight on the target as best as you can, waiting for the moment when it slows down to a crawl. You hold your breath just as the target finally slows down enough to take aim at it. Taking the opportunity, you fire at it as soon as your crosshairs have it dead center on sight. At the moment you fire, the target jerks back to full speed, making you wonder for a split second if you hit it before the target just as abruptly stops again. You see that the target has a mark at the very edge of it, indicating a confirmed hit. The target folds back behind the line and out of sight, after which the prize panel lights up with a bright fanfare, declaring your victory. Fisianna rushes over to you and gives you a surprisingly crushing hug for someone of her small stature."

rows.original: “You did it! You really did it! I was so nervous for you, but you did it! You’re the best, [pc.name]!” Fisianna looks into your eyes with joy written all over her face while her tails are wiggling a mile a minute behind her.
rows.translation: “你成功了！真的成功了！我刚才紧张死了，但你做到了！你最棒了，[pc.name]！”菲西安娜望进你的双眼，满脸喜悦；身后的尾巴正飞快摇摆。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You did it! You really did it! I was so nervous for you, but you did it! You’re the best, [pc.name]!” Fisianna looks into your eyes with joy written all over her face while her tails are wiggling a mile a minute behind her."

rows.original: After Fisianna lets you go, you triumphantly [pc.walk] over to the prize panel and pick out the stuffed cat Fisianna wanted. After it drops into the nearby receptacle, you hand the plushie over to her. She hugs her new toy and sets it aside on a nearby table before wrapping her arms around you again.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜松开你后，你得意地[pc.walk]向奖品面板，选中她想要的猫咪布偶。布偶落进旁边的取物口后，你把它交给她。她抱了抱自己的新玩具，将其放到附近桌上，随后再次伸手抱住你。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter Fisianna lets you go, you triumphantly [pc.walk] over to the prize panel and pick out the stuffed cat Fisianna wanted. After it drops into the nearby receptacle, you hand the plushie over to her. She hugs her new toy and sets it aside on a nearby table before wrapping her arms around you again."

rows.original: “T-thank you so much, [pc.name]. I’ll treasure this cute thing forever, since it was from you. I love you!” Fisianna adds with a sweet smile.
rows.translation: “真、真的非常谢谢你，[pc.name]。这可爱的东西是你送给我的，我会永远珍惜它。我爱你！”菲西安娜甜甜地笑着补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“T-thank you so much, [pc.name]. I’ll treasure this cute thing forever, since it was from you. I love you!” Fisianna adds with a sweet smile."

rows.original: The two of you decide to play a few more carnival games together, with varying success. When about an hour has passed, you decide it would be a good time to take a break for today and head your separate ways for now. Fisianna gives you another kiss as you say your goodbyes outside of the arcade.
rows.translation: 你们决定再一起玩几项游乐场游戏，结果有输有赢。大约一小时后，你觉得今天该休息了，暂时各自离开。你们在街机厅外告别时，菲西安娜又吻了你一次。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you decide to play a few more carnival games together, with varying success. When about an hour has passed, you decide it would be a good time to take a break for today and head your separate ways for now. Fisianna gives you another kiss as you say your goodbyes outside of the arcade."

rows.original: “I had the best time with you, [pc.name]. Let’s do this again more often, just the two of us!”
rows.translation: “今天和你一起玩得太开心了，[pc.name]。以后多来几次吧，就我们两个！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I had the best time with you, [pc.name]. Let’s do this again more often, just the two of us!”"

rows.original: Fisianna lights up in excitement at the mention of going out on a second date. “[pc.name]! I have some wonderful news! I just found out that a new deck just recently opened up here! It’s supposed to be a grand park of some sort. Luscious greenery everywhere complete with various ponds and waterfalls. It also has small forests to take hikes in. They even have artificial sky effects that work in real time as well! I hear it feels just like being outside.”
rows.translation: 听说要进行第二次约会，菲西安娜兴奋得双眼发亮。“[pc.name]！我有个好消息！我刚刚得知，这里最近开放了一层新甲板！据说那是一座宏伟的公园，到处都是繁茂绿植，还有各种池塘和瀑布。那里也有适合徒步的小型森林，甚至还有能够实时运作的人造天空效果！我听说感觉就像真的在户外一样。”
rows.raw: "Fisianna lights up in excitement at the mention of going out on a second date. “[pc.name]! I have some wonderful news! I just found out that a new deck just recently opened up here! It’s supposed to be a grand park of some sort. Luscious greenery everywhere complete with various ponds and waterfalls. It also has small forests to take hikes in. They even have artificial sky effects that work in real time as well! I hear it feels just like being outside.”"

rows.original: Fisianna reaches over her the side of the bench and procures a medium sized basket covered with a white cloth. The smells that emanate from the basket are tantalizingly delicious. “So would you like to check it out with me for our second date, y-y’know... if you want to? I even brought a picnic set complete with snacks and drinks for the day!” Fisianna smiles cutely. She already seems to have everything planned out so you aren’t one to say otherwise. You agree to go check out the new park, to which the excited feline jumps out of her seat with joy.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜伸手越过长椅一侧，拿出一个盖着白布的中型篮子。篮中飘出的气味诱人极了。“所以，你愿意和我一起去看看，把那里当作我们的第二次约会吗？你、你知道的...如果你愿意？我甚至准备了完整的野餐套装，还有今天吃的零食和饮料！”菲西安娜可爱地笑了。她似乎早已安排好一切，你自然不会提出异议。你答应去看看新公园，兴奋的猫娘高兴得从座位上跳了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna reaches over her the side of the bench and procures a medium sized basket covered with a white cloth. The smells that emanate from the basket are tantalizingly delicious. “So would you like to check it out with me for our second date, y-y’know... if you want to? I even brought a picnic set complete with snacks and drinks for the day!” Fisianna smiles cutely. She already seems to have everything planned out so you aren’t one to say otherwise. You agree to go check out the new park, to which the excited feline jumps out of her seat with joy."

rows.original: “Yay! Thank you, [pc.name]! I promise you you’ll enjoy this!” Fisianna says jubilantly as she waits for you to rise up from the park bench. You stand up, taking her free hand in yours, and you both make your way to the central elevators.
rows.translation: “太好了！谢谢你，[pc.name]！我保证你会喜欢的！”菲西安娜欢快地说道，等待你从公园长椅上起身。你站起来，用手握住她空着的爪子，随后一起走向中央电梯。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yay! Thank you, [pc.name]! I promise you you’ll enjoy this!” Fisianna says jubilantly as she waits for you to rise up from the park bench. You stand up, taking her free hand in yours, and you both make your way to the central elevators."

rows.original: The elevator ride takes you quite a ways upward and it takes about a minute before you finally arrive at the Park deck. Once outside, you find that the entryway is fairly crowded. You assume it is so packed here because there isn’t a great deal of nature to interact with on Tavros.
rows.translation: 电梯载着你们向上行进了很长一段距离；大约一分钟后，你们终于抵达公园甲板。走出电梯，你发现入口处相当拥挤。塔夫罗斯能够接触自然的地方并不多，你猜这正是此处人满为患的原因。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe elevator ride takes you quite a ways upward and it takes about a minute before you finally arrive at the Park deck. Once outside, you find that the entryway is fairly crowded. You assume it is so packed here because there isn’t a great deal of nature to interact with on Tavros. "

rows.original: The park is just about as Fisianna described it earlier, and quite accurately too. A gentle, warm breeze flows through the air under an artificial blue sky that looks convincingly real. There is an artificial sun that generates a warm glow over the park. Green fields and shrubberies dotted with wildflowers fill the landscape, along with the occasional pond and small waterfalls. Surprisingly, the park looks devoid of wildlife. You remark to Fisianna as such.
rows.translation: 公园与菲西安娜先前的描述几乎完全相同，而且她说得相当准确。令人信服的人造蓝天下，温暖柔和的微风在空气中流动。人造太阳为公园洒下温暖光辉。绿野和点缀野花的灌木遍布景观，其间还有零星池塘与小瀑布。出人意料的是，公园里似乎完全没有野生动物。你向菲西安娜提起这一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe park is just about as Fisianna described it earlier, and quite accurately too. A gentle, warm breeze flows through the air under an artificial blue sky that looks convincingly real. There is an artificial sun that generates a warm glow over the park. Green fields and shrubberies dotted with wildflowers fill the landscape, along with the occasional pond and small waterfalls. Surprisingly, the park looks devoid of wildlife. You remark to Fisianna as such."

rows.original: “Ah. I imagine since the park is so new, they just haven’t been able to gather the necessary wildlife together yet. They would have to be careful picking what wildlife to place here so that they don’t wind up wreaking havoc on the ecosystem, or make it hard for whoever maintains all of this.” Fisianna shrugs. “Anyways, I figure we have a good amount of time to kill. Let’s check out what’s beyond and walk around for a bit!” Fisianna wraps your arm around hers with her free arm.
rows.translation: “啊。我想是因为公园太新了，他们还没能收集到所需的野生动物吧。选择放进这里的动物时必须很小心，免得它们破坏生态系统，或者给负责维护这里的人增添困难。”菲西安娜耸耸肩。“不管怎样，我觉得我们有不少时间可以消磨。去看看前面有什么，先四处走走吧！”菲西安娜用空着的手臂挽住你的胳膊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah. I imagine since the park is so new, they just haven’t been able to gather the necessary wildlife together yet. They would have to be careful picking what wildlife to place here so that they don’t wind up wreaking havoc on the ecosystem, or make it hard for whoever maintains all of this.” Fisianna shrugs. “Anyways, I figure we have a good amount of time to kill. Let’s check out what’s beyond and walk around for a bit!” Fisianna wraps your arm around hers with her free arm."

rows.original: The two of you disperse from the crowd by the elevator and make your way down to a walkway that leads to a forested area. Along the way, you see a number of occupied benches surrounding various small ponds. The bodies of water are so crystal clear that it looks almost good enough to drink from directly. Their surfaces reflect the sky as ripples flow from the central fountains. There are already quite a lot of people laying on the fields setting up their own picnics, with children running in between each camped out group.
rows.translation: 你们离开电梯旁的人群，沿一条通往林区的步道前进。一路上，你看见数座小池塘周围的长椅都有人坐着。水体清澈见底，几乎让人觉得可以直接饮用。中央喷泉激起涟漪，水面映照着天空。已经有许多人在草地上铺开东西，准备自己的野餐；孩子们则在各个扎营的人群之间奔跑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you disperse from the crowd by the elevator and make your way down to a walkway that leads to a forested area. Along the way, you see a number of occupied benches surrounding various small ponds. The bodies of water are so crystal clear that it looks almost good enough to drink from directly. Their surfaces reflect the sky as ripples flow from the central fountains. There are already quite a lot of people laying on the fields setting up their own picnics, with children running in between each camped out group. "

rows.original: As the two of you walk further down the pathway and into the forested area, you see less people walking the same route. The ground becomes hilly as you start to hear the artificial sounds of birds chirping around you; it looks they at least thought of a temporary fix for the lack of wildlife. Fisianna pulls on your arm gently and leads you off of the walkway onto a dirt path. While walking on the earthy pathway, you notice that there are various trees with holographic markers to prevent anyone from losing their way. You lean out and touch one of the trees with a free arm and sure enough, it feels like the real deal.
rows.translation: 你们沿小径继续深入林区，同路的行人越来越少。地势渐渐起伏，你开始听见周围传来人造鸟鸣；看来他们至少想出了暂时弥补野生动物缺失的办法。菲西安娜轻轻拉住你的手臂，带你离开步道，踏上一条土路。沿泥土小径前行时，你注意到各处树木上都设有全息标记，以免有人迷路。你伸出空着的手臂摸了摸其中一棵树，果然和真正的树木触感一样。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the two of you walk further down the pathway and into the forested area, you see less people walking the same route. The ground becomes hilly as you start to hear the artificial sounds of birds chirping around you; it looks they at least thought of a temporary fix for the lack of wildlife. Fisianna pulls on your arm gently and leads you off of the walkway onto a dirt path. While walking on the earthy pathway, you notice that there are various trees with holographic markers to prevent anyone from losing their way. You lean out and touch one of the trees with a free arm and sure enough, it feels like the real deal."

rows.original: The two of you keep walking down the path until you come to a mid-sized clearing that is remarkably devoid of passersby.
rows.translation: 你们沿小径继续前行，直到来到一片中等大小、几乎没有路人经过的空地。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you keep walking down the path until you come to a mid-sized clearing that is remarkably devoid of passersby."

rows.original: “Alrighty, this looks like a nice spot. Let’s take a picnic break here! We can keep going afterwards, but for now I’m getting pretty hungry from smelling this food the whole entire way...” Fisianna takes the cloth off of the picnic basket she is holding and lays it across the grass. She then places a number of containers full of different types of foods and snacks on one side of the mat. When you sit down next to her, she hands you two bottles of liquids. One of them feels quite warm to the touch, while the other is refreshingly cold.
rows.translation: “好啦，这地方看起来不错。我们在这里停下来野餐吧！之后还能继续走，不过这一路都闻着食物的香味，我现在已经很饿了...”菲西安娜取下手中野餐篮上的布，将其铺在草地上。随后，她把许多装有不同食物和零食的容器摆在垫子一侧。你在她身旁坐下时，她递给你两瓶饮料。一瓶摸起来相当温暖，另一瓶则冰凉清爽。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alrighty, this looks like a nice spot. Let’s take a picnic break here! We can keep going afterwards, but for now I’m getting pretty hungry from smelling this food the whole entire way...” Fisianna takes the cloth off of the picnic basket she is holding and lays it across the grass. She then places a number of containers full of different types of foods and snacks on one side of the mat. When you sit down next to her, she hands you two bottles of liquids. One of them feels quite warm to the touch, while the other is refreshingly cold."

rows.original: “I wasn’t so sure which you would like, so I made a yokto milkshake in the cold one, and in the hot one, some hot apple and cinnamon tea. I-I hope you like them.” Fisianna blushes while she takes out the rest of the contents of the basket. You take a small sip of the yokto shake and find that it has a sourness somewhere between an orange and a lemon in intensity, but it has a flavor similar to blueberries. You can also taste bit of vanilla, which complements the flavor very well. You look towards the food containers nearby and find that are largely filled with sandwiches of different varieties. There are also a few containers filled salad, soup, and crackers to go with them.
rows.translation: “我不太确定你喜欢哪一种，所以冷瓶里做了约克托奶昔，热瓶里则装了苹果肉桂热茶。希、希望你会喜欢。”菲西安娜一边脸红，一边取出篮子里剩余的东西。你浅尝一口约克托奶昔，发现它带着介于橙子与柠檬之间的酸味强度，却有类似蓝莓的风味。你还能尝到一丝香草味，与其滋味相得益彰。你看向附近的食物容器，发现其中大多装着各式三明治，另外还有几盒沙拉、汤和用来搭配的饼干。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I wasn’t so sure which you would like, so I made a yokto milkshake in the cold one, and in the hot one, some hot apple and cinnamon tea. I-I hope you like them.” Fisianna blushes while she takes out the rest of the contents of the basket. You take a small sip of the yokto shake and find that it has a sourness somewhere between an orange and a lemon in intensity, but it has a flavor similar to blueberries. You can also taste bit of vanilla, which complements the flavor very well. You look towards the food containers nearby and find that are largely filled with sandwiches of different varieties. There are also a few containers filled salad, soup, and crackers to go with them."

rows.original: “Wow, Fisi. You really went all out!” You say in amazement. She brought quite the smorgasbord of foods with her. Fisianna smiles in delight at your compliment.
rows.translation: “哇，菲西。你真的下足了功夫！”你惊叹道。她带来的食物种类可真是琳琅满目。听到称赞，菲西安娜欣喜地笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow, Fisi. You really went all out!” You say in amazement. She brought quite the smorgasbord of foods with her. Fisianna smiles in delight at your compliment."

rows.original: “T-thank you, [pc.name]” Fisianna stammers as she passes you a sandwich. She then settles down and leans against you while starting on a bowl of soup.
rows.translation: “谢、谢谢你，[pc.name]。”菲西安娜结结巴巴地说道，同时递给你一个三明治。随后她安顿下来，一边开始喝汤，一边靠在你身上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“T-thank you, [pc.name]” Fisianna stammers as she passes you a sandwich. She then settles down and leans against you while starting on a bowl of soup. "

rows.original: The two of you eat the picnic food while talking about various subjects; Fisianna talks about jobs she recently took, and you tell her about your latest happenings in the Rush. After the two of you finish your food, you relax in each other’s arms while you both sip away at your teas, fully sated from all of the food. Fisianna looks cutely into your eyes at one point and you can’t help but lean down and give her a peck on her lips. She seizes the opportunity to wrap her arms around the back of your head when you break the kiss. Her ears flatten backwards and her eyelids lower into the most adorable golden bedroom eyes you think you have ever seen.
rows.translation: 你们边吃野餐食物，边谈论各种话题；菲西安娜讲起最近接下的工作，你则告诉她自己在星球大开发中的最新经历。吃完后，你们心满意足地啜饮茶水，在彼此怀中放松下来。某一刻，菲西安娜可爱地凝视你的双眼；你情不自禁地低头在她唇上轻啄一下。亲吻分开时，她趁机用双臂环住你的后脑。她的耳朵向后伏平，眼睑低垂，露出你所见过最可爱的金色媚眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you eat the picnic food while talking about various subjects; Fisianna talks about jobs she recently took, and you tell her about your latest happenings in the Rush. After the two of you finish your food, you relax in each other’s arms while you both sip away at your teas, fully sated from all of the food. Fisianna looks cutely into your eyes at one point and you can’t help but lean down and give her a peck on her lips. She seizes the opportunity to wrap her arms around the back of your head when you break the kiss. Her ears flatten backwards and her eyelids lower into the most adorable golden bedroom eyes you think you have ever seen."

rows.original: “I know we just had all of this food to eat, but I think I have enough room for a second helping of your lips...” Fisianna purrs sensually as she leans in to give you another kiss. You accept her lips to yours and lean back while you engage in a long-winded embrace on the picnic mat.
rows.translation: “我知道我们刚吃了这么多东西，但我想，肚子里应该还装得下一份你的嘴唇...”菲西安娜妩媚地呼噜着，凑近再次吻你。你以双唇接纳她，身体向后靠去，在野餐垫上与她投入一场漫长拥吻。

You accept her lips to yours and lean back while you engage in a long-winded embrace on the picnic mat."

rows.original: Fisianna lays atop of you as you hold her close while making out. Her eyes flutter closed as her cascading hair tickles at your cheeks. As she presses into you harder, her tongue begins to prod at your mouth. You part your lips only slightly and she takes full advantage, slipping the oral muscle into the opening. Your tongue rises up to meet hers before they play a frenetic dance inside of your cheeks.
rows.translation: 你紧紧抱住菲西安娜与她亲热，她则趴在你身上。她双眼轻轻闭合，瀑布般垂落的长发搔弄你的脸颊。她更加用力贴紧身体，舌头也开始试探你的嘴。你只稍稍张开双唇，她便充分利用机会，将口中软肉滑入缝隙。你的舌头抬起迎向她的舌头，两者随即在口腔里进行一场狂热共舞。

rows.original: In the heat of the moment, you shift your weight and roll around on the mat, pinning Fisianna beneath you. She separates her lips from you to gasp at the sudden change in position, but you give her no further time to react as you quickly lean in and resume your oral play. Using the opportunity from your lover’s brief pant for air, you slip your tongue into her mouth, searching for hers. She meets yours eventually, and when your tongues begin flicking and flailing against one another, she begins to purr. The vibrations of her body under you stimulates and massages your front side in a very relaxing manner. She presses her body into you, arching her back off of the ground. You take advantage by slipping your arms underneath her, cradling her while her purring intensifies. Her paws slide around your torso in response and her feline legs wrap around your [pc.legsNoun]. The neko sensuously moans into your mouth as you lay entwined with her. After a seemingly long while, Fisianna finally breaks the kiss, looking totally winded and disheveled. You lay to the side of her to catch your own breath.

She separates her lips from you to gasp at the sudden change in position, but you give her no further time to react as you quickly lean in and resume your oral play. Using the opportunity from your lover’s brief pant for air, you slip your tongue into her mouth, searching for hers. She meets yours eventually, and when your tongues begin flicking and flailing against one another, she begins to purr. You lay to the side of her to catch your own breath."

rows.original: “W-whew... w-we... we have to do this more often. That will never get old!” Fisianna laughs in exhaustion. You chuckle and squeeze Fisianna to you while she hugs you back, purring all the while.
rows.translation: “呼...我、我们...以后一定得常这么做。永远都不会腻！”菲西安娜疲惫地笑道。你轻笑着把她抱得更紧；她也回抱住你，始终发出呼噜声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-whew... w-we... we have to do this more often. That will never get old!” Fisianna laughs in exhaustion. You chuckle and squeeze Fisianna to you while she hugs you back, purring all the while. "

rows.original: After a few more minutes of cuddling, the both of you straighten up and pack up Fisianna’s picnic supplies. When you finish, the two of you continue down the dirt path on the other side of the clearing, pointing out different exotic looking flowers and trees along the way. You start to meet more people walking along the same path as the trail beneath you starts to become smoother. Eventually you reach the paved walkways again and follow them out of the forest. In the distance you can see the elevator shafts; the only artificial thing that breaks the natural landscape of the park. You and Fisianna walk arm in arm while you head back towards the elevator shafts.
rows.translation: 又依偎了几分钟后，你们坐直身体，收拾好菲西安娜的野餐用品。完成后，你们沿空地另一侧的土路继续前进，途中指点着各种外观奇异的花草树木。脚下小径渐渐平坦，同路的行人也开始增多。最终，你们重新回到铺砌步道上，循着它走出森林。远处可以看到电梯井，那是唯一打破公园自然景观的人造事物。你和菲西安娜手挽着手，朝电梯井走去。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few more minutes of cuddling, the both of you straighten up and pack up Fisianna’s picnic supplies. When you finish, the two of you continue down the dirt path on the other side of the clearing, pointing out different exotic looking flowers and trees along the way. You start to meet more people walking along the same path as the trail beneath you starts to become smoother. Eventually you reach the paved walkways again and follow them out of the forest. In the distance you can see the elevator shafts; the only artificial thing that breaks the natural landscape of the park. You and Fisianna walk arm in arm while you head back towards the elevator shafts."

rows.original: When you arrive at the crowded elevator shafts, the two of you walk towards one of the lifts. A few holo-posters that you didn’t see when you first arrived catch your attention as you make your way over. The poster that you look at in particular has an announcement that there will be an all-day outdoor movie night event coming soon. You make a mental note of it as a potential date idea for your next outing. When the both of you arrive back on the residential deck, you give each other parting kisses goodbye before Fisianna walks home with picnic basket in hand.
rows.translation: 抵达拥挤的电梯井后，你们走向其中一部电梯。途中，几张初来时没看到的全息海报引起了你的注意。你特别留意的那张海报宣布，近期将举办全天户外电影之夜。你暗自记下这个点子，准备当作下次外出的约会安排。你们回到住宅层后，互相吻别；菲西安娜提着野餐篮走回家。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you arrive at the crowded elevator shafts, the two of you walk towards one of the lifts. A few holo-posters that you didn’t see when you first arrived catch your attention as you make your way over. The poster that you look at in particular has an announcement that there will be an all-day outdoor movie night event coming soon. You make a mental note of it as a potential date idea for your next outing. When the both of you arrive back on the residential deck, you give each other parting kisses goodbye before Fisianna walks home with picnic basket in hand."

rows.original: You remember the posters you saw by the elevators during your last outing to the park with Fisianna about the outdoor movie night event. From what you remembered, the date that they were having the movie event was today. With that in mind, you propose the idea of going to the park again with her to see the movie together.
rows.translation: 你记得上次和菲西安娜去公园时，在电梯旁见过户外电影之夜的海报。根据记忆，电影活动的日期正是今天。想到这里，你提议再次和她去公园，一起看电影。
rows.raw: "You remember the posters you saw by the elevators during your last outing to the park with Fisianna about the outdoor movie night event. From what you remembered, the date that they were having the movie event was today. With that in mind, you propose the idea of going to the park again with her to see the movie together."

rows.original: “Oh! That sounds like a great idea!” Fisianna smiles widely. “It’s nice that it is supposed to air all day so we don’t have to rush. I’ll go home really quickly and get some things ready for us then. I can’t wait!” Fisianna gives you a quick peck on the cheek as she stands up from her seat on the bench. “I’ll meet you by the elevators in about fifteen minutes, ok?” You nod in agreement and watch her walk off towards her home. You figure you may as well take a walk around the plaza while you wait for her.
rows.translation: “噢！听起来棒极了！”菲西安娜灿烂地笑道。“而且全天都会播放，我们不用赶时间，真好。我先赶快回家，为我们准备些东西。好期待啊！”菲西安娜从长椅上起身，在你脸颊上迅速轻吻一下。“大约十五分钟后在电梯旁见，好吗？”你点头同意，看着她朝家中走去。等待期间，你觉得不妨在广场上四处散散步。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh! That sounds like a great idea!” Fisianna smiles widely. “It’s nice that it is supposed to air all day so we don’t have to rush. I’ll go home really quickly and get some things ready for us then. I can’t wait!” Fisianna gives you a quick peck on the cheek as she stands up from her seat on the bench. “I’ll meet you by the elevators in about fifteen minutes, ok?” You nod in agreement and watch her walk off towards her home. You figure you may as well take a walk around the plaza while you wait for her."

rows.original: When fifteen minutes pass, you finish your walk and wait by the North elevator for Fisianna. She arrives only a few minutes after you do. She looks to have brought her picnic basket with her as well much to your delight. She gives you a quick peck on the lips when she reaches you.
rows.translation: 十五分钟过去后，你结束散步，在北侧电梯旁等待菲西安娜。她只比你晚到几分钟。令你欣喜的是，她似乎也带来了野餐篮。走到面前时，她在你唇上迅速轻吻一下。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen fifteen minutes pass, you finish your walk and wait by the North elevator for Fisianna. She arrives only a few minutes after you do. She looks to have brought her picnic basket with her as well much to your delight. She gives you a quick peck on the lips when she reaches you."

rows.original: “S-sorry that I took a little longer than I originally thought I would. I wanted to bring a few snacks from the leftovers we had from picnic before. They should still be fresh!” You thank Fisianna for the thought and take her free paw in your hand as the two of you enter the elevator.
rows.translation: “抱、抱歉，比我原本以为的多花了一点时间。我想带些上次野餐剩下的零食，它们应该还很新鲜！”你感谢菲西安娜如此用心，牵住她空着的爪掌，和她一同走进电梯。
rows.raw: "\n\n“S-sorry that I took a little longer than I originally thought I would. I wanted to bring a few snacks from the leftovers we had from picnic before. They should still be fresh!” You thank Fisianna for the thought and take her free paw in your hand as the two of you enter the elevator."

rows.original: When you exit the elevator at the park, you find that it is more crowded than it was on your last trip here, and understandably so. The sky looks to be set to a permanent night time setting for the day, so artificial stars glimmer in a dark purple and black sky. The artificial sun is replaced by dimly glowing moon, which casts a soft light bright enough to be able to see in a non-sheltered area. At one end of the nearest clearing you can see a humongous holo screen. There is a massive amount of people camped out in front of the screen watching the previews, or otherwise snacking and talking amongst themselves. You can see Fisianna gazing at the scene in amazement, ears twitching and swiveling every which way as her golden eyes glitter in the artificial moonlight.
rows.translation: 走出电梯来到公园时，你发现这里比上次更加拥挤，这也完全可以理解。今天的天空似乎永久设定为夜间模式，人造星辰在深紫与黑色的天空中闪烁。人造太阳被一轮散发黯淡光芒的月亮取代，投下柔和光线，亮度足以让人在无遮蔽区域看清事物。最近一片空地的一端矗立着巨大无比的全息屏幕。海量人群在屏幕前安营扎寨，有的观看预告片，有的吃着零食、彼此交谈。你看到菲西安娜惊叹地凝视这片景象；她的耳朵朝各个方向抽动旋转，金色眼眸在人造月光下闪闪发亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you exit the elevator at the park, you find that it is more crowded than it was on your last trip here, and understandably so. The sky looks to be set to a permanent night time setting for the day, so artificial stars glimmer in a dark purple and black sky. The artificial sun is replaced by dimly glowing moon, which casts a soft light bright enough to be able to see in a non-sheltered area. At one end of the nearest clearing you can see a humongous holo screen. There is a massive amount of people camped out in front of the screen watching the previews, or otherwise snacking and talking amongst themselves. You can see Fisianna gazing at the scene in amazement, ears twitching and swiveling every which way as her golden eyes glitter in the artificial moonlight."

rows.original: “Wow, this setup is amazing! I’ve never would have thought that it would be this... grand.” Fisianna stares pointedly at the holo-screen. Shortly after she turns to you. “We should find an open space to set up on. I’d hate to wind up too far away or smooshed between too many people.”
rows.translation: “哇，这里的布置太惊人了！我从没想过会这么...盛大。”菲西安娜目不转睛地盯着全息屏幕。片刻后，她转向你。“我们该找块空地安顿下来。我可不想离得太远，或者被太多人挤在中间。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow, this setup is amazing! I’ve never would have thought that it would be this... grand.” Fisianna stares pointedly at the holo-screen. Shortly after she turns to you. “We should find an open space to set up on. I’d hate to wind up too far away or smooshed between too many people.”"

rows.original: The two of you head down to the field and look for any open spaces you can find. You eventually find one at a comfortable distance from the holo-screen with a good amount of space around it to give the both of you plenty of room to relax. Fisianna sets her blanket down on the ground and places the picnic basket down next to her, after which she unpacks the contents in the basket. You sit down on the blanket and after reclining back, your feline companion sits down next to you and wraps her arms around you in a hug, relaxing against you.
rows.translation: 你们走进草地，寻找可以使用的空位。最终，你们在距离全息屏幕舒适的位置找到一处，周围也有相当宽裕的空间，足以让两人放松休息。菲西安娜把毯子铺在地上，将野餐篮放到旁边，随后取出篮中物品。你在毯子上坐下，向后舒适靠卧；猫科伴侣也在身旁坐下，伸出双臂拥住你，靠在你身上放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you head down to the field and look for any open spaces you can find. You eventually find one at a comfortable distance from the holo-screen with a good amount of space around it to give the both of you plenty of room to relax. Fisianna sets her blanket down on the ground and places the picnic basket down next to her, after which she unpacks the contents in the basket. You sit down on the blanket and after reclining back, your feline companion sits down next to you and wraps her arms around you in a hug, relaxing against you."

rows.original: “I wonder what movie they’re going to be airing right now?” Fisianna ponders to you. Thinking of which, you actually have no idea which movie is going to be airing right at this moment. You remember seeing a schedule somewhere on the poster you saw before, but you are starting to wish you read it in more detail. You shrug the shoulder that Fisianna is not resting on and tell her that you don’t have the faintest idea yourself.
rows.translation: “不知道现在会播放哪部电影？”菲西安娜向你思索道。说起来，你也完全不知道此刻会放哪部影片。你记得之前看到的海报某处列着时间表，但现在开始后悔当时没有仔细阅读。你耸了耸没有被菲西安娜靠住的肩膀，告诉她自己也毫无头绪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I wonder what movie they’re going to be airing right now?” Fisianna ponders to you. Thinking of which, you actually have no idea which movie is going to be airing right at this moment. You remember seeing a schedule somewhere on the poster you saw before, but you are starting to wish you read it in more detail. You shrug the shoulder that Fisianna is not resting on and tell her that you don’t have the faintest idea yourself."

rows.original: “Oh well... I imagine it’ll be good anyways, especially with you here.” Fisianna says dotingly, squeezing herself tighter to you. The two of you spend a few more moments in each other’s arms, eating Fisianna’s homemade snacks before the previews finish and the movie starts.
rows.translation: “好吧...不过我想电影肯定会很好看，尤其是有你在身边。”菲西安娜深情地说道，更加用力地贴紧你。预告片结束、电影开始前，你们又在彼此怀里依偎片刻，吃着她亲手制作的零食。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh well... I imagine it’ll be good anyways, especially with you here.” Fisianna says dotingly, squeezing herself tighter to you. The two of you spend a few more moments in each other’s arms, eating Fisianna’s homemade snacks before the previews finish and the movie starts."

rows.original: The movie starts rather innocently enough; a starship cruiser is headed for a derelict space station to scavenge for parts. The ship lands and the scavenging crew gathers everything they can reuse. The operation goes smoothly enough and the crew heads back to the ship, though there are subtle undertones of mystery as an unidentified figure flashes across the screen and into the vessel just as the door is closing. Fisianna grips onto you tighter as this happens. The title screen comes up afterwards, reading: “The Intruder”. You start to feel a bit of dread yourself as you are beginning to think that this movie may not be the most pleasant of movies to watch on a date.
rows.translation: 电影开场相当平常：一艘星际巡洋舰正前往一座废弃空间站，准备搜寻可用零件。飞船着陆，打捞队收集一切能够重复利用的物品。行动十分顺利，船员也返回飞船；然而舱门关闭之际，一个身份不明的身影从画面中一闪而过，钻进了船内，为剧情增添隐约的神秘气息。看到这里，菲西安娜把你抓得更紧。随后片名出现在屏幕上：“入侵者”。你自己也开始感到一丝不安，因为这部电影似乎不太适合在约会时观看。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe movie starts rather innocently enough; a starship cruiser is headed for a derelict space station to scavenge for parts. The ship lands and the scavenging crew gathers everything they can reuse. The operation goes smoothly enough and the crew heads back to the ship, though there are subtle undertones of mystery as an unidentified figure flashes across the screen and into the vessel just as the door is closing. Fisianna grips onto you tighter as this happens. The title screen comes up afterwards, reading: “The Intruder”. You start to feel a bit of dread yourself as you are beginning to think that this movie may not be the most pleasant of movies to watch on a date."

rows.original: Sure enough, later on in the movie, crew members start to go missing and the captain of the ship orders a ship-wide assessment of the situation. Things grow even more bleak when several members of the search party go missing and only bloodstains are found. When a lieutenant makes their way down to the cargo bay area, he looks around until he finds a badly mutilated body. You can hear Fisianna gasp in terror as a shadow forms behind the hapless crew member. The officer notices a little too late and comes face to face with the grotesque alien that stowed away on the ship. He screams and manages to fire only a few shots off from his pistol before the alien comes down on him. Fisianna buries her head into your shoulder and shakes in fright. You rub her back gently until she is brave enough to bring her eyes back to the screen again.
rows.translation: 果然，电影继续播放后，船员开始接连失踪，舰长下令对全船情况进行评估。数名搜索队员失踪、现场只留下血迹后，局面变得更加阴暗。一名中尉来到货舱区域，四处查看，最终发现一具严重残缺的尸体。那个倒霉船员身后浮现阴影时，你听见菲西安娜惊恐地倒抽一口气。军官发现得太晚了，与偷偷登船的狰狞异星生物正面相遇。他发出尖叫，手枪只来得及开上几枪，异星生物便猛扑而下。菲西安娜害怕得把头埋进你的肩膀，身体不断颤抖。你轻柔抚摸她的后背，直到她鼓起勇气重新看向屏幕。
rows.raw: "\n\nSure enough, later on in the movie, crew members start to go missing and the captain of the ship orders a ship-wide assessment of the situation. Things grow even more bleak when several members of the search party go missing and only bloodstains are found. When a lieutenant makes their way down to the cargo bay area, he looks around until he finds a badly mutilated body. You can hear Fisianna gasp in terror as a shadow forms behind the hapless crew member. The officer notices a little too late and comes face to face with the grotesque alien that stowed away on the ship. He screams and manages to fire only a few shots off from his pistol before the alien comes down on him. Fisianna buries her head into your shoulder and shakes in fright. You rub her back gently until she is brave enough to bring her eyes back to the screen again. "

rows.original: Once the threat is identified, the whole ship goes into red alert while the crew sets about to hunt the alien down. Fisianna shrinks into your arms each time a member of the crew falls victim to the alien. Eventually there are only a few remaining surviving crew members left on the space cruiser, including the captain. He sets the ship to autopilot as the alien aims to break into the cockpit. The remaining crew members attempt to blast the foreign intruder when it successfully breaks in, to little avail. One of the privates fighting the alien pleads for the captain to escape while they still can.
rows.translation: 威胁得到确认后，整艘飞船进入红色警戒，船员开始追捕异星生物。每当一名船员沦为怪物的受害者，菲西安娜都会缩进你的怀里。最终，星际巡洋舰上只剩下包括舰长在内的少数幸存船员。他将飞船设为自动驾驶，而异星生物则试图闯入驾驶舱。怪物成功破门后，剩余船员向这名外来入侵者开火，却几乎毫无效果。一名与异星生物战斗的列兵恳求舰长趁还有机会赶快逃走。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce the threat is identified, the whole ship goes into red alert while the crew sets about to hunt the alien down. Fisianna shrinks into your arms each time a member of the crew falls victim to the alien. Eventually there are only a few remaining surviving crew members left on the space cruiser, including the captain. He sets the ship to autopilot as the alien aims to break into the cockpit. The remaining crew members attempt to blast the foreign intruder when it successfully breaks in, to little avail. One of the privates fighting the alien pleads for the captain to escape while they still can. "

rows.original: They cry out: “It’s game over man, game over!”
rows.translation: 他高喊：“完蛋了，伙计，全完蛋了！”
rows.raw: "They cry out: “It’s game over man, game over!” "

rows.original: Afterwhich they immediately fall to the intruder. The alien bears down on the now lone captain and lunges at him. The captain barely escapes out of the cockpit in time. The invader chases after the captain relentlessly as he makes his way to the airlocks. Fisianna looks on with bated breath while the captain runs and gasps at every close call he has. Eventually he makes it to the airlocks, but to his dismay, all the escape pods have already been jettisoned; likely by crew members that were too terrified to stay aboard. Even you are starting to feel tense and wondering what he will do next as the alien threat closes in on the unfortunate captain.
rows.translation: 紧接着，他便立即倒在入侵者手下。异星生物逼近如今孤身一人的舰长，猛然扑向他。舰长险之又险地及时逃出驾驶舱。入侵者穷追不舍，舰长一路逃向气闸。菲西安娜屏息注视着舰长奔跑，每逢险象环生便倒抽一口气。最终，他赶到气闸，却沮丧地发现所有逃生舱都已弹射出去；很可能是过度恐惧、不敢继续留在船上的船员干的。就连你也开始紧张起来，想知道异星威胁逐渐逼近时，这位倒霉舰长接下来会怎么办。
rows.raw: "Afterwhich they immediately fall to the intruder. The alien bears down on the now lone captain and lunges at him. The captain barely escapes out of the cockpit in time. The invader chases after the captain relentlessly as he makes his way to the airlocks. Fisianna looks on with bated breath while the captain runs and gasps at every close call he has. Eventually he makes it to the airlocks, but to his dismay, all the escape pods have already been jettisoned; likely by crew members that were too terrified to stay aboard. Even you are starting to feel tense and wondering what he will do next as the alien threat closes in on the unfortunate captain."

rows.original: The invader slowly and menacingly lumbers over to the trapped captain, ready to strike the final blow. In an instant, he holds onto a nearby bar on the wall and slams his hand on the airlock release button, opening the door next to them. Everything not nailed down in the room goes flying out of the airlock and into the empty void of space. The intruder struggles to keep its traction on the ship floor and falls victim to the suction of air being forced rapidly out of the room, but not before grabbing onto the doorframe in desperation. The captain beats at the alien’s limbs that are closest to him while holding his breath.
rows.translation: 入侵者缓慢而险恶地逼近无路可逃的舰长，准备发动致命一击。刹那间，舰长抓住墙边一根横杆，猛拍气闸释放按钮，打开他们身旁的舱门。房间里所有没有固定的东西都飞出气闸，落入空无一物的太空。入侵者拼命维持在舰船地板上的立足，却仍被迅速排出房间的气流吸走；不过最后关头，它绝望地抓住了门框。舰长屏住呼吸，猛击怪物离自己最近的肢体。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe invader slowly and menacingly lumbers over to the trapped captain, ready to strike the final blow. In an instant, he holds onto a nearby bar on the wall and slams his hand on the airlock release button, opening the door next to them. Everything not nailed down in the room goes flying out of the airlock and into the empty void of space. The intruder struggles to keep its traction on the ship floor and falls victim to the suction of air being forced rapidly out of the room, but not before grabbing onto the doorframe in desperation. The captain beats at the alien’s limbs that are closest to him while holding his breath. "

rows.original: You can feel Fisianna rocking and fidgeting next to you while the alien’s grip loosens bit by bit. When you look towards her, she bites her lower lip in anxiousness. Her twinned tails suddenly stretch out while her knees and paws clench together. Dismissing the gestures as mere expressions of terror, you look towards the screen after hugging her reassuringly, not wanting to miss the resolution of the scene.
rows.translation: 异星生物的抓握一点点松开时，你能感觉到身旁的菲西安娜不断摇摆扭动。转头看她，她正焦虑地咬着下唇。两条尾巴突然伸直，双膝和爪掌也紧紧并拢。你把这些动作当作单纯的恐惧表现，安慰般地抱了抱她，随即重新看向屏幕，不想错过这一幕的结局。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can feel Fisianna rocking and fidgeting next to you while the alien’s grip loosens bit by bit. When you look towards her, she bites her lower lip in anxiousness. Her twinned tails suddenly stretch out while her knees and paws clench together. Dismissing the gestures as mere expressions of terror, you look towards the screen after hugging her reassuringly, not wanting to miss the resolution of the scene. "

rows.original: After a few more hits, the alien intruder finally lets go and is vacuumed into the cold recesses of space. The captain slams the airlock button down again to close the door as he, Fisianna, and the rest of the moviegoers breathe a collective sigh of relief. The captain makes their way back to the cockpit of the starship and plots a course for home.
rows.translation: 又挨了几下后，异星入侵者终于松手，被吸进冰冷幽深的太空。舰长再次猛拍气闸按钮关上舱门；他、菲西安娜以及其他观众一同松了口气。舰长返回星舰驾驶舱，设定了返航路线。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few more hits, the alien intruder finally lets go and is vacuumed into the cold recesses of space. The captain slams the airlock button down again to close the door as he, Fisianna, and the rest of the moviegoers breathe a collective sigh of relief. The captain makes their way back to the cockpit of the starship and plots a course for home."

rows.original: When the credits start to roll, Fisianna releases her rather tight hold on you. She looks into your eyes with a weary, but relieved look on her face. You can faintly smell a musky,
rows.translation: 片尾字幕开始滚动时，菲西安娜终于松开紧紧抱住你的双臂。她注视你的眼睛，神情疲惫却如释重负。你隐约闻到她身上传来一股带麝香的
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the credits start to roll, Fisianna releases her rather tight hold on you. She looks into your eyes with a weary, but relieved look on her face. You can faintly smell a musky, "

rows.original: but somewhat tangy aroma wafting from her.
rows.translation: 却又略带酸涩的气味。
rows.raw: "but somewhat tangy aroma wafting from her. "

rows.original: and somewhat familiar tangy aroma wafting from her.
rows.translation: 以及一股略带酸涩而又有些熟悉的气味。
rows.raw: "and somewhat familiar tangy aroma wafting from her. "

rows.original: Did she...?
rows.translation: 她刚才...？
rows.raw: "Did she...?"

rows.original: “T-that... that was really, really scary...” Fisianna blushes and sighs as she slumps against you. You pull her into a comforting hug, kissing her on the cheek all the while.
rows.translation: “那——那...那真的非常、非常吓人...”菲希安娜脸红叹息，无力靠在你身上。你把她拉进安慰的拥抱，同时不断亲吻脸颊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“T-that... that was really, really scary...” Fisianna blushes and sighs as she slumps against you. You pull her into a comforting hug, kissing her on the cheek all the while."

rows.original: “Had I known that they were going to air a horror movie, I probably would have scheduled this at a different time...” You say to Fisianna apologetically. Her ears perk up while she looks up at you with a sweet smile on her face.
rows.translation: “早知道他们要播放恐怖电影，我大概会把约会安排在别的时间...”你歉意地对菲希安娜说道。她竖起耳朵，抬头看你，脸上带着甜美微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Had I known that they were going to air a horror movie, I probably would have scheduled this at a different time...” You say to Fisianna apologetically. Her ears perk up while she looks up at you with a sweet smile on her face."

rows.original: “I-it’s ok, [pc.name]. I still had a lot of fun, plus I-I felt really safe in your arms the entire time anyways, if I’m allowed to sound a bit corny.” Fisianna plants a kiss on your lips before straightening up and packing the rest of the snacks away. You help her put the rest of her picnic things away and once you are done, the both of you head back to the elevator shafts. Once you enter them and exit out into the residential deck, Fisianna gives you another kiss to your lips.
rows.translation: “没——没关系，[pc.name]。我还是玩得很开心，而且整个过程都待在你怀里，感觉非常安全——如果我可以说得这么老套的话。”菲希安娜亲吻你的嘴唇，随后直起身体，收拾剩余零食。你帮她把其他野餐用品收好，完成后一起回到电梯井。进入电梯并在住宅甲板离开后，菲希安娜再次亲吻你的嘴唇。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-it’s ok, [pc.name]. I still had a lot of fun, plus I-I felt really safe in your arms the entire time anyways, if I’m allowed to sound a bit corny.” Fisianna plants a kiss on your lips before straightening up and packing the rest of the snacks away. You help her put the rest of her picnic things away and once you are done, the both of you head back to the elevator shafts. Once you enter them and exit out into the residential deck, Fisianna gives you another kiss to your lips."

rows.original: “Thank you for taking me out today! I’m really looking forward to seeing you again, [pc.name].” Fisianna turns away hesitantly and walks back towards her apartment.
rows.translation: “谢谢你今天带我出来！我真的很期待再次见到你，[pc.name]。”菲希安娜犹豫地转身，走回公寓。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you for taking me out today! I’m really looking forward to seeing you again, [pc.name].” Fisianna turns away hesitantly and walks back towards her apartment."

rows.original: RESIDENTIAL DECK FISIS APARTMENT
rows.raw: "RESIDENTIAL DECK FISIS APARTMENT"

rows.original: You ask Fisianna if she would like to go on another date with you. Your feline lover shifts in her seat nervously, her ears lowering to their sides and she fiddles with one of her tails.
rows.translation: 你询问菲希安娜是否愿意再次约会。你的猫科情人紧张地在座位上挪动，双耳垂向两侧，手指摆弄一条尾巴。
rows.raw: "You ask Fisianna if she would like to go on another date with you. Your feline lover shifts in her seat nervously, her ears lowering to their sides and she fiddles with one of her tails."

rows.original: “U-um... actually, I-I was kinda thinking... d-did you wanna... come over to my apartment for today?” Before you can answer back, Fisianna adds, “O-oh, I wanted to show you the AI I’ve been working on for a while, the one I mentioned a while back?”
rows.translation: “呃...其实，我——我在想...你——你今天想不想...来我的公寓？”你还没回答，菲希安娜便补充道：“哦——哦，我想向你展示自己研究了很久的人工智能，就是之前提过的那个？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“U-um... actually, I-I was kinda thinking... d-did you wanna... come over to my apartment for today?” Before you can answer back, Fisianna adds, “O-oh, I wanted to show you the AI I’ve been working on for a while, the one I mentioned a while back?”"

rows.original: You think back to the conversation you had with Fisianna about her job and programming AI/VIs. You do remember her mentioning that she had an AI that she has been working on in her spare time.
rows.translation: 你回想与菲希安娜讨论职业以及人工智能/虚拟智能编程的谈话。你确实记得她提过，自己业余时间一直在开发一个人工智能。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think back to the conversation you had with Fisianna about her job and programming AI/VIs. You do remember her mentioning that she had an AI that she has been working on in her spare time."

rows.original: “R-right! I think I’m ready to show her to you now. Although she still is being worked on, she’s become my number one assistant when it comes to helping me with other projects. I-I think she would like to meet you!”
rows.translation: “对——对！我觉得现在可以向你展示她了。虽然仍在开发中，可她已经成为协助我处理其他项目的头号助手。我——我想她会希望见到你！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“R-right! I think I’m ready to show her to you now. Although she still is being worked on, she’s become my number one assistant when it comes to helping me with other projects. I-I think she would like to meet you!”"

rows.original: Well, Fisianna sure has piqued your interest at that notion. You tell her that you are interested in meeting her personal AI and stand up from your seat, perhaps a bit more eagerly than you wanted to let on. Fisianna giggles as she rises up from the park bench and leads you to her apartment.
rows.translation: 这个提议确实勾起了你的兴趣。你告诉菲希安娜，自己很想见见她的私人人工智能，随后从座位站起，表现得或许比原本想展现的更加迫不及待。菲希安娜咯咯笑着离开公园长椅，带你前往公寓。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, Fisianna sure has piqued your interest at that notion. You tell her that you are interested in meeting her personal AI and stand up from your seat, perhaps a bit more eagerly than you wanted to let on. Fisianna giggles as she rises up from the park bench and leads you to her apartment."

rows.original: Once you arrive at Fisianna’s apartment, she lets you inside and leads you over to her spare bedroom door.
rows.translation: 抵达菲希安娜的公寓后，她让你进门，把你领到备用卧室门前。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you arrive at Fisianna’s apartment, she lets you inside and leads you over to her spare bedroom door."

rows.original: “A-again, she is a work in progress, so apologies if she says anything... off.” Fisianna laughs sheepishly as she opens the door to her spare bedroom. Once the lights cut on, you immediately see a very professionally arranged workshop setup. One side houses a number of both regular tools and nano tools arranged neatly over a large workbench. There are all manner of heating and cooling stations for welding parts together as well as dozens of compartments set aside for the organization of small parts and wires. Various switches and dials line the side displaying various temperature indicators. Several circuit boards also lay on top of the nano work table from a recent project you gather. There are several skeletons of various droids nearby the other complicated machinery in that side of the room.
rows.translation: “再——再次提醒，她仍在开发中，所以如果说出什么...古怪的话，请原谅。”菲希安娜不好意思地笑着打开备用卧室。灯光亮起，你立刻看见布置极其专业的工作室。一侧摆放普通工具和纳米工具，整齐悬挂在大型工作台上方。那里有各种用于焊接零件的加热与冷却站，还有数十个分类存放小零件与导线的隔间。侧面排列着各种开关与旋钮，显示不同温度指标。纳米工作台上还放着几块电路板，似乎来自最近的项目。房间这一侧复杂机械旁，还立着几具不同机器人的骨架。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A-again, she is a work in progress, so apologies if she says anything... off.” Fisianna laughs sheepishly as she opens the door to her spare bedroom. Once the lights cut on, you immediately see a very professionally arranged workshop setup. One side houses a number of both regular tools and nano tools arranged neatly over a large workbench. There are all manner of heating and cooling stations for welding parts together as well as dozens of compartments set aside for the organization of small parts and wires. Various switches and dials line the side displaying various temperature indicators. Several circuit boards also lay on top of the nano work table from a recent project you gather. There are several skeletons of various droids nearby the other complicated machinery in that side of the room."

rows.original: On the other side of the room you notice a very large console. Below the console is large casing that has a wide variety of displays and lights. On the holo-screen it looks like it is running a diagnostic scan of the supercomputer. There are a number of books and documents strewn about the table top of the computer as well.
rows.translation: 房间另一侧有一台非常巨大的控制台。下方是大型机箱，装有各式显示器与灯光。全息屏幕似乎正在对超级计算机执行诊断扫描。电脑桌面也散落着许多书籍与文件。
rows.raw: "\n\nOn the other side of the room you notice a very large console. Below the console is large casing that has a wide variety of displays and lights. On the holo-screen it looks like it is running a diagnostic scan of the supercomputer. There are a number of books and documents strewn about the table top of the computer as well."

rows.original: “W-well? What do you think, [pc.name]?” Fisianna asks while you survey the room.
rows.translation: “怎——怎么样？你觉得如何，[pc.name]？”你观察房间时，菲希安娜问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well? What do you think, [pc.name]?” Fisianna asks while you survey the room."

rows.original: “Very impressive. I’m pretty amazed that you have all this setup in just the privacy of your own home. Most other places would have the same quality of equipment in expensive labs.” You point out.
rows.translation: “非常了不起。你能在自己家里秘密搭建这一切，真让我惊讶。其他地方只有昂贵实验室才会配备同等质量的设备。”你指出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Very impressive. I’m pretty amazed that you have all this setup in just the privacy of your own home. Most other places would have the same quality of equipment in expensive labs.” You point out."

rows.original: “Y-yeah... I can thank my brother and sister for this for the most part. They’ve really helped me to earn my living here.” Fisianna cheerfully smiles. Her tails wiggle a little more frenetically before an unfamiliar soft female voice echoes in the room.
rows.translation: “对——对...这主要得感谢哥哥姐姐。他们真的帮我在这里维持生计。”菲希安娜开心微笑。尾巴更加急促地摆动，房间里却突然响起陌生而柔和的女声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Y-yeah... I can thank my brother and sister for this for the most part. They’ve really helped me to earn my living here.” Fisianna cheerfully smiles. Her tails wiggle a little more frenetically before an unfamiliar soft female voice echoes in the room."

rows.original: “Regular diagnostic scan completed. Welcome back, Fisianna. Hopefully you are well today. Since your last visit, two job offers are pending and awaiting your app-” The voice cuts off abruptly, but just as suddenly starts up again. “Multiple life signs detected in the vicinity. Do we have a visitor? How exciting!” The voice exclaims.
rows.translation: “常规诊断扫描完成。欢迎回来，菲希安娜。希望你今天一切安好。自上次访问以来，有两份工作邀请正在等待你的批——”声音突然中断，又同样突然重新响起。“附近检测到多个生命信号。我们有访客吗？真令人兴奋！”声音喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Regular diagnostic scan completed. Welcome back, Fisianna. Hopefully you are well today. Since your last visit, two job offers are pending and awaiting your app-” The voice cuts off abruptly, but just as suddenly starts up again. “Multiple life signs detected in the vicinity. Do we have a visitor? How exciting!” The voice exclaims."

rows.original: You take the opportunity to introduce yourself to the ubiquitous voice in the room. After a brief pause, the voice speaks up again as the holo-console displays a name.
rows.translation: 你趁机向房间里无处不在的声音自我介绍。短暂沉默后，全息控制台显示出一个名字，声音再次开口。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take the opportunity to introduce yourself to the ubiquitous voice in the room. After a brief pause, the voice speaks up again as the holo-console displays a name."

rows.original: <i>“Greetings,
rows.translation: <i>“您好，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Greetings, "

rows.translation: 主人
rows.raw: "Master"

rows.original: Mistress
rows.translation: 女主人
rows.raw: "Mistress"

rows.original: Steele. I am the Inclusive Services Intelligence System, but you may call me I.S.I.S., for short. It is a pleasure to finally meet you!” You chuckle and shoot Fisianna a sidelong smirk. Clever name.
rows.translation: ·斯蒂尔。我是综合服务智能系统，简称I.S.I.S.。终于见到您了，我很高兴！”你轻笑着斜眼坏笑菲希安娜。名字取得很聪明。
rows.raw: " Steele. I am the Inclusive Services Intelligence System, but you may call me I.S.I.S., for short. It is a pleasure to finally meet you!” You chuckle and shoot Fisianna a sidelong smirk. Clever name."

rows.original: “Isis... I-I told you already, you don’t need to greet people by master or mistress. It sounds very possessive, not to mention degrading...” Fisianna groans.
rows.translation: “伊西丝...我——我已经告诉过你，不必用主人或女主人称呼别人。听起来占有欲太强，更别说还很贬低人...”菲希安娜呻吟道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Isis... I-I told you already, you don’t need to greet people by master or mistress. It sounds very possessive, not to mention degrading...” Fisianna groans."

rows.original: <i>“Apologies, Fisianna. I thought it would be polite in front of
rows.translation: <i>“抱歉，菲希安娜。我以为在
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Apologies, Fisianna. I thought it would be polite in front of "

rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr."

rows.translation: 女士

rows.original: Steele to use such formalities, especially one of [pc.hisHer] import.” Isis says in a very convincingly apologetic tone.
rows.translation: ·斯蒂尔面前使用这类敬称会显得礼貌，尤其对[pc.hisHer]这样重要的人而言。”伊西丝以非常逼真的歉意语调说道。
rows.raw: " Steele to use such formalities, especially one of [pc.hisHer] import.” Isis says in a very convincingly apologetic tone."

rows.original: “It’s fine.” Fisianna turns to you. “Two guesses as to what the inspiration for that name is from. Isis is my own home grown AI, whom I’ve been nurturing for a good few years now ever since my college days. I’ve been steadily increasing the functionality of her core being since I created her from a school project. Highest marks in the class and helped seal my valedictorian status!” The catgirl’s bosom swells with pride while her tails flick about in a blur. Isis continues on Fisianna’s explanation on her functions.
rows.translation: “没关系。”菲希安娜转向你。“猜两次，这个名字的灵感来自哪里。伊西丝是我自己培育的人工智能，从大学时代起，我已经培养她好几年了。自从把她作为学校项目创造出来，我一直在稳步增加核心功能。全班最高分，还帮我锁定了毕业生代表资格！”猫娘骄傲地挺起胸脯，尾巴飞快甩动，几乎化作模糊影子。伊西丝接着说明自己的功能。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s fine.” Fisianna turns to you. “Two guesses as to what the inspiration for that name is from. Isis is my own home grown AI, whom I’ve been nurturing for a good few years now ever since my college days. I’ve been steadily increasing the functionality of her core being since I created her from a school project. Highest marks in the class and helped seal my valedictorian status!” The catgirl’s bosom swells with pride while her tails flick about in a blur. Isis continues on Fisianna’s explanation on her functions."

rows.original: “I was designed for the purpose of being integrable with a multitude of serviceable androids and/or machinery, thus my accelerated learning programming is longer than what most standard growth type AIs go through. As a result, when I reach one-hundred percent completion of my progress through aforementioned programming, I should be able to help in multiple fields of work outside of helping Fisianna repair droids, androids and programming AIs and VIs for her occupation. Fisianna takes great care in my wellbeing during all of this. I couldn’t be in better hands... or paws, so to say.” Isis quips. Fisianna deflates and blushes at the praise the AI gives to her.
rows.translation: “我的设计目的是与多种服务型机器人及/或机械集成，因此加速学习程序比多数标准成长型人工智能经历的更长。结果是，当我对上述程序的学习进度达到百分之百时，除协助菲希安娜维修机器人、仿生人，并为职业工作编写人工智能和虚拟智能外，我还应能帮助多个工作领域。整个过程中，菲希安娜都非常关心我的健康。我不可能落入更好的人手中...或者应该说爪子。”伊西丝打趣道。人工智能的赞美令菲希安娜泄了气，满脸通红。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was designed for the purpose of being integrable with a multitude of serviceable androids and/or machinery, thus my accelerated learning programming is longer than what most standard growth type AIs go through. As a result, when I reach one-hundred percent completion of my progress through aforementioned programming, I should be able to help in multiple fields of work outside of helping Fisianna repair droids, androids and programming AIs and VIs for her occupation. Fisianna takes great care in my wellbeing during all of this. I couldn’t be in better hands... or paws, so to say.” Isis quips. Fisianna deflates and blushes at the praise the AI gives to her."

rows.original: “Recently, ever since you got me that doll at the arcade, I was working on a design for an avatar I could use for Isis. I got the inspiration to make one for Isis using that doll you won for me, and I made a similar avatar in honor of that as well, so I have to thank you again for that, [pc.name]! Isis, please come here and show [pc.name] what you look like!” Fisianna gleefully asks Isis with a wide smile on her face. The display fades to black for a moment before it abruptly comes back on to show a giant pair of blinking, heterochromatic green and blue feline eyes.
rows.translation: “最近，自从你在游戏厅送我那个玩偶后，我一直在为伊西丝设计可用的化身。你赢给我的玩偶给了我灵感，所以我也制作了类似化身纪念它，因此还得再次感谢你，[pc.name]！伊西丝，请过来向[pc.name]展示你的样子！”菲希安娜满脸灿烂笑容，兴高采烈地请求。屏幕短暂变黑，随后突然重新亮起，显示一对巨大的、不断眨动的异色猫眼，一绿一蓝。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Recently, ever since you got me that doll at the arcade, I was working on a design for an avatar I could use for Isis. I got the inspiration to make one for Isis using that doll you won for me, and I made a similar avatar in honor of that as well, so I have to thank you again for that, [pc.name]! Isis, please come here and show [pc.name] what you look like!” Fisianna gleefully asks Isis with a wide smile on her face. The display fades to black for a moment before it abruptly comes back on to show a giant pair of blinking, heterochromatic green and blue feline eyes."

rows.original: “Err... back up a little, Isis.” Fisianna says, trying to stifle a laugh. The eyes on the screen back up to reveal an humanoid cat in a calico fur pattern. Isis’s avatar is completely nude, but her erogenous zones look to be conveniently covered up by layers of fur. Isis smiles cutely and waves at the both of you.
rows.translation: “呃...退后一点，伊西丝。”菲希安娜说道，努力忍住笑。屏幕中的眼睛退后，显露出一只三花毛色的人形猫。伊西丝的化身完全赤裸，不过性感部位恰好被层层毛发遮住。伊西丝可爱地微笑，朝你们挥手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Err... back up a little, Isis.” Fisianna says, trying to stifle a laugh. The eyes on the screen back up to reveal an humanoid cat in a calico fur pattern. Isis’s avatar is completely nude, but her erogenous zones look to be conveniently covered up by layers of fur. Isis smiles cutely and waves at the both of you."

rows.original: “Apologies, this still requires some getting used to...” Isis shuffles her feet on the bottom of the display. She then walks closer into the display so that you can only see her head, her heterochromatic eyes looking pointedly at you.
rows.translation: “抱歉，我仍需要时间习惯...”伊西丝在屏幕底部不安地挪动双脚。随后她走近屏幕，直到你只能看见脑袋；异色眼睛明确地望向你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Apologies, this still requires some getting used to...” Isis shuffles her feet on the bottom of the display. She then walks closer into the display so that you can only see her head, her heterochromatic eyes looking pointedly at you."

rows.translation: ·斯蒂尔！现在我完全明白菲希安娜为什么如此迷恋您了。您是个非常有趣的存在！”你能看见菲希安娜比刚才脸红得更厉害。伊西丝显然也注意到了，因为她的注意力转向菲希安娜。
rows.raw: " Steele! I can now certainly see why Fisianna is so infatuated with you. You are a very interesting being!” You can see Fisianna blushing even harder than before. Apparently Isis notices this as well as her attention is now diverted towards Fisianna."

rows.original: “Oh, Fisianna. My sensors are indicating a rise in body temperature. Body temperatures slightly warmer in erogenous areas. May I suggest se-”
rows.translation: “哦，菲希安娜。我的传感器显示你的体温上升，性感带的温度略高。我可以建议性——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, Fisianna. My sensors are indicating a rise in body temperature. Body temperatures slightly warmer in erogenous areas. May I suggest se-”"

rows.original: “N-n-no! S-stop!” Fisianna’s eyes widen and she waves her hands about furiously, cutting Isis off mid-suggestion and blushing furiously now. Isis’s avatar looks genuinely surprised at the outburst before showing a look of concern.
rows.translation: “不——不——不！停——停下！”菲希安娜双眼圆睁，疯狂挥手，在伊西丝说出建议前将其打断，如今脸红得厉害。伊西丝的化身对这次爆发显得真正惊讶，随后露出担忧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“N-n-no! S-stop!” Fisianna’s eyes widen and she waves her hands about furiously, cutting Isis off mid-suggestion and blushing furiously now. Isis’s avatar looks genuinely surprised at the outburst before showing a look of concern."

rows.original: “But Fisianna, I thought normally when this happens, you like to-” Is all Isis manages to say before Fisianna waves even more furiously, wearing an exasperated look on her face as the AI obliviously continues to attempt to remedy Fisianna’s unfortunate situation, much to her dismay.
rows.translation: “可是菲希安娜，我以为通常发生这种情况时，你喜欢——”伊西丝只说到这里，菲希安娜便更加疯狂地挥手，脸上满是无奈；而人工智能仍毫无察觉地试图解决菲希安娜不幸的状况，令她万分苦恼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But Fisianna, I thought normally when this happens, you like to-” Is all Isis manages to say before Fisianna waves even more furiously, wearing an exasperated look on her face as the AI obliviously continues to attempt to remedy Fisianna’s unfortunate situation, much to her dismay."

rows.original: “N-not now Isis, p-please!” Fisianna pleads meekly with Isis. The AI finally settles down after her last plea. Fisianna looks at you with a mix of dread and apology. You do your best to pretend you aren’t fazed by Isis’s lack of ‘situational awareness’, though it seems to you that your feline lover is having trouble bringing out certain feelings. You ask Isis if you and Fisianna could be excused and if would be ok to leave the workroom.
rows.translation: “现——现在不要，伊西丝，求你了！”菲希安娜温顺地恳求。最后一次请求后，人工智能终于安静。菲希安娜带着恐惧与歉意望向你。你尽力假装没有被伊西丝缺乏‘情境意识’的表现影响，不过在你看来，猫科情人似乎难以表达某些感受。你询问伊西丝，自己和菲希安娜能否先告辞，离开工作室是否可以。

You ask Isis if you and Fisianna could be excused and if would be ok to leave the workroom."
