rows.original: Steele. It was a pleasure meeting you! Please come by again! I shall be on standby should I be needed, Fisianna.” Isis’s avatar then procures a virtual chair from nothing and sits on it. Isis then materializes a book in front of her and begins reading it. You gently grab Fisianna’s paw and escort her out of the workroom. When the two of you exit the room, Fisianna stares pointedly away and to the ground, avoiding eye contact with you.
rows.translation: ·斯蒂尔。很高兴见到您！请再次来访！如果有需要，我会保持待命，菲希安娜。”伊西丝的化身凭空召出一把虚拟椅子，坐到上面，随后又在面前生成一本书，开始阅读。你温柔地握住菲希安娜的爪子，陪她离开工作室。你们走出房间后，菲希安娜刻意看向别处和地面，避免与你对视。
rows.raw: " Steele. It was a pleasure meeting you! Please come by again! I shall be on standby should I be needed, Fisianna.” Isis’s avatar then procures a virtual chair from nothing and sits on it. Isis then materializes a book in front of her and begins reading it. You gently grab Fisianna’s paw and escort her out of the workroom. When the two of you exit the room, Fisianna stares pointedly away and to the ground, avoiding eye contact with you."

rows.original: <i>“So... about what Isis said. You can come clean with me if you want to. I’m not gonna bite or anything. To me it doesn’t seem like you’re the most comfortable talking about anything
rows.translation: <i>“那么...关于伊西丝说的事。如果愿意，你可以对我坦白。我不会咬你什么的。在我看来，你似乎不太愿意谈论任何
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“So... about what Isis said. You can come clean with me if you want to. I’m not gonna bite or anything. To me it doesn’t seem like you’re the most comfortable talking about anything "

rows.translation: 亲密事情
rows.raw: "intimate"

rows.original: sexual
rows.translation: 性方面的

rows.original: . I’d like to know what that is all about.” You say in as soothing of a voice as you can manage. You gently place your fingers below Fisianna’s chin and turn her head towards you. Fisianna looks into your eyes, her golden eyes glistening.
rows.translation: 。我想知道这是为什么。”你以力所能及最安抚的声音说道。你把手指温柔地放到菲希安娜下巴下方，让她转向自己。菲希安娜望进你的眼睛，金色眼眸闪闪发亮。
rows.raw: ". I’d like to know what that is all about.” You say in as soothing of a voice as you can manage. You gently place your fingers below Fisianna’s chin and turn her head towards you. Fisianna looks into your eyes, her golden eyes glistening."

rows.original: “[pc.name]... I-I’m sorry if I might be coming off prudish to you... I’ve been dealing with these... complicated feelings lately a-and I’m just not sure if I’m ready to deal with them, with you, just yet. I-It’s nothing to do with what you have done. You’ve been nothing but good to me. I-I... I just need a bit of time to open myself up to those feelings and take things... slowly. C-could you give me that?”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]...如果我让你觉得过分保守，我——我很抱歉...最近我一直在应对这些...复杂的感受，而且还不确定自己是否已经准备好面对它们，至少现在还没准备好和你一起面对。这与你做过的事情无关。你一直对我很好。我——我...只是需要一点时间，向这些感受敞开心扉，慢慢...推进。你——你能给我这些时间吗？”

You’ve been nothing but good to me. I-I... I just need a bit of time to open myself up to those feelings and take things... slowly. C-could you give me that?”"

rows.original: You feel it wouldn’t be prudent to rush Fisianna into anything that she wouldn’t be comfortable with so you nod in agreeance, to which Fisianna relaxes and smiles as her ears perk up. She then leans in to give you a kiss before giving you a long hug. “Thank you [pc.name]. You’re the best.”
rows.translation: 你认为不该催促菲希安娜做任何让她不舒服的事，于是点头同意。她放松下来，耳朵竖起，露出微笑。随后她靠近亲吻你，又给了你一个长久拥抱。“谢谢你，[pc.name]。你是最棒的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel it wouldn’t be prudent to rush Fisianna into anything that she wouldn’t be comfortable with so you nod in agreeance, to which Fisianna relaxes and smiles as her ears perk up. She then leans in to give you a kiss before giving you a long hug. “Thank you [pc.name]. You’re the best.” "

rows.original: She murmurs into your ear.
rows.translation: 她在你耳边低语。
rows.raw: "She murmurs into your ear."

rows.original: She murmurs into your shoulder.
rows.translation: 她贴着你肩膀低语。
rows.raw: "She murmurs into your shoulder."

rows.original: She murmurs into your chest.
rows.translation: 她贴着你胸口低语。
rows.raw: "She murmurs into your chest."

rows.original: After you break the hug, Fisianna is all smiling from ear to feline ear.
rows.translation: 拥抱结束后，菲希安娜从一只猫耳到另一只猫耳都洋溢着笑容。
rows.raw: " After you break the hug, Fisianna is all smiling from ear to feline ear."

rows.original: “S-so, did you maybe want to play a game together to pass some time while we’re here?” Fisianna asks sweetly.
rows.translation: “那——那么，我们在这里时，你想不想一起玩个游戏打发时间？”菲希安娜甜甜地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“S-so, did you maybe want to play a game together to pass some time while we’re here?” Fisianna asks sweetly."

rows.original: “Sure, we can do that, but there’s no way that I’m going to lose to you today!” You say jokingly to Fisianna. She giggles while giving you a confident smirk.
rows.translation: “好啊，不过今天我绝不可能输给你！”你开玩笑地对菲希安娜说道。她带着自信坏笑，咯咯笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, we can do that, but there’s no way that I’m going to lose to you today!” You say jokingly to Fisianna. She giggles while giving you a confident smirk."

rows.original: “Is that a challenge then? I guess I’m going to have to give it my all so I can get you off of that high-horse of yours then!” Fisianna teases as she flicks one of her tails at your side. Your playful lover rushes to the holoscreen by her theater setup to prepare her gaming rig. You go over to join Fisianna on the couch after she finishes setting the game up and grab a holo-harness. The two of you spend the rest of your time together playing CoV 8 against each other, winning and losing an equal amount of games before deciding on a tiebreaker when the two of you next have a chance to play together again.
rows.translation: “那么这是挑战吗？看来我必须全力以赴，把你从自负的高头大马上拉下来！”菲希安娜调笑着，用一条尾巴轻扫你侧腰。你顽皮的情人冲向家庭影院设备旁的全息屏幕，准备游戏装置。她完成设置后，你走过去，在沙发上加入她，拿起一副全息束带。你们用剩余时间互相对战《英勇召唤8》，胜负次数相同，最后决定下次有机会一起玩时进行决胜局。

I guess I’m going to have to give it my all so I can get you off of that high-horse of yours then!” Fisianna teases as she flicks one of her tails at your side. Your playful lover rushes to the holoscreen by her theater setup to prepare her gaming rig. You go over to join Fisianna on the couch after she finishes setting the game up and grab a holo-harness. The two of you spend the rest of your time together playing CoV 8 against each other, winning and losing an equal amount of games before deciding on a tiebreaker when the two of you next have a chance to play together again."

rows.original: KALAS.TAVROS.ANON'S BAR AND BOARD
rows.raw: "KALAS.TAVROS.ANON'S BAR AND BOARD"

rows.original: “A-actually, I’ve been wondering...” Fisianna has a faraway look in her golden eyes as she stares thoughtfully ahead. “This time, would you want to go to Anon’s with me for our next date?” Fisianna looks at you with a sweet smile on her peachy lips.
rows.translation: “其——其实，我一直在想...”菲希安娜若有所思地望着前方，金色眼眸显得有些恍惚。“这一次，我们下次约会时，你愿意和我一起去阿农酒吧吗？”菲希安娜桃色嘴唇带着甜美微笑望向你。
rows.raw: "“A-actually, I’ve been wondering...” Fisianna has a faraway look in her golden eyes as she stares thoughtfully ahead. “This time, would you want to go to Anon’s with me for our next date?” Fisianna looks at you with a sweet smile on her peachy lips. "

rows.original: “Fisianna, I didn’t take you to be the type to want to hang out at seedy bars...” The surprise on your face must be very apparent since Fisianna giggles at your expression.
rows.translation: “菲希安娜，我没想到你是会想去那种乌烟瘴气酒吧消遣的人...”你脸上的惊讶一定非常明显，因为菲希安娜看着表情咯咯笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fisianna, I didn’t take you to be the type to want to hang out at seedy bars...” The surprise on your face must be very apparent since Fisianna giggles at your expression."

rows.original: “Hehehe, of course not, silly!” Fisianna playfully punches your arm. “I... I just wanted to reminisce a little about where we first met is all. I know that sounds a little cliche but it actually would mean a lot to me if we could go there for a little.”
rows.translation: “呵呵呵，当然不是啦，傻瓜！”菲希安娜顽皮地捶了一下你的手臂。“我...我只是想稍微怀念一下我们初次相遇的地方。知道这听起来有点老套，可如果能在那里待一会儿，对我真的很有意义。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hehehe, of course not, silly!” Fisianna playfully punches your arm. “I... I just wanted to reminisce a little about where we first met is all. I know that sounds a little cliche but it actually would mean a lot to me if we could go there for a little.”"

rows.original: If it means that much to Fisianna to have a romantic date at Anon’s, however odd that may sound, you figure it would be best to oblige to her wishes. You tell Fisianna that you would be willing to go to Anon’s with her and rise up from the bench to offer her a hand. Fisianna smiles widely and takes your hand as you help her off of the bench. She gives you a quick kiss on your cheek in the same motion.
rows.translation: 如果在阿农酒吧进行浪漫约会对菲希安娜如此重要，无论听起来多么奇怪，你认为最好满足她的愿望。你告诉菲希安娜，愿意和她一起去阿农酒吧，随后从长椅起身，朝她伸手。菲希安娜灿烂微笑，握住你的手；你扶她离开长椅时，她顺势迅速亲了一下你的脸颊。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf it means that much to Fisianna to have a romantic date at Anon’s, however odd that may sound, you figure it would be best to oblige to her wishes. You tell Fisianna that you would be willing to go to Anon’s with her and rise up from the bench to offer her a hand. Fisianna smiles widely and takes your hand as you help her off of the bench. She gives you a quick kiss on your cheek in the same motion."

rows.original: “Thank you for granting my silly request. Shall we then?” Fisianna asks pleasantly while hooking her arm around yours and leaning against you. You nod and head towards the elevator shafts down to the Merchant Deck. When the elevator ride arrives at the Merchant Deck, it is only a short walk until you are back inside Anon’s again.
rows.translation: “谢谢你答应这个傻乎乎的请求。那么，我们出发吧？”菲希安娜愉快地问，一手挽住你的手臂，靠在身旁。你点头，朝通往商业甲板的电梯井走去。电梯抵达商业甲板后，只需走上一小段路，你们便再次进入阿农酒吧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you for granting my silly request. Shall we then?” Fisianna asks pleasantly while hooking her arm around yours and leaning against you. You nod and head towards the elevator shafts down to the Merchant Deck. When the elevator ride arrives at the Merchant Deck, it is only a short walk until you are back inside Anon’s again."

rows.original: Nothing much has changed since last you were here. The air is still rife with the smell of smoke, alcohol, and food. Skimpily dressed three breasted waitresses walk around carrying various trays of drinks and foods on three legs. You take a look next to you at Fisianna. She looks a bit uneasy, but upon catching your eyes, she gives you a seemingly resolute look. The two of you make your way to the corner booth where the two of you met and sit down together. A waitress comes by shortly after and takes both of your drink and food orders. Your drinks arrive within a minute and the waitress heads back into the kitchen. Fisianna takes a sip of her fizzy, fruity drink and looks at you, her eyes gleaming in the dim lights of the bar.
rows.translation: 这里和上次来时相比没有多少变化。空气中仍充满烟雾、酒精和食物气味。穿着暴露的三乳女服务员用三条腿走来走去，端着各式饮料与食物托盘。你看向身旁的菲希安娜。她似乎有些不安，却在迎上目光后露出仿佛下定决心的神情。你们来到初次相遇的角落卡座，一起坐下。不久，一名女服务员过来，记下你们各自的饮料与食物订单。饮料不到一分钟便送达，服务员又回到厨房。菲希安娜啜饮冒泡的水果饮料，望向你，双眼在酒吧昏暗灯光中闪耀。
rows.raw: "\n\nNothing much has changed since last you were here. The air is still rife with the smell of smoke, alcohol, and food. Skimpily dressed three breasted waitresses walk around carrying various trays of drinks and foods on three legs. You take a look next to you at Fisianna. She looks a bit uneasy, but upon catching your eyes, she gives you a seemingly resolute look. The two of you make your way to the corner booth where the two of you met and sit down together. A waitress comes by shortly after and takes both of your drink and food orders. Your drinks arrive within a minute and the waitress heads back into the kitchen. Fisianna takes a sip of her fizzy, fruity drink and looks at you, her eyes gleaming in the dim lights of the bar."

rows.original: “You know, ever since the last time you’ve been to my house, Isis won’t stop asking me when you’ll come by again.” Fisianna giggles. “I think she’s taken quite a liking to you!”
rows.translation: “知道吗，自从你上次来过我家，伊西丝就不停问我，你什么时候会再次登门。”菲希安娜咯咯笑道。“我觉得她真的很喜欢你！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know, ever since the last time you’ve been to my house, Isis won’t stop asking me when you’ll come by again.” Fisianna giggles. “I think she’s taken quite a liking to you!”"

rows.original: “Yeah, she’s quite an impressive AI. To think that you made her as a freelance programmer. Most companies would probably kill to have as skilled a programmer as you on their team.”
rows.translation: “对，她是个非常了不起的人工智能。真难想象你以自由程序员身份创造了她。大多数公司大概会不惜一切代价，让像你这样技术高超的程序员加入团队。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, she’s quite an impressive AI. To think that you made her as a freelance programmer. Most companies would probably kill to have as skilled a programmer as you on their team.”"

rows.original: Fisianna blushes heavily at your praise. “Y-yeah... believe me, I get repeated offers from companies all of the time, especially from JoyCo and KihaCorp. I know those two companies themselves are heated rivals so I’m not even going to touch a permanent contract with either company, but I’ll take any temporary offer I can from them. They pay very well, usually.”
rows.translation: 听见赞美，菲希安娜脸红得厉害。“对——对...相信我，我一直会反复收到公司的邀请，尤其是欢乐公司和基哈公司。我知道这两家公司本身就是激烈竞争对手，所以绝不会与其中任何一家签永久合同，不过会接受它们提供的任何临时工作。通常报酬非常丰厚。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna blushes heavily at your praise. “Y-yeah... believe me, I get repeated offers from companies all of the time, especially from JoyCo and KihaCorp. I know those two companies themselves are heated rivals so I’m not even going to touch a permanent contract with either company, but I’ll take any temporary offer I can from them. They pay very well, usually.”"

rows.original: “Have they ever asked to you make anything as advanced as Isis before?” You wonder aloud to the techy neko.
rows.translation: “他们有没有要求你制作过像伊西丝这样先进的东西？”你对这个技术宅猫娘问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Have they ever asked to you make anything as advanced as Isis before?” You wonder aloud to the techy neko."

rows.original: Fisianna brings a paw to her chin and looks up thoughtfully. “Mmm... not really. Most of my jobs have been pretty standard as far as I know. Just fix this, fix that. Look over this code. Correct anything you see wrong here and there. I try to downplay what I can actually do as much as I can beyond that. I wouldn’t want another Bess-13 and Ben-14 disaster to happen again if they found someone that is as skilled at making AIs as I am...”
rows.translation: 菲希安娜抬起一只爪子放到下巴，若有所思地仰望。“嗯...其实没有。据我所知，大多数工作都相当标准。修理这个，修理那个；检查这段代码；纠正这里那里发现的问题。除此以外，我尽可能淡化自己的真正能力。如果他们找到和我一样擅长制作人工智能的人，我可不希望贝丝-13和本-14的灾难再次发生...”
rows.raw: "\n\nFisianna brings a paw to her chin and looks up thoughtfully. “Mmm... not really. Most of my jobs have been pretty standard as far as I know. Just fix this, fix that. Look over this code. Correct anything you see wrong here and there. I try to downplay what I can actually do as much as I can beyond that. I wouldn’t want another Bess-13 and Ben-14 disaster to happen again if they found someone that is as skilled at making AIs as I am...”"

rows.original: “I wouldn’t say that they were a complete disaster anyways...” You tell Fisianna cryptically. Before she can say anything on the matter, the waitress arrives with your food.
rows.translation: “不过，我不会说他们是彻底的灾难...”你含糊地告诉菲希安娜。她还没来得及对此发表意见，女服务员便端着食物过来。
rows.raw: "“I wouldn’t say that they were a complete disaster anyways...” You tell Fisianna cryptically. Before she can say anything on the matter, the waitress arrives with your food. "

rows.original: The waitress comes out of the kitchen and arrives with your food.
rows.translation: 女服务员从厨房出来，把食物端到桌上。
rows.raw: "The waitress comes out of the kitchen and arrives with your food. "

rows.original: She places down a heaping dish of fish and chips for the both of you and gives the both of you a wink before sashaying off to serve another patron. rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m a bit confused, you might have to elaborate on that, Fisi.” You look down at Fisianna and she has a look of deep curiosity on her face."

rows.original: “O-oh, what I mean is, I-I know the space frontier is usually more libidinous than I’m used to, s-so I imagine on the Rush, you might meet a number of others that are interested in you, possibly. There might come times where you might be enticed to, or even forced into an unfortunate situation, l-like with that zil from before. You might even meet some people that fall in love with you just about as hard as I have. I-I just want to know what your view is if those things were to happen, even though you choose to be with me.” Fisianna cutely traces a finger on your chest while she asks you.
rows.translation: “哦，我的意思是，我，我知道太空边疆通常比我习惯的环境更放纵，所，所以我想在行星淘金热里，你可能会遇见很多对你感兴趣的人。也许有些时候你会受到诱惑，甚至被迫陷入不幸状况，就，就像以前那个齐尔人一样。你甚至可能遇见一些人，像我一样深深爱上你。我，我只是想知道，如果发生这些事，即使你选择和我在一起，你会持什么看法。”菲西安娜一边问，一边用手指可爱地在你胸前描画。
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh, what I mean is, I-I know the space frontier is usually more libidinous than I’m used to, s-so I imagine on the Rush, you might meet a number of others that are interested in you, possibly. There might come times where you might be enticed to, or even forced into an unfortunate situation, l-like with that zil from before. You might even meet some people that fall in love with you just about as hard as I have. I-I just want to know what your view is if those things were to happen, even though you choose to be with me.” Fisianna cutely traces a finger on your chest while she asks you."

rows.original: You scootch over to Fisianna and gently wrap your arms around her shoulders. She yelps in surprise when you pull her to your chest, but quickly relaxes when she sees your intent and makes herself comfortable against you. The two of you recline on the park bench, your feline lover content on listening to the ambience of your steady heartbeat.
rows.translation: 你朝菲西安娜挪近，轻轻用双臂搂住她的肩膀。你把她拉到胸前时，她惊讶地叫了一声；不过看清你的意图后，她很快放松下来，舒适地贴住你。你们一起靠躺在公园长椅上，猫科爱人满足地倾听你平稳心跳营造的氛围。
rows.raw: "You scootch over to Fisianna and gently wrap your arms around her shoulders. She yelps in surprise when you pull her to your chest, but quickly relaxes when she sees your intent and makes herself comfortable against you. The two of you recline on the park bench, your feline lover content on listening to the ambience of your steady heartbeat."

rows.original: You interlace your fingers with Fisianna’s while she gives you a meaningful look. Your lover leans into your shoulder and gently rests her head against it. After her eyes fully close, you can hear her murmur, “I love being with you like this, [pc.name]...” She smiles and purrs as the two of you spend the rest of your time together in comfortable silence.
rows.translation: 你让手指与菲西安娜交扣在一起，她意味深长地看了你一眼。你的爱人靠向肩膀，轻轻把头枕在上面。双眼完全闭合以后，你听见她低声说道：“我喜欢这样和你待在一起，[pc.name]...”你们在舒适的沉默中度过剩余时间，她微笑着发出呼噜声。
rows.raw: "You interlace your fingers with Fisianna’s while she gives you a meaningful look. Your lover leans into your shoulder and gently rests her head against it. After her eyes fully close, you can hear her murmur, “I love being with you like this, [pc.name]...” She smiles and purrs as the two of you spend the rest of your time together in comfortable silence."

rows.original: When you least expect it, Fisianna reaches over and gives you a quick peck on the cheek. She has a sly smile on her peachy lips and giggles softly at your surprised reaction. Not one to be outdone, you pounce on the unfortunate kitty, smothering whatever parts of her face you can catch with kisses. She lets out a small shriek of mock-fear and laughs jovially while she folds under your relentless assault.
rows.translation: 就在你最意想不到的时候，菲西安娜探身飞快亲了一下你的脸颊。她桃色双唇上带着狡黠笑容，看见你惊讶的反应便轻声咯咯直笑。不肯认输的你扑向这只不幸小猫，用亲吻淹没她脸上所有能够抓住的部位。她假装害怕地小声尖叫，又在你无情攻势下蜷起身体，欢快大笑。
rows.raw: "When you least expect it, Fisianna reaches over and gives you a quick peck on the cheek. She has a sly smile on her peachy lips and giggles softly at your surprised reaction. Not one to be outdone, you pounce on the unfortunate kitty, smothering whatever parts of her face you can catch with kisses. She lets out a small shriek of mock-fear and laughs jovially while she folds under your relentless assault."

rows.original: You feel Fisianna shifting steadily closer to you. When you look over to her, she plants a kiss square on your [pc.lipsChaste] before you can react. The feline’s golden eyes close shut while she sinks deeper into you, forcing you to lean against the arm of the bench. You wrap your arms around your lover as you spend the next few minutes making out.
rows.translation: 你感觉菲西安娜不断向自己靠近。转头看她时，她在你来得及反应以前直接吻住[pc.lipsChaste]。猫咪闭紧金色双眼，朝你贴得更深，迫使你靠住长椅扶手。你伸臂环抱爱人，接下来几分钟都在和她热吻。
rows.raw: "You feel Fisianna shifting steadily closer to you. When you look over to her, she plants a kiss square on your [pc.lipsChaste] before you can react. The feline’s golden eyes close shut while she sinks deeper into you, forcing you to lean against the arm of the bench. You wrap your arms around your lover as you spend the next few minutes making out."

rows.original: Fisianna rises up from the bench without any forewarning, making you wonder if she is about to leave you. Before you can ask if anything is wrong, however, she turns to you and smiles widely while she steps in front of you. Your feline lover rotates in place to face away from you before bending over to plant her twin-tailed bottom on your lap.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜毫无预警地从长椅站起，让你怀疑她是不是要离开。可你还没来得及问发生了什么，她就转身面对你，灿烂微笑着走到面前。你的猫科爱人原地转身背对你，随后弯下腰，把那只带着双尾的屁股放到你腿上。
rows.raw: "Fisianna rises up from the bench without any forewarning, making you wonder if she is about to leave you. Before you can ask if anything is wrong, however, she turns to you and smiles widely while she steps in front of you. Your feline lover rotates in place to face away from you before bending over to plant her twin-tailed bottom on your lap."

rows.original: “Sorry, I just feel more comfy sitting here than on the hard bench... Y-you don’t mind, right?” Fisianna asks coyly while sensuously running the tip of one of her tails along your chin. You wrap your arms around her waist to answer her question and relax back against the bench, with the soft feline purring providing the most enjoyable accompaniment.
rows.translation: “抱歉，我只是觉得坐在这里比坐硬邦邦的长椅舒服...你，你不介意吧？”菲西安娜羞涩地问，同时感官十足地用一条尾巴尖扫过你的下巴。你环住她的腰作为回答，向后靠上长椅；柔软猫咪的呼噜声成了最令人愉快的伴奏。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, I just feel more comfy sitting here than on the hard bench... Y-you don’t mind, right?” Fisianna asks coyly while sensuously running the tip of one of her tails along your chin. You wrap your arms around her waist to answer her question and relax back against the bench, with the soft feline purring providing the most enjoyable accompaniment."

rows.original: You lean over to Fisianna and scoop her cheek into your hand before planting a kiss to her peachy lips. She reacts on instinct and presses herself into you before you can think to pull away; not that you wanted to, anyways. Your feline lover moans into your mouth as she prolongs the kiss and leans heavily into you, almost making the two of you fall off the bench. When you shift position to keep your balance, Fisianna suddenly pulls back from you, gasping at her own boldness as soon as your and her lips part.
rows.translation: 你靠向菲西安娜，用手托住她的脸颊，吻上桃色双唇。她本能回应，在你想到退开以前就紧紧贴过来；反正你也不想退开。猫科爱人含着你的嘴呻吟，延长亲吻，身体重重靠向你，险些让两个人一起摔下长椅。你调整姿势保持平衡时，菲西安娜突然退开；你们的嘴唇刚刚分离，她便因自己的大胆而惊喘。
rows.raw: "You lean over to Fisianna and scoop her cheek into your hand before planting a kiss to her peachy lips. She reacts on instinct and presses herself into you before you can think to pull away; not that you wanted to, anyways. Your feline lover moans into your mouth as she prolongs the kiss and leans heavily into you, almost making the two of you fall off the bench. When you shift position to keep your balance, Fisianna suddenly pulls back from you, gasping at her own boldness as soon as your and her lips part."

rows.original: “A-ah! S-sorry, [pc.name]! I don’t know what came over me... I-I kinda lost control for a moment there.” She smiles sheepishly. Trying your best not to chuckle, you straighten yourself out and pet the amorous kitten between her ears, letting her know that you forgive her. She smiles in relief and settles in to lean against you, content with spending the rest of your time together this way.
rows.translation: “啊！对，对不起，[pc.name]！我不知道自己怎么了...刚才有点失去控制。”她难为情地笑起来。你竭力忍住轻笑，重新坐好，抚摸这只多情小猫两耳之间的位置，表示自己原谅她。她如释重负地微笑，安定下来靠着你，满足于用这种方式与你共度剩余时间。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A-ah! S-sorry, [pc.name]! I don’t know what came over me... I-I kinda lost control for a moment there.” She smiles sheepishly. Trying your best not to chuckle, you straighten yourself out and pet the amorous kitten between her ears, letting her know that you forgive her. She smiles in relief and settles in to lean against you, content with spending the rest of your time together this way."

rows.original: You hear a soft mewling next to you while you relax against the bench. Turning to Fisianna, you see that she is looking at you with glimmer in her golden eyes that tells you she really wants something. You can’t help but smile at her overly cute display and gently pat your lap, welcoming her to climb on.
rows.translation: 你靠在长椅上放松时，听见身旁传来轻柔猫叫。转向菲西安娜，你看见她金色眼睛里闪烁着一种明确表示很想要某样东西的光芒。你无法抗拒她过分可爱的表现，微笑着轻拍自己的大腿，欢迎她爬上来。
rows.raw: "You hear a soft mewling next to you while you relax against the bench. Turning to Fisianna, you see that she is looking at you with glimmer in her golden eyes that tells you she really wants something. You can’t help but smile at her overly cute display and gently pat your lap, welcoming her to climb on."

rows.original: Fisi’s face lights up as she eagerly accepts the invitation, rising up from the bench to settle down sideways onto your lap. Fisianna leans into your chest, happily purring while watching the passersby go about their business.
rows.translation: 菲西的脸顿时亮了起来，热切接受邀请，从长椅起身，侧身坐到你腿上。菲西安娜靠住胸膛，开心地发出呼噜声，观看路人各自忙碌。
rows.raw: "\n\nFisi’s face lights up as she eagerly accepts the invitation, rising up from the bench to settle down sideways onto your lap. Fisianna leans into your chest, happily purring while watching the passersby go about their business."

rows.original: You can feel the bench vibrating dully beneath you as you relax. Moments later, you feel Fisianna’s head nuzzling into your shoulder as she tries to get your attention with her animalistic affections. You laugh and wrap an arm around her, stopping to scritch under her soft, rounded chin. On contact, the feline’s ears twitch and flatten against her head. She has a blissed out expression on her face, and her purring intensifies as you gently pet her.
rows.translation: 你放松时，能感觉到长椅在身下沉闷震动。片刻后，菲西安娜为了吸引注意，用脑袋蹭起你的肩膀，以动物般的亲昵向你撒娇。你笑着用手臂搂住她，停下来挠挠柔软圆润的下巴。刚一触碰，猫咪的耳朵就轻弹着贴平脑袋。她脸上带着无比幸福的神情；随着你的轻柔抚摸，呼噜声也越来越响。
rows.raw: "You can feel the bench vibrating dully beneath you as you relax. Moments later, you feel Fisianna’s head nuzzling into your shoulder as she tries to get your attention with her animalistic affections. You laugh and wrap an arm around her, stopping to scritch under her soft, rounded chin. On contact, the feline’s ears twitch and flatten against her head. She has a blissed out expression on her face, and her purring intensifies as you gently pet her."

rows.original: You feel a furred arm wrap itself around yours while the two of you relax on the bench. Fisianna gives you a light tug while she leans in to peck your cheek.
rows.translation: 你们在长椅上放松时，感觉一条覆满绒毛的手臂缠住了自己的手臂。菲西安娜轻轻拉你一下，靠过来亲吻脸颊。
rows.raw: "You feel a furred arm wrap itself around yours while the two of you relax on the bench. Fisianna gives you a light tug while she leans in to peck your cheek."

rows.original: “I love you so much, [pc.name]. Just thought I’d tell you that!” she says sweetly as she rests against you. You return her affections with your own kiss, and the two of you spend a pleasurable few moments in each other’s arms.
rows.translation: “我真的好爱你，[pc.name]。只是觉得应该告诉你！”她甜甜地说道，身体靠在你身上。你也回吻表达感情，随后两人在彼此怀中愉快度过了片刻。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I love you so much, [pc.name]. Just thought I’d tell you that!” she says sweetly as she rests against you. You return her affections with your own kiss, and the two of you spend a pleasurable few moments in each other’s arms."

rows.original: Fisianna wraps her furred arms around one of yours, pulling it close to herself and squeezing it tightly. When you turn your head to look at her, she has a very anxious expression on her face while she gazes at you.
rows.translation: 菲西安娜用覆满绒毛的双臂环住你一条胳膊，拉到身边紧紧抱住。你转头看她时，发现她正以十分焦虑的表情凝视自己。
rows.raw: "Fisianna wraps her furred arms around one of yours, pulling it close to herself and squeezing it tightly. When you turn your head to look at her, she has a very anxious expression on her face while she gazes at you."

rows.original: “You look worried about something. What’s the matter?” you ask Fisianna gently.
rows.translation: “你好像在担心什么。怎么了？”你温和地问菲西安娜。
rows.raw: "“You look worried about something. What’s the matter?” you ask Fisianna gently."

rows.original: <i>“Alright, alright! I’m not going anywhere! What’s gotten you so worked up?”</i > you ask Fisianna lightheartedly.
rows.translation: <i>“好啦，好啦！我哪里也不去！什么事让你这么激动？”</i >你轻松地问菲西安娜。
rows.raw: "<i>“Alright, alright! I’m not going anywhere! What’s gotten you so worked up?”</i > you ask Fisianna lightheartedly."

rows.original: <i>“Alright, something’s obviously got you bothered. Spit it out.”</i > you tell Fisianna bluntly.
rows.translation: <i>“好吧，显然有什么事让你很困扰。说出来。”</i >你直截了当地告诉菲西安娜。
rows.raw: "<i>“Alright, something’s obviously got you bothered. Spit it out.”</i > you tell Fisianna bluntly."

rows.original: Your lover fidgets in her seat for a few moments before inching closer to hug you.
rows.translation: 你的爱人在座位上不安地动了片刻，随后一点点靠近，抱住你。
rows.raw: " Your lover fidgets in her seat for a few moments before inching closer to hug you."

rows.original: “I... I just worry about you sometimes while you’re away on the Rush, about all the dangers that might await you - or that you might have already had to face; about how soon you would come back to me... or even if at all. I don’t know if I could handle potentially losing you...” Fisianna sniffles and buries her head into your side. With your free arm, you reach around to gently pet the feline, stroking your fingers through her long hair, telling her everything will be okay and that you’ll make sure to come back in one piece for her.
rows.translation: “我...你参加行星淘金热、离开这里时，我有时候就是很担心；担心可能有什么危险在等着你，或者你已经不得不面对了什么危险；担心你多久才能回到我身边...甚至还能不能回来。我不知道自己能不能承受可能失去你的结果...”菲西安娜抽着鼻子，把脑袋埋进你身侧。你用空闲手臂环过来，轻柔抚摸这只猫咪，手指梳过长发，告诉她一切都会没事，也保证会完整无缺地回到她身边。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... I just worry about you sometimes while you’re away on the Rush, about all the dangers that might await you - or that you might have already had to face; about how soon you would come back to me... or even if at all. I don’t know if I could handle potentially losing you...” Fisianna sniffles and buries her head into your side. With your free arm, you reach around to gently pet the feline, stroking your fingers through her long hair, telling her everything will be okay and that you’ll make sure to come back in one piece for her."

rows.original: While looking ahead and enjoying the companionable silence the two of you are sharing, you feel something long, skinny and furry start to snake up and around your body. A second tendril-like object coils itself around your midsection, squeezing close to your form. The moment you look towards your lover, she flashes you a sweet smile, and you feel her tails’ grip tightening gently. Their embrace feels lovely, and when she wraps her arms around your torso, you feel as comfy as if you were wrapped with a downy blanket.
rows.translation: 你望向前方，享受两人共享的亲密沉默时，感觉某种细长而覆满绒毛的东西开始沿身体蜿蜒向上并缠绕。第二根卷须般的物体绕住腰腹，贴紧身体。你刚看向爱人，她就朝你甜甜一笑，你也感觉到她的尾巴轻轻收紧。那份拥抱感觉十分美妙；当她再用双臂搂住躯干时，你舒服得仿佛裹在一张羽绒毯里。
rows.raw: "While looking ahead and enjoying the companionable silence the two of you are sharing, you feel something long, skinny and furry start to snake up and around your body. A second tendril-like object coils itself around your midsection, squeezing close to your form. rows.original: “Ooooh...” is all you can blurt out in response as your mind draws a total blank for anything intelligible to say to your lover. You feel as if you are completely melting into nothingness under her, and loving every waking moment of it.

rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooooh...” is all you can blurt out in response as your mind draws a total blank for anything intelligible to say to your lover. You feel as if you are completely melting into nothingness under her, and loving every waking moment of it."

rows.original: After a few moments of this, you gently lift Fisi’s arms and roll yourself onto your back, careful to stay under the still purring neko so that you are hugging her close to you. She looks lovingly into your eyes as you pull her into a kiss. You silently thank her to taking such good care of you, putting those emotions into the embrace while you snuggle together. When you break the kiss, she cradles your face with one of her soft paws.
rows.translation: 这样持续片刻后，你轻轻抬起菲希的手臂，翻身仰躺，小心地仍让呼噜不停的猫娘留在你身上。她惊讶地眨眼，却很快顺势趴到你胸前。你们目光相接，彼此微笑。

rows.original: “I hope I could at least help a little for your future adventures this way. I still worry for you whenever you aren’t here, but... I thank goodness anytime you come back at least relatively unharmed. I’ll be wishing that you find your father’s probes as soon as possible so I don’t have to keep worrying.”
rows.translation: “希望这样至少能为你未来的冒险提供一点帮助。你不在这里时，我一直很担心，但是...我知道不能阻止你去做必须做的事。”菲希安娜温柔说道。

I thank goodness anytime you come back at least relatively unharmed. I’ll be wishing that you find your father’s probes as soon as possible so I don’t have to keep worrying.”"

rows.original: “I’m glad for any chance I could do this for you, especially for moments like this... I know I can’t keep you here forever, but I do hope that you can find your father’s probes as soon as possible so you could possibly be here all the time.”
rows.translation: “只要有机会，我都很高兴能为你做这些，尤其是像现在这样的时刻...我知道不能永远把你留在这里，但每次你平安回来，我都很庆幸。”

rows.original: “I-I... but...” she stammers, struggling to find the words to say to you. With a small sniffle, Fisianna speaks up again. “A-alright, [pc.name], but please... please be very careful for me. It really pains me to see you hurt and not be able to do anything about it. M-maybe it’s partially from having a medical upbringing, but... it’s mainly because I love you so much. Promise me you’ll still be in one piece when this is all over,” Fisianna pleads. You nod your head, and gingerly hug your caring lover, assuring her that you will be okay.
rows.translation: “我、我...可是...”她结结巴巴，不知该说什么。轻轻抽鼻子后，菲希安娜再次开口。“好、好吧，[pc.name]，但请...请一定替我万分小心。看到你受伤、自己却无能为力，真的令我痛苦。也、也许一部分原因是我在医疗环境里长大，但...最主要还是因为我太爱你。答应我，等一切结束时，你仍会完完整整地回来。”菲希安娜恳求道。你点头，轻柔拥抱关心自己的恋人，向她保证会没事。

rows.original: You go with the flow, stepping through the threshold. The door closes soundly behind you. The tall, shirtless man strides past you and through the apartment. Does he expect you to follow?
rows.translation: 你顺其自然地跨过门槛。房门在身后沉稳关闭。高大而赤裸上身的男人从你身边大步走过，穿过公寓。他是想让你跟上吗？

rows.original: You follow in his footsteps through the huge, luxurious apartment, reeling a little at the amount of credits it must have cost. From the polished synth-oak floors to the artwork pieces, there’s definitely a glamorous air to the place. Whoever he is, he’s definitely wealthy, there’s no doubt about that. Spotting an open doorway, you see the beginnings of a bedroom, replete with a silky, king sized bed. It’s not hard to see the silk ropes tied to the foot of the bed... it’s not hard to guess what they would be for.
rows.translation: 你跟着他的脚步穿过巨大豪华的公寓，想到这里耗费的信用点，不禁有些晕眩。从抛光合成橡木地板到一件件艺术品，整个地方显然弥漫着华美气息。不管他是谁，都无疑非常富有。你看见一扇敞开的门，后面露出卧室一角，还有一张丝绸铺就的特大床。床脚绑着丝绳，根本不难看见...也不难猜到它们是做什么的。

It’s not hard to see the silk ropes tied to the foot of the bed... it’s not hard to guess what they would be for."

rows.translation: 不过，他没有把你领去那里，而是来到公共区域里岛屿般的圆形厨房，四周摆满座位。主人转向你，一只手梳过午夜般漆黑的长发。“...想喝一杯吗？这里储备得很充足。”

rows.original: Starting at the top, the devilish-looking man has dark, thick hair that reaches down to his shoulders; the sort you could stroke your hands through for hours. His eyes do nothing to soften his rather wicked appearance; they’re passionate, crimson orbs with black, tiger like slits, capped by powerful brows. His ears, like those of all vildarii, are pointed and elfin.

rows.original: Looking down from the nape of his neck, the first thing to notice is his broad, proud shoulders and chest. They’re held with some inner confidence that never seems to falter. Perhaps it’s his dancing training that gives him such perfect, unwavering poise. Said chest is well displayed by his silk black shirt, deliberately left open all the way down to his slender stomach. His whole body in fact has a perfect V-like shape, starting at the shoulders down to his narrow hips; and if his shapely ass is any indication, they possess some serious thrusting power.
rows.translation: 从后颈向下看，最先映入眼帘的是宽阔骄傲的肩膀和胸膛。某种永不动摇的内在自信支撑着它们。也许舞蹈训练赋予了他如此完美稳定的仪态。黑色丝绸衬衫特意一路敞至纤细腹部，将胸膛充分展示。事实上，整个身体呈完美V形，从肩膀收窄至臀部；而从圆润屁股来看，那副腰胯显然拥有强大冲刺力量。

rows.translation: 你向芬恩询问维尔达里族，很想了解他的种族。黑发男人似乎很乐意回答，开口时身体稍稍后仰。
rows.raw: "You ask Fyn about the vildarii. You’re interested to hear about his species. The midnight-haired man seems happy to answer your questions, leaning back a little as he does so."

rows.original: “Well, where to start? We’re fantastic, mostly because I’m one of them,” Fyn states, a playful glint in his eyes.
rows.translation: “好吧，从哪里说起？我们棒极了，主要因为我是其中一员，”芬恩说道，眼中闪着顽皮光芒。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, where to start? We’re fantastic, mostly because I’m one of them,” Fyn states, a playful glint in his eyes."

rows.original: “Humble!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Humble!”"

rows.original: “I know, I am. All performers are, you know,” he winks, then crosses his arms. “Hmm, I guess I should give a serious answer, spreading culture and all that. Where to start?”
rows.translation: “我知道，我一直都很谦虚。所有表演者都这样，你懂的，”他眨眨眼，随后交叉双臂。“嗯，我想应该认真回答，传播文化什么的。从哪里说起呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know, I am. All performers are, you know,” he winks, then crosses his arms. “Hmm, I guess I should give a serious answer, spreading culture and all that. Where to start?”"

rows.original: “How about the fact you’re all polymorphs?” you suggest, and he nods.
rows.translation: “比如你们全都是变形者？”你提议道，他点了点头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How about the fact you’re all polymorphs?” you suggest, and he nods."

rows.original: “Yes, we are, though we’re not the best out there. Not the worst, either. A lot of people think we’re just all born with the ability to switch into whatever we please, but it’s not really that simple.”
rows.translation: “没错，不过我们不是最优秀的，也不是最差的。很多人以为我们天生就能随意变成任何模样，但事情其实没那么简单。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, we are, though we’re not the best out there. Not the worst, either. A lot of people think we’re just all born with the ability to switch into whatever we please, but it’s not really that simple.”"

rows.original: “It actually takes an awful lot of training over many, many years, and even then, you’ve got to have a natural knack for it. It’s a bit like singing, in that respect. Most terrans and ausar can sing, for example, but not all are good at it.”
rows.translation: “实际上需要许多许多年的大量训练；即使如此，也得有天生诀窍。从这方面看，它有点像唱歌。例如，大多数地球人与奥萨都能唱歌，但并不是每个人都擅长。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It actually takes an awful lot of training over many, many years, and even then, you’ve got to have a natural knack for it. It’s a bit like singing, in that respect. Most terrans and ausar can sing, for example, but not all are good at it.”"

rows.original: “Not only did I study polymorphing at school, I specialized in it at theatrical college. I also honed it as a stripper while I was paying off my tuition fees. It’s a lot of work, this face changing business,” Fyn explains, giving a faux-sigh. “Most everyday vildarii can only change their color, and the shape of our eyes and ears. The dead giveaways.”
rows.translation: “我不仅在学校学习了变形，还在戏剧学院专修这门技术。偿还学费时，我也通过当脱衣舞者磨炼技巧。改变面孔的行当可费工夫了，”芬恩假装叹气解释道。“大多数普通维尔达里人只能改变颜色，以及眼睛和耳朵的形状。那些一眼就能看穿身份的特征。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not only did I study polymorphing at school, I specialized in it at theatrical college. I also honed it as a stripper while I was paying off my tuition fees. It’s a lot of work, this face changing business,” Fyn explains, giving a faux-sigh. “Most everyday vildarii can only change their color, and the shape of our eyes and ears. The dead giveaways.”"

rows.original: “And you?” you ask, your curiosity piqued.
rows.translation: “那你呢？”你好奇心大起，问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And you?” you ask, your curiosity piqued."

rows.original: “Well, I can change the overall texture, shape, and color of everything, really. Sprouting ausar ears or kaithrit whiskers, for example, or even an extra phallus should the mood suit me. On a good day, I can do a tail, but that’s a lot of work.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我基本能改变一切的整体质感、形状与颜色。例如长出奥萨耳朵或凯斯里特胡须；心情合适时，甚至可以多长一根阳具。状态好的日子里，我也能变出尾巴，不过那要花大量工夫。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I can change the overall texture, shape, and color of everything, really. Sprouting ausar ears or kaithrit whiskers, for example, or even an extra phallus should the mood suit me. On a good day, I can do a tail, but that’s a lot of work.”"

rows.original: “That said, it’s not as easy as it looks. Every time I change, I need to binge eat like crazy; transforming burns up things like fats and sugars, so come performance time, I’ve got to chow down like my life depends on it. Not a bad deal, though, eating so much and never having it hit the hips.”
rows.translation: “不过，这并不像看起来那么容易。每次变形，我都得疯狂暴食；变形会消耗脂肪和糖分之类的东西，所以到了演出时，我必须像命悬一线般大吃特吃。不过这交易不坏，吃这么多也永远不会胖到腰臀上。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That said, it’s not as easy as it looks. Every time I change, I need to binge eat like crazy; transforming burns up things like fats and sugars, so come performance time, I’ve got to chow down like my life depends on it. Not a bad deal, though, eating so much and never having it hit the hips.”"

rows.original: You ask Fyn about his career. You recall that he was meant to be a young up-and-coming actor, at least if the holos were to be believed.
rows.translation: 你询问芬恩的事业。你记得他本该是一名崭露头角的年轻演员，至少全息影像是这么说的。
rows.raw: "You ask Fyn about his career. You recall that he was meant to be a young up-and-coming actor, at least if the holos were to be believed."

rows.original: “Yeah. Well, I did make it big time. I was cast a big role with the Starlanders; that’s a theatrical company that do holo-productions as well. I would have been broadcast large as life, all three dimensions across countless star systems...”
rows.translation: “是啊。嗯，我确实大红大紫了。我在星陆剧团获得一个重要角色；那是一家也制作全息作品的戏剧公司。我本会以真人般巨大的三维形象，在无数星系播出...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah. Well, I did make it big time. I was cast a big role with the Starlanders; that’s a theatrical company that do holo-productions as well. I would have been broadcast large as life, all three dimensions across countless star systems...”"

rows.original: Fyn pauses and looks off into a random direction, furrowing his brow. “And someone very close to me died. I didn’t really have it in my heart to perform after that,” he pauses for a moment. “...It nearly killed my agent, but I decided to quit and come out here to the edges of Rush space.”
rows.translation: 芬恩停下来，皱着眉头随意望向一旁。“然后，一个与我非常亲近的人去世了。那之后，我实在没有心情继续表演，”他停顿片刻。“...这差点把经纪人气死，但我决定退出，来到行星开拓区边缘。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFyn pauses and looks off into a random direction, furrowing his brow. “And someone very close to me died. I didn’t really have it in my heart to perform after that,” he pauses for a moment. “...It nearly killed my agent, but I decided to quit and come out here to the edges of Rush space.”"

rows.original: You ask him what he’s looking for, out here on the edges of known space, and Fyn gives a somber smile. “Honestly? I don’t know. All I knew is I wasn’t going to find it back there in the core.”
rows.translation: 你问他在已知空间边缘寻找什么，芬恩露出沉郁笑容。“说实话？我不知道。我只知道，在核心区那里找不到它。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask him what he’s looking for, out here on the edges of known space, and Fyn gives a somber smile. “Honestly? I don’t know. All I knew is I wasn’t going to find it back there in the core.”"

rows.original: You ask Fyn why he loves dancing so much. The midnight-haired man strokes his chin, seemingly trying to articulate his answer.
rows.translation: 你问芬恩为什么如此热爱舞蹈。黑发男人抚摸下巴，似乎正努力组织答案。
rows.raw: "You ask Fyn why he loves dancing so much. The midnight-haired man strokes his chin, seemingly trying to articulate his answer."

rows.original: “Well, it’s expression. It’s energy. It’s... quite obviously hard to explain. You’re in the moment, and in that moment you’re free; nothing else matters. You’re just swallowed by this adrenaline rush, this sort of pure, all-encompassing joy.”
rows.translation: “嗯，那是表达，是能量，是...显然很难解释。你活在那一刻，而在那一刻，你是自由的；其他一切都不重要。你只会被这股肾上腺素激流、这种纯粹而包罗一切的喜悦吞没。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, it’s expression. It’s energy. It’s... quite obviously hard to explain. You’re in the moment, and in that moment you’re free; nothing else matters. You’re just swallowed by this adrenaline rush, this sort of pure, all-encompassing joy.”"

rows.original: By the passionate glint in his eyes, it seems he really likes dancing. You ask him what kind he likes.
rows.translation: 从他眼中热情的光芒看来，他真的很喜欢舞蹈。你问他喜欢哪一种。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the passionate glint in his eyes, it seems he really likes dancing. You ask him what kind he likes."

rows.original: “Well, I have a soft spot for ballroom dancing; there’s something particular about the intimate dynamic of two people dancing, bodies pressed together. Theatrical dance too, though that’s more expression.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我对交际舞情有独钟；两人身体相贴起舞的亲密互动，有种特别之处。还有戏剧舞蹈，不过那更偏向表达。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I have a soft spot for ballroom dancing; there’s something particular about the intimate dynamic of two people dancing, bodies pressed together. Theatrical dance too, though that’s more expression.”"

rows.original: “Oh, and strip tease. Definitely strip tease.”
rows.translation: “噢，还有脱衣舞。绝对少不了脱衣舞。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, and strip tease. Definitely strip tease.”"

rows.original: You remark that strip tease doesn’t seem to fit with the other two classical arts, and Fyn winks.
rows.translation: 你评论说，脱衣舞似乎和另外两种古典艺术不太搭，芬恩眨了眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou remark that strip tease doesn’t seem to fit with the other two classical arts, and Fyn winks."

rows.original: “When I do it, hun, it’s an art. Trust me. Being able to make someone’s lusts and desires flutter back into their head, just with how much you’re winding them up? Forget art; that’s practically magic.”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，由我来跳，那就是艺术。相信我。仅凭不断撩拨，就让某人的欲望与渴求重新飞回脑中？忘掉艺术吧，那简直就是魔法。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When I do it, hun, it’s an art. Trust me. Being able to make someone’s lusts and desires flutter back into their head, just with how much you’re winding them up? Forget art; that’s practically magic.”"

rows.original: You look down at Fyn’s hips, imagining him giving you a hot strip tease... and suddenly you feel yourself swooning. He’s not half wrong; that would be like magic.
rows.translation: 你低头望向芬恩的臀部，想象他为你献上一场火辣脱衣舞...忽然感觉自己都有些神魂颠倒。他说得不算错；那确实会像魔法。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look down at Fyn’s hips, imagining him giving you a hot strip tease... and suddenly you feel yourself swooning. He’s not half wrong; that would be like magic."

rows.original: You remember Fyn mentioning he was a singer who had fanfir gene mods spliced in before he was born, so you ask him about it.
rows.translation: 你记得芬恩提到，他是一名歌手，出生前便植入了凡菲尔基因改造，于是向他询问此事。
rows.raw: "You remember Fyn mentioning he was a singer who had fanfir gene mods spliced in before he was born, so you ask him about it."

rows.original: “Yeah; know much about the fanfir? Gigantic, dragon-like creatures, like out of Der Ring des Nibelungen. Actually, I sang with a female fanfir during Der Ring des Nibelungen; I was Sigurd, and she played the dragon. Her, uh hypnotic voice was very captivating. Even though I slayed her on stage, she was the one who felled me; apparently she had quite the taste for young male actors.”
rows.translation: “对；你了解凡菲尔吗？那是巨大、龙形的生物，就像《尼伯龙根的指环》里走出来的一样。其实我演《尼伯龙根的指环》时，曾和一名女性凡菲尔同台；我扮演西格德，她扮演巨龙。她那，呃，带催眠力的声音非常迷人。尽管舞台上是我杀死了她，真正放倒我的却是她；显然她格外喜欢年轻男演员。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah; know much about the fanfir? Gigantic, dragon-like creatures, like out of Der Ring des Nibelungen. Actually, I sang with a female fanfir during Der Ring des Nibelungen; I was Sigurd, and she played the dragon. Her, uh hypnotic voice was very captivating. Even though I slayed her on stage, she was the one who felled me; apparently she had quite the taste for young male actors.”"

rows.original: “Der Ring der Nibelungen? Isn’t the dragon meant to be played by a man?” you ask, recalling the famous terran opera. The moment you say that, Fyn’s eyes fly open, and his smile couldn’t be wider.
rows.translation: “《尼伯龙根的指环》？巨龙不是应该由男人扮演吗？”你回想着这部著名地球歌剧，问道。话音刚落，芬恩便猛然睁大双眼，笑得不能更灿烂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Der Ring der Nibelungen? Isn’t the dragon meant to be played by a man?” you ask, recalling the famous terran opera. The moment you say that, Fyn’s eyes fly open, and his smile couldn’t be wider."

rows.original: “You know it? Yes, the dragon is meant to be played by a man, traditionally. There were a few creative differences. The role of the Norn was played entirely by one siel woman, who had six arms to play string instruments with.”
rows.translation: “你知道它？没错，传统上巨龙确实应该由男人扮演。制作中存在一些创意分歧。诺伦的角色完全由一名希尔女性独自扮演；她有六条手臂，可以演奏弦乐器。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know it? Yes, the dragon is meant to be played by a man, traditionally. There were a few creative differences. The role of the Norn was played entirely by one siel woman, who had six arms to play string instruments with.”"

rows.original: “Nibelungen is rarely performed outside of the Sol system. My belief is Tiana, the lady fanfir, bankrolled the production to have her pick of young, strapping singers.”
rows.translation: “《尼伯龙根》很少在太阳系外演出。我认为那位凡菲尔女士蒂安娜出资制作，就是为了任意挑选年轻健壮的歌手。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nibelungen is rarely performed outside of the Sol system. My belief is Tiana, the lady fanfir, bankrolled the production to have her pick of young, strapping singers.”"

rows.original: You state that you’ve never heard of the piece, and Fyn nods. “I’m not surprised. It’s a pretty rare piece, hardly performed outside of the sol system. My belief is Tiana, the lady fanfir, bankrolled the production to have her pick of young, strapping singers.”
rows.translation: 你表示自己从未听说过这部作品，芬恩点点头。“我并不意外。这部作品相当罕见，几乎从不在太阳系外演出。我认为那位凡菲尔女士蒂安娜出资制作，就是为了任意挑选年轻健壮的歌手。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou state that you’ve never heard of the piece, and Fyn nods. “I’m not surprised. It’s a pretty rare piece, hardly performed outside of the sol system. My belief is Tiana, the lady fanfir, bankrolled the production to have her pick of young, strapping singers.”"

rows.original: “If it wasn’t for the fact someone new came along to play with, I doubt I’d have escaped her clutches. The fanfir have highly evolved vocal cords; they can lightly manipulate your thoughts and even hormones through their singing. It’s much like being caught under a witch’s spell.”
rows.translation: “要不是后来出现了一个新玩伴，我恐怕无法逃出她的掌心。凡菲尔拥有高度进化的声带；他们能通过歌声轻微操纵你的思维，甚至激素。那很像中了女巫的咒语。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If it wasn’t for the fact someone new came along to play with, I doubt I’d have escaped her clutches. The fanfir have highly evolved vocal cords; they can lightly manipulate your thoughts and even hormones through their singing. It’s much like being caught under a witch’s spell.”"

rows.original: “That said, even though I abhor being on the bottom, I’d highly recommend sleeping with a fanfir if you get the chance. It’s definitely an experience and a half.”
rows.translation: “不过，尽管我讨厌当承受方，要是有机会，我强烈建议你和凡菲尔上床。那绝对是加倍难忘的体验。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That said, even though I abhor being on the bottom, I’d highly recommend sleeping with a fanfir if you get the chance. It’s definitely an experience and a half.”"

rows.original: So, does that mean Fyn can do what fanfir can do? The singer smiles and shakes his head.
rows.translation: 所以，这意味着芬恩也能做到凡菲尔能做的事吗？歌手微笑着摇了摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, does that mean Fyn can do what fanfir can do? The singer smiles and shakes his head."

rows.original: “Not to that degree. I mean, fanfir have massive throats. Even when they talk, it’s truly captivating. My birthright only gives me a superior singing range.”
rows.translation: “达不到那种程度。我的意思是，凡菲尔拥有巨大的喉咙。就连他们说话时也确实令人着迷。我的天赋只让我拥有更优秀的歌唱音域。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not to that degree. I mean, fanfir have massive throats. Even when they talk, it’s truly captivating. My birthright only gives me a superior singing range.”"

rows.original: Fencing seems like an interesting hobby, so you ask Fyn about it. He strides over to a wicker-basket and pulls out what looks like a fencing sword. The raven-haired man gives it a lazy flourish.
rows.translation: 击剑似乎是项有趣的爱好，于是你向芬恩询问。他大步走向一只柳条篮，取出一把看似击剑用剑的东西。黑发男人懒洋洋地挥舞了一下。
rows.raw: "Fencing seems like an interesting hobby, so you ask Fyn about it. He strides over to a wicker-basket and pulls out what looks like a fencing sword. The raven-haired man gives it a lazy flourish."

rows.original: “Good for footwork. That’s why I originally started. Some learn it for practicality - rushers in particular - while other for sport. Me? I do it for fun.”
rows.translation: “有利于步法。这就是我最初开始学习的原因。有些人为了实用而学——尤其是行星开拓者——另一些人则为了竞技。至于我？我只是觉得好玩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good for footwork. That’s why I originally started. Some learn it for practicality - rushers in particular - while other for sport. Me? I do it for fun.”"

rows.original: He hands you the fencing sword, and you take it. Feels light, very light; some sort of special blade? There’s a switch at the handle, and you flick it. There’s suddenly a low hum coming from the blade, and when you touch it against the ground, there’s a light blue crack.
rows.translation: 他把击剑剑递给你，你伸手接过。很轻，非常轻；是某种特殊剑刃？剑柄上有个开关，你把它打开。剑身突然发出低沉嗡鸣；触碰地面时，迸出一道淡蓝电弧。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe hands you the fencing sword, and you take it. Feels light, very light; some sort of special blade? There’s a switch at the handle, and you flick it. There’s suddenly a low hum coming from the blade, and when you touch it against the ground, there’s a light blue crack."

rows.original: “It’s a stun blade. I’m not one for wearing silly outfits or wearing shields. It’s one of the few sports that requires both mind and body in even measure. Self discipline, too. Whether you win or lose, with fencing, it’s up to you. Misinterpret a parry, you change tactics or you lose. You need quick thinking and quick feet.”
rows.translation: “这是眩晕剑。我不喜欢穿傻乎乎的服装，也不爱佩戴护盾。这是少数需要头脑和身体同等参与的运动之一，也需要自律。击剑中无论输赢，都取决于你自己。误判一次格挡，就得改变战术，否则会输。你需要敏捷思维和灵活脚步。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a stun blade. I’m not one for wearing silly outfits or wearing shields. It’s one of the few sports that requires both mind and body in even measure. Self discipline, too. Whether you win or lose, with fencing, it’s up to you. Misinterpret a parry, you change tactics or you lose. You need quick thinking and quick feet.”"

rows.original: Just like everything he does, Fyn seems rather passionate about fencing, too. You could probably get him to teach you a few things about it. Maybe it’ll help you out in rush space?
rows.translation: 和他做的所有事情一样，芬对击剑似乎也充满热情。你大概能让他教你几招。也许会在星球淘金热空间帮助你？
rows.raw: "\n\nJust like everything he does, Fyn seems rather passionate about fencing, too. You could probably get him to teach you a few things about it. Maybe it’ll help you out in rush space?"

rows.raw: "Lesson"

rows.original: What would you like a lesson in?
rows.translation: 你想学什么课程？
rows.raw: "What would you like a lesson in?"

rows.original: Dancing
rows.translation: 舞蹈
rows.raw: "Dancing"

rows.original: There’s a dance studio next door.
rows.translation: 隔壁有一间舞蹈室。
rows.raw: "There’s a dance studio next door. "

rows.original: You might want to change into something more comfortable, though,” Fyn grins.
rows.translation: 不过你也许该换身更舒服的衣服，”芬咧嘴笑道。
rows.raw: "You might want to change into something more comfortable, though,” Fyn grins."

rows.original: “But why wear clothes when I could be naked?” you ask, putting a pointed hand on your bare hip.
rows.translation: “能裸体的话，为什么要穿衣服？”你问道，把一只尖锐的手放到裸露胯部。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But why wear clothes when I could be naked?” you ask, putting a pointed hand on your bare hip."

rows.original: “Well, if you dance like that, we’re not going to end up dancing; we’re going to end up in the bedroom,” Fyn wiggles a brow. “So it’s clothes and classes, or no clothes and no classes.”
rows.translation: “嗯，你要是那样跳，我们最后就不会跳舞，而会进卧室，”芬挑动眉毛。“所以要么穿衣服上课，要么不穿衣服也不上课。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, if you dance like that, we’re not going to end up dancing; we’re going to end up in the bedroom,” Fyn wiggles a brow. “So it’s clothes and classes, or no clothes and no classes.”"

rows.original: “Who said the clothes were for you? There’s no way I can teach you when you’re naked like that!”
rows.translation: “谁说衣服是给你穿的？你像这样裸体，我根本没法教你！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Who said the clothes were for you? There’s no way I can teach you when you’re naked like that!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You head into a side room and, after throwing on some dance-friendly clothes
rows.translation: 你走进侧室，换上一身适合跳舞的衣服
rows.raw: "You head into a side room and, after throwing on some dance-friendly clothes"

rows.original: onto your upper half
rows.translation: ，至少穿在上半身
rows.raw: " onto your upper half"

rows.original: , meet him in the side studio. There’s some music already playing and Fyn is standing in the middle of the room. He then starts the lesson.
rows.translation: ，随后在侧面的舞蹈室与他会合。音乐已经响起，芬站在房间中央，接着开始课程。
rows.raw: ", meet him in the side studio. There’s some music already playing and Fyn is standing in the middle of the room. He then starts the lesson."

rows.original: “Today, we’ll be doing general dance technique. Posture is important to all forms of dance,” Fyn explains, straightening himself out, “You need to stand straight, push your shoulders down and back, and hold your head up. Just this simple thing alone does wonders for any dancer.”
rows.translation: “今天我们学习通用舞蹈技巧。姿势对所有舞蹈都很重要，”芬解释着挺直身体，“你需要站直，肩膀向下向后，抬起头。仅仅这一件简单事情，就能让任何舞者改善许多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Today, we’ll be doing general dance technique. Posture is important to all forms of dance,” Fyn explains, straightening himself out, “You need to stand straight, push your shoulders down and back, and hold your head up. Just this simple thing alone does wonders for any dancer.”"

rows.original: “Another simple yet effective trick is smiling. Whether you’re doing a striptease or a tango, a smile is an expression of pleasure, happiness, and amusement. If you smile while you’re dancing, people will get the feeling you love what you are doing. Even if you’re dancing on your own, smile - you love to dance, so let it show!”
rows.translation: “另一个简单却有效的诀窍是微笑。无论在跳脱衣舞还是探戈，微笑都表达愉悦、幸福和快乐。如果跳舞时微笑，人们会觉得你热爱正在做的事。即使独自跳舞也要笑——你热爱舞蹈，所以表现出来！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Another simple yet effective trick is smiling. Whether you’re doing a striptease or a tango, a smile is an expression of pleasure, happiness, and amusement. If you smile while you’re dancing, people will get the feeling you love what you are doing. Even if you’re dancing on your own, smile - you love to dance, so let it show!”"

rows.original: After going over the theory, the lesson turns to practice. Fyn coaches you on proper posture and poise, circling around and giving advice where he thinks it needs work.
rows.translation: 讲完理论后，课程转入实践。芬指导你保持正确姿势和仪态，绕着你查看，并在认为需要改进的地方提出建议。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter going over the theory, the lesson turns to practice. Fyn coaches you on proper posture and poise, circling around and giving advice where he thinks it needs work."

rows.original: “Good job! The fundamentals are vitally important; no matter what you build, if the foundation is sloppy, the whole thing won’t stay standing. You can practice your poise while doing anything, so try to wherever and whenever you can!”
rows.translation: “做得好！基础至关重要；无论建造什么，地基马虎，整体就站不住。做任何事时都能练习仪态，所以随时随地尽量去做！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good job! The fundamentals are vitally important; no matter what you build, if the foundation is sloppy, the whole thing won’t stay standing. You can practice your poise while doing anything, so try to wherever and whenever you can!”"

rows.original: “Today, we’ll be doing general dance technique,” Fyn informs you, tapping his head. “Half of becoming a good dancer is dealing with what’s up here. There’s anxieties and stresses that build up when you try to dance. There’s an inner critic in your head, just like a little child trying to distract you from doing worthwhile things. Telling you you’re being judged and you’re lacking. Hit the ignore button on them!”
rows.translation: “今天我们学习通用舞蹈技巧，”芬敲着脑袋告诉你。“成为优秀舞者，有一半在于处理这里的东西。尝试跳舞时，焦虑和压力会不断积累。脑中有个内在批评者，就像试图分散你注意、不让你做有价值事情的小孩；它会说别人正在评判你，说你能力不足。按下忽略按钮！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Today, we’ll be doing general dance technique,” Fyn informs you, tapping his head. “Half of becoming a good dancer is dealing with what’s up here. There’s anxieties and stresses that build up when you try to dance. There’s an inner critic in your head, just like a little child trying to distract you from doing worthwhile things. Telling you you’re being judged and you’re lacking. Hit the ignore button on them!”"

rows.original: “So instead of thinking, feel. Don’t focus on the actual steps, but think about how it feels. The more you allow your body to do the dance thinking, the more you’ll develop muscle memory, and stop worrying in your head.”
rows.translation: “所以别去思考，而要感受。不要专注于实际舞步，要想它带来的感觉。你越让身体替舞蹈思考，就越能培养肌肉记忆，不再在脑中担忧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So instead of thinking, feel. Don’t focus on the actual steps, but think about how it feels. The more you allow your body to do the dance thinking, the more you’ll develop muscle memory, and stop worrying in your head.”"

rows.original: After going over the theory, the lesson turns to practice. Just as he suggested, you try to dance on instinct, going with your feelings rather than your thoughts. It’s incredibly liberating, and you find your whole body relaxes, making it easier to dance in turn.
rows.translation: 讲完理论后，课程转入实践。正如他的建议，你尝试凭本能跳舞，跟随感受而不是思绪。这令人无比自由；你发现全身都放松下来，反过来也更容易跳舞。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter going over the theory, the lesson turns to practice. Just as he suggested, you try to dance on instinct, going with your feelings rather than your thoughts. It’s incredibly liberating, and you find your whole body relaxes, making it easier to dance in turn."

rows.original: “Today, we’ll be doing salsa lessons,” Fyn grins, taking you by the hands. “Now, Salsa is a popular kind of terran dance style that spread out to Alpha Centaurii. There, it turned into what’s called the ‘Hot Trot’; they ditched the twirls and kept the footwork.
rows.translation: “今天我们学习萨尔萨，”芬咧嘴笑着牵住你的手。“萨尔萨是流传到半人马座阿尔法星的热门地球舞蹈。在那里，它演变成所谓‘热步舞’；他们抛弃旋转动作，保留了脚步。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Today, we’ll be doing salsa lessons,” Fyn grins, taking you by the hands. “Now, Salsa is a popular kind of terran dance style that spread out to Alpha Centaurii. There, it turned into what’s called the ‘Hot Trot’; they ditched the twirls and kept the footwork."

rows.original: Since you’re a taur, we’ll be doing the Hot Trot.
rows.translation: 因为你是兽体型，我们会学习热步舞。
rows.raw: " Since you’re a taur, we’ll be doing the Hot Trot."

rows.original: “The reason is simple; in many styles of Salsa, as a dancer shifts their weight by stepping, their upper body remains level and nearly unaffected. That means it’s perfect for leithans to show off their fancy hoofwork, so long as their partner isn’t trying to twirl them. Instead, they incorporated the swift side-trot and the cross-trot, allowing them to rotate around the floor in a fast, showy pattern.”
rows.translation: “原因很简单；许多萨尔萨风格中，舞者通过踏步转移重心时，上身保持水平，几乎不受影响。因此它非常适合莱森展示华丽蹄步，只要舞伴不试着让他们旋转。相反，他们融入快速侧小跑与交叉小跑，得以用快速华丽的图案在地板上转动。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The reason is simple; in many styles of Salsa, as a dancer shifts their weight by stepping, their upper body remains level and nearly unaffected. That means it’s perfect for leithans to show off their fancy hoofwork, so long as their partner isn’t trying to twirl them. Instead, they incorporated the swift side-trot and the cross-trot, allowing them to rotate around the floor in a fast, showy pattern.”"

rows.original: “Dancing with Cha-Cha music is a great way to practice Salsa, because it’s essentially Salsa, but slower. Now, as the follower, you need to be attuned to what the leader is telling you to do. Move instinctively in the direction I’m pushing you in, going with the flow.”
rows.translation: “跟着恰恰音乐跳舞是练习萨尔萨的好办法，因为它本质上就是较慢的萨尔萨。现在，作为跟舞者，你得留心领舞者在告诉你做什么。本能地朝我推动的方向移动，顺势而行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dancing with Cha-Cha music is a great way to practice Salsa, because it’s essentially Salsa, but slower. Now, as the follower, you need to be attuned to what the leader is telling you to do. Move instinctively in the direction I’m pushing you in, going with the flow.”"

rows.original: You practice Salsa, Hot Trot, and Cha-Cha with Fyn for a while, moving to the beat of the New Latin rhythm. Once you’re finished, you’re totally puffed! Fyn has a knowing look on his face.
rows.translation: 你和芬练习了一阵萨尔萨、热步舞和恰恰，随着新拉丁节奏移动。结束时，你彻底气喘吁吁！芬露出心领神会的表情。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou practice Salsa, Hot Trot, and Cha-Cha with Fyn for a while, moving to the beat of the New Latin rhythm. Once you’re finished, you’re totally puffed! Fyn has a knowing look on his face."

rows.original: “Yeah, dancing those styles can be pretty exhausting; they’ve got a pretty high beat-count compared to normal dances, so you naturally speed up. But you should feel good, you nailed it!”
rows.translation: “没错，那些舞蹈确实很累；与普通舞蹈相比，拍数很高，所以自然会加速。不过你应该感觉不错，因为你表现得很棒！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, dancing those styles can be pretty exhausting; they’ve got a pretty high beat-count compared to normal dances, so you naturally speed up. But you should feel good, you nailed it!”"

rows.original: “Today, we’ll be doing belly dancing lessons,” Fyn takes a step back and strips off his shirt.
rows.translation: “今天我们学习肚皮舞，”芬退后一步，脱下衬衫。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Today, we’ll be doing belly dancing lessons,” Fyn takes a step back and strips off his shirt."

rows.original: You try quite hard not to ogle his utterly male physique, but fail utterly!
rows.translation: 你拼命不去盯着他充满男子气概的身体，却彻底失败了！
rows.raw: " You try quite hard not to ogle his utterly male physique, but fail utterly!"

rows.original: “Now, contrary to common belief, anyone can belly dance, no matter their sex or physique, so long as they have hips. Here, let me show you.”
rows.translation: “与普遍看法不同，只要有胯部，无论性别或体型，任何人都能跳肚皮舞。来，我示范给你看。”
rows.raw: "“Now, contrary to common belief, anyone can belly dance, no matter their sex or physique, so long as they have hips. Here, let me show you.”"

rows.original: You watch as Fyn sensually gyrates his narrow hips, then begins to thrust and punctuate it to the beat of the music. He uses hip rolls, lifts and twists in time with the music, even moving his chest and shoulders in time with the beat.
rows.translation: 你看着芬性感地转动窄胯，随后配合音乐节拍开始挺动和顿挫。他随音乐运用绕胯、抬胯与扭胯，甚至让胸口和肩膀也跟着节拍移动。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou watch as Fyn sensually gyrates his narrow hips, then begins to thrust and punctuate it to the beat of the music. He uses hip rolls, lifts and twists in time with the music, even moving his chest and shoulders in time with the beat."

rows.original: “See? That’s one element of belly dancing; percussive movement. There’s also fluid movement - that’s the kind best suited to galotians and rahn - where you continuously move your body in flows and coils. It requires a great deal of abdominal muscle control. Then there’s shimmying, which can give the impression you’re moving a lot more than you are; shimmying with your knees, hips, shoulders, they all add to the dance.”
rows.translation: “看见了吗？这是肚皮舞的一种要素：打击式动作。还有流动式动作——最适合加洛蒂安与拉恩的那种——需要身体持续流动和盘旋，对腹部肌肉控制要求很高。然后还有抖动，能让人觉得你的动作比实际更多；膝盖、胯部和肩膀的抖动都会为舞蹈增色。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“See? That’s one element of belly dancing; percussive movement. There’s also fluid movement - that’s the kind best suited to galotians and rahn - where you continuously move your body in flows and coils. It requires a great deal of abdominal muscle control. Then there’s shimmying, which can give the impression you’re moving a lot more than you are; shimmying with your knees, hips, shoulders, they all add to the dance.”"

rows.original: “Throw in some other movements like traveling steps, turns, spins, kicks, backbends, and head-tosses, and you’ve got yourself quite the show, no matter how masculine or feminine you look. We’ll go over each of these moves individually, then combine them over time, working our way up to a full-blown belly dance.”
rows.translation: “再加入行进步、转身、旋转、踢腿、下腰和甩头等动作，无论外表多么男性化或女性化，都能表演一场精彩演出。我们会逐项练习这些动作，再逐渐组合，最终完成一整套肚皮舞。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Throw in some other movements like traveling steps, turns, spins, kicks, backbends, and head-tosses, and you’ve got yourself quite the show, no matter how masculine or feminine you look. We’ll go over each of these moves individually, then combine them over time, working our way up to a full-blown belly dance.”"

rows.original: After going over the theory, the lesson turns to practice. Just as he said, you practice all the individual elements, then add them bit by bit to your dancing routine. By the end of the lesson, you’re totally exhausted; moving so much is a real workout!
rows.translation: 讲完理论后，课程转入实践。正如他说的，你练习各个独立要素，再逐步加入舞蹈套路。课程结束时，你彻底精疲力竭；这么大幅度移动真是很好的锻炼！
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter going over the theory, the lesson turns to practice. Just as he said, you practice all the individual elements, then add them bit by bit to your dancing routine. By the end of the lesson, you’re totally exhausted; moving so much is a real workout!"

rows.original: “Today, we’ll be doing flamenco lessons,” Fyn takes a step back. His fiery eyes are glinting. “I have to admit, I love Flamenco. It’s one of my favorite styles of dance.”
rows.translation: “今天我们学习弗拉明戈，”芬退后一步，火焰般双眼闪着光。“我必须承认，我热爱弗拉明戈。它是我最喜欢的舞蹈风格之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Today, we’ll be doing flamenco lessons,” Fyn takes a step back. His fiery eyes are glinting. “I have to admit, I love Flamenco. It’s one of my favorite styles of dance.”"

rows.original: “The word ‘flamenco’ comes from a terran word for ‘flame’ or ‘fire’, and that’s because it’s full of expressive, passionate, and seductive moves. It’s high intensity, and involves a lot of rhythm, finger-snapping and hand-claps. It also goes fantastically with singing, which, of course, I love.”
rows.translation: “‘弗拉明戈’一词来自地球语言中的‘火焰’或‘烈火’，因为它充满富有表现力、激情而诱人的动作。强度很高，包含大量节奏、弹指和拍手。它也极适合与歌唱结合，而我当然热爱歌唱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The word ‘flamenco’ comes from a terran word for ‘flame’ or ‘fire’, and that’s because it’s full of expressive, passionate, and seductive moves. It’s high intensity, and involves a lot of rhythm, finger-snapping and hand-claps. It also goes fantastically with singing, which, of course, I love.”"

rows.original: Fyn really does sound passionate about it! But then, what doesn’t he sound passionate about? “Now, with flamenco, it can be performed solo, or with a partner. But most important is the feeling, the passion! You hold yourself proudly, expressively using your arms and stamping your feet. You must dance it as if you are on fire with your emotions.”
rows.translation: 芬听起来确实充满热情！不过，他对什么事情不是如此呢？“弗拉明戈既可独舞，也可与舞伴共舞。但最重要的是感受，是激情！你要骄傲地挺起身体，用手臂富有表现力地动作，并踏响双脚。跳舞时必须仿佛情感正在燃烧。”
