rows.translation: 吉尔抓住耳尖揉了揉。“这好像没什么意义...不过我向来有债必偿。你想拿什么交换？”
rows.raw: "\n\nGil grabs the tip of his ear and rubs it. “This seem pointless... but, I always pay my dues. What do y’want in exchange for that?”"

rows.original: You hand him the Pupper Popper and Gil grabs it, unwraps it and chews on it for a while before swallowing it. He pulls his hood down, and you show him his face with the help of your codex’s camera, as you both wait for something to happen.
rows.translation: 你把幼犬爆珠递给他，吉尔接过后拆开，嚼了一阵才咽下。他拉下兜帽，你们一起等待变化时，你用法典摄像头给他看自己的脸。
rows.raw: "You hand him the Pupper Popper and Gil grabs it, unwraps it and chews on it for a while before swallowing it. He pulls his hood down, and you show him his face with the help of your codex’s camera, as you both wait for something to happen."

rows.original: The dog boy’s ears fall down and become floppy again. A twitch of fury tints the corner of his face and he shouts. “Oh, c’mon! Are these things fucking with me?” He takes in a few breaths before sighing and asking, “What do y’want in exchange for that?”
rows.translation: 狗男孩的耳朵垂下，重新变得耷拉。愤怒的抽搐染上他脸角，他大喊道：“哦，拜托！这些东西是在耍我吗？”他深呼吸几次，叹息着问道：“你想拿什么交换？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dog boy’s ears fall down and become floppy again. A twitch of fury tints the corner of his face and he shouts. “Oh, c’mon! Are these things fucking with me?” He takes in a few breaths before sighing and asking, “What do y’want in exchange for that?”"

rows.original: Gil snatches the Pupper Popper out of your hand, unwraps it and chucks it into his mouth, biting and chewing into it angrily. After a few seconds, he bites his tongue and an audible wince escapes his mouth as he covers it with his hand.
rows.translation: 吉尔从你手里抢过幼犬爆珠，拆开包装扔进嘴里，生气地大口啃咬咀嚼。几秒后，他咬到舌头，一边伸手捂嘴，一边发出清晰可闻的痛苦抽气声。
rows.raw: "Gil snatches the Pupper Popper out of your hand, unwraps it and chucks it into his mouth, biting and chewing into it angrily. After a few seconds, he bites his tongue and an audible wince escapes his mouth as he covers it with his hand."

rows.original: “Damn it!” he shouts through his hand, visibly enraged.
rows.translation: “该死！”他隔着手掌大喊，显然怒不可遏。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn it!” he shouts through his hand, visibly enraged."

rows.original: You try to calm down the riled morph, but no matter what you do, his face twists with anger and his snout continues to snarl.
rows.translation: 你试图让激动的变体冷静下来，但无论做什么，他的脸都因愤怒扭曲，口鼻也继续龇牙低吼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to calm down the riled morph, but no matter what you do, his face twists with anger and his snout continues to snarl."

rows.original: “Fuck off!” He growls as his teeth grow sharper and longer than before, already poking out from his lips. You can see sinew growing on the dog-morph’s neck and jaw as they become larger alongside his skull. You back off as he starts to biting at the air as if it were a foe, his jaw snapping shut with astounding strength.
rows.translation: “滚开！”他低吼着，牙齿变得比以前更尖更长，已经从嘴唇间伸出。犬族变体的脖颈和下巴上生出肌肉，随着头骨一同变得更大。你向后退开，他开始撕咬空气，仿佛那里站着敌人；双颚以惊人力量猛然闭合。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck off!” He growls as his teeth grow sharper and longer than before, already poking out from his lips. You can see sinew growing on the dog-morph’s neck and jaw as they become larger alongside his skull. You back off as he starts to biting at the air as if it were a foe, his jaw snapping shut with astounding strength."

rows.original: Where is the roll of space paper when you need one?
rows.translation: 这时候需要的太空报纸卷到底在哪里？
rows.raw: " Where is the roll of space paper when you need one?"

rows.original: His nose also grows a little bit larger and more moist, the last of his canine features to become exaggerated, like a mythical wolf.
rows.translation: 他的鼻子也稍微变得更大、更湿润，这是最后一种受到夸张强化的犬科特征，让他仿佛神话中的巨狼。
rows.raw: " His nose also grows a little bit larger and more moist, the last of his canine features to become exaggerated, like a mythical wolf."

rows.original: “Fuck,” he says half in pain, half in anger, “show me what I look like.”
rows.translation: “操，”他半是痛苦、半是愤怒地说道，“让我看看自己现在的样子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck,” he says half in pain, half in anger, “show me what I look like.”"

rows.original: You take out your Codex and show it to him.
rows.translation: 你拿出法典，展示给他。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take out your Codex and show it to him."

rows.original: Gil passes his hands through his new features before throwing a fist into the air triumphantly. “This is exactly what I wanted!”
rows.translation: 吉尔用双手抚过新特征，随后胜利般朝空中挥拳。“这正是我想要的！”
rows.raw: "\n\nGil passes his hands through his new features before throwing a fist into the air triumphantly. “This is exactly what I wanted!”"

rows.original: “So you don’t need any more snausages?”
rows.translation: “所以你不再需要香肠零食了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you don’t need any more snausages?”"

rows.original: “I still need the eyes to match, so I’ll definitely need more.” He takes a few more moments to pass his hands over his new canine fangs, before pushing the Codex away and asking, “What do y’want in exchange for that?”
rows.translation: “我还需要配套的眼睛，所以肯定还得要更多。”他又花片刻用手摸过新长出的犬齿，随后推开法典，问道：“你想拿什么交换？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I still need the eyes to match, so I’ll definitely need more.” He takes a few more moments to pass his hands over his new canine fangs, before pushing the Codex away and asking, “What do y’want in exchange for that?”"

rows.original: You hand Gil the Pupper Popper, and he unwraps the bite-sized snack and wolfs it down. He mutters a quiet “delicious” as he swallows the snausage and pulls down his hood, waiting for something to happen.
rows.translation: 你把幼犬爆珠递给吉尔，他拆开一口大小的零食，狼吞虎咽地吃下。吞下香肠零食、拉下兜帽时，他轻声嘟囔了一句“好吃”，随后等待变化。
rows.raw: "You hand Gil the Pupper Popper, and he unwraps the bite-sized snack and wolfs it down. He mutters a quiet “delicious” as he swallows the snausage and pulls down his hood, waiting for something to happen."

rows.original: He sighs as he notices his ears perking-up and becoming more wolfish. “Y’win some, y’lose some.” He shrugs. “What do y’want in exchange for that?”
rows.translation: 看见自己的耳朵竖起、变得更像狼耳，他叹了口气。“有得必有失。”他耸耸肩。“你想拿什么交换？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe sighs as he notices his ears perking-up and becoming more wolfish. “Y’win some, y’lose some.” He shrugs. “What do y’want in exchange for that?”"

rows.original: Gil quickly swipes the Pupper Popper from your hands and unwraps it. He takes his time eating it, before pulling down his hood and looking at his reflection in the Codex.
rows.translation: 吉尔迅速从你手里扫走幼犬爆珠，拆开包装。他慢慢把它吃完，随后拉下兜帽，看向法典里的倒影。
rows.raw: "Gil quickly swipes the Pupper Popper from your hands and unwraps it. He takes his time eating it, before pulling down his hood and looking at his reflection in the Codex."

rows.original: Surprisingly, the dog-morph’s face doesn’t seem to change, but his tail suddenly falls limp on his noticeable rear. He yowls, winces and bites his lips, doing his best to contain the pain as the tail splits into two. Both of the appendages are thin and gangly, with missing spots of fur, but soon enough fresh new flesh and hairs cover them until Gil is left with a more healthy-looking pair of tails.
rows.translation: 令人惊讶的是，犬族变体的脸似乎没有变化，但他的尾巴突然无力地垂在醒目臀部上。他嚎叫、抽气并咬住嘴唇，尽力忍受尾巴分成两条带来的痛苦。两条附肢都瘦长难看，毛发东缺西少；不过很快，新鲜血肉和毛发覆盖其上，最后为吉尔留下一对看起来更加健康的尾巴。
rows.raw: "\n\nSurprisingly, the dog-morph’s face doesn’t seem to change, but his tail suddenly falls limp on his noticeable rear. He yowls, winces and bites his lips, doing his best to contain the pain as the tail splits into two. Both of the appendages are thin and gangly, with missing spots of fur, but soon enough fresh new flesh and hairs cover them until Gil is left with a more healthy-looking pair of tails."

rows.original: “Oh cool, I got two tails.” He looks at it, pondering for a moment. “But, I’d rather have one.” The dog boy fetches a black snausage from his pockets, unwraps it, and shoves it down his muzzle, causing one of the tails to recede into his body effortlessly.
rows.translation: “哦，酷，我有两条尾巴了。”他看着尾巴，思考片刻。“不过我还是更喜欢一条。”狗男孩从口袋里取出一根黑色香肠零食，拆开后塞进嘴里，让其中一条尾巴毫不费力地缩回体内。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh cool, I got two tails.” He looks at it, pondering for a moment. “But, I’d rather have one.” The dog boy fetches a black snausage from his pockets, unwraps it, and shoves it down his muzzle, causing one of the tails to recede into his body effortlessly."

rows.original: But that’s not the only thing that changes. The features of his face become smaller. The fangs disappear behind his lips, turning his powerful canine snout into the lean one of a Doberman. “Oh, fuck no!” He grabs his face, as if in a futile attempt to hold it in place and stop the transformation, but the change finishes quickly.
rows.translation: 然而变化还不止这些。他的脸部特征开始缩小。尖牙消失在嘴唇后方，强壮的犬科口鼻变成杜宾犬般瘦长的形状。“哦，操，不要！”他抓住自己的脸，仿佛徒劳地想让它固定在原位、阻止变化，但过程很快便结束了。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut that’s not the only thing that changes. The features of his face become smaller. The fangs disappear behind his lips, turning his powerful canine snout into the lean one of a Doberman. “Oh, fuck no!” He grabs his face, as if in a futile attempt to hold it in place and stop the transformation, but the change finishes quickly."

rows.original: “I totally forgot these custom transformatives do this.” He sighs, slightly punching his forehead. Gil takes a few deep breaths, trying to calm his anger at yet another setback, before asking, “What do y’want in exchange for that?”
rows.translation: “我完全忘了这些定制变形剂会这么做。”他叹息着，轻轻捶了下额头。吉尔深呼吸几次，努力平息又一次受挫带来的怒火，随后问道：“你想拿什么交换？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I totally forgot these custom transformatives do this.” He sighs, slightly punching his forehead. Gil takes a few deep breaths, trying to calm his anger at yet another setback, before asking, “What do y’want in exchange for that?”"

rows.original: You drop the Pupper Popper in Gil’s outstretched hand, and he is quick at unwrapping it and shoving it down his gobbler. He takes a long while to chew it down to bits and swallow it. Impatient, you take off his hood and show him his visage in your Codex.
rows.translation: 你把幼犬爆珠丢进吉尔伸出的手，他迅速拆开包装，塞进嘴里。他花了很长时间把东西嚼碎并咽下。你不耐烦地摘掉他的兜帽，用法典给他看自己的模样。
rows.raw: "You drop the Pupper Popper in Gil’s outstretched hand, and he is quick at unwrapping it and shoving it down his gobbler. He takes a long while to chew it down to bits and swallow it. Impatient, you take off his hood and show him his visage in your Codex."

rows.original: The dog-morph sighs yet again as his ears flop down and become more roundish. You both stand in silence for a few minutes, before he finally speaks.
rows.translation: 犬族变体再次叹息，他的耳朵垂下，变得更加圆润。你们沉默着站了几分钟，最后他终于开口。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dog-morph sighs yet again as his ears flop down and become more roundish. You both stand in silence for a few minutes, before he finally speaks."

rows.original: “I would’ve given up a long time ago if these treats weren’t so delicious. Anyway, what do y’want in exchange for that?”
rows.translation: “要不是这些零食这么好吃，我早就放弃了。总之，你想拿什么交换？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I would’ve given up a long time ago if these treats weren’t so delicious. Anyway, what do y’want in exchange for that?”"

rows.original: You throw the package at Gil’s chest and he tries his best to catch as it jumps between his hand until it slips and falls on the floor.
rows.translation: 你把包装扔向吉尔胸口。他竭力接住，东西却在两手间跳来跳去，最后滑落到地板上。
rows.raw: "You throw the package at Gil’s chest and he tries his best to catch as it jumps between his hand until it slips and falls on the floor."

rows.original: “I’m getting pretty tired of this.”
rows.translation: “我已经受够了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m getting pretty tired of this.”"

rows.original: “Me too,” Gil says as he unwraps the package and swallows it down.
rows.translation: “我也是。”吉尔一边说，一边拆开包装，把东西吞下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Me too,” Gil says as he unwraps the package and swallows it down."

rows.original: You show the dog-morph his face on your Codex as it turns into a snarl and begins to change. His skull grows wider, his nose larger, and the muscles of his neck and jaw swell to become more powerful. His canines lengthen until they poke out from his lips, and the process is complete. Like the last time he underwent this transformation, he seems unreasonably angry, shouting swear words at a random passerby.
rows.translation: 你用法典向犬族变体展示他的脸；那张脸扭成低吼，开始变化。他的头骨变宽，鼻子增大，脖颈和下巴肌肉也膨胀得更加强壮。犬齿不断伸长，直到从嘴唇间探出，变化就此完成。和上次经历这种变形一样，他显得不讲道理地愤怒，对着一个随机路人大声咒骂。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou show the dog-morph his face on your Codex as it turns into a snarl and begins to change. His skull grows wider, his nose larger, and the muscles of his neck and jaw swell to become more powerful. His canines lengthen until they poke out from his lips, and the process is complete. Like the last time he underwent this transformation, he seems unreasonably angry, shouting swear words at a random passerby."

rows.original: Eventually, he calms down and regains his composure. “Well at least I’ve bounced back from that stupid accident. What do y’want in exchange for that?”
rows.translation: 最终，他平静下来，重新恢复镇定。“至少我已经从那场愚蠢意外里恢复了。你想拿什么交换？”
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, he calms down and regains his composure. “Well at least I’ve bounced back from that stupid accident. What do y’want in exchange for that?”"

rows.original: “I hope this is the last one.” You tell Gil as you hand him yet another Pupper Popper.
rows.translation: “我希望这是最后一个。”你又把一个幼犬爆珠递给吉尔时说道。
rows.raw: "“I hope this is the last one.” You tell Gil as you hand him yet another Pupper Popper."

rows.original: “Unlikely. I’ll probably get a few more ear transformations,” he says, the frustration clear in his voice as he unwraps the snausage.
rows.translation: “不太可能。我大概还会遇到几次耳朵变形。”他一边拆开香肠零食，一边说道，语气里的沮丧清晰可闻。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Unlikely. I’ll probably get a few more ear transformations,” he says, the frustration clear in his voice as he unwraps the snausage."

rows.original: You groan in response as the dog-morph shoves the treats into his mouth.
rows.translation: 犬族变体把零食塞进嘴里，你则以呻吟回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou groan in response as the dog-morph shoves the treats into his mouth."

rows.original: “Mah sentiphments exachtly,” he mutters through a mouthful of snausage. He then swallows it down and waits for a change while staring at his reflection in your Codex.
rows.translation: “窝也正是介个意思。”他满嘴香肠零食地嘟囔。随后，他把东西咽下，盯着法典中的倒影等待变化。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mah sentiphments exachtly,” he mutters through a mouthful of snausage. He then swallows it down and waits for a change while staring at his reflection in your Codex."

rows.original: His face twists into an angry snarl as he closes his eyes and rubs them with his hand. When he opens them again they glow with a soft minty-green light, lacking any form of pupils or iris.
rows.translation: 他闭上眼，用手揉搓，脸也扭曲成愤怒低吼。再次睁眼时，双眼发出柔和薄荷绿光芒，看不见任何瞳孔或虹膜。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis face twists into an angry snarl as he closes his eyes and rubs them with his hand. When he opens them again they glow with a soft minty-green light, lacking any form of pupils or iris."

rows.original: “Is this it?” You ask.
rows.translation: “就是这个？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is this it?” You ask."

rows.original: The dog boy nods for a while, and then turns around and plants a sudden and energetic kiss on your [pc.lipsChaste]. Before you can react he’s already parted from your lips and, giddy with joy, says, “Fuck yeah it is. I wanted these glowing eyes from this transformative.”
rows.translation: 狗男孩连连点头，随后突然转身，充满活力地吻上[pc.lipsChaste]。你还没来得及反应，他就已经离开双唇，欣喜若狂地说道：“他妈的，没错。我想从这个变形剂里得到的就是这双发光眼睛。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dog boy nods for a while, and then turns around and plants a sudden and energetic kiss on your [pc.lipsChaste]. Before you can react he’s already parted from your lips and, giddy with joy, says, “Fuck yeah it is. I wanted these glowing eyes from this transformative.”"

rows.original: “Awesome! Now I’m gonna pound your ass so hard, you won’t be able to walk for weeks,” you grunt with a confident grin as you reach behind him and grab his prodigious glutes.
rows.translation: “太棒了！现在我要狠狠操你的屁股，让你几个星期都走不了路。”你自信地咧嘴闷哼，伸手抓住他硕大的臀肌。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awesome! Now I’m gonna pound your ass so hard, you won’t be able to walk for weeks,” you grunt with a confident grin as you reach behind him and grab his prodigious glutes."

rows.original: “Who said you could fuck my ass?” Gil asks as calmly as he can while shooing away your daring hand.
rows.translation: “谁说你可以干我的屁股？”吉尔尽量平静地问，同时赶开你大胆的手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Who said you could fuck my ass?” Gil asks as calmly as he can while shooing away your daring hand."

rows.original: “But...” you grumble. He silences your complaint by putting his finger in front of your mouth with a quick shh.
rows.translation: “可是...”你抱怨道。他迅速发出一声嘘，把手指放在你嘴前，制止你的不满。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But...” you grumble. He silences your complaint by putting his finger in front of your mouth with a quick shh."

rows.original: “If y’want to find out what I meant you’ll just have to fuck me. You can still take the money or a blowjob if y’want.”
rows.translation: “你要是想知道我的意思，就只能亲自来干我。你愿意的话，仍然可以选择拿钱或口交。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If y’want to find out what I meant you’ll just have to fuck me. You can still take the money or a blowjob if y’want.”"

rows.original: “Does that mean I can fuck you now?”
rows.translation: “这意味着我现在可以干你了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Does that mean I can fuck you now?”"

rows.original: “Yes, if that’s what y’want. So... what do you want?”
rows.translation: “是啊，如果你想的话。那么...你到底想要什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, if that’s what y’want. So... what do you want?”"

rows.original: GIL_DOSES
rows.raw: "GIL_DOSES"

rows.original: Credits
rows.translation: 信用点
rows.raw: "Credits"

rows.original: Credits
rows.translation: 信用点
rows.raw: "Credits"

rows.original: Ask him to pay in cash.
rows.translation: 让他用现金付款。
rows.raw: "Ask him to pay in cash."

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Ask him to pay with sex.
rows.translation: 让他用性爱付款。
rows.raw: "Ask him to pay with sex."

rows.original: Gift
rows.translation: 赠礼
rows.raw: "Gift"

rows.original: Gift
rows.translation: 赠礼
rows.raw: "Gift"

rows.original: Tell him it’s a gift.
rows.translation: 告诉他这是礼物。
rows.raw: "Tell him it’s a gift."

rows.original: Lashcharge
rows.raw: "Lashcharge"

rows.original: “How about you just keep the money?”
rows.translation: “要不这钱你就留着吧？”
rows.raw: "“How about you just keep the money?”"

rows.original: “Wha...what?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wha...what?”"

rows.original: “It’s a gift!”
rows.translation: “这是礼物！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a gift!”"

rows.original: He averts his eyes and looks straight down. After a few seconds he answers with a flustered, “Thanks.”
rows.translation: 他移开视线，直直看向地面。几秒后，他慌乱地回答：“谢谢。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe averts his eyes and looks straight down. After a few seconds he answers with a flustered, “Thanks.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Lashcharge
rows.raw: "Lashcharge"

rows.original: GIL_DOSES
rows.raw: "GIL_DOSES"

rows.original: PupperPoppers
rows.raw: "PupperPoppers"

rows.original: “Are you still interested in buying these Pupper Poppers?” You say, as you show him the promotional treat.
rows.translation: “你还想买这些狗狗变形棒吗？”你一边说，一边向他展示这款促销零食。
rows.raw: "“Are you still interested in buying these Pupper Poppers?” You say, as you show him the promotional treat."

rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head. Being hung up by Xanthe is not something you’ve experienced, though you have no doubt the thought has crossed her older sister’s mind."

rows.original: “You know about siel mating habits, right? If she offers, I’d make sure you’ve got the rest of the week free,” Inessa winks. “...You’ll need that long to get your ability to walk back. We saeri are much gentler.”
rows.translation: “你知道西尔的交配习惯，对吧？要是她提出邀请，我会确保你接下来一周都有空。”伊内莎眨眨眼。“...你得花那么久才能恢复行走能力。我们塞里要温柔得多。”

rows.original: You’ve forgotten, so you ask Inessa about her siblings again.
rows.translation: 你已经忘了，于是再次向伊内莎询问兄弟姐妹。
rows.raw: "You’ve forgotten, so you ask Inessa about her siblings again."

rows.original: “Again–? Well, I’ve got a ton of siblings. Twenty-four, in fact. My species generally have big families–well, at least compared to the uplifted ones.”
rows.translation: “又，又来？好吧，我有很多兄弟姐妹，准确来说有二十四个。我的种族通常都有大家庭，至少和那些被提升的物种相比是这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Again–? Well, I’ve got a ton of siblings. Twenty-four, in fact. My species generally have big families–well, at least compared to the uplifted ones.”"

rows.original: “I’m the twentieth daughter, one of the youngest. Most of them still live and work on Xhixia; that’s the siel and saeri home world. They’re pretty high-brow.”
rows.translation: “我是第二十个女儿，也是最小的几个之一。她们大多仍在西尔与塞里的母星希夏生活和工作。她们都很高雅。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m the twentieth daughter, one of the youngest. Most of them still live and work on Xhixia; that’s the siel and saeri home world. They’re pretty high-brow.”"

rows.original: “My sister, Xanthe, runs a second store on Myrellion–some boonie planet full of honey-filled ant girls. I have no idea why she opened one there, of all places; I hear the whole place is about to fall apart.”
rows.translation: “我姐姐Xanthe在米雷利恩经营第二家店，那是颗到处都是装满蜂蜜的蚁女的偏远星球。我完全不明白她为什么偏偏要在那里开店；听说整个地方都快分崩离析了。”

rows.original: “Xanthe gave this to you didn’t she?” You nod and she squees quite loudly. “Ohmyzyi ohmyzyi!” She exclaims, bouncing up and down on the spot, setting her [inessa.breasts] into a jiggle. She places the silk down and begins fluttering around the store, her [inessa.wings] carrying her at a near breakneck speed. She closes up the curtains and shutters, turns off the alarm, dims the lights and turns over the sign on the shop front that says “Bound up tight” as a euphemism for closed. You chuckle at her enthusiasm and watch her do this for a couple of minutes more before giving a sharp whistle to call her over. Inessa stops in her tracks and turns towards you. “Yes, what is it?” She stammers out. Void she’s so cute sometimes, and you say as much before asking what the silk actually means and why she’s buzzing around closing the shop.
rows.translation: “这是珊西给你的，对吧？”你点点头，她顿时高声尖叫起来。“我的兹伊啊，我的兹伊啊！”她惊呼着，在原地蹦蹦跳跳，带得[inessa.breasts]一阵摇晃。她放下丝绸，开始在店里飞来飞去，[inessa.wings]载着她以近乎危险的速度移动。她拉上帘子和百叶窗，关掉警报器，调暗灯光，又把店门前的牌子翻到写着“捆得严严实实”的一面，以此委婉表示歇业。你被她的热情逗笑，又看了她几分钟，才吹响一声尖锐的口哨叫她过来。伊内莎猛地停下脚步，转身望向你。“怎么了，有什么事吗？”她结结巴巴地问。虚空啊，她有时真是可爱极了；你也如实说了出来，随后问那块丝绸究竟意味着什么，她又为什么嗡嗡飞着关店。

You chuckle at her enthusiasm and watch her do this for a couple of minutes more before giving a sharp whistle to call her over. Inessa stops in her tracks and turns towards you. “Yes, what is it?” She stammers out. Void she’s so cute sometimes, and you say as much before asking what the silk actually means and why she’s buzzing around closing the shop."

rows.original: Inessa goes a deep hue of blue at the comment before she replies. “S-Sorry, I’m just so excited. Xanthe wants me to go to Myrellion with you, it’s been so long since I’ve seen her.” She stammers out, then holds up the piece of silk. “And this is how I know, it’s a way that Siel and some Saeri can talk with family members kind of in secret.” She explains. “Each family has a slightly different way of making them, so no other family quite knows how to understand them.” Clutching the silk to her chest, she wiggles on the spot before continuing on. “It’s mostly used by Siel since they can actually produce the silk, but some Saeri learn to stitch them together from plain silk sheets so they can still communicate the same way.”
rows.translation: 听到这句评价，伊内莎的脸变成深蓝色，随后才回答。“对、对不起，我只是太兴奋了。珊西希望我跟你一起去米瑞利恩，我已经很久没有见过她了。”她结结巴巴地说道，随后举起那块丝绸。“我就是从这里看出来的。这是西尔和部分塞里同家人秘密交流的一种方式。”她解释道。“每个家族的制作方式都略有不同，所以其他家族无法真正理解其中含义。”她把丝绸紧紧抱在胸前，原地扭了扭身子，随后继续说道：“这种方式主要由西尔使用，因为她们可以直接产丝；不过有些塞里也会学习如何用普通丝片缝制，这样她们仍能用同样的方式交流。”
rows.raw: "\n\nInessa goes a deep hue of blue at the comment before she replies. “S-Sorry, I’m just so excited. Xanthe wants me to go to Myrellion with you, it’s been so long since I’ve seen her.” She stammers out, then holds up the piece of silk. “And this is how I know, it’s a way that Siel and some Saeri can talk with family members kind of in secret.” She explains. “Each family has a slightly different way of making them, so no other family quite knows how to understand them.” Clutching the silk to her chest, she wiggles on the spot before continuing on. “It’s mostly used by Siel since they can actually produce the silk, but some Saeri learn to stitch them together from plain silk sheets so they can still communicate the same way.”"

rows.original: You nod and smile at her, thanking her for the explanation and letting her finish closing up the shop. “Alright, everything’s all closed up here, let’s get going!” You chuckle softly and tell her to slow down, it will be a long ride. She covers her mouth slightly and blushes. “O-Of course, I’m sorry, whenever you’re ready.”
rows.translation: 你点头朝她微笑，感谢她的解释，并让她把店铺关闭妥当。“好了，这里全都关好了，我们出发吧！”你轻声笑了笑，让她慢一点，毕竟路程还很长。她稍稍掩住嘴，脸颊泛红。“当、当然，对不起，你准备好时我们就走。”

You gently rap your knuckles against the door and the bolts retract from the doorframe as Xanthe opens it from the other side. She stands completely naked in the doorway, giving you a sly grin before turning to Inessa. “Oh my little sister, how I have missed you,” she states, sweeping the comparatively small Saeri girl into a tight hug.

rows.original: Sighing, the curvacious panda nervously looks at her claws as she gathers her thoughts. She bites her lip, thinking hard, and when she finally does talk, the suddenness of it seems to startle her as much as you. “I used to be an orchan. We’re kind of a smaller race - usually shorter than humans and ausar... thinner too. Our homeworld is naturally warm, not hot, mind you, and food is plentiful. We didn’t need the insulation hair provides or to pack on much fat. Staying lean made it easy for us to maneuver through denser obstructions in the jungles we evolved from, I suppose.” Jade nibbles on a finger. “It’s strange talking about this stuff, now that I’m so... I’m so... different.”
rows.translation: 曲线丰腴的熊猫叹了口气，一边整理思绪，一边紧张地看着自己的爪子。她咬住嘴唇苦苦思索；终于开口时，那突如其来的声音似乎把她自己和你都吓了一跳。“我以前是奥尔坎人。我们算是比较娇小的种族，通常比人类和奥萨人矮...也更瘦。我们的母星天生温暖，注意，不是炎热，而且食物充足。我们不需要毛发保温，也没必要囤积太多脂肪。我想，保持精瘦能让我们轻松穿过祖先栖息的丛林里那些更为密集的障碍。”杰德轻咬一根手指。“如今我已经如此...如此...不同，再谈起这些事感觉真奇怪。”

rows.original: “Right,” Jade exhales. “So anyway, our race got discovered about two Planet Rushes back. We were already pretty civilized by that point, but we never developed much industrially. Orchan is a very verdant planet, so we were very, very careful not to damage our forests. Any advancement that was deemed damaging to the environment was shelved until it could be made to work without negative consequences.” She shifts nervously, uncrossing and recrossing her thighs in a surprisingly demure gesture for such a large woman. “To the ausar explorers that found us, we were practically primitives.”
rows.translation: “对，”杰德呼了口气。“总之，我们的种族大约在两次行星开拓潮前被发现。当时我们已经相当文明，但工业从未得到多少发展。奥尔坎是一颗植被极其繁茂的行星，所以我们非常、非常谨慎，绝不破坏森林。凡是被认为会损害环境的进步，都会被搁置，直到人们能让它在不产生负面后果的前提下实现。”她紧张地挪动身体，将双腿松开又重新交叠；如此高大的女人做出这般端庄举动，着实令人意外。“在发现我们的奥萨探险家眼中，我们几乎就是原始人。”

We paraded out every discovery our scientists had made to the ausar and made them see our worth. They supported our bid to join the U.G.C. as an independent planet. It’s a good thing too, if they hadn’t we probably would’ve been taken over by the closest local power and inducted under someone else’s rule. As it is, we’re more or less left to rule ourselves, even if we have one of the lowest trading quotients in the confederacy.”

Well, let’s just say I surprised the whole colony when I saved up enough credits to leave.” She casually adds, “A colony is like an extended family unit - uncles, cousins, and even close family friends. rows.original: Scrunching up her face and licking her nose, the big panda gal answers, “Not much, actually. I had already broken away from my race to see the stars. I was out working odd jobs, learning technology, and trying to make it on my own when I decided to go for it. I had to land a good gig to afford it, of course. I found out I had a head for numbers and figures while working in a friend’s custom starship shop, even though my ‘in’ had been my ability to wriggle through small places. Within six months I was out of the grease pits and into an accountants office. A few months after that I was running the books for two other shops.” She casually wraps her ponytail around her neck and over one shoulder. “I made enough to get access to some of the good stuff.”

rows.raw: "The buxom redhead smiles ear to ear. “That’s what I like to hear!” From afar, you watch her rifle through the cabinets, grabbing two glasses and a very concerning-looking glowing red bottle. As she makes her way back, you notice Pink has a bounce in her step, borderline dancing her way to the couch. “Fuck, it’s been forever since I’ve done shots.” As she half jumps back onto the couch, you ask her if she’s ever done any shots with [var0] and Blue. “No, never. Ari doesn’t drink, and Blue, well, she only drinks stuff that’ll rot your teeth.” She sets down the glasses, then holds up the luminescent bottle. “Now, this is hundred and eighty year old Thraggen whisky.” She starts to fiddle with the top, attempting to get it open. “It’s basically straight poison. It’s only legal use is stripping paint off ship hulls. Hn, fuck, who closed this thing?” You watch the ominous liquid swirl in the bottle as Pink fights to open it, finding it looks more like lava than whisky. “And, you want to drink that?” With a grunt of effort, Pink twists the top off, and immediately your nose is assaulted by a powerful odor that sends a shudder down your spine. You’ve never smelt anything quite like it, the closest thing that comes to mind is if somebody baked bread with ship fuel instead of water. “Hmmm,” grimacing, Pink takes in a big waft of the fragrant liquid. “Oh man, this takes me back.” Carefully, she pours out two perfect shots, then sets the bottle down and picks up both glasses. “Don’t hold it in your mouth,” she warns, offering one of glowing red glasses."

rows.original: You take the drink and hold it up to your face, the scent overwhelmingly powerful. Smiling, Pink salutes you and brings her glass to her lips, tossing it down her throat with a well-practiced motion. Following her lead, you take the shot, trying to mimic Pink’s flawless technique “Urhhgg,” The trace amount that runs over your tongue is just about the worst thing you’ve ever tasted, your body seizing as you shiver in disgust. Almost crying from shock, you nearly spit up the glowing poison, but somehow manage to keep it down. Throat burning, the heat runs all the way to your stomach, with it sitting uncomfortably heavy in your belly after it stops. Chuckling, Pink picks up her codex and starts to punch something up. “Hmm, you took that much better than I did my first time. I just about puked my kidneys out... Ah, here we go.” She taps the codex with a flourish, the image on the screen in front of you changing, along with the music in the room. Eyes watering, you hear the change before you see it, the upbeat music replaced with a somber piano intro. Focusing on the screen, you see Pink has punched up a music video, the credits in the lower left hand corner reading ‘Broken Wings’ by Celestia. After a few seconds the familiar face of Pink enters the frame. Hauntingly beautiful, hair pitch black, her pale face is painted with onyx lipstick and eyeshadow. As she starts to sing, your ears are met with a distressingly depressing song, her incredible voice a stark contrast to the morose lyrics. “Celestia?” You ask, noting the name. “Bah, I use a different name every time I do something new. This was my second, and last, time trying to go solo.” Pink sighs, her voice sounding slightly hoarse. “I was going through a thing, and was being a bit over dramatic.” The song continues and you feel a twinge in your head. You didn’t think it was possible, but hearing Pink sing is causing you literal pain. Then again, it might be the Thraggen whisky you just drank, the walls of the room all of a sudden are quite blurry. Sensing your displeasure, Pink mutes the video, her eyes looking in two different directions at the same time. “Oh man,” she shakes her head, righting her eyes. “When it hits...” she sighs, her cheeks turning redder by the second. “Anyways, after this colossal dumpster fire of a career move, I laid low for... fuck, twenty years almost. Joined Blow after that. I was so fucking done with myself I just wanted to make music and not be the center of attention.” Turning to you, she gives you a sly smile. “Shots?”
rows.translation: 你接过酒，举到面前，那股气味强烈得压倒一切。 小粉微笑着向你敬酒，把酒杯送到唇边，以熟练动作一口倒进喉咙。 你照她的样子喝下烈酒，试图模仿小粉无可挑剔的技巧。 “呃啊——，”仅仅流过舌面的微量液体，便几乎是你尝过最难喝的东西；厌恶令你浑身僵直颤抖。你被冲击刺激得几乎落泪，差点把发光毒液吐出来，却不知怎的勉强咽住。喉咙灼烧，热力一路流进胃里；停止后，它沉甸甸地压在腹中，令人十分不适。 小粉轻笑着拿起终端，开始调出某样东西。“嗯，你第一次喝时的表现比我好多了。我当时差点把肾都吐出来...啊，找到了。”她潇洒地轻触终端，眼前屏幕的图像随之改变，房里的音乐也一并切换。 你泪眼汪汪，先听到变化，随后才看见；欢快音乐被忧郁的钢琴前奏替代。你聚焦屏幕，发现小粉调出了一段音乐视频，左下角字幕写着瑟莱斯蒂娅演唱的《折翼》。几秒后，小粉那张熟悉面孔进入画面。她美得令人心悸，一头乌黑长发，苍白面庞涂着黑玛瑙色唇膏与眼影。她开始歌唱时，一首压抑得令人不安的歌曲传入你耳中；她惊人的嗓音与阴郁歌词形成鲜明反差。 “瑟莱斯蒂娅？”你注意到那个名字，开口询问。 “呸，每次做新事情，我都会换个名字。这是我第二次，也是最后一次尝试单飞。”小粉叹气，声音略显沙哑。“我当时正在经历一些事情，而且有点过度戏剧化。” 歌曲继续，你感觉脑袋一阵刺痛。你本以为这不可能，可听小粉唱歌真的让你感到疼痛。不过话说回来，也可能是刚喝下的特拉根威士忌所致；房间墙壁突然变得相当模糊。 察觉你的不适，小粉把视频静音，双眼同时望向两个不同方向。“哦，天啊，”她摇摇头，让视线重新对齐。“酒劲上来时...”她叹气，双颊一秒比一秒更红。“总之，在这场堪称巨型垃圾场大火的职业决策之后，我低调了...操，差不多二十年。之后加入了Blow。我他妈受够了自己，只想做音乐，不想再成为焦点。”她转向你，露出狡黠笑容。“再来一杯？”

rows.original: “Yaaas,” Pink takes both glasses and pours two - slightly less perfect - shots, then hands you your glass. Sly smile still on her ruby lips, she fires back her drink, slamming the glass down on the table with a proud flourish. A wave of boldness takes over, urging you to follow suit as you down your drink with the same vigor as your busty drinking buddy. The taste is just as foul as you remember, but now that you’re ready you find the steel inside to overcome the warm liquor running down your throat. Mimicking Pink, you slam your glass down next to hers, letting out a throaty gasp of both disgust and pride. Laughing, Pink leans back on the couch, her face just about as red as her hair now. “Thatta [pc.boyGirl]! You drink better now than I did when I was twice your age.” You take the compliment, even though you suddenly feel like you might have made a mistake, Pink’s voice echoing around the room. You sway to the side for a moment, losing your center of balance. Too drunk to notice, Pink reaches for her codex and starts to search for something, the flushed redhead having to backspace more than once to fix spelling mistakes. “If you think that was bad... This was... Fucking thing... This was when I was MUCH younger, so try to cut me a little slack.” After a minute, she pulls up a new video, this one very different from the last two. Despite the sound being turned down, you’re immediately assaulted by a powerful scream, with a thunderous blast of instruments following suit. Some sort of punk band, an all girls group by the looks of it, comes into full focus, playing their instruments with reckless abandon as they thrash around the stage. After a few seconds, a credit in the corner pops up, the song apparently ‘Smash the System’ by some band called Bombastic. Looking like she’s trying to murder her guitar rather than play it, the lead singer wails impossible to parse lyrics to the breakneck song. Blinking a few times, you take a second look at the vicious singer, something very familiar about her. “Holy shit,” you lean in, adjusting your eyes to fight the blur. “That’s you?!” “Yeah...” Pink swats at the air between you, channeling her inner [var0] with a head-tilting eye roll. “I said cut me some slack...” Pink in the video is almost unrecognizable compared to how she is now, partly because her thick makeup looks like it was applied while shitfaced and left on for days. Her hair is two-toned, mostly black with crimson red highlights, the bulk of it on the shorter side with half her head shaved completely. You count about half a dozen pieces of metal in her face alone, along with several eye-catching tattoos visible on parts of exposed flesh. When you ask Pink about them, the tittering redhead just laughs. “Oh, let me tell you!” She sticks her finger in your face, her painted nail inches from your nose. “Ink you get when you’re forty you’re gonna hate when you’re one-forty!” “You’re forty there?” You turn back to the screen, the light stinging your eyes more than it did a second ago. “Ehh, I think so.” She scrunches up her face, trying to remember. “This was before I got pregnant, and I know I was 42 when I got knocked up.” You nod for a moment, then pause, reflecting on what you heard. “What?” Pink stares at you, slack jawed, looking through you more than at you. “Oh, right...” She rubs her face, regaining focus. “I guess we’ve never talked about my kids.” The news nearly knocks you over, although the two shots of pure death might be the actual cause. Kids. Plural. Pink has kids and this is the first you’ve heard of it. Thinking about it, your hazed mind only comes to one logical conclusion. “You’re... A MILF...” Pink sputters her lips, then bursts out cackling, laughing so hard she nearly kicks over the bottle. “Fucking gods, [pc.name]!” She gasps, struggling to keep her laughter under control. “THAT is what you focus on?” “Hey...” you breathe in deep through your nose, trying to gather your thoughts.
rows.translation: “好耶——，”小粉拿起两个杯子，倒出两杯稍微没那么完美的烈酒，随后把你的杯子递过来。红宝石色嘴唇仍挂着狡黠笑容，她一口灌下酒，得意地把杯子重重砸在桌上。 一股豪气占据你，催促你也照做；你以这位丰满酒友同样的气势把酒灌下。味道和记忆中一样恶心，不过如今已有准备，你找到了钢铁般的意志，足以克服沿喉咙流下的温热烈酒。你模仿小粉，把杯子砸在她的杯子旁，同时因厌恶与自豪发出低沉喘息。 小粉大笑着靠回沙发，脸如今几乎和头发一样红。“这才是好[pc.boyGirl]！你现在的酒量，比我在你两倍年纪时还好。” 你接受了赞美，尽管忽然感觉自己可能犯了错误；小粉的声音正在房间里回荡。你向旁边摇晃片刻，失去平衡中心。 小粉醉得没有察觉，伸手拿起终端开始搜索某样东西；涨红脸的女人不得不按了好几次退格键修正拼写错误。“如果你觉得那个已经很糟...这个是...该死的玩意儿...这是我年轻得多的时候，所以请尽量对我宽容一点。”一分钟后，她调出新视频，风格与前两段截然不同。 尽管音量被调低，一声强烈尖叫仍立刻袭来，随后是雷鸣般的乐器爆发。一支似乎完全由女孩组成的朋克乐队清晰出现在画面里；她们在舞台上疯狂甩动，毫无顾忌地演奏乐器。几秒后，角落弹出字幕；这首歌显然叫《砸烂体制》，出自一支名叫Bombastic的乐队。主唱看起来不像在弹吉他，倒像试图谋杀它；她对着这首快得要命的歌曲嚎叫着无法辨认的歌词。你眨了几次眼，再次看向这个凶悍歌手，觉得她身上有种非常熟悉的感觉。 “我操，”你靠近屏幕，调整视线对抗模糊。“那是你？！” “对...”小粉朝你们之间的空气拍了一巴掌，歪头翻眼，唤醒自己内在的[var0]。“我说了对我宽容一点...” 视频里的小粉与如今相比几乎无法辨认，部分原因是她厚重的妆容看起来像在烂醉时画上，又连续留了好几天。她的头发有两种颜色，主体为黑色，间杂深红挑染；大部分较短，半边脑袋则被彻底剃光。你光在她脸上就数到约六件金属饰品，暴露肌肤上还有几处显眼文身。你问起它们，小粉只是咯咯大笑。 “哦，让我告诉你！”她把手指戳到你脸前，涂过颜色的指甲距离鼻子只有几英寸。“四十岁时刺的墨水，到一百四十岁时准会让你讨厌！” “你那时四十岁？”你转回屏幕，亮光比一秒前更加刺眼。 “呃，我想是吧。”她皱起脸，努力回忆。“这是我怀孕前的事，而且我知道自己中招时是42岁。” 你点头片刻，随后停住，回想听到的话。“什么？” 小粉张口结舌地盯着你，与其说在看你，不如说视线穿过了你。“哦，对...”她揉揉脸，重新集中精神。“看来我们从没谈过我的孩子。” 这条消息几乎将你击倒，尽管真正原因也可能是两杯纯粹死亡。孩子。复数。小粉有孩子，而这是你第一次听说。模糊的意识思考片刻，只得出一个合乎逻辑的结论。“你是...一个熟女辣妈...” 小粉噗地喷气，随后爆发出咯咯大笑，笑得差点踢翻酒瓶。“诸神在上，[pc.name]！”她大口喘息，努力控制笑声。“你关注的居然是这个？” “嘿...”你用鼻子深吸气，努力整理思绪。

rows.original: You tell the redhead that her MILF status is a major turn on. Pink rolls her eyes, but the playful smile on her puffy lips tell you the motion is anything but dismissive. “I’ve heard THAT before,” her words are laced with a heavy sarcasm. “You wouldn’t believe the amount of guys who think it’s a sign you wanna be bred.” “Aha...” Perhaps it’s the booze talking but you can’t help but ask: “And do you?” “What?” Pink scrunches up her face, clearly not following. “Wanna be bred.” Pink doesn’t answer, instead just smiling and chewing the edge of her lower lip. The silence feels heavy, the mood of the room shifting. The now very tipsy redhead’s eyes linger on you, her gaze making your [pc.skinFurScales] feel flushed. Your own eyes shift downward from her face, finding her voluptuous curves suddenly a much better place to focus. You swallow hard, your mouth now feeling uncomfortably wet. “[pc.name]...” Pink’s voice is smooth as silk, the sultry redhead scooting closer to you. “Yeah?” You barely even muster the reply, your booze blinded mind just going through the motions. “I can’t feel my face.” The two of you burst out into giddy laughter, the declaration hitting your collective funny bones just right. Pink in particular is cracking up so bad she’s likely to bruise a lung. It takes a while for you both to calm down, with the last few chuckles quite hard to shake. “Oh fuck,” Pink gasps, trying to compose herself. “Well now what?” “Hmm,” you think for a moment, your brain chugging along at a snail’s pace.

Setting down the bottle, she picks up the glasses and hands you one. Taking the glass, you bring it up to your lips, bracing yourself. You moreso pour it down your throat than drink it, tossing it back so quickly your head spins for a second. Grimacing, the pungent liquid burns your throat, your eyes watering in response to its power. Out of the corner of your eye you register Pink taking her shot as well, the redheaded woman downing it without any noticeable issue. “Oh fuck,” Pink roughly wipes her lips with her forearm. “I think that might need to be the last one...” Clearing your eyes, your murmur in agreement. Your face feels warm against your cool hands, and you find holding them there for a minute extremely relaxing. “S-Sooo,” Pink starts to screw the cap back on the bottle. “Did yo- Oh!” She hiccups, nearly dropping the bottle as her whole body bounces. “Hrn, fuck.” Still holding your face, you feel the thick liquor sitting heavy in your belly. Focusing on it, you’re certain it’s slowly starting to lighten, but as of this moment the weight of it is almost enough to make you sick. Faintly you hear Pink ask you something, but you can’t seem to will yourself into listening. Instead you focus on how much warmer your face feels, its temperature rising as the weight inside of you lessens. “[pc.name]!” Pink nudges your shoulder, forcing your attention to her. Dropping your hands, you stare at the red-faced woman, her skin so flushed she looks ridiculous. You almost let out a chuckle, but stifle it back, asking Pink to repeat herself. “I asked if you wanted to crash here.” Pink face twists into an awkward frown, her lips not quite resting on her face properly. Rubbing your eyes, you think about the offer. rows.original: As you ask Pink about her kids, you notice her expression flatten. “Hmm,” she smacks her lips, eyes shifting to the ceiling. “That’s a heavy topic, boss. Fuck, I don’t even know where to start.” Shrugging, you find the answer simple. “Start at... the start.” Pink snorts. “Smartass.” She shifts her gaze down to her codex, muting the music. “Alright then... Well, I never planned on having kids. Not because I didn’t like them or some shit, I just... never thought about it. And since my childhood was so... fucked, I had literally no idea how a parent was even supposed to act. So...” she trails off, her eyelids looking like they weigh a thousand pounds. “I fucked it up.” Emboldened by your buzz, you ask the suddenly talkative woman why. Pink’s eyes flutter as she smacks her lips a few times. “I was a shit mom. And before you try to say something like ‘Oh, everybody thinks that’ or ‘don’t be so hard on yourself’... No, I was just shit and I never got better.” She tilts her head to the ceiling again. “First time, I tried to be a cool mom. Ice cream for dinner and bedtime whenever, and that was just the fucking start. I got him a fucking stripper for his thirteenth birthday party. Who the fuck does that?” Although you don’t say it aloud, you understand how that could be a problem. “Second time around, and this was...” Pink strains for a second, trying to think. “Fuck, a long ass time later, I tried the exact opposite.” She holds her hands up as if grasping some invisible ball. “I was, like, fucking psycho mom. I micromanaged her so much... Bah...” Pink throws her hands in the air, sinking back into the couch. “She didn’t even breathe without me knowing. I have no idea why I thought it would work.” Lost in thought, the two of you stay quiet for a moment. “My third,” Pink rubs her forehead, breaking the silence. “I pawned her off on a nanny. At first, I just wanted...” she drops her hand, letting it land on her lap with a thump. “I don’t fucking know. Help? Well, whatever the reason I ended up using it as an excuse to not parent at all.” She turns to you and weakly smiles. “She turned out okay... I just... don’t really know her.” You frown as her words run through your brain. You’re not certain what to say, if there is even anything you could say.

rows.original: A heavenly smell stirs you. Head aching, you open your eyes, the light of the room a painful sting. Groaning, you roll over on the couch, clutching your temples and closing your eyes tight. Instead you try to focus on the delicious aroma wafting through the air, but hear a faint sound of humming off in the distance as well. Tempting fate, you lift your head to take a peek, only to recoil back in head-splitting agony the moment you start to open your eyes. “I see someone’s awake.” A serene voice chuckles from far away. Grumbling, you bury your face into the couch, trying to keep the pervasive light at bay. Gentle footsteps encroach on you, with a clatter of what sounds like dishes audible inches from your head. You shy away from the noise, your head feeling like it may explode from the unwanted stimulus, but something else about it draws your attention. That intoxicating smell. “Eat up. This will make you feel much better.” The voice chimes, sounding smooth in the ear despite your apparent noise sensitivity. Cracking open a single eye the faintest slit, you look over at a plate of breakfast foods: eggs, toast, and some sort of small sandwiches with meat you don’t recognize. An orange glass of liquid sits close by, with drops of condensation rolling down from the edge. Swallowing hard, your mouth waters, and thinking with your stomach you pull yourself upright to better view the food. In the process, you catch sight of the voice’s owner, noting Pink sitting cross legged opposite you, naked as the day she was born, and sipping from a steaming mug. While normally, the sight of her naked might get a rise out of you, your stomach pulls you back to the plate. Seizing a fork and knife left by the plate, you fall upon the meal like a ravenous beast, shoveling it down your throat with a gluttonous fervor. Smiling, Pink sips her drink. “You remind me of your father.” “Hmm?” You barely pay attention, stuffing a whole wedge of toast into your half full mouth. “He used to be just as... Enthusiastic about breakfast after a long night of... well...” She sips her drink, letting the thought hang. Slowing down, you turn your attention to the nude redhead, giving her a closer look over. She doesn’t seem even a little hung over, and aside from being buck naked she looks just as pristine as always. Between bites, you ask her why she isn’t nursing the same headache you are. Laughing, Pink sets down her mug. “Plenty of practice... How’s your head?” You stop chewing to consider the question. “Better...” you blink, suddenly noticing that your head doesn’t feel two sizes too small anymore. “Good,” she smiles, tapping her painted nails on her exposed knee. “Well. I need to get dressed and head out. Okay?” You nod, the question catching you as you guzzle down some juice. Smiling, Pink pulls herself to her feet and walks over to you. Leaning low, she plants a kiss on the side of your head, her soft lips feeling like heavenly pillows against your temple. “Thanks for the fun night, [pc.name]. You can leave your dishes there when you’re done. Feel free to stay as long as you like.” As she walks off, you turn to watch her. Her pale, well shaped rump wiggles as she walks, making for an excellent show as you pick away at your meal. Disappearing into her room, she’s only gone for what seems like seconds before reappearing fully dressed. Munching the last wedge of toast, you watch her saunter towards the elevator, her ass looking almost as good in her jeans as it did bare. “Bye, Boss.” She shoots you wink as she enters the elevator. “Bye.” You reply, barely getting the toast down before the elevator doors close. It takes you a few minutes to finish the rest of the meal, barely resisting the urge to lick the plate for every last crumb of it. rows.translation: 一股天堂般的香气唤醒了你。 你头痛欲裂地睁开眼，房间里的光线如痛苦针刺。你呻吟着在沙发上翻身，按住太阳穴，紧紧闭起双眼。你转而试图专注于空气中飘荡的诱人香气，却也听见远处传来微弱的哼唱声。你冒险抬头偷看，结果眼睛刚开始睁开，就因撕裂脑袋般的剧痛缩了回去。 “看来有人醒了。”一个安详的声音从远处轻笑。 你嘟囔着把脸埋进沙发，试图隔绝无孔不入的光线。 轻柔的脚步向你逼近，听起来像餐具碰撞的叮当声在离脑袋几英寸处响起。你躲开噪声，感觉不受欢迎的刺激几乎要让脑袋爆炸，但其中另一些东西吸引了你的注意。 那股令人沉醉的香味。 “吃吧。这会让你好受许多。”那个声音清脆地说道，尽管你似乎对声音极其敏感，听起来仍十分悦耳。 你把一只眼睛睁开最细的缝，望向一盘早餐：鸡蛋、吐司，以及一些夹着陌生肉类的小三明治。旁边放着一杯橙色液体，杯沿凝结的水珠正向下滚落。你用力吞咽，口水不断分泌；肚子代替脑子思考，让你撑起身体，以便更好地看清食物。在这个过程中，你看见了声音的主人：小粉正盘腿坐在对面，浑身赤裸，啜饮一只冒着热气的杯子。 平常看到她裸体或许会让你兴奋，但此刻胃把你的注意力拉回餐盘。你抓起盘边留下的刀叉，像饥饿野兽般扑向食物，以贪婪热情把它们塞进喉咙。 小粉微笑着啜饮饮料。“你让我想起了你父亲。” “嗯？”你几乎没在听，把整块楔形吐司塞进半满的嘴。 “漫长一夜之后，他对早餐也曾经同样...热情，尤其是在...嗯...”她啜饮一口，让话中的意味悬在那里。 你放慢动作，把注意力转向裸体红发女人，更仔细地打量她。她看起来一点都没有宿醉，除了全身光溜溜以外，依旧如平常一样完美无瑕。你在进食间隙问她，为什么没有承受和自己一样的头痛。 小粉笑着放下杯子。“大量练习...你的头怎么样？” 你停止咀嚼，思考这个问题。“好多了...”你眨眨眼，突然注意到脑袋不再感觉小了两号。 “很好，”她微笑着，用涂过指甲油的指甲轻敲裸露膝盖。“那么，我得穿好衣服出门了。好吗？” 你点点头，正大口喝着果汁，这问题让你有些猝不及防。 小粉微笑着撑起身体，朝你走来。她俯下身，在你脑袋一侧亲了一口，柔软嘴唇贴着太阳穴，感觉像天堂般的枕头。“谢谢你陪我度过有趣的一晚，[pc.name]。吃完后把餐具留在那里就行。想待多久都可以。” 她走开时，你转头看着她。她苍白而形状姣好的臀部随着步伐扭动，让你在慢慢吃饭时欣赏了一场绝佳表演。她消失在房间里，仿佛只过了几秒便再次现身，已经穿戴整齐。你咀嚼着最后一块楔形吐司，看她摇曳着走向电梯；她的屁股裹在牛仔裤里，几乎与赤裸时一样漂亮。 “再见，老板。”她走进电梯时朝你眨了眨眼。 “再见。”你回答道，在电梯门关闭前勉强咽下吐司。 你花了几分钟才吃完剩下的食物，几乎无法抵抗舔盘子、收走最后一点碎屑的冲动。你从没想到小粉是如此优秀的厨师，不过话说回来，鸡蛋和吐司也不是最复杂的菜肴。独自一人吃完饭后，你终于从沙发上站起，身体一度有些摇晃，随后稳住平衡。
rows.raw: "A heavenly smell stirs you. Head aching, you open your eyes, the light of the room a painful sting. Groaning, you roll over on the couch, clutching your temples and closing your eyes tight. Instead you try to focus on the delicious aroma wafting through the air, but hear a faint sound of humming off in the distance as well. Tempting fate, you lift your head to take a peek, only to recoil back in head-splitting agony the moment you start to open your eyes. “I see someone’s awake.” A serene voice chuckles from far away. Grumbling, you bury your face into the couch, trying to keep the pervasive light at bay. Gentle footsteps encroach on you, with a clatter of what sounds like dishes audible inches from your head. You shy away from the noise, your head feeling like it may explode from the unwanted stimulus, but something else about it draws your attention. That intoxicating smell. “Eat up. This will make you feel much better.” The voice chimes, sounding smooth in the ear despite your apparent noise sensitivity. Cracking open a single eye the faintest slit, you look over at a plate of breakfast foods: eggs, toast, and some sort of small sandwiches with meat you don’t recognize. An orange glass of liquid sits close by, with drops of condensation rolling down from the edge. Swallowing hard, your mouth waters, and thinking with your stomach you pull yourself upright to better view the food. In the process, you catch sight of the voice’s owner, noting Pink sitting cross legged opposite you, naked as the day she was born, and sipping from a steaming mug. While normally, the sight of her naked might get a rise out of you, your stomach pulls you back to the plate. Seizing a fork and knife left by the plate, you fall upon the meal like a ravenous beast, shoveling it down your throat with a gluttonous fervor. Smiling, Pink sips her drink. “You remind me of your father.” “Hmm?” You barely pay attention, stuffing a whole wedge of toast into your half full mouth. “He used to be just as... Enthusiastic about breakfast after a long night of... well...” She sips her drink, letting the thought hang. Slowing down, you turn your attention to the nude redhead, giving her a closer look over. She doesn’t seem even a little hung over, and aside from being buck naked she looks just as pristine as always. Between bites, you ask her why she isn’t nursing the same headache you are. Laughing, Pink sets down her mug. “Plenty of practice... How’s your head?” You stop chewing to consider the question. “Better...” you blink, suddenly noticing that your head doesn’t feel two sizes too small anymore. “Good,” she smiles, tapping her painted nails on her exposed knee. “Well. I need to get dressed and head out. Okay?” You nod, the question catching you as you guzzle down some juice. Smiling, Pink pulls herself to her feet and walks over to you. Leaning low, she plants a kiss on the side of your head, her soft lips feeling like heavenly pillows against your temple. “Thanks for the fun night, [pc.name]. You can leave your dishes there when you’re done. Feel free to stay as long as you like.” As she walks off, you turn to watch her. Her pale, well shaped rump wiggles as she walks, making for an excellent show as you pick away at your meal. Disappearing into her room, she’s only gone for what seems like seconds before reappearing fully dressed. Munching the last wedge of toast, you watch her saunter towards the elevator, her ass looking almost as good in her jeans as it did bare. “Bye, Boss.” She shoots you wink as she enters the elevator. “Bye.” You reply, barely getting the toast down before the elevator doors close. It takes you a few minutes to finish the rest of the meal, barely resisting the urge to lick the plate for every last crumb of it. You never pegged Pink to be such an excellent chef, but then again eggs and toast isn’t the most complicated of meals. Left alone and done with your food, you finally rise from the couch, feeling slightly shaky for a moment before steeling your balance."

rows.original: You ask Blue why she’s wearing... that. “Oh!” Her face lights up. “It’s my new swimsuit, ya like it?” Considering how to answer, you give her a once over. The scanty piece of attire is a one piece, although that doesn’t seem quite the appropriate classification. Thin, bright pink strips of fabric run across Blue’s purple scales, most of them no wider than a finger. They hug against her wickedly curvy form tight in most places, although the strips running up her chest are stretched through the air. Near the bottom the fabric gets slightly thicker, offering just enough coverage so her crotch isn’t on display, although you still see enough to paint a fairly lascivious picture. Towards her chest you’re certain that if the blonde woman had nipples the thin pink material wouldn’t cover them up in the least, with only one skinny strip running over each massive tit. Swiveling on the balls of her feet, Blue strikes a few poses. “I, like, wanted to get it in blue, but all they had in my size was pink...” Planting her feet, she smiles. “But that’s okay. I still like it a lot!” Frowning, you get back to the root of your original question, asking her why she’s wearing it here and now. Blue blinks. “Cause I’m on vacay silly! That’s, like, the perfect time to wear a swimsuit!” Glancing around the hangar, you can tell Blue is getting stared at by more than a few sets of eyes. Not wanting to burst the accidental exhibitionist’s bubble, you decide to drop it.

rows.original: Before you’re even finished saying you will, Blue throws up her arms in celebration. “Yay!” She hoots, scooping up her bags awkwardly with her arms and tail. “Let’s go on an adventure!” The ‘adventure’ to the bar isn’t exactly as exciting as Blue’s enthusiasm made it sound, although you do admit there is some intrigue. As the two of you make your way through the hollowed ships corridors more than a few stares and catcalls are thrown towards the bouncing ovir, in no small part due to her skipping rather than walking. Blue, for her own part, seems completely oblivious to the attention, humming a soft tune as she skips, her bags swinging nearly as much as her barely covered chest. Staring yourself, you can’t seem to stop watching her tits sway, their movement oddly comforting... “Ooooo, I think this is it.” You snap to attention when Blue cries out, your attention being fixed more than you realized on the curvy woman. “Let’s go in!” You follow Blue into The Mess, your eyes now having a hard time not looking at her massive behind. ‘Hmm’ing and ‘Ha’ing, Blue looks around the cafeteria before spotting the pair of heavy doors that lead to the bar proper, her facing lighting up when she spots it. Giggling, she skips her way over to the doors, leaving you trailing several feet behind. Not that you mind the view, watching her ass bounce up and down... Shaking your head, you focus up and follow after. By the time you catch up, Blue has already checked in with a hostess, whose eyes you notice seem to be locked on Blue’s chest rather than her face. It’s fine. I grew up in places like this. It’s actually, like, almost nos... nos..uh..” “Nostalgic?” “Gazuntite. Alright, Imma go get a drink. Do ya want somethin’? My treat!”

rows.original: Before your answer can form in your throat, a sing-song voice pulls both of your attentions over. “I’m baaa- Oh! Hiya!” Lip twitching, Tessa glares at Blue, the shorter ovir seemingly trying to blow the purple woman’s head off with just a look. Unbelievably, Blue doesn’t seem to notice, smiling like an innocent fool at the very agitated, and very dangerous, white woman. You contemplate how to disarm the situation, but before you do Blue pipes up. “Whoooa.” The blonde ovir moves in closer, sticking her face so close to the pale woman you feel your butthole clench in concern. “You’re, like, super pretty... Boss, isn’t she super pretty?” Tessa blinks a few times rapidly, her eyes softening noticeably as they shift between you and Blue. “Boss?” She asks both of you at the same time, her voice tainted with confusion. The purple ovir giggles, bouncing a half step away from the suddenly disarmed white woman. “Yeah! [pc.name] is my boss!” Blue sticks out her tongue slightly, her eyes rolling. “But I’m on vacay though, so we’re just hangin’ out as friends. Oh! I’m Blue by the way. Pleased to meet ya!” “Blue?” Tessa’s jaw slacks in confusion. “Yeah! It’s a stage name, but I like it a lot!” Blue giggles bouncing slightly on the balls of her feet. “What’s your name? Man. I love your hair... It’s, like, so white and shiny...” “T-Tessa...” The pale ovir turns to you again, her brow raised. Silently, she mouths ‘what the fuck’ to you, motioning towards Blue with a head nod. Shrugging, you’re not even sure how to begin explaining Blue, and are just happy the assassin’s attitude seems suppressed. “Ooooo, Tesssssssaa.” The blonde woman’s tongue flicks out on the ‘S’ syllable. “That’s a...” Stopping mid-thought, Blue flicks her tongue out again, wiggling it in the air just in front of her. “Say...” The purple ovir scrunches up her face, voice turning flat as she squints hard at Tessa. “Do I, like, know you?” Tessa turns her gaze back to Blue, an exasperated frown curling her lips. “Trust me. If we’d met before I’d...” Tessa cuts herself off, her eyes twitching. “Wait...” she leans in closer to the taller woman, returning the squint. The two women stare at each other for what feels like minutes, the tension you felt before replaced with something harder to describe. Despite being the same species, they look almost nothing alike at first glance. Blue stands over half a foot taller, with her bright purple scales a stark contrast to Tessa’s pure white. Granted, both are wickedly curvy, although Blue’s hyper exaggerated body makes the albino woman look much less impressive under direct comparison. But as you look back and forth between the two, something you can’t quite shake itches at your brain. Something in their eyes as they look at each other is nagging you, but you can’t quite place it. Something clicks. A connection you already suspected but couldn’t form until this very moment. They couldn’t be. They can’t be. Are they really...?
rows.translation: 你还未来得及形成答案，一道唱歌般的声音便吸引了你们的注意。“我回——哦！嗨呀！” 泰莎嘴唇抽动，怒视蓝蓝；较矮的奥维尔人似乎试图只凭眼神轰掉紫色女性的脑袋。难以置信的是，蓝蓝似乎毫无察觉，像个无辜的傻瓜一样朝极度激动且危险的白色女性微笑。你正考虑如何化解局面，蓝蓝却先开口了。 “哇——。”金发奥维尔人凑得更近，脸贴近苍白女性，近到你因担忧而夹紧屁眼。“你，像是，超级漂亮...老大，她是不是超级漂亮？” 泰莎迅速眨了几下眼，目光在你与蓝蓝之间移动时明显柔和。“老大？”她同时问你们两人，声音充满困惑。 紫色奥维尔人咯咯笑着，从忽然解除戒备的白色女性身旁蹦开半步。“对！[pc.name]是我的老大！”蓝蓝稍稍吐舌，转动双眼。“不过我正在度假，所以我们只是像朋友一样一起玩。哦！对了，我叫蓝蓝。很高兴认识你！” “蓝蓝？”泰莎困惑地垂下下巴。 “对！是艺名，不过我非常喜欢！”蓝蓝咯咯笑着，用脚掌轻轻蹦跳。“你叫什么？天哪，我喜欢你的头发...它，像是，又白又闪亮...” “泰——泰莎...”苍白奥维尔人再次转向你，挑起眉毛。她无声地对你比出口型“什么鬼”，并用头朝蓝蓝示意。 你耸耸肩，甚至不知道该从何解释蓝蓝，只庆幸刺客的态度似乎已经受到抑制。 “哦——，泰——莎——。”金发女性说到“S”音节时弹了弹舌头。“这是个...”蓝蓝思绪中断，又伸出舌头，在面前空气中摇晃。“等等...”紫色奥维尔人皱起脸，用力眯眼看着泰莎，声音变得平淡。“我是不是，像是，认识你？” 泰莎重新望向蓝蓝，恼怒地皱起嘴唇。“相信我。如果我们以前见过，我早就...”泰莎忽然止住，双眼抽动。“等等...”她凑近高个女性，同样眯起眼睛。 两名女性凝视彼此，仿佛持续了数分钟；先前的紧张感被某种更难描述的东西取代。 尽管属于同一种族，乍看之下她们几乎毫无相似。蓝蓝高出半英尺以上，亮紫鳞片与泰莎纯白皮肤形成鲜明对比。当然，两人都曲线惊人，不过蓝蓝夸张到极点的身体让白化女性在直接对比下逊色不少。但当你来回看着两人时，某种无法摆脱的感觉在脑中发痒。她们互相注视时的眼神让你在意，却说不清是什么。 某个念头忽然成形。 这是你早已怀疑、直到此刻才终于形成的联系。不会吧。不可能。她们真的会是...?

Tessa’s eyes flutter, her shoulders slumping. You also ease up, getting the impression Tessa isn’t going to do what Tessa does. “I shouldn’t have assumed anythin’. I shoulda known better. People assume all kinds of stuff ‘bout me all the time and I know how much that hurts.” Blue lifts her head and smiles. “I don’t want us to get off on the wrong foot. I wanna be friends with you, cause any friend of [pc.name] should be a friend of mine, yanno?” The white woman’s stares hard at Blue, her face unreadable. “I... I don’t have many friends.” Blue continues, lowering her gaze. “People judge me before they get to know me. I know I’m stupid and I talk funny, but...” She lifts her head and smiles, tears welling up in her big bright eyes. “I just have this feelin’, yanno? Like... You’re maybe the same as me.” Watching Tessa’s face closely, you see her lower lip quiver. “I... don’t have many friends either. And I don’t know if we’re the same but...” She pulls one of her hands free from Blue’s grasp, then clasps it against Blue’s shoulder. Tessa takes a deep breath, then shrugs. “I’d love to be your friend.” Blue’s face lights up. “Really?! Yay!” In one quick motion, Blue pulls Tessa in for what looks like a bone crushing hug, the smaller ovir noticeably clenching up as she’s embraced. A chime goes off. “Oh!” Blue releases Tessa, the white woman taking a deep breath as she reels backwards. Pulling out a codex, the blonde ovir starts to frown. “Oh... My ride is almost here... I gotta go...” “Ride?” Tessa looks over at Blue, her brow raised. “You mean you’re not traveling with Steele in [pc.hisHer] mobile sex bus?” You frown at Tessa, taking more than a little issue with her simplification of your ship. “No.” Blue shrugs. “I booked a flight with...” “Whoa, whoa, WHOA. Fuck. That. Steele is going to give you a ride home.” You and Blue look at each other. “I am?” “[pc.HeShe] is?” Tessa turns to you. “Yeah, you fucking are, Steele.” Tessa leans in closer, her voice barely above a whisper. “Are seriously such a fucking asshole you’re going to let HER travel alone in this shitty, and super fucking dangerous, part of the galaxy?”

Turning, you see Blue standing in the entryway to the cockpit, her eyes wide and full of wonder. “Wooow.” She looks around. “Are all cockpits like this?” You tell her most are, with a shrug, then ask your blonde guest if she was looking for something. “Hmmm,” Blue chews the corner of her mouth, “I was just thinkin’...” her tongue slips out from between her lips, giving them a seductive lick. “I could show ya how much I appreciate the ride..... Uh, yanno... Sexually.”

rows.original: “So what do you guys do for work?” You ask, turning to face Scully and Ori. “Daddy’s a tracker.” Sata pipes up, stabbing a vegetable a few times with her fork, struggling to get it to stick. Chuckling, Scully reaches over and helps her spear the pesky veggie. “Search and rescue.” He clarifies. “Mostly I just sit in the office these days, the ol’ nose isn’t quite as sharp as it used to be.” Ori frowns. “Don’t listen to him. That nose of his is sharp as ever.” Not really fighting his wife’s claim, Scully just shrugs. You turn your attention to Ori, asking her what she does. “Homemaker.” Inna answers for her mother, glancing up from her lap long enough to make eye contact with you, her neon orbs sharp. Ori huffs. “That...” she bobs her head from side to side. “Is not inaccurate, however officially I’m still in the employ of the Huntsman’s League.” “Huntsman’s League?” You ask, not sure you’ve heard of it. “Hmm.” Ori nods, chewing on a piece of meat. “They’re a sport hunting organization.” “Poachers, you mean.” Inna snorts, giving her mother a sideways glance. “Inna.” Ori’s tone is firm, and seems to cow her daughter’s attention back to her lap. Clearing her throat, she continues. “I’m still technically on the payroll. But that’s ancient history. I haven’t really worked for them in years... What about you dear? What exactly do you do?”
rows.translation: “那么你们做什么工作？”你问道，转向斯卡利与奥莉。 “爸爸是追踪员。”萨塔插话，用叉子反复戳一块蔬菜，努力让它叉住。 斯卡利轻笑着伸手帮她叉起难缠蔬菜。“搜救。”他澄清。“这些日子我大多只是坐办公室，老鼻子不像以前那么灵了。” 奥莉皱眉。“别听他的。那只鼻子仍然和以前一样灵。” 斯卡利没真正反驳妻子的说法，只是耸肩。 你转向奥莉，询问她的工作。 “家庭主妇。”因娜替母亲回答，从膝上抬眼与你短暂对视，霓虹双眸锐利。 奥莉哼了一声。“那...”她左右摆头。“不能说不准确，不过正式来说，我仍受雇于猎人联盟。” “猎人联盟？”你不确定是否听说过。 “嗯。”奥莉点头，咀嚼一块肉。“他们是运动狩猎组织。” “你是说偷猎者。”因娜哼了一声，侧眼看母亲。 “因娜。”奥莉语气坚定，似乎压得女儿重新把注意放回膝上。她清清嗓子继续说道：“严格来说，我仍领着工资。不过那已是古老历史。我很多年没真正替他们工作了...你呢，亲爱的？你到底做什么？”

rows.original: “Oh it was adorable!” You turn to [var0], giving her a big smile. “We first met after a show. She was quite the feisty one!” Chuckling, Scully nods. “Sounds like our Ari alright.” Shrugging, you tell the whole table how that all changed very quickly. “All I had to do was turn on my natural Steele charm, and she changed her tune right away. Everytime I walked into the room her tail would start wagging.” A vein in the side of [var0]’s head starts to bulge, her lips forming a tight seal. “Really?” Ori sounds skeptical, and looks across the table at her daughter for confirmation. Grumbling, the simmering half-breed mutters out a half-hearted ‘yes’. The table seems to accept the answer, but you’re pretty sure nobody really believes her.

rows.original: “So how did you two meet?” You look back and forth between the two. On appearance alone, they look like quite the odd couple. “Oh my...” Ori chuckles. “It’s not a very romantic story...” Chuckling, Scully explains. “Orinne here graced this moon with her presence some forty years ago.” He smiles at his wife, looking at her like she’s a goddess. “Came as part of an entourage to hunt Frostwyrms, but-” “But,” she cuts him off, letting out a deep sigh. “Nobody saw fit to tell the girl who was born and raised in a jungle just how cold it gets here.” “Frostwyrms, darling. rows.original: Thinking quick, you try to shift the spotlight off of [var0]. “Grandchildren, huh? That must be pretty wild.” “Oh, it’s incredible!” Ori answers, beaming proudly. “Show him the pictures, dear!” Shifting to the side, Scully reaches into his pocket and pulls out a very old fashioned looking wallet. Flipping it open, a plastic insert unfolds several times, revealing a huge collection of small retro style pictures. Leaning in closer, you take a proper look. If your count is correct they have at least a dozen different grandkids, although many of them look so similar it’s hard to say if that count is correct. While most of them appear more Huskar than not, you do note a few with a bit more complex genealogies. “Aren’t they just adorable?” Ori leans over the table to get a better look, her chest tipping it over as she shifts her weight. “Oopsies, sorry.” She leans back quickly, righting the table before anything slid off. “Got a little too excited there!”

rows.original: “So you two must like being parents.” You look around the table at their pups and all the empty chairs. “A lot...” Ori blushes. “Well I wouldn’t have had eleven of them if I didn’t like them...” Scully rolls his eyes. “If she had her way we’d be closing in on twenty...” The dzaan woman frowns. “I agreed to take a break, yes, but you’re not exactly a young pup anymore, darling.” She stabs her fork into a piece of meat with far more power than necessary. “If we wait any longer, we may find your well has run dry...” “Gross...” Inna shudders, shying away from her mother slightly. “Super gross...” [var0] murmurs, shuddering. Throwing his hands up in defeat, Scully laughs. “Getting back to your question [pc.name], our children are the light of our lives.” He turns to Sata, reaching out and tapping her nose gently. “Each one is a blessing, and the greatest gift in the galaxy.” Out of the corner of your eye you’re pretty sure you notice Gol rolling his eyes, although all the hair in his face makes it hard to tell. “Well...” Ori gives you a curious look “Maybe there is one greater gift...” “Ahh, yes...” Scully nods, “Grandchildren! We’ve already quite a few, but...” he shifts his gaze past you, towards [var0]. “We’re always looking for more.” [var0] noticeably flinches.

rows.original: “So tell me more about Ari.” You hear her choke on her food next to you when you mention her name. “What was she like growing up?” “Oh well...” Ori titters slightly. “Ari was always very artistic! Singing, dancing, putting on shows... We knew quite early she was going to be a star. We’re so proud of her...” [var0] smiles weakly, appearing almost bashful. “She was also quite the handful,” Scully muses. “From the moment she started walking. She used to pick fights the way other children pick their noses.” “Really?” You turn to face the half-breed, noticing her eye twitch. “Really.” The Huskar continues. “And she was bloody good at it too! Only lost one fight if memory serves, and that was when she tried to take that older set of twins at the same time. What were their names...” “I grew out of it.” [var0] declares, a bit too defensively Scully stares at his daughter for a beat, then nods. “You did. And you were very well behaved afterwards.” “Well...” Gol speaks up, the whole table, even Inna, turning towards him. [var0] tosses daggers at her brother, her glare set to kill. “Except for when she lit the school on fire.” “Gol.” Ori’s voice is sharp. “You know that’s not true.” “Pft.” The shaggy half-breed scoffs, turning his attention to you. “She got cut from the prep squad and lit up their clubroom.” “Gol!” Scully barks, silencing his son. Turning to you, Scully clears his throat. “There was an incident at the school years ago, yes. Ari was questioned about it, but was cleared of all suspicion.” [var0] sighs, focusing on her plate, playing with her food rather than eating it. “She didn’t do it,” Inna mutters, returning her gaze to her lap. As all eyes turn to her, with [var0] suddenly looking nervous. “She was babysitting me...” she looks up, tossing her sister a sly grin. “Remember?” [var0] chuckles, a surge of confidence brightening her eyes. “Yeah. I was.” She turns to her brother. “You were just too busy jacking off to your doll collection to notice”. “Ari!” Ori chides her daughter from across the table. “They’re not fucking dolls! They’re figurines!” “Gol! Language!” Scully barks again, covering Sata’s ears. “That’s not a denial, idiot!” [var0] mutters, crosses her arms over her chest. Inna chuckles, clearly quite pleased with the discord she’s sown. After a few more tense exchanges, silence ensues. Scully, clearly trying to change the subject, turns to you. “So. [pc.name]. Maybe you can solve a little mystery for me.” He tosses [var0] a smile. “About a certain ovir my daughter’s been so tight-lipped about.” [var0] nearly falls out of her chair, the small woman almost yelling across the table. “Daaad!”
rows.translation: “多告诉我一些艾莉的事。”你提到她的名字时，听见身旁的她被食物呛到。“她小时候是什么样？” “哦，嗯...”奥莉轻声窃笑。“艾莉一直很有艺术天分！唱歌、跳舞、表演...我们很早就知道她会成为明星。我们为她感到骄傲...” [var0]勉强微笑，看起来几乎有些害羞。 “她也相当难管。”斯卡利沉思道。“从刚学会走路那一刻开始。其他孩子挖鼻孔有多频繁，她就有多频繁地挑架。” “真的？”你转向半血统女性，注意到她眼角抽动。 “真的。”哈斯卡人继续说道。“而且她他妈还很会打！如果没记错，只输过一次，就是她试图同时挑战那对年长双胞胎的时候。他们叫什么来着...” “我后来改掉了。”[var0]宣布，语气防御性强得过头。 斯卡利盯着女儿片刻，随后点头。“你确实改了。之后也非常乖。” “嗯...”戈尔开口，整桌人甚至包括因娜都看向他。[var0]向弟弟投去利刃般的目光，杀意十足。“除了她放火烧学校那次。” “戈尔。”奥莉语气尖锐。“你知道那不是真的。” “噗。”毛发蓬乱的半血统男性嗤之以鼻，把注意转向你。“她被预备队开除，然后烧了他们的活动室。” “戈尔！”斯卡利厉声呵斥，让儿子住嘴。他转向你，清清嗓子。“多年前学校确实发生过一场事故。艾莉接受了询问，但最后洗清所有嫌疑。” [var0]叹气，专注于餐盘，玩弄食物而非进食。 “不是她做的。”因娜低声说道，目光重新落向膝上。所有人都看向她，[var0]忽然显得紧张。“她当时在照看我...”她抬起头，狡黠地朝姐姐笑。“记得吗？” [var0]轻笑，信心涌入双眼。“对。我当时在照看她。”她转向弟弟。“你只顾着对着玩偶收藏打飞机，根本没注意。” “艾莉！”奥莉隔着桌子责备女儿。 “那他妈不是玩偶！是模型！” “戈尔！注意用词！”斯卡利再次厉声呵斥，捂住萨塔的耳朵。 “这可不算否认，白痴！”[var0]低声说道，双臂交叉抱胸。 因娜轻笑，显然非常满意自己制造的纷争。 又经历几次紧张交锋后，沉默降临。斯卡利显然试图换话题，转向你。“那么，[pc.name]。也许你能替我解开一个小谜团。”他朝[var0]微笑。“关于某个我女儿一直守口如瓶的奥维尔人。” [var0]差点从椅子上摔下，娇小女性几乎隔桌大喊：“爸——爸！”

Singing, dancing, putting on shows... We knew quite early she was going to be a star. We’re so proud of her...” [var0] smiles weakly, appearing almost bashful. “She was also quite the handful,” Scully muses. “From the moment she started walking. She used to pick fights the way other children pick their noses.” “Really?” You turn to face the half-breed, noticing her eye twitch. “Really.” The Huskar continues. “And she was bloody good at it too! Only lost one fight if memory serves, and that was when she tried to take that older set of twins at the same time. What were their names...” “I grew out of it.” [var0] declares, a bit too defensively Scully stares at his daughter for a beat, then nods. “You did. And you were very well behaved afterwards.” “Well...” Gol speaks up, the whole table, even Inna, turning towards him. Turning to you, Scully clears his throat. “There was an incident at the school years ago, yes. Ari was questioned about it, but was cleared of all suspicion.” [var0] sighs, focusing on her plate, playing with her food rather than eating it. “She didn’t do it,” Inna mutters, returning her gaze to her lap. As all eyes turn to her, with [var0] suddenly looking nervous. “She was babysitting me...” she looks up, tossing her sister a sly grin. “Remember?” [var0] chuckles, a surge of confidence brightening her eyes. “Yeah. I was.” She turns to her brother. “You were just too busy jacking off to your doll collection to notice”. “Ari!” Ori chides her daughter from across the table. “They’re not fucking dolls! They’re figurines!” “Gol! Language!” Scully barks again, covering Sata’s ears. “That’s not a denial, idiot!” [var0] mutters, crosses her arms over her chest. Inna chuckles, clearly quite pleased with the discord she’s sown. After a few more tense exchanges, silence ensues. Scully, clearly trying to change the subject, turns to you. “So. [pc.name]. Maybe you can solve a little mystery for me.” He tosses [var0] a smile. “About a certain ovir my daughter’s been so tight-lipped about.” [var0] nearly falls out of her chair, the small woman almost yelling across the table. “Daaad!”"

Turning to you, he gives you a pensive look. “I’m not completely sure what to make of you. But my nose and gut tell me you might just be good people. It takes a big man to ask this of somebody, but... Take care of my daughter.” You look back at the old Huskar, [pc.nmh|assuring him you will.|giving him a smile and a promise.|giving him a slight nod.] Moving into the entryway, you’re treated to a series of goodbyes, including a second handshake from Scully, two kisses on either cheek from Ori that leave giant lipstick marks, and a final, freaky stare from Sata. [var0] also bids you safe travels, walking you right up to the door while the rest of the family starts to disperse. “I’ll see ya back at The Penthouse, Boss. I’m gonna have a lot of work to do after all these home cooked meals.”

rows.original: Wondering what [var0] has in store, you make your way to the back of the house, trying your best not to appear like a burglar as you sneak around. The wait feels like it’s taking forever, with the cold Uveto winds howling the whole time you linger by the back door. Just as you go to check the time, you hear the back door creep open. Sticking her head out, [var0] locks eyes with you and smiles coyly. Holding a finger to her lips, she beckons you to follow her inside. Slipping in quitely, you find yourself positioned on a landing with two doors, one closed with the other ajar, revealing a flight of downward stairs. Having changed into a housecoat, [var0] leads you down into the basement, making sure the door to the landing is closed behind you. The basement is fairly packed, appearing to double both as a second living space and a laundry room. Looking around, you can tell it hasn’t been used for the former in quite some time, some boxes stacked around and old couches coated in a thin layer of dust. As you look around the room, you can’t help but notice the walls and ceiling are covered in dark black foam. “Soundproofing,” [var0] explains, catching your gaze. “Back when the house was full, this is where my older brothers and sisters used to hang out with their friends. Dad got tired of hearing them from two floors up so he sound proofed the hell out of it.” Examining the walls a bit more closely, you ask [var0] how well it works. “Extremely well,” the halfbreed replies, moving around the room behind you. “Nobody will hear us down here, even if we scream.” Smiling, you turn around to face the dark haired woman, asking her how much screaming she plans on doing. Chewing the corner of her lip, she reaches down towards her waist and unfastens her housecoat’s lazily knotted belt. “That’s all on you, Boss.” As she slowly parts it open, dark flesh catches your eye as she reveals she’s not wearing anything else underneath her thin robe. “After all these home cooked meals, I’m feeling thick as fuck,” she continues, sliding her coat down shoulders, exposing her perky chest and stiff nipples to you. “I need a workout, and you’re the only equipment around.” Letting the robe fall to the floor, [var0] reveals herself properly, then beckons you over. “I figure you deserve a little treat.”
rows.translation: 你好奇[var0]准备了什么，便走向屋后，偷偷绕行时尽力不让自己看起来像窃贼。 等待仿佛永无止境，乌维托寒风在你停留后门旁期间不断呼啸。你刚准备查看时间，便听见后门吱呀打开。[var0]探出脑袋，与你对视，含蓄地微笑。她竖起一根手指放在唇边，招手让你跟她进去。 你悄悄溜入，发现自己站在一处有两扇门的平台上；一扇关闭，另一扇半开，露出向下的楼梯。[var0]已经换上睡袍，引你下到地下室，并确保身后的平台门已经关好。 地下室塞得相当满，似乎兼作第二起居空间与洗衣房。你环顾四周，能看出前一种用途已经很久没被使用，周围堆着箱子，旧沙发覆着薄薄灰尘。查看房间时，你忍不住注意到墙壁和天花板都覆盖着黑色泡沫。 “隔音材料。”[var0]发现你的目光，解释道。“以前家里住满人时，我的哥哥姐姐会在这里和朋友一起玩。爸爸受够了隔着两层楼都能听见他们，于是把这里彻底隔音。” 你更加仔细地检查墙壁，询问[var0]效果如何。 “极其有效。”半血统女性回答，在你身后的房间里移动。“没人能听见我们在下面做什么，即使我们尖叫。” 你微笑着转身面对黑发女性，问她打算尖叫多少次。 她咬着嘴角，伸手解开睡袍腰间随意打结的腰带。“那全看你了，老大。”她缓缓敞开睡袍，深色肉体映入眼帘；薄袍下没有穿任何东西。“吃了这么多家常菜，我觉得自己胖得要命。”她继续说道，把外袍滑下肩膀，向你露出挺翘胸膛与硬挺乳头。“我需要锻炼，而周围唯一的器械就是你。” [var0]让睡袍落在地板，彻底展露身体，随后朝你招手。“我觉得你应得一点奖励。”
