rows.original: Cautiously, you follow behind him, not having a difficult time catching up due to the tiny strides of the small Tove. Why he’s taking you down a back alley is anybody’s guess, but you’re willing to roll with it for now. Entering through a side door, he takes you through a short service hall before exiting out into what appears to be a crowded foyer. Droves of people are gathered in the large room, around a set of double doors, being checked over by a small army of security. Above the door, you spot a large digital banner reading ‘Floor Space’.
rows.translation: 你谨慎跟在身后；这名娇小托夫人步幅很短，因此并不难追上。没人知道他为什么带你走后巷，不过你暂时愿意顺其自然。他从侧门进入，带你穿过一条短暂的服务走廊，随后走进看起来十分拥挤的门厅。大批人群聚集在大房间里，围绕一对双开门，并接受一小支保安大军检查。门上方有块大型数字横幅，写着“舞池空间”。
rows.raw: "\n\nCautiously, you follow behind him, not having a difficult time catching up due to the tiny strides of the small Tove. Why he’s taking you down a back alley is anybody’s guess, but you’re willing to roll with it for now. Entering through a side door, he takes you through a short service hall before exiting out into what appears to be a crowded foyer. Droves of people are gathered in the large room, around a set of double doors, being checked over by a small army of security. Above the door, you spot a large digital banner reading ‘Floor Space’."

rows.original: “Here, this way.” Colm waves you over to another side hall, which appears to be used for maintenance. After a short jaunt down the hall, he taps open another hidden door, the keypad discreet and easy to miss. Suddenly you’re met with a sea of people, and an incomprehensible amount of noise. A few heads turn to regard you as the door opens, but their eyes don’t linger, turning back to face the far end of the crowded room. Following Colm inside, you realize you’re inside of a large arena, the floor seemingly standing room only, but you note rows of seating on upper levels. On the far end of the room sits a darkened stage, with all eyes in the room fixed on it.
rows.translation: “这里，这边走。”科尔姆招手让你走进另一条侧厅，看起来用于维护。沿走廊短暂前行后，他按开另一扇隐藏门；键盘十分隐蔽，很容易错过。突然间，人海和难以理解的噪音迎面而来。门打开时，几颗脑袋转向你，却没有长久停留，重新面向拥挤房间的远端。你跟随科尔姆进入，发现自己位于一座大型竞技场；地面似乎只有站席，但上层有一排排座位。房间远端坐落着昏暗舞台，全场目光都锁定那里。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here, this way.” Colm waves you over to another side hall, which appears to be used for maintenance. After a short jaunt down the hall, he taps open another hidden door, the keypad discreet and easy to miss. Suddenly you’re met with a sea of people, and an incomprehensible amount of noise. A few heads turn to regard you as the door opens, but their eyes don’t linger, turning back to face the far end of the crowded room. Following Colm inside, you realize you’re inside of a large arena, the floor seemingly standing room only, but you note rows of seating on upper levels. On the far end of the room sits a darkened stage, with all eyes in the room fixed on it."

rows.original: “Not a bad house,” you hear Colm say over the din of the crowd. “Find a place to stand close to the stage, go on, don’t be shy! A few elbows never hurt anybody!”
rows.translation: “观众不少。”你听见科尔姆的声音越过人群喧嚣。“找个靠近舞台的位置，去吧，别害羞！挤几下又不会伤到谁！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not a bad house,” you hear Colm say over the din of the crowd. “Find a place to stand close to the stage, go on, don’t be shy! A few elbows never hurt anybody!”"

rows.original: At the small manager’s request, you start to shoulder your way to the front.
rows.translation: 应小经理要求，你开始挤向前方。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt the small manager’s request, you start to shoulder your way to the front."

rows.original: TAVROS THE OASIS
rows.raw: "TAVROS THE OASIS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: fridge
rows.raw: "fridge"

rows.original: You head over to the minifridge and pop it open.
rows.translation: 你走向迷你冰箱，把它打开。
rows.raw: "You head over to the minifridge and pop it open."

rows.original: It’s mostly full of water, but on the bottom shelf you notice it’s loaded up with juice boxes. While on it’s own that may not be particularly strange, the fact they are all pineapple flavor does stand out slightly...
rows.translation: 里面大多是水，不过你注意到底层装满盒装果汁。单独来看或许不算奇怪，但它们全都是菠萝味，就显得有些突出...
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s mostly full of water, but on the bottom shelf you notice it’s loaded up with juice boxes. While on it’s own that may not be particularly strange, the fact they are all pineapple flavor does stand out slightly..."

rows.original: seat
rows.raw: "seat"

rows.original: You move over to the couch and have a seat.
rows.translation: 你走到沙发旁坐下。
rows.raw: "You move over to the couch and have a seat."

rows.original: To say it’s uncomfortable would be a massive understatement. It feels more like you’re sitting on a slab of cement rather than leather. Shifting around, you can’t find a single way to sit on it that’s even remotely comfortable. You hop up after a minute, not willing to stay on it a moment longer.
rows.translation: 说它不舒服都是严重低估。与其说坐在皮革上，不如说坐在水泥板上。你来回移动，却找不到任何哪怕稍微舒服的坐姿。一分钟后你便跳起来，一刻也不愿继续待着。
rows.raw: "\n\nTo say it’s uncomfortable would be a massive understatement. It feels more like you’re sitting on a slab of cement rather than leather. Shifting around, you can’t find a single way to sit on it that’s even remotely comfortable. You hop up after a minute, not willing to stay on it a moment longer."

rows.original: You decide to take a look around the room.
rows.translation: 你决定环顾房间。
rows.raw: "You decide to take a look around the room."

rows.original: Honestly, it seems pretty empty. Clean, to be sure, but it has a sterile feeling to you. If you had to guess, you’d say the room is largely unused.
rows.translation: 说实话，这里相当空旷。确实很干净，但给你一种无菌感。若要猜测，你会说房间基本没人使用。
rows.raw: "\n\nHonestly, it seems pretty empty. Clean, to be sure, but it has a sterile feeling to you. If you had to guess, you’d say the room is largely unused."

rows.original: As you give the room another once over, you hear the door open behind you, along with the sound of chatter as somebody enters.
rows.translation: 你再次扫视房间时，听见身后门打开，伴随着有人进入的谈话声。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you give the room another once over, you hear the door open behind you, along with the sound of chatter as somebody enters."

rows.original: “I’m just sayin’. I think we cou- OH!” The chattering stops, and you turn to face three familiar women. The same three women, of course, who you just saw on stage a few short minutes beforehand. They stare at you blankly for a moment, before the blue clad ovir chimes in, her bubbly voice letting you know she was the one talking before. “Um, hiya?”
rows.translation: “我只是说。我觉得我们可——哦！”谈话声停止，你转身面对三名熟悉女性。当然，正是几分钟前刚在舞台上见过的三人。她们茫然地盯着你片刻，随后身穿蓝装的奥维尔人开口；活泼声音让你知道先前正是她在说话。“呃，嗨呀？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m just sayin’. I think we cou- OH!” The chattering stops, and you turn to face three familiar women. The same three women, of course, who you just saw on stage a few short minutes beforehand. They stare at you blankly for a moment, before the blue clad ovir chimes in, her bubbly voice letting you know she was the one talking before. “Um, hiya?”"

rows.original: “Shh!” the woman in green scowls at the thick ovir. “Don’t talk to fucking strangers. They could be a serial killer, or a rapist, or-”
rows.translation: “嘘！”身穿绿色服装的女性怒视丰满奥维尔人。“别他妈和陌生人说话。他们可能是连环杀手，或者强奸犯，或者——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shh!” the woman in green scowls at the thick ovir. “Don’t talk to fucking strangers. They could be a serial killer, or a rapist, or-”"

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele.” The pink one speaks, tossing a glance at her group mate. “Colm told us he was setting up a meeting, remember?” The green woman seems to shy back, letting the pink-clad terran turn her attention back to you. “It’s a pleasure to finally make your acquaintance. We, as you surely know, are the Love Starz.”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”身穿粉色服装的女性开口，瞥向组员。“科尔姆说过他会安排见面，记得吗？”绿色女性似乎向后缩去，让身穿粉装的地球女性重新看向你。“很高兴终于认识你。我们，正如你肯定知道的，是爱之星。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] Steele.” The pink one speaks, tossing a glance at her group mate. “Colm told us he was setting up a meeting, remember?” The green woman seems to shy back, letting the pink-clad terran turn her attention back to you. “It’s a pleasure to finally make your acquaintance. We, as you surely know, are the Love Starz.”"

rows.original: Just behind the pink woman, the blue ovir strikes an overly dramatic pose as if on cue. The dusky green woman, clearly unimpressed, buries her face in her palm, audibly groaning. “Don’t do it when we’re not on stage, dumbass...”.
rows.translation: 就在粉装女性身后，蓝色奥维尔人仿佛得到提示般摆出过度夸张的姿势。暗绿色女性显然毫无兴趣，用手掌捂住脸，清晰呻吟。“不在舞台上就别这么做，白痴...”。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust behind the pink woman, the blue ovir strikes an overly dramatic pose as if on cue. The dusky green woman, clearly unimpressed, buries her face in her palm, audibly groaning. “Don’t do it when we’re not on stage, dumbass...”."

rows.original: While the two quietly squabble behind their pink leader, you take a moment to really get a look at the three of them.
rows.translation: 她们在粉色领队身后低声争执时，你花片刻真正打量三人。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile the two quietly squabble behind their pink leader, you take a moment to really get a look at the three of them."

rows.original: Despite their matching outfits, the similarities between the three ladies stop there. The ovir is built, and sounds, like a bimbo, while the black haired halfbreed in green is trim and lean, with a particularly foul mouth. The human in pink is a healthy middle between the extremes, almost like a marriage of the two body types, her demeanor serene and in control. You also note that while at first glance they appear to all be the same height, they’re in fact all wearing boots with different sized heels, an interesting costume choice you’re sure has a purpose.
rows.translation: 除了配套服装，三位女士的相似之处到此为止。奥维尔人的身材和声音都像花瓶女郎，身穿绿装的黑发半血统女性则精瘦利落，满嘴脏话。粉装人类处于两个极端的健康中间位置，仿佛两种体型结合，举止平静而掌控局面。你还注意到，虽然乍看之下三人似乎一样高，其实她们穿着鞋跟高度不同的靴子；这项有趣的服装选择肯定有其目的。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite their matching outfits, the similarities between the three ladies stop there. The ovir is built, and sounds, like a bimbo, while the black haired halfbreed in green is trim and lean, with a particularly foul mouth. The human in pink is a healthy middle between the extremes, almost like a marriage of the two body types, her demeanor serene and in control. You also note that while at first glance they appear to all be the same height, they’re in fact all wearing boots with different sized heels, an interesting costume choice you’re sure has a purpose."

rows.original: Realizing you’re staring, you pull your eyes off them and introduce yourself properly. “Yes. Ahem. Hi, I’m [pc.name] Steele. Your manager Colm said I might be your boss...”
rows.translation: 你意识到自己一直盯着，便移开目光，正式自我介绍。“对。咳。嗨，我是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。你们的经理科尔姆说，我也许是你们的老板...”
rows.raw: "\n\nRealizing you’re staring, you pull your eyes off them and introduce yourself properly. “Yes. Ahem. Hi, I’m [pc.name] Steele. Your manager Colm said I might be your boss...”"

rows.original: The young woman in green rolls her eyes, but the redheaded terran speaks instead. “That seems to be the case, yes. As far as the lawyers can tell, but there was something about... what did he say again?” She turns back and looks at the green half breed.
rows.translation: 身穿绿装的年轻女性翻白眼，但红发地球女性先开口。“看来确实如此。至少律师能确认到这个程度，不过其中还有些...他刚才怎么说的？”她回头看向绿色半血统女性。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe young woman in green rolls her eyes, but the redheaded terran speaks instead. “That seems to be the case, yes. As far as the lawyers can tell, but there was something about... what did he say again?” She turns back and looks at the green half breed."

rows.original: “A scavenger hunt!” The ovir in blue answers instead, hopping at her exclamation, her massive chest nearly smacking her square in the face.
rows.translation: “寻宝游戏！”蓝装奥维尔人抢先回答，喊叫时跳了起来，硕大胸膛几乎正正撞上自己的脸。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A scavenger hunt!” The ovir in blue answers instead, hopping at her exclamation, her massive chest nearly smacking her square in the face."

rows.original: The human woman smiles, nodding slowly. “Ah. Yes. Something to that effect,” she turns her attention back towards you, her bright eyes gleaming. “Oh. Where are our manners? We didn’t formally introduce ourselves. I am Pink-Star. I’m sort of the leader here. This lovely lady to my right is Blue-Star, and to my lef-”
rows.translation: 人类女性微笑着缓慢点头。“啊，对。大概就是这么回事。”她重新看向你，明亮双眼闪耀。“哦。我们真没礼貌。还没正式自我介绍。我是粉星，算是这里的领队。我右边这位可爱的女士是蓝星，左边——”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe human woman smiles, nodding slowly. “Ah. Yes. Something to that effect,” she turns her attention back towards you, her bright eyes gleaming. “Oh. Where are our manners? We didn’t formally introduce ourselves. I am Pink-Star. I’m sort of the leader here. This lovely lady to my right is Blue-Star, and to my lef-”"

rows.original: The one in green cuts her off. “Names Ari.” She crosses her arms over her chest, staring you down with bright green eyes not unlike her outfit.
rows.translation: 绿装女性打断她。“名字叫艾莉。”她双臂抱胸，用与服装相似的明亮绿眼盯着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe one in green cuts her off. “Names Ari.” She crosses her arms over her chest, staring you down with bright green eyes not unlike her outfit."

rows.original: “Green! No!” The ovir called Blue-Star declares, puffing up her cheeks. “You’ve gotta use your other name! We promised!”
rows.translation: “绿绿！不行！”被称作蓝星的奥维尔人宣布，鼓起双颊。“你得用另一个名字！我们说好了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Green! No!” The ovir called Blue-Star declares, puffing up her cheeks. “You’ve gotta use your other name! We promised!”"

rows.original: “When we’re in public, sure. I’ll be Green-Star all fucking day. But when we’re here in the damn green room? Fuck. That.” Ari turns away from her blue groupmate with an audible ‘hmph’.
rows.translation: “在公共场合，当然。我他妈整天都能当绿星。可是在该死的休息室里？去。他。妈。的。”艾莉转身背对蓝色组员，清晰地“哼”了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“When we’re in public, sure. I’ll be Green-Star all fucking day. But when we’re here in the damn green room? Fuck. That.” Ari turns away from her blue groupmate with an audible ‘hmph’."

rows.original: “Green, don’t be like that.” Pink-Star tosses a sideways look to the defiant woman, the faintest hint of a frown on her pink painted lips. She turns her gaze back towards you, beaming politely. “We need to get back on stage, but it was a pleasure meeting you, [pc.name]. If you would like to meet with us in more... personal settings, please feel free to stop by our penthouse. It’s not far,” she points up, giving you a coy smile. “It’s on the premises in fact.”
rows.translation: “绿绿，别这样。”粉星侧眼看向反抗的女性，涂成粉色的双唇浮现最轻微的皱眉。她重新望向你，礼貌地喜笑颜开。“我们需要回到舞台，不过很高兴认识你，[pc.name]。如果想在更加...私人的环境中与我们见面，请随时来顶层公寓。并不远。”她向上指，含蓄微笑。“事实上，就在这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Green, don’t be like that.” Pink-Star tosses a sideways look to the defiant woman, the faintest hint of a frown on her pink painted lips. She turns her gaze back towards you, beaming politely. “We need to get back on stage, but it was a pleasure meeting you, [pc.name]. If you would like to meet with us in more... personal settings, please feel free to stop by our penthouse. It’s not far,” she points up, giving you a coy smile. “It’s on the premises in fact.”"

rows.original: “Awe. Does this mean I have to clean my room?” Blue’s shoulders slump, the ovir suddenly visibly dejected.
rows.translation: “唉。这代表我得打扫房间吗？”蓝蓝肩膀垂下，奥维尔人忽然明显情绪低落。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awe. Does this mean I have to clean my room?” Blue’s shoulders slump, the ovir suddenly visibly dejected."

rows.original: Ari scoffs. “Don’t worry about it, dumbass. Come on, let’s get moving.” She turns to leave, grabbing Blue’s tail as she goes and gives it a sharp yank. The ovir lets out a small yelp, but doesn’t seem overly upset, just opting to give you a playful finger waggle as she’s dragged from the room.
rows.translation: 艾莉嗤之以鼻。“别担心，白痴。来吧，该走了。”她转身离开，经过时抓住蓝蓝尾巴，用力猛拉。奥维尔人轻声尖叫，却似乎没有太过不满，只在被拖出房间时朝你顽皮地摇动手指。
rows.raw: "\n\nAri scoffs. “Don’t worry about it, dumbass. Come on, let’s get moving.” She turns to leave, grabbing Blue’s tail as she goes and gives it a sharp yank. The ovir lets out a small yelp, but doesn’t seem overly upset, just opting to give you a playful finger waggle as she’s dragged from the room."

rows.original: Pink sighs, then starts to turn to leave herself. “I’ll tell Colm to give you access. Just use the lift and it’ll take you right on up. It really was a pleasure to meet you [pc.Mr]. Steele. I hope to have the same pleasure again soon.” She tosses you a wink as she departs, an oddly familiar gesture you can’t quite place. You’re certain you know her from somewhere now...
rows.translation: 粉粉叹气，随后也开始转身离开。“我会让科尔姆给你权限。只要使用电梯，就会直接带你上去。真的很高兴认识你，[pc.Mr]·斯蒂尔。希望很快能再次享受同样的荣幸。”她离开时朝你眨眼；这是个奇怪地熟悉、却说不清出处的动作。你现在确信自己曾在哪里见过她...
rows.raw: "\n\nPink sighs, then starts to turn to leave herself. “I’ll tell Colm to give you access. Just use the lift and it’ll take you right on up. It really was a pleasure to meet you [pc.Mr]. Steele. I hope to have the same pleasure again soon.” She tosses you a wink as she departs, an oddly familiar gesture you can’t quite place. You’re certain you know her from somewhere now..."

rows.original: Left alone in the room, you don’t really know what to do with yourself. Tactfully, you opt to leave rather than stick around.
rows.translation: 你独自留在房间，不太知道该做什么。你谨慎地选择离开，而不是留在这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nLeft alone in the room, you don’t really know what to do with yourself. Tactfully, you opt to leave rather than stick around."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: “Eh?” Colm leans in, clearly not hearing your answer over the noise. “Bah, follow me, we’ll talk backstage. I love those damn girls, but these fans of theirs... Come on.” The small black Tove motions for you to follow him as he starts to push his way through the crowd.
rows.translation: “啊？”科尔姆凑近，显然没在噪音中听见你的回答。“呸，跟我来，我们去后台谈。我爱那些该死的姑娘，可她们的粉丝...来吧。”娇小黑色托夫人开始挤过人群，示意你跟随。
rows.raw: "“Eh?” Colm leans in, clearly not hearing your answer over the noise. “Bah, follow me, we’ll talk backstage. I love those damn girls, but these fans of theirs... Come on.” The small black Tove motions for you to follow him as he starts to push his way through the crowd."

rows.original: A few rowdy fans bump into you as you shoulder your way through the sea of people, eager to push in closer to the stage as you move further away from it. Barely able to see the diminutive manager, you can’t help but wonder how the hell he isn’t being trampled by the rowdy crowd. You see him make it to a far wall and a very large ausar with ‘security’ printed across his shirt. As you join them, you catch the last part of their conversation. “Yeah, yeah. Open up, buddy. We’re going to the green room.”
rows.translation: 你挤过人海时，几个吵闹粉丝撞上身体；你越远离舞台，他们越急于向前挤。你几乎看不见矮小经理，不禁奇怪他到底怎么没被喧闹人群踩死。你看见他走到远墙旁，那里站着一个身材硕大的奥萨人，衣服上印着“保安”。你加入他们时，听到谈话最后一部分。“对，对。开门，伙计。我们要去休息室。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA few rowdy fans bump into you as you shoulder your way through the sea of people, eager to push in closer to the stage as you move further away from it. Barely able to see the diminutive manager, you can’t help but wonder how the hell he isn’t being trampled by the rowdy crowd. You see him make it to a far wall and a very large ausar with ‘security’ printed across his shirt. As you join them, you catch the last part of their conversation. “Yeah, yeah. Open up, buddy. We’re going to the green room.”"

rows.original: The security guard rolls his eyes and steps to the side, revealing a rather modest looking door hidden behind his wide frame. He holds it open, but seems more than a little annoyed to be doing so. Colm glances back at you, checking to see if you’re there, before passing through the doorway. You follow behind him, eager to get out of the increasingly loud room.
rows.translation: 保安翻白眼，向一旁退开，露出藏在宽阔身躯后方、外观相当普通的门。他帮忙扶着门，却显然对此颇为恼火。科尔姆回头看你，确认你在场，随后穿过门口。你跟在身后，急于离开这个越来越嘈杂的房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe security guard rolls his eyes and steps to the side, revealing a rather modest looking door hidden behind his wide frame. He holds it open, but seems more than a little annoyed to be doing so. Colm glances back at you, checking to see if you’re there, before passing through the doorway. You follow behind him, eager to get out of the increasingly loud room."

rows.original: As soon as the door shuts behind you, everything goes deathly quiet. The silence is almost unnerving, but Colm fills the void quickly enough with his fast talk. “The green room is this way. Come, come.” He starts down the hall, walking at a brisk pace despite his small size.
rows.translation: 门刚在身后关闭，一切便陷入死寂。沉默几乎令人不安，不过科尔姆很快用飞快话语填补空白。“休息室在这边。来，来。”他沿走廊前进，尽管身材娇小，步伐依然轻快。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs soon as the door shuts behind you, everything goes deathly quiet. The silence is almost unnerving, but Colm fills the void quickly enough with his fast talk. “The green room is this way. Come, come.” He starts down the hall, walking at a brisk pace despite his small size."

rows.original: “That song...” you start to speak, but your voice seems off, the lack of noise of the soundproof hall making it feel flat. Shaking your head clear, you ask the short manager why you didn’t understand it.
rows.translation: “那首歌...”你开始说话，声音却感觉不对；隔音走廊没有噪声，使其显得平板。你摇头清醒，询问矮小经理为何自己无法听懂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That song...” you start to speak, but your voice seems off, the lack of noise of the soundproof hall making it feel flat. Shaking your head clear, you ask the short manager why you didn’t understand it."

rows.original: “It’s L-Pop.” Colm says, glancing over his shoulder. “Part of the appeal is the added language barrier. The audio has this signal mixed in that canceled out translators.” The small tove shrugs. “I don’t really get it, but people love it.”
rows.translation: “那是L-Pop。”科尔姆回头瞥了一眼。“额外的语言障碍正是吸引力之一。音频中混有一种信号，会抵消翻译器。”娇小托夫人耸肩。“我也不太理解，不过人们很喜欢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s L-Pop.” Colm says, glancing over his shoulder. “Part of the appeal is the added language barrier. The audio has this signal mixed in that canceled out translators.” The small tove shrugs. “I don’t really get it, but people love it.”"

rows.original: “Right...” You are vaguely aware of L-Pop as a genre, but aren’t particularly knowledgeable about the scene.
rows.translation: “好吧...”你对L-Pop这种音乐类型略有耳闻，但并不特别了解这个圈子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right...” You are vaguely aware of L-Pop as a genre, but aren’t particularly knowledgeable about the scene."

rows.original: “So you were telling me how you-” a beeping sound cuts him off, drawing his attention to a small device on his wrist. Reading it, Colm scowls. “Motherfuckers... I’m very sorry. I’ve got to deal with something. Damn bastards are trying to edge in on the shirt percentages... You head on to the green room and have some refreshments. The girls will be with you shortly.” The small tove brushes past you, muttering under his breath as he stomps back down the hall.
rows.translation: “所以你刚才在告诉我，你是怎么——”哔哔声打断他，把注意吸引到手腕上的小设备。科尔姆阅读后怒容满面。“混蛋...非常抱歉。我得处理点事情。那些该死的混蛋想插手衬衫分成比例...你去休息室，吃点茶点。姑娘们很快会去见你。”娇小托夫人擦身而过，一边低声咒骂，一边沿走廊跺着脚返回。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you were telling me how you-” a beeping sound cuts him off, drawing his attention to a small device on his wrist. Reading it, Colm scowls. “Motherfuckers... I’m very sorry. I’ve got to deal with something. Damn bastards are trying to edge in on the shirt percentages... You head on to the green room and have some refreshments. The girls will be with you shortly.” The small tove brushes past you, muttering under his breath as he stomps back down the hall."

rows.original: Left alone, you proceed down the hall as instructed and find a door with a name plate reading ‘green room’. You poke your head in and take a quick look around, not exactly sure if the room is supposed to be empty or not.
rows.translation: 独自留下后，你依照指示沿走廊前进，找到一扇名牌写着“休息室”的门。你探头迅速环顾，不太确定房间是否本就应该空着。
rows.raw: "\n\nLeft alone, you proceed down the hall as instructed and find a door with a name plate reading ‘green room’. You poke your head in and take a quick look around, not exactly sure if the room is supposed to be empty or not."

rows.original: Aside from a minifridge and a few couches, it’s currently vacant.
rows.translation: 除了迷你冰箱和几张沙发，目前空无一人。
rows.raw: "\n\nAside from a minifridge and a few couches, it’s currently vacant."

rows.original: Stepping in, you’re not completely sure what to do with yourself...
rows.translation: 走进去后，你不太确定自己该做些什么...
rows.raw: "\n\nStepping in, you’re not completely sure what to do with yourself..."

rows.original: Check Fridge
rows.translation: 检查冰箱
rows.raw: "Check Fridge"

rows.raw: "fridge"

rows.original: Check The Fridge
rows.translation: 检查冰箱
rows.raw: "Check The Fridge"

rows.original: He did say you could.
rows.translation: 他说过你可以这么做。
rows.raw: "He did say you could."

rows.original: Have Seat
rows.translation: 坐下
rows.raw: "Have Seat"

rows.original: seat
rows.raw: "seat"

rows.original: Have A Seat
rows.translation: 找地方坐下
rows.raw: "Have A Seat"

rows.original: Might as well get comfy.
rows.translation: 不妨让自己舒服些。
rows.raw: "Might as well get comfy."

rows.original: Snoop Around
rows.translation: 四处窥探
rows.raw: "Snoop Around"

rows.original: snoop
rows.raw: "snoop"

rows.original: Snoop Around
rows.translation: 四处窥探
rows.raw: "Snoop Around"

rows.original: Cause why not?
rows.translation: 为什么不呢？
rows.raw: "Cause why not?"

rows.original: The Love Starz
rows.translation: 爱之星乐队
rows.raw: "The Love Starz"

rows.original: Fr0sty
rows.raw: "Fr0sty"

rows.original: The room dims, the noise in the room lulling as the light fades. Faintly, you hear the slight sound of feedback as a microphone turns on.
rows.translation: 房间里的灯光暗下，随着光线消退，室内的噪声也逐渐平息。你隐约听见麦克风开启时发出的轻微反馈声。
rows.raw: "The room dims, the noise in the room lulling as the light fades. Faintly, you hear the slight sound of feedback as a microphone turns on."

rows.original: A smooth, sultry voice speaks. “Are you ready to fall in love?”
rows.translation: 一个圆润妖艳的声音响起。“准备好坠入爱河了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nA smooth, sultry voice speaks. “Are you ready to fall in love?”"

rows.original: The crowd roars in response.
rows.translation: 人群以轰鸣回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe crowd roars in response."

rows.original: Bright lights power on, the sudden flash catching you off guard and stinging your eyes. Squinting, you make out three feminine figures posing on stage, each bathed in a light of a different color. Over the deafening noise of the crowd you hear the speaker once again.
rows.translation: 明亮灯光骤然亮起，突如其来的闪光令你猝不及防，刺痛双眼。你眯起眼，辨认出舞台上三个摆着姿势的女性身影，每个人都沐浴在不同颜色的灯光中。越过人群震耳欲聋的喧嚣，你再次听见那个声音。
rows.raw: "\n\nBright lights power on, the sudden flash catching you off guard and stinging your eyes. Squinting, you make out three feminine figures posing on stage, each bathed in a light of a different color. Over the deafening noise of the crowd you hear the speaker once again."

rows.original: “Let’s do it.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s do it.”"

rows.original: The crowd cheers louder as a song begins to play, one you can’t say you’ve ever heard before, but the roar of the crowd makes it hard to know for sure. It has a fast tempo and is certainly very pop-y, but something about it catches you off guard: you can’t understand a word of it. Still squinting, you try to make out the figures on stage; you can tell they are indeed singing, but for some reason their song doesn’t seem affected by your translator. You blink a few times, trying to focus on the figures.
rows.translation: 歌曲开始播放，人群的欢呼变得更加响亮。你不能说自己以前听过这首歌，但现场的咆哮让人很难确定。它节奏明快，无疑有着浓厚流行乐味道，但有件事令你措手不及：你一个字都听不懂。你仍眯着眼，试图辨认舞台上的身影；能看出她们确实在唱歌，可不知为何，她们的歌曲似乎完全不受翻译器影响。你眨了几下眼睛，努力聚焦于那些身影。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe crowd cheers louder as a song begins to play, one you can’t say you’ve ever heard before, but the roar of the crowd makes it hard to know for sure. It has a fast tempo and is certainly very pop-y, but something about it catches you off guard: you can’t understand a word of it. Still squinting, you try to make out the figures on stage; you can tell they are indeed singing, but for some reason their song doesn’t seem affected by your translator. You blink a few times, trying to focus on the figures."

rows.original: You take in the sight of the three women, each wearing a matching, yet distinct, outfit that goes with their respective color light. All three seem to be nearly the same height, and move in perfect unison, and despite the noise of the crowd you can tell they are singing in perfect harmony, whatever language they’re singing in. With your eyes finally adjusted, you give them a good look over.
rows.translation: 你打量三个女人。每个人都穿着与各自灯光颜色相配、彼此协调却各具特色的服装。三人身高似乎几乎完全相同，动作也完美同步；尽管现场嘈杂，你仍能听出她们无论使用何种语言，都正以完美和声歌唱。双眼终于适应光线后，你仔细打量她们。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take in the sight of the three women, each wearing a matching, yet distinct, outfit that goes with their respective color light. All three seem to be nearly the same height, and move in perfect unison, and despite the noise of the crowd you can tell they are singing in perfect harmony, whatever language they’re singing in. With your eyes finally adjusted, you give them a good look over."

rows.original: On the left, basking in blue light, is a voluptuous blonde ovir. Moving her body to the music, you note her to be exceptionally curvy, sinfully so, her costume struggling to contain her impressive assets. Her heavy tail swings back and forth rhythmically as she moves, miraculously not knocking over either of the other dancers, perhaps a testament to her skill as a dancer. The blue light makes it hard to tell exactly what color her scales are, but as far as you can tell they must be quite bright.
rows.translation: 左侧沐浴在蓝光中的，是一位身材丰腴的金发奥维尔。她随着音乐舞动身体，你注意到她曲线异常夸张，简直罪恶，演出服几乎无法容纳那令人印象深刻的资本。她沉重的尾巴随动作有节奏地来回摆动，却奇迹般没有撞倒另外两位舞者，或许证明了她精湛的舞技。蓝光让人难以判断鳞片究竟是什么颜色，但据你所见，那颜色一定相当鲜亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nOn the left, basking in blue light, is a voluptuous blonde ovir. Moving her body to the music, you note her to be exceptionally curvy, sinfully so, her costume struggling to contain her impressive assets. Her heavy tail swings back and forth rhythmically as she moves, miraculously not knocking over either of the other dancers, perhaps a testament to her skill as a dancer. The blue light makes it hard to tell exactly what color her scales are, but as far as you can tell they must be quite bright."

rows.original: As you shift your gaze to regard the next one over, the dancers suddenly switch positions, the lights changing in line with a shift in the rhythm of the song. The green singer moves across center stage, catching your eye as she glides past. You can’t quite place her race, thinking her to be at least half ausar due to the presence of a thick bushy tail, however her ears seem far more elven than wolfish, making you ponder what else she may be. While much more lithe than the ovir, she is still plenty impressive to look at, especially since she boasts an eye catching bubble butt which she knows how to move distractingly well.
rows.translation: 当你移开视线去看旁边那人时，舞者突然交换位置，灯光也随歌曲节奏变化而改变。绿色歌手穿过舞台中央，滑行而过时吸引了你的目光。你无法确定她的种族；浓密蓬松的尾巴让你觉得她至少有一半奥萨血统，但耳朵远比狼耳更像精灵，又让你思索她还混有何种血统。她比奥维尔苗条得多，但仍十分养眼，尤其是拥有一个格外吸睛的浑圆翘臀，而且知道如何用极具干扰力的方式摇动它。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you shift your gaze to regard the next one over, the dancers suddenly switch positions, the lights changing in line with a shift in the rhythm of the song. The green singer moves across center stage, catching your eye as she glides past. You can’t quite place her race, thinking her to be at least half ausar due to the presence of a thick bushy tail, however her ears seem far more elven than wolfish, making you ponder what else she may be. While much more lithe than the ovir, she is still plenty impressive to look at, especially since she boasts an eye catching bubble butt which she knows how to move distractingly well."

rows.original: The song slows, and as if on cue the green and blue singers seem to fade into the background, their respective lights dimming. The third singer moves forward, her pink light narrowing in and singling her out as she sings a soft solo verse. Clearly the speaker from before, her voice is mesmerizing, more so than the other singers, and you find yourself being drawn in by each syllable of her siren song. She’s terran, or at least you think she is, with straight, long bright red hair that trails straight down her back. Build wise, she’s somewhere in between the other two singers, striking a delicate balance that seemingly gives her the best of both worlds. Oddly, you can’t shake the feeling you’ve seen her somewhere before...
rows.translation: 歌曲节奏放缓，绿色与蓝色歌手仿佛得到信号般退入背景，各自的灯光随之变暗。第三位歌手走上前，粉色灯光收窄，将她单独照亮；她唱起一段轻柔独唱。显然她就是先前说话的人，嗓音令人着迷，甚至胜过另外两位歌手；你发现自己被海妖歌声的每个音节逐渐吸引。她是泰伦人，至少你觉得如此；一头笔直、鲜红的长发垂至背后。论体形，她介于另外两个歌手之间，达成了一种微妙平衡，似乎同时拥有双方的优点。奇怪的是，你始终无法摆脱曾在某处见过她的感觉...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe song slows, and as if on cue the green and blue singers seem to fade into the background, their respective lights dimming. The third singer moves forward, her pink light narrowing in and singling her out as she sings a soft solo verse. Clearly the speaker from before, her voice is mesmerizing, more so than the other singers, and you find yourself being drawn in by each syllable of her siren song. She’s terran, or at least you think she is, with straight, long bright red hair that trails straight down her back. Build wise, she’s somewhere in between the other two singers, striking a delicate balance that seemingly gives her the best of both worlds. Oddly, you can’t shake the feeling you’ve seen her somewhere before..."

rows.original: The solo ends and the lights shift, the other two singers returning to the side of their pink clad comrade. The three sing the chorus again, dancing in sync while the crowd cheers. Seemingly falling into a trance, you jump when you feel a tap on your shoulder. Turning quickly, you see the stout form of Colm smiling up at you.
rows.translation: 独唱结束，灯光变化，另外两个歌手回到身穿粉色服装的同伴身边。三人再次唱起副歌，伴随人群欢呼同步起舞。你似乎渐渐陷入恍惚，肩膀突然被拍了一下，吓得一跳。你迅速转身，看见身材矮壮的科尔姆正仰头对你微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe solo ends and the lights shift, the other two singers returning to the side of their pink clad comrade. The three sing the chorus again, dancing in sync while the crowd cheers. Seemingly falling into a trance, you jump when you feel a tap on your shoulder. Turning quickly, you see the stout form of Colm smiling up at you."

rows.original: He gives you a wide grin. “Enjoying the show?”
rows.translation: 他咧嘴大笑。“喜欢这场演出吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe gives you a wide grin. “Enjoying the show?”"

rows.original: Not Really
rows.translation: 不太喜欢
rows.raw: "Not Really"

rows.original: Not Really
rows.translation: 不太喜欢
rows.raw: "Not Really"

rows.original: You can’t even understand it!
rows.translation: 你甚至完全听不懂！
rows.raw: "You can’t even understand it!"

rows.original: It’s Okay
rows.translation: 还行
rows.raw: "It’s Okay"

rows.original: It’s Okay
rows.translation: 还行
rows.raw: "It’s Okay"

rows.original: It’s not half bad, but not your style.
rows.translation: 不算太差，但不是你的风格。
rows.raw: "It’s not half bad, but not your style."

rows.original: I Love It
rows.translation: 我喜欢
rows.raw: "I Love It"

rows.original: I Love It
rows.translation: 我喜欢
rows.raw: "I Love It"

rows.original: This is totally awesome!
rows.translation: 简直太棒了！
rows.raw: "This is totally awesome!"

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original: Free concert? Why not?
rows.translation: 免费演唱会？为什么不呢？
rows.raw: "Free concert? Why not?"

rows.original: Another Time
rows.translation: 下次吧
rows.raw: "Another Time"

rows.original: “Another time,” you tell him. “I’ve got to go, but I’ll take you up on the offer when I’m free.”
rows.translation: “下次吧，”你告诉他。“我得走了，不过等有空时一定会接受你的邀请。”
rows.raw: "“Another time,” you tell him. “I’ve got to go, but I’ll take you up on the offer when I’m free.”"

rows.original: “Hmm,” Colm shrugs. “Understandable, you do have a very important inheritance to secure. Don’t be a stranger, boss. The girls are eager to meet you!” He winks and turns his attention off you, seemingly over recognizing your presence.
rows.translation: “嗯，”科尔姆耸耸肩。“可以理解，你确实有一份非常重要的遗产需要确保到手。别太见外，老板。姑娘们都很想见你！”他眨眨眼，将注意力从你身上移开，似乎已经不再在意你的到来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm,” Colm shrugs. “Understandable, you do have a very important inheritance to secure. Don’t be a stranger, boss. The girls are eager to meet you!” He winks and turns his attention off you, seemingly over recognizing your presence."

rows.original: Heading off, you take a mental note of the standing offer.
rows.translation: 离开时，你在心里记下了这个长期有效的邀请。
rows.raw: "\n\nHeading off, you take a mental note of the standing offer."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Another Time
rows.translation: 下次吧
rows.raw: "Another Time"

rows.original: You’re busy anyways.
rows.translation: 反正你也很忙。
rows.raw: "You’re busy anyways."

rows.original: love_starz_email
rows.raw: "love_starz_email"

rows.original: Along the way you spot a large opening, a massive digital sign calling it ‘The Oasis.’ While the function of the place is not immediately apparent, you can see a sea of people crowding around the main entrance. Off to the side, you spot a rather handsomely dressed Tove. He might be the one from the email you received...
rows.translation: 途中，你发现一个巨大入口，上方的巨型数字招牌称其为“绿洲”。尽管无法立刻看出这里的用途，你却能看见人山人海拥挤在正门周围。在一旁，你发现一位穿着相当体面的托夫人。他或许就是先前给你发邮件的那位...
rows.raw: "\n\nAlong the way you spot a large opening, a massive digital sign calling it ‘The Oasis.’ While the function of the place is not immediately apparent, you can see a sea of people crowding around the main entrance. Off to the side, you spot a rather handsomely dressed Tove. He might be the one from the email you received..."

rows.original: Sharp Tove
rows.translation: 精明的托夫人
rows.raw: "Sharp Tove"

rows.original: You ask Colm who the Love Stars are.
rows.translation: 你问科尔姆爱之星是什么。
rows.raw: "You ask Colm who the Love Stars are."

rows.original: “Only the hottest act in the sector,” he answers, bristling with pride. “They’re the biggest female pop sensation since The Sugar Chicks, and currently have two singles on ‘Holonet Top 10’.”
rows.translation: “她们可是这个星区最火的组合，”他骄傲地回答。“自甜心女孩以来，她们是最轰动的女性流行乐团体，目前有两首单曲进入‘全息网十强’。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Only the hottest act in the sector,” he answers, bristling with pride. “They’re the biggest female pop sensation since The Sugar Chicks, and currently have two singles on ‘Holonet Top 10’.”"

rows.original: “Huh,” You like what you’re hearing so far, and ask Colm to continue.
rows.translation: “哦，”目前听到的内容令你很感兴趣，于是让科尔姆继续。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh,” You like what you’re hearing so far, and ask Colm to continue."

rows.original: “The girls have been together for a bit now, and have accumulated quite a following. It’s not just music either. Merchandise sales are huge. The whole IP is a goldmine. I’d tell you more specifics, but...” he looks both ways then leans in. “Sort of a need to know things.”
rows.translation: “姑娘们已经在一起一段时间，也积累了相当庞大的追随者群体。而且不只是音乐，周边商品销量也非常惊人。整个知识产权就是一座金矿。我本来可以告诉你更多细节，但...”他左右看了看，随后凑近。“有些事情需要按知情权限来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The girls have been together for a bit now, and have accumulated quite a following. It’s not just music either. Merchandise sales are huge. The whole IP is a goldmine. I’d tell you more specifics, but...” he looks both ways then leans in. “Sort of a need to know things.”"

rows.original: “I thought I was the boss?” You ask flatly.
rows.translation: “我还以为自己是老板？”你平淡地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I thought I was the boss?” You ask flatly."

rows.original: Colm chuckles and shrugs, squinting at you. “In theory, but not in practice. Not yet at least.”
rows.translation: 科尔姆轻笑着耸肩，眯眼看着你。“理论上是，实际却不是。至少现在还不是。”
rows.raw: "\n\nColm chuckles and shrugs, squinting at you. “In theory, but not in practice. Not yet at least.”"

rows.original: You ask Colm what it means to be the owner.
rows.translation: 你问科尔姆，成为所有者意味着什么。
rows.raw: "You ask Colm what it means to be the owner."

rows.original: “Majority owner,” he corrects. “While we’re not publicly traded, we did have a variety of investors on start up. Your father just happened to invest the controlling amount.”
rows.translation: “多数股东，”他纠正道。“虽然我们没有公开上市，但创业时确实有各种投资者。你父亲碰巧投入了足以取得控制权的金额。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Majority owner,” he corrects. “While we’re not publicly traded, we did have a variety of investors on start up. Your father just happened to invest the controlling amount.”"

rows.original: Confused, you ask Colm why they needed private investors for a music group.
rows.translation: 你感到困惑，问科尔姆为什么一个音乐团体需要私人投资者。
rows.raw: "\n\nConfused, you ask Colm why they needed private investors for a music group."

rows.original: “Eh, the music biz is complicated in this century. Anybody with a social media account and a half decent connection to the net can be a huge star,” Colm scratches his cheek, letting out a resigned sigh. “Signing with major labels is a quick way to get yourself huge, sure. But you’d better believe they take the lion’s share of control and profits. Private investors, when they’re not allowed to take control, are a much better option.”
rows.translation: “呃，这个世纪的音乐产业很复杂。任何拥有社交媒体账号和半个还算过得去的网络连接的人，都可能成为超级明星，”科尔姆挠着脸颊，无奈地叹了口气。“和大型唱片公司签约当然是迅速走红的办法，但你最好相信，他们会拿走绝大部分控制权和利润。私人投资者只要不被允许取得控制权，就是好得多的选择。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eh, the music biz is complicated in this century. Anybody with a social media account and a half decent connection to the net can be a huge star,” Colm scratches his cheek, letting out a resigned sigh. “Signing with major labels is a quick way to get yourself huge, sure. But you’d better believe they take the lion’s share of control and profits. Private investors, when they’re not allowed to take control, are a much better option.”"

rows.original: “So, unlike my father,” You reason.
rows.translation: “所以，和我父亲不同，”你推断道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, unlike my father,” You reason."

rows.original: Colm flinches. “That was an oversight. Your father used a number of shell companies and bought up a number of small percentages that add up to a majority,” Colm frowns as much as his beak can allow. “It was basically a hostile takeover!”
rows.translation: 科尔姆畏缩起来。“那是一次疏忽。你父亲利用许多空壳公司，买下许多零碎的小额股份，累积起来取得了多数，”科尔姆尽其鸟喙所能皱起眉。“那基本就是一次恶意收购！”
rows.raw: "\n\nColm flinches. “That was an oversight. Your father used a number of shell companies and bought up a number of small percentages that add up to a majority,” Colm frowns as much as his beak can allow. “It was basically a hostile takeover!”"

rows.original: “Huh,” you wonder aloud why he would invest in a startup pop group.
rows.translation: “哦，”你出声思索，他为什么会投资一家初创流行乐团体。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh,” you wonder aloud why he would invest in a startup pop group."

rows.original: “I’d say you’d have to ask him,” Colm chuckles. “But that comment may be in bad taste.”
rows.translation: “我会说你得去问他，”科尔姆轻笑道。“但这话或许有些不合时宜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’d say you’d have to ask him,” Colm chuckles. “But that comment may be in bad taste.”"

rows.original: You ask Colm why the Love Starz are set up here.
rows.translation: 你问科尔姆，爱之星为什么驻扎在这里。
rows.raw: "You ask Colm why the Love Starz are set up here."

rows.original: “Concerts! Going on tour these days is...” Colm grimaces. “Well, it’s not what it used to be. Too many pirates, cutthroats, and the like. So, we set up shop and get the fans to come to us.”
rows.translation: “开演唱会！如今外出巡演...”科尔姆面露苦色。“嗯，已经不像从前了。海盗、亡命徒之类的家伙太多。所以我们固定驻扎，让粉丝来找我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Concerts! Going on tour these days is...” Colm grimaces. “Well, it’s not what it used to be. Too many pirates, cutthroats, and the like. So, we set up shop and get the fans to come to us.”"

rows.original: “And that works?”
rows.translation: “这样行得通？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that works?”"

rows.original: “Well enough. The girls run shows often, all at the same venue.” Colm smirks, “I got them a very sweet deal as well. And since they’re not traveling, they’re able to rest, relax, and work on new ideas. It’s a total win!”
rows.translation: “效果还不错。姑娘们经常演出，而且全在同一场地。”科尔姆坏笑道，“我也替她们谈下了非常优厚的协议。而且因为不用旅行，她们能够休息、放松，并构思新点子。完全是各方共赢！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well enough. The girls run shows often, all at the same venue.” Colm smirks, “I got them a very sweet deal as well. And since they’re not traveling, they’re able to rest, relax, and work on new ideas. It’s a total win!”"

rows.original: As you enter the Penthouse, your attention is immediately drawn to the sounds of conversation. “You don’t need more than one fucking bag, dumbass.” [var0] huffs. “We’re only gonna be gone a few fucking days.” You move further into the room, noting Blue dragging three large suitcases across the floor, one with each arm with the last grasped by her powerful tail. “Hnn, but I don’t wanna, like, leave anythin’ behind I might need!” Blue drops the cases and pouts. “What if I, like, don’t bring my fuzzy socks and totes need ‘em!” “Why the fu-” [var0] notices you, cutting herself off. “Oh, [pc.name]. Fuck, talk about timing.” You look at Blue’s three suitcases, then notice a single, smaller bag by [var0]’s feet. Connecting the dots, you ask them where they’re going. “Vacation,” a smooth voice answers from the corner of the room. Turning, you spot Pink sitting in the kitchen area, sipping a steaming cup of tea. You didn’t even notice her there, despite it being where she’s typically perched. “A new lighting package is being installed, so we’re off the hook for performing, although we’ve got a video shoot next week, so we can’t be late, ladies.” “We won’t!” Blue exclaims, bouncing from excitement. “It’s going to be sooo fun! I’m going to a resort!” [var0] flattens her mouth into a frown. “At least one of us is going to be warm... Come on dumbass, we’re going to be late.” She scoops up her bag and walks to the door, brushing past you on her way to the elevator. “See ya, boss...” Blue grabs her bags and hurries to the elevelator. “Hold the door!” She bolts past you, awkwardly jostling with her stuff as she clamours in next to [var0]. As the elevator doors close, you see the diminutive crossbreed roll her eyes one last time. “Sorry if that ruined your plans,” Pink declares, drawing your attention back to her. She takes a sip from her tea then sets her mug down. “They won’t be away for long. Surely you can last a few days without your little harem.” Amused, you ask the sultry redhead why she isn’t leaving. Pink shrugs. “I’m perfectly fine here.” Shifting onto her feet, Pink walks towards her room, glancing back at you from over her shoulder. “Especially since I can have. Some. Fun. With. You.” She smiles, slightly chewing the corner of her lip.
rows.translation: 你走进顶层公寓，立刻注意到谈话声。 “你他妈根本不需要超过一个包，笨蛋。”[var0]怒哼道。“我们他妈只离开几天。” 你继续走进房间，注意到小蓝正拖着三个大行李箱穿过地板，两只手臂各拖一个，最后一个则由强壮的尾巴抓住。 “嗯，可我不想，怎么说，把可能用到的东西落下！”小蓝放下箱子，噘起嘴。“要是我，怎么说，没带毛绒袜子，结果真的超级需要它们怎么办！” “你他妈为什么”[var0]注意到你，猛然住口。“哦，[pc.name]。操，来得真巧。” 你看看小蓝的三个行李箱，随后注意到[var0]脚边只有一个较小的包。把线索拼起来后，你问她们要去哪里。 “度假，”房间角落传来一个圆润的声音。你转过身，看见小粉坐在厨房区域，啜饮一杯冒着热气的茶。尽管那里是她通常待着的位置，你甚至完全没注意到她。“这里要安装一套新的灯光设备，所以我们不用演出。不过下周还有视频拍摄，因此女士们，我们不能迟到。” “不会的！”小蓝叫道，兴奋得弹跳起来。“一定会超级好玩！我要去度假村！” [var0]抿起嘴皱眉。“至少我们中有个人能待在温暖的地方...走吧，笨蛋，我们要迟到了。”她捞起自己的包走向门口，在前往电梯的路上与你擦肩而过。“再见，老板...” 小蓝抓起行李，匆匆奔向电梯。“别关门！”她从你身边冲过，笨拙地拖着东西挤到[var0]身边。电梯门关闭时，你看见娇小混血儿最后一次翻了个白眼。 “抱歉，如果这破坏了你的计划，”小粉宣布道，把你的注意力重新吸引到她身上。她啜饮一口茶，随后放下杯子。“她们不会离开太久。你肯定能在没有小后宫的情况下撑过几天。” 你觉得好笑，问妖艳的红发女人为什么不离开。 小粉耸耸肩。“我待在这里就很好。”小粉站起身，走向自己的房间，越过肩膀回望你。“尤其是因为我可以。和。你。找。点。乐。子。”她微笑着，轻轻咬住嘴角。

rows.original: As you enter the Penthouse, you find that the lights are dimmed. Somewhere in the room a song is playing faintly, but far too quiet to make out. Looking around, you spot Pink on the other side of the room seated on the couch, watching a small section of the monitor wall that also seems to be the source of the music. As you move towards her, you can tell she hasn’t noticed that you’re there, the terran woman completely enthralled by whatever she’s watching. You spot a glass of wine in her hand as you get close, with a large empty bottle on the table in front of her. It isn’t until you’re within a few feet that she hears you, snapping to attention and letting out a sudden gasp of surprise. “[pc.name]!” she jumps, the wine in her glass nearly sloshing out as she taps a codex next to her, the music muting. “Wh- I wasn’t expecting company tonight.” Pink’s cheeks are noticeably rosy. You can smell the wine on her breath as well, but even so you get the impression she’s not THAT drunk. Turning to the muted screen you ask the tipsy woman what she was watching. “What I was...” Pink turns to the screen, her finger grazing over the codex. “Ahh, uh, I was just reminiscing.” “Reminiscing?” You ask, turning to take a real look at what’s on the screen. At first glance it looks like a music video, but after watching it play for a few seconds you note it to be live concert footage. You don’t know the band playing, but one member you surprisingly recognize. Playing the bass, and having the brightest blonde hair you’ve ever seen, is Pink, bobbing to the beat of the muted song. “Yeah...” Pink sighs, takes a sip from her wine, then unmutes the music. The volume is low, but being so close now to its source you can clearly make it out. It’s a poppy song, quite catchy in fact, and one you’re almost certain you’ve heard before. [pc.isTaur|Squatting down next to Pink|Taking a seat next to Pink], you listen closely, trying to remember where you’ve heard it. “What is this?” you ask, with the name of the tune on the tip of your tongue. Pink chuckles, the color in her cheeks turning a bit darker. “It’s ‘Party Time’ by Blow,” she sips her wine again. “It was a pretty big hit, ahhh, around fifty years ago or so. Gets a good deal of playtime still.” “Fifty years ago?” you glance over at the screen, giving the younger Pink in the video a once over. You tell Pink that aside from the hair she looks exactly the same. Pink snorts then lets out an awkward laugh. “Yeah, I always made for a great blonde.” Downing her drink, she smacks her lips and sets the glass aside. “So, are you just checking in on me or what?”
rows.translation: 你走进顶层公寓，发现灯光已经调暗。房间某处隐约播放着一首歌，但声音太小，根本听不清。你环视四周，发现小粉坐在房间另一边的沙发上，正看着监控墙上的一小块区域，那里似乎也是音乐的来源。 你朝她走去，看得出她还没注意到你的存在，这个泰伦女人完全沉浸在所看的内容中。靠近时，你发现她手里拿着一杯葡萄酒，面前桌上则摆着一个已经空掉的大酒瓶。直到你走到几英尺外，她才听见声音，猛然回神，突然惊喘一声。 “[pc.name]！”她吓得一跳，杯中葡萄酒几乎晃出来；她轻点身旁的终端，音乐随之静音。“什，我没想到今晚会有人来。” 小粉的双颊明显泛红。你也能闻到她呼吸中的酒气，但即便如此，仍觉得她没有醉得那么厉害。你转向静音的屏幕，问这个微醺的女人刚才在看什么。 “我在看什么...”小粉转向屏幕，手指轻触终端。“啊，呃，我只是在回忆往事。” “回忆往事？”你问道，转身认真看看屏幕上的内容。乍一看像是音乐视频，但播放几秒后，你发现那是现场演唱会录像。你不认识正在演出的乐队，却惊讶地认出了其中一位成员。演奏贝斯、拥有你见过最明亮金发的人正是小粉，她随着无声歌曲的节拍点头。 “是啊...”小粉叹息着啜饮一口葡萄酒，随后解除音乐静音。音量很小，但如今离音源如此之近，你能清楚听见。那是一首很有流行风格、事实上相当抓耳的歌，而且你几乎确信以前听过。[pc.isTaur|你蹲到小粉身边|你坐到小粉身边]，仔细聆听，努力回想在哪里听过。 “这是什么？”你问道，曲名已经到了嘴边。 小粉轻笑，双颊颜色变得更深。“是Blow乐队的《派对时间》，”她再次啜饮葡萄酒。“它曾是一首相当热门的歌，啊，大约五十年前吧。现在仍经常播放。” “五十年前？”你瞥向屏幕，从头到脚打量视频里更年轻的小粉。你告诉小粉，除了头发以外，她看起来完全没有变化。 小粉哼了一声，随后尴尬地笑起来。“是啊，我一直很适合金发。”她喝光杯中酒，咂咂嘴，把杯子放到一旁。“所以，你只是来看看我，还是有什么事？”

rows.original: You enter The Oasis, and take the lift up to the Penthouse. Reaching the door, you knock first, not really sure on the protocol, then step inside.
rows.translation: 你走进“绿洲”，乘电梯前往顶层公寓。到达门口后，你先敲敲门，不太确定规矩是什么，随后走了进去。
rows.raw: "You enter The Oasis, and take the lift up to the Penthouse. Reaching the door, you knock first, not really sure on the protocol, then step inside."

rows.original: Beyond the threshold is a large and lavish room. At first you think it to be a studio apartment based on the size, but several doors around the corners of the space force you to second guess that assessment. The room is filled with typical living room furniture, along with a kitchenette stocked to the teeth in the corner. The crowning piece to the room is the far wall, which you quickly identify as a wall wide monitor, used to simulate views in areas without one. The screen is currently set to a skyline on an idyllic world you can’t immediately identify, the view quite beautiful despite being artificial.
rows.translation: 门槛后是一间宽敞豪华的房间。起初，你根据面积以为这是间单间公寓，但空间各角落的几扇门迫使你重新考虑这个判断。房间里摆满常见的客厅家具，角落还有一座储备齐全的小厨房。房间最引人瞩目的部分是远端墙壁，你很快认出那是一面覆盖整墙的显示器，用于在没有景观的区域模拟风景。屏幕目前显示一个你无法立刻认出的田园世界天际线；尽管是人造景象，风景仍非常美丽。
rows.raw: "\n\nBeyond the threshold is a large and lavish room. At first you think it to be a studio apartment based on the size, but several doors around the corners of the space force you to second guess that assessment. The room is filled with typical living room furniture, along with a kitchenette stocked to the teeth in the corner. The crowning piece to the room is the far wall, which you quickly identify as a wall wide monitor, used to simulate views in areas without one. The screen is currently set to a skyline on an idyllic world you can’t immediately identify, the view quite beautiful despite being artificial."

rows.original: As you walk into the room, you very quickly notice you’re not alone.
rows.translation: 你走进房间，很快注意到自己并非独自一人。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you walk into the room, you very quickly notice you’re not alone."

rows.original: “Oh!” The ovir known as Blue sits up on one of the couches, dressed in what looks like her underwear, a giant tub of ice cream on her lap. “Pink! That Irons person or whatever is here!”
rows.translation: “哦！”那个名叫小蓝的奥维尔从一张沙发上坐起，身上穿着看起来像内衣的东西，大腿上放着一大桶冰淇淋。“小粉！那个叫艾恩斯还是什么的人来了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh!” The ovir known as Blue sits up on one of the couches, dressed in what looks like her underwear, a giant tub of ice cream on her lap. “Pink! That Irons person or whatever is here!”"

rows.original: One of the doors on the room’s corners opens, a familiar head of red hair sticking out. “Irons?” Pink looks around before spotting you in the doorway. “Oh!” she exclaims, stepping into the room fully, dressed down casually from when you last saw her. “[pc.name]. You came after all.”
rows.translation: 房间角落的一扇门打开，一颗熟悉的红发脑袋探了出来。“艾恩斯？”小粉环顾四周，随后发现站在门口的你。“哦！”她惊呼着完全走进房间，穿着比上次见面时休闲许多。“[pc.name]。你终究还是来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the doors on the room’s corners opens, a familiar head of red hair sticking out. “Irons?” Pink looks around before spotting you in the doorway. “Oh!” she exclaims, stepping into the room fully, dressed down casually from when you last saw her. “[pc.name]. You came after all.”"

rows.original: The sound of another door opening turns your attention to the other side of the room. Ari, the third member of the group, walks in as well. “Irons? Who the hell is-” she looks over at you. “Oh.”
rows.translation: 另一扇门打开的声音把你的注意力吸引到房间另一边。团体第三位成员阿里也走了进来。“艾恩斯？到底是谁”她看向你。“哦。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sound of another door opening turns your attention to the other side of the room. Ari, the third member of the group, walks in as well. “Irons? Who the hell is-” she looks over at you. “Oh.”"

rows.original: Pink moves towards you, but calls out to Blue. “It’s Steele, honey. [pc.name] Steele. You know that.”
rows.translation: 小粉朝你走来，却向小蓝喊道：“是斯蒂尔，亲爱的。[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。你明明知道。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink moves towards you, but calls out to Blue. “It’s Steele, honey. [pc.name] Steele. You know that.”"

rows.original: “Oh right,” the ovir waves at you and after a beat flops back onto the couch, her attention back on her ice cream. “Nice to meet ya.”
rows.translation: “哦，对哦，”奥维尔朝你挥挥手，过了一拍又倒回沙发，把注意力放回冰淇淋。“很高兴认识你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh right,” the ovir waves at you and after a beat flops back onto the couch, her attention back on her ice cream. “Nice to meet ya.”"

rows.original: “Really, fatass?” Ari makes her way over to you as well, the small woman barely wearing anything at all, a thin veil of sweat on her body. She turns her attention to you, crossing her arms over her chest. “So what do you fucking want?”
rows.translation: “认真的吗，肥婆？”阿里也朝你走来，这个娇小女人几乎什么都没穿，身上覆着一层薄汗。她把注意力转向你，双臂交叉抱在胸前。“所以你他妈想干什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really, fatass?” Ari makes her way over to you as well, the small woman barely wearing anything at all, a thin veil of sweat on her body. She turns her attention to you, crossing her arms over her chest. “So what do you fucking want?”"

rows.original: You tell the small, feisty woman you were invited, and you figured you’d stop by.
rows.translation: 你告诉这个娇小泼辣的女人，自己受到了邀请，便想着顺路来看看。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell the small, feisty woman you were invited, and you figured you’d stop by."

rows.original: Ari looks over at Pink and sighs. “Hm. Right,” she turns around with a flick of her tail and heads back to the door she entered from, offering you a rather pleasant view of her well formed ass as she moves, the impressive feature barely contained by her tiny shorts. “Well I’m busy right now, so if you wanna talk to me it’ll have to damn well wait.” She disappears through the door, taking that slappable ass with her.
rows.translation: 阿里看向小粉，叹了口气。“嗯。好吧，”她甩动尾巴转身，走回自己出来的那扇门；她移动时让你欣赏到形状姣好的屁股，而那令人印象深刻的部位几乎无法被超短裤容纳。“我现在很忙，所以如果你想和我谈，就他妈只能等着。”她消失在门后，也带走了那个让人想拍打的屁股。
rows.raw: "\n\nAri looks over at Pink and sighs. “Hm. Right,” she turns around with a flick of her tail and heads back to the door she entered from, offering you a rather pleasant view of her well formed ass as she moves, the impressive feature barely contained by her tiny shorts. “Well I’m busy right now, so if you wanna talk to me it’ll have to damn well wait.” She disappears through the door, taking that slappable ass with her."

rows.original: Pink clears her throat, drawing your attention back to her. “Sorry about her. She’s just a bit prickly around new people,” she offers a small shrug. “So, I assume you want to have that conversation about your stake in our group?”
rows.translation: 小粉清了清嗓子，把你的注意力拉回她身上。“抱歉，她在陌生人身边只是有点暴躁，”她轻轻耸肩。“那么，我猜你想谈谈自己在我们团体中的股份？”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink clears her throat, drawing your attention back to her. “Sorry about her. She’s just a bit prickly around new people,” she offers a small shrug. “So, I assume you want to have that conversation about your stake in our group?”"

rows.original: You look Pink in the eye, trying to get a read on her. That is why she invited you, isn’t it? You ask her, not sure what other motive she could have.
rows.translation: 你直视小粉的眼睛，试图看透她。这就是她邀请你的原因，不是吗？你问了出来，不确定她还能有何种其他动机。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look Pink in the eye, trying to get a read on her. That is why she invited you, isn’t it? You ask her, not sure what other motive she could have."
