rows.original: Pink raises an eyebrow, a coy smile on her puffy lips. “Do I? Well, if that’s the case it’s purely incidental. Performing is pretty much my whole life, you see. I’ve not done much else with it aside from that.”
rows.translation: 小粉挑起眉毛，丰满嘴唇上带着羞涩笑容。“是吗？嗯，如果真是这样，也完全只是偶然。你知道，表演几乎就是我的整个人生。除此之外，我的人生没做过多少别的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink raises an eyebrow, a coy smile on her puffy lips. “Do I? Well, if that’s the case it’s purely incidental. Performing is pretty much my whole life, you see. I’ve not done much else with it aside from that.”"

rows.original: Putting two and two together, you point out a small hiccup in Pink’s narrative. “Your whole life? So before Love Starz?”
rows.translation: 你把线索拼到一起，指出小粉叙述中的小问题。“你的一生？所以在爱之星之前也是？”
rows.raw: "\n\nPutting two and two together, you point out a small hiccup in Pink’s narrative. “Your whole life? So before Love Starz?”"

rows.original: The redheaded terran lets out a small scoff. “Why yes in fact,” she sighs and tilts her head. “I’ll spare you the trouble of asking the next logical question: Love Starz is not my first group. It’s not even my second group. I’ve been at this since I was little, and I’m very, very good at it.”
rows.translation: 红发泰伦人轻嗤一声。“事实上，正是如此，”她叹息着歪起头。“我替你省去问下一个合乎逻辑的问题：爱之星并不是我的第一个团体，甚至不是第二个。我从小就在做这一行，而且非常、非常擅长。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe redheaded terran lets out a small scoff. “Why yes in fact,” she sighs and tilts her head. “I’ll spare you the trouble of asking the next logical question: Love Starz is not my first group. It’s not even my second group. I’ve been at this since I was little, and I’m very, very good at it.”"

rows.original: You’re not really surprised by that answer. You ask her if that’s why she looks so familiar to you.
rows.translation: 这个答案并不令你真正惊讶。你问她，这是不是她看起来如此眼熟的原因。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not really surprised by that answer. You ask her if that’s why she looks so familiar to you."

rows.original: Pink gives her shoulders a quick shrug, again remaining non committal. “Probably. Who can say? My face got around quite a bit when I was young.”
rows.translation: 小粉迅速耸耸肩，再次保持不置可否。“大概吧。谁说得准？我年轻时，这张脸可是到处出现。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink gives her shoulders a quick shrug, again remaining non committal. “Probably. Who can say? My face got around quite a bit when I was young.”"

rows.original: Thinking about it, that must be how you know her face. Although you can’t say you’ve listened to much L-Pop. Expressing that to Pink draws a chuckle from her.
rows.translation: 仔细想想，你一定就是因此认识她的脸。虽然不能说自己听过多少L-Pop。你向小粉说出这一点，引来她一声轻笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThinking about it, that must be how you know her face. Although you can’t say you’ve listened to much L-Pop. Expressing that to Pink draws a chuckle from her."

rows.original: “I wasn’t always in L-Pop specifically. I started out as part of a very typical pop star group.”
rows.translation: “我并非一直专门唱L-Pop。最初加入的是一个非常典型的流行偶像团体。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I wasn’t always in L-Pop specifically. I started out as part of a very typical pop star group.”"

rows.original: “Ah,” you nod, the chances of you seeing her at some point on some screen before having just increased considerably. Curious, you ask her why she switched to L-Pop.
rows.translation: “啊，”你点点头；这让你过去在某块屏幕上见过她的概率大幅上升。出于好奇，你问她为什么转向L-Pop。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah,” you nod, the chances of you seeing her at some point on some screen before having just increased considerably. Curious, you ask her why she switched to L-Pop."

rows.original: “Hm,” Pink rubs her chin, seemingly seriously considering her answer. “Well, when we were forming up it made a lot of sense to us. Ari was interested in how the genre sounded technically, and it gave me a chance to write fresh sounding lyrics. I’ll be the first to admit, my stuff was starting to get a bit stale.”
rows.translation: “嗯，”小粉揉着下巴，似乎在认真考虑答案。“我们组团时，这对大家而言很合理。阿里对这种曲风在技术层面的声音很感兴趣，而我也获得了创作新鲜歌词的机会。我会第一个承认，自己的作品当时已经有点陈腐。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm,” Pink rubs her chin, seemingly seriously considering her answer. “Well, when we were forming up it made a lot of sense to us. Ari was interested in how the genre sounded technically, and it gave me a chance to write fresh sounding lyrics. I’ll be the first to admit, my stuff was starting to get a bit stale.”"

rows.original: “So you’ve done a lot of song writing then?” you ask.
rows.translation: “所以你写过很多歌？”你问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you’ve done a lot of song writing then?” you ask."

rows.original: Pink lets out a soft giggle. “More than you know.” She takes a deep breath, stretching out her neck. “See? Told you I’m boring. We’ve only been talking about my music. You should ask something else. Might make for a more stimulating conversation.”
rows.translation: 小粉轻声笑起来。“比你知道的还多。”她深吸一口气，伸展脖子。“看吧？早就告诉你我很无聊。我们一直只在谈我的音乐。你应该问些别的，也许能让谈话更加刺激。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink lets out a soft giggle. “More than you know.” She takes a deep breath, stretching out her neck. “See? Told you I’m boring. We’ve only been talking about my music. You should ask something else. Might make for a more stimulating conversation.”"

rows.original: You ask Pink what she does in the Love Starz.
rows.translation: 你问小粉，她在爱之星里负责什么。
rows.raw: "You ask Pink what she does in the Love Starz."

rows.original: Pink lets out a soft chuckle. “Well, officially I’m the lead singer, so that means I stand in the middle and sing some solo bits,” she scratches her chin with her thumb, giving you a small shrug. “I also deal with Colm the most, but I think that’s because Ari couldn’t be bothered to, and Blue... well she’s Blue.”
rows.translation: 小粉轻笑起来。“嗯，正式来说我是主唱，也就是说站在中间，唱几段独唱，”她用拇指挠挠下巴，轻轻耸肩。“我也是和科尔姆打交道最多的人，不过我觉得那是因为阿里懒得理他，而小蓝...嗯，她就是小蓝。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink lets out a soft chuckle. “Well, officially I’m the lead singer, so that means I stand in the middle and sing some solo bits,” she scratches her chin with her thumb, giving you a small shrug. “I also deal with Colm the most, but I think that’s because Ari couldn’t be bothered to, and Blue... well she’s Blue.”"

rows.original: You nod, fully understanding her implication. “And unofficially?”
rows.translation: 你点点头，完全明白她的暗示。“那非正式来说呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, fully understanding her implication. “And unofficially?”"

rows.original: She stares at you for a beat before answering. “Well... I’m a mentor, I suppose. Blue and Ari are talented, but inexperienced. I try to help them be the best that they can be.”
rows.translation: 她盯着你看了一会儿才回答。“这个...我想，我算是导师。小蓝和阿里很有天赋，但缺乏经验。我努力帮助她们做到自己所能达到的最好程度。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stares at you for a beat before answering. “Well... I’m a mentor, I suppose. Blue and Ari are talented, but inexperienced. I try to help them be the best that they can be.”"

rows.original: Based on what you saw on stage, it seems like Pink’s doing a fairly good job on that so far. You ask her how exactly she helps the others out.
rows.translation: 根据舞台上见到的表现，小粉目前似乎做得相当不错。你问她究竟如何帮助其他人。
rows.raw: "\n\nBased on what you saw on stage, it seems like Pink’s doing a fairly good job on that so far. You ask her how exactly she helps the others out."

rows.original: “Well, with Blue it’s mostly just helping adapt her ideas. Her choreography is very innovative, but she tends to forget that all three of us don’t have tails that can hold our weight.” Pink chuckles under her breath, shaking her head. “Ari is a little different,” she continues. “She loves to experiment, and some of her ideas need to be reigned in. I hate to stifle her creative spark... but maybe one day we can branch out.”
rows.translation: “这个，对小蓝来说，主要只是帮助她调整构思。她的编舞非常创新，但她总会忘记我们三个人并不是都有能支撑体重的尾巴。”小粉低声轻笑，摇了摇头。“阿里有些不同，”她继续说道。“她喜欢实验，而有些想法需要加以约束。我讨厌压制她的创意火花...不过也许有一天，我们能拓展出去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, with Blue it’s mostly just helping adapt her ideas. Her choreography is very innovative, but she tends to forget that all three of us don’t have tails that can hold our weight.” Pink chuckles under her breath, shaking her head. “Ari is a little different,” she continues. “She loves to experiment, and some of her ideas need to be reigned in. I hate to stifle her creative spark... but maybe one day we can branch out.”"

rows.original: Listening along, you inquire. “One day? So you plan on being together for a while?”
rows.translation: 你一边听一边问道：“有一天？所以你打算长时间待在一起？”
rows.raw: "\n\nListening along, you inquire. “One day? So you plan on being together for a while?”"

rows.original: Pink doesn’t answer right away, giving you an oddly distant stare instead. “I’d like to think we’ll stick together... but who knows, I’ve thought that before and here I am...”
rows.translation: 小粉没有立即回答，反而以奇异而疏远的目光看着你。“我愿意相信我们会一直在一起...可谁知道呢，我以前也这么想过，而现在我却在这里...”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink doesn’t answer right away, giving you an oddly distant stare instead. “I’d like to think we’ll stick together... but who knows, I’ve thought that before and here I am...”"

rows.original: The topic seems to have made for a downturn in the mood. Best change the subject for now.
rows.translation: 这个话题似乎让气氛低落下来。现在最好换个话题。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe topic seems to have made for a downturn in the mood. Best change the subject for now."

rows.original: You tell her you remember. Painfully so.
rows.translation: 你告诉她自己记得，记得痛彻心扉。
rows.raw: "You tell her you remember. Painfully so."

rows.original: Pink chuckles, shaking her head. “Good. Now get to it. Last thing I want is that horrible cousin of yours swooping in and ruining our brand.”
rows.translation: 小粉笑着摇头。“很好。现在快去做吧。我最不希望看到的，就是你那个讨厌的表亲突然出现，毁掉我们的品牌。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink chuckles, shaking her head. “Good. Now get to it. Last thing I want is that horrible cousin of yours swooping in and ruining our brand.”"

rows.original: You ask her if it even matters.
rows.translation: 你问她这是否真的重要。
rows.raw: "You ask her if it even matters."

rows.original: Pink frowns, her painted lips pressed tight against each other. “Of course it matters. If you don’t step up that horrible cousin of yours will swoop in and ruin everything we’ve built.”
rows.translation: 小粉皱起眉头，涂过颜色的双唇紧紧抿住。“当然重要。你要是不挺身而出，那个讨厌的表亲就会突然出现，毁掉我们建立的一切。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink frowns, her painted lips pressed tight against each other. “Of course it matters. If you don’t step up that horrible cousin of yours will swoop in and ruin everything we’ve built.”"

rows.original: “Wait,” you raise your brow, the air suddenly tense with suspicion. “How do you know about my cousin?”
rows.translation: “等等，”你挑起眉毛，空气骤然因怀疑而紧绷。“你怎么知道我表亲的事？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait,” you raise your brow, the air suddenly tense with suspicion. “How do you know about my cousin?”"

rows.original: Pink smacks her lips and chuckles. “I’ve been keeping a bit of an eye on things from afar. Even a slack-jawed New Texan breeding stud could see that one is making moves against you. All while you’re keeping me... entertained as well.” Pink shrugs. “Not that I’m saying you should stop mind you, I do so enjoy your company, but if you want to enjoy your father’s you’d best not dawdle.” She lets out a soft, teasing chuckle.
rows.translation: 小粉咂咂嘴，轻笑起来。“我一直从远处稍微关注着事态。连一个目瞪口呆的新德克萨斯种马都看得出，那家伙正在采取行动对付你。而你同时也一直让我...乐在其中。”小粉耸耸肩。“当然，我不是让你停下；我确实很享受你的陪伴。不过想享用你父亲留下的东西，最好别再磨蹭。”她发出轻柔而调侃的笑声。
rows.raw: "\n\nPink smacks her lips and chuckles. “I’ve been keeping a bit of an eye on things from afar. Even a slack-jawed New Texan breeding stud could see that one is making moves against you. All while you’re keeping me... entertained as well.” Pink shrugs. “Not that I’m saying you should stop mind you, I do so enjoy your company, but if you want to enjoy your father’s you’d best not dawdle.” She lets out a soft, teasing chuckle."

rows.original: You ask Pink about your ownership of the Love Starz
rows.translation: 你询问小粉，自己对 爱之星乐队 拥有多少所有权
rows.raw: "You ask Pink about your ownership of the Love Starz"

rows.original: “Not full ownership,” Pink corrects, a small frown on her face. “You, potentially, own a piece of our brand. A significant piece mind you, but not all.”
rows.translation: “不是完全所有权，”小粉纠正道，脸上微微皱眉。“你有可能拥有我们品牌的一部分。是很重要的一部分，但不是全部。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not full ownership,” Pink corrects, a small frown on her face. “You, potentially, own a piece of our brand. A significant piece mind you, but not all.”"

rows.original: “Right,” you nod, remembering that detail. You ask her who, then, owns the rest.
rows.translation: “对，”你想起这个细节，点了点头。你问她，其余部分属于谁。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right,” you nod, remembering that detail. You ask her who, then, owns the rest."

rows.original: Pink smirks, rolling her eyes. “Me. Well, me, Blue, Ari and a few other private investors we don’t need to name.”
rows.translation: 小粉坏笑着翻了个白眼。“我。好吧，我、小蓝、阿里，还有几个没必要说出名字的私人投资者。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink smirks, rolling her eyes. “Me. Well, me, Blue, Ari and a few other private investors we don’t need to name.”"

rows.original: You nod along, but ask her how your father managed to buy up so much of it if all the investors were private.
rows.translation: 你一边点头，一边问她：既然所有投资者都是私人身份，你父亲怎么能买下这么大一部分。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod along, but ask her how your father managed to buy up so much of it if all the investors were private."

rows.original: She mulls over the question before answering, chewing on the inside of her cheek. “That’s a question Colm could answer better than I... Your father really had a way with sneaking his money around.”
rows.translation: 她咬着面颊内侧，思考一番才回答。“这个问题科尔姆比我更能回答...你父亲很懂得如何悄悄调动资金。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe mulls over the question before answering, chewing on the inside of her cheek. “That’s a question Colm could answer better than I... Your father really had a way with sneaking his money around.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, tell me about it...” you shake your head, letting out a sigh.
rows.translation: “是啊，别提了...”你摇摇头，叹了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, tell me about it...” you shake your head, letting out a sigh."

rows.original: “You remember the situation, correct?” Pink crosses her arms over her chest. “No say until you take control of Steele Tech.”
rows.translation: “你还记得当时的情况，对吧？”小粉双臂交叉在胸前。“在你掌控斯蒂尔科技以前，我什么都不会说。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You remember the situation, correct?” Pink crosses her arms over her chest. “No say until you take control of Steele Tech.”"

rows.original: Remember
rows.translation: 记得
rows.raw: "Remember"

rows.original: Does It Matter
rows.translation: 有关系吗
rows.raw: "Does It Matter"

rows.original: You ask Pink what she thinks about Blue.
rows.translation: 你问小粉如何看待小蓝。
rows.raw: "You ask Pink what she thinks about Blue."

rows.original: Pink raises an eyebrow and gives you a wry smile. “Asking for business, or pleasure?”
rows.translation: 小粉挑起眉毛，苦笑着看你。“你是为了公事问，还是私事？”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink raises an eyebrow and gives you a wry smile. “Asking for business, or pleasure?”"

rows.original: You shrug. “Can’t it be both?”
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩。“不能两者都有吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug. “Can’t it be both?”"

rows.original: “I suppose,” she tilts her head, her eyes narrowing. “Fine then. Well, Blue is often underestimated due to her more...” Pink pauses, letting a moment of understanding hang in the air between you. “...Obvious shortcomings. That said she is perhaps one of the most naturally gifted dancers I’ve ever met. Her singing needed a bit of help when we first met, but we worked that out fairly quickly.”
rows.translation: “也许吧，”她歪着头眯起眼睛。“那好吧。小蓝经常因为她更加...”小粉停顿片刻，让你们之间悬着一丝心照不宣。“...明显的缺点而受到低估。话虽如此，她可能是我见过最具天生才华的舞者之一。刚认识时，她的歌唱需要一点帮助，不过我们很快便解决了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I suppose,” she tilts her head, her eyes narrowing. “Fine then. Well, Blue is often underestimated due to her more...” Pink pauses, letting a moment of understanding hang in the air between you. “...Obvious shortcomings. That said she is perhaps one of the most naturally gifted dancers I’ve ever met. Her singing needed a bit of help when we first met, but we worked that out fairly quickly.”"

rows.original: “How did you manage that?”
rows.translation: “你们怎么做到的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How did you manage that?”"

rows.original: “Ari did most of the work. She’s got the right ear for it, after all.” Pink frowns, and you get the distinct impression she’s fighting off the urge to roll her eyes. “She wanted to kill Blue afterwards. But Ari is wise enough to appreciate Blue, even if she has a hard time seeing past some things.”
rows.translation: “主要是阿里的功劳。毕竟她的耳朵很适合做这个。”小粉皱起眉头，你明显觉得她正努力克制翻白眼的冲动。“之后她简直想杀了小蓝。不过阿里足够聪明，懂得欣赏小蓝，即使她很难忽略某些事情。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ari did most of the work. She’s got the right ear for it, after all.” Pink frowns, and you get the distinct impression she’s fighting off the urge to roll her eyes. “She wanted to kill Blue afterwards. But Ari is wise enough to appreciate Blue, even if she has a hard time seeing past some things.”"

rows.original: “I see.” Her words sound like fairly high praise, all things considered. “But that sounds an awful lot like just ‘business’ to me.”
rows.translation: “明白了。”综合考虑，她这番话已经算是相当高的评价。“但在我听来，这几乎完全只是‘公事’。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I see.” Her words sound like fairly high praise, all things considered. “But that sounds an awful lot like just ‘business’ to me.”"

rows.original: “Hm.” Pink gives you a small nod. “True. Well, personally speaking, I’m quite envious of Blue.”
rows.translation: “嗯。”小粉轻轻点头。“确实。好吧，从私人角度来说，我相当羡慕小蓝。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm.” Pink gives you a small nod. “True. Well, personally speaking, I’m quite envious of Blue.”"

rows.original: “Really?” The declaration catches you off guard, but you wait for Pink to elaborate.
rows.translation: “真的？”这番宣言令你措手不及，不过你等待小粉继续解释。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really?” The declaration catches you off guard, but you wait for Pink to elaborate."

rows.original: “Mhm. I am. She’s so bright and happy. I’d use the word ‘innocent’, but then again I’ve walked in on her in the bathroom enough times...” Pink shakes her head slightly, chuckling softly to herself.
rows.translation: “嗯哼，真的。她那么开朗快乐。我本来会用‘纯真’这个词，不过我已经太多次在洗手间撞见她...”小粉轻轻摇头，自顾自地低声笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mhm. I am. She’s so bright and happy. I’d use the word ‘innocent’, but then again I’ve walked in on her in the bathroom enough times...” Pink shakes her head slightly, chuckling softly to herself."

rows.original: Your curiosity peaked, and a coy smile on your face, you ask exactly what it is she does in the bathroom.
rows.translation: 你的好奇心达到顶峰，脸上挂着狡黠笑容，追问她在洗手间究竟做些什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour curiosity peaked, and a coy smile on your face, you ask exactly what it is she does in the bathroom."

rows.original: Pink returns the smile, and offers a coy wink. “Ask her. I’m sure she’d love to share.”
rows.translation: 小粉以微笑回应，还狡黠地眨眼。“去问她。我相信她很乐意分享。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink returns the smile, and offers a coy wink. “Ask her. I’m sure she’d love to share.”"

rows.original: You ask Pink what she thinks of
rows.translation: 你问小粉如何看待
rows.raw: "You ask Pink what she thinks of "

rows.original: “Ah,” Pink shifts her weight from one foot to the other. “Ari... is a complicated one. She sells herself short, thinking she has something to prove.” The red haired woman rocks back on her heels, her gaze shifting to the ceiling. “She’s just as important to the group as me or Blue, she just has a hard time seeing that.”
rows.translation: “啊，”小粉把重心从一只脚移到另一只。“阿里...很复杂。她低估自己，觉得自己必须证明些什么。”红发女人向后靠上脚跟，目光移向天花板。“她对组合的重要性不亚于我或小蓝，只是自己很难看见这一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah,” Pink shifts her weight from one foot to the other. “Ari... is a complicated one. She sells herself short, thinking she has something to prove.” The red haired woman rocks back on her heels, her gaze shifting to the ceiling. “She’s just as important to the group as me or Blue, she just has a hard time seeing that.”"

rows.original: You ask why she thinks she sells herself short.
rows.translation: 你问她为何认为阿里低估自己。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask why she thinks she sells herself short."

rows.original: “She’s young.” Pink shrugs. “What young woman doesn’t worry about her worth?”
rows.translation: “她还年轻。”小粉耸耸肩。“哪个年轻女人不会担心自己的价值？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She’s young.” Pink shrugs. “What young woman doesn’t worry about her worth?”"

rows.original: You note that she and Blue don’t seem to have that problem.
rows.translation: 你指出，她和小蓝似乎没有这个问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou note that she and Blue don’t seem to have that problem."

rows.original: That makes Pink laugh harder than you would have expected. “I’m not a young woman anymore, and Blue... well, she’s Blue.” She clears her throat, trying to stifle another laugh. “Ari has worked hard to get where she is, and keeps working hard to keep it. She’s a bit rough around the edges, sure, but she has what it takes. More so than I did at her age.”
rows.translation: 这句话让小粉笑得比预想中厉害。“我已经不再年轻，至于小蓝...好吧，她就是小蓝。”她清了清嗓子，努力忍住又一次大笑。“阿里很努力才走到今天，也一直努力守住这里。没错，她有些棱角，不过她具备所需的一切，远胜于同龄时的我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThat makes Pink laugh harder than you would have expected. “I’m not a young woman anymore, and Blue... well, she’s Blue.” She clears her throat, trying to stifle another laugh. “Ari has worked hard to get where she is, and keeps working hard to keep it. She’s a bit rough around the edges, sure, but she has what it takes. More so than I did at her age.”"

rows.original: “Right...” You can definitely agree with the rough edges. “Is that all?”
rows.translation: “对...”你绝对同意她有棱角。“只有这些？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right...” You can definitely agree with the rough edges. “Is that all?”"

rows.original: Pink tilts her head. “About Ari? Well...” Pink rubs her thumb against her jaw, a painted nail gently grazing her skin. “Well, I do think she should try to play nicer with Blue. I understand they have their differences, but really...” she frowns, dropping her hand. “It’s rather childish.”
rows.translation: 小粉歪了歪头。“关于阿里？好吧...”她用拇指摩擦下颌，涂过颜色的指甲轻轻擦过肌肤。“我确实认为，她应该试着对小蓝友善些。我理解她们存在分歧，但说真的...”她放下手，皱起眉头。“实在太幼稚了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink tilts her head. “About Ari? Well...” Pink rubs her thumb against her jaw, a painted nail gently grazing her skin. “Well, I do think she should try to play nicer with Blue. I understand they have their differences, but really...” she frowns, dropping her hand. “It’s rather childish.”"

rows.original: You can’t say you haven’t noticed. “Then why don’t you try and do something about it?”
rows.translation: 你不能说自己没有注意到。“那你为什么不试着做点什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t say you haven’t noticed. “Then why don’t you try and do something about it?”"

rows.original: “I’m not their mother.” Pink presses her lips together, frowning. “Either way, I do believe Ari wants to connect with Blue, but simply doesn’t know how, despite her constant jabs.”
rows.translation: “我不是她们的母亲。”小粉抿着嘴皱眉。“无论如何，我确实相信阿里想与小蓝建立联系，只是不知道该怎么做，尽管她总在挖苦对方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not their mother.” Pink presses her lips together, frowning. “Either way, I do believe Ari wants to connect with Blue, but simply doesn’t know how, despite her constant jabs.”"

rows.original: “What makes you think that?”
rows.translation: “你为什么会这么想？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What makes you think that?”"

rows.original: Pink let out a soft chuckle. “I’ve spent most of my life around young women, [pc.name]. I know how they think better than most.”
rows.translation: 小粉轻笑。“我一生大部分时间都和年轻女人相处，[pc.name]。我比绝大多数人更了解她们如何思考。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink let out a soft chuckle. “I’ve spent most of my life around young women, [pc.name]. I know how they think better than most.”"

rows.original: Based on her tone, you don’t think you’re going to get much else from her now.
rows.translation: 根据她的语气，你觉得现在无法从她口中得到更多内容。
rows.raw: "\n\nBased on her tone, you don’t think you’re going to get much else from her now."

rows.original: You ask Pink about her former groups.
rows.translation: 你向小粉询问她以前参加的组合。
rows.raw: "You ask Pink about her former groups."

rows.original: She stares at you a moment, her eyes thinning. “How much do you know already?”
rows.translation: 她眯起眼睛盯了你一会儿。“你已经知道多少？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stares at you a moment, her eyes thinning. “How much do you know already?”"

rows.original: “Not much really,” you answer, reflecting only for a minute. “Only that Love Starz isn’t your first group.”
rows.translation: “其实不多，”你稍作思考后回答。“只知道 爱之星乐队 并不是你的第一个组合。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not much really,” you answer, reflecting only for a minute. “Only that Love Starz isn’t your first group.”"

rows.original: “Hm.” Pink’s eyes narrow. “Well, let’s leave it there for now then. It’s not a topic I want to get into... fresh. Is there something else we can talk about instead?
rows.translation: “嗯。”小粉眯起眼睛。“那么现在就先说到这里。这不是我想毫无准备便谈起的话题...我们能不能换点别的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm.” Pink’s eyes narrow. “Well, let’s leave it there for now then. It’s not a topic I want to get into... fresh. Is there something else we can talk about instead?"

rows.original: “Well, I do know you used to be very close with your first group,” you answer, remembering
rows.translation: “好吧，我确实知道你和第一个组合的成员曾经非常亲密，”你回忆起
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I do know you used to be very close with your first group,” you answer, remembering "

rows.original: ’s gossip. “They were like sisters to you, right?”
rows.translation: 的八卦，回答道。“她们对你来说就像姐妹，对吧？”
rows.raw: "’s gossip. “They were like sisters to you, right?”"

rows.original: Pink presses her painted lips together, forming a tight seal of silence. She stays quiet for many heartbeats, but relents and exhales. “Not... exactly. While we may not have been sisters in the strict sense of the word, we may as well have been.”
rows.translation: 小粉将涂过颜色的双唇紧紧抿住，形成一道沉默封条。她安静了许多个心跳的时间，最终让步并吐出一口气。“不...不完全是。严格来说我们也许并非姐妹，但其实没有区别。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink presses her painted lips together, forming a tight seal of silence. She stays quiet for many heartbeats, but relents and exhales. “Not... exactly. While we may not have been sisters in the strict sense of the word, we may as well have been.”"

rows.original: Not exactly following, you decide to drop the topic. You have a feeling you’re missing a piece to this puzzle...
rows.translation: 你没有完全听懂，于是决定放弃这个话题。你觉得自己缺少解开谜题的一块拼图...
rows.raw: "\n\nNot exactly following, you decide to drop the topic. You have a feeling you’re missing a piece to this puzzle..."

rows.original: Remembering something Blue said, you ask if this has something to do with her being adopted by some company.
rows.translation: 想起小蓝说过的某件事，你问这是否与她被某家公司收养有关。
rows.raw: "\n\nRemembering something Blue said, you ask if this has something to do with her being adopted by some company."

rows.original: Pink seems taken aback by your question, her eyes opening wide, but speaks all the same. “Yes...” her eyes quickly narrow, nostrils flaring in a way you haven’t seen before. “I see you’ve been talking to the others...” she sighs, pinching the bridge of her nose. “But then again I did want you to do just that, so I suppose this was bound to come out eventually.” Dropping her hand, she sighs again and explains. “Before I was born, I was adopted by the fledgling music division of one Gynax Corp.”
rows.translation: 你的问题似乎令小粉措手不及；她睁大双眼，却仍开口回答。“是...”她的眼睛迅速眯起，鼻孔以你从未见过的方式张开。“看来你一直在和其他人交谈...”她叹着气，捏住鼻梁。“不过我本来就希望你这么做，所以这件事迟早会暴露。”她放下手，再次叹息并解释道：“我出生以前，就被盖纳克斯公司的新兴音乐部门收养了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink seems taken aback by your question, her eyes opening wide, but speaks all the same. “Yes...” her eyes quickly narrow, nostrils flaring in a way you haven’t seen before. “I see you’ve been talking to the others...” she sighs, pinching the bridge of her nose. “But then again I did want you to do just that, so I suppose this was bound to come out eventually.” Dropping her hand, she sighs again and explains. “Before I was born, I was adopted by the fledgling music division of one Gynax Corp.”"

rows.original: “Gynax?” You think about the name for a moment, trying to recall it.
rows.translation: “盖纳克斯？”你思考片刻，试图回忆这个名字。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gynax?” You think about the name for a moment, trying to recall it."

rows.original: “You’ve probably never heard of them.” Pink shrugs, her eyes fluttering. “Your father forced them into bankruptcy, then picked the bones clean.”
rows.translation: “你大概从未听说过。”小粉耸耸肩，眨了眨眼。“你父亲迫使他们破产，随后把残骸搜刮得干干净净。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve probably never heard of them.” Pink shrugs, her eyes fluttering. “Your father forced them into bankruptcy, then picked the bones clean.”"

rows.original: “What?” While that certainly sounds like your father, you’ve no recollection of this happening, not that you keep a great mental record of all the companies he ever took over. “When did he do that?”
rows.translation: “什么？”这确实像你父亲会做的事，但你完全不记得它发生过；当然，你也没有把他收购过的所有公司牢牢记在脑中。“他什么时候做的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?” While that certainly sounds like your father, you’ve no recollection of this happening, not that you keep a great mental record of all the companies he ever took over. “When did he do that?”"

rows.original: In a blink-and-you-miss-it moment, Pink’s upper lip twitches. She stays silent for a moment, carefully measuring her answer. “Many years ago. But that’s a different story. Anyways, they decided they wanted to edge in on the music industry, and decided to grow their own talent rather than find it themselves.”
rows.translation: 小粉上唇在一眨眼便会错过的瞬间抽动了一下。她沉默片刻，仔细斟酌答案。“很多年前。不过那是另一个故事。总之，他们决定插足音乐产业，并且决定自行培养人才，而不是出去寻找。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIn a blink-and-you-miss-it moment, Pink’s upper lip twitches. She stays silent for a moment, carefully measuring her answer. “Many years ago. But that’s a different story. Anyways, they decided they wanted to edge in on the music industry, and decided to grow their own talent rather than find it themselves.”"

rows.original: You raise your brow slightly. “Grow talent?”
rows.translation: 你微微挑眉。“培养人才？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise your brow slightly. “Grow talent?”"

rows.original: Pink rolls her eyes, emulating
rows.translation: 小粉翻了个白眼，把
rows.raw: "\n\nPink rolls her eyes, emulating "

rows.original: to a T. “Oh come on. Don’t be so dense,” she pauses, taking a moment to sigh. “There are ways to ensure children follow the path you want for them. You and I are not that different, [pc.name], nor were those that set our paths.”
rows.translation: 模仿得惟妙惟肖。“噢，拜托，别这么迟钝，”她停下来叹了口气。“有些方法能确保孩子走上你为他们选择的道路。[pc.name]，你我并没有那么不同，为我们设定道路的人也一样。”
rows.raw: " to a T. “Oh come on. Don’t be so dense,” she pauses, taking a moment to sigh. “There are ways to ensure children follow the path you want for them. You and I are not that different, [pc.name], nor were those that set our paths.”"

rows.original: You get the picture pretty quick, your eyes opening wide in understanding. Pink was modded before she was born, the same as yourself.
rows.translation: 你很快便明白过来，双眼因理解而睁大。小粉和你一样，在出生以前便接受了改造。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get the picture pretty quick, your eyes opening wide in understanding. Pink was modded before she was born, the same as yourself."

rows.original: “Bingo.” she points at you with a finger snap. “But not just me. Five girls total. They went out and got themselves a whole set.” Pink lowers her hand and clicks her tongue. “Tuned us up real well in fact. Handcrafted us to compliment each other in a group setting, right down to our harmony. Raised us as sisters as well, but more to get us to practice together than attempt to instill.... I don’t know... something positive.”
rows.translation: “答对了。”她打了个响指，指向你。“但不只是我，一共五个女孩。他们专门弄齐了一整套。”小粉放下手，咂了咂舌。“事实上，他们把我们调制得非常好。亲手打造我们，让彼此在组合中互补，甚至精确到和声。他们还把我们当姐妹抚养，不过更多是为了让我们一起练习，而非试图灌输...我也不知道...某种积极的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bingo.” she points at you with a finger snap. “But not just me. Five girls total. They went out and got themselves a whole set.” Pink lowers her hand and clicks her tongue. “Tuned us up real well in fact. Handcrafted us to compliment each other in a group setting, right down to our harmony. Raised us as sisters as well, but more to get us to practice together than attempt to instill.... I don’t know... something positive.”"

rows.original: You weren’t really expecting the conversation to go this direction. Not sure what to say, you let Pink continue at her own pace.
rows.translation: 你完全没想到对话会朝这个方向发展。不知道该说什么，于是任由小粉按自己的节奏继续。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou weren’t really expecting the conversation to go this direction. Not sure what to say, you let Pink continue at her own pace."

rows.original: “It had its ups and downs, but we had each other... Until we didn’t. Once we all came of age... Well let’s just say Gynax wished they enslaved us outright and didn’t formally adopt us.” Pink crosses her arms over her chest, striking a defensive pose she rarely utilizes. “We broke up overnight, and there wasn’t much they could do about it. We didn’t even have proper contracts. They were so sure they had us brainwashed, they figured we would just... stay.” She smirks and shakes her head, seemingly amused by the memory. “Idiots.”
rows.translation: “有好有坏，但我们至少拥有彼此...直到再也没有。我们全部成年之后...这么说吧，盖纳克斯肯定希望当初直接奴役我们，而不是正式收养。”小粉双臂交叉在胸前，摆出她很少使用的防御姿态。“我们一夜之间解散，他们也束手无策。我们甚至没有正规的合同。他们太确信自己已经把我们洗脑，以为我们会就这样...留下来。”她坏笑着摇头，似乎觉得这段回忆很有趣。“白痴。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It had its ups and downs, but we had each other... Until we didn’t. Once we all came of age... Well let’s just say Gynax wished they enslaved us outright and didn’t formally adopt us.” Pink crosses her arms over her chest, striking a defensive pose she rarely utilizes. “We broke up overnight, and there wasn’t much they could do about it. We didn’t even have proper contracts. They were so sure they had us brainwashed, they figured we would just... stay.” She smirks and shakes her head, seemingly amused by the memory. “Idiots.” "

rows.original: You recall
rows.translation: 你想起
rows.raw: "\n\nYou recall "

rows.original: telling the story slightly different, and ask her about breaking up over group differences.
rows.translation: 讲述的版本略有不同，于是问她是否因为组合分歧而解散。
rows.raw: " telling the story slightly different, and ask her about breaking up over group differences."

rows.original: Pink chuckles and shakes her head again. “Oh, that was the second time. Four of us formed a new group a few weeks later,” she offers a small shrug then continues. “What can I say? We were literally designed to do it, so we just couldn’t quit. It was in our DNA.”
rows.translation: 小粉笑着再次摇头。“噢，那是第二次。几周后，我们四个组建了新组合，”她轻轻耸肩，继续说道。“还能怎么说？我们天生就是为此设计的，所以根本无法放弃。这写在我们的DNA里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink chuckles and shakes her head again. “Oh, that was the second time. Four of us formed a new group a few weeks later,” she offers a small shrug then continues. “What can I say? We were literally designed to do it, so we just couldn’t quit. It was in our DNA.”"

rows.original: “Makes sense... but why only four of you?”
rows.translation: “有道理...不过为什么只有四个人？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Makes sense... but why only four of you?”"

rows.original: “Gods... Well, Three wanted to settle down....” she frowns, seemingly sensing your confusion already. “If you simply must know: Yes, our names, our real names, were just numbers. That’s how insane the whole thing was. And no, I won’t tell you my number.” Pink rolls her eyes, perhaps the first time you’ve seen her do it out of genuine annoyance. “It’s a damn embarrassment. Anyways. Without being metaphorically on leashes anymore, we imploded. Makes sense in hindsight. A bunch of young girls who spent eighteen years being repressed suddenly given the galaxy on a silver platter? It got messy.”
rows.translation: “诸神啊...好吧，三号想安定下来...”她皱起眉头，似乎已经察觉到你的困惑。“既然你非得知道：没错，我们的名字，我们的真名，只是数字。整件事就是如此疯狂。而且不，我不会告诉你自己的编号。”小粉翻了个白眼，这也许是你第一次看见她出于真正的恼怒这么做。“简直丢死人了。总之，不再被比喻意义上的牵绳拴住后，我们从内部崩溃了。事后看来很合理。一群被压抑了十八年的年轻女孩，突然有人把整个银河装在银盘里送到面前？事情变得一团糟。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gods... Well, Three wanted to settle down....” she frowns, seemingly sensing your confusion already. “If you simply must know: Yes, our names, our real names, were just numbers. That’s how insane the whole thing was. And no, I won’t tell you my number.” Pink rolls her eyes, perhaps the first time you’ve seen her do it out of genuine annoyance. “It’s a damn embarrassment. Anyways. Without being metaphorically on leashes anymore, we imploded. Makes sense in hindsight. A bunch of young girls who spent eighteen years being repressed suddenly given the galaxy on a silver platter? It got messy.”"

rows.original: “So we broke up,” she continues. “And I’ve spent years trying to... live up to my programming I guess?” She shakes her head, making her long red hair dance behind her. “This life isn’t just all I know. It’s all I want. Is that so wrong?... Don’t answer that.”
rows.translation: “所以我们解散了，”她继续说道。“而我花了许多年，试图...不辜负自己的程序设定？”她摇摇头，长长红发在身后飞舞。“这种生活不只是我唯一了解的，也是我唯一想要的。这样真有错吗？...别回答。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So we broke up,” she continues. “And I’ve spent years trying to... live up to my programming I guess?” She shakes her head, making her long red hair dance behind her. “This life isn’t just all I know. It’s all I want. Is that so wrong?... Don’t answer that.”"

rows.original: She smiles at you. “Okay, enough about that. New topic. Please. I fear this is far too sentimental for my taste.”
rows.translation: 她朝你微笑。“好了，这事说够了。换个话题，拜托。这对我的口味而言恐怕太过伤感。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles at you. “Okay, enough about that. New topic. Please. I fear this is far too sentimental for my taste.”"

rows.original: “So how old are you exactly?” You ask.
rows.translation: “所以你究竟多大年纪？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“So how old are you exactly?” You ask."

rows.original: Pink scoffs. “Didn’t your father ever teach you it’s rude to ask a lady her age?”
rows.translation: 小粉嗤之以鼻。“你父亲没教过你，询问女士年龄很失礼吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink scoffs. “Didn’t your father ever teach you it’s rude to ask a lady her age?”"

rows.original: You consider your response, measuring out your next step.
rows.translation: 你思考着该如何回应，衡量下一步行动。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou consider your response, measuring out your next step."

rows.original: “My father taught me lots of things. He also taught me the importance of being honest and frank.”
rows.translation: “我父亲教过我很多事。他也教过我，诚实坦率非常重要。”
rows.raw: " “My father taught me lots of things. He also taught me the importance of being honest and frank.”"

rows.original: “How can I be sure you’re even a lady? You haven’t exactly been honest.”
rows.translation: “我怎么确定你甚至算得上女士？你可并不完全诚实。”
rows.raw: " “How can I be sure you’re even a lady? You haven’t exactly been honest.”"

rows.original: “It’s a simple question. Least you could do is give me a simple answer.”
rows.translation: “只是个简单问题。你至少可以给我一个简单回答。”
rows.raw: " “It’s a simple question. Least you could do is give me a simple answer.”"

rows.original: The fiery haired woman rolls her eyes. “I’m old, okay? Considerably so. I don’t care to put a number on it.” She presses her lips together, clearly not amused by the topic.
rows.translation: 这位烈焰般红发的女人翻了个白眼。“我年纪很大，好吗？相当大。我不想给出具体数字。”她抿紧嘴唇，显然对这个话题毫无兴趣。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe fiery haired woman rolls her eyes. “I’m old, okay? Considerably so. I don’t care to put a number on it.” She presses her lips together, clearly not amused by the topic."

rows.original: Giving Pink a look over, you can’t even begin to field a guess. She could pass for 20, but how much does that really mean? You ask her to at least give you a point of reference.
rows.translation: 你上下打量小粉，完全无法作出猜测。她说自己二十岁也有人信，但这究竟说明什么？你请她至少提供一个参照。
rows.raw: "\n\nGiving Pink a look over, you can’t even begin to field a guess. She could pass for 20, but how much does that really mean? You ask her to at least give you a point of reference."

rows.original: She rolls her eyes, but replies all the same. “Fine. I knew your father.”
rows.translation: 她翻了个白眼，却仍回答道：“好吧，我认识你父亲。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rolls her eyes, but replies all the same. “Fine. I knew your father.”"

rows.original: “That’s hardly a surprise,” you say flatly. “He did own a piece of your brand. It makes sense you would have met him at some point.”
rows.translation: “这根本不意外，”你平淡地说道。“他确实拥有你们品牌的一部分。你在某个时候见过他很合理。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s hardly a surprise,” you say flatly. “He did own a piece of your brand. It makes sense you would have met him at some point.”"

rows.original: Pink smirks, shaking her head. “No. I mean I knew him before. Back when Victor Steele was just plain old Vic. A man with barely a name and a dream far bigger than his means.”
rows.translation: 小粉坏笑着摇头。“不，我是说以前就认识他。在维克多·斯蒂尔只是普通的维克时。那时他几乎还没有名气，梦想却远远超出自己的财力。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPink smirks, shaking her head. “No. I mean I knew him before. Back when Victor Steele was just plain old Vic. A man with barely a name and a dream far bigger than his means.”"

rows.original: You stare at Pink hard for a moment, digesting the revelation, and its implications.
rows.translation: 你紧盯小粉片刻，消化这番揭露及其含义。

He was rather clingy like that... Never stopped wanting to own me. In many, many ways...”

rows.original: Pink’s bedroom isn’t quite what you expected. Oddly spartan, it just has a medium sized bed and nightstand, both of which are quite plain and likely rather cheap. You also notice the floor has been cleaned very recently, and you can’t seem to find a speck of dust anywhere.

rows.original: “Wait, what did you ask again?” She furrows her brow, her jaw falling slack for a moment. “Oh! Duh, me! Well, names Blue... I’m a dancer... Uh, I drink a lotta juice and eat a lotta ice cream... and.... I only have one kidney... Uh... Guess that’s it.”
rows.translation: “等等，你刚才问什么来着？”她皱起眉头，下巴一时松垂。“哦！笨蛋，是我！嗯，我叫小蓝...我是舞者...呃，我喝很多果汁，吃很多冰淇淋...而且....我只有一颗肾...呃...大概就这些。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait, what did you ask again?” She furrows her brow, her jaw falling slack for a moment. “Oh! Duh, me! Well, names Blue... I’m a dancer... Uh, I drink a lotta juice and eat a lotta ice cream... and.... I only have one kidney... Uh... Guess that’s it.”"

rows.original: “That’s it? I was kind of expecting something with a few more... sentences.”
rows.translation: “就这些？我本来还期待能多出几个...句子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s it? I was kind of expecting something with a few more... sentences.”"

rows.original: Blue scratches her head. “You, like, put me on the spot, man, I don’t know. It’s hard to think when I’m all called out and junk.” She seems a bit frazzled, the curvy dancer pouting noticeably.
rows.translation: 小蓝挠挠头。“你这相当于，怎么说呢，突然点我名，老兄，我不知道。被这样叫出来什么的，很难思考。”她看起来有些慌乱，这位曲线丰腴的舞者明显撅起嘴巴。
rows.raw: "\n\nBlue scratches her head. “You, like, put me on the spot, man, I don’t know. It’s hard to think when I’m all called out and junk.” She seems a bit frazzled, the curvy dancer pouting noticeably."

rows.original: You would hardly consider your question a call out. You ask her if there’s anything else at all.
rows.translation: 你完全不觉得自己的问题算是点名批评。你问她究竟还有没有别的可说。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou would hardly consider your question a call out. You ask her if there’s anything else at all."

rows.original: The purple ovir smacks her lips a few times, tilting her head to the side while she thinks. “I didn’t finish high school, is that the kinda stuff you wanna know?”
rows.translation: 紫色奥维尔人咂了几次嘴，一边思考一边把脑袋歪向一侧。“我没读完高中，这是你想知道的那种事吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe purple ovir smacks her lips a few times, tilting her head to the side while she thinks. “I didn’t finish high school, is that the kinda stuff you wanna know?”"

rows.original: You’re not really surprised, but still ask her why she didn’t finish.
rows.translation: 你并不怎么惊讶，却仍问她为什么没读完。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not really surprised, but still ask her why she didn’t finish."

rows.original: Blue shrugs. “Oh man, long story. See, I landed this gig dancin’ for Lil’ B11gg3. You know, the android techno rapper? Anywho, he was lookin’ for ‘thick bitches’ for this music video he was shootin’. It was called ‘Thick Bitches’. So-so song, but meh, killer video. One thing led to another and I ended up in, like, six music videos that year. After that they got me teachin’ some other girls to dance. Alotta them would show up with the right look, but, like, no moves, yanno? It started off with me showin’ them a thing or two, and before ya know it I was teachin’ a class, like, every other dang day. THEN they had me do the choreography for that Kitty Berry music video, ‘White Cow’.” The blonde woman scratches the back of her head, sighing. “I don’t know what the heck happened man, I just wanted to grind on Lil’ B11gg3’s robo junk on camera.”
rows.translation: 小蓝耸耸肩。“哦，老兄，说来话长。你看，我得到一份工作，替小B11gg3伴舞。你知道，就是那个安卓科技说唱歌手？总之，他当时正在为一部音乐视频找‘丰满母狗’。视频名字就叫《丰满母狗》。歌普普通通，但视频嘛，绝对精彩。事情一件接一件，那一年我最后出演了差不多六部音乐视频。后来他们让我教其他一些女孩跳舞。她们很多人来的时候外形合适，可怎么说呢，根本不会动，懂吧？一开始只是我教她们一两招，不知不觉我就开始差不多每隔一天教一堂课。然后他们又让我替凯蒂·贝瑞的音乐视频《白牛》编舞。”金发女人挠挠后脑，叹了口气。“我也不知道他妈的发生了什么，老兄，我当初只是想对着镜头磨蹭小B11gg3的机器人家伙。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBlue shrugs. “Oh man, long story. See, I landed this gig dancin’ for Lil’ B11gg3. You know, the android techno rapper? Anywho, he was lookin’ for ‘thick bitches’ for this music video he was shootin’. It was called ‘Thick Bitches’. So-so song, but meh, killer video. One thing led to another and I ended up in, like, six music videos that year. After that they got me teachin’ some other girls to dance. Alotta them would show up with the right look, but, like, no moves, yanno? It started off with me showin’ them a thing or two, and before ya know it I was teachin’ a class, like, every other dang day. THEN they had me do the choreography for that Kitty Berry music video, ‘White Cow’.” The blonde woman scratches the back of her head, sighing. “I don’t know what the heck happened man, I just wanted to grind on Lil’ B11gg3’s robo junk on camera.”"

rows.original: “Huh,” you actually learned something about her there. You ask if that’s the only reason why she dropped out of high school.
rows.translation: “哦，”这一次你确实从她那里了解到了一些东西。你问这是否就是她高中退学的唯一原因。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh,” you actually learned something about her there. You ask if that’s the only reason why she dropped out of high school."

rows.original: She offers a small shrug. “Well that, and I failed senior year, like, three times.”
rows.translation: 她轻轻耸肩。“嗯，是这个，而且我毕业年级好像还留级了三次。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe offers a small shrug. “Well that, and I failed senior year, like, three times.”"

rows.original: “Ah.” You nod, that reason being more what you would have guessed.
rows.translation: “啊。”你点点头，这个理由更符合你的猜测。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah.” You nod, that reason being more what you would have guessed."

rows.original: You ask Blue what she does in the Love Starz.
rows.translation: 你询问小蓝在爱之星组合中负责什么。
rows.raw: "You ask Blue what she does in the Love Starz."

rows.original: Blue starts to giggle, the curvy ovir starting to bounce up and down on the balls of her feet. Suddenly, she strikes a mysterious, crouched pose. “Idol of love, chosen from afar!” Hopping up, she strikes a new and far more dramatic pose, projecting her voice proudly. “Open your heart, for I am Blue Star!”
rows.translation: 小蓝开始咯咯轻笑，这位曲线丰腴的奥维尔人踮着前脚掌上下弹动。突然间，她摆出神秘的低伏姿势。“来自遥远彼方，爱之偶像受选而至！”她向上一跳，摆出一个更加戏剧性的全新姿势，自豪地放声高喊：“敞开你的心，因为我就是蓝星！”
rows.raw: "\n\nBlue starts to giggle, the curvy ovir starting to bounce up and down on the balls of her feet. Suddenly, she strikes a mysterious, crouched pose. “Idol of love, chosen from afar!” Hopping up, she strikes a new and far more dramatic pose, projecting her voice proudly. “Open your heart, for I am Blue Star!”"

rows.original: Silence.
rows.translation: 一片沉默。
rows.raw: "\n\nSilence."

rows.original: You blink. “Um...” Collecting your thoughts, you ask again, more specifically, what she does IN the group.
rows.translation: 你眨眨眼。“呃...”你整理思绪，再次询问，更具体地说，她在组合里负责什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink. “Um...” Collecting your thoughts, you ask again, more specifically, what she does IN the group."

rows.original: “Oh, well the moves, silly!” Blue starts to hop back and forth on the balls of her feet once more, her chest bouncing in time with her movements. While you struggle to keep eye contact, she continues. “I mean, I sing, sure. But I’m the choreographer, I, like, come up with the dances.”
rows.translation: “哦，当然是动作啦，笨蛋！”小蓝再次踮着前脚掌来回蹦跳，胸脯随着动作同步弹动。你费力保持眼神接触，她则继续说道：“我的意思是，我当然也唱歌。但我是编舞，怎么说呢，就是设计舞蹈。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, well the moves, silly!” Blue starts to hop back and forth on the balls of her feet once more, her chest bouncing in time with her movements. While you struggle to keep eye contact, she continues. “I mean, I sing, sure. But I’m the choreographer, I, like, come up with the dances.”"

rows.original: Watching her bounce back and forth, forcing your eyes off her chest for a moment, you note her to be oddly light on her feet. Her figure doesn’t particularly strike you as that of a dancer. “Do you do it all yourself?”
rows.translation: 你看着她来回弹动，强迫视线暂时离开胸脯，注意到她的脚步出奇轻盈。她的身材并没有特别让你联想到舞者。“全都由你自己完成？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWatching her bounce back and forth, forcing your eyes off her chest for a moment, you note her to be oddly light on her feet. Her figure doesn’t particularly strike you as that of a dancer. “Do you do it all yourself?”"

rows.original: “Nah. Pink helps out,” she stops her bouncing, her chest wobbling an awkward amount of time afterwards. “She’s, like, good at everythin’. It’s nice to be able to talk to somebody who gets it, yanno?”
rows.translation: “才不是。小粉会帮忙，”她停止弹动，胸脯随后却尴尬地继续摇晃了很久。“她怎么说呢，什么都很擅长。能和一个理解那种感觉的人聊聊，真的很不错，懂吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nah. Pink helps out,” she stops her bouncing, her chest wobbling an awkward amount of time afterwards. “She’s, like, good at everythin’. It’s nice to be able to talk to somebody who gets it, yanno?”"

rows.original: “It?” You ask.
rows.translation: “哪种感觉？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It?” You ask."

rows.original: “Yanno. It.” When you shrug in response, Blue’s mouth twists in frustration. “It’s like... this feelin’ in your tummy when you’re movin’ to the music, kay...” Blue closes her eyes, and shakes out her arms. “The music tells you how to move, but it’s like... more than that, yanno? It’s like sex.” She starts to sway her hips slowly, her tail flicking back and forth behind her. “You’re bringing somethin’ out in the music, like this whole other thing that wasn’t there before. Two things comin’ together to make this whole new thing.”
rows.translation: “你知道。就是那种感觉。”你耸肩回应，小蓝的嘴巴因挫败而扭曲。“就像是...你随着音乐移动时，肚子里的这种感觉，好吗...”小蓝闭上眼睛，甩动双臂。“音乐会告诉你该怎么动，但怎么说呢...不只是这样，懂吧？就像做爱。”她开始缓缓摆动臀部，尾巴在身后来回甩动。“你会从音乐中带出一些东西，就像创造了原本不存在的另一种东西。两样事物结合在一起，产生一个崭新的整体。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yanno. It.” When you shrug in response, Blue’s mouth twists in frustration. “It’s like... this feelin’ in your tummy when you’re movin’ to the music, kay...” Blue closes her eyes, and shakes out her arms. “The music tells you how to move, but it’s like... more than that, yanno? It’s like sex.” She starts to sway her hips slowly, her tail flicking back and forth behind her. “You’re bringing somethin’ out in the music, like this whole other thing that wasn’t there before. Two things comin’ together to make this whole new thing.”"

rows.original: She hums to herself a tune, her movements becoming more defined. Twisting on the balls of her feet now, the purple woman begins to sways her hips back and forth with more accentuated moves, all in time with the simple tune. She raises her hands up absentmindedly to her chest, her hands running over herself in a seductive display, her painted nails grazing against her fat tit flesh. Her tail flicking behind her, you watch Blue dance for you, humming her soft tune.
rows.translation: 她自顾自地哼起曲调，动作变得更加清晰。紫色女人如今踮着前脚掌旋转，开始以更加强调的动作来回摆动臀部，全部配合简单的旋律。她心不在焉地把双手抬到胸前，以诱惑姿态抚过身体；涂过颜色的指甲擦过肥厚乳肉。尾巴在身后甩动，你看着小蓝为你起舞，轻哼柔和曲调。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hums to herself a tune, her movements becoming more defined. Twisting on the balls of her feet now, the purple woman begins to sways her hips back and forth with more accentuated moves, all in time with the simple tune. She raises her hands up absentmindedly to her chest, her hands running over herself in a seductive display, her painted nails grazing against her fat tit flesh. Her tail flicking behind her, you watch Blue dance for you, humming her soft tune."

rows.original: When she suddenly stops, you feel as if somebody slammed on the breaks in your brain. You didn’t even notice how enthralled you were, time completely lost to you. Realizing your face is flushed, you suddenly feel your [pc.skinFurScales] is quite hot under the collar. Did her simple dance affect you that much?
rows.translation: 她突然停下时，你感觉仿佛有人猛踩了大脑里的刹车。你甚至没察觉自己有多着迷，完全失去了时间感。意识到脸庞涨红，你突然感觉[pc.skinFurScales]热得领口发烫。她那简单的舞蹈对你的影响真有这么大？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she suddenly stops, you feel as if somebody slammed on the breaks in your brain. You didn’t even notice how enthralled you were, time completely lost to you. Realizing your face is flushed, you suddenly feel your [pc.skinFurScales] is quite hot under the collar. Did her simple dance affect you that much?"

rows.original: She opens her eyes and smiles. “See?”
rows.translation: 她睁眼微笑。“明白了吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe opens her eyes and smiles. “See?”"

rows.original: You ask Blue what she thinks of Pink.
rows.translation: 你询问小蓝对小粉的看法。
rows.raw: "You ask Blue what she thinks of Pink."

rows.original: “Oh, well Pink’s, like, amazeballs.” Blue smiles, stroking her chin lightly. “I mean, seriously, have you seen her? She’s, like, really pretty, and just so creative and stuff.” The curvy ovir ponders in silence for a moment, trying to think of more to say.
rows.translation: “哦，小粉嘛，她简直棒呆了。”小蓝笑着轻抚下巴。“我的意思是，说真的，你没见过她吗？她怎么说呢，真的很漂亮，而且特别有创意什么的。”曲线丰腴的奥维尔人沉默思考片刻，试图想出更多话来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, well Pink’s, like, amazeballs.” Blue smiles, stroking her chin lightly. “I mean, seriously, have you seen her? She’s, like, really pretty, and just so creative and stuff.” The curvy ovir ponders in silence for a moment, trying to think of more to say."

rows.original: After a beat, you chime in. “So you respect her?”
rows.translation: 片刻后，你插话道：“所以你尊敬她？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a beat, you chime in. “So you respect her?”"

rows.original: Blue rolls her eyes, a lazy smirk on her painted lips. “Well yeah, she’s like, da best. She’s the reason we all got together and are killin’ it out there, yanno?”
rows.translation: 小蓝翻了个白眼，涂过颜色的嘴唇挂着懒洋洋的坏笑。“那当然，她怎么说呢，最棒了。我们能聚到一起、在外面大杀四方，全都是因为她，懂吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBlue rolls her eyes, a lazy smirk on her painted lips. “Well yeah, she’s like, da best. She’s the reason we all got together and are killin’ it out there, yanno?”"

rows.original: You raise your brow, under the impression Colm did that.
rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛，原本以为那是科尔姆的功劳。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise your brow, under the impression Colm did that."

rows.original: “What? Nah. He’s just, like, a suit and junk. Pink totes wears the pants and makes all the plays. Colm just kinda deals with numbers. Pink’s smart and all, but she doesn’t really care for that sorta thing.”
rows.translation: “什么？才不是。他只是怎么说呢，个穿西装的什么家伙。小粉才是绝对的当家人，所有主意都由她拍板。科尔姆只是负责处理数字。小粉当然很聪明，可她不怎么喜欢那种事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What? Nah. He’s just, like, a suit and junk. Pink totes wears the pants and makes all the plays. Colm just kinda deals with numbers. Pink’s smart and all, but she doesn’t really care for that sorta thing.”"

rows.original: That makes sense to you from what you’ve seen. You ask what Pink does care about then.
rows.translation: 根据你目前看到的情况，这个说法确实合理。你继续询问小粉究竟在乎什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat makes sense to you from what you’ve seen. You ask what Pink does care about then."

rows.original: She starts to answer but stops, leaving her jaw hanging in the air for a beat. “Huh,” Blue scratches the side of her head, ruffling her blonde hair. “Well, music I guess. She takes that very seriously... but I mean now that you mention it I don’t really know what else...”
rows.translation: 她刚要回答却停住，下巴悬在半空片刻。“嗯，”小蓝挠挠脑袋一侧，弄乱金发。“我想是音乐吧。她对音乐非常认真...不过，我的意思是，现在被你一说，我还真不知道她除此以外还在乎什么...”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe starts to answer but stops, leaving her jaw hanging in the air for a beat. “Huh,” Blue scratches the side of her head, ruffling her blonde hair. “Well, music I guess. She takes that very seriously... but I mean now that you mention it I don’t really know what else...”"

rows.original: You give Blue a second to collect her thoughts, knowing the woman to often have a hard time putting them into words.
rows.translation: 你给小蓝一点时间整理思绪，知道这个女人经常难以用语言表达想法。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give Blue a second to collect her thoughts, knowing the woman to often have a hard time putting them into words."

rows.original: “I mean,” she starts after a long pause. “She was kinda born into it. Maybe it’s, like, all she really knows. Yanno?”
rows.translation: “我的意思是，”长时间停顿后，她终于开口。“她多少算是生来就在这个行业里。也许这怎么说呢，就是她唯一真正了解的东西。懂吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I mean,” she starts after a long pause. “She was kinda born into it. Maybe it’s, like, all she really knows. Yanno?”"

rows.original: Seeking some elaboration, you ask Blue what she means by that.
rows.translation: 你希望她进一步解释，于是询问这话是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeeking some elaboration, you ask Blue what she means by that."

rows.original: “Well, yanno. She was, like, adopted by that company all in the womb and junk.” Blue points to her belly with both her index fingers, poking herself a few times to illustrate her point. “Like, literally born and raised to be a star. She learned to tap dance, like, a week after learning to walk. I don’t know, you’d have to ask her about it. The whole topic is just super depresso.” Blue lowers her hands and takes a deep sigh. “Like, my childhood sucked nards, but at least I had one, yanno?”
rows.translation: “嗯，你知道。她怎么说呢，还在子宫里时就被那家公司收养了什么的。”小蓝用两根食指指向腹部，戳了几下自己以说明观点。“字面意义上为了成为明星而出生、成长。她学会走路大概一周后，就开始学踢踏舞。我不知道，你得亲自问她。整个话题实在超级致郁。”小蓝放下双手，深深叹气。“就像是，我的童年烂透了，但至少我有过童年，懂吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, yanno. She was, like, adopted by that company all in the womb and junk.” Blue points to her belly with both her index fingers, poking herself a few times to illustrate her point. “Like, literally born and raised to be a star. She learned to tap dance, like, a week after learning to walk. I don’t know, you’d have to ask her about it. The whole topic is just super depresso.” Blue lowers her hands and takes a deep sigh. “Like, my childhood sucked nards, but at least I had one, yanno?”"

rows.original: You ask Blue what she thinks about
rows.translation: 你询问小蓝对
rows.raw: "You ask Blue what she thinks about "

rows.translation: 的看法。

rows.original: “Hmmm,” she taps a painted nail against her chin, brow furrowed as she thinks about the question. “Well, and don’t tell Pink this, but I think she might like me. Like, I mean ‘like-like’ me.”
rows.translation: “嗯——，”她皱着眉思考这个问题，用涂过颜色的指甲轻敲下巴。“好吧，别告诉小粉，但我觉得她可能喜欢我。我的意思是，像是‘那种喜欢’我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmmm,” she taps a painted nail against her chin, brow furrowed as she thinks about the question. “Well, and don’t tell Pink this, but I think she might like me. Like, I mean ‘like-like’ me.”"

rows.original: You try not to go slack jawed at her answer. If anything, from what you’ve seen,
rows.translation: 你努力不让下巴掉下来。就你所见，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try not to go slack jawed at her answer. If anything, from what you’ve seen, "

rows.original: can barely keep herself from throttling the blonde ovir. “Uh... what gave you that impression?”
rows.translation: 几乎每时每刻都在努力克制自己掐死金发奥维尔人的冲动。“呃...是什么让你产生这种印象？”
rows.raw: " can barely keep herself from throttling the blonde ovir. “Uh... what gave you that impression?”"

rows.original: “Well, for one, she doesn’t shut up about my butt. Like ever.” Blue sighs, twisting around a free lock of hair with her finger. “It’s always ‘fatass this’ or ‘dumbass that’. It’s, like, uh, hello Green! I’m more than just a thick tushy. I have a rockin’ pair of boobies too, yanno?” Blue gives her chest a honk, showing off that she does indeed have a ‘rockin’ pair’.
rows.translation: “首先，她一直没完没了地谈论我的屁股。怎么说呢，从来就没停过。”小蓝叹气，用手指缠绕一缕散发。“总是什么‘肥屁股这个’或者‘蠢货那个’。这就像是，呃，拜托，小绿！我不只是一只丰满翘臀。我还有一对超棒奶子，懂吧？”小蓝捏响自己的胸脯，证明她的确拥有“超棒的一对”。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, for one, she doesn’t shut up about my butt. Like ever.” Blue sighs, twisting around a free lock of hair with her finger. “It’s always ‘fatass this’ or ‘dumbass that’. It’s, like, uh, hello Green! I’m more than just a thick tushy. I have a rockin’ pair of boobies too, yanno?” Blue gives her chest a honk, showing off that she does indeed have a ‘rockin’ pair’."

rows.original: You stare at the poor girl for a moment in silent pity. Does she REALLY think

rows.translation: “过来看嘛！”她说道，身后的尾巴以令人担忧的力道摇摆起来。“求你了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come see!” she says, her tail wagging behind her with a concerning amount of power. “Please?”"

rows.original: “So about Little Blue...”
rows.translation: “那么，关于小小蓝...”
rows.raw: "“So about Little Blue...”"

rows.original: Blue’s eyes open wide, the purple woman’s heavy tail starting to sway behind her again. “Did ya change your mind? Do ya wanna see?”
rows.translation: 小蓝双眼大睁，紫色女人沉重的尾巴又开始在身后摇摆。“你改变主意了？你想看看吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBlue’s eyes open wide, the purple woman’s heavy tail starting to sway behind her again. “Did ya change your mind? Do ya wanna see?”"

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original: Not Now
rows.translation: 现在不要
rows.raw: "Not Now"

rows.original: You ask Blue about her sex.
rows.translation: 你向小蓝询问她的性别。
rows.raw: "You ask Blue about her sex."

rows.original: “Wait, you wanna have sex?” Blue raises her brow. “I mean, I’ve been asked in worse ways...”
rows.translation: “等等，你想做爱？”小蓝挑起眉毛。“我是说，我听过更糟的邀约方式...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait, you wanna have sex?” Blue raises her brow. “I mean, I’ve been asked in worse ways...”"

rows.original: “No...” You rub your brow.
rows.translation: “不...”你揉了揉眉心。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No...” You rub your brow."

rows.original: Seriously? She thought THAT was a pick-up line?
rows.translation: 认真的？她居然以为那是句搭讪？
rows.raw: " Seriously? She thought THAT was a pick-up line?"

rows.original: You tell her you’re asking about her being male.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，自己是在问她身为男性这件事。
rows.raw: " You tell her you’re asking about her being male."

rows.original: “Oh,” Blue frowns. “Well, I mean, I have a dick, so I’m male. What’s there to say?”
rows.translation: “哦，”小蓝皱起眉。“嗯，我是说，我有鸡巴，所以我是男性。还有什么可说的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh,” Blue frowns. “Well, I mean, I have a dick, so I’m male. What’s there to say?”"

rows.original: “Well... it’s kinda funny you’re in a L-Pop all-female group.” Blue stares at you a moment, not connecting the dots. “...since you’re not really a female.”
rows.translation: “呃...你待在一支全女性L-Pop组合里，感觉有点好笑。”小蓝盯着你看了一会儿，没有明白其中关联。“...毕竟你其实不是女性。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well... it’s kinda funny you’re in a L-Pop all-female group.” Blue stares at you a moment, not connecting the dots. “...since you’re not really a female.”"

rows.original: “Oh,” Blue chuckles to herself. “Right. THAT. Well, I mean, people don’t really know. Most male ovir have fancy color patterns, I kinda don’t for some reason...” She shrugs. “So even my own species think I’m female sometimes.”
rows.translation: “哦，”小蓝独自轻笑起来。“对。那件事。嗯，我是说，大家其实不知道。大多数男性奥维尔人都有花哨的色彩纹路，可我出于某种原因就是没有...”她耸耸肩。“所以就连我的同族有时都会以为我是女性。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh,” Blue chuckles to herself. “Right. THAT. Well, I mean, people don’t really know. Most male ovir have fancy color patterns, I kinda don’t for some reason...” She shrugs. “So even my own species think I’m female sometimes.”"

rows.original: “Really?” You give Blue a decent look over. You ask her aren’t females typically less endowed.
rows.translation: “真的？”你好好打量了一番小蓝，问她雌性通常不是没那么丰满吗。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really?” You give Blue a decent look over. You ask her aren’t females typically less endowed."

rows.original: “Not all female ovir are flat chested, [pc.name]. Good genes count for somethin’, yanno?” She gives you a wink. “Well, my sister ain’t flat at least, but my mother woulda been the real test I guess...”
rows.translation: “不是所有雌性奥维尔人都平胸，[pc.name]。好基因还是有点用的，懂吧？”她朝你眨眨眼。“至少我姐姐不平，不过我想，真正能验证这一点的本该是我母亲...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not all female ovir are flat chested, [pc.name]. Good genes count for somethin’, yanno?” She gives you a wink. “Well, my sister ain’t flat at least, but my mother woulda been the real test I guess...”"

rows.original: You raise a brow. “Would have been?”
rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛。“本该是？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise a brow. “Would have been?”"

rows.original: Blue’s jaw goes slack as she thinks about your question. “Oh, uh. Yeah, forget that bit,” she shifts in place, suddenly noticeably uncomfortable. “Anywho, yeah. If everybody thinks I’m female it doesn’t matter, right? I mean, it ain’t like I’m lying, yanno? Ovir go by ‘she’ and ‘her’ anyways, so really all I’m doing is not talkin’ about Little Blue. If somebody asked I’d tell ‘em, but nobodies askin’.”
rows.translation: 小蓝想着你的问题，嘴巴愣愣张开。“哦，呃。对，忘掉那部分吧，”她挪了挪身体，突然显得很不自在。“总之，对啊。既然所有人都以为我是女性，那就没关系，对吧？我是说，我又没有撒谎，懂吧？奥维尔人反正都用‘她’来称呼，所以我其实只是不谈小小蓝。要是有人问，我会告诉他们，可谁也没问。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBlue’s jaw goes slack as she thinks about your question. “Oh, uh. Yeah, forget that bit,” she shifts in place, suddenly noticeably uncomfortable. “Anywho, yeah. If everybody thinks I’m female it doesn’t matter, right? I mean, it ain’t like I’m lying, yanno? Ovir go by ‘she’ and ‘her’ anyways, so really all I’m doing is not talkin’ about Little Blue. If somebody asked I’d tell ‘em, but nobodies askin’.”"

rows.original: “That’s fair...” You say with a chuckle, thinking the topic reached its end.
rows.translation: “这倒也说得通...”你轻笑着说道，以为这个话题已经结束。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s fair...” You say with a chuckle, thinking the topic reached its end."

rows.original: “You said something about not having a childhood, what was that about?”
rows.translation: “你说过自己没有童年，那是怎么回事？”
rows.raw: "“You said something about not having a childhood, what was that about?”"

rows.original: “Oh...” Blue blinks. “Uh... that was, like, uh...” She shifts in place, wringing her hands in front of her. “Yeah, that’s a big one, yanno?”
rows.translation: “哦...”小蓝眨眨眼。“呃...那件事，怎么说，呃...”她不安地挪动身体，在身前绞着双手。“对，那可是件大事，懂吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh...” Blue blinks. “Uh... that was, like, uh...” She shifts in place, wringing her hands in front of her. “Yeah, that’s a big one, yanno?”"

rows.original: Sensing some tension, you drop it.
rows.translation: 察觉到几分紧张，你不再追问。
rows.raw: "\n\nSensing some tension, you drop it."

rows.original: “Ah, yeah.” Blue scratches the back of her neck, her blue eyes falling to the floor. “That’s... I mean, I COULD talk about it, but it’s, like, big, yanno? I wouldn’t even know where to start...”
rows.translation: “啊，对。”小蓝挠挠后颈，蓝色双眼落向地板。“那件事...我是说，我可以谈，但它，怎么说，太大了，懂吧？我甚至不知道该从哪里开始...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, yeah.” Blue scratches the back of her neck, her blue eyes falling to the floor. “That’s... I mean, I COULD talk about it, but it’s, like, big, yanno? I wouldn’t even know where to start...”"

rows.original: Not wanting to push her, and not having any ideas yourself, you decide to drop it.
rows.translation: 你不想逼迫她，自己也想不到该怎么开口，于是决定不再追问。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot wanting to push her, and not having any ideas yourself, you decide to drop it."

rows.original: Not sure how to comfort her, you move in and wrap your arms around the crying ovir. That seems to help, as Blue buries her face against you, accepting your hug without hesitation. Instinctively, you stroke her hair, running your fingers through her silky blonde locks.
rows.translation: 你不知道该如何安慰她，便走上前抱住哭泣的奥维尔人。这似乎起了作用，小蓝把脸埋在你身上，毫不犹豫地接受拥抱。你本能地抚摸她的头发，手指穿过丝滑的金色发丝。
rows.raw: "Not sure how to comfort her, you move in and wrap your arms around the crying ovir. That seems to help, as Blue buries her face against you, accepting your hug without hesitation. Instinctively, you stroke her hair, running your fingers through her silky blonde locks."

rows.original: You’re not sure how long you’ve held her, but when she pulls herself from your arms she looks much better. Her eyes, however, are noticeably red.
rows.translation: 你不知道自己抱了她多久，但当她离开你的怀抱时，看起来已经好多了。不过她的眼睛明显发红。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure how long you’ve held her, but when she pulls herself from your arms she looks much better. Her eyes, however, are noticeably red."

rows.original: “Thanks, [pc.name]. That... meant a heck of a lot.”
rows.translation: “谢谢，[pc.name]。这...对我真的意义重大。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks, [pc.name]. That... meant a heck of a lot.”"

rows.original: Not sure what to do, you let Blue be.
rows.translation: 你不知道该做什么，于是让小蓝自己待着。
rows.raw: "Not sure what to do, you let Blue be."

rows.original: She wipes her eyes, trying to dry her tears the best she can. “Sorry, uh... one second...” She rubs her eyes roughly, desperately trying to dry them. “I’m sorry, this is so embarrassing... I shouldn’t cry in front of you. You’re my boss...” She laughs nervously, clearly struggling.
rows.translation: 她擦着眼睛，竭力拭干泪水。“抱歉，呃...等一下...”她粗鲁地揉着眼睛，拼命想把它们擦干。“对不起，这太丢人了...我不该在你面前哭。你是我的老板...”她紧张地笑着，显然正在勉强支撑。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe wipes her eyes, trying to dry her tears the best she can. “Sorry, uh... one second...” She rubs her eyes roughly, desperately trying to dry them. “I’m sorry, this is so embarrassing... I shouldn’t cry in front of you. You’re my boss...” She laughs nervously, clearly struggling."

rows.original: After a minute she sniffs, and clears her throat. “I... think I’m good now. Sorry about that.”
rows.translation: 过了一会儿，她吸吸鼻子，清了清嗓子。“我...我想我没事了。刚才对不起。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a minute she sniffs, and clears her throat. “I... think I’m good now. Sorry about that.”"

rows.original: You ask the red-eyed ovir if she’s like to talk about something else now.
rows.translation: 你问这个眼睛发红的奥维尔人，现在是否愿意聊点别的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask the red-eyed ovir if she’s like to talk about something else now."

rows.original: Blue shrugs. “We can talk about how happy I am this makeup doesn’t run.” Blue chuckles, rubbing her thumb against the side of her eye. “No... I think that’s pretty much it... Ma got locked up when we were twelve and I haven’t seen her since... She’s out now, I hear, but... I’m never gonna see her again, and that’s a promise.”
rows.translation: 小蓝耸耸肩。“我们可以聊聊，我有多庆幸这妆不会花。”小蓝轻笑着，用拇指擦过眼角。“不...我想差不多就这些了...我们十二岁时，老妈被关了起来，从那以后我就没见过她...我听说她现在出来了，可是...我永远不会再见她，我保证。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBlue shrugs. “We can talk about how happy I am this makeup doesn’t run.” Blue chuckles, rubbing her thumb against the side of her eye. “No... I think that’s pretty much it... Ma got locked up when we were twelve and I haven’t seen her since... She’s out now, I hear, but... I’m never gonna see her again, and that’s a promise.”"

rows.original: Ending the topic, Blue takes a deep breath then smiles, putting on a happy face for you.
rows.translation: 结束这个话题后，小蓝深吸一口气，随后露出微笑，努力在你面前装出开心的样子。
rows.raw: "\n\nEnding the topic, Blue takes a deep breath then smiles, putting on a happy face for you."

rows.original: “You said something about your mother, why not start there?”
rows.translation: “你刚才提到了母亲，为什么不从她说起？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You said something about your mother, why not start there?”"

rows.original: “Oh.. well... that’s tough since I never met her.” Blue shrugs. “She died not long after layin’ us, me and my sisters I mean.”
rows.translation: “哦..嗯...这很难，因为我从没见过她。”小蓝耸耸肩。“她生下我们后不久就死了，我是说我和姐妹们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh.. well... that’s tough since I never met her.” Blue shrugs. “She died not long after layin’ us, me and my sisters I mean.”"

rows.original: The mood suddenly shifts, Blue’s demeanor becoming serious and dour. You start to backpedal, trying to salvage the situation. “We don’t have to talk about it if you don’t-”
rows.translation: 气氛骤然转变，小蓝的神情变得严肃阴郁。你开始往回找补，试图挽救局面。“如果你不想，我们不必谈——”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe mood suddenly shifts, Blue’s demeanor becoming serious and dour. You start to backpedal, trying to salvage the situation. “We don’t have to talk about it if you don’t-”"

rows.original: “It’s fine,” she says, cutting you off. “It’s... fine. It’s just... hard, yanno? I really don’t know anything about her be-... gah.” Blue presses her palms on the sides of her head, rubbing her scalp roughly. “Sorry. I’m, like, just... tryin’ to sort it out in my head. The words I mean.”
rows.translation: “没关系，”她打断你说道。“没...关系。只是...很难，懂吧？我真的完全不了解她，因——...啊。”小蓝双掌按住脑袋两侧，用力揉着头皮。“抱歉。我只是，怎么说...正在脑子里把它理清。我是说那些话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s fine,” she says, cutting you off. “It’s... fine. It’s just... hard, yanno? I really don’t know anything about her be-... gah.” Blue presses her palms on the sides of her head, rubbing her scalp roughly. “Sorry. I’m, like, just... tryin’ to sort it out in my head. The words I mean.”"

rows.original: “Take your time.” You assure her with a smile, trying to comfort her.
rows.translation: “慢慢来。”你微笑着向她保证，努力安慰她。
rows.raw: "“Take your time.” You assure her with a smile, trying to comfort her."

rows.original: “It’s okay. I have a hard time putting stuff like this into words too.” You chuckle, trying to be disarming.
rows.translation: “没事。我也很难把这种事情说清楚。”你轻笑着，试图让她放松下来。
rows.raw: "“It’s okay. I have a hard time putting stuff like this into words too.” You chuckle, trying to be disarming."

rows.original: “Come on, out with it. You know what you’ve gotta say, so say it.” You say, coaxing her out with tough love.
rows.translation: “来吧，说出来。你知道自己该说什么，那就说吧。”你用严厉的关爱催促她开口。
rows.raw: "“Come on, out with it. You know what you’ve gotta say, so say it.” You say, coaxing her out with tough love."

rows.original: After a moment, Blue lowers her hands and takes a deep breath. “My sire... um, father, I guess... well, she was involved in some stuff. Piracy, murder, slavin’... the whole deal. She was also... um, hard... on us... me and my sister.” Blue scratches her neck, her bright eyes starting to water. “Um... my mother too... she, uh... couldn’t take it...”
rows.translation: 片刻后，小蓝放下双手，深吸一口气。“我的生父...呃，我想该叫父亲...嗯，她参与过一些事情。海盗、谋杀、奴役...全套都有。她对我们也...呃...很严厉...对我和姐姐。”小蓝挠着脖子，明亮双眼开始泛起泪光。“呃...我母亲也是...她，呃...承受不住...”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment, Blue lowers her hands and takes a deep breath. “My sire... um, father, I guess... well, she was involved in some stuff. Piracy, murder, slavin’... the whole deal. She was also... um, hard... on us... me and my sister.” Blue scratches her neck, her bright eyes starting to water. “Um... my mother too... she, uh... couldn’t take it...”"

rows.original: You listen, letting Blue talk at her own pace.
rows.translation: 你静静倾听，让小蓝按自己的节奏讲述。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou listen, letting Blue talk at her own pace."

rows.original: “When she found out she was pregnant, she uh... ran...” she chuckles nervously. “Tried to get away with us. Away from... her. Layed us on the run. But Ma... well... she tracked her down... Wasn’t too happy she ran away, especially when she found out why... So she...” Blue trails off, her lips quivering.
rows.translation: “她发现自己怀孕后，就，呃...逃跑了...”她紧张地轻笑。“想带着我们逃走。逃离...她。逃亡途中生下了我们。可是老妈...嗯...她追上了母亲...对她逃跑很不高兴，尤其是发现原因后...所以她...”小蓝的声音逐渐消失，嘴唇微微颤抖。
rows.raw: "\n\n“When she found out she was pregnant, she uh... ran...” she chuckles nervously. “Tried to get away with us. Away from... her. Layed us on the run. But Ma... well... she tracked her down... Wasn’t too happy she ran away, especially when she found out why... So she...” Blue trails off, her lips quivering."

rows.original: You feel your face twist, connecting the dots. “Your sire killed your mother?”
rows.translation: 你把线索串联起来，脸不由得扭曲。“你的生父杀了你母亲？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel your face twist, connecting the dots. “Your sire killed your mother?”"

rows.original: “Yeah... and... one of my sisters too...” Blue rubs her brow, half hiding her face from you. “‘Woulda been a freak’ she said. Left her egg to rot and didn’t even feel bad about it. Said she wished she’d done the same thing to me and Sel nearly everyday for the first twelve years of our lives, so that was, like, nice of her.” Blue sniffs, her eyes wandering around the room. “She only beat us when she was real ticked off, but the rest of the time... It was just...” She stops herself tears rolling down her purple cheeks. “You get told you’re a useless retard long enough it starts to stick, yanno? I mean... I know I’m not smart but...” Blue chokes up, the thought catching in her throat.
rows.translation: “对...而且...还杀了我的一个姐妹...”小蓝揉着眉心，用手半掩住脸。“她说‘长大也会是个怪胎’。把她的蛋扔在那里腐烂，甚至一点也不觉得愧疚。在我们人生最初十二年里，她几乎每天都说，希望当初也对我和塞尔这么做，所以她真是，怎么说，太体贴了。”小蓝吸吸鼻子，目光在房间里游移。“她只有在真的气疯时才会打我们，可其他时候...那就只是...”她停住话语，泪水顺着紫色脸颊滚落。“被人说成没用的弱智，说得够久，就会开始相信，懂吧？我是说...我知道自己不聪明，可是...”小蓝哽咽起来，那个念头卡在喉咙里。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah... and... one of my sisters too...” Blue rubs her brow, half hiding her face from you. “‘Woulda been a freak’ she said. Left her egg to rot and didn’t even feel bad about it. Said she wished she’d done the same thing to me and Sel nearly everyday for the first twelve years of our lives, so that was, like, nice of her.” Blue sniffs, her eyes wandering around the room. “She only beat us when she was real ticked off, but the rest of the time... It was just...” She stops herself tears rolling down her purple cheeks. “You get told you’re a useless retard long enough it starts to stick, yanno? I mean... I know I’m not smart but...” Blue chokes up, the thought catching in her throat."

rows.original: Frowning, you ask the small woman if there is anything not obvious she would like to share.
rows.translation: 你皱起眉头，问这名娇小女子有没有什么不那么显而易见的事愿意分享。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrowning, you ask the small woman if there is anything not obvious she would like to share."

rows.original: “I work out,” she shrugs. “I also do cardio, running mostly, but I do 100 squats a day as well. Oh, wait...” She rolls her eyes and gives herself a tap on her well toned rear. “Obvious. Sorry.”
rows.translation: “我会健身，”她耸耸肩。“我也做有氧运动，主要是跑步，不过每天还会做一百个深蹲。哦，等等...”她翻了个白眼，拍了拍自己线条紧实的屁股。“太明显了。抱歉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I work out,” she shrugs. “I also do cardio, running mostly, but I do 100 squats a day as well. Oh, wait...” She rolls her eyes and gives herself a tap on her well toned rear. “Obvious. Sorry.”"

rows.original: “Right,” you chuckle, asking her if she’s a health nut or something.
rows.translation: “好吧，”你轻笑着，问她是不是健康狂人之类的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right,” you chuckle, asking her if she’s a health nut or something."

rows.original: “Or something,”
rows.translation: “之类的吧，”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Or something,” "

rows.original: smacks her lips, her neon eyes not making direct contact with yours. “I sing and dance for a living, Steele. It’s part of the job to stay in shape.”
rows.translation: 咂了咂嘴，那双霓虹色眼睛避开了你的视线。“我是靠唱歌跳舞谋生的，斯蒂尔。保持身材是工作的一部分。”
rows.raw: " smacks her lips, her neon eyes not making direct contact with yours. “I sing and dance for a living, Steele. It’s part of the job to stay in shape.”"

rows.original: “Does that go for Pink and Blue as well?”
rows.translation: “小粉和小蓝也是这样吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Does that go for Pink and Blue as well?”"

rows.original: scoffs. “Pink does yoga with me every morning. Health wise, she puts most terrans to shame. As for fatass, she dances off enough calories a day for a whole dance troupe. Keep in mind she’s eating the same amount of food as said troupe, but...”
rows.translation: 嗤笑一声。“小粉每天早上都和我一起做瑜伽。论健康，她能让大多数泰伦人自愧不如。至于那个肥屁股，她每天跳舞消耗的热量够整个舞团用。别忘了，她吃的东西也和那个舞团一样多，不过...”
rows.raw: " scoffs. “Pink does yoga with me every morning. Health wise, she puts most terrans to shame. As for fatass, she dances off enough calories a day for a whole dance troupe. Keep in mind she’s eating the same amount of food as said troupe, but...”"

rows.original: “I hope you don’t call her fatass to her face. It’s pretty messed up if you do.”
rows.translation: “我希望你不会当面叫她肥屁股。要真那么做，可就太过分了。”
rows.raw: "“I hope you don’t call her fatass to her face. It’s pretty messed up if you do.”"

rows.original: “Fat as her ass may be, you know what they say about fat bottomed girls. You should be a little nicer to her.”
rows.translation: “她的屁股确实肥，不过你也知道人们怎么评价大屁股姑娘。你该对她好一点。”
rows.raw: "“Fat as her ass may be, you know what they say about fat bottomed girls. You should be a little nicer to her.”"

rows.original: “Heh, at least you’re honest, but that kind of honestly doesn’t win friends.”
rows.translation: “呵，至少你很诚实，但这种诚实可交不到朋友。”
rows.raw: "“Heh, at least you’re honest, but that kind of honestly doesn’t win friends.”"

rows.original: rolls her eyes. “Me and dumbass are tight. She knows it’s just busting chops.”
rows.translation: 翻了个白眼。“我和那个笨蛋关系铁得很。她知道我只是损她几句。”
rows.raw: " rolls her eyes. “Me and dumbass are tight. She knows it’s just busting chops.”"

rows.original: “Dumbass? I thought it was ‘fatass’?”
rows.translation: “笨蛋？我还以为是‘肥屁股’呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dumbass? I thought it was ‘fatass’?”"

rows.original: She shrugs. “Dumb. Fat. She’s mostly just ass either way. And tits too, I guess. Those things are monsters...”
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩。“又笨。又胖。反正她基本全是屁股。还有奶子，我猜。那玩意儿简直是怪物...”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shrugs. “Dumb. Fat. She’s mostly just ass either way. And tits too, I guess. Those things are monsters...”"

rows.raw: "\n\nYour gaze falls down to "
