rows.translation: 那相对朴素的胸部，至少和小蓝相比是如此。你很确定自己从她的语气里听出了一丝嫉妒，不过还是决定不戳穿她。
rows.raw: "’s relatively modest chest, at least compared to Blue’s. You’re pretty sure you heard some envy in her tone, but opt not to call her out."

rows.original: snaps her fingers, pulling your gaze back up to her neon green eyes. “Eye’s up here, fuckface.”
rows.translation: 打了个响指，把你的目光重新拉回她那双霓虹绿的眼睛。“眼睛看上面，臭傻逼。”
rows.raw: " snaps her fingers, pulling your gaze back up to her neon green eyes. “Eye’s up here, fuckface.”"

rows.original: You ask
rows.translation: 你询问
rows.raw: "You ask "

rows.translation: 她在爱之星乐队里负责什么。

rows.original: “I sing and dance, what the fuck do you think I do?” she rolls her eyes and lets out a deep exasperated sigh. “I compose most of our music. Pink helps, but I do maybe 80% of it myself.”
rows.translation: “唱歌跳舞啊，你他妈以为我是干什么的？”她翻了个白眼，深深地叹了口气，显得极不耐烦。“我们大部分音乐都是我创作的。小粉会帮忙，但大概八成是我自己做的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I sing and dance, what the fuck do you think I do?” she rolls her eyes and lets out a deep exasperated sigh. “I compose most of our music. Pink helps, but I do maybe 80% of it myself.”"

rows.original: “So you write all the songs?”
rows.translation: “所以所有歌都是你写的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you write all the songs?”"

rows.original: rolls her eyes again, but not quite as hard. “Yeah. Kinda. But like I said, Pink helps out. I’m still sorta new to doing this professionally, so she keeps me on track.”
rows.translation: 又翻了个白眼，不过没那么用力。“对。算是吧。不过就像我说的，小粉会帮忙。我才刚开始把这当成职业不久，所以她会确保我不跑偏。”
rows.raw: " rolls her eyes again, but not quite as hard. “Yeah. Kinda. But like I said, Pink helps out. I’m still sorta new to doing this professionally, so she keeps me on track.”"

rows.original: Curious, you ask her what she means by that.
rows.translation: 你有些好奇，便问她这是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nCurious, you ask her what she means by that."

rows.original: “Eh, I used to mess around making some stuff in my free time back when I was on my own. I was doing some background dancing on tour for that bleach blonde cunt Ashley whats-her-tits, and had a lot of free time while we travelled. I tinkered around with a bunch of different genres back then.”
rows.translation: “呃，以前我独自生活时，闲下来会随便做点东西。我那时在巡演中给那个漂成金发的贱货阿什莉什么大奶子来着伴舞，旅途中有很多空闲时间。当时我尝试了不少不同的音乐流派。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eh, I used to mess around making some stuff in my free time back when I was on my own. I tinkered around with a bunch of different genres back then.”"

rows.original: “Really? You were a backup dancer?” You take stock of the young woman, guessing her to be 20 or so. You tell her that sounds like a big step up from where she is now.
rows.translation: “真的？你以前是伴舞？”你打量着这名年轻女子，猜她大概二十岁左右。你告诉她，如今的地位听起来比当时高出不少。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really? You were a backup dancer?” You take stock of the young woman, guessing her to be 20 or so. You tell her that sounds like a big step up from where she is now."

rows.original: The lithe woman crosses her arms over her chest, frowning and clearly unimpressed at your remark. “Everybody has to start somewhere, asshat. When you’re just outta school, your options are pretty fucked. Anyways, I uploaded some stuff on the net and Pink ended up hearing it somehow. Tracked me down and asked if I wanted to make music with her.”
rows.translation: 身材纤细的女子双臂抱胸，皱起眉头，显然对你的话很不满意。“所有人都得从某个地方起步，蠢货。刚毕业时，你他妈根本没多少选择。不管怎样，我把一些作品上传到了网上，不知道怎么就被小粉听见了。她找到我，问我愿不愿意和她一起做音乐。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lithe woman crosses her arms over her chest, frowning and clearly unimpressed at your remark. “Everybody has to start somewhere, asshat. When you’re just outta school, your options are pretty fucked. Anyways, I uploaded some stuff on the net and Pink ended up hearing it somehow. Tracked me down and asked if I wanted to make music with her.” "

rows.original: shrugs and chuckles. “Best thing that ever happened to me.”
rows.translation: 耸耸肩，轻笑一声。“这是我这辈子遇到过最好的事。”
rows.raw: " shrugs and chuckles. “Best thing that ever happened to me.”"

rows.original: “Huh,” you chuckle with her, trying to ease the mood. “It must have been pretty good stuff.”
rows.translation: “哦，”你和她一起笑着，试图缓和气氛。“那作品肯定很不错。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh,” you chuckle with her, trying to ease the mood. “It must have been pretty good stuff.”"

rows.original: gives you a proud smirk you haven’t seen before, her tail starting to wag slightly behind her. A nice change from the usual eye roll. “It was okay,” she scratches her neck absentmindedly, the short woman more focused on sounding modest than anything, despite her tail telling a very different story. “It wasn’t the most technically sound, but I was pretty happy with it. It was good stuff for how inexperienced I was then.”
rows.translation: 朝你露出一个前所未见的自豪笑容，她身后的尾巴也开始微微摇摆。这可比平常翻白眼的模样好多了。“还行吧，”她心不在焉地挠着脖子；尽管尾巴讲述着完全不同的故事，这名矮个女子却一心只想让自己听起来谦虚些。“技术上不是特别扎实，不过我自己很满意。考虑到那时我毫无经验，已经算是好作品了。”
rows.raw: " gives you a proud smirk you haven’t seen before, her tail starting to wag slightly behind her. A nice change from the usual eye roll. “It was okay,” she scratches her neck absentmindedly, the short woman more focused on sounding modest than anything, despite her tail telling a very different story. “It wasn’t the most technically sound, but I was pretty happy with it. It was good stuff for how inexperienced I was then.”"

rows.original: You note it must have been a steep learning curve making whole albums.
rows.translation: 你指出，学着制作整张专辑的过程肯定相当艰难。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou note it must have been a steep learning curve making whole albums."

rows.original: “Yeah, it was kinda fucked,” the dusky woman nods. “Writing lyrics for L-Pop in particular is kinda janky. The words need to flow and shit, or it’ll all just be gibberish.”
rows.translation: “对，当时挺他妈难搞的，”肤色黝黑的女子点点头。“尤其是给L-Pop写歌词，多少有点别扭。文字得顺畅押韵什么的，否则最后就全成胡言乱语了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, it was kinda fucked,” the dusky woman nods. “Writing lyrics for L-Pop in particular is kinda janky. The words need to flow and shit, or it’ll all just be gibberish.” "

rows.original: runs her fingers through her dark hair, scratching her scalp. “Pink does most of that stuff still, but I’m learning.”
rows.translation: 用手指梳过黑发，抓了抓头皮。“这些事现在还是大多由小粉来做，不过我正在学。”
rows.raw: " runs her fingers through her dark hair, scratching her scalp. “Pink does most of that stuff still, but I’m learning.”"

rows.translation: 阿里笑着朝你轻轻点头。“我没意见。你知道吗，阿里更像是个昵称。我的全名念起来有点拗口。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAri smiles, giving you a small nod. “Fine by me. You know, Ari is more of a nickname. My full name is kind of a mouthful.”"

rows.translation: 你狡黠地一笑。“愿意说说吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her a coy smile. “Up to sharing?”"

rows.raw: "\n\nGreen nods and gives you a small sigh. “Fair enough. Just don’t be a jerk and correct people that still call me Ari, okay?”"

rows.original: Thinking about it, the only one who seems to do that is Pink. Either way, you chuckle and nod a quick promise.

rows.raw: "\n\nThinking about it, the only one who seems to do that is Pink. Either way, you chuckle and nod a quick promise."

rows.original: Green
rows.raw: "Green"

rows.translation: 你问小绿，她为什么希望你改叫她阿里。

rows.translation: “因为那是我的名字，”矮个女子耸耸肩。“嗯，至少是名字的一部分...我知道小粉和小蓝都彻底接受了舞台身份那套东西，但我还在适应别人叫我‘小绿’。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Because it’s my name,” the short woman shrugs. “Well, a bit of it at least... Like, I know Pink and Blue really own the whole stage persona identity shit, but I’m still getting used to being called ‘Green’.”"

rows.original: “So you would like me to call you Ari?”
rows.translation: “所以你希望我叫你阿里？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you would like me to call you Ari?”"

But almost everybody calls me Green now.” The dusky woman sighs and drops her hand. “If you want to call me Green, it’s totally cool. I need to get used to it more anyways, so if you’re going to be nagging me every day anyways, it would help.”
rows.translation: 她思考片刻，尾巴在身后摆动。“嗯，对。不过现在几乎所有人都叫我小绿。”肤色黝黑的女子叹了口气，放下手。“你想叫我小绿也完全没问题。反正我得更习惯这个名字；既然你无论如何每天都要来烦我，那也会有点帮助。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe thinks for a moment, her tail swishing around behind her. “Well, yeah. I need to get used to it more anyways, so if you’re going to be nagging me every day anyways, it would help.”"

rows.raw: " chews at the corner of her mouth, contemplating in silence. “Like don’t get me wrong, she’s great. But it’s like she’s the galaxy’s biggest... eh... big sister I guess? I don’t know.”"

rows.translation: 察觉到一处破绽，你继续追问。“你为什么觉得自己会让她失望？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSensing a loose thread, you push the issue. “Why do you think you’d let her down?”"

rows.translation: 她顿了顿，脸上浮现忧虑之色。她把忧虑抛到一旁，继续说道。“因为她他妈超级有才华？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses, a concerned look on her face. She pushes it aside and continues. “Cause she’s super fucking talented?” "

rows.original: rolls her eyes, noticeably breaking eye contact. “Her singing voice is pitch perfect, and when I say perfect...” she points the side of her head, giving her long pointed ears a small wiggle. “I mean literally perfect. rows.raw: "\n\nRaising your brow, you catch a hold of something. “‘Shit she’s been through’? What does that mean?”"

rows.original: chews her lip again, considering the question. “I don’t wanna get into Pink’s shit too much... but she’s had a lot of bad luck with group mates in the past.” The small woman shifts in place, crossing her arms over her chest with her tail going limp behind her. “Like, between you and me?”
rows.translation: 又咬了咬嘴唇，思考这个问题。“我不想过多议论小粉的私事...不过她过去和组合成员相处时倒霉透了。”娇小女子换了个姿势，双臂抱胸，身后的尾巴也无力地垂下。“就你我之间说？”

rows.original: You nod, agreeing to the terms.
rows.translation: 你点点头，同意这个条件。

rows.original: Moving towards the half-naked ovir, you can tell she hasn’t noticed your approach, instead fiddling with a small codex. When you’re within a few feet away from her, you clear your throat and call to her. “Blue?” “Bah!” The sinfully curvy woman whips around wildly, nearly every part of the overly endowed woman bouncing or jiggling from the quick rotation. “Who the- [pc.name]?” She pulls her sunglasses down slightly. “Oh heck! [pc.name]!” Lunging forward, she seizes you, hugging you up with a strength that you didn’t think she possessed. Her massive tits press hard against your [var0|face|chest] as she squeezes you, breathing suddenly a labor. “I can’t believe you’re here!” Shifting around, you try to pry yourself from the purple woman’s grip, only for her to nuzzle her face lovingly against [var0|the top of your head|shoulder]. Deciding not to fight the shockingly strong woman, you instead return the hug the best you can despite your arms being pressed to your sides. After a minute she releases you, a strong current of air reaching your lungs as she springs back half a step. Fighting back a giggle, she beams a bright smile at you. “This is SO weird. I, like, never thought I’d see anybody I’d know way out here!”

rows.original: Smiling, Scully pulls off his heavy jacket, then turns and hands it to his younger daughter. “Put this away for daddy, please. Then wash up for dinner.” With a nod, Sata takes the jacket and hurries off, disappearing into a side hall. Returning his attention to you, the older Huskar sniffs the air. “I assume you’re staying for supper, yes? Oh, you’re in for a treat! Come, come. I can smell it’s almost done, and my wife is one hell of a cook!” Shepherding you through the doorway his wife exited before, you find yourself in a room just as big as the living room that serves as both a kitchen and eating area. Most of the room is dominated by a massive table, with what you quickly count as twenty seats positioned around it, although you note only seven settings are laid out. The far wall of the room looks dedicated to cooking, with a massive oven fired up and the most delicious smell wafting through the air. You also can’t miss the towering figure of Ori, who turns as the three of you enter. “Darling!” She prances over, her heavy chest bouncing. Coming up to her husband, she bends at the waist, nearly folding herself in half to give her comically shorter husband a kiss on the cheek. “I see you’ve met our dinner guest. Come, sit all of you! Dinner is just about ready.” Moving to the table, you find a place at one of the settings, [var0] parking herself on your right. Scully sits at the head of the table, towards your left, leaving one vacant seat beside you and three across. You notice one of the chairs, on Scully’s direct left, looks much larger and sits far lower than all the other chairs. “Shall I call the pups, dear?” Ori chimes, leaning down low to pull something from the oven. Swallowing hard, you find yourself staring at her huge rump. “I got it, love.” Scully puts a finger and thumb in his mouth, letting out a sharp whistle. Immediately you hear the sounds of footsteps up above, at least two sets if your hearing is correct. On your left, a scraping against the floor causes you to jump for the second time today. Looking over, you see Sata pulling back a chair, staring at you wide eyed as she climbs up and plops down. You find yourself in a mini staring contest with the young pup, as the footsteps draw closer. “Oh man, I’m stavi- Uh, who’s this?” You turn to find a slightly new face. You can quickly tell this is [var0]’s other sister. Taller than most of her family, except her mother of course, you’re fairly sure she’s also younger than [var0], the way she’s dressed screams teenaged girl. While not as big as her father, she’s slightly on the plump side, although her extra height allows her to carry the weight a bit better. One thing about her that really strikes you is her very prominent resting bitch face. Scully smiles, addressing this third daughter. “This is Ari’s boss, [pc.name]. They’ll be joining us for dinner this evening.” Turning to you, he gestures to the new arrival. “This lovely young woman is Inna, my second youngest... And that handsome young man sulking about is my son Gol.” Looking back, you note another family member entered the room, waddling more than walking. Around the same height as Inna but significantly fatter, Gol strikes you as something of an odd specimen. A thick mop of black hair covers most of his face, his clothes wrinkled and stained, with something about him telling you he just rolled out of bed. He must be the younger brother [var0] mentioned before, the one she only spoke of briefly and not favorably. “Can I eat in my room...” he murmurs, his voice sullen. “Gol, we’ve talked about this.” Ori chimes, not even looking over her shoulder at her son. “We eat together in this household.” “Uhhh,” the chunky half-breed sits down across from [var0], the chair creaking under his weight. Inna snorts, then takes a seat next to her brother, immediately pulling out a small codex, thumbs flying. “Not at the table, Inna.” Scully chides, smiling when his daughter huffs and stuffs it away. Ori sweeps in a moment later, laying down an absolutely massive platter of meat and steamed veggies on the table. Taking a seat herself, her chest half on the table, she clears her throat and smiles. “Dinner is served. Dig in!”
rows.translation: 斯卡利微笑着脱下厚重外套，转身交给小女儿。“请替爸爸把这个收好，然后洗手吃饭。” 萨塔点头接过外套，匆匆离开，消失在侧面走廊。 年长胡斯卡重新把注意力转向你，嗅了嗅空气。“我想你会留下来吃晚饭，对吧？哦，你可有口福了！来，来。我闻得出来，饭快做好了，我妻子的厨艺可是棒极了！” 他引着你穿过妻子先前离开的门口，你来到一个与客厅同样宽敞、兼作厨房和用餐区的房间。房间大部分空间被一张巨型餐桌占据；你迅速数出周围摆着二十把椅子，不过只有七个位置放了餐具。远处墙面似乎专用于烹饪，一台巨型烤箱正在运转，最诱人的香气飘散在空气中。你也不可能错过奥莉高耸的身影；你们三人进门时，她转过身。 “亲爱的！”她轻快地走来，沉重胸部不断弹跳。来到丈夫身旁，她从腰间弯下身，几乎把自己折成两半，在身高滑稽地矮于自己的丈夫脸颊上亲了一口。“看来你已经见过我们的晚餐客人了。来，你们都坐下！晚餐马上就好。” 你走向餐桌，在一套餐具前坐下，[var0]在你右侧落座。斯卡利坐在桌首，位于你左侧；你身旁空着一把椅子，对面则空着三把。你注意到斯卡利正左侧有把椅子远比其他椅子宽大，而且座位低得多。 “亲爱的，要我叫孩子们吗？”奥莉一边欢快说道，一边俯低身体从烤箱里拿东西。你艰难吞咽，发现自己正盯着她巨大的臀部。 “我来吧，宝贝。”斯卡利用一根手指和拇指伸进嘴里，吹出尖锐口哨。 你立刻听见楼上传来脚步声；如果听力没错，至少有两组。左侧椅子刮擦地板的声音令你今天第二次吓了一跳。你转头看见萨塔拉开椅子，睁大眼睛盯着你，随后爬上去坐下。你与这只小幼犬陷入一场迷你瞪眼比赛，而脚步声也越来越近。 “哦，天哪，我快饿——呃，这是谁？”你转身看见一张略微陌生的新面孔。 你很快就能看出这是[var0]的另一个姐妹。她比家里大多数人都高，当然母亲除外；你相当确定她也比[var0]年轻，因为穿着简直在大喊“少女”。她虽然不像父亲那么胖，却稍显丰满；不过额外的身高让她更能撑起这份体重。她最令你印象深刻的一点，是那张极其明显、天生就不耐烦的脸。 斯卡利微笑着向第三个女儿介绍。“这是阿莉的老板，[pc.name]。今晚会和我们一起吃饭。”他转向你，指着新来的人。“这位可爱的年轻女士是伊娜，我第二小的女儿...而那个闷闷不乐的英俊年轻人，是我儿子戈尔。” 你回头注意到另一个家庭成员已经走进房间；与其说他走路，不如说是摇摇摆摆。戈尔身高与伊娜相仿，却胖得多，看起来颇为奇特。一头浓密黑发遮住大半张脸，衣服皱皱巴巴、满是污渍，整个人都在告诉你他刚从床上爬起来。他肯定就是[var0]先前提过的弟弟；她只简略提了几句，而且毫无好话。“我能回房间吃吗...”他闷闷不乐地嘟囔。 “戈尔，我们谈过这件事。”奥莉欢快说道，甚至没回头看儿子。“这个家里的人要一起吃饭。” “呃——”丰满混血儿坐在[var0]对面，椅子在体重下嘎吱作响。 伊娜哼了一声，随后坐到哥哥身旁，立刻掏出一部小型数据库，双拇指飞速动作。 “餐桌上不许用，伊娜。”斯卡利责怪道；女儿气呼呼地把它塞回去，他露出微笑。 片刻后，奥莉轻快走来，把一个巨大得不可思议、盛满肉类与蒸蔬菜的餐盘放在桌上。她自己坐下，胸部有一半搁在桌面，清清嗓子微笑道：“晚餐好了。开动吧！”
rows.raw: " Smiling, Scully pulls off his heavy jacket, then turns and hands it to his younger daughter. “Put this away for daddy, please. Then wash up for dinner.” With a nod, Sata takes the jacket and hurries off, disappearing into a side hall. Returning his attention to you, the older Huskar sniffs the air. “I assume you’re staying for supper, yes? Oh, you’re in for a treat! Come, come. I can smell it’s almost done, and my wife is one hell of a cook!” Shepherding you through the doorway his wife exited before, you find yourself in a room just as big as the living room that serves as both a kitchen and eating area. Most of the room is dominated by a massive table, with what you quickly count as twenty seats positioned around it, although you note only seven settings are laid out. The far wall of the room looks dedicated to cooking, with a massive oven fired up and the most delicious smell wafting through the air. You also can’t miss the towering figure of Ori, who turns as the three of you enter. “Darling!” She prances over, her heavy chest bouncing. Coming up to her husband, she bends at the waist, nearly folding herself in half to give her comically shorter husband a kiss on the cheek. “I see you’ve met our dinner guest. Come, sit all of you! Dinner is just about ready.” Moving to the table, you find a place at one of the settings, [var0] parking herself on your right. Scully sits at the head of the table, towards your left, leaving one vacant seat beside you and three across. You notice one of the chairs, on Scully’s direct left, looks much larger and sits far lower than all the other chairs. “Shall I call the pups, dear?” Ori chimes, leaning down low to pull something from the oven. Swallowing hard, you find yourself staring at her huge rump. “I got it, love.” Scully puts a finger and thumb in his mouth, letting out a sharp whistle. Immediately you hear the sounds of footsteps up above, at least two sets if your hearing is correct. On your left, a scraping against the floor causes you to jump for the second time today. Looking over, you see Sata pulling back a chair, staring at you wide eyed as she climbs up and plops down. You find yourself in a mini staring contest with the young pup, as the footsteps draw closer. “Oh man, I’m stavi- Uh, who’s this?” You turn to find a slightly new face. You can quickly tell this is [var0]’s other sister. Taller than most of her family, except her mother of course, you’re fairly sure she’s also younger than [var0], the way she’s dressed screams teenaged girl. While not as big as her father, she’s slightly on the plump side, although her extra height allows her to carry the weight a bit better. One thing about her that really strikes you is her very prominent resting bitch face. Scully smiles, addressing this third daughter. “This is Ari’s boss, [pc.name]. They’ll be joining us for dinner this evening.” Turning to you, he gestures to the new arrival. “This lovely young woman is Inna, my second youngest... And that handsome young man sulking about is my son Gol.” Looking back, you note another family member entered the room, waddling more than walking. Around the same height as Inna but significantly fatter, Gol strikes you as something of an odd specimen. A thick mop of black hair covers most of his face, his clothes wrinkled and stained, with something about him telling you he just rolled out of bed. He must be the younger brother [var0] mentioned before, the one she only spoke of briefly and not favorably. “Can I eat in my room...” he murmurs, his voice sullen. “Gol, we’ve talked about this.” Ori chimes, not even looking over her shoulder at her son. “We eat together in this household.” “Uhhh,” the chunky half-breed sits down across from [var0], the chair creaking under his weight. Inna snorts, then takes a seat next to her brother, immediately pulling out a small codex, thumbs flying. “Not at the table, Inna.” Scully chides, smiling when his daughter huffs and stuffs it away. Ori sweeps in a moment later, laying down an absolutely massive platter of meat and steamed veggies on the table. Taking a seat herself, her chest half on the table, she clears her throat and smiles. “Dinner is served. Dig in!”"

rows.original:
As you work your way through the meal, you’re happy to say the food is some of the best you’ve had in a while. Trying not to overdo it, you pace yourself, fighting the urge to shovel it down.

		Glancing around the table, you gauge everyone’s progress.

		Gol is done already, having inhaled his food rather than chew it. He’s already asked to be excused twice, only to be rebuffed by his mother.

		Inna’s hands keep disappearing under the table, her codex clearly in her lap and the main focus of her attention.

		At first you think Ori’s barely touched her food, only to realize her portion size was nearly double everybody else’s.

		Scully’s progress is less impressive, the old Huskar spending a bit more time chewing than you think necessary.

		Sata, despite her father’s chiding, seems absolutely against eating her vegetables, a pile of them pushed to the side of her plate.

		[var0] has barely touched her food, aside from pushing it around her plate and popping the occasional morsel into her mouth.

		Although dinner’s been quiet so far, you can tell that’s about to change. Scully and Ori have been giving you quite a few looks, and maybe it’s best to beat them to the conversational punch.
rows.translation:
你吃着晚餐，高兴地发现这是最近一段时间吃过最美味的食物之一。你努力避免过量，控制进食速度，抵抗把食物铲进嘴里的冲动。

		你环视餐桌，观察每个人的进度。

		戈尔已经吃完了；与其说咀嚼，不如说是把食物吸了进去。他已经两次请求离席，都被母亲拒绝。

		伊娜的手不停消失在桌下，数据库显然放在腿上，才是她注意力的中心。

		起初你以为奥莉几乎没碰食物，后来才发现她那份差不多是其他人的两倍。

		斯卡利的进度没那么令人赞叹；这个年长胡斯卡花在咀嚼上的时间比你认为有必要的更久。

		萨塔尽管被父亲责怪，似乎仍坚决拒绝吃蔬菜，把它们堆到盘子一侧。

		[var0]几乎没碰食物，除了在盘子里推来推去，偶尔把一小口送进嘴里。

		尽管晚餐至今相当安静，你看得出这即将改变。斯卡利和奥莉已经看了你好几眼，也许最好抢在他们之前发起谈话。

rows.translation: 你低头看着孩子，没有回答她的问题。她一眨不眨地盯着你，持续了令人尴尬的很长时间。

rows.original: “Sata,” [var0] addresses her sister with perhaps the sweetest tone you’ve ever heard pass through her normally foul mouth. “This is [pc.name], my boss.” The tiny half-breed looks back and forth between the two of you, as if trying to understand the meaning of your connection. Cute as a button, she really looks like a mini [var0], just with longer hair. You also can’t help notice she still hasn’t blinked... The awkward moment is broken when the small child’s ears wiggle, sharply turning her head towards the door, her thick black tail wagging behind her slight frame. Next to you [var0] perks up, half lifting herself up off the couch also looking towards the door. Confused, and more than a little weirded out, you ask her what’s going on. “Daddy’s home.” Sata answers, her voice deadpan despite her tail’s enthusiasm. A second later the door opens, a cold wind blowing in and carrying with it a short, fat figure wearing just about the heaviest jacket you’re ever seen. Sata scampers over, her tail nearly knocking over a lamp, halting a foot away from the stout man as he moves in and closes the door. Pulling his hood back reveals him as a Huskar, slightly on the older side, with his beard and hair a dark gray. Noticing the tiny half-breed, he beams a wide smile then gives her thick hair a playful ruffle. “Hello sweet girl! Were you waiting for me!” Sata nods, then turns and points directly towards you and [var0]. Following his daughter’s finger, the old Huskar looks over, his smile widening. “And who’s this?” [var0] is up on her feet in an instant, dragging you up with her by your elbow. Half dragging you, she makes her way over to her snow-covered father, much to the stout man’s amusement. Standing next to him, you can tell he is quite short, maybe only three or four inches taller than [var0]. “Dad. This is [pc.name] Steele. My boss.” “Ohhh,” The Huskar nods, giving you a look over. “Well this is unexpected. Welcome! But unexpected.” Reaching out, he offers you his hand. “Scully Vargsmor. At your service!”
rows.translation: “萨塔，”[var0]用你从她平时那张脏嘴里听过最甜美的语气称呼妹妹。“这是[pc.name]，我的老板。” 娇小混血儿来回看着你们，仿佛试图理解你们关系的含义。她可爱得像颗纽扣，确实像迷你版[var0]，只是头发更长。你也忍不住注意到，她仍然没有眨眼... 小孩的耳朵忽然抖动，猛然转头望向门口，粗壮黑尾巴在纤细身后摇动，打破了尴尬时刻。身旁的[var0]也振作起来，半站离沙发，同样望向门口。 你既困惑又颇感古怪，询问她发生了什么。 “爸爸回来了。”萨塔平淡回答，尽管她的尾巴热情无比。 一秒后房门打开，冷风吹进屋内，同时带来一个矮胖身影，穿着你见过几乎最厚重的外套。萨塔飞奔过去，尾巴差点撞倒一盏灯；矮壮男人进门关门时，她在一英尺外停下。他拉下兜帽，露出胡斯卡身份，年纪略大，胡须与头发都是深灰色。他注意到娇小混血儿，露出灿烂笑容，顽皮地揉乱她浓密头发。“你好，甜心！你一直在等我吗！” 萨塔点头，随后转身直接指向你和[var0]。年长胡斯卡顺着女儿手指望来，笑容变得更加灿烂。“这位是谁？” [var0]瞬间站起，抓住你的手肘把你也拖起来。她半拖着你走向满身是雪的父亲，令矮壮男人颇感有趣。你站到他身旁，看得出他相当矮，也许只比[var0]高三四英寸。“爸，这是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。我的老板。” “哦——”胡斯卡点头，上下打量你。“这真出乎意料。欢迎！不过确实出乎意料。”他伸出手。“斯卡利·瓦格斯莫尔。随时效劳！”

rows.original:
You can’t help yourself. Eyes fixed firmly on her tits, you bask in their light. The titanic twin orbs extend well over two feet out from the rest of her, expanding out so wide you can’t properly see her shoulders. Due to her height, you can’t even begin to guess her cup size. Even so, they still look massive on her big frame.

		After a moment, you shake yourself to attention, feeling [var0] burning a hole in the back of your head.
rows.translation:
你无法控制自己。双眼牢牢盯着她的乳房，沐浴在它们的光辉中。这对巨型圆球从她身体其余部分向前伸出两英尺有余，横向扩展得如此宽阔，让你根本看不清她的肩膀。她身材高大，你甚至无法开始猜测罩杯尺寸。即便如此，它们放在她庞大身躯上仍显得无比巨大。

		片刻后，你猛然回神，感觉[var0]的目光快把后脑勺烧穿。

The titanic twin orbs extend well over two feet out from the rest of her, expanding out so wide you can’t properly see her shoulders. Due to her height, you can’t even begin to guess her cup size. Even so, they still look massive on her big frame.\n\n\t\tAfter a moment, you shake yourself to attention, feeling [var0] burning a hole in the back of your head."

rows.original: Quickly, you lift your gaze up to her eyes, trying your best to focus on them instead of her massive mommy milkers. They are, not really to your surprise, the exact same neon green as [var0]’s, although much, much larger.
rows.translation: 你迅速把目光抬到她眼睛上，竭力专注于那里，而不是她巨大的妈妈奶器。并不出乎意料，那双眼睛与[var0]完全一样，呈霓虹绿色，只是大得多。

rows.original: “Hi,” You clear your throat, focusing. “I’m [pc.name] Steele.” “Oooo,” the massive woman moves closer, her chest jiggling with each step. “Ari’s told me so much about you! I’m Orinne, but call me Ori. Or Mom! Everybody else does in this house, after all.” She lifts her hand to her lips to cover a giggle. “Ugh, Ma...” [var0] moves in front of you, holding [var1|the spice|something] in her hands. “Don’t be weird.” She hands it over to her mother. “Please?” Looking back and forth between the two, you definitely see a resemblance, even with the massive differences in height and bust size. “Oh, alright.” She smiles down at her daughter before turning her attention back to you. “Are you joining us for supper?” “I am.” You turn to [var0], mostly just to avoid looking at Ori’s chest. “Oh wonderful! More mouths are always welcome in this house! I always make way too much... Come! Sit! Make yourself at home.” Placing a large, but surprisingly soft, hand on your shoulder, she guides you towards the couches. [pc.isTaur|Finding one you can fit on,|Taking a seat,] [var0] moves in and parks herself right next to you. “We’ll be eating soon. I’d love to sit and visit, but I’ve got to tend to the roast,” Ori starts to glide away, the massive woman insanely light on her feet. “But we’ll have tons of time to talk over dinner! So much to talk about!” You watch her turn and leave, catching sight of her very large behind wiggle as she walks, only for a sharp elbow to jab you in the ribs to pull you to attention. “What did I say?” [var0] growls, her voice low. “What?” You protest, adding that she never said anything about checking out her butt. “Ha. Ha.” The halfbreed shifts slightly closer, maybe too close, with her shoulder and rump brushing up against you. “Just remember: keep the conversation off of me. I don’t care what the fuck you talk about, just leave me out of it.” As you nod in understanding, a very soft voice speaks off to your side. “Are you Ari’s [pc.boyGirl]friend?” Jolting from surprise, you turn to face what looks like a mini [var0] standing just to your right, barely biting back an expletive when you realize she’s a child. Obviously one of your companion’s sisters, the mini [var0] looks up with huge, neon green eyes.

rows.original: “Fuck yeah, you’re the best.” [var0] lets out a sigh of relief. “Alright well, let’s get going, but a few things...” She turns and starts to walk, motioning for you to follow. “First, and maybe I should have led with this, but it’s not just my parents. Two of my sisters and my little brother are kicking around the house. Thank fuck it’s just them, because if the whole family was home I’d have blown my brains out already.” You’re sure she’s being overly dramatic. Pretty sure at least. “Second: Don’t stare at my mom’s tits.” You promise nothing. “Third, and this is the most fucking important part, we are NOT fucking. You understand me?” She turns slightly, her nostrils flaring. “Last thing I need is my parents knowing, or even thinking, I’m fucking my boss.” Considering the final point, [var0] turns towards a house and makes her way up the path towards it. Your first impression is the house is noticeably bigger than all of the others in the area. Not nicer, per say, just bigger. Following [var0] to the front door, you ready yourself. “I’m home!” [var0] calls, stepping through the threshold. “And I brought a...” she looks at you for a moment and shrugs. “Er... My boss...” Walking inside, you feel like you’ve stepped into another world. The first word that pops into your mind is ‘cozy’, but instead settle on ‘warm’. The entryway leads directly into what looks like a living room, the space dominated by a massive fireplace on the far wall. Furs cover the furniture, floors, and even some of the walls. Moving into the room proper, it looks like there’s enough seating for at least a dozen people, with around four couches positioned near the fire. Many framed pictures, both holo and classic, adorn the walls, mantle, and just about every surface. A tap on your shoulder pulls your attention. Turning to face [var0], you see she’s stripped off her layers, although she’s still covered up more than usual, donning a light sweater and fuzzy pants. “Remember, don’t look at her-” A voice turns your attention away from [var0]. “Oh my! Did I hear that right?” You turn to see a massive woman entering the room. A dzaan. You very quickly understand why the house is bigger than others in the neighborhood. Towering, even by her species’ standards, you eyeball her to be well over eight feet tall, but your attention quickly turns to her humongous chest. “Oh hello there!”

rows.original: It takes a few minutes to catch your breath, then another couple to peel yourself off the floor. [var0] slumps down on one of the couches, still quite naked. As you collect your gear she muses aloud. “Fuck, they may not have heard us, but if anybody comes down they’ll certainly fucking smell us.” You sniff the air. The whole room reeks of sex, and you have a feeling that might not change even if you leave based on what looks like a stain on the carpet. “I’ll clean up a bit,” she sighs, wiping her brow. “You should get going though. Just in case.” “In case?” You ask, cocking a brow. “Well,” the dark haired woman scratches her chin. “It is laundry day...” You toss a glance at the washing machine behind you. “So you mean we could have been caught anytime?” Waving it off, [var0] shrugs. “I made sure we’d have enough time. rows.original: “Mmm,” she sniffs. “Not bad, for an establishment of this order. Nastizia Lusch en Romavia, daughter of the Felucia Lusch en Romavia, at your service.” Her hand falls upon your forearm, trails a tickling path up to your hand; she bends forward ever so slightly to do it, gives you the faintest glimpse down her gown; soft, alabaster intimacy. Her smile is warm and wicked. “It’s a pleasure to meet you, [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: “嗯，”她轻哼。“以这种档次的场所而言，不算差。娜斯蒂齐娅·卢施·恩·罗马维亚，那位菲露西亚·卢施·恩·罗马维亚之女，听候差遣。”她的手落在你前臂上，沿着令人发痒的路线滑向手掌；为此，她微微向前俯身，让你得以从礼服领口向下窥见最细微的一眼，柔软而雪白的私密景象。她的笑容温暖而邪恶。“很高兴认识你，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”

Nastizia Lusch en Romavia, daughter of the Felucia Lusch en Romavia, at your service.” Her hand falls upon your forearm, trails a tickling path up to your hand; she bends forward ever so slightly to do it, gives you the faintest glimpse down her gown; soft, alabaster intimacy. Her smile is warm and wicked. “It’s a pleasure to meet you, [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: We come from Tenevo - we are Tenevo really. Its history, its architecture, its cuisine, its culture. You haven’t been? Oh you must darling, I shall get you on our next river cruise when I go back, it is quite the most beautiful place in the galaxy. My great grandmothers used to rule the place, really I mean, back in their day. That’s all in the past though - one must move with the times. We are now the Tenevan Royal Bank, and my aunt is merely the Cate of Sis Marcella.” She pauses to sip her cocktail.
rows.translation: 我们来自特内沃，实际上我们就是特内沃。它的历史、建筑、菜肴与文化。你没去过？哦，亲爱的，你一定要去；下次回去时，我要让你登上我们的游河船，那简直是银河里最美丽的地方。我的曾祖母们曾统治那里，我是说真的，在她们那个时代。不过那全都过去了，人必须与时俱进。我们如今是特内沃皇家银行，而我的姨母也不过是西斯·玛切拉的凯特。”她停下来啜饮鸡尾酒。

My great grandmothers used to rule the place, really I mean, back in their day. That’s all in the past though - one must move with the times. We are now the Tenevan Royal Bank, and my aunt is merely the Cate of Sis Marcella.” She pauses to sip her cocktail."

rows.original: “So you’re an heir to some sort of throne?”

rows.original: “Oh my, noooo!” Nastizia flourishes that musical laughter again, upon which so much sophistication and naughtiness seems to ride. “I’m a nobody really darling, that’s the truth. The youngest of the youngest princess? Nooo, all I was born to do was have fun, nothing more! To spring from tree to tree, to dance and make my people laugh, clap and sigh.” She sighs herself, swirling the fizzing cocktail with its pick, blue eyes peering at you over the rim. “That’s what I thought until recently, anyway.”
rows.translation: “哦，天哪，不是！”娜斯蒂齐娅再次发出音乐般的笑声，其中承载着如此丰富的优雅与顽皮。“亲爱的，我其实是个无名小卒，这才是真相。最小那位公主最小的女儿？不，我出生后要做的只有享乐，除此之外什么都没有！从一棵树跳到另一棵树，跳舞，让我的人民欢笑、鼓掌和叹息。”她自己也叹了口气，用酒签搅动冒泡的鸡尾酒，蓝眼越过杯沿凝视你。“不管怎么说，直到最近我都这么认为。”

To experience the excitement close at hand! Being a princess can be ever so tiresome darling, one has to wriggle free of mama and papa’s clutches if one is to live a little.
rows.translation: <i>“那件事结束后，嗯，人家反正已经来到这里，而且这种开拓潮之类的事情每两百年才发生一次，不是吗？我想亲眼看看银河运转！近距离体验这种刺激！当公主实在太累了，亲爱的，如果想稍微享受人生，人家就必须从妈妈和爸爸的掌控下扭脱出来。

rows.original: “To be in the nitty gritty - to see the common folk at the nano-filament edge of life, intent on fortune, creating the stories and worlds of the future - oh, it makes my heart race, dear Steele.” The manicured hand lands on her chest, just north of the swell of her bosom. “It’s so real. So sexual.”
rows.translation: “置身于真正的琐碎细节中，看到平民站在生活的纳米纤维刀锋上，一心追逐财富、创造未来的故事与世界，哦，亲爱的斯蒂尔，这让人家心跳加速。”修饰精美的手落在胸前，正好位于乳房隆起上方。“这一切太真实了。太性感了。”

rows.original: “Oh, mama insisted upon a security detail whilst I’m out and about here on Tavros,” the kaithrit says, when she sees you looking. She straightens her back and puts on a withering, older tone, hand to her throat. “You may wish to carry on as if there weren’t ransomers and other ne’er-do-wells around every corner Nastizia, but I’m afraid I will insist on looking out for you! Particularly now. And I happen to know one or two wallahs in the Peacekeeper executive branch, I’ll make sure they assign you the best.”
rows.translation: “哦，妈妈坚持让我在塔夫罗斯外出活动时带上安保人员，”凯斯里特看见你注视便说道。她挺直后背，手按喉咙，摆出衰老而尖刻的腔调。“娜斯蒂齐娅，你也许想当每个角落都没有绑匪和其他恶棍般继续生活，但恐怕我必须坚持照看你！尤其是现在。而且我碰巧认识维和人员行政部门的一两个家伙，会确保他们把最优秀的人派给你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, mama insisted upon a security detail whilst I’m out and about here on Tavros,” the kaithrit says, when she sees you looking. She straightens her back and puts on a withering, older tone, hand to her throat. “You may wish to carry on as if there weren’t ransomers and other ne’er-do-wells around every corner Nastizia, but I’m afraid I will insist on looking out for you! Particularly now. And I happen to know one or two wallahs in the Peacekeeper executive branch, I’ll make sure they assign you the best.”"

rows.original: “That’s right, Steele. The best.” Riya smirks at you. You glare daggers in response. “Maybe you thought you got rid of me when you pissed your pants and ran to Mommy Grence the second somebody said a mean word to you? Real talent can’t be wished away. You should learn that.”
rows.translation: “没错，斯蒂尔。最优秀的。”莉娅朝你坏笑。你以刀锋般的怒视回应。“也许当有人对你说句难听的话，你就尿裤子跑去找格伦斯妈妈时，还以为已经摆脱我了？真正的才华无法靠许愿消失。你应该学会这一点。”

rows.original: “But enough about me,” Nastizia says abruptly. Her cocktail glass is almost empty, and there are bright spots of red on her alabaster cheeks. Her eyes shine. “Tell me about you. Tell me about some of the marvellous adventures you’ve had out here on the frontier dear Steele, fill my ears with them! You must, I demand it.”
rows.translation: “不过我的事说够了，”娜斯蒂齐娅突然说道。她的鸡尾酒杯几乎已经空了，雪白脸颊上浮现鲜亮红斑。她双眼闪闪发光。“谈谈你吧。告诉我你在边疆经历过的精彩冒险，亲爱的斯蒂尔，让人家大饱耳福！你必须说，这是命令。”

Tell me about some of the marvellous adventures you’ve had out here on the frontier dear Steele, fill my ears with them! You must, I demand it.”"

rows.original: You can oblige, better than anyone here, though she is surrounded by friends, sycophants and barflies drawn to her luminescence, all of whom seek to draw her away to dance, drink and try and impress. If she’s not a princess, she has the graces of one: to each the white kaithrit bestows laughter and cheer, whilst skillfully evading the clutches of one after the other. If someone displeases her they are gone, blown away, some forbidden technique of etiquette and movement that means she can never be reached by them again. One ausar pup, driven to madness by your own largesse, buys her another Uvetan Sunrise; she thanks him, strokes his cheek, whispers in his floppy ear and never says another word to him. He stumbles away, looking less like he blew two weeks’ wages on nothing and more as if he had been struck by a star.
rows.translation: 你可以满足她，而且比这里任何人都更有资格，尽管她被朋友、谄媚者和受到光彩吸引的酒吧常客包围，每个人都想把她拉去跳舞、喝酒，并试图给她留下印象。如果她不是公主，也拥有公主般的风度：白毛凯斯里特向每个人赐予欢笑与欢乐，同时巧妙躲开一个又一个人的纠缠。若有人惹她不快，那人便彻底出局、被吹走；她运用某种礼仪与动作的禁忌技巧，让他们再也无法接近自己。一只因你的慷慨而疯狂的奥萨幼犬给她又买了一杯乌维托日出；她向他道谢，抚摸他的脸颊，在下垂的耳边低语，此后再也没有对他说过一句话。他踉跄着离开，看起来不像白白浪费了两周工资，反倒像被一颗星星击中。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can oblige, better than anyone here, though she is surrounded by friends, sycophants and barflies drawn to her luminescence, all of whom seek to draw her away to dance, drink and try and impress. If she’s not a princess, she has the graces of one: to each the white kaithrit bestows laughter and cheer, whilst skillfully evading the clutches of one after the other. If someone displeases her they are gone, blown away, some forbidden technique of etiquette and movement that means she can never be reached by them again. One ausar pup, driven to madness by your own largesse, buys her another Uvetan Sunrise; she thanks him, strokes his cheek, whispers in his floppy ear and never says another word to him. He stumbles away, looking less like he blew two weeks’ wages on nothing and more as if he had been struck by a star."

rows.original: Throughout it all Riya watches from the bar, not drinking, her only action cords tightening in her neck when one of the locals gets slightly too handsy - and that seems to be enough to defuse matters each time.
rows.translation: 在整个过程中，莉娅都从吧台处注视着，没有喝酒；每当某个当地人稍微过于动手动脚时，她唯一的动作就是颈部筋络绷紧，而这似乎每次都足以化解事态。
rows.raw: "\n\nThroughout it all Riya watches from the bar, not drinking, her only action cords tightening in her neck when one of the locals gets slightly too handsy - and that seems to be enough to defuse matters each time."

rows.original: “Dear Hortenze’s death... it’s changed things.” The toes climb, rubbing gently, but her tone remains calmly musing, blue eyes fixed on your face. “She was the next in line to the title of Cate of the Romavians. With her gone, theeeeerrrrre... aren’t any other females of breeding age in my family. Traditionally, that’s who it’s supposed to default to. Traditionally.”
rows.translation: “亲爱的霍滕泽之死...改变了一些事情。”脚趾向上攀爬，轻柔摩擦，可她的语气依旧平静沉思，蓝眼睛牢牢注视你的脸。“她原本是罗马维安家族‘凯特’头衔的下一顺位继承人。她不在后，我家族里就再——也——没...有其他处于生育年龄的女性了。按照传统，头衔本该顺延到这样的人身上。按照传统。”

rows.original: “Of course, one would have to prove one’s, umm... fruitfulness. One cannot be the matriarch of a royal kaithrit clan if she cannot bear offspring and show some responsibility to it, instead of being the silly, carefree little chit one is assumed to be.” Up and down, down and up, goes that grazing toe. “But of course if one was to do that, one would have to find a suitable mate... the heir of a famous business magnate, perhaps. A rugged adventurer one could show off to mama and papa. But one wonders if they’re up to that task...”
rows.translation: “当然，一个人得证明自己的，嗯...生育能力。如果无法生下后代并表现出对后代的责任感，而只被视作一个愚蠢、无忧无虑的小丫头，那就不可能成为凯斯瑞特王族氏族的女家长。”那只轻蹭的脚趾上下往复，来来回回。“不过，一个人如果要这样做，当然就得找个合适的配偶...譬如一位著名商业巨头的继承人。一个可以带去向爸爸妈妈炫耀的粗犷冒险家。只是不知道对方能不能胜任这项任务...”

rows.original: “Listen, kitten...” Riya turns from the crowd to look at the kaithrit side-on, displaying her tall, brawny body, her full breasts, the hefty package she’s sporting in her breaches. Her tight uniform creaks slightly. The human talks with the casual menace of a born cop, blood red intent and ardor coursing underneath her calm words. “You want knocking up? rows.original: Nastizia is lounging upon a black settee in the spacious living room you are ushered, a glass of wine on the table of floating marble in front of her, a feline in a sunbeam. In substance the rooms of this place have the sterile, anodyne good taste of any expensive hotel. However, royal effort has gone into personalizing them. Above an honest-to-goodness open fireplace an oil portrait of what you assume is a high-ranking member of the Romavian family hangs; felt, gilded chairs are arranged around the floating coffee table; in front of it the scaly pelt of a green-and-yellow striped predator is lain; lush tropical plants hang from baskets and sit on ledges. Through into the dining room, impressive holographic and sound work produce a facsimile of a Tenevan villa, open to warm sunlight, a lake and tall, tree-covered hills. On the table a small, traditional kaithrit feast is laid.

rows.translation: 这个梳着发髻的凝胶女人有着令人愉悦的梨形身材，相对含蓄的葡萄柚大小乳房，在尺寸上无法与髋部和臀部无尽的曲线竞争；后两者催眠般隆起，撑开她黑色及膝裙。在空荡客厅里，她给你端来一杯罗尚茶，随后坐到身旁，双手攥紧围裙，带着近似敬畏的神情朝你眨眼。她身上散发的金银花气味十分浓烈；热意与硬挺势不可挡地攀进你的胯间，而她坐得如此靠近，更让这种感觉越发强烈。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe bun-haired gel woman is pleasantly pear-shaped, her relatively modest grapefruit-sized breasts not competing in size with the endless curves of her hips and bottom, hypnotically swelling and stretching her black, knee-length skirt. In the empty living room, she fetches you some Roshan tea then sits down next to you, hands scrunched into her apron, blinking at you with something akin to awe. The smell of honeysuckle coming off her is strong; heat and hardness clamber unstoppably into your groin, made all the more powerful by how close she’s sitting to you. "

rows.original: Rahn
rows.raw: "Rahn"

rows.original: Don’t the purple rahn give off particularly powerful pheromones? You’re pretty sure you read that somewhere.
rows.translation: 紫色拉恩人不是会散发格外强烈的信息素吗？你相当确定自己在哪里读到过。
rows.raw: "Don’t the purple rahn give off particularly powerful pheromones? You’re pretty sure you read that somewhere."

rows.original: “Mademoiselle is, how you say, many demanding,” Jhoi says. “If I may so,
rows.translation: “小姐，怎么说，非常多要求，”茹瓦说道。“如果我可以这样说，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mademoiselle is, how you say, many demanding,” Jhoi says. “If I may so, "

rows.original: Monsieur
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Monsieur"

rows.original: Madame
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Madame"

rows.original: Steele... I think she treats you very badly. Oui! I will say it! The way she talks of you... as if you were nothing but a toy. This is no way to treat such a person of celebrity.”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔...我觉得她对您非常不好。是的！我要说出来！她谈起您的方式...仿佛您只是一件玩具。这样对待一位如此知名的人物，实在不应该。”
rows.raw: " Steele... I think she treats you very badly. Oui! I will say it! The way she talks of you... as if you were nothing but a toy. This is no way to treat such a person of celebrity.”"

rows.original: She knows about you?
rows.translation: 她知道你的事？
rows.raw: "\n\nShe knows about you?"

rows.original: “Of course!” She giggles self-consciously, playing with her apron. “You are all over the extranet, your adventures - your father. I thought maybe you were a fantasy until Mademoiselle brought you here for first time. It is said you have rescued slaves and conquered planets. That you are a fantastic lover...”
rows.translation: “当然！”她有些不好意思地咯咯笑着，摆弄自己的围裙。“整个外部网络都是您的消息，您的冒险——还有您的父亲。小姐第一次带您来这里之前，我还以为您或许只是个幻想。听说您解救过奴隶，征服过星球。还说您是一位绝妙的情人...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course!” She giggles self-consciously, playing with her apron. “You are all over the extranet, your adventures - your father. I thought maybe you were a fantasy until Mademoiselle brought you here for first time. It is said you have rescued slaves and conquered planets. That you are a fantastic lover...”"

rows.original: The starchy material of her outfit creaks. Dark eyes look deep into yours.
rows.translation: 她服装的硬挺布料吱嘎作响。深色眼眸直直望进你的眼睛。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe starchy material of her outfit creaks. Dark eyes look deep into yours."

rows.original: Monsieur
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Monsieur"

rows.original: Madame
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Madame"

rows.original: Steele,” she murmurs, “both of us, we are driven distracted by the same person. And you know she is, how you say, putting on your lead? She doesn’t mean truly to have your children I don’t think. Oh, show me what she’s missing. Right here, where she usually sits. I can tell you are frustrated. How you’d like that...”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔，”她低声说道，“我们两人都被同一个人折磨得心神不宁。而且您知道，她正在，怎么说，给您套缰绳？我认为她并不是真的想要您的孩子。哦，让我看看她错过了什么。就在这里，在她平常坐的位置。我看得出您很不满。您会多么喜欢这样...”
rows.raw: " Steele,” she murmurs, “both of us, we are driven distracted by the same person. And you know she is, how you say, putting on your lead? She doesn’t mean truly to have your children I don’t think. Oh, show me what she’s missing. Right here, where she usually sits. I can tell you are frustrated. How you’d like that...”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Fuck her
rows.translation: 操她
rows.raw: "Fuck her"

rows.original: Decline
rows.translation: 拒绝
rows.raw: "Decline"

rows.original: You check the clock on your codex for what seems like the twentieth time today as you approach the Romavian estate. Your heart suddenly lurches. What if she meant the time on Tenevo or something? But no, thank Void, here comes the princess herself, hurrying lightly down the driveway to haul open the gates.
rows.translation: 今天你接近罗马维安庄园时，似乎已经第二十次查看终端上的时钟。你的心脏突然一沉。要是她指的是特内沃时间什么的呢？但没有，感谢虚空，公主本人正轻快地沿车道匆匆赶来，拉开大门。
rows.raw: "You check the clock on your codex for what seems like the twentieth time today as you approach the Romavian estate. Your heart suddenly lurches. What if she meant the time on Tenevo or something? But no, thank Void, here comes the princess herself, hurrying lightly down the driveway to haul open the gates."

rows.original: “Steeeele. My clever [pc.boy],” she purrs, taking hold of both of your hands and leading you inwards. “It was foolish of one to even think you’d fail this test, wasn’t it? You hang upon every word I send you.”
rows.translation: “斯蒂——尔。我聪明的[pc.boy]，”她呼噜着，握住你的双手，把你领向里面。“一个人居然曾经想过你会通不过这场考验，实在太愚蠢了，对吧？我发给你的每一个字，你都看得无比认真。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steeeele. My clever [pc.boy],” she purrs, taking hold of both of your hands and leading you inwards. “It was foolish of one to even think you’d fail this test, wasn’t it? You hang upon every word I send you.”"

rows.original: Riya looms beyond her, looking enjoyably irked.
rows.translation: 莉娅高大的身影就在她后面，看起来恼火得令人愉快。
rows.raw: "\n\nRiya looms beyond her, looking enjoyably irked."

rows.original: “[pc.He] had it way easier,” she complains. “I was supposed to notice your breakfast order was different? That’s bullshit.”
rows.translation: “[pc.He]的题简单多了，”她抱怨道。“我本该注意到你的早餐点单不一样？这太扯了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.He] had it way easier,” she complains. “I was supposed to notice your breakfast order was different? That’s bullshit.”"

rows.original: “You are the bodyguard to an heir of the Romavian throne, you overgrown ape!” Nastizia swishes a pale hand at Riya with magisterial contempt. “The slightest difference in my routine, the faintest suspicion of sabotage or subversion, should have you speeding to find the culprit. You have lost to darling Steele fair and square.”
rows.translation: “你是罗马维安王位继承人的保镖，你这只长过头的猿猴！”娜斯蒂茜娅带着威严的蔑视向莉娅挥了挥苍白的手。“我的日常惯例哪怕出现最细微的差异，哪怕只有最微弱的破坏或颠覆嫌疑，你都该飞奔着去找出罪魁祸首。你已经堂堂正正地输给亲爱的斯蒂尔了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are the bodyguard to an heir of the Romavian throne, you overgrown ape!” Nastizia swishes a pale hand at Riya with magisterial contempt. “The slightest difference in my routine, the faintest suspicion of sabotage or subversion, should have you speeding to find the culprit. You have lost to darling Steele fair and square.”"

rows.original: She walks back up the steps. The expression she throws over her shoulder to you is sultry.
rows.translation: 她走回台阶上，越过肩膀投向你的神情妩媚诱人。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe walks back up the steps. The expression she throws over her shoulder to you is sultry."

rows.original: “Now. Let’s retire somewhere private and dish out reward and penalty, shall we?”
rows.translation: “现在。我们去一个私密地方，发放奖励和惩罚，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now. Let’s retire somewhere private and dish out reward and penalty, shall we?”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_PC_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_PC_WINS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You [pc.move] up to the security buzzer to the side of the gate, press it, announce that once again, [pc.name] Steele is here upon invitation.
rows.translation: 你[pc.move]到大门旁的安保门铃前，按下按钮，宣布[pc.name] Steele又一次应邀前来。
rows.raw: "You [pc.move] up to the security buzzer to the side of the gate, press it, announce that once again, [pc.name] Steele is here upon invitation."

rows.original: As usual, Riya arrives to open the gate. But when you move to enter the estate you find yourself walking face-first into her
rows.translation: 和往常一样，莉娅前来开门。可当你准备走进庄园时，却发现自己一头撞上了她的
rows.raw: "\n\nAs usual, Riya arrives to open the gate. But when you move to enter the estate you find yourself walking face-first into her "

rows.original: own face.
rows.translation: 脸。
rows.raw: "own face."

rows.original: chest.
rows.translation: 胸膛。
rows.raw: "chest."

rows.original: abs.
rows.translation: 腹肌。
rows.raw: "abs."

rows.original: groin.
rows.translation: 胯间。
rows.raw: "groin."

rows.original: “Where do you think you’re going, champ?” she smirks, leaning against the gatepost. “This isn’t the time you were told to show up.” She nods at the pocket containing your codex. “Go ahead. Check.”
rows.translation: “你以为自己要去哪儿，冠军？”她靠着门柱坏笑。“现在可不是让你到场的时间。”她朝你装着终端的口袋点点头。“来吧。检查一下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Where do you think you’re going, champ?” she smirks, leaning against the gatepost. “This isn’t the time you were told to show up.” She nods at the pocket containing your codex. “Go ahead. Check.”"

rows.original: You grab your device and check the most recent invitation you were sent.
rows.translation: 你拿出设备，查看最近收到的那封邀请。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grab your device and check the most recent invitation you were sent."

rows.original: Another Cordial Invitation
rows.translation: 又一封诚挚邀请
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother Cordial Invitation"

rows.original: From: nastinice@MegMess.org
rows.translation: 发件人：nastinice@MegMess.org
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom: nastinice@MegMess.org"

rows.original: To: [pc.name] Steele <@SteeleTech.corp>
rows.translation: 收件人：[pc.name] Steele <@SteeleTech.corp>
rows.raw: "\nTo: [pc.name] Steele <@SteeleTech.corp>"

rows.original: To the honorable [pc.name] Steele esq.,
rows.translation: 致尊敬的[pc.name] Steele阁下：
rows.raw: "\n\nTo the honorable [pc.name] Steele esq.,"

rows.original: Hello darling! It’s me, your favorite princess. I got to wondering if you were still being a good [pc.boy] and reading these things properly, and decided a rum challenge would be finding out. So the time you have to arrive at my place tonight is seventeen hours. On the dot, you understand? Manage that, and you shall win the challenge automatically. I’m giving this one away to you dear, all I’m asking of you is an attention span. That’s how much I want you to win!
rows.translation: 你好，亲爱的！是我，你最喜欢的公主。我开始好奇，你是不是依然是个听话的[pc.boy]，有没有认真阅读这些内容，于是决定设计一项朗姆酒般有趣的挑战来验证一下。所以你今晚必须在十七时抵达我的住所。必须分秒不差，明白吗？做到这一点，你就会自动赢下挑战。这一轮我简直是在白送给你，亲爱的，我只要求你保持一点注意力。这正说明我有多希望你赢！
rows.raw: "\n\nHello darling! It’s me, your favorite princess. I got to wondering if you were still being a good [pc.boy] and reading these things properly, and decided a rum challenge would be finding out. So the time you have to arrive at my place tonight is seventeen hours. On the dot, you understand? Manage that, and you shall win the challenge automatically. I’m giving this one away to you dear, all I’m asking of you is an attention span. That’s how much I want you to win!"

rows.original: Yours faithfully,
rows.translation: 您忠诚的，
rows.raw: "\n\nYours faithfully,"

rows.original: 1st Sc. Marvo Fauntilio
rows.translation: 第一秘书马尔沃·方蒂利奥
rows.raw: "\n\n1st Sc. Marvo Fauntilio"

rows.original: “I am most disappointed, Steele dear.” You can only stare beseechingly at Nastizia as she descends the front door steps beyond Riya, gazing at you glacially. “My invitations are not circulars, and the word of the heir apparent to the Romavian throne is not to be glibly assumed! You have lost this round, and failed to even amuse me in so doing.”
rows.translation: “我非常失望，亲爱的斯蒂尔。”娜斯蒂茜娅从莉娅身后的前门台阶走下，冷若冰霜地注视你，而你只能哀求般回望她。“我的邀请函不是传单，罗马维安王位推定继承人的话也不容你轻率猜测！你输掉了这一轮，而且输得甚至没能逗我开心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am most disappointed, Steele dear.” You can only stare beseechingly at Nastizia as she descends the front door steps beyond Riya, gazing at you glacially. “My invitations are not circulars, and the word of the heir apparent to the Romavian throne is not to be glibly assumed! You have lost this round, and failed to even amuse me in so doing.”"

rows.original: “Shall I turf this fool to the curb, kitten?” asks Riya, cracking her knuckles.
rows.translation: “要我把这个蠢货扔到路边吗，小猫咪？”莉娅捏得指节咔咔作响，问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shall I turf this fool to the curb, kitten?” asks Riya, cracking her knuckles."

rows.original: “Oh no.” The dazzlingly beautiful kaithrit gestures with a smirk, turning back towards the manor. “[pc.He] can still, and will, amuse me. Come come: I do believe it’s time to levy out prizes and forfeits.”
rows.translation: “哦，不。”光彩照人的凯斯里特美女坏笑着做了个手势，转身走向庄园。“[pc.He]仍然能、也将会取悦我。来吧来吧：我相信该发放奖品、执行惩罚了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh no.” The dazzlingly beautiful kaithrit gestures with a smirk, turning back towards the manor. “[pc.He] can still, and will, amuse me. Come come: I do believe it’s time to levy out prizes and forfeits.”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You [pc.move] up to the security buzzer to the side of the gate, press it, announcing that once again, [pc.name] Steele is here upon invitation.
rows.translation: 你[pc.move]到大门旁的安保对讲机前，按下按钮，宣告[pc.name]·斯蒂尔再次应邀而来。
rows.raw: "You [pc.move] up to the security buzzer to the side of the gate, press it, announcing that once again, [pc.name] Steele is here upon invitation."

rows.original: The response on the other side is silence, followed by a squawk of feedback. A minute later, a familiar brown-skinned human in a security uniform opens the front gate, jerks her head for you to come inside.
rows.translation: 另一端先是一片寂静，随后响起一声刺耳的回授音。一分钟后，一名身穿安保制服、肤色棕褐的熟悉人类女子打开前门，猛一偏头示意你进来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe response on the other side is silence, followed by a squawk of feedback. A minute later, a familiar brown-skinned human in a security uniform opens the front gate, jerks her head for you to come inside."

rows.original: “Hands out to the side,” Riya says, before roughly patting you down. “Weapons in the gatehouse. You’ll get them back when you leave. I’m going to kick your ass this time.”
rows.translation: “双手张开。”莉娅说着，粗鲁地搜了你的身。“武器留在门房。离开时会还你。这次我要狠狠干翻你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hands out to the side,” Riya says, before roughly patting you down. “Weapons in the gatehouse. You’ll get them back when you leave. I’m going to kick your ass this time.”"

rows.original: This last is delivered in the same cool tone, as if she were simply giving you directions. You smirk at her and carry on to the front door.
rows.translation: 最后一句话仍以同样冷静的语气说出，仿佛她只是在给你指路。你朝她得意一笑，继续走向前门。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis last is delivered in the same cool tone, as if she were simply giving you directions. You smirk at her and carry on to the front door."

rows.original: The response on the other side is silence, followed by a squawk of feedback. A minute later, a familiar brown-skinned human in a security uniform swaggers up to the front gate, lets you in with a little smile.
rows.translation: 另一端先是一片寂静，随后响起一声刺耳的回授音。一分钟后，一名身穿安保制服、肤色棕褐的熟悉人类女子大摇大摆地走到前门，微笑着放你进来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe response on the other side is silence, followed by a squawk of feedback. A minute later, a familiar brown-skinned human in a security uniform swaggers up to the front gate, lets you in with a little smile."

rows.original: “Hands out to the side. Good [pc.boy].” Riya’s strong hands travel up and down your body, helping themselves to your [pc.ass], your [pc.fullChest], your neck and inner thighs. “Won’t lie: looking forward to having this as my side course tonight,” she murmurs in your ear. “You are, too. Don’t lie.”
rows.translation: “双手张开。乖[pc.boy]。”莉娅有力的双手在你全身上下游走，毫不客气地摸过你的[pc.ass]、[pc.fullChest]、脖颈与大腿内侧。“不瞒你说：我很期待今晚拿这个当配菜，”她在你耳边低语。“你也期待。别撒谎。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hands out to the side. Good [pc.boy].” Riya’s strong hands travel up and down your body, helping themselves to your [pc.ass], your [pc.fullChest], your neck and inner thighs. “Won’t lie: looking forward to having this as my side course tonight,” she murmurs in your ear. “You are, too. Don’t lie.”"

rows.original: She steps back and slaps your ass, directing you to the front door.
rows.translation: 她后退一步，拍了拍你的屁股，示意你去前门。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe steps back and slaps your ass, directing you to the front door."

rows.original: “You found the nerve to show up, did you?” The amusement in Riya’s tone carries clearly through the feedback. “Good.”
rows.translation: “你还真鼓起勇气来了，是吧？”莉娅语气里的戏谑透过回授音清晰传来。“很好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You found the nerve to show up, did you?” The amusement in Riya’s tone carries clearly through the feedback. “Good.”"

rows.original: She strides out to the front gate and lets you through, patting you down in a way that might be construed as over-familiar.
rows.translation: 她大步走到前门，让你进去，并以一种可能显得过分熟络的方式搜了你的身。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe strides out to the front gate and lets you through, patting you down in a way that might be construed as over-familiar."

rows.original: “Weapons in the gatehouse,” she says, smiling widely at you. “I’ve been looking forward to this all day, Steele. Tonight, I’m putting you in your place.”
rows.translation: “武器留在门房，”她冲你咧嘴大笑。“我一整天都在期待这一刻，斯蒂尔。今晚，我要让你认清自己的位置。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Weapons in the gatehouse,” she says, smiling widely at you. “I’ve been looking forward to this all day, Steele. Tonight, I’m putting you in your place.”"

rows.original: Your carry on without a word to the front door.
rows.translation: 你一言不发地继续走向前门。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour carry on without a word to the front door."

rows.original: The enjoyably plump, maid-costumed rahn opens it for you. She blushes deeply when she sees you, and stumbles slightly to get out of your way.
rows.translation: 那名身材丰满得恰到好处、穿着女仆装的拉恩人为你开门。她看到你时脸涨得通红，慌忙让路时还踉跄了一下。
rows.raw: " The enjoyably plump, maid-costumed rahn opens it for you. She blushes deeply when she sees you, and stumbles slightly to get out of your way."

rows.original: The stern old kaithrit boy servant opens it for you.
rows.translation: 那名神情严厉、年长的凯斯里特男仆为你开门。
rows.raw: " The stern old kaithrit boy servant opens it for you."

rows.original: “Darling Steele! I’m sooooo glad you could come.”
rows.translation: “亲爱的斯蒂尔！我太——高兴你能来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Darling Steele! I’m sooooo glad you could come.”"

rows.original: Nastizia is where she usually is, lounging in the ornately appointed living area in one of her many stunning and tastefully-revealing outfits. She grins at you coyly, taking a sip from her wine glass.
rows.translation: 娜斯蒂齐娅像往常一样，穿着众多华美而得体暴露的服装之一，慵懒地倚在装饰华丽的起居区。她娇俏地朝你一笑，抿了一口杯中葡萄酒。
rows.raw: "\n\nNastizia is where she usually is, lounging in the ornately appointed living area in one of her many stunning and tastefully-revealing outfits. She grins at you coyly, taking a sip from her wine glass."

rows.original: “Do go right through,” she says, waving at the facsimile villa in the dining room. “Remember dear, no over-indulging. On food, anyway.”
rows.translation: “尽管进去吧，”她指了指餐厅里的仿制别墅。“记住，亲爱的，别放纵过头。至少在食物方面。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do go right through,” she says, waving at the facsimile villa in the dining room. “Remember dear, no over-indulging. On food, anyway.”"

rows.original: Grilled, oily, eel-like fish; citrus fruit and udon-like noodle stuffed into crisp vine leaves; wine so dry and white it looks like sparkling water; plump Tenevan ishis and jerris baked in brown sugar that you dangle into your mouth by their tails; smoky Roshan tea to follow.
rows.translation: 烤得油亮、形似鳗鱼的鱼；柑橘和乌冬般的面条塞进酥脆藤叶；干爽清澈得宛如气泡水的白葡萄酒；在红糖中烤制、肥美的特内万伊希和杰里，你揪着尾巴将它们垂进嘴里；餐后则是烟香浓郁的罗珊茶。
rows.raw: "\n\nGrilled, oily, eel-like fish; citrus fruit and udon-like noodle stuffed into crisp vine leaves; wine so dry and white it looks like sparkling water; plump Tenevan ishis and jerris baked in brown sugar that you dangle into your mouth by their tails; smoky Roshan tea to follow."

rows.original: kaithrit
rows.raw: "kaithrit"

rows.original: You so rarely get high quality kaithrit home cooking on the frontier, and you find it difficult to control yourself in front of it.
rows.translation: 在边境很少能吃到如此高品质的凯斯里特家常菜，你发现自己在它面前很难克制。
rows.raw: " You so rarely get high quality kaithrit home cooking on the frontier, and you find it difficult to control yourself in front of it."

rows.original: You are getting a taste for this stuff. It must be even better on Tenevo itself, where the ingredients are fresh.
rows.translation: 你开始喜欢上这些东西了。在特内沃本土，食材足够新鲜，味道肯定更加出色。
rows.raw: " You are getting a taste for this stuff. It must be even better on Tenevo itself, where the ingredients are fresh."

rows.original: The white-furred kaithrit picks at her food and bats her eyelashes, whilst Riya leans on the door, eyes fixed on the fake middle distance. Both are eager for you to finish.
rows.translation: 白毛凯斯里特女子小口拨弄着食物，眨动睫毛；莉娅则靠在门边，双眼盯着虚假的远方。两人都迫切希望你赶快吃完。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white-furred kaithrit picks at her food and bats her eyelashes, whilst Riya leans on the door, eyes fixed on the fake middle distance. Both are eager for you to finish."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: You’ve gathered that she needs to prove her fecundity in order to have a solid claim to the Romavian throne. What is she planning on doing, once she is pregnant?
rows.translation: 你已经知道，她需要证明自己的生育能力，才能稳固地宣称罗马维亚王位。怀孕后，她打算怎么做？
rows.raw: "You’ve gathered that she needs to prove her fecundity in order to have a solid claim to the Romavian throne. What is she planning on doing, once she is pregnant?"

rows.original: “Oh Steele darling, you’re here to entertain me!” Nastizia slaps lightly at your arm in admonishment. “I refuse to bother myself with serious details like that now. I am here to live in the moment - we are on the frontier, for goodness sake! But - if you must know...” she sighs deeply. “One supposes that she will have to present herself back at home. There will be much to discuss with the family. One’s siblings and cousins might attempt... hanky-panky.”
rows.translation: “哦，亲爱的斯蒂尔，你来这里是为了取悦我！”娜斯蒂齐娅责怪似的轻拍你的手臂。“我现在拒绝为那种严肃细节烦心。我来这里就是要活在当下——天哪，我们可是在边境！不过——既然你非要知道...”她深深叹气。“人家想来必须回家露面。还要和家族讨论许多事情。人家的兄弟姐妹和堂表亲或许会企图...搞些阴谋诡计。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh Steele darling, you’re here to entertain me!” Nastizia slaps lightly at your arm in admonishment. “I refuse to bother myself with serious details like that now. I am here to live in the moment - we are on the frontier, for goodness sake! But - if you must know...” she sighs deeply. “One supposes that she will have to present herself back at home. There will be much to discuss with the family. One’s siblings and cousins might attempt... hanky-panky.”"

rows.original: Hanky-panky? How many siblings does she have?
rows.translation: 阴谋诡计？她有多少兄弟姐妹？
rows.raw: "\n\nHanky-panky? How many siblings does she have?"

rows.original: “Four. No, wait - three. Poor Hortenze.” Another deep sigh. “We may be mostly symbolic these days but there’s still a lot of power, and prestige, and money on the line here, dear. Most of my siblings are grown-up and I get along with them just fine (except for Miklias of course, what a stiff), but some of my cousins are very ambitious, and the legalities of it all are... vague. Centuries old. One must be prepared to draw her claws, even if one’s claim is paramount. That has always been the Tenevan way.”
rows.translation: “四个。不，等等——三个。可怜的霍滕泽。”她又深深叹了口气。“如今我们或许大多只是象征，但这里仍关系到许多权力、声望与金钱，亲爱的。我的兄弟姐妹大多已经成年，我和他们相处得很好（当然，米克利亚斯除外，多么刻板的家伙），不过我的一些堂表亲野心勃勃，而所有相关法律都...含糊不清。那是几百年前的旧法。哪怕自己的继承权最为优先，也必须准备好亮出利爪。这向来是特内万人的行事方式。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Four. No, wait - three. Poor Hortenze.” Another deep sigh. “We may be mostly symbolic these days but there’s still a lot of power, and prestige, and money on the line here, dear. Most of my siblings are grown-up and I get along with them just fine (except for Miklias of course, what a stiff), but some of my cousins are very ambitious, and the legalities of it all are... vague. Centuries old. One must be prepared to draw her claws, even if one’s claim is paramount. That has always been the Tenevan way.”"

rows.original: Another light, brisk slap.
rows.translation: 又是轻快的一巴掌。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother light, brisk slap."

rows.original: “I don’t wish to talk about it, Steele. I wish to have as much fun as I can, with the time I have remaining. Have you finished with your food quite yet?”
rows.translation: “我不想谈这件事，斯蒂尔。我只想在剩余的时间里尽可能享乐。你的食物到底吃完了没有？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t wish to talk about it, Steele. I wish to have as much fun as I can, with the time I have remaining. Have you finished with your food quite yet?”"

rows.translation: 接下来呢？
rows.raw: "What next?"

rows.translation: 接下来呢？

rows.translation: 你刚聊过这个话题。
rows.raw: "You just talked about this."

rows.raw: "Franks"

rows.original: Riya is very tall for a human woman, standing 6' 2" by ancient Imperial measurements. She has midnight-black hair in a crew cut, smooth, dusky skin and deep, intense brown eyes. She is in remarkable shape, her rolled-up sleeves showing forearms corded with muscles that flex powerfully with every slight movement she makes. She has two heavy, round, firm D-cup breasts, a flat, hard stomach, and slender, powerful thighs that propel her forward with panther-like grace. She has one tattoo, a lone ebony wing on the left side of her neck just under her jaw.
rows.translation: 按照古代帝国度量，莉娅身高六英尺二英寸，对人类女性而言非常高挑。她留着午夜般漆黑的平头短发，肌肤光滑黝黑，深棕色双眼锐利逼人。她体格出众，卷起的袖子露出肌肉虬结的前臂，每次细微动作都会有力绷紧。她拥有一对沉甸甸、浑圆紧实的D罩杯乳房，平坦坚硬的腹部，以及修长有力的大腿，推动她以黑豹般的优雅前行。她只有一处纹身，是下颌正下方、颈部左侧的一只孤独乌黑羽翼。
rows.raw: "Riya is very tall for a human woman, standing 6' 2\" by ancient Imperial measurements. She has midnight-black hair in a crew cut, smooth, dusky skin and deep, intense brown eyes. She is in remarkable shape, her rolled-up sleeves showing forearms corded with muscles that flex powerfully with every slight movement she makes. She has two heavy, round, firm D-cup breasts, a flat, hard stomach, and slender, powerful thighs that propel her forward with panther-like grace. She has one tattoo, a lone ebony wing on the left side of her neck just under her jaw."

rows.original: She is clad in a U.G.C. Peacekeeper uniform and dark blue beret. As you gaze on her form, you notice a rather conspicuous bulge down the left leg of her pants... it seems officer Batra is packing a little something extra.
rows.translation: 她身穿星联维和部队制服，头戴深蓝色贝雷帽。你端详她的身体时，注意到裤子左腿处有一团相当显眼的隆起...看来巴特拉警官还藏着一点额外的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe is clad in a U.G.C. Peacekeeper uniform and dark blue beret. As you gaze on her form, you notice a rather conspicuous bulge down the left leg of her pants... it seems officer Batra is packing a little something extra."
