rows.translation: 莉·外貌
rows.raw: "R. Appearance"

rows.original: Riya’s Appearance
rows.translation: 莉娅的外貌
rows.raw: "Riya’s Appearance"

rows.original: You have already looked at Riya.
rows.translation: 你已经观察过莉娅了。
rows.raw: "You have already looked at Riya."

rows.original: You push your plate away, offering your compliments to the chef.
rows.translation: 你推开餐盘，向厨师表达赞美。
rows.raw: "You push your plate away, offering your compliments to the chef."

rows.original: “You should save those,” husks Nastizia, sapphire eyes heavy-lidded, “until you’ve had the real main course of this evening, darling.”
rows.translation: “那些赞美还是留着吧，”娜斯蒂齐娅嗓音沙哑地说，蓝宝石般的双眸半阖着，“等你品尝过今晚真正的主菜以后再说，亲爱的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You should save those,” husks Nastizia, sapphire eyes heavy-lidded, “until you’ve had the real main course of this evening, darling.”"

rows.original: She stands and sashays out of the holographic dining room into a darkened side chamber, small delectable rump swelling and scrunching against its expensive covering. You glance at Riya, and see she’s looking at the same thing.
rows.translation: 她站起身，摇曳生姿地离开全息餐厅，走进昏暗的侧室；小巧诱人的圆臀在昂贵衣料下鼓胀挤压。你瞥向莉娅，发现她也在看同一个地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stands and sashays out of the holographic dining room into a darkened side chamber, small delectable rump swelling and scrunching against its expensive covering. You glance at Riya, and see she’s looking at the same thing."

rows.original: “I don’t know what she has planned, if that’s what you’re wondering,” she says, giving you a brief, hard smile. “I didn’t cheat. I don’t need to.”
rows.translation: “如果你想问这个，那我不知道她计划了什么，”她短促而强硬地笑着说。“我没有作弊。我不需要。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know what she has planned, if that’s what you’re wondering,” she says, giving you a brief, hard smile. “I didn’t cheat. I don’t need to.”"

rows.original: “Still haven’t looked,” she says evenly. “You’ve coasted on luck so far, Steele. Tonight, things change.”
rows.translation: “还是没看过，”她平静地说。“到目前为止，你全靠运气蒙混过关，斯蒂尔。今晚，一切都会改变。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Still haven’t looked,” she says evenly. “You’ve coasted on luck so far, Steele. Tonight, things change.”"

rows.original: “Don’t know why you’re looking there. That isn’t what you’re getting.” She smiles at you wolfishly. “I know what you really want, Steele. And I’m going to deliver it.”
rows.translation: “不知道你为什么往那里看。你拿不到那个。”她如狼般冲你一笑。“我知道你真正想要什么，斯蒂尔。而我会亲自满足你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t know why you’re looking there. That isn’t what you’re getting.” She smiles at you wolfishly. “I know what you really want, Steele. And I’m going to deliver it.”"

rows.original: “It’s good of you to put up a fight,” she says with a toothy smile. “It’s going to make me winning and knocking up your cute girlfriend there all the more gratifying.”
rows.translation: “你肯奋力反抗真是太好了，”她露齿一笑。“这样一来，等我获胜并让你那位可爱的女朋友怀孕时，就会更加令人满足。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s good of you to put up a fight,” she says with a toothy smile. “It’s going to make me winning and knocking up your cute girlfriend there all the more gratifying.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Nastizia approaches you, her kittenishness replaced by a strangely intense vulnerability, brought out perhaps by her pale, flawless skin. Her eyes are pools of blue; the scales on her neck shimmer when they catch the light.
rows.translation: 娜斯蒂齐娅走向你，猫儿般的娇俏被一种异乎寻常的强烈脆弱所取代，或许是她苍白无瑕的肌肤让这份脆弱更加明显。她的双眼宛如湛蓝水潭；颈间鳞片一触到光线便熠熠生辉。
rows.raw: "Nastizia approaches you, her kittenishness replaced by a strangely intense vulnerability, brought out perhaps by her pale, flawless skin. Her eyes are pools of blue; the scales on her neck shimmer when they catch the light."

rows.original: “You may kiss one,” she murmurs. “If you wish.”
rows.translation: “你可以吻一位，”她低声说。“如果你愿意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You may kiss one,” she murmurs. “If you wish.”"

rows.original: You have macheted your way through sprawling jungles of steaming sexuality since you came to the frontier; every one of your senses has been subjected to sustained erotic bombardment, giving them the hardened refinement of a being centuries older than your real age.
rows.translation: 自从来到边境，你一路挥刀砍过广袤无边、热气腾腾的欲望丛林；每一种感官都遭受过持续不断的色情轰炸，因此磨炼出远超你真实年龄数百年的老练敏锐。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have macheted your way through sprawling jungles of steaming sexuality since you came to the frontier; every one of your senses has been subjected to sustained erotic bombardment, giving them the hardened refinement of a being centuries older than your real age."

rows.original: And yet in this moment you feel rendered a fumbling adolescent. You must make conscious effort to prevent your [pc.hand] from trembling as it slides around the kaithrit’s slim, firm waist, drawing her close enough to feast upon the scent of that exotic neck and pale chest; the crinkle of her dazzling outfit beneath your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], the touch of her hip and tummy, makes your breath catch slightly; and oh, the way she lifts her small, delicate chin to yours and then stops, drops her eyes demurely, drawing the moment out before your [pc.lips] do eventually press against her black tar, and you taste her breath.
rows.translation: 然而此刻，你却感觉自己变回了笨手笨脚的青春少年。你的[pc.hand]滑过凯斯里特女子纤细紧实的腰肢时，必须刻意控制才不至于颤抖；你将她拉近，尽情嗅闻那异域颈项与苍白胸口的香气；华美衣装在你[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]下发出的窸窣声、她臀部与小腹的触感，都令你的呼吸微微停滞；而她把小巧精致的下巴仰向你，却又突然停下，羞涩地垂下双眼，刻意延长这一刻，直到你的[pc.lips]终于贴上她那焦油般漆黑的双唇，品尝到她的气息——这一切更是妙不可言。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd yet in this moment you feel rendered a fumbling adolescent. You must make conscious effort to prevent your [pc.hand] from trembling as it slides around the kaithrit’s slim, firm waist, drawing her close enough to feast upon the scent of that exotic neck and pale chest; the crinkle of her dazzling outfit beneath your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], the touch of her hip and tummy, makes your breath catch slightly; and oh, the way she lifts her small, delicate chin to yours and then stops, drops her eyes demurely, drawing the moment out before your [pc.lips] do eventually press against her black tar, and you taste her breath."

rows.original: It’s as chaste as a kiss on a prom dance floor at first; you part from her, gaze into dilated blue eyes and meet her lips with your lips again, and this time there’s hints of something darker, more exciting beneath the surface, beckoning you in deeper. Her cool fingers fasten themselves between yours and her hot mouth opens, enticing you inside; when you slip your [pc.tongue] beyond her pointed teeth she whimpers, so quietly that you’d think you’d imagined it if you hadn’t tasted the vibrations. Is her mouth particularly sensitive? Is her neck indicative that she’s modded...?
rows.translation: 起初，这个吻纯洁得如同毕业舞会上的轻吻；你与她分开，凝望那双放大的蓝眼睛，随后再次以双唇迎上她的唇。这一次，表面之下隐约显露出更黑暗、更刺激的东西，引诱你深入。她冰凉的手指扣入你的指缝，滚烫的嘴巴张开，诱你进入；当你的[pc.tongue]滑过她尖锐的牙齿时，她低声呜咽，声音轻得几乎会令你以为是幻觉，若非你亲口尝到了那阵颤动。她的口腔是否格外敏感？她的脖颈是否表明她接受过改造...？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s as chaste as a kiss on a prom dance floor at first; you part from her, gaze into dilated blue eyes and meet her lips with your lips again, and this time there’s hints of something darker, more exciting beneath the surface, beckoning you in deeper. Her cool fingers fasten themselves between yours and her hot mouth opens, enticing you inside; when you slip your [pc.tongue] beyond her pointed teeth she whimpers, so quietly that you’d think you’d imagined it if you hadn’t tasted the vibrations. Is her mouth particularly sensitive? Is her neck indicative that she’s modded...?"

rows.original: She pulls away like a silk scarf brushing down your arm before the thought can fully form, gently biting and pulling at your lip as she does. It’s only when the kaithrit is standing away from you, smiling smokily, that you realize how ragingly hard your [pc.cocksIsAre].
rows.translation: 这个念头还未完全成形，她便像丝巾拂过手臂般抽身离去，离开时还轻轻咬住并拉扯你的嘴唇。直到这名凯斯里特女子站到远处，含情脉脉地微笑，你才意识到自己的[pc.cocksIsAre]已经硬得近乎狂暴。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pulls away like a silk scarf brushing down your arm before the thought can fully form, gently biting and pulling at your lip as she does. It’s only when the kaithrit is standing away from you, smiling smokily, that you realize how ragingly hard your [pc.cocksIsAre]."

rows.original: “I hope you enjoyed that, [pc.name] darling,” Nastizia says softly. She raises her voice, eyes full of feline malevolence as she turns them to Riya. “And I do hope it moves you to even greater heights of cunning and bravery in the jousts ahead.
rows.translation: “希望你喜欢刚才的吻，[pc.name]亲爱的，”娜斯蒂齐娅轻声说。她提高音量，转眼看向莉娅时，眸中满是猫科动物般的恶意。“我也希望它能激励你，在接下来的比试中展现更高明的狡猾与勇气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I hope you enjoyed that, [pc.name] darling,” Nastizia says softly. She raises her voice, eyes full of feline malevolence as she turns them to Riya. “And I do hope it moves you to even greater heights of cunning and bravery in the jousts ahead. "

joinAfter.expression: e < 0 ? "You’ve already seen what might be yours, all yours if you can turn this contest around..." : "Why, just imagine what one might be willing to bestow if you impressed me again..."

rows.original: You’ve already seen what might be yours, all yours if you can turn this contest around...
rows.translation: 你已经见过自己可能得到的东西了；只要能扭转这场比赛，这一切都将属于你...
rows.raw: "You’ve already seen what might be yours, all yours if you can turn this contest around..."

rows.original: Why, just imagine what one might be willing to bestow if you impressed me again...
rows.translation: 哎呀，只要想象一下，若你再次给我留下深刻印象，人家会愿意赏赐些什么...
rows.raw: "Why, just imagine what one might be willing to bestow if you impressed me again..."

rows.original: Riya is poker-faced; but her brown eyes are livid, fixed upon Nastizia, and her fatigues do nothing to disguise the fact that she’s nursing a hard-on at least as acute as yours. Seeing you get one over her in such an elemental way was tough for the big human, and when she forces her gaze over to your own big dopey grin she doesn’t need to say anything for you to know she’ll do everything in her power to prevent it happening again.
rows.translation: 莉娅面无表情；但她棕色的眼睛怒火中烧，死死盯着娜斯蒂齐娅，而战斗服根本掩盖不了一个事实：她正承受着至少和你同样强烈的勃起。眼看你以如此原始的方式胜她一筹，这名高大的人类女子很不好受；当她强迫自己把目光转向你那张傻兮兮的灿烂笑脸时，无需开口，你也知道她会竭尽所能，阻止这种事再次发生。
rows.raw: "\n\nRiya is poker-faced; but her brown eyes are livid, fixed upon Nastizia, and her fatigues do nothing to disguise the fact that she’s nursing a hard-on at least as acute as yours. Seeing you get one over her in such an elemental way was tough for the big human, and when she forces her gaze over to your own big dopey grin she doesn’t need to say anything for you to know she’ll do everything in her power to prevent it happening again."

rows.original: The chase, yes, and this feeling of intense rivalry; these are elements which are usually missing from the plentiful amounts of action you see elsewhere.
rows.translation: 追逐本身，没错，还有这种强烈的竞争感；这些要素通常不会出现在你从别处获得的大量性爱中。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe chase, yes, and this feeling of intense rivalry; these are elements which are usually missing from the plentiful amounts of action you see elsewhere."

rows.original: “Another invitation will soon be in the mail dear,” Nastizia says as she leads you to the estate’s door. Her hand descends down your back, her claws extending to graze the small. “I do look forward to these evenings so. You will come back?”
rows.translation: “另一封邀请很快就会寄出，亲爱的，”娜斯蒂齐娅领你走向宅邸大门时说道。她的手顺着你的后背向下滑，利爪伸出，擦过腰背。“我真的非常期待这些夜晚。你会回来吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Another invitation will soon be in the mail dear,” Nastizia says as she leads you to the estate’s door. Her hand descends down your back, her claws extending to graze the small. “I do look forward to these evenings so. You will come back?”"

rows.original: Her gleaming, fanged smile remains with you long after the door has closed and you’ve gotten your gear back from the gatehouse.
rows.translation: 直到大门关闭许久、你从门房取回装备后，她那闪亮露齿的笑容依然留在你的脑海中。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer gleaming, fanged smile remains with you long after the door has closed and you’ve gotten your gear back from the gatehouse."

rows.original: Of course you will.
rows.translation: 你当然会。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course you will."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You’ve failed. Riya only needed to win one last time, and she’s done it.
rows.translation: 你失败了。莉娅只需再赢最后一次，而她做到了。
rows.raw: "You’ve failed. Riya only needed to win one last time, and she’s done it. "

rows.original: You put everything into it and pushed the big human all the way, and perhaps there’s no real shame in defeat. Except... you know there will be. Riya herself has promised it, in the bedroom afterwards. Your [pc.knees] turn to water.
rows.translation: 你倾尽全力，将这名高大的人类女子逼到极限，或许败北本身并不可耻。只不过...你知道之后一定会受辱。莉娅本人已经承诺，会在卧室里兑现。你的[pc.knees]顿时软如流水。
rows.raw: "You put everything into it and pushed the big human all the way, and perhaps there’s no real shame in defeat. Except... you know there will be. Riya herself has promised it, in the bedroom afterwards. Your [pc.knees] turn to water."

rows.original: Perhaps it’s time to admit that she’s right, and you wanted it to end this way. Let the big forceful amazon have the onerous responsibility of siring an heir to an alien throne. You will take being dominated by her instead. So transcendentally freeing. So deliciously horny.
rows.translation: 也许该承认她是对的，而你本就希望以这种方式结束。让那名强势高大的亚马逊承担为异星王位孕育继承人的繁重责任吧。你则会代替她接受支配。自由得超凡脱俗。又淫荡得无比美味。
rows.raw: "Perhaps it’s time to admit that she’s right, and you wanted it to end this way. Let the big forceful amazon have the onerous responsibility of siring an heir to an alien throne. You will take being dominated by her instead. So transcendentally freeing. So deliciously horny."

rows.original: You watch Nastizia as she gazes at Riya with glittering, icy eyes, hands on her hips, an all-too familiar little smile playing over her black lips. She’s weighing up pulling the string a little further down the road, the unholy little minx.
rows.translation: 你看着娜斯蒂齐娅双手叉腰，以冰冷闪亮的眼睛凝视莉娅，漆黑嘴唇上浮现出再熟悉不过的浅笑。这个邪恶的小妖精正在考虑把这根弦再往后拉一段路。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou watch Nastizia as she gazes at Riya with glittering, icy eyes, hands on her hips, an all-too familiar little smile playing over her black lips. She’s weighing up pulling the string a little further down the road, the unholy little minx."

rows.original: “Darling Riya,” she coos. “My rock. My indomitable praetorian. You’ve done as you said you would and shoved the competition aside. Each time I thought I’d devised a challenge that would trip you up, you emerged the victor. A lady should not notice her security detail - instead, I profess, I cannot stop thinking about you.” A slender, snowy finger touches wet, black obsidian. “But we have been enjoying ourselves us three, haven’t we? It’s been a scrumptious past week. And dear Steele has been trying so hard. I wonder if it would be so bad to prolong the competition a while longer...?”
rows.translation: “亲爱的莉娅，”她柔声说道。“我的磐石。我不可征服的禁卫军。你兑现了承诺，将竞争者推到一旁。每当我以为自己设计出一项能绊倒你的挑战，你最终都会成为胜者。淑女本不该注意到身边的安保人员——然而我承认，自己已经无法停止想你。”一根纤细雪白的手指触上湿润漆黑的黑曜石。“不过我们三个一直玩得很开心，对吧？过去这一周真是美味至极。亲爱的斯蒂尔也一直如此努力。我在想，让比赛再延长一阵是否真有那么糟...？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Darling Riya,” she coos. “My rock. My indomitable praetorian. You’ve done as you said you would and shoved the competition aside. Each time I thought I’d devised a challenge that would trip you up, you emerged the victor. A lady should not notice her security detail - instead, I profess, I cannot stop thinking about you.” A slender, snowy finger touches wet, black obsidian. “But we have been enjoying ourselves us three, haven’t we? It’s been a scrumptious past week. And dear Steele has been trying so hard. I wonder if it would be so bad to prolong the competition a while longer...?”"

rows.original: Riya is across to her in two quick strides. Nastizia gasps as she’s swept off her feet into burly, brown arms.
rows.translation: 莉娅两步便冲到她身前。娜斯蒂齐娅被结实棕褐的双臂抱离地面，发出惊呼。
rows.raw: "\n\nRiya is across to her in two quick strides. Nastizia gasps as she’s swept off her feet into burly, brown arms."

rows.original: “I get it, kitten,” Riya says in an unusually tender tone. “You’re scared. You came up with a funny game so you could put off doing the thing you know you have to do, the thing you gotta if you want a shot at being someone real. Now it’s suddenly time to face up and get bred, and you’re nervous. Well, listen. I’m your bodyguard, and as long as that’s the case you’ll never get hurt. That’s true of you, and the kid I’m gonna give you. Alright?”
rows.translation: “我明白，小猫咪，”莉娅以异乎寻常的温柔语气说道。“你害怕了。你设计这个有趣游戏，是为了推迟自己明知必须做的事——如果你想有机会真正成就一番事业，就非做不可的事。现在突然到了面对现实、接受配种的时候，你紧张了。听着，我是你的保镖，只要这一点不变，你就永远不会受伤。对你如此，对我要给你的孩子也如此。明白吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I get it, kitten,” Riya says in an unusually tender tone. “You’re scared. You came up with a funny game so you could put off doing the thing you know you have to do, the thing you gotta if you want a shot at being someone real. Now it’s suddenly time to face up and get bred, and you’re nervous. Well, listen. I’m your bodyguard, and as long as that’s the case you’ll never get hurt. That’s true of you, and the kid I’m gonna give you. Alright?”"

rows.original: “O-ohh Riya,” coos Nasti, a gooey look on her face as she gazes up at the human, bodice gently fluttering.
rows.translation: “哦——哦，莉娅，”娜斯蒂娇声说道，仰望着这名人类女子，脸上露出黏糊糊的神情，紧身胸衣轻轻起伏。

rows.original: “C’mon. I want to see what’s in that bedside cabinet of yours. You too, Steele.” She shoots a fleeting, fiery look at you that makes your heart quail (and, guiltily, warmth towards your crotch) as she turns with her glittering luggage to the grand stairs. “It’s time for second prize. Don’t feel bad - silver suits you a whole lot better.”
rows.translation: “来吧。我想看看你床头柜里放了些什么。你也来，斯蒂尔。”她朝你投来转瞬即逝却火热无比的一眼，令你心生畏缩（也让你怀着负罪感，感觉胯间一热），随后带着闪亮的行李转身走向宏伟楼梯。“该发二等奖了。别难过——银色可比金色适合你多了。”

rows.original: Nastizia sashays up the main stairs of the manor, her fluffy white tails beckoning you further into the embrace of her plush, obscenely spacious holiday home. Riya follows closely, her big, muscular butt scrunching in her fatigues, striding after the kaithrit with barely disguised eagerness. For a moment, at the foot of the stairs, you consider turning tail and leaving.

rows.original: Nastizia’s boudoir is her in a space: Highly gilded and ornate, polished wooden floor, decorated in rich blue, pearl and gold, dominated by a huge poster bed beyond which a screen of luminous, color-shifting bead strands hangs. It’s glacially imperious, and only subtly, teasingly - in the shifting, sensuous beads, the suggestively shaped ornaments that loiter beyond the miniatures of family members, slightly ajar cabinets and wardrobes filled with all sorts of dim, interesting shapes - does it hint at a deep, multifarious carnality.
rows.translation: 娜斯蒂齐娅的闺房就是她本人的空间化身：大量镀金，装饰华丽，地板由抛光木材铺成，以浓郁的蓝色、珍珠色和金色装点；一张巨大的四柱床占据中心，床后悬着一面发光变色的珠串屏风。这里带着冰川般威严的气息，只有那些不断变化、感性迷人的珠串，那些徘徊在家族成员微缩像之后、形状惹人遐想的饰物，以及微微敞开、装满各种昏暗有趣轮廓的橱柜和衣柜，才以含蓄撩人的方式，暗示出一种深沉而多样的肉欲。

rows.original: The kaithrit princess sits her round, delectable rump down on the bed, and waits cross-legged, half-lidded eyes cast silently towards Riya, until the human walks across to her. She draws in close, touches her long nose against Nastizia’s dainty, up-turned nose; a strong, brown hand descends upon a china-bone shoulder, pushes the strap of her dress away unresistingly. Your heart lurches.

She draws in close, touches her long nose against Nastizia’s dainty, up-turned nose; a strong, brown hand descends upon a china-bone shoulder, pushes the strap of her dress away unresistingly. rows.translation: 在事后终于享受到的奢华淋浴中，以及随后曲折离开罗马维亚庄园的路上，你有充足时间反思过去几小时里怪诞而淫荡的经历。你已经失去为异星王位孕育继承人的机会... 但娜斯蒂齐娅似乎仍希望你参与其中，无论在卧室内外。你能忍受吗，再次把自己交到那个洋洋得意、霸道强势的女种马手中？你几乎无法否认，这场性爱——以及置身王室奢华怀抱中的体验——堪称绝妙。你的[pc.anus]隐隐作痛。莉娅的麝香味与娜斯蒂百合般清凉的香气依然萦绕口中。
rows.raw: "In the sumptuous shower you manage to catch afterwards, and then your winding passage out of the Romavian estate, you have plenty of time to reflect on the strange, horny events of the past few hours. You have lost the opportunity to sire an heir to an alien throne... but it appears Nastizia still wishes for you to be involved, in the bedroom and otherwise. Could you stomach that, put yourself back in the hands of her gloating, domineering she-stud? You can hardly deny the sex - and the experience of the royal lap of luxury - hasn’t been superb. Your [pc.anus] aches. The musky taste of Riya, and Nasti’s cool, lily-like scent, lingers in your mouth."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_QUEST
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_QUEST"

rows.original: The room Nastizia leads you into is a long hall with a cream armchair at the end. Spotlighted, motionless, metallic figures line it, eleven on each side. One side is red, the other is blue.
rows.translation: 娜斯蒂齐娅带你进入的房间是一条长廊，尽头摆着一张奶油色扶手椅。静止不动的金属身影被聚光灯照亮，沿长廊两侧排列，每侧各有十一具。一边是红色，另一边是蓝色。
rows.raw: "The room Nastizia leads you into is a long hall with a cream armchair at the end. Spotlighted, motionless, metallic figures line it, eleven on each side. One side is red, the other is blue."

rows.original: “Simple, VI-operated military droids,” Nastizia says, lightly touching the jaw of one. With a whirr it lifts its square, featureless face as if to look at her. “The Romavian family used to use them as actual guards on nepeta barges, centuries ago.” She touches the SMG-like weapon in its hands next, and it presents it for inspection. “These give mild electric shocks to their targets, enough to debilitate unarmored organics and droids.”
rows.translation: “由虚拟智能操控的简单军用机器人，”娜斯蒂齐娅轻触其中一具的下颌，说道。伴随嗡鸣，它抬起方正而没有五官的脸，仿佛正在看她。“几个世纪前，罗马维亚家族曾把它们当作尼佩塔驳船上的真正守卫。”接着，她触碰机器人手中类似冲锋枪的武器，它便将武器递上供她检视。“这些会对目标释放轻微电击，足以让没有护甲的有机体和机器人失去行动能力。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Simple, VI-operated military droids,” Nastizia says, lightly touching the jaw of one. With a whirr it lifts its square, featureless face as if to look at her. “The Romavian family used to use them as actual guards on nepeta barges, centuries ago.” She touches the SMG-like weapon in its hands next, and it presents it for inspection. “These give mild electric shocks to their targets, enough to debilitate unarmored organics and droids.”"

rows.original: On the armchair two of the electroguns are laid; Nastizia picks up each and with surprising alacrity flings them to you and Riya.
rows.translation: 扶手椅上摆着两把电击枪；娜斯蒂齐娅分别拿起，以惊人的敏捷将它们扔给你和莉娅。
rows.raw: "\n\nOn the armchair two of the electroguns are laid; Nastizia picks up each and with surprising alacrity flings them to you and Riya."

rows.original: “You already know the drill, dears,” Nastizia says, turning to give you both a delicately-fanged smile. “The last time we did this went so excitingly - well, I just had to do it again!”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，你们已经知道规矩了，”娜斯蒂齐娅转身，用精致尖牙向你们二人微笑。“上次玩这个实在太刺激了——所以我就是必须再来一次！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You already know the drill, dears,” Nastizia says, turning to give you both a delicately-fanged smile. “The last time we did this went so excitingly - well, I just had to do it again!”"

rows.original: She sits herself down on the armchair, gestures at the SMGs laid on either arm. You each collect one.
rows.translation: 她在扶手椅上坐下，指向两侧扶手上摆放的冲锋枪。你们各自取走一把。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sits herself down on the armchair, gestures at the SMGs laid on either arm. You each collect one."

rows.original: “Each side is programmed to obey one of you,” the kaithrit says, sitting back in the armchair with a smug smile. “Riya: you will command Team Blue. My faithful bodyguard, it is your duty to protect one from being spirited away by kidnappers, who might do unspeakable things to one. You must arrest their leader!” She closes her eyes and wriggles slightly, revelling in the notion. “Steele, you will command Team Red. My brave, roguish outsider, you must successfully invade this house and seize me, spirit me to the outside in one piece.”
rows.translation: “每一边都被设定为服从你们其中一人，”凯斯里特靠在扶手椅上，得意地微笑着说道。“莉娅：你指挥蓝队。作为本宫忠诚的保镖，你有责任保护本宫，防止被绑匪掳走；他们可能会对本宫做出不可言说的事情。你必须逮捕他们的首领！”她闭上眼睛，轻轻扭动，陶醉在这种想象中。“斯蒂尔，你指挥红队。作为本宫勇敢不羁的外来者，你必须成功入侵这座宅邸并夺取本宫，将本宫完好无损地带到外面。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Each side is programmed to obey one of you,” the kaithrit says, sitting back in the armchair with a smug smile. “Riya: you will command Team Blue. My faithful bodyguard, it is your duty to protect one from being spirited away by kidnappers, who might do unspeakable things to one. You must arrest their leader!” She closes her eyes and wriggles slightly, revelling in the notion. “Steele, you will command Team Red. My brave, roguish outsider, you must successfully invade this house and seize me, spirit me to the outside in one piece.”"

rows.original: The armchair lifts from the ground. It floats directly upwards, to a hole in the high ceiling.
rows.translation: 扶手椅离开地面，径直向上漂浮，进入高处天花板上的洞口。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe armchair lifts from the ground. It floats directly upwards, to a hole in the high ceiling."

rows.original: “I shall be in my boudoir,” the kaithrit princess calls down, wiggling the fingers of one hand at you. “Whosoever has droids still standing by the end, or completes the objective, wins.”
rows.translation: “本宫会在闺房等候，”凯斯里特公主一边向下喊，一边对你摆动单手的手指。“最终仍有机器人站立，或是完成目标的一方获胜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I shall be in my boudoir,” the kaithrit princess calls down, wiggling the fingers of one hand at you. “Whosoever has droids still standing by the end, or completes the objective, wins.”"

rows.original: “Good luck. You’re going to need it,” Riya says, examining the weapon in her hand thoughtfully. “This game is my actual job. Kitten wants me to win.”
rows.translation: “祝你好运。你会非常需要的，”莉娅若有所思地检查手中武器，说道。“这场游戏本来就是我的工作。小猫咪希望我赢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good luck. You’re going to need it,” Riya says, examining the weapon in her hand thoughtfully. “This game is my actual job. Kitten wants me to win.”"

rows.original: “This is where it turns,” Riya smirks, carefully examining the weapon in her hand. “I’m on home turf, doing my actual job. You may as well just let me put the cuffs on you now, Steele.”
rows.translation: “这就是局势逆转的地方，”莉娅得意一笑，仔细检查手中武器。“这是我的主场，而且我正在做本职工作。你不如现在就让我给你戴上手铐吧，斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is where it turns,” Riya smirks, carefully examining the weapon in her hand. “I’m on home turf, doing my actual job. You may as well just let me put the cuffs on you now, Steele.”"

rows.original: “I thought kitten might go easy on you,” Riya sighs, examining the weapon in her hand. “But nah, she wants me to win just as much as you do. Let’s get this over with. Try and make it look convincing, ok?”
rows.translation: “我还以为小猫咪可能会对你手下留情，”莉娅检查着手中武器，叹息道。“但没有，她和你一样希望我赢。赶紧结束吧。尽量让场面看起来像那么回事，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I thought kitten might go easy on you,” Riya sighs, examining the weapon in her hand. “But nah, she wants me to win just as much as you do. Let’s get this over with. Try and make it look convincing, ok?”"

rows.original: “Ooh, tough luck Steele,” Riya smirks, carefully examining the weapon in her hand. “I get to do my actual job and you have to pretend you know the first thing about taking a secure position. Why don’t you let me put the cuffs on you right now?”
rows.translation: “哦哦，斯蒂尔，真不走运，”莉娅得意一笑，仔细检查手中武器。“我可以做自己的本职工作，而你得假装自己多少懂一点如何攻占防御阵地。何不现在就让我给你戴上手铐？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooh, tough luck Steele,” Riya smirks, carefully examining the weapon in her hand. “I get to do my actual job and you have to pretend you know the first thing about taking a secure position. Why don’t you let me put the cuffs on you right now?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You order the red droids to follow you and they do so, clinking and clanking with you out of the front door of the Romavian temporary estate and around to one side. Sheltered in a grotto of garden crystals, one of your team of titanium terrorists helpfully beams a floorplan of the building onto the ground in front of you, highlighting Nastizia’s room on the second floor.
rows.translation: 你命令红色机器人跟随自己，它们便叮叮当当地随你走出罗马维亚临时庄园的前门，绕向一侧。你们隐蔽在一处花园水晶洞穴中，一名钛制恐怖分子队员贴心地把建筑平面图投射到你面前的地面上，并高亮标出娜斯蒂齐娅位于二楼的房间。
rows.raw: "You order the red droids to follow you and they do so, clinking and clanking with you out of the front door of the Romavian temporary estate and around to one side. Sheltered in a grotto of garden crystals, one of your team of titanium terrorists helpfully beams a floorplan of the building onto the ground in front of you, highlighting Nastizia’s room on the second floor."

rows.original: You could go for a frontal assault, force your way in with the whole team, rely upon your own skill in combat. Or you could try something cleverer. Split your droids up, lure Riya to one side of the estate, then come in and seize Nastizia from the other.
rows.translation: 你可以正面强攻，带领整个队伍闯进去，仰赖自己的战斗技巧。也可以尝试更加聪明的办法：拆分机器人，把莉娅诱向庄园一侧，然后从另一侧进入并夺走娜斯蒂齐娅。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou could go for a frontal assault, force your way in with the whole team, rely upon your own skill in combat. Or you could try something cleverer. Split your droids up, lure Riya to one side of the estate, then come in and seize Nastizia from the other."

rows.original: Brute Force
rows.translation: 强力突破
rows.raw: "Brute Force"

rows.original: Brute Force
rows.translation: 强力突破
rows.raw: "Brute Force"

rows.original: Frontal assault. Riya probably isn’t expecting you to be so bold.
rows.translation: 正面强攻。莉娅大概料不到你会这么大胆。
rows.raw: "Frontal assault. Riya probably isn’t expecting you to be so bold."

rows.original: Cunning Plan
rows.translation: 妙计
rows.raw: "Cunning Plan"

rows.original: Cunning Plan
rows.translation: 妙计
rows.raw: "Cunning Plan"

rows.original: A plan so cunning you could put a tail on it and call it a weasel.
rows.translation: 这计划巧妙得可以给它装条尾巴，称其为黄鼠狼。
rows.raw: "A plan so cunning you could put a tail on it and call it a weasel."

rows.original: Auto Fail
rows.translation: 自动失败
rows.raw: "Auto Fail"

rows.original: Auto Fail
rows.translation: 自动失败
rows.raw: "Auto Fail"

rows.original: Let Riya win.
rows.translation: 让莉娅获胜。
rows.raw: "Let Riya win."

rows.original: You move around the generously sized res deck partition, considering the big square building from each side, before choosing two large, ground floor windows. You lie out of sight and wait half an hour - long enough, perhaps, for your opposite number to second guess herself - and then, with a terse flick of two fingers mimicked from the dozens of extranet serials you’ve consumed, you order your troops to breach.
rows.translation: 你绕着宽阔的居住甲板隔区移动，从各个方向观察这座方正的大型建筑，最后选定一楼的两扇大窗户。你伏在视野外等待半小时——也许足以让对手开始怀疑自己的判断——然后模仿自己看过的无数外联网连续剧，简洁地弹动两根手指，下令部队突入。
rows.raw: "You move around the generously sized res deck partition, considering the big square building from each side, before choosing two large, ground floor windows. You lie out of sight and wait half an hour - long enough, perhaps, for your opposite number to second guess herself - and then, with a terse flick of two fingers mimicked from the dozens of extranet serials you’ve consumed, you order your troops to breach."

rows.original: “Moger moger.”
rows.translation: “莫格莫格。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Moger moger.”"

rows.original: The vanguard smash through the panels of hard light, the fragments winking out of existence as they pass out of line of the generator. Almost immediately one of your droids is gunned down by the two sentries posted here, but the sheer weight of red bots jumping through the frames quickly overwhelm them. You step over their buzzing, twitching chassis and urge your team on, blitzing towards a servant’s flight of stairs that will take you to the second floor.
rows.translation: 先锋砸穿硬光板，碎片脱离发生器的投射线路后闪烁着消失。几乎就在同一时间，你的一具机器人被驻守这里的两名哨兵击倒，但跃过窗框的大批红色机器人很快便以数量优势压垮了他们。你跨过那些嗡鸣抽搐的机体，催促队伍继续前进，迅速冲向一段通往二楼的仆役楼梯。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe vanguard smash through the panels of hard light, the fragments winking out of existence as they pass out of line of the generator. Almost immediately one of your droids is gunned down by the two sentries posted here, but the sheer weight of red bots jumping through the frames quickly overwhelm them. You step over their buzzing, twitching chassis and urge your team on, blitzing towards a servant’s flight of stairs that will take you to the second floor."

rows.original: At the end of the long hall leading to Nastizia’s room another blue bot has been posted: sheltering behind an upturned table, it takes potshots at your team as they gain ground. As you crouch-walk into a side bedroom one of yours manages to crown the sentry and sends it tumbling squawking to the ground. You feel a stirring of unease. Why is this so easy?
rows.translation: 通往娜斯蒂齐娅房间的长廊尽头还驻守着另一具蓝色机器人；它躲在一张翻倒的桌子后方，随着你的队伍推进，不断对他们放冷枪。当你蹲身走进侧面一间卧室时，己方某个机器人成功一枪击中哨兵头部，令其尖叫着翻倒在地。你心中泛起一阵不安。为什么如此轻松？
rows.raw: "\n\nAt the end of the long hall leading to Nastizia’s room another blue bot has been posted: sheltering behind an upturned table, it takes potshots at your team as they gain ground. As you crouch-walk into a side bedroom one of yours manages to crown the sentry and sends it tumbling squawking to the ground. You feel a stirring of unease. Why is this so easy?"

rows.original: In this spare room there’s a locked door; if you remember rightly this leads to an ensuite which adjoins Nastizia’s room. It looks barricaded. The front way in, meanwhile, is visibly off the latch.
rows.translation: 这间客房里有一扇锁住的门；如果没记错，它通向与娜斯蒂齐娅房间相连的套内浴室。门看起来已被堵住。与此同时，正面入口显然没有上闩。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn this spare room there’s a locked door; if you remember rightly this leads to an ensuite which adjoins Nastizia’s room. It looks barricaded. The front way in, meanwhile, is visibly off the latch."

rows.original: The Front
rows.translation: 正门
rows.raw: "The Front"

rows.original: The Front
rows.translation: 正门
rows.raw: "The Front"

rows.original: Waste no time, go in through the bedroom’s main door.
rows.translation: 不要浪费时间，从卧室正门进去。
rows.raw: "Waste no time, go in through the bedroom’s main door."

rows.original: The Ensuite
rows.translation: 套内浴室
rows.raw: "The Ensuite"

rows.original: The Ensuite
rows.translation: 套内浴室
rows.raw: "The Ensuite"

rows.original: Ram the door down, go in and out the back way.
rows.translation: 撞开房门，从后方进出。
rows.raw: "Ram the door down, go in and out the back way."

rows.original: The Ensuite
rows.translation: 套内浴室
rows.raw: "The Ensuite"

rows.original: The Ensuite
rows.translation: 套内浴室
rows.raw: "The Ensuite"

rows.original: The only thing you’re going to get by running into that door is a bruised shoulder. If you were of a stronger physique...
rows.translation: 冲撞那扇门只会让你的肩膀挫伤。如果你的体格更加强壮...
rows.raw: "The only thing you’re going to get by running into that door is a bruised shoulder. If you were of a stronger physique..."

rows.original: You might want to be as fast as possible, but you aren’t stupid. You have the rearguard watch your exit route carefully, and then have two other droids barge into the bedroom simultaneously.
rows.translation: 你或许想尽可能迅速，但并不愚蠢。你让后卫严密监视撤离路线，随后命令另外两具机器人同时闯进卧室。
rows.raw: "You might want to be as fast as possible, but you aren’t stupid. You have the rearguard watch your exit route carefully, and then have two other droids barge into the bedroom simultaneously."

rows.original: “Ooh my!” cries Nastizia, excitement shining in her eyes. The kaithrit is huddled on the bed, dressed in a thin and frilly chemise. “My dastardly kidnappers! Come in and grab me, quick - there’s no-one in here, I forbade them...”
rows.translation: “哦，天啊！”娜斯蒂齐娅叫道，双眼因兴奋而闪闪发光。凯斯里特蜷缩在床上，身穿轻薄而带褶边的衬裙。“本宫卑鄙的绑匪！快进来抓住我——这里没有别人，我已经禁止他们进来了...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooh my!” cries Nastizia, excitement shining in her eyes. The kaithrit is huddled on the bed, dressed in a thin and frilly chemise. “My dastardly kidnappers! Come in and grab me, quick - there’s no-one in here, I forbade them...”"

rows.original: You order one of your charges to fireman’s lift her out; no sense in the best marksman on the team doing it. She squeals piercingly as her lovely bottom is hoisted up into the air, and your team hustle out of the room.
rows.translation: 你命令一名手下用消防员搬运法把她带走；没理由让队里枪法最好的人做这件事。当她可爱的屁股被高高抬到空中时，她发出刺耳尖叫，而你的队伍匆匆离开房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou order one of your charges to fireman’s lift her out; no sense in the best marksman on the team doing it. She squeals piercingly as her lovely bottom is hoisted up into the air, and your team hustle out of the room."

rows.original: Two of your droids are blasted out of commission right in front of you. The one hauling Nastizia manages to turn before it too takes a shot to the torso and goes tumbling down. In the split second available to you you realize Riya’s constructed a killzone around the bedroom front door, let you walk right into it - there’s shots coming from the skylights above, from the side, from rooms you passed along the corridor... you manage to roll, grab the soft, light objective and haul ass down a flight of stairs to an atrium, take shelter behind a gilded lounger. None of the rest of team red make it.
rows.translation: 你眼前的两具机器人被轰到失去行动能力。搬运娜斯蒂齐娅的那具刚转过身，也被一枪击中躯干，翻滚着倒下。在仅有的一刹那间，你意识到莉娅在卧室正门周围布置了杀伤区，故意让你径直走进来——枪火从上方天窗、侧面、以及你沿走廊经过的房间里袭来... 你成功翻滚，抱住柔软轻盈的任务目标，飞奔下一段楼梯来到中庭，躲在一张镀金躺椅后面。红队其余成员全部覆灭。
rows.raw: "\n\nTwo of your droids are blasted out of commission right in front of you. The one hauling Nastizia manages to turn before it too takes a shot to the torso and goes tumbling down. In the split second available to you you realize Riya’s constructed a killzone around the bedroom front door, let you walk right into it - there’s shots coming from the skylights above, from the side, from rooms you passed along the corridor... you manage to roll, grab the soft, light objective and haul ass down a flight of stairs to an atrium, take shelter behind a gilded lounger. None of the rest of team red make it."

rows.original: <i>“Surrender, terrorist
rows.translation: <i>“投降吧，恐怖分子
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Surrender, terrorist "

rows.original: worm
rows.translation: 蛆虫
rows.raw: "worm"

rows.original: slut
rows.translation: 小荡妇
rows.raw: "slut"

rows.original: ,” comes Riya’s cool voice from up above. “All of your buddies are kaput, and I need someone for... interrogation.”
rows.translation: ，”莉娅冷静的声音从上方传来。“你的伙伴已经全完蛋了，而我需要某个人来接受... 审讯。”
rows.raw: ",” comes Riya’s cool voice from up above. “All of your buddies are kaput, and I need someone for... interrogation.”"

rows.original: “She’s really gotten into it, hasn’t she? What larks!” whispers Nastizia, hands over mouth.
rows.translation: “她真的入戏了，对吧？太好玩了！”娜斯蒂齐娅双手掩嘴，低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“She’s really gotten into it, hasn’t she? What larks!” whispers Nastizia, hands over mouth."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Third Eye Aim
rows.raw: "Third Eye Aim"

rows.original: You ignore your opponent’s taunts and consider the situation with a cold sniper’s eye. You’ve stumbled into an arena as well suited to one against nine as the one could reasonably hope for: there are many arched doorways out of the atrium, but all of them can be seen reasonably well from the furniture below, and none of them offer any cover. What will Riya do? Sacrifice droids to draw you out for a clear shot. That’s what you’d do. You will have to try and bleed her, frustrate her.
rows.translation: 你无视对手的嘲讽，以冷静狙击手的眼光审视局势。你误入了一片非常适合一对九作战的场地，简直是孤身一人所能合理奢望的最佳环境：中庭有许多拱门出口，但从下方家具处都能相当清楚地看到，而且没有任何出口能提供掩护。莉娅会怎么做？牺牲机器人来把你引出来，争取一次清晰射击。换作你也会这么做。你必须设法放她的血，令她焦躁。
rows.raw: "You ignore your opponent’s taunts and consider the situation with a cold sniper’s eye. You’ve stumbled into an arena as well suited to one against nine as the one could reasonably hope for: there are many arched doorways out of the atrium, but all of them can be seen reasonably well from the furniture below, and none of them offer any cover. What will Riya do? Sacrifice droids to draw you out for a clear shot. That’s what you’d do. You will have to try and bleed her, frustrate her."

rows.original: You put one finger to your lips and point at the floor with another. Just about containing her giggles, Nastizia lies flat as a pancake behind the lounger. You sit and wait, eyes trained on the archways above. Minutes crawl by. The click of drumming claws intrudes.
rows.translation: 你将一根手指放到唇边，再用另一根指向地面。娜斯蒂齐娅勉强忍住笑声，像煎饼一样平躺在躺椅后。你坐着等候，双眼紧盯上方拱门。时间一分一秒缓慢流逝。利爪敲击地面的咔嗒声闯入耳中。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou put one finger to your lips and point at the floor with another. Just about containing her giggles, Nastizia lies flat as a pancake behind the lounger. You sit and wait, eyes trained on the archways above. Minutes crawl by. The click of drumming claws intrudes."

rows.original: “One is getting bo -”
rows.translation: “本宫开始觉得无——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“One is getting bo -”"

rows.original: Four droids burst in simultaneously from different directions, their fire cracking and zapping off the floor and furniture, little arcs of electricity crawling off them. You remain perfectly still for a few more seconds, carefully note each’s path, then rise and fire four precise, circuit-halting shots, immediately flatten yourself. A white bolt whips past your [pc.hairNoun] close enough to
rows.translation: 四具机器人同时从不同方向闯入，火力噼啪作响地击中地面和家具，小股电弧在上面爬行。你又保持绝对静止数秒，仔细记下每一具的路径，随后起身精准射出四枪，令其电路停摆，并立刻重新伏下。一道白色电光从你的[pc.hairNoun]旁呼啸而过，近得足以
rows.raw: "\n\nFour droids burst in simultaneously from different directions, their fire cracking and zapping off the floor and furniture, little arcs of electricity crawling off them. You remain perfectly still for a few more seconds, carefully note each’s path, then rise and fire four precise, circuit-halting shots, immediately flatten yourself. A white bolt whips past your [pc.hairNoun] close enough to"

rows.original: make your fur raise
rows.translation: 让你的毛发竖起
rows.raw: " make your fur raise"

rows.original: to make your [pc.skin] cringe
rows.translation: 让你的[pc.skin]紧缩
rows.raw: " to make your [pc.skin] cringe"

rows.original: make your hairs raise
rows.translation: 让你的汗毛竖起
rows.raw: " make your hairs raise"

rows.original: Where did that come from? A flash of brown from the upper right hand door, you’re sure of it. A better angle... you put your butt on the tiled floor and with a thrust of your [pc.legOrLegs] slide across to the cover of the leather chesterfield. Not a second later four more droids pile in through the lower entrance opposite and make the lounger shudder and crackle with fire. Nastizia buries her head under her arms and screams fit to burst. You aren’t paying attention to anything but that upper right hand door... nothing exists but that upper right hand door... there’s nothing in the universe but that splash of brown in the upper right hand door... you raise your gun and fire.
rows.translation: 那一枪来自哪里？你确信在右上方的门里看到了一抹棕色。更好的角度... 你把屁股坐在瓷砖地面上，猛蹬[pc.legOrLegs]，滑到皮革切斯特菲尔德沙发的掩护后。不到一秒，另外四具机器人从对面的下层入口蜂拥而入，以火力打得躺椅震颤、噼啪作响。娜斯蒂齐娅把脑袋埋在双臂下，放声尖叫。你的注意力全都集中在右上方那扇门上... 除了右上方那扇门，其他一切都不复存在... 宇宙中只剩下右上方门里的那抹棕色... 你举枪射击。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhere did that come from? A flash of brown from the upper right hand door, you’re sure of it. A better angle... you put your butt on the tiled floor and with a thrust of your [pc.legOrLegs] slide across to the cover of the leather chesterfield. Not a second later four more droids pile in through the lower entrance opposite and make the lounger shudder and crackle with fire. Nastizia buries her head under her arms and screams fit to burst. You aren’t paying attention to anything but that upper right hand door... nothing exists but that upper right hand door... there’s nothing in the universe but that splash of brown in the upper right hand door... you raise your gun and fire."

rows.original: Riya gasps and spits an inventive ethnic slur as she drops her gun, current shuddering through her. Swiftly you get to work on the remaining droids. Without their commander, they’re little more than roombas with laser pointers attached. In a few moments, you’re standing alone in the centre of the atrium, weapon rested on your shoulder, the jerking, crackling corpses of team blue arrayed all around. Warm hands and arms wrap themselves around your [pc.legNoun].
rows.translation: 莉娅倒吸一口气，吐出一个极富创意的族裔蔑称，同时松开武器，电流令她浑身颤抖。你迅速开始处理剩余机器人。没有指挥官，它们不过是装了激光指示器的扫地机器人。片刻后，你独自站在中庭中央，武器搭在肩上，蓝队抽搐、噼啪作响的尸体散落四周。温暖的双手和手臂环住你的[pc.legNoun]。
rows.raw: "\n\nRiya gasps and spits an inventive ethnic slur as she drops her gun, current shuddering through her. Swiftly you get to work on the remaining droids. Without their commander, they’re little more than roombas with laser pointers attached. In a few moments, you’re standing alone in the centre of the atrium, weapon rested on your shoulder, the jerking, crackling corpses of team blue arrayed all around. Warm hands and arms wrap themselves around your [pc.legNoun]."

rows.original: “What a performance!” exclaims Nastizia, blue eyes shining up at you with delight. “What drama! The way you got your whole team destroyed just so you could put this showdown on for me, [pc.name]... oh, you are a winner’s winner, there can be no doubt!”
rows.translation: “何等精彩的表演！”娜斯蒂齐娅惊叹道，蓝眼睛仰望着你，因喜悦而闪闪发光。“多么富有戏剧性！[pc.name]，你故意让整个队伍全军覆没，就为了给本宫献上这场决战... 哦，你是赢家中的赢家，这一点毋庸置疑！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What a performance!” exclaims Nastizia, blue eyes shining up at you with delight. “What drama! The way you got your whole team destroyed just so you could put this showdown on for me, [pc.name]... oh, you are a winner’s winner, there can be no doubt!”"

rows.original: Yes. Yes, that’s definitely what you were planning all along. You smile down at her with the roguish twinkle you’ve perfected, and turn the same expression on Riya when she emerges scowling on the landing above.
rows.translation: 没错。没错，这绝对从一开始就是你的计划。你低头向她露出自己磨炼已久、闪烁着不羁光芒的微笑；当莉娅怒容满面地出现在上方平台时，你也把同样的表情投向她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYes. Yes, that’s definitely what you were planning all along. You smile down at her with the roguish twinkle you’ve perfected, and turn the same expression on Riya when she emerges scowling on the landing above."

rows.original: “You got owned,” she gristles. “One lucky shot right at the end, that’s all you had.”
rows.translation: “你被彻底打爆了，”她咬牙说道。“只不过最后走运打中一枪，那就是你的全部本事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You got owned,” she gristles. “One lucky shot right at the end, that’s all you had.”"

rows.original: “Oh don’t be such a sore loser, darling,” Nastizia smirks. Her hand slides up your [pc.thigh] as she gets to her feet. “Come come - let us three retire somewhere private and administer prizes. And, ah, forfeits.”
rows.translation: “哦，亲爱的，别当个输不起的人，”娜斯蒂齐娅得意一笑。起身时，她的手沿你的[pc.thigh]向上滑动。“来吧，来吧——我们三个去某个私密的地方颁发奖品。还有，呃，惩罚。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh don’t be such a sore loser, darling,” Nastizia smirks. Her hand slides up your [pc.thigh] as she gets to her feet. “Come come - let us three retire somewhere private and administer prizes. And, ah, forfeits.”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_PC_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_PC_WINS"

rows.original: You grit your teeth and tighten your grip on the electro smg, resolving to make this as difficult for her as you possibly can.
rows.translation: 你咬紧牙关，握紧电击冲锋枪，决心尽一切可能给她制造困难。
rows.raw: "You grit your teeth and tighten your grip on the electro smg, resolving to make this as difficult for her as you possibly can."

rows.original: And you do pretty well, in the circumstances. When droids begin pouring in from every arched doorway, you take down one, then another, then are quick enough to duck back into cover before the white, crackling barrage aimed your way finds you. But they’re in the room now, circling around you, and it’s only a matter of time. When you emerge again to try and pick off the one crawling down your three o’ clock, Riya nails you right in the
rows.translation: 考虑到眼下的情况，你表现得相当不错。当机器人开始从每一扇拱门涌入时，你击倒一具，又击倒一具，随后及时缩回掩体，避开射向自己的白色噼啪弹幕。但它们现在已经进入房间，正从周围包抄你，落败只是时间问题。你再次现身，试图射掉从三点钟方向爬来的那具机器人时，莉娅从上方平台的位置准确命中你的
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd you do pretty well, in the circumstances. When droids begin pouring in from every arched doorway, you take down one, then another, then are quick enough to duck back into cover before the white, crackling barrage aimed your way finds you. But they’re in the room now, circling around you, and it’s only a matter of time. When you emerge again to try and pick off the one crawling down your three o’ clock, Riya nails you right in the "
