rows.translation: 乳房
rows.raw: "tits"

rows.original: chest
rows.translation: 胸口
rows.raw: "chest"

rows.original: from her position on the landing above. You cry out and convulse, reactively hurling your smg away from you. When you recover, it’s to find the ripped form of Riya standing over you, smirking triumphantly.
rows.translation: 。你惊叫着浑身抽搐，本能地把冲锋枪远远扔开。等你恢复过来，发现肌肉分明的莉娅正站在上方，胜利地得意微笑。
rows.raw: " from her position on the landing above. You cry out and convulse, reactively hurling your smg away from you. When you recover, it’s to find the ripped form of Riya standing over you, smirking triumphantly."

rows.original: “What did I tell you, kitten?” She reaches down and hauls Nastizia into her arms. “You’re in safe hands as long as you’re employing me. At least if every kidnapper is as dumb as this goober.”
rows.translation: “我告诉过你什么，小猫咪？”她伸手把娜斯蒂齐娅抱进怀里。“只要还雇着我，你就安全得很。至少每个绑匪都像这个呆瓜一样蠢的话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What did I tell you, kitten?” She reaches down and hauls Nastizia into her arms. “You’re in safe hands as long as you’re employing me. At least if every kidnapper is as dumb as this goober.”"

rows.original: “You’re so utterly without mercy, darling.” The kaithrit hisses the word with delight, stroking the human’s muscular arms. “What a ruthless display you put on!” She turns her half-lidded sapphire eyes on you. “Come along, dear. It’s time to administer prizes! And it would hardly be a prize if there wasn’t a forfeit to go with it, would it?”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，你真是彻底不知仁慈为何物。”凯斯里特愉悦地嘶声吐出这个词，抚摸人类肌肉发达的手臂。“你上演了何等冷酷无情的表演！”她用半阖的蓝宝石双眼看向你。“来吧，亲爱的。该颁发奖品了！而且如果没有惩罚相伴，奖品也很难算得上奖品，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re so utterly without mercy, darling.” The kaithrit hisses the word with delight, stroking the human’s muscular arms. “What a ruthless display you put on!” She turns her half-lidded sapphire eyes on you. “Come along, dear. It’s time to administer prizes! And it would hardly be a prize if there wasn’t a forfeit to go with it, would it?”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You take a couple of steps back then charge at the door, slamming into it shoulder first. It parts from its hinges cleanly, snapping the table that had been leaned against the other side in half. You stampede through the ensuite with a bestial roar, making the kaithrit waiting in the bedroom beyond jump with fright.
rows.translation: 你向后退了几步，接着冲向房门，用肩膀率先撞上去。房门干净利落地脱离铰链，把抵在另一侧的桌子撞断成两截。你发出野兽般的吼声，狂奔穿过套内浴室，把等在后方卧室里的凯斯里特吓得跳了起来。
rows.raw: "You take a couple of steps back then charge at the door, slamming into it shoulder first. It parts from its hinges cleanly, snapping the table that had been leaned against the other side in half. You stampede through the ensuite with a bestial roar, making the kaithrit waiting in the bedroom beyond jump with fright."

rows.original: “Oh my Steele darling, you gave one quite the shock! What an alarming kidnapper you make! Quick quick - there’s no-one in here, I forbade them - ”
rows.translation: “哦，亲爱的斯蒂尔，你可把本宫吓了一大跳！真是个骇人的绑匪！快，快——这里没有别人，我已经禁止他们进来了——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my Steele darling, you gave one quite the shock! What an alarming kidnapper you make! Quick quick - there’s no-one in here, I forbade them - ”"

rows.original: You order one of your droids to firelift her out; no sense in the best marksman on the team doing it. The droid does so, lifting a squealing Nastizia onto its metal shoulder. Avoiding the main door entirely, you swiftly marshall your force out the way you came.
rows.translation: 你命令一具机器人以消防员搬运法把她带出去；没理由让队里枪法最好的人做这件事。机器人照办，把尖叫的娜斯蒂齐娅扛上金属肩膀。你们完全避开正门，迅速组织队伍沿原路撤离。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou order one of your droids to firelift her out; no sense in the best marksman on the team doing it. The droid does so, lifting a squealing Nastizia onto its metal shoulder. Avoiding the main door entirely, you swiftly marshall your force out the way you came."

rows.original: It’s at the head of the stairs you encounter problems. You didn’t go where Riya wanted you to, but she’s adapted swiftly, moving her forces around. Blue droids burst out of nearby rooms and open fire; below, the big busty human bursts into view, running and gunning as she barks at the droids with her to take positions behind the drawing room furniture. She takes out red droids with remorseless precision. The one carrying Nastizia gets popped in the torso. Crackling and sputtering, it spills the objective wriggling and giggling hysterically onto the carpet.
rows.translation: 你们在楼梯顶端遭遇了麻烦。你没有去莉娅希望你去的地方，但她迅速适应，调动了兵力。蓝色机器人从附近房间冲出开火；下方，那个丰乳高大的人类冲入视野，一边奔跑射击，一边高声命令随行机器人占据客厅家具后的阵地。她以冷酷精准的枪法逐个击倒红色机器人。搬运娜斯蒂齐娅的那具被击中躯干，噼啪作响、断续喷火地倒下，把扭动着、歇斯底里大笑的任务目标摔在地毯上。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s at the head of the stairs you encounter problems. You didn’t go where Riya wanted you to, but she’s adapted swiftly, moving her forces around. Blue droids burst out of nearby rooms and open fire; below, the big busty human bursts into view, running and gunning as she barks at the droids with her to take positions behind the drawing room furniture. She takes out red droids with remorseless precision. The one carrying Nastizia gets popped in the torso. Crackling and sputtering, it spills the objective wriggling and giggling hysterically onto the carpet."

rows.original: Third Eye Aim
rows.raw: "Third Eye Aim"

rows.original: You remain calm, ignoring Nastizia for the moment to crouch-sprint to the stairs, staying out of view directly behind one of your droids, eye and gun on the floor below. Riya darts out again, confidently nailing the droid in front of you before it can fire... gifting you a clear and easy shot on the human herself. You land it on her clavicle with a satisfyingly meaty ZAP, stopping the human in her tracks and spilling her brawny bod onto the floor.
rows.translation: 你保持冷静，暂时无视娜斯蒂齐娅，蹲身冲向楼梯，直接躲在一具己方机器人身后避开视野，同时用眼睛和枪口盯住下层。莉娅再次冲出来，自信地击中你面前的机器人，令其还没来得及开火便倒下... 这也恰好送给你一次清晰而轻松的射击机会，目标正是那个人类。你一枪命中她的锁骨，伴随令人满足的肉感滋啪声，令她脚步戛然而止，健壮的身体摔倒在地。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou remain calm, ignoring Nastizia for the moment to crouch-sprint to the stairs, staying out of view directly behind one of your droids, eye and gun on the floor below. Riya darts out again, confidently nailing the droid in front of you before it can fire... gifting you a clear and easy shot on the human herself. You land it on her clavicle with a satisfyingly meaty ZAP, stopping the human in her tracks and spilling her brawny bod onto the floor."

rows.original: Riya’s fluent curses in your ears, you marshall your team to form up and take out the remaining blue droids around you. Without their commander they know little more than how to take cover and fire, and soon enough you’ve brought them all down. You stand amongst the crackling, zapping, gently smoking devastation with your three surviving bots, smg rested on your shoulder. Warm hands and arms wrap themselves around your [pc.legs].
rows.translation: 耳中响着莉娅流畅的咒骂，你组织队伍集结，消灭周围剩余的蓝色机器人。没有指挥官，它们除了寻找掩体和开火，几乎什么都不懂；很快你便将其全部击倒。你和幸存的三具机器人站在这片噼啪放电、微微冒烟的废墟之间，冲锋枪搭在肩上。温暖的双手和手臂环住你的[pc.legs]。
rows.raw: "\n\nRiya’s fluent curses in your ears, you marshall your team to form up and take out the remaining blue droids around you. Without their commander they know little more than how to take cover and fire, and soon enough you’ve brought them all down. You stand amongst the crackling, zapping, gently smoking devastation with your three surviving bots, smg rested on your shoulder. Warm hands and arms wrap themselves around your [pc.legs]."

rows.original: “What a performance!” exclaims Nastizia, blue eyes shining up at you with delight. “What brutish, bestial will brought to bear! Ooh, I’m coming over faint just thinking about you bursting down that door... you are an animal, Steele darling!”
rows.translation: “何等精彩的表演！”娜斯蒂齐娅惊叹道，蓝眼睛仰望着你，因喜悦而闪闪发光。“何等粗野的兽性意志得到了展现！哦哦，一想到你撞开那扇门的模样，本宫就要昏过去了... 亲爱的斯蒂尔，你真是一头野兽！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What a performance!” exclaims Nastizia, blue eyes shining up at you with delight. “What brutish, bestial will brought to bear! Ooh, I’m coming over faint just thinking about you bursting down that door... you are an animal, Steele darling!”"

rows.original: You smile down at her with that roguish twinkle you’ve perfected, and turn the same expression on Riya, scowlingly brushing herself down below.
rows.translation: 你低头向她露出自己磨炼已久、闪烁着不羁光芒的微笑；莉娅在下方怒容满面地拍掉身上灰尘时，你也把同样的表情投向她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile down at her with that roguish twinkle you’ve perfected, and turn the same expression on Riya, scowlingly brushing herself down below."

rows.original: “I’ll admit,” she says. “I wasn’t expecting you to cause actual property damage just to win a dumb laser tag contest.”
rows.translation: “我承认，”她说道，“我没料到你仅仅为了赢一场愚蠢的激光枪战比赛，居然真的会破坏财物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll admit,” she says. “I wasn’t expecting you to cause actual property damage just to win a dumb laser tag contest.”"

rows.original: “Oh don’t be such a sore loser, darling,” Nastizia smirks. Her hand slides up your [pc.thigh] as she gets to her feet. “Come - it’s time to administer prizes. And, ah, forfeits.”
rows.translation: “哦，亲爱的，别这么输不起，”娜斯蒂齐娅露出坏笑。她站起身时，一只手沿你的[pc.thigh]向上滑动。“来吧——该颁发奖品了。还有，啊，惩罚。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh don’t be such a sore loser, darling,” Nastizia smirks. Her hand slides up your [pc.thigh] as she gets to her feet. “Come - it’s time to administer prizes. And, ah, forfeits.”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_PC_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_PC_WINS"

rows.original: You’re torn between hurrying across to grab Nastizia and watching the floor below for a moment... and Riya uses that moment to rise and nail you right in the chest with her zap gun. You yell, fall struggling and convulsing with the charge, and lose your own gun in the process. By the time you’ve managed to stagger to your feet the rest of your team has been felled, and you can only watch as a smirking Riya strides up the stairs and scoops Nastizia into her arms.
rows.translation: 你一时难以决定，是该赶快冲过去抓住娜斯蒂齐娅，还是再看一会儿下方楼层...而莉娅利用这一瞬起身，用电击枪正中你的胸膛。你大喊着倒下，在电流中挣扎抽搐，同时丢掉自己的枪。等你终于踉跄站起，队伍其他成员已经全部倒下；你只能眼看莉娅坏笑着大步登上楼梯，把娜斯蒂齐娅抱进怀里。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re torn between hurrying across to grab Nastizia and watching the floor below for a moment... and Riya uses that moment to rise and nail you right in the chest with her zap gun. You yell, fall struggling and convulsing with the charge, and lose your own gun in the process. By the time you’ve managed to stagger to your feet the rest of your team has been felled, and you can only watch as a smirking Riya strides up the stairs and scoops Nastizia into her arms."

rows.original: “What did I tell you, kitten?” She reaches down and hauls Nastizia into her arms. “You’re in safe hands as long as you’re employing me. At least if every kidnapper is as much a meathead as this
rows.translation: “我告诉过你什么，小猫？”她俯身把娜斯蒂齐娅抱起。“只要雇用我，你就绝对安全。至少所有绑匪都像这个
rows.raw: "\n\n“What did I tell you, kitten?” She reaches down and hauls Nastizia into her arms. “You’re in safe hands as long as you’re employing me. At least if every kidnapper is as much a meathead as this "

rows.original: idiot
rows.translation: 蠢货
rows.raw: "idiot"

rows.original: bimbo
rows.translation: 花瓶女
rows.raw: "bimbo"

rows.translation: 一样头脑简单。”

rows.original: “You’re so utterly without mercy, darling.” The kaithrit hisses the word with delight, stroking the human’s muscular arms. “What a ruthless display you put on!” She turns her half-lidded sapphire eyes on you. “Come along, dear. It’s time to administer prizes! And it would hardly be a prize if there wasn’t a forfeit to go with it, would it?”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，你真是完全不懂仁慈。”凯斯瑞特愉悦地嘶出这个词，抚摸人类肌肉发达的手臂。“你刚才的表现真是冷酷无情！”她把半眯的蓝宝石眼睛转向你。“过来吧，亲爱的。该颁发奖品了！不过奖品若不配上惩罚，就很难算是奖品，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re so utterly without mercy, darling.” The kaithrit hisses the word with delight, stroking the human’s muscular arms. “What a ruthless display you put on!” She turns her half-lidded sapphire eyes on you. “Come along, dear. It’s time to administer prizes! And it would hardly be a prize if there wasn’t a forfeit to go with it, would it?”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You could split the droids into two parties, draw Riya off with one group and then ride in and seize the objective with the other. But she’ll surely be expecting that. What you need to do is really convince her you’re with the decoy party. And how you might do that is...
rows.translation: 你可以把机器人分成两队，用一队引开莉娅，再带另一队冲进去夺取目标。但她肯定预料得到。你真正需要做的，是让她彻底相信你和诱饵队伍在一起。至于该怎么做到...
rows.raw: "You could split the droids into two parties, draw Riya off with one group and then ride in and seize the objective with the other. But she’ll surely be expecting that. What you need to do is really convince her you’re with the decoy party. And how you might do that is..."

rows.original: What are the capabilities of these droids?
rows.translation: 这些机器人的能力是什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat are the capabilities of these droids?"

rows.original: “Hey,” you say to your lieutenant. “Can you mimic my voice?”
rows.translation: “嘿，”你对副官说道，“能模仿我的声音吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey,” you say to your lieutenant. “Can you mimic my voice?”"

rows.original: The droid gazes back at you with its featureless box of a face. There’s a click like a cassette player being turned on.
rows.translation: 机器人用毫无特征的方盒脸望着你。伴随一声仿佛磁带播放器启动的咔哒。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe droid gazes back at you with its featureless box of a face. There’s a click like a cassette player being turned on."

rows.original: “Hey,” the droid says in your voice. “Can you mimic my voice?”
rows.translation: “嘿，”机器人用你的声音说道，“能模仿我的声音吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey,” the droid says in your voice. “Can you mimic my voice?”"

rows.original: From a short distance, in the heat of battle, you wouldn’t be able to tell the difference, maybe. You quickly give the droid a dozen phrases to repeat as it’s leading its group in from one side of the Romavian mansion.
rows.translation: 从不远处听，在激战中，也许根本分辨不出区别。机器人带领小组从罗马维亚宅邸一侧进入时，你迅速交给它十几句话反复播放。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom a short distance, in the heat of battle, you wouldn’t be able to tell the difference, maybe. You quickly give the droid a dozen phrases to repeat as it’s leading its group in from one side of the Romavian mansion."

rows.original: You shuck off your [pc.upperGarment] as you instruct it, throw the garment over its metallic shoulders. Yeah. Again, if you just happened to catch a glimpse of it, from a distance...
rows.translation: 你一边指示，一边脱下[pc.upperGarment]，把衣物披在它金属肩膀上。对。还是那句话，如果只是碰巧从远处瞥见...
rows.raw: " You shuck off your [pc.upperGarment] as you instruct it, throw the garment over its metallic shoulders. Yeah. Again, if you just happened to catch a glimpse of it, from a distance..."

rows.original: “Go over there!” it drones, leading 7 other droids off. “Through this room! Enemy at eleven o’ clock, tin tits! Go over there!”
rows.translation: “去那边！”它发出单调机械声，带着另外7台机器人离开。“穿过这个房间！十一点方向有敌人，铁皮奶子！去那边！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Go over there!” it drones, leading 7 other droids off. “Through this room! Enemy at eleven o’ clock, tin tits! Go over there!”"

rows.original: With your smaller group, you carefully sneak over to the opposite side of the estate. You’ve already pinpointed your own entry point: a small bathroom window on the first floor, some distance away from Nastizia’s room, surely unguarded. The decoy will have to work to give you the time necessary to hustle up to her.
rows.translation: 你带着规模较小的队伍，小心潜行到庄园另一侧。你已经选好自己的入口：一楼的小浴室窗户，与娜斯蒂齐娅的房间相隔一段距离，肯定无人把守。诱饵必须发挥作用，为你争取冲到她身边所需的时间。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your smaller group, you carefully sneak over to the opposite side of the estate. You’ve already pinpointed your own entry point: a small bathroom window on the first floor, some distance away from Nastizia’s room, surely unguarded. The decoy will have to work to give you the time necessary to hustle up to her."

rows.original: You hear the tinkle and zip of breaking hard light on the other side, the clank and clatter of multiple droids jumping through a window frame. You wait thirty unbearable seconds, long enough for Riya to hear your voice... and then you leap into action. You and your team of three throw a ladder borrowed from the crystal garden tool shed against the synth-steel wall and clamber up it, squeezing one after the other into the darkness of the bathroom. To your ears, you make an unbearable amount of noise - but when you emerge into the light of the hall, nobody is there to greet you.
rows.translation: 另一侧传来硬光破裂的叮当与嗖响，以及多台机器人跳过窗框的铿锵碰撞声。你熬过难以忍受的三十秒，足够莉娅听见你的声音...随后立刻行动。你和三人小队把一架从水晶花园工具棚借来的梯子架在合成钢墙上，迅速爬上去，一个接一个挤进浴室的黑暗中。在你耳里，自己制造的噪声大得无法忍受——但当你走进走廊灯光时，没有任何人迎接。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hear the tinkle and zip of breaking hard light on the other side, the clank and clatter of multiple droids jumping through a window frame. You wait thirty unbearable seconds, long enough for Riya to hear your voice... and then you leap into action. You and your team of three throw a ladder borrowed from the crystal garden tool shed against the synth-steel wall and clamber up it, squeezing one after the other into the darkness of the bathroom. To your ears, you make an unbearable amount of noise - but when you emerge into the light of the hall, nobody is there to greet you."

rows.original: The sound of metal carnage can be heard faintly below. Without anyone to command them Riya will make short work of your bots, and then she’ll realize her mistake. You move as quickly and quietly as you can up to the second floor.
rows.translation: 下方隐约传来金属毁灭的声响。没有人指挥，莉娅很快就能收拾你的机器人，随后会意识到错误。你尽可能迅速而安静地赶往二楼。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sound of metal carnage can be heard faintly below. Without anyone to command them Riya will make short work of your bots, and then she’ll realize her mistake. You move as quickly and quietly as you can up to the second floor."

rows.original: In front of Nastizia’s room three blue droids have been left, barricaded behind tables. They immediately start firing as your team emerges in the hallway. Your vanguard droid eats a couple of shots and goes down fizzing and stuttering. You are next in line.
rows.translation: 娜斯蒂齐娅房门前留下三台蓝色机器人，躲在桌子构成的路障后。你的队伍刚出现在走廊，它们就立刻开火。先锋机器人挨了几枪，滋滋作响、结结巴巴地倒下。下一个就是你。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn front of Nastizia’s room three blue droids have been left, barricaded behind tables. They immediately start firing as your team emerges in the hallway. Your vanguard droid eats a couple of shots and goes down fizzing and stuttering. You are next in line."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Split the droids into two groups. Have the larger group go in on one side, wait a little bit, then dart in with the smaller group on the other and cap the objective. That should work, right?
rows.translation: 把机器人分成两组。让较大一组从一侧进入，稍等片刻，再带较小一组从另一侧冲进去夺取目标。这应该能奏效，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nSplit the droids into two groups. Have the larger group go in on one side, wait a little bit, then dart in with the smaller group on the other and cap the objective. That should work, right?"

rows.original: You select one of the better paint jobs as your lieutenant, issue it with careful instructions. It clicks and clanks off with seven other droids. With the remainder, you sneak across to the other wing, select a bathroom window on the first floor, some distance away from Nastizia’s room, surely unguarded. The decoy will have to work to give you the time necessary to hustle up there.
rows.translation: 你从涂装较好的机器人中挑选一台作为副官，给它下达详细指示。它咔哒铿锵地带着另外七台机器人离开。你带着剩余成员偷偷穿过另一翼楼，选中一楼的小浴室窗户；那里与娜斯蒂齐娅的房间相隔一段距离，肯定无人把守。诱饵必须发挥作用，为你争取冲上去所需的时间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou select one of the better paint jobs as your lieutenant, issue it with careful instructions. It clicks and clanks off with seven other droids. With the remainder, you sneak across to the other wing, select a bathroom window on the first floor, some distance away from Nastizia’s room, surely unguarded. The decoy will have to work to give you the time necessary to hustle up there."

rows.original: You hear the tinkle and zip of breaking hard light on the other side, the clank and clatter of multiple droids jumping through a window frame. You wait thirty unbearable seconds, long enough for Riya to be drawn away... and then you leap into action. You and your team of three throw a ladder borrowed from the crystal garden tool shed against the synth-steel wall and clamber up it, squeezing one after the other into the darkness of the bathroom. To your ears, you make an unbearable amount of noise - but when you emerge into the light of the corridor, nobody is there to greet you.
rows.translation: 另一侧传来硬光破裂的叮当与嗖响，以及多台机器人跳过窗框的铿锵碰撞声。你熬过难以忍受的三十秒，足够把莉娅引开...随后立刻行动。你和三人小队把一架从水晶花园工具棚借来的梯子架在合成钢墙上，迅速爬上去，一个接一个挤进浴室的黑暗中。在你耳里，自己制造的噪声大得无法忍受——但当你走进走廊灯光时，没有任何人迎接。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hear the tinkle and zip of breaking hard light on the other side, the clank and clatter of multiple droids jumping through a window frame. You wait thirty unbearable seconds, long enough for Riya to be drawn away... and then you leap into action. You and your team of three throw a ladder borrowed from the crystal garden tool shed against the synth-steel wall and clamber up it, squeezing one after the other into the darkness of the bathroom. To your ears, you make an unbearable amount of noise - but when you emerge into the light of the corridor, nobody is there to greet you."

rows.original: At the end of the long hall leading to Nastizia’s room a single blue bot has been posted: sheltering behind an upturned table, it takes potshots at your team as they gain ground. As you crouch-walk into a side bedroom one of yours manages to crown the sentry and sends it tumbling squawking to the ground. You can hear the sound of metal carnage further below; your decoy must have worked. You barge straight into the bedroom, zap gun at the ready.
rows.translation: 通往娜斯蒂齐娅房间的长廊尽头驻守着一台蓝色机器人：它躲在翻倒的桌子后，在你的队伍推进时断续射击。你蹲行进入侧面卧室时，己方一台机器人成功击中哨兵头顶，让它尖叫着翻滚倒地。更下方传来金属毁灭的声响；诱饵肯定成功了。你举着电击枪，径直闯入卧室。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt the end of the long hall leading to Nastizia’s room a single blue bot has been posted: sheltering behind an upturned table, it takes potshots at your team as they gain ground. As you crouch-walk into a side bedroom one of yours manages to crown the sentry and sends it tumbling squawking to the ground. You can hear the sound of metal carnage further below; your decoy must have worked. You barge straight into the bedroom, zap gun at the ready."

rows.original: “Ooh my!” cries Nastizia, excitement shining in her eyes. The kaithrit is huddled on the bed, dressed in a thin and frilly chemise. “My dastardly kidnappers! Come in and grab me, quick - there’s no-one in here, I forbade them...”
rows.translation: “哦，天哪！”娜斯蒂齐娅叫道，双眼闪烁兴奋。凯斯瑞特蜷在床上，穿着一件轻薄蕾丝衬裙。“我卑鄙的绑匪们！快进来抓住我——这里没有别人，我禁止他们进入...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooh my!” cries Nastizia, excitement shining in her eyes. The kaithrit is huddled on the bed, dressed in a thin and frilly chemise. “My dastardly kidnappers! Come in and grab me, quick - there’s no-one in here, I forbade them...”"

rows.original: You order one of your charges to fireman’s lift her out; no sense in the best marksman on the team doing it. She squeals piercingly as her lovely bottom is hoisted up into the air, and your team hustle out of the room.
rows.translation: 你命令一名手下用消防员抱法把她带出去；没理由让队里枪法最好的成员亲自搬运。她可爱的臀部被高高抬起时发出刺耳尖叫，你的小队匆忙冲出房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou order one of your charges to fireman’s lift her out; no sense in the best marksman on the team doing it. She squeals piercingly as her lovely bottom is hoisted up into the air, and your team hustle out of the room."

rows.original: One of your droids is blasted out of commission right in front of you. The one hauling Nastizia manages to turn before it too takes a shot to the torso and goes tumbling down. In the split second available to you you realize Riya’s constructed a killzone around the bedroom front door, let you walk right into it - there’s shots coming from the skylights above, from the side,from rooms you passed along the corridor... you manage to roll, grab the soft, light objective and haul ass down a flight of stairs to an atrium, take shelter behind a gilded lounger. Your other droid doesn’t stand a chance.
rows.translation: 一台机器人就在面前被轰到无法运转。搬运娜斯蒂齐娅的那台成功转身，却也被击中躯干，翻滚倒下。你在转瞬之间意识到，莉娅在卧室前门周围布置了杀戮区，故意让你径直走进来——射击来自上方天窗、侧面、来自你沿走廊经过的房间...你成功翻滚，抓住柔软轻盈的目标，拼命冲下一段楼梯来到中庭，躲在镀金躺椅后。另一台机器人毫无胜算。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of your droids is blasted out of commission right in front of you. The one hauling Nastizia manages to turn before it too takes a shot to the torso and goes tumbling down. In the split second available to you you realize Riya’s constructed a killzone around the bedroom front door, let you walk right into it - there’s shots coming from the skylights above, from the side,from rooms you passed along the corridor... you manage to roll, grab the soft, light objective and haul ass down a flight of stairs to an atrium, take shelter behind a gilded lounger. Your other droid doesn’t stand a chance."

rows.original: <i>“Surrender, terrorist
rows.translation: <i>“投降吧，恐怖分子
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Surrender, terrorist "

rows.original: worm
rows.translation: 蛆虫
rows.raw: "worm"

rows.original: slut
rows.translation: 小荡妇
rows.raw: "slut"

rows.original: ,” comes Riya’s cool voice from up above. “All of your buddies are kaput, and I need someone for... interrogation.”
rows.translation: ，”莉娅冷静的声音从上方传来。“你的同伴全完蛋了，而我需要一个人来...审讯。”
rows.raw: ",” comes Riya’s cool voice from up above. “All of your buddies are kaput, and I need someone for... interrogation.”"

rows.original: “She’s really gotten into it, hasn’t she? What larks!” whispers Nastizia, hands over mouth.
rows.translation: “她真的沉浸进去了，对不对？多有趣啊！”娜斯蒂齐娅双手掩嘴，低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“She’s really gotten into it, hasn’t she? What larks!” whispers Nastizia, hands over mouth."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Third Eye Aim
rows.raw: "Third Eye Aim"

rows.original: You clock one cold as you like, then dart into an adjoining room for cover, white energy bolts crackling and melting the varnish off the nearby woodwork. Your friendlies draw the remaining two out to try again, and this time you are able to lead your fire and take both of them out. You step over their twitching chassis into Nastizia’s room.
rows.translation: 你从容地一枪击倒一台机器人，随后冲进相邻房间寻找掩护；白色能量束噼啪飞过，熔掉附近木制装饰的清漆。友军把剩下两台引出来再次尝试，这次你成功提前瞄准，击倒两台。你跨过它们抽搐的机体，进入娜斯蒂齐娅的房间。
rows.raw: "You clock one cold as you like, then dart into an adjoining room for cover, white energy bolts crackling and melting the varnish off the nearby woodwork. Your friendlies draw the remaining two out to try again, and this time you are able to lead your fire and take both of them out. You step over their twitching chassis into Nastizia’s room."

rows.original: “Ooh my!” cries Nastizia, excitement shining in her eyes. The kaithrit is huddled on the bed, dressed in a thin and frilly chemise. “My dastardly kidnappers! Come in and grab me, quick - there’s no-one in here, I forbade them...”
rows.translation: “哦，天哪！”娜斯蒂齐娅叫道，双眼闪烁兴奋。凯斯瑞特蜷在床上，穿着一件轻薄蕾丝衬裙。“我卑鄙的绑匪们！快进来抓住我——这里没有别人，我禁止他们进入...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooh my!” cries Nastizia, excitement shining in her eyes. The kaithrit is huddled on the bed, dressed in a thin and frilly chemise. “My dastardly kidnappers! Come in and grab me, quick - there’s no-one in here, I forbade them...”"

rows.original: You do the honors yourself, hauling her light, soft weight onto your shoulder. The kaithrit comes with a delighted squeal which surely everyone in the house can hear.
rows.translation: 你亲自完成这份荣誉，把她轻盈柔软的身体扛到肩上。凯斯瑞特发出欣喜尖叫，肯定整栋屋子里的人都能听见。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do the honors yourself, hauling her light, soft weight onto your shoulder. The kaithrit comes with a delighted squeal which surely everyone in the house can hear."

rows.original: Sure enough, as you’re emerging back into the hallway, you hear the thunder of approaching feet from the stairway at the opposite end you came in. Time to be ruthless.
rows.translation: 果然，你刚回到走廊，就听见脚步如雷，从进入方向相反一端的楼梯传来。该冷酷一点了。
rows.raw: "\n\nSure enough, as you’re emerging back into the hallway, you hear the thunder of approaching feet from the stairway at the opposite end you came in. Time to be ruthless."

rows.original: “You two, there,” you command, nodding at the table barricade. “Hold ‘em for as long as you can.”
rows.translation: “你们两个，就在那里，”你命令道，朝桌子路障点头。“尽可能长时间拖住他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You two, there,” you command, nodding at the table barricade. “Hold ‘em for as long as you can.”"

rows.original: “Moger moger.”
rows.translation: “莫格莫格。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Moger moger.”"

rows.original: You haul ass down the hallway. An electric bolt snaps an inch past your ear as you turn down the stairs, and there’s a snarl of frustration behind you. You allow yourself a grin.
rows.translation: 你沿走廊拼命狂奔。转下楼梯时，一道电束从耳边一英寸处划过，身后传来恼怒咆哮。你允许自己露出笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou haul ass down the hallway. An electric bolt snaps an inch past your ear as you turn down the stairs, and there’s a snarl of frustration behind you. You allow yourself a grin."

rows.original: “Did you really sacrifice your whole team just to get your paws all over me, Steele dear?” coos a musical voice just beyond your ear. “That’s so scrumptiously ruthless of you! That’s so... oop!”
rows.translation: “亲爱的斯蒂尔，你真的牺牲整支队伍，只为了用爪子把我摸遍吗？”音乐般的声音在耳边不远处娇声说道。“你真是美味地冷酷！真是太...呀！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did you really sacrifice your whole team just to get your paws all over me, Steele dear?” coos a musical voice just beyond your ear. “That’s so scrumptiously ruthless of you! That’s so... oop!”"

rows.original: You’ve sat her bottom down on the bathroom’s windowsill. Managing to summon a gentleman thief’s voice from somewhere, you tell the good lady that she must climb down... or else you don’t know what you’ll do. Eyes shining, she hurries down the ladder, and a moment later you follow - just as Riya bursts into the bathroom, SMG in hand. You haul outside air into your lungs. Tastes like victory.
rows.translation: 你已经让她的臀部坐在浴室窗台上。你不知从哪里召唤出绅士盗贼的声音，告诉这位好女士必须爬下去...否则连你都不知道自己会做什么。她双眼闪亮，匆忙沿梯子爬下；片刻后你也跟了下去——就在莉娅手持冲锋枪闯入浴室之际。你把户外空气大口吸进肺中。尝起来像胜利。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve sat her bottom down on the bathroom’s windowsill. Managing to summon a gentleman thief’s voice from somewhere, you tell the good lady that she must climb down... or else you don’t know what you’ll do. Eyes shining, she hurries down the ladder, and a moment later you follow - just as Riya bursts into the bathroom, SMG in hand. You haul outside air into your lungs. Tastes like victory."

rows.original: “That was wonderful darling,” Nastizia is saying, tails wrapping themselves around your [pc.feet] as you stroll with her back through the main entrance. “So devilish of you! Oh, it would make a marvellous plot for an extranet drama. I know some chaps on Nueva Monica you know, we should look into it... ”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，刚才太精彩了，”娜斯蒂齐娅说道；你陪她从正门走回去时，尾巴缠绕着[pc.feet]。“太邪恶了！哦，这会成为外联网剧集的绝佳剧情。我在新莫妮卡认识几个人，你知道，我们应该研究一下... ”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That was wonderful darling,” Nastizia is saying, tails wrapping themselves around your [pc.feet] as you stroll with her back through the main entrance. “So devilish of you! Oh, it would make a marvellous plot for an extranet drama. I know some chaps on Nueva Monica you know, we should look into it... ”"

rows.original: “You lost your whole team, and in real life I would’ve capped you from the window,” scowls Riya, emerging in the atrium, throwing her zap gun onto a chair. “But sure. Technically you won. Drink it in.”
rows.translation: “你损失了整支队伍，而且现实里我会从窗户一枪毙了你，”莉娅皱眉说道，从中庭出现，把电击枪扔到椅子上。“不过好吧。严格来说你赢了。好好享受。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You lost your whole team, and in real life I would’ve capped you from the window,” scowls Riya, emerging in the atrium, throwing her zap gun onto a chair. “But sure. Technically you won. Drink it in.”"

rows.original: “Oh Riya dear, don’t be such a sore loser,” Nastizia titters, waving a hand at her. “Come - it’s time to administer prizes. And, ah, forfeits.”
rows.translation: “哦，亲爱的莉娅，别这么输不起，”娜斯蒂齐娅咯咯笑着向她挥手。“来吧——该颁发奖品了。还有，啊，惩罚。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh Riya dear, don’t be such a sore loser,” Nastizia titters, waving a hand at her. “Come - it’s time to administer prizes. And, ah, forfeits.”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_PC_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_PC_WINS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You level your gun, aim at the nearest droid, fire, miss... and in response it plants a stun bolt right in your neck. You cry out in pain, staggering backwards as electricity judders through you, losing your gun as you do.
rows.translation: 你举枪瞄准最近的机器人，开火，射偏...作为回应，它把一道眩晕电束正正打进你颈部。你痛叫着向后踉跄，电流令全身剧烈震颤，同时丢掉了枪。
rows.raw: "You level your gun, aim at the nearest droid, fire, miss... and in response it plants a stun bolt right in your neck. You cry out in pain, staggering backwards as electricity judders through you, losing your gun as you do."

rows.original: You manage to recover, clamber back to your feet, grab a discarded SMG... but Riya has heard you. Before you can take care of the sentries around Nastizia’s door, a thunder of feet announces her and the rest of her team emerging at the opposite end of the hallway. A blizzard of bolts puts your two remaining bots and you back on your ass again. You are powerless as a smirking Riya strides over.
rows.translation: 你成功恢复，挣扎站起，捡起一把丢弃的冲锋枪...但莉娅已经听见。你还没能处理娜斯蒂齐娅门边的哨兵，对面走廊尽头便传来雷鸣脚步，宣告她与队伍剩余成员现身。暴风雪般的电束又把仅剩两台机器人和你打翻在地。莉娅坏笑着大步走来，你毫无反抗之力。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou manage to recover, clamber back to your feet, grab a discarded SMG... but Riya has heard you. Before you can take care of the sentries around Nastizia’s door, a thunder of feet announces her and the rest of her team emerging at the opposite end of the hallway. A blizzard of bolts puts your two remaining bots and you back on your ass again. You are powerless as a smirking Riya strides over."

rows.original: “That little decoy of yours was quite clever, I admit.” She reaches down and hauls Nastizia into her arms. “Shame you couldn’t plan for the fact you’re too much of a
rows.translation: “我承认，你的小诱饵相当聪明。”她俯身把娜斯蒂齐娅抱起。“可惜你没能考虑到，自己太像个
rows.raw: "\n\n“That little decoy of yours was quite clever, I admit.” She reaches down and hauls Nastizia into her arms. “Shame you couldn’t plan for the fact you’re too much of a "

rows.original: sissy
rows.translation: 娘娘腔
rows.raw: "sissy"

rows.original: bimbo
rows.translation: 花瓶女
rows.raw: "bimbo"

rows.original: to overcome a bot.”
rows.translation: ，连一台机器人都打不过。”
rows.raw: " to overcome a bot.”"

rows.original: “Oh be nice Riya darling,” the white kaithrit coos, stroking the human’s muscular arms. “You won, didn’t you? And to you will go the prize.” She turns her half-lidded sapphire eyes on you. “Come along, dear. It would hardly be a prize if there wasn’t a forfeit to go with it, would it?”
rows.translation: “哦，亲爱的莉娅，友善一点，”白色凯斯瑞特娇声说道，抚摸人类肌肉发达的手臂。“你赢了，对吧？奖品会归你。”她把半眯的蓝宝石眼睛转向你。“过来吧，亲爱的。奖品若不配上惩罚，就很难算是奖品，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh be nice Riya darling,” the white kaithrit coos, stroking the human’s muscular arms. “You won, didn’t you? And to you will go the prize.” She turns her half-lidded sapphire eyes on you. “Come along, dear. It would hardly be a prize if there wasn’t a forfeit to go with it, would it?”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You line all of your droids up outside the front in plain sight, then lead them in a Light Brigade charge straight through the main entrance. In a spectacular if brief light show, you and your whole team are sat on your ass by the killzone Riya has constructed around the foyer with her own droids.
rows.translation: 你把所有机器人在正门外一字排开，完全暴露在视野里，随后带领它们像轻骑兵旅一样径直冲过主入口。在一场壮观却短暂的光影秀中，你和整支队伍都被莉娅用机器人在门厅周围布置的杀戮区打翻在地。
rows.raw: "You line all of your droids up outside the front in plain sight, then lead them in a Light Brigade charge straight through the main entrance. In a spectacular if brief light show, you and your whole team are sat on your ass by the killzone Riya has constructed around the foyer with her own droids."

rows.original: “Oh dear,” you smile, clambering back to your [pc.feet]. “It looks like Riya has won!”
rows.translation: “哦，天哪，”你微笑着重新爬回[pc.feet]。“看来莉娅赢了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh dear,” you smile, clambering back to your [pc.feet]. “It looks like Riya has won!”"

rows.original: “Damn right,” the statuesque human smirks, twirling her shock carbine. Her eyes flash at you; she probably knows you just threw the competition. You don’t think it will change how she treats you one bit.
rows.translation: “那当然，”身材高挑的人类坏笑着转动电击卡宾枪。她双眼向你一闪；大概知道你故意输掉比赛。不过你不认为这会丝毫改变她对你的方式。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn right,” the statuesque human smirks, twirling her shock carbine. Her eyes flash at you; she probably knows you just threw the competition. You don’t think it will change how she treats you one bit."

rows.original: “Gosh, that was quick!” Nastizia picks her way through the gently smoking debris. “Very well then - I suppose it’s time we retired somewhere quiet to discuss prizes.” She strokes both your arms. “And forfeits.”
rows.translation: “天哪，真快！”娜斯蒂齐娅小心穿过微微冒烟的残骸。“那好吧——我想我们该退到安静地方讨论奖品了。”她抚摸你们两人的手臂。“还有惩罚。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gosh, that was quick!” Nastizia picks her way through the gently smoking debris. “Very well then - I suppose it’s time we retired somewhere quiet to discuss prizes.” She strokes both your arms. “And forfeits.”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You are dueling Riya Batra. She is a human [shemale|npc|f] that stands 6' 2" by ancient imperial measurements. She has midnight-black hair in a crew cut, smooth, dusky skin and deep, intense brown eyes. She is in remarkable shape, her rolled-up sleeves showing forearms corded with muscles that flex powerfully with every slight movement she makes. She has two heavy, round, firm D-cup breasts, a flat, hard stomach, and slender, powerful thighs that propel her forward with panther-like grace. She has one tattoo, a lone black wing on the left side of her neck just under her jaw. She is dressed in fatigue bottoms and a white shirt, simple clothes that both show off her intimidating body and allow her to move with easy grace and strength. She is armed with an ancient plasma foil just like you, and she wields it like she knows what she’s doing.
rows.translation: 你正在与莉娅·巴特拉决斗。按照古老帝国单位，她是一名身高6英尺2英寸的人类[shemale|npc|f]。她留着午夜般漆黑的平头短发，肌肤光滑黝黑，双眼深棕、目光强烈。她体格出众，卷起的衣袖露出肌肉虬结的前臂；她每次轻微动作，肌肉都会强劲收缩。她有一对沉重、圆润、紧实的D罩杯乳房，腹部平坦坚硬，大腿纤长有力，让她以黑豹般的优雅向前移动。她只有一处纹身：颈部左侧、下颌下方的一只孤独黑翼。 她穿着作战裤和白衬衫；这套简单衣物既凸显威慑力十足的身体，也让她能以轻松的优雅与力量行动。她和你一样装备一把古老等离子花剑，挥舞起来显然知道自己在做什么。
rows.raw: "You are dueling Riya Batra. She is a human [shemale|npc|f] that stands 6' 2\" by ancient imperial measurements. She has midnight-black hair in a crew cut, smooth, dusky skin and deep, intense brown eyes. She is in remarkable shape, her rolled-up sleeves showing forearms corded with muscles that flex powerfully with every slight movement she makes. She has two heavy, round, firm D-cup breasts, a flat, hard stomach, and slender, powerful thighs that propel her forward with panther-like grace. She has one tattoo, a lone black wing on the left side of her neck just under her jaw.\n\nShe is dressed in fatigue bottoms and a white shirt, simple clothes that both show off her intimidating body and allow her to move with easy grace and strength. She is armed with an ancient plasma foil just like you, and she wields it like she knows what she’s doing."

rows.original: The room Nastizia leads you into is a long marble hall with a cream armchair at the end.
rows.translation: 娜斯蒂齐娅领你进入的房间是一条长长的大理石厅堂，尽头放着奶油色扶手椅。
rows.raw: "The room Nastizia leads you into is a long marble hall with a cream armchair at the end."

rows.original: No droids this time. Your brave boys must spend most of their time jumbled up in a storage closet somewhere. There is a small wooden table on either side of the armchair. Each one has a small metal tube lying upon it. Nastizia picks one up, her voice echoing along the large, bare room as she twists the device around in her delicate fingers.
rows.translation: 这次没有机器人。你勇敢的小伙子们大部分时间肯定都杂乱堆在某个储藏室里。扶手椅两侧各有一张小木桌，每张桌上都放着一根小金属管。娜斯蒂齐娅拿起其中一根，用纤巧手指转动装置；她的声音在宽阔空荡的房间里回响。
rows.raw: " No droids this time. Your brave boys must spend most of their time jumbled up in a storage closet somewhere. There is a small wooden table on either side of the armchair. Each one has a small metal tube lying upon it. Nastizia picks one up, her voice echoing along the large, bare room as she twists the device around in her delicate fingers."

rows.original: “These are plasma foils, antiques, from an age of chivalry long since past. In that time, the nobility of Tenevo dueled one another to settle matters of honor, blood-debt and love.”
rows.translation: “这是等离子花剑，是早已逝去的骑士时代留下的古董。那个时代，特内沃贵族会彼此决斗，以解决荣誉、血债与爱情纠纷。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“These are plasma foils, antiques, from an age of chivalry long since past. In that time, the nobility of Tenevo dueled one another to settle matters of honor, blood-debt and love.”"

rows.original: The blade comes alive with a harsh, rasping PSSHHHT in her hands, a blunt, crackling, three-foot long beam of red light projected from the hilt. Nastizia’s face is flattened and stark as she gazes up at it.
rows.translation: 剑刃在她手中伴随刺耳粗粝的嘶——声启动，一道钝头、噼啪作响、三英尺长的红色光束从剑柄投射而出。娜斯蒂齐娅抬头凝视，脸上表情严肃而鲜明。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe blade comes alive with a harsh, rasping PSSHHHT in her hands, a blunt, crackling, three-foot long beam of red light projected from the hilt. Nastizia’s face is flattened and stark as she gazes up at it."

rows.original: “My great-great-great grandmother beheaded the Cate of Ongae in her own floating garden to claim the fair hand of Prince Lusch I, and the high throne of Tenevo itself. These were the very weapons they dueled with.” The blade cracks as it’s turned off. Nastizia turns a smile almost as blinding to you. “They’ve been modified with a stun field, of course. You two are not getting blood and limbs all over the floor. That would make one quite ill.”
rows.translation: “我的曾曾曾祖母在翁盖凯特自己的浮空花园里将她斩首，借此赢得卢施一世王子的美丽手掌，以及特内沃的至高王位。她们决斗用的正是这些武器。”剑刃关闭时噼啪一响。娜斯蒂齐娅转向你，露出几乎同样耀眼的笑容。“当然，它们已经装上眩晕力场。你们两个不能把鲜血和断肢弄得到处都是，那会让人非常不适。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My great-great-great grandmother beheaded the Cate of Ongae in her own floating garden to claim the fair hand of Prince Lusch I, and the high throne of Tenevo itself. These were the very weapons they dueled with.” The blade cracks as it’s turned off. Nastizia turns a smile almost as blinding to you. “They’ve been modified with a stun field, of course. You two are not getting blood and limbs all over the floor. That would make one quite ill.”"

rows.original: “You want us to fight.” Riya picks the other one up, weighs it in her hand thoughtfully. “With these.”
rows.translation: “你想让我们打架。”莉娅拿起另一把，在手中若有所思地掂量。“就用这个。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You want us to fight.” Riya picks the other one up, weighs it in her hand thoughtfully. “With these.”"

rows.original: “You will duel one another, gendarme. This will not be one of your grubby little wrestling matches with the station’s drunkards on a Friday night. These are matters of state and pride and desire that are being decided here!”
rows.translation: “你们将彼此决斗，宪兵。这不是你星期五晚上和空间站醉汉进行的肮脏摔跤赛。这里要决定的是国家事务、骄傲和欲望！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You will duel one another, gendarme. This will not be one of your grubby little wrestling matches with the station’s drunkards on a Friday night. These are matters of state and pride and desire that are being decided here!”"

rows.original: The kaithrit titters to herself as she flings herself back into the armchair. It lifts from the ground soundlessly on anti-grav projectors, and rises up about ten feet above the centre of the hallway. You pick up the plasma foil she left, [pc.move] across so that you’re below the aristocratic spectator, and face Riya. The foils are turned on almost in the same moment; the beam of lurid red light is quite weightless in your hand.
rows.translation: 凯斯瑞特轻声窃笑，向后扑进扶手椅。椅子依靠反重力投射器无声离地，上升到走廊中央上方约十英尺处。你拿起她留下的等离子花剑，[pc.move]到贵族观众下方，面对莉娅。两把花剑几乎同时启动；手中艳红光束完全没有重量。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe kaithrit titters to herself as she flings herself back into the armchair. It lifts from the ground soundlessly on anti-grav projectors, and rises up about ten feet above the centre of the hallway. You pick up the plasma foil she left, [pc.move] across so that you’re below the aristocratic spectator, and face Riya. The foils are turned on almost in the same moment; the beam of lurid red light is quite weightless in your hand."

rows.original: You are a skilled melee fighter, however you aren’t sure if any of the little tricks you’ve picked up through experience are going to be any use in this highly stylized format, wielding this thing instead of your trusty weapon.
rows.translation: 你是一名熟练的近战战士，但不确定从经验中学到的那些小技巧，在这种高度程式化的形式中、手持这个东西而非可靠武器时能否派上用场。
rows.raw: " You are a skilled melee fighter, however you aren’t sure if any of the little tricks you’ve picked up through experience are going to be any use in this highly stylized format, wielding this thing instead of your trusty weapon."

rows.original: The blue of Riya’s blade touches yours lightly. The light hisses and crackles angrily. She smiles confidently as she steadies herself. You can’t imagine the big human has any proficiency with fencing, but she’ll certainly know how to use a stun baton.
rows.translation: 莉娅的蓝色剑刃轻轻碰上你的。光芒愤怒地嘶鸣噼啪。她稳住身体，自信微笑。你无法想象这个高大人类精通击剑，但她肯定知道如何使用眩晕棍。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe blue of Riya’s blade touches yours lightly. The light hisses and crackles angrily. She smiles confidently as she steadies herself. You can’t imagine the big human has any proficiency with fencing, but she’ll certainly know how to use a stun baton."

rows.original: “What a deeeelightful sight this is.” Nastizia sounds like she’s been at the nepeta. Well, she certainly is high right now. “When it touches the ground, my stout-hearted paramours...”
rows.translation: “这是多——么令人愉悦的景象。”娜斯蒂齐娅听起来像是服用了荆芥草。好吧，她现在确实高高在上。“当它触及地面时，我勇敢坚定的爱人们...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What a deeeelightful sight this is.” Nastizia sounds like she’s been at the nepeta. Well, she certainly is high right now. “When it touches the ground, my stout-hearted paramours...”"

rows.original: The white handkerchief floats delicately downwards. As absurd as all this is, your mouth is dry and your heart is pounding. You hold guard against Riya, not moving a muscle, not making a sound. It’s so quiet you actually hear the fabric when it drifts onto the marble. Both of you raise your blades and leap into action.
rows.translation: 白色手帕轻盈向下飘落。尽管这一切荒谬至极，你仍口干舌燥、心脏狂跳。你面对莉娅摆好防守架势，纹丝不动，也一言不发。四周安静得甚至能听见布料落在大理石上的声音。你们同时举剑，跃入行动。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white handkerchief floats delicately downwards. As absurd as all this is, your mouth is dry and your heart is pounding. You hold guard against Riya, not moving a muscle, not making a sound. It’s so quiet you actually hear the fabric when it drifts onto the marble. Both of you raise your blades and leap into action."

rows.original: No droids this time. Your brave boys must be back in their storage closet. There is a small wooden table on either side of the armchair. Each one has a small metal tube lying upon it. Your heart beats a little faster.
rows.translation: 这次没有机器人。你勇敢的小伙子们肯定回到了储藏室。扶手椅两侧各有一张小木桌，每张桌上都放着一根小金属管。你的心跳略微加快。
rows.raw: " No droids this time. Your brave boys must be back in their storage closet. There is a small wooden table on either side of the armchair. Each one has a small metal tube lying upon it. Your heart beats a little faster."

rows.original: Even though you won last time, these mano-o-mano duels are easily the most fraught competition the princess has thus far devised.
rows.translation: 即使上次赢了，这种一对一决斗仍轻易成为公主至今设计过最令人紧张的比赛。
rows.raw: " Even though you won last time, these mano-o-mano duels are easily the most fraught competition the princess has thus far devised."

rows.original: You remember the stress and pain of losing last time. These mano-o-mano duels are easily the most fraught competition the princess has thus far devised.
rows.translation: 你记得上次落败的压力与痛苦。这种一对一决斗轻易成为公主至今设计过最令人紧张的比赛。
rows.raw: " You remember the stress and pain of losing last time. These mano-o-mano duels are easily the most fraught competition the princess has thus far devised."

rows.original: “I considered a number of other possibilities for games, but my mind just kept turning back to your last duel,” Nastizia says. She picks up the plasma foils and throws one to you each. “The artfulness, married to strength, and precision, and passion... oh, it is timeless, you see that don’t you? Why decide this contest any other way!”
rows.translation: “我考虑过许多其他比赛可能，但思绪总是回到你们上次的决斗，”娜斯蒂齐娅说道。她拿起等离子花剑，分别向你们各扔一把。“艺术性与力量、精准和激情结合...哦，这是永恒的，你们看得出来，对吧？为什么还要用其他方式决定这场竞赛！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I considered a number of other possibilities for games, but my mind just kept turning back to your last duel,” Nastizia says. She picks up the plasma foils and throws one to you each. “The artfulness, married to strength, and precision, and passion... oh, it is timeless, you see that don’t you? Why decide this contest any other way!”"

rows.original: “Good. I’m glad we’re doing this again.” Riya smiles at you challengingly. “No bullshit, just me versus you. This is what I wanted. This is where the comeback begins.”
rows.translation: “很好。我很高兴我们再次这么做。”莉娅挑衅地冲你微笑。“没有废话，只有我对你。这正是我想要的。反攻从这里开始。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good. I’m glad we’re doing this again.” Riya smiles at you challengingly. “No bullshit, just me versus you. This is what I wanted. This is where the comeback begins.”"

rows.original: “It’s not really sporting to hand a weakling’s ass to them,” Riya says, casually tossing one of the plasma foils and catching it like a baton. “But whatever. Let’s get this over with so we can get to the fun stuff.”
rows.translation: “把弱者揍得落花流水并不算公平竞技，”莉娅说道，随意把一把等离子花剑当作指挥棒抛起接住。“不过无所谓。赶快结束，好开始有趣的部分。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s not really sporting to hand a weakling’s ass to them,” Riya says, casually tossing one of the plasma foils and catching it like a baton. “But whatever. Let’s get this over with so we can get to the fun stuff.”"

rows.original: “Good. I’m glad we’re doing this again.” Riya smiles at you challengingly. “No bullshit, just me versus you. This is how it should be. This is how I win.”
rows.translation: “很好。我很高兴我们再次这么做。”莉娅挑衅地冲你微笑。“没有废话，只有我对你。这才是应有的样子。我会这样取胜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good. I’m glad we’re doing this again.” Riya smiles at you challengingly. “No bullshit, just me versus you. This is how it should be. This is how I win.”"

rows.original: Nasitzia is clapping her hands with delight as the armchair bears her up into the air, ten feet above the hall, so that she can get the perfect view of you battling her bodyguard with every inch you’ve got. You pace the hall with her; you turn your blades on with a harsh, crackling PSSHHHHT. They hiss as they meet in the middle. You hold guard against Riya stoutly, not moving a muscle, not making a sound; a white handkerchief drifts slowly downward. It’s so quiet you actually hear the fabric when it drifts onto the marble. Both of you raise your blades and leap into action.
rows.translation: 扶手椅把娜斯蒂齐娅托到大厅上方十英尺高，让她完美观看你拼尽全力与保镖战斗；她高兴地拍着双手。你与莉娅沿大厅踱步；伴随刺耳噼啪的嘶——声启动剑刃。它们在中央相遇时嘶鸣。你坚定地面对莉娅摆好防守架势，纹丝不动，一言不发；白色手帕缓缓向下飘落。四周安静得甚至能听见布料落在大理石上的声音。你们同时举剑，跃入行动。
rows.raw: "\n\nNasitzia is clapping her hands with delight as the armchair bears her up into the air, ten feet above the hall, so that she can get the perfect view of you battling her bodyguard with every inch you’ve got. You pace the hall with her; you turn your blades on with a harsh, crackling PSSHHHHT. They hiss as they meet in the middle. You hold guard against Riya stoutly, not moving a muscle, not making a sound; a white handkerchief drifts slowly downward. It’s so quiet you actually hear the fabric when it drifts onto the marble. Both of you raise your blades and leap into action."

rows.original: No doubt about it - she’s going all out, intending to use her strength to beat you into the ground. Maybe if you adopt a countering stance, you can use her bullishness against her.
rows.translation: 毫无疑问——她会全力以赴，打算用力量把你碾进地面。也许采用反制架势，就能利用她的蛮横对付她。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo doubt about it - she’s going all out, intending to use her strength to beat you into the ground. Maybe if you adopt a countering stance, you can use her bullishness against her."

rows.raw: "Defensive Mode"

rows.original: She’s holding herself back, seeing if she can’t wear you out before going in for the kill. You should take the initiative and bully her.
rows.translation: 她正在保留实力，想看看能否先耗尽你，再发起致命一击。你应该掌握主动，压制她。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s holding herself back, seeing if she can’t wear you out before going in for the kill. You should take the initiative and bully her."

rows.original: Counter Mode
rows.raw: "Counter Mode"

rows.original: She has a medium stance, keeping her guard up and going for harassing little strikes. Baiting you out, looking for a counterstroke? A big girl like her will quickly wear herself out if you stonewall that.
rows.translation: 她采取中等架势，保持防守，用骚扰性小攻击试探。是在引诱你出手，寻找反击机会？像她这样的大个子若遇上坚固防守，很快就会耗尽体力。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe has a medium stance, keeping her guard up and going for harassing little strikes. Baiting you out, looking for a counterstroke? A big girl like her will quickly wear herself out if you stonewall that."

rows.original: That last blow sends Riya staggering backwards, tears in her eyes from the pain of receiving yet another electroshock. You raise your plasma foil again, and she recoils.
rows.translation: 最后一击让莉娅踉跄后退；她再次遭受电击，眼中泛起泪水。你再次举起等离子花剑，她畏缩了。
rows.raw: "That last blow sends Riya staggering backwards, tears in her eyes from the pain of receiving yet another electroshock. You raise your plasma foil again, and she recoils."

rows.original: “No! No. You - you win,” she mutters. SPPPHHHT goes her blue blade as she switches it off.
rows.translation: “不！不。你——你赢了，”她咕哝道。她关闭蓝色剑刃，伴随嘶——的一声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No! No. You - you win,” she mutters. SPPPHHHT goes her blue blade as she switches it off."

rows.original: Riya is drenched in sweat now, wheezing for breath; you’ve run the athletic woman ragged. It’s the easiest thing in the galaxy to feint one way, and when she throws a tired block that way to come in from the other and tap her sword-hand with your blade. Her blue plasma foil drops crackling and sparking to the floor.
rows.translation: 莉娅如今浑身汗湿，喘得上气不接下气；你把这个健壮女人彻底耗垮。先佯攻一侧，她疲惫地向那边格挡后，再从另一侧切入，用剑刃轻点她持剑的手，这是银河里最简单的事。蓝色等离子花剑噼啪冒火地落到地板。
rows.raw: "Riya is drenched in sweat now, wheezing for breath; you’ve run the athletic woman ragged. It’s the easiest thing in the galaxy to feint one way, and when she throws a tired block that way to come in from the other and tap her sword-hand with your blade. Her blue plasma foil drops crackling and sparking to the floor."

rows.original: “Fuck,” she gasps, clutching her hand. “Alright f- fine. You win.”
rows.translation: “操，”她捂着手喘道。“好——好吧。你赢了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck,” she gasps, clutching her hand. “Alright f- fine. You win.”"

rows.original: “Oh, that was splendid! One feels like one has stepped backward in time!” Above you, your spectator is pealing her delight at the roof, clapping the rests of her hoverchair excitedly. “My two paramours, sweaty and passionate, ramming and rutting against each other, all to win one’s hand... it’s so romantic! You have both pleased me greatly.”
rows.translation: “哦，刚才真是精彩！让人感觉仿佛回到了过去！”上方的观众向屋顶高声表达喜悦，兴奋拍打悬浮椅扶手。“我的两位爱人，汗流浃背、激情四溢，彼此猛撞、彼此交媾，只为赢得我的手...太浪漫了！你们两个都令我非常满意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, that was splendid! One feels like one has stepped backward in time!” Above you, your spectator is pealing her delight at the roof, clapping the rests of her hoverchair excitedly. “My two paramours, sweaty and passionate, ramming and rutting against each other, all to win one’s hand... it’s so romantic! You have both pleased me greatly.”"

rows.original: The chair descends to its former spot. Nastizia sighs as she gets up and sashays down the hallway, extending her hand.
rows.translation: 椅子下降到原先的位置。娜斯蒂齐娅叹息着起身，向走廊款款而去，伸出一只手。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe chair descends to its former spot. Nastizia sighs as she gets up and sashays down the hallway, extending her hand."

rows.original: “However, in contests of romance: there can be only one winner. Steele, darling.” You take her cool, white hand in your own roughened, hot sword hand, gaze into her glittering smile. “It is time for your reward.”
rows.translation: “不过，浪漫竞赛只能有一个赢家。亲爱的斯蒂尔。”你用粗糙滚烫的持剑手握住她冰凉白皙的手，凝视闪亮笑容。“该领取你的奖励了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“However, in contests of romance: there can be only one winner. Steele, darling.” You take her cool, white hand in your own roughened, hot sword hand, gaze into her glittering smile. “It is time for your reward.”"

rows.translation: 最后一击让你跪倒在[pc.knees]上，全身仿佛因电击疼痛而发光。一道刺眼蓝色光条抵在颈部；你痛苦地仰望莉娅，关闭自己的武器。你输了。

rows.original: You are completely exhausted now, soaked in sweat and almost doubled over with stitch, barely even able to hold your blade up. Riya moves about you with athleticism you can’t match; she has outlasted you. She steps inward suddenly, disdaining the blades to grab you by the wrist, shoving the back of your head between her tits and putting you in a half-nelson. You can’t even begin to get out of it.
rows.translation: 现在你已经彻底筋疲力竭，浑身汗湿，侧腹剧痛得几乎弯成两半，甚至勉强才能举起剑刃。莉娅以你无法匹敌的运动能力绕着你移动；她成功耗垮了你。她突然向内踏步，不屑于再用剑刃，而是抓住你的手腕，把你的后脑勺塞进她双乳之间，用半尼尔森锁控制住你。你根本无法挣脱。
rows.raw: "You are completely exhausted now, soaked in sweat and almost doubled over with stitch, barely even able to hold your blade up. Riya moves about you with athleticism you can’t match; she has outlasted you. She steps inward suddenly, disdaining the blades to grab you by the wrist, shoving the back of your head between her tits and putting you in a half-nelson. You can’t even begin to get out of it."

rows.original: “Give in?” Your wrist is pulled a little further up your back.
rows.translation: “认输吗？”你的手腕被进一步扭向背后。

rows.original: “Yes!” you cry. “You win.”

rows.original: Beneath your very hands she disintegrates, a swarm of purple insects that fly between your fingers and then blink out of existence. Within seconds all that’s left on the plush leather beneath you is your sorry [pc.cockNoun 0] and a mini-drone attached to a tiny perfume dispenser. It hisses honeysuckle scent at you mockingly.
rows.translation: 就在你双手下，她解体成一群紫色昆虫，从指间飞过，随后闪烁着消失。几秒之内，你身下柔软皮革上只剩下可怜的[pc.cockNoun 0]，以及一架连接微型香水喷洒器的迷你无人机。它嘶嘶喷出忍冬香气，仿佛在嘲弄你。
rows.raw: "\n\nBeneath your very hands she disintegrates, a swarm of purple insects that fly between your fingers and then blink out of existence. Within seconds all that’s left on the plush leather beneath you is your sorry [pc.cockNoun 0] and a mini-drone attached to a tiny perfume dispenser. It hisses honeysuckle scent at you mockingly."

rows.original: “Why, Steele darling! One didn’t hear you being announced.” You can’t help but jump guiltily as Nastizia sashays into the room behind you, grinning with dazzling evil. “Having fun, are we?”
rows.translation: “哎呀，亲爱的斯蒂尔！我没听见有人通报你来访。”娜斯蒂齐娅摇曳着从你身后走进房间，脸上带着耀眼而邪恶的笑容；你不禁心虚地跳了一下。“玩得开心吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why, Steele darling! One didn’t hear you being announced.” You can’t help but jump guiltily as Nastizia sashays into the room behind you, grinning with dazzling evil. “Having fun, are we?”"

rows.original: “Look, the hard light projection came onto ME, alright?” you manage.
rows.translation: “听着，是那个硬光投影主动勾引我的，好吗？”你设法说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look, the hard light projection came onto ME, alright?” you manage."

rows.original: “You setting that up was sadism. You know that, right?” you say stonily.
rows.translation: “你布置这个局就是虐待狂行为。你知道吧？”你冷冷说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You setting that up was sadism. You know that, right?” you say stonily."

rows.original: “I - er - ” you stumble.
rows.translation: “我-呃-”你结结巴巴。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I - er - ” you stumble."

rows.original: “I was told [pc.name] Steele would fall for the first pretty thing that batted her eyelashes at [pc.him], but I wasn’t expecting it to be quite that easy,” the white kaithrit says, shaking her head and tutting. “On one’s own lounger, darling? Really? Is this the regard you have for one’s invitations and delightful entertainments?” Riya appears behind her, smirking at you insolently. Nastizia lays a delicate hand on the human’s jaw. “Riya dear wins this round.”
rows.translation: “我听说[pc.name]·斯蒂尔会爱上第一个朝[pc.him]眨动睫毛的漂亮东西，可我没想到会这么容易，”白色凯斯里特人摇头咂舌。“在我的躺椅上，亲爱的？真的吗？你就是这样看待我的邀请与美妙娱乐？”莉娅出现在她身后，傲慢地朝你坏笑。娜斯蒂齐娅把纤细的手放上人类下巴。“亲爱的莉娅赢下这一轮。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was told [pc.name] Steele would fall for the first pretty thing that batted her eyelashes at [pc.him], but I wasn’t expecting it to be quite that easy,” the white kaithrit says, shaking her head and tutting. “On one’s own lounger, darling? Really? Is this the regard you have for one’s invitations and delightful entertainments?” Riya appears behind her, smirking at you insolently. Nastizia lays a delicate hand on the human’s jaw. “Riya dear wins this round.”"

rows.original: From the deep hole you’re currently inhabiting you don’t particularly want to talk about Riya, but you suppose you should learn how she resisted a pheromone-soaked gel maid nonetheless.
rows.translation: 你目前正身处深坑，实在不想谈论莉娅，但你觉得自己还是应该了解她究竟如何抵抗一个浸满信息素的凝胶女仆。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the deep hole you’re currently inhabiting you don’t particularly want to talk about Riya, but you suppose you should learn how she resisted a pheromone-soaked gel maid nonetheless."

rows.original: “She insulted it severely, which I believe caused the VI to malfunction slightly,” Nastizia sighs. “So then she knew it wasn’t real. A crude way to win, but...”
rows.translation: “她狠狠羞辱了那个东西，我相信这导致虚拟智能略微发生故障，”娜斯蒂齐娅叹气。“所以她随后知道那不是真的。获胜方式很粗鲁，不过...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She insulted it severely, which I believe caused the VI to malfunction slightly,” Nastizia sighs. “So then she knew it wasn’t real. A crude way to win, but...”"

rows.original: “I knew she wasn’t real to begin with,” Riya retorts. “A rahn frog? C’mon. I just wanted to see how sophisticated it was. You need to invest in better tech, kitten.” She flicks a contemptuous look at you. “Better [pc.boyGirl]friends, too.”
rows.translation: “我从一开始就知道她不是真的，”莉娅反驳道。“拉恩青蛙？拜托。我只是想看看它有多先进。你得投资更好的技术，小猫。”她轻蔑地瞥了你一眼。“还有更好的[pc.boyGirl]朋友。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I knew she wasn’t real to begin with,” Riya retorts. “A rahn frog? C’mon. I just wanted to see how sophisticated it was. You need to invest in better tech, kitten.” She flicks a contemptuous look at you. “Better [pc.boyGirl]friends, too.”"

rows.original: “It’s prize awarding time,” Nastizia says softly. Her fingers descend, touching the top of Riya’s breasts. “Forfeits, as well.”
rows.translation: “到了颁发奖品的时候，”娜斯蒂齐娅轻声说道。她的手指向下移动，碰触莉娅乳房顶部。“也到了接受惩罚的时候。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s prize awarding time,” Nastizia says softly. Her fingers descend, touching the top of Riya’s breasts. “Forfeits, as well.”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_RIYA_WINS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: No. Right here in Nastizia’s home? It doesn’t seem right.
rows.translation: 不行。就在娜斯蒂齐娅家里？这样不太妥当。
rows.raw: "No. Right here in Nastizia’s home? It doesn’t seem right."

rows.original: And something about this smells fishy. Doesn’t mix with the honeysuckle well.
rows.translation: 而且这件事总有股可疑气味。和忍冬香气混在一起并不好闻。
rows.raw: " And something about this smells fishy. Doesn’t mix with the honeysuckle well."

rows.original: “I’m sorry kind miss, but I must decline,” you say, gently taking Jhoi’s wandering hands and laying them on her lap.
rows.translation: “抱歉，善良的小姐，但我必须拒绝，”你说着，温柔地拿住茹瓦四处游走的双手，将它们放回她腿上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry kind miss, but I must decline,” you say, gently taking Jhoi’s wandering hands and laying them on her lap."

pc.IQ() > 60

rows.original: You make sure to say it loudly and with a frisson of assaulted gallantry.
rows.translation: 你确保自己说得响亮，还带着一丝绅士尊严受到侵犯的战栗。
rows.raw: " You make sure to say it loudly and with a frisson of assaulted gallantry."

rows.original: “I have eyes for only one lady in this house.”
rows.translation: “这座房子里，我眼中只有一位女士。”
rows.raw: " “I have eyes for only one lady in this house.”"

rows.original: <i>“Oh
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Oh "

rows.original: Monsieur
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Monsieur"

rows.original: Madame
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Madame"

rows.original: Steele. You’ve disappointed me so badly,” the rahn says, eyes turning soulful and lower lip beginning to tremble. “You’ve defeated my purpose.”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔。你让我失望透顶，”拉恩人说道，双眼变得哀伤，下唇也开始颤抖。“你挫败了我的使命。”
rows.raw: " Steele. You’ve disappointed me so badly,” the rahn says, eyes turning soulful and lower lip beginning to tremble. “You’ve defeated my purpose.”"

rows.original: Before your eyes she disintegrates into a cascade of purple grains, falling down onto the couch and then blinking out of existence. Within a few seconds, all that’s lying there in front of you is a deactivated mini-drone attached to a tiny perfume dispenser.
rows.translation: 她在你眼前解体成瀑布般的紫色颗粒，洒落沙发，随后闪烁着消失。几秒后，你面前只剩下一架已停用、连接微型香水喷洒器的迷你无人机。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore your eyes she disintegrates into a cascade of purple grains, falling down onto the couch and then blinking out of existence. Within a few seconds, all that’s lying there in front of you is a deactivated mini-drone attached to a tiny perfume dispenser."

rows.original: “My word, Steele darling.” You turn to find Nastizia framed in the doorway, smiling dazzlingly. “Love has made you quite cruel, hasn’t it? To deny your own base urges and a poor lonely chit like that, all in vainglorious pursuit of me... I will admit...” She leans back against the arch, hooks a long, lithe leg back against the wall, lets a marvellously cruel laugh gambol around the chandelier. “...It does set one’s pulse racing. You win this round, dear.”
rows.translation: “天哪，亲爱的斯蒂尔。”你转身，看见娜斯蒂齐娅站在门框中，笑得耀眼夺目。“爱情让你变得相当残忍，对吧？为了徒劳追求我，竟然否定自己的低俗欲望，还拒绝了那样一个可怜孤独的小姑娘...我承认...”她靠在拱门上，把一条修长纤柔的腿向后勾在墙边，让一阵极其残酷的笑声在吊灯周围嬉戏。“...这确实让一位女士心跳加速。亲爱的，这一轮你赢了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My word, Steele darling.” You turn to find Nastizia framed in the doorway, smiling dazzlingly. “Love has made you quite cruel, hasn’t it? To deny your own base urges and a poor lonely chit like that, all in vainglorious pursuit of me... I will admit...” She leans back against the arch, hooks a long, lithe leg back against the wall, lets a marvellously cruel laugh gambol around the chandelier. “...It does set one’s pulse racing. You win this round, dear.”"

rows.original: “I don’t see why.” Riya looms behind her, scowling. “I saw through it, too. It was obvious. A rahn frog? C’mon.”
rows.translation: “我不明白为什么。”莉娅阴沉着脸，从她身后高高逼近。“我也看穿了。太明显了。拉恩青蛙？拜托。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t see why.” Riya looms behind her, scowling. “I saw through it, too. It was obvious. A rahn frog? C’mon.”"

rows.original: “And that’s exactly why you lost, my frowny frumpy gendarme!” The white kaithrit lashes her tails at the bodyguard impatiently. “You did it so rudely and gracelessly. Steele, meanwhile... [pc.he] has the manners of a prince. Most suitable.” She smiles at you both, more sultry now. “Come along. It’s time for prizes... and forfeits.”
rows.translation: “而这正是你输掉的原因，我那皱眉又土气的宪兵！”白色凯斯里特人不耐烦地甩动尾巴，拍向保镖。“你的方式太粗鲁、太不优雅。而斯蒂尔... [pc.he]拥有王子般的礼仪。极其合适。”她朝你们两人微笑，如今更显妩媚。“来吧。到了颁奖...和接受惩罚的时候。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that’s exactly why you lost, my frowny frumpy gendarme!” The white kaithrit lashes her tails at the bodyguard impatiently. “You did it so rudely and gracelessly. Steele, meanwhile... [pc.he] has the manners of a prince. Most suitable.” She smiles at you both, more sultry now. “Come along. It’s time for prizes... and forfeits.”"

rows.original: NASTIZIA_PC_WINS
rows.raw: "NASTIZIA_PC_WINS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Nastizia leads you to a narrow servant’s staircase, which takes you down into the spacious, starkly lit basements of the temporary estate. You pass the well-stocked kitchens and larders that provided the sumptuous meal now sticking to your gut.
rows.translation: 娜斯蒂齐娅领着你走向狭窄的仆人楼梯，沿楼梯进入临时庄园宽敞而灯光刺眼的地下室。你经过储备充足的厨房和食品储藏室；那里提供的丰盛餐点如今正沉甸甸地留在你的胃里。
rows.raw: "Nastizia leads you to a narrow servant’s staircase, which takes you down into the spacious, starkly lit basements of the temporary estate. You pass the well-stocked kitchens and larders that provided the sumptuous meal now sticking to your gut. "

rows.original: You sense a certain tenseness in Riya’s lumbering stride. She knows what’s coming.
rows.translation: 你感觉莉娅沉重步伐中透着某种紧张。她知道接下来会发生什么。
rows.raw: "You sense a certain tenseness in Riya’s lumbering stride. She knows what’s coming."

rows.original: You now share Riya’s tenseness as you descend into the bowels of the building: you both know what’s coming, and neither of you are big fans of it. Or rather, him.
rows.translation: 当你向建筑深处下降时，也开始分享莉娅的紧张：你们都知道接下来会发生什么，而且谁都不怎么喜欢那东西。或者更准确地说，那个雄性。
rows.raw: "You now share Riya’s tenseness as you descend into the bowels of the building: you both know what’s coming, and neither of you are big fans of it. Or rather, him."

rows.original: “When one came out to the frontier, one thought it wise to travel with a companion,” Nastizia says, stopping by a bulky sliding steel door. “One that could be completely trusted.”
rows.translation: “一位女士来到边疆时，认为带上一位同伴同行相当明智，”娜斯蒂齐娅在厚重的滑动钢门旁停下。“一位完全值得信任的同伴。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When one came out to the frontier, one thought it wise to travel with a companion,” Nastizia says, stopping by a bulky sliding steel door. “One that could be completely trusted.”"

rows.original: “I had a little tickle last night... a tiny tickle,” Nastizia says, stopping by a bulky sliding steel door. “That perhaps Tzacha made the wrong choice last time? To err is to be Tenevan, after all.”
rows.translation: “昨晚我有种微弱预感...只是极其轻微的预感，”娜斯蒂齐娅在厚重的滑动钢门旁停下。“也许扎查上次选错了？毕竟，人非特涅沃，孰能无过。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I had a little tickle last night... a tiny tickle,” Nastizia says, stopping by a bulky sliding steel door. “That perhaps Tzacha made the wrong choice last time? To err is to be Tenevan, after all.”"

rows.original: She clicks a button, and the door rolls back to reveal a dimly lit room and the earthy stink of the wild. Something within stirs; a yellow eye the size of a side plate catches the light outside. Smiling brightly, Nastizia nods at the door. You wait until Riya shuffles inside before following suit.
rows.translation: 她按下按钮，门向后滑开，露出一间光线昏暗的房间，野性泥土的臭味扑面而来。里面有什么东西动了起来；一只餐盘大小的黄眼睛捕捉到外面的光。娜斯蒂齐娅灿烂微笑，朝门口点头。你等莉娅拖着脚步走进去后才跟上。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe clicks a button, and the door rolls back to reveal a dimly lit room and the earthy stink of the wild. Something within stirs; a yellow eye the size of a side plate catches the light outside. Smiling brightly, Nastizia nods at the door. You wait until Riya shuffles inside before following suit."

rows.original: The
rows.translation: 你走进铺有瓷砖的大房间，其中
rows.raw: "\n\nThe "

rows.translation: 坐在里面、叉车大小的生物
