rows.original: The gatehouse is a utilitarian space consisting of two rooms. The first is an office dominated by a dozen monitors over a desk, each displaying a feed from what are presumably drones scattered all over the estate. A workstation loaded with sophisticated-looking surveillance programs and accessories completes the set-up. There are weapon racks on one wall, taken up by a remarkable amount of armor and guns, as well as your own [pc.weapon]. Some bass-heavy pop with husky female vocals is coming from somewhere. The other room, which you glimpse through the door, is a billet. One bed, one desk, one table, one en suite, all scrupulously tidy. There are weights on the floor and a Tripuron Tigers grav ball team poster on one wall. “Couldn’t even fit my Game Tesseract in there,” Riya sighs when she sees you looking. “Maybe for the best. I’ve had to find other ways to occupy myself.” She sits herself down in her deskchair and swings it around to face you, leaning back, knees apart, hands behind her head. Maybe wide-stancing, maybe just letting you get an eyeful of her undeniably intimidating body: full breasts, abs, muscle-thickened thighs and fat prick all visible to one degree or another beneath her tight, navy uniform. “Alright Steele,” she says. “Let’s talk.” [var0 |She lets you hang for a moment before going on. “You think I’m gonna bust your balls now. Well... I’m really not. I told you before: you lost, you took your medicine, now we’re even. You can come and go here, visit your cute uptown girlfriend any night you want, I’m cool with that. I just want to make clear that I’m still the security chief here, I still call all the shots. So don’t overstep the mark.” She holds you with her brown eyes, smile widening into a leer. “But here’s the thing: I think maybe you want me to play hardball with you. I put myself in your shoes and think: why would I ever come back here? You got a whole galaxy to explore, supposedly[crewRange 3|, and a whole harem of whores fussing over you in that interstellar campervan of yours]. I don’t think it’s about freeloading; there’s loads of ways someone like you could do that. I think it’s cuz you liked what I did to you last time. I think you took your medicine and thought: I like that. It did me good. I want more.” She lets that sit with you for a few moments. “What do you think? Am I right?” |She nods at a chair, and waits until you’re sat before going on. “You can come and see your cute uptown girlfriend any night you like. She wants to see you, and I want what she wants. But what goes on here, it’s on my terms now. And I got a few. Ready to hear them?” Guess so. “First off. Guess this is obvious, but I’ll state it for the record.” Riya’s calm brown eyes bore into you. “You obey me. While you’re here, if I give you an order, you do it. And I want to hear a ‘yes, Mistress’ while you do it. Actually no, fuck that.” She waves at the air irritatedly. “‘Mistress’. It’s so corny, Voiddamn! ‘Yes ma’am’ will do. Or ‘yes commander’, if you wanna push the boat out.” She grins toothily. “You know what? I’d like to hear you say that now. Say ‘yes commander’. So I know you heard me.” ]
rows.translation: 门房是一处由两个房间组成的实用空间。第一个房间是办公室，书桌上方的十几台显示器占据了主要位置，每台都显示着画面，想来是来自散布在整座庄园各处的无人机。工作站上装有看起来十分先进的监控程序和配件，令整套布置得以完善。一面墙上设有武器架，摆放着数量惊人的护甲和枪械，以及你自己的[pc.weapon]。不知从哪里传来一首低音强劲、由嗓音沙哑的女歌手演唱的流行歌曲。 透过门口瞥见的另一个房间是一间营房。一张床、一张书桌、一张桌子和一个套间浴室，全都收拾得一丝不苟。地板上放着举重器材，一面墙上则贴有特里普隆猛虎重力球队的海报。 “连我的游戏超立方体都塞不进去，”莉娅看到你打量房间时叹了口气。“或许这样反而更好。我不得不寻找其他方式打发时间。” 她在办公椅上坐下，转过椅子面对你，向后靠去，双膝分开，双手放在脑后。也许她只是在大开双腿，也许只是让你饱览那具无可否认地令人望而生畏的身体：丰满乳房、腹肌、因肌肉而粗壮的大腿和肥大肉棒，全都不同程度地显露在紧身海军蓝制服下。 “好了，斯蒂尔，”她说道。“我们谈谈。” [var0 |她故意让你等了一会儿，才继续说下去。 “你以为我现在要找你麻烦。嗯...其实不会。我以前说过：你输了，也接受了惩罚，现在我们扯平了。你可以自由出入这里，任何晚上都能来拜访你那位可爱的上城区女朋友，我没意见。我只是想明确一点：我仍然是这里的安保主管，一切仍由我说了算。所以别越界。” 她用棕色双眼牢牢盯住你，笑容逐渐变成淫笑。 “不过问题在这里：我觉得你或许希望我对你采取强硬手段。我设身处地替你想：我为什么还会回来？据说你有一整个银河系可以探索[crewRange 3|，而且你那辆星际露营车里还有一整群妓女围着你转]。我不觉得你是来白吃白住；像你这样的人有很多办法占便宜。我认为是因为你喜欢上次我对你做的事。我觉得你接受惩罚后心想：我喜欢这个。这对我有好处。我还想要更多。” 她让你独自品味这番话片刻。 “你觉得呢？我说对了吗？” |她朝一把椅子点点头，等你坐下后才继续。 “你随时都可以来看你那位可爱的上城区女朋友。她想见你，而我希望她得偿所愿。但这里发生的一切，如今都必须按我的条件来。而我有几条规矩。准备好听了吗？” 大概吧。 “第一。这应该显而易见，不过我要正式声明。”莉娅平静的棕色双眼仿佛钻进你心里。“你服从我。只要你在这里，我下令，你就照做。而且做的时候，我要听见一句‘遵命，女主人’。其实不，去他妈的。”她烦躁地挥了挥手。“‘女主人’。俗气得要命，虚空在上！说‘是，女士’就行。或者‘是，指挥官’，如果你想表现得更卖力。” 她露齿一笑。 “知道吗？我现在就想听你说一次。说‘是，指挥官’。好让我知道你听见了。” ]

rows.original: Breezily you tell her she’s mistaken. You much prefer the arrangement where you shake hands and carry on as peers. “Suit yourself.” Leaning back in her chair, Riya looks supremely unconcerned. “Looks like I’ll have to spell this out to you, though: I’m not your peer. I’m in charge, out there and in here. I decide whether you can come through that gate, and on what terms. It’s just that I’m such a nice girl I’m being cool with you — for now. Got that?” Summoning a great deal of restraint, you respond cordially that yes, you got it. “Good.” Her eyes remain on you for a couple more seconds. Evaluating. Surveilling. “Well, if you wanna... talk, I’ll be here, when I’m not in the manor. It’s bedtime now though, so I gotta go tuck kitten in. You run along.” You retrieve your [pc.weapon] and leave. You feel as if there’s a complicated dynamic going on between you, Riya and the princess that you haven’t entirely sussed out. Maybe if you keep going back, go to these parties Nasti intends on throwing, it’ll become clearer.

It’s jolly good of [pc.name] to learn what [pc.his] duties are in that respect without it being entirely spelled out to [pc.him]. ]” |“Nah,” Riya replies. “[pc.He] shot off as quickly as [pc.he] could.” “Well, if you could, do you think you could be slightly more, ah... accommodating of [pc.him]?” The princess takes a prim little sip from her cup. “[nastizia.pregStage 3 |One can’t be doing the usual funny business with you in one’s current state, and you get so antsy when you aren’t getting regular drainings. That’s [pc.name]’s duty, and it would be dreadful if one had to actually spell it out to [pc.him]. |Soon enough, one won’t be able to do any of the usual hanky panky with you, and forgive me dear, but you get so antsy when you aren’t getting properly drained. That’s [pc.name]’s duty, and it would be dreadful if one had to actually spell it out to [pc.him]. ] So perhaps dear, you could try being a bit nicer to [pc.him]?” ] Riya pauses the recording to get your reaction. |Still wants you sleeping separately, then. “Yep.” Riya drapes her well-padded arm around you and gives you a good squeeze. “I’m alright with the alternative, though.” ] "

rows.original: That’s not something you should have been privy to, and it’s creepy of her to show you it. It’s mean, and frankly unprofessional of her. You know Riya well enough now to know how to touch a nerve, and indeed the word ‘unprofessional’ makes a tendon jump in her neck and immediately exit the recording. “Even when you’re watching her call you the royal cum sponge, you’re gonna be like that? Fine, void.” She’s scowling hard enough to think she might chuck you out, but the look she eventually turns on you contains a certain softness. “You really take the ‘confidante’ thing seriously, huh? Kitten’s lucky to have you, [riya.vitaminRange 81 |[riya.nickname] |Steele ]. I will say that.”
rows.translation: 你本不该看到这种私密内容，而她把它展示给你也很令人毛骨悚然。这很刻薄，而且坦白说，十分不专业。 你如今已经足够了解莉娅，知道如何刺中她的痛处；果然，“不专业”一词令她颈间的肌腱猛地一跳，并立刻退出录像。 “就算你正在看她叫你皇家精液海绵，也要摆出这副态度？好吧，虚空在上。”她怒目而视，凶狠得像要把你扔出去；但最终转向你的眼神却带着某种柔和。“你还真把‘知己’这回事当真，对吧？小猫咪有你很幸运，[riya.vitaminRange 81 |[riya.nickname] |斯蒂尔 ]。这一点我得承认。”

rows.original: Riya taps into her Exquark account through the holo-screen, goes straight to a list of [var0 |TV serial |Humbleside Homicides |Humbleside Homicides ] episodes she’s got lined up.[var0 | ‘Humbleside Homicides’? ] She taps a button on the screen’s perimeter, and withdraws her hands. It floats by itself in front of you as the title credits appear, and a doomy classical piece theme oozes out of the speakers. She puts her big, ropey arm around your shoulders and firmly squishes you into her side boob as you watch. [flags.NASTIZIA_HUMBLESIDE |There is season after season of Humbleside Homicides, it turns out. It’s one of those shows which is clearly vastly popular with one demographic or another, and yet is never talked about anywhere that you’ve seen. You’ve barely scratched the surface of the landfill of murdered vicars, bobbies and fruity tarts that Detective Ironside and Lieutenant Cheribotti must get to the bottom of in this quiet, leafy village in deepest Albion. A crime serial that mostly takes place in tidy back gardens and poky shops makes for strangely comforting viewing (particularly tucked firmly away in the arm of a lover), and you do get why Riya watches this; it’s the perfect lubricant for unwinding that tightly wound coil of aggression and machismo until it is, finally, willing to accept sleep.[var1| You do wonder if this sort of heavily romanticized impression of traditional terran life influenced her xenophobic outlook. Or maybe you’re getting consequence in front of cause. This is her comfort food, after all.] You murmur as you watch, laying your bets on whodunnit. It was the mechanic. No, it was the earl! Ah no, it was the maid. Just like the too-smart-for-her-own-good Cheribotti, your lovely bum was led up a cul-de-sac. Riya’s commentary dries up as the episode wears on, and by the last ten minutes, light snores are puffing over your [pc.hair]. The screen switches off, and descends to the sheets with a powering-down little ‘vroom’. You are left alone in the dark in Riya’s little home-away-from-home, locked securely to her side by her arm. You entertain the notion of sliding free and leaving only because it makes the inevitable decision to remain exactly where you are all the more comforting. It’s really cozy in the crook of Riya’s swole arm, cozy enough that sleep comes to you like a clean descent down the world’s longest, sweetest slide. |You weren’t sure what Riya watches in her downtime. Sports? Gaming livestreams? Your worst thought was she was going to make you watch some kind of hideous anti-xeno talkshow. You know, as a ‘joke’. What she instead has you watch with her (there was never, at any point, a question of you deciding what the pair of you watch) is a strangely cozy crime serial, set in the fictional town of Humbleside, on the[silly| sadly] non-fictional world of Albion. For a place consisting of cozy, rose-covered brick cottages and little shops that sell things like ‘scotch eggs’ and ‘parkin’, Humbleside has a truly remarkable number of hideous and inventive murders, which are solved by a portly, dishevelled detective and his younger, attractive assistant. Though it is the assistant who sniffs out many of the clues and appears to be the sharper one, it is generally the seemingly bungling detective who makes the murderer reveal themselves by underestimating him. All of the cast — apart from a token ausar, you think? - are human. You know, intuitively, that by seeing one episode, you’ve seen them all. Does she... really watch this regularly? Isn’t she sick of police stuff from her regular work? “This looks like police work the way porn looks like sex, and shut up!” Riya replies sharply, not turning her eyes away from the floating screen. “If you don’t want to watch, there’s the door.” You quell your sigh and settle yourself further into her admittedly very soothing clinch. It is strangely satisfying viewing, and it certainly slips down very easily. Like a cup of tea and a big piece of parkin. “Terrible bloody business,” mutters Detective Ironside, as a scowling Professor Puffintree is led away to a waiting police van. “Anyway, ‘ow about that big ruckus ‘n commotion o’ yours, eh lieutenant? You should be in the city, not wasting your talents here with an ol’ broken down I’ll ‘ave the check like me.” “I turned it down. I’m ok right here, sarge,” Lt. Cheribotti says with a saucy smile, as they both look out over the river flowing out of town. “You know what they say: Stay humble.” You are startled out of the mild coma you’ve slipped into by a noise by your ear. Riya has drifted off; light snores puff out of her nose. The screen switches off, and descends to the sheets with a powering-down little ‘vroom’. You are left alone in the dark in Riya’s little home-away-from-home, locked securely to her side by her arm. You could probably [riya.chastity|retrieve the key fob from around her neck, unlock your [pc.chasDevice] and leave without disturbing her.|winch yourself clear and leave without disturbing her.] Probably. The issue is that you’re pretty sleepy yourself, and... it is very cozy exactly where you are, firmly cuddled by your bully-lover. Cozy enough that you, ah, keep losing your train of thought of... what were you thinking about... lieutenant...? ]
rows.translation: 莉娅通过全息屏幕登录她的艾克斯夸克账号，径直打开自己排好的一列[var0 |电视剧 |《谦卑镇凶案》 |《谦卑镇凶案》 ]剧集。[var0 |《谦卑镇凶案》？ ]她轻点屏幕边缘的一枚按钮，然后收回双手。片头字幕出现时，屏幕自行悬浮在你们面前，扬声器里流淌出一段阴郁的古典乐主题曲。观看时，她那条粗壮、筋肉分明的手臂搂住你的肩，将你紧紧挤进她的侧乳。 [flags.NASTIZIA_HUMBLESIDE |事实证明，《谦卑镇凶案》拍了一季又一季。这显然是那种在某一类观众中极受欢迎，却从未在你见过的任何地方被人谈起的节目。艾恩赛德警探与切里博蒂中尉必须在阿尔比恩腹地这座宁静、绿树成荫的小村庄里，查清一桩又一桩牧师、警察与风骚女人的谋杀案，而你才刚刚触及这座尸山的表层。 一部主要发生在整洁后院与狭小店铺里的罪案剧，看起来竟有种奇异的慰藉感（尤其是被情人的手臂牢牢搂着时）；你也能明白莉娅为什么会看它：这正是让那根由攻击性与大男子气概紧绷而成的发条逐渐松弛，直到它终于愿意接受睡眠的完美润滑剂。[var1|你不禁怀疑，这种对传统泰伦生活高度浪漫化的印象，是否影响了她排外的世界观。也可能你把结果当成了原因。毕竟，这是她的精神慰藉。] 你们看着节目，小声押注谁是凶手。是那个机械师。不，是伯爵！啊不，是女仆。就像聪明过头的切里博蒂一样，你可爱的屁股也被引进了死胡同。 随着剧情推进，莉娅的评论渐渐停了下来；到了最后十分钟，轻轻的鼾声已经吹拂着你的[pc.hair]。屏幕关闭，伴随一声关机时的小小“嗡鸣”降落到床单上。你被独自留在莉娅这处临时小窝的黑暗里，她的手臂把你牢牢锁在身侧。 你幻想了一下挣脱出去并离开，但这只是为了让自己最终选择原地不动时更加惬意。蜷在莉娅壮硕手臂的臂弯里实在太舒服，舒服得让睡意如同沿着世上最长、最甜美的滑梯顺畅滑下般降临到你身上。 |你原本不知道莉娅空闲时会看什么。体育比赛？游戏直播？你最担心的是，她会逼你看某种恶心透顶的反异族谈话节目。你知道，就是当成一个“玩笑”。 可她让你陪她看的（从始至终，你都没有机会决定你们俩要看什么）却是一部奇异而温馨的罪案剧，故事发生在虚构的谦卑镇，而它所在的阿尔比恩星球却[silly|遗憾地]并非虚构。这个地方尽是爬满玫瑰的温馨砖屋，以及出售“苏格兰蛋”和“帕金蛋糕”之类东西的小店，却发生了数量惊人、手法骇人而别出心裁的谋杀案；负责破案的是一名身材发福、衣着邋遢的警探和他年轻迷人的助手。尽管许多线索都是由助手嗅出来的，她看起来也更敏锐，但通常总是那位貌似笨拙的警探，诱使凶手因低估他而自曝身份。全体演员——除了一个象征性出现的奥萨人，你觉得？——都是人类。你凭直觉就知道，看过一集，也就等于看过了全部。 她...真的经常看这个？日常工作里做了那么多警务，她还没看腻吗？ “这东西像色情片里的性爱一样，只是看起来像警务工作；给我闭嘴！”莉娅厉声回答，目光始终没有离开悬浮的屏幕。“不想看，门就在那边。” 你压下叹息，在她那确实极具安抚效果的拥抱中坐得更深了些。它的确有种奇异的满足感，也确实非常容易入口。就像一杯茶配上一大块帕金蛋糕。 “真是桩可怕的血案，”艾恩赛德警探嘟囔道，脸色阴沉的帕芬特里教授正被押往等候的警车。“话说回来，你那份闹得沸沸扬扬的调令呢，中尉？你该去城里，别跟我这种等着领支票的破烂老头待在这儿浪费才华。” “我拒绝了。我待在这里就很好，警长，”切里博蒂中尉露出俏皮的笑容说道，两人一同眺望流出小镇的河流。“老话怎么说来着：保持谦卑。” 耳边响起的声音把你从浅浅的昏沉中惊醒。莉娅已经睡着；轻轻的鼾声从她鼻中吹出。屏幕关闭，伴随一声关机时的小小“嗡鸣”降落到床单上。你被独自留在莉娅这处临时小窝的黑暗里，她的手臂把你牢牢锁在身侧。 你大概可以[riya.chastity|从她脖子上取下遥控钥匙，解开你的[pc.chasDevice]，然后在不惊醒她的情况下离开。|把自己绞出来，在不惊醒她的情况下离开。]大概可以。问题在于，你自己也相当困倦，而且...你现在被这位欺负你的情人牢牢抱着，非常舒服。舒服得让你，呃，总是忘记自己刚才在想...你在想什么来着...中尉...？ ]

rows.original:
You awake after a deep, pleasant sleep. There is no natural light on Tavros, but long term space station residents usually install windows that light up and emit small amounts of UV radiation at daily intervals, and the gatehouse billet has one of these, prodding your brain and telling you it’s time to get up.
	
	You are no longer cuddle-locked. Riya shifted over during the night, and now has her arm firmly locked around the faded, blue stuffed rabbit known as Mr Thumpies. You gaze into his unblinking glass eyes with a wry smirk. Imagine getting third-wheeled by a stuffed rabbit. You are finding new levels of bitch-hood to plumb by pursuing this relationship, somehow.
	
	Riya rolls over to face you, and her eyes flutter open. Her jaw and grip stiffen for a moment, then relaxes when she remembers who you are.
rows.translation:
你从一场深沉而愉快的睡眠中醒来。塔罗斯没有自然光，但长期居住在空间站的人通常会安装每天定时发光并释放少量紫外线的窗户，门房宿舍里也有一扇，它刺激着你的大脑，告诉你该起床了。
	
	你已经不再被抱住无法动弹。莉娅夜里挪到了一边，如今她的手臂紧紧搂着那只褪色的蓝色兔子玩偶，也就是哚哚先生。你带着戏谑的坏笑凝视它一眨不眨的玻璃眼睛。想象一下，居然被一只兔子玩偶挤成了多余的第三者。不知为什么，追求这段关系正让你探索到当受气包的全新深度。
	
	莉娅翻过身来面对你，眼睛缓缓睁开。她的下颌和手上的力道瞬间紧绷，随后在记起你是谁时放松下来。

This whole thing — the two of us basically toys for a very bored princess — I get why you’d want to talk about it. She’s a bit like you, [riya.vitaminRange 81 |[riya.nickname] |Steele ] — seen and done loads superficially, but naive in a lot of ways. I mean, think about it. Not really the actions of someone who’s got her head screwed on all the way. I can see why her family are trying to keep a closer handle on her, particularly if she’s supposed to become queen of Planet Cardboard Box or whatever.” She doesn’t think she is? “I dunno. A lil bastard who’s dad’s a common human becoming the heir to an ancient alien dynasty’s throne. Does that sound completely above board to you?” Riya scratches her head. “I’ve tried pinning her down on the specifics of what’s gonna happen after she’s had the kid, and she keeps brushing me off. ‘Don’t worry so much, Riya dahling! rows.translation: 继续进攻，尝试击中莉娅。
rows.raw: "Press the attack and try and land a blow on Riya."

rows.original: Guard
rows.translation: 防守
rows.raw: "Guard"

rows.original: Guard
rows.translation: 防守
rows.raw: "Guard"

rows.original: Keep your guard up and stay defensive.
rows.translation: 保持防守架势，继续采取防御。
rows.raw: "Keep your guard up and stay defensive."

rows.original: Counter
rows.translation: 柜台
rows.raw: "Counter"

rows.original: Counter
rows.translation: 柜台
rows.raw: "Counter"

rows.original: Adopt a medium stance and see if you can’t hit back when she over-commits.
rows.translation: 采取中等架势，看看能否趁她用力过猛时反击。
rows.raw: "Adopt a medium stance and see if you can’t hit back when she over-commits."

rows.original: Sense
rows.translation: 感知
rows.raw: "Sense"

rows.original: Sense
rows.translation: 感知
rows.raw: "Sense"

rows.original: Try and get a sense of how Riya intends to fight you. She’ll get a free hit on you.
rows.translation: 尝试判断莉娅打算如何与你战斗。她会获得一次自由攻击。
rows.raw: "Try and get a sense of how Riya intends to fight you. She’ll get a free hit on you."

rows.original: Nothing
rows.translation: 什么也不做
rows.raw: "Nothing"

rows.original: Nothing
rows.translation: 什么也不做
rows.raw: "Nothing"

rows.original: Stand there and let Riya do as she wishes. Maybe she’ll go easy on you.
rows.translation: 站在原地，任由莉娅为所欲为。也许她会手下留情。
rows.raw: "Stand there and let Riya do as she wishes. Maybe she’ll go easy on you."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Your blade flashes and crackles as you push at Riya, putting your strength into every strike.
rows.translation: 你挥剑逼向莉娅，剑刃闪烁噼啪，每一击都倾注力量。
rows.raw: "Your blade flashes and crackles as you push at Riya, putting your strength into every strike."

rows.original: Aggressive Mode
rows.raw: "Aggressive Mode"

rows.original: Riya fights back furiously, trying to hit you just as much as you’re trying to hit her. You’re like two rabid animals flying at each other.
rows.translation: 莉娅疯狂反击；你有多想击中她，她就有多想击中你。你们仿佛两头狂犬扑向彼此。
rows.raw: "Riya fights back furiously, trying to hit you just as much as you’re trying to hit her. You’re like two rabid animals flying at each other."

rows.original: You land a meaty hit on her flank, forcing a flinch and gasp of pain from her.
rows.translation: 你沉重击中她的侧腹，逼得她畏缩并痛苦喘息。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou land a meaty hit on her flank, forcing a flinch and gasp of pain from her."

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: You are unable to land a hit on her in the storm of light.
rows.translation: 你无法在光芒风暴中击中她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou are unable to land a hit on her in the storm of light."

rows.original: You are able to escape Riya’s flurry without taking a hit.
rows.translation: 你成功逃出莉娅的狂攻，没有挨上一击。
rows.raw: " You are able to escape Riya’s flurry without taking a hit."

rows.original: Numbing, stinging pain flares in your thigh as Riya’s stun blade thwacks into it.
rows.translation: 莉娅的眩晕剑重重击中大腿，麻木刺痛顿时爆发。
rows.raw: "\n\nNumbing, stinging pain flares in your thigh as Riya’s stun blade thwacks into it."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Defensive Mode
rows.raw: "Defensive Mode"

rows.original: You force Riya back along the hall, landing crackling blow after blow on her guard. Sweat rolls down her face as she adeptly defends herself.
rows.translation: 你迫使莉娅沿大厅后退，一记又一记噼啪作响的攻击落在她的防守上。她娴熟抵御，汗水沿脸庞淌下。
rows.raw: "You force Riya back along the hall, landing crackling blow after blow on her guard. Sweat rolls down her face as she adeptly defends herself."

rows.original: You dummy for her head and instead go for her abs, landing a blow that makes her double up and wheeze.
rows.translation: 你佯攻她的脑袋，实则转向腹肌；这一击让她弯下腰，喘息不止。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou dummy for her head and instead go for her abs, landing a blow that makes her double up and wheeze."

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: She wards off every lick you give, panting with the effort. Your limbs ache from the recoils.
rows.translation: 她挡开你发出的每一击，因用力而气喘吁吁。反作用力令你四肢酸痛。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe wards off every lick you give, panting with the effort. Your limbs ache from the recoils."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: Counter Mode
rows.raw: "Counter Mode"

rows.original: Riya parries you skillfully, falling back along the hall. You go for another heavy swing and she suddenly turns inwards, smashing you square in the chest with her blade as you follow through. Shock and pain judders all the way through you.
rows.translation: 莉娅熟练格挡，沿大厅不断后退。你再次沉重挥剑，她却突然向内转身，在你顺势完成动作时用剑刃正中胸膛。电击与疼痛震遍全身。
rows.raw: "\n\nRiya parries you skillfully, falling back along the hall. You go for another heavy swing and she suddenly turns inwards, smashing you square in the chest with her blade as you follow through. Shock and pain judders all the way through you."

rows.original: You tense, hold your blade up and watch Riya carefully, ready for whatever she throws at you.
rows.translation: 你绷紧身体，举起剑刃仔细观察莉娅，准备应对她的一切招数。
rows.raw: "You tense, hold your blade up and watch Riya carefully, ready for whatever she throws at you."

rows.original: Aggressive Mode
rows.raw: "Aggressive Mode"

rows.original: Riya bullies into you, landing strike after uncontested strike upon your blade, forcing you backwards down the hall. Your lungs burn and your arms ache: It is hard, hard work denying her.
rows.translation: 莉娅强硬压向你，一次次毫无阻碍地攻击剑刃，迫使你沿大厅后退。你的肺部灼烧，双臂酸痛：抵挡她实在是极其艰苦的工作。
rows.raw: "Riya bullies into you, landing strike after uncontested strike upon your blade, forcing you backwards down the hall. Your lungs burn and your arms ache: It is hard, hard work denying her."

rows.original: She slashes low as she senses you tire, but you’re quick enough to jump out of the way.
rows.translation: 她察觉你开始疲惫，挥剑横扫下盘，但你足够迅速，及时跳开。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe slashes low as she senses you tire, but you’re quick enough to jump out of the way."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: She sweeps low as you tire, and you can’t jump back quickly enough. Stunning pain thunders into your [pc.leg].
rows.translation: 你疲惫时她扫向下盘，而你没能及时后跳。眩晕剧痛轰然击入[pc.leg]。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sweeps low as you tire, and you can’t jump back quickly enough. Stunning pain thunders into your [pc.leg]."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Defensive Mode
rows.raw: "Defensive Mode"

rows.original: You circle one another warily. You offer only token strikes at her, and receive only token strikes in return. Two turtles glare at each other. It’s exhausting keeping this up, but at least it’s exhausting for her as well.
rows.translation: 你们警惕地绕着彼此移动。你只向她发动象征性攻击，她也只以象征性攻击回应。两只乌龟互相瞪视。维持下去令人疲惫，但至少她也同样疲惫。
rows.raw: "You circle one another warily. You offer only token strikes at her, and receive only token strikes in return. Two turtles glare at each other. It’s exhausting keeping this up, but at least it’s exhausting for her as well."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: Counter Mode
rows.raw: "Counter Mode"

rows.original: Riya comes at you light-footed, stinging your blade with quick strikes before darting backwards. You aren’t having it; you stay stolidly behind your crackling guard.
rows.translation: 莉娅脚步轻快地袭来，以迅捷攻击敲击你的剑刃，随后猛然后退。你不吃这一套，始终沉稳地守在噼啪作响的防御后。
rows.raw: "Riya comes at you light-footed, stinging your blade with quick strikes before darting backwards. You aren’t having it; you stay stolidly behind your crackling guard."

rows.original: She gets more desperate in her attempts to draw you out, but you easily parry her each time. The human has thrown a lot of energy into achieving nothing.
rows.translation: 她越来越急于引你出手，但你每次都轻松格挡。这个人类耗费大量精力，却一无所获。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gets more desperate in her attempts to draw you out, but you easily parry her each time. The human has thrown a lot of energy into achieving nothing."

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: It’s tough, tiring work keeping her out, but you manage it. Her breasts heave as she glares at you, trying to seek out your weaknesses.
rows.translation: 把她挡在外面是艰难又疲惫的工作，但你成功做到了。她瞪着你，试图寻找弱点，乳房不断起伏。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s tough, tiring work keeping her out, but you manage it. Her breasts heave as she glares at you, trying to seek out your weaknesses."

rows.original: Steele

rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You tense, hold your blade up and watch Riya carefully, ready for whatever she throws at you.
rows.translation: 你绷紧身体，举起剑刃仔细观察莉娅，准备应对她的一切招数。
rows.raw: "You tense, hold your blade up and watch Riya carefully, ready for whatever she throws at you."

rows.original: Aggressive Mode
rows.raw: "Aggressive Mode"

rows.original: Riya bullies into you, landing strike after uncontested strike upon your blade, forcing you backwards down the hall. Your lungs burn and your arms ache: It is hard, hard work denying her.
rows.translation: 莉娅强硬压向你，一次次毫无阻碍地攻击剑刃，迫使你沿大厅后退。你的肺部灼烧，双臂酸痛：抵挡她实在是极其艰苦的工作。
rows.raw: "Riya bullies into you, landing strike after uncontested strike upon your blade, forcing you backwards down the hall. Your lungs burn and your arms ache: It is hard, hard work denying her."

rows.original: She slashes low as she senses you tire, but you’re quick enough to jump out of the way.
rows.translation: 她察觉你开始疲惫，挥剑横扫下盘，但你足够迅速，及时跳开。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe slashes low as she senses you tire, but you’re quick enough to jump out of the way."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: She sweeps low as you tire, and you can’t jump back quickly enough. Stunning pain thunders into your [pc.leg].
rows.translation: 你疲惫时她扫向下盘，而你没能及时后跳。眩晕剧痛轰然击入[pc.leg]。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sweeps low as you tire, and you can’t jump back quickly enough. Stunning pain thunders into your [pc.leg]."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Defensive Mode
rows.raw: "Defensive Mode"

rows.original: You circle one another warily. You offer only token strikes at her, and receive only token strikes in return. Two turtles glare at each other. It’s exhausting keeping this up, but at least it’s exhausting for her as well.
rows.translation: 你们警惕地绕着彼此移动。你只向她发动象征性攻击，她也只以象征性攻击回应。两只乌龟互相瞪视。维持下去令人疲惫，但至少她也同样疲惫。
rows.raw: "You circle one another warily. You offer only token strikes at her, and receive only token strikes in return. Two turtles glare at each other. It’s exhausting keeping this up, but at least it’s exhausting for her as well."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: Counter Mode
rows.raw: "Counter Mode"

rows.original: Riya comes at you light-footed, stinging your blade with quick strikes before darting backwards. You aren’t having it; you stay stolidly behind your crackling guard.
rows.translation: 莉娅脚步轻快地袭来，以迅捷攻击敲击你的剑刃，随后猛然后退。你不吃这一套，始终沉稳地守在噼啪作响的防御后。
rows.raw: "Riya comes at you light-footed, stinging your blade with quick strikes before darting backwards. You aren’t having it; you stay stolidly behind your crackling guard."

rows.original: She gets more desperate in her attempts to draw you out, but you easily parry her each time. The human has thrown a lot of energy into achieving nothing.
rows.translation: 她越来越急于引你出手，但你每次都轻松格挡。这个人类耗费大量精力，却一无所获。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gets more desperate in her attempts to draw you out, but you easily parry her each time. The human has thrown a lot of energy into achieving nothing."

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: It’s tough, tiring work keeping her out, but you manage it. Her breasts heave as she glares at you, trying to seek out your weaknesses.
rows.translation: 把她挡在外面是艰难又疲惫的工作，但你成功做到了。她瞪着你，试图寻找弱点，乳房不断起伏。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s tough, tiring work keeping her out, but you manage it. Her breasts heave as she glares at you, trying to seek out your weaknesses."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Aggressive Mode
rows.raw: "Aggressive Mode"

rows.original: Riya comes at you blade hissing through the air, and you’re ready for her. You allow yourself to be led backwards, parrying her furious strikes, coiling yourself cobra-like for the counterstroke.
rows.translation: 莉娅挥着嘶鸣破空的剑刃向你袭来，而你已经做好准备。你任由她逼着自己后退，格挡她愤怒的攻击，同时像眼镜蛇般蓄势，等待反击时机。
rows.raw: "Riya comes at you blade hissing through the air, and you’re ready for her. You allow yourself to be led backwards, parrying her furious strikes, coiling yourself cobra-like for the counterstroke."

rows.original: She takes a particularly wild swing at you, and you whirl around it, neatly slamming your blade into her neck. The meaty impact, the cry of shock and pain - extremely satisfying.
rows.translation: 她对你使出一次格外狂野的挥砍，你绕着剑刃旋身，利落地把自己的剑砸在她颈部。沉重碰撞、震惊与痛苦的叫声——令人极其满足。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes a particularly wild swing at you, and you whirl around it, neatly slamming your blade into her neck. The meaty impact, the cry of shock and pain - extremely satisfying."

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: You leap forwards when you sense an opening, but at the last second she manages to turn her blade inward and block your attack. Dammit!
rows.translation: 你察觉破绽时向前跃出，但她在最后一刻成功把剑刃向内转动，挡下攻击。该死！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou leap forwards when you sense an opening, but at the last second she manages to turn her blade inward and block your attack. Dammit!"

rows.original: You’re light enough on your feet that you put barely any energy in countering her storm.
rows.translation: 你的脚步足够轻盈，几乎不用耗费任何力气就化解了她的风暴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re light enough on your feet that you put barely any energy in countering her storm."

rows.original: It’s tough work defending against her. Sweat pours down your temples.
rows.translation: 抵挡她是项艰苦工作。汗水从你太阳穴滚落。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s tough work defending against her. Sweat pours down your temples."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Defensive Mode
rows.raw: "Defensive Mode"

rows.original: You dance around Riya, whipping your blade at her, trying to draw her out so you can get under her guard. The big human stonewalls you with minimal effort, flicking away your light attacks like flies. Your body glows with exertion, and for no reward at all.
rows.translation: 你围绕莉娅起舞，挥剑攻击，试图引她出手，好钻入防守之下。高大人类几乎毫不费力地坚守，只用细微动作就拨开你的轻击。你消耗了许多精力，却没有任何收获。
rows.raw: "You dance around Riya, whipping your blade at her, trying to draw her out so you can get under her guard. The big human stonewalls you with minimal effort, flicking away your light attacks like flies. Your body glows with exertion, and for no reward at all."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Counter Mode
rows.raw: "Counter Mode"

rows.original: You dance around one another on the marble, blades crackling and spitting, a series of waspish blows as you both seek that telling little sidestep and cut.
rows.translation: 你们在大理石上彼此绕行，剑刃噼啪吐火；双方都在寻找那次足以决定结果的细微侧步与斩击，发动一连串黄蜂般迅捷的攻击。
rows.raw: "You dance around one another on the marble, blades crackling and spitting, a series of waspish blows as you both seek that telling little sidestep and cut."

rows.original: There! You zap her quick as a flash on the solar plexus, a light blow that nonetheless will hurt like absolute fuck. Good.
rows.translation: 就是现在！你快如闪电地击中她的太阳神经丛；这一击虽轻，却肯定疼得要命。很好。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere! You zap her quick as a flash on the solar plexus, a light blow that nonetheless will hurt like absolute fuck. Good."

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: You duck and dodge and weave, but cannot find a way around the human’s liquid guard. The sweat is beginning to sting your eyes.
rows.translation: 你低头、闪避、穿梭，却找不到绕过人类流畅防守的路径。汗水开始刺痛双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou duck and dodge and weave, but cannot find a way around the human’s liquid guard. The sweat is beginning to sting your eyes."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Riya
rows.translation: 莉娅
rows.raw: "\nRiya "

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.raw: "Aggressive Mode"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You watch Riya’s movements carefully, how she’s set herself, how she cuts around you, how she holds her blade.
rows.translation: 你仔细观察莉娅的动作、她如何站稳身体、如何围绕你斩击，以及如何持剑。
rows.raw: "You watch Riya’s movements carefully, how she’s set herself, how she cuts around you, how she holds her blade."

rows.original: Aggressive Mode
rows.raw: "Aggressive Mode"

rows.original: No doubt about it - she’s going all out, intending to use her strength to beat you into the ground. Maybe if you adopt a countering stance, you can use her bullishness against her.
rows.translation: 毫无疑问——她正全力以赴，打算用力量把你碾进地面。也许采用反制架势，就能利用她的蛮横对付她。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo doubt about it - she’s going all out, intending to use her strength to beat you into the ground. Maybe if you adopt a countering stance, you can use her bullishness against her."

rows.original: Defensive Mode
rows.raw: "Defensive Mode"

rows.original: She’s holding herself back, seeing if she can’t wear you out before going in for the kill. You should take the initiative and bully her.
rows.translation: 她正在保留实力，想看看能否先耗尽你，再发起致命一击。你应该掌握主动，压制她。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s holding herself back, seeing if she can’t wear you out before going in for the kill. You should take the initiative and bully her."

rows.original: Counter Mode
rows.raw: "Counter Mode"

rows.original: She has a medium stance, keeping her guard up and going for harassing little strikes. Baiting you out, looking for a counterstroke? A big girl like her will quickly wear herself out if you stonewall that.
rows.translation: 她采取中等架势，保持防守，用骚扰性小攻击试探。是在引诱你出手，寻找反击机会？像她这样的大个子若遇上坚固防守，很快就会耗尽体力。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe has a medium stance, keeping her guard up and going for harassing little strikes. Baiting you out, looking for a counterstroke? A big girl like her will quickly wear herself out if you stonewall that."

rows.original: Mode Known
rows.raw: "Mode Known"

rows.original: It’s no use - she’s moving too quickly and you aren’t at all used to this style of combat. You’ll just have to guess and hope your physicality can see you through this.
rows.translation: 没用——她动作太快，而你完全不习惯这种战斗风格。你只能猜测，并希望自己的身体素质能撑过这一关。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s no use - she’s moving too quickly and you aren’t at all used to this style of combat. You’ll just have to guess and hope your physicality can see you through this."

rows.original: Grimacing at your passivity, Riya suddenly takes a big, overarm swing at you.
rows.translation: 莉娅对你的消极态度露出不悦，突然使出一记巨大的过顶挥砍。
rows.raw: "Grimacing at your passivity, Riya suddenly takes a big, overarm swing at you."

rows.original: You manage to deftly duck out of the way.
rows.translation: 你灵巧地低头避开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou manage to deftly duck out of the way."

rows.original: You can’t block it and gasp as you take a numbing, painful blow that sends you sliding backward on the marble.
rows.translation: 你无法挡住，只能喘息着承受这记麻木剧痛的攻击，被打得沿大理石向后滑行。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t block it and gasp as you take a numbing, painful blow that sends you sliding backward on the marble."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You go completely passive, allowing Riya to fence you back along the hall, only putting in the minimum amount of effort to block her swipes and strikes. Emboldened, she becomes a whirlwind of blue light; once, twice, thrice she inflicts stinging blows to unguarded parts of your body. You gasp with pain.
rows.translation: 你彻底转入消极，让莉娅一路把你逼退到大厅深处，只用最低限度的力量格挡她的扫击与斩击。她受到鼓舞，越发肆无忌惮；你的敷衍动作让她相信你根本不是威胁。她向前扑进，用剑刃正正击中胸膛。
rows.raw: "You go completely passive, allowing Riya to fence you back along the hall, only putting in the minimum amount of effort to block her swipes and strikes. Emboldened, she becomes a whirlwind of blue light; once, twice, thrice she inflicts stinging blows to unguarded parts of your body. You gasp with pain."

rows.original: Steele
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\nSteele "

rows.original: [flags.NASTIZIA_LAST_DUEL_VICTORY |“Aaaagh...” Your final blow sends Riya, finally, toppling to her knees. You aren’t so stoic as to not clutch your thighs and heave air into your lungs, sweat dripping off of you in a steady drizzle. Void damn that was tough. When you wipe the stinging salt from your [pc.eyes], you find Riya gazing up at you, a frown of complete bewilderment on her face. “I really thought I could do it that time,” she pants. “I don’t — I can’t believe it. How are you so...” She can’t go on, either because she can’t bring herself to say it, or she’ll be sick if she tries saying anything. You think that’s as close as you’re ever going to get to dragging a statement of admiration out of her. “My word.” Nasti sounds genuinely awed as she glides back down to the marble floor. “[pc.name], you truly are a duelist from another planet! One could scarcely believe the display one just saw! By the stars, if only you’d demonstrated that kind of skill the night that...” She pauses, then tip-taps over to her fallen champion’s side. “It only makes me more proud of you, Riya darling,” she proclaims, throwing a comforting arm around her burly, sweaty shoulders. “You defeated this [pc.mf |master |mistress ] of the blade to win my hand, once upon a time! The more one learns of [pc.name] and [pc.his] exploits, the greater an accomplishment it becomes!” “Alright kitten, that’s enough,” Riya says with a shaky laugh, getting back to her feet and returning her squeeze around her waist. “My ego isn’t that bruised.” The look she shoots you is the disprovement of that statement. |[var0 |That last blow sends Riya staggering backwards, tears in her eyes from the pain of receiving yet another electroshock. You raise your plasma foil again, and she recoils. “No! No. You — you win,” she mutters. SPPPHHHT goes her blue blade as she switches it off. |Riya is drenched in sweat now, wheezing for breath; you’ve run the athletic woman ragged. It’s the easiest thing in the galaxy to feint one way, and when she throws a tired block that way, to come in from the other and tap her sword-hand with your blade. Her blue plasma foil drops crackling and sparking to the floor. “Fuck,” she gasps, clutching her hand. “Alright f- fine. You win.” ] “That was splendid, darlings.” Nasti brings her seat down next to you with a little ‘wumph’. She has her heels kicked back on it, and she’s eating a packet of fish-shaped snacks she’s pulled from somewhere. “One does so love these little exhibitions you two put on for one. It is a blessing to have such athletic and combative companions by one’s side during this testing period! One’s pulse is set racing, which I’m told is only good news for the little fetcher one is carrying...” Her hand rubs over her[nastizia.pregStage 2 | heavily swollen ] belly as she deposits the empty packet on Marvo’s silver platter, who has appeared like magic. ]

rows.original: [pc.isHPDefeated |You are brought to your [pc.knees] by that last blow, your entire body feeling like it’s glowing with electric pain. A harsh blue bar of light is brought to your neck; you grimace up at Riya, and click your own weapon off. You’ve lost. |You are completely exhausted now, soaked in sweat and almost doubled over with side stitch, barely even able to hold your blade up. Riya moves about you with athleticism you can’t match; she has outlasted you. She steps inward suddenly, disdaining the blades to grab you by the wrist, shoving the back of your head between her tits and putting you in a half-nelson. You can’t even begin to get out of it. “Give in?” Your wrist is pulled a little further up your back. “Yes!” you cry. “You win.” Your hand is let go. ] “Oh, that was splendid! One feels like one has stepped backward in time!” Above you, your spectator is pealing her delight at the roof, clapping the rests of her hoverchair excitedly. “My two paramours, sweaty and passionate, ramming and rutting against each other, working out all their unspoken aggressions... What a private treat!” The chair descends to its former spot. Nastizia sashays down the hallway, and extends her hand to you both. “My thanks to you both, indulging me in this manner. You both performed admirably... but, ah...” She releases your hand to stroke Riya’s jaw. “... it was soooo satisfying to see you [flags.NASTIZIA_LAST_DUEL_VICTORY |really push yourself in a way one hasn’t seen in some time, Riya dear! I think it’s only [pc.name] that’s able to bring that out of you. |prove your paramountcy once again, Riya darling. ] It made me all a-quiver!” Riya gives her a big, loving smile and slides her hand down the slim, achingly perfect arch of her back. She sets her eyes on you as she does so. “You got the best protecting you and your kitten, kitten.” Her hand extends downwards a bit further and squeezes. Nasti squeaks and giggles. “Never doubt that.”

rows.original: “Phew! Well...” Nasti slides a painted fan from her waist, snaps it open and begins waving it in front of her flushed cheeks. “I think that’s enough excitement for tonight. Thank you ever so much for coming, darling...” She comes across and plants a kiss on each of your cheeks. “You’ll come again soon, won’t you? It’s simply not the same when you aren’t around. Riya may have her own way of showing it, but she gets all mopey too when you haven’t visited for a while. I am sure she’d like to, ahm, show her own appreciation on the way out. So do be a sweetheart and pay her a visit, hmm?” Long, black eyelashes flash you a wink. “Ta ta!” Fan wafting lazily like a peacock’s tail, she wanders off towards the main atrium. Riya goes with her, but after exchanging a quiet word at the foot of the stairs, heads off in the direction of the gatehouse. After throwing you a sultry, wordless look. [var0 |You could just go. There’s no reason to follow Riya, after all. |[riya.chastity |She knows that you can’t leave... not if you want your [pc.chasDevice] taken off. You can delay as much as you like here, but eventually you have to head to that little cottage down near the estate wall, its porch light beckoning you. |You can’t leave immediately. You already know, if you went down to the main gate, it wouldn’t open. With a little thrill, you slowly [pc.move] towards that little cottage down near the estate wall, its porch light beckoning you. ] ]
rows.translation: “呼！好吧...”娜斯蒂从腰间抽出一把彩绘扇子，啪地展开，在绯红双颊前扇动。“我想今晚的刺激已经够多了。亲爱的，非常、非常感谢你前来...” 她走过来，在你的两边脸颊各亲一下。 “你很快会再来的，对吧？你不在时，一切都不一样。莉娅有自己的表达方式，但你有一阵没来拜访时，她也会闷闷不乐。我相信她会想在你离开途中，啊，表达自己的谢意。所以做个甜心，去拜访她一下，好吗？”黑色长睫毛冲你眨动。“再见！” 扇子像孔雀尾巴般懒洋洋摆动，她朝主中庭走去。莉娅与她同行，但在楼梯脚下低声交谈几句后，便朝门房方向离开。临走前，她向你投来一道妩媚而无言的目光。 [var0 |You could just go. You can delay as much as you like here, but eventually you have to head to that little cottage down near the estate wall, its porch light beckoning you. |You can’t leave immediately. You already know, if you went down to the main gate, it wouldn’t open. With a little thrill, you slowly [pc.move] towards that little cottage down near the estate wall, its porch light beckoning you. ] ]

rows.original:
The walkway leading to No. 52 is lined with gleaming, state-of-the-art hovercabs. The gate, manned by two monolithic besuited thraggen, has been thrown open, and through it glamorous beings in arresting attire drift in twos and threes. The hubbub of conversation, urbane laughter, and the tinkle of glass spills outwards from the estate, the ineffable allure of high life at its highest. Nastizia is throwing a bash.
	
	Will you head inside?
rows.translation:
通往52号宅邸的步道两侧停满闪亮的最先进悬浮出租车。大门已经敞开，两名穿西装、巨石般魁梧的斯拉根把守门口；衣着夺目的华丽宾客三三两两从中飘然而入。交谈喧嚣、优雅笑声与玻璃轻响从庄园向外流淌，散发上流生活登峰造极、难以言喻的诱惑。娜斯蒂齐娅正在举办盛会。
	
	你要进去吗？

rows.original: The thraggen taps and squints at the holopad in his paw when you tell him your name, then stiffly jerks his head inside. You [pc.move] past chatting groups on the drive up to the front door, where the next ring of security is waiting: Riya. She is wearing a smart blue gilet, tie and flared trousers ensemble together with a sleek, black headset strapped to her ear and temple; a clear, and not wholly unsuccessful, stab at combining business with fanciness. [var0 |She takes in your outfit with a sigh and a roll of her eyes. “Wouldn’t have killed you to try and make an effort,” she says. “No-one in there is going to fire depleted uranium at you, you know. That’s a Commander Batra guarantee.” ] [var1 |She raises an eyebrow, maybe even smirks approvingly at what you’re wearing. “Brave!” she says. “They’ll love you on the dancefloor, I’m sure.” ] [flags.NASTIZIA_PARTY |She nods at the door. “Kitten’s in the ballroom. Why don’t you go keep her company? She needs someone in there.” |Shouldn’t she be inside, mingling? Nasti will want to show her off. “Ahh, you know how I feel about these things, Steele,” Riya says with a discomfited shrug. “I do go in and meet people when she wants, but I gotta, like, come up for air. And if I’m not keeping a tab on the security arrangements, it nags at me.” She jerks her head towards the door. “That’s why you’re here. Go and keep her company. She should be in the ballroom.” ]

rows.original: Her proud features light up. You’re a sight she’s been waiting to see all evening. You feel flushes of hot and cold as she clops down the main stairs and stands deliberately in your personal space, filling it with her cool lavender scent as she appraises you with a glittering eye. “[riya.vitaminRange 81 |[riya.nickname] |Steele ],” she says, brushing an invisible piece of lint off your shoulders. “We can’t let you inside without further security arrangements now, can we?” No, you guess not. Heart thumping, you follow her breezy march and big, brawny bum creasing her well-ironed trousers to a cloakroom, packed with coats, scarves, and dozens of other, more alien accessories. She clicks the door locked shut behind her.

rows.original: From the right of the estate’s entrance hall is a large, two-tiered atrium with a polished marble floor, flanked with lush Tenevan ferns. A tastefully dressed band of classical musicians — at least you assume some of those instruments are kaithrit counterparts to string and brass — have taken up residence in a booth for just such a purpose on the second floor. Couples break away from the space cleared in the middle of the first floor to clap as the notes of an intricate waltz-like piece come to an end. “Darling!” The flick of Nastizia’s fingers and her cut-glass tone summon you from across the room. The princess’s face, already a little flush from her pregnancy, fairly glows with pleasure when she locks eyes with you. She is bedecked in jewelry this evening, a snowy christmas tree, wearing a dark dress that tastefully shows off [nastizia.pregStage 2 |her hefty baby bulge |her growing bump ]. “I’m sooooo glad you could come,” she purrs, touching your arm. “One has been dying to show you off! Everyone, this is [pc.name] Steele. Heir to the Steele fortune[flags.TARKUS_DESTROYED |, escaper of the destruction of Tarkus |Saviour of Tarkus ][var0 |, liberator of Zhèng Shi. ][var1]” Her circle of immaculately dressed, teethed and coiffed attendees raise their glasses and smile at you, some with slightly fixed expressions. “And let me introduce you!” Nasti says. “This is Bertrand Flazigan, son of Bran... this is Sevetli Renau III, I’m sure you know all about her... this is Oxidentaline the Malevolent, scourge of the Bloodeye Nebula... this is Roger, he works in advertising...” “Charmed.” “Hello there!” “Greetings, mortal.” “Tell them one of your stories from the frontier, darling!” Nasti’s claws lightly prickle your [pc.skin]. “And none of your nonsense, please. [pc.He] can be sooooo silly if you don’t watch [pc.him]...”
rows.translation: 庄园门厅右侧是一座宽敞的双层中庭，地面铺着抛光大理石，两旁种满茂盛的特内沃蕨类。一支衣着考究的古典乐团——至少你猜其中某些乐器是凯斯瑞特版弦乐器与铜管乐器——驻扎在二楼专用乐池。复杂的华尔兹般乐曲结束时，舞伴们从一楼中央清出的空间散开鼓掌。 “亲爱的！” 娜斯蒂齐娅弹动手指，以水晶般清脆的声调从房间另一头召唤你。公主因怀孕本就微微红润的脸，在与你对视时喜悦地发光。今晚她珠光宝气，宛如白雪圣诞树；深色礼服得体地展示着[nastizia.pregStage 2 |her hefty baby bulge |her growing bump ]。 “我太——高兴你能来，”她娇声说道，触碰你的手臂。“人一直迫不及待想炫耀你！各位，这是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，斯蒂尔财富的继承人[flags.TARKUS_DESTROYED |, escaper of the destruction of Tarkus |Saviour of Tarkus ][var0 |, liberator of Zhèng Shi. ][var1]。” 她身边衣着、牙齿和发型都无可挑剔的宾客举杯向你微笑，其中一些人的表情略显僵硬。 “让我介绍你们认识！”娜斯蒂说道。“这是布兰之子伯特兰·弗拉兹甘...这是塞维特莉·雷诺三世，相信你肯定听说过她...这是恶毒者奥克西登塔琳，血眼星云的灾厄...这是罗杰，他从事广告业...” “幸会。” “你好！” “向你致意，凡人。” “亲爱的，给他们讲一个你的边疆故事！”娜斯蒂的爪子轻轻刺挠[pc.skin]。“请别胡说八道。要是你不盯着[pc.He]，[pc.him]就会变得太——胡闹...”

rows.original: It costs but a morsel of your patience to act like a prince[pc.mf | |ss ]. You give the assembled upper crust some highly sanitized versions of your adventures out in the burgeoning colony worlds and free zone outposts. Most of these people have never experienced anything close to real danger and hardship, and your tales are lapped up. “Remarkable! And how did you two meet?” asks one. “In a frontier bar,” Nasti says with a wide, glittering grin. She squeezes your arm happily. The attention and gossip swirling around her are what she has instead of champagne right now, and by doing this for her you’ve poured out a generous round. Eventually you manage to extricate yourself, and head to another part of the estate.
rows.translation: 只需付出一点耐心，你便能表现得像王子[pc.mf | |ss ]。你向聚集的上流人士讲述自己在新兴殖民世界与自由区哨站冒险的高度净化版本。这些人大多从未经历任何接近真正危险与艰辛的事，因此如饥似渴地吸收你的故事。 “真了不起！你们两个是怎么认识的？”其中一人问。 “在一家边疆酒吧，”娜斯蒂露出灿烂闪亮的笑容说道，开心地抱紧你的手臂。如今围绕她的关注与八卦取代了香槟；你这样配合她，等于慷慨斟上了一轮。 最终你成功脱身，前往庄园其他区域。

rows.original: “Have you heard about the planet with the lobster people that make love with their whiskers?” An echoing silence. Your grin widens. “Let me tell you about the planet with the sex whisker lobster people.” You spin one yarn after another about your escapades out on the frontier with the colorful crew of perverts you’ve assembled. Into the total fabrications you slip real things you’ve seen and done — bizarre things but real — and you see the odd flicker of recognition on the glitterati around you, some of whom must be reasonably well up on news from the colonies. You have them so they’ve no idea where your madness ends and the frontier’s begins. “Darling.” “And then, wouldn’t you know it, from the head of the Frost Wyrm out popped--” “Darling!” Small, sharp claws prickle your arm. “I must apologize for [pc.him],” Nasti trills. “[pc.He] does, ah, get carried away sometimes!” In her little smile and lively crystal eyes you see a glimmer of gratitude. You took her prompt and ran with it, her wild card lover swinging in to inject some spice into this stultifying affair. You’ve provided gossip for a week. “What a rum [pc.mf |fellow |gal ],” you hear one of them remark as you head off to another part of the party.
rows.translation: “听说过那个龙虾人用触须做爱的星球吗？”四周一片回响般的沉默。你的笑容扩大。“让我给你们讲讲那个住着性爱触须龙虾人的星球。” 你把与自己召集的多彩变态同伴在边疆的冒险一个接一个编成故事。在彻底虚构的内容中，你掺入亲眼见过、亲身做过的真实事情——古怪但真实——并看见周围名流偶尔闪过了然神色；其中有些人肯定相当熟悉殖民地新闻。你让他们完全分不清你的疯狂在哪里结束、边疆的疯狂又从哪里开始。 “亲爱的。” “然后，你们绝对想不到，一颗冰霜巨龙的脑袋里突然蹦出——” “亲爱的！”小而尖锐的爪子刺挠你的手臂。“我必须替[pc.him]道歉，”娜斯蒂用颤音说道。“[pc.He]有时确实会，啊，说得太投入！” 从她浅浅的笑容与活跃的水晶眼眸中，你看见一丝感激。你接过她的提示尽情发挥，作为她的百搭恋人突然出现，为这场沉闷活动注入刺激。你提供了足够一周谈论的八卦。 “真是个古怪的[pc.mf |fellow |gal ]，”你前往聚会其他区域时，听见其中一人评价。

rows.original: “It’s a place where the weak and naive are turned into paste or slaves. The natives are colorful and amorous, unaware of what’s about to happen to them. It’s good to interact with them now, see them as they are, before they either become peons to the mega-corporations, or are swept away by history.” There are murmurings of shock, and some turn away as you describe reality on the frontier, the hard things you’ve seen and done for your own advancement. But more than that, you see excitement and appreciation in the ring of faces around you. You realize most of these people already know what the cost of doing business is. But they rarely get to hear it said in such breathtakingly blunt terms. “Come now darling, why don’t we talk about something a little more pleasant?” Nastizia says eventually with a nervous little titter. “You must excuse [pc.him]. [pc.He], ah, can come back from his adventures in quite the rough state!” “We must have [pc.him] round for brunch sometime, Nasti sweetness,” you hear one of them say as you head off to another corner of the party. “[pc.He]’s so rugged and candid! I can only imagine what [pc.he] is like in the bedroom...”
rows.translation: “那里会把弱者和天真的人变成肉酱或奴隶。当地人色彩鲜艳、热情多欲，却不知道自己即将遭遇什么。现在与他们接触、在他们尚保持原貌时看看他们，是件好事；往后他们要么成为巨型企业的苦工，要么被历史冲走。” 你描述边疆现实，以及为自己发展而见过、做过的艰难之事，周围响起震惊低语，有些人转身离开。但更多时候，你在周围一圈面孔上看见兴奋与赞赏。你意识到，这些人大多早已知道做生意的代价，只是很少听见有人以如此惊人而直白的语言说出来。 “好了，亲爱的，我们何不聊些更愉快的话题？”娜斯蒂齐娅终于紧张地轻笑着说道。“你们得原谅[pc.him]。[pc.He]从冒险归来时，啊，有时状态会相当粗野！” “亲爱的娜斯蒂，我们必须找时间请[pc.him]来吃早午餐，”你走向聚会另一角时，听见一人说道。“[pc.He]真粗犷又坦率！我只能想象[pc.he]在床上是什么样子...”
rows.raw: " “It’s a place where the weak and naive are turned into paste or slaves. The natives are colorful and amorous, unaware of what’s about to happen to them. It’s good to interact with them now, see them as they are, before they either become peons to the mega-corporations, or are swept away by history.” There are murmurings of shock, and some turn away as you describe reality on the frontier, the hard things you’ve seen and done for your own advancement. But more than that, you see excitement and appreciation in the ring of faces around you. You realize most of these people already know what the cost of doing business is. But they rarely get to hear it said in such breathtakingly blunt terms. “Come now darling, why don’t we talk about something a little more pleasant?” Nastizia says eventually with a nervous little titter. “You must excuse [pc.him]. [pc.He], ah, can come back from his adventures in quite the rough state!” “We must have [pc.him] round for brunch sometime, Nasti sweetness,” you hear one of them say as you head off to another corner of the party. “[pc.He]’s so rugged and candid! I can only imagine what [pc.he] is like in the bedroom...” "

rows.original: Ballroom
rows.raw: "Ballroom"

rows.original: From the right of the estate’s entrance hall is a large, two-tiered atrium with a polished marble floor, flanked with lush Tenevan ferns. A tastefully dressed band of classical musicians — at least you assume some of those instruments are kaithrit counterparts to string and brass — have taken up residence on the second floor. They are kicking out a quite lively waltz-like tune, and the polished wood floor below is filled with couples whirling around each other, dancing with arch, classical precision. It’s all glitter, perfect haircuts and remarkable outfits. “Darling.” A cool hand lands on your arm. Nasti is there at your elbow. Her eyes are sparkling and her grip is firm. “I request a turn around the ballroom floor with my closest confidante,” she purrs. “Riya’s not here to do so... so you shall have the honors of showing the princess at her best!” Before you can say anything, you are pulled to the center of the atrium, where all eyes are on you. With a light cough, the conductor on the first floor lifts his baton, and the band begins a slow romantic number.
rows.translation: 庄园门厅右侧是一座宽敞的双层中庭，地面铺着抛光大理石，两旁种满茂盛的特内沃蕨类。一支衣着考究的古典乐团——至少你猜其中某些乐器是凯斯瑞特版弦乐器与铜管乐器——驻扎在二楼。他们正演奏颇为活泼的华尔兹般曲调，下方抛光木地板上满是彼此旋转的舞伴，以傲慢而古典的精准舞动。四周尽是闪光、完美发型与非凡服装。 “亲爱的。” 一只冰凉的手落在你手臂上。娜斯蒂已经来到身旁。她双眼闪亮，抓握坚定。 “人请求与最亲密的知己绕舞厅一周，”她娇声说道。“莉娅不在这里做这件事...所以将由你获得让公主展现最佳姿态的荣誉！” 你还没来得及说话，便被拉到中庭中央，所有目光都落在你身上。一楼的指挥轻咳一声，举起指挥棒，乐团开始演奏缓慢浪漫的乐曲。

rows.original: Nasti is in her element here, while you are not, and you only need to apply a slight amount of pressure with your hands for her to gracefully take matters into her stride. “Hand on my waist darling, that’s it... and...” she mouths ‘one’ and ‘two’ and ‘one’ and then lets her mouth stay gently ajar, blue eyes locked on yours as you find the simple rhythm and begin to dance, slowly and fluidly, to the sweet instrumental floating down from the small orchestra above, making her dress swirl around the glossy, patterned wood. [riya.chastity |It’s very tough not to be self-conscious about your [pc.chasDevice] — you imagine everyone can see its outline against your [pc.lowerGarment] — [pc.isExhibitionist |and the thought makes you very horny. |but you do your best to put it out of mind. ] |[riya.discipline | The mortifying thought of your love egg slipping out causes you to grip up around it as tight as you can, an action which causes you to feel its vibrations even more acutely.[pc.hasLowerGarment | [pc.femCum] moistens your [pc.lowerUndergarment] ] ] ]. But as her hip brushes over yours[nastizia.pregStage 2 | and her tremendous baby bump occasionally burgeons against your [pc.belly] ]; your self-consciousness drifts away and you find yourself enjoying the romantic moment the princess has crafted for herself, like a soap bubble that catches the light as it rises and chooses a graceful moment to pop. The assembled crowd gives you a polite round of applause as the song comes to an end and you bow together. “How charmingly rustic,” you hear one socialite murmur to another as you head in the direction of a beverage-wielding servant. “Oh Nastipaws, [pc.he]’s so rugged and basic!” one of the princesses’ friends brays as she sashays across to rejoin them. “It’s so frontier, babe!” By making you take a hardscrabble job at a young age, your dad prevented you from ever feeling like you belong amongst this class of people. Perhaps he really did have your best interests at heart.
rows.translation: 娜斯蒂在这里如鱼得水，你却不是；你只需用双手施加一点压力，她便会优雅地接过主导。 “手放在人腰上，亲爱的，对了...然后...”她无声念着“一”“二”“一”，随后让嘴巴温柔地微张；你找到简单节奏，开始随着上方小型乐团飘下的甜美器乐缓慢流畅地起舞，她的蓝眼睛始终锁住你的目光，裙摆在光亮的花纹木地板上旋转。[riya.chastity |It’s very tough not to be self-conscious about your [pc.chasDevice] — you imagine everyone can see its outline against your [pc.lowerGarment] — [pc.isExhibitionist |and the thought makes you very horny. |but you do your best to put it out of mind. ] |[riya.discipline | The mortifying thought of your love egg slipping out causes you to grip up around it as tight as you can, an action which causes you to feel its vibrations even more acutely.[pc.hasLowerGarment | [pc.femCum] moistens your [pc.lowerUndergarment] ] ] ]。 但当她的腰胯擦过你的[nastizia.pregStage 2 | and her tremendous baby bump occasionally burgeons against your [pc.belly] ]时，你的局促逐渐散去；你开始享受公主为自己打造的浪漫时刻，如同一颗上升时捕捉光芒、选择优雅瞬间破裂的肥皂泡。 乐曲结束，你们一同鞠躬，聚集的人群礼貌鼓掌。 “多么迷人的乡野风格，”你走向端着饮料的仆人时，听见一位名流对另一人低语。 “哦，娜斯蒂爪，[pc.he]真粗犷又朴素！”公主的一位朋友款款走回同伴身边时大声说道。“太有边疆味了，宝贝！” 父亲让你年纪轻轻就做艰苦工作，使你永远无法觉得自己属于这个阶层。也许他确实把你的最大利益放在心上。

rows.original:
To the left of the estate’s entrance hall is the spacious lounge where Nasti usually entertains you. Its furniture has been moved away so that half a dozen cream-clothed tables can occupy the center, leading into the dining room area, with silver platters and multi-tiered china heaped with fine Tenevan cuisine. In the dining room itself, a bar has been set up, attended by a tight-suited boy-servant. 
	
	Guests swirl around the kaithrit smorgasbord. Polite laughter and the clink of cutlery and glass is the soundtrack here. You could probably find someone to converse with, if you were so minded. Otherwise, there’s the food and there’s the drink.
rows.translation:
庄园门厅左侧是娜斯蒂平时招待你的宽敞休息室。家具已经移走，中央摆着六张铺奶油色桌布的桌子，一直延伸到餐厅区；银盘和多层瓷器上堆满精致的特内沃美食。餐厅里还设有一间酒吧，由穿紧身服装的男仆看管。
	
	宾客围绕凯斯瑞特自助餐流动。礼貌笑声与刀叉、玻璃碰撞声构成这里的背景音。如果有心，你大概能找到交谈对象。否则，这里还有食物和饮料。

rows.original: You collect a plate, nudge your way to the table, and pile it high with everything that looks vaguely recognizable (there are labels for the things that are poisonous to [pc.race], helpfully). It’s maybe not quite as nice as when the meal is made specifically for you. Still, Nasti’s kitchen remains fit for a princess, and Tenevan food really is very good, once you’ve developed a taste for it. You set your plate aside with a citrus-accented burp.
rows.translation: 你拿起盘子，挤到桌边，把所有看起来勉强能认出的食物堆得高高的（好心的是，对[pc.race]有毒的东西都贴着标签）。它也许不如专门为你制作的餐点那么美味，但娜斯蒂的厨房依然配得上公主；而且一旦培养出品味，特内沃食物确实非常不错。你带着柑橘味打了个嗝，把盘子放到一旁。

rows.original: “I should go.” “Yeah?” Riya smirks as she eyes you, up and down. “You think you’ve been enough of a good little [pc.boy] that the gate down there is gonna roll open for you, do you?” You can’t help but blush. Surely you have been a good little [pc.boy], by her own twisted standards anyway?[flags.RIYA_LOST_DUEL_TONIGHT|You let her beat you in that duel.|[flags.NASTIZIA_FAILED_RECREATA_TONIGHT|You let her humiliate you in the Recreata.|You just got done getting thoroughly sexually humiliated by her again, after all.]] You try and not let your resentment show as the silence draws out. rows.raw: " You keep your eyes locked on Riya’s face as you lower yourself, splaying your fingers over the cool floor either side of her feet, perhaps to let her see the embers of resentment, ire, embarrassment, distaste in there... so she can know again how she crushed them with her implacable will when you close them, extend your [pc.tongue] and lathe it along smooth, burnished leather. That’s what she wants to see, that’s the spice in this act for her, and you, you live to serve. You know you did it right because as ever, Riya’s breath betrays her: that long, quiet exhalation when you begin worshipping her buttoned up booties with your tongue, so much like you were pleasuring an erogenous zone. Which, in many ways, it is. Commander Batra’s boots are an essential part of her edifice of authority; their brisk crunch and tap on the estate’s gravel and marble as they approach never fails to send a tiny shiver down your spine. You lick them because you love them; you love their sternness, as you love Riya’s. Once you understood this as a punishment. Now you know it to be a reward. [pc.hasTongueFlag prehensile |And your tongue was designed to do this. See how it eagerly unspools and slathers over every inch of the smooth leather like an eager pet! Your body cannot disguise your subservient willingness to bend to your better’s indomitable will. ] “And how’s that Sparklestick, [riya.nickname]?” Riya inquires in a husky voice. “Letting you feel every inch, I hope?” She taps your crown sternly, and points towards the bottom end of the tongue. “You missed a spot. Pay attention.” Yes, she’s right, you were being lazy... you get your tongue and [pc.lips] really in there to give it all a satisfying sheen. And, yes, your menthol-infused lips feel her scuffed leather all so intimately. Truly it is your mouth that is your real sexual organ on these nights, not [pc.eachVagina]... as much as the Commander might enjoy [pc.hasVaginas 2 |those |that ], on occasion. rows.original: You ask what he’s doing on Tavros. “Whatever the empire requires of me,” the hard-faced avian replies, eyes back on the room. “Requisition. Liaising. Monitoring. Every week, a new set of orders arrives at the embassy from the Volar, often entirely opaque in nature, and it is my duty to see to them. Such is the nature of administering territory that expands by tens of light years in every direction every day. I am on this station until it is decided otherwise.” He must get quite tired of it? “Tired? Yes! But that is good. That’s the nature of duty, Steele.” He directs his hawkish eyes back to you. “To know your place within a great effort, and know that your talents are being put to good use — there is no better feeling in the galaxy. I return from my work exhausted every night, and rise to meet it every morning gratified and willing. I look in the faces of every person here and know that almost none of them can say the same. What all this wealth and idyll created by exploitation and colonial looting has earned them is misery, and a yearning for more that can never be satiated. Tragic. Horrifying.” You return his fierce, unblinking gaze and decide against following this line of thought any further.
rows.translation: 你询问他在塔弗罗斯做什么。 “帝国要求我做什么，我就做什么，”面容冷硬的鸟人回答，视线重新落在房间里。“征用。联络。监控。每周，大使馆都会从沃拉收到一批新命令，其性质往往完全不透明，而执行它们正是我的职责。这就是管理一片每天向各个方向扩张数十光年的领土所必须面对的现实。在另有决定之前，我会一直待在这个空间站。” 他一定对此相当疲惫吧？ “疲惫？没错！但这是好事。这就是职责的本质，斯蒂尔。”他再次用鹰隼般的双眼看向你。“知道自己在伟大事业中的位置，也知道才华得到了妥善运用——银河中没有比这更好的感受。每天夜里，我筋疲力尽地结束工作；每天早晨，我又满足而自愿地起身迎接它。我看着这里每个人的脸，知道他们几乎没人能说出同样的话。剥削与殖民掠夺创造出的所有财富和安逸，只为他们换来痛苦，以及永远无法满足的更多渴望。可悲。骇人。” 你迎着他凶狠而一眨不眨的目光，决定不再继续这条话题。

rows.original: It doesn’t seem as if Kirlarwe enjoys these soirees much. Why [var0 |do you keep encountering him at them then? |is he at this one then? ] “See them?” The anatae nods at [flags.NASTIZIA_PARTY_EXILES |Raqaia and Fa Oo |two striking alien females that appear to be twins ], on the other side of the room. One of them sees the look and offers a thin, sidelong sneer back. “Tiraxian emigres. That’s the polite phrase, I believe,” Kirlarwe growls. “The Anatae Empire recently completed the liberation of Tiraxiq, dismantling the monarchical society that dominated it previously as we did. We moved faster than we usually do — it was believed the loss of life that would’ve taken place over the course of standard annexation protocols would’ve been too great. But, hmm, a price must be paid somewhere, and in this case it’s the propagation of individuals like those two.” He pauses to sip his drink, which is a fascinating sight in itself. “Members of the former Tiraxian upper class; they flit around the UGC, telling their tales of anatae brutality to anyone who will listen. Particularly anyone who might be willing to fund a counter coup. There will always be a number.” And — what? Is he here to build a case against them? Deport them back? “I very much doubt it’ll come to that.” He sounds a little wistful. “No, I’m just here to keep an eye on them. I’m a reminder. That wherever they go, however high or low they go looking for a helping hand in the UGC... we will be watching. That ought to be enough to deter them from doing anything too drastic.” He swirls his glass and gazes at you sidelong. “Talk to them if you like, I don’t mind. They’ll be delightful and dazzle you, and paint you a picture of a beautiful world that was cruelly snatched away by heartless aliens who did not understand it. But be aware of what lies behind that picture. Mass poverty. Camps. Plans for worse. We moved quicker than we usually do for a reason.”
rows.translation: 基拉尔维似乎不太喜欢这些晚宴。那么为什么[var0 |你总在这种场合遇见他？ |他还会出席这一场？ ] “看见她们了吗？” 阿纳泰朝房间另一头的[flags.NASTIZIA_PARTY_EXILES |拉卡娅和法·乌 |两个貌似双胞胎、极其醒目的异星女性 ]点头。其中一人看见他的目光，从侧面回以淡淡冷笑。 “提拉克西安移民。我相信这是礼貌说法，”基拉尔维低吼。“阿纳泰帝国最近完成了对提拉克西克的解放，像我们当年一样，瓦解了此前主宰当地的君主社会。我们的行动比平常更迅速——据判断，按照标准吞并程序推进将造成过多生命损失。但，嗯，代价总得由某处承担，而这次就是滋生了那两个一样的人。” 他停下来啜饮，这个景象本身就十分有趣。 “前提拉克西安上层阶级成员；她们在UGC四处活动，向任何愿意倾听的人讲述阿纳泰的暴行。尤其是可能愿意资助反政变的人。这种人总会有一些。” 所以——什么？他来这里搜集指控她们的证据？把她们遣返回去？ “我非常怀疑事情会走到那一步。”他的语气略带惆怅。“不，我只是在这里监视她们。我是一种提醒：无论她们去往哪里，无论她们为了在UGC寻找援手而攀得多高或沉得多低... 我们都会看着。这应该足以阻止她们做出太过极端的事情。” 他摇晃杯中液体，从侧面凝视你。 “喜欢的话就去和她们交谈，我不介意。她们会表现得愉快、令你眼花缭乱，再描绘一幅美丽世界的画卷，说它被不理解当地文化的无情异星人残酷夺走。但要清楚画面背后隐藏着什么。大规模贫困。集中营。更加恶劣的计划。我们出于某种原因才会比平常行动更快。”

rows.original: So if he’s Nasti’s father, that makes him... king? King Albreit? “Oh. Ah, no, haha. I forgot about your human upbringing. This must be quite complicated for you,” the old blond says with a little cough. “Firstly, dear Fedorize — Nasti’s mother — is only a princess herself. The younger sister of Belleta, the current Cate. But you see, in kaithrit culture, power is passed down matrilineally. Traditional kaithrit culture, that is to say — the young folk have newfangled ideas on the matter, I gather. When it comes to the Romavians, the throne can only be occupied by a queen; a female relation of the old queen. Which is why the business of whether a claimant is capable of bearing sprogs is so essential. You must be capable of issue. As my Nasti so successfully impressed upon Ms. Batra!” So what does that make him? “A consort, dear [pc.girl]! A consort!” he brays merrily. “Just like Ms. Batra, haha! It is quite the best role to have in the whole affair [pc.name], trust me. You just have to stand around and look good at these sorts of things. Have all the fun while the girls bother themselves with the wretched matters of state business. Nothing but the paparazzi and the odd kidnapping to worry yourself over.” Kidnapping...? “Well, aheh, the Romavians did once have something of a penchant for pinching consorts in order to, ahem, negotiate certain dynastic arrangements,” Albreit says, fiddling with his collar. “But that’s all in the distant past. A fascinating past. You should really look into it: I’ll happily lend you some vids, they’ll help explain the whole palaver much better than I can!”
rows.translation: 所以，如果他是娜斯蒂的父亲，那他就是...国王？阿尔布雷特国王？ “哦。啊，不是，哈哈。我忘了你是在人类环境中长大的。这对你来说一定相当复杂，”金发老人轻咳一声。“首先，亲爱的费多丽兹——娜斯蒂的母亲——本人也只是一位公主，是现任凯特贝莱塔的妹妹。不过你要知道，在凯斯里特文化中，权力按母系传承。准确说，是传统凯斯里特文化——据我了解，年轻人在这件事上有些新潮观念。说到罗马维亚家族，王位只能由女王占据；也就是老女王的女性亲属。因此，王位宣称者能否生育后代至关重要。你必须有能力留下子嗣。就像我的娜斯蒂如此成功地向巴特拉女士证明的那样！” 那这又让他算是什么？ “王夫，亲爱的[pc.girl]！王夫！”他欢快地大声笑道。“就像巴特拉女士，哈哈！相信我，[pc.name]，这可是整件事里最好的角色。你只需要在这种场合站着，让自己看起来漂亮。姑娘们为那些糟糕的国家事务操心时，你只管尽情享乐。除了狗仔队和偶尔的绑架，没什么值得担忧。” 绑架...？ “嗯，咳，罗马维亚家族确实曾经很喜欢掳走王夫，以便，呃，协商某些王朝安排，”阿尔布雷特摆弄着衣领说。“不过那全是遥远的过去了。一段迷人的历史。你真的该了解一下：我很乐意借你一些影像，它们能比我更好地解释这整场麻烦！”

rows.original: He’s presumably come from Tenevo to look after Nasti? “That’s the excuse, dear [pc.boy],” the slim kaithrit responds with a twinkle and a nudge of the elbow. “The truth is Nasti doesn’t need my or anybody else’s help to get along — and Ms. Batra does all the serious, ah, ‘looking after’. But I wouldn’t miss seeing some of the frontier for the world! Not that safaris and official visits and whatnot could possibly compare to the experiences you have garnered for yourself. Could you not — of course, I am joking, haha... But could you not spirit me out of here and take me along on one of your jaunts...?” He’s looking at you with a cat’s hungry, dilated eyes. Hurriedly, you ask if Nasti has always had a penchant for exploring. “Oh, yes. From a very young age. I can’t even tell you how many times the palace guards had to be fetched to get her out of a tree in the Autumn Garden. She was always good like that, she accepted...” He sighs, expression turning slightly graver. “...You see, younger Tenevan princesses are meant to embody joy and curiosity, that part of what kaithrit regard as the universal values of our race, you know. While the older princesses learn statecraft and rhetoric, the younger learn dance and orienteering. In this way, they may grow into the role they will most likely have in life: away from official power, but still expected to represent the royal family at all points. It is a difficult thing, more difficult than outside commentators often appreciate. More restless princesses often head into the sciences. There are many institutions throughout kaithrit space that were founded by Tenevan royalty. And still carry our heraldry, I might add!” So what happens when a younger princess is in line to become Cate? “Ah well, there’s the rub, right there.” Albreit frets a bit with his cufflink. “Younger princesses brought into succession by, ahm, circumstances, tend to make for — mercurial rulers. I suppose that’s a good way of putting it? Their reigns are often remarkable, for, ahm... one reason or another. To suddenly have all of that responsibility laid in one’s lap when one hasn’t prepared for it... it is a difficult thing.” “But!” He straightens his back and beams at you. “I believe our little Nasti is making the transition magnificently. Why, these soirees of hers: a wonderful way for her to blend what she’s good at with the necessity of getting to know the sort of people she’ll need to know once she ascends. And, perhaps — we have you to thank for that, eh?” He gives you another of those knowing little elbow nudges. “Getting to know an explorer-cum-entrepreneur such as yourself has set herself up magnificently for the challenges ahead. Our family surely owe you a debt of gratitude! Aheheheh.”
rows.translation: 想必他是从特内沃赶来照顾娜斯蒂的？ “那只是借口，亲爱的[pc.boy]，”纤细的凯斯里特人眨着眼，用手肘轻推你。“事实是，娜斯蒂不需要我或任何人的帮助也能过得很好——而严肃的，呃，‘照顾’工作都由巴特拉女士负责。不过就算全世界都不要，我也不会错过亲眼看看边境的机会！当然，狩猎旅行、公务访问之类的经历，无论如何都比不上你亲自收获的体验。你能不能——我当然是在开玩笑，哈哈...不过你能不能偷偷带我离开这里，让我跟你一起参加某次远游...？” 他以猫儿般饥渴放大的双眼看着你。你赶忙问，娜斯蒂是否一直都很喜欢探索。 “哦，是的。从很小的时候就这样。我都说不清宫廷卫兵有多少次不得不把她从秋日花园的树上救下来。她在这方面一直很懂事，她接受...” 他叹了口气，神情变得略微严肃。 “...你要知道，年轻的特内万公主应该体现喜悦与好奇；凯斯里特人认为，那是我们种族普世价值的一部分。年长公主学习治国术与修辞时，年轻公主则学习舞蹈与定向越野。这样，她们便能逐渐适应自己一生最可能承担的角色：远离正式权力，却仍被期待随时代表王室。这很艰难，比外界评论者通常理解的更加艰难。比较坐不住的公主往往会投身科学。凯斯里特宇域各处有许多机构，都是由特内万王族创立的。而且我要补充，它们至今仍沿用我们的纹章！” 那么，当一位年轻公主确实进入凯特继承序列时，会发生什么？ “啊，问题就在这里。”阿尔布雷特有些焦躁地摆弄袖扣。“因，呃，某些情况进入继承序列的年轻公主，往往会成为——变化无常的统治者。我想这样形容比较恰当？她们的统治常常令人难忘，至于原因，呃...各不相同。一个毫无准备的人突然被迫承担所有责任...那是很艰难的事。” “不过！”他挺直后背，向你灿烂微笑。“我相信我们的小娜斯蒂正在出色地完成转变。瞧，她举办的这些晚会：以绝妙方式把自己的长处，与认识那些登基后必须打交道之人的需要结合起来。而且，或许——我们得为此感谢你，对吧？”他又用手肘会意地轻推你。“结识你这样集探险家与企业家于一身的人，令她为未来挑战做好了极佳准备。我们家族肯定欠你一份感激！啊哈哈哈。”

To suddenly have all of that responsibility laid in one’s lap when one hasn’t prepared for it... it is a difficult thing.” “But!” He straightens his back and beams at you. “I believe our little Nasti is making the transition magnificently. Why, these soirees of hers: a wonderful way for her to blend what she’s good at with the necessity of getting to know the sort of people she’ll need to know once she ascends. And, perhaps — we have you to thank for that, eh?” He gives you another of those knowing little elbow nudges. “Getting to know an explorer-cum-entrepreneur such as yourself has set herself up magnificently for the challenges ahead. Our family surely owe you a debt of gratitude! Aheheheh.” "

rows.original: “She’s certainly the bold specimen, isn’t she!” Albreit leans in closer and glances over both shoulders, comically making sure that Riya is not listening in (not without good cause, perhaps). “It caused quite the stir back on Tenevo you know, when it filtered through that the young princess had taken her bodyguard as her consort. ‘If she was going to — ahem, do that — with a common-or-garden gendarme, she may as well have stayed at home where I can keep an eye on her!’ Fedorize said... paraphrasing slightly. My dear wife can be quite cutting. But! Having met the young lady in question, I think she will make for a perfectly good consort, for the time being. In many ways, precisely the sort of catch you only find by travelling outside the cosseted halls of the palace.” He beams, touching your arm. “She’s so thrillingly human, isn’t she just? So enterprising and certain of herself, just doing and damn the consequences! She’s the frontier spirit personified. Fedorize may complain, but I do believe she will make quite the splash back at court — if, ah, her habit of disappearing outside at regular intervals can be trained out of her.”
rows.translation: “她无疑是个胆大妄为的家伙，不是吗！” 阿尔布雷特凑得更近，夸张地朝两边肩后张望，确认莉娅没有偷听（也许他的谨慎不无道理）。 “你知道，年轻公主把自己的保镖收为伴侣的消息传回特内沃时，可引起了轩然大波。‘要是她非得——咳，和一个随处可见的普通宪兵做那种事——那她还不如待在家里，让我能看着她！’费多丽丝说...我稍微改述了一下。我亲爱的妻子说话有时很刻薄。不过！见过这位年轻女士后，我认为至少目前而言，她会成为一个非常出色的伴侣。从许多方面来看，她恰恰是那种只有离开备受呵护的宫廷殿堂，才能邂逅的良配。” 他笑容满面地碰了碰你的手臂。 “她是如此激动人心地富有人性，不是吗？如此进取，如此自信，只管行动，根本不在乎后果！她简直是边疆精神的化身。费多丽丝也许会抱怨，但我确实相信，她回到宫廷后会引起一场轰动——只要，啊，能改掉她定期消失到外面的习惯。”

This is what I discern: our cause naturally draws your keen sense of justice.” She knits both sets of hands. “But, as I said before, this is not the place to discuss more sensitive matters.” “Sensitive, yes...” Fa Oo breathes, openly ogling you. “To know and meld and satiate. This is why [pc.he] approaches us, yes?” “Not right now, sister.” Raqaia’s tone is prim and cool. “[pc.He] belongs to Commander Batra. It would be most improper.” “Ohh.” |“The [pc.race] approaches us freely, Fa Oo.” “So bold, Raqaia... so free and lissom in [pc.his] movements...” The two beings are each at least seven feet tall and slim, with ghostly, shark-like skin. They are vaguely humanoid with four long arms and webbed fingers, although their striking, long-skirted dresses, with arching bows, flanges and slices that make them appear both formidable and vulnerable at different angles, makes it difficult to tell quite what their overall bodily structure is. They have four eyes, black, glittering amethyst, one above the other, and sweeping, plated, ceratop-like crowns instead of hair. Seemingly, a stripe of holes below the crown function as ears. Despite these very alien features, they are each possessed of a fascinating, eerie facial beauty, both very similar to one another, with only the one called Raqaia dressing in purple while the one called Fa Oo dressing in cyan to tell them apart. Soft, grapefruit-sized breasts swell each of their low-cut bodices... you suppose those aren’t so alien to your sensibilities. “One of Princess Nastizia’s consorts. We are honored that you have made time for us,” Raqaia says, taking your hand in the lower two of hers and gently squeezing it in the manner of a formal gesture. “We are Velamihn of Teraxiq. Velamihn are not dissimilar to princesses, in your culture’s understanding of things... although it is to our shame that you find us in such reduced circumstances.” “Such shame...” murmurs Fa Oo. [pc.his]动作如此自由轻盈...” 这两个生物都至少七英尺高，身材纤细，皮肤幽灵般苍白，近似鲨鱼。她们大致呈人形，长着四条修长手臂和带蹼手指；不过醒目拖地长裙有拱形蝴蝶结、凸缘和开口，从不同角度令她们既强悍又脆弱，很难看清整体身体结构。她们有四只眼睛，黑色而闪烁紫水晶光芒，上下排列；代替头发的是向后延伸、覆有甲片、类似角龙的头冠。头冠下的一排孔洞似乎充当耳朵。尽管特征极为异星，她们都拥有迷人而诡异的面部美感，彼此十分相像；只有名叫拉卡娅的身穿紫色，名叫法·乌的身穿青色，借此区分。葡萄柚大小的柔软乳房从各自低胸紧身胸衣中隆起... 你想，这一点对你的审美倒不算太异星。 “娜斯蒂齐娅公主的一位王室配偶。你愿意为我们抽出时间，我们深感荣幸，”拉卡娅说，用下方两只手牵起你的手，以正式礼节的方式轻轻握住。“我们是特拉克西克的维拉敏。依照你们文化对事物的理解，维拉敏与公主并没有太大不同... 尽管你在如此落魄的处境下见到我们，令我们深感羞耻。” “如此羞耻...”法·乌低声说道。闪亮黑眸中带着近似渴望的神情望向你。“寒冷升起。无法忍受...” ]
