rows.original: “We are of the planet Tiraxiq,” Raqaia says, hands clasped together, forming a double chevron down her rich, purple dress. “Brought into the wider galactic consciousness during what you call the current Rush. It is a wonder to gain awareness of so many other civilisations, to see what they have accomplished over the ages...” “Beautiful,” gasps Fa Oo, eyes shining as she gazes over the well-heeled glamor all around Nasti’s receiving rooms. “Such shapes... vigor married to refinement...” “...even if the way we were brought to it was not the way we would have wished.” Raqaia pauses somberly. “Our planet was taken from us. Tiraxiq...” “Beautiful,” murmurs Fa Oo again. “The shimmer of gosserbloom in the winter sun... lattice of light in the Abyssal Palace...” “Beautiful,” Raqaia agrees. “Which is why the vulture people seized it from us. Incapable of beauty or sophistication, they simply steal it from others, then ruin it.” Vulture people? Raqaia gestures with a limp wave at [flags.NASTIZIA_PARTY_KIRLARWE |Kirlarwe |a stern-looking, uniformed anatae ] on the other side of the room. He returns their stare with cold, unblinking hawkishness. “At first I thought they were merely cruel brutes, these anatae,” she continues. “When they first arrived and ripped Teraxiq from the Velamihn, that we had ruled for time out of memory, as was our born right. Then I learned about them, and understood they are much worse. They think they’re doing good.” “Tragedy over and over, chaos made law... why such pain? Such ugliness?” Fa Oo sounds close to tears. “Upon every world they inflict themselves upon, they bring ruin, reduce every being to the same grubby, gray existence, groveling underneath them. They call it fairness.” Raqaia’s expression is calm, concentrated fury. “They expect gratitude.” “The cycle will be broken!” Shining joy has bloomed on Fa Oo’s face. “An ecstasy felt by an entire planet! Oh how I yearn, sister!” “Indeed, sister.” Raqaia places a soothing hand on Fa Oo’s shoulder. “It was a relief to arrive here and find there are many here who understand Tiraxiq’s tragedy for what it is, and yearn for it to be free as we do. Tiraxiq will be free, the Velamihn will return... you and the Cate-to-be understand such matters innately, of course. Your position, your bearing, we see the same noble patterns in you as we do in our highest sisters.” She smiles at you congenially, lower hands smoothing down her dress. “I do hope you can provide support. Even the smallest kindnesses provided at our darkest hour will not be forgotten, when the time comes...” she glances back towards [flags.NASTIZIA_PARTY_KIRLARWE |Kirlarwe |the anatae ]. “...but we will perhaps discuss that elsewhere. Somewhere more private.” “Such kindnesses.” Fa Oo regards you with that yearning, almost helplessly needy look again. You suddenly wonder if the rather large bulge on the front of her skirt is another odd fold of her dress, or something else. “To love such willingness and luminous energy!”
rows.translation: “我们来自提拉克西克星球，”拉卡娅说道，双手合拢，在华贵紫裙前形成双重倒V形。“你们所谓的本次星球淘金热期间，我们被带入更广阔的银河意识。能够认识如此多其他文明，见证他们历经岁月取得的成就，真是奇迹...” “美丽，”法·乌喘息道；她凝视娜斯蒂会客厅四周富贵优雅的景象，双眼闪亮。“这样的形态...活力与精致结合...” “...即使我们接触这一切的方式并非出于所愿。”拉卡娅神情阴沉地停顿。“我们的星球被夺走了。提拉克西克...” “美丽，”法·乌再次低语。“冬日阳光下微光闪烁的戈瑟花...深渊宫殿里的光之格栅...” “美丽，”拉卡娅赞同道。“正因如此，秃鹫人才从我们手里夺走了它。他们没有能力创造美或精致，只会从别人那里偷走，再将其毁掉。” 秃鹫人？ 拉卡娅无力地挥手，指向[flags.NASTIZIA_PARTY_KIRLARWE |Kirlarwe |a stern-looking, uniformed anatae ]，后者位于房间另一侧，用冰冷、不眨眼的鹰隼目光回望她们。 “起初我以为这些阿纳泰只是残忍的野蛮人，”她继续说道。“他们第一次到来，从维拉米恩手中夺走提拉克西克时——自记忆诞生前我们就统治那里，这是与生俱来的权利。后来我了解他们，才明白情况糟糕得多。他们以为自己在做好事。” “悲剧一遍又一遍，把混乱化为法律...为什么有如此痛苦？如此丑陋？”法·乌听起来快哭了。 “他们侵害每个世界，带来毁灭，把所有存在都压缩成同一种肮脏灰暗的生活，在脚下卑躬屈膝。他们称之为公平。”拉卡娅平静的表情中凝聚着愤怒。“他们还期待感激。” “循环终将打破！”闪耀喜悦在法·乌脸上绽放。“整颗星球共同感受的狂喜！哦，姐姐，我多么渴望！” “确实，妹妹。”拉卡娅把安抚的手放在法·乌肩上。“来到这里后，发现许多人理解提拉克西克悲剧的本质，并像我们一样渴望它获得自由，真令人宽慰。提拉克西克将会自由，维拉米恩将会归来...你和未来的凯特自然天生理解这类事务。你的地位、举止，我们在你身上看见了与最高贵姐妹相同的高贵模式。” 她亲切地冲你微笑，下方双手抚平裙摆。 “我真心希望你能提供支持。当时机到来，即使在最黑暗时刻给予的最微小善意，也不会被遗忘...”她回头望向[flags.NASTIZIA_PARTY_KIRLARWE |Kirlarwe |the anatae ]。“...不过也许应该换个地方讨论。更加私密的地方。” “如此善意。”法·乌再次用那种渴望、几乎无助而急需的眼神看你。你突然怀疑她裙子正面颇大的鼓包究竟是另一道古怪褶皱，还是别的东西。“去爱这种意愿与明亮能量！”

rows.original: Are they sisters? “Indeed. But Tiraxian sisterhood is a different thing to how it is understood amongst kaithrit, and ausar, and humans,” Raqaia says, gazing [pc.isHeight 72 |up |down ] at you with her quad of dark, mesmeric eyes. “The biological processes of beings not of Tiraxiq — remarkable. A whole other sex! Sometimes three!” “Rainbows of flesh and verve,” coos Fa Oo. Her own eyes are locked on Raqaia. “Tiraxians communicate psi-on-ic-ally.” Raqaia pronounces this carefully, an alien word in her mouth. “We can only do it with those we have spent time melding with: family and mates. It is dangerous to do it with others, as the influence you can have over one you have melded with is considerable. It is intimate.” “Conquest over and under and within... eternal summer,” whines Fa Oo blissfully. “And we mate with one we trust in this way.” Raqaia angles one pair of hands down and the other pair up, forming a kind of diamond from her collarbone to her groin. “When we become ripe, twice every solar cycle, if we are with a lover, the body forms a gamete of its own volition. The father provides a transmission of electric signals through the mind-meld which shapes the gamete’s DNA at its earliest stage. Thus, though we appear to reproduce asexually, in fact a mother’s child is as different yet similar to her as one of your own.” “Wavelengths... currents in the deep...” “For you see, the Velamihn’s right to rule is not born of anything so meaningless as blood and name,” Raqaia continues. “We were shaped by the very thoughts of those who came before us! The ideas of justice and intellect and tact that led our ancestors to such empyrean majesty were imprinted upon us at the very moment of our inception. And thus also our common folk innately know the virtues of honesty, humility and hard work.” So... are they sisters or not? “Oh! Forgive me. Born of the same mother, yes, we are.” Raqaia smiles at her sister with what might be affection. “But I don’t feel like we really were sisters until we, hmm, spent more time melding together during this exile of ours.” “Cream sheet...” groans Fa Oo. Her eyelashes flutter and her breasts rise and fall. “...stamped with black paint. Leaking into the grain...” “Fa Oo’s older than me, and she was always so bossy towards me when we were growing up,” Raqaia goes on, sliding her webbed hand into Fa Oo’s. “But that changed when I... delved into her more sensual side, shall we say? And now we’re rarely apart, because we really are closer to one being than two. She expresses and notices things that I cannot readily, whilst I... decide where we go, and what we do. Hmm. And you like that, don’t you paleblossom?” “Pale fire. A kite in the wind,” gasps Fa Oo. Her head crown appears to be pulsing blue. “But... sister holds my string...” “We partook of some of your gene-mods that admirers graciously provided with us as well,” Raqaia says, smirking at her sister, who seems quite overcome. “So though we may appear strange, [pc.name], we are more accommodating to the sensual delights this wonderful galaxy has to offer than we may appear.” “So accommodating!” “If only Taraxiq could freely know such wonders,” Raqaia sighs, her crepuscular radiance dimming.
rows.translation: 她们是姐妹吗？ “的确。但提拉克西安的姐妹关系不同于凯斯里特、奥萨和人类的理解，”拉卡娅用四只幽暗而催眠的眼睛[pc.isHeight 72 |仰视 |俯视 ]着你说道。“非提拉克西克生物的生理过程——令人惊叹。完整的另一种性别！有时甚至三种！” “血肉与活力的彩虹，”法·乌轻声咕噜。她自己的双眼始终锁定拉卡娅。 “提拉克西安通过灵——能——方式交流。”拉卡娅仔细发音，仿佛嘴里含着异星词汇。“我们只能与长期交融的人这样做：家人和伴侣。对其他人使用很危险，因为你对交融对象能够施加的影响相当巨大。这十分亲密。” “征服上下内外... 永恒盛夏，”法·乌幸福地呜咽。 “我们也会以这种方式和自己信任的人交配。”拉卡娅把一双手向下、一双手向上，在锁骨至胯间形成类似菱形的姿势。“我们成熟时，每个太阳周期两次，只要身边有爱人，身体便会自主形成配子。父亲通过心灵交融传递电信号，在配子最初阶段塑造其DNA。因此，尽管看似无性繁殖，母亲的孩子其实和你们的一样，与她既不同又相似。” “波长... 深处的电流...” “你要明白，维拉敏的统治权并非源于血统和姓名这种毫无意义的东西，”拉卡娅继续说道。“我们由前人的思想亲自塑造！令祖先达到崇高威严的正义、智慧与机敏理念，在我们诞生之时便烙印其中。因此，我们的平民也天生懂得诚实、谦逊和勤劳的美德。” 所以... 她们到底是不是姐妹？ “哦！请原谅。没错，我们由同一位母亲所生。”拉卡娅用可能称得上深情的目光朝姐姐微笑。“不过，直到流亡期间花更多时间彼此交融，我才觉得我们真正成为姐妹。” “奶油色床单...”法·乌呻吟。她的睫毛颤动，乳房起伏。“...盖着黑漆印章。渗入纹理...” “法·乌比我年长，我们成长时，她总是对我颐指气使，”拉卡娅继续说道，把带蹼的手滑进法·乌手里。“不过当我... 深入她更加感性的一面后，可以这么说吧？情况便改变了。如今我们很少分开，因为我们真的更接近一个生物，而非两个。她会表达并注意到我无法轻易察觉的事情，而我则... 决定我们去哪里、做什么。嗯。你喜欢这样，对吧，苍花？” “苍白火焰。风中的风筝，”法·乌喘息。她的头冠似乎正闪烁蓝光。“可是... 姐姐握着我的线...” “我们也服用了一些仰慕者慷慨提供的基因改造药物，”拉卡娅看着似乎已经不胜刺激的姐姐，得意微笑。“所以，[pc.name]，尽管我们看起来很奇怪，但对于这个美妙银河所提供的感官享乐，我们可能比外表显示得更加适应。” “无比适应！” “要是塔拉克西克也能自由了解这样的奇迹就好了，”拉卡娅叹息，暮光般的辉芒逐渐暗淡。

A whole other sex! Sometimes three!” “Rainbows of flesh and verve,” coos Fa Oo. It is dangerous to do it with others, as the influence you can have over one you have melded with is considerable. It is intimate.” “Conquest over and under and within... eternal summer,” whines Fa Oo blissfully. “And we mate with one we trust in this way.” Raqaia angles one pair of hands down and the other pair up, forming a kind of diamond from her collarbone to her groin. “When we become ripe, twice every solar cycle, if we are with a lover, the body forms a gamete of its own volition. The father provides a transmission of electric signals through the mind-meld which shapes the gamete’s DNA at its earliest stage. Thus, though we appear to reproduce asexually, in fact a mother’s child is as different yet similar to her as one of your own.” “Wavelengths... currents in the deep...” “For you see, the Velamihn’s right to rule is not born of anything so meaningless as blood and name,” Raqaia continues. “We were shaped by the very thoughts of those who came before us! The ideas of justice and intellect and tact that led our ancestors to such empyrean majesty were imprinted upon us at the very moment of our inception. And thus also our common folk innately know the virtues of honesty, humility and hard work.” So... are they sisters or not? “Oh! Forgive me. Born of the same mother, yes, we are.” Raqaia smiles at her sister with what might be affection. “But I don’t feel like we really were sisters until we, hmm, spent more time melding together during this exile of ours.” “Cream sheet...” groans Fa Oo. Her eyelashes flutter and her breasts rise and fall. “...stamped with black paint. Leaking into the grain...” “Fa Oo’s older than me, and she was always so bossy towards me when we were growing up,” Raqaia goes on, sliding her webbed hand into Fa Oo’s. “But that changed when I... delved into her more sensual side, shall we say? And you like that, don’t you paleblossom?” “Pale fire. A kite in the wind,” gasps Fa Oo. rows.original: You [pc.move] towards the lounge’s french windows, drawn by the cool air and lights outside... “Not so fast, [riya.vitaminRange 81 |[riya.nickname] |Steele ].” [pc.hasCock |A strong arm catches you around the waist, and yanks you over to a side door as abruptly as if you were an intruder. For a moment that’s exactly what you think you are, because the person who’s grabbed you is a security guard dressed in a menacing three-piece. But then — terran, dark skin, black hair, big boobs, a body language that mostly speaks in slurs — recognition asserts itself. “Been having yourself a nice time, sissy?” Riya inquires, billowing minty breath over your face. She pats your groin briskly — right there, where everyone can see her do it — and grunts approvingly when she feels your [pc.chasDevice]. “Time to pay your keep. I’ve got an assignment for you. Come on.” |The vibrating orb in your [pc.vagina], which you had almost managed to put out of your mind, increases its intensity by roughly 200%, almost turning your [pc.knees] to water and spilling you onto the carpet. Oh Void, oh fuck... you stare around the crowd wildly, biting your lip. Did anyone notice? Does anyone suspect? Riya is leaning out of a door to one side of the french window, jaw working, hand in pocket. She blows a bubble with her gum, slowly retracts it back into her mouth, gazing at you with monstrous nonchalance when you rush over to her and babble at her to stop, turn it down. “Not just yet,” she says. “I’ve got a job for you. Come on.” ]
rows.translation: 你[pc.move]向休息室的落地窗，被外面的凉爽空气和灯光吸引... “别这么急，[riya.vitaminRange 81 |[riya.nickname] |斯蒂尔 ]。” [pc.hasCock |一条强壮手臂搂住你的腰，猛然把你拖向侧门，动作之突兀，仿佛你是个闯入者。片刻间，你的确以为自己是，因为抓住你的是一名身穿骇人三件套的保安。但随后——地球人、深色皮肤、黑发、巨乳、肢体语言大多由侮辱组成——认知重新占据上风。 “玩得开心吗，娘炮？”莉娅询问，薄荷味呼吸扑上你的脸。她干脆地拍打你的胯间——就在这里，每个人都能看见她这样做——摸到[pc.chasDevice]后赞许地闷哼。“该交住宿费了。我有任务给你。过来。” |[pc.vagina]里的振动球——你几乎已经设法将它抛在脑后——强度骤增约百分之二百，几乎把你的[pc.knees]化成水，令你瘫倒在地毯上。哦，虚空，哦，操... 你疯狂扫视人群，咬紧嘴唇。有人注意到了吗？有人起疑吗？ 莉娅从落地窗一侧的门内探身，嘴巴咀嚼着，一只手插进口袋。她用口香糖吹出泡泡，再缓缓收回嘴里；当你冲向她，语无伦次地要求她停下，把强度调低时，她以怪物般的冷漠凝视着你。 “还不行，”她说道。“我有个任务给你。过来。” ]

rows.original: Riya & Tiraxians
rows.translation: 莉娅与提拉克西安人
rows.raw: "Riya & Tiraxians"

rows.original: You have no choice but to follow Riya... not if you want to [riya.chastity |get out of your cage at some point. |get blessed relief from her love egg at some point. ] She takes you into a room which is lit only by the luminous giant crystals and tealight drones beyond the large bay window. It’s a study of some sort, tastefully appointed with real wooden furniture, plants and Tenevan ornaments — the lissom delicateness of which may explain why it’s been closed off to the public. There’s a generously sized leather sofa set by the window. Reclining on the sofa are two beings, their pale skin ghostly in the darkened room. It’s Raqaia and Fa Oo, the Tiraxian exiles. “And this is the entertainment you promised us, is it guard?” says Raqaia, blinking her four tar-black eyes at you. She sets one pair of hands on her purple-clad hips. “We’ve already had the pleasure of this entity. They struck us as mundane.” “Not,” murmurs Fa Oo. She is gazing at you with unsettling intensity. “Experience, beyond the stars, in the stars... spiced wine.” “You haven’t had the pleasure of [pc.him],” Riya responds, with that cool confidence of hers that flattens all before her. “You said you wanted to experience flesh the way the rest of the galaxy does — ok. I don’t have anyone who’d be better suited to showing you that.” “We’ve already had this experience,” Raqaia responds tartly. Your eyes can’t help but be drawn to the front of the hauntingly beautiful xeno’s gown. No, it’s not a trick of the light — there’s a rather large bulge there. It seems to be twitching. “What we want is to partake of flesh that is truly worthwhile. And this — individual...” She gestures at you. “...is yours to freely give?” “Yep.” Riya’s boob presses into your shoulder. Her minty breath washes past your [pc.ear]. Her hand imprints itself into your [pc.ass]. “[pc.He]’s my piece of ass — the Tenevan crown’s piece of ass. And we loan [pc.him] out for extra special guests. Say it, [riya.vitaminRange 81 |[riya.nickname] |Steele ].” [pc.hasCock |You are very, uncomfortably aware of your [pc.chasCock], throbbing softly away in its [pc.chasDevice]. |The love egg ebbs and then shudders to maximum, like someone running their fingers up and down a piano. ] “...I’m R- the Commander’s piece of ass,” you mumble. Hot flushes run through you as the truth of that, and its material meaning here, grips you. The atmosphere in the darkened room shifts. One of the seven foot xeno twins stalks over to you. You feel a strange buzzing sensation in your head[pc.hasCock | |, not completely dissimilar to the vibrations currently quaking through your [pc.vagina], as if someone were running an auto-razor over your head ]. “Servant? Housebound?” Fa Oo inquires softly. She touches your arm, then presses one long digit into your [pc.lips], tracing them gently. “No. Something different, differently, the same. A game? But serious... blood and verdure and sweet exhaustion...” She gasps and closes her eyes, a flutey, windy sound, and clenches one set of fists. “I must know! Ohh sister, I keen to understand this alienness!” “And you will, sister,” Raqaia says with a small smile. She waves loftily at Riya. “You may retire, guard. Tell your velamihn we accept her gift with gratitude.” “Sure,” Riya says. She gives you a smirk as she heads for the door. “Be a good [pc.boy] for them, ok [riya.vitaminRange 81 |[riya.nickname] |Steele ]? I know you will. You know how to act around princesses.” The door locking shut behind you sounds very loud.
rows.translation: 你别无选择，只能跟着莉娅...至少，如果你还想[riya.chastity |在某个时候摆脱笼子。 |在某个时候从她的跳蛋中获得仁慈解脱。 ]她把你带进一个房间，唯一的光源来自巨大凸窗外的发光巨型水晶和茶灯无人机。这似乎是一间书房，布置雅致，摆着真正的木制家具、植物和特涅沃饰品——那些物件纤细轻巧，或许正是这里不向公众开放的原因。窗边摆着一张尺寸宽裕的皮沙发。 两个人斜倚在沙发上，苍白皮肤在昏暗房间中宛若幽灵。是拉卡娅与法·乌，那对遭到放逐的提拉克西安人。 “这就是你答应给我们的娱乐吗，卫兵？”拉卡娅说道，四只漆黑的眼睛朝你眨动。她把一双手放在紫衣包裹的腰间。“我们已经体验过这个实体带来的乐趣。他们给我们的印象很平庸。” “并非如此，”法·乌喃喃说道。她用令人不安的专注目光凝视着你。“体验，在群星之外，在群星之中...香料酒。” “你们还没有享用过[pc.him]，”莉娅以那份足以压倒一切的冷静自信回答。“你们说想像银河其他生物那样体验肉体——好吧。没人比这个人更适合向你们展示了。” “我们已经有过这种体验，”拉卡娅尖刻地回答。你的目光不由自主地被这个美得摄人心魄的异族礼服前方吸引。不，这不是光影造成的错觉——那里鼓起了相当大的一团，似乎还在抽动。“我们想要享用的是真正值得的肉体。而这个——个体...”她朝你比划。“...是可以由你自由赠予的吗？” “没错。”莉娅的乳房压在你肩上。她带着薄荷味的呼吸拂过你的[pc.ear]。她的手牢牢印进你的[pc.ass]。“[pc.He]是我的一块肉——也是特涅沃王室的一块肉。我们会把[pc.him]借给格外尊贵的客人。说出来，[riya.vitaminRange 81 |[riya.nickname] |斯蒂尔 ]。” [pc.hasCock |你极其清楚、也极其不舒服地感觉到[pc.chasCock]正在[pc.chasDevice]里轻轻搏动。 |那枚跳蛋先缓缓减弱，接着又猛然震至最大强度，仿佛有人让手指在钢琴键上来回奔跑。 ] “...我是莉——指挥官的一块肉，”你嘟囔道。这个事实及其在此处的实际含义攫住你，阵阵灼热的红潮流遍全身。 昏暗房间中的气氛发生了变化。两名七英尺高的异族双胞胎之一大步向你走来。你感觉脑中泛起奇异的嗡鸣[pc.hasCock | |，和眼下震撼着[pc.vagina]的振动并非完全不同，仿佛有人正拿自动剃刀刮过你的头皮 ]。 “仆人？居家者？”法·乌轻声询问。她碰了碰你的手臂，随后将一根修长的手指按进[pc.lips]，温柔地描摹它们。“不。不同之物，以不同方式，却又相同。一场游戏？却很严肃...鲜血、青翠与甜美的疲惫...”她喘息着闭上眼，发出长笛般空灵的声音，并握紧一双拳头。“我必须知道！哦，姐姐，我渴望理解这种异质性！” “你会理解的，妹妹，”拉卡娅微微一笑说道。她傲慢地朝莉娅挥手。“你可以退下了，卫兵。告诉你们的维拉敏，我们怀着感激之情接受她的赠礼。” “当然，”莉娅说。她走向门口时朝你坏笑。“为她们做个好[pc.boy]，好吗，[riya.vitaminRange 81 |[riya.nickname] |斯蒂尔 ]？我知道你会的。你知道在公主身边该怎么表现。” 身后的门锁闭时，声音显得格外响亮。

rows.original: Out through the french windows the estate’s garden provides a welcome, cool release from the pressure cooker of laughter, chatter and dance inside — even though this is only a fleeting impression of being in fresh air. It’s something you quickly come to crave, here on Tavros. High above, you can see the curve of the station’s protective dome, and the uncaring beauty of the stars studding the infinite night beyond. From the vantage point of the manor’s patio you can see over the garden, the giant crystal formations and tea light drones bathing the guests out here in soothing, shifting light. [flags.NASTIZIA_RECREATA |The courtyard-like area where you put on Recreata spectacles for Nasti on quiet nights serves now as another dancefloor; although the music here is slower and dreamier, the couples clasping each other in more intimate fashion, than the ones in the ballroom. |There are some couples dancing out here in the romantic setting, but most just seem to be chatting or catching a smoke. ] Set further back from the crystals there are rambling paths and wrought-iron seats nestled within lush, bushy greenery, where two (or three) could easily spend an unforgettable few minutes away from prying eyes. In the fullness of time, you’ll get to explore these grounds. For now though, it’s time to be elsewhere.

rows.original: You press the buzzer next to the gates of the Romavian Estate. They open silently for you. No escort, nothing. The gatehouse is dark. After a few moments of hesitation, you make your way up to the manor’s main entrance. There, waiting at the door, is Marvo. Nasti’s elderly kaithrit page gives you a surprisingly tender smile. “Mistress is in the receiving room,” he says. “She’s expecting you.” Princess Nastizia is propped up in a bank of frilly cushions, wearing a blue bedroom gown. There are dark rings under her eyes, she looks somewhat like a deflated white balloon, but there is a small, proud smile on her black lips. In her arms, swaddled in pale silk, is a sleeping baby. Riya stands behind her, leaning over the chesterfield. There is an uncharacteristically soft and unfocused look on the human’s features as she gazes down at the pair. Nasti’s smile widens when she sees you standing there in the doorway. “Darling,” she says softly, and for a moment you aren’t sure who she’s referring to. “Would you like to come see?” You head over to take a closer look at the little bundle of joy. They have pointy cat ears, a single dark brown cat tail, brown skin, and a flash of white amongst the thin brown hair that otherwise covers their scalp. You can’t tell what sex they are, but there’s little doubting who their parents are. “18 hours of labor,” Nasti informs you with a little sniff. “That’s what one gets for making one’s consort such a large individual. Large genes.” The curt retort you’d expect from Riya isn’t forthcoming. She continues to look down on the pair with silent tenderness, and no small amount of pride. She barely seems aware you’re there. You ask if they have a name yet. “I’m leaning towards Albreit,” Nasti says (so a boy, then). “It has very fine connotations in Romavian history — and I know one person who I will make very happy by naming him so. I am letting Riya have the middle name. One of them, anyway.” “Rudra,” Riya says. “He’ll be Rudra, to me.” What happens now? “Oh...” Nasti leans back into her nest of cushions and closes her eyes for a moment. “We shall have to repair to Tenevo, so that he can be recognised by the Cate, and one can officially state one’s case for the throne. It will be a grand old fuss that one can scarcely bring oneself to think about, but it must be done, now we have committed ourselves to this path.” She wrinkles her nose and grins at you, a little of her old kittenish nature peeking out at you. “To be honest with you darling, it is difficult to imagine myself more content than I am right now. With my indomitable consort... my baby... and my best, most intimate friend.” She reaches out to squeeze your hand. [pc.isCat |“Three kittens,” Riya murmurs to herself. ]
rows.translation: 你按下罗马维亚庄园大门旁的门铃。 大门悄无声息地为你打开。没有迎接者，什么都没有。门房一片漆黑。犹豫片刻后，你朝庄园主宅的正门走去。 马尔沃正等在门口。娜丝蒂那位年迈的凯瑟丽侍从朝你露出一个出奇温柔的微笑。 “女主人在接待室，”他说。“她正在等你。” 娜斯蒂齐娅公主穿着蓝色睡袍，靠在一大堆带褶边的软垫上。她眼下挂着深色眼圈，看起来有些像一只泄了气的白气球，但黑色嘴唇上仍带着一抹骄傲的小小笑容。她怀中抱着一个用浅色丝绸裹住的熟睡婴儿。莉娅站在身后，俯身越过切斯特菲尔德沙发。她低头凝视这对母子，脸上罕见地带着柔和而恍惚的神情。 娜丝蒂看见你站在门口时，笑容变得更加灿烂。 “亲爱的，”她轻声说道；一时间，你甚至不确定她是在称呼谁。“要过来看看吗？” 你走过去，近距离端详这小小的快乐结晶。孩子长着尖尖的猫耳、一条深棕色猫尾、棕色皮肤；覆盖头皮的稀薄棕发中，还闪过一缕白色。你看不出孩子的性别，但毫无疑问能看出双亲是谁。 “十八个小时的产程，”娜丝蒂轻轻哼了一声，告诉你。“让自己的伴侣成为如此高大的个体，就会落得这个结果。大号基因。” 莉娅没有像你预想的那样尖刻回嘴。她继续默默而温柔地俯视这对母子，神情中还带着相当浓厚的骄傲。她似乎几乎没有意识到你也在场。 你问孩子有没有名字。 “本宫倾向于阿尔布雷特，”娜丝蒂说道（所以是男孩）。“在罗马维亚历史中，这个名字有非常美好的含义——而且本宫知道，有一个人会因为本宫如此为他命名而十分开心。本宫会让莉娅决定中间名。至少是其中一个中间名。” “鲁德拉，”莉娅说。“对我而言，他就是鲁德拉。” 接下来会怎样？ “哦...”娜丝蒂向后靠进自己的软垫巢穴，闭目片刻。“我们必须返回特内沃，好让他得到教廷承认，本宫也能正式陈述自己继承王位的理由。那将是一场盛大而古老的繁文缛节，想一想都让本宫难以承受；但既然我们已经决意走上这条道路，就必须完成它。” 她皱起鼻子，对你咧嘴一笑，昔日那份小猫般的性情又向你显露了一点。 “老实说，亲爱的，本宫很难想象自己还能比此刻更加满足。有本宫不可战胜的伴侣...本宫的宝宝...还有本宫最亲密、最要好的朋友。” 她伸手握了握你的手。 [pc.isCat |“三只小猫，”莉娅自言自语般低声说道。 ]

rows.original: You spend a little more time in the soft, maternal cocoon Nasti’s drawn around herself — long enough for Albreit Jr. Rudra Romavia to open his blue eyes and give you the frank, silent baby stare and curl his tiny fingers with their even tinier claws around your index. But the princess is obviously knackered and quite soon she politely dismisses you. Riya sees you to the gate. “This is it, Steele,” she says.[riya.vitaminRange 81 | The fact she’s using your real name adds sobriety to her words. ] “Kitten — kittens — will be taking off by the end of the week, I’ll have to go with them, and there won’t be time to fit in anything else. No more parties. No more get-togethers. This... thing, the three of us had, it’s over now.” She turns to face you, in the shadow of the gatehouse. “Told you the day would come. Well, it’s here.” You look back towards the manor and think about that. The desire to make a smart alec remark that you’re pretty glad [riya.chastity |to never have to wear a chastity cage to attend a dinner again |to never have to watch Riya and Nasti have it off again ] comes and goes. Because ultimately, you are going to miss that. You wouldn’t be here if you weren’t, would you? So in the end you just give Riya a big hug. She tenses up momentarily, then relaxes and folds her arms around you as well. “Probably won’t be the last time we see each other,” she says. “Kitten will want you at the coronation, at the very least. But if it is... [flags.RIYA_GATEHOUSE_LOVE |you know that thing I said, when it was really good for us in the gatehouse that time? Well... I meant it. I really did. |eh... umm... yeah. ]” You feel her eyes on your back as the gates of the Romavian estate close behind you for the last time.
rows.translation: 你又在娜丝蒂为自己营造的柔软母性襁褓中待了一会儿——久到小阿尔布雷特·鲁德拉·罗马维亚睁开蓝色眼睛，用婴儿坦率而沉默的目光望着你，还让带着更细小爪子的微小手指蜷在你的食指上。不过，公主显然已经精疲力竭，很快便礼貌地让你离开。 莉娅送你到大门。 “就到这里了，斯蒂尔，”她说。[riya.vitaminRange 81 |她使用了你的真名，这让她的话更显严肃。 ]“小猫——还有小小猫——会在本周结束前启程，我必须和他们一起走，也没时间再安排任何其他活动了。不会再有派对。不会再有聚会。我们三个人之间的这件...事，现在结束了。”她在门房的阴影中转身面对你。“我告诉过你，这一天会来的。现在，它到了。” 你回头望向庄园，思考着这件事。你一度想自作聪明地说，自己很高兴[riya.chastity |再也不必为了参加晚宴戴上贞操笼 |再也不必看莉娅与娜丝蒂做爱 ]，但这个念头很快便消失了。因为归根结底，你会想念这些。否则你也不会来到这里，对吧？ 所以最后，你只是给了莉娅一个大大的拥抱。她短暂地绷紧身体，随后放松下来，也用双臂抱住你。 “这大概不会是我们最后一次见面，”她说。“至少，小猫会希望你参加加冕典礼。但如果真是最后一次... [flags.RIYA_GATEHOUSE_LOVE |你还记得吗，那次我们在门房里特别尽兴时，我说过的那件事？好吧...那是我的真心话。真的。 |呃...嗯...就这样。 ]” 当罗马维亚庄园的大门最后一次在你身后关闭时，你感觉到她的目光一直落在你的背上。

rows.original: “I should go.” Riya eyes you, almost a silhouette before the avid glow of her monitors. “Don’t let the door hit your ass on the way out,” she says at last, swivelling to face them. She waits until you’ve retrieved your [pc.weapon] and are almost outside before adding, “That’s my job.” The gates of the estate roll soundlessly open when you approach it. Your time in the strange, rarefied world that Princess Nasti inhabits is over, for now.

rows.original: Your half-behemoth kids live in a jungle-like enclosure that somewhat simulates the Radwoods, based on your descriptions and other rushers’ accounts. Sections of the jungle are outfitted with modern conveniences, including a classroom equipped with a holo projector. The caretaker turns out to be a muscular, middle-aged gryvain amazon with matronly looks and a retired mercenary background – apparently, it takes someone that strong to keep your little kaiju under control when they decide to get rambunctious.

rows.original: of the rooms is kept air-tight, its locked door plastered with warnings. The viewing window next to it reveals nothing but blackness - but you can use controls next to it to change the whole screen to stark night vision, allowing you to see within. rows.original: One of the modular chambers has been opened up and filled with soil sourced directly from Mhen’ga, allowing for the absolute best growing conditions possible for your venus pitcher offspring. Somehow, Briget has managed to secure a naleen female onto the staff, who is currently slithering about the jungle-like environ making sure everything is picture-perfect - and guaranteeing that your planty offspring will have someone native to play with as they develop.
rows.translation: 其中一间模块化舱室已经打开，填入直接取自门加的土壤，为你的捕蝇草后代提供绝对最佳的生长条件。不知何故，布丽姬特设法招募了一名纳林女性；她现在正在丛林般的环境里滑行，确保一切都完美如画，也保证你的植物后代成长时能有一位本地伙伴陪伴玩耍。

rows.original: Connected to the main entrance via a pressurized airlock is a water-filled chamber, simulating a deep saltwater lake with a sandy island in its center. Though the rooms inside are pitch black, a camera feed inside has been set to night vision, showing your Water Princesses scuttling about, half-submerged and completely hidden in the dark waters. Your head nurse has hired on a dusky female nyrea from their homeworld to help oversee their development - a brief word with her reveals the huntress is well acquainted with the Queen of the Deep, and that the princesses’ mother sends her regards.
rows.translation: 一个充满水的舱室通过加压气闸与主入口连接，模拟中央带沙岛的深盐水湖。尽管里面的房间漆黑一片，内部摄像头画面已经设为夜视模式，显示你的水域公主们四处爬行，半浸在水中，完全隐藏于黑暗水域。护士长从她们的母星雇来一名黝黑的尼瑞亚女性，帮助监督成长；与她简短交谈后得知，这位女猎手与深海女王非常熟悉，而且公主们的母亲向你致意。
rows.raw: "\n\nConnected to the main entrance via a pressurized airlock is a water-filled chamber, simulating a deep saltwater lake with a sandy island in its center. Though the rooms inside are pitch black, a camera feed inside has been set to night vision, showing your Water Princesses scuttling about, half-submerged and completely hidden in the dark waters. Your head nurse has hired on a dusky female nyrea from their homeworld to help oversee their development - a brief word with her reveals the huntress is well acquainted with the Queen of the Deep, and that the princesses’ mother sends her regards."

rows.original: Zheniya walks past you with a spring in her step. You catch her with a brief hug, and note that she’s looking quite... slim today. At least, her normally bodacious bosom looks a little smaller. She chuckles and indicates the small box she’s carrying under an arm: full of honey vials, fresh from the milker station upstairs. “I could get used to that kind of treatment,” she smiles. “The machine may not be gentle... but it is wonderfully vigorous.”
rows.translation: 热妮娅脚步轻快地从你身边走过。你短暂拥抱住她，并注意到她今天看起来相当... 苗条。至少，平时丰腴诱人的胸脯似乎小了一些。她轻笑着示意夹在腋下的小盒子：里面装满刚从楼上挤奶站取得的蜂蜜小瓶。 “我可以习惯这种待遇，”她微笑道。“机器或许并不温柔... 但动作美妙地有力。”
rows.raw: "Zheniya walks past you with a spring in her step. You catch her with a brief hug, and note that she’s looking quite... slim today. At least, her normally bodacious bosom looks a little smaller. rows.original: Quite the prolific breeder you’re becoming. Then again, what did I expect from a Steele?
rows.translation: 你正在成为相当多产的繁育者。不过话说回来，对于一名斯蒂尔，我还能期待什么呢？
rows.raw: " Quite the prolific breeder you’re becoming. Then again, what did I expect from a Steele?"

rows.original: your one and only child. You must be so proud!
rows.translation: 你唯一的孩子。你一定非常自豪！
rows.raw: " your one and only child. You must be so proud!"

rows.original: all of no children. Do me a favor and get to breeding, dearest. Your father didn’t bring me out of retirement to sit here idle!
rows.translation: 整整零个孩子。帮个忙，赶紧去繁育吧，亲爱的。你父亲可不是为了让我闲坐在这里，才把我从退休生活中请出来！
rows.raw: " all of no children. Do me a favor and get to breeding, dearest. Your father didn’t bring me out of retirement to sit here idle!"

rows.original: <i>“Our facilities are
rows.translation: <i>“我们的设施
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Our facilities are"

rows.original: somewhat upgraded thanks to you. Please, continue finding more staff and equipment out there on your adventures - everything you bring back makes the nursery that much better of a place for your children to grow up.
rows.translation: 在你的帮助下得到了一些升级。请继续在冒险途中寻找更多员工和设备——你带回的每件东西都会让育儿所变得更加适合孩子成长。
rows.raw: " somewhat upgraded thanks to you. Please, continue finding more staff and equipment out there on your adventures - everything you bring back makes the nursery that much better of a place for your children to grow up."

rows.original: as your father bought them. We’re operating at near-perfect efficiency, and at budget.
rows.translation: 仍与父亲购置时一样。我们的运作效率接近完美，也完全符合预算。
rows.raw: " as your father bought them. We’re operating at near-perfect efficiency, and at budget."

rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“The staff is"

rows.original: still more robotic than organic, but is becoming more diverse by the day. Thanks to your efforts, I’m sure we’ll soon boast the most colorful staff in the galaxy - a fitting way to operate, given what your father
rows.translation: 仍然以机器人多于有机体，但正日益变得更加多样。感谢你的努力，我相信我们很快就能拥有全银河最多姿多彩的员工阵容——考虑到你父亲
rows.raw: " still more robotic than organic, but is becoming more diverse by the day. Thanks to your efforts, I’m sure we’ll soon boast the most colorful staff in the galaxy - a fitting way to operate, given what your father"

rows.original: expected of you and your brood.
rows.translation: 对你和后代抱有的期望，这种运营方式十分恰当。
rows.raw: " expected of you and your brood."

rows.original: We’re flush with everything we could ever need, all thanks to you, oh captain my captain. The way things are going, you might want to start asking some of your many, many half-siblings if they’d like to make use of the facility: we have more than enough staff.
rows.translation: 各种所需资源都极为充裕，全都多亏了你，哦，船长，我的船长。照这个趋势发展，你或许应该开始询问众多同父异母的兄弟姐妹，看看他们是否愿意使用这座设施：我们的员工远远足够。
rows.raw: " We’re flush with everything we could ever need, all thanks to you, oh captain my captain. The way things are going, you might want to start asking some of your many, many half-siblings if they’d like to make use of the facility: we have more than enough staff."

rows.original: largely robotic, with some specialists in education and infant-handling on retainer. The nurse-droid staff is quite capable, though, I assure you - and we both know I’m quite able to handle as many children as needed myself.
rows.translation: 主要由机器人组成，另有一些教育和婴儿照护专家接受常备聘用。不过我向你保证，护士机器人员工完全能够胜任；而且我们都知道，我本人也完全有能力照顾任何数量的孩子。
rows.raw: " largely robotic, with some specialists in education and infant-handling on retainer. The nurse-droid staff is quite capable, though, I assure you - and we both know I’m quite able to handle as many children as needed myself."

rows.original: Briget flashes you a smile and taps on her Codex, glancing through the information at her display. “I believe that covers everything of note at present. Anything else, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: 布丽姬特朝你微笑，轻点她的宝典，浏览显示屏上的信息。“我相信目前值得一提的内容都涵盖了。还有别的问题吗，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBriget flashes you a smile and taps on her Codex, glancing through the information at her display. “I believe that covers everything of note at present. Anything else, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “How’s the staff doing?” you ask. Things certainly seem a little more lively around here.
rows.translation: “员工过得怎样？”你问道。这里看起来的确比以前热闹了一些。
rows.raw: "“How’s the staff doing?” you ask. Things certainly seem a little more lively around here."

rows.original: Briget smiles, directing your attention to the holoterminal on the wall. It flickers over to a status display, showing off current numbers of synthetic and organic employees working in the nursery, along with breakdowns of their roles and terms of employment.
rows.translation: 布丽姬特微笑着，将你的注意力引向墙上的全息终端。画面闪烁着切换为状态显示，列出当前在育儿所工作的合成体与有机员工数量，以及他们的职责和雇佣条款明细。
rows.raw: "\n\nBriget smiles, directing your attention to the holoterminal on the wall. It flickers over to a status display, showing off current numbers of synthetic and organic employees working in the nursery, along with breakdowns of their roles and terms of employment."

rows.original: <i>“Everything is going quite well, dear.
rows.translation: <i>“一切进展得相当顺利，亲爱的。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Everything is going quite well, dear."

rows.original: Though most of the nursery’s duties are still fulfilled by drones and nurse droids, having an organic touch has certainly made our little home away from home that much more vibrant and pleasant. Even I have to admit, children do seem to respond better to living caregivers... at least until they get to know me.” She chuckles pleasantly, though her eyes turn downcast rather quickly.
rows.translation: 虽然育儿所的大部分工作仍由无人机和护理机器人完成，但有了有机生命的亲切照料，我们这个远离家乡的小家确实变得更加生机勃勃、舒适宜人。即便是我也不得不承认，孩子们似乎对活生生的照料者反应更好...至少在他们了解我之前是如此。”她愉快地轻笑，不过目光很快便黯淡下来。
rows.raw: " Though most of the nursery’s duties are still fulfilled by drones and nurse droids, having an organic touch has certainly made our little home away from home that much more vibrant and pleasant. Even I have to admit, children do seem to respond better to living caregivers... at least until they get to know me.” She chuckles pleasantly, though her eyes turn downcast rather quickly."

rows.original: You’ve certainly found more employees than I would have expected. Our budget is a bit strained at present, but I believe the effects more than justify a bit of

rows.raw: " You’ve certainly found more employees than I would have expected. Our budget is a bit strained at present, but I believe the effects more than justify a bit of "

rows.original: Out of curiosity, you ask “If I find someone out there in the galaxy that would fit in well here at the nursery, can I offer them a job?”
rows.translation: 出于好奇，你问道：“如果我在银河系里找到一个很适合育儿所的人，可以给他们提供工作吗？”
rows.raw: "Out of curiosity, you ask “If I find someone out there in the galaxy that would fit in well here at the nursery, can I offer them a job?”"

rows.original: Briget purses her lips a moment, thinking. “I suppose so. Technically speaking, I am in charge of all matters related to staff, but of course I trust your judgement, dear, especially in regards to your own children. If you find someone with skills or talents you think would make the nursery a better place for us to bring up your offspring, I would be happy to have them. There will need to be interviews and contracts, of course, but those should be a formality.”
rows.translation: 布丽姬特抿着嘴唇思考片刻。“我想可以。严格来说，所有员工相关事务都由我负责，不过我当然信任你的判断，亲爱的，尤其是在你自己孩子的问题上。如果你找到某个拥有技能或才华、能让育儿所更适合我们抚养你后代的人，我很乐意接纳他们。当然，面试和合同还是必需的，不过那些应该只是走个形式。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBriget purses her lips a moment, thinking. “I suppose so. Technically speaking, I am in charge of all matters related to staff, but of course I trust your judgement, dear, especially in regards to your own children. If you find someone with skills or talents you think would make the nursery a better place for us to bring up your offspring, I would be happy to have them. There will need to be interviews and contracts, of course, but those should be a formality.”"

rows.original: That answers that, you suppose. Does she have any suggestions for staff she needs? Any particular skillsets you should be on the lookout for?
rows.translation: 你想，这就回答了问题。她对所需员工有什么建议吗？有什么特定技能值得你留意？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat answers that, you suppose. Does she have any suggestions for staff she needs? Any particular skillsets you should be on the lookout for?"

rows.original: “Oh, I take care of everything we need here, strictly speaking,” Briget assures you. “But that doesn’t mean I always have the contacts to find us truly unique skills on demand. Your father had the foresight to make accommodations for a laboratory and bio-science center on the second floor, which could begin to provide all manner of benefits to your reproductive health - and your fertility/virility - were it staffed and equipped. We also have a modular living bay designed to accommodate your differently-abled children, and those who need non-standard conditions to grow. Finding specialist caretakers for these environments is within my purview, but finding additional experts who can better educate and care for Rush-space species may be easier for you than it is for me.”
rows.translation: “严格来说，育儿所里我们需要的一切都由我负责，”布丽姬特向你保证。“但这并不意味着，我总能立即找到拥有人家真正独特技能的联系人。你父亲很有远见，在二楼为实验室和生物科学中心预留了空间；若能配备人员和设备，它们便可以开始为你的生殖健康——以及生育能力或雄性生殖力——带来各种益处。我们还有一处模块化居住舱，设计用于容纳你身体能力不同的孩子，以及需要非标准环境成长的孩子。为这些环境寻找专业照料者属于我的职责范围，不过要寻找能更好教育和照顾星球大淘金时代物种的其他专家，对你而言可能比对我更加容易。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I take care of everything we need here, strictly speaking,” Briget assures you. “But that doesn’t mean I always have the contacts to find us truly unique skills on demand. Your father had the foresight to make accommodations for a laboratory and bio-science center on the second floor, which could begin to provide all manner of benefits to your reproductive health - and your fertility/virility - were it staffed and equipped. We also have a modular living bay designed to accommodate your differently-abled children, and those who need non-standard conditions to grow. Finding specialist caretakers for these environments is within my purview, but finding additional experts who can better educate and care for Rush-space species may be easier for you than it is for me.”"

rows.original: So scientists and aliens, basically?

rows.raw: "\n\nSo scientists and aliens, basically?"

rows.original: “Basically,” Briget nods. “Oh, and while we’re quite able to source milk and other foods from corporate sources, I’ve always found that children respond better to a mother’s touch... and nourishment. Of course I am equipped for such functions - I nursed you, after all - but I am still a synthetic, as is my milk.
rows.translation: “基本如此，”布丽姬特点点头。“哦，另外，虽然我们完全可以从企业渠道采购乳汁和其他食物，但我一直发现，孩子们对母亲的亲手照料...以及营养反应更好。当然，我配备了相应功能——毕竟当初是我哺育了你——但我仍是合成体，我的乳汁也是合成的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Basically,” Briget nods. “Oh, and while we’re quite able to source milk and other foods from corporate sources, I’ve always found that children respond better to a mother’s touch... and nourishment. Of course I am equipped for such functions - I nursed you, after all - but I am still a synthetic, as is my milk."

When you were impregnated, the Queen asked me to come and find you; to serve you as I would have her. rows.original: That’s about as good as you’re likely to get, you suppose. For now, you ask how the princesses are doing.
rows.translation: 你想，这大概已经是所能得到的最佳人选。现在，你询问公主们过得如何。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s about as good as you’re likely to get, you suppose. For now, you ask how the princesses are doing."

rows.original: “They’re well. Very well,” the huntress answers, turning towards the monitors on the wall. “They’re still sensitive to the light, and we’ve had to expand their living space - Queens of the Deep Water are solitary beings, and they like to keep their distance from each other. And from me, when they don’t wish to nurse or play-fight. You’ll be pleased to know they’re growing quickly, and growing strong, too. The Queen was worried her daughters would be anemic, if they survived at all; she’s quite happy to have been proven wrong.”
rows.translation: “她们很好。非常好，”女猎手转向墙上监视器回答。“她们依旧对光敏感，我们不得不扩大生活空间——深水女王是独居生物，喜欢彼此保持距离。不需要哺乳或玩耍打斗时，她们也会远离我。你会很高兴知道，她们成长很快，也十分强壮。女王曾担心女儿即使存活也会贫血；事实证明她错了，她十分高兴。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They’re well. Very well,” the huntress answers, turning towards the monitors on the wall. “They’re still sensitive to the light, and we’ve had to expand their living space - Queens of the Deep Water are solitary beings, and they like to keep their distance from each other. And from me, when they don’t wish to nurse or play-fight. You’ll be pleased to know they’re growing quickly, and growing strong, too. The Queen was worried her daughters would be anemic, if they survived at all; she’s quite happy to have been proven wrong.”"

rows.original: As are you. On that note, is it alright for you to go inside and visit?
rows.translation: 你也一样。说到这里，你可以进去探望吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nAs are you. On that note, is it alright for you to go inside and visit?"

rows.original: <i>“Of course! The princesses have been asking after you almost non-stop since their arrival. They’ll be overjoyed to see their
rows.translation: <i>“当然！公主们从抵达后几乎一直在问你的消息。她们会欣喜若狂地再次见到自己的
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Of course! The princesses have been asking after you almost non-stop since their arrival. They’ll be overjoyed to see their "

rows.original: father
rows.translation: 父亲
rows.raw: "father"

rows.original: mother
rows.translation: 母亲
rows.raw: "mother"

rows.original: again. Head inside whenever you like - just be very loud when you do. They can be a little jumpy when they’re nesting.”
rows.translation: 。随时都可以进去——只要进去时弄出很大声响。她们筑巢时可能有些容易受惊。”
rows.raw: " again. Head inside whenever you like - just be very loud when you do. They can be a little jumpy when they’re nesting.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Water Princesses
rows.translation: 水之公主
rows.raw: "Water Princesses"

rows.original: NURSERY_WATER_PRINCESS_VISTS
rows.raw: "NURSERY_WATER_PRINCESS_VISTS"

rows.original: You step up to the door and take a peek at the night-sight monitor next to it. The screen is divided into a number of different viewpoints, each keeping track of one of your
rows.translation: 你走向房门，查看旁边的夜视监视器。屏幕分成多个不同视角，每个都监控着你的一位
rows.raw: "You step up to the door and take a peek at the night-sight monitor next to it. The screen is divided into a number of different viewpoints, each keeping track of one of your "

rows.original: young princesses. Most of your royal brood is quietly nesting, tucked away in the various half-submerged corners of the modified chamber and soaking underneath beds of fungus and leaves.
rows.translation: 年幼公主。大多数王室子女都在安静筑巢，藏在改造房间各处半浸水的角落，泡在真菌和树叶铺成的床下。
rows.raw: " young princesses. Most of your royal brood is quietly nesting, tucked away in the various half-submerged corners of the modified chamber and soaking underneath beds of fungus and leaves."

rows.original: As their caretaker suggested, you make sure that opening the door makes plenty of noise. The door itself is huge, befitting the size its occupants will grow to, and a long tunnel stretches out after it to help funnel out the nursery’s light so opening up doesn’t accidentally blind your subterranean spawn. You traverse the tunnel, stepping out onto a little sandy island at the water’s edge, not much more than three yards to a side.
rows.translation: 按照照料者的建议，你确保开门时制造足够响声。房门本身非常巨大，与居住者将来长成的体型相称；门后延伸着一条长隧道，帮助导出育儿所灯光，避免开启时意外照瞎地下子女。你穿过隧道，走到水边的小沙洲上，边长不过三码。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs their caretaker suggested, you make sure that opening the door makes plenty of noise. The door itself is huge, befitting the size its occupants will grow to, and a long tunnel stretches out after it to help funnel out the nursery’s light so opening up doesn’t accidentally blind your subterranean spawn. You traverse the tunnel, stepping out onto a little sandy island at the water’s edge, not much more than three yards to a side."

rows.original: It’s pitch black inside, save for the dim light filtering through the tunnel at your back. A pair of red lanterns have been set up at the water’s edge, hooked up to power cables on the bulkheads. You flip them on and close the door, leaving yourself in dim crimson glow. Remembering that the princesses are already able to read and write, and so presumably speak, you call out a “Hello?” into the shadows.
rows.translation: 里面漆黑一片，只有背后隧道透入微光。水边架设了一对红灯笼，连接舱壁上的电源线。你打开它们并关门，让自己置身暗淡红光中。想起公主们已经能读写，想必也能说话，你朝黑暗喊了一声“有人吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s pitch black inside, save for the dim light filtering through the tunnel at your back. A pair of red lanterns have been set up at the water’s edge, hooked up to power cables on the bulkheads. You flip them on and close the door, leaving yourself in dim crimson glow. Remembering that the princesses are already able to read and write, and so presumably speak, you call out a “Hello?” into the shadows."

rows.original: A long moment passes.
rows.translation: 漫长的一刻过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nA long moment passes."

rows.original: The water ripples in front of you, and a head of silky hair blossoms on the surface, followed by a pair of dark eyes. Unlike the Queen’s, your daughter’s are fundamentally human in shape and color, staring up at you with wild curiosity. She rises from the pool a moment later, revealing a humanoid upper half the same lustrous blue as her mother, wrapped up in a one-piece swimsuit from shoulders to her waist, where the sprawling, spidery crab-body begins in earnest.
rows.translation: 面前水面泛起涟漪，一头丝滑秀发在水面绽放，随后露出一双黑眸。与女王不同，你女儿的眼睛在形状和颜色上基本类似人类，以狂野好奇仰望你。片刻后她从水池升起，露出与母亲同样泛着光泽的蓝色人形上半身；从肩部到腰间包裹一件连体泳衣，而真正庞大、蜘蛛般的蟹身从腰部开始。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe water ripples in front of you, and a head of silky hair blossoms on the surface, followed by a pair of dark eyes. Unlike the Queen’s, your daughter’s are fundamentally human in shape and color, staring up at you with wild curiosity. She rises from the pool a moment later, revealing a humanoid upper half the same lustrous blue as her mother, wrapped up in a one-piece swimsuit from shoulders to her waist, where the sprawling, spidery crab-body begins in earnest."

rows.original: Daddy
rows.translation: 爸爸
rows.raw: "Daddy"

rows.original: Mommy
rows.translation: 妈妈
rows.raw: "Mommy"

rows.original: , is that you?” the princess asks, suddenly smiling. “It is! Everyone, come look who’s here, quick!”
rows.translation: ，是你吗？”公主问道，忽然露出笑容。“真的是！大家快来看看谁来了！”
rows.raw: ", is that you?” the princess asks, suddenly smiling. “It is! Everyone, come look who’s here, quick!”"

rows.original: She scuttles up out of the water, and suddenly you’re made aware again of just how massive her species is. Once she’s on land, you’re left
rows.translation: 她迅速爬出水面，你顿时再次意识到这个物种何其巨大。来到陆地后，你
rows.raw: "\n\nShe scuttles up out of the water, and suddenly you’re made aware again of just how massive her species is. Once she’s on land, you’re left"

rows.original: staring more or less eye-to-eye with your young daughter. Her spindly legs put her on a much higher vantage than a human, and her more personable half is shapely and tall, built like a swimmer.
rows.translation: 与年幼女儿差不多平视。纤细长腿使她的视点远高于人类，而更亲切的人形上半身匀称高挑，如游泳运动员般健美。
rows.raw: " staring more or less eye-to-eye with your young daughter. Her spindly legs put her on a much higher vantage than a human, and her more personable half is shapely and tall, built like a swimmer."

rows.original: staring up at your towering daughter. She’s bigger than a leithan already, a bit awkward on her spindly land legs but riding so high that it’s hard to see her face in the gloom.
rows.translation: 仰望高耸的女儿。她已经比利萨恩还大，细长的陆地步足略显笨拙，却把身体托得如此高，在昏暗中很难看清她的脸。
rows.raw: " staring up at your towering daughter. She’s bigger than a leithan already, a bit awkward on her spindly land legs but riding so high that it’s hard to see her face in the gloom."

rows.original: leaning back and staring wide-eyed at the titan you gave birth to. She’s enormous, easily as big as the Queen herself now, riding high on slender legs each taller than a human, elevating her so high that it’s hard to see her face in the red gloom. You can, however, see that the more personable half sitting atop the crab-like lower body has developed into quite the woman, voluptuous and strong and just as gorgeous as her mother.
rows.translation: 向后仰身，睁大眼睛看着自己产下的泰坦。她庞大无比，如今轻易便和女王本身一样大；每条纤细长腿都高过人类，将她托得如此高，很难在红色昏暗中看清面容。不过你能看出，蟹形下半身顶部更加亲切的那一半已成长为真正的女人，丰满强壮，和母亲一样美丽。
rows.raw: " leaning back and staring wide-eyed at the titan you gave birth to. She’s enormous, easily as big as the Queen herself now, riding high on slender legs each taller than a human, elevating her so high that it’s hard to see her face in the red gloom. You can, however, see that the more personable half sitting atop the crab-like lower body has developed into quite the woman, voluptuous and strong and just as gorgeous as her mother."

rows.original: If only the Queen could see her now...
rows.translation: 要是女王现在能看到她就好了...
rows.raw: " If only the Queen could see her now..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Water Princesses
rows.translation: 水之公主
rows.raw: "Water Princesses"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Several more heads of tentacled hair peek up from the water’s edge a few moments later, and soon you’re overwhelmed with chattering voices - a chorus of “Hi!” “Welcome home!” “We missed you so much!” and more. Half a dozen pairs of hands grab at you, pulling you into hugs and kisses every which way. Your not-so-little girls giggle and cry out with joy, pulling you in so many directions at once that you’re momentarily afraid they’ll forget their own strength... but no, they’re as gentle as angels once you start squirming, setting you back down on the sandbar and folding their legs under themselves, coming down to your level.
rows.translation: 片刻后，又有几颗长着触手头发的脑袋从水边探出；很快，叽叽喳喳的声音将你淹没——“你好！”“欢迎回家！”“我们好想你！”还有更多。六双手从各个方向抓住你，拉进拥抱与亲吻。已经不再娇小的女孩们咯咯欢笑、喜悦欢呼，同时把你拉向如此多方向，令你一度担心她们会忘记自己的力气... 但没有；你一开始挣动，她们便像天使一样温柔，把你放回沙洲，双腿折叠在身下，降到与你相同的高度。
rows.raw: "Several more heads of tentacled hair peek up from the water’s edge a few moments later, and soon you’re overwhelmed with chattering voices - a chorus of “Hi!” “Welcome home!” “We missed you so much!” and more. Half a dozen pairs of hands grab at you, pulling you into hugs and kisses every which way. Your not-so-little girls giggle and cry out with joy, pulling you in so many directions at once that you’re momentarily afraid they’ll forget their own strength... but no, they’re as gentle as angels once you start squirming, setting you back down on the sandbar and folding their legs under themselves, coming down to your level."

rows.original: Before long, your princesses have coaxed you into sharing your adventurous tales with them. Their curiosity is boundless, you soon discover: wanderlust and starry-eyed wonder fills them with every word, and they’re on the edge of their crabby seats as you recount some of your more dangerous exploits and less steamy encounters.
rows.translation: 没过多久，公主们便哄你分享冒险故事。你很快发现，她们的好奇心没有边界：每句话都令她们充满远游欲和星光般的惊奇；当你讲述一些更加危险的功绩和没那么色情的遭遇时，她们都坐在蟹腿座位边缘。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore long, your princesses have coaxed you into sharing your adventurous tales with them. Their curiosity is boundless, you soon discover: wanderlust and starry-eyed wonder fills them with every word, and they’re on the edge of their crabby seats as you recount some of your more dangerous exploits and less steamy encounters."

rows.original: Eventually between stories, you note that your princesses have really grown since you birthed them - much, much faster than a human child. You remember the Queen hinted at herself being quite young by Terran standards, so... just how mature are her spawn already? They were talking, reading, and writing just moments after they hatched, after all. And they’re already so big...
rows.translation: 最终，在故事间隙，你指出公主们自出生后确实成长许多——远远快过人类孩子。你记得女王曾暗示，按地球人标准，她自己也相当年轻，所以... 她的后代究竟已经成熟到什么程度？毕竟，她们孵化后片刻就会说话、阅读和书写。而且已经这么大了...
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually between stories, you note that your princesses have really grown since you birthed them - much, much faster than a human child. You remember the Queen hinted at herself being quite young by Terran standards, so... just how mature are her spawn already? They were talking, reading, and writing just moments after they hatched, after all. And they’re already so big..."

rows.original: “We don’t know!” the first of the bunch answers apologetically. “We’ve tried to find a, um... a codex? For our race! But we can’t find any information.”
rows.translation: “我们不知道！”这群孩子中的第一个歉意地回答。“我们试着寻找，呃... 一本宝典？关于我们的种族！但找不到任何信息。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We don’t know!” the first of the bunch answers apologetically. “We’ve tried to find a, um... a codex? For our race! But we can’t find any information.”"

rows.original: “Briget’s been helping us!” another princess offers. “She says nobody’s ever seen a Water Queen before.”
rows.translation: “布丽姬特一直在帮助我们！”另一位公主补充。“她说以前从来没人见过深水女王。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Briget’s been helping us!” another princess offers. “She says nobody’s ever seen a Water Queen before.”"

rows.original: “Or whatever we’re supposed to be called!” a third chimes in. “Mother knows more, but our ‘caretaker’ says she won’t leave Myrellion. Not even to come visit!”
rows.translation: “或者不管我们究竟该叫什么！”第三个插嘴。“母亲知道得更多，但我们的‘照料者’说她不会离开迈瑞利昂。甚至不肯来探望！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Or whatever we’re supposed to be called!” a third chimes in. “Mother knows more, but our ‘caretaker’ says she won’t leave Myrellion. Not even to come visit!”"

rows.original: They’ve been talking to the Queen? If so, you have to wonder: does she want her daughters back home, now that they’re born?
rows.translation: 她们一直在和女王交谈？如果是这样，你不禁疑惑：女儿们如今已经出生，她是否希望她们回家？
rows.raw: "\n\nThey’ve been talking to the Queen? If so, you have to wonder: does she want her daughters back home, now that they’re born?"

rows.translation: “没有，”你的大女儿承认道。“我是说，我相信她会喜欢我们去拜访！但把你变成我们的

rows.translation: ，呃，目的不就是确保我们离开迈瑞利昂吗？那里没有值得我们留恋的东西...”
rows.raw: " was to make sure we got off Myrellion, wasn’t it? There’s nothing for us there...”"

rows.translation: “我们得去殖民新的星球！”这群孩子中的另一个咧嘴笑道。“就像你一样！参加星球热潮时，每到一颗星球都要有一位公主

rows.translation: 其余孩子大笑欢呼；有几个拍打姐姐的后背或屁股，令她羞得脸色变成深蓝。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe rest of them laugh and cheer; a few slap their sister on the back or rump, making her blush a dark blue."

rows.original: After a few moments, the first of them leans over and puts her head on your shoulder. A few of her head-tendrils wrap softly around your neck. <i>“Don’t worry,
rows.translation: 片刻后，第一个女孩倾身把脑袋靠在你肩上。几根头部触须温柔缠住你的脖子。<i>“别担心，
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few moments, the first of them leans over and puts her head on your shoulder. A few of her head-tendrils wrap softly around your neck. <i>“Don’t worry, "

rows.original: , we’re not going anywhere for a while. There’s so much to learn before we go! Briget’s promised to teach us day and night while we’re here, and even says some of us might be able to go to a, um... a universe-city!”
rows.translation: ，我们暂时哪里也不会去。出发前要学的东西太多了！布丽姬特答应在这里期间日夜教导我们，甚至说我们中有些人或许可以去，呃... 去一座宇宙城！”

rows.original: “But some of us are gonna be big, tough warriors instead!” one of the tallest princesses boasts, flexing her impressive muscles. Several of her sisters ooh and ahh, scuttling over to grope at her biceps or poke at her chiseled abs.
rows.translation: “不过我们有些人要成为强壮厉害的战士！”最高大的公主之一夸耀道，同时绷紧令人赞叹的肌肉。几个姐妹发出哦哦啊啊的惊叹，匆忙爬过去摸她的二头肌，或戳她轮廓分明的腹肌。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But some of us are gonna be big, tough warriors instead!” one of the tallest princesses boasts, flexing her impressive muscles. Several of her sisters ooh and ahh, scuttling over to grope at her biceps or poke at her chiseled abs. "

rows.original: “Some of us!” another of the princesses grins, a slender, willowy girl on a particularly long-legged lower body. “I’ve been watching grav-ball, though, and I’m totally going to try out for it!”
rows.translation: “只是有些人！”另一位公主咧嘴笑道；她身材纤细修长，下半身的腿特别长。“不过我一直在看重力球，而且绝对会去参加选拔！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Some of us!” another of the princesses grins, a slender, willowy girl on a particularly long-legged lower body. “I’ve been watching grav-ball, though, and I’m totally going to try out for it!”"

rows.original: “They’ll never let you in!” another huffs. The two start squabbling, and have to be pulled apart by their sisters.
rows.translation: “他们绝对不会让你加入！”另一个哼道。两人开始争吵，不得不由姐妹们把她们拉开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“They’ll never let you in!” another huffs. The two start squabbling, and have to be pulled apart by their sisters."

rows.original: aim
rows.raw: "aim"

rows.original: One of the other princesses scuttles forward and puts her hands on her hips, towering over the first. “Maybe you, smarty-crab! I’m thinking about joining the Peacekeepers! See the galaxy before I settle down with a brood of my own.”
rows.translation: 另一位公主向前爬行，双手叉腰，高高俯视第一个。“也许你会，聪明螃蟹！我正在考虑加入和平卫队！先见识银河，再安定下来，养育自己的孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the other princesses scuttles forward and puts her hands on her hips, towering over the first. “Maybe you, smarty-crab! I’m thinking about joining the Peacekeepers! See the galaxy before I settle down with a brood of my own.”"

rows.original: intelligence
rows.raw: "intelligence"

rows.original: “Yeah!” another of them beams. “Mo- I mean, Miss Briget says if I keep acing all her math tests, I could probably get a scholarship to Terra Prima. She says I’ve got what it takes to be an, um... an astro-physicist! Whatever that is!”
rows.translation: “对！”另一个眉开眼笑。“布——我是说，布丽姬特小姐说，如果我继续在所有数学测验中拿满分，很可能获得前往第一地球的奖学金。她说我具备成为，呃... 天体物理学家的资质！不管那是什么！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah!” another of them beams. “Mo- I mean, Miss Briget says if I keep acing all her math tests, I could probably get a scholarship to Terra Prima. She says I’ve got what it takes to be an, um... an astro-physicist! Whatever that is!”"

rows.original: You find yourself laughing at the princess’s antics. Despite what their caretaker said, you’re quickly coming to see that they love each other very much - and you, too, the way they cuddle up around you with adoring eyes, content to bask in your presence.

rows.original: You smile and put your arms around a pair of the young princesses, holding your brood close for a while. Eventually, though, a few of them start yawning, or mumbling complaints about their carapaces getting dry. That seems like your cue to let them get back to their watery nests - an idea that earns you groans and pleas to stay, but you know you need to let them get some rest. Giving them farewell hugs, you see them back into the water before turning to the tunnel and switching the lights back out to darkness.
rows.translation: 你微笑着搂住两位年轻公主，抱紧自己的孩子们一阵。不过最终，有些人开始打哈欠，或小声抱怨甲壳变干。看来你该让她们回到水中巢穴了——这个想法换来呻吟与挽留，但你知道必须让她们休息。你给她们告别拥抱，看着她们回到水中，随后转向隧道，把灯光重新切换成黑暗。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile and put your arms around a pair of the young princesses, holding your brood close for a while. Eventually, though, a few of them start yawning, or mumbling complaints about their carapaces getting dry. Giving them farewell hugs, you see them back into the water before turning to the tunnel and switching the lights back out to darkness."

rows.original: At long last, you finish the day by tucking them in bed and telling a bedtime story: a heroic interpretation of one of your space adventures. They love it and begs for one more. But, after so much activity, the body demands sleep, and it only takes another few minutes for them to doze off. You can’t help smiling with pride as you watch their sleeping faces.
rows.translation: 终于，你把他们安顿到床上，并讲述一个睡前故事，为一天画上句号：那是你某次太空冒险的英雄化演绎。他们非常喜欢，还央求你再讲一个。但经过这么多活动，身体终究需要睡眠；又过了几分钟，他们便沉沉睡去。望着他们熟睡的脸庞，你不禁自豪地微笑。

rows.translation: 侧抱住你——这令你心中充满一种在其他任何地方都无法获得的特殊喜悦。
rows.raw: " sides – it fills your heart with a special joy that you can’t get anywhere else."

rows.original: Once the initial uproar winds down, it’s time for breakfast, which turns out to be a hefty serving of eggs, bacon and fatty milk, though the staff also brings an alternative meal, in case you feel like eating something lighter in the morning. Their caretaker explains that behemoths have steep nutritional requirements, especially when it comes to protein – and you believe it when you see your kids chomping down on everything that is brought to them. Their single-minded focus when it comes to eating is impressive in a way, but their caretaker doesn’t quite seem to share this opinion as she tries (and mostly fails) to teach them table manners.
rows.translation: 最初的骚动平息后，早餐时间到了：份量十足的鸡蛋、培根和高脂牛奶，不过工作人员也准备了替代餐，以防你早上想吃些清淡的东西。照料者解释说，巨兽族对营养的需求很高，尤其需要蛋白质——看见孩子们狼吞虎咽地吃光端来的所有食物后，你完全相信了这一点。他们进食时那种一心一意的专注从某种角度来看颇为惊人，但照料者似乎并不赞同；她正努力教导他们餐桌礼仪，尽管大多数时候都以失败告终。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce the initial uproar winds down, it’s time for breakfast, which turns out to be a hefty serving of eggs, bacon and fatty milk, though the staff also brings an alternative meal, in case you feel like eating something lighter in the morning. Their caretaker explains that behemoths have steep nutritional requirements, especially when it comes to protein – and you believe it when you see your kids chomping down on everything that is brought to them. Their single-minded focus when it comes to eating is impressive in a way, but their caretaker doesn’t quite seem to share this opinion as she tries (and mostly fails) to teach them table manners."

rows.original: After breakfast, you take them to brush their sharp teeth – both rows – which they do with a level of diligence you wouldn’t expect from kids. However, when it comes to changing into day clothes, they suddenly rebel with words like ‘Awww!’ and ‘But whyyy?!’ As it turns out, they absolutely love their pajamas and would laze around in them the whole day if allowed. The caretaker explains that their clothes are made from a special fabric, so that they don’t tear from the cragginess of the kids’ scales.
rows.translation: 早餐后，你带他们去刷两排尖牙；他们刷牙时的认真程度远超你对孩子的预期。然而，轮到换上日常衣服时，他们突然反抗起来，嘴里嚷着“啊——！”和“可为什么嘛——？！”原来，他们非常喜欢自己的睡衣，只要允许，就会穿着睡衣懒散一整天。照料者解释说，他们的衣服由特殊织物制成，才不会被孩子们粗糙嶙峋的鳞片撕破。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter breakfast, you take them to brush their sharp teeth – both rows – which they do with a level of diligence you wouldn’t expect from kids. However, when it comes to changing into day clothes, they suddenly rebel with words like ‘Awww!’ and ‘But whyyy?!’ As it turns out, they absolutely love their pajamas and would laze around in them the whole day if allowed. The caretaker explains that their clothes are made from a special fabric, so that they don’t tear from the cragginess of the kids’ scales."

rows.original: When you look closely, you see that their scales are indeed much thicker than when they were born; it feels like yesterday! By the stars, now that you think of it, behemoths grow up fast! They arrived not so long ago, and they already have a full set of scale plates on their forelimbs.
rows.translation: 仔细观察后，你发现他们的鳞片确实比出生时厚了许多；那仿佛还是昨天的事！星辰在上，现在想想，巨兽族长得真快！他们出生还没多久，前肢就已经长出了完整的一套鳞甲。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you look closely, you see that their scales are indeed much thicker than when they were born; it feels like yesterday! By the stars, now that you think of it, behemoths grow up fast! They arrived not so long ago, and they already have a full set of scale plates on their forelimbs."

rows.original: The psychoactive crystals on their backs are also longer than you remember, forming a line from the nape of their necks to tip of their thick tails. The staff says they glow when the kids experience strong emotions, which helps the caretaker to know when something is up.
rows.translation: 他们背上的精神活性水晶也比你记忆中更长，从后颈一直排列到粗尾巴的末端。工作人员说，孩子们情绪强烈时，水晶便会发光，方便照料者知道是否发生了什么。
rows.raw: " The psychoactive crystals on their backs are also longer than you remember, forming a line from the nape of their necks to tip of their thick tails. The staff says they glow when the kids experience strong emotions, which helps the caretaker to know when something is up."

rows.original: Your little kaiju are big enough to play with your other kids, though the staff has to be attentive at all times because of behemoths’ tendency to get competitive. They love fighting each other, and they instinctively expect others to be the same way. However, since their bodies are strong and armored, they can easily hurt other children by accident, so it’s important for them to learn about empathy and self-restraint.
rows.translation: 你的小怪兽已经大到可以和其他孩子一起玩了，不过由于巨兽族天性争强好胜，工作人员必须时刻留意。他们喜欢彼此打斗，也本能地认为别人同样如此。然而，他们的身体强壮且覆盖甲壳，很容易意外伤到其他孩子，因此学会同理心和自我克制对他们非常重要。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour little kaiju are big enough to play with your other kids, though the staff has to be attentive at all times because of behemoths’ tendency to get competitive. They love fighting each other, and they instinctively expect others to be the same way. However, since their bodies are strong and armored, they can easily hurt other children by accident, so it’s important for them to learn about empathy and self-restraint."

rows.original: With some persistence and[pc.isNice| gentle words| lowkey blackmail], you finally convince the kids to change their clothing. The next couple of hours are spent playing in the jungle, and ironically YOU have to play the part of the building-sized monster that’s destroying the city and threatening world peace. Apparently, they found out about the kaiju genre and fell in love with it – for all the wrong reasons. Their caretaker awkwardly explains that she had to step away for a few minutes one day, and they seized the remote in her absence; the rest is history.
rows.translation: 经过一番坚持，并用[pc.isNice| gentle words| lowkey blackmail]，你终于说服孩子们换上衣服。接下来几个小时是在丛林中玩耍度过的；讽刺的是，反而是你扮演那只摧毁城市、威胁世界和平的建筑般巨大怪兽。显然，他们了解了怪兽题材并爱上了它——理由却完全不对。照料者尴尬地解释说，有一天她不得不离开几分钟，他们趁她不在时抢走了遥控器；之后的事便人尽皆知。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith some persistence and[pc.isNice| gentle words| lowkey blackmail], you finally convince the kids to change their clothing. The next couple of hours are spent playing in the jungle, and ironically YOU have to play the part of the building-sized monster that’s destroying the city and threatening world peace. Apparently, they found out about the kaiju genre and fell in love with it – for all the wrong reasons. Their caretaker awkwardly explains that she had to step away for a few minutes one day, and they seized the remote in her absence; the rest is history."

rows.original: Having been through your fair share of alien encounters, you find it laughably easy (and surprisingly fun) to play the part of the big bad. Time passes in a daze, until your stomach starts rumbling; it’s time for lunch! The kids find it funny that you have to eat so often; they only eat about twice per day. As it turns out, behemoth bodies are very energy-efficient – even after all this playing, they’re still not hungry at all! Thankfully, their caretaker takes over while you slip away to have your meal.
rows.translation: 经历过不少外星遭遇后，你发现扮演大反派简直轻而易举，而且意外地有趣。时间在恍惚中流逝，直到肚子开始咕咕叫；午饭时间到了！孩子们觉得你必须如此频繁地进食很有趣；他们每天只吃两顿左右。事实证明，巨兽族的身体极其节能——即使玩了这么久，他们依然一点也不饿！好在你溜去用餐时，照料者接手照看他们。
rows.raw: "\n\nHaving been through your fair share of alien encounters, you find it laughably easy (and surprisingly fun) to play the part of the big bad. Time passes in a daze, until your stomach starts rumbling; it’s time for lunch! The kids find it funny that you have to eat so often; they only eat about twice per day. As it turns out, behemoth bodies are very energy-efficient – even after all this playing, they’re still not hungry at all! Thankfully, their caretaker takes over while you slip away to have your meal."

rows.original: Around that time, Briget drops by to check on you and the kids. She explains that they would normally have light educational activities at this hour, but it’s been called off so that they can spend more time with their[pc.mfn| father| mother| parent]. You appreciate it.
rows.translation: 大约这时，布里吉特过来看望你和孩子们。她解释说，他们通常会在这个时间进行轻松的教育活动，但今天已经取消，好让他们能多陪陪自己的[pc.mfn| father| mother| parent]。你对此十分感激。
rows.raw: "\n\nAround that time, Briget drops by to check on you and the kids. She explains that they would normally have light educational activities at this hour, but it’s been called off so that they can spend more time with their[pc.mfn| father| mother| parent]. You appreciate it."

rows.original: The gynoid goes on to reveal that she usually conducts the classes herself, since she’s immune to behemoths’ telepathic powers – they can drive a teacher crazy by directly bombarding one’s head with questions and quips. But, there is another reason too: though far from fully developed, this power could allow them to pick up random pieces of information from people’s brains, so the staff is being extra careful not to expose your kids to potentially bad influences when they’re still so young.
rows.translation: 女性机器人接着透露，课程通常由她亲自教授，因为她不受巨兽族心灵感应能力影响——他们可以把问题和俏皮话直接轰进老师脑中，逼得对方发疯。不过还有另一个原因：这种能力虽然远未完全发育，却可能让他们从他人大脑中随机获取信息，因此工作人员格外谨慎，避免孩子们年纪尚小时接触潜在的不良影响。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gynoid goes on to reveal that she usually conducts the classes herself, since she’s immune to behemoths’ telepathic powers – they can drive a teacher crazy by directly bombarding one’s head with questions and quips. But, there is another reason too: though far from fully developed, this power could allow them to pick up random pieces of information from people’s brains, so the staff is being extra careful not to expose your kids to potentially bad influences when they’re still so young."

rows.original: Once your lunch is over, you find that the kids are watching cartoons, so you join them for a while. What was supposed to be just an hour turns into four as they find a new martial arts movie to watch, and even after that it’s still hard to tear them away from the screen. Apparently, the staff is strict with their education, so watching TV for hours on end is a luxury they only get on weekends, or when you’re visiting. Thankfully, their caretaker drops by to announce that it’s dinner time; now this draws their attention away from the screen.
rows.translation: 午饭结束后，你发现孩子们正在看动画片，于是陪他们看了一会儿。原本只打算看一小时，却因为他们找到一部新的武术电影而变成了四小时；即使电影结束，也还是很难把他们从屏幕前拉走。显然，工作人员对教育要求严格，所以连续看几小时电视是他们只有周末或你来访时才能享受的奢侈。幸好照料者过来宣布晚饭时间到了；这下终于把他们的注意力从屏幕上吸引开了。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce your lunch is over, you find that the kids are watching cartoons, so you join them for a while. What was supposed to be just an hour turns into four as they find a new martial arts movie to watch, and even after that it’s still hard to tear them away from the screen. Apparently, the staff is strict with their education, so watching TV for hours on end is a luxury they only get on weekends, or when you’re visiting. Thankfully, their caretaker drops by to announce that it’s dinner time; now this draws their attention away from the screen."

rows.original: When dinner is over, you notice it’s already getting dark in the enclosure, as dictated by the sky simulation system, so you’ve got only a couple of hours left before the kids’ bedtime. You ask them how they would like to spend the rest of the day.
rows.translation: 晚饭结束后，你注意到围场已经依照天空模拟系统的设定暗了下来，所以距离孩子们上床睡觉只剩几个小时。你询问他们想怎样度过这一天剩下的时间。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen dinner is over, you notice it’s already getting dark in the enclosure, as dictated by the sky simulation system, so you’ve got only a couple of hours left before the kids’ bedtime. You ask them how they would like to spend the rest of the day."

rows.original: They look to each other, pondering – or, more like, exchanging ideas telepathically – until they finally reach a conclusion: they want to hear about your adventures! Well, it’s not like you didn’t expect this one, after all you’re kind of a hero to them. Not every child can boast about having a[pc.mfn| father| mother| parent] who pioneered in one of the Space Rushes!
rows.translation: 他们彼此对视，陷入思考——或者更准确地说，是通过心灵感应交换意见——最终得出结论：他们想听你的冒险故事！好吧，这也没有出乎你的意料，毕竟你在他们眼中算得上英雄。并非每个孩子都能夸耀自己的[pc.mfn| father| mother| parent]曾在某次太空淘金热中充当开拓者！
rows.raw: "\n\nThey look to each other, pondering – or, more like, exchanging ideas telepathically – until they finally reach a conclusion: they want to hear about your adventures! Well, it’s not like you didn’t expect this one, after all you’re kind of a hero to them. Not every child can boast about having a[pc.mfn| father| mother| parent] who pioneered in one of the Space Rushes!"

rows.original: Sitting down with your kaiju kids, you tell them about adventures recent and old. You just can’t help playing up the perils and mishaps, enjoying their surprised, witty or funny reactions as they drink up every detail of your storytelling. Naturally, you take special care to omit the, shall we say, more ‘vivid’ parts of your journey, and you can only hope they’re not using psychic powers to pick up anything they shouldn’t.
rows.translation: 你和怪兽孩子们坐下来，讲述自己新近和从前的冒险。你忍不住把危险和意外说得更加夸张，看着他们如饥似渴地听取故事的每个细节，并享受他们惊讶、机灵或滑稽的反应。当然，你格外小心地省略旅途中那些不妨称为更加“生动”的部分，只能希望他们没有用精神能力读取任何不该知道的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nSitting down with your kaiju kids, you tell them about adventures recent and old. You just can’t help playing up the perils and mishaps, enjoying their surprised, witty or funny reactions as they drink up every detail of your storytelling. Naturally, you take special care to omit the, shall we say, more ‘vivid’ parts of your journey, and you can only hope they’re not using psychic powers to pick up anything they shouldn’t."

rows.original: You lose track of time, until eventually their caretaker announces they should be getting ready for bed. As it turns out, the thick, craggy scales on their forelimbs and tails take quite a scrubbing to clean up, but soon enough they’re in their favorite pajamas.
rows.translation: 你忘记了时间，直到照料者最终宣布他们该准备睡觉了。事实证明，他们前肢和尾巴上厚实嶙峋的鳞片需要用力刷洗才能清洁，不过没过多久，他们便换上了最喜欢的睡衣。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lose track of time, until eventually their caretaker announces they should be getting ready for bed. As it turns out, the thick, craggy scales on their forelimbs and tails take quite a scrubbing to clean up, but soon enough they’re in their favorite pajamas."

rows.original: As you tuck them in bed, you take the chance to
rows.translation: 把他们安顿到床上时，你趁机
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you tuck them in bed, you take the chance to"

rows.original: bare your milky chest and nurse them for a few minutes each. Thankfully, they had dinner not too long ago, so it doesn’t take much for them to get fully satisfied. With their bellies full, they
rows.translation: 露出溢乳的胸膛，分别哺乳他们几分钟。幸好他们不久前才吃过晚饭，因此不需要多少乳汁便彻底满足。肚子填饱后，他们
rows.raw: " bare your milky chest and nurse them for a few minutes each. Thankfully, they had dinner not too long ago, so it doesn’t take much for them to get fully satisfied. With their bellies full, they"

rows.original: hum a lullaby – something your father sang for you a long, long time ago. You didn’t even remember it until now. The kids
rows.translation: 哼起一首摇篮曲——那是很久很久以前父亲唱给你听的曲子。直到现在，你甚至都不记得它了。孩子们
rows.raw: " hum a lullaby – something your father sang for you a long, long time ago. You didn’t even remember it until now. The kids"

rows.original: soon doze off, and you kiss them goodnight before quietly taking your leave.
rows.translation: 很快便睡着了，你吻别他们，随后悄悄离开。
rows.raw: " soon doze off, and you kiss them goodnight before quietly taking your leave."

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Spend Day
rows.translation: 共度一天
rows.raw: "Spend Day"

rows.original: You could spend the day with your kaiju kids. This will advance time to 20:00.
rows.translation: 你可以陪你的怪兽孩子度过一天。时间将推进至20:00。
rows.raw: "You could spend the day with your kaiju kids. This will advance time to 20:00."

rows.original: Spend Day
rows.translation: 共度一天
rows.raw: "Spend Day"

rows.original: Spend Day
rows.translation: 共度一天
rows.raw: "Spend Day"

rows.original: To spend a full day with your kids, try visiting early in the morning (between 5:00 and 10:00).
rows.translation: 若想陪孩子们度过一整天，请尽量在清晨前来（5:00至10:00之间）。
rows.raw: "To spend a full day with your kids, try visiting early in the morning (between 5:00 and 10:00)."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: SKOM
rows.raw: "SKOM"

rows.original: Incubation Room
rows.translation: 孵化室
rows.raw: "Incubation Room"

rows.original: The incubation room is protected by a high-security door, making it accessible only to you, people you’ve cleared and select members of the staff. It boasts different chambers, each a carefully controlled environment sealed behind a plexiglass window, to make sure your eggs are hatching in the right temperature, pressure, humidity and other variables.
rows.translation: 孵化室由一扇高度安全的门保护，只有你、获得你许可的人以及部分指定工作人员可以进入。这里设有不同的舱室，每个舱室都是由有机玻璃窗密封、受到精密控制的环境，以确保你的蛋在合适的温度、压力、湿度及其他条件下孵化。
rows.raw: "The incubation room is protected by a high-security door, making it accessible only to you, people you’ve cleared and select members of the staff. It boasts different chambers, each a carefully controlled environment sealed behind a plexiglass window, to make sure your eggs are hatching in the right temperature, pressure, humidity and other variables."

rows.original: You [pc.walk] towards the nearest crib, looking down to see two of your youngest laquines sharing it, sleeping peacefully together.
rows.translation: 你朝最近的婴儿床[pc.walk]过去，低头看见两个最年幼的拉奎因孩子挤在里面，正一起安详地熟睡。
