rows.raw: "Maternal"

rows.original: pride bubbles inside, riding up your spine and exploding in your brain. You smile, overcome with too many emotions just looking down and seeing your babies at rest. They’ll no doubt grow fast, so it’s all the more important you take this time to enjoy their most precious years.
rows.translation: 骄傲在你体内涌动，沿着脊柱攀升，在脑海中轰然绽放。你低头看着熟睡的宝宝们，仅仅这一幕就让太多情绪将你淹没，脸上不由得露出微笑。他们无疑会成长得很快，因此你更应该把握这段时光，好好享受他们最珍贵的年幼岁月。
rows.raw: " pride bubbles inside, riding up your spine and exploding in your brain. You smile, overcome with too many emotions just looking down and seeing your babies at rest. They’ll no doubt grow fast, so it’s all the more important you take this time to enjoy their most precious years."

rows.original: Alerted by your shadow, they both begin to stir. Noses twitching, they squeak at first, then begin to cry. There’s a moment of embarrassment and concern, but you do what you need to do: pick them up and cradle them in your [pc.arms]. Knowing that they’re secure, their sobbing ends, and they’re back to sleep with sibilant purrs and frail grips. Empathic delight crests in your fluttering heart, and you’re forced to sit down, lost in the overwhelming bliss of parenthood.
rows.translation: 你的影子惊动了他们，两个孩子都开始翻动身体。鼻子抽动着，他们先是发出吱吱声，随后哭了起来。你一时既尴尬又担心，但还是做了该做的事：将他们抱起来，搂进[pc.arms]。知道自己已安全无虞后，他们停止抽泣，在嘶嘶的呼噜声与虚弱的抓握中重新睡去。感同身受的喜悦在你颤动的心中漫过顶峰，父母之爱的无边幸福将你彻底淹没，迫使你坐了下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlerted by your shadow, they both begin to stir. Noses twitching, they squeak at first, then begin to cry. There’s a moment of embarrassment and concern, but you do what you need to do: pick them up and cradle them in your [pc.arms]. Knowing that they’re secure, their sobbing ends, and they’re back to sleep with sibilant purrs and frail grips. Empathic delight crests in your fluttering heart, and you’re forced to sit down, lost in the overwhelming bliss of parenthood."

rows.original: Some of your older children come over, eager to see their
rows.translation: 几个年纪稍大的孩子跑过来，迫不及待地想见自己的
rows.raw: "\n\nSome of your older children come over, eager to see their "

rows.original: father
rows.translation: 父亲
rows.raw: "father"

rows.original: mother
rows.translation: 母亲
rows.raw: "mother"

rows.original: , saying nothing and merely hugging you. They hop up on the nearby seats to kiss you on the cheek before snuggling, wrapping their small arms around you and providing their sibling presence to the fuzzy gathering.
rows.translation: ；他们一言不发，只是抱住你。他们跳上附近的座椅亲吻你的脸颊，随后依偎过来，用小小的手臂环住你，为这群毛茸茸的团聚者送上兄弟姐妹的陪伴。
rows.raw: ", saying nothing and merely hugging you. They hop up on the nearby seats to kiss you on the cheek before snuggling, wrapping their small arms around you and providing their sibling presence to the fuzzy gathering."

rows.original: Since you’re here, you see no reason why you can’t indulge them and yourself a bit. You guide one of the infants to your [pc.breasts]
rows.translation: 既然已经来了，你觉得没有理由不稍微纵容一下孩子们和自己。你把一个婴儿引向[pc.breasts]
rows.raw: "\n\nSince you’re here, you see no reason why you can’t indulge them and yourself a bit. You guide one of the infants to your [pc.breasts]"

rows.original: , slipping your [pc.chestCovers] out of the way
rows.translation: ，将[pc.chestCovers]挪开
rows.raw: ", slipping your [pc.chestCovers] out of the way"

rows.original: , and encourage them with your
rows.translation: ，并用你的
rows.raw: ", and encourage them with your "

rows.translation: 勃起、滴着[pc.milkNoun]的乳头
rows.raw: "erect, [pc.milkNoun]-dribbling teat"

rows.original: engorged, [pc.milkNoun]-dribbling spout
rows.translation: 充血肿胀、滴着[pc.milkNoun]的乳汁喷口
rows.raw: "engorged, [pc.milkNoun]-dribbling spout"

rows.original: . Sensing the treat, the tiny bunny opens its mouth and begins to suckle, but not too much. The staff must have fed them already, because they’re back to napping rather quickly... but their rest seems much more relaxed, somehow!
rows.translation: . 小兔子感觉到了美味，张开小嘴开始吮吸，不过并没有吸太多。工作人员肯定已经喂过他们了，因为他们很快又睡着了...但不知为何，这一次他们似乎睡得安稳多了！
rows.raw: ". Sensing the treat, the tiny bunny opens its mouth and begins to suckle, but not too much. The staff must have fed them already, because they’re back to napping rather quickly... but their rest seems much more relaxed, somehow!"

rows.original: Sadly, you can’t hold them forever. With a heavy heart, you stand and return them to their bed, fitting a blanket tight under their limbs and making sure they’re holding each other tight.
rows.translation: 遗憾的是，你不能永远抱着他们。你怀着沉重的心情站起身，把他们放回床上，将毯子紧紧塞到他们的四肢下面，并确保他们彼此紧紧相拥。
rows.raw: "\n\nSadly, you can’t hold them forever. With a heavy heart, you stand and return them to their bed, fitting a blanket tight under their limbs and making sure they’re holding each other tight."

rows.original: You reach for your Codex and take a quiet pic of the napping duo, firing it off to their missing parent’s provided address. Surprisingly, you get a near instant response from the laquine pirate:
rows.translation: 你伸手拿出《法典》，悄悄拍下这对小家伙熟睡的照片，发送到他们那位不在身边的家长所提供的地址。出人意料的是，你几乎立刻就收到了那名拉奎因海盗的回复：
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach for your Codex and take a quiet pic of the napping duo, firing it off to their missing parent’s provided address. Surprisingly, you get a near instant response from the laquine pirate:"

rows.original: Ohhh maaan! That’s sooo cute! I was having such a shit day until you sent that, thank you so much!
rows.translation: 哦哦哦，天啊！太——可爱了！你发来这张照片之前，我今天过得糟透了，真是太谢谢你了！
rows.raw: "Ohhh maaan! That’s sooo cute! I was having such a shit day until you sent that, thank you so much!"

rows.original: Holy shit! That’s the best thing I’ve seen all day. Look at how small they are, it’s so cute! And their paws are interlocked omigod. THANK YOU!
rows.translation: 我操！这是我今天见过最棒的东西。看他们多小啊，太可爱了！而且他们的爪爪还扣在一起，我的天啊。谢谢你！
rows.raw: "Holy shit! That’s the best thing I’ve seen all day. Look at how small they are, it’s so cute! And their paws are interlocked omigod. THANK YOU!"

rows.original: Ooohhh, look at those ears, kinda shimmery from this angle! I’m glad they’ve got a soft looking bed, too. Nobody should have to grow up without one. Thanks, babe, you really brightened my day.
rows.translation: 哦哦哦，看看那些耳朵，从这个角度看有点闪闪发亮！我也很高兴他们有张看起来很柔软的床。没有人应该在连床都没有的环境中长大。谢谢，宝贝，你真的照亮了我的一天。
rows.raw: "Ooohhh, look at those ears, kinda shimmery from this angle! I’m glad they’ve got a soft looking bed, too. Nobody should have to grow up without one. Thanks, babe, you really brightened my day."

rows.original: Wooah... that’s great! Sorry I can’t talk now, too many-
rows.translation: 哇哦...太棒了！抱歉，我现在不能聊，实在太多——
rows.raw: "Wooah... that’s great! Sorry I can’t talk now, too many-"

rows.original: They’re growing so fast! They look so healthy. Thanks for the pics!
rows.translation: 他们长得真快！看起来都很健康。谢谢你发来的照片！
rows.raw: "They’re growing so fast! They look so healthy. Thanks for the pics!"

rows.original: You’re not sure what else to do but encourage them to do their best. They never speak over you, and always look up when you’re talking. You tell them to focus on their studies when they’re expected to, but also to look after each other. They’ll find these things difficult for a while, but they’ll always have each other to look to for support. When you’re at a loss for any other endearing spiels, you let your kids stay cuddling, clinging tight to your limbs and waist.
rows.translation: 你不知道还能做些什么，只能鼓励他们竭尽全力。他们从不抢你的话，而且你说话时总会抬头看着你。你告诉他们，该学习的时候就要专心学习，同时也要互相照顾。这些事情暂时仍会让他们感到困难，但他们永远都可以向彼此寻求支持。等你再也想不出其他温馨的话可说时，便任由孩子们继续依偎着，紧紧抱住你的四肢和腰。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure what else to do but encourage them to do their best. They never speak over you, and always look up when you’re talking. You tell them to focus on their studies when they’re expected to, but also to look after each other. They’ll find these things difficult for a while, but they’ll always have each other to look to for support. When you’re at a loss for any other endearing spiels, you let your kids stay cuddling, clinging tight to your limbs and waist."

rows.original: . Many of your laquine children are playing with their food to the staff’s chagrin. The leporine tykes, however, perk right back up when they see you in her place, waving and smiling as always.
rows.translation: 。许多拉奎因孩子都在摆弄食物，令工作人员十分懊恼。布丽吉特似乎刚刚严厉警告完他们；她朝你点点头，随后回去处理每日事务。然而，那些兔族小家伙一看到你代替她出现在眼前，立刻又精神起来，一如既往地挥手微笑。
rows.raw: ". Many of your laquine children are playing with their food to the staff’s chagrin. Briget seems to be concluding her stern warning, nodding her head to you as she returns to her daily affairs. The leporine tykes, however, perk right back up when they see you in her place, waving and smiling as always."

rows.original: Your laquine children have certainly organized themselves into the little lords and ladies of this room. Of the play that goes on here now, they try to be at the center of it. Hard not to be when there are so many boundless, determined rabbit-boys and rabbit-girls looking for any excuse to run, jump, and fall... then do it over again. When they see you, they all try to tackle you by the [pc.legOrLegs], eager to shower you with pent-up affection.
rows.translation: 你的拉奎因孩子们显然已经把自己组织成了这个房间里的小领主与小贵妇。如今这里举行的每一场游戏，他们都努力成为中心。毕竟，这么多精力无穷、意志坚定的兔男孩和兔女孩一直在寻找任何能够奔跑、跳跃和摔倒的借口...然后再来一次，他们很难不成为中心。他们看见你时，全都试图扑向你的[pc.legOrLegs]，迫不及待地要把积攒已久的爱意倾注给你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour laquine children have certainly organized themselves into the little lords and ladies of this room. Of the play that goes on here now, they try to be at the center of it. Hard not to be when there are so many boundless, determined rabbit-boys and rabbit-girls looking for any excuse to run, jump, and fall... then do it over again. When they see you, they all try to tackle you by the [pc.legOrLegs], eager to shower you with pent-up affection."

rows.original: There seems to be a spur of the moment art club in effect. A bunch of your laquine children are arguing back and forth on the quality of three presented art pieces. Your opinion of the displayed canvases are that they’re typical of a child’s quality, but you appreciate the competitive edge two of your bunny-sons are showing. They’re even casting votes!
rows.translation: 这里似乎临时成立了一个艺术俱乐部。一群拉奎因孩子正为三件展示出来的艺术品质量如何争论不休。依你看来，展出的画布具有典型的儿童水准，不过你很欣赏两个兔儿子表现出的竞争意识。他们甚至还在投票！
rows.raw: "\n\nThere seems to be a spur of the moment art club in effect. A bunch of your laquine children are arguing back and forth on the quality of three presented art pieces. Your opinion of the displayed canvases are that they’re typical of a child’s quality, but you appreciate the competitive edge two of your bunny-sons are showing. They’re even casting votes!"

rows.original: While most of your kids probably eat in the cafeteria, your laquine children seem to enjoy feasting at the far corner at their own big table.
rows.translation: 虽然你的大多数孩子可能都在食堂用餐，但拉奎因孩子们似乎喜欢在远处角落的大桌旁一起大吃一顿。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile most of your kids probably eat in the cafeteria, your laquine children seem to enjoy feasting at the far corner at their own big table."

rows.original: Other children are welcome, but most have since had their meal.
rows.translation: 其他孩子也可以加入，不过大多数孩子这时已经吃过饭了。
rows.raw: " Other children are welcome, but most have since had their meal."

rows.original: Echoing squeals and giggles fill the air when they see you. So much positive energy is directed your way when they smile and wave at you.
rows.translation: 他们一看见你，空气中便回荡起尖叫与咯咯笑声。他们朝你微笑挥手时，满满的正能量全都涌向了你。
rows.raw: " Echoing squeals and giggles fill the air when they see you. So much positive energy is directed your way when they smile and wave at you."

rows.original: The two of you pass the time playing with your kids, a knot gently unraveling in your chest. Being here is a blessing and a privilege. It’s a miracle. You try to come up with more ways to feel good about it, and find yourself lost in a field of celandines. It’s funny, in a way. You’re supposed to be out there seeing the universe... but you don’t want to. You don’t want to leave this room, you don’t want to leave the giggles, the tiny little grasps at your hand, the gleaming smiles on your children’s faces...
rows.translation: 你们俩陪孩子玩耍着消磨时间，胸中的心结也在缓缓解开。能待在这里是一份恩赐，也是一种殊荣。这是个奇迹。你试着想出更多美好的说法，却发现自己迷失在一片白屈菜花田中。某种程度上，这很有趣。你本该在外面见识宇宙...可你并不想去。你不想离开这个房间，不想离开这些笑声，不想离开抓住你手掌的小手，也不想离开孩子们脸上闪耀的笑容...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you pass the time playing with your kids, a knot gently unraveling in your chest. Being here is a blessing and a privilege. It’s a miracle. You try to come up with more ways to feel good about it, and find yourself lost in a field of celandines. It’s funny, in a way. You’re supposed to be out there seeing the universe... but you don’t want to. You don’t want to leave this room, you don’t want to leave the giggles, the tiny little grasps at your hand, the gleaming smiles on your children’s faces..."

rows.original: ... Maybe you can just shimmy yourself across the room! The munchkins are swarming your lower half, hopping up and down and trying to climb all over you. You plan your moves and take what little ground you can without harming them, only to hear a loud snort. Roxy has her gadget pointed up at you, clearly recording this whole event.
rows.translation: ...也许你可以拖着脚步慢慢蹭过房间！小家伙们蜂拥在你的下半身周围，上蹿下跳，试图爬到你身上。你规划好动作，小心翼翼地一点点前进，尽量不伤到他们，却听见一声响亮的喷鼻声。罗克茜正把设备对准你，显然在录下整个过程。
rows.raw: "... Maybe you can just shimmy yourself across the room! The munchkins are swarming your lower half, hopping up and down and trying to climb all over you. You plan your moves and take what little ground you can without harming them, only to hear a loud snort. Roxy has her gadget pointed up at you, clearly recording this whole event."

rows.original: You make sure to glare for the camera as she says, “I won’t post it, don’t worry.”
rows.translation: 她说道“我不会发出去的，别担心。”时，你特意瞪着镜头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make sure to glare for the camera as she says, “I won’t post it, don’t worry.”"

rows.original: The tone of her voice says otherwise! Oh god, and she’ll name the video something embarrassing!!
rows.translation: 她的语气显然不是这个意思！天啊，她肯定还会给视频起个尴尬的名字！！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tone of her voice says otherwise! Oh god, and she’ll name the video something embarrassing!!"

rows.original: But if you’re going to do anything about it, you’re gonna have to get over to Roxy first. And your kids are not helping, bless their little hearts.
rows.translation: 不过，如果你想对此做些什么，就必须先走到罗克茜身边。而你的孩子们完全没有帮忙，愿他们的小心肝得到祝福。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut if you’re going to do anything about it, you’re gonna have to get over to Roxy first. And your kids are not helping, bless their little hearts."

rows.original: They’re too big to pick up all at once now so that’s not an option and trying to step over the group won’t work.
rows.translation: 他们现在太大了，没法一次全部抱起来，因此这个办法行不通；想从人群上方跨过去也不行。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey’re too big to pick up all at once now so that’s not an option and trying to step over the group won’t work."

rows.original: The pair are guaranteed to make it too hard to pick them up and trying to step over them won’t work.
rows.translation: 这两个孩子肯定会让你无法把他们一起抱起来，而试图从他们上方跨过去也行不通。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe pair are guaranteed to make it too hard to pick them up and trying to step over them won’t work."

rows.original: A part of you wishes someone would help you, but that someone is too busy filming you. Briget is curiously absent, and none of the nursery staff, biological or mechanical, are around.
rows.translation: 你有那么一部分希望某个人能帮帮自己，可那位某个人正忙着拍摄你。布里吉特奇怪地不见踪影，育儿所的工作人员，无论生物还是机械，也都不在附近。
rows.raw: " A part of you wishes someone would help you, but that someone is too busy filming you. Briget is curiously absent, and none of the nursery staff, biological or mechanical, are around."

rows.original: Shit. But you’re [pc.name] Steele. You can do this.
rows.translation: 该死。但你可是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。你能做到。
rows.raw: "\n\nShit. But you’re [pc.name] Steele. You can do this."

rows.original: Somehow, through a mix of shuffling and awkward steps, you maneuver to Roxy with a crowd of wibbly-wobbly ears around your feet. She only laughs harder at you.
rows.translation: 不知怎么，靠着拖动脚步和笨拙迈步，你终于带着脚边一大群摇摇晃晃的耳朵挪到罗克茜身旁。她却只是笑得更厉害了。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomehow, through a mix of shuffling and awkward steps, you maneuver to Roxy with a crowd of wibbly-wobbly ears around your feet. She only laughs harder at you."

rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s nice to know you have Roxy around, and moments like these make it all so worth it to be a parent."

Everyone’s assembled on one side, the entire common area modified to support her dangerous little game. “Heya, [pc.name]! Check this out!”

Everyone’s assembled on one side, the entire common area modified to support her dangerous little game. “Heya, [pc.name]! Check this out!”"

rows.original: The athletic bun is handling herself as gracefully and magnificently as you would expect, rolling around the room and pulling off moves you’d described as sick (and possibly too nasty), impressing her children and nearly colliding with things several times. To be fair, she’s probably doing that for dramatic effect. It eventually becomes clear that she’s too much of a pro and much too used to that style of movement to be done in by a few tipped tables.
rows.translation: 这只运动型兔女郎一如预期般优雅出色地控制着身体，在房间四处滑动，做出你会称为酷毙了（也可能太过火）的动作，令孩子们印象深刻，又好几次险些撞上东西。公平地说，她大概是故意制造戏剧效果。最后显而易见，她实在太专业，也太习惯这种移动方式，不可能被几张翻倒的桌子难住。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe athletic bun is handling herself as gracefully and magnificently as you would expect, rolling around the room and pulling off moves you’d described as sick (and possibly too nasty), impressing her children and nearly colliding with things several times. To be fair, she’s probably doing that for dramatic effect. It eventually becomes clear that she’s too much of a pro and much too used to that style of movement to be done in by a few tipped tables."

rows.original: is holding steady, barely keeping his balance. Roxy’s there to baby him, and you eventually join the arrayed children, watching your laquine walk your child through the motions, how to bend the body just right, how to stay on your feet, how to accelerate and decelerate without falling. Any time he looks like he’s about to fall, your lovebun steadies him.

rows.original: All of your kids have surrounded and begun to climb all over you, vying and begging for attention. You didn’t even realize it at some point, so enamored with watching the motherly sports-bun instruct one of the youngest roller bladers of all time. “Looks like you’re having fun!”
rows.translation: 你所有孩子都围拢过来，开始往你身上爬，争抢着乞求关注。你甚至没注意到他们何时聚来的，因为你完全沉醉于观看这位充满母爱的运动兔教导有史以来最年轻的轮滑新手之一。“看来你玩得很开心！”
rows.raw: "\n\nAll of your kids have surrounded and begun to climb all over you, vying and begging for attention. You didn’t even realize it at some point, so enamored with watching the motherly sports-bun instruct one of the youngest roller bladers of all time. “Looks like you’re having fun!”"

rows.original: She yanks you out of the pile and brings you into the firmest hug of all time. “Sorry you don’t have much to offer up here, and I only got one extra pair of roller blades, kid sized.” She scratches her head, nuzzling into your [pc.chestNoun]. “But hey, glad you’re still visiting and all that.”
rows.translation: 她把你从孩子堆里拉出来，给了你一个无比有力的拥抱。“抱歉，这里没什么能给你玩的，而且我只有一双备用轮滑鞋，还是儿童尺寸。”她挠挠头，在你的[pc.chestNoun]上蹭了蹭。“不过嘛，很高兴你还会来看我们什么的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe yanks you out of the pile and brings you into the firmest hug of all time. “Sorry you don’t have much to offer up here, and I only got one extra pair of roller blades, kid sized.” She scratches her head, nuzzling into your [pc.chestNoun]. “But hey, glad you’re still visiting and all that.”"

rows.original: M

There’s a crash and a sudden bout of crying. Roxy’s head whips around and she sees her son fallen to the ground and beginning to cry. Poor thing lost his balance! “Daww... well, you can’t stand unless you’ve fallen! Hey, I’ve got this taken care of, don’t mind me. And, hey, don’t tell Briget!”
rows.translation: 一声撞击后，哭声突然响起。罗克茜猛地转头，看见儿子摔倒在地，开始哭泣。可怜的小家伙失去平衡了！“哦哦...不摔倒就学不会站稳！嘿，我会处理好，别在意。还有，别告诉布丽姬特！”

rows.original: . It gives you a warm, fuzzy feeling, knowing that you’ve met someone as loyal and devoted as her, knowing that she’ll be there for them as much as she will be for you.
rows.translation: 。得知自己遇到了像她这样忠诚专一的人，知道她会像陪伴你一样陪伴他们，令你心中泛起温暖柔软的感觉。

rows.raw: "foyer"

rows.original: Roxy is present, leading a lot of your kids around like a school teacher, helping them take their first steps in the galaxy. A powerful swell in your chest explodes like a pinata of delirium-causing happy feelings. It’s just too adorable.
rows.translation: 罗克茜就在这里，像老师一样领着许多孩子，帮助他们迈出探索银河系的第一步。一股强烈情感在胸中膨胀，像塞满令人欣喜若狂情绪的彩罐突然爆开。实在太可爱了。

rows.raw: "common"

rows.original: Roxy is still skating around the room, training for a few minutes at a time each one of the children present. Only the ones old enough get to have a go in those trainee roller blades! Now that they have full attention, there are no more unfortunate crashes.
rows.translation: 罗克茜仍在房间里滑行，每次花几分钟训练一名在场的孩子。只有年龄足够大的孩子才可以穿那双训练轮滑鞋试试！如今他们得到了全心关注，再也没有发生不幸的碰撞。
rows.raw: "\n\nRoxy is still skating around the room, training for a few minutes at a time each one of the children present. Only the ones old enough get to have a go in those trainee roller blades! Now that they have full attention, there are no more unfortunate crashes."

rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You’re not exactly sure how long you spend cradling and playing with your baby daughter. Somehow, you end up both cradling a baby and being cradled by Mirrin as you lay on your back with baby on belly. She takes a similar fascination with your features: stroking your [pc.hair], trailing her thumb across your cheekbones and jaw, some very light massaging of the temples in all the right places, just like that baby, oh ye-
rows.translation: 你不太清楚自己抱着小女儿玩了多久。不知怎的，你最终仰躺着，宝宝趴在肚子上，而你既抱着宝宝，也被米琳抱在怀里。她同样对你的特征充满兴趣：抚摸你的[pc.hair]，拇指划过颧骨与下颌，又在太阳穴所有恰到好处的位置轻柔按摩，正像那个宝宝，哦，太——
rows.raw: "You’re not exactly sure how long you spend cradling and playing with your baby daughter. Somehow, you end up both cradling a baby and being cradled by Mirrin as you lay on your back with baby on belly. She takes a similar fascination with your features: stroking your [pc.hair], trailing her thumb across your cheekbones and jaw, some very light massaging of the temples in all the right places, just like that baby, oh ye-"

rows.original: “Ah fokk, the time. You see this? This is to tell me that some men in suits are waiting to give me some money for letting them turn me into a video game thiinnnng or uhhh, whatever it was. I gotta... gotta go,” fluffs the qilin, showing you a brief glimpse of some alert coming up on her communicator.
rows.translation: “啊，操，时间。看见这个没？它是在告诉我，有几个穿西装的男人等着给我钱，让他们把我做成某种电子游戏东——西，或者呃，管它是什么。我得...得走了，”这名麒麟含糊说道，向你短暂展示通讯器上出现的某条提醒。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah fokk, the time. You see this? This is to tell me that some men in suits are waiting to give me some money for letting them turn me into a video game thiinnnng or uhhh, whatever it was. I gotta... gotta go,” fluffs the qilin, showing you a brief glimpse of some alert coming up on her communicator."

rows.original: Well shit. With all this going on, you hadn’t even noticed little Jenta drifting to sleep on your chest. Aw...
rows.translation: 真该死。发生这么多事，你甚至没注意到小延塔已经在你胸口渐渐睡着。啊...
rows.raw: "\n\nWell shit. With all this going on, you hadn’t even noticed little Jenta drifting to sleep on your chest. Aw..."

rows.original: You carefully slide yourself out of the comfort zone that is Mirrin’s lap and give her enough space to hurry off to where she needs. Some part of you wishes that you had a little more knowledge of all that’s going on in her business ventures, yet... something else tells you that it’s not exactly the same as shooting big ol’ space lasers. A nearby nursedroid already has her arms extended to receive the motionless Jenta, and you sigh as you hand her over.
rows.translation: 你小心地从米琳舒适的怀抱中抽身，给她留出足够空间赶往目的地。你有一部分希望自己能多了解一些她商业事业中的情况，然而...另一个念头告诉你，那和发射老大的太空激光并不完全相同。附近一台护理机器人已经伸出双臂，准备接过一动不动的延塔；你叹息着把她递过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou carefully slide yourself out of the comfort zone that is Mirrin’s lap and give her enough space to hurry off to where she needs. Some part of you wishes that you had a little more knowledge of all that’s going on in her business ventures, yet... something else tells you that it’s not exactly the same as shooting big ol’ space lasers. A nearby nursedroid already has her arms extended to receive the motionless Jenta, and you sigh as you hand her over."

rows.original: Space ain’t no place for the babes just yet.
rows.translation: 太空暂时还不是小宝宝该待的地方。

rows.original: “[pc.name]! I know it’s been some time, but I do remember teaching you not to stare. At least not so blatantly,” the robotic woman chuckles, tucking her Codex under an arm and leaning back against the desk. “It’s so good to see you again, dear.”

rows.original: Wait. No way... “Briget!?” you all but blurt out, blinking away your surprise. “What are you doing here?”
rows.translation: 等等。不可能...“布丽姬特！？”你几乎脱口而出，眨眨眼压下惊讶。“你怎么会在这里？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWait. No way... “Briget!?” you all but blurt out, blinking away your surprise. “What are you doing here?”"

rows.original: A flood of childhood memories come rushing back, of the first decade of your life spent in the nurse-droid’s loving care. She was like a surrogate mother in your own’s absence, with you and Dad every step of the way until your tween years. You haven’t really seen her since.
rows.translation: 童年记忆如洪水般涌回：人生最初十年都在护理机器人充满爱意的照料下度过。你亲生母亲不在时，她就像代母；直到你十来岁以前，她始终陪伴你和父亲走过每一步。自那以后，你几乎没再见过她。
rows.raw: "\n\nA flood of childhood memories come rushing back, of the first decade of your life spent in the nurse-droid’s loving care. She was like a surrogate mother in your own’s absence, with you and Dad every step of the way until your tween years. You haven’t really seen her since."

rows.original: “In the synth-flesh,” she answers, pushing up the hardlight spectacles on the bridge of her nose. “As for what I’m doing here... when Victor commissioned the nursery for you, he decided someone with experience raising Steeles would be the natural choice to oversee things. With a hundred and thirty years of raising your father’s offspring under my belt, there’s hardly anyone more qualified.”
rows.translation: “以合成肉身站在这里，”她回答着，把鼻梁上的硬光眼镜向上推了推。“至于我为何在此...维克托为你委托建造育儿所时，认为由拥有抚养斯蒂尔家族成员经验的人监督一切，自然最合适。我有一百三十年抚养你父亲后代的经验，几乎没人比我更合格。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In the synth-flesh,” she answers, pushing up the hardlight spectacles on the bridge of her nose. “As for what I’m doing here... when Victor commissioned the nursery for you, he decided someone with experience raising Steeles would be the natural choice to oversee things. With a hundred and thirty years of raising your father’s offspring under my belt, there’s hardly anyone more qualified.”"

rows.original: Letting herself swell with pride for a moment, Briget adds, “Besides, we both thought you could use a familiar face out here.”
rows.translation: 布丽姬特让自己自豪了一会儿，又补充道：“此外，我们都觉得你在这里需要一张熟悉的面孔。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLetting herself swell with pride for a moment, Briget adds, “Besides, we both thought you could use a familiar face out here.”"

rows.original: You give Briget a look, eliciting a pouted sigh and a shrug from her. “Tsk, tsk. Very well, [pc.name], I suppose we can skip the pleasantries. As your father should have explained, the nursery here is pre-paid and held in trust for you: any children you have can be sent here for care and education, in virtually any number, and we are equipped to provide for any species, core-world or Rush-space, you end up breeding with. If you’re anything like Victor, I suspect that my staff and I will be quite busy before long.”
rows.translation: 你看了布丽姬特一眼，惹得她撅嘴叹息，耸了耸肩。“啧，啧。好吧，[pc.name]，我想我们可以省略寒暄。你父亲应该解释过：这里的育儿所已经预付费用，并为你设立信托；无论数量多少，你生下的任何孩子都可以送来接受照料和教育。无论你最后与核心世界还是星球大淘金时代的哪个物种繁育，我们都有能力照顾。如果你和维克托有半点相似，我猜不用多久，我和员工就会非常忙碌。”
rows.raw: "You give Briget a look, eliciting a pouted sigh and a shrug from her. “Tsk, tsk. Very well, [pc.name], I suppose we can skip the pleasantries. As your father should have explained, the nursery here is pre-paid and held in trust for you: any children you have can be sent here for care and education, in virtually any number, and we are equipped to provide for any species, core-world or Rush-space, you end up breeding with. If you’re anything like Victor, I suspect that my staff and I will be quite busy before long.”"

rows.original: Now there’s something you’ve been missing! You step forward and allow yourself to be pulled into a tight embrace, squished against the nurse-droid’s oh-so-soft, fleshy body. You’re immediately subsumed in a sense of warmth and security that’s been too-long absent from your life; the smell of rich, sweet perfume washes over you. More like a child than you’d intended, you find yourself nuzzling your [pc.face] into the lapel of Briget’s jacket, just enjoying the softness of the silky fabric on your [pc.skinFurScales].
rows.translation: 现在，这才是你一直怀念的东西！你向前一步，任由自己被拉进紧紧的拥抱，挤在护理机器人无比柔软肉感的身体上。你立刻被生命中久违的温暖与安全感吞没；浓郁甜美的香水气息冲刷全身。你的表现比预想中更像孩子，发现自己正把[pc.face]埋进布丽姬特外套翻领，只顾享受丝滑布料拂过[pc.skinFurScales]的柔软触感。
rows.raw: "Now there’s something you’ve been missing! You step forward and allow yourself to be pulled into a tight embrace, squished against the nurse-droid’s oh-so-soft, fleshy body. You’re immediately subsumed in a sense of warmth and security that’s been too-long absent from your life; the smell of rich, sweet perfume washes over you. More like a child than you’d intended, you find yourself nuzzling your [pc.face] into the lapel of Briget’s jacket, just enjoying the softness of the silky fabric on your [pc.skinFurScales]."

rows.original: Briget laughs pleasantly, running a hand across your [pc.hair]. “It really is good to see you again, dear. Retirement was so thoroughly unfulfilling without at least one of my precious Steeles to take care of... though now that the nursery is up and running, I trust you’ll be keeping me busy with a whole new generation of the family, hmm?”
rows.translation: 布丽姬特愉快地笑着，一只手抚过你的[pc.hair]。“再次见到你真的很高兴，亲爱的。没有至少一位珍贵的斯蒂尔让我照顾，退休生活实在空虚得彻底...不过如今育儿所已经开始运营，我相信你会让我忙着照料家族的全新一代，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBriget laughs pleasantly, running a hand across your [pc.hair]. “It really is good to see you again, dear. Retirement was so thoroughly unfulfilling without at least one of my precious Steeles to take care of... though now that the nursery is up and running, I trust you’ll be keeping me busy with a whole new generation of the family, hmm?”"

rows.original: If you’re anything like your father, the answer will no doubt be a resounding “yes.”
rows.translation: 如果你和父亲有半点相似，答案无疑会是一声响亮的“是。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you’re anything like your father, the answer will no doubt be a resounding “yes.”"

rows.original: “So,” Briget says, turning your attention towards the holoscreen dominating the nearby wall. “The nursery’s controller V.I. has been set to give you up to the minute status of the facility and any children you send here. Of course, it’s merely a monitoring agent: the actual act of caregiving and education falls to me and the staff I’ve assembled. As I did for your father, so too will I do for you. You have my solemn promise that your heirs will be the best-cared-for and educated children in the galaxy.”
rows.translation: “那么，”布丽姬特说着，把你的注意力引向占据附近墙面的全息屏幕。“育儿所的控制虚拟智能已经设定为随时向你提供设施和所有送来孩子的最新状态。当然，它只是监控代理：真正的照料和教育工作由我和召集的员工负责。我过去怎样为你父亲服务，如今也会怎样为你服务。我郑重承诺，你的继承人会成为银河系中受到最佳照料与教育的孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So,” Briget says, turning your attention towards the holoscreen dominating the nearby wall. “The nursery’s controller V.I. has been set to give you up to the minute status of the facility and any children you send here. Of course, it’s merely a monitoring agent: the actual act of caregiving and education falls to me and the staff I’ve assembled. As I did for your father, so too will I do for you. You have my solemn promise that your heirs will be the best-cared-for and educated children in the galaxy.”"

rows.original: Considering the way Briget brought you up, completely in the lap of luxury with all the love and attention - and expensive things - you could ever want, you know she’s telling the truth.
rows.translation: 想想布丽姬特抚养你的方式：完全生活在奢华之中，得到自己可能想要的一切爱与关注——还有昂贵物品——你知道她说的是实话。
rows.raw: "\n\nConsidering the way Briget brought you up, completely in the lap of luxury with all the love and attention - and expensive things - you could ever want, you know she’s telling the truth."

rows.original: Maybe without Dad around to force your kids to endure what you went through, she’ll actually be able to live up to that promise.
rows.translation: 也许父亲不在身边，无法强迫你的孩子承受你经历过的一切，她真的能够兑现承诺。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe without Dad around to force your kids to endure what you went through, she’ll actually be able to live up to that promise."

rows.original: You’re more concerned about them growing up nice and strong like you - but despite her soft, curvy physique, you know Briget’s more than capable of ensuring that. She plays a mean game of gravball for a hundred and thirty year old.
rows.translation: 你更关心他们能否像自己一样长得健康强壮——不过尽管她身体柔软丰满，你知道布丽姬特完全有能力保证这一点。对一位一百三十岁的老人而言，她重力球打得相当厉害。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re more concerned about them growing up nice and strong like you - but despite her soft, curvy physique, you know Briget’s more than capable of ensuring that. She plays a mean game of gravball for a hundred and thirty year old."

rows.original: Education, you know, Briget can handle in spades. She looks every bit the sexy teacher, and has the cyber-brain to match.
rows.translation: 你知道，布丽姬特完全有能力处理好教育。她看起来就是个性感教师，又拥有与之相配的电子大脑。
rows.raw: "\n\nEducation, you know, Briget can handle in spades. She looks every bit the sexy teacher, and has the cyber-brain to match."

rows.original: You turned out better than average under her care, and that was in Dad’s estate, not that much different from your average kid. With a staff of experts and a top of the line facility under her direction, you can’t wait to see what Briget can do.
rows.translation: 在她照料下，你的成长结果高于平均水平；而那还是在父亲的庄园里，你和普通孩子并没有多少不同。如今她指挥着一群专家和一座顶级设施，你迫不及待想看看布丽姬特能做到什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turned out better than average under her care, and that was in Dad’s estate, not that much different from your average kid. With a staff of experts and a top of the line facility under her direction, you can’t wait to see what Briget can do."

rows.translation: 你轻声笑着向前伸出双臂，将这个混血小家伙搂进怀里，告诉她：有时候人会做错事，也必须因此受罚，但承认错误、接受后果同样才是正确的做法。你也有必要解释，她以后必须更加小心自己的腹部。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle and extend your arms forward, then pull the tiny half-breed into a hug, telling her that sometimes you do something wrong and you have to get in trouble, but that it’s also the right thing to do. It also behooves you to explain that she needs to be more careful with her abdomen."

rows.original: You walk through the nursery to look for the leithan children, approaching their room and stepping through the door. It quietly hisses open, and you’re somewhat surprised to be greeted with complete silence. The door closes behind you, leaving you to silently pad over to where the cots are set up. The first two you check are suspiciously devoid of any leithan children, but before alarm can take hold of you, you check the third cot.
rows.translation: 你穿过育儿所寻找利萨恩孩子，来到他们的房间并走进门内。房门轻轻嘶响着打开，迎接你的彻底寂静令你有些惊讶。门在身后关闭，你无声走向婴儿床。检查的前两张床可疑地没有任何利萨恩孩子，不过在惊慌占据内心前，你查看了第三张。
rows.raw: "You walk through the nursery to look for the leithan children, approaching their room and stepping through the door. It quietly hisses open, and you’re somewhat surprised to be greeted with complete silence. The door closes behind you, leaving you to silently pad over to where the cots are set up. The first two you check are suspiciously devoid of any leithan children, but before alarm can take hold of you, you check the third cot."

rows.original: The two sisters are wrapped around their brother in a gangly little mess of limbs, snoozing lightly. He seems to be doing okay, even with the legs splayed across his face. You think about gently prying them apart, but decide to leave them be. You spend some idle time watching their tiny chests gently rise and fall.
rows.translation: 两个姐妹用细长凌乱的四肢缠在兄弟身上，轻轻酣睡。即使有腿横在脸上，他似乎也没事。你考虑过温柔分开他们，但决定让他们保持原样。你悠闲地看着他们小小的胸膛轻轻起伏。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two sisters are wrapped around their brother in a gangly little mess of limbs, snoozing lightly. He seems to be doing okay, even with the legs splayed across his face. You think about gently prying them apart, but decide to leave them be. You spend some idle time watching their tiny chests gently rise and fall."

rows.original: At one point,
rows.translation: 某一刻，
rows.raw: "\n\nAt one point, "

rows.original: awakens, blearily looking up at you. You smile down at him, his eyes fluttering until they lightly fall closed once more, and he drifts back to sleep. You decide to let them get their rest, and step outside.
rows.translation: 醒来，睡眼惺忪地抬头看你。你低头微笑，他的眼皮颤动，随后再次轻轻闭合，重新进入梦乡。你决定让他们继续休息，走出房间。
rows.raw: " awakens, blearily looking up at you. You smile down at him, his eyes fluttering until they lightly fall closed once more, and he drifts back to sleep. You decide to let them get their rest, and step outside."

rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello ladies,” you call, the door hissing shut behind you. "

rows.original: peeks at you from behind one of Ellie’s legs. “And gentleman.”
rows.translation: 从艾莉一条腿后探头看你。“还有小先生。”

rows.raw: " giggles as Ellie wiggles her legs around in midair, wobbling from side to side. “Whatcha doin’, girl? Oof!”"

rows.original: You sweep Ellie into a loving hug along with

rows.raw: ", squeezing them tight. Ellie nuzzles against your neck, sighing in contentment and inhaling."

rows.translation: “你好香，”她如梦似幻地低语。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You smell nice,” she murmurs dreamily."

rows.original: “Eau de Spaceship,” you quip, kissing her cheek as she giggles. She sounds just like your kids. “Having fun?”
rows.translation: “太空船香水，”你开玩笑说道，在她咯咯笑时亲吻脸颊。她听起来和你们的孩子一模一样。“玩得开心吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eau de Spaceship,” you quip, kissing her cheek as she giggles. She sounds just like your kids. “Having fun?”"

rows.original: “Uh huh,” she nods, slowly pulling back with her hand still on your arm. “They were just waking up when I got here, so now I’m tiring them out again.”
rows.translation: “嗯哼，”她点头，缓缓退开，手仍放在你手臂上。“我来时他们刚醒，所以现在要重新把他们累坏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh huh,” she nods, slowly pulling back with her hand still on your arm. “They were just waking up when I got here, so now I’m tiring them out again.”"

rows.original: “Sounds like a plan!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds like a plan!”"

rows.original: The two of you spend some time frolicking with your kids, rolling around and tickling them into fits of laughter. Eventually, all three of them are tired enough for a nap, so you put them back in their cots and kiss them good night. You and Ellie head to the break room for food and chitchat.
rows.translation: 你们两人陪孩子嬉闹了一阵，在地上翻滚、搔痒他们，令其大笑不止。最终，三个孩子都累得足以午睡，于是你们把他们放回婴儿床，亲吻道晚安。你和艾莉前往休息室吃饭聊天。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you spend some time frolicking with your kids, rolling around and tickling them into fits of laughter. Eventually, all three of them are tired enough for a nap, so you put them back in their cots and kiss them good night. You and Ellie head to the break room for food and chitchat."

rows.raw: "You walk through the door to be greeted by three little leithan heads turning to peer at you curiously, then a chorus of happy squeals. "

rows.original: and
rows.translation: 和
rows.raw: " and "

rows.translation: 小跑着穿过地板，以小小的跳跃迎接你。
rows.raw: " scamper across the floor to meet you with little leaps and bounds."

rows.original: “Haha, hello! What are you three up to, huh?”
rows.translation: “哈哈，你们好！你们三个在做什么呀？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Haha, hello! What are you three up to, huh?”"

rows.original: You sweep the kids off the floor into a bear hug, rubbing their giggling forms with your face. Spotting their toys where they were congregated, you break into a grin. “Looks like I got here just in time to play!”
rows.translation: 你把孩子们从地板抱起，拥进熊抱，用脸磨蹭他们咯咯笑着的身体。看到他们聚集处的玩具，你咧嘴一笑。“看来我来得正是时候，可以一起玩！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sweep the kids off the floor into a bear hug, rubbing their giggling forms with your face. Spotting their toys where they were congregated, you break into a grin. “Looks like I got here just in time to play!”"

rows.original: At their insistence at going back ‘up’ when you put them down, you toss them into the air and catch them one after the other until their attention is redirected elsewhere. You spend some time playing with them and their toys until eventually, all three of them are tired enough for a nap. You softly deposit the sleepy leithans into their cots and pull the blankets up, giving them good night kisses and stepping outside for food. Playing with kids is hard work.
rows.translation: 你放下他们时，他们坚持要再次“上去”，于是你把他们依次抛向空中再接住，直到注意力被其他事物吸引。你陪他们和玩具玩了一阵，最终三个孩子都累得足以午睡。你轻柔地把困倦的利萨恩放进婴儿床，拉好被子，送上晚安吻，然后去外面找食物。陪孩子玩真是辛苦。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt their insistence at going back ‘up’ when you put them down, you toss them into the air and catch them one after the other until their attention is redirected elsewhere. You spend some time playing with them and their toys until eventually, all three of them are tired enough for a nap. You softly deposit the sleepy leithans into their cots and pull the blankets up, giving them good night kisses and stepping outside for food. Playing with kids is hard work."

rows.translation: ·斯蒂尔，你为什么到处乱跑？”

rows.translation: 听到全名，他猛然刹住脚步；但还没发生别的事，一张熟悉面孔从转角探出。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt the sound of his full name he skids to a stop, but before anything else happens a familiar face peeks around the corner."

rows.raw: "! Where are y- oh, [pc.name]! Hiya babe! Oh, you found him!”"

rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, so you were making a getaway huh?” you ask, scooping your son off the ground and into your arms. “Nice try, kiddo. Hi babe.”"

rows.translation: “哦，你们好！刚才躲在妈妈漂亮的头发里，对不对？”你问道。“带孩子们出来探险吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, hello! Hiding in mommy’s lovely hair, were we?” you ask. “Taking the kids exploring?”"

rows.raw: " seems to want to adventure on his own, even though he’s not allowed.”"

rows.original: “Oh well, the staff won’t mind, probably. Let’s go and take a look around, shall we?”
rows.translation: “好吧，工作人员大概不会介意。我们四处看看，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh well, the staff won’t mind, probably. Let’s go and take a look around, shall we?”"

rows.translation: 你和艾莉手牵手走过育儿所，三个孩子挂在你们肩上，四处查看房间，并向里面的人挥手。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou and Ellie walk hand in hand through the nursery with your three kids hanging off your shoulders, checking out the rooms and waving at the inhabitants."

rows.original: “I’m glad you treat them the same way you treat ours, [pc.name],” Ellie murmurs, rubbing against your shoulder. “For some of them, you’re the only parent they’ll ever have.”
rows.translation: “我很高兴你对待他们就像对待我们的孩子一样，[pc.name]，”艾莉依偎着你的肩膀低语。“对其中一些孩子来说，你会是他们此生唯一的父母。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m glad you treat them the same way you treat ours, [pc.name],” Ellie murmurs, rubbing against your shoulder. “For some of them, you’re the only parent they’ll ever have.”"

rows.original: “Gotta share the love, right?” you say with a smile. “They’re all good kids.”
rows.translation: “爱当然要分享，对吧？”你微笑着说道。“他们都是好孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gotta share the love, right?” you say with a smile. “They’re all good kids.”"

rows.original: Ellie stops you in the middle of the hall and turns towards you, but before you can say anything she’s caught you in a deep, passionate kiss. She pulls back with a beautiful smile and shining eyes, and you find yourself smiling back at her.
rows.translation: 艾莉在走廊中央叫住你，转身面向你；但你还来不及说话，她便将你拉进一个深情而热烈的吻。她带着美丽的笑容和闪亮双眸退开，你发现自己也在对她微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nEllie stops you in the middle of the hall and turns towards you, but before you can say anything she’s caught you in a deep, passionate kiss. She pulls back with a beautiful smile and shining eyes, and you find yourself smiling back at her. "

rows.translation: 趴在你肩头吐出舌头，发出“呸——”的一声，你们俩都笑了起来。

rows.original: You make some stops in various rooms as you show the kids around, getting them acquainted with the Nursery. The various staff are all very helpful and friendly, and handle the kids with practiced deftness. When the exploration comes to an end, you and Ellie are walking back to their rooms with sleepy kids in tow.
rows.translation: 你带孩子们四处参观，途中在不同房间停留，让他们熟悉育儿所。各处工作人员都十分乐于助人且态度友善，照料孩子时也熟练灵巧。探索结束后，你和艾莉带着昏昏欲睡的孩子们走回他们的房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make some stops in various rooms as you show the kids around, getting them acquainted with the Nursery. The various staff are all very helpful and friendly, and handle the kids with practiced deftness. When the exploration comes to an end, you and Ellie are walking back to their rooms with sleepy kids in tow."

rows.original: “Do you think you’ll have other kids, [pc.name]?” she asks, peering at your expression.
rows.translation: “你觉得自己还会有其他孩子吗，[pc.name]？”她仔细观察着你的表情问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you think you’ll have other kids, [pc.name]?” she asks, peering at your expression."

rows.original: “I don’t know myself, really,” you shrug. “Would you prefer it if I didn’t?”
rows.translation: “说真的，我自己也不知道，”你耸耸肩。“你希望我不要再生了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know myself, really,” you shrug. “Would you prefer it if I didn’t?”"

rows.original: “No!” she gasps, squeezing your arm. “[pc.name], you can’t just let love pass you by, even if it’s not only for me. Don’t feel like you gotta keep yourself cel- celebr- um, I’m okay with you having more kids. I think it would be fun to have more of them in the Nursery, and maybe I’ll even get to make friends with their mommies.”
rows.translation: “不！”她倒吸一口气，紧紧挽住你的手臂。“[pc.name]，就算那份爱不只属于我，你也不能任由它与你擦肩而过。别觉得自己必须保持独-独身-呃，我不介意你有更多孩子。我觉得育儿所有更多孩子会很有趣，也许我甚至能和他们的妈妈交朋友。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No!” she gasps, squeezing your arm. “[pc.name], you can’t just let love pass you by, even if it’s not only for me. Don’t feel like you gotta keep yourself cel- celebr- um, I’m okay with you having more kids. I think it would be fun to have more of them in the Nursery, and maybe I’ll even get to make friends with their mommies.”"

rows.original: She gives you a kiss on the cheek.
rows.translation: 她亲了亲你的脸颊。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a kiss on the cheek."

rows.original: “Or daddies,” she adds after a pause, looking at you. “I never know with you.”
rows.translation: “或者爸爸们，”她停顿片刻后看着你补充道。“我总是猜不准你的情况。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Or daddies,” she adds after a pause, looking at you. “I never know with you.”"

rows.translation: “你们好呀！小怪物们在做什么呢，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello! What’re you little monsters doing, hm?”"

rows.original: At the sound of your voice they turn and squeal in excitement, bounding over to you in eager joy. Upon chatting with the staff while picking them up, you find they were out exploring the Nursery just for fun. You decide to help them out, and soon enough you’re traveling from room to room with three leithan children draped over your shoulders and head, saying hi to staff and checking out the facilities.

rows.original: Your little pups crawl all over each other and their surroundings, constantly sniffing and staring at everyone and everything around them. They wag their fluffy little tails whenever they’re happy, which Briget says is primarily when you’re around. Whenever they see something flashy on a computer or codex screen though, they all crawl over to it, wagging their tails and staring curiously until they fall asleep curled up against each other.
rows.translation: 你的小幼崽们在彼此身上和周围环境中到处爬，不断嗅闻并凝视身边的每个人、每样东西。他们开心时会摇动毛茸茸的小尾巴，而布里杰特说，你在身边时正是他们最开心的时候。不过，每当他们在电脑或终端屏幕上看到什么闪亮的东西，就会全部爬过去，摇着尾巴好奇地凝视，直到彼此蜷缩着睡着。

rows.original: Your kids fathered by Zephyr look like they’re growing up fast; undoubtedly entirely human, something of a rarity in your nursery, but mightily energetic. Probably little troublemakers in waiting for you and the nursery staff!
rows.translation: 你和泽菲尔生下的孩子似乎长得很快；他们无疑完全是人类，这在你的育儿室里颇为罕见，而且精力极其旺盛。他们大概正等着成为你和育儿室工作人员眼中的小捣蛋鬼！
rows.raw: "\n\nYour kids fathered by Zephyr look like they’re growing up fast; undoubtedly entirely human, something of a rarity in your nursery, but mightily energetic. Probably little troublemakers in waiting for you and the nursery staff!"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: Heading into the Nursery proper, you find your and Zephyr’s kids in their cribs. They’re awake for now, bright-eyed and bushy-tailed, and demanding your attention. You poke one’s cheek and he grabs at your finger, delighting in its presence, and giving it a cursory bite for good measure. You wince slightly and begin shaking a baby rattle above his crib instead, your baby clapping in joy.
rows.translation: 你走进育儿室内部，发现你和泽菲尔的孩子们正待在婴儿床里。他们现在都醒着，眼睛明亮、精神十足，正要求你关注。你戳了戳一个孩子的脸颊，他抓住你的手指，为它的出现高兴不已，还顺便随意咬了一口。你微微吃痛，于是改为在他的婴儿床上方摇起拨浪鼓；你的宝宝开心地拍起手来。
rows.raw: "Heading into the Nursery proper, you find your and Zephyr’s kids in their cribs. They’re awake for now, bright-eyed and bushy-tailed, and demanding your attention. You poke one’s cheek and he grabs at your finger, delighting in its presence, and giving it a cursory bite for good measure. You wince slightly and begin shaking a baby rattle above his crib instead, your baby clapping in joy."

rows.original: “Awww, the two of you’re so cute,” a voice murmurs from behind you, and you turn to see Zephyr, who walks up alongside you to wrap her arm around your [pc.hips] and give you a kiss on the cheek. “Hey there, beautiful.”
rows.translation: “啊呜，你们两个真可爱，”身后传来一个低声细语的声音。你转过身，看见泽菲尔走到身边，用手臂搂住你的[pc.hips]，亲了亲你的脸颊。“你好啊，美人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awww, the two of you’re so cute,” a voice murmurs from behind you, and you turn to see Zephyr, who walks up alongside you to wrap her arm around your [pc.hips] and give you a kiss on the cheek. “Hey there, beautiful.”"

rows.original: “Hey lover,” you reply, smiling at her as she leans over into the crib, putting out a finger.
rows.translation: “你好，亲爱的，”你回答，对她微笑；她俯身探进婴儿床，伸出一根手指。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey lover,” you reply, smiling at her as she leans over into the crib, putting out a finger."

rows.original: “Hello! Ow,” Zephyr says, wincing as she falls prey to the same gambit you did.
rows.translation: “你好！嗷，”泽菲尔说道；她中了和你一样的招，吃痛地缩了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello! Ow,” Zephyr says, wincing as she falls prey to the same gambit you did."

rows.original: “He likes to bite,” you helpfully inform her. “I think he gets it from you.”
rows.translation: “他喜欢咬人，”你热心地告诉她。“我觉得这是遗传你的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He likes to bite,” you helpfully inform her. “I think he gets it from you.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, thanks,” she says, sighing. “Oh well, at least he’s having a good time.”
rows.translation: “对，多谢提醒，”她叹气说道。“算了，至少他玩得很开心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, thanks,” she says, sighing. “Oh well, at least he’s having a good time.”"

rows.original: The two of you pass the time playing with your kids until they start to fall asleep, at which point Zephyr gives you a goodbye kiss and leaves. You stay behind to watch the kids get some rest, then tiptoe out of the room as best you can.
rows.translation: 你们俩陪孩子玩耍，打发时间，直到他们开始入睡；这时泽菲尔吻别了你，然后离开。你留下来，看着孩子们休息，接着尽可能蹑手蹑脚地走出房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you pass the time playing with your kids until they start to fall asleep, at which point Zephyr gives you a goodbye kiss and leaves. You stay behind to watch the kids get some rest, then tiptoe out of the room as best you can."

rows.original: You take some time switching between cribs to pay attention to all of your kids, playing with them in rotation until eventually they start to fall asleep again, worn out by all the hubbub of mom being home. After you’re assured they’re all asleep, you tiptoe out of the room as best you can.
rows.translation: 你花了一些时间在各张婴儿床间轮换，逐个关注所有孩子，轮流陪他们玩，直到他们最终再次睡去；妈妈回家引起的所有喧闹已经让他们精疲力尽。确认他们全都睡着后，你尽可能蹑手蹑脚地走出房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take some time switching between cribs to pay attention to all of your kids, playing with them in rotation until eventually they start to fall asleep again, worn out by all the hubbub of mom being home. After you’re assured they’re all asleep, you tiptoe out of the room as best you can."

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: Having spied Zephyr asleep in the Nursery with the kids, you quickly duck out to grab a datapad that carries a camera. Making your way back, you grin at the sight. She’s got two kids in her massive arms, both fast asleep, all while she quietly snoozes against a wall. She must have gotten carried away playing with them.
rows.translation: 发现泽菲尔和孩子们一起睡在育儿室里后，你迅速溜出去，拿来一块带摄像头的数据板。返回后，眼前景象令你咧嘴一笑。她粗壮的双臂中抱着两个孩子，两个都睡得正熟；与此同时，她自己也靠着墙安静地打盹。她陪孩子玩时一定是忘乎所以了。
rows.raw: "Having spied Zephyr asleep in the Nursery with the kids, you quickly duck out to grab a datapad that carries a camera. Making your way back, you grin at the sight. She’s got two kids in her massive arms, both fast asleep, all while she quietly snoozes against a wall. She must have gotten carried away playing with them."

rows.original: You snap a couple of cute pictures, including a family selfie where you’re leaning over Zephyr and giving the camera a big grin and a peace sign. She’s none the wiser when she wakes up groggily, but you’ll be sure that the photos make their way to her email when she’s totally unsuspecting.
rows.translation: 你拍下几张可爱的照片，其中还有一张家庭自拍：你俯身越过泽菲尔，对着镜头咧开大大的笑容，还比出胜利手势。她睡眼惺忪地醒来时完全不知情，但你肯定会趁她毫无防备时，把这些照片发进她的邮箱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou snap a couple of cute pictures, including a family selfie where you’re leaning over Zephyr and giving the camera a big grin and a peace sign. She’s none the wiser when she wakes up groggily, but you’ll be sure that the photos make their way to her email when she’s totally unsuspecting."

rows.original: You snap a comedic picture of Zephyr and your kids with a filter and a caption, quickly hiding it in the history when she snaps awake and sees you holding a camera. You sit down next to her and put your arm around her, taking a nice picture of the four of you, two with giant, heartfelt smiles and two fast asleep.
rows.translation: 你用滤镜和配文拍下一张泽菲尔与孩子们的搞笑照片；她猛然醒来，看见你拿着摄像机时，你迅速把照片藏进历史记录。你在她身边坐下，用手臂搂住她，给你们四个拍了一张漂亮的照片：两个人露出巨大而真挚的笑容，另外两个则酣睡不醒。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou snap a comedic picture of Zephyr and your kids with a filter and a caption, quickly hiding it in the history when she snaps awake and sees you holding a camera. You sit down next to her and put your arm around her, taking a nice picture of the four of you, two with giant, heartfelt smiles and two fast asleep."

rows.original: You’re about to try and very carefully extricate the children from her arms so you can snap some funny pictures, but she awakens the moment you touch them. With a sheepish smile, you confess your idea and she gives you a proud grin.
rows.translation: 你正准备极其小心地把孩子从她怀中抱出来，好拍几张有趣的照片，然而你一碰到他们，她便醒了。你带着不好意思的笑容坦白自己的想法，她则骄傲地咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re about to try and very carefully extricate the children from her arms so you can snap some funny pictures, but she awakens the moment you touch them. With a sheepish smile, you confess your idea and she gives you a proud grin."

rows.original: “Ain’t no one putting their hands on the kids without my knowledge, not even you, [pc.name]!” Zephyr declares before realizing she should be more quiet. “Oops.”
rows.translation: “没人能在我不知情时碰孩子，就连你也不行，[pc.name]！”泽菲尔宣告道，随后才意识到自己应该小声一点。“哎呀。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ain’t no one putting their hands on the kids without my knowledge, not even you, [pc.name]!” Zephyr declares before realizing she should be more quiet. “Oops.”"

rows.original: Since you’re both awake and present anyway, you take some pictures of the happy family.
rows.translation: 反正你们两个都醒着，也都在场，于是便给这个幸福的家庭拍了些照片。
rows.raw: "\n\nSince you’re both awake and present anyway, you take some pictures of the happy family."

rows.original: You help her carefully put the kids back in their cribs so as to not wake them before you leave.
rows.translation: 离开前，你帮她小心地把孩子放回婴儿床，免得惊醒他们。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou help her carefully put the kids back in their cribs so as to not wake them before you leave."

You don’t do this for long, however, as the other [var2| babies get lonely and start giving signs that they’re going to cry, prompting you to give them some attention too. A member of the staff helps to pacify the more demanding ones until their turn arrives.|baby gets lonely and starts giving signs that they’re going to cry, prompting you to give them some attention too]]
				
				You lose track of time as you play with [var0|[var1|him, moving his limbs and responding to his|her, moving her limbs and responding to her|your baby, moving their limbs and responding to their]|your babies, moving their limbs and responding to their] cute, nonsensical coos with phrases and sounds of your own.[var3| Sometimes, they even say actual words — your heart practically melts when you hear [pc.mfn|dadda|momma|momma]!]
				
				[pc.isLactating|As they start getting hungry, you oblige by[pc.isChestGarbed| baring your chest and] bringing [var1|him|her|them] up for some nutritious [pc.milkNoun], which [var1|he|she|they] drink happily.]
				
				Eventually, nap time comes, and you decide to say goodbye, giving [var1|him|her|each of them] a tender kiss before they drift to sleep.

你小心翼翼地走进房间，生怕惊到[var0|宝宝，可[var1|他|她|宝宝]一下子就盯住了你，[var1|他|她|宝宝]随即咧嘴开心地笑了起来。|宝宝们，可他们一下子就盯住了你，一个个都咧嘴开心地笑了起来。]
				
				你从婴儿床里[var0|抱起[var1|他|她|宝宝]，搂在怀里，惬意地抱了好一会儿。你望着那双可爱的眼睛，里面闪着喜悦的光，你也笑着回应。|抱起其中一个宝宝，搂在怀里。你望着那双可爱的眼睛，里面闪着喜悦的光，你也笑着回应。不过你没抱太久，因为[var2| 其他宝宝觉得没人陪，眼看就要哭了，你也得去陪陪他们。一位工作人员过来哄着几个尤其闹腾的宝宝，等轮到他们。|另一个宝宝觉得没人陪，眼看就要哭了，你也得去陪陪这个宝宝。]]

				终于到了午睡时间，你准备告别，在[var1|他|她|每个宝宝]睡着前轻轻亲了一下。

rows.original:
Mere seconds after you enter the room, your [var0|kid rushes to hug you|kids flock to crush you with hugs]. It takes a while for [var1|him|her|them] to be satisfied! Once greetings are out of the way and you’ve been given a full report by the staff, you elect to spend a day with your [var0|child|children], and the first thing you decide to do is flip their usual schedule on its head.
				
				The first half of the day is spent playing games to [var1|his|her|their] heart’s content, from the simple tag, to hide and seek, to board games, to video games. Truth be told, there’s no way a child their age could ever have enough of this, but fortunately you are saved when the staff member comes in to announce lunch time, which is followed by a cat-nap.
				
				After that, you decide to lead by example and help your [var0|kid|kids] with schoolwork for the next two hours. [var1|He learns|She learns|They learn] so fast! The teacher on duty glows with pride when you praise their good work, though they admit it’s all owed to your [var0|child’s|children’s] dedication.[var2| Naturally, some kids have more facility with certain fields and difficulty with other fields, but they all study hard because they want to impress you.]
				
				You reward your [var0|kid|kids] by playing with [var1|him|her|them] some more, and when bedtime comes, you spend quite a few hours telling [var1|him|her|them] stories of your space adventures — minus the lurid details, of course. One moment, [var1|he’s|she’s|they’re] listening with rapt attention, only to bombard you with questions as soon as you give [var1|him|her|them] a breach. Eventually, however, exhaustion wins out, and [var1|he|she|they] finally fall asleep.
				
				As you kiss [var1|him|her|them] goodbye, your heart already grows heavy with longing. You wish you could stay more, but there’s just so much you have to do... Still, the time you’ve spent with them today will live forever in your heart as a treasured memory. It helps to renew your sense of purpose — the faster you finish your quest, the more time you’ll be able to dedicate to your [var0|child|children].
rows.translation:
你才进门几秒，[var0|你的孩子就冲过来抱住你|你的孩子们就一拥而上，把你抱得快喘不过气]。[var1|他|她|他们]抱了好一阵才心满意足！打过招呼，听完工作人员详细汇报孩子的近况，你决定花一天时间陪陪[var0|你的孩子|你的孩子们]。你做的第一件事，就是把平日的作息安排彻底打乱。
				
				这一天的前半段都用来陪[var1|他|她|他们]玩个痛快，从简单的你追我跑、捉迷藏，一直玩到桌游和电子游戏。说实话，这个年纪的孩子怎么都玩不够。好在工作人员及时进来宣布午饭时间到了，你这才得以歇口气，午饭后还安排了一小会儿午睡。
				
				接下来，你决定以身作则，花两个小时辅导[var0|你的孩子|你的孩子们]做功课。[var1|他学得|她学得|他们学得]真快！你夸值班老师教得好，对方脸上顿时满是自豪，不过也坦言，这都要归功于[var0|孩子|孩子们]自己用功。[var2| 当然，有的孩子对某些科目更有天分，学别的就吃力些，但他们都很努力，因为都想让你刮目相看。]
				
				为了奖励[var0|你的孩子|你的孩子们]，你又陪[var1|他|她|他们]玩了一阵。到了睡觉时间，你花了好几个小时，给[var1|他|她|他们]讲你在太空中冒险的故事 — 当然省去了那些不宜细说的情节。前一刻[var1|他|她|他们]还听得入神，你刚给[var1|他|她|他们]留出插话的空当，问题就一个接一个砸了过来。可到最后，困意还是占了上风，[var1|他|她|他们]终于睡着了。
				
				你亲了亲[var1|他|她|他们]，作为道别，心里已经沉甸甸地满是牵挂。你真想再多留一会儿，可还有太多事等着你去做... 不过，今天和孩子相处的时光会永远留在你心里，成为一段珍贵的回忆。这也让你重新有了干劲 — 越早完成自己的使命，你就越能腾出时间陪伴[var0|你的孩子|你的孩子们]。

rows.original: You find Ellie, happily playing with your other kids, singing to them in a lilting tone and waving her hands from side to side. She looks so adorable like that and you don’t want to disturb them, so you stay hidden for a while and watch. She’s the picture of motherhood, effortlessly entertaining the children and mesmerizing them with her song. Soon enough, the kids are asleep and she gently scoops them up, getting ready to put them back in their cribs. She starts when she sees you, then smiles genially.
rows.translation: 你发现艾莉正开心地和其他孩子玩耍，用轻快的声调为他们唱歌，双手左右挥动。她这样子可爱极了，你不想打扰他们，于是暂时躲在一旁观看。她就是母亲的化身，毫不费力地逗孩子们开心，用歌声令他们着迷。没过多久，孩子们便睡着了；她温柔地把他们抱起来，准备送回婴儿床。看见你时，她吓了一跳，随后和善地笑了。
rows.raw: "You find Ellie, happily playing with your other kids, singing to them in a lilting tone and waving her hands from side to side. She looks so adorable like that and you don’t want to disturb them, so you stay hidden for a while and watch. She’s the picture of motherhood, effortlessly entertaining the children and mesmerizing them with her song. Soon enough, the kids are asleep and she gently scoops them up, getting ready to put them back in their cribs. She starts when she sees you, then smiles genially."

rows.original: “Let me just put them to bed,” she whispers. You nod, and she goes to deposit her tiny, snoring cargo in their cots before returning. “Looks like you caught me, [pc.name],” Ellie says with a smile. “I was just going to check on the eggs before I found the kids, and then I got distracted.”
rows.translation: “让我先把他们安顿到床上，”她低声说道。你点点头，她便把怀里打鼾的小家伙们分别放入婴儿床，随后返回。“看来被你逮到了，[pc.name]，”艾莉微笑着说道。“我本来只是想去看看蛋，后来遇见孩子们，就分心了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let me just put them to bed,” she whispers. You nod, and she goes to deposit her tiny, snoring cargo in their cots before returning. “Looks like you caught me, [pc.name],” Ellie says with a smile. “I was just going to check on the eggs before I found the kids, and then I got distracted.”"

rows.original: “You look good with the kids,” you say, smiling. “Like you were meant to be a mom.”
rows.translation: “你和孩子们待在一起时很好看，”你微笑着说道。“仿佛天生就该成为母亲。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You look good with the kids,” you say, smiling. “Like you were meant to be a mom.”"

rows.original: “Aw, thanks, [pc.name],” she says, a rare hint of shyness showing itself in her manner. “I hope our kids think so too.”
rows.translation: “啊，谢谢，[pc.name]，”她说道，举止间罕见地流露出一丝羞涩。“希望我们的孩子也这样想。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aw, thanks, [pc.name],” she says, a rare hint of shyness showing itself in her manner. “I hope our kids think so too.”"

rows.original: “They will. I know it,” you assure her, reaching out to hold her hand. “Did you wanna go check on the eggs?”
rows.translation: “他们会的。我知道，”你伸手握住她的手，向她保证。“你想去看看蛋吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They will. I know it,” you assure her, reaching out to hold her hand. “Did you wanna go check on the eggs?”"

rows.original: “Right!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right!”"

rows.original: You find Ellie milling about in the reception area, clearly deep in thought as she mumbles to herself.
rows.translation: 你发现艾莉正在接待区来回踱步，显然陷入沉思，嘴里自言自语。
rows.raw: "You find Ellie milling about in the reception area, clearly deep in thought as she mumbles to herself."

rows.original: “Hey babe,” you call out, walking over. “Everything okay?”
rows.translation: “嘿，宝贝，”你走过去招呼她。“一切都好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey babe,” you call out, walking over. “Everything okay?”"

rows.original: “Oh, [pc.name]!” Ellie says, surprised. “I was just wondering whether I should call you over!”
rows.translation: “哦，[pc.name]！”艾莉惊讶地说道。“我刚才还在想该不该叫你过来！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, [pc.name]!” Ellie says, surprised. “I was just wondering whether I should call you over!”"

rows.original: “You know it’s fine for you to be here without me,” you remind her.
rows.translation: “你知道，没有我陪着，你也可以来这里，”你提醒她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know it’s fine for you to be here without me,” you remind her."

rows.original: “I know, but it feels nicer to have you around,” she says.
rows.translation: “我知道，但有你在身边感觉更好，”她说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know, but it feels nicer to have you around,” she says."

rows.original: “C’mon then,” you say, reaching out to hold her hand. “Let’s go check on the eggs.”
rows.translation: “那走吧，”你伸手握住她的手说道。“我们去看看蛋。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“C’mon then,” you say, reaching out to hold her hand. “Let’s go check on the eggs.”"

rows.original: The two of you stand and watch the eggs for a while. To races that don’t lay eggs, standing around and watching them might seem odd, but you suspect that most parents would understand. After a while, you turn to Ellie.
rows.translation: 你们站在那里观察了一阵那些蛋。对于不产卵的种族来说，站着观察蛋也许显得奇怪，但你猜大多数父母都能理解。过了一会儿，你转向艾莉。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you stand and watch the eggs for a while. To races that don’t lay eggs, standing around and watching them might seem odd, but you suspect that most parents would understand. After a while, you turn to Ellie."

rows.original: “Thought of any good names yet?”
rows.translation: “想到什么好名字了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thought of any good names yet?”"

rows.original: “I’m still thinking,” she says, sighing. “I know I’ll know them when I know them! I mean... I’ll figure it out.”
rows.translation: “我还在想，”她叹息道。“等我知道他们以后，自然就会知道名字！我是说...我会想出来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m still thinking,” she says, sighing. “I know I’ll know them when I know them! I mean... I’ll figure it out.”"

rows.original: “Fair enough,” you say, nodding.
rows.translation: “有道理，”你点头说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fair enough,” you say, nodding."

rows.original: After a few minutes, you and Ellie exit the room still holding hands. You spend a few minutes just chatting, then give her a kiss goodbye as she departs to get back to New Texas. She leaves you with a fuzzy feeling in your stomach and a smile on your face.
rows.translation: 几分钟后，你和艾莉仍牵着手走出房间。你们只是闲聊了一会儿，随后在她出发返回新得克萨斯时吻别。她让你腹中留下暖融融的感觉，脸上也挂着微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few minutes, you and Ellie exit the room still holding hands. You spend a few minutes just chatting, then give her a kiss goodbye as she departs to get back to New Texas. She leaves you with a fuzzy feeling in your stomach and a smile on your face."

You’re about to call a member of the staff when a crack appears in one of the shells, eliciting an excited gasp from you.

rows.original: Their leithan teacher approaches soon after: “Hey kids, I hope you haven’t forgotten that we’re still in the middle of a lesson,” he says playfully yet sternly. And then, turning to you: “I’m sorry, [pc.misterMiss] Steele, Briget would get on my case if I encouraged them to slack off,” he apologizes with a hint of embarrassment. You chuckle and tell him it’s quite alright, he’s doing a good job.

rows.original: Pouting, the kids seem reluctant to go back, until you promise you’ll be right there to play with them afterwards. Even if it turns out they’re not going to use this kind of skill when they grow up, it’s important to develop dexterity when one has such a bulky frame.
rows.translation: 孩子们撅着嘴，似乎不情愿回去，直到你承诺之后会留在那里陪他们玩。即使他们长大后不会用到这种技能，拥有如此庞大的身躯时，培养灵活性也很重要。
rows.raw: "\n\nPouting, the kids seem reluctant to go back, until you promise you’ll be right there to play with them afterwards. Even if it turns out they’re not going to use this kind of skill when they grow up, it’s important to develop dexterity when one has such a bulky frame."

rows.original: But of course, since you have a tauric body too, you’re not going to just stand by idly: you decide to take part in the track. It’s easy for you to dodge or jump right over the obstacles, but to your kids, you look like a paragon – you can practically see the awe shining in their eyes, and your example inspires them to overcome the parts that were giving them trouble before.
rows.translation: 不过，你自己同样有着牛身，当然不会只站在旁边无所事事：你决定亲自参与障碍赛道。对你而言，躲开或直接跃过障碍轻而易举；但在孩子们看来，你就是典范——你几乎能看见他们眼中闪耀的敬佩，而你的示范也激励他们克服之前遇到困难的部分。

rows.original: Afterwards, their teacher surreptitiously erases the schedule board, freeing your kids to play with you for the rest of the day. And that’s exactly what you do: indulging their every whim, playing every game they want to, watching every show they want to and, lastly, telling bedtime stories before kissing them goodnight. Taking a look at the time, you realize it’s well past their bedtime, and you’re more exhausted than if you’d been fighting on a Rush planet, but the happy smiles on their sleeping faces tell you it was worth it.
rows.translation: 之后，他们的老师悄悄擦掉日程板上的内容，让孩子们能在当天剩余时间里陪你玩。而你们也确实这样做了：满足他们的每个愿望，陪他们玩想玩的每种游戏、看想看的每个节目，最后讲完睡前故事，亲吻他们道晚安。看了看时间，你意识到早已过了他们的就寝时间，自己也比在淘金热星球上战斗过后更加疲惫；但他们熟睡脸庞上的幸福笑容告诉你，这一切都值得。

rows.original: You enter the room and head to the play area, where you spot a myriad of toys scattered around. Despite the plethora of options, your kids are toying with something rather simpler: paper and crayons. Their caretaker, a blond Terran woman, is so immersed in cleaning up the mess that she fails to notice your approach.
rows.translation: 你进入房间，走向游戏区，看见各式各样的玩具散落一地。尽管选择繁多，你的孩子们却在玩一种简单得多的东西：纸和蜡笔。他们的看护者是一名金发泰伦女性，她专心清理这片狼藉，甚至没有注意到你走近。
rows.raw: "You enter the room and head to the play area, where you spot a myriad of toys scattered around. Despite the plethora of options, your kids are toying with something rather simpler: paper and crayons. Their caretaker, a blond Terran woman, is so immersed in cleaning up the mess that she fails to notice your approach."

rows.original: Of course, given their young age, their scribbles might as well be alien markings, but they seem to be having so much fun with the colors that you just stand there, watching with a dorky smile. “Oh, I’m sorry, [pc.sir], I wasn’t informed of your visit!” she says eventually. You reassure her that it’s quite alright and turn your attention back to the kids.
rows.translation: 当然，考虑到他们还很年幼，那些涂鸦与异族符号几乎没有区别；但他们玩弄色彩时看起来如此开心，你只得站在那里，傻乎乎地微笑着观看。“哦，抱歉，[pc.sir]，没人通知我您会来！”她终于说道。你向她保证完全没关系，接着把注意力重新转回孩子身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course, given their young age, their scribbles might as well be alien markings, but they seem to be having so much fun with the colors that you just stand there, watching with a dorky smile. “Oh, I’m sorry, [pc.sir], I wasn’t informed of your visit!” she says eventually. You reassure her that it’s quite alright and turn your attention back to the kids."

rows.original: The kids finally take notice and flock to you with happy smiles on their faces.
rows.translation: 孩子们终于注意到你，脸上带着开心的笑容蜂拥而来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe kids finally take notice and flock to you with happy smiles on their faces."

rows.original: Of course, now they’ve noticed you and are inching closer as best they can on their tiny limbs.
rows.translation: 当然，他们现在已经注意到你，正用小小的四肢竭尽所能地一点点靠近。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course, now they’ve noticed you and are inching closer as best they can on their tiny limbs."

rows.original: Like little angels starved for attention, they cling to your [pc.legOrLegsNoun] as you pick each one up in turn and give them a tight hug.
rows.translation: 他们像一群渴望关注的小天使，紧紧抱住你的[pc.legOrLegsNoun]；你依次抱起每一个，给他们一个用力的拥抱。
rows.raw: " Like little angels starved for attention, they cling to your [pc.legOrLegsNoun] as you pick each one up in turn and give them a tight hug."

rows.original: It takes a while, given how many children you have, and by the time you’ve hugged the last one, the first one already wants another hug. Eventually, you manage to satisfy them all.
rows.translation: 考虑到你有这么多孩子，这花了不少时间；等你抱完最后一个，第一个已经又想要一次拥抱。最终，你设法满足了所有孩子。
rows.raw: " It takes a while, given how many children you have, and by the time you’ve hugged the last one, the first one already wants another hug. Eventually, you manage to satisfy them all."

rows.original: Unceremoniously, you sit down and take some crayons yourself. Time passes in a blur as you doodle with your kids. When doodling starts to get boring, you switch to other toys, or turn on the television, or read them a book – there is no shortage of things to do, and your kids are so happy to have you around that it makes you want to extend your stay as much as possible. Just one more hour... you tell yourself time and time again.
rows.translation: 你随意坐下，自己也拿起几根蜡笔。陪孩子们一起涂鸦时，时间在模糊中飞逝。涂鸦开始变得无聊后，你们便换成其他玩具，或是打开电视，或是读一本书——能做的事情多得数不清，而孩子们又因为你的陪伴如此开心，让你想尽可能延长这次停留。再多待一小时...你一次又一次地告诉自己。

Just one more hour... you tell yourself time and time again."

rows.original: They have such a large appetite that you’re sure they’re going to grow up hale and hearty!

rows.raw: " They have such a large appetite that you’re sure they’re going to grow up hale and hearty!"

rows.original: With their bellies full, drowsiness soon settles in. You tuck them in bed and give each one a kiss on their head before deciding to take a short nap yourself. When you wake up, they’re still asleep, and you decide this is your chance to slip away, lest you find yourself unable to leave. You feel a tightness in your chest as you gaze upon their peaceful sleeping faces and whisper your goodbyes.
rows.translation: 填饱肚子后，睡意很快降临。你把他们安置到床上，逐个亲吻他们的头顶，随后决定自己也小睡一会儿。醒来时，他们依然在睡；你觉得这是溜走的机会，否则自己恐怕再也舍不得离开。凝视那些安详的睡脸、低声道别时，你感到胸口一阵发紧。

rows.original: You glance around the apartment, finding your hand drifting to your [pc.belly]. Maybe you shouldn’t be gallivanting about the galaxy when you’ve got a young, vulnerable life growing inside you, you think to yourself. The nursery is equipped to support you and your spawn almost indefinitely: you can stay here in safety and comfort until you’re ready to give birth, whenever that may be. Hopefully your space-race quest can wait.
rows.translation: 你环顾公寓，发现自己的手不知不觉移向[pc.belly]。你心想，既然体内正孕育着一条年幼脆弱的生命，也许不该继续在银河里四处冒险。育儿室配备齐全，几乎可以无限期地照顾你和你的后代：你可以安全舒适地待在这里，直到准备好分娩，不论那一天何时到来。希望你的太空竞赛任务可以等等。

rows.original: , but eased somewhat by the fact Zephyr shows up halfway in, all smiles and tears. You deliver while holding her hand, squeezing down on her delicate grip.
rows.translation: ，不过泽菲尔在分娩进行到一半时出现，满脸笑容与泪水，这让过程稍微轻松了些。你握着她的手分娩，用力挤压她纤细的手掌。
rows.raw: ", but eased somewhat by the fact Zephyr shows up halfway in, all smiles and tears. You deliver while holding her hand, squeezing down on her delicate grip."

rows.original: “Is [pc.heShe]- are you done?” Zephyr asks at the end, unsure if the ordeal is over, and smiling when you nod tiredly. “Oh my gosh, look at them,” she whispers, nuzzling up against your face and looking down at your beautiful litter of babies.
rows.translation: “[pc.heShe]——你生完了吗？”一切结束时，泽菲尔问道；她不确定这场磨难是否已经结束，而你疲惫地点头时，她笑了。“我的天啊，看看他们，”她低声说道，贴近你的脸轻轻磨蹭，低头看向你那一窝美丽的宝宝。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is [pc.heShe]- are you done?” Zephyr asks at the end, unsure if the ordeal is over, and smiling when you nod tiredly. “Oh my gosh, look at them,” she whispers, nuzzling up against your face and looking down at your beautiful litter of babies."

rows.original: “I’m a- a, well, I guess a dad, but let’s go with second mommy.”
rows.translation: “我成了——成了，呃，我想该算是爸爸，不过还是叫第二位妈妈吧。”
rows.raw: " “I’m a- a, well, I guess a dad, but let’s go with second mommy.”"

rows.original: “Yeah,” you murmur happily, watching your healthy kids being swathed in warm cloth. “I’m glad you’re here, Zephyr.”
rows.translation: “是啊，”你幸福地低声说道，看着健康的孩子们被温暖布料包裹。“我很高兴你在这里，泽菲尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah,” you murmur happily, watching your healthy kids being swathed in warm cloth. “I’m glad you’re here, Zephyr.”"

rows.original: You give her hand another warm, comforting squeeze before you fall asleep, tired out by your delivery.
rows.translation: 分娩令你筋疲力尽；睡着之前，你又温暖而安慰地握了握她的手。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her hand another warm, comforting squeeze before you fall asleep, tired out by your delivery."

rows.original: It’s a couple of days before you’re up and walking about again, mostly being tended to by Zephyr (who insists on doing everything for you) with some help from the staff, but eventually you’re out of bed and ready to head back out.
rows.translation: 过了几天，你才重新起床走动；这段时间主要由泽菲尔照料你（她坚持为你做好一切），工作人员也提供了一些帮助。不过，你最终还是离开病床，准备再次出发。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a couple of days before you’re up and walking about again, mostly being tended to by Zephyr (who insists on doing everything for you) with some help from the staff, but eventually you’re out of bed and ready to head back out."

rows.original: “[pc.Mister] Steele! We’ve been expecting you! Please, please, this way!” chimes in a robotic voice from behind as a nursedroid grips you by the forearm. Although you’d normally react to this, a moment of disorientation takes you out of the zone. You willfully follow the droid in a rush of sudden adrenaline, as if your body was anticipating something magical to happen right around the corner...
rows.translation: “[pc.Mister]斯蒂尔！我们一直在等您！请，请往这边来！”身后响起机器人般的声音；一台护士机器人抓住你的前臂。平时你肯定会对此作出反应，但一时的迷茫让你完全不在状态。突如其来的肾上腺素推动你心甘情愿地匆忙跟随机器人，仿佛身体正期待着某种神奇之事就发生在下一个转角后面...

You willfully follow the droid in a rush of sudden adrenaline, as if your body was anticipating something magical to happen right around the corner..."

rows.translation: 然后，你看见了她们。

rows.original: Just after the break room where a small line of chairs sit against the wall is a makeshift playpen. A crouched over Mirrin, now sporting a cheesy shirt with ‘Galaxy’s Best Dadmom’ on the front, cradles and tickles a tiny tot. She only needs the palm of her powerlifter’s hand to hold the small thing, all safe and secure inside a finger-wall of red.
rows.translation: 休息室外侧有一小排椅子靠墙摆放，椅子旁边就是一个临时游戏围栏。米琳弓着身子蹲在那里，如今穿着一件俗气的衬衫，正面写着“银河最佳爸妈”；她怀抱着一个小宝宝，逗得孩子咯咯发笑。她只需用举重运动员般巨大手掌的掌心就能托住这小东西，红色手指筑成的围墙把孩子安全稳妥地护在里面。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust after the break room where a small line of chairs sit against the wall is a makeshift playpen. A crouched over Mirrin, now sporting a cheesy shirt with ‘Galaxy’s Best Dadmom’ on the front, cradles and tickles a tiny tot. She only needs the palm of her powerlifter’s hand to hold the small thing, all safe and secure inside a finger-wall of red."

rows.raw: "\n\n“Aboobooboboooooo,” teases the dragoness, blowing raspberries on her tiny daughter’s belly. The resultant giggling from both of them almost seems to leap out at you and tickle your very heart."

rows.original: Your older laquine children often spend their time here, watching their younger siblings grow, no doubt eager to add them to their ranks for all the mischief they get up to. rows.raw: "\n\nYour older laquine children often spend their time here, watching their younger siblings grow, no doubt eager to add them to their ranks for all the mischief they get up to.
