rows.original: With a heavier heart than you might have expected, you tell Reaha that, now that the two of you are financially even, and Reaha’s clearly found at least something to support herself with, she should leave. You can’t take care of her forever - she need to go out there and find her own place in the galaxy.
rows.translation: 怀着比预想中更加沉重的心情，你告诉蕾娅，既然你们在经济上已经两清，而且她显然至少找到了一种养活自己的办法，她就该离开了。你不可能永远照顾她——她需要走出去，在星系中找到属于自己的位置。
rows.raw: "With a heavier heart than you might have expected, you tell Reaha that, now that the two of you are financially even, and Reaha’s clearly found at least something to support herself with, she should leave. You can’t take care of her forever - she need to go out there and find her own place in the galaxy."

rows.original: She listens with wide, placid [reaha.eyeColor] eyes locked on you all the while. When you’re done, there’s a long moment of silence before Reaha sniffles and twists her lips up like she just sucked on something bitter. “Okay,” she says simply. “Yeah, okay. I’ll, uh, I’ll go get packed. That’s fine.”
rows.translation: 她睁大那双平静的[reaha.eyeColor]眼睛，始终一眨不眨地望着你。等你说完后，漫长的沉默持续了片刻，蕾娅抽了抽鼻子，撇起嘴唇，仿佛刚刚吸吮了什么苦涩的东西。“好吧，”她只简单地说道。“嗯，好吧。我，呃，我去收拾行李。没关系。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe listens with wide, placid [reaha.eyeColor] eyes locked on you all the while. When you’re done, there’s a long moment of silence before Reaha sniffles and twists her lips up like she just sucked on something bitter. “Okay,” she says simply. “Yeah, okay. I’ll, uh, I’ll go get packed. That’s fine.”"

rows.original: Reaha turns on a heel and stomps off. All the usual jiggle and bounce in her step is gone.
rows.translation: 蕾娅猛地转身，重重地跺着脚离开了。她步伐中平日里惯有的摇晃与弹动全都消失了。
rows.raw: "\n\nReaha turns on a heel and stomps off. All the usual jiggle and bounce in her step is gone."

rows.original: She vanishes into her cabin, and for a few minutes, you think that’s all settled. Might as well grab your Codex and look up a taxi company to come pick her up. Just when you’re about to hit the message button, though, you hear a loud CRACK! sound coming from Reaha’s quarters. Instinct kicks in, and you toss your Codex away and take off running down the corridor. You almost slide right past her, trying to stop on the too-smooth chrome.
rows.translation: 她消失在自己的舱室里。几分钟里，你以为事情就这么解决了。不妨拿出CODEX终端，查找一家出租车公司来接她。可就在你将要按下发送键时，蕾娅的住处传来一声响亮的咔嚓！。本能立即接管了身体，你扔开CODEX终端，沿着走廊飞奔而去。你竭力想在过于光滑的铬合金地面上停下，差点直接从她门前滑过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe vanishes into her cabin, and for a few minutes, you think that’s all settled. Might as well grab your Codex and look up a taxi company to come pick her up. Just when you’re about to hit the message button, though, you hear a loud CRACK! sound coming from Reaha’s quarters. Instinct kicks in, and you toss your Codex away and take off running down the corridor. You almost slide right past her, trying to stop on the too-smooth chrome."

rows.original: Reaha’s standing in the middle of her quarters, surrounded by the shattered pieces of one of your ship’s holoscreen projectors. Torn right out of the wall and busted underfoot.
rows.translation: 蕾娅站在自己舱室中央，四周散落着飞船一台全息屏幕投影仪的碎片。它被从墙上硬生生扯下，又踩得粉碎。
rows.raw: "\n\nReaha’s standing in the middle of her quarters, surrounded by the shattered pieces of one of your ship’s holoscreen projectors. Torn right out of the wall and busted underfoot."

rows.original: “Uh,” Reaha stammers, looking between you and the device. “I-it was an accident. My bag got hooked and... and I know that was really expensive! I’m sorry!”
rows.translation: “呃，”蕾娅结结巴巴地说，看看你又看看设备。“这——这是意外。我的包被勾住了，然后...而且我知道那东西非常昂贵！对不起！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh,” Reaha stammers, looking between you and the device. “I-it was an accident. My bag got hooked and... and I know that was really expensive! I’m sorry!”"

rows.original: You squint at her. Is she really...
rows.translation: 你眯眼看她。她该不会真的...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou squint at her. Is she really..."

rows.original: After a few minutes of blabbering and fussing, Reaha finally says “I can’t believe I did that! I-I’ve got to owe you, like, at least another five grand for that! I’m so sorry, I’ll-”
rows.translation: 语无伦次地折腾了几分钟后，蕾娅终于说道：“真不敢相信我做了这种事！我——我至少又欠你五千吧！真的对不起，我会——”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few minutes of blabbering and fussing, Reaha finally says “I can’t believe I did that! I-I’ve got to owe you, like, at least another five grand for that! I’m so sorry, I’ll-”"

rows.original: You cut her off, saying...
rows.translation: 你打断她，说道...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cut her off, saying..."

rows.original: Stay in Debt
rows.translation: 继续负债
rows.raw: "Stay in Debt"

rows.original: “At least that much,” you growl, playing along. “Maybe more!”
rows.translation: “至少这么多，”你配合着低吼。“也许更多！”
rows.raw: "“At least that much,” you growl, playing along. “Maybe more!”"

rows.original: Reaha blanches, “M-more?”
rows.translation: 蕾娅脸色煞白。“更——更多？”
rows.raw: "\n\nReaha blanches, “M-more?”"

rows.original: You nod. “That was an expensive holo-player. I think you’re going to be working that debt off for a long, long time. And maybe I’ll just start charging you room and board while I’m at it, since you’re such a klutzy cow!”
rows.translation: 你点点头。“那是一台昂贵的全息播放器。看来你得花很久很久才能还清这笔债。而且既然你是这么笨手笨脚的奶牛，也许我该开始收你的食宿费！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod. “That was an expensive holo-player. I think you’re going to be working that debt off for a long, long time. And maybe I’ll just start charging you room and board while I’m at it, since you’re such a klutzy cow!”"

rows.original: She nods slowly, but you can’t help but notice the way her tail is swishing behind her like an ausar’s. She really is helpless, isn’t she? Guess you’ll have to keep on taking care of her for now.
rows.translation: 她缓缓点头，但你不禁注意到，她的尾巴像奥萨犬一样在身后摇摆。她真的如此无助，不是吗？看来你暂时还得继续照顾她。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods slowly, but you can’t help but notice the way her tail is swishing behind her like an ausar’s. She really is helpless, isn’t she? Guess you’ll have to keep on taking care of her for now."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Stay in Debt
rows.translation: 继续负债
rows.raw: "Stay in Debt"

rows.original: She clearly doesn’t know how to live as anything other than a slave at this point. You might as well just take care of her. Let her keep feeding money into your accounts, and keep her around.
rows.translation: 显然，她如今已经不知道除了奴隶以外还能怎样生活。你不妨继续照顾她，让她继续把钱存进你的账户，也把她留在身边。
rows.raw: "She clearly doesn’t know how to live as anything other than a slave at this point. You might as well just take care of her. Let her keep feeding money into your accounts, and keep her around."

rows.original: Stay Free
rows.translation: 保持自由
rows.raw: "Stay Free"

rows.original: “Okay, okay. You can stay, Reaha,” you assure her, putting a hand on her shoulder.
rows.translation: “好了，好了。你可以留下，蕾娅，”你将手放在她肩上，安慰道。
rows.raw: "“Okay, okay. You can stay, Reaha,” you assure her, putting a hand on her shoulder."

rows.original: In the blink of an eye, the almost-tearful cowgirl bounces into your arms, squeezing you like a miniature wrestler. “Thankyouthankyouthankyou!” she blubbers, hugging and kissing you as hard as she can. “I’m so sorry. I just... I couldn’t bear to leave! I love you way too much!”
rows.translation: 转眼之间，几乎哭出来的牛女郎便扑进你怀里，像个小摔跤手般紧紧抱住你。“谢谢谢谢谢谢你！”她哭喊着，竭尽全力又抱又亲。“真的对不起。我只是...我受不了离开你！我太爱你了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nIn the blink of an eye, the almost-tearful cowgirl bounces into your arms, squeezing you like a miniature wrestler. “Thankyouthankyouthankyou!” she blubbers, hugging and kissing you as hard as she can. “I’m so sorry. I just... I couldn’t bear to leave! I love you way too much!”"

rows.original: She...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe..."

rows.original: Reaha blushes beet-red, only letting you see for a second before burying her face in your [pc.chest]. You sigh, putting your arms around the little cow-girl and letting her get it all out. Looks like you’re going to be watching over her for a while yet.
rows.translation: 蕾娅的脸涨得通红，只让你看了一秒，便把脸埋进[pc.chest]。你叹了口气，双臂环住娇小的牛女郎，任她尽情宣泄。看来你还要继续照看她一阵。
rows.raw: "\n\nReaha blushes beet-red, only letting you see for a second before burying her face in your [pc.chest]. You sigh, putting your arms around the little cow-girl and letting her get it all out. Looks like you’re going to be watching over her for a while yet."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Stay Free
rows.translation: 保持自由
rows.raw: "Stay Free"

rows.original: You had no idea she’d actually be so desperate to stay with you that she’d pull something like this. Reaha’s made her point: let her stick around - how much trouble can she be?
rows.translation: 你根本没想到，她为了留在你身边竟会绝望到做出这种事。蕾娅已经表明了态度：让她留下吧——她又能惹出多少麻烦？
rows.raw: "You had no idea she’d actually be so desperate to stay with you that she’d pull something like this. Reaha’s made her point: let her stick around - how much trouble can she be?"

rows.original: Leave Now
rows.translation: 现在离开
rows.raw: "Leave Now"

rows.original: Reaha looks positively crestfallen, standing in the middle of a bunch of busted circuitry as she is, pouting about being thrown off your ship. But it’s the best thing for both of you, you’re sure - even surer now that she’s pulled this.
rows.translation: 蕾娅站在一堆破损电路中央，为被赶下飞船而撅着嘴，看起来心碎极了。但你确信这对你们双方都最好——她做出这种事后，你更确信了。
rows.raw: "Reaha looks positively crestfallen, standing in the middle of a bunch of busted circuitry as she is, pouting about being thrown off your ship. But it’s the best thing for both of you, you’re sure - even surer now that she’s pulled this."

rows.original: You tell her as much, then finish packing her things for her. The taxi arrives a few awkward hours later, and you make sure the cow-girl and all her belongings are safely aboard before shutting the door. You don’t even get so much as a good-bye at this point: she just looks shame-facedly between her feet as the airlock cycles closed.
rows.translation: 你把这些话告诉她，随后帮她收拾完行李。几小时后，出租飞船终于在尴尬的等待中抵达；你确认牛女郎和全部随身物品安全登船后，关上舱门。这一次你甚至没听到道别：气闸关闭时，她只是羞愧地低头望着双脚之间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her as much, then finish packing her things for her. The taxi arrives a few awkward hours later, and you make sure the cow-girl and all her belongings are safely aboard before shutting the door. You don’t even get so much as a good-bye at this point: she just looks shame-facedly between her feet as the airlock cycles closed."

rows.original: You let out a long, heavy breath as the taxi departs. That sucked.
rows.translation: 出租飞船离去时，你沉重地长叹一声。这感觉糟透了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let out a long, heavy breath as the taxi departs. That sucked."

rows.original: REAHA
rows.raw: "REAHA"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Leave Now
rows.translation: 现在离开
rows.raw: "Leave Now"

rows.original: You’re not falling for her very, very obvious attempts to get you to keep her around. Is she really that dependent on you?
rows.translation: 她那极其明显、试图让你挽留她的把戏骗不了你。她真的如此依赖你吗？
rows.raw: "You’re not falling for her very, very obvious attempts to get you to keep her around. Is she really that dependent on you?"

rows.original: She vanishes into her cabin, and for a few minutes, you think that’s all settled. Might as well grab your Codex and look up a taxi company to come pick her up. You order the taxi, and a few minutes later, Reaha returns to you with her gear all packed up in a duffel bag you’re not sure you’ve seen before. She sits down beside you with a heavy sigh, wrapping her arms around her bag.
rows.translation: 她消失在舱室里；过了几分钟，你以为事情就这样解决了。不妨拿出CODEX终端，查找一家出租飞船公司来接她。你叫了飞船，几分钟后，蕾娅带着全部装备回来，装在一个你似乎从未见过的旅行袋里。她在你身旁坐下，沉重叹息，双臂抱住袋子。
rows.raw: "She vanishes into her cabin, and for a few minutes, you think that’s all settled. Might as well grab your Codex and look up a taxi company to come pick her up. You order the taxi, and a few minutes later, Reaha returns to you with her gear all packed up in a duffel bag you’re not sure you’ve seen before. She sits down beside you with a heavy sigh, wrapping her arms around her bag."

rows.original: “I don’t know what I’m going to do,” she admits after a while. “I haven’t been a free woman... I mean, really free... since I was eighteen. For all of a week, maybe. I pretty much bounced right from the military into Beth’s. I’ve always had someone telling me what to do. How to live. What to think. Who to fuck, or fight, or care about.”
rows.translation: “我不知道自己该怎么办，”过了一会儿，她承认道。“从十八岁起，我就不再是自由女人了...我是说，真正的自由...也许总共只有一个星期。我几乎是从军队直接辗转进了贝丝那里。一直有人告诉我该做什么、该怎么生活、该想什么、该和谁做爱、战斗，或在乎谁。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know what I’m going to do,” she admits after a while. “I haven’t been a free woman... I mean, really free... since I was eighteen. For all of a week, maybe. I pretty much bounced right from the military into Beth’s. I’ve always had someone telling me what to do. How to live. What to think. Who to fuck, or fight, or care about.”"

rows.original: You reach over and put a comforting hand on her shoulder. She leans into it, but doesn’t look at you.
rows.translation: 你伸手安慰地按住她的肩膀。她靠向你的手，却没有看你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach over and put a comforting hand on her shoulder. She leans into it, but doesn’t look at you."

rows.original: “Guess I’ll need to find a job, then. How do I even do that? I’ve never... no, don’t tell me. I’ll figure it out. Maybe I’ll go back to Tavros, hook up with some of the girls that used to work at Beth’s. I remember a few of them said they’d stay on station. Probably turning tricks in the red light, still. Just new management: less cunt-y management, I hope.”
rows.translation: “看来我得找份工作了。可到底怎么找？我从来没有...不，别告诉我。我会自己弄明白。也许我会回塔维罗斯，找几个以前在贝丝手下工作的姑娘。我记得有几个人说过要留在空间站。她们大概还在红灯区卖身，只是换了新管理——希望没那么混蛋。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Guess I’ll need to find a job, then. How do I even do that? I’ve never... no, don’t tell me. I’ll figure it out. Maybe I’ll go back to Tavros, hook up with some of the girls that used to work at Beth’s. I remember a few of them said they’d stay on station. Probably turning tricks in the red light, still. Just new management: less cunt-y management, I hope.”"

rows.original: The idea of Reaha just going back to prostitution doesn’t exactly leave a good taste in your mouth after all you’ve done for her so far, but... well, what else can she do? You suggest she look into waitressing, or maybe cooking somewhere. Or leverage her service with the Coalition to get a job in security somewhere. Though a five-foot nothing, fleshy little buxom babe like her isn’t exactly intimidating. Maybe she could smother ne’er-do-wells in her tits.
rows.translation: 经历了你为她所做的一切，想到蕾娅直接重操旧业，令你很不舒服；但...她还能做什么？你建议她考虑当服务员，也许去某处做饭，或者利用在星系联军服役的经历找份安保工作。不过，身高不过五英尺、肉感十足的娇小丰满姑娘实在没什么威慑力。也许她可以用乳房闷住歹徒。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe idea of Reaha just going back to prostitution doesn’t exactly leave a good taste in your mouth after all you’ve done for her so far, but... well, what else can she do? You suggest she look into waitressing, or maybe cooking somewhere. Or leverage her service with the Coalition to get a job in security somewhere. Though a five-foot nothing, fleshy little buxom babe like her isn’t exactly intimidating. Maybe she could smother ne’er-do-wells in her tits."

rows.original: She snickers at the idea, finally turning her gaze to you. “I’ll manage. Somehow. Look... thanks for everything, [pc.name]. I mean it. If it weren’t for you, I wouldn’t have to ask myself these questions - I’d be tied up in a sex dungeon somewhere, or mounted on some gross fat alien’s dick forever. Never really thought I’d be free again after I was stuck in Beth’s. Especially not after the patches started. But here we are! I’ve got a whole life to look forward to now, thanks to you.”
rows.translation: 她听到这个主意嗤笑起来，终于转头看向你。“我会想办法过下去。听着...谢谢你所做的一切，[pc.name]。我是认真的。要不是你，我根本不会有机会问自己这些问题——我会被绑在某个性爱地牢里，或永远套在某个恶心肥胖外星人的鸡巴上。被困在贝丝那里后，我从没真正想过自己还能重获自由。尤其是在开始用贴片之后。但现在我们做到了！多亏有你，我还有整个人生可以期待。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe snickers at the idea, finally turning her gaze to you. “I’ll manage. Somehow. Look... thanks for everything, [pc.name]. I mean it. If it weren’t for you, I wouldn’t have to ask myself these questions - I’d be tied up in a sex dungeon somewhere, or mounted on some gross fat alien’s dick forever. Never really thought I’d be free again after I was stuck in Beth’s. Especially not after the patches started. But here we are! I’ve got a whole life to look forward to now, thanks to you.”"

rows.original: You ruffle her strawberry hair, possibly for the last time, and tell her to keep in touch. She nods, just as you get an alert that the taxi is arriving. You grab her bag from her and escort her to the airlock.
rows.translation: 你揉乱她草莓色的头发，也许这是最后一次，并叫她保持联系。她点点头，恰好此时你收到出租飞船抵达的提示。你替她提起袋子，送她前往气闸。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ruffle her strawberry hair, possibly for the last time, and tell her to keep in touch. She nods, just as you get an alert that the taxi is arriving. You grab her bag from her and escort her to the airlock."

rows.original: “Bye, [pc.name],” she says, reaching
rows.translation: “再见，[pc.name]，”她说着，伸手
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bye, [pc.name],” she says, reaching "

rows.original: up
rows.translation: 向上
rows.raw: "up"

rows.original: down
rows.translation: 向下
rows.raw: "down"

rows.original: over
rows.translation: 过来
rows.raw: "over"

rows.original: to give you a farewell hug. “I l- I’ll see you around, I hope.”
rows.translation: 给你一个告别拥抱。“我爱——希望以后还能见到你。”
rows.raw: " to give you a farewell hug. “I l- I’ll see you around, I hope.”"

rows.original: You smile as she departs, slipping through the airlock and sealing it behind herself. When she’s gone, you let out a heavy, weary sigh. Hopefully, she’s able to take care of herself out there. You gave her every chance in the world.
rows.translation: 她穿过气闸，亲手将其关闭；你目送她离开，微微一笑。她走后，你疲惫地重重叹息。希望她能在外面照顾好自己。你已经给了她世间所有机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile as she departs, slipping through the airlock and sealing it behind herself. When she’s gone, you let out a heavy, weary sigh. Hopefully, she’s able to take care of herself out there. You gave her every chance in the world."

rows.original: REAHA
rows.raw: "REAHA"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “I wouldn’t have put in that much work on you if I didn’t love having you around,” you say, putting a hand on Reaha’s shoulder that swiftly turns into a firm hug. “Of course you can stay if that’s what you want. For a week, a year, even forever.”
rows.translation: “要不是我喜欢你留在身边，就不会在你身上花那么多心力，”你将手放在蕾娅肩上，随即把她紧紧抱住。“只要这是你的愿望，当然可以留下。一个星期、一年，甚至永远。”
rows.raw: "“I wouldn’t have put in that much work on you if I didn’t love having you around,” you say, putting a hand on Reaha’s shoulder that swiftly turns into a firm hug. “Of course you can stay if that’s what you want. For a week, a year, even forever.”"

rows.original: Reaha lets out a whimper of relief at your words, burying her face in your shoulder.
rows.translation: 听到你的话，蕾娅如释重负地呜咽一声，将脸埋进你的肩膀。
rows.raw: "\n\nReaha lets out a whimper of relief at your words, burying her face in your shoulder."

rows.original: “And,” you continue, “I’m not going to be just a starship captain forever. When I’m running Steele Tech, I’ll be happy to have you as my bodyguard.”
rows.translation: “而且，”你继续道，“我不会永远只当星舰舰长。等我执掌斯蒂尔科技时，很乐意让你做我的保镖。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And,” you continue, “I’m not going to be just a starship captain forever. When I’m running Steele Tech, I’ll be happy to have you as my bodyguard.”"

rows.original: Leaning against a bulkhead next to the dark-skinned officer, you strike up a conversation with her, making idle chatter for a while before you chance onto discussing the finer points of your favorite games. It seems you’ve struck a chord - her eyes light up and she immediately launches into a detailed review of the newest VR game she’s picked up. Over the next half hour or so, she gives you a detailed and shining recommendation for the latest installment in the VRMMORPG Occiyre and it’s latest expansion, Fury of the Ivory Lord. She didn’t strike you as the nerdy type, but you’re quickly disabused of that assumption as the human woman regales you with the lore of the world of Occiyre, a world of magic and fantasy based loosely around the human medieval era.
rows.translation: 你靠在这位深肤色警官身边的舱壁上，跟她搭起话来。闲扯了一会儿，你们偶然聊到各自最喜欢的游戏，开始讨论里面的门道。这话题似乎正中她下怀。她两眼一亮，立刻开始详细点评自己最近买的一款 VR 游戏。接下来半个小时左右，她滔滔不绝地向你推荐 VR 大型多人在线角色扮演游戏奥西尔的最新一作和它最新的资料片象牙领主之怒。你原以为她不像是会钻研游戏的人，可这位人类女性兴致勃勃地给你讲起奥西尔世界的背景设定，很快就让你打消了这个念头。那是个大致以人类中世纪为原型、充满魔法与奇幻的世界。
rows.raw: "Leaning against a bulkhead next to the dark-skinned officer, you strike up a conversation with her, making idle chatter for a while before you chance onto discussing the finer points of your favorite games. It seems you’ve struck a chord - her eyes light up and she immediately launches into a detailed review of the newest VR game she’s picked up. Over the next half hour or so, she gives you a detailed and shining recommendation for the latest installment in the VRMMORPG Occiyre and it’s latest expansion, Fury of the Ivory Lord. She didn’t strike you as the nerdy type, but you’re quickly disabused of that assumption as the human woman regales you with the lore of the world of Occiyre, a world of magic and fantasy based loosely around the human medieval era."

rows.original: She spends a good fifteen minutes giving you a rundown of the game’s features. Apparently, it has an incredible amount of customization, playable races and player freedom, and - interestingly enough - the guard tells you there are no factions or quests, or even tutorials. Players are able to choose any of five hundred classes, but are only able to gain fifteen levels in any given class, up to a total level cap of one hundred.
rows.translation: 她花了足足十五分钟，把游戏特色给你数了一遍。据她说，游戏的自定义选项、可玩种族和玩家自由度都多得惊人。有意思的是，这位警官告诉你，游戏里没有阵营，没有任务，连新手教程都没有。玩家可以在五百个职业中任意选，但单个职业最多只能升到十五级，角色总等级最高一百级。

Players are able to choose any of five hundred classes, but are only able to gain fifteen levels in any given class, up to a total level cap of one hundred."

rows.original: “Lot of questions there, Steele. I was born on Earth - The region known as India, more specifically. Dad’s a freight captain, mom’s his first mate. I thought about following in their footsteps, but... Well, I did a stint in the U.G.C. Marines, and I guess I just decided I like the discipline and structure. Not to mention getting to cruise around the galaxy and get paid for it, kill all kinds of different aliens... dirty deeds, done dirt cheap. Oh, and chicks love the uniform. Of course, sleeping in a bed the size of a coffin, getting yelled at all the time, woken up at ungodly hours of the night for drills, and eating cat food three meals a day, that’s not so much fun.”
rows.translation: “你问题还挺多，斯蒂尔。我在地球出生，确切地说，是在那个叫印度的地方。爸是货运船长，妈是他的大副。我本想跟他们走一样的路，不过...怎么说呢，我在银河联合邦联的陆战队干过一阵子，后来发现自己还挺喜欢那种讲纪律、有规矩的日子。何况还能拿着薪水在银河到处逛，干掉各种各样的外星人...花小钱办脏活儿。哦，还有，姑娘们最喜欢那身制服了。当然，睡一张棺材大小的床、成天挨骂、半夜被叫起来操练、一日三顿吃猫粮，就没那么好玩了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Lot of questions there, Steele. I was born on Earth - The region known as India, more specifically. Dad’s a freight captain, mom’s his first mate. rows.original: Well, maybe the second time’s the charm. You’ve already gotten her relocated here to Canadia... maybe you can get her moved somewhere else, somewhere you’re not likely to ever go? You spend a few minutes digging up the info for the local U.G.C. relations officer, then shoot them off an email with your contact information. It doesn’t take long to get a call after that, and you’re speaking shortly with a tired-sounding, irritable female voice who, in between taking loud sips of whatever drink she has and typing away at her keyboard assures you that your complaint will be looked into.
rows.translation: 说不定第二次就能成。你已经让她被调来卡纳迪亚站了...也许你还能让她调去别的地方，调到一个你这辈子多半都不会去的地方？你花了几分钟查出当地银河联合邦联联络官的联系方式，给对方发了封邮件，附上自己的联络信息。没多久电话就来了。接线的女人听起来疲惫又不耐烦，一边大声啜饮着不知道什么饮料，一边敲着键盘，向你保证会调查这起投诉。
rows.raw: "Well, maybe the second time’s the charm. You’ve already gotten her relocated here to Canadia... maybe you can get her moved somewhere else, somewhere you’re not likely to ever go? You spend a few minutes digging up the info for the local U.G.C. relations officer, then shoot them off an email with your contact information. It doesn’t take long to get a call after that, and you’re speaking shortly with a tired-sounding, irritable female voice who, in between taking loud sips of whatever drink she has and typing away at her keyboard assures you that your complaint will be looked into."

rows.original: Report filed, you continue smugly on your way. There’s no way this could possibly backfire, right? Of course not.
rows.translation: 举报一交，你便得意地继续上路。这事总不可能反过来害了自己吧？当然不可能。
rows.raw: "\n\nReport filed, you continue smugly on your way. There’s no way this could possibly backfire, right? Of course not."

rows.original: Well, fuck. Back to square one. You’re not giving up, though. Fuming, you dig up Commander Grence’s contact information again, requesting a meeting with the gold-maned ausar. As before, she’s willing to meet with you on short notice - in fact, you get a response even faster this time, more than likely because of the help you provided against the Black Void. When you enter her office she’s at her desk, typing faster than you’ve ever seen... anyone type really, eyes scanning a screen you can’t see, fluffy yellow ears pinned against her skull. They stand straight up as you enter though, the woman turning to face you with a warm smile on her face.
rows.translation: 操，又回到原点了。不过你可没打算放弃。你气冲冲地重新找出格伦斯指挥官的联系方式，要求与这位金发的奥萨尔女性见面。和上次一样，她愿意临时安排会面。其实这次的回复来得更快，多半是因为你帮忙对付过黑色虚空。你走进办公室，她正坐在办公桌后打字，速度快得你从来没见过...没见过谁打字能这么快。她盯着一块你看不见的屏幕，毛茸茸的金黄色耳朵紧贴着脑袋。不过你一进门，那双耳朵便竖了起来。她转过身来，热情地朝你微笑。
rows.raw: "Well, fuck. Back to square one. You’re not giving up, though. Fuming, you dig up Commander Grence’s contact information again, requesting a meeting with the gold-maned ausar. As before, she’s willing to meet with you on short notice - in fact, you get a response even faster this time, more than likely because of the help you provided against the Black Void. When you enter her office she’s at her desk, typing faster than you’ve ever seen... anyone type really, eyes scanning a screen you can’t see, fluffy yellow ears pinned against her skull. They stand straight up as you enter though, the woman turning to face you with a warm smile on her face."

rows.original: “Good to see you again, Steele. How may I help you?” she asks, fingers steepled. You
rows.translation: “又见面了，斯蒂尔。有什么我能帮你的吗？”她问道，双手指尖相抵。你
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good to see you again, Steele. How may I help you?” she asks, fingers steepled. You "

rows.original: take a seat in front of her desk
rows.translation: 在她桌前坐下
rows.raw: "take a seat in front of her desk"

rows.original: stand before her desk
rows.translation: 站在她桌前
rows.raw: "stand before her desk"

rows.original: as she reaches under her desk for refreshments, coming up with nice cold glasses of fruit juice for both of you. Taking a sip and setting it down, you begin to speak. It’s about Riya again, you say, but before you can get even halfway through your sentence Grence raises her hand to interrupt you.
rows.translation: 。她伸手从桌底拿出饮料，给你们各倒了一杯冰凉可口的果汁。你喝了一口，放下杯子，开口说又是关于莉娅的事。可你连半句话都还没说完，格伦斯便抬手打断了你。
rows.raw: " as she reaches under her desk for refreshments, coming up with nice cold glasses of fruit juice for both of you. Taking a sip and setting it down, you begin to speak. It’s about Riya again, you say, but before you can get even halfway through your sentence Grence raises her hand to interrupt you."

rows.original: “Steele, do you think this is a taxi service?” she asks evenly, sipping her drink.
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔，你以为这是出租车服务吗？”她抿了一口果汁，语气平静地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele, do you think this is a taxi service?” she asks evenly, sipping her drink."

rows.original: What? Of course you don’t. What does that have to do with anything, you ask? The ausar women takes another sip before replying.
rows.translation: 什么？你当然没有这么想。你问她，这跟你说的事有什么关系？这位奥萨尔女性又喝了一口才回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat? Of course you don’t. What does that have to do with anything, you ask? The ausar women takes another sip before replying."

rows.original: “Do you think we’re going to endlessly shuttle Lieutenant Batra back and forth between duty stations?” she asks, still even and polite. “I understand that she’s abrasive, but honestly? I don’t have nearly as much of a problem with it now that I know I can trust her with my life. I’m very sorry, but I’m afraid I’m not going to try to reassign her this time.”
rows.translation: “你觉得我们能让巴特拉中尉在各个驻地之间无限期地调来调去吗？”她的语气依然平静而客气。“我知道她很呛人，可说实话吧，既然我已经知道她是个能托付性命的人，就没以前那么介意了。我确实很遗憾，可恐怕这次我不会再试着调走她。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you think we’re going to endlessly shuttle Lieutenant Batra back and forth between duty stations?” she asks, still even and polite. “I understand that she’s abrasive, but honestly? I don’t have nearly as much of a problem with it now that I know I can trust her with my life. I’m very sorry, but I’m afraid I’m not going to try to reassign her this time.”"

rows.original: You gape for a moment, speechless. Grence notes your demeanor and blinks, ears twitching. “Furthermore, aside from being the single most aggravating person I’ve met in the past year, she’s got an exemplary knack for busting up crime here on Tavros - including human crime - which makes me a lot less leery of her continued presence in my command. So... will that be all?”
rows.translation: 你张着嘴呆了一会儿，说不出话。格伦斯注意到你的反应，眨了眨眼，耳朵一抖。“再说了，她虽然是过去一年里我遇到的最让人恼火的人，打击塔夫罗斯站上的犯罪却是一把好手，连人类犯的案也照查。这让我对她继续留在我手下放心了不少。所以...还有别的事吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gape for a moment, speechless. Grence notes your demeanor and blinks, ears twitching. “Furthermore, aside from being the single most aggravating person I’ve met in the past year, she’s got an exemplary knack for busting up crime here on Tavros - including human crime - which makes me a lot less leery of her continued presence in my command. So... will that be all?”"

rows.translation: 是

rows.translation: 是

rows.original: Pieces of your mind are a valuable commodity and should not be sold, given, or traded lightly.
rows.translation: 你心里那几句真话可金贵了，不能随随便便就卖掉、送人，或拿去交换。
rows.raw: "Pieces of your mind are a valuable commodity and should not be sold, given, or traded lightly."

rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: Franks
rows.raw: "Franks"

rows.original: You figure the best thing to do is go to her superior officer. After all, they might just legitimately not know about her. Maybe she’s a new transfer?
rows.translation: 你觉得最妥当的办法是去找她的上司。毕竟，上司可能真不知道她的所作所为。说不定她才刚调来？
rows.raw: "You figure the best thing to do is go to her superior officer. After all, they might just legitimately not know about her. Maybe she’s a new transfer?"

rows.original: You say your goodbyes to Riya, walking around a corner out of her sight before fiddling with your Codex, performing a brief Extranet search for the head of the Tavros station U.G.C. detachment. It takes a few minutes, but it’s information, so it can only evade you for so long... and there it is. Commander Lorna Grence. A photo of the Commander pops up alongside her name - she’s an ausar! A surprisingly young one, considering her posting.
rows.translation: 你向莉娅道别，绕过拐角，等她看不见你了才拿出CODEX终端，在外联网上简单搜索塔夫罗斯站银河联合邦联分遣队的负责人。查起来花了几分钟，但只要是信息，就总有被你找到的时候...这不就有了。洛娜·格伦斯指挥官。姓名旁弹出了一张指挥官的照片，她是个奥萨尔人！以她的职位而言，年轻得出人意料。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou say your goodbyes to Riya, walking around a corner out of her sight before fiddling with your Codex, performing a brief Extranet search for the head of the Tavros station U.G.C. detachment. It takes a few minutes, but it’s information, so it can only evade you for so long... and there it is. Commander Lorna Grence. A photo of the Commander pops up alongside her name - she’s an ausar! A surprisingly young one, considering her posting."

rows.original: Not much older than
rows.translation: 年纪比
rows.raw: " Not much older than "

rows.raw: "Syri"

rows.translation: 安诺
rows.raw: "Anno"

rows.original: , if you had to hazard a guess.
rows.translation: 大不了多少，你猜。
rows.raw: ", if you had to hazard a guess."

rows.original: Well, this is going to be interesting.
rows.translation: 看来这下有意思了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, this is going to be interesting."

rows.original: It takes some doing to actually get in touch with the Commander’s office, but once you do they get back to you almost immediately, surprisingly. Probably the weight of the Steele family name at work. You’re offered an immediate appointment with the ausar woman, who you find sitting behind her desk in an immaculate uniform after your escort leads you to her office. She has bright blue eyes and fluffy, luxurious-looking golden fur and hair of the same color coating her head and perky ears - if not for the seriousness of the situation, you’d be extremely tempted to stroke it. She rises to shake your hand as you enter her office,
rows.translation: 你费了点功夫才联系到指挥官办公室，没想到对方几乎马上就给了回复。多半是斯蒂尔这个姓氏起了作用。办公室安排你立刻与这位奥萨尔女性见面。随行人员领你走进办公室时，她正坐在办公桌后，制服穿得一丝不苟。她有一双明亮的蓝眼睛，头上是同样金黄的秀发，竖起的双耳上也长着蓬松柔亮的金毛。要不是现在有正事，你肯定很想摸上一把。你走进办公室，她便起身与你握手，
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes some doing to actually get in touch with the Commander’s office, but once you do they get back to you almost immediately, surprisingly. Probably the weight of the Steele family name at work. You’re offered an immediate appointment with the ausar woman, who you find sitting behind her desk in an immaculate uniform after your escort leads you to her office. She has bright blue eyes and fluffy, luxurious-looking golden fur and hair of the same color coating her head and perky ears - if not for the seriousness of the situation, you’d be extremely tempted to stroke it. She rises to shake your hand as you enter her office, "

rows.original: ‘offering you refreshments.’
rows.translation: “请你喝点东西。”
rows.raw: "‘offering you refreshments.’"

rows.original: ‘offering you a seat and refreshments.’
rows.translation: “请你坐下，喝点东西。”
rows.raw: "‘offering you a seat and refreshments.’"

rows.original: “So, [pc.name] Steele wants an interview with me,” she begins, smiling warmly. “I’m flattered, but I assume you’re not just here to chat me up. What’s your concern, citizen?”
rows.translation: “原来是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔想见我一面。”她热情地笑着开口。“真是荣幸，不过我猜你来这里不是为了跟我闲聊。有什么事，公民？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, [pc.name] Steele wants an interview with me,” she begins, smiling warmly. “I’m flattered, but I assume you’re not just here to chat me up. What’s your concern, citizen?”"

rows.original: Straight to the point, this one. You name Riya, then go on to describe her treatment of nonhumans, noting as you talk that the Commander’s expression is growing pained. After you’re finished she sighs, ears flicking back, and begins to respond.
rows.translation: 这位倒是开门见山。你报出莉娅的名字，又说起她是怎么对待非人类的。你一边说，一边注意到指挥官的表情越来越难受。等你说完，她叹了口气，双耳往后一抿，这才开口。
rows.raw: "\n\nStraight to the point, this one. You name Riya, then go on to describe her treatment of nonhumans, noting as you talk that the Commander’s expression is growing pained. After you’re finished she sighs, ears flicking back, and begins to respond."

rows.original: <i>“Ugh. I do know about Riya, yes. And as much as I absolutely hate to say it,
rows.translation: <i>“唉。对，莉娅的事我知道。可有句话我实在不想说，斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Ugh. I do know about Riya, yes. And as much as I absolutely hate to say it, "

rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr."

rows.original: Ms.
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Ms."

rows.original: Steele, there’s not a lot I can do.”
rows.translation: ，我能做的事不多。”
rows.raw: " Steele, there’s not a lot I can do.”"

rows.original: What.
rows.translation: 什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat."

rows.original: Isn’t Riya under her, though? Isn’t Commander Grence, well, the Commander? The ausar woman sighs in exasperation, rubbing her temples.
rows.translation: 可莉娅不是她的下属吗？格伦斯指挥官不就是指挥官吗？这位奥萨尔女性恼火地叹了口气，揉了揉太阳穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nIsn’t Riya under her, though? Isn’t Commander Grence, well, the Commander? The ausar woman sighs in exasperation, rubbing her temples."

rows.original: “Steele, if it were up to me I’d have that dirtbag court-martialed and drummed out of the Peacekeeper Corps. It’s not up to me, though. She’s former special forces - lot of very important friends. She scratches their backs, they scratch hers. Last time I really pushed to have her punished, I was offered reassignment. It’s bullshit, quite frankly.” The poor woman looks absolutely livid as she speaks despite how impressively even her voice is, her golden canine ears flat against her skull, and you imagine you’re not even hearing the half of it from the way her nails are digging into her desk.
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔，要是由我说了算，我早把那个混蛋送上军事法庭，再把她轰出维和部队了。可这事轮不到我说了算。她以前在特种部队，认识不少大人物。她替他们办事，他们就罩着她。上回我真下了力气要处分她，结果倒是有人问我要不要调职。说白了，就是一堆狗屁。”可怜的格伦斯虽然语气平稳得惊人，看上去却已经气得够呛，一双金色犬耳紧紧贴着脑袋。看她的指甲都快抠进办公桌里了，你猜她说出来的恐怕连一半都不到。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele, if it were up to me I’d have that dirtbag court-martialed and drummed out of the Peacekeeper Corps. It’s not up to me, though. She’s former special forces - lot of very important friends. She scratches their backs, they scratch hers. Last time I really pushed to have her punished, I was offered reassignment. It’s bullshit, quite frankly.” The poor woman looks absolutely livid as she speaks despite how impressively even her voice is, her golden canine ears flat against her skull, and you imagine you’re not even hearing the half of it from the way her nails are digging into her desk."

rows.original: “I really am sorry, Steele. I wish there was more I could do. I can promise you that everything you’ve just told me stays between us, though,” she says, taking a deep breath and removing her nails from her desk, giving you a perfect view of the deep furrows her claws have left in the wood. She sighs, poking at them with her index finger. “Now, if you have any other comments, questions or concerns, I’ll do everything I can to help you.” Her ears are still pinned back against her skull as she says this, you note.
rows.translation: “我真的很遗憾，斯蒂尔。我也希望自己能多做一点。不过我可以保证，刚才你说的事只会留在我们之间。”她深吸一口气，从办公桌上抽回指甲，让你看清爪尖在木头里划出的几道深槽。她叹了口气，用食指戳了戳那些槽。“那么，你还有什么别的意见、疑问或顾虑吗？我会尽力帮你。”你注意到，她说这番话时，耳朵依然紧紧向后贴着脑袋。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I really am sorry, Steele. I wish there was more I could do. I can promise you that everything you’ve just told me stays between us, though,” she says, taking a deep breath and removing her nails from her desk, giving you a perfect view of the deep furrows her claws have left in the wood. She sighs, poking at them with her index finger. “Now, if you have any other comments, questions or concerns, I’ll do everything I can to help you.” Her ears are still pinned back against her skull as she says this, you note."

rows.original: Snap
rows.translation: 发火
rows.raw: "Snap"

rows.original: Snap
rows.translation: 发火
rows.raw: "Snap"

rows.original: Give the fluffy Commander a piece of your mind. Kind of a dick move, considering that she seems every bit as angry as you do.
rows.translation: 对这位毛茸茸的指挥官发一通火。考虑到她看起来和你一样生气，这么做有点混蛋。
rows.raw: "Give the fluffy Commander a piece of your mind. Kind of a dick move, considering that she seems every bit as angry as you do."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Franks
rows.raw: "Franks"

rows.original: You point a finger at the Commander accusingly - what is the meaning of this? She’s Riya’s commanding officer, damn it, and you’d appreciate it if she acted like it instead of literally tucking her tail between her legs and letting the woman do whatever she wants. You give her a tongue lashing that lasts a good twenty seconds or so, through which the senior officer sits wordlessly. After you finish, though, you see that she looks... hurt.
rows.translation: 你指着指挥官，厉声质问她这是什么意思。她他妈是莉娅的直属长官。你倒希望她拿出点长官的样子，别真夹起尾巴，任由那女人为所欲为。你劈头盖脸地骂了足有二十来秒，那位高级军官坐在那里，一句话都没说。但等你骂完，才看到她似乎...很受伤。
rows.raw: "You point a finger at the Commander accusingly - what is the meaning of this? She’s Riya’s commanding officer, damn it, and you’d appreciate it if she acted like it instead of literally tucking her tail between her legs and letting the woman do whatever she wants. You give her a tongue lashing that lasts a good twenty seconds or so, through which the senior officer sits wordlessly. After you finish, though, you see that she looks... hurt."

rows.original: “Get out of my office, Steele. You clearly have no desire to understand my position,” she says, pointedly looking away from you and poking at the claw marks in her desk, eyes downcast.
rows.translation: “离开我的办公室，斯蒂尔。你显然压根儿不想理解我的处境。”她故意不看你，只垂着眼拨弄桌上的爪痕。

rows.translation: 刚走下飞船，你就意识到自己究竟把事情搞砸到了什么程度。没有人呼叫你，也没人试图阻止你靠港，但现在你看见大约十二具身穿黑色虚空装甲的尸体横七竖八地散落在地，爆炸痕迹和血迹玷污了原本出奇洁净的墙壁；视野边缘一道模糊影子闪过，紧接着你便被扑倒在地，至少四名戴着面具、身披装甲的士兵毫不温柔地叠压在你身上。你隐约听到一个声音命令他们把你翻过来；他们立刻照办。你眨眨眼，看到莉娅和格伦斯指挥官站在面前。莉娅率先开口，目光明显冰冷。
rows.raw: "As soon as you get out of your ship, you realize exactly how badly you fucked up. Nobody hailed you or tried to stop you from docking in, but now you see the dozen or so Black Void armored bodies strewn haphazardly about, blast marks and bloodstains marring the otherwise surprisingly pristine walls, and a blur at the edge of your vision right before you’re tackled to the ground and dogpiled none too gently by no less than four masked, armored soldiers. You faintly hear a voice ordering them to flip you over - they do so promptly, and you blink, seeing Riya and Commander Grence standing over you. Riya is the first to speak, eyes distinctly cold."

rows.original: “You just landed your ship in the middle of a special forces raid on a Black Void base. What in the everlasting fuck are you doing here, Steele?” she asks, smoothly drawing her sidearm and cocking it, waiting for an answer. “Choose your next words carefully.”
rows.translation: “你刚把飞船降落在特种部队突袭黑色虚空基地的正中央。你他妈到底来这里干什么，斯蒂尔？”她问道，流畅地拔出随身武器并上膛，等待你的回答。“仔细选择接下来要说的话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You just landed your ship in the middle of a special forces raid on a Black Void base. What in the everlasting fuck are you doing here, Steele?” she asks, smoothly drawing her sidearm and cocking it, waiting for an answer. “Choose your next words carefully.”"

rows.original: You open your mouth to reply, but just then an explosion rocks the asteroid, sending everyone nearby - Riya and Grence included - sprawling to the ground. You quickly gain your [pc.legs], taking cover and grabbing your [pc.weapon] as more Void soldiers pour through the hangar doors. Riya and company are on their feet in record time, trading fire with the pirates in a series of plasma flashes so bright as to be nearly blinding.
rows.translation: 你张嘴想要回答，恰在此时，一场爆炸撼动了小行星，把附近所有人，包括莉娅和格伦斯，都掀翻在地。你迅速站稳[pc.legs]，寻找掩护并抓起[pc.weapon]，更多虚空士兵则涌过机库大门。莉娅一行人以创纪录的速度起身，在一连串几乎耀眼到令人失明的等离子闪光中与海盗交火。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou open your mouth to reply, but just then an explosion rocks the asteroid, sending everyone nearby - Riya and Grence included - sprawling to the ground. You quickly gain your [pc.legs], taking cover and grabbing your [pc.weapon] as more Void soldiers pour through the hangar doors. Riya and company are on their feet in record time, trading fire with the pirates in a series of plasma flashes so bright as to be nearly blinding."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: VOID GOONS
rows.raw: "VOID GOONS"

rows.original: OH NO...
rows.translation: 哦不...
rows.raw: "OH NO..."

rows.original: As your knees hit the metal of the deck, you look up to see the pirates advancing on you, the sound of their taunting laughter filling your ears - then a blinding flash, and then... nothing. Grence, Riya and the rest may make it out without you, or they may not. It’s of no consequence to the pile of charcoal that used to be [pc.name] Steele.
rows.translation: 膝盖撞上甲板金属时，你抬头看见海盗向自己逼近，耳中充斥着他们嘲弄的笑声，接着是一道刺眼闪光，然后...什么也没有了。格伦斯、莉娅和其他人或许能在没有你的情况下逃出去，也或许不能。这对那堆曾经是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔的焦炭而言，已经无关紧要。
rows.raw: "As your knees hit the metal of the deck, you look up to see the pirates advancing on you, the sound of their taunting laughter filling your ears - then a blinding flash, and then... nothing. Grence, Riya and the rest may make it out without you, or they may not. It’s of no consequence to the pile of charcoal that used to be [pc.name] Steele."

rows.original: GAME OVER.
rows.translation: 游戏结束。
rows.raw: "GAME OVER."

rows.original: As the last of the pirates falls, Riya turns to face you, blinking and speaking. “Well then. Guess you’re with us for now, Steele. We’re conducting a raid on this station because we’ve traced a large amount of slavery, weapons and drug running operations being conducted by the Black Void back here - this is one of their hubs, as far as we can tell. I’m sure it won’t stop them from setting up shop on another asteroid somewhere, but we can at least use whatever info we get here to break up some of their crime rings. Come on,” she says, jogging down a hallway leading further into the station.
rows.translation: 最后一名海盗倒下后，莉娅转身面对你，眨着眼睛说道：“好吧。那么眼下你就跟我们一起行动，斯蒂尔。我们突袭这座空间站，是因为追踪到黑色虚空在此进行大量奴隶贸易、武器走私和毒品运输活动；据我们所知，这里是他们的一个枢纽。我敢肯定，这阻止不了他们在其他某颗小行星上另起炉灶，但我们至少可以利用在这里获取的情报，瓦解他们的一些犯罪网络。来吧，”她说着，沿一条深入空间站的走廊小跑而去。
rows.raw: "As the last of the pirates falls, Riya turns to face you, blinking and speaking. “Well then. Guess you’re with us for now, Steele. We’re conducting a raid on this station because we’ve traced a large amount of slavery, weapons and drug running operations being conducted by the Black Void back here - this is one of their hubs, as far as we can tell. I’m sure it won’t stop them from setting up shop on another asteroid somewhere, but we can at least use whatever info we get here to break up some of their crime rings. Come on,” she says, jogging down a hallway leading further into the station."

rows.original: So what’s the deal with Riya? You’re guessing she’s not really a cop...
rows.translation: 所以莉娅究竟是怎么回事？你猜她其实不是真正的警察...
rows.raw: "So what’s the deal with Riya? You’re guessing she’s not really a cop..."

rows.original: Grence nods, fluffy golden ears swiveling to and fro rapidly. <i>“Nope. She’s still in the Ebon Wing, as it turns out.
rows.translation: 格伦斯点点头，毛茸茸的金色耳朵飞快地来回转动。<i>“不是。结果证明，她仍然隶属于黑翼。
rows.raw: "\n\nGrence nods, fluffy golden ears swiveling to and fro rapidly. <i>“Nope. She’s still in the Ebon Wing, as it turns out. "

rows.original: This explains why I wasn’t able to get her in any kind of trouble.
rows.translation: 这就解释了我为什么没办法给她惹上任何麻烦。
rows.raw: "This explains why I wasn’t able to get her in any kind of trouble. "

rows.original: This explains why she got a soundproofed office. And this explains...” she pauses, ears twitching as she jogs. “Well. And a lot of other things. Nobody ever told me, but I really should’ve figured it out before now. It doesn’t explain how someone with her unashamed, disgusting racism rose to the upper echelons of soldiery, though,” she finishes, simmering anger clear on her pale face as her ears pin back against her skull.
rows.translation: 这解释了她为什么有一间隔音办公室。也解释了...”她停顿下来，边跑边抖动耳朵。“嗯，还解释了很多其他事情。没人告诉过我，但我其实早就该弄明白了。不过，这解释不了一个毫不羞耻、种族主义得令人作呕的人，究竟如何爬到军队高层，”她说完时，苍白的脸上显然压抑着怒火，耳朵紧贴在头骨上。
rows.raw: "This explains why she got a soundproofed office. And this explains...” she pauses, ears twitching as she jogs. “Well. And a lot of other things. Nobody ever told me, but I really should’ve figured it out before now. It doesn’t explain how someone with her unashamed, disgusting racism rose to the upper echelons of soldiery, though,” she finishes, simmering anger clear on her pale face as her ears pin back against her skull."

rows.original: The burly, surprisingly masculine kaithrit keeping pace with the two of you takes this moment to speak up, his voice a rumbling, deep growl. “She’s not as bad as all that, believe it or not. In combat, Lieutenant Batra is one of the finest sapient beings in the galaxy. She just needs someone to throw hand grenades at her for the rest of her life,” he says, chuckling. Commander Grence looks unconvinced, but says nothing.
rows.translation: 那个体格魁梧、出奇阳刚，并与两人保持相同步伐的凯斯里特趁此时开口，声音是隆隆作响的低沉咆哮。“信不信由你，她没那么糟。在战斗中，巴特拉中尉是整个星系最优秀的智慧生命之一。她只不过需要余生都有人朝她扔手榴弹而已。”他轻笑着说。格伦斯指挥官显然并不信服，却没有出声。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe burly, surprisingly masculine kaithrit keeping pace with the two of you takes this moment to speak up, his voice a rumbling, deep growl. “She’s not as bad as all that, believe it or not. In combat, Lieutenant Batra is one of the finest sapient beings in the galaxy. She just needs someone to throw hand grenades at her for the rest of her life,” he says, chuckling. Commander Grence looks unconvinced, but says nothing."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: So, you ask, how did Grence herself end up tagging along for this mission? She doesn’t look like a fighter, you say - no offense intended, of course. She actually giggles a bit before answering. “None taken, Steele. It’s true enough - I’m a desk jockey. I can finish a stack of paperwork half as tall as me in record time, I can get leave approved for just about any of my officers, I can save credits like nobody else, I pull overtime almost every day, and I’m cute as a button to boot. It’s how I got promoted so fast. I’m only thirty, you know.” she says proudly. That is pretty impressive, you have to admit. She never answered your initial question, though - what made a self-admitted desk jockey like her tag along for a dangerous top secret mission?
rows.translation: 于是你问道，格伦斯本人又是怎么参与这次任务的？你说，她看起来不像战士，当然，无意冒犯。她回答前居然轻笑了一下。“没有冒犯，斯蒂尔。事实的确如此，我是个坐办公室的。我能以创纪录的速度处理完一摞有我半人高的文书，能替几乎任何一名下属批准休假，省信用点的本事无人能及，几乎每天都会加班，而且还长得可爱得不得了。这就是我晋升这么快的原因。要知道，我才三十岁。”她骄傲地说道。你不得不承认，这的确相当了不起。但她仍然没有回答你最初的问题，究竟是什么让一个自称坐办公室的人参加危险的绝密任务？
rows.raw: "So, you ask, how did Grence herself end up tagging along for this mission? She doesn’t look like a fighter, you say - no offense intended, of course. She actually giggles a bit before answering. “None taken, Steele. It’s true enough - I’m a desk jockey. I can finish a stack of paperwork half as tall as me in record time, I can get leave approved for just about any of my officers, I can save credits like nobody else, I pull overtime almost every day, and I’m cute as a button to boot. It’s how I got promoted so fast. I’m only thirty, you know.” she says proudly. That is pretty impressive, you have to admit. She never answered your initial question, though - what made a self-admitted desk jockey like her tag along for a dangerous top secret mission?"

rows.original: Her ears droop off to the sides, and she looks sheepish, even a bit ashamed.
rows.translation: 她的耳朵向两侧耷拉下来，显得局促不安，甚至有些羞愧。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer ears droop off to the sides, and she looks sheepish, even a bit ashamed."

rows.original: “I kinda, well... I kinda forced my way in. I was so ticked off at Riya that when she told me she had a top secret matter to attend to, I pulled rank. I do have top secret clearance after all, being a Commander, but I never would’ve been approved to tag along on a raid like this. And rightfully so,” she says, baby blue eyes shifting. “I’m way more than a little bit in over my head. Those pirates you fought back in the hangar would’ve eaten me alive, and apparently they’re the small fries.”
rows.translation: “我算是，嗯...算是硬挤进来的。我当时对莉娅气坏了，所以她告诉我有一件绝密事务需要处理时，我就用军衔压她。毕竟身为指挥官，我的确拥有绝密许可，但上面绝不会批准我参加这样的突袭行动。而且他们不批准才是对的，”她说着，浅蓝色的眼睛游移不定。“这完全超出了我的能力。你在机库里对付的那些海盗会把我生吞活剥，而他们显然还只是小喽啰。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I kinda, well... I kinda forced my way in. I was so ticked off at Riya that when she told me she had a top secret matter to attend to, I pulled rank. I do have top secret clearance after all, being a Commander, but I never would’ve been approved to tag along on a raid like this. And rightfully so,” she says, baby blue eyes shifting. “I’m way more than a little bit in over my head. Those pirates you fought back in the hangar would’ve eaten me alive, and apparently they’re the small fries.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Making your way further into the asteroid complex, you’re stopped by a barricade, small arms fire spraying out from behind it - up until the kaithrit you spoke to earlier lifts his rifle next to your shoulder and fires the grenade launcher slung under the rifle’s barrel. The barricade explodes in a deafening hail of shrapnel and fire, and you continue on. The group doesn’t get very far though, before you find yourselves in what appears to be a planning room - datachips, holo-tapes and even regular old-fashioned stacks of paper are strewn haphazardly across the many tables, control centers and desks. Buttons and beeping alarms are flashing everywhere, and a few helmless pirates of assorted races are frantically setting fire to everything and smashing computers with sledgehammers. They stop when your group enters the room, diving for cover and drawing their weapons.
rows.translation: 你们继续深入小行星设施，却被一道路障挡住，轻武器火力从后方喷射而出，直到先前和你交谈过的凯斯里特在你肩旁举起步枪，发射了挂在枪管下方的榴弹发射器。路障在震耳欲聋的弹片与烈焰风暴中爆炸，你们继续前进。然而队伍没走多远，就来到一间看似规划室的地方；数据芯片、全息磁带，甚至一叠叠老式纸张都杂乱地散落在众多桌子、控制台和办公桌上。到处都有按钮与蜂鸣警报器闪烁，几个未戴头盔、种族各异的海盗正疯狂地放火烧毁一切，并用大锤砸烂电脑。你的队伍进入房间时，他们停下动作，扑向掩体并拔出武器。
rows.raw: "Making your way further into the asteroid complex, you’re stopped by a barricade, small arms fire spraying out from behind it - up until the kaithrit you spoke to earlier lifts his rifle next to your shoulder and fires the grenade launcher slung under the rifle’s barrel. The barricade explodes in a deafening hail of shrapnel and fire, and you continue on. The group doesn’t get very far though, before you find yourselves in what appears to be a planning room - datachips, holo-tapes and even regular old-fashioned stacks of paper are strewn haphazardly across the many tables, control centers and desks. Buttons and beeping alarms are flashing everywhere, and a few helmless pirates of assorted races are frantically setting fire to everything and smashing computers with sledgehammers. They stop when your group enters the room, diving for cover and drawing their weapons."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: VOID GOONS
rows.raw: "VOID GOONS"

rows.original: Riya & Commander
rows.translation: 莉娅与指挥官
rows.raw: "Riya & Commander"

rows.original: GRENCE
rows.raw: "GRENCE"

rows.original: _NUDE
rows.raw: "_NUDE"

rows.original: As the last of the pirates you were fighting collapses, you see movement out of the corner of your eye - head swiveling, you see it’s Commander Grence, kicking and clawing frantically as she’s dragged down a hallway by two pirates in full armor, her eyes wild and full of terror. More pirates are laying down covering fire on you and the Ebon Wing troopers beside you. They must’ve seen her rank and grabbed her while everyone was distracted fighting!
rows.translation: 你们正在交战的最后一名海盗倒下时，你从眼角看到动静；猛地转头，你发现那是格伦斯指挥官。两名全副武装的海盗正拖着她穿过走廊，她疯狂地踢打抓挠，双眼充满惊恐。更多海盗正向你和身旁的黑翼士兵倾泻掩护火力。他们一定是看到了她的军衔，趁所有人忙于战斗时抓住了她！
rows.raw: "As the last of the pirates you were fighting collapses, you see movement out of the corner of your eye - head swiveling, you see it’s Commander Grence, kicking and clawing frantically as she’s dragged down a hallway by two pirates in full armor, her eyes wild and full of terror. More pirates are laying down covering fire on you and the Ebon Wing troopers beside you. They must’ve seen her rank and grabbed her while everyone was distracted fighting!\n\n"

rows.original: BLACK_VOID_JUGGERNAUT
rows.raw: "BLACK_VOID_JUGGERNAUT"

rows.original: HOVER_DRONE
rows.raw: "HOVER_DRONE"

rows.original: HOVER_DRONE
rows.raw: "HOVER_DRONE"

rows.original: Black Void Juggernaut
rows.translation: 黑色虚空重装兵
rows.raw: "Black Void Juggernaut"

rows.original: OH SHIT!
rows.translation: 哦，该死！
rows.raw: "OH SHIT!"

rows.original: Just then, as if on cue, you hear the sound of metal clanking against the deck plates. Turning, you see a hulking humanoid in Black Void armor bringing weapons to bear on you, two sentry drones angrily buzzing about him.
rows.translation: 就在此时，仿佛配合着这一幕，你听到金属撞击甲板的铿锵声。转过身，你看见一个身穿黑色虚空装甲的魁梧类人生物正把武器瞄准你，两台哨戒无人机在他身边愤怒地嗡嗡盘旋。
rows.raw: "Just then, as if on cue, you hear the sound of metal clanking against the deck plates. Turning, you see a hulking humanoid in Black Void armor bringing weapons to bear on you, two sentry drones angrily buzzing about him."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: JUGGERNAUT
rows.raw: "JUGGERNAUT"

rows.original: UH OH...
rows.translation: 不妙...
rows.raw: "UH OH..."

rows.original: As your knees hit the metal of the deck, you look up to see the Juggernaut advancing on you, the sound of his taunting laughter filling your ears - then a blinding flash, and then... nothing. Grence, Riya and the rest may make it out without you, or they may not. It’s of no consequence to the pile of charcoal that used to be [pc.name] Steele.
rows.translation: 膝盖撞上甲板金属时，你抬头看见重装兵向自己逼近，耳中充斥着他嘲弄的笑声，接着是一道刺眼闪光，然后...什么也没有了。格伦斯、莉娅和其他人或许能在没有你的情况下逃出去，也或许不能。这对那堆曾经是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔的焦炭而言，已经无关紧要。
rows.raw: "As your knees hit the metal of the deck, you look up to see the Juggernaut advancing on you, the sound of his taunting laughter filling your ears - then a blinding flash, and then... nothing. Grence, Riya and the rest may make it out without you, or they may not. It’s of no consequence to the pile of charcoal that used to be [pc.name] Steele."

rows.original: GAME OVER
rows.translation: 游戏结束
rows.raw: "GAME OVER"

rows.original: Commander & Riya
rows.translation: 指挥官与莉娅
rows.raw: "Commander & Riya"

rows.original: As the last of your enemies falls, you look over to see Riya and co. rifling through the pockets of their fallen foes, presumably looking for more information or trophies. After a moment they’re finished, jogging back down the corridor towards the hangar as the asteroid takes another impact, your feet barely staying under you. You meet no opposition on your way back to the hangar, though you notice the short run has poor Commander Grence completely out of breath, her fluffy ears drooping as she struggles to hold the duffel bag in her arms aloft. Riya slows down as you reach the hangar, plucks the bag out of the tuckered-out ausar’s hands and bends down, scooping the unresisting Commander up around her belly and carrying her into their ship.
rows.translation: 最后一名敌人倒下后，你转头看去，发现莉娅一行人正在搜查倒下敌人的口袋，大概是在寻找更多情报或战利品。片刻后，他们完成了搜查，沿走廊向机库跑去；小行星又遭到一次撞击，你的双脚几乎无法站稳。回机库的路上没有遇到抵抗，不过你注意到，这段短跑已经让可怜的格伦斯指挥官彻底喘不过气；她毛茸茸的耳朵耷拉着，怀里那只旅行袋也几乎举不起来。抵达机库后，莉娅放慢脚步，从筋疲力尽的奥萨手中取走袋子，俯身环住毫不反抗的指挥官的腹部，将她抱起来带进了他们的飞船。
rows.raw: "As the last of your enemies falls, you look over to see Riya and co. rifling through the pockets of their fallen foes, presumably looking for more information or trophies. After a moment they’re finished, jogging back down the corridor towards the hangar as the asteroid takes another impact, your feet barely staying under you. You meet no opposition on your way back to the hangar, though you notice the short run has poor Commander Grence completely out of breath, her fluffy ears drooping as she struggles to hold the duffel bag in her arms aloft. Riya slows down as you reach the hangar, plucks the bag out of the tuckered-out ausar’s hands and bends down, scooping the unresisting Commander up around her belly and carrying her into their ship.\n\n"

rows.original: Maybe Riya has grown on you. Maybe you never wanted her gone in the first place. Whatever your reason is, you consider for a moment and then tell the golden pup before you that you’d rather she stays. After all, as Grence pointed out, she did save the Commander’s life at no small risk to her own. She can’t be that bad.
rows.translation: 也许莉娅已经逐渐赢得了你的好感。也许你从一开始就不希望她离开。不论出于什么原因，你思索片刻，随后告诉面前这只金毛小狗，你宁愿让莉娅留下。毕竟，正如格伦斯指出的，她冒着不小的风险救了指挥官一命。她不可能那么糟糕。
rows.raw: "Maybe Riya has grown on you. Maybe you never wanted her gone in the first place. Whatever your reason is, you consider for a moment and then tell the golden pup before you that you’d rather she stays. After all, as Grence pointed out, she did save the Commander’s life at no small risk to her own. She can’t be that bad."

rows.original: Grence nods, ears still swiveling slowly.
rows.translation: 格伦斯点点头，耳朵仍然缓缓转动。
rows.raw: "\n\nGrence nods, ears still swiveling slowly."

rows.original: “Yeah. It’d be nice to have more reliable hands around, too. I’ll have to have a talk with her first, though...”
rows.translation: “是啊。身边多一些可靠的人手也挺好。不过，我得先和她谈谈...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah. It’d be nice to have more reliable hands around, too. I’ll have to have a talk with her first, though...”"

rows.original: No, you say, shaking your head for emphasis. Riya may be a good soldier, but she’s not a good person, and you don’t want to have to deal with her and her nastiness - or for anyone else to be subjected to it, for that matter. Besides, she’ll be an even better soldier once she learns to respect other species.
rows.translation: 不，你摇着头强调自己的意见。莉娅也许是个优秀的士兵，但她不是一个好人；你不想忍受她和她的恶劣态度，也不想让其他任何人承受这些。况且，一旦学会尊重其他种族，她会成为一个更出色的士兵。
rows.raw: "No, you say, shaking your head for emphasis. Riya may be a good soldier, but she’s not a good person, and you don’t want to have to deal with her and her nastiness - or for anyone else to be subjected to it, for that matter. Besides, she’ll be an even better soldier once she learns to respect other species."

rows.original: Grence nods, ears still swiveling slowly.
rows.translation: 格伦斯点点头，耳朵仍然缓缓转动。

rows.original: “Yeah. Yeah, you’re right. I can’t risk her causing a PR nightmare here, or... yeah.”

rows.original: This is absolutely absurd, and you don’t mind saying so. How can she possibly want Riya to stay, after all the things she’s said? After she herself tried to get her removed? The Commander thinks for a moment, expression softening. “Steele, I understand where you’re coming from. I do. But as abrasive and obnoxious as Riya can be, she’s someone I can truly rely on. That’s... not as common as I’d like it to be, in the Peacekeepers or the U.G.C. in general. If you haven’t noticed, there aren’t nearly as many competent people in this organization as we need. So like I said... knowing now that I can rely on her, the benefits of having Riya around outweigh the detriments. I’m sorry, but that’s my decision and it’s final. I’ll have one of my officers see you out.”
rows.translation: 这实在荒谬至极，你也不介意直说。说了那么多话之后，她怎么可能还希望莉娅留下？她本人不是也曾设法把莉娅赶走吗？指挥官思考了片刻，神情随之缓和。“斯蒂尔，我理解你的想法。真的。但莉娅虽然尖刻又令人讨厌，却是一个我真正可以依靠的人。这一点...无论在维和部队还是整个银河联合邦联，都不像我希望的那么常见。如果你还没注意到，这个组织里称职的人远远没有我们需要的那么多。所以就像我刚才说的...既然现在知道可以信任她，让莉娅留下的好处就超过了坏处。很抱歉，但这是我的决定，而且不会改变。我会让一名警官送你出去。”
rows.raw: "This is absolutely absurd, and you don’t mind saying so. How can she possibly want Riya to stay, after all the things she’s said? After she herself tried to get her removed? The Commander thinks for a moment, expression softening. “Steele, I understand where you’re coming from. I do. But as abrasive and obnoxious as Riya can be, she’s someone I can truly rely on. That’s... not as common as I’d like it to be, in the Peacekeepers or the U.G.C. in general. If you haven’t noticed, there aren’t nearly as many competent people in this organization as we need. So like I said... knowing now that I can rely on her, the benefits of having Riya around outweigh the detriments. I’m sorry, but that’s my decision and it’s final. I’ll have one of my officers see you out.”"

rows.original: You turn towards them, weapon raised, but they just jerk Grence around so she’s in the line of fire and keep retreating... they’re almost at the door when Riya of all people comes out of nowhere, elbowing one of the pirates in the jaw and scooping the golden-haired ausar up like a baby, setting out towards you at a full sprint. She’s unable to use her weapons while carrying Grence and so naturally the Black Void open fire, plasma bolts and slugs skipping off the deck as the dusky [shemale|npc|f] makes her escape. Her squadmates lay down covering fire, and the pirates are forced to retreat down the corridor, diving and sliding on her back to safety. Grence simply stares at her, jaw working silently for a moment as Riya sets her down on her legs, the ausar woman still clutching the human’s forearms.
rows.translation: 你转身面向他们，举起武器，可他们只是猛地把格伦斯拽到你的射线上，挡着自己继续后撤...眼看就要退到门口，偏偏是莉娅不知从哪儿冲了出来，一肘打在一个海盗的下巴上，像抱婴儿一样把这位金发奥萨尔人抱起来，撒腿朝你冲来。抱着格伦斯，她没法用武器，黑色虚空的人自然立刻开火。这位深肤色的[shemale|npc|f]奔逃时，等离子弹和实弹擦着甲板四处弹飞。她的队友开火掩护，逼得海盗沿走廊后撤。莉娅纵身一扑，背贴甲板滑进安全地带。格伦斯只是呆呆地望着她，下巴无声地动了片刻。莉娅扶她站稳时，这位奥萨尔女性还紧紧抓着对方的前臂。
rows.raw: "You turn towards them, weapon raised, but they just jerk Grence around so she’s in the line of fire and keep retreating... they’re almost at the door when Riya of all people comes out of nowhere, elbowing one of the pirates in the jaw and scooping the golden-haired ausar up like a baby, setting out towards you at a full sprint. She’s unable to use her weapons while carrying Grence and so naturally the Black Void open fire, plasma bolts and slugs skipping off the deck as the dusky [shemale|npc|f] makes her escape. Her squadmates lay down covering fire, and the pirates are forced to retreat down the corridor, diving and sliding on her back to safety. Grence simply stares at her, jaw working silently for a moment as Riya sets her down on her legs, the ausar woman still clutching the human’s forearms."

rows.original: “You... saved me. You risked your life. I thought-” the ausar cuts off as Riya begins to talk over her.
rows.translation: “你...救了我。你豁出命救我。我还以为——”莉娅一开口压过她的声音，这位奥萨尔人便住了口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You... saved me. You risked your life. I thought-” the ausar cuts off as Riya begins to talk over her."

rows.original: “All fucking ausar must fucking hang,” Riya says, smug grin on her face. Grence just stares at her in bewilderment for a second... and then slaps her across the face and storms away, the sound cracking through the room. The kaithrit soldier shakes his head slowly as the group begins to rifle through the scattered datacards and other bits of information in the room, Grence joining in with her ears pinned flat against her skull while Riya stands guard, smirking. A few short moments later, Grence’s ears stand straight up and her bushy golden tail begins to wag slowly. The ausar officer hurriedly and carefully places a stack of papers into Riya’s hands, her earlier anger seemingly forgotten amidst the excitement of whatever she’s found. Riya takes it and stares at it for a moment before smiling and wrapping one arm around Grence’s shoulders, pulling the high-ranking pup tight against her side.
rows.translation: “所有他妈的奥萨尔人都该他妈被吊死。”莉娅一脸得意地说。格伦斯茫然地盯了她一秒...紧接着甩了她一耳光，啪的一声响彻整间屋子，然后怒气冲冲地走开。队伍开始翻查房间里散落的数据卡和其他情报，那名凯斯里特士兵慢慢摇了摇头。格伦斯耳朵紧贴头皮，也加入搜索。莉娅带着坏笑站在旁边警戒。片刻之后，格伦斯的双耳突然竖了起来，蓬松的金色尾巴开始慢慢摇晃。她急忙把一叠文件小心翼翼地递给莉娅，似乎太为自己的发现兴奋，先前的火气早抛到了脑后。莉娅接过来，盯着看了片刻，随后笑着伸出一条胳膊揽住格伦斯的肩膀，把这位军衔不低的小狗紧紧搂在身侧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All fucking ausar must fucking hang,” Riya says, smug grin on her face. Grence just stares at her in bewilderment for a second... and then slaps her across the face and storms away, the sound cracking through the room. The kaithrit soldier shakes his head slowly as the group begins to rifle through the scattered datacards and other bits of information in the room, Grence joining in with her ears pinned flat against her skull while Riya stands guard, smirking. A few short moments later, Grence’s ears stand straight up and her bushy golden tail begins to wag slowly. The ausar officer hurriedly and carefully places a stack of papers into Riya’s hands, her earlier anger seemingly forgotten amidst the excitement of whatever she’s found. Riya takes it and stares at it for a moment before smiling and wrapping one arm around Grence’s shoulders, pulling the high-ranking pup tight against her side."

rows.original: “Jackpot,” she says, handing the papers off to another helmeted trooper who stows them in a duffel bag at his side, the container already almost overflowing with other captured information. “Alright,” Riya says, releasing a now confused-looking Commander Grence, “let’s get the fuck out of here before more scumbags show up.”
rows.translation: “中大奖了。”她说着，把文件交给另一名戴头盔的士兵。那人把它们塞进身边的行军包，里头已经装满其他缴获的情报，几乎要溢出来。“行了。”莉娅松开此时一脸困惑的格伦斯指挥官。“趁更多杂碎赶来之前，赶紧他妈地撤。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Jackpot,” she says, handing the papers off to another helmeted trooper who stows them in a duffel bag at his side, the container already almost overflowing with other captured information. “Alright,” Riya says, releasing a now confused-looking Commander Grence, “let’s get the fuck out of here before more scumbags show up.”"

rows.original: “Gotta get your ass in shape, Rover!” she quips as plasma bolts begin to splatter off the decks and ships around you, the pirates making a last-ditch effort to save their intel. You make your way onto your own ship with time to spare, the Ebon Wing dropship firing up and lifting off alongside you. The naval battle you were watching earlier is drawing to a close, with several reinforcement ships from the U.G.C. Navy having entered the fight. In fact, just as you leave the system the last of the pirate ships explodes down its port side, the warship listing off to the side with crew members being sucked into the hard vacuum of space by the dozens. It’s over. And now you notice that the dropship carrying Riya and Grence is gone too, presumably having started the jump back to Tavros. You key in the coordinates too, not wanting to be mistaken for a hostile by the small U.G.C. fleet that is currently searching the asteroid field for any surviving pirates.
rows.translation: “该好好练练了，狗子！”她打趣道。等离子弹开始打在你们周围的甲板和飞船上，迸得四处都是。海盗正在孤注一掷，试图保住自己的情报。你绰绰有余地赶回自己的船，黑翼登陆艇也点火升空，与你并行。早些时候你看到的太空海战已接近尾声，银河联合邦联海军的几艘增援舰也已加入战斗。就在你离开星系时，最后一艘海盗船的左舷炸开，战舰斜斜倾向一边，几十名船员被卷进冰冷的太空真空。结束了。你这才发现，载着莉娅和格伦斯的登陆艇也消失了，想必已经跃迁返回塔夫罗斯站。你也输入了坐标，免得那支正在小行星带搜寻幸存海盗的小型邦联舰队把你当成敌人。
rows.raw: "“Gotta get your ass in shape, Rover!” she quips as plasma bolts begin to splatter off the decks and ships around you, the pirates making a last-ditch effort to save their intel. You make your way onto your own ship with time to spare, the Ebon Wing dropship firing up and lifting off alongside you. The naval battle you were watching earlier is drawing to a close, with several reinforcement ships from the U.G.C. Navy having entered the fight. In fact, just as you leave the system the last of the pirate ships explodes down its port side, the warship listing off to the side with crew members being sucked into the hard vacuum of space by the dozens. It’s over. And now you notice that the dropship carrying Riya and Grence is gone too, presumably having started the jump back to Tavros. You key in the coordinates too, not wanting to be mistaken for a hostile by the small U.G.C. fleet that is currently searching the asteroid field for any surviving pirates."

rows.original: Arriving back at Tavros, you’re immediately hailed by the station’s chief customs officer and instructed to dock and submit to inspection. The wrinkled, tired-looking old human man looks incredibly bored as he sips his coffee and waits for you to comply. Not very much time later you’re stepping off your ship to the sight of Riya, Grence and a few of the troopers from the raid on the pirates. Grence steps forward and hands you a small stack of papers and pen, blinking as you take it, then speaking.
rows.translation: 一回到塔夫罗斯站，空间站的海关主管就立刻呼叫你，要求你停靠并接受检查。那位满脸皱纹、神情疲惫的人类老头一边啜咖啡，一边等你照做，一副无聊透顶的样子。没过多久，你走下飞船，迎面就见到莉娅、格伦斯和几名突袭海盗时的士兵。格伦斯走上前，递给你一小叠文件和一支笔。你接过来，她眨眨眼，开口道。
rows.raw: "\n\nArriving back at Tavros, you’re immediately hailed by the station’s chief customs officer and instructed to dock and submit to inspection. The wrinkled, tired-looking old human man looks incredibly bored as he sips his coffee and waits for you to comply. Not very much time later you’re stepping off your ship to the sight of Riya, Grence and a few of the troopers from the raid on the pirates. Grence steps forward and hands you a small stack of papers and pen, blinking as you take it, then speaking."

rows.original: “Here, Steele. These are non-disclosure agreements and... other things you need to sign. You can read it if you want, but you’re going to want to sign it- trust me.”
rows.translation: “给，斯蒂尔。这些是保密协议，还有...其他需要你签字的东西。想看的话可以看，不过你会愿意签的。相信我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here, Steele. These are non-disclosure agreements and... other things you need to sign. You can read it if you want, but you’re going to want to sign it- trust me.”"

rows.original: What? And what if you don’t want to? There’s a lot of fine print on these, after all. Riya shrugs and cuts in just as Grence opens her mouth to speak.
rows.translation: 什么？你要是不想签呢？毕竟这上面密密麻麻有一大堆小字条款。格伦斯正要开口，莉娅便耸耸肩，抢过话头。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat? And what if you don’t want to? There’s a lot of fine print on these, after all. Riya shrugs and cuts in just as Grence opens her mouth to speak."

rows.original: “The alternative is you being arrested and detained indefinitely on suspicion of espionage for interfering with a top-secret U.G.C. operation. We’re doing you a big favor, Steele. Just sign. This isn’t Carver’s whorehouse, there’s no secret clause that says we get to mod the shit out of you or something.”
rows.translation: “要不然，你干扰银河联合邦联的绝密行动，涉嫌从事间谍活动，就得被捕，然后无限期拘留。我们可是在帮你一个大忙，斯蒂尔。签就是了。这里又不是卡弗的妓院，没有什么秘密条款说我们能把你往死里改造之类的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The alternative is you being arrested and detained indefinitely on suspicion of espionage for interfering with a top-secret U.G.C. operation. We’re doing you a big favor, Steele. Just sign. This isn’t Carver’s whorehouse, there’s no secret clause that says we get to mod the shit out of you or something.”"

rows.original: Whatever. Deciding to pick your battles (Not least because you’re in a hangar full of armed, uniformed Peacekeepers and naval personnel), you make your mark on the papers presented and hand them back. Riya takes them and marches off with them, idly flipping through to make sure you signed, though her body expression tells you she doesn’t actually care that much. Grence watches her leave for a few moments, ears swiveling back and forth slowly, a thoughtful expression on her face. She turns to you after the human woman is out of sight.
rows.translation: 行吧。有些事没必要争，尤其是你现在就站在一个满是持枪、穿制服的维和人员和海军官兵的机库里。你在递来的文件上签了字，把文件还了回去。莉娅接过来大步走开，随手翻了翻，确认你都签了。从她的肢体动作看，她其实没多在乎。格伦斯望着她离开，双耳慢慢转来转去，脸上若有所思。等那位人类女性走出视线，她才转向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhatever. Deciding to pick your battles (Not least because you’re in a hangar full of armed, uniformed Peacekeepers and naval personnel), you make your mark on the papers presented and hand them back. Riya takes them and marches off with them, idly flipping through to make sure you signed, though her body expression tells you she doesn’t actually care that much. Grence watches her leave for a few moments, ears swiveling back and forth slowly, a thoughtful expression on her face. She turns to you after the human woman is out of sight."

rows.original: “So... my boss hinted to me after we got back that now would be a good time to make noise about Riya, if I still wanted to. Apparently she was only really here for the raid, but since some of the intel her team captured was pretty good stuff, the powers that be want to leave her here to head up regional anti-piracy operations. Explains why I couldn’t get rid of her the last time I tried. Thing is, as abrasive as she is... I’m not totally sure I still want to get rid of her. She saved my life twice back there, after all.” the ausar says.
rows.translation: “所以...我们回来以后，我上司暗示，如果我还想投诉莉娅，现在就是时候。看来她本来只是为了这次突袭才调过来的，可她小队缴获的有些情报相当有价值，上头就想把她留下，负责这片地区的反海盗行动。难怪我上次想把她调走，没能办成。问题是，她这人说话虽然很刺耳...我现在也说不准自己是不是真的还想把她调走了。毕竟她刚才在那边救了我两次。”这位奥萨尔人说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So... my boss hinted to me after we got back that now would be a good time to make noise about Riya, if I still wanted to. Apparently she was only really here for the raid, but since some of the intel her team captured was pretty good stuff, the powers that be want to leave her here to head up regional anti-piracy operations. Explains why I couldn’t get rid of her the last time I tried. Thing is, as abrasive as she is... I’m not totally sure I still want to get rid of her. She saved my life twice back there, after all.” the ausar says."

rows.raw: "\n\nFlagging down a peace officer, you hurriedly explain your situation and the deputy nods, training kicking in. They call an emergency medical team in, and within minutes you’re safely inside an ambulance, the officer waving with a happy grin on their face, shouting congratulations to you as the doors close."

rows.original: . All things must end though, and all too soon the shuttle arrives to take your baby away. You hold it up as long as you can, ignoring the drone’s automated requests until the soulless machine irritably informs you that it’s going to leave soon. Sadness in your heart, you bundle your baby into the climate-controlled device and watch it return to the shuttle.

You even hold up the shuttle, ignoring the drone’s automated requests until you can’t wait any longer. So to speak, anyway. The pirates’ opening salvo broke the old girl’s back, and we’re lucky we managed to limp home after you showed up.”

So to speak, anyway. The pirates’ opening salvo broke the old girl’s back, and we’re lucky we managed to limp home after you showed up.”"

rows.original: “Oh come on, it’s not that bad,” Saen laughs, though half-heartedly.

rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh come on, it’s not that bad,” Saen laughs, though half-heartedly. "

rows.original: Valeria rolls her eyes. “Either way, without the Phoenix, we’re out of work, so to answer your question, [pc.name], work’s nonexistent and my fluffball here is a fluff-bum.”

rows.raw: "\n\nValeria sighs. “Sorry, captain. I’m just... frustrated by all this. I didn’t mean anything....”"

rows.original: Saen grins and reaches down to rub Valeria’s holo-avatar on the cheek. “Yeah, me too, sweetheart. Me too.” Turning back to you, she says, “Well, I’ve got a job right now fixing things around the station. This bucket’s barely holding together, so there’s plenty of work. Just doesn’t pay for piss. Especially since it costs an arm and a leg to have my baby sitting in dry dock. Still, I’ve got a few things lined up, don’t you worry. I’ll be back out in the Black before you know it.”
rows.translation: 赛恩咧嘴一笑，伸手抚摸瓦莱里娅全息化身的脸颊。“是啊，我也是，甜心。我也是。”她转回来看着你，说道：“嗯，我现在有份工作，负责修理空间站各处的东西。这个破桶都快散架了，所以活计多得很。只是赚不到几个屁钱。尤其是让我的宝贝一直停在干船坞里，费用高得要命。不过，我已经安排好了几件事，别担心。你还没反应过来，我就已经重返黑暗太空了。”

rows.original: “Make fun of people on the ‘net, mostly. Aside from VR, there’s not really a whole lot to do on this damn station. Flirt with the bar girls, a few odd jobs to keep food and booze in me. I feel like I’m spending all my free time working on my ship, these days. That or drowning my sorrows in here. And with my baby’s wings broke, I’ve got plenty of troubles to ruminate on.”
rows.translation: “主要是在星网上取笑别人。除了虚拟现实，这座该死的空间站其实没多少事可做。调戏酒吧姑娘，打几份零工，好让自己有饭吃、有酒喝。最近我感觉所有空闲时间都花在修飞船上了。要不然就是待在这里借酒浇愁。而且我的宝贝折了翅膀，我有太多烦恼可以反复琢磨。”

rows.original: “Well, it’s not all bad. I’m actually got into the playtest for the new edition of Perils in Perdition, which FINALLY fixes the damn broken rules in the last one. 12th Edition didn’t even try to fix the obvious, painful flaws of 11th Edition. The Troubadour I was playing for like, two years was so stupidly powerful... and it’s a white magic class! I shouldn’t even be doing damage, much less outclassing the Dervish or Blood Mage. I mean, I’m not even min-maxing this shit!”
