rows.original: “Implying you don’t watch it, too!” Valeria snaps before vanishing back into Saen’s wrist, leaving the halfbreed laughing uncontrollably.
rows.translation: “说得好像你不看一样！”瓦莱里娅厉声反驳，随后消失回赛恩的手腕中，只留下这个混血儿笑得无法自制。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Implying you don’t watch it, too!” Valeria snaps before vanishing back into Saen’s wrist, leaving the halfbreed laughing uncontrollably."

rows.original: Looking the cat-eared, fluffy-tailed space slut over, you finally ask her what she is, exactly.
rows.translation: 你打量着这个猫耳、毛尾的太空荡妇，终于问起她究竟是什么种族。
rows.raw: "Looking the cat-eared, fluffy-tailed space slut over, you finally ask her what she is, exactly. "

rows.original: “[pc.name]... I am... your father!” Saen says in a low, deep voice... before snickering and waving you off. “Seriously though, that’s a weird question out of the blue. But alright, uh, well, I’m what you’d call a halfbreed. My mom was a kaithrit - a pirate, actually, for most of her life - and my dad was an ausar cargo hauler. The Phoenix was actually his, before... well, you know. So I guess I got a little bit of both races in me: mom’s ears and eyes, dad’s big ol’ fluffy tail and forelimbs.” She pauses to look at her left arm, then grimaces when she suddenly remembers the shiny chrome where the fluff on her other arm would begin. Saendra sighs and rubs at her cybernetic limb.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]...我就是...你的父亲！”赛恩用低沉浑厚的声音说道...随后窃笑着摆摆手。“不过说真的，这个问题问得莫名其妙。但好吧，呃，嗯，我就是你们所谓的混血儿。我妈妈是凯斯里特，她一生的大部分时间其实都是海盗，而我爸爸是奥萨货运船长。凤凰号原本属于他，后来...嗯，你知道。所以我想，我两种族的特征都有一些：妈妈的耳朵和眼睛，爸爸那条毛茸茸的大尾巴和前肢。”她停下来看看左臂，随后突然想起另一条手臂本应开始长出绒毛的地方如今只有闪亮铬金属，不禁皱起脸。赛恩德拉叹息着摩挲自己的机械义肢。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]... I am... your father!” Saen says in a low, deep voice... before snickering and waving you off. “Seriously though, that’s a weird question out of the blue. But alright, uh, well, I’m what you’d call a halfbreed. My mom was a kaithrit - a pirate, actually, for most of her life - and my dad was an ausar cargo hauler. The Phoenix was actually his, before... well, you know. So I guess I got a little bit of both races in me: mom’s ears and eyes, dad’s big ol’ fluffy tail and forelimbs.” She pauses to look at her left arm, then grimaces when she suddenly remembers the shiny chrome where the fluff on her other arm would begin. Saendra sighs and rubs at her cybernetic limb. "

rows.original: With a wry chuckle, she composes herself back into her normally lewd self and, snapping a finger towards her groin, says, “Got some girly perks from the ausar half, too: I’m built to take ‘em down there, if you know what I mean.
rows.translation: 她苦笑一声，恢复了平时淫荡的模样，又朝胯间打了个响指，说道：“我也从奥萨那一半继承了一些女性优点：下面的构造天生就适合承受它们，如果你明白我的意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a wry chuckle, she composes herself back into her normally lewd self and, snapping a finger towards her groin, says, “Got some girly perks from the ausar half, too: I’m built to take ‘em down there, if you know what I mean."

rows.original: And now I’ve got this kick-ass kitty-puppy-dick-thing going on. So that’s pretty cool.
rows.translation: 而且现在，我还拥有了这根帅爆的猫狗鸡巴玩意儿。所以这也挺酷。
rows.raw: " And now I’ve got this kick-ass kitty-puppy-dick-thing going on. So that’s pretty cool."

rows.original: I guess the best way to describe what I am is ‘bitch-kitten.’ Tough as a wolf, playful as a kitten: that’s me!”
rows.translation: 我想，描述我是什么的最佳方式就是‘母狗小猫’。像狼一样强悍，像小猫一样顽皮：那就是我！”
rows.raw: " I guess the best way to describe what I am is ‘bitch-kitten.’ Tough as a wolf, playful as a kitten: that’s me!”"

rows.original: You chuckle at the half-baked double entendre, and ask how a kaithrit pirate and an ausar cargo captain could have got together. “Talk about opposite world, right?”
rows.translation: 你对这个半生不熟的双关轻笑一声，问起一名凯斯里特海盗和一名奥萨货船船长怎么可能走到一起。“简直是截然相反的世界，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle at the half-baked double entendre, and ask how a kaithrit pirate and an ausar cargo captain could have got together. “Talk about opposite world, right?”"

rows.original: Saen chuckles. “Yeah, definitely. You know, they never really talked about it much - how they got together, that is. I guess my mom must have tried to rob him, and somehow somewhere a whirlwind romance started. Or a really ironic one-night stand gone horribly wrong.”
rows.translation: 赛恩轻笑起来。“是啊，当然。你知道，他们从来没有多谈这件事，也就是他们怎么走到一起。我猜妈妈一定是想抢劫他，然后不知怎么、不知在哪里，一场旋风般的恋情就开始了。又或者，那只是一场讽刺至极、结果糟糕透顶的一夜情。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaen chuckles. “Yeah, definitely. You know, they never really talked about it much - how they got together, that is. I guess my mom must have tried to rob him, and somehow somewhere a whirlwind romance started. Or a really ironic one-night stand gone horribly wrong.”"

rows.original: She shrugs and rests her chin in her hands, looking you square in the eye. “C’mon, hero, let’s change the subject before I get all nostalgic and need a hug. Or are you just trying to get me to introduce you to my folks? Careful, mom’s still got a laser shotgun!”
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩，双手托住下巴，直直望进你的眼睛。“好啦，英雄，我们换个话题吧，免得我开始怀旧，变得需要一个拥抱。还是说，你只是想让我把父母介绍给你？小心点，妈妈手里仍然有一把激光霰弹枪！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shrugs and rests her chin in her hands, looking you square in the eye. “C’mon, hero, let’s change the subject before I get all nostalgic and need a hug. Or are you just trying to get me to introduce you to my folks? Careful, mom’s still got a laser shotgun!”"

rows.original: Parents
rows.translation: 父母
rows.raw: "Parents"

rows.original: “Tell me a little bit more about your folks.”
rows.translation: “再多说一点你父母的事吧。”
rows.raw: "“Tell me a little bit more about your folks.”"

rows.original: Saen sighs. “There was a hint back there, you know. Ugh, fine. My mom’s still around, yeah. Not a pirate anymore, but still an asskicker of the highest order. She does private security work now, I think, out on the rim. We actually bumped into each other a few months ago, working. That was pretty neat.”
rows.translation: 赛恩叹了口气。“刚才其实已经有提示了，你知道。唉，好吧。是的，我妈妈还活着。她已经不当海盗了，但依然是最顶尖的狠角色。我想她现在在边缘地区做私人安保。几个月前，我们工作时还偶然碰见了彼此。那挺不错的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaen sighs. “There was a hint back there, you know. Ugh, fine. My mom’s still around, yeah. Not a pirate anymore, but still an asskicker of the highest order. She does private security work now, I think, out on the rim. We actually bumped into each other a few months ago, working. That was pretty neat.”"

rows.original: “But, uh, dad passed a couple of years back. Got in a fight he couldn’t win, I guess.”
rows.translation: “不过，呃，爸爸几年前去世了。我想，他参加了一场赢不了的战斗。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But, uh, dad passed a couple of years back. Got in a fight he couldn’t win, I guess.”"

rows.original: “Oh. Sorry,” you say, putting a hand on Saen’s.
rows.translation: “哦。节哀，”你把手放在赛恩的手上说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh. Sorry,” you say, putting a hand on Saen’s."

rows.original: She shrugs. “It’s fine. That was years ago, I’m okay now,” she says, patting your hand. “Now c’mon, let’s talk about something a little bit more fun, huh?”
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩。“没关系。那已经是几年前的事了，我现在没事。”她说着拍了拍你的手。“好了，我们聊点更有趣的事情吧，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shrugs. “It’s fine. That was years ago, I’m okay now,” she says, patting your hand. “Now c’mon, let’s talk about something a little bit more fun, huh?”"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So, mind telling me a little about that chrome?” you ask, nodding to her cybernetic arm.
rows.translation: “那么，介意和我说说那身铬金属吗？”你朝她的机械手臂点点头，问道。
rows.raw: "“So, mind telling me a little about that chrome?” you ask, nodding to her cybernetic arm. "

rows.original: Saendra blinks at you, then looks to her half-mechanical arm, almost like she’d forgotten it was there. “Oh, yeah. Nothing too fancy, I guess. Between medical bills and patching my ship up, I’m pretty tight on credits. Had to settle for the most basic model, pretty much. I can kind-of-sort-of feel things through it, but it responds pretty much one-to-one and it’s easy to clean and fix.”
rows.translation: 赛恩德拉眨眨眼，随后看向自己那条半机械手臂，仿佛已经忘了它的存在。“哦，是啊。我想，也没什么特别的。医疗费和修理飞船的开支加在一起，让我的信用点相当紧张。基本上只能将就着用最基础的型号。我勉勉强强能通过它感觉到东西，不过它几乎可以一比一地响应动作，而且容易清洁和修理。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaendra blinks at you, then looks to her half-mechanical arm, almost like she’d forgotten it was there. “Oh, yeah. Nothing too fancy, I guess. Between medical bills and patching my ship up, I’m pretty tight on credits. Had to settle for the most basic model, pretty much. I can kind-of-sort-of feel things through it, but it responds pretty much one-to-one and it’s easy to clean and fix.”"

rows.original: As she speaks, Saen moves her silvery left arm around, rotating the wrist and wiggling her fingers. She breaks her melancholy long enough to put her hand on your arm and give you a little smile. “Like I said when we met, it could be a lot worse. Besides, with some spare parts from my ship and a little scrounging, I’ve managed to do some modding. Reworked a dead holo-terminal into a wrist-display...”
rows.translation: 说话时，赛恩转动银色左臂，旋转手腕并活动手指。她暂时摆脱忧郁，把手放在你的胳膊上，对你微微一笑。“就像我们见面时我说过的，情况本来可能糟糕得多。而且，我用飞船上的一些备用零件，再四处搜罗了一番，已经成功做了些改装。把一台报废的全息终端改造成手腕显示器...”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she speaks, Saen moves her silvery left arm around, rotating the wrist and wiggling her fingers. She breaks her melancholy long enough to put her hand on your arm and give you a little smile. “Like I said when we met, it could be a lot worse. Besides, with some spare parts from my ship and a little scrounging, I’ve managed to do some modding. Reworked a dead holo-terminal into a wrist-display...”"

rows.original: Valeria shimmers to life on her wrist, waving at you.
rows.translation: 瓦莱里娅闪烁着出现在她的手腕上，向你挥手。
rows.raw: "\n\nValeria shimmers to life on her wrist, waving at you."

rows.original: “...built a telescoping probe out of some old mil-spec hardware. Good for fuckin’ and fixin’. Oh, and a flamethrower. Just some old fuel cells and a lighter, but good enough to burn the next pirate that wants a piece of me! I’d show you, but, uh, I don’t want to burn the place down. But it totally works!”
rows.translation: “...用一些老式军规硬件造了一根伸缩探针。既能操人，也能修东西。哦，还有火焰喷射器。只不过是几块旧燃料电池和一个点火器，但足以烧死下一个想打我主意的海盗！我本来可以展示给你看，不过，呃，我不想把这里烧掉。但它真的能用！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...built a telescoping probe out of some old mil-spec hardware. Good for fuckin’ and fixin’. Oh, and a flamethrower. Just some old fuel cells and a lighter, but good enough to burn the next pirate that wants a piece of me! I’d show you, but, uh, I don’t want to burn the place down. But it totally works!”"

rows.original: “Right. So about that probe...?”
rows.translation: “好吧。那么，那根探针的事...？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right. So about that probe...?”"

rows.original: Saen gives you a grin and flicks her cyber-wrist. From the palm, a long, thick metallic hose snakes out, slithering across the table toward you. “Three feet long, thick as a bullcock, and completely prehensile. Took a little mucking around with the firmware and the control chip they put in my brain - ow, by the way. Don’t recommend it - but I got it to work! Give it a kiss!” she laughs as the slithering probe rears up like a cobra, its rounded, pointy tip reaching over to peck you on the lips.
rows.translation: 赛恩咧嘴一笑，甩动机械手腕。一条又粗又长的金属软管从掌心伸出，蜿蜒爬过桌面，朝你逼近。“三英尺长，和公牛鸡巴一样粗，而且完全能够自由弯曲。为了让它运转，我得稍微折腾一下固件和他们装进我脑子里的控制芯片，顺便一提，很疼，不建议你尝试，但我成功了！亲它一下！”她笑着说道，那根游动的探针像眼镜蛇般昂起，圆润而尖锐的顶端伸过来，在你的嘴唇上轻轻一啄。
rows.raw: "\n\nSaen gives you a grin and flicks her cyber-wrist. From the palm, a long, thick metallic hose snakes out, slithering across the table toward you. “Three feet long, thick as a bullcock, and completely prehensile. Took a little mucking around with the firmware and the control chip they put in my brain - ow, by the way. Don’t recommend it - but I got it to work! Give it a kiss!” she laughs as the slithering probe rears up like a cobra, its rounded, pointy tip reaching over to peck you on the lips. "

rows.original: SAENDRA TIMES SEXED
rows.raw: "SAENDRA TIMES SEXED"

rows.original: “So... when do I get to use this bad boy on you, hero?” she teases, adding an exaggerated wink for emphasis.
rows.translation: “那么...我什么时候才能把这个坏家伙用在你身上，英雄？”她调侃道，又故意夸张地眨眨眼以加强语气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So... when do I get to use this bad boy on you, hero?” she teases, adding an exaggerated wink for emphasis."

rows.original: SAENDRA TALK PHOENIX STATUS
rows.raw: "SAENDRA TALK PHOENIX STATUS"

rows.original: “So how’s your ship doing, Saen?”
rows.translation: “那么你的飞船怎么样了，赛恩？”
rows.raw: "“So how’s your ship doing, Saen?”"

rows.original: Saendra sighs, resting her cheek in her hand. “Not great, hero. Those damn pirates broke the old girl’s back with a rocket when they jumped me. Her hull’s torn to pieces, the flux converters are shot all over, and the shields are blown out. Went out with a bang just before I punched the light drive getting out of there.”
rows.translation: 赛恩德拉叹息着，把脸颊托在手中。“不太好，英雄。那些该死的海盗伏击我时，一发火箭就打断了老姑娘的脊梁。船体被撕得七零八落，通量转换器到处都烧毁了，护盾也彻底报废。就在我启动光驱动逃离那里前，它还轰然炸掉了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaendra sighs, resting her cheek in her hand. “Not great, hero. Those damn pirates broke the old girl’s back with a rocket when they jumped me. Her hull’s torn to pieces, the flux converters are shot all over, and the shields are blown out. Went out with a bang just before I punched the light drive getting out of there.”"

rows.original: “That bad, huh?” you ask, just as a waitress comes by with another full stein for your companion.
rows.translation: “有那么糟啊？”你问道，恰在此时，一名女服务员给你的同伴送来另一只装满酒的大杯。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That bad, huh?” you ask, just as a waitress comes by with another full stein for your companion. "

rows.original: She nods. “It ain’t great, that’s for sure. I had insurance on the Phoenix, of course, but not enough to cover her getting torn up by that kind of weapons fire. At least it was enough to get most of the interior patched up, and the life support works, uh, most of the time. I’m ending up spending most of my free time down there fixing her by hand, with whatever spare parts I can beg or skirt off the garage crew. Gonna take me forever at this rate, though.”
rows.translation: 她点点头。“肯定不怎么样。我当然给凤凰号买了保险，但保险金额不足以弥补那种武器火力造成的损坏。至少足够修复大部分内部空间，而且生命维持系统在，呃，大多数时候都能运转。最后，我大部分空闲时间都耗在那里，用能从车库人员手里讨来或偷偷弄走的各种备用零件，亲手修理它。不过照这个速度，我得修上一辈子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods. “It ain’t great, that’s for sure. I had insurance on the Phoenix, of course, but not enough to cover her getting torn up by that kind of weapons fire. At least it was enough to get most of the interior patched up, and the life support works, uh, most of the time. I’m ending up spending most of my free time down there fixing her by hand, with whatever spare parts I can beg or skirt off the garage crew. Gonna take me forever at this rate, though.”"

rows.original: SAENDRA PHOENIX STATUS TIMES
rows.raw: "SAENDRA PHOENIX STATUS TIMES"

rows.original: After a moment of thought, Saendra adds, “Hey, if you want... I’m pretty sure we’re parked in the same dock. Lemme give you the berth number... you could drop by any time. Would be nice to have some company while I’m working.”
rows.translation: 思考片刻后，赛恩德拉补充道：“嘿，如果你愿意...我很确定我们停在同一个船坞。让我把泊位编号给你...你随时都可以过来。我工作的时候有个人陪着也挺好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment of thought, Saendra adds, “Hey, if you want... I’m pretty sure we’re parked in the same dock. Lemme give you the berth number... you could drop by any time. Would be nice to have some company while I’m working.”"

rows.original: She scribbles something down on her napkin and hands it over to you.
rows.translation: 她在餐巾上潦草地写下什么，递给了你。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe scribbles something down on her napkin and hands it over to you."

rows.original: The Phoenix has been unlocked from the Tavros Station central lift.
rows.translation: 你现在可以从塔夫罗斯站的中央升降梯前往凤凰号。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Phoenix has been unlocked from the Tavros Station central lift."

rows.original: SAENDRA PHOENIX AVAILABLE
rows.raw: "SAENDRA PHOENIX AVAILABLE"

rows.original: SAENDRA PHOENIX STATUS TIMES
rows.raw: "SAENDRA PHOENIX STATUS TIMES"

rows.original: After a moment Saen adds, “Progress is just so slow. Weapons and shields are giving me a world of trouble, and...” she sighs heavily. “Dammit all.”
rows.translation: 片刻后，赛恩又说道：“进展实在太慢了。武器和护盾给我带来了一大堆麻烦，而且...”她沉重地叹了口气。“真该死。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment Saen adds, “Progress is just so slow. Weapons and shields are giving me a world of trouble, and...” she sighs heavily. “Dammit all.”"

rows.original: Valeria shimmers into being on Saen’s wrist. “Slow and steady wins the race, captain. Just be patient.”
rows.translation: 瓦莱里娅闪烁着出现在赛恩的手腕上。“稳扎稳打才能赢得比赛，船长。耐心一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\nValeria shimmers into being on Saen’s wrist. “Slow and steady wins the race, captain. Just be patient.”"

rows.original: “I know, I know,” the captain sighs, her ears lowering. “I just feel so fuckin’ helpless cooped up here. I hate not having my ship.”
rows.translation: “我知道，我知道。”船长垂下耳朵，叹息道。“我只是觉得被困在这里什么也做不了，真他妈无助。我讨厌没有飞船的日子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know, I know,” the captain sighs, her ears lowering. “I just feel so fuckin’ helpless cooped up here. I hate not having my ship.”"

rows.original: You reach over and put a hand on Saendra’s shoulder, and she visibly relaxes, smiling over at you. “Sorry, hero. Don’t let me get you down... maybe you’d like to help me take my mind off it?” she adds with a lusty wink, her fluffy tail coiling around your [pc.leg].
rows.translation: 你伸手按住赛恩德拉的肩膀。她明显放松下来，对你露出笑容。“对不起，英雄。别让我害你也情绪低落...也许你愿意帮我转移一下注意力？”她充满欲望地眨眨眼，毛茸茸的尾巴缠上你的[pc.leg]。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach over and put a hand on Saendra’s shoulder, and she visibly relaxes, smiling over at you. “Sorry, hero. Don’t let me get you down... maybe you’d like to help me take my mind off it?” she adds with a lusty wink, her fluffy tail coiling around your [pc.leg]."

rows.original: SAENDRA CREDITS TALK AVAILABLE
rows.raw: "SAENDRA CREDITS TALK AVAILABLE"

rows.original: “You’ve been at it long enough,” you say gently.
rows.translation: “你已经为此努力够久了。”你温柔地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve been at it long enough,” you say gently. "

rows.original: Saen sighs. “Yeah. I just... I don’t know what the fuck I’m doing. I’m so strapped for cash doing odd jobs that I can barely pay the docking fees, much less get the parts I need to fix my girl. I don’t know what I’m doing wrong... it shouldn’t be this hard to fix a damn ship.”
rows.translation: 赛恩叹了口气。“是啊。我只是...我他妈根本不知道自己在干什么。打零工让我穷得要命，几乎连停靠费都付不起，更别说购买修好我家姑娘所需的零件了。我不知道自己做错了什么...修好一艘该死的飞船不该这么难。”

rows.original: Out of the corner of your eye, you watch Saen get slammed down onto the side of the fountain. A few moments later, the elevator dings open behind you, and another figure strides into the corridor. A woman, dressed in an all-red jumpsuit under a black longcoat. Her flowing dark hair half-conceals a face that’s a network of scars and tattoos that wrap around an eyepatch.
rows.translation: 你从眼角看见赛恩被猛撞到喷泉侧面。片刻后，身后的电梯叮一声打开，另一个身影大步走进走廊。那是一个女人，在黑色长外套下面穿着一套全红连体服。飘逸黑发遮住半张脸；脸上纵横交错着伤疤与文身，一直环绕到眼罩周围。
rows.raw: "\n\nOut of the corner of your eye, you watch Saen get slammed down onto the side of the fountain. A few moments later, the elevator dings open behind you, and another figure strides into the corridor. A woman, dressed in an all-red jumpsuit under a black longcoat. Her flowing dark hair half-conceals a face that’s a network of scars and tattoos that wrap around an eyepatch."

One of her gloved hands rests on the hilt of a saber at her hip; the other carries a sleek laser pistol.
rows.translation: 光芒涌入昏暗走廊，三个人大步走出：另外两名装甲男子，以及一个在飘逸黑色长外套下穿着紧身红色连体服的女人。女人的黑发遮住半张脸；脸上纵横交错着伤疤与文身，一直环绕到眼罩周围。她一只戴手套的手搭在腰间军刀的刀柄上，另一只则握着一把流线型激光手枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nLight floods into the darkened corridor, and a trio of people stride out - two more armored men, and a woman in a skin-tight red jumpsuit, worn under a flowing black longcoat. The woman’s dark hair half-conceals a face that’s a network of scars and tattoos that wrap around an eyepatch. One of her gloved hands rests on the hilt of a saber at her hip; the other carries a sleek laser pistol."

rows.original: “Fuck,” one of the armored goons says, waving a flashlight over the corridor full of bodies and hot brass. “How did one woman do all this?”
rows.translation: “操。”一个装甲暴徒说道，用手电筒扫过遍布尸体和滚烫弹壳的走廊。“一个女人怎么做到这一切的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck,” one of the armored goons says, waving a flashlight over the corridor full of bodies and hot brass. “How did one woman do all this?”"

rows.original: “I told your men not to underestimate her, captain,” the woman says, holstering her pistol. “And the man she was supposed to be meeting?”
rows.translation: “我警告过你的手下，不要低估她，船长。”女人一边收起手枪，一边说道。“她本该去见的那个男人呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I told your men not to underestimate her, captain,” the woman says, holstering her pistol. “And the man she was supposed to be meeting?”"

rows.original: The ‘captain’ grunts and rests his gun on his shoulder. “He’s been taken care of. Stashed him in a private room at Anon’s, just like you asked.”
rows.translation: 那个“船长”低吼一声，把枪搁上肩膀。“已经处理好了。按你的要求，把他藏在阿农酒吧的一间私人房里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ‘captain’ grunts and rests his gun on his shoulder. “He’s been taken care of. Stashed him in a private room at Anon’s, just like you asked.”"

rows.original: The woman nods. “Good. I’ll be down to collect him shortly.”
rows.translation: 女人点点头。“很好。我很快就下去接他。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman nods. “Good. I’ll be down to collect him shortly.”"

rows.original: She turns on a heel and re-embarks onto the elevator. Her soldiers follow her, leaving you and Saendra in darkness. You release a breath you hadn’t known you’d been holding, and your vice grip on Saendra’s belly relents, letting the halfbreed slip out of your arms.
rows.translation: 她转身重新登上电梯，士兵也跟随其后，让你和赛恩德拉留在黑暗中。你吐出一口自己都没意识到一直憋着的气，也松开如台钳般箍住赛恩德拉腹部的双臂，让混血儿滑出怀抱。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe turns on a heel and re-embarks onto the elevator. Her soldiers follow her, leaving you and Saendra in darkness. You release a breath you hadn’t known you’d been holding, and your vice grip on Saendra’s belly relents, letting the halfbreed slip out of your arms."

rows.original: “Shit,” she sighs, holstering her gun again. She’s still half-shouting over the ringing in her ears. “How the fuck did she find me?”
rows.translation: “该死。”她叹息着再次收起枪。耳中的嗡鸣让她仍在半喊着说话。“她他妈怎么找到我的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit,” she sighs, holstering her gun again. She’s still half-shouting over the ringing in her ears. “How the fuck did she find me?”"

rows.original: “Who was that?”
rows.translation: “那到底是谁？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Who was that?”"

rows.original: Saen shrugs. “I, uh... look, we can talk about this later, hero. My buddy’s in trouble because of me, and I’m gonna go bail him out. Meet you back at the bar!”
rows.translation: 赛恩耸耸肩。“我，呃...听着，英雄，我们之后再谈。我朋友因为我遇到了麻烦，我要去救他。酒吧见！”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaen shrugs. “I, uh... look, we can talk about this later, hero. My buddy’s in trouble because of me, and I’m gonna go bail him out. Meet you back at the bar!”"

rows.original: The halfbreed runs off towards the elevator bank, disappearing into the car you’d taken up. She gives you a wink as the door closes, taking her back down to the merchant decks.
rows.translation: 混血儿跑向电梯区，钻进你们上来时搭乘的轿厢，消失不见。电梯门关闭，把她带回商贸甲板时，她朝你眨眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe halfbreed runs off towards the elevator bank, disappearing into the car you’d taken up. She gives you a wink as the door closes, taking her back down to the merchant decks."

rows.original: ...And now you’re going to have to wait for another elevator.
rows.translation: ...而现在，你只能等待另一部电梯。
rows.raw:
"

...And now you’re going to have to wait for another elevator.

"

rows.original: KALAS.TAVROS.TAVROS LIFT
rows.raw: "KALAS.TAVROS.TAVROS LIFT"

rows.original: “Hey,” you say, reaching across the table to take Saen’s robotic hand. “That friend of yours... did you find him?”
rows.translation: “嘿。”你隔着桌子伸手握住赛恩的机械手。“你那个朋友...找到他了吗？”
rows.raw: "“Hey,” you say, reaching across the table to take Saen’s robotic hand. “That friend of yours... did you find him?”"

rows.original: “Yeah, actually. He’s here, at the bar. Just upstairs, like the pirate said. I saw one of the rooms with an armed guard outside. Not, like, some dude in power armor or anything, but a guy trying not to be too obvious leaning on the wall all the time, playing with a cigar he won’t light. Pretty sure I saw a machine pistol under his coat.”
rows.translation: “其实找到了。他就在这里，在酒吧里。就在楼上，和那个海盗说的一样。我看到一间房外面站着武装守卫。倒不是穿动力装甲之类的家伙，只是一个靠墙站着、努力表现得不那么显眼的人，一直摆弄一根不会点燃的雪茄。我很确定自己在他外套下面看见了一把机器手枪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, actually. He’s here, at the bar. Just upstairs, like the pirate said. I saw one of the rooms with an armed guard outside. Not, like, some dude in power armor or anything, but a guy trying not to be too obvious leaning on the wall all the time, playing with a cigar he won’t light. Pretty sure I saw a machine pistol under his coat.”"

rows.original: Saendra fidgets, eyes locking on your hand. “I, uh, I’d knock him out myself, but I don’t know what’s in the room. Could be a lot more assholes. They even put a block on the room’s sensors when I sent Val in to check.”
rows.translation: 赛恩德拉坐立不安，目光锁定你的手。“我，呃，我本可以自己打晕他，但我不知道房里有什么。可能还有一大群混蛋。我派瓦尔进去查看时，他们甚至屏蔽了房间传感器。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaendra fidgets, eyes locking on your hand. “I, uh, I’d knock him out myself, but I don’t know what’s in the room. Could be a lot more assholes. They even put a block on the room’s sensors when I sent Val in to check.”"

rows.original: “They know we’re coming,” Valeria adds, flickering up onto Saendra’s mechanical wrist. Her avatar stumbles back when it materializes next to your hand, and she ends up falling onto her holographic butt. “Probably, anyway. The pirates you and Saen saw at the elevator have most likely alerted their friends here at Anon’s.”
rows.translation: “他们知道我们要来。”瓦莱里娅补充道，闪烁着出现在赛恩德拉的机械手腕上。她的化身具现时正好在你手边，踉跄后退，最终一屁股摔在全息地面。“反正很可能知道。你和赛恩在电梯旁看到的海盗，大概已经向阿农酒吧里的同伴发出了警报。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They know we’re coming,” Valeria adds, flickering up onto Saendra’s mechanical wrist. Her avatar stumbles back when it materializes next to your hand, and she ends up falling onto her holographic butt. “Probably, anyway. The pirates you and Saen saw at the elevator have most likely alerted their friends here at Anon’s.”"

rows.original: That makes things interesting. “Want some help?” you offer, squeezing Saen’s hand.
rows.translation: 这下事情变得有趣了。“想要帮忙吗？”你一边提议，一边捏了捏赛恩的手。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat makes things interesting. “Want some help?” you offer, squeezing Saen’s hand."

rows.original: The halfbreed’s cheeks flush a little red. “You don’t have to, hero. It’s not your fight. God knows I’ve dragged you into too many of my problems already.”
rows.translation: 混血儿的脸颊微微泛红。“你不必这么做，英雄。这不是你的战斗。天知道，我已经把你拖进了太多自己的麻烦。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe halfbreed’s cheeks flush a little red. “You don’t have to, hero. It’s not your fight. God knows I’ve dragged you into too many of my problems already.”"

rows.original: You assure her that you’re willing. You’ve come this far after all.
rows.translation: 你向她保证，自己愿意帮忙。毕竟已经走到这一步了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure her that you’re willing. You’ve come this far after all."

rows.original: Saen smiles at that, her twin tails swishing loudly on the leather seat. “Alright, alright. Keep this up and I’m not going to be able to solve any of my own problems,” she teases with a wink, hopping up from her seat and adjusting the gunbelt on her hip.
rows.translation: 赛恩闻言微笑，两条尾巴在皮革座椅上响亮扫动。“好吧，好吧。再这样下去，我就连任何自己的问题都解决不了了。”她眨眨眼调侃道，从座位上跳起来，调整腰间枪带。
rows.raw: "\n\nSaen smiles at that, her twin tails swishing loudly on the leather seat. “Alright, alright. Keep this up and I’m not going to be able to solve any of my own problems,” she teases with a wink, hopping up from her seat and adjusting the gunbelt on her hip."

rows.original: “Please don’t shoot up the bar!” Val whines, fluttering after Saendra. “We really need the free room and board here!”
rows.translation: “请不要在酒吧里开枪！”瓦尔哀叫着，飘在赛恩德拉身后。“我们真的很需要这里的免费食宿！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please don’t shoot up the bar!” Val whines, fluttering after Saendra. “We really need the free room and board here!”"

rows.original: “Yeah, yeah, I know,” Saen huffs. “[pc.name] and I will think of something, won’t we?”
rows.translation: “好好好，我知道。”赛恩哼道。“[pc.name]和我会想出办法，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, yeah, I know,” Saen huffs. “[pc.name] and I will think of something, won’t we?”"

rows.original: She gives you a hand up onto your [pc.feet], and you follow her towards the stairs...
rows.translation: 她伸手把你拉上[pc.feet]，你跟随她走向楼梯...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a hand up onto your [pc.feet], and you follow her towards the stairs..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You and Saendra walk up the stairs behind the bar, towards the small hall of rooms for rent Anon’s sports. It’s small and undecorated, steel walls straight down a ten foot corridor. A fluorescent light flickers uneasily overhead, casting dark shadows across the dull gray bulkheads.
rows.translation: 你和赛恩德拉走上酒吧后方的楼梯，前往阿农酒吧那条设有出租小房间的走廊。这里狭小而毫无装饰，钢铁墙壁沿一条十英尺长的走廊笔直延伸。头顶荧光灯不安地闪烁，在暗灰色舱壁上投下黑影。
rows.raw: "You and Saendra walk up the stairs behind the bar, towards the small hall of rooms for rent Anon’s sports. It’s small and undecorated, steel walls straight down a ten foot corridor. A fluorescent light flickers uneasily overhead, casting dark shadows across the dull gray bulkheads."

rows.original: You hear muffled moans and distant thumps against the walls, sounds of pleasure echoing from the handful of side rooms as you pass them. A man in a long, heavily worn brown coat is standing with his back to one of the doors, chewing on the butt of an unlit cigar. His hands are shoved into his pockets. The handful of self-defense classes Dad put you through tip you off to the way the man’s right pocket seems weighed down by something heavy... like a gun.
rows.translation: 经过几扇侧门时，你听见压抑呻吟和远处撞击墙壁的闷响，欢愉声在房间中回荡。一个身穿破旧棕色长外套的男人背靠其中一扇门站着，嘴里嚼着未点燃的雪茄屁股，双手插进口袋。父亲安排你参加过几堂防身课；它们提醒你，男人右侧口袋似乎被某个沉重物体坠着...比如一把枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hear muffled moans and distant thumps against the walls, sounds of pleasure echoing from the handful of side rooms as you pass them. A man in a long, heavily worn brown coat is standing with his back to one of the doors, chewing on the butt of an unlit cigar. His hands are shoved into his pockets. The handful of self-defense classes Dad put you through tip you off to the way the man’s right pocket seems weighed down by something heavy... like a gun."

rows.original: Saen gives you a look and falls behind you,
rows.translation: 赛恩向你递来一个眼神，落在身后，
rows.raw: "\n\nSaen gives you a look and falls behind you, "

joinAfter.expression:
pc.tallness < 60
                ? "awkwardly hiding her face behind your tiny form"
                : "trying to hide behind you"

rows.original: awkwardly hiding her face behind your tiny form
rows.translation: 笨拙地把脸藏在你娇小的身体后面
rows.raw: "awkwardly hiding her face behind your tiny form"

rows.original: trying to hide behind you
rows.translation: 试图躲在你身后
rows.raw: "trying to hide behind you"

rows.original: . That should give you a momentary advantage -- just enough to get you close to the guard. You pick up the pace, trying to seem as nonchalant as you can until you’re within striking range.
rows.translation: 。这应该能给予你短暂优势——刚好足以靠近守卫。你加快脚步，竭力表现得若无其事，直到进入攻击范围。
rows.raw: ". That should give you a momentary advantage -- just enough to get you close to the guard. You pick up the pace, trying to seem as nonchalant as you can until you’re within striking range."

rows.original: The man looks up, chomping his cigar and sneering at you. <i>“
rows.translation: 男人抬头，嚼着雪茄朝你冷笑。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nThe man looks up, chomping his cigar and sneering at you. <i>“"

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isMasculine()
                ? "Move along, bro."
                : "Hey, sweetheart. You lookin’ for a good time?"

rows.original: Move along, bro.
rows.translation: 走开，兄弟。
rows.raw: "Move along, bro."

rows.original: Hey, sweetheart. You lookin’ for a good time?
rows.translation: 嘿，甜心。想找点乐子吗？
rows.raw: "Hey, sweetheart. You lookin’ for a good time?"

rows.original: ” he growls, turning towards you...
rows.translation: ”他低吼着转向你...
rows.raw: "” he growls, turning towards you..."

rows.original: ... and right into a sucker-punch to the face. You deck the bastard, putting him down with one swift strike to the eye. He grunts and crumples, lying motionless on the floor.
rows.translation: ...结果迎面撞上突袭的一拳。你一击打中这个混蛋的眼睛，把他放倒。他低吼着瘫倒，在地板上一动不动。
rows.raw: "\n\n... and right into a sucker-punch to the face. You deck the bastard, putting him down with one swift strike to the eye. He grunts and crumples, lying motionless on the floor."

rows.original: “Nice hit!” Saen cheers, taking a knee beside the unconscious guard and lifting his wallet.
rows.translation: “打得漂亮！”赛恩欢呼着，在昏迷守卫身旁单膝跪地，拿走他的钱包。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nice hit!” Saen cheers, taking a knee beside the unconscious guard and lifting his wallet."

rows.original: You lunge forward, sinking your fist right into his gut. He gasps for the wind you just knocked out of him, pulling his gun just in time for the tentacle-probe in Saendra’s wrist to shoot out and wrench it out of his hand.
rows.translation: 你猛扑向前，一拳深深打进他的腹部。他因被你打得无法呼吸而喘息，刚拔出枪，赛恩德拉腕部的触手探针就猛然射出，把枪从手中扯走。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lunge forward, sinking your fist right into his gut. He gasps for the wind you just knocked out of him, pulling his gun just in time for the tentacle-probe in Saendra’s wrist to shoot out and wrench it out of his hand."

rows.original: The hapless guard crumples to his knees and promptly gets a boot in the face from your halfbreed companion. He grunts, lying motionless on the floor.
rows.translation: 这个倒霉守卫双膝跪地，随即挨了混血同伴迎面一靴。他低吼着倒下，在地板上一动不动。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe hapless guard crumples to his knees and promptly gets a boot in the face from your halfbreed companion. He grunts, lying motionless on the floor."

rows.original: “Good teamwork!” Saen grins, taking a knee beside the unconscious guard and lifting his wallet.
rows.translation: “配合得不错！”赛恩咧嘴笑着，在昏迷守卫身旁单膝跪地，拿走他的钱包。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good teamwork!” Saen grins, taking a knee beside the unconscious guard and lifting his wallet."

rows.original: You take a swing at him, but the guard nimbly dodges out of the way of your fist, drawing his own weapon in the same fluid motion. Behind you, Saen hisses a curse and dives for it, tackling the guard to the ground and burying her knee in his crotch. He groans, and his weapon goes clattering across the floor.
rows.translation: 你挥拳打向他，守卫却灵巧地闪开，并在同一个流畅动作中拔出武器。身后的赛恩低声咒骂，扑向对方，把守卫撞倒在地，用膝盖顶进他的胯间。他呻吟着，武器也哐当落上地板。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a swing at him, but the guard nimbly dodges out of the way of your fist, drawing his own weapon in the same fluid motion. Behind you, Saen hisses a curse and dives for it, tackling the guard to the ground and burying her knee in his crotch. He groans, and his weapon goes clattering across the floor."

rows.original: “Fuck off!” Saendra growls, sucker-punching him with her robotic arm. The guard grunts and crumples, lying motionless on the floor.
rows.translation: “滚开！”赛恩德拉低吼着，用机械手臂突袭他的脸。守卫低吼着瘫倒，在地板上一动不动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck off!” Saendra growls, sucker-punching him with her robotic arm. The guard grunts and crumples, lying motionless on the floor."

rows.original: With a sigh of relief, Saendra sits back on her knees and runs a hand through her crimson hair. “Let me handle the rough stuff next time,” she teases, clenching her chromed fist. “I punch harder.”
rows.translation: 赛恩德拉如释重负地叹息一声，跪坐下来，用手梳过深红头发。“下次把粗活交给我。”她握紧镀铬拳头调侃道。“我打得更重。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a sigh of relief, Saendra sits back on her knees and runs a hand through her crimson hair. “Let me handle the rough stuff next time,” she teases, clenching her chromed fist. “I punch harder.”"

rows.original: You bite back a comment as she lifts the guy’s wallet and crawls off of him.
rows.translation: 她拿走男人的钱包，从他身上爬开时，你忍住了评论。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bite back a comment as she lifts the guy’s wallet and crawls off of him."

rows.original: Just like Saen had suggested, you find a compact machine pistol next to the guard’s unconscious body.
rows.translation: 正如赛恩所说，你在昏迷守卫身旁发现了一把紧凑型机器手枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust like Saen had suggested, you find a compact machine pistol next to the guard’s unconscious body."

rows.original: Take It
rows.translation: 带走
rows.raw: "Take It"

rows.original: Leave It
rows.translation: 留下它
rows.raw: "Leave It"

rows.original: You snatch up the pistol from the guards body, hefting it in your grip with ease. Feels... pretty light actually, but not in a bad way.
rows.translation: 你从守卫身上捡起手枪，轻松地在手中掂量。感觉...其实相当轻，但并非坏事。
rows.raw: "You snatch up the pistol from the guards body, hefting it in your grip with ease. Feels... pretty light actually, but not in a bad way."

rows.original: “Okay, I don’t think anybody heard that,” Saendra says, pulling the Hammer pistol off her hip. “Or if they did, they probably figured it was that busty callgirl next door slamming her headboard into the wall again. Trust me, it was only sexy listening to her moaning all night the first time,” she laughs.
rows.translation: “好了，我觉得没人听见。”赛恩德拉说道，从腰间拔出铁锤手枪。“即使听见，他们大概也会以为是隔壁那个大胸应召女郎又把床头板撞上墙。相信我，整夜听她呻吟只有第一次时才性感。”她笑道。
rows.raw: "“Okay, I don’t think anybody heard that,” Saendra says, pulling the Hammer pistol off her hip. “Or if they did, they probably figured it was that busty callgirl next door slamming her headboard into the wall again. Trust me, it was only sexy listening to her moaning all night the first time,” she laughs."

rows.original: The way Saen’s cheeks tint with red, something tells you she did more than just listen to the local call-girl at that...
rows.translation: 赛恩的脸颊泛起红色；这让你觉得，她对那个本地应召女郎所做的恐怕不只是旁听...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe way Saen’s cheeks tint with red, something tells you she did more than just listen to the local call-girl at that..."

rows.original: “Alright, how do you want to do this, hero?” she asks, nodding towards the door. “We could go in guns blazing, but that’s going to draw a lot of attention. Anybody back in the bar could be a pirate in disguise, or the ones in there might call for reinforcements. Might get me kicked out of my free digs, too.”
rows.translation: “好了，你想怎么做，英雄？”她朝房门点头问道。“我们可以开枪冲进去，但那会引来很多注意。酒吧里的任何人都可能是伪装的海盗，里面那些人也可能呼叫增援。而且我也可能被赶出免费的住处。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, how do you want to do this, hero?” she asks, nodding towards the door. “We could go in guns blazing, but that’s going to draw a lot of attention. Anybody back in the bar could be a pirate in disguise, or the ones in there might call for reinforcements. Might get me kicked out of my free digs, too.”"

rows.original: “Any other suggestions, then?”
rows.translation: “那还有其他建议吗？”
