rows.original: “Knock knock!” Saen says, cracking the woman over the head with the butt of her pistol.
rows.translation: “敲门敲门！”赛恩说道，用手枪握把猛击女人的脑袋。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Knock knock!” Saen says, cracking the woman over the head with the butt of her pistol."

rows.original: The pirate tech collapses with blood spilling out of her nose, leaving you and Saen to hop over her body and into the room. It’s a small, cramped space with peeling wallpaper and dim lights that barely let you see. A bed has been pushed against the northern wall, opposite a metal desk where a truckload of computer gear is set up.
rows.translation: 海盗技术员倒在地上，鼻子不断流血；你和赛恩跨过她的身体，进入房间。这里狭小拥挤，墙纸剥落，昏暗灯光几乎无法让你看清。床被推到北墙边，对面是一张金属桌，上面架设了卡车大小的一堆计算机设备。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe pirate tech collapses with blood spilling out of her nose, leaving you and Saen to hop over her body and into the room. It’s a small, cramped space with peeling wallpaper and dim lights that barely let you see. A bed has been pushed against the northern wall, opposite a metal desk where a truckload of computer gear is set up."

rows.original: Sitting on the bed with ropes tied around his arms and legs is a grizzled looking human who’s clearly had some better days: he’s gotten roughed up pretty good, and his mechanic’s outfit’s been darkened with blood and grease. Saendra runs over to him and grabs the man’s shoulders.
rows.translation: 床上坐着一个饱经风霜的人类，双臂和双腿都被绳子绑住，显然已经过了些苦日子；他遭受了相当严重的殴打，机械师制服也被鲜血和油污染黑。赛恩德拉跑过去，抓住男人的肩膀。
rows.raw: "\n\nSitting on the bed with ropes tied around his arms and legs is a grizzled looking human who’s clearly had some better days: he’s gotten roughed up pretty good, and his mechanic’s outfit’s been darkened with blood and grease. Saendra runs over to him and grabs the man’s shoulders."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Valeria, think you can overload the power in there?” you ask, jerking a thumb to the pirates’ door.
rows.translation: “瓦莱里娅，你觉得自己能让里面的电力过载吗？”你朝海盗房间竖起拇指，问道。
rows.raw: "“Valeria, think you can overload the power in there?” you ask, jerking a thumb to the pirates’ door."

rows.original: The little holo-fairy shakes her head apologetically. “Not from digital space. I’m equipped for basic security tasks, but I don’t have the training protocols to go toe to toe with their hacker. You’d have to do it manually, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 小小全息仙女歉意地摇摇头。“从数字空间做不到。我配备了基础安保任务功能，却没有足以和他们的黑客正面对决的训练协议。你必须手动完成，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe little holo-fairy shakes her head apologetically. “Not from digital space. I’m equipped for basic security tasks, but I don’t have the training protocols to go toe to toe with their hacker. You’d have to do it manually, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: Well, shit. You’ll have to find another way.
rows.translation: 好吧，该死。你得另想办法。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, shit. You’ll have to find another way."

rows.original: You can do that. “Find me an access port and-”
rows.translation: 这个你能做到。“帮我找一个接入端口，然后——”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can do that. “Find me an access port and-”"

rows.original: “There’s one right there,” Val says, flying over to a small panel on the wall. “If you know what wires to cross, you should be able to cause a power surge. If I’m right, the pirates’ hacker is plugged into a holobank computer inside. Cause an overload, and you’ll knock him out at the very least.”
rows.translation: “那里就有一个。”瓦尔说着飞向墙上的一块小面板。“只要知道该让哪些线路交叉，你应该能制造电涌。如果我猜得没错，海盗的黑客正在里面接入全息库计算机。制造过载，至少可以把他击昏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There’s one right there,” Val says, flying over to a small panel on the wall. “If you know what wires to cross, you should be able to cause a power surge. If I’m right, the pirates’ hacker is plugged into a holobank computer inside. Cause an overload, and you’ll knock him out at the very least.”"

rows.original: Sounds good. You crouch down and, with Saen’s help, pull the panel off of the wall and start to pull wires. With a little help from your halfbreed companion and her fairy partner, you find the right wires to cross and converters to boost until the panel erupts in a cloud of sparks and smoke.
rows.translation: 听起来不错。你蹲下，在赛恩帮助下把面板从墙上拆下，开始拉扯线路。混血同伴与她的仙女伙伴提供了一些帮助，你找到需要交叉的正确线路和需要增压的转换器，直到面板在火花与烟雾中爆发。
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds good. You crouch down and, with Saen’s help, pull the panel off of the wall and start to pull wires. With a little help from your halfbreed companion and her fairy partner, you find the right wires to cross and converters to boost until the panel erupts in a cloud of sparks and smoke."

rows.original: From the pirates’ room, you hear a shriek of pain and a heavy thud, like a body collapsing. A second later and the door slams open, and a burly guy wearing a duster over a ballistic vest storms out, a shotgun at the ready.
rows.translation: 你听见海盗房中传来痛苦尖叫与沉重闷响，仿佛有人倒下。片刻后，房门猛然打开，一个魁梧男人冲了出来；他在防弹背心外穿着风衣，手中霰弹枪蓄势待发。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the pirates’ room, you hear a shriek of pain and a heavy thud, like a body collapsing. A second later and the door slams open, and a burly guy wearing a duster over a ballistic vest storms out, a shotgun at the ready."

rows.original: Saendra has just enough time to yell “Shit!” before bullets start flying.
rows.translation: 赛恩德拉只来得及大喊一声“该死！”，子弹便开始飞舞。
rows.raw: "\n\nSaendra has just enough time to yell “Shit!” before bullets start flying."

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: “Alright, we’ll go with your plan,” you tell Saendra, eyeing her mouthwatering rack. “Let’s lure the bastards out.”
rows.translation: “好吧，就按你的计划来。”你盯着赛恩德拉令人垂涎的胸脯说道。“把那些混蛋引出来。”
rows.raw: "“Alright, we’ll go with your plan,” you tell Saendra, eyeing her mouthwatering rack. “Let’s lure the bastards out.”"

rows.original: She laughs and pulls her shirt up over her head, letting her pink-tipped tits pop free. She gives a jubilant little bounce and saunters over to the pirates’ door, putting herself on full display as she knocks. You put your back to the wall, out of sight of whoever might answer.
rows.translation: 她笑着把衬衫从头顶脱下，让粉色尖端的乳房弹出。她欢快地弹跳一下，大摇大摆地走到海盗房门前，敲门时把自己完全展示出来。你背靠墙壁，躲在应门者的视线外。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs and pulls her shirt up over her head, letting her pink-tipped tits pop free. She gives a jubilant little bounce and saunters over to the pirates’ door, putting herself on full display as she knocks. You put your back to the wall, out of sight of whoever might answer."

rows.original: Then again, with a gigantic animal body like yours, you’re not exactly hard to spot...
rows.translation: 不过，拥有这样一副巨型动物身躯，你其实并不难被发现...
rows.raw: " Then again, with a gigantic animal body like yours, you’re not exactly hard to spot..."

rows.original: The door opens a few moments later, revealing a burly, gruff-looking pirate in a long coat and a ballistic vest, with a shotgun slung over his shoulder. While he starts out with a scowl and narrowed eyes, his attention immediately shifts down to the halfbreed’s ample tits, and his jaw goes slack.
rows.translation: 片刻后，房门打开，露出一个身穿长外套与防弹背心、肩上挂着霰弹枪的魁梧粗野海盗。起初他还皱着眉、眯起眼，但注意力立刻移向混血儿丰满的乳房，下巴也随之松垮。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe door opens a few moments later, revealing a burly, gruff-looking pirate in a long coat and a ballistic vest, with a shotgun slung over his shoulder. While he starts out with a scowl and narrowed eyes, his attention immediately shifts down to the halfbreed’s ample tits, and his jaw goes slack."

rows.original: “Woah,” he says, staring at Saen’s chest. You take advantage of the man’s momentary distraction to lunge forward and
rows.translation: “哇哦。”他盯着赛恩的胸口说道。你利用男人短暂分心的机会猛扑向前，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Woah,” he says, staring at Saen’s chest. You take advantage of the man’s momentary distraction to lunge forward and"

rows.original: deck the bastard, cracking him over the head and watching the body tumble to the deck
rows.translation: 放倒这个混蛋，重击他的脑袋，看着身体翻倒在甲板上
rows.raw: " deck the bastard, cracking him over the head and watching the body tumble to the deck"

rows.original: punch him right in the throat, dropping him gagging onto the deck
rows.translation: 一拳打中他的喉咙，让他干呕着倒上甲板
rows.raw: " punch him right in the throat, dropping him gagging onto the deck"

rows.original: grab him, wresting the bastard down until Saen can bash him over the head with a steel-tipped boot
rows.translation: 抓住他，将这个混蛋扭倒，直到赛恩能用钢头靴猛击他的脑袋
rows.raw: " grab him, wresting the bastard down until Saen can bash him over the head with a steel-tipped boot"

rows.original: “Down you go!” Saen laughs, drawing her handgun.
rows.translation: “给我倒下！”赛恩笑着拔出手枪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Down you go!” Saen laughs, drawing her handgun."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Kick the door,” you say, pulling a flash grenade out and pulling the pin. Saen gives you a nod, rears her leg back, and slams her foot into the door. It buckles, tumbling back on its hinges and you toss the flashbang in.
rows.translation: “踹门。”你一边说，一边掏出闪光手榴弹并拔掉保险销。赛恩朝你点点头，向后抬腿，重重一脚踹上房门。门板弯折着从铰链上倒下，你也把闪光弹扔了进去。
rows.raw: "“Kick the door,” you say, pulling a flash grenade out and pulling the pin. Saen gives you a nod, rears her leg back, and slams her foot into the door. It buckles, tumbling back on its hinges and you toss the flashbang in."

rows.original: A thunderous kabang echoes out of the room with a blinding flash to accompany it. The moment the bang passes, you and Saendra charge in with weapons drawn - and come face to face with a staggering man, dressed in a long coat and a ballistic vest, fumbling for the shotgun strapped to his back.
rows.translation: 一声雷鸣般的轰隆从屋内回荡而出，伴随刺眼闪光。巨响一过，你和赛恩德拉便拔出武器冲进去，迎面撞上一个踉跄的男人；他身穿长外套与防弹背心，正慌乱地伸手去拿绑在背后的霰弹枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nA thunderous kabang echoes out of the room with a blinding flash to accompany it. The moment the bang passes, you and Saendra charge in with weapons drawn - and come face to face with a staggering man, dressed in a long coat and a ballistic vest, fumbling for the shotgun strapped to his back."

rows.original: FlashGrenade
rows.raw: "FlashGrenade"

rows.original: FlashGrenade
rows.raw: "FlashGrenade"

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: “Fuck it. Let’s do it loud,” you say, nodding towards the door. Saen grins and thumbs the safety on her Hammer pistol.
rows.translation: “去他的。我们就大闹一场。”你朝门口点头说道。赛恩咧嘴笑着，用拇指拨开铁锤手枪的保险。
rows.raw: "“Fuck it. Let’s do it loud,” you say, nodding towards the door. Saen grins and thumbs the safety on her Hammer pistol."

rows.original: “Guess I didn’t need a free place to stay anyway,” she chuckles, following your lead and getting ready to knock the door in. The two of you exchange and glance, then shove the door in together, charging in the moment the heavy mass of steel buckles beneath your shoulder.
rows.translation: “反正我大概也不需要免费的住处。”她轻笑着跟随你的动作，准备撞开房门。你们交换眼神，随后一同推门；沉重的钢铁在肩膀下弯折时，你们立刻冲了进去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Guess I didn’t need a free place to stay anyway,” she chuckles, following your lead and getting ready to knock the door in. The two of you exchange and glance, then shove the door in together, charging in the moment the heavy mass of steel buckles beneath your shoulder."

rows.original: Just inside the door is a gruff-looking man in a long coat and a ballistic vest - and who’s got a shotgun aimed right at you. There’s no avoiding a fight now!
rows.translation: 房门内侧正站着一个身穿长外套与防弹背心、外表粗野的男人，而且一把霰弹枪正瞄准你。现在已经无法避免战斗了！
rows.raw: "\n\nJust inside the door is a gruff-looking man in a long coat and a ballistic vest - and who’s got a shotgun aimed right at you. There’s no avoiding a fight now!"

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: Saendra quickly pokes out of cover from time to time, ready to take potshots at anything and everything she can sight quickly enough before shifting back to safety.
rows.translation: 赛恩德拉迅速地时不时探出掩体，准备朝任何足够快进入视野的东西开上几枪，随后重新退回安全位置。
rows.raw: "Saendra quickly pokes out of cover from time to time, ready to take potshots at anything and everything she can sight quickly enough before shifting back to safety."

rows.original: Saen casually sidesteps out of the way.
rows.translation: 赛恩若无其事地向旁边闪开。
rows.raw: "Saen casually sidesteps out of the way."

rows.original: VOID PIRATE
rows.raw: "VOID PIRATE"

rows.original: MERCGUARD
rows.raw: "MERCGUARD"

rows.original: Void Pirate
rows.translation: 虚空海盗
rows.raw: "Void Pirate"

rows.original: Victory
rows.translation: 胜利
rows.raw: "Victory"

rows.original: The guard collapses, unable to fight anymore. Saen gives him a solid kick to the head, making sure he’s down for the count, and flashes you a cocky grin.
rows.translation: 守卫倒下，再也无力战斗。赛恩狠狠踢了一脚他的脑袋，确保他彻底失去行动能力，又朝你露出自负的笑容。
rows.raw: "The guard collapses, unable to fight anymore. Saen gives him a solid kick to the head, making sure he’s down for the count, and flashes you a cocky grin."

rows.original: The two of you advance into the pirates’ room, stepping over the guard’s body as you go.
rows.translation: 你们跨过守卫的身体，向海盗房间深处推进。
rows.raw: " The two of you advance into the pirates’ room, stepping over the guard’s body as you go."

rows.original: Inside, you find a knocked out ausar woman jacked into an expensive-looking computer rig. She’s face-down on a desk at the side of the room, with smoke coming from the headset plugged into her ears. Ouch.
rows.translation: 屋内，一个昏迷的奥萨女人接入了一套看起来价格昂贵的计算机设备。她脸朝下趴在房间侧面的桌上，插进耳朵的头戴设备正冒着烟。真痛。
rows.raw: "\n\nInside, you find a knocked out ausar woman jacked into an expensive-looking computer rig. She’s face-down on a desk at the side of the room, with smoke coming from the headset plugged into her ears. Ouch."

rows.original: Opposite her, a bed has been pushed against the northern wall, opposite a metal desk where a truckload of computer gear is set up. Sitting on the bed with ropes tied around his arms and legs is a grizzled looking human who’s clearly had some better days: he’s gotten roughed up pretty good, and his mechanic’s outfit’s been darkened with blood and grease. Saendra runs over to him and grabs the man’s shoulders.
rows.translation: 她的对面，北墙边放着一张床；另一侧金属桌上架设着卡车大小的一堆计算机设备。床上坐着一个饱经风霜的人类，双臂和双腿都被绳子绑住，显然已经过了些苦日子；他遭受了相当严重的殴打，机械师制服也被鲜血和油污染黑。赛恩德拉跑过去，抓住男人的肩膀。
rows.raw: "\n\nOpposite her, a bed has been pushed against the northern wall, opposite a metal desk where a truckload of computer gear is set up. Sitting on the bed with ropes tied around his arms and legs is a grizzled looking human who’s clearly had some better days: he’s gotten roughed up pretty good, and his mechanic’s outfit’s been darkened with blood and grease. Saendra runs over to him and grabs the man’s shoulders."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The two of you advance into the pirates’ room, stepping over the guard’s body as you go.
rows.translation: 你们跨过守卫的身体，向海盗房间深处推进。
rows.raw: "The two of you advance into the pirates’ room, stepping over the guard’s body as you go."

rows.original: An ausar woman with a shock of blonde hair is standing inside, aiming a machine pistol at you and stumbling back until she’s against the far wall with nowhere else to go. Wires lead down from a brace around her neck to a huge rig of computer equipment planted on a desk a few feet away.
rows.translation: 一个有着蓬乱金发的奥萨女人站在里面，用机器手枪瞄准你，并一路后退，直到抵住最远处的墙壁，再也无路可走。电线从她颈间的支架向下延伸，连接到几英尺外桌上那套庞大计算机设备。
rows.raw: "\n\nAn ausar woman with a shock of blonde hair is standing inside, aiming a machine pistol at you and stumbling back until she’s against the far wall with nowhere else to go. Wires lead down from a brace around her neck to a huge rig of computer equipment planted on a desk a few feet away."

rows.original: “Stay back!” she shouts, waving her gun around. “I’m warning you!”
rows.translation: “退后！”她挥舞着枪大喊。“我在警告你！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Stay back!” she shouts, waving her gun around. “I’m warning you!”"

rows.original: “Get fucked, bitch,” Saen answers, taking aim.
rows.translation: “去你妈的，母狗。”赛恩瞄准她回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Get fucked, bitch,” Saen answers, taking aim."

rows.original: That settles that!
rows.translation: 这下没有疑问了！
rows.raw: "\n\nThat settles that!"

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: Void Techie
rows.translation: 虚空技术员
rows.raw: "Void Techie"

rows.original: Cautiously, you peer into the room. An ausar woman with a shock of blonde hair is standing inside, aiming a machine pistol toward the door and stumbling back until she’s against the far wall with nowhere else to go. Wires lead down from a brace around her neck to a huge rig of computer equipment planted on a desk a few feet away.
rows.translation: 你谨慎地朝房间里窥视。一个有着蓬乱金发的奥萨女人站在里面，用机器手枪瞄准门口，并一路后退，直到抵住最远处的墙壁，再也无路可走。电线从她颈间的支架向下延伸，连接到几英尺外桌上那套庞大计算机设备。
rows.raw: "Cautiously, you peer into the room. An ausar woman with a shock of blonde hair is standing inside, aiming a machine pistol toward the door and stumbling back until she’s against the far wall with nowhere else to go. Wires lead down from a brace around her neck to a huge rig of computer equipment planted on a desk a few feet away."

rows.original: “Stay back!” she shouts, waving her gun around. “I’m warning you!”
rows.translation: “退后！”她挥舞着枪大喊。“我在警告你！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Stay back!” she shouts, waving her gun around. “I’m warning you!”"

rows.original: “Get fucked, bitch,” Saen answers, taking aim through the door.
rows.translation: “去你妈的，母狗。”赛恩隔着门瞄准她回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Get fucked, bitch,” Saen answers, taking aim through the door."

rows.original: That settles that!
rows.translation: 这下没有疑问了！
rows.raw: "\n\nThat settles that!"

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: MERCGUARD
rows.raw: "MERCGUARD"

rows.original: Void Pirate
rows.translation: 虚空海盗
rows.raw: "Void Pirate"

rows.original: Defeat
rows.translation: 战败
rows.raw: "Defeat"

rows.original: “Hehehe,” the pirate chuckles as you and Saen collapse, battered down by his barrage of shells. “Got us a couple of live ones here... and what’s this?” he grunts, turning to Saendra. “Ah, you’re the kitten Bragga was after, aren’t you? Come to rescue your friend, huh?”
rows.translation: “嘿嘿嘿。”你和赛恩在他的霰弹轰击下倒地时，海盗轻笑起来。“这里有两个活口...这又是什么？”他转向赛恩德拉低吼。“啊，你就是布拉加要找的那只小猫，对吧？来救你的朋友，嗯？”
rows.raw: "“Hehehe,” the pirate chuckles as you and Saen collapse, battered down by his barrage of shells. “Got us a couple of live ones here... and what’s this?” he grunts, turning to Saendra. “Ah, you’re the kitten Bragga was after, aren’t you? Come to rescue your friend, huh?”"

rows.original: He tsks his tongue and kicks Saen’s pistol away, leaving her defenseless. “There’s a bounty out on you, kitten. Guess I’ll be getting paid double... plus a little fun before I hand you over. As for your friend...” he waves his shotgun over in your direction, and pulls the trigger as casually as he might toss away a cigarette butt. Your world is overwhelmed by a lightning bolt of pain, and the world goes black.
rows.translation: 他咂咂舌，一脚踢开赛恩的手枪，让她失去防备。“有人悬赏你，小猫。我想我会拿到双倍赏金...而且交人前还能找点乐子。至于你的朋友...”他让霰弹枪转向你，扣动扳机时随意得仿佛只是在扔掉一截烟头。一道闪电般的疼痛淹没你的世界，随后一切陷入黑暗。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe tsks his tongue and kicks Saen’s pistol away, leaving her defenseless. “There’s a bounty out on you, kitten. Guess I’ll be getting paid double... plus a little fun before I hand you over. As for your friend...” he waves his shotgun over in your direction, and pulls the trigger as casually as he might toss away a cigarette butt. Your world is overwhelmed by a lightning bolt of pain, and the world goes black."

rows.original: In the end, you got the easy way out.
rows.translation: 到头来，你反而得到了解脱。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn the end, you got the easy way out."

rows.original: Saendra quickly pokes out of cover from time to time, ready to take potshots at anything and everything she can sight quickly enough before shifting back to safety.
rows.translation: 赛恩德拉迅速地时不时探出掩体，准备朝任何足够快进入视野的东西开上几枪，随后重新退回安全位置。
rows.raw: "Saendra quickly pokes out of cover from time to time, ready to take potshots at anything and everything she can sight quickly enough before shifting back to safety."

rows.original: Saen casually sidesteps out of the way.
rows.translation: 赛恩若无其事地向旁边闪开。
rows.raw: "Saen casually sidesteps out of the way."

rows.original: VOID TECHIE
rows.raw: "VOID TECHIE"

rows.original: Void Techie
rows.translation: 虚空技术员
rows.raw: "Void Techie"

rows.original: Victory
rows.translation: 胜利
rows.raw: "Victory"

rows.original: The techie pirate
rows.translation: 技术员海盗
rows.raw: "The techie pirate"

rows.original: The last of the pirates
rows.translation: 最后一名海盗
rows.raw: "The last of the pirates"

rows.original: collapses, unable to put up any more resistance. Saen breathes a sigh of relief, and the two of you advance into the room. It’s a small affair, with peeling wallpaper and dim lights that barely let you see. A bed has been pushed against the northern wall, opposite a metal desk where a truckload of computer gear is set up.
rows.translation: 倒下，再也无法继续抵抗。赛恩如释重负地叹息一声，你们一同进入房间。这里狭小，墙纸剥落，昏暗灯光几乎无法让人看清；床被推到北墙边，对面金属桌上架设了卡车大小的一堆计算机设备。
rows.raw: " collapses, unable to put up any more resistance. Saen breathes a sigh of relief, and the two of you advance into the room. It’s a small affair, with peeling wallpaper and dim lights that barely let you see. A bed has been pushed against the northern wall, opposite a metal desk where a truckload of computer gear is set up."

rows.original: Sitting on the bed with ropes tied around his arms and legs is a grizzled looking human who’s clearly had some better days: he’s gotten roughed up pretty good, and his mechanic’s outfit’s been darkened with blood and grease. Saendra runs over to him and grabs the man’s shoulders.
rows.translation: 床上坐着一个饱经风霜的人类，双臂和双腿都被绳子绑住，显然已经过了些苦日子；他遭受了相当严重的殴打，机械师制服也被鲜血和油污染黑。赛恩德拉跑过去，抓住男人的肩膀。
rows.raw: "\n\nSitting on the bed with ropes tied around his arms and legs is a grizzled looking human who’s clearly had some better days: he’s gotten roughed up pretty good, and his mechanic’s outfit’s been darkened with blood and grease. Saendra runs over to him and grabs the man’s shoulders."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Void Techie
rows.translation: 虚空技术员
rows.raw: "Void Techie"

rows.original: Defeat
rows.translation: 战败
rows.raw: "Defeat"

rows.original: The resistance drains out of you, and soon you find yourself slumping to the ground with a groan. Saen follows you a moment later, succumbing to her injuries.
rows.translation: 抵抗的力量从你体内流失，很快，你呻吟着瘫倒在地。片刻后，赛恩也跟着倒下，屈服于伤势。
rows.raw: "The resistance drains out of you, and soon you find yourself slumping to the ground with a groan. Saen follows you a moment later, succumbing to her injuries."

rows.original: “Holy shit. Get some!” the pirate babe cheers, fist-pumping the air in front of her. She holsters her machine pistol and walks over to Saendra, grabbing the halfbreed by the scruff of the neck. “And you’re that renegade we were supposed to keep an eye out for, aren’t you? Man, there’s a huge bounty on your head, bitch. Guess I get to collect.
rows.translation: “我的天。吃我一招！”那个女海盗欢呼着，在身前挥拳庆祝。她收起机器手枪，走到赛恩德拉身边，抓住混血儿的后颈。“你就是我们被要求留意的那个叛徒，对吧？天啊，你脑袋上的赏金多得吓人，母狗。看来我要领到了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Holy shit. Get some!” the pirate babe cheers, fist-pumping the air in front of her. She holsters her machine pistol and walks over to Saendra, grabbing the halfbreed by the scruff of the neck. “And you’re that renegade we were supposed to keep an eye out for, aren’t you? Man, there’s a huge bounty on your head, bitch. Guess I get to collect."

rows.original: “As for you,” she says, turning your way. “Who the fuck are you? You know what; doesn’t matter. Fuck off.”
rows.translation: “至于你。”她转向你说道。“你他妈是谁？算了，不重要。滚开。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As for you,” she says, turning your way. “Who the fuck are you? You know what; doesn’t matter. Fuck off.”"

rows.original: Her boot comes down with an agonizing crack, and your world goes black.
rows.translation: 她的靴子伴随痛苦的咔嚓声落下，你的世界陷入黑暗。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer boot comes down with an agonizing crack, and your world goes black."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Defeat
rows.translation: 战败
rows.raw: "Defeat"

rows.original: MERCHANT'S THOROUGHFARE
rows.raw: "MERCHANT'S THOROUGHFARE"

rows.original: You wake up... what must be hours later with a splitting headache and swimming vision. Everything hurts.
rows.translation: 你醒来时...大概已经过了几个小时，脑袋剧痛，视野摇晃。全身都在疼。
rows.raw: "You wake up... what must be hours later with a splitting headache and swimming vision. Everything hurts."

rows.original: “You okay?” a voice says as you strain to open your eyes. You’re on Tavros station still - that much is obvious, by the blinding lights and the faint music playing over the merchant row speakers. A uniformed station security officer is kneeling over you, a concerned look on her face.
rows.translation: “你还好吗？”你努力睁眼时，一个声音说道。你仍在塔夫罗斯站，这一点从刺眼灯光和商贸街扬声器播放的微弱音乐便能看出。一名身穿制服的空间站安保人员跪在你身边，脸上满是关切。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You okay?” a voice says as you strain to open your eyes. You’re on Tavros station still - that much is obvious, by the blinding lights and the faint music playing over the merchant row speakers. A uniformed station security officer is kneeling over you, a concerned look on her face."

rows.original: “Hey, you alright?” the officer repeats, shaking your shoulder. She’s reaching for her radio by the time you manage to nod, and pull yourself up into a sitting position. You grunt and grab your head, trying to arrest the pounding in your skull.
rows.translation: “嘿，你没事吧？”警官再次问道，摇动你的肩膀。等你终于能够点头、撑着坐起时，她已经伸手去拿无线电。你低吼着抱住脑袋，试图制止颅内的阵阵剧痛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, you alright?” the officer repeats, shaking your shoulder. She’s reaching for her radio by the time you manage to nod, and pull yourself up into a sitting position. You grunt and grab your head, trying to arrest the pounding in your skull."

rows.original: You look around, at the glowing white lights above and the flickering holo-signs of the merchant shops around you. You’re just outside
rows.translation: 你环顾四周，看向头顶发光的白灯与周围商店不断闪烁的全息招牌。你就在
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look around, at the glowing white lights above and the flickering holo-signs of the merchant shops around you. You’re just outside "

joinAfter.expression:
void 0 === flags.MET_SERA
                ? "one of the transformative vendors"
                : "Sera’s shop"

rows.original: one of the transformative vendors
rows.translation: 一家变身物品商店
rows.raw: "one of the transformative vendors"

rows.original: Sera’s shop
rows.translation: 塞拉的商店
rows.raw: "Sera’s shop"

rows.original: near Anon’s... and very much alone. Saendra’s nowhere to be seen.
rows.translation: 外面，靠近阿农酒吧...而且完全孤身一人。赛恩德拉不见踪影。
rows.raw: " near Anon’s... and very much alone. Saendra’s nowhere to be seen."

rows.original: “I’m... I’m fine,” you groan. You must have been dumped on the side of the corridor after the pirates were done with you.
rows.translation: “我...我没事。”你呻吟道。海盗处理完你后，大概把你扔在了走廊旁。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m... I’m fine,” you groan. You must have been dumped on the side of the corridor after the pirates were done with you."

rows.original: The guard helps you up and you end up having to file a report with Tavros security: telling them that you and your friend got into a firefight with pirates twice, and ended up losing this second time. The officer expresses her sympathies, but tells you that there’s not a lot security can do about it: the station’s cameras tracked the pirates all the way to the docks, but they left well before you woke up. With Saen in tow, too.
rows.translation: 守卫扶你起来，你最终不得不向塔夫罗斯安保部门提交报告，告诉他们，你和朋友两次与海盗交火，并在第二次输了。警官表示同情，却说安保部门对此无能为力；空间站摄像头一路追踪海盗到船坞，但他们早在你醒来前便离开了，而且还带着赛恩。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe guard helps you up and you end up having to file a report with Tavros security: telling them that you and your friend got into a firefight with pirates twice, and ended up losing this second time. The officer expresses her sympathies, but tells you that there’s not a lot security can do about it: the station’s cameras tracked the pirates all the way to the docks, but they left well before you woke up. With Saen in tow, too."

rows.original: As you’re discharged from station security and make your way back down to the merchant deck, you are forced to come to the realization that you’ll probably never see Saendra again...
rows.translation: 你从空间站安保部门获准离开，返回商贸甲板时，被迫意识到自己大概再也见不到赛恩德拉了...
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you’re discharged from station security and make your way back down to the merchant deck, you are forced to come to the realization that you’ll probably never see Saendra again..."

rows.original: “Pete! Peter, you okay?” Saendra says, gently shaking the man’s shoulders. He groans and slumps forward into her arms, alive but badly beaten.
rows.translation: “皮特！彼得，你还好吗？”赛恩德拉轻轻摇动男人的肩膀，说道。他呻吟着倒进她怀中；还活着，但伤势严重。
rows.raw: "“Pete! Peter, you okay?” Saendra says, gently shaking the man’s shoulders. He groans and slumps forward into her arms, alive but badly beaten."

rows.original: “Shit,” Saen sighs, putting her arms around his shoulders. “I gotta get him to a hospital, [pc.name]. Thanks for the help... I owe you.”
rows.translation: “该死。”赛恩叹息着，用双臂环住他的肩膀。“我得送他去医院，[pc.name]。谢谢你的帮助...我欠你一次。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit,” Saen sighs, putting her arms around his shoulders. “I gotta get him to a hospital, [pc.name]. Thanks for the help... I owe you.”"

rows.original: Something’s been gnawing at you for a while about... well, everything with Saendra. You’re not dumb enough to think these attacks are just random anymore. “I think you owe me an explanation.”
rows.translation: 有件事一直在困扰你，事关...嗯，与赛恩德拉有关的一切。你还没有蠢到继续以为这些袭击只是随机事件。“我觉得你欠我一个解释。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething’s been gnawing at you for a while about... well, everything with Saendra. You’re not dumb enough to think these attacks are just random anymore. “I think you owe me an explanation.”"

rows.original: She flinches as if struck, and her twin tails coil down defensively under her legs. <i>“Yeah... I guess I do, huh, hero? Look, like I said, I gotta get Pete here to a doctor. Catch me down at the bar sometime and I’ll tell you. I promise.
rows.translation: 她像是挨了一击般畏缩，两条尾巴防御性地卷到腿下。<i>“是啊...我想的确如此，对吧，英雄？听着，像我说的，我得送皮特去看医生。找个时间来楼下酒吧见我，我会告诉你。我保证。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe flinches as if struck, and her twin tails coil down defensively under her legs. <i>“Yeah... I guess I do, huh, hero? Look, like I said, I gotta get Pete here to a doctor. Catch me down at the bar sometime and I’ll tell you. I promise."

rows.original: Well, assuming I don’t get arrested first,” she says, looking around at the bullet holes in the walls.
rows.translation: 嗯，前提是我没有先被逮捕。”她看着墙上的弹孔说道。
rows.raw: " Well, assuming I don’t get arrested first,” she says, looking around at the bullet holes in the walls."

rows.original: That’ll have to do. You step out of Saendra’s way, and she hefts her friend up into her arms and staggers out towards the stairs. For your part, you spend a few minutes ransacking the place, trying to find anything of use.
rows.translation: 只能这样了。你从赛恩德拉面前让开，她把朋友抱进怀中，踉跄着走向楼梯。至于你，则花了几分钟洗劫这里，试图寻找任何有用的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’ll have to do. You step out of Saendra’s way, and she hefts her friend up into her arms and staggers out towards the stairs. For your part, you spend a few minutes ransacking the place, trying to find anything of use."

joinAfter.expression:
2 === flags.SAENDRA_XPACK1_RESCUE_TECHGUARD_STATE
                ? "Unfortunately, you fried the pirates’ computer"
                : "Unfortunately, the pirate techie must have fried her hard drive before she went down"

rows.original: Unfortunately, you fried the pirates’ computer
rows.translation: 很遗憾，你烧毁了海盗的计算机
rows.raw: "Unfortunately, you fried the pirates’ computer"

rows.original: Unfortunately, the pirate techie must have fried her hard drive before she went down
rows.translation: 很遗憾，那个海盗技术员一定在倒下前烧毁了硬盘
rows.raw: "Unfortunately, the pirate techie must have fried her hard drive before she went down"

rows.original: . You won’t be getting any information from that. You do, however, find a datapad on the tech’s body. Not only is it loaded with credits, which you quickly hijack, but there’s a bounty notice on it as well.
rows.translation: 。你无法从中获取任何情报。不过，你确实在技术员身上找到了一台数据板。它不仅存有大量信用点，被你迅速劫走，上面还有一份悬赏公告。
rows.raw: ". You won’t be getting any information from that. You do, however, find a datapad on the tech’s body. Not only is it loaded with credits, which you quickly hijack, but there’s a bounty notice on it as well."

rows.original: Somebody’s offering a hefty twenty grand for Saendra’s capture. Somebody named “Lord Bragga” of the Black Void Pirates. What the hell has Saen gotten herself mixed up with?
rows.translation: 有人悬赏整整两万信用点抓捕赛恩德拉。悬赏人名叫黑色虚空海盗的“布拉加大人”。赛恩到底把自己卷进了什么鬼事？
rows.raw: "\n\nSomebody’s offering a hefty twenty grand for Saendra’s capture. Somebody named “Lord Bragga” of the Black Void Pirates. What the hell has Saen gotten herself mixed up with?"

rows.original: You pocket the datapad and head back down to the bar. You’ll have to ask your hybrid companion herself if you want to find out the truth.
rows.translation: 你把数据板塞进口袋，返回楼下酒吧。想查明真相，只能亲自询问你的混种同伴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pocket the datapad and head back down to the bar. You’ll have to ask your hybrid companion herself if you want to find out the truth."

rows.original: Pirate Datapad
rows.raw: "Pirate Datapad"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Did you manage to find your friend?” you ask, immediately regretting asking when she gets a very sad look on her face.
rows.translation: “找到你的朋友了吗？”你问道；她脸上露出极其悲伤的神情，让你立刻后悔开口。
rows.raw: "“Did you manage to find your friend?” you ask, immediately regretting asking when she gets a very sad look on her face."

rows.original: “No,” Saen says, resting her chin in her hands. “Well, yes, but too late. Pirate bastards had already put a bullet in him by the time I got there. I fucked up, [pc.name]. Real bad.”
rows.translation: “没有。”赛恩把下巴搁在手中说道。“嗯，找到了，但太迟了。那些海盗混蛋在我赶到前就已经给了他一枪。我搞砸了，[pc.name]。搞得非常糟糕。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No,” Saen says, resting her chin in her hands. “Well, yes, but too late. Pirate bastards had already put a bullet in him by the time I got there. I fucked up, [pc.name]. Real bad.”"

rows.original: You grimace and put a hand on hers, squeezing it tight as the halfbreed lets out a ragged breath. “Pete is... he was a mechanic at the docks. The station chief decided the Phoenix was too banged up to take off - but she’s space worthy, I made sure of it! Pete agreed with me, said he’d smuggle me the access codes I’d need to take off without the chief noticing. I guess somebody must have been monitoring my comms... or maybe they grabbed Pete from the get-go. Who knows. Either way, I got him killed, and I’ve got nothing to show for it.”
rows.translation: 你皱起脸，把手放在她手上紧紧握住；混血儿发出凌乱的喘息。“皮特是...他以前是船坞的机械师。空间站负责人认定凤凰号损坏太重，无法起飞，但它能在太空航行，我亲自确认过！皮特也同意；他说会偷偷给我必要的访问码，让我在负责人没有发现的情况下起飞。我猜一定有人在监控我的通讯...或者他们从一开始就抓住了皮特。谁知道呢。无论如何，是我害死了他，而且什么也没得到。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grimace and put a hand on hers, squeezing it tight as the halfbreed lets out a ragged breath. “Pete is... he was a mechanic at the docks. The station chief decided the Phoenix was too banged up to take off - but she’s space worthy, I made sure of it! Pete agreed with me, said he’d smuggle me the access codes I’d need to take off without the chief noticing. I guess somebody must have been monitoring my comms... or maybe they grabbed Pete from the get-go. Who knows. Either way, I got him killed, and I’ve got nothing to show for it.”"

rows.original: A moment of silence passes before you ask if there’s anything you can do to help her.
rows.translation: 沉默片刻后，你问自己能否提供任何帮助。
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment of silence passes before you ask if there’s anything you can do to help her."

rows.original: Saen sighs and runs her chrome fingers through her hair. “I don’t know, hero. Unless you’ve got Tavros access codes tucked up your ass, I don’t think I’m ever going to get out of here. Not for a few years, anyway, until I can save up enough for a total refit of the Phoenix.”
rows.translation: 赛恩叹着气，用铬金属手指梳过头发。“我不知道，英雄。除非你屁股里藏着塔夫罗斯访问码，否则我觉得自己永远离不开这里。至少几年之内不行，得等我攒够钱，彻底整修凤凰号。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaen sighs and runs her chrome fingers through her hair. “I don’t know, hero. Unless you’ve got Tavros access codes tucked up your ass, I don’t think I’m ever going to get out of here. Not for a few years, anyway, until I can save up enough for a total refit of the Phoenix.”"

rows.original: If you have the credits to spare, maybe you could help Saendra out with that.
rows.translation: 如果有多余的信用点，也许你可以帮助赛恩德拉。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you have the credits to spare, maybe you could help Saendra out with that."

rows.original: “Hey, I’ve been thinking,” you say, fishing a credit stick out of your pack. “If this would help you out, Saen...”
rows.translation: “嘿，我一直在想。”你一边说，一边从背包里掏出信用点存储条。“如果这能帮到你，赛恩...”
rows.raw: "“Hey, I’ve been thinking,” you say, fishing a credit stick out of your pack. “If this would help you out, Saen...”"

rows.original: Her eyes widen as she realizes what it is in your hand. “Hey, what... what is this?”
rows.translation: 意识到你手里拿着什么，她睁大双眼。“嘿，什么...这是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer eyes widen as she realizes what it is in your hand. “Hey, what... what is this?”"

rows.original: You shrug. “I know you’re strapped for cash, so, I mean, I have plenty to spare...”
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩。“我知道你手头紧，所以，我的意思是，我有很多信用点可以拿出来...”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug. “I know you’re strapped for cash, so, I mean, I have plenty to spare...”"

rows.original: <i>“Oh, you
rows.translation: <i>“哦，你这个
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Oh, you "

rows.original: big
rows.translation: 大
rows.raw: "big"

rows.original: little
rows.translation: 小小的
rows.raw: "little"

rows.original: idiot...” Saen sighs, reaching across the table and curling your fingers back around the credit chit. “I don’t... I can’t take that, hero. You’ve done so much for me already. The last thing I want is to owe you more than I already do.”
rows.translation: 笨蛋...”赛恩叹了口气，隔着桌子伸出手，让你的手指重新握紧信用点芯片。“我不...我不能收下，英雄。你已经为我做了太多。我最不想做的，就是欠你的比现在更多。”
rows.raw: " idiot...” Saen sighs, reaching across the table and curling your fingers back around the credit chit. “I don’t... I can’t take that, hero. You’ve done so much for me already. The last thing I want is to owe you more than I already do.”"

rows.original: She tries to push your hand back, but you insist. You tell her to quit playing tough, to let you help her. After all, you have helped her so much in the past - you don’t want to see her rotting here on Tavros forever. She deserves a second chance, and you’re in a position to give it to her.
rows.translation: 她试着把你的手推回去，但你坚持己见。你让她别再逞强，允许你提供帮助。毕竟，过去你已经帮了她那么多；你不想看她永远烂在塔夫罗斯站。她值得第二次机会，而你恰好有能力给予。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe tries to push your hand back, but you insist. You tell her to quit playing tough, to let you help her. After all, you have helped her so much in the past - you don’t want to see her rotting here on Tavros forever. She deserves a second chance, and you’re in a position to give it to her."

rows.original: Saendra sighs. “You’re a sweetheart, you know that?” she says with a wry laugh. “One hell of a sweetheart.”
rows.translation: 赛恩德拉叹了口气。“你真是个甜心，知道吗？”她苦笑着说。“真他妈是个甜心。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaendra sighs. “You’re a sweetheart, you know that?” she says with a wry laugh. “One hell of a sweetheart.”"

rows.original: She smiles and wraps her chromed fingers around your hand, and the credit chit therein. Before she takes it, though, you squeeze her hand and ask if “sweetheart” is all she thinks about you.
rows.translation: 她微笑着，用镀铬手指包住你的手，以及里面的信用点芯片。不过她还没接走，你便捏住她的手，问道，在她心中，你是否只不过是“甜心”而已。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles and wraps her chromed fingers around your hand, and the credit chit therein. Before she takes it, though, you squeeze her hand and ask if “sweetheart” is all she thinks about you."

rows.original: “Not by a long shot,” Saendra says, reaching across the table to plant a kiss on your lips: soft, gentle, loving. You give her the credit chit, and return the red-maned pilot’s kiss with as much ardor as you can muster.
rows.translation: “远远不止。”赛恩德拉说着越过桌子，在你嘴唇上印下一吻，柔软、温和又充满爱意。你把信用点芯片交给她，并竭尽所能地热烈回应红发飞行员的吻。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not by a long shot,” Saendra says, reaching across the table to plant a kiss on your lips: soft, gentle, loving. You give her the credit chit, and return the red-maned pilot’s kiss with as much ardor as you can muster."

rows.original: When you break the kiss, Saen leans her brow against yours, keeping you together a moment longer. “Alright. I’m gonna go get started putting this to good use. I, um... thank you, [pc.name]. This means the world to me. I’ll see you soon.”
rows.translation: 亲吻结束时，赛恩把额头抵住你的额头，让两人多贴近了片刻。“好了。我要去开始好好利用这笔钱。我，呃...谢谢你，[pc.name]。这对我意义重大。很快再见。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you break the kiss, Saen leans her brow against yours, keeping you together a moment longer. “Alright. I’m gonna go get started putting this to good use. I, um... thank you, [pc.name]. This means the world to me. I’ll see you soon.”"

rows.original: You nod and wave, letting Saendra slip out of the bar to start putting that money to use.
rows.translation: 你点头挥手，让赛恩德拉溜出酒吧，开始使用那笔钱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and wave, letting Saendra slip out of the bar to start putting that money to use."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Hey,” you say, drawing the pirate datapad from your pack and tossing it onto the table. “We need to talk.”
rows.translation: “嘿。”你从背包取出海盗数据板，扔在桌上。“我们得谈谈。”
rows.raw: "“Hey,” you say, drawing the pirate datapad from your pack and tossing it onto the table. “We need to talk.”"

rows.original: Saen cocks an eyebrow and picks it up. Murmuring “What’s this,” she starts to flip through it. As she does, her emerald eyes grow wide. “What the fuck...”
rows.translation: 赛恩挑起一边眉毛，将它拿起。她低声说着“这是什么”，开始浏览。与此同时，她的翡翠色眼睛越睁越大。“这他妈是什么...”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaen cocks an eyebrow and picks it up. Murmuring “What’s this,” she starts to flip through it. As she does, her emerald eyes grow wide. “What the fuck...”"

rows.original: “Don’t tell me you don’t know what that’s about,” you say, narrowing your eyes. “You don’t get the Black Void putting a bounty that big on you just because.”
rows.translation: “别告诉我你不知道这是怎么回事。”你眯起眼睛说道。“黑色虚空不会无缘无故用那么高的赏金悬赏你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t tell me you don’t know what that’s about,” you say, narrowing your eyes. “You don’t get the Black Void putting a bounty that big on you just because.”"

rows.original: She doesn’t answer you for a while, too busy staring slack-jawed at the datapad you looted from her would-be attackers. After what seems like a brief eternity, Saendra sets it down and steeples her fingers.
rows.translation: 她久久没有回答，忙于目瞪口呆地盯着你从那些未遂袭击者手中掠来的数据板。仿佛短暂的永恒过去，赛恩德拉终于把它放下，十指相抵。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe doesn’t answer you for a while, too busy staring slack-jawed at the datapad you looted from her would-be attackers. After what seems like a brief eternity, Saendra sets it down and steeples her fingers."

rows.original: “I can’t believe she did that,” Saen finally says, sighing. “I understand the shit with the Phoenix, even kind of expected it. But a bounty? That’s low, Miri.”
rows.translation: “我不敢相信她这么做了。”赛恩终于叹息着说道。“凤凰号那件破事我能理解，甚至有些预料到了。但悬赏？这太卑鄙了，米莉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can’t believe she did that,” Saen finally says, sighing. “I understand the shit with the Phoenix, even kind of expected it. But a bounty? That’s low, Miri.”"

rows.original: “What’re you talking about? Who’s Miri?”
rows.translation: “你在说什么？米莉是谁？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’re you talking about? Who’s Miri?”"

rows.original: Your companion doesn’t meet your eye as she answers. “Mirian Bragga. A Dread Lord of the Black Void pirates, one of the most powerful women in the galaxy’s underworld. She... we were...” she pauses for a moment, struggling to collect her thoughts. When she continues, Saendra’s robotic fingers clench hard. “Miri and I were raised together. Like sisters, almost. And yeah, before you ask, that means I used to be part of the Void. My parents commanded an interceptor frigate on the fringe; when I was born, they left me on a Void base to keep me safe. Miri was just a year older, and our parents were good friends. So Miss Bragga and her servants brought me up, same as her daughter.”
rows.translation: 同伴回答时没有与你对视。“米莉安·布拉加。黑色虚空海盗的一位恐惧领主，也是整个星系地下世界最有权势的女人之一。她...我们曾经...”她停顿片刻，努力整理思绪。继续时，赛恩德拉的机械手指紧紧握起。“米莉和我一起长大。几乎就像姐妹。而且没错，在你开口问之前，这意味着我以前是虚空的一员。我父母在边疆指挥一艘拦截护卫舰；我出生时，他们把我留在虚空基地，确保我的安全。米莉只比我大一岁，我们的父母又是好友。所以布拉加女士和她的仆人把我抚养长大，和她女儿享受同样的待遇。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour companion doesn’t meet your eye as she answers. “Mirian Bragga. A Dread Lord of the Black Void pirates, one of the most powerful women in the galaxy’s underworld. She... we were...” she pauses for a moment, struggling to collect her thoughts. When she continues, Saendra’s robotic fingers clench hard. “Miri and I were raised together. Like sisters, almost. And yeah, before you ask, that means I used to be part of the Void. My parents commanded an interceptor frigate on the fringe; when I was born, they left me on a Void base to keep me safe. Miri was just a year older, and our parents were good friends. So Miss Bragga and her servants brought me up, same as her daughter.”"

rows.original: “I could have been her second in command,” Saen laughs sadly. “We were such good friends...”
rows.translation: “我本来可以成为她的副手。”赛恩悲伤地笑道。“我们以前是那么要好的朋友...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I could have been her second in command,” Saen laughs sadly. “We were such good friends...”"

rows.original: She puts her chin in her hands and glances up at you, waiting for you to speak. “What happened to make you leave?”
rows.translation: 她用双手托住下巴，抬眼看你，等待你开口。“发生了什么，让你决定离开？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe puts her chin in her hands and glances up at you, waiting for you to speak. “What happened to make you leave?”"

rows.original: “I didn’t get the chance to leave. Not officially. I guess you could call the day you rescued me my farewell party.” She laughs, “No, I didn’t leave. I did steal something though - or at least, I refused to give Miri something she wanted. I just never thought she wanted it that badly.”
rows.translation: “我没有机会离开，至少没有正式机会。我想，你救我的那天可以称作告别派对。”她笑了，“不，我没有离开。不过我的确偷了一件东西，或者至少可以说，我拒绝把米莉想要的东西交给她。我只是从没想过她那么想要它。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I didn’t get the chance to leave. Not officially. I guess you could call the day you rescued me my farewell party.” She laughs, “No, I didn’t leave. I did steal something though - or at least, I refused to give Miri something she wanted. I just never thought she wanted it that badly.”"

rows.original: “Bad enough to want to kill you.”
rows.translation: “想要到要杀死你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bad enough to want to kill you.”"

rows.original: “Probably worse than that,” Saendra says with a shake of her head. “Listen, I know you have questions... and if you never want to talk to a filthy pirate again, well... I’d understand. I’d feel like shit for a while, but I’d understand. Pirates have a bad rep for a reason, and I deserve that. I’ve done some shitty things that I wish I hadn’t. But my friend, Pete -- the guy we rescued? He’s fine, by the way -- he gave me the codes to pull the Phoenix out of Tavros without the chief mechanic’s permission. What I stole from Miri... that’s my chance to start fresh. It’s intelligence, data the Void’s been gathering and studying for years now. Some kind of treasure map, basically. And I’m going to steal it right out from under the bastards.”
rows.translation: “大概比那还糟。”赛恩德拉摇着头说道。“听着，我知道你有很多问题...而且如果你再也不想和一个肮脏海盗说话，嗯...我能理解。我会难受一段时间，但我能理解。海盗名声差是有原因的，而我理应承受这些。我做过一些糟糕的事，如今希望自己不曾做过。但是我的朋友皮特，就是我们救下的那个男人，他没事，顺便一提，他给了我访问码，让凤凰号可以在未经总机械师许可的情况下离开塔夫罗斯。我从米莉那里偷来的东西...是我重新开始的机会。那是情报，虚空多年以来一直收集并研究的数据。基本上就是某种藏宝图。而我要从那些混蛋眼皮底下把宝藏偷走。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Probably worse than that,” Saendra says with a shake of her head. “Listen, I know you have questions... and if you never want to talk to a filthy pirate again, well... I’d understand. I’d feel like shit for a while, but I’d understand. Pirates have a bad rep for a reason, and I deserve that. I’ve done some shitty things that I wish I hadn’t. But my friend, Pete -- the guy we rescued? He’s fine, by the way -- he gave me the codes to pull the Phoenix out of Tavros without the chief mechanic’s permission. What I stole from Miri... that’s my chance to start fresh. It’s intelligence, data the Void’s been gathering and studying for years now. Some kind of treasure map, basically. And I’m going to steal it right out from under the bastards.”"

rows.original: First Saendra turns out to be an ex-pirate, and now she wants to go on a treasure hunt? What storybook did she fall out of?
rows.translation: 赛恩德拉先是被揭露为前海盗，现在又想踏上寻宝之旅？她是从哪本故事书里掉出来的？
rows.raw: "\n\nFirst Saendra turns out to be an ex-pirate, and now she wants to go on a treasure hunt? What storybook did she fall out of?"

rows.original: “If you still want anything to do with me, I could always use a first mate when I go to find the Void’s treasure. Hopefully I’ll be ready to leave soon, now that I have the codes.”
rows.translation: “如果你仍然愿意和我扯上关系，等我出发寻找虚空的宝藏时，正好需要一名大副。希望现在有了访问码，我很快就能做好离开的准备。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you still want anything to do with me, I could always use a first mate when I go to find the Void’s treasure. Hopefully I’ll be ready to leave soon, now that I have the codes.”"

rows.original: You suppose you have a decision to make regarding your pirate-babe
rows.translation: 看来你得就自己的海盗宝贝
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suppose you have a decision to make regarding your pirate-babe "

rows.original: SAENDRA TIMES SEXED
rows.raw: "SAENDRA TIMES SEXED"

rows.original: companion
rows.translation: 同伴
rows.raw: "companion"

rows.original: lover
rows.translation: 情人
rows.raw: "lover"

rows.translation: 做出一个决定。

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Jacques00
rows.raw: "Jacques00"

rows.original: You ask Saendra about the whereabouts of the ausar techie the two of you encountered during her rescue mission on Deck 92.
rows.translation: 你询问赛恩德拉，两人在92号甲板营救行动中遇到的那个奥萨技术员去了哪里。
rows.raw: "You ask Saendra about the whereabouts of the ausar techie the two of you encountered during her rescue mission on Deck 92."

rows.original: The crimson halfbreed perks up. “Oh? I distinctly remember we defeated her in a fight... and it’s very likely she was sent off to the bowels of Gastigoth with the rest of the other low-lives. Bitch got what was coming to her if you ask me!”
rows.translation: 深红色的混血儿振作起来。“哦？我清楚记得，我们在战斗中击败了她...而且她很可能和其他那些社会渣滓一起被送进了加斯蒂戈斯最深处。要我说，那母狗是罪有应得！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe crimson halfbreed perks up. “Oh? I distinctly remember we defeated her in a fight... and it’s very likely she was sent off to the bowels of Gastigoth with the rest of the other low-lives. Bitch got what was coming to her if you ask me!”"

rows.original: As she continues with a more snarled expression, you tap your codex and make a note then segway the conversation to something less hostile. Soon, you find yourself chuckling at one of Val’s compromising anecdotes about Saendra with an embarrassed Saendra just taking it with some modest humility.
rows.translation: 她带着更加凶恶的表情继续说下去时，你轻点CODEX终端记下一笔，随后把谈话转向敌意较少的话题。很快，瓦尔开始讲赛恩德拉某个令人难堪的轶事，你忍不住轻笑；尴尬的赛恩德拉则带着几分谦逊，默默承受这一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she continues with a more snarled expression, you tap your codex and make a note then segway the conversation to something less hostile. Soon, you find yourself chuckling at one of Val’s compromising anecdotes about Saendra with an embarrassed Saendra just taking it with some modest humility."

rows.original: She turns away, dejected. “I-I see... I suppose you have a point,” she mutters softly to herself as she gets up, slowly walking to the door with her head downturned.
rows.translation: 她沮丧地转过身。“我，我明白了...我想你说得有道理。”她轻声自言自语，站起身来，低着头缓缓走向门口。
rows.raw: "She turns away, dejected. “I-I see... I suppose you have a point,” she mutters softly to herself as she gets up, slowly walking to the door with her head downturned."

rows.original: “I just thought you should know, sugar.” She dons a false grin and raises her head as she opens the door. “That’s all I needed to talk to you about,
rows.translation: “我只是觉得你应该知道，甜心。”她摆出虚假笑容，开门时抬起头。“我只需要和你谈这些，
rows.raw: "\n\n“I just thought you should know, sugar.” She dons a false grin and raises her head as she opens the door. “That’s all I needed to talk to you about, "

rows.original: sir
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "sir"

rows.original: miss
rows.translation: 小姐
rows.raw: "miss"

rows.original: ,” she says, ushering you out the door.
rows.translation: 。”她说着，把你引出房门。
rows.raw: ",” she says, ushering you out the door."

rows.original: You shrug and rise to your [pc.feet], walking out the door.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，站上[pc.feet]，走出房门。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug and rise to your [pc.feet], walking out the door. "

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isNice() || pc.isMischievous()
                ? "You’re about to turn back to say goodbye when you hear the door click closed behind you, followed by the lock engaging"

rows.raw: "You’re about to turn back to say goodbye when you hear the door click closed behind you, followed by the lock engaging"

rows.original: You shrug to yourself again and walk away with your head held high
rows.translation: 你再次独自耸肩，昂首走开
rows.raw: "You shrug to yourself again and walk away with your head held high"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Sugar, it isn’t hard to figure,” she smiles up at you demurely as her thumb softly strokes your [pc.thigh]. “Most of my customers don’t make such vigorous use of my services,
rows.translation: “甜心，这不难猜。”她含蓄地抬头朝你微笑，拇指轻抚[pc.thigh]。“我的大多数顾客不会如此激烈地使用服务，
rows.raw: "“Sugar, it isn’t hard to figure,” she smiles up at you demurely as her thumb softly strokes your [pc.thigh]. “Most of my customers don’t make such vigorous use of my services,"

rows.original: or leave behind such a plentiful tip
rows.translation: ，也不会留下如此丰厚的小费
rows.raw: " or leave behind such a plentiful tip"

rows.original: or leave behind such a potent tip
rows.translation: ，也不会留下如此强劲的小费
rows.raw: "or leave behind such a potent tip"

rows.original: ,” she licks her strikingly black lips idly before shaking herself from her thoughts.
rows.translation: 。”她漫不经心地舔舐醒目的黑色嘴唇，随后摇摇身子，摆脱思绪。
rows.raw: ",” she licks her strikingly black lips idly before shaking herself from her thoughts."

rows.original: “Plus, the DNA test confirmed it,” she adds matter-of-factly.
rows.translation: “而且，DNA检测也证实了这一点。”她实事求是地补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Plus, the DNA test confirmed it,” she adds matter-of-factly."

rows.original: “I hate to suddenly push all of this onto you, sugar. I know it’s unfair,” she says as she reaches out to stroke your [pc.arm] affectionately, “But I was hoping so much that I could count on you as the father.”
rows.translation: “我不想突然把这一切推给你，甜心。我知道这不公平。”她伸手亲昵抚摸[pc.arm]，说道，“但我非常希望能够依靠你这个父亲。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I hate to suddenly push all of this onto you, sugar. I know it’s unfair,” she says as she reaches out to stroke your [pc.arm] affectionately, “But I was hoping so much that I could count on you as the father.”"

rows.original: She leans in close to meet your gaze pleadingly with her own, her hand moving from your arm to your [pc.face]. You can’t help but notice some slight worry subtly creeping into her seductive, but now wavering, tone.
rows.translation: 她凑近身体，用自己的目光恳求般迎上你的凝视，手也从胳膊移到[pc.face]。你忍不住注意到，她充满诱惑、如今却不断动摇的语气中悄然渗入一丝忧虑。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leans in close to meet your gaze pleadingly with her own, her hand moving from your arm to your [pc.face]. You can’t help but notice some slight worry subtly creeping into her seductive, but now wavering, tone."

rows.translation: 滚开

rows.translation: 钱
rows.raw: "Money"

rows.translation: 钱
rows.raw: "Money"

rows.original: Well, it would be mighty shitty of you not to at least offer the unexpected mother-to-be some financial support.
rows.translation: 嗯，如果连至少给这个意外怀孕的准妈妈提供一些经济支持都不愿意，那你实在太混蛋了。
rows.raw: "Well, it would be mighty shitty of you not to at least offer the unexpected mother-to-be some financial support."

rows.translation: 父亲
rows.raw: "Father"

rows.translation: 父亲

rows.original: Of course you’ll be there for her and the child. You wouldn’t want for her to have to raise it by herself, or for it to grow up without a father.
rows.translation: 你当然会陪伴她和孩子。你不希望她独自抚养，也不希望孩子在没有父亲的情况下长大。
rows.raw: "Of course you’ll be there for her and the child. You wouldn’t want for her to have to raise it by herself, or for it to grow up without a father."

rows.original: How is this any concern of yours, even if it is your kid? It’s her job. She should have taken better precautions to prevent this.
rows.translation: 即使这是你的孩子，又关你什么事？这是她的工作。她本该采取更好的预防措施。
rows.raw: "How is this any concern of yours, even if it is your kid? It’s her job. She should have taken better precautions to prevent this."

rows.original: You’re about to turn back to say goodbye when you hear the door click closed behind you, followed by the lock engaging. rows.original: The elevator door opens onto an open, dark area. Looks to be under construction, with half-finished walls arranged along an avenue, and heavy equipment lying all over. Tarps and semi-transparent sheets are tacked up on the skeletal outlines of walls, making it almost impossible to see more than a few yards ahead of you. As the elevator door locks open and beeps, a flashlight suddenly clicks on just ahead, blinding you for a moment.
rows.translation: 电梯门打开，外面是一片开阔而昏暗的区域。这里似乎仍在施工，道路两旁排列着半成品墙体，重型设备散落得到处都是。防水布与半透明薄膜钉在墙壁的骨架轮廓上，使你几乎无法看清几码以外的地方。随着电梯门锁定在开启状态并发出哔声，前方一支手电筒突然亮起，令你一时睁不开眼。
rows.raw: "The elevator door opens onto an open, dark area. Looks to be under construction, with half-finished walls arranged along an avenue, and heavy equipment lying all over. Tarps and semi-transparent sheets are tacked up on the skeletal outlines of walls, making it almost impossible to see more than a few yards ahead of you. As the elevator door locks open and beeps, a flashlight suddenly clicks on just ahead, blinding you for a moment."

rows.original: “Oh, there you are!” Saendra’s familiar voice says as the light swings out of your eyes. You can just make her out, sitting on the edge of a half-finished fountain. Her robotic hand’s clutching a light, you can see, and her other is wrapped around her Hammer pistol.
rows.translation: “哦，你终于来了！”光束从你眼前移开时，赛恩德拉那熟悉的声音响起。你勉强看清她正坐在一座尚未完工的喷泉边缘。你能看到她的机械手握着一盏灯，另一只手则握着她的铁锤手枪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, there you are!” Saendra’s familiar voice says as the light swings out of your eyes. You can just make her out, sitting on the edge of a half-finished fountain. Her robotic hand’s clutching a light, you can see, and her other is wrapped around her Hammer pistol."

rows.original: “Looks like you’re expecting trouble,” you call over to her, stepping out of the elevator before the doors can close on you.
rows.translation: “看来你正等着麻烦上门，”你在电梯门关上前走出来，朝她喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Looks like you’re expecting trouble,” you call over to her, stepping out of the elevator before the doors can close on you."

rows.original: Saen’s usual mirth is nowhere to be found. “You could say that. I was supposed to meet somebody here, but he’s been a no-show. I’m starting to get worried.”
rows.translation: 赛恩平日里的欢快荡然无存。“可以这么说。我本该在这里和某个人碰面，可他一直没出现。我开始有些担心了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaen’s usual mirth is nowhere to be found. “You could say that. I was supposed to meet somebody here, but he’s been a no-show. I’m starting to get worried.”"

rows.original: You make it over to Saen, and give her a hand up. She pulls herself to her feet, and all the way into a hug. It would almost be nice, if not for the cold hardness of her gun’s magazine pressed into the small of your back.
rows.translation: 你走到赛恩身边，伸手拉她起来。她借力站起身，顺势一把抱住你。若不是她枪械冰冷坚硬的弹匣正抵着你的后腰，这拥抱几乎称得上美好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make it over to Saen, and give her a hand up. She pulls herself to her feet, and all the way into a hug. It would almost be nice, if not for the cold hardness of her gun’s magazine pressed into the small of your back."

rows.original: “So what’s the story?” you ask, looking from Saendra to the half-built deck around her.
rows.translation: “所以到底怎么回事？”你问道，视线从赛恩德拉移向她周围尚未完工的甲板。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what’s the story?” you ask, looking from Saendra to the half-built deck around her."

rows.original: She clicks her flashlight off and slips it onto her gunbelt. “Like I said, I was meeting somebody. A station tech who was supposed to be getting me something. Fuck knows why he wanted to meet up here, but overriding station security and wandering on up wasn’t exactly hard. But he should have showed before I even sent you that message. I’m getting worried.”
rows.translation: 她关掉手电筒，把它别回枪带上。“就像我说的，我来见一个人。一个空间站技师，他本该替我弄到某样东西。鬼知道他为什么非要约在这里，不过绕过空间站安保再溜上来倒也不算难。可他本该在我给你发消息前就到了。我开始担心了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe clicks her flashlight off and slips it onto her gunbelt. “Like I said, I was meeting somebody. A station tech who was supposed to be getting me something. Fuck knows why he wanted to meet up here, but overriding station security and wandering on up wasn’t exactly hard. But he should have showed before I even sent you that message. I’m getting worried.”"

rows.original: “You didn’t pay up front, did you?” you chuckle, trying not to let the eerie silence of the deck get to you.
rows.translation: “你没提前付钱吧？”你轻笑着，努力不让甲板上诡异的寂静影响自己。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You didn’t pay up front, did you?” you chuckle, trying not to let the eerie silence of the deck get to you."

rows.original: “That’d imply I have any money,” Saen answers with a half-hearted laugh. “So no. I was going to trade for it. Good old-fashioned barter.”
rows.translation: “那得先假设我有钱，”赛恩有气无力地笑着回答。“所以没有。我打算拿东西交换。最传统的以物易物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’d imply I have any money,” Saen answers with a half-hearted laugh. “So no. I was going to trade for it. Good old-fashioned barter.”"

rows.original: As she says it, Saen pulls a small device out of her blouse - some kind of starship part, you’d guess.
rows.translation: 说话间，赛恩从衬衫里掏出一个小装置，据你判断，像是某种星舰零件。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she says it, Saen pulls a small device out of her blouse - some kind of starship part, you’d guess."

rows.original: “Anyway, I don’t want to play damsel in distress or anything, but lightning has a tendency to strike twice with me, if you know what I mean. If you don’t have anything better to do, think you could just... I dunno... sit with me for a bit?”
rows.translation: “总之，我也不想扮什么落难少女，可麻烦总喜欢一而再地找上我，你懂我的意思吧。要是你没别的要紧事，能不能就...我不知道...陪我坐一会儿？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, I don’t want to play damsel in distress or anything, but lightning has a tendency to strike twice with me, if you know what I mean. If you don’t have anything better to do, think you could just... I dunno... sit with me for a bit?”"

rows.original: Before you answer, you have to ask: “What exactly is it you were trying to buy, anyway?”
rows.translation: 回答之前，你得先问一句：“话说回来，你到底想买什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you answer, you have to ask: “What exactly is it you were trying to buy, anyway?”"

rows.original: Saen fidgets a bit, rubbing at the back of her head with her robotic hand. “Docking codes for the station. I’ve got the Phoenix beaten together enough to fly... and probably not explode, too. But the bastard running the garage refuses to clear me to launch. Apparently my girl doesn’t meet ‘Confederate regulation’ standards anymore. Bah.”
rows.translation: 赛恩有些坐立不安，用机械手揉了揉后脑勺。“空间站的对接代码。我已经把凤凰号勉强拼到能飞了...而且大概也不会爆炸。可那个管机库的混蛋不肯批准我起飞。显然，我的姑娘已经不符合什么‘邦联法规’标准了。呸。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSaen fidgets a bit, rubbing at the back of her head with her robotic hand. “Docking codes for the station. I’ve got the Phoenix beaten together enough to fly... and probably not explode, too. But the bastard running the garage refuses to clear me to launch. Apparently my girl doesn’t meet ‘Confederate regulation’ standards anymore. Bah.”"

rows.original: The holo-projector on Saen’s wrist flickers, and Valeria’s avatar pops up with her hands on her hips and a scowl on her lips. “That’s because it probably WILL explode, you psychopath!” Val snaps, glowering at her mistress. “You’re going to get us both killed!”
rows.translation: 赛恩腕上的全息投影仪闪烁起来，瓦莱莉娅的化身双手叉腰、满脸怒容地跳了出来。“因为它很可能真的会爆炸，你这个疯子！”瓦尔怒斥道，怒瞪着自己的女主人。“你会把我们两个都害死的！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe holo-projector on Saen’s wrist flickers, and Valeria’s avatar pops up with her hands on her hips and a scowl on her lips. “That’s because it probably WILL explode, you psychopath!” Val snaps, glowering at her mistress. “You’re going to get us both killed!”"

rows.original: “Am not,” Saen huffs, sounding a little less self-assured.
rows.translation: “才不会，”赛恩气呼呼地说，语气却没有那么自信了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Am not,” Saen huffs, sounding a little less self-assured."

rows.original: While the two of them start bickering about whatever plan Saendra’s got up her sleeve, you turn and start looking around the construction site. You imagine they’re building shops here, probably high end judging by the fountain and wide open corridors. Much swankier than the main merchant deck near the hangar, that’s for sure.
rows.translation: 她们两个开始为赛恩德拉暗中筹划的某个计划争吵起来，你则转身打量这片施工区。看样子这里正在修建商铺，从喷泉和宽阔开放的走廊来看，多半还是高档店铺。至少肯定比机库附近的主商业甲板气派多了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile the two of them start bickering about whatever plan Saendra’s got up her sleeve, you turn and start looking around the construction site. You imagine they’re building shops here, probably high end judging by the fountain and wide open corridors. Much swankier than the main merchant deck near the hangar, that’s for sure."

rows.original: And you’re almost certain you can hear a clinking sound coming towards you.
rows.translation: 而且你几乎可以肯定，有一阵叮当声正朝你们靠近。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd you’re almost certain you can hear a clinking sound coming towards you."

rows.original: You have just enough time to yell “GET DOWN!” when you see a small, black disc sliding across the floor towards your halfbreed friend.
rows.translation: 看见一个黑色小圆盘沿地板滑向你的混血朋友时，你只来得及大喊“趴下！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have just enough time to yell “GET DOWN!” when you see a small, black disc sliding across the floor towards your halfbreed friend."

rows.original: The grenade goes off with a deafening KABANG and a blinding flash, burning at your dark-adjusted eyes. You manage to cover your eyes and grab at your [pc.weapon], but the sounds of jackboots pounding on the deck, rushing towards you makes you realize you’re in a hell of a spot. You stumble into the closest thing you can find to cover and rub at your eyes, trying to adjust back to blackness.
rows.translation: 手雷伴着震耳欲聋的轰响和刺眼闪光爆炸，灼痛了你已经适应黑暗的双眼。你勉强遮住眼睛，伸手去抓[pc.weapon]，可甲板上传来军靴急促逼近的重踏声，让你意识到自己的处境糟透了。你踉跄着躲到最近的掩体后，揉着眼睛，试图重新适应黑暗。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe grenade goes off with a deafening KABANG and a blinding flash, burning at your dark-adjusted eyes. You manage to cover your eyes and grab at your [pc.weapon], but the sounds of jackboots pounding on the deck, rushing towards you makes you realize you’re in a hell of a spot. You stumble into the closest thing you can find to cover and rub at your eyes, trying to adjust back to blackness."

rows.original: By the time you’re able to see again, the first things your eyes alight on are a twitching mass of small green lasers flickering across the bulkheads behind you, searching for targets. You’re able to see Saendra across from you, ducking down behind the edge of the fountain with her Hammer pistol shakily held in her hands. Slowly, you risk a peek around the corner of your hole. Several men in heavy armor are moving in from the far side of the merchant square, machine pistols held at their hips.
rows.translation: 等你终于恢复视力，最先映入眼帘的是一团颤动的小型绿色激光，在你身后的舱壁上闪烁游移，搜寻着目标。你看见对面的赛恩德拉正蹲在喷泉边缘后方，双手颤抖着握住铁锤手枪。你慢慢冒险从藏身处的角落探头看去。几名身穿重甲的男人正从商业广场另一侧推进，腰间端着冲锋手枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you’re able to see again, the first things your eyes alight on are a twitching mass of small green lasers flickering across the bulkheads behind you, searching for targets. You’re able to see Saendra across from you, ducking down behind the edge of the fountain with her Hammer pistol shakily held in her hands. Slowly, you risk a peek around the corner of your hole. Several men in heavy armor are moving in from the far side of the merchant square, machine pistols held at their hips."

rows.original: With silent determination, the mysterious assailants storm forward, fingers on their triggers.

rows.raw: "\n\nWith silent determination, the mysterious assailants storm forward, fingers on their triggers."

rows.original: Saendra shoots you a look before leaping to her feet and firing off a shot. One of the assassins at the front of their formation screams and drops, firing his gun wildly into the ceiling and walls. The others start yelling, shooting, and diving for cover.
rows.translation: 赛恩德拉看了你一眼，随即跃起开枪。队形最前方的一名刺客惨叫着倒下，手中枪械朝天花板和墙壁胡乱扫射。其他人开始叫喊、开火，并纷纷扑向掩体。
rows.raw: "\n\nSaendra shoots you a look before leaping to her feet and firing off a shot. One of the assassins at the front of their formation screams and drops, firing his gun wildly into the ceiling and walls. The others start yelling, shooting, and diving for cover."

rows.original: Semith is a 4' 11" maroon-skinned vulkrim. He isn’t squat or dwarf-like, his thin but fairly muscular frame entirely proportional to his size. Like most vulkrimi he has had the majority of his natural carapace armor removed, retaining only the two covering his shoulders, like two shiny black shoulder-guards. His skin is smooth, hairless and looks like it might be quite stretchy. However, he has gene-modded himself so he has dark brown, human-like hair on his head: shoulder length and swept back on his scalp, crafted into arching brows and an immaculate beard on his face. He has a narrow but quite handsome face, with a strong, roman nose, high cheekbones and pointed ears, and sports a pair of small, curved horns. He dresses as smartly as he grooms, in a casual blazer, cotton shirt and trousers.
rows.translation: 塞米斯是一名身高4英尺11英寸、皮肤栗红的沃尔克里姆人。他并不矮胖，也不像侏儒，身材清瘦却颇为健壮，与他的个头完全成比例。和大多数沃尔克里姆人一样，他已经移除了大部分天然甲壳护甲，只保留覆盖双肩的两块，看起来像两片乌黑发亮的肩甲。他的皮肤光滑无毛，似乎颇具弹性。不过，他通过基因改造让头部长出了类似人类的深棕色头发：长及肩头，在头皮上向后梳拢，还塑成了弧形眉毛与脸上整洁无瑕的胡须。他脸型狭长却相当英俊，有着挺拔的罗马鼻、高耸的颧骨和尖耳朵，头上还长着一对小巧弯曲的角。他的穿着和仪容同样考究，身穿休闲西装外套、棉衬衫与长裤。
rows.raw: "Semith is a 4' 11\" maroon-skinned vulkrim. He isn’t squat or dwarf-like, his thin but fairly muscular frame entirely proportional to his size. Like most vulkrimi he has had the majority of his natural carapace armor removed, retaining only the two covering his shoulders, like two shiny black shoulder-guards. His skin is smooth, hairless and looks like it might be quite stretchy. However, he has gene-modded himself so he has dark brown, human-like hair on his head: shoulder length and swept back on his scalp, crafted into arching brows and an immaculate beard on his face. He has a narrow but quite handsome face, with a strong, roman nose, high cheekbones and pointed ears, and sports a pair of small, curved horns. He dresses as smartly as he grooms, in a casual blazer, cotton shirt and trousers."

rows.original: “Well, of course!” replies Semith, who responds by tapping a pawn forward in three dimensions with unnerving speed. “I only dabble in stocks and shares really - I haven’t the will or need for it to be a full-time job - but even I know about Steele Tech, and how its former owner decided to select its inheritor. Sensational stuff! Brilliantly eccentric billionaire behaviour, the kind of thing every businessman dreams of being able to do one day. On some of the insider tip websites I go to, the dedicated thread about you doubles in size every minute.”
rows.translation: “那当然！”塞米斯回答，并以令人不安的速度在三维空间中点动一枚兵向前。“其实我只是偶尔涉足股票和股份买卖，我既没有意愿，也不需要把它当成全职工作，不过连我都知道斯蒂尔科技，也知道它的前任所有者如何决定继承人。真是轰动！才华横溢的古怪亿万富翁行径，正是每个商人都梦想有朝一日能做的事。我常去的几个内幕消息网站上，关于你的专属讨论串每分钟都会扩大一倍。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, of course!” replies Semith, who responds by tapping a pawn forward in three dimensions with unnerving speed. “I only dabble in stocks and shares really - I haven’t the will or need for it to be a full-time job - but even I know about Steele Tech, and how its former owner decided to select its inheritor. Sensational stuff! Brilliantly eccentric billionaire behaviour, the kind of thing every businessman dreams of being able to do one day. On some of the insider tip websites I go to, the dedicated thread about you doubles in size every minute.”"

rows.original: “Really?” you say uneasily. Some sympathy creeps into Semith’s mischievous, smouldering gaze.
rows.translation: “真的？”你不安地说道。塞米斯淘气而灼热的目光中浮现出几分同情。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really?” you say uneasily. Some sympathy creeps into Semith’s mischievous, smouldering gaze."

rows.original: “It must be quite tough being saddled with that kind of celebrity, particularly straight after the death of your father,” he goes on in a more sober tone. “I am sorry. I would hate to have that kind of attention fixed on me, whatever the circumstances were.” He considers the board thoughtfully. “If it’s any consolation, I don’t think you’re that widely talked about outside of business circles. It’s just the way that world is - fevered and incestuous. Fortunes are on the line, after all.”
rows.translation: “刚失去父亲，就背负上这种名声，想必很难受，”他用更严肃的语气继续说道。“我很遗憾。无论情况如何，我都不愿意让这种关注集中到自己身上。”他若有所思地端详着棋盘。“如果这能让你好受些，我认为在商业圈之外，谈论你的人并没有那么多。那个世界就是如此，狂热而又近亲繁殖。毕竟，有无数财富悬在一线。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It must be quite tough being saddled with that kind of celebrity, particularly straight after the death of your father,” he goes on in a more sober tone. “I am sorry. I would hate to have that kind of attention fixed on me, whatever the circumstances were.” He considers the board thoughtfully. “If it’s any consolation, I don’t think you’re that widely talked about outside of business circles. It’s just the way that world is - fevered and incestuous. Fortunes are on the line, after all.”"

rows.original: “How is Steele Tech doing?” you ask, as you take/don’t take his castle.
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔科技现在经营得怎么样？”你一边问，一边吃掉／没有吃掉他的车。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How is Steele Tech doing?” you ask, as you take/don’t take his castle."

rows.original: “Shares collapsed a bit after Victor’s retirement, but have been doing pretty well since,” the vulkrim replies, reasserting a small part of perceivable reality and warping his castle back in. “I took the opportunity of the fall in shares to purchase some.” He grins at you, unable to contain his urbane wickedness. “I have something like a 0.4% interest in your continued successes, [pc.name]. Why do you think I didn’t suggest gambling money on this game?”
rows.translation: “维克托退休后，股价确实跌了一阵，不过此后表现一直相当不错，”沃尔克里姆人回答，同时重新确立一小部分可感知现实，把他的车扭曲了回来。“我趁股价下跌时买了一些。”他冲你咧嘴一笑，掩饰不住那份老练的邪气。“你能否继续取得成功，大约关系到我0.4%的利益，[pc.name]。你以为我为什么没提议拿钱当这盘棋的赌注？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shares collapsed a bit after Victor’s retirement, but have been doing pretty well since,” the vulkrim replies, reasserting a small part of perceivable reality and warping his castle back in. “I took the opportunity of the fall in shares to purchase some.” He grins at you, unable to contain his urbane wickedness. “I have something like a 0.4% interest in your continued successes, [pc.name]. Why do you think I didn’t suggest gambling money on this game?”"

rows.original: “In a manner of speaking,” Semith replies. The compact, red-skinned devil watches you think with measured interest, as if even the wrinkles of your frown are telling him something about you. “We have a reputation of being a pack of ne’er-do-wells, only travelling to the frontier in order to engage in piracy. Which is difficult for me to say isn’t true, seeing as I used to be a pirate myself. Got out of that game a while ago of course, moved my fortune into a more sanitary profession. A slightly more sanitary profession,” he amends with a quiet grin.
rows.translation: “某种意义上是的，”塞米斯回答。这个身形紧凑的红皮恶魔不动声色、饶有兴趣地看着你思考，仿佛就连你皱眉形成的纹路都在向他透露些什么。“我们素有一群无赖的名声，只会为了从事海盗活动而前往边疆。我很难说这并非事实，毕竟我自己过去就是个海盗。当然，我早已退出那一行，把财产转进了一种更干净的职业。一种稍微干净一点的职业，”他安静地咧嘴一笑，改口道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“In a manner of speaking,” Semith replies. The compact, red-skinned devil watches you think with measured interest, as if even the wrinkles of your frown are telling him something about you. “We have a reputation of being a pack of ne’er-do-wells, only travelling to the frontier in order to engage in piracy. Which is difficult for me to say isn’t true, seeing as I used to be a pirate myself. Got out of that game a while ago of course, moved my fortune into a more sanitary profession. A slightly more sanitary profession,” he amends with a quiet grin."

rows.original: “What’s with the tail?” you ask, biding for time. Maybe if you sacrifice your knight you can draw out his queen, wherever it is...
rows.translation: “你的尾巴是怎么回事？”你为了拖延时间而问道。或许只要牺牲掉自己的马，就能把他的后引出来，不管它现在到底在哪里...
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s with the tail?” you ask, biding for time. Maybe if you sacrifice your knight you can draw out his queen, wherever it is..."

rows.original: “The secret to our continued existence, that’s what!” Semith exclaims, his tail flexing inwards in surprise at the question. “We are an all male race, [pc.name]; our women died out many centuries ago. In order to reproduce we use our stings to, ah, imbue wombs in others...” The blunt tip of his scorpion-like appendage jerks inwards and outwards suggestively. “...before doing the deed as you might normally expect. I had my sting removed when I moved into business, though. I got the distinct impression it made other people uncomfortable - not really the kind of thing someone wants to see bobbing over the head of your stockbroker. I had it gene-modded to something more... traditionally enjoyable.” Your eyes are unavoidably drawn to the wide, horizontal slit on the club-like end to his tail. It doesn’t look like a vagina; more like a housing for something...
rows.translation: “那可是我们延续至今的秘密！”塞米斯惊呼道，尾巴因这个问题而吃惊地向内弯起。“我们是一个全雄性种族，[pc.name]；我们的女性早在许多个世纪前就灭绝了。为了繁衍，我们会用尾刺把子宫植入其他人，呃...”他那蝎形附肢的钝头暗示性地向内外抽动。“...然后再以你通常会想到的方式行事。不过，我投身商界时就切除了尾刺。我明显感觉到它会让其他人不自在，毕竟谁也不想看见自己的股票经纪人脑袋上方晃着这种东西。我把它基因改造成了某种更...传统而令人愉悦的东西。”你的目光无法避免地被他尾巴棒状末端那道宽阔的横缝吸引。它看起来不像阴道，更像是某种东西的容纳腔...
rows.raw: "\n\n“The secret to our continued existence, that’s what!” Semith exclaims, his tail flexing inwards in surprise at the question. “We are an all male race, [pc.name]; our women died out many centuries ago. In order to reproduce we use our stings to, ah, imbue wombs in others...” The blunt tip of his scorpion-like appendage jerks inwards and outwards suggestively. “...before doing the deed as you might normally expect. I had my sting removed when I moved into business, though. I got the distinct impression it made other people uncomfortable - not really the kind of thing someone wants to see bobbing over the head of your stockbroker. I had it gene-modded to something more... traditionally enjoyable.” Your eyes are unavoidably drawn to the wide, horizontal slit on the club-like end to his tail. It doesn’t look like a vagina; more like a housing for something..."

rows.original: “And your people weren’t tempted to gene mod some of themselves back into females?” you query. You decide to shift your knight into a paradoxical state instead.
rows.translation: “你们就没想过通过基因改造，让一部分族人重新变成女性吗？”你问道。你转而决定让自己的马进入矛盾状态。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And your people weren’t tempted to gene mod some of themselves back into females?” you query. You decide to shift your knight into a paradoxical state instead."

rows.original: “We can no longer produce pure strain vulkrimi that way,” he sighs, sliding a bishop six spaces forward on the other side of the board. “And our culture has changed to accommodate how we are now. Being both male and bearing children is expected amongst us, [pc.name], however difficult that might be for you to contemplate; please don’t imagine we are there to be improved. As far as gene-modding is concerned,” he goes on in a lighter tone, “that’s one of the reasons why the U.G.C. were still eager to uplift us, despite us being such a disreputable bunch of scoundrels. The likes of Xenogen were desperate to study our degradable womb-instilling properties. Thank goodness for corporate greed!”
rows.translation: “用那种方法，我们已经无法生育纯种沃尔克里姆人了，”他叹息着，将棋盘另一侧的一枚象向前移动六格。“而且我们的文化已经改变，以适应如今的状态。在我们之中，既是男性又要生育是理所当然的，[pc.name]，无论你对此多么难以理解；请不要以为我们需要被改良。至于基因改造，”他用更轻快的语气继续说道，“那正是为什么即便我们是一群声名狼藉的恶棍，银河联合政府仍然急于提升我们的原因之一。像异源生物科技这样的企业简直迫不及待想研究我们可降解、植入子宫的特性。谢天谢地还有企业贪婪！”
