Being both male and bearing children is expected amongst us, [pc.name], however difficult that might be for you to contemplate; please don’t imagine we are there to be improved. As far as gene-modding is concerned,” he goes on in a lighter tone, “that’s one of the reasons why the U.G.C. were still eager to uplift us, despite us being such a disreputable bunch of scoundrels. The likes of Xenogen were desperate to study our degradable womb-instilling properties. Thank goodness for corporate greed!”"

rows.original: “So you’re into business?” you ask.
rows.translation: “所以你从事商业？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“So you’re into business?” you ask."

rows.original: “To a certain degree,” Semith replies, grimacing as if the prospect of being ‘into business’ is a bit distasteful to him. “I came into a large amount of wealth a few years back, and chose to invest most of it in a range of different stocks and shares. I live quite comfortably off liquidating the odd interest here and there, reinvesting in the right things when the opportunity arises.”
rows.translation: “在一定程度上吧，”塞米斯回答，表情像是觉得“从事商业”这件事本身令他有点反感。“几年前我得到了一大笔财富，选择把其中大部分投资到各种不同的股票与股份中。偶尔卖掉这里或那里的一点权益，就足够让我过得相当舒适；机会出现时，我也会重新投资到合适的项目里。”

I live quite comfortably off liquidating the odd interest here and there, reinvesting in the right things when the opportunity arises.”"

rows.original: “Where did this wealth come from?” you poke. You block the advance of his castle with a Euclidian pawn.
rows.translation: “这笔财富是从哪来的？”你追问道，同时用一枚欧几里得兵挡住他的车。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Where did this wealth come from?” you poke. You block the advance of his castle with a Euclidian pawn."

rows.original: “Piracy,” he answers, with a winsome smile. “Imagine, in the lead-up to the opening of the planetary Rush, the level of traffic in and around major spaceports. Imagine the haste with which some commercial haulers planned their journeys, the lack of proper forethought or security. Imagine how eager some travellers were to jump to completely unknown systems, once the warp gates had opened. It was a bonanza, for some.” His black eyes move back to the board.
rows.translation: “海盗活动，”他带着迷人的微笑回答。“想象一下，行星拓荒热潮开放前夕，各大太空港内外会有多么繁忙的交通。想象一下，某些商业货船是何等仓促地规划行程，完全缺乏妥善考虑或安保。再想象一下，跃迁门开启后，某些旅客多么急切地想跳往彻底未知的星系。对某些人而言，那可是一场盛宴。”他漆黑的双眼重新移向棋盘。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Piracy,” he answers, with a winsome smile. “Imagine, in the lead-up to the opening of the planetary Rush, the level of traffic in and around major spaceports. Imagine the haste with which some commercial haulers planned their journeys, the lack of proper forethought or security. Imagine how eager some travellers were to jump to completely unknown systems, once the warp gates had opened. It was a bonanza, for some.” His black eyes move back to the board."

rows.original: “Every pirate in the galaxy thinks the next job is their last,” he goes on after a little while. “They always need just a little more for the retirement fund. But the hardest part of the job is getting out of it. Actually saving your gains, instead of blowing it all on throbb and indentured hookers at the next station. Being smart enough to launder it little by little, in a way that doesn’t tie a U.G.C.-funded noose around your neck. Cutting your ties and disappearing in a way that isn’t going to plant a plasma bolt in your back. Not sticking out like a sore sting when you sidle back into legal society. And even then, if you can manage all that... you never stop looking over your shoulder. Never.”
rows.translation: “银河里的每个海盗都觉得下一票就是最后一票，”过了一会儿，他继续说道。“他们总觉得退休金还差那么一点。但这份工作最难的部分，就是全身而退。要真正把收益存下来，而不是在下一座空间站把钱全花在悸动药和契约妓女身上。要足够聪明，一点一点地洗钱，不至于让银河联合政府出资的绞索套上你的脖子。还要切断联系并消失，同时又不让一发等离子弹栽进你的后背。等你悄悄回归合法社会时，也不能像一根肿痛的尾刺那样显眼。即使你能做到这一切...你也永远不会停止回头张望。永远不会。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Every pirate in the galaxy thinks the next job is their last,” he goes on after a little while. “They always need just a little more for the retirement fund. But the hardest part of the job is getting out of it. Actually saving your gains, instead of blowing it all on throbb and indentured hookers at the next station. Being smart enough to launder it little by little, in a way that doesn’t tie a U.G.C.-funded noose around your neck. Cutting your ties and disappearing in a way that isn’t going to plant a plasma bolt in your back. Not sticking out like a sore sting when you sidle back into legal society. And even then, if you can manage all that... you never stop looking over your shoulder. Never.”"

rows.original: “Just to be clear on this,” you say. “By acquisitions, you mean slaves?”
rows.translation: “先确认一下，”你说道。“你所说的‘可以买下的东西’，指的是奴隶？”
rows.raw: "“Just to be clear on this,” you say. “By acquisitions, you mean slaves?”"

rows.original: “Indentured servants,” Teron corrects. “We pride ourselves on being specialist recruitment consultants, yes. We aim to find our stock positions that they are most well suited for – carefully adjusting attitudes and expectancies where necessary - and treat them with the utmost care whilst they are in our possession.” He clenches his fist and jaw in polite disgust. “The facilities this place used to have were barbaric. They apparently chained their stock up in the basement and pumped them full of addictive pheromones in order to keep them suppressed! Perhaps I should not expect anything better from humans.
rows.translation: “契约佣人，”特隆纠正道。“没错，我们以专业招聘顾问的身份为荣。我们的目标，是为库存找到最适合他们的职位；必要时会仔细调整其态度与期望，并在他们归我们所有期间给予最周到的照料。”他礼貌而厌恶地攥紧拳头、绷住下颌。“这里以前的设施野蛮至极。据说他们把库存锁在地下室里，再往体内注入大量成瘾信息素，以此压制他们！也许我本就不该期待人类能做得更好。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Indentured servants,” Teron corrects. “We pride ourselves on being specialist recruitment consultants, yes. We aim to find our stock positions that they are most well suited for – carefully adjusting attitudes and expectancies where necessary - and treat them with the utmost care whilst they are in our possession.” He clenches his fist and jaw in polite disgust. “The facilities this place used to have were barbaric. They apparently chained their stock up in the basement and pumped them full of addictive pheromones in order to keep them suppressed! Perhaps I should not expect anything better from humans."

rows.original: “Repossession, mostly.” Attica places a delicate emphasis on “mostly”. “We are silent partners in a number of loan and mod companies. If a mod-happy deadbeat cannot pay their monthly installments... well, it’s difficult to repossess someone’s eye stalks specifically isn’t it?”
rows.translation: “主要是收回抵押品。”阿蒂卡微妙地强调了“主要”二字。“我们是许多贷款公司和改造公司的隐名合伙人。要是一个沉迷改造的赖账者付不起每月分期...嗯，想专门收回某人的眼柄可不容易，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Repossession, mostly.” Attica places a delicate emphasis on “mostly”. “We are silent partners in a number of loan and mod companies. If a mod-happy deadbeat cannot pay their monthly installments... well, it’s difficult to repossess someone’s eye stalks specifically isn’t it?”"

rows.original: “The female who sold the rights of this place to us was not just a brute but a fool,” Teron murmurs, a salacious smile spreading across his long, elegant face. “Frontier rushes are a time of hasty business decisions; of people mortgaging themselves to the hilt to come out here with a spaceship; of new, beautiful and deliciously naive sentients. The acquisitions that will be flowing through this spaceport in the months to come will be a wonder to behold.” He sighs. “But right now there is little to try and tempt you with, rue collar.
rows.translation: “把这里权利卖给我们的女人，不仅是个野蛮人，还是个蠢货，”特隆低声说道，狭长而优雅的脸上渐渐浮现淫邪笑容。“边疆拓荒热潮总会催生仓促的商业决策；有人为了开飞船来到这里，把自己抵押得一干二净；还有新鲜、美丽又天真得可口的智慧生物。未来几个月里，即将流经这座太空港的收购品一定蔚为奇观。”他叹了口气。“不过眼下几乎没什么能用来诱惑你，悔领者。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The female who sold the rights of this place to us was not just a brute but a fool,” Teron murmurs, a salacious smile spreading across his long, elegant face. “Frontier rushes are a time of hasty business decisions; of people mortgaging themselves to the hilt to come out here with a spaceship; of new, beautiful and deliciously naive sentients. The acquisitions that will be flowing through this spaceport in the months to come will be a wonder to behold.” He sighs. “But right now there is little to try and tempt you with, rue collar."

rows.raw: " With our problem case gone, we are simply waiting for the trade from the frontier to start trickling in. Come back in a month’s time or so, we’ll have many fresh and exotic pieces of property to show you."

rows.original: “From the frontier,” replies Attica calmly. “Nobody misses pirates. And newly discovered species do not have the same rights as Core-ward races, at least not before the U.G.C. or whoever else signs them up to a bill of protection. They are also an exotic novelty collectors pay highly for.”
rows.translation: “来自边疆，”阿蒂卡平静地回答。“没人会想念海盗。新发现的物种也不具备与核心区种族相同的权利，至少在银河联合政府或其他势力签署保护法案、将他们纳入保护之前没有。而且，他们也是收藏家愿意高价购买的异域新奇品。”

rows.original: “We at Sentient Acquisitions merely serve the galactic market interests the best we can,” carries on Teron with a noble air. “but there are some tarratch swarms that are in it for the acquiring itself. Right collars have... certain needs... which rue collar species are perfect for satiating.” The two of them eye you silently for a moment. “If you stumble upon one of our recruitment teams out there on virgin soil, just turn around and let them get on with their business,” suggests Teron dogmatically. “They won’t be interested in you unless you force them to be.”
rows.translation: “我们智慧生物收购公司只是竭尽所能，为银河市场利益服务，”特隆带着高尚气度继续说道。“但也有些塔拉特虫群，追求的就是收购行为本身。正领者有...某些需求...而悔领物种非常适合满足这些需求。”两人沉默地打量你片刻。“如果你在外面某片处女地上遇到我们的招聘团队，只要转身离开，让他们继续工作，”特隆武断地建议。“除非你逼他们对你产生兴趣，否则他们不会关注你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We at Sentient Acquisitions merely serve the galactic market interests the best we can,” carries on Teron with a noble air. “but there are some tarratch swarms that are in it for the acquiring itself. Right collars have... certain needs... which rue collar species are perfect for satiating.” The two of them eye you silently for a moment. “If you stumble upon one of our recruitment teams out there on virgin soil, just turn around and let them get on with their business,” suggests Teron dogmatically. “They won’t be interested in you unless you force them to be.”"

Amongst many other things.” Teron plucks a tablet screen off the counter and taps it a few times. “Bought quite a number of expensive mods this human did, and then a shop on this self same station on top of it. ‘The Dark Chrysalis.’ I don’t think she looked at the fine print of her rent agreement closely, if at all. These succulent young rue collars, they never think it’s going to happen to them. Until it does.”
rows.translation: “是的。以及许多其他东西。”特隆从柜台上拿起一块平板屏幕，轻点几下。“这个人类买了相当多昂贵的改造剂，之后又在同一座空间站上买下一家商店，名叫‘暗黑蝶蛹’。我看她根本没有仔细读过租赁协议的细则，甚至可能完全没读。这些鲜嫩的年轻悔领者总以为这种事绝不会发生在自己身上，直到它真的发生。”

rows.original: “She is heavily in debt, but we’re not minded to chase it yet – we’ve done the due background check on her and by all accounts she would make for a terrible indentured servant. And who knows, maybe her shop really will enable her to pay it down.” His immaculate sneer tells you exactly how likely he thinks that is.
rows.translation: “她债台高筑，但我们目前并不打算追讨；我们已经对她进行过适当的背景调查，无论从哪方面看，她都会是一个极其糟糕的契约佣人。况且谁知道呢，也许她的商店真能让她还清债务。”他那无可挑剔的冷笑，清楚告诉你他认为这种可能性有多大。
rows.raw: "\n\n“She is heavily in debt, but we’re not minded to chase it yet – we’ve done the due background check on her and by all accounts she would make for a terrible indentured servant. And who knows, maybe her shop really will enable her to pay it down.” His immaculate sneer tells you exactly how likely he thinks that is."

rows.original: “You will listen to me now, worthless rue collar, and you will listen carefully. You shall learn to show gratitude to your new owner. [pc.He] has paid off the debt you so carelessly ran up, and removed all obligations from your life except one: To serve [pc.him] well. Believe me when I say there are far worse owners you could have ended up with – we were drawing up a list of them when [pc.he] stepped in. You shall learn to show gratitude to your new owner mostly, though, because that collar you are now wearing will shock you if you raise your hands against [pc.him], or if you travel outside [pc.his] ship without permission. Do you understand?” As Attica speaks Teron steps over to you, pressing into your side as he hands you a small, steel remote and a briefcase.
rows.translation: “现在听我说，毫无价值的悔领者，而且要仔细听。你要学会向新主人表示感激。[pc.He]替你偿还了如此轻率欠下的债务，移除了你生活中的所有义务，只留下一个：好好服侍[pc.him]。相信我，你本可能落到远比现在糟糕的主人手里；[pc.he]介入时，我们正在拟定他们的名单。不过你之所以主要得学会感激新主人，是因为现在佩戴的项圈会在你对[pc.him]动手时电击你，也会在未经允许离开[pc.his]飞船时电击你。明白了吗？”阿蒂卡说话时，特隆走到你身边，身体贴着你的侧面，把一个小巧的钢制遥控器和公文包交给你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You will listen to me now, worthless rue collar, and you will listen carefully. You shall learn to show gratitude to your new owner. rows.original: Mind on the alien sights and sounds you’ve recently experienced, you meander back to your... you stare. Where is your ship? You wave your hands in a juddering panic at the gaping hole where it once stood, as if that will magic it back into existence. You race around the docking area, futilely attempting to locate it, speaking to every official you can collar. Nobody noted anything unusual - it seems someone on your crew got departure clearance and then cleared off with it.
rows.translation: 脑中仍想着最近经历的异星景象与声音，你漫步返回自己的...你瞪大双眼。飞船呢？你朝它原本所在的巨大空洞惊慌而颤抖地挥舞双手，仿佛这样就能凭空让它回来。你在停靠区四处奔跑，徒劳地寻找飞船，询问每个能拦住的官员。没有人注意到异常；看来船员中的某个人取得了离港许可，随后开着它逃走了。

You race around the docking area, futilely attempting to locate it, speaking to every official you can collar. Nobody noted anything unusual - it seems someone on your crew got departure clearance and then cleared off with it."

rows.original: “Just wanna talk,” you say, pulling a chair over. Sera’s wicked grin retreats behind a guarded scowl.

rows.original: “Why?” she replies sullenly. “I’m your fuck toy now, that’s all that matters. You don’t need to know how it got to this.”
rows.translation: “为什么？”她阴沉地回答。“我现在就是你的操弄玩具，这才是唯一重要的事。你不需要知道我是怎么沦落到这一步的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why?” she replies sullenly. “I’m your fuck toy now, that’s all that matters. You don’t need to know how it got to this.”"

rows.original: “Don’t say that!” You reach forward and pull her into a big hug. “How my fuck toys tick is, like, sooo important to me. And anyway, your voice is really sexy. I wanna listen to it more.”
rows.translation: “别这么说！”你伸手把她抱进一个大大的拥抱。“我的操弄玩具是怎么运作的，对我来说真的好——重要。再说，你的声音真的很性感。我想多听听。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t say that!” You reach forward and pull her into a big hug. “How my fuck toys tick is, like, sooo important to me. And anyway, your voice is really sexy. I wanna listen to it more.”"

rows.original: “There’s more to you than being my fuck toy,” you say patiently. “I’d like to hear about it.”
rows.translation: “你不只是我的操弄玩具，”你耐心地说道。“我想听听其他部分。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There’s more to you than being my fuck toy,” you say patiently. “I’d like to hear about it.”"

rows.original: “I don’t need to, but I want to,” you say, lip quirking. “And I’m not the one wearing the electric collar. So c’mon. Let’s chat.”
rows.translation: “我不需要知道，但我想知道，”你唇角一翘，说道。“而且戴着电击项圈的人又不是我。所以来吧，聊聊。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t need to, but I want to,” you say, lip quirking. “And I’m not the one wearing the electric collar. So c’mon. Let’s chat.”"

rows.original: “I want to know what makes you tick,” you say dryly, “so I know exactly what buttons to press, if need be. I’m sure you did similar with your own slaves, once.”
rows.translation: “我想知道你是怎么运作的，”你干巴巴地说道，“这样必要时，我才能确切知道该按哪些按钮。我相信你以前对自己的奴隶也做过类似的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I want to know what makes you tick,” you say dryly, “so I know exactly what buttons to press, if need be. I’m sure you did similar with your own slaves, once.”"

rows.original: Grudgingly Sera scooches herself up against the wall, hugging her knees and gazing at you sidelong.

rows.raw: "\n\nGrudgingly Sera scooches herself up against the wall, hugging her knees and gazing at you sidelong."

rows.original: “Do something for me first. Tell me who you are, really, and what you’re doing on the frontier. Please?” she throws in at the end.
rows.translation: “先为我做件事。告诉我真正的你是谁，又在边疆做什么。好吗？”她在最后补了一句。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do something for me first. Tell me who you are, really, and what you’re doing on the frontier. Please?” she throws in at the end."

rows.original: She’ll find out sooner or later - if she hasn’t already gotten most of the details from the extranet - so you fill her in. She nods tersely as you explain your father’s quest, his bequeathments and how far you’ve so far gotten.
rows.translation: 她迟早会知道，如果还没有从星网上查到大部分细节的话，因此你把情况告诉了她。你解释父亲的任务、他的遗赠，以及自己目前取得的进展时，她简短地点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’ll find out sooner or later - if she hasn’t already gotten most of the details from the extranet - so you fill her in. She nods tersely as you explain your father’s quest, his bequeathments and how far you’ve so far gotten."

rows.original: “What a fun and generous dad you had,” she sighs at last. “Alright then, if you insist. What do you want to know?”

rows.raw: "\n\n“What a fun and generous dad you had,” she sighs at last. “Alright then, if you insist. What do you want to know?”"

rows.original: “Why?” she replies sullenly. “I already told you about me. How else would you have known about my debt, and done this to me otherwise?”

rows.raw: "\n\n“Why?” she replies sullenly. “I already told you about me. How else would you have known about my debt, and done this to me otherwise?”"

rows.original: “Yeah,” sneers Sera. “Then your company goes tits up, or you get your ass captured by pirates and someone has to pay a massive ransom, and suddenly you don’t have a fully financed nursery no more. rows.original: “You don’t know Jarvis?” Sera grips the air with her claws and stares at the ceiling in exasperation. “For One’s sake [pc.name]. You don’t need a second name when you are one of the most influential human modders in the galaxy! He personally designed most of the things I’ve used on myself. I heard that he was one of the original founders of Xenogen, but he’s been working independently for years now. I met him only once, back on Earth... I’m amazed that he remembers me. I mean I don’t know why – I don’t know what he’s doing here, why he sent a card when he could have fucking e-mailed me, who else is going to be there...” she’s pacing back and forth, ranting almost, gesticulating fretfully.
rows.translation: “你不认识贾维斯？”塞拉用爪子抓挠空气，恼火地瞪着天花板。“看在独一神的份上，[pc.name]。当你是银河系最具影响力的人类改造师之一时，根本不需要第二个名字！我用在自己身上的大部分东西都是他亲自设计的。我听说他是异源生物科技最初的创始人之一，不过这些年来一直独立工作。我只在地球上见过他一次...真没想到他还记得我。我的意思是，我不知道为什么，我不知道他在这里做什么，不知道他明明可以他妈的给我发电子邮件，为什么非要寄卡片，也不知道还有谁会去...”她来回踱步，几乎是在喋喋不休地抱怨，焦躁地比划着手势。

rows.original: “With a guest, dear. With a guest who is going to show supreme gratitude for my generosity. Nothing says up-and-coming modder like a well-behaved, presentable bitch on a leash. You won’t even have to worry about a costume. I’ve got that sorted out...” She laughs to herself, before going on more soberly. “We only get one chance at this, [pc.name]. This is the biggest opportunity I will ever have to get the kind of contacts that could put this place on a secure financial footing, and everything we do and say with these people could make a difference. Jarvis won’t be here for long – it’s likely this is the only party he’ll be throwing on Tavros. So if you want to go prepare or primp or whatever, go ahead and do it. I can wait.”
rows.translation: “还要带一位宾客，亲爱的。一个必须对我的慷慨表现出无上感激的宾客。没有什么比一条皮带上乖巧、体面的母狗，更能彰显一位前途无量的改造师。你甚至不必操心服装。我已经把那安排好了...”她自顾自地笑了起来，随后换上更加严肃的口吻。“我们的机会只有一次，[pc.name]。这是我获得那些人脉的最大机遇，它们能让这里的财务基础稳固下来；我们在这些人面前的一言一行都可能带来影响。贾维斯不会在这里久留，这很可能是他唯一一次在塔夫罗斯举办聚会。所以，如果你想去准备或者打扮一番什么的，就去吧。我可以等。”

Oh, that takes me back. I want to cane you and then nail you and then cane and nail you some more until you’re begging me to stop...” With visible effort, she stops her hand sinking downwards. “...later, maybe. There will be time later...” She takes a deep breath and then gestures irritably at the pile of clothes she’s created on her side of the bed. “I can’t decide. What do you think I should wear?” Flattered and vaguely confused by her asking your opinion, you consider the outfits she’s laid out with as clear a mind as you can."

rows.original: “I work on my own,” Sera cuts in frostily. “I am the lead gene mod merchant on this station, but I am not a front for no f- damn Earth company. I’ve got big plans for Tavros.” She puts a hand on her hip and smiles at the pair challengingly. “So, you two don’t have any... companions?”
rows.translation: “我独立经营，”塞拉冷冰冰地打断他。“我是这座空间站首屈一指的基因改造商人，但我不是什么该——该死的地球公司的幌子。我对塔弗罗斯有宏伟的规划。”她一手叉腰，挑衅地朝两人微笑。“所以，你们两个没有任何... 伴儿吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I work on my own,” Sera cuts in frostily. “I am the lead gene mod merchant on this station, but I am not a front for no f- damn Earth company. I’ve got big plans for Tavros.” She puts a hand on her hip and smiles at the pair challengingly. “So, you two don’t have any... companions?”"

rows.original: “Oh, I collect dear, but why would I bring along toys to a night like this?” purrs Vedice, her glistening green lips curving into a smile as she continues to stare at you. “Not as much fun that way.”
rows.translation: “噢，亲爱的，我确实会收藏，但像今晚这种场合，我为什么要带玩具来呢？”维迪丝柔声说道，闪亮的绿色嘴唇弯成微笑，仍目不转睛地注视着你。“那样就没这么好玩了。”

rows.original: Sipping your drink, you break off and wander aimlessly through the party. Away from the main room the lighting is dimmer and things seem a lot less tense; there is an awful lot of whispering, giggling and closing of doors going on. You find yourself in a tiled corridor lined with plinths, upon each of which a slim man or woman is dancing slowly. They are all naked except for concealing latex gimp masks; underneath them groups of suited people with animal heads are talking amongst themselves animatedly. You pause by a door from which extremely heavy music seems to be emanating.

rows.original: After a few moments you are plugged into the VR simulation with four others. You are designated a slim, male vulpine rogue called Rafa. Although you are dimly aware of your real body, lying on a couch in the real world somewhere, you certainly feel like your character as you and your party attempt to quest through a dungeon which turns out to contain a deeply unfair number of booby traps and fuck-hungry enemies. One of your troupe gets taken for a minotaur bride; the rest fall victim to the floor suddenly becoming a vast nest of tentacles. With your swiftness and reflexes you manage to escape it, wriggling, sneaking and ferreting your way further and further into the perverted underground maze, sheer determination driving you on – however not even hiding in a water barrel can prevent you finally being apprehended by two burly ausar soldiers.

rows.original: You are on the residential deck of Tavros. Unlike the rows of apartments and squashed-together shops found elsewhere, the dwellings here are large, separate buildings, mansions almost. Above it all a vast, transparent ceiling hangs, through which the glittering void of space gazes back. The price of places like these on a vessel like Tavros must be huge.
rows.translation: 你们身处塔夫罗斯住宅层。不同于其他地方成排的公寓与挤作一团的商店，这里的住宅是大型独立建筑，近乎豪宅。一片广阔透明的穹顶悬在一切之上，闪烁的太空虚空透过它回望。像塔夫罗斯这种飞行器上的这类住所，价格一定高得惊人。

rows.original: Sera drags you up to the doorway of one such tastefully white decorated estate. You can feel the bass vibrations of music and conversation, and there is a man stood outside in a smoking jacket with a glass of wine. He raises it and smiles as you approach.
rows.translation: 塞拉拖着你来到其中一座品味高雅、以白色装饰的宅邸门口。你能感到音乐与谈话的低音震动，外面还站着一名身穿吸烟装、手持酒杯的男人。你们走近时，他举杯微笑。
rows.raw: "Sera drags you up to the doorway of one such tastefully white decorated estate. You can feel the bass vibrations of music and conversation, and there is a man stood outside in a smoking jacket with a glass of wine. He raises it and smiles as you approach."

rows.original: “Ah, Sera. I was beginning to think you weren’t going to make it – how pleasant to see you again.”
rows.translation: “啊，塞拉。我刚开始还以为你不会来了，很高兴再次见到你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, Sera. I was beginning to think you weren’t going to make it – how pleasant to see you again.”"

rows.original: “Jarvis,” coos Sera slyly in response, offering her other hand. Jarvis neither shakes nor kisses it, simply holds it for a moment while looking her with friendly, cunning interest. For a human supposedly of legendary modding fame he’s remarkably normal looking – he has a long, clean shaven, intelligent face with a mane of combed back brown hair. His voice, a low, measured murmur, immediately makes you think he’s never raised it in his life.
rows.translation: “贾维斯。”塞拉狡黠地娇声回应，同时伸出另一只手。贾维斯既没有握手也没有吻手，只是握了片刻，以友好而精明的兴趣打量着她。作为一名据说在改造领域享有传奇声望的人类，他的长相却出奇普通：一张修长、刮得干干净净而又透着聪慧的脸，棕色头发如鬃毛般向后梳理整齐。他的嗓音低沉、从容，像是喃喃细语，立刻让你觉得他这辈子从未提高过音量。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Jarvis,” coos Sera slyly in response, offering her other hand. Jarvis neither shakes nor kisses it, simply holds it for a moment while looking her with friendly, cunning interest. For a human supposedly of legendary modding fame he’s remarkably normal looking – he has a long, clean shaven, intelligent face with a mane of combed back brown hair. His voice, a low, measured murmur, immediately makes you think he’s never raised it in his life."

rows.original: “Oh dear! What’s the matter with her? Is she taking immuno-boosters? Is she eating alright? Is she taking lots of fluids?” She hurries up to the counter and lays her cool gel hands on your arm, looks into your face pleadingly. “Please - let me see her. I took a first aid class when I started working on the flight deck, I have to make sure she’s alright...”
rows.translation: “天哪！她怎么了？她有服用免疫增强剂吗？有好好吃饭吗？有补充大量水分吗？”她匆忙走到柜台前，把冰凉的凝胶手放在你的手臂上，恳求地看着你的脸。“求你了 - 让我见见她。我开始在飞行甲板工作时上过急救课，我必须确认她没事...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh dear! What’s the matter with her? Is she taking immuno-boosters? Is she eating alright? Is she taking lots of fluids?” She hurries up to the counter and lays her cool gel hands on your arm, looks into your face pleadingly. “Please - let me see her. I took a first aid class when I started working on the flight deck, I have to make sure she’s alright...”"

rows.original: Let Her
rows.translation: 让她去
rows.raw: "Let Her"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Harem members should look out for one another, in your view. You tell her to head on through. The rahn squeezes a thank you into your arm, and then hurries her dark skirt-clad butt into the back.
rows.translation: 在你看来，后宫成员应该互相照顾。你让她直接进去。这个拉恩在你手臂上挤出一句谢谢，随后匆匆把裹在深色裙子里的屁股送进后屋。
rows.raw: "Harem members should look out for one another, in your view. You tell her to head on through. The rahn squeezes a thank you into your arm, and then hurries her dark skirt-clad butt into the back."

rows.original: You hear raised voices... but Jardi’s high but calm tones climb highest. You grin to yourself and busy yourself with customers. Maybe an hour later, the rahn returns.
rows.translation: 你听见了争执声...但贾迪高亢而平静的语调盖过了其他声音。你暗自一笑，转而忙着招呼顾客。大约一小时后，拉恩回来了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hear raised voices... but Jardi’s high but calm tones climb highest. You grin to yourself and busy yourself with customers. Maybe an hour later, the rahn returns."

rows.original: “I’ve made her promise to drink sugar water, made a pot of vegetable soup, and put bandages on the worst of the swelling. She doesn’t look after herself!” Jardi squeaks indignantly. “The junk she eats, the things she uses on herself! No wonder the silly bony thing has so much aggression.” She pecks you on the cheek and squeezes your hand again. “You’re such a hero [pc.name], looking after her shop like this. I’ve left my number on the nightstand - give me a call if it gets too much. I’ll check back in a couple of days anyway.”
rows.translation: “我让她答应喝糖水，煮了一锅蔬菜汤，还给肿得最厉害的地方绑了绷带。她根本不会照顾自己！”贾迪愤愤不平地尖声说道。“瞧她吃的那些垃圾，还有往自己身上用的东西！难怪这个傻乎乎的骨感家伙脾气这么大。”她轻啄你的脸颊，又握了握你的手。“[pc.name]，你真是个英雄，像这样替她照看店铺。我把号码留在床头柜上了 - 要是忙不过来，就给我打电话。反正过几天我也会再来看看。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve made her promise to drink sugar water, made a pot of vegetable soup, and put bandages on the worst of the swelling. She doesn’t look after herself!” Jardi squeaks indignantly. “The junk she eats, the things she uses on herself! No wonder the silly bony thing has so much aggression.” She pecks you on the cheek and squeezes your hand again. “You’re such a hero [pc.name], looking after her shop like this. I’ve left my number on the nightstand - give me a call if it gets too much. I’ll check back in a couple of days anyway.”"

rows.original: It seems cruel not to. Maybe the rahn can help anyway.
rows.translation: 不让她去似乎太残忍了。也许这个拉恩还能帮上忙。
rows.raw: "It seems cruel not to. Maybe the rahn can help anyway."

rows.translation: 不行

rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You tell her that Sera asked to be left alone until she recovers. You swear you’re not making that up - she’s feeling very self-conscious at the moment. It’s hard to remain steadfast in the face of Jardi’s soulful eyes and concerned expression, but you manage it.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，塞拉要求在康复前独处。你发誓这不是你编出来的 - 她现在非常在意自己的模样。面对贾迪深情的双眼和忧虑的表情，想要坚持立场很难，但你还是做到了。
rows.raw: "You tell her that Sera asked to be left alone until she recovers. You swear you’re not making that up - she’s feeling very self-conscious at the moment. It’s hard to remain steadfast in the face of Jardi’s soulful eyes and concerned expression, but you manage it."

rows.original: “Are you sure there’s nothing I can do? Well... ok. Let me give you my number at least. If it ever gets too much, please give me a call. I’ll be back in a couple of days.”
rows.translation: “你确定我什么都帮不上吗？那...好吧。至少让我把号码给你。要是你忙不过来，请给我打电话。我过几天还会再来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you sure there’s nothing I can do? Well... ok. Let me give you my number at least. If it ever gets too much, please give me a call. I’ll be back in a couple of days.”"

rows.original: The rahn leaves, looking wilted and sad. You feel like a bit of a dick - on the other hand, you did what Mistress asked of you.
rows.translation: 这个拉恩神情萎靡而悲伤地离开了。你觉得自己有点混蛋 - 但另一方面，你确实照女主人的吩咐做了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe rahn leaves, looking wilted and sad. You feel like a bit of a dick - on the other hand, you did what Mistress asked of you."

rows.translation: 拒绝
rows.raw: "Refuse"

rows.translation: 塞拉明确告诉过你，别让她的其他奴仆看到她。
rows.raw: "Sera specifically told you to not let her other subs see her."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You don’t get much chance to reflect on your decision. The hallways outside the Chrysalis’s window are thronged with traffic - some confluence of large space transports arriving and a work shift ending - and you find yourself inundated with customers. Torn between making fast purchases, bringing out fresh stock, trying to offer advice to the mod-curious and attempting to make sure no-one’s stealing anything is exhausting and bewildering.
rows.translation: 你没多少机会反思自己的决定。暗黑蝶蛹窗外的走廊挤满了来往人群 - 几艘大型太空运输船抵达，又恰逢一个班次结束 - 顾客顿时将你淹没。在迅速结账、拿出新货、为对改造好奇的人提供建议，以及设法确保没人偷东西之间疲于奔命，既累人又令人晕头转向。
rows.raw: "You don’t get much chance to reflect on your decision. The hallways outside the Chrysalis’s window are thronged with traffic - some confluence of large space transports arriving and a work shift ending - and you find yourself inundated with customers. Torn between making fast purchases, bringing out fresh stock, trying to offer advice to the mod-curious and attempting to make sure no-one’s stealing anything is exhausting and bewildering."

rows.translation: 的外在表现当成抵御紧张情绪的某种盾牌确实有所帮助，尽管这也意味着你得花时间拍开那些伸向你[pc.butts]的手。
rows.raw: " facade as a sort of shield for your nerves helps, even though it also means spending time slapping hands away from your [pc.butts]."

rows.original: At long last there’s a pause in the deluge, and you shut shop for a break. Wiping your brow, you check in on Sera.
rows.translation: 漫长的顾客洪流终于出现了间歇，你关店休息。你擦了擦额头，去查看塞拉的状况。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt long last there’s a pause in the deluge, and you shut shop for a break. Wiping your brow, you check in on Sera."

rows.original: She is a still, horned huddle underneath her blankets. Her tail hangs limply down onto the floor. Tentatively, you ask if she’s feeling better.
rows.translation: 她缩成一团，一动不动，长着角的身体藏在毯子下面。尾巴无力地垂到地板上。你试探着问她有没有好一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe is a still, horned huddle underneath her blankets. Her tail hangs limply down onto the floor. Tentatively, you ask if she’s feeling better."

rows.original: “No.” It’s a quiet, quavering sound. You pause for a long, bad moment, wondering what you should do. “[pc.name]... d’you think you c’d just... hold me? Jus f’r a little while.” She sniffs wetly. “Not infectious.”
rows.translation: “没有。”声音轻微而颤抖。你难受地停顿了许久，思索着自己该怎么办。“[pc.name]...你能不能就...抱抱我？就一小会儿。”她湿漉漉地吸了吸鼻子。“不会传染。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No.” It’s a quiet, quavering sound. You pause for a long, bad moment, wondering what you should do. “[pc.name]... d’you think you c’d just... hold me? Jus f’r a little while.” She sniffs wetly. “Not infectious.”"

rows.original: Do It
rows.translation: 做吧
rows.raw: "Do It"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Without a word you pick your way through the tissue paper rubble and then slide yourself between the sheets to gently spoon a very sorry demon morph.
rows.translation: 你一言不发，小心穿过满地纸巾的废墟，钻进被窝，轻柔地从背后抱住这个可怜兮兮的恶魔变形者。
rows.raw: "Without a word you pick your way through the tissue paper rubble and then slide yourself between the sheets to gently spoon a very sorry demon morph."

rows.original: “‘Nk you.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“‘Nk you.”"

rows.original: Sera’s usually supple flesh is cool and clammy except where the spots have erupted, which are very hot. They may have calmed down a bit, actually: no longer luridly bloated and fluorescent, they’ve mostly darkened and scabbed over. You carefully rub them, and make sure when you clinch her to your [pc.chest] you’re not pressing down on any. She responds with a long sigh, a deep tension relaxing.
rows.translation: 塞拉平时柔软的肌肤又凉又黏，只有斑点爆发的地方滚烫。事实上，它们可能已经有所缓和：不再肿得刺眼、泛着荧光，大多已经变暗结痂。你小心地揉着她，确保将她搂向你的[pc.chest]时没有压到任何一处。她长叹一声，深藏的紧绷随之舒缓下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nSera’s usually supple flesh is cool and clammy except where the spots have erupted, which are very hot. They may have calmed down a bit, actually: no longer luridly bloated and fluorescent, they’ve mostly darkened and scabbed over. You carefully rub them, and make sure when you clinch her to your [pc.chest] you’re not pressing down on any. She responds with a long sigh, a deep tension relaxing."

rows.original: “Don’t get sick usually... when I wuz little there was a Sigius Fever outbreak, ‘n I got it. My mom held me under the blankets, like this... I remember cuz she never did that any other time. I remember feeling so helpless... so loved. Maybe I could give other people that feeling, one day...”
rows.translation: “我平时不会生病...小时候爆发过一次西吉乌斯热，然后我就染上了。我妈妈像这样把我抱在毯子底下...我记得，是因为她其他时候从来不会那么做。我记得自己那么无助...又那么被爱着。也许有一天，我也能让别人感受到那种感觉...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t get sick usually... when I wuz little there was a Sigius Fever outbreak, ‘n I got it. My mom held me under the blankets, like this... I remember cuz she never did that any other time. I remember feeling so helpless... so loved. Maybe I could give other people that feeling, one day...”"

rows.original: Her tone is very woozy. You doubt she’ll remember telling you this afterwards. Or she’ll pretend she doesn’t. You murmur nothings in her ear as you hold and stroke her flu-racked body, tell her that she is loved, she is safe, and she’ll soon be better. She doesn’t respond; a few more moments and her breathing is the slow and steady fall of the soundly asleep.
rows.translation: 她的语调昏昏沉沉。你怀疑她事后不会记得自己告诉过你这些。或者她会假装不记得。你抱着她、抚摸她饱受流感折磨的身体，在她耳边低声说些安慰的话，告诉她有人爱她，她很安全，而且很快就会好起来。她没有回应；又过了片刻，她的呼吸变成了熟睡时缓慢而平稳的起伏。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer tone is very woozy. You doubt she’ll remember telling you this afterwards. Or she’ll pretend she doesn’t. You murmur nothings in her ear as you hold and stroke her flu-racked body, tell her that she is loved, she is safe, and she’ll soon be better. She doesn’t respond; a few more moments and her breathing is the slow and steady fall of the soundly asleep."

rows.original: You clean her room, leave water, medicine and her phone with Tavros med bay on speed dial in easy reach, then quietly depart.
rows.translation: 你打扫了她的房间，把水、药物和她的手机放在随手可及的地方，手机快速拨号设为了塔维罗斯医疗舱，随后悄然离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou clean her room, leave water, medicine and her phone with Tavros med bay on speed dial in easy reach, then quietly depart."

rows.translation: 那天晚上，你自己也在育儿所睡得很沉。你一头扎进这份兼任店铺经理和护士的双重职责，整整干了两天，早已筋疲力尽。事实上，你最后还睡过了头。

rows.translation: 你只来得及迅速洗漱一番，随后

rows.translation: 匆匆赶回暗黑蝶蛹。
rows.raw: " you hurry back down to the Dark Chrysalis."

rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.raw: "KALAS.TAVROS.DARK CHRYSALIS"

rows.original: The lights are on and it’s already open. You peer through the window. Sera, tall, straight, bare-breasted and flawlessly made-up, is gesticulating aggressively with a gene mod in hand to a couple of enthralled customers. Barring one or two band-aids on her arms and brow, she looks redolent with health. Your heart rises as your brow descends. How has she managed that? She made like she was on death’s door last night.
rows.translation: 灯已经亮了，店也已经开门。你透过窗户向里张望。塞拉身材高挑、站得笔直，袒露双乳，妆容无可挑剔，手握一份基因改造剂，正对两名听得入迷的顾客激烈地比划着。除了手臂和额头贴着一两块创可贴，她浑身都散发着健康活力。你心中一喜，眉头却皱了起来。她怎么做到的？昨晚她还表现得像是命悬一线。
rows.raw: "The lights are on and it’s already open. You peer through the window. Sera, tall, straight, bare-breasted and flawlessly made-up, is gesticulating aggressively with a gene mod in hand to a couple of enthralled customers. Barring one or two band-aids on her arms and brow, she looks redolent with health. Your heart rises as your brow descends. How has she managed that? She made like she was on death’s door last night."

rows.original: The demon-morph catches your eye through the window as she talks. The spade tip of her tail crookedly beckons you inside.
rows.translation: 恶魔变形者说话时隔着窗户注意到了你。她尾巴的铲形尖端弯了弯，招呼你进去。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe demon-morph catches your eye through the window as she talks. The spade tip of her tail crookedly beckons you inside."

rows.original: “--Later! I’ve got important business to intend to,” she declaims, waving the timid pair of ausar away. “I’ll show you things you never even knew you wanted if you come back. When you come back.”
rows.translation: “--回头见！我有重要事务要处理，”她高声宣布，挥手赶走那对胆怯的奥萨。“如果你们回来，我会让你们见识连自己都不知道想要的东西。是等你们回来以后。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“--Later! I’ve got important business to intend to,” she declaims, waving the timid pair of ausar away. “I’ll show you things you never even knew you wanted if you come back. When you come back.”"

rows.original: She smiles at you triumphantly as the front door swings shut, leaning on the counter and displaying her sharp teeth (and everything else) to you.
rows.translation: 前门摆动着关上时，她得意地朝你微笑，倚在柜台上，向你展示她尖锐的牙齿（以及其他一切）。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles at you triumphantly as the front door swings shut, leaning on the counter and displaying her sharp teeth (and everything else) to you."

rows.original: “That’s right, bitch. I’m back.”
rows.translation: “没错，婊子。我回来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s right, bitch. I’m back.”"

rows.original: “How have you recovered so quickly, Mistress?” you burst out with
rows.translation: “女主人，你怎么恢复得这么快？”你脱口问道，同时
rows.raw: "\n\n“How have you recovered so quickly, Mistress?” you burst out with"

rows.original: , bouncing up and down anxiously
rows.translation: 焦急地上下蹦跳
rows.raw: ", bouncing up and down anxiously"

rows.original: . “Are you sure you’re feeling ok? Maybe you should take things a little slower...”
rows.translation: 。“你确定自己没事吗？也许你应该放慢一点...”
rows.raw: ". “Are you sure you’re feeling ok? Maybe you should take things a little slower...”"

rows.original: She cuts you off with a throaty, teasing laugh.
rows.translation: 她用低沉而戏谑的笑声打断了你。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe cuts you off with a throaty, teasing laugh."

rows.original: “Oh, my sweet little slut. You were really worried, weren’t you? I told you.” She taps her sable corset, with its eerily glowing baubles. “This thing stabilizes me back to this state whatever nasty shit I do to my DNA. rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s good to have you back, Mistress.”"

rows.original: She hugs you tightly, seemingly on impulse. Her high breasts pillow into your [pc.chest] and her smoky, spicy smell fills your nostrils as she squeezes you tightly. Lips press firmly on your cheek.
rows.translation: 她似乎一时冲动，紧紧抱住了你。她高挺的乳房软绵绵地贴上你的[pc.chest]，烟熏般辛辣的气味灌满你的鼻腔，同时紧紧抱住你。嘴唇用力印在你的脸颊上。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hugs you tightly, seemingly on impulse. Her high breasts pillow into your [pc.chest] and her smoky, spicy smell fills your nostrils as she squeezes you tightly. Lips press firmly on your cheek."

rows.original: “I’m so lucky to have you,” she says, low in your ear. “I promise I’ll... I’ll call if ever something goes wrong. My best sub.”
rows.translation: “有你在，我真幸运。”她贴着你的耳朵低声说道。“我保证...以后出了任何问题，我都会打电话。我的最佳受方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m so lucky to have you,” she says, low in your ear. “I promise I’ll... I’ll call if ever something goes wrong. My best sub.”"

rows.original: She coughs slightly as she pulls away, irritatedly flicking her hand over her fluorescent eyes.
rows.translation: 她稍稍咳嗽一声，一边抽身，一边烦躁地在荧光眼睛前挥挥手。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe coughs slightly as she pulls away, irritatedly flicking her hand over her fluorescent eyes."

rows.original: “Right. Now then. Is there anything else you’re here for?”
rows.translation: “好了。那么，你来这里还有别的事吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right. Now then. Is there anything else you’re here for?”"

rows.original: A lot of the things the highly strung demon-morph is usually not able to say are said with that.
rows.translation: 这个拥抱表达了许多这个神经紧绷的恶魔变体平常无法诉诸言语的感情。
rows.raw: " A lot of the things the highly strung demon-morph is usually not able to say are said with that."

rows.original: The show starts off fairly humbly, showing the Kalas system and Tavros’s location and size within it; solar flares on Kalas itself, in all their blistering, withering intensity. The presenter talks a little bit about the function of the warp gates; the projector simultaneously shows a spaceship entering a gate and emerging from its twin at the same time as showing the distance actually traveled fast forwarded, this slightest representation of the scales involved making your heart leap to your mouth.
rows.translation: 演出开场颇为朴实，展示了卡拉斯星系，以及塔夫罗斯在其中的位置与规模；卡拉斯恒星本身的耀斑也以灼热而摧枯拉朽的全部威力呈现出来。讲解员稍微介绍了跃迁门的功能；投影仪同时展示一艘飞船进入一扇门、从它的孪生门中出现，并以快进方式呈现实际跨越的距离。仅仅这样稍稍展现所涉及的尺度，就令你的心提到嗓子眼。
rows.raw: "The show starts off fairly humbly, showing the Kalas system and Tavros’s location and size within it; solar flares on Kalas itself, in all their blistering, withering intensity. The presenter talks a little bit about the function of the warp gates; the projector simultaneously shows a spaceship entering a gate and emerging from its twin at the same time as showing the distance actually traveled fast forwarded, this slightest representation of the scales involved making your heart leap to your mouth."

rows.original: Then some of the worlds in the process of being discovered in the Rush are shown, recorded by Tavros’s own delicate machinery. Mhen’ga is zoomed in upon, from a tiny white dot amongst many others to a hazy green ball orbiting Ara Ara and then all the way in through its stratosphere, so that you can practically breath in the humid, tropical air. Then the bizarre, hourglass shape of Tarkus
rows.translation: 随后，塔夫罗斯自身的精密仪器记录下大开拓中正在被发现的一些世界，并将它们呈现在众人眼前。镜头对准门加，从无数白色小点中的一颗放大成环绕阿拉阿拉的朦胧绿色球体，随后一路穿过平流层，近得仿佛能让你吸入潮湿的热带空气。接下来是塔库斯奇异的沙漏形状
rows.raw: "\n\nThen some of the worlds in the process of being discovered in the Rush are shown, recorded by Tavros’s own delicate machinery. Mhen’ga is zoomed in upon, from a tiny white dot amongst many others to a hazy green ball orbiting Ara Ara and then all the way in through its stratosphere, so that you can practically breath in the humid, tropical air. Then the bizarre, hourglass shape of Tarkus"

rows.original: - or how it was, anyway. The presentation skips over what it looks like now, which is probably for the best -
rows.translation: ——或者说，它曾经的形状。演示跳过了它如今的模样，这或许是件好事——
rows.raw: " - or how it was, anyway. The presentation skips over what it looks like now, which is probably for the best -"

rows.original: and the beckoning, glittering dark pink of Dhaal. Half a dozen other planets and barely-believable objects caught in the unblinking eye of the station’s telescope flash before you.
rows.translation: ，还有达尔那诱人而闪耀的深粉色。空间站望远镜不眨眼的镜头捕捉到另外六七颗行星和几乎令人无法置信的天体，它们逐一在你眼前闪过。
rows.raw: " and the beckoning, glittering dark pink of Dhaal. Half a dozen other planets and barely-believable objects caught in the unblinking eye of the station’s telescope flash before you."

rows.original: “YOUNG CHILDREN AND THOSE OF A DELICATE PREDISPOSITION ARE ASKED TO LEAVE THE AUDITORIUM NOW,” booms the presenter. All the young children remain exactly where they are, of course. You have an inkling of what they’re going to do - you’ve seen it plenty of times on the extranet before - but not on this size of projector. It goes blank, then displays a top-down view of the auditorium. In real time, you discover, as plenty look up and wave at the invisible camera. It slowly zooms out, into darkness at first, then out into space, over the grand spinning top roof of Tavros. A vast piece of architecture, a remarkable piece of technology when you really consider it. But tiny in comparison to the planets nearby...
rows.translation: “请年幼儿童及心性敏感者现在离开观众厅。”讲解员用轰鸣般的声音宣布。当然，所有年幼儿童都纹丝不动地留在原处。你隐约猜到他们准备做什么——以前在星网上见过很多次——但从未在这么大的投影仪上看过。画面变得一片空白，随后显示出观众厅的俯视图。你发现这是实时画面，因为许多人抬头向看不见的镜头挥手。视角缓缓拉远，起初没入黑暗，接着进入太空，越过塔夫罗斯宏伟的陀螺形屋顶。仔细想来，这是一座庞大的建筑，也是一项非凡的技术。然而，与附近的行星相比，它微小得不值一提...
rows.raw: "\n\n“YOUNG CHILDREN AND THOSE OF A DELICATE PREDISPOSITION ARE ASKED TO LEAVE THE AUDITORIUM NOW,” booms the presenter. All the young children remain exactly where they are, of course. You have an inkling of what they’re going to do - you’ve seen it plenty of times on the extranet before - but not on this size of projector. It goes blank, then displays a top-down view of the auditorium. In real time, you discover, as plenty look up and wave at the invisible camera. It slowly zooms out, into darkness at first, then out into space, over the grand spinning top roof of Tavros. A vast piece of architecture, a remarkable piece of technology when you really consider it. But tiny in comparison to the planets nearby..."

rows.original: The zoom speeds up slowly but exponentially, as if it were a rollercoaster cresting a rise and hurtling downwards. Or at least the effect it has on your stomach is the same, as the huge holographic projector bugs away from Tavros, encompasses the whole Kalas system, then outwards, outwards, outwards... until it is nothing but a bright dot amongst the other nearby bright dots. And then outward again into the cloudy foam that is this region of the Milky Way, outward so far you can see the entire arm you are in, vast beyond all imagining. And then outward again so you can see the whole thing, a spiral of spectral light in the great blackness... and then further out again, so that all the other galaxies come into view, tiny little pockets of white, out so far that maybe you can see the very shape of existence, an impossible view...
rows.translation: 拉远的速度缓慢却呈指数增长，仿佛过山车越过坡顶后向下疾驰。至少它对你胃部造成的效果一模一样：巨大的全息投影仪飞速远离塔夫罗斯，将整个卡拉斯星系纳入画面，随后向外、向外、不断向外...直到它变成附近其他亮点之间的一颗亮点。接着再次向外，进入银河系这一区域如云般的泡沫，远到足以看见自己所在的整条旋臂，那规模浩瀚得超出一切想象。随后再次向外，让你看见它的全貌，那是在无尽黑暗中由幽灵般光芒组成的螺旋...接着继续向外，所有其他星系都进入视野，化为一小团一小团的白色，远到或许能让你看见存在本身的形状，那是一幅不可能的景象...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zoom speeds up slowly but exponentially, as if it were a rollercoaster cresting a rise and hurtling downwards. Or at least the effect it has on your stomach is the same, as the huge holographic projector bugs away from Tavros, encompasses the whole Kalas system, then outwards, outwards, outwards... until it is nothing but a bright dot amongst the other nearby bright dots. And then outward again into the cloudy foam that is this region of the Milky Way, outward so far you can see the entire arm you are in, vast beyond all imagining. And then outward again so you can see the whole thing, a spiral of spectral light in the great blackness... and then further out again, so that all the other galaxies come into view, tiny little pockets of white, out so far that maybe you can see the very shape of existence, an impossible view..."

rows.original: And then it zooms all the way back in again in the space of three seconds, centering in on the starstruck face of a puazi child in the auditorium. She’s not crying anymore. There is applause and cries and whoops of childish joy, one of which comes from the person sat next to you.
rows.translation: 随后，画面在三秒内一路重新放大，将中心对准观众厅里一名普阿兹儿童惊叹的面孔。她已经不哭了。掌声、欢呼和孩子们喜悦的叫喊响彻四周，其中一声来自坐在你身旁的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd then it zooms all the way back in again in the space of three seconds, centering in on the starstruck face of a puazi child in the auditorium. She’s not crying anymore. There is applause and cries and whoops of childish joy, one of which comes from the person sat next to you."

rows.original: “Yeah! Woooo!” cheers Sera, standing up and clapping, an ecstatic grin on her fanged face. “Do it again! Do it again!”
rows.translation: “好耶！呜呼！”塞拉欢呼着站起身鼓掌，长着獠牙的脸上挂着欣喜若狂的笑容。“再来一次！再来一次！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah! Woooo!” cheers Sera, standing up and clapping, an ecstatic grin on her fanged face. “Do it again! Do it again!”"

rows.raw: "“Alright, I admit, that was kinda fun,” the demon-morph says over coffee in the café afterwards. “After all that time cooped up inside... it was good to get out. Even if what you chose was total nerd shit.”"

rows.original: Tavros’s planetarium is right at the top of the station, near the state-of-the-art observational equipment the UGC uses to closely monitor the never-ending ebb and flow of space traffic through the outpost. Sera wears a furious scowl the whole way there, increasing her already intimidating aspect.
rows.translation: 塔夫罗斯的天文馆位于空间站最顶端，紧邻银河联合邦联用于密切监控经由这座前哨站永无休止、起伏变化的太空交通的尖端观测设备。一路上，塞拉始终怒容满面，让她本就极具威慑力的模样变得更加骇人。

Sera wears a furious scowl the whole way there, increasing her already intimidating aspect."

rows.original: “Alright, let’s get this fucking over with,” she snaps as the elevator doors open upon the lobby leading into the wide, glittering dark of the planetarium’s entrance. A small puazi child nearby starts crying. You begin wondering if this was such a good idea.
rows.translation: “好吧，赶紧把这破事做完。”电梯门打开，露出通往天文馆入口那片宽阔闪耀的黑暗的大厅时，她厉声说道。附近一名普阿兹儿童顿时哭了起来。你开始怀疑这究竟是不是个好主意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, let’s get this fucking over with,” she snaps as the elevator doors open upon the lobby leading into the wide, glittering dark of the planetarium’s entrance. A small puazi child nearby starts crying. You begin wondering if this was such a good idea."

rows.original: The exhibits have rather more Akkadi branding and advertising than you’d like, but the models of early spacecraft and grainy videos of ausar and mankind’s first faltering footsteps into the great unknown are stirring. At some point, you notice that Sera’s arm has slipped out of yours. You find her gazing into a holographic model of the evolution of a supergiant star.
rows.translation: 展品中阿卡迪的品牌标识与广告比你希望看到的更多，不过早期航天器的模型，以及奥萨人与人类蹒跚踏入浩瀚未知的模糊影像，仍令人心潮澎湃。不知何时，你发现塞拉的手臂已经从你臂弯中滑走。你找到她时，她正凝望着一颗超巨星演化过程的全息模型。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe exhibits have rather more Akkadi branding and advertising than you’d like, but the models of early spacecraft and grainy videos of ausar and mankind’s first faltering footsteps into the great unknown are stirring. At some point, you notice that Sera’s arm has slipped out of yours. You find her gazing into a holographic model of the evolution of a supergiant star."

rows.original: “I used to be into this type of shit when I was young,” she admits, the blazing light playing over her purple face. “It’s the same with every human kid isn’t it, first dinosaurs and then... do they have one of a black hole? Yes! They do!” Her heels clack-clack-clack across the dark synth-marble floor to another holographic display. “Mmm. Reminds me of your throat a lil bit, from that angle.”
rows.translation: “我小时候曾经很喜欢这种破玩意。”她承认道，灼热的光芒掠过她紫色的脸。“每个人类小孩都一样，对不对？先喜欢恐龙，然后...这里有黑洞的模型吗？有！真的有！”她的鞋跟在黑暗的合成大理石地面上嗒、嗒、嗒地响着，走向另一座全息展台。“嗯。从那个角度看，让我有点想起你的喉咙。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I used to be into this type of shit when I was young,” she admits, the blazing light playing over her purple face. “It’s the same with every human kid isn’t it, first dinosaurs and then... do they have one of a black hole? Yes! They do!” Her heels clack-clack-clack across the dark synth-marble floor to another holographic display. “Mmm. Reminds me of your throat a lil bit, from that angle.”"

rows.original: “Come in, come iinnnnn,” oozes a roehm attendant to you outside the auditorium. “The afternoon show is just about to begin. It’s speculacious, truuuust me.”
rows.translation: “进来吧，进来吧——”观众厅外，一名罗姆接待员用黏腻的语气招呼你们。“下午场马上就要开始了。场面相当壮观，相——信我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come in, come iinnnnn,” oozes a roehm attendant to you outside the auditorium. “The afternoon show is just about to begin. It’s speculacious, truuuust me.”"

rows.original: “Do we really have to?” gripes your date, gesturing at the multi-colored assortment of chattering children being herded inside by teachers and parents.
rows.translation: “我们真的非去不可吗？”你的约会对象抱怨道，指向由老师和家长带进场内、五颜六色而又叽叽喳喳的孩子们。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do we really have to?” gripes your date, gesturing at the multi-colored assortment of chattering children being herded inside by teachers and parents."

rows.original: (You think you recognize some of the nursery staff in there. Is that YOUR little...? Oh my. You decide to keep a low profile in the theatre, otherwise you’ll be here all day.)
rows.translation: （你觉得自己认出了里面的一些育儿中心员工。那个是你的小...? 我的天。你决定在剧场里保持低调，否则今天一整天都会被耽搁在这里。）

rows.original: She pulls her necker down. Her cheeks and swollen neck are covered in lurid green spots, rising angrily from her purple skin. Is that... a cosmetic mod? If she’s covering her arms as well, then...
rows.translation: 她拉下护颈。脸颊和肿胀的脖子上覆盖着刺眼的绿色斑点，从紫色皮肤上愤怒地凸起。那是... 某种外观改造吗？如果她连手臂都遮住了，那么...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pulls her necker down. Her cheeks and swollen neck are covered in lurid green spots, rising angrily from her purple skin. Is that... a cosmetic mod? If she’s covering her arms as well, then..."

rows.original: “Took new mods,” the demon-morph growls, tail flicking fretfully. “Always test stuff ‘fore selling it, harness gets me back to me. Something I took - mebbe couple things, together - immune system reacted. Taint. Got harness, I’ll be - be fine. Couple days. Happened before.” She pauses to take a racking cough that shakes her from horn to tip. “‘M fine! Juss leeme be.”
rows.translation: “用了新的改造品，”恶魔变体低吼道，尾巴焦躁地甩动。“卖东西前总得先测试，束具会把我变回来。我用了某样东西——也许是几样一起——免疫系统起了反应。腐化。束具有了，我会——会没事的。几天就好。以前也发生过。”她停下来猛烈咳嗽，浑身从角尖一直颤到尾端。“我没事！让我一个人待着。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Took new mods,” the demon-morph growls, tail flicking fretfully. “Always test stuff ‘fore selling it, harness gets me back to me. Something I took - mebbe couple things, together - immune system reacted. Taint. Got harness, I’ll be - be fine. Couple days. Happened before.” She pauses to take a racking cough that shakes her from horn to tip. “‘M fine! Juss leeme be.”"

rows.translation: “哦，还有件事该提一下，”绍里亚继续道，“扳手是个人工生命体。他是我亲手制造的小微型机器人。我称他为人工灵魂。他一英尺高，飞行技术一流。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, and I should mention,” Shourya continues, “Spanner is an artificial lifeform. He’s a lil’ microbot I made myself. I call him an artificial soul. He’s one foot tall and flies like a champion.”"

rows.original: “A microbot?” you echo.
rows.translation: “微型机器人？”你重复道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A microbot?” you echo."

rows.original: “Yup!” she says, nodding up and down hard enough that her ears flop back and forth. “He’s cute as a button and I love him.”
rows.translation: “没错！”她说着，用力上下点头，耳朵随之前后甩动。“他可爱极了，我爱他。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yup!” she says, nodding up and down hard enough that her ears flop back and forth. “He’s cute as a button and I love him.”"

rows.original: Spanner?
rows.translation: 扳手？
rows.raw: "Spanner?"

rows.original: Who’s Spanner?
rows.translation: 扳手是谁？
rows.raw: "Who’s Spanner?"

rows.original: S.I.T.S.
rows.translation: S.I.T.S.
rows.raw: "S.I.T.S."

rows.original: “What’s SITS like?” you ask. “I see them everywhere.”
rows.translation: “SITS是什么样的？”你问。“我到处都能看见他们。”
rows.raw: "“What’s SITS like?” you ask. “I see them everywhere.”"

rows.original: “Yup, you will,” Shou says, nodding. “We’re spread across almost every planet you can name, and working on the rest. The fleet has tens of millions of vehicles, with different standardizations based on the environment, economy, and all that. I don’t even know how many employees we have, you’d have to ask Spanner, but it’s a lot.”
rows.translation: “没错，你当然会看见，”绍点头说道。“我们遍布几乎所有你能叫出名字的行星，其余地方也正在拓展。车队拥有数千万台载具，会根据环境、经济等因素采用不同标准。我甚至不知道有多少员工，得去问扳手，但数量非常庞大。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yup, you will,” Shou says, nodding. “We’re spread across almost every planet you can name, and working on the rest. The fleet has tens of millions of vehicles, with different standardizations based on the environment, economy, and all that. I don’t even know how many employees we have, you’d have to ask Spanner, but it’s a lot.”"

rows.original: “The Scout’s Authority must be pretty important, then,” you surmise.
rows.translation: “那么，侦察兵管理局一定非常重要，”你推测道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Scout’s Authority must be pretty important, then,” you surmise."

rows.original: “Oh yeah. Dealing with the UGC in general is a pain in the butt,” she says, grimacing. “At least the scouts are nice. Never run into a bad one, and I’ve met hundreds.”
rows.translation: “哦，没错。总的来说，与银河联合邦联打交道非常麻烦，”她做了个鬼脸，说道。“至少侦察兵们人不错。我从没遇过坏人，而我见过好几百个。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yeah. Dealing with the UGC in general is a pain in the butt,” she says, grimacing. “At least the scouts are nice. Never run into a bad one, and I’ve met hundreds.”"

rows.original: “They are pretty helpful, aren’t they?” you say, thinking over it. “Not often you run into a company that just wants to help.”
rows.translation: “他们确实很乐于助人，对吧？”你思索着说道。“很少能遇见一家只想帮助别人的公司。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They are pretty helpful, aren’t they?” you say, thinking over it. “Not often you run into a company that just wants to help.”"

rows.original: “A luxury afforded to them by government funding, for sure,” Shou says with a wink. “Well, not totally true. Some private companies are charitable for reasons other than tax writeoffs. Still, I like ‘em.”
rows.translation: “那当然是政府资助带来的奢侈条件，”绍眨眼说道。“好吧，也不完全正确。有些私营公司做慈善并不只是为了税务减免。不过我还是喜欢他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A luxury afforded to them by government funding, for sure,” Shou says with a wink. “Well, not totally true. Some private companies are charitable for reasons other than tax writeoffs. Still, I like ‘em.”"

rows.original: S.I.T.S.
rows.translation: S.I.T.S.
rows.raw: "S.I.T.S."

rows.translation: 向绍里亚询问她的公司。
rows.raw: "Ask Shourya about her company."

rows.original: Artificial Soul?
rows.translation: 人工灵魂？
rows.raw: "Artificial Soul?"

rows.original: “You called Spanner an artificial soul,” you say. “What does that mean?”
rows.translation: “你把扳手称作人工灵魂，”你说。“那是什么意思？”
rows.raw: "“You called Spanner an artificial soul,” you say. “What does that mean?”"

rows.original: “Weeellll, this’ll be our secret, but I trained an AI and put it in his body,” Shou says, smiling. “Not technically legal. Well, at all, really.”
rows.translation: “这——个嘛，这是我们的秘密，不过我训练了一个人工智能，把它装进他的身体，”绍微笑道。“严格来说不合法。好吧，其实完全不合法。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Weeellll, this’ll be our secret, but I trained an AI and put it in his body,” Shou says, smiling. “Not technically legal. Well, at all, really.”"

rows.original: “Not even a little bit,” you agree.
rows.translation: “一点都不合法，”你赞同道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not even a little bit,” you agree."

rows.original: You’ll have to keep news about your tauric mistress on the down-low, that’s for sure... she seems pretty capable herself, though.
rows.translation: 你肯定得对那位兽形女主人的消息保密...不过她自己似乎相当能干。
rows.raw: " You’ll have to keep news about your tauric mistress on the down-low, that’s for sure... she seems pretty capable herself, though."

rows.original: “Seems like you might have some familiarity with the topic?” Shou probes, grinning a little.
rows.translation: “看来你对这个话题也许有些了解？”绍带着一点笑容试探道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Seems like you might have some familiarity with the topic?” Shou probes, grinning a little."

rows.original: “Some,” you admit.
rows.translation: “略有了解，”你承认。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Some,” you admit."

rows.original: “Well, good. That makes us buddies,” she says with a wink, brushing her purple hair out of her face.
rows.translation: “那好。这样我们就是同伴了，”她眨眼说道，把紫色头发从脸前拨开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, good. That makes us buddies,” she says with a wink, brushing her purple hair out of her face."

rows.original: It’s common knowledge that true artificial intelligence is extremely banned in UGC space. If anyone’s going to be “exempt”, though, it’s a trillionaire.
rows.translation: 众所周知，真正的人工智能在银河联合邦联太空遭到极其严格的禁用。不过，要说有谁能得到“豁免”，那肯定是万亿富翁。
rows.raw: " It’s common knowledge that true artificial intelligence is extremely banned in UGC space. If anyone’s going to be “exempt”, though, it’s a trillionaire."

rows.original: “No wonder Spanner can handle all the work at SITS,” you say in realization. “Ha. Here was me thinking he was just particularly business-minded!”
rows.translation: “难怪扳手能处理SITS的全部工作，”你恍然大悟地说道。“哈。我之前还以为他只是特别有商业头脑！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No wonder Spanner can handle all the work at SITS,” you say in realization. “Ha. Here was me thinking he was just particularly business-minded!”"

rows.original: “Oh yeah, it’s a breeze. I don’t think any company this size could run without a few... secrets,” Shou says sagely.
rows.translation: “哦，是啊，轻而易举。我觉得这种规模的公司若没有几个...秘密，根本无法运转，”绍意味深长地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yeah, it’s a breeze. I don’t think any company this size could run without a few... secrets,” Shou says sagely."

rows.original: “Just ‘Shou’ is fine!” she says, giving you a cheery grin and flicking her oversized ears. “Now, then. I’m just about to get off work. I imagine you’ve got such important things to do so I won’t get in your way, but if you happen to catch me in a bar come say hi! Ciao!”
rows.translation: “叫我‘绍’就好！”她欢快地咧嘴一笑，甩动那对超大耳朵。“好了。我正要下班。我猜你有很多重要的事情要做，就不挡你的路了；不过如果碰巧在酒吧见到我，记得来打招呼！再见！”

rows.original: The little ausar is gone in a figurative puff of smoke and a gleaming taxi before you can reply. No doubt it’s easy to secure transportation when you’re the CEO, you muse. Maybe you’ll take her up on that offer when you’ve got some free time.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及回答，小个子奥萨尔便随着并不存在的一阵烟雾与一辆闪亮的出租车消失了。你心想，身为首席执行官，安排交通工具肯定轻而易举。等有空时，你或许会接受她的邀请。

rows.original: is conversing with what looks like a modded ausar woman. She turns to look at you with a friendly smile, her giant wolf-like ears bobbing on her head.
rows.translation: 正在与一个看起来经过改造的奥萨尔女人交谈。她转头友好地朝你微笑，脑袋上那对狼一样的巨大耳朵随之晃动。

rows.original: “Hope I’m not interrupting anything,” you say, looking between the two of them.
rows.translation: “希望我没有打扰什么，”你看看她们两人说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hope I’m not interrupting anything,” you say, looking between the two of them."

rows.original: “Nope!” the woman declares, patting the scout girl’s hand. She can’t be more than an inch over five feet tall. “I was just making sure Nessa’s ships were okay.”
rows.translation: “没有！”那个女人一边断言，一边拍了拍侦察员女孩的手。她的身高最多只比五英尺多一英寸。“我只是在确认内莎的飞船状况良好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nope!” the woman declares, patting the scout girl’s hand. She can’t be more than an inch over five feet tall. “I was just making sure Nessa’s ships were okay.”"

rows.original: “Oh, you’re a mechanic?” you ask, vaguely impressed. “Actually, I guess you’d be pretty good at fitting in an engine bay.”
rows.translation: “哦，你是机械师？”你略感钦佩地问道。“不过仔细想想，你大概确实很擅长钻进引擎舱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, you’re a mechanic?” you ask, vaguely impressed. “Actually, I guess you’d be pretty good at fitting in an engine bay.”"

rows.original: “Ha!” she says, grinning. “Mechanic by hobby, sure. Whenever I can get out of the office.”
rows.translation: “哈！”她咧嘴笑道。“机械维修是我的爱好，当然。只要我能离开办公室。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ha!” she says, grinning. “Mechanic by hobby, sure. Whenever I can get out of the office.”"

rows.original: “Not the mechanic, then,” you consider, looking her over. “Hmm.”
rows.translation: “那就不是机械师了，”你上下打量她，思索道。“嗯。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not the mechanic, then,” you consider, looking her over. “Hmm.”"

rows.original: “Keep guessing. This is fun,” she says.
rows.translation: “继续猜。这挺有意思，”她说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Keep guessing. This is fun,” she says."

rows.original: She’s got an impressive body, to say the least. The two enormous jewelry-pierced gray wolf ears meet her shock of purple hair and segue into a pretty face with two bright blue eyes full of adventure and curiosity. Her clothes leave a lot of her on show, too - her sizeable bust is just barely contained within her one-legged suit, hints of her pink areolae visible above its edges - and on top of that, her jutting nipples are pierced through.
rows.translation: 至少可以说，她的身材令人印象深刻。两只佩戴珠宝穿环的巨大灰狼耳与一头醒目紫发相接，下方是一张漂亮面孔，两只亮蓝眼睛充满冒险精神与好奇。她的衣服也暴露了大量身体，她那丰满的胸部勉强包裹在单腿连体衣中，粉色乳晕从边缘上方若隐若现，除此之外，突出的乳头还戴着穿环。

The two enormous jewelry-pierced gray wolf ears meet her shock of purple hair and segue into a pretty face with two bright blue eyes full of adventure and curiosity. Her clothes leave a lot of her on show, too - her sizeable bust is just barely contained within her one-legged suit, hints of her pink areolae visible above its edges - and on top of that, her jutting nipples are pierced through."

rows.original: A big, bushy gray tail sweeps the air behind her through a hole in the jacket, and her wide-hipped bottom half fades into two furred digitigrade legs ending in paws. Even with her leg bared, though, you find your attention returning to her generous chest. She props it up with an arm and gives you a warm smile. There’s just something about it...
rows.translation: 一条蓬松的灰色大尾巴从外套的洞中伸出，在她身后扫过空气；宽臀的下半身逐渐化作两条覆盖毛发的趾行腿，末端生有兽爪。不过即使她裸露着一条腿，你还是发现自己的注意力不断回到她丰满的胸部。她用一条胳膊托起乳房，温暖地朝你微笑。这东西就是有某种...
rows.raw: "\n\nA big, bushy gray tail sweeps the air behind her through a hole in the jacket, and her wide-hipped bottom half fades into two furred digitigrade legs ending in paws. Even with her leg bared, though, you find your attention returning to her generous chest. She props it up with an arm and gives you a warm smile. There’s just something about it..."

rows.original: “Ah,” you say in realization. “A SITS badge.”
rows.translation: “啊，”你恍然说道。“SITS徽章。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah,” you say in realization. “A SITS badge.”"

rows.original: “Yup!” she says, excited. “Shourya’s Intergalactic Transportation Service, if ya don’t know. So,” she continues, leaning back against the desk and grinning wolfishly, “who’d’you think I am?”
rows.translation: “没错！”她兴奋地说道。“绍里亚星际运输服务，如果你不知道的话。那么，”她继续说着，靠在桌边露出狼一般的笑容，“你觉得我是谁？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yup!” she says, excited. “Shourya’s Intergalactic Transportation Service, if ya don’t know. So,” she continues, leaning back against the desk and grinning wolfishly, “who’d’you think I am?”"

rows.original: “The woman in charge, I imagine,” you guess, smiling.
rows.translation: “我猜是负责人，”你微笑着猜道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The woman in charge, I imagine,” you guess, smiling."

rows.original: “Bingo!” she says, pushing off the desk and taking a step towards you before profferring her hand. “Shourya Mokuzai. Nice to meet you,
rows.translation: “答对了！”她离开桌边，朝你走近一步，伸出手。“绍里亚·莫库扎伊。很高兴认识你，

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele,” you say, squeezing her furry fingers softly and shaking her hand.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”你轻柔地握住她毛茸茸的手指，与她握手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] Steele,” you say, squeezing her furry fingers softly and shaking her hand."

rows.original: “Oh, the Steele heir?” Shourya says, lifting her eyebrows. “Didn’t know I was in the company of a fellow trillionaire! I would’ve taken more clothes off.”
rows.translation: “哦，斯蒂尔家的继承人？”绍里亚扬起眉毛。“我都不知道自己正和另一位万亿富翁作伴！早知道我会多脱几件衣服。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, the Steele heir?” Shourya says, lifting her eyebrows. “Didn’t know I was in the company of a fellow trillionaire! I would’ve taken more clothes off.”"

rows.original: “Well, you’re not - yet,” you say, smiling at her. “Long story.”
rows.translation: “嗯，现在还不是，”你朝她微笑道。“说来话长。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, you’re not - yet,” you say, smiling at her. “Long story.”"

rows.original: “You’ll have to tell me over drinks sometime,” she says with a wink. “Gotta run for now, [pc.name]. I’m doing some check-ups over the fleet. You might catch me at one of the other scout stations if we’re lucky, or back here if I need to chat to Nessa. Bye bye!”
rows.translation: “以后喝酒时你得讲给我听，”她眨眼说道。“我现在得走了，[pc.name]。我正在检查整个车队。运气好的话，你也许会在其他侦察站遇见我；如果我需要找内莎谈话，也可能会回到这里。再见！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ll have to tell me over drinks sometime,” she says with a wink. “Gotta run for now, [pc.name]. I’m doing some check-ups over the fleet. You might catch me at one of the other scout stations if we’re lucky, or back here if I need to chat to Nessa. Bye bye!”"

rows.original: You bid her farewell and watch as she prances out of the station. Turning to Nessa, you see her regarding you with a coy smile.
rows.translation: 你向她道别，看着她蹦蹦跳跳地走出空间站。转向内莎时，你发现她正含蓄地朝你微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bid her farewell and watch as she prances out of the station. Turning to Nessa, you see her regarding you with a coy smile."

rows.original: “I think she likes you,” she says, nodding at her console.
rows.translation: “我觉得她喜欢你，”她点向自己的控制台说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think she likes you,” she says, nodding at her console."

rows.translation: 每隔一会儿，就会有人滑进她对面的隔间，你也能看到双方交换信用点。这里太暗，看不清具体发生了什么，但她的顾客离开时似乎总是脸颊泛红、面带微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nEvery so often, someone slides into the booth across from her and you see credits being exchanged. It’s too dark to see what exactly transpires, but her customers always seem to leave with a flush on their cheeks and a smile."

rows.original: Feeling a bit curious, you walk up to chat to him. When you get close, his brown canine ears perk and he looks up with a brilliant smile. His sandy tail is swishing back and forth.
rows.translation: 你有些好奇，于是走上前与他交谈。靠近后，他棕色的犬耳竖了起来，抬头朝你露出灿烂笑容。沙色尾巴正在来回摆动。
rows.raw: "Feeling a bit curious, you walk up to chat to him. When you get close, his brown canine ears perk and he looks up with a brilliant smile. His sandy tail is swishing back and forth."

rows.original: “Hi there, Captain Steele! Nice ship you’ve got here,” the technician cheerfully tells you. He stretches out a hand and you shake it. “I’m Vahn, one of the ground crew assigned to your ship.”
rows.translation: “你好，斯蒂尔船长！你的船真不错。”技术员欢快地对你说。他伸出一只手，你与他握了握。“我是万恩，负责你这艘船的地勤人员之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hi there, Captain Steele! Nice ship you’ve got here,” the technician cheerfully tells you. He stretches out a hand and you shake it. “I’m Vahn, one of the ground crew assigned to your ship.”"

rows.original: You’ve never heard anyone call your ship ‘nice’. Really, it’s an old clunker. You ask him why he thinks it’s so amazing.
rows.translation: 你从没听人说过自己的船“不错”。说真的，它就是一堆破铜烂铁。你问他为什么觉得这艘船如此了不起。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve never heard anyone call your ship ‘nice’. Really, it’s an old clunker. You ask him why he thinks it’s so amazing."

rows.original: “W-well, I guess it’s not from a pilot’s perspective. But for me, your old Casstech Z14 is like a big puzzlebox, always breaking down and a real brain-teaser to fix. Pretty obvious why I became a mechanic, right? It’s really challenging to keep your old clunker going. Sometimes it even stumps the boss, and that’s saying something!”
rows.translation: “这、这个嘛，从驾驶员的角度来看，我猜它确实不算好。不过对我而言，你那艘老卡斯科技Z14号就像一个巨大的谜盒，总是发生故障，修理起来也真正考验脑力。现在很明显我为什么会成为机械师了，对吧？要让你这堆老破烂继续运转，真的很有挑战性。有时连老板都会被难住，那可很能说明问题！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well, I guess it’s not from a pilot’s perspective. But for me, your old Casstech Z14 is like a big puzzlebox, always breaking down and a real brain-teaser to fix. Pretty obvious why I became a mechanic, right? It’s really challenging to keep your old clunker going. Sometimes it even stumps the boss, and that’s saying something!”"

rows.original: He deactivates and tucks the pad away, turning his full attention to you. “...So, was there something you want, or just checking up on your ship? Don’t worry, the repair costs are footed by Steele Industries - anything extra, though, and we’d have to charge.”
rows.translation: 他关闭平板，把它收好，将全部注意力转向你。“...那么，你有什么需要，还是只是来查看飞船状况？别担心，维修费用由斯蒂尔工业承担，不过任何额外项目就得收费了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe deactivates and tucks the pad away, turning his full attention to you. “...So, was there something you want, or just checking up on your ship? Don’t worry, the repair costs are footed by Steele Industries - anything extra, though, and we’d have to charge.”"

rows.translation: “没有一艘顶尖飞船，就连最伟大的行星开拓者也只能困在停泊港里无聊地摆弄手指。这和你现在做的事也没多大区别，对吧？”他调笑地眨眨眼，蓬松尾巴来回摆动。“...你的引擎、护盾、火炮、生命维持系统...全都倾注了我的汗水和努力。很酷吧？”

rows.original: “My hobbies? Every time I try to talk to the Tavros recruiters they look like they’re gonna piss themselves. Of course she got to them first,” she ends morosely. “So yeah, I’m studying to be a scientist. Hey, it’s a good living and a good job! I’ll be making credits hand over fist, even if it’s not what I wanted to do at first.” she says, sounding like she’s trying to convince herself more than anyone else."

The storm that wipes out the pathetic little thing you call your life. You’re fucking dead, kid. I can be anywhere, anytime, and I can kill you in over seven hundred ways, and that’s just with my bare hands. Not only am I extensively trained in unarmed combat, but I have access to the entire arsenal of the United Galactic Confederacy and I will use it to its full extent to wipe your miserable ass off the face of the continent, you little shit. If only you could have known what unholy retribution your little “clever” comment was about to bring down upon you, maybe you would have held your fucking tongue. But you couldn’t, you didn’t, and now you’re paying the price, you goddamn idiot. I will shit fury all over you and you will drown in it. You’re fucking dead, kiddo,”

rows.original: Unfortunately, not drawing attention to the two of you isn’t one of her talents. Numerous busybodies are shaking their heads disapprovingly at you, taking the cute brown girl’s side without having any idea what’s going on. You’re innocent! ...but not in the court of opinion. Finally, you manage to quiet the childish college student, but not before an elderly Ausar woman with her gray ears pinned back against her skull berates you for ‘playing games with lovely young women’s hearts’, leaving the jogging teen smug as can be as the crone hobbles off, leaning heavily on her cane and ranting about how cruel young folk can be.
rows.translation: 遗憾的是，不引起他人注意并非她的强项。许多爱管闲事的人不赞同地朝你摇头，完全不清楚发生了什么，就站在那个可爱的棕肤女孩一边。你是无辜的！...但舆论法庭并不这么认为。你终于设法让这个幼稚的大学生安静下来，但在此之前，一位灰色耳朵紧贴头骨的年迈奥萨女人还因你“玩弄可爱年轻女人的感情”而训斥了你一顿；老妇人拄着拐杖蹒跚离去，一边抱怨年轻人有多残忍，留下那个慢跑少女得意至极。

rows.original: ou ask what her family is like, prompting a pleased little ‘hmm’ from the girl. “They’re pretty nice. There’s me, my mom and dad, and I have two sisters and two brothers. My dad is from Latvia, and my mom is from India - mom was a cop back when they met. She said she pulled my dad and his buddies over for speeding while he was on vacation in India with his friends, and that’s how they met; she loves telling that story. She says he got out of the backseat, looked her dead in the face, and said ‘I’m not as think as you drunk I am, officer.’” she says, giggling uncontrollably as she recounts the story. “And then she said he threw up all over her boots!”
rows.translation: 问她的家庭是什么样子，让女孩满意地轻哼一声“嗯”。“他们都很好。有我、爸爸妈妈，还有两个姐妹和两个兄弟。我爸爸来自拉脱维亚，妈妈来自印度 - 他们相识时，妈妈还是警察。她说爸爸和朋友在印度度假时，她因为他们超速把车拦了下来，他们就是这样认识的；她最爱讲这个故事。她说他从后座下来，直勾勾看着她的脸，说：‘警官，我可没醉得像你想的那么醉。’”她一边讲述，一边无法控制地咯咯笑。“然后她说，他吐得她靴子上到处都是！”

rows.original: ; stopping her jumping jacks, she starts into another round of stretches, huffing and puffing as the sheen of sweat she’s picked up from her exercise becoming obvious now that she’s taking a break. She pulls her canteen from her waist, taking a few small gulps from it before continuing. She must be pretty serious about her workout routine - you don’t know how long she’s been out here, but she looks pretty tired and she’s still plugging away! And well, if you even needed any more proof of her dedication, you might just look at those washboard abs, glistening with sweat. Hot chocolate, goddamn... Swallowing hard, you force yourself to pay attention to what she’s saying.

The Dzaan I mean,” Ophelia asks. “She’s alive, in Gastigoth.” You’re honestly surprised that she spared her, you didn’t take her for the merciful kind. Ophelia seems to think the same and actually voices the question of why she spared her. “I... I don’t know, Maybe I meant to use her as a hostage, or maybe I wasn’t thinking clearly, but I dragged her back to the ships. It turned out to be a good decision too, as they weren’t too keen on blowing up the person paying their bills. I don’t remember what happened after the take-off, since I passed out shortly after.” “Well, we’re glad you’re safe,” Ophelia says, patting the hyena mercenary on the shoulder. Before you can say anything, the doctor steps inside and ushers you out, telling you that you can come back later. Ophelia accompanies you down to the ship. She waves you goodbyes as the ship takes off. "
