rows.original: Just like last time, you have no trouble getting aboard the merc ship. And once again Ophelia is waiting for you in the hangar. Walking behind her, you ask why she was waiting for you. “Don’t take it personally, it’s just that all civilians need to be escorted, so they don’t wander anywhere they shouldn’t be.” Fair enough. The elevator doors dings open as you arrive at the medical deck. The nurse at the desk greets you and tells you two that Verusha should be recovering from another surgery any time now, and you can wait in the room. It’s silent except for the steady beeping of the heartbeat monitor, and Verusha’s breathing. Sitting there, you doze off for a few minutes, but when Verusha wakes up with a groan you’re shaken from your dazed state. “Verusha, are you ok?” you ask, as you walk next to the bed. “Yeah, just a bit drowsy from the anesthetics. Could you get me some water?” she asks, rather politely, to your mild surprise. You step outside the room and get her a cup of water. As you return, she finishes reattaching her leg. “Thanks,” Verusha says, as you hand it to her. She empties it and looks at you. “Oh, and [pc.name], I’ve been meaning to talk to you.” Behind you, Ophelia makes a stealthy exit, giving the two of your privacy. “I’ve been thinking about this for a while, before the botched job. I-” before she can finish her sentence, she gasps for breath. Her heart starts beating faster and faster. Clearly something is wrong, so you rush out of the room and tell the first person you see that something’s wrong with Verusha. You, Ophelia, the doctor, and a couple of nurses rush back into Verusha’s room. Her heart is still beating very fast, her muscles are tensing, and her pupils are dilated. As the doctor moves closer to try to figure out what’s wrong, she suddenly springs to life, throwing the doctor across the room. One nurse runs for help while the other tries to calm the frenzied woman. [pc.reflexesRange 80 |You manage to duck out of the way of the flying woman. Standing up, Verusha grabs you by the neck and lifts you in the air. |You’re knocked on your ass as the nurse hits you. Pushing her off of you, you stand up, only for Verusha to grab you and lift you in the air. [pc.physiqueRange 80 |You manage to pry her hands off of you. Struggling against her, she recognizes you. |You try to pull her hands off of your neck, but she’s too strong. You’re starting to black out, but before you pass out, she loosens the grip on you. ] ] “Steele?” she asks, sounding confused. Suddenly Ophelia tackles her, and before she can beat her back, the doctor sticks a needle in her arm, putting her to sleep. “Wha- what the hell was that!?” Ophelia pants. “I have no idea,” the doctor responds. She grabs Verusha by the knees and Ophelia grabs her by the shoulders, and they lift her onto the bed. She takes a needle out of her pocket and draws some blood from her arm. “You should get out of here,” she says to you. “We’ll need to keep her sedated until we figure out why she went berserk.” “Come on, let’s go,” Ophelia says reassuringly as she leads you back to the hangar. “She’ll be fine, our medics have always pulled through in the end.” You can’t help but to worry about her. You’re sure she’ll be fine, but still.
rows.translation: 和上次一样，你毫不费力地登上了佣兵船。奥菲莉娅也再次在机库里等着你。你跟在她身后，询问她为什么要等你。 “别往心里去，只是所有平民都必须有人陪同，免得他们闯进不该去的地方。” 这倒也合情合理。 抵达医疗甲板时，电梯门叮的一声打开。值班台后的护士向你们问好，并告诉你们，维露莎应该随时会从又一次手术中恢复过来，你们可以在病房里等候。 房间里一片寂静，只有心率监护仪稳定的哔哔声，以及维露莎的呼吸声。坐在那里时，你打了几分钟瞌睡；但维露莎呻吟着醒来后，你也从恍惚状态中惊醒。 “维露莎，你还好吗？”你走到床边问道。 “没事，只是麻醉药让我还有点昏沉。能帮我拿点水吗？”她颇为礼貌地问道，令你略感意外。你走出病房，给她取来一杯水。等你回来时，她刚好把腿重新接好。“谢谢，”维露莎接过你递来的水时说道。她一饮而尽，随后望向你。“哦，对了，[pc.name]，我一直想和你谈谈。”你身后的奥菲莉娅悄然离开，给你们两人留出私密空间。“这件事我已经想了一阵子了，在那次搞砸的任务之前就一直在想。我——”她还没说完，便猛然喘不过气来。她的心跳开始越来越快。显然出了问题，于是你冲出病房，告诉遇见的第一个人维露莎情况不对。你、奥菲莉娅、医生和几名护士一同冲回维露莎的病房。她的心脏仍跳得飞快，肌肉紧绷，瞳孔也已经放大。 医生靠近，试图弄清出了什么问题，她却突然暴起，把医生扔到了房间另一头。一名护士跑出去求援，另一名则试图安抚这个陷入狂乱的女人。[pc.reflexesRange 80 |你成功低头躲开飞来的女人。维露莎站起身，一把掐住你的脖子，将你举到空中。 |护士撞上你，把你撞得一屁股坐倒在地。你推开压在身上的护士站起来，却立刻被维露莎抓住，举到空中。[pc.physiqueRange 80 |你成功掰开她的双手。你与她奋力对抗，她终于认出了你。 |你试图把她的双手从脖子上拉开，但她的力气太大了。你的意识开始发黑，不过就在彻底昏迷之前，她放松了对你的钳制。 ] ] “斯蒂尔？”她困惑地问道。奥菲莉娅突然扑倒她；还没等她反击，医生便把针扎进她的手臂，令她陷入沉睡。 “什——刚才到底是怎么回事！？”奥菲莉娅喘息道。 “我也毫无头绪，”医生回答。她抓住维露莎的膝盖，奥菲莉娅则抬住她的肩膀，两人一起把她放到床上。医生从口袋里取出一根针，从她手臂抽取了一些血液。“你应该离开这里，”她对你说道。“在查明她为什么发狂之前，我们需要让她一直保持镇静状态。” “来吧，我们走，”奥菲莉娅安慰着说道，把你带回机库。“她会没事的，我们的医护人员最后总能解决问题。” 你还是忍不住担心她。你相信她会没事，可心中依然难以释怀。

rows.original: Approaching the ship, you buzz on the intercom. After a while, a voice responds. “This is the captain of the Mercs-4-More transport ship echo. State your business.” “I’m [pc.name] Steele, here to visit Verusha,” you respond. “Please wait while I confirm with the brass.” After a few minutes, the radio buzzes with life again. “Alright, come aboard.” The door slides open and you step inside. “It’ll be a couple of hours until the guys get back with the supplies, so I’ll drop you off immediately,” the captain says over the intercom. You strap in as the engines come to life and the ship takes off. After a surprisingly short time the ship lands, and as you exit it you see that you’re now in a hangar with multiple ships bearing the same symbol. “Hey, Steele.” someone yells at you. Turning to look at the person calling your name, you see a dark-skinned gryvain. It takes you a good while to recognize her, but eventually you realize that she’s the mercenary you met on Tarkus when Verusha was taking you back to your ship. You wave back at her and step off the ship ramp. “Are you here to see Verusha?” she asks. “What else would I be here for?” you respond. “You never know. Come on, I’ll show you to the medical center,” she says with a little wave as she turns around. “Any improvements? Is she doing better?” you ask her as you exit the hangar and start walking down the corridor. “No, she’s still out cold, the docs are doing their best. They’ve pumped her full of anti-venoms and healing boosters. Now they’re waiting for her to recover enough to do more surgery.” she says in a flat tone of voice, but you detect a hint of worry in her voice. “So what exactly happened?” “Don’t know the details. I wasn’t in the team that was sent for the job,” she says as you two enter an elevator. “The reports are still classified and being reviewed.” The rest of the elevator ride is completely silent. You have to admit that you’re a bit worried. You know that Verusha is tough and has been through the wringer before, but this is the first time hearing that she’s out cold. Your thoughts are cut short when the elevator stops moving and the doors slide open. Stepping out of the elevator, you see that you’re in a lobby. “Hello, Ophelia,” the woman at the front desk greets you. “Hi, we’re here to see Verusha.” “She’s yet to recover consciousness, but if you’re sure, then go on ahead.” Ophelia leads you down one last corridor and to the room with Verusha. Your throat dries as you see Verusha laying there, unconscious, hooked up to machines and tubes. From the contour of the thin cloth covering her, you can see that her cybernetics have been removed. It really is a heart-wrenching sight. “She’ll be fine,” Ophelia assures you while placing a comforting hand on your shoulder. After a while, a doctor opens the door and informs you two that it’s time to leave as they need to perform more surgery on her. “Hey, Steele, don’t worry about her. It’ll take time, but she’ll be back up eventually,” Ophelia reassures you as the two of you make your way back to the hangar. “I’ll message you once her status improves,” she promises as you enter one of the transport ships.
rows.translation: 你走近飞船，按响对讲机。过了一会儿，一个声音作出回应。“这里是‘佣兵多多’回声号运输船的舰长。说明来意。” “我是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，来探望维露莎，”你回答道。 “请稍等，我需要向上级确认。”几分钟后，无线电再次响了起来。“好了，上船吧。”舱门滑开，你迈步进入。“弟兄们还要几小时才能带着补给回来，所以我会立刻送你过去，”舰长通过对讲机说道。引擎启动，飞船起飞，你也把自己固定在座位上。 出乎意料的是，飞船没过多久便降落了。走出舱门时，你发现自己置身一座机库，周围停着多艘带有相同标志的飞船。“嘿，斯蒂尔。”有人朝你喊道。你转身望向那个呼唤自己名字的人，看见一名深色皮肤的格莱维因。你花了好一会儿才认出她，但最终还是想起来了：当维露莎在塔库斯护送你返回飞船时，你曾见过这名佣兵。 你朝她挥挥手，走下飞船舷梯。“你是来看维露莎的吗？”她问道。 “不然我还能为什么来这里？”你回答道。 “谁知道呢。来吧，我带你去医疗中心，”她说着轻轻挥手，转过身去。 “有好转吗？她情况怎么样了？”你和她离开机库，开始沿走廊前进时问道。 “没有，她仍然昏迷不醒，医生正在尽最大努力。他们给她注射了大量抗毒剂和治疗强化剂，现在正等她恢复到足以接受更多手术的程度。”她的语调平淡，但你还是从声音里听出一丝担忧。 “所以究竟发生了什么？” “具体情况不清楚。我不在被派去执行任务的那支队伍里，”你们二人走进电梯时，她说道。“报告仍处于保密状态，也还在审核。”接下来的电梯行程完全寂静无声。你不得不承认，自己有些担心。你知道维露莎非常强悍，也曾经历过不少磨难，但这是你第一次听说她陷入昏迷。 电梯停下、舱门滑开时，你的思绪被打断了。走出电梯，你发现自己来到一间大厅。“你好，奥菲莉娅，”前台的女人向你们打招呼。 “你好，我们是来看维露莎的。” “她还没有恢复意识，不过如果你们确定要看，那就进去吧。” 奥菲莉娅带你走过最后一条走廊，来到维露莎所在的病房。看见维露莎昏迷不醒地躺在那里，身上连接着各种机器和管线，你的喉咙顿时变得干涩。从覆盖她身体的薄布轮廓可以看出，她的义体已经被拆除了。这幅景象实在令人心碎。 “她会没事的，”奥菲莉娅安慰道，同时把一只手放在你的肩膀上。过了一会儿，一名医生打开房门，通知你们该离开了，因为他们需要对她进行更多手术。 “嘿，斯蒂尔，别担心她。虽然需要一些时间，但她最终一定会恢复过来，”你们一同返回机库时，奥菲莉娅安慰道。“她的状况一有好转，我就给你发消息，”她在你走进其中一艘运输船时承诺道。

rows.original: Standing outside the apartment, you can hear music coming through the door. Either Verusha’s having a party, or you have the wrong address. You knock on the door and wait for someone to open it. Verusha opens the door. She’s wearing the same pants as always, but she has put on a very short tank top, leaving her midriff and the underside of her breasts bare. “Steele! Come in,” she says, pulling you into a crushing hug, pressing your [pc.face] into her tits. She drags you inside the apartment. “We’re having a housewarming party,” she tells you. Looking around the apartment, you see plenty of people who must be her workmates. “So, what’s with the apartment and all?” “I’m retiring, so I need somewhere to live. While I was still working with Mercs-4-More, I had room aboard their ship, but not anymore.” “You quit? Why?” “Eh, this isn’t the time to talk about something like that. Come, drink, and have fun.” You’re not sure how you ended up with a drink in your hand. But you do. You get the feeling if you’re going to stay, you’ll end up wasted.
rows.translation: 站在公寓外面，你能听见音乐声从门后传来。要么是维露莎正在举办派对，要么就是你找错了地址。你敲响房门，等待有人开门。维露莎打开了门。她穿着和平时一样的裤子，但上身换了一件极短的背心，露出腰腹和乳房下缘。 “斯蒂尔！快进来，”她说着用力将你拥入怀中，把你的[pc.face]压进乳房。她把你拖进公寓。“我们正在办乔迁派对，”她告诉你。环顾公寓，你看见许多人，想必都是她的同事。 “所以，这套公寓究竟是怎么回事？” “我要退休了，所以需要一个住处。还在为佣兵多多工作时，我在他们的飞船上有自己的房间，但现在没有了。” “你辞职了？为什么？” “呃，现在不适合谈这种事。来吧，喝酒，好好玩。” 你也不知道手里怎么就多出了一杯酒。反正它现在就在手里。你有种感觉，如果继续留下来，最后肯定会喝得烂醉。

rows.original: Wistral is way out on the frontier, a red giant which glowers a vast, weary welcome to you as you emerge in its system. No living creature has ever looked up from its complement of planets and moons and called it home - but the small fleet of ships hanging over Planet No. 5 is looking to change that. You have to assume the conditions there must be almost right, or there is something very precious down on that brown, hazy surface, to make it worth those arrays of solar mirrors and cloud seeders that you can see on your monitors. Terraforming is not cheap.
rows.translation: 维斯特拉尔远在边疆深处，是一颗红巨星；当你驶入星系时，它投来一片广阔、疲惫而阴沉的欢迎红光。从未有任何生物仰望它所拥有的行星与卫星，并将这里称为家园；但悬停在第五号行星上方的小型舰队正试图改变这一点。要让监视器上那些太阳反射镜阵列和人工降雨设备物有所值，你只能猜测那里的环境几乎已经合适，或者那片棕褐朦胧的地表上藏着某种极其珍贵的东西。行星改造可不便宜。

No living creature has ever looked up from its complement of planets and moons and called it home - but the small fleet of ships hanging over Planet No. 5 is looking to change that. You have to assume the conditions there must be almost right, or there is something very precious down on that brown, hazy surface, to make it worth those arrays of solar mirrors and cloud seeders that you can see on your monitors. Terraforming is not cheap."

rows.original: Breedwell Incubation Centre, meanwhile, is in orbit around the nearest gas giant. It’s a large, white space station, stamped with a purple Tamani logo half a mile tall. It has two ports that you can see; the one with NEW ARRIVALS in glowing letters above it is busy with small, oblong carriers coming and going from the warp gate. As you draw your craft closer, that sign blinks out and the word DONORS blinks into being above the less busy entrance. Clear enough.
rows.translation: 与此同时，繁育孵化中心正环绕最近的气态巨行星运行。那是一座大型白色空间站，外壳印着足有半英里高的紫色塔玛妮标志。你能看见两个港口；其中一个上方用发光字样写着“新到访者”，许多往返跃迁门的小型长椭圆运输船令那里格外繁忙。你的飞船逐渐靠近时，那块标牌熄灭，较为空闲的入口上方则闪现出“捐献者”一词。意思够清楚了。

rows.original: “Hello, and welcome to Breedwell!” she trills. “Thank you so much for traveling out here to lend yourself to the great effort! If you just head up to reception that way and say hi to Quaelle at the desk, she’ll sort you out with where you need to go, and any questions you might have. Um, word of warning though - I’d loosen your clothing a lil’ bit before entering reception. Ok bye now!” She hurries off to another passenger ship that’s just landed.

rows.original: The roehm matron of Breedwell Incubation Centre is about 9' 10" from conch-hatted head to blunt-tipped tail, but half of that is horizontal. With its soft, moist epidermis and brilliant orange spots, her great, thick, yellow, lozenge of a lower body is reminiscent of nothing so much as the body of a giant sea slug. When she moves she does so with a kind of glacial grace, slowly undulating to where she needs to be, abetted by a thin trail of slime which quickly dries behind her, more like sweat than mucus. rows.original: “The logic behind it is straightforward and monoceptive really, Steele,” says Quaelle, pushing her charms further up her wide arms. “The rahn are fairly new arrivals on the galactic scene. rows.translation: “这背后的逻辑其实很简单，也很单一，斯蒂尔，”奎尔一边说，一边把饰物往宽阔的手臂上方推了推。“拉恩进入银河舞台的时间相当短。他们直到上一次银河开拓潮才被发现，而且当时还处于相当原始的发展阶段。

rows.original: Sooooo, they’ve been working hard at catching up, now that they’re full members of the U.G.C. But no matter how hard you work your cute jelly tush, you’re never going to have the same sort of influence in the U.G.C. as humans and ausar do. Demographics, finances, vested interests: they are all stacked against you. Galactic rushes present an opportunity to the rahn and other such, emmm, minor races. For everyone to stop calling them minor.”
rows.translation: 所以呢，如今他们已经成为银河联合邦联的正式成员，一直在努力追赶其他种族。但无论你多么拼命地摆动自己可爱的果冻屁股，也永远不可能在银河联合邦联中拥有与人类和奥萨同等的影响力。人口结构、财力、既得利益，一切条件都对你不利。银河开拓潮为拉恩以及其他此类，嗯，所谓的次要种族带来了机会。让所有人不再称他们为次要种族。”

For everyone to stop calling them minor.”"

rows.original: She pauses and pulls some leaves off the nearest vine, transferring them to her mouth. You’re left watching, and eventually fiddling with your codex, as the roehm placidly munches on them, politely swallowing before continuing.

rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses and pulls some leaves off the nearest vine, transferring them to her mouth. You’re left watching, and eventually fiddling with your codex, as the roehm placidly munches on them, politely swallowing before continuing."

rows.original: “Sorry, judderific Steele. These little chats are also my lunch breaks. And I need lots of those. What were we talking about? Oh yes!” She claps. “Fluctulicious rahn, and why we’re helping them make more of them. As if we really need a reason!”
rows.translation: “抱歉，令人震颤的斯蒂尔。这些闲聊时间也是我的午休时间。而且我需要很多次午休。我们刚才说到哪里了？哦，对！”她拍了拍手。“摇曳可口的拉恩，以及我们为什么要帮助他们生出更多同胞。好像我们真的需要理由一样！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, judderific Steele. These little chats are also my lunch breaks. And I need lots of those. What were we talking about? Oh yes!” She claps. “Fluctulicious rahn, and why we’re helping them make more of them. As if we really need a reason!”"

rows.original: “But, yes. The more planets and sectors you control, the more representatives you can have in the Galactic Senate. But gaining planets and sectors is not easy, emmmm, until a Frontier Rush comes along. The rahn have been gearing up for this for decades. Stockpiling credits, picking out livable and terraformable planets that will be linked to warp gates that they intend to swamp with colonists. The lil’ brown rock you saw coming in, that’s just one of a dozen. We’re sending rahn kids to care centres all over the frontier!”
rows.translation: “不过，是的。控制的行星和星区越多，在银河议会中能够拥有的代表也就越多。然而取得行星和星区可不容易，嗯，除非恰逢边疆开拓潮。拉恩已经为此准备了几十年。他们囤积信用点，挑选那些适宜居住、可以地貌改造，而且将与曲速门相连的行星，打算以殖民者将其淹没。你进来时看到的那颗棕色小岩球，只不过是十几颗行星中的一颗。我们正把拉恩孩子送往遍布边疆的照护中心！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But, yes. The more planets and sectors you control, the more representatives you can have in the Galactic Senate. But gaining planets and sectors is not easy, emmmm, until a Frontier Rush comes along. The rahn have been gearing up for this for decades. Stockpiling credits, picking out livable and terraformable planets that will be linked to warp gates that they intend to swamp with colonists. The lil’ brown rock you saw coming in, that’s just one of a dozen. We’re sending rahn kids to care centres all over the frontier!”"

rows.original: “So this is an artificial baby boom?” you say wonderingly. “Hundreds of rahn being brought into this world, purely for political purposes?”
rows.translation: “所以这是一场人为制造的婴儿潮？”你惊讶地说道。“数以百计的拉恩被带到这个世界上，纯粹是为了政治目的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So this is an artificial baby boom?” you say wonderingly. “Hundreds of rahn being brought into this world, purely for political purposes?”"

rows.original: “Just because it has a political purpose doesn’t make it wrong, throbbose Steele,” replies Quaelle placidly. “Having little Senatorial representation means being exploited or outright owned by one of the major corporations, or vassalized by one of the more established and aggressive races. The rahn wish not to be so much at the mercy of others anymore. They have had three centuries sampling what that is like. Rahn born now will be proud of what they did for their people, just by existing.”
rows.translation: “仅仅因为具有政治目的，并不意味着这件事就是错的，悸动不已的斯蒂尔，”奎尔平静地回答。“议会代表人数太少，就意味着遭到某家大型企业剥削，甚至彻底占有，又或者沦为某个更加成熟且咄咄逼人的种族的附庸。拉恩不愿再如此任人摆布。他们已经花了三个世纪体会那是什么滋味。如今出生的拉恩会为自己仅凭存在便替人民作出的贡献而骄傲。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just because it has a political purpose doesn’t make it wrong, throbbose Steele,” replies Quaelle placidly. “Having little Senatorial representation means being exploited or outright owned by one of the major corporations, or vassalized by one of the more established and aggressive races. The rahn wish not to be so much at the mercy of others anymore. They have had three centuries sampling what that is like. Rahn born now will be proud of what they did for their people, just by existing.”"

rows.original: She folds some more leaves into her mouth. You get the impression that Quaelle has perhaps more to say on this subject, but she’s done talking about it for now. There’s a very purposeful air to her munching.
rows.translation: 她又把几片叶子叠起来塞进嘴里。你觉得奎尔对这个话题或许还有更多话想说，但她现在已经谈完了。她咀嚼叶片的模样显得格外刻意。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe folds some more leaves into her mouth. You get the impression that Quaelle has perhaps more to say on this subject, but she’s done talking about it for now. There’s a very purposeful air to her munching."

rows.original: “You’ve never met any roehm before?” Quaelle grins widely. “Perhaps that is not so surprising. We need warm, wet environments to be comfortable. Such as--” She opens her arms to the sweltering haze of the room you’re in. “Otherwise we start shrivelling up. On our first trip out from Hdar-Roe, me and my friends went without our climate suits into a human/ausar starport, just to see what it was like. Ugh! Never again. I do not know how you febrilicious, erratisome creatures stand the dryness. Your skin must be so numb and deadened to taste and smell. It is very mellible to think of it.”
rows.translation: “你以前从未见过罗姆？”奎尔咧嘴大笑。“或许这也不奇怪。我们需要温暖湿润的环境才能感到舒适。比如--”她张开双臂，展示你所在房间闷热的雾气。“否则我们就会开始干瘪。第一次离开赫达-罗时，我和朋友们为了体验一下，在没有穿气候服的情况下走进了一座人类与奥萨共用的星港。呃！绝不会有下一次。我真不知道你们这些热烈可口、躁动不休的生物是怎么忍受这种干燥的。你们的皮肤对味道和气味一定已经麻木迟钝。想想就令人软绵绵地难受。”
rows.raw: "“You’ve never met any roehm before?” Quaelle grins widely. “Perhaps that is not so surprising. We need warm, wet environments to be comfortable. Such as--” She opens her arms to the sweltering haze of the room you’re in. “Otherwise we start shrivelling up. On our first trip out from Hdar-Roe, me and my friends went without our climate suits into a human/ausar starport, just to see what it was like. Ugh! Never again. I do not know how you febrilicious, erratisome creatures stand the dryness. Your skin must be so numb and deadened to taste and smell. It is very mellible to think of it.”"

rows.original: She pauses a moment to pluck some leaves off a nearby vine, and munches on them with obvious enjoyment. One thing you definitely are learning about the roehm is that you’re going to have to be patient if you’re going to spend time around them.
rows.translation: 她停顿片刻，从附近一根藤蔓上摘下几片叶子，显然吃得津津有味。关于罗姆，你现在至少切实地明白了一件事：如果想和他们相处，就必须拥有耐心。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses a moment to pluck some leaves off a nearby vine, and munches on them with obvious enjoyment. One thing you definitely are learning about the roehm is that you’re going to have to be patient if you’re going to spend time around them."

rows.original: “So then! Us,” Quaelle says, once she’s politely swallowed away her cud. “Emmm, one of the really important differences between us and most other people is that we have no ears.” She lifts her conch-like hat to reveal she’s bald, her smooth, yellow skin unbroken all the way around her scalp and down to her neck. “We have these instead!” She replaces her hat and strokes her six blue-tipped antennae with an exaggerated sweep. “And they’re just as good!” This is receiving a lesson on basic anatomy from a kindergarten teacher. Although perhaps a kindergarten teacher wouldn’t have huffed with such obvious sensual enjoyment when she touched her wiggling cilia like that.
rows.translation: “那么！该说我们了，”奎尔礼貌地咽下反刍物以后说道。“嗯，我们与大多数其他人之间有一项十分重要的差异，那就是我们没有耳朵。”她掀起海螺般的帽子，露出光秃秃的脑袋。光滑的黄色皮肤完好无损地环绕整个头皮，一直延伸到颈部。“我们有的是这些！”她重新戴好帽子，以夸张的大幅动作抚过六根蓝色尖端的触角。“而且它们同样好用！”这简直像在听幼儿园老师讲授基础解剖课。不过，幼儿园老师抚摸自己不断扭动的纤毛时，大概不会如此明显地沉醉其中，发出享受的喘息。

Although perhaps a kindergarten teacher wouldn’t have huffed with such obvious sensual enjoyment when she touched her wiggling cilia like that."

rows.original: “The difference comes across in our translation chips,” she goes on. “When you describe hearing something, what I must sound like to you, I only have a partial understanding of what that must be like... so the words come out garbled, the Babelware doing its best to translate what you’re trying to express.” She laughs. It’s a series of giggly “hmms”, one every two seconds. “It’s so funny sometimes! So vivicious and fluctacular!”
rows.translation: “这种差异也会体现在我们的翻译芯片上，”她继续说道。“当你描述自己听见某样东西时，也就是在说我在你听来是什么样，我只能部分理解那究竟是一种怎样的体验...因此翻译出来的词句会变得混乱，而巴别翻译软件只能竭力转译你试图表达的意思。”她笑了起来。那是一连串咯咯作响的“嗯”声，每两秒响起一次。“有时候实在太有趣了！又鲜活又波动壮观！”

It’s a series of giggly “hmms”, one every two seconds. “It’s so funny sometimes! So vivicious and fluctacular!”"

rows.original: “If you don’t mind me asking - is it not frustrating, moving so much slower than everyone else?”
rows.translation: “如果你不介意我这么问，行动速度比所有人都慢这么多，难道不会令人沮丧吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you don’t mind me asking - is it not frustrating, moving so much slower than everyone else?”"

rows.original: “You’re so slow, though!” you teasingly exclaim, enjoying being able to cut loose and laugh at one other, strange aliens that you are. “How annoying that must be!”
rows.translation: “但你实在太慢了！”你戏谑地惊呼道。身为两个古怪的外星人，你们可以放松下来互相取笑，这令你十分享受。“那肯定烦死人了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re so slow, though!” you teasingly exclaim, enjoying being able to cut loose and laugh at one other, strange aliens that you are. “How annoying that must be!”"

rows.original: “I don’t think I’d be able to stand moving as slow as you do,” you remark.
rows.translation: “我觉得自己肯定受不了像你这么慢地移动，”你评论道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t think I’d be able to stand moving as slow as you do,” you remark."

rows.original: Quaelle shrugs, a great ripple of soft flesh, her bust quivering slightly.
rows.translation: 奎尔耸了耸肩，一身柔软的肉随之泛起巨大的波浪，胸脯也微微颤动。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuaelle shrugs, a great ripple of soft flesh, her bust quivering slightly."

rows.original: “It’s a matter of perspective,” she replies, still gazing at you with her apparently imperturbable air of condescending kindness. “We live for hundreds upon hundreds of years naturally, and always aim to be in the most pleasant of places and occupations. There is time enough for everything. Whereas you...” She sighs. “If you do not mind me saying, shiverous Steele, we find you dry and fleet things rather tragic.”
rows.translation: “这要看你从什么角度看，”她答道，依旧用那种似乎永远不会动摇、居高临下却又和善的神情注视着你。“我们天生就能活上几百年，而且总是力求置身于最惬意的地方，从事最舒心的工作。凡事都有充足的时间。至于你们...”她叹了口气。“如果你不介意我这么说，颤巍巍的斯蒂尔，我们觉得你们这些干巴巴又匆匆忙忙的生物实在有些可悲。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a matter of perspective,” she replies, still gazing at you with her apparently imperturbable air of condescending kindness. “We live for hundreds upon hundreds of years naturally, and always aim to be in the most pleasant of places and occupations. There is time enough for everything. Whereas you...” She sighs. “If you do not mind me saying, shiverous Steele, we find you dry and fleet things rather tragic.”"

rows.translation: 她一脸满足地又往嘴里塞了些叶子。你感觉奎尔对这个话题或许还有更多话想说，但她暂时已经说够了。她咀嚼时显得极有目的性。

rows.original: . “You forget that I have a file on you. And we picked you exactly because of your, emmm, profligacy. Do you wish to flirt? Shiver sweet nothings into my antennae? Do you think if you exhaust all conversation with me, I will then be obliged to sweep you into my arms?” Whether it’s the humid heat or the truth of her words, you blush, and she laughs again winningly. (Still. Wasn’t there just a hint of a come-on there?)
rows.translation: . “你忘了我手头有你的档案。我们选中你，正是因为你，嗯——相当放纵。你是想调情吗？想对着我的触角颤声呢喃甜言蜜语？你是不是觉得，只要把能和我聊的话全聊完，我就有义务把你拥进怀里？”不知是因为湿热的空气，还是因为她一语中的，你脸红了，而她又迷人地笑了起来。（不过，她刚才是不是确实带着那么一点挑逗的意思？）

(Still. Wasn’t there just a hint of a come-on there?)"

rows.original: “Aww. I’m sorry, quiverful Steele,” the roehm says, sobering slightly and leaning back again. “I have all of your information at my fingertips, and yet I tease you when you ask something of me. That’s mean.”
rows.translation: “噢。对不起，颤悠悠的斯蒂尔，”这名罗姆说道，神情稍稍认真起来，又向后靠去。“你的所有资料我都唾手可得，你问我点事情，我却还拿你寻开心。这样太刻薄了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aww. I’m sorry, quiverful Steele,” the roehm says, sobering slightly and leaning back again. “I have all of your information at my fingertips, and yet I tease you when you ask something of me. That’s mean.”"

rows.original: Quaelle reaches out, tears a handful of leaves from a creeper and folds them into her mouth. She chews with her brilliant double eyes elsewhere, mind apparently elsewhere.
rows.translation: 奎尔伸出手，从一株藤蔓上扯下一把叶子，塞进嘴里。她咀嚼着，明亮的两双眼睛望向别处，思绪似乎也飘到了远方。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuaelle reaches out, tears a handful of leaves from a creeper and folds them into her mouth. She chews with her brilliant double eyes elsewhere, mind apparently elsewhere."

rows.original: “Well,” she continues once she’s swallowed, “I come from Hdar-Roe itself. So beautiful and thrombulent, Steele! The mucus falls! The moss symphonies and the Viscerous Palace! You MUST visit when you get the chance. I’ll take you.” She has the enthusiasm of a fresh-faced teacher who’s just thought of a great field trip. “But even before I was 5, I was restless. I wanted to see the galaxy! I’ve always been like that, even outside my full years. My dad was a cundarian - my mom thinks anyway, she went a bit wild during some of her own full years - and she thinks I inherited that from him.”
rows.translation: “嗯，”她咽下去后继续说道，“我来自赫达尔-罗本土。那里太美了，也太颤荡了，斯蒂尔！黏液飞瀑！苔藓交响乐，还有脏腑宫殿！你有机会一定要去看看。我带你去。”她兴奋得像一位刚想出绝佳郊游点子的年轻教师。“不过我甚至还没到5岁时，就已经坐不住了。我想看看整个银河！我一直都是这样，哪怕不在盛年期也一样。我爸爸是坎达利安——至少我妈妈觉得是，她在自己的某次盛年期里玩得有点疯——她觉得我是从他那里继承了这一点。”

I wanted to see the galaxy! I’ve always been like that, even outside my full years. My dad was a cundarian - my mom thinks anyway, she went a bit wild during some of her own full years - and she thinks I inherited that from him.”"

rows.original: “I was subcontracted by Tamani to be Head of PR here, as soon as the Great Effort really began. We Roehm are supposed to be very good in these sorts of roles - which is a liiiiittle bit insulting. The telepathic slug thing, you know. Hmm!” she harrumphs, cilia wiggling fitfully. “It only requires a bit of empathy to tell whether someone wants a cup of protein, a hug, or to be left alone, you know.”
rows.translation: “宏图大业一真正开始，我就被塔玛妮分包聘来担任这里的公关主管。大家都说我们罗姆特别适合这类职位——这其实有那——么一点侮辱人。你知道的，就是心灵感应鼻涕虫那套说法。哼！”她不满地哼了一声，纤毛烦躁地扭动着。“要判断一个人是想要一杯蛋白饮料、一个拥抱，还是只想独处，明明只要有一点同理心就够了。”

Hmm!” she harrumphs, cilia wiggling fitfully. “It only requires a bit of empathy to tell whether someone wants a cup of protein, a hug, or to be left alone, you know.”"

rows.original: “I’d built up some cash from stocks - it’s easy to do if you’re patient, you know - and used it to give myself a couple of mods. Like these!” She casually hefts one of her huge, pendulous breasts, fingers disappearing as she squeezes it slightly. “Breasts have always seemed to me like the most roehm-like part of aliens - so soft and loving and trembulent. People have been so much more likely to agree to do what I ask them to do since I grew them, too! Also the sweet scent, I’m sure you’ve noticed.” She extends her palm and blows across it towards you, billowing caramel over your face. “It’s for the kids in the nursery, mainly. If you smell like candy, they’re a lot more obedient. And more likely to give hugs!”
rows.translation: “我靠股票攒了些钱——只要有耐心，这事很容易——然后用它给自己做了几项改造。比如这些！”她随手托起一只硕大下垂的乳房，轻轻一捏，手指便陷了进去。“在我看来，乳房一直是外星人身上最像罗姆的部位——那么柔软、充满爱意，又颤颤荡荡。而且自从我把它们变大后，别人更愿意答应我的请求了！还有这股甜香，我相信你已经注意到了。”她伸出手掌，朝你的方向吹了一口气，焦糖甜香顿时扑了你满脸。“主要是为了育儿室里的孩子。如果你闻起来像糖果，他们就听话多了。也更愿意拥抱你！”

rows.original: “Speaking of which...” Quaelle pauses, hands knitted, gazing at you. There’s an unusual tension on her erstwhile calm and pleasant face; an urge breaking loose of a certain timidity. “You asked about me, and I’ve always felt you get to know and bond with someone much better by hugging than by talking. My people do it all the time, twine antennae, but - well. I know others don’t always appreciate being hugged by a roehm. Expensive clothes, and so on. I certainly learned that on my first trip away from Hdar-Roe.”
rows.translation: “说到这个...”奎尔顿了顿，双手交握，注视着你。她原本平静愉悦的脸上浮现出异样的紧张；某种冲动正挣脱一丝胆怯的束缚。“你问起了我的事，而我一直觉得，比起交谈，拥抱能让人更好地了解彼此、建立感情。我的族人总是这样做，还会把触角缠在一起，可是——嗯。我知道其他人并不总喜欢被罗姆拥抱。昂贵的衣服之类的。我第一次离开赫达尔-罗旅行时，确实学到了这一点。”

My people do it all the time, twine antennae, but - well. I know others don’t always appreciate being hugged by a roehm. Expensive clothes, and so on. rows.original: “Aww. Thank you so much, shiverous Steele!” she says, once she’s released you. You now have a wet imprint all the way down your front and, yes, you do smell like horny caramel. “I wish I could give hugs to everyone that passed through my reception. But most of my visitors move so fast, and don’t seem to realize how much they need one... I do hope you’ll keep coming back for them, Steele,” she goes on, looking at you with a slightly more amorous, sly bend to her peaceful smile. “Bodily contact, it’s so important for making the world a much better place.”
rows.translation: “噢。太谢谢你了，颤巍巍的斯蒂尔！”她放开你后说道。现在你身前从上到下都留下了一道湿漉漉的印子，而且没错，你闻起来就像发情的焦糖。“我真希望能给每个经过接待处的人一个拥抱。可我的访客大多走得太快，而且似乎没意识到自己有多需要拥抱...我真希望你以后还会回来找我抱抱，斯蒂尔，”她继续说，望着你的眼神里，那平和的笑意似乎更多了一丝含情脉脉的狡黠。“身体接触对让世界变得更美好实在太重要了。”

rows.original: This is barely a choice. Being a rahn incubator is wonderful, getting paid to do it is even better. A mod to make your body even more fertile and capacious? The cherry on top. You sign with a flourish.
rows.translation: 这几乎算不上一个选择。当拉恩孵化器非常美妙，拿钱做这件事则更加美妙。再来一项让身体更加肥沃、容量更大的改造？简直是锦上添花。你潇洒地签下名字。

rows.translation: “你真的很喜欢这行，对吧？”多赫·拉恩看着你在虚线上签名说道。“稍等一下，我带你去改造套间。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You really love this line of work, huh?” says the doh’rahn, watching you sign the dotted line. “Gimme a sec, and I’ll take you over to the modding suite.”"

rows.original: “What a giving person you are, hoverful Steele,” coos Quaelle, as she watches you sign the dotted line. “How many rahn were given the gift of life because of you! Come on - let’s go straight over to the modding suite, shall we?”
rows.translation: “你真是一位乐于奉献的人，孕卵丰盈的斯蒂尔，”夸埃勒看着你在虚线上签名，娇声说道。“有多少拉恩因为你而获得了生命的礼物！来吧，我们直接去改造套间，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What a giving person you are, hoverful Steele,” coos Quaelle, as she watches you sign the dotted line. “How many rahn were given the gift of life because of you! Come on - let’s go straight over to the modding suite, shall we?”"

rows.original: Once again, you’re whisked to Breedwell’s gleaming white and steel Modding Bay, where the sleek, smiling loo’rahn consultant is ready to greet you enthusiastically, and sit you down in a padded, dentist-like chair.
rows.translation: 你再次被迅速带往繁育中心那座闪耀着白色与钢铁光泽的改造舱；在那里，身材流畅、面带笑容的露·拉恩顾问已经准备好热情迎接你，并让你坐进一张带软垫、类似牙科椅的座椅。

rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔！我听说过你好多事情，”红皮肤的变形者微笑道。“你已经成为相当有价值的资产。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] Steele! I’ve heard so much about you,” smiles the red-skinned shapeshifter, raising their glass to you. “I’m very pleased to meet our corporation’s newest piece of intellectual property.”"

rows.original: Intellectual property?
rows.translation: 知识产权？
rows.raw: "\n\nIntellectual property?"

rows.original: “Of course!” The vildarii looks professionally bemused by your questioning tone. “Within you are contained several prototype pieces of Tamani Corp bio-engineering. Very expensive ones, all of which you agreed to install inside you. Really, that piece of paper you signed is a simple confirmation of what’s been true for a while - Tamani Corp own you, and your lovely body, in perpetuity.”
rows.translation: “当然！”维尔达里人对你疑问的语气表现出职业性的困惑。“你体内装有数项塔玛妮公司的生物工程原型，而且全都价值不菲；它们也都是经你同意才植入的。说真的，你签下的那张纸不过是确认一项早已持续许久的事实——塔玛妮公司永久拥有你，以及你可爱的身体。”

rows.original: “You’re a highly sought after piece of property, I may say,” the Tamani representative says. They indicate the documents in front of them. With a tightening of the chest, you recognize Lavender Leverage’s logo. “LavLev have a buyout offer placed, were you ever to take the final step. A substantial buyout offer. How did you ever get tangled up with those crooks? Anyway, I am authorized to accept it... if you’d prefer to be owned by them.” They smile at you urbanely. “Your happiness is a priority.”
rows.translation: “可以说，你是一件极受追捧的财产，”塔玛妮代表说道。他们示意面前的文件。你胸口一紧，认出了“薰衣草杠杆”的标志。“如果你愿意迈出最后一步，LavLev已经提出了买断报价。一笔极其可观的买断报价。你究竟是怎么跟那些骗子纠缠上的？总之，我有权接受它...如果你更愿意归他们所有的话。”他们彬彬有礼地朝你微笑。“你的幸福是我们的首要考虑。”

How did you ever get tangled up with those crooks? Anyway, I am authorized to accept it... if you’d prefer to be owned by them.” They smile at you urbanely. “Your happiness is a priority.”"

rows.translation: 浏览几秒后，你决定离开自动售货机。当你[pc.walk]远去时，仍能把电视购物广告听得一清二楚，仿佛还站在机器旁边。天啊，米莉·贝斯的嗓门可真够洪亮。
rows.raw: "After a few seconds of browsing, you opt to back away from the vending machine. As you [pc.walk] away, you can still hear the infomercials playing just as clearly as if you were still standing right next to them. My, but Milly Bayes has some pipes on her."

rows.original: You select your desired item and swipe your Codex across the dispenser’s scanner. It voices a delighted beep as it charges your account, and soon after the black box begins to hum calmly, the replicator inside it hard at work.
rows.translation: 你选中想要的物品，用个人终端划过出货机的扫描器。机器发出欢快的哔声，从你的账户扣款；不久后，黑色箱体开始平静地嗡嗡作响，里面的复制器正在卖力工作。
rows.raw: "You select your desired item and swipe your Codex across the dispenser’s scanner. It voices a delighted beep as it charges your account, and soon after the black box begins to hum calmly, the replicator inside it hard at work. "

rows.original: You warp into the Wistral system and head on towards the gas giant that BIC is orbiting around, keeping your monitors fixed upon Planet No. 5 as you do so. It’s fascinating, and weirdly moving, to watch that bleak, brown orb slowly being painted green and blue.
rows.translation: 你跃迁进入维斯特拉尔星系，朝布里德维尔孵化中心所环绕的气态巨行星前进，同时始终让监视器锁定五号行星。看着那颗荒凉的褐色星球逐渐被染上绿色和蓝色，既令人着迷，又莫名令人感动。
rows.raw: "You warp into the Wistral system and head on towards the gas giant that BIC is orbiting around, keeping your monitors fixed upon Planet No. 5 as you do so. It’s fascinating, and weirdly moving, to watch that bleak, brown orb slowly being painted green and blue."

rows.original: You navigate your way into the DONORS entrance and land in the sparsely populated hangar without issue. You power down the ship
rows.translation: 你一路驶入“捐献者”入口，顺利降落在人烟稀少的机库中。你关闭飞船动力
rows.raw: "\n\nYou navigate your way into the DONORS entrance and land in the sparsely populated hangar without issue. You power down the ship"

rows.original: and step out the airlock. The fuu’rahn greeter smiles at you, but she knows you know your way around now.
rows.translation: ，走出气闸。那名弗·拉恩接待员向你微笑，不过她知道你现在已经熟悉这里的路了。
rows.raw: " and step out the airlock. The fuu’rahn greeter smiles at you, but she knows you know your way around now."

rows.original: You are standing in the center’s secondary hangar, where ‘donors’ such as yourself come and go. It’s tall and airy, utilitarian white except for the grime and scorch marks that any place which houses spacecraft picks up. One wall is a vast energy barrier, beyond which the black eternity of space stares back. Facing it on the far wall is a giant Tamani logo, under which flat monitors endlessly loop adverts of the corporation’s products. Or porn. There’s no obvious distinction between the two.
rows.translation: 你正站在中心的次级机库里，像你这样的‘捐献者’从这里来来往往。机库高挑开阔，除了任何收容航天器的地方都会沾上的污垢和焦痕外，整体都是实用的白色。一面墙是巨大的能量屏障，屏障之外，太空永恒的黑暗正凝视着你。正对屏障的远墙上有一个巨大的塔玛妮标志，下面的平面显示器不断循环播放公司产品广告。或者色情片。两者之间并没有明显区别。
rows.raw: "You are standing in the center’s secondary hangar, where ‘donors’ such as yourself come and go. It’s tall and airy, utilitarian white except for the grime and scorch marks that any place which houses spacecraft picks up. One wall is a vast energy barrier, beyond which the black eternity of space stares back. Facing it on the far wall is a giant Tamani logo, under which flat monitors endlessly loop adverts of the corporation’s products. Or porn. There’s no obvious distinction between the two."

rows.original: It’s pretty empty and quiet in here, aside from the distant sounds of the station’s activity. The fuu’rahn greeter is
rows.translation: 这里相当空旷安静，只有空间站活动的声音从远处传来。那名弗·拉恩接待员正在
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s pretty empty and quiet in here, aside from the distant sounds of the station’s activity. The fuu’rahn greeter is "

rows.original: chatting with a bald, muscular man
rows.translation: 和一个秃头肌肉男交谈
rows.raw: "chatting with a bald, muscular man"

rows.original: chatting with a skittish-looking saeri
rows.translation: 和一个看起来神经兮兮的赛里交谈
rows.raw: "chatting with a skittish-looking saeri"

rows.original: standing on her own, browsing a tablet device
rows.translation: 独自站着浏览平板设备
rows.raw: "standing on her own, browsing a tablet device"

rows.original: chatting with a heavily pregnant gryvain
rows.translation: 和一名身怀六甲的格莱温交谈
rows.raw: "chatting with a heavily pregnant gryvain"

rows.original: nowhere to be seen. Probably with another visitor in a handy nearby closet
rows.translation: 不见踪影。大概正和另一名访客待在附近某个方便的小储物间里
rows.raw: "nowhere to be seen. Probably with another visitor in a handy nearby closet"

rows.original: . To the east, a ramp and corridor lead to reception.
rows.translation: . 东边有一条坡道和走廊通往接待处。
rows.raw: ". To the east, a ramp and corridor lead to reception."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You head up the ramp from the hangar and along a white, brightly-lit corridor to some double doors labeled ‘Visitors Reception’.
rows.translation: 你从机库沿坡道而上，穿过一条明亮的白色走廊，来到一对标着‘访客接待处’的双开门前。
rows.raw: "You head up the ramp from the hangar and along a white, brightly-lit corridor to some double doors labeled ‘Visitors Reception’."

rows.original: You are met with a heavy, humid blast of air when you open them, as if you’d stepped into a greenhouse. The walls in here are covered in lush, wet creeping vines, the ceiling with hanging baskets overflowing with greenery - a remarkable change from the dry, clinical whiteness your senses have been treated to so far.
rows.translation: 你一打开门，沉重湿热的空气便扑面而来，仿佛踏进了温室。这里的墙面爬满茂盛湿润的藤蔓，天花板上悬着一篮篮满溢的绿植——这与感官此前接触到的干燥、临床般洁白形成了惊人的反差。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou are met with a heavy, humid blast of air when you open them, as if you’d stepped into a greenhouse. The walls in here are covered in lush, wet creeping vines, the ceiling with hanging baskets overflowing with greenery - a remarkable change from the dry, clinical whiteness your senses have been treated to so far."

rows.original: “Hello there!” says a fluid, womanly voice somewhere at the heart of it. “I can shiver you, but if you could - and then - yes. Splendid!” You lift one of the hanging fronds to see who you’re talking to.
rows.translation: “你好呀！”某个身处绿意中心的流畅女声说道。“我可以颤动你，不过如果你能——然后——对。太棒了！”你掀起一片垂下的叶丛，看看自己正在和谁说话。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello there!” says a fluid, womanly voice somewhere at the heart of it. “I can shiver you, but if you could - and then - yes. Splendid!” You lift one of the hanging fronds to see who you’re talking to."

rows.original: The being behind the wide reception desk is the very embodiment of softness and wetness, writ on letters large, yellow and feminine. Her lower body is serpentine, but there’s nothing snake-like about that big, wide, blunt tail, patterned with brilliant orange spots, shining with moisture; it looks distinctly more like something that would spend three hours patiently climbing up a garden wall. Up from that edgeless wedge of a base a human-like body climbs, albeit a very thick, wet, hairless human, dressed in a waterproof chocolate-colored dress and lab-coat, against which mountainous, F-cup breasts are placing a mighty strain. At the top of this is a head and a flat-nosed, pleasantly-featured face, with full, golden lips and brilliant, frog-like, double-pupiled eyes. A number of cilia-like antennae slowly undulate from underneath a beige, conch-like hat. If the gastropodic being is irritated by you spending several moments properly taking her in, she doesn’t show it. She simply waves to direct your attention up to her face when you’re done.
rows.translation: 宽大接待台后的生物正是柔软与湿润的化身，这一点用巨大、明黄而充满女性气息的字体写在她身上。她的下半身呈蛇形，但那条宽大、粗钝、遍布亮橙色斑点并闪着水光的尾巴毫无蛇类特征；它显然更像某种会耐心花上三个小时爬过花园围墙的生物。一具类人的身体从那块毫无棱角的楔形基座上耸起，只不过是个非常粗壮、湿润、无毛的人类，身穿防水的巧克力色连衣裙和实验服；山峦般的F罩杯乳房将衣服绷得紧紧的。最上方是一颗脑袋和一张鼻梁扁平、五官和善的脸，长着丰满的金色嘴唇，以及明亮如青蛙般、拥有双重瞳孔的眼睛。数根纤毛般的触角从一顶米色海螺形帽子下缓缓摆动。即使这名腹足类生物对你花了好一会儿仔细打量她感到不满，她也没有表现出来。等你看够后，她只是挥挥手，把你的注意力引回她的脸上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe being behind the wide reception desk is the very embodiment of softness and wetness, writ on letters large, yellow and feminine. Her lower body is serpentine, but there’s nothing snake-like about that big, wide, blunt tail, patterned with brilliant orange spots, shining with moisture; it looks distinctly more like something that would spend three hours patiently climbing up a garden wall. Up from that edgeless wedge of a base a human-like body climbs, albeit a very thick, wet, hairless human, dressed in a waterproof chocolate-colored dress and lab-coat, against which mountainous, F-cup breasts are placing a mighty strain. At the top of this is a head and a flat-nosed, pleasantly-featured face, with full, golden lips and brilliant, frog-like, double-pupiled eyes. A number of cilia-like antennae slowly undulate from underneath a beige, conch-like hat. If the gastropodic being is irritated by you spending several moments properly taking her in, she doesn’t show it. She simply waves to direct your attention up to her face when you’re done."

rows.original: “Welcome to the Breedwell Incubation Centre. I’m Quaelle, the matron here,” she says, drawing out the ‘e’ in ‘Breedwell’ and ‘here’ into a kind of happy hush. She pauses to brush the crude, colorful bracelets hanging from her wide arms further up. She’s in no hurry, and in the hot, humid environment here it’s hard not to share her mood. “If you’ll give me one moment...”
rows.translation: “欢迎来到布里德维尔孵育中心。我叫奎尔，是这里的女总管，”她说道，把‘布里德维尔’和‘这里’中的尾音拖成一种愉快的轻吟。她停下来，将挂在宽大手臂上的粗制彩色手镯向上拨了拨。她一点也不着急，而在这里炎热潮湿的环境中，你很难不被她的心情感染。“请稍等片刻...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome to the Breedwell Incubation Centre. I’m Quaelle, the matron here,” she says, drawing out the ‘e’ in ‘Breedwell’ and ‘here’ into a kind of happy hush. She pauses to brush the crude, colorful bracelets hanging from her wide arms further up. She’s in no hurry, and in the hot, humid environment here it’s hard not to share her mood. “If you’ll give me one moment...”"

rows.original: Peacefully she turns and taps a few times at a monitor. A tiny camera fixed to the roof eyeballs you. A glad smile slowly spreads over Quealle’s face.
rows.translation: 她平静地转过身，在显示器上轻点几下。一台固定在屋顶上的小摄像头盯着你。奎尔脸上缓缓绽开欣喜的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nPeacefully she turns and taps a few times at a monitor. A tiny camera fixed to the roof eyeballs you. A glad smile slowly spreads over Quealle’s face."

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele!” she says. [pc.name] Steeeeeeeeele! “Going off our analytics, it’s wonderful that you’ve taken up the offer to help the rahn with your shiversome body. So fertile! Such genes! Would you like the induction now, or do you have other questions?” She gazes at you beatifically with her striking, double-pupiled eyes, antennae gently waving. “You do, of course. Why don’t we sit aside and chat for a while?”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔！”她说道。[pc.name]·斯蒂——尔！“根据我们的分析，你愿意用自己颤巍巍的身体来帮助拉恩，实在太好了。多么旺盛的生育力！多么优秀的基因！你想现在接受入职介绍，还是还有别的问题？”她用那双醒目的双瞳眼睛幸福安详地凝望着你，触角轻柔摆动。“你当然有问题。不如我们坐到一旁聊一会儿吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] Steele!” she says. [pc.name] Steeeeeeeeele! “Going off our analytics, it’s wonderful that you’ve taken up the offer to help the rahn with your shiversome body. So fertile! Such genes! Would you like the induction now, or do you have other questions?” She gazes at you beatifically with her striking, double-pupiled eyes, antennae gently waving. “You do, of course. Why don’t we sit aside and chat for a while?”"

rows.original: Roehm
rows.raw: "Roehm"

rows.original: Your codex beeps to inform you that it has downloaded details of Quealle’s race.
rows.translation: 你的终端发出哔声，通知你已经下载了奎尔种族的详细资料。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour codex beeps to inform you that it has downloaded details of Quealle’s race."

rows.original: Roehm
rows.raw: "Roehm"

rows.original: Breedwell’s reception area is a fairly large, circular room, dominated by a curved desk against the north wall. It is hot and very humid here, greenhouse-like, the lights muzzy with the water in the air. Moisture drips down the walls, slathered with exotic creepers. Hanging baskets droop lush greenery from the ceiling.
rows.translation: 布里德维尔的接待区是一间相当宽敞的圆形房间，北墙边的一张弧形接待台占据主导位置。这里炎热而极其潮湿，宛如温室，空气中的水汽让灯光显得朦胧。墙上挂满奇异的藤蔓，水珠不断沿墙滴落。吊篮从天花板垂下葱郁的绿植。
rows.raw: "Breedwell’s reception area is a fairly large, circular room, dominated by a curved desk against the north wall. It is hot and very humid here, greenhouse-like, the lights muzzy with the water in the air. Moisture drips down the walls, slathered with exotic creepers. Hanging baskets droop lush greenery from the ceiling."

rows.original: From here, corridors fan out to every part of the station, and there’s a relative amount of bustle going on. Rahn of every color and shape, either staff members in nurse uniforms or swollen, eager studs dressed in all sorts of styles, hurry from one place to the other. One or two thoroughly impregnated surrogates relax on seats, flush-faced.
rows.translation: 走廊从这里呈扇形通往空间站各处，周围颇为忙碌。各色各样的拉恩匆忙来往，有的是身穿护士制服的员工，有的是肿胀而迫不及待、穿着各式服装的种公。一两个已经被彻底受孕的代孕者红着脸坐在座椅上休息。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom here, corridors fan out to every part of the station, and there’s a relative amount of bustle going on. Rahn of every color and shape, either staff members in nurse uniforms or swollen, eager studs dressed in all sorts of styles, hurry from one place to the other. One or two thoroughly impregnated surrogates relax on seats, flush-faced."

rows.original: At the hub of it all is a rather stern-looking doh’rahn.
rows.translation: 整个枢纽的中心是一名神情颇为严厉的多赫·拉恩。
rows.raw: " At the hub of it all is a rather stern-looking doh’rahn."

rows.original: Quaelle, the roehm matron, isn’t anywhere in sight.
rows.translation: 罗姆女总管奎尔不见踪影。
rows.raw: " Quaelle, the roehm matron, isn’t anywhere in sight."

rows.original: At the hub of it all is a rather stern-looking doh’rahn.
rows.translation: 整个枢纽的中心是一名神情颇为严厉的多赫·拉恩。
rows.raw: " At the hub of it all is a rather stern-looking doh’rahn."

rows.original: The back-up matron catches your eye the moment you enter and gives you a brief smile. Looks like she’s been waiting for you.
rows.translation: 你一进门，代理女总管便与你对上目光，朝你短暂一笑。看来她一直在等你。
rows.raw: " The back-up matron catches your eye the moment you enter and gives you a brief smile. Looks like she’s been waiting for you."

rows.original: “You should go to the natal unit,” the purple rahn says, before you can open your mouth. “Go through the south doors, then west a short distance past the breeding pods.” She shakes her head slightly. “Imagine deliberately getting pregnant in a place like this. Takes some cheek!”
rows.translation: “你应该去产育区，”你还没来得及开口，那名紫色拉恩便说道。“穿过南边的门，再往西走一小段，经过繁育舱就是。”她微微摇头。“真想不到居然有人故意在这种地方怀孕。脸皮可真够厚的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You should go to the natal unit,” the purple rahn says, before you can open your mouth. “Go through the south doors, then west a short distance past the breeding pods.” She shakes her head slightly. “Imagine deliberately getting pregnant in a place like this. Takes some cheek!”"

rows.original: The back-up matron catches your eye the moment you enter, gives you a brief smile. You recognize that look. Nervous excitement tightens your chest.
rows.translation: 你一进门，代理女总管便与你对上目光，朝你短暂一笑。你认得那种眼神。紧张的兴奋感令你胸口发紧。
rows.raw: " The back-up matron catches your eye the moment you enter, gives you a brief smile. You recognize that look. Nervous excitement tightens your chest."

rows.original: “Congratulations, you’re a dad. Again.”
rows.translation: “恭喜，你当爸爸了。又一次。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Congratulations, you’re a dad. Again.”"

rows.original: The purple rahn points southwards with her stylus.
rows.translation: 紫色拉恩用触控笔指向南方。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe purple rahn points southwards with her stylus."

rows.original: “You know where to go, right? Hope you brought flowers. She’s very hungry.”
rows.translation: “你知道该往哪走，对吧？希望你带了花。她现在非常饿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know where to go, right? Hope you brought flowers. She’s very hungry.”"

rows.original: At the hub of it all is a rather stern-looking doh’rahn.
rows.translation: 整个枢纽的中心是一名神情颇为严厉的多赫·拉恩。
rows.raw: " At the hub of it all is a rather stern-looking doh’rahn."

rows.original: Quaelle must still be on maternity leave.
rows.translation: 奎尔肯定还在休产假。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuaelle must still be on maternity leave."

rows.original: At the hub of it all is a rather stern-looking doh’rahn.
rows.translation: 整个枢纽的中心是一名神情颇为严厉的多赫·拉恩。
rows.raw: " At the hub of it all is a rather stern-looking doh’rahn."

rows.original: Quaelle, the roehm matron, isn’t anywhere in sight. What’s become of her?
rows.translation: 罗姆女总管奎尔不见踪影。她怎么了？
rows.raw: " Quaelle, the roehm matron, isn’t anywhere in sight. What’s become of her?"

rows.original: You guess Quaelle must have become incapacitated by pregnancy again. Thanks to a certain randy someone.
rows.translation: 你猜奎尔一定又因为怀孕而无法工作了。都怪某个欲火旺盛的家伙。
rows.raw: " You guess Quaelle must have become incapacitated by pregnancy again. Thanks to a certain randy someone."

rows.original: Quaelle must still be incapacitated.
rows.translation: 奎尔肯定还无法工作。

rows.original: “Hello, Surrogate [pc.name],” says the bulky incubator drone with the Tamani logo emblazoned upon it in a sweet voice. “Thank you for helping Breedwell with the great effort! You shall be credited for each rahn child you have borne to term. Rest assured, they shall be quite safe w--”

rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello, Surrogate [pc.name],” says the bulky incubator drone with the Tamani logo emblazoned upon it in a sweet voice. “Thank you for helping Breedwell with the great effort! You shall be credited for each rahn child you have borne to term. Rest assured, they shall be quite safe w--”"

rows.original: “Hello and congratulations, [pc.name] Steele,” says the bulky incubator drone with the Steele logo emblazoned upon it in a matter-of-face voice, butting into the first drone from behind. “Shall I take these children of yours to your nursery? I also have combat protocols installed to ward off cot-robbing interlopers. You merely need to say when.”
rows.translation: “你好，恭喜你，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”印着斯蒂尔标志的笨重孵化无人机从背后挤开第一台，以平淡声音说道。“要我把这些你的孩子送往你的育儿室吗？我还安装了战斗协议，可以击退抢夺婴儿床的入侵者。只需一声令下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello and congratulations, [pc.name] Steele,” says the bulky incubator drone with the Steele logo emblazoned upon it in a matter-of-face voice, butting into the first drone from behind. “Shall I take these children of yours to your nursery? I also have combat protocols installed to ward off cot-robbing interlopers. You merely need to say when.”"

rows.original: “You shall not be paid if you choose to keep any of the rahn you agreed to hand over at this time, surrogate [pc.name],” says the sweet-voiced Tamani drone, turning slowly and deliberately to face the Steele drone. “It may also affect your standing with the Breedwell Centre, should you choose to work with us again. I would also surely hate to vaporize any robotic personnel of yours for failing to keep their distance.”
rows.translation: “若你选择保留此时同意交出的任何拉恩，将不会获得报酬，代孕者[pc.name]，”塔玛妮无人机以甜美声音说道，缓慢而刻意地转向斯蒂尔无人机。“若今后再次选择与我们合作，这也可能影响你在布里德韦尔中心的地位。若你的任何机器人职员不肯保持距离，我也一定会非常遗憾地将其气化。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You shall not be paid if you choose to keep any of the rahn you agreed to hand over at this time, surrogate [pc.name],” says the sweet-voiced Tamani drone, turning slowly and deliberately to face the Steele drone. “It may also affect your standing with the Breedwell Centre, should you choose to work with us again. I would also surely hate to vaporize any robotic personnel of yours for failing to keep their distance.”"

rows.original: A beep, followed by a second beep in a slightly different tone, startles you out of your post-natal haze. Hovering nearby are both the Tamani drone and the Steele drone. They say nothing, simply waiting expectantly with their incubators, passive-aggressively occupying one another’s space. It’s remarkable how two silent, faceless entities can still manage to convey a simmering hatred for one another.
rows.translation: 两声音调略有不同的哔响接连传来，将你从产后恍惚中惊醒。塔玛妮无人机与斯蒂尔无人机都悬浮在附近。它们一言不发，只带着孵化器期待等待，以消极挑衅的方式侵占彼此空间。两个沉默而没有面孔的实体竟仍能传达对彼此暗自沸腾的憎恨，实在令人惊叹。
rows.raw: "A beep, followed by a second beep in a slightly different tone, startles you out of your post-natal haze. Hovering nearby are both the Tamani drone and the Steele drone. rows.translation: 她花了大约一分钟向其他员工迅速发布命令，随后干脆利落地把你领进繁育舱观察区。你再次俯瞰成群色彩鲜艳的凝胶女性；她们一边等待交配时段，一边兴奋地彼此交谈。

rows.original: “They still haven’t provided us with a proper vid for the breeders,” scowls the doh’rahn. She taps and scrolls at one of the screens. “But, look, you can watch the advert intended for the subscribers. That should make everything clear.”
rows.translation: “他们还是没给繁育者制作一部合适的视频，”多赫·拉恩皱眉说道。她在其中一块屏幕上轻点滚动。“不过你看，可以观看给订阅者准备的广告。这样一切应该都会清楚。”

rows.original: “You took rahn kids, instead of giving them to the drone,” she says bluntly. “Don’t do that. This isn’t an art insem clinic. Next time you do, we’re gonna be obliged to do something about it. Either tearing up your contract, or a sanction.”
rows.translation: “你把拉恩孩子带走了，没有交给无人机，”她直截了当地说道。“别那么做。这里不是人工授精诊所。下次再这么做，我们就不得不采取措施。要么撕毁你的合同，要么给予制裁。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You took rahn kids, instead of giving them to the drone,” she says bluntly. “Don’t do that. This isn’t an art insem clinic. Next time you do, we’re gonna be obliged to do something about it. Either tearing up your contract, or a sanction.”"

rows.translation: 她心照不宣地抬头看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks up at you knowingly."

rows.original: “You might enjoy the sanction, you incubators, I dunno. But don’t do it anymore. Save me the paperwork, k?”
rows.translation: “你们这些孵化者说不定会喜欢制裁，我也不知道。但别再做了。省得我填表，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You might enjoy the sanction, you incubators, I dunno. But don’t do it anymore. Save me the paperwork, k?”"

rows.original: She dismisses you with a flick of her cilia hair.
rows.translation: 她甩动纤毛般的头发，示意你离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe dismisses you with a flick of her cilia hair."

rows.original: “Fluctilious Steele! Could I talk to you for a moment?”
rows.translation: “波动不止的斯蒂尔！能和你谈谈吗？”
rows.raw: "“Fluctilious Steele! Could I talk to you for a moment?”"

rows.original: Quaelle calls over to you the moment you step into the humid hush of Breedwell’s reception. She has that expression of patient, professional concern native to HR managers about to administer the Quiet Word, and it cannot fail to seed dread in your heart. You follow the roehm into the leafy sitting area.
rows.translation: 你刚踏进繁育中心接待处那片湿热的寂静，夸埃勒便叫住了你。她脸上带着一种耐心而职业的关切神情，正是人力资源经理准备进行私下提醒时特有的表情，令你心中无法抑制地滋生恐惧。你跟着这名罗姆走进绿意盎然的休息区。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuaelle calls over to you the moment you step into the humid hush of Breedwell’s reception. She has that expression of patient, professional concern native to HR managers about to administer the Quiet Word, and it cannot fail to seed dread in your heart. You follow the roehm into the leafy sitting area."

rows.original: “The incubator drone we sent you told us that you have an, emmmmm, alternative arrangement set up,” she says, knitting her fingers beneath her bosom and gazing at you placidly. “That’s nice! And I understand, pulsiment Steele, I genuinely do.” She pats you on the hand. “If I were the one bearing cute little baby rahn, I do not think I could bear to let them go either. I would keep them all for myself too!”
rows.translation: “我们派给你的孵化无人机告诉我们，你安排了某种，嗯——替代方案，”她说道，在胸部下方交叠手指，平静地凝视你。“这很好！而且我理解，脉动不已的斯蒂尔，我真的理解。”她拍了拍你的手。“如果是我孕育那些可爱的小拉恩宝宝，我想自己也舍不得让她们离开。我也会把她们全都留给自己！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The incubator drone we sent you told us that you have an, emmmmm, alternative arrangement set up,” she says, knitting her fingers beneath her bosom and gazing at you placidly. “That’s nice! I would keep them all for myself too!”"

rows.original: “Buuut. You can’t do that. You must let us have the babies. You know we look after them well, right? I can show you around the living complexes here, if you like.” Quaelle smiles at you patiently. “If you do it again, then... the matter will be out of my hands. We will either have to void your incubator rights, or sanction you. Sanctioning... well, Breedwell will make sure you produce the babies you agreed you would, put it that way.”
rows.translation: “但是，你不能那么做。你必须把宝宝交给我们。你知道我们会好好照顾她们，对吧？如果愿意，我可以带你参观这里的生活区。”夸埃勒耐心地对你微笑。“如果你再这么做，那么...事情就不再由我决定。我们要么取消你的孵化权利，要么制裁你。至于制裁...这么说吧，繁育中心会确保你产下自己同意交付的宝宝。”

rows.original: “I was going to tell you shiverous Steele, Tamani Corp are fulminous with how you did,” the roehm says brightly. She rummages through her desk, and presents you with a holopad, covered in tight writing. “So much so, they want to offer you an improved contract! They are both pure roehm from their tiny wriggling cilia down to their blunt, dazzling, sea slug ends... but their faces. Oh yes, you can see a trace of the roguish Steele charm there.
rows.translation: 你走过去，用一条手臂搂住她柔软湿润的肩膀，低头看着自己的女儿们。仿佛掐准时机般，其中一个睁开眼睛，以银河各地婴儿共有的坦率而难以置信的好奇目光回望你（不过，大多数婴儿可没有四枚瞳孔来做这件事）。从微微扭动的小纤毛一直到钝圆炫目的海蛞蝓尾端，她们都是纯种罗姆...但那两张脸。哦，没错，你看得出上面带着几分斯蒂尔式的顽皮魅力。

rows.original: “Thank you, shiverous Steele.” Quaelle sighs and rocks the children gently. “It will make it easier for me to continue here, doing my job. If they were here... I doubt I would let them out of my sight.”
rows.translation: “谢谢你，颤动诱人的斯蒂尔。”奎尔叹了口气，轻轻摇晃孩子们。“这会让我更容易留在这里，继续完成自己的工作。如果她们留在这里...我恐怕一刻也不会让她们离开视线。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you, shiverous Steele.” Quaelle sighs and rocks the children gently. “It will make it easier for me to continue here, doing my job. If they were here... I doubt I would let them out of my sight.”"

rows.original: You allow yourself to breathe the humid atmosphere deep and sink into that almost Zen-like peace you adopt to interact with Quaelle, all the more profound now she’s cradling two children, and sit with her for a long while, cuddling her, playing with your daughter’s tiny, pudgy fingers until they finally drift into sleep.
rows.translation: 你深深呼吸潮湿的空气，沉入与奎尔相处时采用的那种近乎禅意的宁静；如今她怀抱两个孩子，这份宁静也变得更加深邃。你和她久久坐在一起，拥抱她，逗弄女儿细小圆润的手指，直到她们终于渐渐睡去。

rows.original: “I will be back at work soon,” she says at last, holding your hand. “You’ll still visit, won’t you? I feel so vibriscent in your company.” She squeezes your hand and is silent for a few moments, antennae waving, seeming just to bask in your presence.
rows.translation: “我很快就会回去工作，”最后她握着你的手说道。“你还是会来看我，对吧？和你在一起，我感觉好有活力。”她捏了捏你的手，沉默了片刻，触角轻轻摆动，仿佛只是在享受你的陪伴。

rows.original: “Ohhhhh.” Quaelle looks mostly relieved at this, as if she had thought you’d immediately swipe the
rows.translation: “噢——。”奎尔听后主要是松了口气，仿佛她真的以为你会立刻把
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohhhhh.” Quaelle looks mostly relieved at this, as if she had thought you’d immediately swipe the"

rows.original: babies
rows.translation: 宝宝们
rows.raw: " babies"

rows.original: baby
rows.translation: 宝宝
rows.raw: " baby"

rows.original: out of her arms. “Ok then, shiversome Steele. We’ll do that.”
rows.translation: 从她怀里抢走。“那好吧，令人颤动的斯蒂尔。我们就这么办。”
rows.raw: " out of her arms. “Ok then, shiversome Steele. We’ll do that.”"

rows.original: You allow yourself to breathe the humid atmosphere deep and sink into that almost Zen-like peace you adopt to interact with Quaelle, all the more profound now she’s cradling
rows.translation: 你让自己深深吸入湿润的空气，沉入那种近乎禅意的平静之中——和奎尔相处时你总会进入这种状态，而如今她怀里还抱着
rows.raw: "\n\nYou allow yourself to breathe the humid atmosphere deep and sink into that almost Zen-like peace you adopt to interact with Quaelle, all the more profound now she’s cradling"

rows.original: two children
rows.translation: 两个孩子
rows.raw: " two children"

rows.original: a child
rows.translation: 一个孩子
rows.raw: " a child"

rows.original: , and sit with her for a long while, cuddling her, playing with your daughter’s tiny, pudgy fingers until she finally drifts into sleep.
rows.translation: ，这份平静便更加深邃。你陪她坐了很久，拥抱她，逗弄女儿胖乎乎的小手指，直到她终于沉沉睡去。
rows.raw: ", and sit with her for a long while, cuddling her, playing with your daughter’s tiny, pudgy fingers until she finally drifts into sleep."

rows.original: “I can’t believe I’m going to have to go through this all over again,” she groans,
rows.translation: “真不敢相信，我又得把这一切重新经历一遍，”她呻吟道，
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can’t believe I’m going to have to go through this all over again,” she groans,"

rows.original: hand sliding down the growing bulge of her belly.
rows.translation: 手沿着腹部渐渐隆起的弧度向下滑去。
rows.raw: " hand sliding down the growing bulge of her belly."

rows.original: eyes on the fattening midriff of her slug half.
rows.translation: 目光落在蛞蝓下半身日渐丰腴的腹部。
rows.raw: " eyes on the fattening midriff of her slug half."

rows.original: “I should have chosen a less flickersome, exhausting father!”
rows.translation: “我真该挑一个没那么躁动、没那么折腾人的父亲！”
rows.raw: " “I should have chosen a less flickersome, exhausting father!”"

rows.original: She loves it though, the sensation of being stuffed full of new life, it’s plain to see. You give her a soft kiss on the lips and then leave, heading back to reception.
rows.translation: 不过她其实很享受，享受体内被新生命塞得满满的感觉，这一点显而易见。你在她唇上轻轻一吻，随后离开，返回接待处。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe loves it though, the sensation of being stuffed full of new life, it’s plain to see. You give her a soft kiss on the lips and then leave, heading back to reception."

rows.original: “I will back at work soon,” she says at last, holding your hand. “You’ll still visit, won’t you? I feel so vibriscent in your company. And, I think, once I’ve recovered...” she squeezes your hand and is silent for a few moments, just looking at you with soft intent. “...I would like some more.”
rows.translation: “我很快就会回去工作，”最后她握着你的手说道。“你还是会来看我，对吧？和你在一起，我感觉好有活力。而且我想，等我恢复以后...”她捏了捏你的手，沉默了片刻，只是怀着温柔的期待注视着你。“...我还想再要一些。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I will back at work soon,” she says at last, holding your hand. “You’ll still visit, won’t you? I feel so vibriscent in your company. And, I think, once I’ve recovered...” she squeezes your hand and is silent for a few moments, just looking at you with soft intent. “...I would like some more.”"

rows.original: Void, she’s keen! You give her a soft kiss on the lips and then leave, heading back to reception.
rows.translation: 虚空啊，她可真积极！你在她唇上轻轻一吻，随后离开，返回接待处。
rows.raw: "\n\nVoid, she’s keen! You give her a soft kiss on the lips and then leave, heading back to reception."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: WISTRAL.NO 5.BREEDWELL_RECEPTION
rows.raw: "WISTRAL.NO 5.BREEDWELL_RECEPTION"

rows.original: For a long while you just sit together in silence - silence but for the crunch and munch of vine leaves in Quaelle’s mouth, that is. You’ve spent enough time in the roehm’s company to fall into the gastropod’s rhythms, and you no longer feel uncomfortable kicking back and doing nothing when you’re around her. Let the topics come up slowly, naturally. There’s no rush.
rows.translation: 很长一段时间里，你们只是静静坐在一起——当然，除了奎尔嘴里咔嚓咔嚓嚼着藤叶的声音。你已经和这名罗姆相处得够久，逐渐适应了这只腹足生物的节奏；待在她身边时，就算放松下来什么也不做，你也不再觉得不自在。让话题缓慢而自然地浮现吧。没什么可着急的。
rows.raw: "For a long while you just sit together in silence - silence but for the crunch and munch of vine leaves in Quaelle’s mouth, that is. You’ve spent enough time in the roehm’s company to fall into the gastropod’s rhythms, and you no longer feel uncomfortable kicking back and doing nothing when you’re around her. Let the topics come up slowly, naturally. There’s no rush."

rows.original: “The baby rahn get packaged off to frontier worlds, then?” you say at last. “Who looks after them? Do they find out who their parents are?”
rows.translation: “那么，拉恩宝宝会被成批送往边疆世界？”最后你开口说道。“谁来照顾她们？她们会知道自己的父母是谁吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The baby rahn get packaged off to frontier worlds, then?” you say at last. “Who looks after them? Do they find out who their parents are?”"

rows.original: “They are raised in communal nurseries,” Quaelle replies, once her mouth is clear. “If possible, they’re sent to the same planet their former was sent.”
rows.translation: “她们在公共育儿室里长大，”奎尔清空嘴里的食物后答道。“如果可能，她们会被送到自己的成卵者被派往的同一颗星球。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They are raised in communal nurseries,” Quaelle replies, once her mouth is clear. “If possible, they’re sent to the same planet their former was sent.”"

rows.original: She gazes placidly over at the brightly colored gel women staff, busy at the front desk.
rows.translation: 她平静地望向那些色彩鲜艳的凝胶女性员工；她们正在前台忙碌。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gazes placidly over at the brightly colored gel women staff, busy at the front desk."

rows.original: “They don’t understand moms and dads as we do, pulsiment Steele. Whoever provided the genetic material to inseminate a batch of eggs is not considered an important part of the relationship. That’s considered to be... like a natural force. Remember that for millennia, they used animal semen to do it! There is your former - the rahn that grew your egg - and your bearer - the person who bore you in their womb. They are the closest thing they have to parent, hmm, hmm, parallels. A baby rahn is raised by their bearer, or by their bearer and former, or communally. In which case you have many, many aunts.”
rows.translation: “她们对爸爸妈妈的理解和我们不同，悸动的斯蒂尔。为一批卵提供授精遗传物质的人，不被视为这段关系中的重要一方。那被认为是...类似自然力量的东西。别忘了，她们曾用动物精液授精了数千年！你会有成卵者——培育你那颗卵的拉恩——以及承育者——在子宫里孕育你的人。她们是最接近父母的，嗯，嗯，对应概念。拉恩宝宝可以由承育者抚养，也可以由承育者与成卵者共同抚养，或者接受集体抚养。最后一种情况下，你就会有许许多多的姨妈。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They don’t understand moms and dads as we do, pulsiment Steele. Whoever provided the genetic material to inseminate a batch of eggs is not considered an important part of the relationship. That’s considered to be... like a natural force. Remember that for millennia, they used animal semen to do it! There is your former - the rahn that grew your egg - and your bearer - the person who bore you in their womb. They are the closest thing they have to parent, hmm, hmm, parallels. A baby rahn is raised by their bearer, or by their bearer and former, or communally. In which case you have many, many aunts.”"

rows.original: There’s a long pause, as if Quaelle were allowing for this to sink in.
rows.translation: 接下来是一阵漫长的停顿，仿佛奎尔是在给你时间消化这些信息。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a long pause, as if Quaelle were allowing for this to sink in."

rows.original: “To answer your question... no. The rahn who are created here will not know who their bearer was, or who provided the sperm. That information is kept classified... as you know, because you read all the terms and conditions of your contract with Breedwell, didn’t you?” She grins at you knowingly. “Hmm. Hmm. Hmm.”
rows.translation: “回答你的问题...不会。在这里诞生的拉恩不会知道孕育她们的人是谁，也不会知道是谁提供了精子。这些资料属于机密...你当然清楚，因为你已经读过自己与布里德维尔签订的合同中全部条款和条件，对吧？”她心照不宣地朝你咧嘴一笑。“嗯。嗯。嗯。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“To answer your question... no. The rahn who are created here will not know who their bearer was, or who provided the sperm. That information is kept classified... as you know, because you read all the terms and conditions of your contract with Breedwell, didn’t you?” She grins at you knowingly. “Hmm. Hmm. Hmm.”"

rows.original: “Do you think creating all of these babies will have the effect the rahn government is hoping for?” you ask.
rows.translation: “你认为，创造这么多婴儿能达到拉恩政府期待的效果吗？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you think creating all of these babies will have the effect the rahn government is hoping for?” you ask."

rows.original: “Hmmmmmmmmm.” A long, musical note of doubt. “Getting baby booties on the ground is an age-old tactic, the anatae empire has used it since the formation of the U.G.C. of course. But they have had millennia to establish themselves. The rahn central government can weigh colonies demographically in their favor... but perhaps mega-corporations will take over the chosen planets anyway, perhaps war and piracy will render them inconsequential, or even a burden. And perhaps your jelly babies will not vote or act in the way you hope!”
rows.translation: “嗯————。”她发出一道悠长而悦耳的迟疑音。“让婴儿真正落地生根，是一种古老的策略；当然，安纳泰帝国从银河联合邦联成立之初便一直采用这种手段。但他们已经有数千年时间巩固自身地位。拉恩中央政府可以让殖民地的人口结构向自己倾斜...不过，也许巨型企业最终仍会接管选定的行星，也许战争与海盗活动会让这些殖民地变得无关紧要，甚至沦为负担。而且，也许你们的凝胶宝宝不会按照你所希望的方式投票或行动！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmmmmmmmmm.” A long, musical note of doubt. “Getting baby booties on the ground is an age-old tactic, the anatae empire has used it since the formation of the U.G.C. of course. But they have had millennia to establish themselves. The rahn central government can weigh colonies demographically in their favor... but perhaps mega-corporations will take over the chosen planets anyway, perhaps war and piracy will render them inconsequential, or even a burden. And perhaps your jelly babies will not vote or act in the way you hope!”"

rows.original: The roehm opens her arms speculatively, stuffed bosom wobbling.
rows.translation: 罗姆若有所思地张开双臂，饱满的胸脯随之摇晃。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe roehm opens her arms speculatively, stuffed bosom wobbling."

rows.original: “Colonists of strange planets develop in ways you cannot plan for, particularly if they are young. I think this baby boom will help them, shiverous Steele... a little.” She leans forward, still smiling. “Those are my unofficial thoughts, hmm hmm, ok? Officially I think the Great Effort will be a Great Success, like everyone else here. Please keep
rows.translation: “陌生行星上的殖民者会以你无法预先规划的方式发展，尤其是在他们还年轻的时候。我认为这场婴儿潮会对拉恩有所帮助，颤动诱人的斯蒂尔...一点点。”她依旧微笑着向前倾身。“这些只是我非官方的想法，嗯哼，好吗？官方说法是，我和这里的所有人一样，相信伟业必将取得伟大成功。请继续
rows.raw: "\n\n“Colonists of strange planets develop in ways you cannot plan for, particularly if they are young. I think this baby boom will help them, shiverous Steele... a little.” She leans forward, still smiling. “Those are my unofficial thoughts, hmm hmm, ok? Officially I think the Great Effort will be a Great Success, like everyone else here. Please keep"

rows.original: giving us your lovely, fecund sperm and bearing sweet little gel girls for us!
rows.translation: 为我们提供你可爱而生机勃勃的精子，并替我们孕育甜美的小凝胶女孩！
rows.raw: " giving us your lovely, fecund sperm and bearing sweet little gel girls for us!"

rows.original: giving us your lovely, fecund sperm.
rows.translation: 为我们提供你可爱而生机勃勃的精子。
rows.raw: " giving us your lovely, fecund sperm."

rows.original: bearing sweet little gel girls for us!
rows.translation: 替我们孕育甜美的小凝胶女孩！
rows.raw: " bearing sweet little gel girls for us!"

rows.original: doing what you do.
rows.translation: 做你一直在做的事。
rows.raw: " doing what you do."

rows.original: You find yourself pondering the very nature of these long pauses you go through with Quaelle. If you free yourself from impatience, those niggling, very human compulsions to do something, anything with your time, it is quite peaceful to just sit with the friendly roehm. Zen-like. But...
rows.translation: 你发现自己正在思索，与奎尔相处时这些漫长停顿的本质。只要摆脱不耐烦，也摆脱那种非得用时间做点什么，随便什么的恼人而极其人类的冲动，单纯陪这个友善的罗姆坐着其实相当宁静，近乎禅意。不过...
rows.raw: "You find yourself pondering the very nature of these long pauses you go through with Quaelle. If you free yourself from impatience, those niggling, very human compulsions to do something, anything with your time, it is quite peaceful to just sit with the friendly roehm. Zen-like. But..."

rows.original: “Surely there are downsides to being such a slow race,” you say. “You’d be useless in a war. What if another race or government decides it’s going to own you?”
rows.translation: “行动如此缓慢的种族肯定也有缺点吧，”你说道。“你们在战争里毫无用处。要是另一个种族或政府决定占有你们，怎么办？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Surely there are downsides to being such a slow race,” you say. “You’d be useless in a war. What if another race or government decides it’s going to own you?”"

rows.original: “We already know, because we’ve already gone through it, erratisome Steele,” Quaelle replies, smiling gently. “We were uplifted by the Orchans many centuries ago, when they were at the height of their power. A military coup put in place an orchan supremacist leadership, that wished to expand greatly and dominate those worlds it deemed under its control. They greatly restricted roehm rights and ability to travel, and built contraltic colonies and vibrantless monuments across Hdar-Roe itself. It was a very bad time.”
rows.translation: “我们已经知道答案了，因为我们早就经历过，飘忽不定的斯蒂尔，”奎尔温柔地微笑着答道。“许多世纪以前，奥尔坎人在国力最鼎盛时提升了我们。后来，一场军事政变扶植起奉行奥尔坎至上主义的领导层；他们希望大举扩张，支配那些被其视作控制范围内的世界。他们严重限制罗姆的权利和旅行自由，还在赫达尔-罗本土各处修建压抑的殖民地与毫无生机的纪念碑。那是一段非常糟糕的时期。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We already know, because we’ve already gone through it, erratisome Steele,” Quaelle replies, smiling gently. “We were uplifted by the Orchans many centuries ago, when they were at the height of their power. A military coup put in place an orchan supremacist leadership, that wished to expand greatly and dominate those worlds it deemed under its control. They greatly restricted roehm rights and ability to travel, and built contraltic colonies and vibrantless monuments across Hdar-Roe itself. It was a very bad time.”"

rows.original: “What did you do?”
rows.translation: “你做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What did you do?”"

rows.original: “We waited.”
rows.translation: “我们等了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We waited.”"

rows.original: As if to reinforce her point, Quaelle inhales another mouthful of green leaves. You watch, and wait, as she peacefully munches.
rows.translation: 仿佛为了加强自己的论点，奎尔又把一口绿叶吸进嘴里。你看着她安详地咀嚼，同时耐心等待。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs if to reinforce her point, Quaelle inhales another mouthful of green leaves. You watch, and wait, as she peacefully munches."

rows.original: “Eventually, the orchan supremacists went the way of all shudderific, destructive movements,” she goes on, after she’s swallowed. “They bankrupted themselves over-extending, started a war with the Camarilla when they couldn’t pay back their loans, and were defeated by the Tove’s mercenary army. Today the orchans are a fringe race - they are great gene-mod experimenters, because the tastes and ways of the galaxy have left them behind. Their monuments on Hdar-Roe? Hmmmm. I’ve read an ancient human poem that describes them very well.” She blinks her spectacular, double-pupiled eyes at you. “When you live for much longer than most species, you gain a different perspective. All things pass. We can wait.”
rows.translation: “最终，奥坎至上主义者走上了所有震颤不已的破坏性运动都会走的老路，”她咽下食物后继续说道。“他们因过度扩张而破产；无力偿还贷款后，又与卡玛利拉开战，最终被托芙的雇佣军击败。如今奥坎已是一个边缘种族——他们热衷于基因改造实验，因为银河系的品味与潮流早已把他们抛在身后。他们在赫达-罗的纪念碑？嗯——。我读过一首古代人类诗歌，对它们的描述十分贴切。”她眨着那双惊艳的双瞳眼睛望向你。“当你的寿命远比大多数物种漫长，就会获得不同的视角。万事终将逝去。我们可以等待。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eventually, the orchan supremacists went the way of all shudderific, destructive movements,” she goes on, after she’s swallowed. “They bankrupted themselves over-extending, started a war with the Camarilla when they couldn’t pay back their loans, and were defeated by the Tove’s mercenary army. Today the orchans are a fringe race - they are great gene-mod experimenters, because the tastes and ways of the galaxy have left them behind. Their monuments on Hdar-Roe? Hmmmm. I’ve read an ancient human poem that describes them very well.” She blinks her spectacular, double-pupiled eyes at you. “When you live for much longer than most species, you gain a different perspective. All things pass. We can wait.”"

rows.original: You’re not sure you buy this philosophy of complacency.
rows.translation: 你不确定自己是否认同这种安于现状的哲学。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure you buy this philosophy of complacency."

rows.original: “What if these orchan race warriors had decided to wipe you all out?” you ask. “What then?”
rows.translation: “要是这些奥坎种族主义战士决定把你们全都消灭呢？”你问。“那时怎么办？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What if these orchan race warriors had decided to wipe you all out?” you ask. “What then?”"

rows.original: “But they didn’t,” replies the roehm, antennae waving curiously.
rows.translation: “可他们没有啊，”这个罗姆答道，触角好奇地摆动着。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But they didn’t,” replies the roehm, antennae waving curiously."

rows.original: “But. What. If. They. Had,” you persist. “You can’t sit and wait for things to work out on its own in every case, that’s insane!”
rows.translation: “可。要。是。他。们。真。这。么。做。了。呢，”你坚持追问。“你不可能每次都坐着等事情自行解决，那太疯狂了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But. What. If. They. Had,” you persist. “You can’t sit and wait for things to work out on its own in every case, that’s insane!”"

rows.original: “Shiverous Steele...” Quaelle smiles at you with infuriating compassion and kindness. “...what if you kill yourself careening fluctacularly around the frontier as you do? What if you and all of your crew wind up enslaved to a cruel and terrible pirate lord? With your skills and upbringing, you could find a safe and peaceful living in the core. This has all occurred to you, I’m sure. And yet you act as you do, flickersome and humful nonetheless, because you are the child of your parents, and can do nothing other.”
rows.translation: “颤动迷人的斯蒂尔...”奎尔以令人恼火的同情与和善朝你微笑。“...要是你继续像现在这样，跌跌撞撞、起伏不定地闯荡边疆，最后害死自己呢？要是你和全体船员最终被某个残忍可怕的海盗领主奴役呢？凭你的本领和出身，本可以在核心星域过上安全平静的生活。我相信你肯定考虑过这些。可你仍旧如此行事，依然跃动不止、哼鸣不停，因为你是父母的孩子，根本无法成为别的样子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shiverous Steele...” Quaelle smiles at you with infuriating compassion and kindness. “...what if you kill yourself careening fluctacularly around the frontier as you do? What if you and all of your crew wind up enslaved to a cruel and terrible pirate lord? With your skills and upbringing, you could find a safe and peaceful living in the core. This has all occurred to you, I’m sure. And yet you act as you do, flickersome and humful nonetheless, because you are the child of your parents, and can do nothing other.”"

rows.original: She laughs. “Hmm. Hmm. Hmm.”
rows.translation: 她笑了。“嗯。嗯。嗯。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs. “Hmm. Hmm. Hmm.”"

rows.original: “And I adore you, and all others like you! How lovely to see you stride about impetuously, vibrosely, magnificently uncaring of your impending doom! Please - don’t ask why roehm act like we do. Simply marvel at the differences that make this throbbulent galaxy so beautiful.”
rows.translation: “而我爱慕你，也爱慕所有与你相似的人！看着你冲动、颤动、气势非凡地大步前行，对迫近的厄运毫不在意，这是多么美妙！请不要问罗姆为什么会有这样的行为。只需惊叹于这些差异，正是它们让这个搏动不已的银河如此美丽。”
