rows.original: “Emmmmmm. Hellooooo, trembulous Steeeeeeeele.”
rows.translation: “嗯——。你——好啊，颤抖不已的斯——蒂——尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Emmmmmm. Hellooooo, trembulous Steeeeeeeele.”"

rows.original: The big, yellow roehm is laid out on her side in her cushioned bed pit, dressed in a long, flowery gown sort of garment. It does nothing to disguise how bloated she has become, both her front abdomen and her wide, wet tail packed and taut with pregnancy, making her look somewhat like a caterpillar that just went beast mode on a banana tree. Her breasts and face, too, look flush and swollen, ripe and heavy. The only part of her that still looks happy to move are her antennae, waggling away happily, currently pointed in your direction. The bed pit is surrounded by half-eaten pot plants.
rows.translation: 这个黄色的大罗姆侧躺在铺满软垫的床坑中，穿着一件长长的花卉图案长袍似服装。这完全遮不住她变得多么臃肿：她前腹与宽阔湿润的尾部都因怀孕而塞得又满又紧，让她看起来活像一只在香蕉树上暴食过的毛毛虫。她的乳房和脸也显得红润肿胀，成熟而沉重。全身唯有触角仍乐意活动，此刻正欢快地摆动并指向你。床坑周围摆满了吃掉一半的盆栽。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe big, yellow roehm is laid out on her side in her cushioned bed pit, dressed in a long, flowery gown sort of garment. It does nothing to disguise how bloated she has become, both her front abdomen and her wide, wet tail packed and taut with pregnancy, making her look somewhat like a caterpillar that just went beast mode on a banana tree. Her breasts and face, too, look flush and swollen, ripe and heavy. The only part of her that still looks happy to move are her antennae, waggling away happily, currently pointed in your direction. The bed pit is surrounded by half-eaten pot plants."

rows.original: “If roehm get pregnant in both their woooombs,” she says, hands on her belly, “it’s traditional for themmm to gather together foooood and then hibernate until it is oooooover.” It’s like listening to a recording slowed down for effect. “I thooouuuught that was a little extremmmme when I read about it, but now... hmmmmmmm.”
rows.translation: “如果罗姆的两个子——宫都怀孕了，”她双手放在腹部说道，“传统上她们会一起收集食——物，然后冬眠到一切结——束。”听起来就像一段为了效果而放慢的录音。“我读到这件事时，觉——得它有点太极——端了，可现在...嗯——。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If roehm get pregnant in both their woooombs,” she says, hands on her belly, “it’s traditional for themmm to gather together foooood and then hibernate until it is oooooover.” It’s like listening to a recording slowed down for effect. “I thooouuuught that was a little extremmmme when I read about it, but now... hmmmmmmm.”"

rows.original: She closes her eyes for so long that you think she’s drifted off.
rows.translation: 她闭眼闭了太久，让你以为她已经睡着了。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe closes her eyes for so long that you think she’s drifted off."

rows.original: “I’m afraid I woooonnn’t be much fuuuuuun in this state, lovely, shiverous Steele,” she sighs at last, blue eyes opening to regard you. She sounds faintly embarrassed. “Buuuuut... would you like to staaaaay? We can watch something. I’d like that.” Another long, sleepy pause. “I’d like to hooooold you,” she whispers.
rows.translation: “恐怕我现——在不会太有——趣，亲爱的、颤动迷人的斯蒂尔，”她终于叹道，睁开蓝眼睛望向你。她的语气略显难为情。“不——过...你愿意留——下来吗？我们可以看点东西。我会喜欢的。”又是一阵漫长困倦的停顿。“我想抱——着你，”她低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m afraid I woooonnn’t be much fuuuuuun in this state, lovely, shiverous Steele,” she sighs at last, blue eyes opening to regard you. She sounds faintly embarrassed. “Buuuuut... would you like to staaaaay? We can watch something. I’d like that.” Another long, sleepy pause. “I’d like to hooooold you,” she whispers."

rows.original: You head past reception and down the ramp into the living quarters. You enter Quaelle’s dim, humid apartment cautiously.
rows.translation: 你穿过接待区，沿坡道走进生活区。你小心翼翼地进入奎尔昏暗潮湿的公寓。
rows.raw: "You head past reception and down the ramp into the living quarters. You enter Quaelle’s dim, humid apartment cautiously."

rows.original: “I caaaaaan’t believe I let you dooooooo thissss to me agaaaiiiiin,” moans Quaelle. She is, once again, utterly engorged with pregnancy, her front belly watermelon-like in size, the middle of her lower body bulging with growing life. “I can baaaaarely move, and aalll I want to do is eat and...”
rows.translation: “真不敢相——信我又让你对我做——了这——种事，”奎尔呻吟道。她又一次因为怀孕而彻底肿胀，前腹大如西瓜，下半身中段也因其中成长的生命而隆起。“我几——乎动不了，而且我只——想吃东西然后...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I caaaaaan’t believe I let you dooooooo thissss to me agaaaiiiiin,” moans Quaelle. She is, once again, utterly engorged with pregnancy, her front belly watermelon-like in size, the middle of her lower body bulging with growing life. “I can baaaaarely move, and aalll I want to do is eat and...”"

rows.original: She pauses and closes her eyes for at least twenty seconds.
rows.translation: 她停下来，闭眼至少二十秒。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses and closes her eyes for at least twenty seconds."

rows.original: She manages to wave the very tip of her blunt tail at you.
rows.translation: 她勉强朝你摆了摆钝尾巴的最尖端。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe manages to wave the very tip of her blunt tail at you."

rows.original: “You’ll staaaay for a little while, won’t you?” she asks. “I’ll put sooomething on. I’d just liiiike to hold you. Please?”
rows.translation: “你会留——一会儿的，对吧？”她问。“我会放点什——么来看。我只——想抱着你。好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ll staaaay for a little while, won’t you?” she asks. “I’ll put sooomething on. I’d just liiiike to hold you. Please?”"

rows.original: (You think she’s quietly enjoying this. Certainly it’s giving her a great excuse to be even more sluggardly than usual.)
rows.translation: （你觉得她暗地里其实很享受这样。毕竟，这无疑给了她一个绝佳借口，让她比平时更加懒散。）
rows.raw: "\n\n(You think she’s quietly enjoying this. Certainly it’s giving her a great excuse to be even more sluggardly than usual.)"

rows.original: You head past reception, down the ramp into the living quarters, and from there into Quaelle’s dim, damp quarters.
rows.translation: 你穿过接待区，沿坡道进入生活区，再从那里走进奎尔昏暗潮湿的住所。
rows.raw: "You head past reception, down the ramp into the living quarters, and from there into Quaelle’s dim, damp quarters."

rows.original: “Ohh helloooooo, trembulous Steeeeeeele!”
rows.translation: “哦——你——好啊，颤抖不已的斯——蒂——尔！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohh helloooooo, trembulous Steeeeeeele!”"

rows.original: Quaelle is still pooled into her cushioned bed pit, a great wet yellow mass of pregnant, hormonal feminineness. Somehow she looks even more swollen than the last time you saw her.
rows.translation: 奎尔仍摊在铺满软垫的床坑中，是一大团湿漉漉、黄澄澄、怀着孕且荷尔蒙旺盛的女性肉体。不知怎的，她看起来比你上次见她时更加肿胀。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuaelle is still pooled into her cushioned bed pit, a great wet yellow mass of pregnant, hormonal feminineness. Somehow she looks even more swollen than the last time you saw her."

rows.original: “I’m sooooo glad you visited,” she smiles. “You brought some snugglesssss, didn’t you? Please say yeesssssss.”
rows.translation: “真——高兴你来看我，”她笑道。“你带了些抱——抱来的，对吧？请说是——的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sooooo glad you visited,” she smiles. “You brought some snugglesssss, didn’t you? Please say yeesssssss.”"

rows.original: Bath
rows.translation: 沐浴
rows.raw: "Bath"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Beyond the staff only door of Breedwell’s reception area there’s a small storage area and a ramp which leads further into the bowels of the station, all clad in the same spotless, well-lit white that is the trademark everywhere. Down the ramp is a long corridor of doors: entrances to the apartments where the mostly rahn staff of Breedwell live.
rows.translation: 在布里德韦尔接待区的员工专用门后，有一小片储藏区和一条通往空间站更深处的坡道；各处都覆着同样一尘不染、灯火通明的白色，这是这里随处可见的标志。坡道下方是一条布满房门的长廊：那些主要由拉恩组成的布里德韦尔员工就住在这些公寓里。
rows.raw: "Beyond the staff only door of Breedwell’s reception area there’s a small storage area and a ramp which leads further into the bowels of the station, all clad in the same spotless, well-lit white that is the trademark everywhere. Down the ramp is a long corridor of doors: entrances to the apartments where the mostly rahn staff of Breedwell live."

rows.original: Most of the otherwise featureless doors are decorated, and you’d know which one was Quaelle’s even if you didn’t apply the logic that it’s probably the one the shortest distance from Reception. The nearest is surrounded in a glistening, ivy-like vine and flanked by hanging baskets containing brightly colored flowers and drooping ferns. It opens with a quiet hiss when you approach it, and as you step through you’re enveloped by tropical heat and humidity.
rows.translation: 大多数原本毫无特色的房门都装饰过；即便不用“奎尔大概住在离接待处最近的房间”这番推理，你也能认出哪扇是她的。最近的那扇门周围爬着闪闪发亮、形似常春藤的藤蔓，两侧悬篮里装着鲜艳花朵和低垂蕨类。你靠近时，门伴着轻微嘶声开启；迈进去后，热带的高温与湿气立即将你包围。
rows.raw: "\n\nMost of the otherwise featureless doors are decorated, and you’d know which one was Quaelle’s even if you didn’t apply the logic that it’s probably the one the shortest distance from Reception. The nearest is surrounded in a glistening, ivy-like vine and flanked by hanging baskets containing brightly colored flowers and drooping ferns. It opens with a quiet hiss when you approach it, and as you step through you’re enveloped by tropical heat and humidity."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “My vibrose lover,” says Quaelle, antennae wriggling excitedly in your direction when you approach the front desk. She’s oozing with happiness, and you can see for yourself why:
rows.translation: “我那颤动迷人的爱人，”你走近前台时，奎尔说道，触角兴奋地朝你扭动。她洋溢着幸福，而你一眼便能看出原因：
rows.raw: "“My vibrose lover,” says Quaelle, antennae wriggling excitedly in your direction when you approach the front desk. She’s oozing with happiness, and you can see for yourself why:"

rows.original: Her pudgy stomach has taken on a fresh tautness, stretching the waterproof fabric of her dress. Not only that, her lower body is swollen around the midriff, as if she had eaten a tree-load of leaves in preparation for forming a cocoon.
rows.translation: 她胖乎乎的肚子新添了一份紧绷感，将裙子的防水布料撑开。不仅如此，她下半身的腰腹也肿了起来，仿佛为了结茧而吃掉了整整一棵树的叶子。
rows.raw: " Her pudgy stomach has taken on a fresh tautness, stretching the waterproof fabric of her dress. Not only that, her lower body is swollen around the midriff, as if she had eaten a tree-load of leaves in preparation for forming a cocoon."

rows.original: Her pudgy stomach has taken on a new tautness, stretching the waterproof fabric of her dress.
rows.translation: 她胖乎乎的肚子新添了一份紧绷感，将裙子的防水布料撑开。
rows.raw: " Her pudgy stomach has taken on a new tautness, stretching the waterproof fabric of her dress."

rows.original: Her big, soft lower body is swollen around the midriff, as if she had eaten a tree-load of leaves in preparation for forming a cocoon.
rows.translation: 她柔软庞大的下半身腰腹肿了起来，仿佛为了结茧而吃掉了整整一棵树的叶子。
rows.raw: " Her big, soft lower body is swollen around the midriff, as if she had eaten a tree-load of leaves in preparation for forming a cocoon."

rows.original: “I cannot believe this is finally happening for me,” the roehm says, hand drifting
rows.translation: “我不敢相信这件事终于发生在我身上了，”这个罗姆说道，手缓缓移向
rows.raw: "\n\n“I cannot believe this is finally happening for me,” the roehm says, hand drifting"

rows.original: over her stomach.
rows.translation: 她的肚子。
rows.raw: " over her stomach."

rows.original: along her tail.
rows.translation: 她的尾部。
rows.raw: " along her tail."

rows.original: “It is strange. I have been surrounded by pregnancy ever since I started working here. I imagined I would find the whole thing normalized, monoceptive and simple... but it is not. It becomes something else, when the life is growing inside of you.” She strokes herself, lost in a marvelling reverie, before blinking and returning her double-pupiled eyes to you, warmth and happiness radiating out of her pleasant face.
rows.translation: “真奇怪。自从开始在这里工作，我就一直被怀孕的人包围着。我原以为自己会觉得整件事稀松平常、单一而简单...可事实并非如此。当生命在你体内成长时，它就成了另一种东西。”她抚摸着自己，沉浸在惊叹的遐想中；随后她眨眨眼，双瞳眼睛重新望向你，和煦的脸庞洋溢着温暖与幸福。
rows.raw: "“It is strange. I have been surrounded by pregnancy ever since I started working here. I imagined I would find the whole thing normalized, monoceptive and simple... but it is not. It becomes something else, when the life is growing inside of you.” She strokes herself, lost in a marvelling reverie, before blinking and returning her double-pupiled eyes to you, warmth and happiness radiating out of her pleasant face."

rows.original: “Thank you for visiting, shiverous Steele. You have other business here I’m sure... but you’ll sit with me for a little while, won’t you?”
rows.translation: “谢谢你来看我，颤动迷人的斯蒂尔。我知道你在这里还有别的事情...但你会陪我坐一会儿的，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you for visiting, shiverous Steele. You have other business here I’m sure... but you’ll sit with me for a little while, won’t you?”"

rows.raw: "“Here [pc.he] is,” Quaelle says, antennae wriggling excitedly in your direction when you approach the front desk. “My vibrose lover. My fruillisome lover.” It’s said loudly and with pride, and you can see why; already"

rows.original: the front of her dress stretches with the weight of another baby and her wide, undulating midriff is unmistakable swollen, heavy with child.
rows.translation: 裙子前襟因另一个孩子的重量而绷紧，宽阔起伏的腰腹也明显肿胀，沉甸甸地怀着孩子。
rows.raw: " the front of her dress stretches with the weight of another baby and her wide, undulating midriff is unmistakable swollen, heavy with child."

rows.original: the front of her dress stretches with the weight of another baby.

rows.raw: " the front of her dress stretches with the weight of another baby."

rows.original: her wide, undulating midriff is unmistakable swollen, heavy with child.
rows.translation: 她宽阔起伏的腰腹明显肿胀，沉甸甸地怀着孩子。
rows.raw: " her wide, undulating midriff is unmistakable swollen, heavy with child."

rows.original: “You are insatiable,” she beams. She seems much calmer about this than with her first pregnancy - although as ever with Quaelle, calm is simply a matter of degrees. “I wonder sometimes if I have borne enough... but then you [pc.move] through that door, and my epidermis shivers, cries out to make another with you.” Warmth and happiness radiate out of her pleasant face.
rows.translation: “你真是欲壑难填，”她笑容灿烂。相比第一次怀孕，她对此显得平静多了——尽管对奎尔而言，所谓平静永远只是程度问题。“我有时会想，自己生得是否已经够多了...可随后你[pc.move]进那扇门，我的表皮便开始颤抖，呼喊着要与你再孕育一个孩子。”她和煦的脸庞洋溢着温暖与幸福。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are insatiable,” she beams. She seems much calmer about this than with her first pregnancy - although as ever with Quaelle, calm is simply a matter of degrees. “I wonder sometimes if I have borne enough... but then you [pc.move] through that door, and my epidermis shivers, cries out to make another with you.” Warmth and happiness radiate out of her pleasant face."

rows.original: “You have other business here I’m sure... but you’ll sit with me for a little while, won’t you?”
rows.translation: “我知道你在这里还有别的事情...但你会陪我坐一会儿的，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You have other business here I’m sure... but you’ll sit with me for a little while, won’t you?”"

rows.original: QuaellePregnancy
rows.raw: "QuaellePregnancy"

rows.original: “Vibrantic Steele! You are... is that...?” Quaelle wrings her hands, antennae ashiver, very un-roehm-like in her anxious wonder as she gazes down at your [pc.belly]. You smile at her, draw close to her slimy bulk so that she can have a stroke. Her wet, warm hand moves across your growing bulge.
rows.translation: “活力四射的斯蒂尔！你...那是...？”奎尔绞着双手，触角颤抖；她怀着焦虑而惊奇的神情低头凝视你的[pc.belly]，表现得很不像罗姆。你朝她微笑，贴近她黏滑的庞大身体，好让她抚摸。她湿润温暖的手滑过你渐渐隆起的腹部。
rows.raw: "“Vibrantic Steele! You are... is that...?” Quaelle wrings her hands, antennae ashiver, very un-roehm-like in her anxious wonder as she gazes down at your [pc.belly]. You smile at her, draw close to her slimy bulk so that she can have a stroke. Her wet, warm hand moves across your growing bulge."

rows.original: “I never imagined it would be this way,” she murmurs, lost in a reverie. She seems unable to take her eyes off your stomach. “I was prepared for my body to grow fat with tumbulous life. All those extranet videos I watched, how to prepare for it! But...” she raises her double-pupiled eyes to meet yours, smiling. “That was foolish of me, wasn’t it? Hoping to meet someone in this place of all places, expecting that was how my partner would wish it to be. It’s strange but... wonderful.”
rows.translation: “我从没想过事情会变成这样，”她沉浸在遐想中喃喃道，似乎无法把目光从你的腹部移开。“我原本准备好让自己的身体因颤动的生命而发胖。我看了那么多讲解准备方法的外网视频！可是...”她抬起双瞳眼睛与你对视，露出微笑。“我真傻，对吧？竟希望在这种地方遇到某个人，还以为我的伴侣会希望以那种方式进行。虽然奇怪，但是...很美妙。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I never imagined it would be this way,” she murmurs, lost in a reverie. She seems unable to take her eyes off your stomach. “I was prepared for my body to grow fat with tumbulous life. All those extranet videos I watched, how to prepare for it! But...” she raises her double-pupiled eyes to meet yours, smiling. “That was foolish of me, wasn’t it? Hoping to meet someone in this place of all places, expecting that was how my partner would wish it to be. It’s strange but... wonderful.”"

rows.original: She sighs happily, and then withdraws her hand.
rows.translation: 她幸福地叹息一声，随后收回手。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs happily, and then withdraws her hand."

rows.original: “Thank you for visiting, shiverous Steele. You have other business here I’m sure... but you’ll sit with me for a little while, won’t you?”
rows.translation: “谢谢你来看我，颤动迷人的斯蒂尔。我知道你在这里还有别的事情...但你会陪我坐一会儿的，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you for visiting, shiverous Steele. You have other business here I’m sure... but you’ll sit with me for a little while, won’t you?”"

rows.original: “Shiverous Steele.” Quaelle gives you a wide smile when she catches sight of you - and your [pc.belly]. “That’s mine, isn’t it? I can tell. I can feel it on the tips of my antennae... come here. Let me feel.”
rows.translation: “颤动迷人的斯蒂尔。”奎尔一看到你——以及你的[pc.belly]——便朝你露出灿烂笑容。“那是我的，对吧？我能分辨出来，触角尖端能感觉到...过来，让我摸摸。”
rows.raw: "“Shiverous Steele.” Quaelle gives you a wide smile when she catches sight of you - and your [pc.belly]. “That’s mine, isn’t it? I can tell. I can feel it on the tips of my antennae... come here. Let me feel.”"

rows.original: You come across and let her lay her eager hands upon the burgeoning weight in your womb, warm, sweet smoothness circling across your taut [pc.skin]. Mmm... almost as nice as getting coconut oil rubbed on it.
rows.translation: 你走过去，让她急切的双手抚上子宫里日渐增长的重量；温暖甜美的光滑触感在你紧绷的[pc.skin]上打着圈。嗯...几乎和在上面涂抹椰子油一样舒服。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou come across and let her lay her eager hands upon the burgeoning weight in your womb, warm, sweet smoothness circling across your taut [pc.skin]. Mmm... almost as nice as getting coconut oil rubbed on it."

rows.original: “How are you feeling?” she asks. “Are you eating well? You’re taking a bottle of water everywhere you go, aren’t you? You should exercise frequently but gently, and rest at regular intervals. Would you like me to type up a schedule for you?” On and on go the matronly instructions as she continues to rub you, until at last she subsides into amiable silence.
rows.translation: “你感觉怎么样？”她问。“吃得好吗？你无论去哪里都随身带着一瓶水，对吧？你应该经常做些轻柔的运动，并定时休息。要我为你列一份日程表吗？”她一边继续抚摸你，一边没完没了地给出这些慈母般的叮嘱，最后才归于亲切的沉默。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How are you feeling?” she asks. “Are you eating well? You’re taking a bottle of water everywhere you go, aren’t you? You should exercise frequently but gently, and rest at regular intervals. Would you like me to type up a schedule for you?” On and on go the matronly instructions as she continues to rub you, until at last she subsides into amiable silence."

rows.original: “I’d prefer you to stay here, where I could keep an eye on you...” your brightly-colored sugar sluggy sighs, withdrawing her paw. “I worry a lot, hmm, you running around the frontier. But... you are a flickersome creature, I know. I made my peace with that when I decided to have children with you.” She smiles at you lovingly. “And I wouldn’t change anything about you.”
rows.translation: “我更希望你留在这里，让我能照看你...”你那色彩鲜艳的甜糖蛞蝓叹道，收回了爪子。“你在边疆四处奔波，我很担心，嗯。可是...我知道你是个闲不住的生物。当我决定与你生育孩子时，我就接受了这点。”她深情地朝你微笑。“而且我不会想改变你的任何地方。”

rows.original: A short distance down a corridor from the breeding pod chamber, Breedwell opens out into a massive, airy, state-of-the-art natal wing, dazzling white and gleaming chrome stretching out as far as the eye can see, synth windows opposite looking out upon space and the sand-colored gas giant the station is orbiting.
rows.translation: 沿着一条走廊，从育种舱室走出不远，布里德韦尔便豁然展开为一座巨大、通透、技术先进的产科翼楼；耀眼白色与闪亮铬面一直延伸到视野尽头，对面的合成窗则望向太空，以及空间站所环绕的沙色气态巨行星。
rows.raw: "A short distance down a corridor from the breeding pod chamber, Breedwell opens out into a massive, airy, state-of-the-art natal wing, dazzling white and gleaming chrome stretching out as far as the eye can see, synth windows opposite looking out upon space and the sand-colored gas giant the station is orbiting."

rows.original: From your position halfway up one curving wall, you can see various glass-fronted cylinders that reach from the floor to the ceiling, each the size of an apartment building. Within you can see staff both mechanical and organic busying themselves with rahn babies and children, brightly colored jelly beans which stand out against the clinical whites and silvers of the architecture and equipment. You can see nurseries, schools, play areas and dormitories on various different floors, all of them busy with rahn both young and old. This is a hell of an operation.
rows.translation: 从弧形墙面半腰处的位置，你能看到许多从地面直达天花板、正面镶着玻璃的圆柱体，每一个都有公寓楼那么大。里面的机械与有机员工都在忙着照料拉恩婴儿和儿童；那些色彩鲜艳的软糖豆，在建筑和设备的临床白色与银色之间格外醒目。不同楼层上分布着托儿所、学校、游乐区和宿舍，每一处都有年轻或年长的拉恩忙碌其中。这套体系的规模真是惊人。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom your position halfway up one curving wall, you can see various glass-fronted cylinders that reach from the floor to the ceiling, each the size of an apartment building. Within you can see staff both mechanical and organic busying themselves with rahn babies and children, brightly colored jelly beans which stand out against the clinical whites and silvers of the architecture and equipment. You can see nurseries, schools, play areas and dormitories on various different floors, all of them busy with rahn both young and old. This is a hell of an operation."

rows.original: You are, fortunately, in the best place it’s possible to be to give birth. A quick tap on your alarm button is enough to summon Briget, who takes charge with comforting crispiness, telling you exactly what to do.
rows.translation: 幸好，你身处的地方是所有可能的分娩地点中最理想的一处。轻按一下警报按钮便足以叫来布里吉特；她以令人安心的干练态度接管一切，清楚告诉你该做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou are, fortunately, in the best place it’s possible to be to give birth. A quick tap on your alarm button is enough to summon Briget, who takes charge with comforting crispiness, telling you exactly what to do."

rows.original: As quickly as you can, you waddle into the nearest restroom, grab the medkit drone off the wall (frontier bathrooms are thankfully readily equipped for this sort of thing), lock yourself in a cubicle and spread your [pc.thighs], biological imperative virtually ordering you what to do.
rows.translation: 你以最快速度蹒跚走进最近的卫生间，从墙上取下医疗箱无人机（谢天谢地，边疆的卫生间通常配备应对此类情况的装置），把自己锁进隔间并张开[pc.thighs]，生理本能几乎在命令你该怎么做。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs quickly as you can, you waddle into the nearest restroom, grab the medkit drone off the wall (frontier bathrooms are thankfully readily equipped for this sort of thing), lock yourself in a cubicle and spread your [pc.thighs], biological imperative virtually ordering you what to do."

rows.original: position yourself the best you can in the inhospitable terrain. You wish you’d obeyed your deeper instincts and found somewhere safe and warm to do this, but there’s no helping it now -- you’ll have to deliver on your own.
rows.translation: 尽可能在这片恶劣地形上摆好姿势。你真希望自己听从了更深层的本能，找个安全温暖的地方做这件事，可如今已无可挽回——你只能独自分娩。
rows.raw: " position yourself the best you can in the inhospitable terrain. You wish you’d obeyed your deeper instincts and found somewhere safe and warm to do this, but there’s no helping it now -- you’ll have to deliver on your own."

rows.original: The nurse droid monitors your pulse and places a large sheet beneath your thighs, instructing you to bear down rhythmically with soft, firm assertions. You push, shoving down on the huge, soft weight in your womb, the pressure building and building, your cervix and vagina dilating beyond the point you thought possible... and then, in a great, long ‘schlorp’, your child comes loose, gliding with boneless ease like an otter off a river bank into the great, wide world.
rows.translation: 护理机器人监测着你的脉搏，在大腿下铺开一张大垫单，并以轻柔而坚定的陈述指导你有节奏地用力。你开始推动，把子宫中那团巨大柔软的重量向下挤压；压力不断积聚，子宫颈与阴道扩张到你从未想过的程度...随后，伴着一声漫长响亮的“噗溜”，你的孩子挣脱出来，像水獭从河岸滑入水中一般，柔若无骨地滑进这个广阔世界。

rows.original: She is soft and pliant but oh, there’s so much of her! You grunt, sweat running down your reddened face as you push more and more of that thick body, that long, blunt tail past your painfully stretched lips. You hear her cry whilst you’re still bearing her out - it sounds more like sleepy surprise than a baby’s usual cry of frightened indignation - and it’s only after long, shattering minutes of exertion that you can finally prop yourself up, gather her
rows.translation: 她柔软而顺从，可是，天啊，她的身体实在太多了！你低声用力，汗水沿着涨红的脸庞流下，将那粗壮身体与长长钝尾越来越多地推出被痛苦撑开的阴唇。你还在把她娩出时就听见她哭了——那声音更像困倦的惊讶，而不是婴儿通常那种受惊而愤怒的哭喊——直到经历漫长而令人崩溃的数分钟用力后，你终于能撑起身体，将她

rows.original: , slimy-skinned gastropod girl, the edge of her foot rippling up and down, the wondering gaze of her brilliant, double-pupiled eyes split between her slowly flexing fingers and your face, trying to make sense of it all. Her antennae are still slicked down, but even as you watch they begin to come loose, getting ready to stretch out and tune into the quivers and tremors of the universe.
rows.translation: ，这个皮肤黏滑的腹足族女孩，足缘上下起伏；她那双璀璨的双瞳眼带着惊奇，视线在缓缓屈伸的手指与你的脸之间来回移动，努力理解眼前的一切。她的触须仍湿漉漉地贴伏着，但就在你注视时，它们已经开始松脱，准备伸展出去，调谐宇宙中的颤动与震颤。

rows.original: The great, yellow bulk of Quaelle dominates the nursery. One of her daughters curled in her arms, she radiates tropical happiness.
rows.translation: 奎尔庞大的黄色身躯占据了育儿室。她的一个女儿蜷在她怀里。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe great, yellow bulk of Quaelle dominates the nursery. One of her daughters curled in her arms, she radiates tropical happiness."

rows.original: “You are sooooo fortunate,” she sighs, booping the nose of the cooing slug baby. “If I were able to visit this place freely, I would never leave.
rows.translation: “你实在太——幸运了，”她叹息着，轻点咕咕叫的蛞蝓宝宝鼻尖。“如果我能自由来这里，我就永远不会离开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are sooooo fortunate,” she sighs, booping the nose of the cooing slug baby. “If I were able to visit this place freely, I would never leave."

rows.original: pregnancy/total day care
rows.raw: "pregnancy/total day care"

rows.original: pregnancy/quaelle daughters
rows.raw: "pregnancy/quaelle daughters"

rows.original: And you have sooooo many children, fervotatious Steele! How do you cope with the thought of them? How do you not shiver out of your membrane with worry when you are away from them?
rows.translation: 而且你有这——么多孩子，热情洋溢的斯蒂尔！想到他们，你是怎么承受那份感情的？离开他们时，你怎么不会因为担忧而抖得脱离自己的薄膜？
rows.raw: " And you have sooooo many children, fervotatious Steele! How do you cope with the thought of them? How do you not shiver out of your membrane with worry when you are away from them?"

rows.original: She’s warped across from Breedwell on her free day. She’s spending it spoiling her babies with waterproof ribbons and blankets, raspberries delivered to their soft tummies, and the strange, slow, traditional games of the roehm, more about patience than recognition or coordination. Or maybe... those things through patience. You find yourself nodding off watching them; the effect of watching a roehm with her children is rather like whale music.
rows.translation: 她在休息日从布里德韦尔跃迁过来，把这一天全用来宠爱自己的宝宝们：给她们防水丝带与毯子，把树莓送到柔软小肚皮上，还陪她们玩罗姆那些奇异、缓慢的传统游戏。这些游戏相比识别力或协调性，更看重耐心。又或许...是通过耐心培养那些能力。你看着看着便开始打瞌睡；观看罗姆与孩子相处，效果颇像鲸歌。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s warped across from Breedwell on her free day. She’s spending it spoiling her babies with waterproof ribbons and blankets, raspberries delivered to their soft tummies, and the strange, slow, traditional games of the roehm, more about patience than recognition or coordination. Or maybe... those things through patience. You find yourself nodding off watching them; the effect of watching a roehm with her children is rather like whale music."

rows.original: They may not see her everyday, but Quaelle certainly knows how to ingratiate herself with her daughters. They coo and grow excited whenever she’s in eyeshot, and grow sulky and whiny when she leaves to quiz Briget hard about their feeding regimen.
rows.translation: 她们也许不能每天见到奎尔，但她显然很懂得如何讨女儿们喜欢。只要她进入视野，孩子们就会咕咕叫着兴奋起来；而当她离开、去仔细盘问布丽吉特她们的喂养方案时，孩子们便闷闷不乐地哼唧。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey may not see her everyday, but Quaelle certainly knows how to ingratiate herself with her daughters. They coo and grow excited whenever she’s in eyeshot, and grow sulky and whiny when she leaves to quiz Briget hard about their feeding regimen."

rows.original: “I will be here for, emmmmm, some time,” Quaelle says to you when she returns, with a glance at her miniature device. “You don’t mind, do you?”
rows.translation: “我会在这里待，嗯嗯嗯嗯，很久，”奎尔回来时看了一眼自己的微型设备，对你说道。“你不会介意吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I will be here for, emmmmm, some time,” Quaelle says to you when she returns, with a glance at her miniature device. “You don’t mind, do you?”"

rows.original: Of course not. You leave her singing a sweet, ponderous song over the cradles before you yourself are transported to sleep.
rows.translation: 你当然不会反对。离开前，你看见她在摇篮旁唱起一首甜美而缓慢的歌。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course not. You leave her singing a sweet, ponderous song over the cradles before you yourself are transported to sleep."

rows.original: “Shimmerlous Steele!”
rows.translation: “闪闪发亮的斯蒂尔！”
rows.raw: "“Shimmerlous Steele!”"

rows.original: Quaelle is here, her great, soft bulk filling the nursery. Evidently she’s warped over from Breedwell for the day. She looks startled to see you, which might have something to do with the fact she’s currently festooned in her babies. Limpeted to her yellow membrane, the tiny slug girls are babbling and cooing as they crawl interestedly over their parent’s body.
rows.translation: 奎尔就在这里，庞大柔软的身体塞满了育儿室。显然，她今天从布里德韦尔跃迁了过来。见到你时她吃了一惊，这也许和她此刻浑身挂满宝宝有关。小小的蛞蝓女孩们像帽贝一样吸附在她黄色薄膜上，一边咿呀咕咕叫，一边好奇地在母亲身上爬行。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuaelle is here, her great, soft bulk filling the nursery. Evidently she’s warped over from Breedwell for the day. She looks startled to see you, which might have something to do with the fact she’s currently festooned in her babies. Limpeted to her yellow membrane, the tiny slug girls are babbling and cooing as they crawl interestedly over their parent’s body."

rows.original: “This is, emmmmmm, how roehm mothers carry their children. Traditionally,” she says, antennae twitching. She looks very embarrassed. “I, emmmm... wanted to know what it felt like.”
rows.translation: “这就是，嗯嗯嗯嗯，罗姆母亲传统上携带孩子的方式，”她说道，触须抽动。她看起来非常尴尬。“我，嗯嗯嗯...只是想知道那是什么感觉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is, emmmmmm, how roehm mothers carry their children. Traditionally,” she says, antennae twitching. She looks very embarrassed. “I, emmmm... wanted to know what it felt like.”"

rows.original: She gets even more agitated when you take out your codex and take several pictures of the wiggly edifice of gastropodic softness, one of them taking Quaelle’s conch-like hat off and sinking it over her own head. It’s adorable.
rows.translation: 当你拿出电子书，给这座由腹足族柔软肉体组成的蠕动建筑连拍几张照片时，她变得更加不安；其中一个孩子摘下奎尔那顶海螺般的帽子，扣到自己头上。实在可爱极了。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gets even more agitated when you take out your codex and take several pictures of the wiggly edifice of gastropodic softness, one of them taking Quaelle’s conch-like hat off and sinking it over her own head. It’s adorable."

rows.original: “You... leave me alone now!” she half-laughs, half-scowls at you, waving her hands. “I need to put them to bed.”
rows.translation: “你...现在别管我啦！”她半笑半瞪地对你说道，挥动双手。“我得哄她们睡觉了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You... leave me alone now!” she half-laughs, half-scowls at you, waving her hands. “I need to put them to bed.”"

rows.original: The robotic staff could do that, of course, but you suspect Quaelle is in charge here for as long as she can possibly manage.
rows.translation: 机器人职员当然也能照料孩子，但你怀疑奎尔暂时完全掌控了这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe robotic staff could do that, of course, but you suspect Quaelle is in charge here for as long as she can possibly manage."

rows.original: Your gastropod daughters are still very young. They have their own squishy egg cup-shaped cribs in which they sleep, and occasionally throw their toys at the nurse staff from.
rows.translation: 你的腹足族女儿们仍很年幼。她们在育儿室里各有一张柔软、形似蛋杯的摇篮。
rows.raw: "Your gastropod daughters are still very young. They have their own squishy egg cup-shaped cribs in which they sleep, and occasionally throw their toys at the nurse staff from."

rows.original: Your gastropod daughter is still very young. She has her own squishy egg cup-shaped crib in which she sleeps, and occasionally throws her toys at the nurse staff from.
rows.translation: 你的腹足族女儿仍很年幼。她在育儿室里有一张柔软、形似蛋杯的摇篮。
rows.raw: "Your gastropod daughter is still very young. She has her own squishy egg cup-shaped crib in which she sleeps, and occasionally throws her toys at the nurse staff from."

rows.original: Some are asleep, but others grip their crib bars and raise their upper bodies up, regarding you with a multitude of strange, curious eyes as you approach. You are a curiosity to them - a creature quite different to any of the mostly robotic nurses, making incomprehensible vibrations when it opens its food hole - but a happy, diverting curiosity nonetheless.
rows.translation: 有些正在睡觉，另一些则抓住摇篮栏杆抬起上半身；你走近时，一大群奇异而好奇的眼睛注视着你。对她们而言，你是个稀奇事物——和那些以机器人为主的护士截然不同，会在张开进食孔时制造无法理解的振动——不过仍是个让她们开心、转移注意力的稀奇事物。
rows.raw: "\n\nSome are asleep, but others grip their crib bars and raise their upper bodies up, regarding you with a multitude of strange, curious eyes as you approach. You are a curiosity to them - a creature quite different to any of the mostly robotic nurses, making incomprehensible vibrations when it opens its food hole - but a happy, diverting curiosity nonetheless."

rows.original: They coo when you run your hands through their wave, sensitive cilia, and then you play with them for a bit, playing very slow patticake and word blocks, splitting your attention between each. Eventually a drone nurse declares its changing time. The roehm grouse wetly but gently as you leave them. They make for extremely good-natured infants.
rows.translation: 当你用手梳过她们波浪般敏感的纤毛时，她们咕咕叫起来；随后你陪她们玩了一阵，玩动作极慢的拍手游戏和字块游戏，把注意力分给每一个孩子。最后，一台护理无人机宣布到了换尿布时间。你离开时，罗姆们湿漉漉却温和地抱怨着。她们真是一群脾气极好的婴儿。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey coo when you run your hands through their wave, sensitive cilia, and then you play with them for a bit, playing very slow patticake and word blocks, splitting your attention between each. Eventually a drone nurse declares its changing time. The roehm grouse wetly but gently as you leave them. They make for extremely good-natured infants."

rows.original: They make wet farty noises and blow spit bubbles happily when they see you, peering over a shared crib’s edge with their dazzling blue eyes. You have to bear in mind they can’t hear anything you say - it’s just you opening your mouth and making strange vibrations to them - but they giggle happily when you run your hand through their sensitive cilia, and then play where’s-the-dolly with you.
rows.translation: 她们见到你时开心地发出湿漉漉的放屁声、吹起口水泡，用耀眼的蓝眼睛从共用摇篮边缘探头看你。你得记住，她们听不见你说的任何话——在她们看来，你只是张开嘴制造奇怪振动——但当你用手梳过敏感纤毛时，她们仍开心地咯咯笑，随后和你玩起“娃娃在哪里”。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey make wet farty noises and blow spit bubbles happily when they see you, peering over a shared crib’s edge with their dazzling blue eyes. You have to bear in mind they can’t hear anything you say - it’s just you opening your mouth and making strange vibrations to them - but they giggle happily when you run your hand through their sensitive cilia, and then play where’s-the-dolly with you."

rows.original: They don’t seem all that grumpy when the drone nurse declares it changing time, and ushers you out, simply waving their antennae at you as a goodbye. Roehm make for very good-natured children.
rows.translation: 当护理无人机宣布到了换尿布时间并把你请出去时，她们似乎并没有太不高兴，只是挥动触须向你道别。罗姆孩子的性情实在非常温和。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey don’t seem all that grumpy when the drone nurse declares it changing time, and ushers you out, simply waving their antennae at you as a goodbye. Roehm make for very good-natured children."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Roehm Kids
rows.translation: 罗姆孩子
rows.raw: "Roehm Kids"

rows.original: Quaelle is in the classroom, helping your roehm daughters with their Aural Perception Primary Training. They frown intently, antennae waving and curling at the long, cylindrical pulse-units at the front of the room, throbbing away whilst the rahn teacher faces them and care-full-ee ann-unn-see-ates eh-vurr-ee word.
rows.translation: 奎尔正在教室里，帮助你的罗姆女儿们完成“听觉感知入门”训练。她们专注地皱着眉，触须朝教室前方那些细长圆柱形的脉冲装置挥舞、卷曲；装置不断搏动，而拉恩教师面对着她们，把每——一——个——词——都——仔——细——发——音。
rows.raw: "Quaelle is in the classroom, helping your roehm daughters with their Aural Perception Primary Training. They frown intently, antennae waving and curling at the long, cylindrical pulse-units at the front of the room, throbbing away whilst the rahn teacher faces them and care-full-ee ann-unn-see-ates eh-vurr-ee word."

rows.original: Quaelle follows this up by knitting her antennae with theirs and sitting in silence for a while with each, imparting something through some form of wiggly osmosis. Your daughters’ faces scrunch up as the cilia embrace goes on and then brighten with understanding each time, beaming at their parent as they pull apart.
rows.translation: 随后，奎尔把自己的触须与她们的触须交织在一起，分别陪每个孩子静坐片刻，通过某种蠕动的渗透方式传授东西。纤毛的拥抱持续时，女儿们的脸会皱成一团；每一次分开时，又因理解而明亮起来，笑容满面地望向母亲。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuaelle follows this up by knitting her antennae with theirs and sitting in silence for a while with each, imparting something through some form of wiggly osmosis. Your daughters’ faces scrunch up as the cilia embrace goes on and then brighten with understanding each time, beaming at their parent as they pull apart."

rows.original: Without copious amounts of genemods they’ll never hear the world around them, anymore than you’ll know what it’s like to perceive it through vibration. But these classes will enable them to easily get by communicating with their eared friends. Perhaps with just as delightful a speech impediment as Quaelle herself.
rows.translation: 若不接受大量基因改造，她们永远无法听见周围世界，就像你永远无法知道通过振动感知世界是什么感觉。不过，这些课程能让她们轻松与长耳朵的朋友交流。或许她们也会拥有和奎尔一样可爱的口音。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout copious amounts of genemods they’ll never hear the world around them, anymore than you’ll know what it’s like to perceive it through vibration. rows.original: Your infant roehm daughters are in the classroom, in the middle of their Aural Perception Primary Training. They frown intently, antennae waving and curling at the long, cylindrical pulse-units at the front of the room, throbbing away whilst the rahn teacher faces them and care-full-ee ann-unn-see-ates eh-vurr-ee word. Without copious amounts of genemods they’ll never hear the world around them, anymore than you’ll know what it’s like to perceive it through vibration. But these classes will enable them to easily get by communicating with their eared friends. Perhaps with just as delightful a speech impediment as their mother.
rows.translation: 你的罗姆幼女们正在教室里上“听觉感知入门”课程。她们专注地皱着眉，触须朝教室前方那些细长圆柱形的脉冲装置挥舞、卷曲；装置不断搏动，而拉恩教师面对着她们，把每——一——个——词——都——仔——细——发——音。若不接受大量基因改造，她们永远无法听见周围世界，就像你永远无法知道通过振动感知世界是什么感觉。不过，这些课程能让她们轻松与长耳朵的朋友交流。或许她们也会拥有和母亲一样可爱的口音。

rows.original: Briget combines mealtime with storytime for your young roehm daughters in the main atrium. Here there is plentiful amounts of edible greenery, thronging out of planters built into the walls... but they are being taught to graze responsibly, tending for the plants themselves with wee watering cans, and only eating them once they’re mature.
rows.translation: 布丽姬特在主中庭把用餐时间和故事时间结合起来，陪伴你年幼的罗姆女儿们。这里有大量可食用绿植，从嵌在墙里的种植槽中茂密长出...不过她们正接受负责任的放牧教育，要亲自用迷你水壶照料植物，只等成熟后才可以食用。

rows.original: They munch their cud, solemn double-pupiled eyes fixed on Briget as the robot reads a roehm fairytale to them, in which the heroine bravely waits for the monster under her bed to die of old age.
rows.translation: 她们咀嚼反刍物，庄严的双瞳孔眼睛紧盯布丽姬特；机器人正给她们朗读一个罗姆童话，故事里的女主角勇敢地等待床下怪物自然老死。

rows.original: At Briget’s behest you step in and tell an alternative story, a heavily edited version of one of your adventures. They mostly find it highly amusing, your words drawing giggly, harmonious choruses of ‘hmm’s out of them. To them, your gallivanting around the frontier comes across as the actions of a berserk clown. Possibly they are correct? You find yourself laughing along to your own escapades by the end.
rows.translation: 在布丽姬特的鼓励下，你加入进来，讲了另一个故事，即你某次冒险经过大幅删改的版本。她们大多觉得非常有趣，你的话引得她们发出咯咯而和谐的“嗯”声合唱。在她们看来，你在边疆四处闯荡的行为就像一个狂暴小丑。也许她们是对的？到最后，你发现自己也在为自己的冒险经历一起发笑。

rows.translation: 她咀嚼反刍物，庄严的双瞳孔眼睛紧盯布丽姬特；机器人正给她朗读一个罗姆童话，故事里的女主角勇敢地等待床下怪物自然老死。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe munches her cud, solemn double-pupiled eyes fixed on Briget as the robot reads a roehm fairytale to her, in which the heroine bravely waits for the monster under her bed to die of old age."

rows.original: At Briget’s behest you step in and tell an alternative story, a heavily edited version of one of your adventures. She mostly finds it highly amusing, your words drawing long, humming giggles out of her. To her, your gallivanting around the frontier comes across as the actions of a berserk clown. Possibly she is correct? You find yourself laughing along to your own escapades by the end.
rows.translation: 在布丽姬特的鼓励下，你加入进来，讲了另一个故事，即你某次冒险经过大幅删改的版本。她大多觉得非常有趣，你的话引得她发出悠长低哼般的咯咯笑声。在她看来，你在边疆四处闯荡的行为就像一个狂暴小丑。也许她是对的？到最后，你发现自己也在为自己的冒险经历一起发笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt Briget’s behest you step in and tell an alternative story, a heavily edited version of one of your adventures. She mostly finds it highly amusing, your words drawing long, humming giggles out of her. To her, your gallivanting around the frontier comes across as the actions of a berserk clown. Possibly she is correct? You find yourself laughing along to your own escapades by the end."

rows.original: Finally you give her a hug from their silly old
rows.translation: 最后，你以她傻乎乎的老
rows.raw: "\n\nFinally you give her a hug from their silly old "

rows.translation: 爸
rows.raw: "dad"

rows.original: mom
rows.translation: 妈
rows.raw: "mom"

rows.original: and bid her a fond farewell.
rows.translation: 身份拥抱她，深情道别。
rows.raw: " and bid her a fond farewell."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Efficervescent Steele.”
rows.translation: “活力四溢的斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "“Efficervescent Steele.”"

rows.original: The roehm has not only gotten her aides to take over her duties by the time you’ve gotten over to her, she’s actually oozed out of reception itself, so she can clasp your hands and beam at you without a counter blocking the way.
rows.translation: 等你走到她身边时，这名罗姆不仅已经让助手接手自己的职责，甚至已经从接待台后方蠕动出来，这样她便能握住你的双手，灿烂地朝你微笑，而不会有柜台挡在中间。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe roehm has not only gotten her aides to take over her duties by the time you’ve gotten over to her, she’s actually oozed out of reception itself, so she can clasp your hands and beam at you without a counter blocking the way."

rows.original: You think that as much as you’ve had to develop a deep patience in order to interact and get intimate with this creature, so something of you has rubbed off on her (certainly, a lot of rubbing’s been going on). She got all of that done so she can draw you into her favourite vine-festooned nook at a very un-sluggardly pace.
rows.translation: 你觉得，正如自己必须培养深厚耐心才能与这个生物互动、亲密相处，你身上的某些东西也感染了她，当然，你们确实发生了许多摩擦。她把所有事情都安排妥当，只为以绝不蛞蝓般迟缓的速度把你拉进她最喜欢的藤蔓环绕角落。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think that as much as you’ve had to develop a deep patience in order to interact and get intimate with this creature, so something of you has rubbed off on her (certainly, a lot of rubbing’s been going on). She got all of that done so she can draw you into her favourite vine-festooned nook at a very un-sluggardly pace."

rows.original: You sit with Quaelle, holding her warm, slimy hands, enjoying that easy, silent peace you’re able to sink into with her. There is something different about her... and she wants you to know what it is. That realisation surfaces slowly. It’s the smell. Still sweet and creamy, but... less urgent. Much less sexual.
rows.translation: 你和奎尔坐在一起，握住她温暖黏滑的双手，享受你能与她一同沉入的那份轻松静谧。她身上有什么不同...而且她希望你察觉到。这个认识缓缓浮现。是气味。依然甜美而奶香浓郁，却...不再那么急切。性爱意味淡了许多。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sit with Quaelle, holding her warm, slimy hands, enjoying that easy, silent peace you’re able to sink into with her. There is something different about her... and she wants you to know what it is. That realisation surfaces slowly. It’s the smell. Still sweet and creamy, but... less urgent. Much less sexual."

rows.original: “Your full year has ended,” you say at last.
rows.translation: “你的丰年结束了，”你终于说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your full year has ended,” you say at last."

rows.original: “Yeeessssssss,” the roehm says approvingly. “I have been feeling that part of me closing up over the last few weeks. I am going dormant again, still and somnolent, for another five years.” She squeezes your hands. “Before, when it happened, it was a sad time. I felt I had not done what I had wanted. I understood that... you couldn’t always expect everything to come to you, eventually. That was a monoceptive realization.”
rows.translation: “是————的，”这名罗姆赞同地说道。“过去几周里，我一直感觉那部分身体正在闭合。我又要进入休眠，静止而困倦地度过五年。”她挤了挤你的手。“以前发生这种事时，那是一段悲伤时期。我觉得自己没有做到想做的事。我明白了...你不能总指望一切最终都会来到身边。那是一个单一而深刻的领悟。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeeessssssss,” the roehm says approvingly. “I have been feeling that part of me closing up over the last few weeks. I am going dormant again, still and somnolent, for another five years.” She squeezes your hands. “Before, when it happened, it was a sad time. I felt I had not done what I had wanted. I understood that... you couldn’t always expect everything to come to you, eventually. That was a monoceptive realization.”"

rows.original: She smiles at you, eyes glittering.
rows.translation: 她对你微笑，双眼闪闪发亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles at you, eyes glittering."

rows.original: <i>“But this time... it is a joyous time. Because I found a lover who gave me what I wanted. Moorrrrre! A lover who was willing to provide for my child
rows.translation: <i>“但这一次...这是段欢乐时光。因为我找到了一位给我想要之物的爱人。更————多！一位愿意在我工作时照顾我的孩
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“But this time... it is a joyous time. Because I found a lover who gave me what I wanted. Moorrrrre! A lover who was willing to provide for my child"

rows.original: ren
rows.translation: 子们
rows.raw: "ren"

rows.original: , as I worked. You are a shiverous, fulcrulent, luminous being, Steele! You have made me happier than you can imagine.”
rows.translation: ,的爱人。你是一个颤意十足、支点坚实、光辉明亮的存在，斯蒂尔！你带给我的幸福超乎你的想象。”
rows.raw: ", as I worked. You are a shiverous, fulcrulent, luminous being, Steele! You have made me happier than you can imagine.”"

rows.original: You ask if she’s happy with the number you had together.
rows.translation: 你问她是否满意你们共同拥有的孩子数量。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if she’s happy with the number you had together."

rows.original: “Emmmmmm,” she hums, cheeks turning orange. “I.... never expected to have as many as we did. You are so virulescent, Steele!
rows.translation: “嗯————”她哼声说道，脸颊变成橙色。“我....从没想到我们会有这么多。你实在太有生殖活力了，斯蒂尔！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Emmmmmm,” she hums, cheeks turning orange. “I.... never expected to have as many as we did. You are so virulescent, Steele! "

rows.original: ! My mother will be shudderific! But... if you pray for rain, you should not spite a deluge. You have filled my arms with children, my heart with love, Steele. For that, I thank you.”
rows.translation: ！我母亲一定会震撼不已！不过...如果你祈求降雨，就不该憎恨洪水。你让我的怀抱里满是孩子，心中满是爱，斯蒂尔。为此，我感谢你。”
rows.raw: "! My mother will be shudderific! But... if you pray for rain, you should not spite a deluge. You have filled my arms with children, my heart with love, Steele. For that, I thank you.”"

rows.original: You ask if she’s happy with the number you had together.
rows.translation: 你问她是否满意你们共同拥有的孩子数量。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if she’s happy with the number you had together."

rows.original: “Very,” she replies, antennae bobbing as she brings them to mind. “They will grow up in a trembluous environment, perhaps, but they will have each other if it ever seems too strange. I am content, when I think of them.
rows.translation: “非常满意，”她回答，想起孩子们时触角不断摆动。“或许她们会在一个颤动不安的环境中长大，但若一切显得太陌生，她们至少还有彼此。每当想到她们，我就很满足。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Very,” she replies, antennae bobbing as she brings them to mind. “They will grow up in a trembluous environment, perhaps, but they will have each other if it ever seems too strange. I am content, when I think of them. "

rows.original: is an excellent number to have.”
rows.translation: 是一个非常理想的数量。”
rows.raw: " is an excellent number to have.”"

rows.original: You ask if she’s alright about the fact you only had one together.
rows.translation: 你问她是否介意你们只共同拥有一个孩子。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if she’s alright about the fact you only had one together."

rows.original: “It is my first full year. It makes sense to have a single child first, doesn’t it? See how we get on?” She hum-giggles a bit. “My only daughter, brought into being with the heir to a huge corporation. She will be the most ssssspooiiiillled roehm in this hemisphere of the galaxy!”
rows.translation: “这是我的第一个丰年。先有一个孩子很合理，对吧？看看我们相处得如何？”她哼笑了几声。“我唯一的女儿，由一家庞大企业的继承人共同孕育。她会成为这个银河半球最受————宠的罗姆！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It is my first full year. It makes sense to have a single child first, doesn’t it? See how we get on?” She hum-giggles a bit. “My only daughter, brought into being with the heir to a huge corporation. She will be the most ssssspooiiiillled roehm in this hemisphere of the galaxy!”"

rows.original: You ask what she intends to do now.
rows.translation: 你询问她接下来打算做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask what she intends to do now."

rows.original: “I will continue to work here for a while longer,” she says. “Tamani has been very good towards me... and the work suits me.
rows.translation: “我会继续在这里工作一段时间，”她说道。“塔玛妮一直待我很好...而且这份工作很适合我。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I will continue to work here for a while longer,” she says. “Tamani has been very good towards me... and the work suits me."

rows.original: Once all of my daughters have come of age, I shall take them to Hdar-Roe, show them their home. From there... they will have their own destiny to choose.
rows.translation: 等所有女儿都成年后，我会带她们前往赫达-罗，让她们看看自己的家园。从那里开始...她们可以选择自己的命运。
rows.raw: " Once all of my daughters have come of age, I shall take them to Hdar-Roe, show them their home. From there... they will have their own destiny to choose."

rows.original: Once my daughter has come of age, I shall take her to Hdar-Roe, show her home. From there... she will have her own destiny to choose.
rows.translation: 等女儿成年后，我会带她前往赫达-罗，让她看看自己的家园。从那里开始...她可以选择自己的命运。
rows.raw: " Once my daughter has come of age, I shall take her to Hdar-Roe, show her home. From there... she will have her own destiny to choose."

rows.original: By then...” she sighs, lapsing into silence for a little while. “...It will be my next full year again. And I will have some choosing to do myself. But I shall do it with peace in my heart.”
rows.translation: 到那时...”她叹息着陷入片刻沉默。“...我又会迎来下一个丰年。届时我自己也必须作出一些选择。不过，我会怀着平静的心去选择。”
rows.raw: " By then...” she sighs, lapsing into silence for a little while. “...It will be my next full year again. And I will have some choosing to do myself. But I shall do it with peace in my heart.”"

rows.original: Her attention turns by degrees back to you.
rows.translation: 她的注意力逐渐回到你身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer attention turns by degrees back to you."

rows.original: “You’ll still visit, won’t you?” she asks. “I will come by the nursery when I can, of course. Buuuttt... it would make me vigroful to spend time with you, still.”
rows.translation: “你还是会来拜访，对吧？”她问。“当然，我有空时会去育儿室。不过...若是仍能和你共度时光，我一定会充满活力。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ll still visit, won’t you?” she asks. “I will come by the nursery when I can, of course. Buuuttt... it would make me vigroful to spend time with you, still.”"

rows.original: “We can still smash, right?” you ask with a certain anxiety.
rows.translation: “我们还是可以做爱，对吧？”你略带焦虑地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We can still smash, right?” you ask with a certain anxiety."

rows.original: “Oooof coouuuurrrse!” She touches your face fondly. “Just because I’m no longer fertile doesn’t mean I won’t want to bed my lover from time to time. In many ways, it will be better. There is no goal, now. I will not grow fat and brumdugulous anymore. We can have as much fun as we like.”
rows.translation: “当————然！”她深情地抚摸你的脸。“我不再有生育力，并不意味着偶尔不想和爱人上床。从很多方面来说，这样反而更好。现在已经没有目标了。我不会再变得肥胖而臃肿。我们想怎么玩都可以。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oooof coouuuurrrse!” She touches your face fondly. “Just because I’m no longer fertile doesn’t mean I won’t want to bed my lover from time to time. In many ways, it will be better. There is no goal, now. I will not grow fat and brumdugulous anymore. We can have as much fun as we like.”"

rows.original: You answer that by getting up and going across to give her a big hug. Mmm... that lovely wet marshmallow give, that sweet smell, the harmonious ‘emmmmm’ it draws, the way she gathers you into her generous breasts. Yeah. You’re pretty sure you’ll keep coming back.
rows.translation: 你站起身走过去，给了她一个大大的拥抱作为回答。嗯...那种可爱湿润的棉花糖般凹陷，那股甜美气味，被拥抱引出的和谐“嗯————”声，还有她用丰满乳房把你搂住的方式。是啊。你很确定自己还会不断回来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou answer that by getting up and going across to give her a big hug. Mmm... that lovely wet marshmallow give, that sweet smell, the harmonious ‘emmmmm’ it draws, the way she gathers you into her generous breasts. Yeah. You’re pretty sure you’ll keep coming back."

rows.original: “Did you stop by for any other reason?” she asks at last, letting going of your hands to pinch off some vine leaves. “Effivescerent Steele.”
rows.translation: “你这次过来还有别的原因吗？”她终于问道，松开你的手，掐下几片藤叶。“活力洋溢的斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did you stop by for any other reason?” she asks at last, letting going of your hands to pinch off some vine leaves. “Effivescerent Steele.”"

rows.original:
You’re within a stuffy tube of metal and plastic. Steady, mechanical thrums suffuse the air around you. The inside of the cylinder-like lift is lined by a brass-hued railing, used to steady oneself during high speed travel through the kilometers-long station.

There’s a sturdy mechanical keypad with which to designate your target level. Right now, the only floors of interest are the hangar, merchant, residential, and nursery levels.
rows.translation:
你置身于一条闷热的金属与塑料管道中。稳定的机械嗡鸣充斥周围空气。圆筒状电梯内部沿壁装有黄铜色扶手，供乘客在穿越这座绵延数公里的空间站、进行高速移动时稳住身体。

这里有一块坚固的机械键盘，可用来指定目标楼层。目前值得前往的只有机库层、商业层、住宅层和育儿层。

The inside of the cylinder-like lift is lined by a brass-hued railing, used to steady oneself during high speed travel through the kilometers-long station.\n\nThere’s a sturdy mechanical keypad with which to designate your target level. rows.original: “Itching for a game of 4D chess?” reads one note, in tall, loopy cursive. “The north-west plaza has tables. Always around in the afternoons.”
rows.translation: “想来一局四维象棋吗？”一张告示用高挑而环绕的花体字写道，“西北广场有棋桌。下午一直都在。”
rows.raw: "“Itching for a game of 4D chess?” reads one note, in tall, loopy cursive. “The north-west plaza has tables. Always around in the afternoons.”"

rows.original: While this notice board is holographic, it’s easy to bring up a digipen and scribble whatever you want on it. There’s a section for official notices to deck residents, informing them of maintenance schedules and other important events. The rest is for use by the public; filled with general requests or advertisements.
rows.translation: 这块公告板虽然是全息的，却很容易调出数码笔，在上面随意写下任何内容。其中一部分专供发布给本层居民的官方通知，告知维护计划与其他重要事件。其余区域则向公众开放，满是普通请求或广告。
rows.raw: "While this notice board is holographic, it’s easy to bring up a digipen and scribble whatever you want on it. There’s a section for official notices to deck residents, informing them of maintenance schedules and other important events. The rest is for use by the public; filled with general requests or advertisements.\n\n"

rows.original: A small, cramped corridor connects many of the rooms-for-rent offered at Anon’s Bar and Board, locked away behind a security access door to keep out ‘undesireables’. The furnishings are cheap, the walls are dank and horrible, and the floor is a mess. Not that it matters much; not like you’d willingly spend much time in a corridor.
rows.translation: 一条狭小拥挤的走廊连接着阿农酒吧旅舍提供的许多出租房间；它们被锁在一道安全门后，以阻挡所谓的“不受欢迎者”。家具廉价，墙壁潮湿难看，地板也一片狼藉。不过这无关紧要，反正你也不会自愿在走廊里久留。

rows.original: Located at the top of a stairway above the bar, this short hallway stretches briefly to the north before coming to an unremarkable, metallic dead-end. Automated doorways line the east and west sides, connecting to different rooms, their surfaces kept moderately clean but pitted with rust here or there. This isn’t the kind of place you’d want to stay for long, if you could help it. Anon’s Bar and Board lies down the steel-grated stairwell to the south.
rows.translation: 这条短走廊位于酒吧上方楼梯顶端，向北延伸不远便抵达一面毫不起眼的金属死路。东西两侧排列着通往不同房间的自动门；门面还算干净，但这里那里都布满锈蚀凹坑。如果可以选择，这绝不是你愿意久住的地方。沿南边钢格栅楼梯向下，便是阿农酒吧旅舍。
rows.raw: "Located at the top of a stairway above the bar, this short hallway stretches briefly to the north before coming to an unremarkable, metallic dead-end. Automated doorways line the east and west sides, connecting to different rooms, their surfaces kept moderately clean but pitted with rust here or there. This isn’t the kind of place you’d want to stay for long, if you could help it. Anon’s Bar and Board lies down the steel-grated stairwell to the south."

rows.original: Heady alcoholic scents combine with drug-laced smoke and salty food to give this place the unquestionable aroma of a seedy bar. Three-breasted waitresses balancing trays full of drinks one-handed sashay around in short skirts and sheer tops, their gait made awkward by their three legs and small feet. A rickety metal stairway rises up to the north, leading to the board portion of this establishment. You’ve already roomed there once, and the accommodations were far from great. A door to the west opens out into a central thoroughfare. To the east is a quieter back room.
rows.translation: 浓烈酒气与掺杂药物的烟雾、咸香食物混合，让这里散发着毫无疑问属于下流酒吧的气味。三乳女服务员单手托着装满饮料的托盘，穿着短裙和透明上衣四处摇曳；三条腿与小脚让她们的步态显得有些别扭。一座摇摇欲坠的金属楼梯向北延伸，通往这家店的旅舍区域。你曾在那里住过一次，住宿条件远谈不上理想。西侧的门通往中央主干道，东侧则是一间更安静的后室。
rows.raw: "Heady alcoholic scents combine with drug-laced smoke and salty food to give this place the unquestionable aroma of a seedy bar. Three-breasted waitresses balancing trays full of drinks one-handed sashay around in short skirts and sheer tops, their gait made awkward by their three legs and small feet. A rickety metal stairway rises up to the north, leading to the board portion of this establishment. You’ve already roomed there once, and the accommodations were far from great. A door to the west opens out into a central thoroughfare. To the east is a quieter back room."

rows.original: The crowds in this part of the station are particularly thick thanks to the Rush. You hear talk of old shops closing, their owners out trawling the rim, trying to strike it rich, while newer stores have opened their doors to take their place. For now, Anon’s Bar and Board is ready for your business to the east. Its interior promises cheap but delicious foods likely to broaden the waistline, but then again, what are you to expect from bar food?
rows.translation: 受开拓潮影响，空间站这一区域的人群格外拥挤。你听见人们谈论老店关门，店主们外出搜寻边缘地带、试图一夜暴富；与此同时，新商店又开门填补空缺。目前，东边的阿农酒吧旅舍正等着招揽你的生意。里面承诺提供便宜却美味、很可能让腰围变粗的食物；不过话说回来，酒吧食物还能指望什么呢？
rows.raw: "The crowds in this part of the station are particularly thick thanks to the Rush. You hear talk of old shops closing, their owners out trawling the rim, trying to strike it rich, while newer stores have opened their doors to take their place. For now, Anon’s Bar and Board is ready for your business to the east. Its interior promises cheap but delicious foods likely to broaden the waistline, but then again, what are you to expect from bar food?"

rows.original: The busy merchant’s deck sprawls out before you. Arranged in a circular pattern, it winds its way around the entire station filled with shops of every style and variety. A cornucopia of races attend to their business here, forming a crowd as dense and multicultured as any you’ve seen before. People of all walks of life have come together here, united by the Rush, or at least united by a desire to eke a profit out of it.
rows.translation: 繁忙的商业层在你面前铺展开来。它以环形布局绕遍整座空间站，里面开满各种风格、各式各样的商店。形形色色的种族在此处理事务，形成你所见过最为密集、也最具多元文化色彩的人群之一。各行各业的人汇聚于此，被开拓潮团结起来，或者至少被从中谋取利润的愿望团结起来。
rows.raw: "The busy merchant’s deck sprawls out before you. Arranged in a circular pattern, it winds its way around the entire station filled with shops of every style and variety. A cornucopia of races attend to their business here, forming a crowd as dense and multicultured as any you’ve seen before. People of all walks of life have come together here, united by the Rush, or at least united by a desire to eke a profit out of it."

rows.original: Shear Beauty is a nicely kept hair salon, with white tile flooring and darker gray walls lined with shelves of hair care products and pictures of various fashion models. Currently the waiting lounge is empty, allowing you to go straight to the front counter if you please. Beyond it you can see three sets of salon chairs along the right wall, while along the left is what looks like a massage table with a privacy screen currently open. In the back you can see the entrance to what must be the employee break room.
rows.translation: “剪切之美”是一家维护得相当不错的美发沙龙，铺着白色瓷砖地板，深灰色墙壁旁排列着摆满护发产品的架子和各种时装模特照片。目前等候区空无一人，只要愿意，你可以直接走到前台。越过前台能看见右墙旁排列着三组沙龙座椅；左侧则像是一张按摩床，旁边的隐私屏风目前敞开。后方可以看见一个入口，想必通往员工休息室。

Beyond it you can see three sets of salon chairs along the right wall, while along the left is what looks like a massage table with a privacy screen currently open. In the back you can see the entrance to what must be the employee break room."

rows.original: A well-tanned girl with sparkling pink hair accentuated by a pair of long, pointed ears is leaning at the counter, chewing bubblegum. Her ears hang a little low of horizontal, but twitch upward as she notices you.
rows.translation: 一名晒得皮肤黝黑、拥有闪亮粉红头发的女孩靠在柜台旁嚼泡泡糖；一对修长尖耳使她的发色更加醒目。她的耳朵略低于水平位置，不过注意到你时便向上抖动。
rows.raw: "A well-tanned girl with sparkling pink hair accentuated by a pair of long, pointed ears is leaning at the counter, chewing bubblegum. Her ears hang a little low of horizontal, but twitch upward as she notices you."

rows.original:
You’re within a stuffy tube of metal and plastic. Steady, mechanical thrums suffuse the air around you. The inside of the cylinder-like lift is lined by a brass-hued railing, used to steady oneself during high speed travel through the kilometers-long station.

There’s a sturdy mechanical keypad with which to designate your target level. Right now, the only floors of interest are the hangar, merchant, residential, and nursery levels.
rows.translation:
你置身于一条闷热的金属与塑料管道中。稳定的机械嗡鸣充斥周围空气。圆筒状电梯内部沿壁装有黄铜色扶手，供乘客在穿越这座绵延数公里的空间站、进行高速移动时稳住身体。

这里有一块坚固的机械键盘，可用来指定目标楼层。目前值得前往的只有机库层、商业层、住宅层和育儿层。
rows.raw: "You’re within a stuffy tube of metal and plastic. Steady, mechanical thrums suffuse the air around you. The inside of the cylinder-like lift is lined by a brass-hued railing, used to steady oneself during high speed travel through the kilometers-long station.\n\nThere’s a sturdy mechanical keypad with which to designate your target level. Right now, the only floors of interest are the hangar, merchant, residential, and nursery levels."

rows.original: You also have the option to take the lift up to Deck 92 to meet up with Saendra
rows.translation: 你还可以乘电梯前往第92层，与赛恩德拉会合

rows.original: A sprawling, brightly lit hangar greets your eyes, empty save for a single ship near the back. Your gaze is pulled away from the distant craft by the sheer size of the enclosure. A hangar like this must have cost your father a veritable fortune to buy out - not much considering how wealthy he was, but no insignificant chunk of change. Magnetically-bounded plasma shields hold in the atmosphere while remaining transparent enough for you to view the nearby warp gate and inky blackness beyond. Perhaps the only thing this place couldn’t hold would be a capital ship, but a number of moorings with connective umbilicals stand by to tether one outside in that extreme scenario.
rows.translation: 映入眼帘的是一座宽阔而灯火通明的机库，除了后方附近停着的一艘飞船外空无一物。围场的庞大规模让你的视线从远处的飞船上移开。买下这样一座机库肯定花了你父亲一大笔钱——考虑到他有多富有，这算不上什么，却也绝非小数目。磁力约束的等离子护盾将大气封在其中，同时足够透明，让你可以看见附近的跃迁门和更远处墨黑的虚空。或许这里唯一容不下的只有主力舰，不过在那种极端情况下，旁边还有数个带连接脐带的泊位，可以把它系泊在外面。

rows.original: The interior of this shop is difficult to make out thanks to a combination of dim lighting and a smoky haze that smells vaguely of walnuts. Looking around, you manage to locate the source of the illumination - four custom glowbulbs pumping out an unnatural-looking blue-black aura. The walls are covered in shelves with dozens of perverted-looking nicknames, many of them demonic in theme, and the lone counter in the back of the store is similarly decorated.
rows.translation: 店内光线昏暗，还笼罩着一层隐约带有核桃气味的烟雾，因此很难看清内部。环顾四周后，你找到了照明来源——四枚定制发光灯泡，散发着不自然的蓝黑色光晕。墙壁上摆满了货架，陈列着几十种看起来颇为淫邪的奇特玩意儿，其中许多带有恶魔主题；店铺后方唯一的柜台也采用了类似装饰。

rows.original: Sera seems to be quite furious, her bosom heaving with labored breathing and sweat, almost certainly from having a shouting match like no other. She lays eyes on you, and makes a visible effort to calm herself. Through gritted teeth, she says “Come. Here.”

rows.original: The walls in this section of the merchant deck are awkwardly curved, and the round doorway of a shop in this corner looks to have been made to accommodate that. rows.original: A spacious window (or convincing display) lines the curving wall to the north. The view is magnificent. You can see the sun drift across your view as the station spins, and just as it passes beyond sight, the faint sparkles of the system’s ice belt light up like shining diamonds against the glimmering starfield behind. Companionship can be had for a few credits - or a few thousand. Crimson lighting paves the way north and south through the red light section of the merchant deck.

rows.original: The gradually arcing curve of the merchant deck bends away to the north and the west from here. In the former direction is a tunnel lighted in a hazy, ruby glow - the red light zone. Many shops of ill repute conduct business in that area, and holograms warn away any sapients below their species’ age of consent. The other direction wraps back around, eventually leading to the lift, where more mundane boutiques ply their wares.

rows.original: There’s no substitute for seeing the kind of racial diversity that the Rush brings on. Daynar and ovir alike fill the corridor, mixed with more humans and ausar than you care to count. A party of burly thraggen part the mismatched races more effectively than any wall of hardlight ever could. Nobody wants to mess with a few hundred pounds of green-skinned fury. The shops in the immediate area are all shut down, barricaded up by the health department, but glowing signs still declare, “Reduce protonic thruster buildup with SKREMULAX! Now in blue!”
rows.translation: 亲眼见识“大淘金热”带来的种族多样性，是任何描述都无法替代的。戴纳尔人与奥维尔人挤满走廊，混杂着多得数不过来的人类和奥萨尔。一队魁梧的斯拉根比任何硬光墙都更有效地把各族人群分开；没人愿意招惹几百磅绿皮怒火。附近店铺全被卫生部门勒令关闭并封死，但发光招牌仍宣称：“用斯克雷穆拉克斯减少质子推进器积垢！现有蓝色款！”

Most stores closed down, either to get away from the Rush madness or to try to strike it rich themselves. Yet the storefronts in this area are as lively as ever. rows.original:
You’re in front of a row of elevator shafts surrounded by a large plaza area. The design reminds you of a city square, but instead of a fountain feature, the lifts are the centerpiece. Still, there’s all the common fare of a common space; there are decorative garden beds with exotic yet harmless shrubbery and park benches to sit on.

Beyond the sprawling public space and in each of the four cardinal directions are residential arcades; high-roofed walkways marked by countless successive arches.
rows.translation:
你面前是一排升降梯井，四周环绕着一片宽阔广场。这种设计让你想起城市广场，只不过这里的中心不是喷泉，而是升降梯。尽管如此，公共空间常见的设施一样不少：装饰花坛中种着奇异却无害的灌木，旁边还有供人休息的长椅。

越过广阔公共区域，四个基本方向上各有住宅拱廊；那是一条条屋顶高耸、由无数连续拱门标示的通道。

rows.original:
This corner of the residential plaza is quite busy. The foot traffic is between the large elevator shafts in the center of the plaza and people’s dwellings. There are apartments lining the plaza, a premium spot for anyone in a rush.

There are some large trees here casting shade upon the paved ground. The only breeze is from the deck’s air conditioning systems, which keep everything at a nice, mild temperature.

You can follow the curve of the plaza here northward, towards the bridge to the western ward. You can also head west where the entrance to the deck’s elevators are.
rows.translation:
住宅广场的这个角落相当繁忙。人流往返于广场中央的大型升降梯井与居民住所之间。广场周围排列着许多公寓，对赶时间的人来说，这可是黄金地段。

这里有几棵大树，在铺装地面上投下阴影。唯一的微风来自甲板空调系统，它们让环境始终维持在宜人的温和温度。

你可以沿广场弧线向北走，前往通往西区的桥；也可以向西，那里是甲板升降梯的入口。

There’s a large lush patch of purple plants here in the plaza. They’re covered in patchy blue spots. Soft, cyan blossoms are poking out from them on long, dangly stems. They smell fresh and crisp rather than floral.

The plaza stretches out north to south, but there’s a large residential arcade to the east. It seems to head all the way out to a residential ward, though the thoroughfare itself is lined with doors to residential apartments.

广场向南北两端延伸，东边则有一条大型住宅拱廊。它似乎一路通往远处的住宅区，而大道本身两侧也排满住宅门扉。

They smell fresh and crisp rather than floral.\\n\\nThe plaza stretches out north to south, but there’s a large residential arcade to the east. It seems to head all the way out to a residential ward, though the thoroughfare itself is lined with doors to residential apartments."

rows.original: North-East Plaza
rows.raw: "North-East Plaza"

rows.original:
This part of the plaza is marked by large, leafy ferns, and by their distinctly green look, they’re likely terran. Some station tourists are stopping to take photos; they must be authentic palm trees. They lack coconuts, either through rigorous pruning or selective breeding, making it safe for pedestrians to pass beneath.

The plaza continues east and south in a wide curve.
rows.translation:
广场这一带以大片枝叶茂盛的蕨类为标志；从那鲜明绿色来看，它们很可能来自地球。一些空间站游客正停下来拍照——这些想必是真正的棕榈树。它们没有椰子，不知是经过严格修剪还是选择性育种，因此行人从下方经过也很安全。

广场在这里以宽阔弧线向东和向南延伸。

rows.raw: "North Plaza"

rows.original:
You’re standing on the north side of the plaza and in front of a large row of elevator shafts. All around you is a massive public plaza, filled with scenic shrubbery and paved walkways. There’s a few park benches as well, which residents seem to be making full use of.

At each of the cardinal points are gigantic residential arcades that continue out as far as the eye can see. Just like the walls of the plaza, the arcades are lined with residential entrances. It must be nice to walk right out your door and into such a nice garden-filled space.

You can head in any direction, with south heading back into the elevators and north heading into one of the residential thoroughfares. East and west heads around the plaza.
rows.translation:
你站在广场北侧，面前是一长排大型升降梯井。四周是一片巨大的公共广场，遍布景观灌木和铺装步道，还有几张公园长椅，居民们显然正充分利用。

四个基本方位上都有巨型住宅拱廊，一直延伸到视野尽头。和广场墙壁一样，拱廊两侧排满住宅入口。一出家门就能踏入如此宜人、遍布花园的空间，想必很舒服。

你可以朝任何方向前进：向南返回升降梯，向北进入一条住宅大道，向东或向西则环绕广场。

rows.original: North-West Plaza
rows.raw: "North-West Plaza"

rows.original:
It’s hard not to be dazzled by this portion of the plaza. Between the walkways are clusters of prismatic crystals, ranging in size from tiny gem-like shrubs to twenty-foot monoliths. Artificial light flows from above, striking the stones and causing them to sparkle.

A few water features run over the crystals, causing their scintillating light to flurry about beneath the ripples. It’s almost hypnotic, but very relaxing. Understandably, there’s a lot of public seating about. Among the normal tables, and nestled beneath some of the larger crystals, are 4D chess tables - square, black and white cage-like objects floating in mid-air, each flanked by a pair of chairs.

The plaza curves here from west to south, lined by various residential apartments.
rows.translation:
广场这一带令人目眩神迷。步道之间簇生着棱彩水晶，小的像宝石灌木，大的则是高达二十英尺的巨型晶柱。人工光线从上方洒落，击中晶石，让它们熠熠生辉。

几处水景流过水晶，使闪耀光芒在波纹下四处飞舞。景象近乎催眠，却也令人非常放松。难怪周围设置了大量公共座位。普通桌椅之间、一些较大水晶下方，还摆着四维象棋桌——黑白相间的方形笼状物悬浮在半空，两侧各配一把椅子。

广场从这里由西向南弯曲，沿途排列着各种住宅公寓。

rows.original:
This part of the plaza is filled with shielded aviaries housing all kinds of colorful winged creatures. When they’re not hovering about, they’re resting in their nests, most of which are built in hollowed out trees. A rainbow-hued, six-winged bird seems to have pride of place at the top of the largest tree.

There’s a large arcade-like thoroughfare to the west, stretching out all the way to a far off residential ward. Identical to the plaza, the side-walls are lined with residential entryways, each decorated as the owner sees fit.

Besides the west walkway, you can head north or south here and circle around the plaza. This side doesn’t seem to have an entry point to the elevators.
rows.translation:
广场这一带布满带护盾的鸟舍，里面栖息着各种色彩斑斓的有翼生物。它们不在空中盘旋时，便会在巢中休息；大多数鸟巢都筑在中空树干里。一只彩虹色的六翼鸟高踞最大那棵树顶，仿佛享有至高地位。

西边是一条大型拱廊式大道，一路延伸至远方住宅区。和广场一样，两侧墙壁排满住宅入口，每户都按主人喜好装饰。

除了向西走，你也可以从这里向北或向南，绕广场而行。这一侧似乎没有升降梯入口。

rows.original:
This area has a lot of strange interpretive art. There are a number of residents dwelling near them, each arguing about what exactly the messy-looking statues are. It’s like an inkblot test; everyone seems to see something a little different.

The plaza curves around here from north to west. The latter leads to the front of the deck’s elevators.
rows.translation:
这个区域摆着许多奇怪的诠释艺术。几名居民聚在附近，每个人都在争论那些看起来乱糟糟的雕像究竟表现了什么。这就像墨迹测验；每个人似乎都看出了略有不同的东西。

广场在这里从北向西弯曲；西边通往甲板升降梯正面。

rows.original:
The eastern thoroughfare is massive and multi-laned, with some residents opting to take small hover-carts between the plaza elevators and the outer wards. Thankfully, the small yet speedy vehicles don’t share the same routes as the pedestrians, only scooting along the inner lanes.

There are many residential estates located in the plaza, some with vehicles parked out front and console locked.

To the south is a tall but narrow apartment, its facade decorated in understated dull red and slate trimmings, mimicking an old-fashioned brick townhouse. Its door and windows are slightly smaller and lower than seems to be the norm around here. The holo-number next to the door reads 107.
rows.translation:
东侧大道宽阔无比，分成多条车道；有些居民选择乘坐小型悬浮车，在广场升降梯与外围住宅区之间往返。幸好这些小巧却迅捷的车辆不与行人共用路线，只会沿内侧车道飞驰。

广场内坐落着许多住宅，有些门前停着车辆，并由控制台上锁。

南边是一栋高而狭窄的公寓，外墙用低调的暗红和板岩色饰边装饰，模仿老式砖砌联排住宅。门窗都比这里的常见尺寸略小、略低。门边的全息门牌显示为107号。

rows.original: Semith’s home is a series of cozy spaces orientated quite vertically. A circular lift in the middle of the tall apartment can soundlessly transport you from a plush lounge stuffed with squashy settees, to a spice-scented kitchen, to an incredibly untidy study, to who knows what else. Semith likes synth-mahogany, and it shows. Every space is furnished in rich red-brown, with pieces of artwork straddling the line between tasteful and unsettling here and there.
rows.translation: 塞米斯的家由一系列纵向排列的舒适空间组成。高层公寓中央有一部圆形升降梯，可以悄无声息地把你从塞满柔软沙发的豪华客厅送到香料气息浓郁的厨房，再到乱得惊人的书房，乃至其他未知房间。塞米斯喜欢合成桃花心木，这一点显而易见：每个空间都采用浓郁的红棕色家具，间或摆放着游走于雅致与不安之间的艺术品。

rows.original:
There are a number of double story apartments here with balconies, easily fitting into the high-roofed residential arcade. There’s also a dock for hover carts and a small payment terminal, for those not wishing to walk back and forth down the thoroughfare.

There’s a particularly large apartment to the north of here. The classy pillars and archways mix with the lascivious color scheme of red and gold, making it look like an upper-class bordello more than a residence. The holo-sign next to the door reads 112.

rows.original: The residential deck seems to sprawl miles away from the central hub of the station. This particular section is one of many that features a little indoor greenery, the multi-laned paths splitting around a small sitting garden in the middle of the public space. rows.original: This incredibly large apartment must have cost a small fortune of credits to buy, far and above the normal fare in Tavros station. The polished synth-oak floors look indistinguishable from the real thing, giving the whole place a glamorous air. The common area is huge, filled with a circular island-like kitchen and seating around the outskirts. It’s the sort of place where many people can visit quite easily. There’s an open doorway leading to a lush looking bedroom with silky sheets and a king sized bed. The bedhead has silk ropes around it... whatever could they be for? Another room seems to lead to a dance studio.
rows.translation: 这套大得惊人的公寓肯定花了一小笔信用点巨款购买，远远高于塔夫罗斯空间站的普通住房。抛光合成橡木地板与真品几乎无法分辨，让整个地方显得格外华贵。公共区域非常宽敞，中央是一座圆形岛式厨房，外围设有座位；这里显然能轻松招待许多人。一扇敞开的门通往一间装潢奢华的卧室，里面铺着丝滑床单和一张特大号床。床头还缠着丝绳……那些究竟是做什么用的？另一个房间似乎通往舞蹈室。
rows.raw: "This incredibly large apartment must have cost a small fortune of credits to buy, far and above the normal fare in Tavros station. The polished synth-oak floors look indistinguishable from the real thing, giving the whole place a glamorous air. The common area is huge, filled with a circular island-like kitchen and seating around the outskirts. It’s the sort of place where many people can visit quite easily. There’s an open doorway leading to a lush looking bedroom with silky sheets and a king sized bed. The bedhead has silk ropes around it... whatever could they be for? Another room seems to lead to a dance studio."

rows.original:
The northward walkway is huge both longways and upward, making it easier for larger species to get about. Hover-carts are for rent here, allowing easy travel around the residential deck. You notice some of them have different steering wheels and seating, allowing for all sorts of species to make use of them.

The residential buildings lining this part of the deck aren’t very decorated, and those that are have been done with cheap holos. You can easily see through the flickering facades, making such holo-decor all but pointless.

To the north, the walkway continues for quite some time. The central plaza lies to the south, along with the elevators that allow deck transit.
rows.translation:
向北的步道无论长度还是高度都十分惊人，方便体型较大的种族通行。这里可以租用悬浮车，让人在住宅甲板四处通行更加方便。你注意到其中一些装有不同类型的方向盘和座椅，以便各种种族使用。

甲板这一区域两旁的住宅建筑几乎没有装饰；即使有，也只是用廉价全息影像做成。你能轻易看穿闪烁不定的假立面，让这种全息装饰几乎毫无意义。

向北的步道还会延伸很长一段。中央广场位于南边，那里也有可在甲板间通行的升降梯。

rows.original:
This largely unlived in part of the deck is almost achingly quiet, each footstep echoing down the incredibly tall and long walkway. Each room has ridiculously cheap pricing on it. There are also a few advertising boards up, mostly displaying the latest movies and soft-drink products.

South leads towards the central plaza. To the north, there’s a big block of cheap apartments, grav shafts enabling access to the identikit steel boxes further up.
rows.translation:
甲板这片几乎无人居住的区域安静得令人难受，每一步脚步声都沿着高得惊人、长得看不到尽头的通道回响。每个房间都标着便宜得离谱的价格。附近还有几块广告牌，大多展示最新电影和软饮产品。

向南通往中央广场。北边则是一大片廉价公寓，重力井可让人抵达更高处那些一模一样的钢铁盒子。

rows.original: The western walkway has a lot of glitzy looking apartments. It’s only a very close look and touch that reveals they’re all covered in hard-light holos, not designed out of gold and marble. By the look of the few who haven’t ‘covered up’, they’re actually exceptionally plain; probably why their owners invested in the hard-light flourish. The walkway continues west for quite a while. It’s a considerably shorter walk back east and to the deck’s public plaza.
rows.translation: 西侧步道有许多看起来珠光宝气的公寓。只有极其仔细地观察和触摸，才能发现它们全都覆盖着硬光全息影像，并非真的用黄金与大理石建成。从少数没有“遮掩”的公寓来看，它们实际上平淡得出奇；这大概正是主人花钱添置硬光华饰的原因。步道继续向西延伸很长一段；若向东返回甲板公共广场，路程则短得多。

It’s a considerably shorter walk back east and to the deck’s public plaza."

rows.original: Aina’s apartment is incredibly spacious with large open spaces and doorways. What does fill it is tastefully chosen, from the expressive pot-plants and paintings to the cushy centaur-friendly couches that lie about. There’s also seating for visitors of the two-legged variety, particularly around a friendly looking coffee table.
