rows.original: The considerably large southern arcade stretches out as far as the eye can see, but many of the residences are for sale. By the looks of things, they’re unlived in, which means this part of the deck must be brand new. Given the Rush started not long ago, it’s not surprising—galactic expansion is the name of the game right now. You can head south and along the walkway, or north and towards the public plaza.
rows.translation: 宽阔得惊人的南部拱廊一直延伸到视野尽头，不过许多住宅都挂着出售标志。从外表来看，它们从未有人住过，这意味着甲板的这一部分肯定刚刚建成。考虑到淘金热开始还没多久，这并不奇怪，毕竟银河扩张正是眼下的主旋律。你可以向南沿步道前行，也可以向北前往公共广场。
rows.raw: "The considerably large southern arcade stretches out as far as the eye can see, but many of the residences are for sale. By the looks of things, they’re unlived in, which means this part of the deck must be brand new. Given the Rush started not long ago, it’s not surprising—galactic expansion is the name of the game right now. You can head south and along the walkway, or north and towards the public plaza."

rows.original: One of the apartments is certainly occupied, though: several Mhen’gan flowers are growing from pots in the window, and red silk curtains are flittering in the artificial breeze. A nameplate underneath that residence reads “Zheniya” - your lover has found quite a lovely place for herself with her new paycheck.
rows.translation: 不过，其中一套公寓显然有人居住：窗边花盆里生长着几株门加花，红色丝绸窗帘在人工微风中轻轻飘动。住宅下方的名牌写着“热妮娅”，你的爱人利用新工资为自己找到了一个相当可爱的住处。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the apartments is certainly occupied, though: several Mhen’gan flowers are growing from pots in the window, and red silk curtains are flittering in the artificial breeze. A nameplate underneath that residence reads “Zheniya” - your lover has found quite a lovely place for herself with her new paycheck."

rows.original: The inside of Zheniya’s apartment is cozy and warm. Silk and bead curtains hang from the walls and doorways, and the lights have been tuned down to a low, sensual red glow throughout. The heat is above station standard, mimicking the musky humidity of her native planet’s jungles. A few incense candles are burning on shelves and tables, though the scent is nowhere near as overwhelming as you remember from Zheniya’s last abode.
rows.translation: 热妮娅的公寓内部舒适温暖。丝绸和珠帘悬挂在墙壁与门框上，整间屋子的灯光都被调暗，散发低沉而性感的红色光芒。室温高于空间站标准，模拟着她故乡行星丛林中麝香浓郁的湿热环境。架子和桌面上点着几支熏香蜡烛，不过香气远没有你记忆中热妮娅上一处住所那样浓烈得令人难以招架。
rows.raw: "The inside of Zheniya’s apartment is cozy and warm. Silk and bead curtains hang from the walls and doorways, and the lights have been tuned down to a low, sensual red glow throughout. The heat is above station standard, mimicking the musky humidity of her native planet’s jungles. A few incense candles are burning on shelves and tables, though the scent is nowhere near as overwhelming as you remember from Zheniya’s last abode."

rows.original: The inside of Bunny’s Buns & Confectionary is an almost overwhelming assault on the senses: bright pastel colors and flashing lights adorn every wall, drawing your eye to dozens of different menu options each flickering on a holodisplay; booming bass-heavy music fills the air, accompanied by crooning female vocals in an ausari accent. Across from the entrance and big bay windows is an old-school Terran bar, complete with stools and polished until it shines, though behind it are several different flavors of ice-cream dispenser and a soda machine that runs all the way into the ceiling - like everything else, it pulses with electronic lights, showing off its wares in a garish holographic commercial that never ends.
rows.translation: 兔兔面包与糖果店内部几乎对感官形成压倒性的冲击：明亮的粉彩色和闪烁灯光装饰着每一面墙，将你的视线吸引到几十种不同的菜单选项上，每一项都在全息显示器中闪动；重低音轰鸣的音乐充斥空气，伴随着带奥萨口音的女声吟唱。入口和宽大凸窗对面是一座老式泰伦吧台，配有高脚凳，表面被擦得闪闪发亮；不过吧台后方排列着多种口味的冰淇淋分配器，还有一台直通天花板的汽水机。和其他一切一样，它也闪烁着电子灯光，用永不停歇、花哨刺眼的全息广告展示商品。
rows.raw: "The inside of Bunny’s Buns & Confectionary is an almost overwhelming assault on the senses: bright pastel colors and flashing lights adorn every wall, drawing your eye to dozens of different menu options each flickering on a holodisplay; booming bass-heavy music fills the air, accompanied by crooning female vocals in an ausari accent. Across from the entrance and big bay windows is an old-school Terran bar, complete with stools and polished until it shines, though behind it are several different flavors of ice-cream dispenser and a soda machine that runs all the way into the ceiling - like everything else, it pulses with electronic lights, showing off its wares in a garish holographic commercial that never ends."

rows.original: This part of the thoroughfare shines with countless holo-decorated apartments. The light-projected exteriors spruce up the otherwise plain exteriors, transforming this region into a shimmering cultural hotpot. One of the apartments to the west doesn’t have a virtual exterior, but it does have a rather pimped-out looking hoverbike. Black, sleek looking plates cover its outside, with constantly shifting flame-paint on the sides; must be digital. Looks like a two-seater. A fair way north is the central plaza and the deck elevators.
rows.translation: 这段大道因无数装饰着全息影像的公寓而光彩夺目。投影外墙为原本朴素的表面增色，将这里变成一片闪耀的文化熔炉。西侧有套公寓没有虚拟外墙，却确实停着一辆外观极其招摇的悬浮摩托。车身外部覆盖着黑色流线型板材，两侧的火焰涂装不断变化，应该是数字图案。看起来能坐两个人。 往北相当一段距离便是中央广场和甲板电梯。

rows.original: You’re standing in the nursery’s cafeteria, a cozy structure modelled after a posh cafe on one side -- for the older children, no doubt -- and that of a play palace on the other, replete with benches and an animatronic servant that distributes the food. The two sides are separated by a small divide, just enough to keep the noise down.
rows.translation: 你站在育儿室的食堂中。这栋舒适建筑的一侧仿照高档咖啡馆设计，无疑是给年长孩子准备的；另一侧则仿照游乐宫殿，配有长椅和负责分发食物的仿生服务员。两侧由一道小隔断分开，恰好足以降低噪音。

rows.original: The nursery’s education center greets you with a sprawling, circular chamber dominated by a rounded desk and several holoscreens along the walls, displaying curriculums and after-school opportunities. Several doors branch off from the main chamber, into individual sets of classrooms for each grade -- from preschool all the way to 12th grade, and even including a few technical and shop classes.
rows.translation: 育儿室教育中心以一间宽阔的圆形大厅迎接你。大厅中央是一张弧形办公桌，墙边排列着几块全息屏幕，展示课程安排和课外活动机会。几扇门从主厅分向各处，通往每个年级各自的一组教室，从学前班一直到十二年级，甚至还包括一些技术课和实习工坊课程。
rows.raw: "The nursery’s education center greets you with a sprawling, circular chamber dominated by a rounded desk and several holoscreens along the walls, displaying curriculums and after-school opportunities. Several doors branch off from the main chamber, into individual sets of classrooms for each grade -- from preschool all the way to 12th grade, and even including a few technical and shop classes."

rows.original: The schoolrooms are up and operational now that you’ve started to deposit your offspring here. Steele Tech keeps several teachers on retainer here, and those who aren’t actively busy overseeing your children’s’ education are working away on future course material and lesson plans.
rows.translation: 如今你已开始把后代安置在这里，学校教室也正式投入运转。斯蒂尔科技长期聘请了几名教师；没有忙着监督孩子们学习的人，则正在制作未来的课程材料和教案。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe schoolrooms are up and operational now that you’ve started to deposit your offspring here. Steele Tech keeps several teachers on retainer here, and those who aren’t actively busy overseeing your children’s’ education are working away on future course material and lesson plans."

rows.original: Without any children to attend to, the staff of teachers and experts on retainer are milling around the desk. They’re currently in the middle of a game of cards.
rows.translation: 眼下没有孩子需要照顾，长期受聘的教师和专家都在办公桌附近闲逛。他们正在进行一场纸牌游戏。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout any children to attend to, the staff of teachers and experts on retainer are milling around the desk. They’re currently in the middle of a game of cards."

rows.original: The milking room feels so soft and comfortable, entirely designed to be as relaxing and soothing as possible for long, stress-free hours spent producing sustenance for the nursery’s charges. Soft, warm light floods the room; bright enough to comfortably illuminate the room, but completely unlike the harsh fluorescent lighting used throughout the rest of the station, with a soft, inviting couch tucked against one of the walls. Far more homely than anywhere else around Tavros.
rows.translation: 挤奶室感觉极其柔软舒适，整体设计都旨在让人在漫长、毫无压力的产出育儿室儿童口粮期间，尽可能放松安宁。柔和温暖的灯光洒满房间，亮度足以舒适地照明，却完全不同于空间站其他地方使用的刺眼荧光灯；一张柔软诱人的长沙发贴墙摆放。这里比塔弗罗斯周围任何地方都更有家的感觉。

rows.original:
The private suite you’ve been assigned in the nursery is... well, it looks like your room growing up. So much so that you’re half sure Dad just boxed your things up and mailed them out here. Familiar posters, devices, and even the bedspread all remind you of home.

On top of the bedroom suite, your apartment comes equipped with a kitchen, living room... everything you need to live here more than comfortably for extended periods of time, really.
rows.translation:
育儿室分配给你的私人套房...怎么说呢，简直像你从小住到大的房间。相似到让你有一半把握，父亲只是把你的东西装箱，直接邮寄到了这里。熟悉的海报、设备，甚至床罩，都让你想起家。

除了卧室套间，你的公寓还配有厨房、客厅...说真的，长期住在这里所需的一切都很齐全，舒适程度绰绰有余。

rows.original:
Qailla taps a button on her outfit, and a hardlight apron flutters out to protect her body. She flies into action, ferrying the gems between numerous pieces of heavy machinery. Some of them have transparent housings you assume are plastic at first but reveal themselves to be made of hardened light like much of the rest of the shop. When you ask questions, she swiftly shushes you, explaining that it is a delicate process that requires her entire concentration. She’s like a different woman entirely while she works. Her movements are precise, and her curses are more refined, like a zaikan peer instead of any goblin you’ve ever met.

	After an hour, the gems are securely arranged in a titanium-steel-printed housing and ready for use. All that remains is to name the finished product.
rows.translation:
凯拉按下衣服上的一个按钮，一条硬光围裙飘展开来，护住她的身体。她立刻投入行动，在数台重型机械之间来回运送宝石。其中一些机械装有透明外壳，你起初以为那是塑料，随后才发现，它们和店里许多其他东西一样，都是由固化光制成的。你开口询问时，她迅速嘘声制止你，并解释说这道精细的工序需要她全神贯注。工作中的她简直判若两人。她的动作精准利落，咒骂也文雅了许多，听起来更像一位扎伊卡贵族，而不是你见过的任何哥布林。

	一个小时后，宝石被牢牢地排列在一个钛钢打印的外壳中，已经可以投入使用。现在只剩下为成品命名了。
rows.raw: "Qailla taps a button on her outfit, and a hardlight apron flutters out to protect her body. She flies into action, ferrying the gems between numerous pieces of heavy machinery. Some of them have transparent housings you assume are plastic at first but reveal themselves to be made of hardened light like much of the rest of the shop. When you ask questions, she swiftly shushes you, explaining that it is a delicate process that requires her entire concentration. She’s like a different woman entirely while she works. Her movements are precise, and her curses are more refined, like a zaikan peer instead of any goblin you’ve ever met.\n\n\tAfter an hour, the gems are securely arranged in a titanium-steel-printed housing and ready for use. All that remains is to name the finished product."

rows.original:
The inside of this low-ceilinged shop glows from everywhere at once: the comedy-sized hardlight mallets on the wall, the illusory plants sprouting from pots of every shape and style, and a hardlight chandelier that massively outshines the low-burning candles it supports. Crude corrugated metal splits the chamber across the middle, topped with a perfectly flat photonic surface that supports the register and the short-statured shop-owner’s swollen bosom.

	A decidedly un-goblin-like tail curls curiously over her shoulder, wrapped in the zaika style.
rows.translation:
这间低矮店铺的内部仿佛每个角落都在发光：墙上挂着滑稽巨大的硬光槌，各式各样的花盆里长着幻象植物，还有一盏硬光枝形吊灯，其光芒远远盖过了它所托举的昏暗蜡烛。粗糙的波纹金属板从中间将房间一分为二，顶端则是一面绝对平整的光子台面，既托着收银机，也托着矮个子店主丰硕的胸脯。

	一条明显不像哥布林所有的尾巴好奇地卷过她的肩头，并以扎伊卡风格缠绕起来。
rows.raw: "The inside of this low-ceilinged shop glows from everywhere at once: the comedy-sized hardlight mallets on the wall, the illusory plants sprouting from pots of every shape and style, and a hardlight chandelier that massively outshines the low-burning candles it supports. Crude corrugated metal splits the chamber across the middle, topped with a perfectly flat photonic surface that supports the register and the short-statured shop-owner’s swollen bosom.\n\n\tA decidedly un-goblin-like tail curls curiously over her shoulder, wrapped in the zaika style."

rows.original: The freckled goblin leans forward excitedly. “Oooooh, a customer! What can I get ya? Holopalm? Ausareze Machine Lily? Some cog-punk Gear Blooms?” She abruptly stops as if seeing you for the first time, her nose wrinkling. “Ohhh, you’re a Rusher. I can tell; got that star-stink on ya. You’re not gonna be needin’ the only kind of plant the Gyre’s pollution can’t kill. You’re gonna want something SPECIAL. Something bespoke. Something like a Peer would order if they ever got their heads out of the clouds and stepped in.” Her voice pitches deeper and her pasted-on shopkeeper’s smile morphs into one of quiet confidence. “Want me to make a custom weapon for ya? Hardlight can be any shape, any size, and with the right kinds of crystals, any element.” She waggles her eyebrows. “Come oooon, you know you wanna get one. Something that ain’t mass market, designed for the lowest common denominator? Let’s say...
rows.translation: 长着雀斑的哥布林兴奋地向前探身。“噢——，有客人！想要点什么？全息棕榈？奥萨式机械百合？还是来几株齿轮朋克机械花？”她仿佛这时才第一次看清你，突然停了下来，鼻子微微皱起。“噢，你是个冲袭者。我看得出来；你身上带着那股星际臭味。你可不会需要那种连环带污染都杀不死的唯一植物。你会想要点特别的东西。量身定制的东西。就像那些贵族要是肯把脑袋从云端抽出来、亲自踏进店里时会订购的东西。” 她的声音压低了些，脸上那副刻意摆出的店主笑容也变成了沉静的自信。“想让我给你打造一把定制武器吗？硬光可以变成任何形状、任何尺寸；只要搭配合适的水晶，也能拥有任何元素属性。”她挑了挑眉。“来——嘛，你知道自己想要一把。难道要那种面向最低需求、批量生产的大路货？这样吧...

rows.original: Qailla beams excitedly. “You ain’t gonna find another weapon like mine anywhere short of yer dreams! Well... maybe mine.” The goblin makes a show of sharing an enormous wink. “But I betcha that one wadn’t enough for a Rusher like you, right? You have appetites. You need more. Maybe we can do better...? Maybe another fits better in your hand, has some better balance, or is just what you need to seduce a hoity-toity Peer that’ll put out for any alien with a hint of power.” She smirks smugly. “Come on, you got more gems right? Custom work is soooo much more fun than making dime-a-dozen hardlight plants for some gakker’s office! Let me fix you up an even better one!”
rows.translation: 凯拉兴奋得满面放光。“除非在梦里，否则你哪儿都找不到另一把像我做的武器！嗯...也许在我的梦里可以。”哥布林夸张地朝你眨了个大大的眼。“但我敢说，对你这样的冲袭者来说，那一把肯定不够，对吧？你胃口很大。你需要更多。也许我们能做得更好...? 也许另一把拿在手里更称手、平衡更出色，或者正好能帮你勾引某个趾高气扬的贵族——那种只要外星人显出一点力量就会投怀送抱的家伙。”她得意地坏笑。“来吧，你还有更多宝石，对不对？定制活儿可比给某个嘎克人的办公室制作那些烂大街的硬光植物有趣多——了！让我再给你做一把更棒的！”

rows.original: Qailla grins knowingly at the sight of you. “Change your mind yet? You know you want me to make a gleaming, custom weapon to your exact... tastes. Your wants, your desires, writ in crystal and steel.” She flutters her eyelashes and sighs longingly. “I’ll strum the photons like a lover’s clit, guide them into a full, tumescent shape to rival and tail- err, cock. But a weapon, yah. You know the price.
rows.translation: 凯拉一看见你，便露出心领神会的笑容。“改变主意了吗？你知道自己想让我按你的确切...口味，打造一把闪闪发亮的定制武器。你的需求、你的欲望，全都铭刻在水晶和钢铁之中。”她扑闪着睫毛，渴望地叹了口气。“我会像拨弄爱人的阴蒂那样拨动光子，引导它们长成饱满、勃胀的形状，足以媲美尾——呃，肉棒。不过是武器，对。你知道价钱。

rows.raw: "\n\nThe dark woman presses her lips together, clearly not impressed. “What do you want me to say? I talk to myself. I’m clearly just nuts, right? Pretty cut and dry to me.” The Servant crosses her arms over her chest, her face telling you she very much wishes to move on."

rows.original: You know she isn’t being honest with you, but her body language is screaming discomfort. Sparing her, you let the topic lie, but you fully intend to explore the topic later when she’s willing to be more forthcoming.
rows.translation: 你知道她没有坦诚相告，但肢体语言正大声诉说着不适。你暂且放过她，不再提这个话题；不过等她愿意更加坦白时，你绝对打算再次深入探究。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou know she isn’t being honest with you, but her body language is screaming discomfort. Sparing her, you let the topic lie, but you fully intend to explore the topic later when she’s willing to be more forthcoming."

rows.original: The dark woman gives you an oddly warm smile, seemingly appreciative of you letting her move the conversation off the topic. “Thank you, [pc.name]. Now, as for your other question, about my style, well the truth is simply that I like it. I could give you a pretentious answer about how I’ve always felt ‘strange and unusual’, but that would be partially disingenuous of me. I’ve just always found it pleasing. Dark colors, fishnets, corsets, tea by candlelight. It’s just so... me.”
rows.translation: 黑衣女人露出一个异样温暖的微笑，似乎很感激你允许她把谈话从那个话题上移开。“谢谢你，[pc.name]。至于你另一个关于我风格的问题，事实很简单：我喜欢。我当然可以故作高深，说自己一直觉得‘怪异而不同寻常’，但那多少有些言不由衷。我只是一直觉得这些东西赏心悦目。深色、渔网、束腰、烛光下喝茶。这就是...我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dark woman gives you an oddly warm smile, seemingly appreciative of you letting her move the conversation off the topic. “Thank you, [pc.name]. Now, as for your other question, about my style, well the truth is simply that I like it. I could give you a pretentious answer about how I’ve always felt ‘strange and unusual’, but that would be partially disingenuous of me. I’ve just always found it pleasing. Dark colors, fishnets, corsets, tea by candlelight. It’s just so... me.”"

rows.original: She leans back in her chair, tapping a painted black fingernail against her chin. “It’s a rabbit hole, you see.. It just gets deeper and deeper. I started off just wanting to wear black. Then the hair dye became a must. Then the make-up started. Before I knew it I was drowning in it.” She closes her eyes and smiles. “Deeper than I ever thought possible...”
rows.translation: 她靠回椅背，用涂成黑色的指甲轻敲下巴。“你瞧，这是个兔子洞...只会越来越深。一开始我只是想穿黑色。接着染发成了必需。然后又开始化妆。等我回过神来，已经彻底淹没其中了。”她闭眼微笑。“比我曾经想象的还要深...”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leans back in her chair, tapping a painted black fingernail against her chin. “It’s a rabbit hole, you see.. It just gets deeper and deeper. I started off just wanting to wear black. Then the hair dye became a must. Then the make-up started. Before I knew it I was drowning in it.” She closes her eyes and smiles. “Deeper than I ever thought possible...”"

rows.original: When she opens her eyes you notice she is oddly composed, and almost you’d dare say normal. When she’s not talking to herself, or having a fit, her company isn’t half bad. The two of you sit in silence for a moment, enjoying the brief pause.
rows.translation: 她睁眼时，你发现她出奇地镇定，甚至几乎可以说很正常。不自言自语、也不突然发作时，她其实不算难相处。你们沉默地坐了一会儿，享受这短暂的停顿。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she opens her eyes you notice she is oddly composed, and almost you’d dare say normal. When she’s not talking to herself, or having a fit, her company isn’t half bad. The two of you sit in silence for a moment, enjoying the brief pause."

rows.original: “So,” she she leans back in, her blue eyes shining in the candlelight once more. “Does that answer your questions?”
rows.translation: “所以，”她重新倾身靠近，蓝眼睛再次在烛光中闪耀。“这满足你的好奇心了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So,” she she leans back in, her blue eyes shining in the candlelight once more. “Does that answer your questions?” "

rows.original: You consider her question for a moment before you answer. “Mostly.” As much as you’d like to crack deeper into why she is the way she is, you can’t help but feel that quitting while you’re ahead is a smart idea.
rows.translation: 你思考片刻后回答。“大致上吧。”尽管你很想进一步弄清她为何变成现在这样，却又忍不住觉得见好就收才是明智之举。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou consider her question for a moment before you answer. “Mostly.” As much as you’d like to crack deeper into why she is the way she is, you can’t help but feel that quitting while you’re ahead is a smart idea."

rows.original: Her Deal
rows.translation: 她的情况
rows.raw: "Her Deal"

rows.original: You ask The Servant about her past.
rows.translation: 你询问仆从的过去。
rows.raw: "You ask The Servant about her past."

rows.original: She seems to shudder at the question, almost like a child forced to eat some disgusting veggie. “Oh. I promise you, that is an objectively banal topic. I’m sure we could talk about something far more... stimulating.” Below the table, you feel her foot reach out, brushing against your leg slightly. She gives you a coy smile, with suggestive bedroom eyes.
rows.translation: 她听到问题后似乎打了个寒颤，就像被迫吃下某种恶心蔬菜的孩子。“哦。我向你保证，那客观上是个无聊透顶的话题。我们肯定能聊点更...刺激的东西。”桌子下方，你感到她伸来一只脚，轻轻擦过你的腿。她露出暧昧微笑，双眼充满卧室里的暗示。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to shudder at the question, almost like a child forced to eat some disgusting veggie. “Oh. I promise you, that is an objectively banal topic. I’m sure we could talk about something far more... stimulating.” Below the table, you feel her foot reach out, brushing against your leg slightly. She gives you a coy smile, with suggestive bedroom eyes."

rows.original: Now you’re curious. The dark woman has skirted topics before, but not like this. You don’t feel like she’s hiding something, just that she doesn’t seem to want to talk about it. With a small smile, you shake off the woman’s foot and press the issue.
rows.translation: 这下你更好奇了。黑衣女人以前也回避过话题，却从没像这样。你不觉得她在隐藏什么，只是觉得她完全不想谈论这件事。你微微一笑，甩开女人的脚，继续追问。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow you’re curious. The dark woman has skirted topics before, but not like this. You don’t feel like she’s hiding something, just that she doesn’t seem to want to talk about it. With a small smile, you shake off the woman’s foot and press the issue."

rows.original: The Servant lets out a small huff, seemingly of defeat, and pulls her foot away. “You’re no fun. Very well then. Where to start...” she leans back in her chair, playing with a dark lock of hair absentmindedly. “Well I’m from Terra... we call it ‘Earth’, but that’s not the point.” She lets go of her hair and starts scratching at her temple. You notice a small bit of color tint her pale cheeks. Is she blushing? “I lived there until I was eighteen, then I left for school and... well here I am. That’s my story.” Shifting in her seat, her gaze continues to wander, not meeting yours directly.
rows.translation: 仆从轻轻哼了一声，似乎认输了，把脚收了回去。“你真没意思。那好吧。该从哪里说起呢...”她靠回椅背，心不在焉地把玩一缕黑发。“我来自泰拉...我们叫它‘地球’，不过这不重要。”她放开头发，开始抓挠太阳穴。你注意到一丝颜色染上她苍白的脸颊。她在脸红吗？“我在那里住到十八岁，然后离家上学，再后来...嗯，我就到了这里。这就是我的故事。”她在座位上挪动，目光依旧游移，不肯直视你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant lets out a small huff, seemingly of defeat, and pulls her foot away. “You’re no fun. Very well then. Where to start...” she leans back in her chair, playing with a dark lock of hair absentmindedly. “Well I’m from Terra... we call it ‘Earth’, but that’s not the point.” She lets go of her hair and starts scratching at her temple. You notice a small bit of color tint her pale cheeks. Is she blushing? “I lived there until I was eighteen, then I left for school and... well here I am. That’s my story.” Shifting in her seat, her gaze continues to wander, not meeting yours directly."

rows.original: “That’s it?” Her answer leaves much to be desired, and you can clearly tell she’s holding back. You decide to press again, if only because her behavior has you still curious.
rows.translation: “就这些？”她的回答远不能令人满意，而且你看得出她仍有所隐瞒。哪怕只是因为她的表现让你好奇心未消，你也决定再次追问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s it?” Her answer leaves much to be desired, and you can clearly tell she’s holding back. You decide to press again, if only because her behavior has you still curious."

rows.original: “That can’t be all. What about after you left home?”
rows.translation: “不可能只有这些。你离家之后呢？”
rows.raw: " “That can’t be all. What about after you left home?”"

rows.original: “You’re a terrible liar. Come on, tell me everything.”
rows.translation: “你撒谎糟透了。来吧，把一切都告诉我。”
rows.raw: " “You’re a terrible liar. Come on, tell me everything.”"

rows.original: “We both know you’re going to tell me what I want to know, so quit jerking my chain.”
rows.translation: “我们都知道你最后会告诉我想知道的，所以别再吊我胃口。”
rows.raw: " “We both know you’re going to tell me what I want to know, so quit jerking my chain.”"

rows.original: The Servant fiddles with the rings on her fingers, her gaze still not meeting yours. After a few long heartbeats, she lets out a deep sigh and rolls her eyes, continuing on with a tone you’ve never heard from her before: Bratty. “Look. I was just a typical Earth girl who did typical Earth girl things, okay? My life didn’t get even remotely interesting until a year ago.” She pauses for a moment, seemingly catching herself on some minor slip up. “My Mommy never beat me, my Daddy didn’t diddle me, and I didn’t cry myself to sleep every night until I learned to spread my wings, be myself, and morph into a camel, or whatever it is people do.”
rows.translation: 仆从摆弄着指环，目光仍不与你相接。几个漫长心跳后，她深深叹气、翻了个白眼，用一种你从未听她用过的语气继续：任性而孩子气。“听着。我只是个普通的地球女孩，做着普通地球女孩会做的事，明白吗？直到一年前，我的人生才出现哪怕一丁点算得上有趣的东西。”她停顿片刻，似乎意识到自己不小心说漏了什么。“我妈咪从没打我，我爹地也没猥亵我；我也没每晚哭着睡着，直到终于学会展翅、做自己、变形成骆驼，或者人们故事里通常会做的什么事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant fiddles with the rings on her fingers, her gaze still not meeting yours. After a few long heartbeats, she lets out a deep sigh and rolls her eyes, continuing on with a tone you’ve never heard from her before: Bratty. “Look. I was just a typical Earth girl who did typical Earth girl things, okay? My life didn’t get even remotely interesting until a year ago.” She pauses for a moment, seemingly catching herself on some minor slip up. “My Mommy never beat me, my Daddy didn’t diddle me, and I didn’t cry myself to sleep every night until I learned to spread my wings, be myself, and morph into a camel, or whatever it is people do.”"

rows.original: She leans back in her chair, crossing her arms over her chest defensively. “I have no sad and tragic backstory, Steele. So I’m really not sure what the fuck you’re looking for. What you see is what you get, and that’s fucking it. I’m not some deep book. Fuck, I’m barely a pamphlet at best. Ya got it?” The Servant turns her head away from you, pouting.
rows.translation: 她靠回椅背，防备地把双臂交叉在胸前。“我没有什么悲惨动人的身世，斯蒂尔。所以我真不知道你他妈到底想找什么。你看到的就是全部，就是他妈这么回事。我不是什么内涵深刻的书。操，充其量也就是本宣传册。懂了吗？”仆从扭头不看你，气鼓鼓地噘着嘴。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leans back in her chair, crossing her arms over her chest defensively. “I have no sad and tragic backstory, Steele. So I’m really not sure what the fuck you’re looking for. What you see is what you get, and that’s fucking it. I’m not some deep book. Fuck, I’m barely a pamphlet at best. Ya got it?” The Servant turns her head away from you, pouting. "

rows.original: Something you said upset her, but her reaction was far less mature than you would have expected. Does she really not want to talk about herself that much? In an attempt to change the topic, you ask the pouting woman what she went to school for.
rows.translation: 你的某句话惹恼了她，但她的反应远比你想象得幼稚。她真的这么不愿意谈自己吗？为了换个话题，你询问这个正在闹别扭的女人当初在学校学了什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething you said upset her, but her reaction was far less mature than you would have expected. Does she really not want to talk about herself that much? In an attempt to change the topic, you ask the pouting woman what she went to school for."

rows.original: As you ask the question The Servant’s demeanor seems to change, her arm loosening up over her chest, and her eyes shifting back to you. “I... have a degree in anthropology. It’s from the First University of Europa.” She lowers her arms, the last traces of her brattiness fading away. “My focus was on shared myths and legends between different worlds,” she seems to come alive as she speaks, her painted lips turning into something resembling a smile. “I had recently started a graduate program abroad. My thesis was... well, I wanted to prove that there were common threads between civilizations. Cultures light years apart, mind you. Things that didn’t just resemble each other by coincidence.”
rows.translation: 你提出问题时，仆从的神态似乎改变了；交叠在胸前的手臂放松下来，目光也转回你身上。“我...有人类学学位。是木卫二第一大学颁发的。”她放下双臂，最后一点任性神态也消失了。“我的研究重点是不同世界之间共有的神话和传说，”她越说越有精神，涂彩的嘴唇弯成近似笑容的形状。“我当时刚在外地开始一个研究生项目。我的论文是...嗯，我想证明不同文明之间存在共同脉络。注意，是相距数光年的文化。那些相似之处不可能只是巧合。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you ask the question The Servant’s demeanor seems to change, her arm loosening up over her chest, and her eyes shifting back to you. “I... have a degree in anthropology. It’s from the First University of Europa.” She lowers her arms, the last traces of her brattiness fading away. “My focus was on shared myths and legends between different worlds,” she seems to come alive as she speaks, her painted lips turning into something resembling a smile. “I had recently started a graduate program abroad. My thesis was... well, I wanted to prove that there were common threads between civilizations. Cultures light years apart, mind you. Things that didn’t just resemble each other by coincidence.”"

rows.original: “Now I’m not just talking some similar iconography,” she leans in close, her face lighting up. “I’m talking the same stuff at a structural level. Some academics take it as possible proof of seeder races... um, yanno, advanced civilizations that start up life on other planets. But this can’t be that.” She chews her lip, barely containing her enthusiasm. “This stuff doesn’t pop up when civilizations just start, it dates much later on, well after their cultures are already established. Thousands of years after in some cases.”
rows.translation: “我说的可不只是相似的图案，”她靠近你，整张脸明亮起来。“我说的是结构层面完全相同的东西。有些学者把这当成播种者种族可能存在的证据...呃，你知道，就是那些在其他星球启动生命的先进文明。但这不可能是那种情况。”她咬着嘴唇，几乎压抑不住兴奋。“这些东西并不是在文明刚诞生时出现，而是在很久以后——文化已经确立之后。有时甚至晚了数千年。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now I’m not just talking some similar iconography,” she leans in close, her face lighting up. “I’m talking the same stuff at a structural level. Some academics take it as possible proof of seeder races... um, yanno, advanced civilizations that start up life on other planets. But this can’t be that.” She chews her lip, barely containing her enthusiasm. “This stuff doesn’t pop up when civilizations just start, it dates much later on, well after their cultures are already established. Thousands of years after in some cases.”"

rows.original: You’ve never really looked into this before. Could there be something to it? And if so what does this mean?
rows.translation: 你以前从未真正研究过这件事。也许其中确实另有文章？如果是，那对她又意味着什么？
rows.raw: " You’ve never really looked into this before. Could there be something to it? And if so what does this mean?"

rows.original: You’ve actually heard about this before, but nothing concrete. If true, it’s certainly something worth studying, although the implications are difficult to predict.
rows.translation: 你以前其实听说过这件事，但从未得到确切信息。若是真的，那绝对值得进一步了解。
rows.raw: " You’ve actually heard about this before, but nothing concrete. If true, it’s certainly something worth studying, although the implications are difficult to predict."

rows.original: Just from watching her, you can tell she’s truly passionate about the subject. Keeping the conversation going, you ask her how her research is going at her school.
rows.translation: 光看她的样子，你就知道她对这个话题真的很有热情。让谈话继续下去似乎没有坏处。
rows.raw: " Just from watching her, you can tell she’s truly passionate about the subject. Keeping the conversation going, you ask her how her research is going at her school."

rows.original: The Servant’s smile melts away, the woman suddenly becoming crestfallen. “I... dropped out around a year ago.” She turns away from you, starting to play with her hair again, closing herself off.
rows.translation: 仆从的笑容消失了，她突然垂头丧气。“我...大约一年前退学了。”她转开脸，再次把玩起头发，将自己封闭起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant’s smile melts away, the woman suddenly becoming crestfallen. “I... dropped out around a year ago.” She turns away from you, starting to play with her hair again, closing herself off."

rows.original: “What?” Based on the way she was just talking about it, you can hardly believe your ears. “Was the workload too much or...” you pause, keying in on what she just said. This is the second time now she’s mentioned something happening a year ago. “What happened a year ago?”
rows.translation: “什么？”从她刚才谈论这件事的方式来看，你简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。“是课业负担太重，还是...”你停下来，抓住她刚才说的话。这已经是她第二次提到一年前发生过什么。“一年前究竟发生了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?” Based on the way she was just talking about it, you can hardly believe your ears. “Was the workload too much or...” you pause, keying in on what she just said. This is the second time now she’s mentioned something happening a year ago. “What happened a year ago?”"

rows.original: She glances over at you, her bright blue eyes wide as saucers. Remaining silent for a moment, you hear her mutter something under her breath. “No. I’m not going to say anything. Shut up.”
rows.translation: 她看向你，明亮的蓝眼睛睁得像碟子一样大。她沉默片刻，你听见她压低声音嘟囔。“不。我什么都不会说。闭嘴。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe glances over at you, her bright blue eyes wide as saucers. Remaining silent for a moment, you hear her mutter something under her breath. “No. I’m not going to say anything. Shut up.”"

rows.original: You frown. “Excuse me?”
rows.translation: 你皱起眉。“你说什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou frown. “Excuse me?”"

rows.original: The dark woman flinches. “Oh. No. Not you... I was talking to...”
rows.translation: 黑衣女人猛地一缩。“哦。不，不是你...我是在和...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dark woman flinches. “Oh. No. Not you... I was talking to...”"

rows.original: “Your master...” You feel your frown tighten.
rows.translation: “你的主人...”你的眉头皱得更紧了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your master...” You feel your frown tighten."

rows.original: “Yeah...” she presses her thick lips together, her gaze falling away from you. After a moment of awkward silence, she turns back to you. “Can... can we just move on? Like to sex or something? Sorry, I’m just really... bummed out right now.”
rows.translation: “对...”她抿紧厚唇，把视线移开。尴尬沉默片刻后，她重新转向你。“我们...能不能换个话题？比如做爱之类的？抱歉，我现在真的...心情很糟。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah...” she presses her thick lips together, her gaze falling away from you. After a moment of awkward silence, she turns back to you. “Can... can we just move on? Like to sex or something? Sorry, I’m just really... bummed out right now.”"

rows.original: Reading the sudden shift in the mood, you let the topic die.
rows.translation: 察觉气氛突然变化，你让这个话题就此结束。
rows.raw: "\n\nReading the sudden shift in the mood, you let the topic die."

rows.original: History
rows.translation: 过去
rows.raw: "History"

rows.original: You ask The Servant about her family, if she has one.
rows.translation: 你询问仆从是否有家人。
rows.raw: "You ask The Servant about her family, if she has one."

rows.original: The Servant blinks. “Ah. Yeah, of course I do.”
rows.translation: 仆从眨了眨眼。“啊。有，我当然有。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant blinks. “Ah. Yeah, of course I do.”"

rows.original: She smiles at you faintly, and it’s only after a few moments you realize that was her whole answer. “Wow... could you... tell me about them?”
rows.translation: 她淡淡地对你一笑；过了几秒你才意识到，那就是她的全部回答。“哇...你能不能...多说说他们？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles at you faintly, and it’s only after a few moments you realize that was her whole answer. “Wow... could you... tell me about them?”"

rows.original: “Oh!” She sits up a little straighter in her seat, like a student addressing a teacher. “Well, I have two parents. A mother and father, standard human affair, you know? Uh, they both live on Terra, and...” She presses her lips together, her eyes wandering as she thinks for a moment. “Well... I haven’t spoken to them in around a year, but last I heard all was well.” She shrugs, seemingly finished once more.
rows.translation: “哦！”她在座位上坐直了些，像回答老师问题的学生。“嗯，我有两位父母。一位母亲和一位父亲，标准的人类组合，你懂吧？呃，他们都住在泰拉，而且...”她抿紧嘴唇，眼神游移着思考片刻。“嗯...我大概一年没和他们说话了，不过上次听说时一切都好。”她耸耸肩，似乎又说完了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh!” She sits up a little straighter in her seat, like a student addressing a teacher. “Well, I have two parents. A mother and father, standard human affair, you know? Uh, they both live on Terra, and...” She presses her lips together, her eyes wandering as she thinks for a moment. “Well... I haven’t spoken to them in around a year, but last I heard all was well.” She shrugs, seemingly finished once more."

rows.original: “Wait. Hold on a second.” You’ve seen the pale woman be evasive before, but this is something else. Is that really all she has to say?
rows.translation: “等等。先停一下。”你以前见过这个苍白女人闪烁其词，但这次明显另有隐情。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait. Hold on a second.” You’ve seen the pale woman be evasive before, but this is something else. Is that really all she has to say?"

rows.original: “Why haven’t you spoken to your parents in so long?”
rows.translation: “你为什么这么久没和父母说过话？”
rows.raw: " “Why haven’t you spoken to your parents in so long?”"

rows.original: “Geez, and I thought things were rough with my Dad. What’s the deal with that?”
rows.translation: “天啊，我还以为我和老爸的关系够糟了。你们到底怎么回事？”
rows.raw: " “Geez, and I thought things were rough with my Dad. What’s the deal with that?”"

rows.original: “Really? Shit, I thought I was cold.”
rows.translation: “真的？该死，我还以为自己够冷漠了。”
rows.raw: " “Really? Shit, I thought I was cold.”"

rows.original: The Servant frowns, then mutters something to herself. “Yes, it’s a legitimate question.” She seems to fight off the urge to roll her eyes, then looks you dead in the eye. “I’ve been busy. Maybe not with what they think I’ve been busy with mind you... but still busy. They think I’m still in school, and I simply feel no need to correct that.” She shrugs, seemingly unable to offer anything else. “That’s really just about it, [pc.name]. But if it’ll make you feel better, I’ll call them over the holidays.”
rows.translation: 仆从皱起眉，随后低声自言自语。“是的，这是个合理的问题。”她似乎强忍住翻白眼的冲动，随后直视你的双眼。“我一直很忙。也许忙的不是他们以为我在忙的事...但还是很忙。他们以为我仍在上学，而我觉得没必要纠正。”她耸耸肩，似乎再也说不出别的。“差不多就是这样，[pc.name]。不过如果能让你好受点，我会在节日期间打给他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant frowns, then mutters something to herself. “Yes, it’s a legitimate question.” She seems to fight off the urge to roll her eyes, then looks you dead in the eye. “I’ve been busy. Maybe not with what they think I’ve been busy with mind you... but still busy. They think I’m still in school, and I simply feel no need to correct that.” She shrugs, seemingly unable to offer anything else. “That’s really just about it, [pc.name]. But if it’ll make you feel better, I’ll call them over the holidays.”"

rows.original: Now it’s your turn to frown. “It doesn’t.” You get the feeling this topic was more or less dead the moment you opened your mouth.
rows.translation: 现在轮到你皱眉了。“这根本说不通。”你觉得这个话题大致已经走到尽头。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow it’s your turn to frown. “It doesn’t.” You get the feeling this topic was more or less dead the moment you opened your mouth."

rows.original: Family?
rows.translation: 家人？
rows.raw: "Family?"

rows.original: You ask The Servant why she doesn’t want you using her real name.
rows.translation: 你询问仆从为什么不希望你使用她的真名。
rows.raw: "You ask The Servant why she doesn’t want you using her real name."

rows.original: “Ah...” She shifts in her seat and fiddles with her rings, clearly uncomfortable with your question. “Well... it’s not exactly my choice mind you... but my master insists that names are merely labels that limit us.”
rows.translation: “啊...”她在座位上挪动，摆弄着指环，显然因你的问题感到不自在。“嗯...严格说来这也不是我的选择...但主人坚持认为，名字只是限制我们的标签。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah...” She shifts in her seat and fiddles with her rings, clearly uncomfortable with your question. “Well... it’s not exactly my choice mind you... but my master insists that names are merely labels that limit us.”"

rows.original: You sigh and roll your eyes. “What the hell does that mean?”
rows.translation: 你叹气并翻了个白眼。“这到底是什么意思？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh and roll your eyes. “What the hell does that mean?”"

rows.original: The Servant rubs her forehead, seemingly wincing. “I’ll explain it, god... give me a second.” Something about the way she answers tells you she isn’t talking to you.
rows.translation: 仆从揉着额头，似乎在忍痛。“我会解释的，天啊...给我一点时间。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant rubs her forehead, seemingly wincing. “I’ll explain it, god... give me a second.” Something about the way she answers tells you she isn’t talking to you."

rows.original: She takes a deep breath and lowers her hand, steeling herself before you. “Think of it this way... You’re last name is Steele, correct? Think about all that means and entails. Now, in your case, that means a lot right? People know something because of it. You’ve been defined. But you’re not just Steele. You’re something else. Nonconstant. You can change, and grow. So how can a label you got at birth possibly define you for the rest of your life?”
rows.translation: 她深吸一口气，放下手，在你面前坚定心神。“这么想吧...你的姓是斯蒂尔，对吧？想想它所代表、所包含的一切。对你而言，这意味着很多，对吗？人们因为它而知道一些事情。你已经被定义了。但你不只是斯蒂尔。你还是别的东西。你并非恒定不变。你可以改变，可以成长。那么，一个出生时得到的标签，怎么可能定义你的余生？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes a deep breath and lowers her hand, steeling herself before you. “Think of it this way... You’re last name is Steele, correct? Think about all that means and entails. Now, in your case, that means a lot right? People know something because of it. You’ve been defined. But you’re not just Steele. You’re something else. Nonconstant. You can change, and grow. So how can a label you got at birth possibly define you for the rest of your life?”"

rows.original: Despite yourself, you follow her reasoning. That’s not to say you agree with it, but you at least understand where she’s coming from. “So why ‘The Servant’ then? Why call you that in particular?”
rows.translation: 尽管你并不情愿，却还是顺着她的逻辑想了下去。你未必赞同，但至少明白她的出发点。“那为什么是‘仆从’？为什么偏偏这样称呼你？”
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite yourself, you follow her reasoning. That’s not to say you agree with it, but you at least understand where she’s coming from. “So why ‘The Servant’ then? Why call you that in particular?”"

rows.original: The dark woman doesn’t answer right away, and just rocks back in her chair. Watching her, you notice one of her eyes twitch slightly. “Because... right now, it is what I am. Look... Miranda... I’m not her anymore. Not really. Haven’t been for awhile. If you’d rather call me that, then that’s fine, but I’d rather you respect...” she pauses searching for the right word. “My wish and call me The Servant.” The pale woman takes a deep breath and shrugs. “And yes, I realize how awkward that is to use in a sentence.”
rows.translation: 黑衣女人没有立刻回答，只是在椅子上向后摇晃。观察着她，你注意到其中一只眼睛微微抽动。“因为...现在的我就是这个。听着...米兰达...我已经不是她了。不完全是。已经有一段时间了。如果你宁愿那样叫我，也可以，但我希望你能尊重...”她停下来寻找合适的词。“我的意愿，叫我仆从。”苍白女人深吸一口气，耸耸肩。“是的，我知道这个称呼放进句子里很别扭。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dark woman doesn’t answer right away, and just rocks back in her chair. Watching her, you notice one of her eyes twitch slightly. “Because... right now, it is what I am. Look... Miranda... I’m not her anymore. Not really. Haven’t been for awhile. If you’d rather call me that, then that’s fine, but I’d rather you respect...” she pauses searching for the right word. “My wish and call me The Servant.” The pale woman takes a deep breath and shrugs. “And yes, I realize how awkward that is to use in a sentence.”"

rows.original: You chew on that in silence. While her answer isn’t particularly good, you don’t see the harm in indulging her for now.
rows.translation: 你沉默着咀嚼这番话。她的回答虽算不上好，但你也看不出继续逼问能有什么益处。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chew on that in silence. While her answer isn’t particularly good, you don’t see the harm in indulging her for now."

rows.original: You ask The Servant about her tattoos.
rows.translation: 你询问仆从身上的纹身。
rows.raw: "You ask The Servant about her tattoos."

rows.original: “Ah.” An excited smile creeps across her face. “Well. I assume you’re asking about one in particular, but since you asked...” She turns her head slightly, lifting a thin finger to point at the back of her neck. “You saw this one right?”
rows.translation: “啊。”兴奋的笑容爬上她的脸。“好吧。我猜你是在问某一幅特别的纹身，不过既然你问了...”她微微偏过头，抬起纤细手指指向后颈。“你看过这幅，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah.” An excited smile creeps across her face. “Well. I assume you’re asking about one in particular, but since you asked...” She turns her head slightly, lifting a thin finger to point at the back of her neck. “You saw this one right?”"

rows.original: You nod, faintly remembering the infinity symbol on the back of her neck when she stripped for you before.
rows.translation: 你点点头，隐约记得她曾为你脱衣时，后颈上露出的无限符号。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, faintly remembering the infinity symbol on the back of her neck when she stripped for you before."

rows.original: “This was number one. I got it when I was fourteen and really shouldn’t have been getting tattoos at all. But, I really just wanted to get one, so I forged my mother’s signature and that was that. Small and in a place they wouldn’t see. Or so I thought. They found out a few weeks later.” She drops her hand and turns her neck back. “Grounded for a week, but they let me keep it, so it all worked out.” Scooting her chair back slightly, she pats her stocking covered thighs. “Now, these two were a different story.”
rows.translation: “这是第一幅。我十四岁时纹的，那年纪根本不该去纹身。但我实在想要一幅，于是伪造了母亲的签名，就这么成了。图案很小，位置也不会被他们看到——至少我原本这么以为。几周后他们还是发现了。”她放下手，把脖子转回来。“禁足一周，不过他们允许我留下它，所以结果还不错。”她把椅子稍稍往后挪，拍了拍丝袜覆盖的大腿。“至于这两幅，就是另一个故事了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This was number one. I got it when I was fourteen and really shouldn’t have been getting tattoos at all. But, I really just wanted to get one, so I forged my mother’s signature and that was that. Small and in a place they wouldn’t see. Or so I thought. They found out a few weeks later.” She drops her hand and turns her neck back. “Grounded for a week, but they let me keep it, so it all worked out.” Scooting her chair back slightly, she pats her stocking covered thighs. “Now, these two were a different story.”"

rows.original: “The ribbons.” you say aloud. You clearly remember those ones, one the back of each of her pale thighs.
rows.translation: “那些丝带。”你说。你清楚记得那两幅，一幅在她每条腿的后侧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The ribbons.” you say aloud. You clearly remember those ones, one the back of each of her pale thighs."

rows.original: “With these two I wanted something sexy, but classy. Me and my mother came to an agreement and she let me get them.” She shifts her chair forward, chuckling slightly. “Only after she rejected a few more risque choices of mine. I was sixteen, so still on a short leash with her.” Leaning back in her chair, she pats her corset covered abdomen. “Now with this one I waited until I was eighteen, so no note required this time.”
rows.translation: “这两幅我想要既性感又优雅。我和母亲达成了协议，她允许我纹。”她把椅子往前挪，轻轻笑了。“当然，是在她否决了我几个更大胆的选择之后。我当时十六岁，所以她还管得很严。”她靠回椅背，拍了拍束腰覆盖的腹部。“至于这幅，我等到十八岁才纹，所以这次不需要许可条。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“With these two I wanted something sexy, but classy. Me and my mother came to an agreement and she let me get them.” She shifts her chair forward, chuckling slightly. “Only after she rejected a few more risque choices of mine. I was sixteen, so still on a short leash with her.” Leaning back in her chair, she pats her corset covered abdomen. “Now with this one I waited until I was eighteen, so no note required this time.”"

rows.original: The odd design around her belly button. You remember it, but couldn’t make heads or tail of what exactly it was supposed to be. Not that you were really inspecting it.
rows.translation: 她肚脐周围那个奇怪图案。你记得它，却完全看不出究竟代表什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe odd design around her belly button. You remember it, but couldn’t make heads or tail of what exactly it was supposed to be. Not that you were really inspecting it. "

rows.original: “It’s an alchemical symbol, however I had the artist spice it up slightly. Actual alchemy symbols are rather... bland, so it’s more based on fiction rather than history.” She smiles, sitting up in her chair, her excitement starting to rise. She seems to take great pride is talking about her tattoos, a passion she doesn’t seem to have for anything other than the necklace at her throat and a few other small subjects. “Now you likely want to know more about my most recent acquisition don’t you?”
rows.translation: “那是一个炼金术符号，不过我让纹身师稍微润色过。真正的炼金术符号通常相当...乏味，所以它更多基于虚构，而非历史。”她微笑着坐直，兴奋逐渐高涨。她显然以谈论自己的纹身为荣；除了颈间项链和少数几个小话题，她对其他东西似乎都没有这种热情。“现在，你大概想进一步了解我最近获得的那幅，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s an alchemical symbol, however I had the artist spice it up slightly. Actual alchemy symbols are rather... bland, so it’s more based on fiction rather than history.” She smiles, sitting up in her chair, her excitement starting to rise. She seems to take great pride is talking about her tattoos, a passion she doesn’t seem to have for anything other than the necklace at her throat and a few other small subjects. “Now you likely want to know more about my most recent acquisition don’t you?”"

rows.original: As you picture the tattoo in your mind, you feel a small ache in your temple. You start to wince at the ache, but when the image leaves your mind’s eye, the pain subsides instantly.
rows.translation: 当你在脑海中勾勒那幅纹身时，太阳穴传来轻微疼痛。你因疼痛开始皱起脸，但那幅图像一离开脑海，痛感便瞬间消退。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you picture the tattoo in your mind, you feel a small ache in your temple. You start to wince at the ache, but when the image leaves your mind’s eye, the pain subsides instantly."

rows.original: The Servant’s blue eyes are fixed on you, watching you closely. “Do you... recognize it?”
rows.translation: 仆从的蓝眼睛紧盯着你，仔细观察。“你...认得它吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant’s blue eyes are fixed on you, watching you closely. “Do you... recognize it?”"

rows.original: You picture it again, the pain returning for a moment. As the image forms, you feel like you have seen it somewhere else before, like something from a dream...
rows.translation: 你再次想象那幅图，疼痛短暂回归。随着影像成形，你觉得自己仿佛就要抓住某段记忆。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou picture it again, the pain returning for a moment. As the image forms, you feel like you have seen it somewhere else before, like something from a dream..."

rows.original: The Servant seems to read your mind. “I thought so.” She bites her lip, her cheeks flushing red. “It took months to complete, and more than a few artists worked on it. When I first drew the design... well, I had to break it up into separate chunks, but as it drew closer to completion, the last artist had to drop out. I finished the final touches myself.” She gives you a wide smile, clearly more than a little proud of herself.
rows.translation: 仆从似乎读懂了你的想法。“我就知道。”她咬住嘴唇，双颊泛红。“它花了几个月才完成，而且参与的纹身师不止一位。我最初画出设计时...嗯，我不得不把它拆成几个独立部分；但接近完成时，最后一位纹身师退出了。我亲自补完最后细节。”她对你灿烂一笑，显然对自己颇为自豪。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant seems to read your mind. “I thought so.” She bites her lip, her cheeks flushing red. “It took months to complete, and more than a few artists worked on it. When I first drew the design... well, I had to break it up into separate chunks, but as it drew closer to completion, the last artist had to drop out. I finished the final touches myself.” She gives you a wide smile, clearly more than a little proud of herself."

rows.original: Something about the image is nagging at you. Like an itch you can’t quite reach. In a moment of clarity, you ask her a simple question. “But what is it?”
rows.translation: 那幅图像一直让你介怀，像一处怎么也挠不到的痒。在某个清醒瞬间，你问了她一个简单的问题。“可它究竟是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething about the image is nagging at you. Like an itch you can’t quite reach. In a moment of clarity, you ask her a simple question. “But what is it?”"

rows.original: The dark woman’s smile fades, replaced by a look of mild disappointment. “You... don’t know?” When you shake your head no, she seems to deflate even more. “I see... well...” she thinks for a moment, seemingly searching for the right thing to say. “It’s... of a god.”
rows.translation: 黑衣女人的笑容淡去，换成轻微失望。“你...不知道？”你摇头否认后，她显得更加泄气。“我明白了...嗯...”她思索片刻，似乎在寻找合适的说法。“那是...一位神。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dark woman’s smile fades, replaced by a look of mild disappointment. “You... don’t know?” When you shake your head no, she seems to deflate even more. “I see... well...” she thinks for a moment, seemingly searching for the right thing to say. “It’s... of a god.”"

rows.original: Thinking back, you don’t recall any god that looks quite like the image on her back, although a few do come somewhat close. Either way, it’s an impressive piece, even if you don’t fully understand it.
rows.translation: 回想起来，你不记得有哪位神祇与她背上的图像完全相同，尽管其中几位多少有些接近。无论如何，那仍是一幅令人印象深刻的作品，即便你并不完全理解它。
rows.raw: "\n\nThinking back, you don’t recall any god that looks quite like the image on her back, although a few do come somewhat close. Either way, it’s an impressive piece, even if you don’t fully understand it."

rows.original: Tattoos
rows.translation: 纹身
rows.raw: "Tattoos"

rows.original: You ask The Servant to tell you more about her necklace.
rows.translation: 你请仆从多讲讲她的项链。
rows.raw: "You ask The Servant to tell you more about her necklace."

rows.original: Her eyes go wide, and the small woman almost falls from her chair. “What... what do... you mean?”
rows.translation: 她睁大眼睛，娇小的身体差点从椅子上摔下来。“什...什么...你是什么意思？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer eyes go wide, and the small woman almost falls from her chair. “What... what do... you mean?”"

rows.original: “I’m not an idiot.” You point across the table, finger directed at the simple stone laying against her chest. “I know when I’m being fucked with. That things got some mojo to it.”
rows.translation: “我又不是白痴。”你指向桌子对面，手指直指贴在她胸前的朴素石头。“我知道什么时候有人在耍我。那东西有某种魔力。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not an idiot.” You point across the table, finger directed at the simple stone laying against her chest. “I know when I’m being fucked with. That things got some mojo to it.”"

rows.original: The Servant opens her mouth to speak, but only stammers a few disjointed syllables.
rows.translation: 仆从张嘴想说话，却只结结巴巴地挤出几个不连贯的音节。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant opens her mouth to speak, but only stammers a few disjointed syllables."

rows.original: While waiting for the woman’s explanation, you notice the stone around her neck start to shine.
rows.translation: 等待她解释时，你注意到她颈间的石头开始发光。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile waiting for the woman’s explanation, you notice the stone around her neck start to shine."

rows.original: Despite seeing it coming, you’re helpless against it. A shiver runs up your spine. You feel your heart start to beat faster and faster, your blood burning hot. You release a shuddering gasp, the cool air rushing into your lungs a mercy against the heat of your rising lust.
rows.translation: 尽管看见它袭来，你却无力抵抗。一阵战栗沿脊椎窜过。你感觉心脏越跳越快，鲜血滚烫灼热。你颤抖着倒吸一口气，凉爽空气涌入肺部，在不断升腾的欲火中如同恩赐。
rows.raw: " Despite seeing it coming, you’re helpless against it. A shiver runs up your spine. You feel your heart start to beat faster and faster, your blood burning hot. You release a shuddering gasp, the cool air rushing into your lungs a mercy against the heat of your rising lust."

rows.original: You see it coming, and steel yourself against it. Something hits your brain, blurring your vision and making you wince. Whatever it was, it seems to have bounced off of your... mind?
rows.translation: 你看见它袭来，并鼓起意志抵抗。某种东西撞击大脑，令视野模糊，你也痛苦皱眉。不管那是什么，似乎从你的...意识上弹开了？
rows.raw: " You see it coming, and steel yourself against it. Something hits your brain, blurring your vision and making you wince. Whatever it was, it seems to have bounced off of your... mind?"

rows.original: You understand what this is: A psionic attack.
rows.translation: 你明白这是什么：一次灵能攻击。
rows.raw: " You understand what this is: A psionic attack."

rows.original: The Servant grabs ahold of the stone around her neck, her fingers blocking out its light. “Master, please,” her tone is ragged, and you realize she, too, is being subjected to an attack. “[pc.HeShe] already knows.”
rows.translation: 仆从一把抓住颈间石头，手指挡住它的光芒。“主人，求你了，”她的声音断断续续，你意识到她也正在遭受攻击。“[pc.HeShe]已经知道了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant grabs ahold of the stone around her neck, her fingers blocking out its light. “Master, please,” her tone is ragged, and you realize she, too, is being subjected to an attack. “[pc.HeShe] already knows.”"

rows.original: You take a moment, catching your breath while the heat subsides.
rows.translation: 你停顿片刻，在热意消退时恢复呼吸。
rows.raw: "You take a moment, catching your breath while the heat subsides."

rows.original: You ready yourself, preparing for another mental attack.
rows.translation: 你做好准备，防备另一次精神攻击。
rows.raw: "You ready yourself, preparing for another mental attack."

rows.original: “What are you talking about?”
rows.translation: “你在说什么？”
rows.raw: " “What are you talking about?”"

rows.original: The Servant tightens her grasp around the stone. “It’s... my master...”
rows.translation: 仆从更用力地抓紧石头。“是...我的主人...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant tightens her grasp around the stone. “It’s... my master...”"

rows.original: “What...” From you time spent with her, you know her to be a terrible liar. As far as you can see: She’s telling the truth.
rows.translation: “什么...”根据与她相处的经历，你知道她非常不擅长撒谎。就你所见，她说的是实话。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What...” From you time spent with her, you know her to be a terrible liar. As far as you can see: She’s telling the truth."

rows.original: “If you have questions...” she winces, then tightens her grasp once more. “Master, please...” her jaw tightens and eyes flutter, the woman clearly still fighting off a sinfully lascivious attack.
rows.translation: “如果你有问题...”她痛苦皱眉，随后再次握紧石头。“主人，求你了...”她咬紧下颌，眼睑颤动，显然仍在抵抗那场罪恶淫荡的攻击。
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you have questions...” she winces, then tightens her grasp once more. “Master, please...” her jaw tightens and eyes flutter, the woman clearly still fighting off a sinfully lascivious attack."

rows.original: This is getting out of hand. You need to do something.
rows.translation: 事情越来越失控。你必须做点什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis is getting out of hand. You need to do something."

rows.original: Before you can act, she lets out a deep gasp, deflating in her chair and dropping her hand from her chest, the red stone dimming once more. “It... it’s fine. If you have questions... ask. I will answer...”
rows.translation: 你还没来得及行动，她便深深倒吸一口气，瘫软在椅子里，手从胸口落下，红石也再次暗淡。“没...没事。如果你有问题...就问吧。我会回答...”
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can act, she lets out a deep gasp, deflating in her chair and dropping her hand from her chest, the red stone dimming once more. “It... it’s fine. If you have questions... ask. I will answer...”"

rows.original: The Servant presses her lips together and frowns. “This again?” At her chest, you notice the stone glimmer slightly. “Fine. Ask away. We’re willing to indulge your curiosity.”
rows.translation: 仆从抿紧嘴唇，皱起眉头。“又来？”你注意到她胸前的石头微微闪烁。“好吧。尽管问。我们愿意满足你的好奇心。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant presses her lips together and frowns. “This again?” At her chest, you notice the stone glimmer slightly. “Fine. Ask away. We’re willing to indulge your curiosity.”"

rows.original: Red Stone
rows.translation: 红石
rows.raw: "Red Stone"

rows.original: The Red Stone
rows.translation: 红石
rows.raw: "The Red Stone"

rows.original: What’s in the necklace?
rows.translation: 项链里有什么？
rows.raw: "What’s in the necklace?"

rows.original: Origins
rows.translation: 来历
rows.raw: "Origins"

rows.original: Origins
rows.translation: 来历
rows.raw: "Origins"

rows.original: Ask where it came from.
rows.translation: 询问它来自哪里。
rows.raw: "Ask where it came from."

rows.original: Origins
rows.translation: 来历
rows.raw: "Origins"

rows.original: Origins
rows.translation: 来历
rows.raw: "Origins"

rows.original: You need a little more foundation before you push for more details...
rows.translation: 你需要先了解更多基础情况，才能追问更多细节...
rows.raw: "You need a little more foundation before you push for more details..."

rows.original: Her
rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "Her"

rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "Her"

rows.original: What’s her role in all this?
rows.translation: 她在这一切中扮演什么角色？
rows.raw: "What’s her role in all this?"

rows.original: Her
rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "Her"

rows.translation: 你需要先了解更多基础情况，才能追问更多细节...
rows.raw: "You need a little more foundation before you push for more details..."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: You ask her to tell you the secret behind the Red Stone Necklace.
rows.translation: 你让她告诉自己红石项链背后的秘密。
rows.raw: "You ask her to tell you the secret behind the Red Stone Necklace."

rows.original: The Servant frowns. “I think I’ve made that fairly clear already.” She lifts her hand and points towards her throat. “It’s my master.”
rows.translation: 仆从皱起眉头。“我以为自己已经说得很清楚了。”她抬起手，指向喉咙。“它就是我的主人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant frowns. “I think I’ve made that fairly clear already.” She lifts her hand and points towards her throat. “It’s my master.”"

rows.original: You roll your eyes. “You’ve said that, but havent really explained it.” For your own part, you know it’s clearly psionic, but whether it’s some sort of focus or if it really has a mind of its own... you can’t be sure.
rows.translation: 你翻了个白眼。“你是这么说过，但根本没有解释。”就你自己所知，它显然具有灵能；然而它究竟是某种聚焦器，还是确实拥有自己的意识...你无法确定。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou roll your eyes. “You’ve said that, but havent really explained it.” For your own part, you know it’s clearly psionic, but whether it’s some sort of focus or if it really has a mind of its own... you can’t be sure."

rows.original: She lowers her hand and sighs, tapping the table with her painted nail. “It’s the simple answer. The hard answer...” she frowns and continues. “The necklace I’m wearing is a...” she hesitates a moment, searching for the right word. “Well, it’s a vessel. An anchor of sorts that my master needs to be able to exist on this plane.”
rows.translation: 她放下手，叹了口气，用涂过颜色的指甲轻敲桌面。“这是简单答案。困难的答案...”她皱眉继续说道。“我戴着的项链是一个...”她犹豫片刻，寻找合适的词。“嗯，它是一件容器。某种锚点，让我的主人得以存在于这个位面。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lowers her hand and sighs, tapping the table with her painted nail. “It’s the simple answer. The hard answer...” she frowns and continues. “The necklace I’m wearing is a...” she hesitates a moment, searching for the right word. “Well, it’s a vessel. An anchor of sorts that my master needs to be able to exist on this plane.”"

rows.original: You eyeball the necklace for a moment. It seems to shine slightly with a light of its own, an other worldly gleam that makes you feel slightly... hot. Shaking away the feeling, you press the dark woman for more answers. “This plane? What does that even mean?”
rows.translation: 你盯着项链看了一会儿。它似乎散发着自身的微光，那种异世界光泽让你感觉微微...发热。你甩开这种感觉，继续追问这个黑暗女人。“这个位面？那到底是什么意思？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou eyeball the necklace for a moment. It seems to shine slightly with a light of its own, an other worldly gleam that makes you feel slightly... hot. Shaking away the feeling, you press the dark woman for more answers. “This plane? What does that even mean?”"

rows.original: The Servant cracks a smile, then offers a casual shrug. “I’m not sure myself, if I’m being perfectly honest. All I know is it’s not from here.” Sighing, she leans back in her chair, fiddling with a loose strand of her hair. “It came to me from beyond the veil, and it helped me put itself inside of this necklace. It was so small when it came to me... so... weak.” She sighs, her blue eyes dropping down to look at her chest.
rows.translation: 仆从露出一丝笑容，随后随意耸肩。“老实说，我自己也不确定。我只知道它不属于这里。”她叹息着靠回椅背，摆弄一缕散开的头发。“它从帷幕彼端来到我身边，并帮助我把它自己装进这条项链。刚来到我身边时，它非常渺小...非常...虚弱。”她叹息着，蓝眼睛低垂望向胸口。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant cracks a smile, then offers a casual shrug. “I’m not sure myself, if I’m being perfectly honest. All I know is it’s not from here.” Sighing, she leans back in her chair, fiddling with a loose strand of her hair. “It came to me from beyond the veil, and it helped me put itself inside of this necklace. It was so small when it came to me... so... weak.” She sighs, her blue eyes dropping down to look at her chest."

rows.original: Watching her, she suddenly seems depressed, as if all the moxy was sucked from her. “Weak? What do you mean it was weak?”
rows.translation: 看着她，她忽然显得很沮丧，仿佛所有锐气都被抽走。“虚弱？你说它很虚弱是什么意思？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWatching her, she suddenly seems depressed, as if all the moxy was sucked from her. “Weak? What do you mean it was weak?”"

rows.original: “Weak. Yes.” she looks up from her chest and faces you, her eyes wet and on the verge of tears. “It needed to be nursed back to health. It feeds on... well lots of things really, but lust seems to be what works best. It craves it, grows fat from it. The more lust I feel, the more sinful the pleasure, the greater it feeds and grows.” The Servant chuckles to herself, reaching for the stone and stroking it tenderly. “I called out to a god, and what came was a sliver of a shadow. It was hurt. It needed me. So I nurtured it, holding it in the womb of mind and feeding it the sweet milk of sinful depravity,” she cracks a weak smile. “I cared for it like it was my own child, and in many ways I still do.”
rows.translation: “虚弱。没错。”她把视线从胸口抬起，面对着你，双眼湿润得几乎要落泪。“它需要被照料才能恢复健康。它以...其实很多东西为食，但欲望似乎最有效。它渴望欲望，并因欲望而茁壮。我的欲望越强烈，快感越罪恶，它便能吸取更多、成长更多。”仆从轻声笑着，伸手温柔抚摸石头。“我向一位神明呼唤，而到来的只是一缕阴影。它受了伤。它需要我。因此我滋养它，把它抱在心灵的子宫里，用罪恶堕落的甜美乳汁喂养，”她勉强一笑。“我像照顾自己的孩子一样照顾它，在许多方面，至今依然如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Weak. Yes.” she looks up from her chest and faces you, her eyes wet and on the verge of tears. “It needed to be nursed back to health. It feeds on... well lots of things really, but lust seems to be what works best. It craves it, grows fat from it. The more lust I feel, the more sinful the pleasure, the greater it feeds and grows.” The Servant chuckles to herself, reaching for the stone and stroking it tenderly. “I called out to a god, and what came was a sliver of a shadow. It was hurt. It needed me. So I nurtured it, holding it in the womb of mind and feeding it the sweet milk of sinful depravity,” she cracks a weak smile. “I cared for it like it was my own child, and in many ways I still do.”"

rows.original: “So let me get this straight...” you take a breath, collecting your thoughts. “You’re telling me... that an interdimensional being, using your words a ‘god’, is living in a piece of jewelry around your neck... and it eats orgasms...”
rows.translation: “所以让我理清楚...”你深吸一口气，整理思绪。“你是在告诉我...一个跨维度存在，用你的话说是一位‘神’，正住在你颈间的一件首饰里...而且它以高潮为食...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So let me get this straight...” you take a breath, collecting your thoughts. “You’re telling me... that an interdimensional being, using your words a ‘god’, is living in a piece of jewelry around your neck... and it eats orgasms...”"

rows.original: The Servant chuckles, clearly seeing the ridiculousness of it all. “Yeah, that’s pretty much the crux of it.”
rows.translation: 仆从轻声笑了起来，显然也意识到这一切有多荒谬。“没错，基本上就是这么回事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant chuckles, clearly seeing the ridiculousness of it all. “Yeah, that’s pretty much the crux of it.”"

rows.original: Your eyes fall back down to the necklace at her chest. You believe the woman is telling the truth, or at least think she is.
rows.translation: 你的目光再次落向她胸前的项链。你相信这个女人说的是真话，或者至少认为她说的是真话。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes fall back down to the necklace at her chest. You believe the woman is telling the truth, or at least think she is."

rows.original: You’re not sure how to feel about that...
rows.translation: 你不知道该对此作何感想...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure how to feel about that..."

rows.original: Red Stone
rows.translation: 红石
rows.raw: "Red Stone"

rows.original: You ask The Servant where exactly the necklace came from.
rows.translation: 你询问仆从，这条项链究竟来自哪里。
rows.raw: "You ask The Servant where exactly the necklace came from."

rows.original: “Oh, well that one’s easy. I made it.” She gives you a wide smile, sitting up to her full height, brimming with pride.
rows.translation: “哦，这个很简单。我做的。”她朝你灿烂一笑，挺直身体坐到最高，满脸自豪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, well that one’s easy. I made it.” She gives you a wide smile, sitting up to her full height, brimming with pride."

rows.original: You get the distinct impression she’s telling the truth, but you surmise that she isn’t exactly telling the whole truth. The psionic power inside of bauble tells you that much at least. “How, exactly, did you make it?”
rows.translation: 你明显感觉她说的是实话，但推测她并没有说出全部真相。至少，饰物内部的灵能力量让你确定这一点。“你究竟是怎么制作它的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get the distinct impression she’s telling the truth, but you surmise that she isn’t exactly telling the whole truth. The psionic power inside of bauble tells you that much at least. “How, exactly, did you make it?”"

rows.original: The Servant’s smile cracks, and you can’t help but notice her ringed fingers clench shut. Something about the question seems to have thrown her off, clearly taking her by surprise that you asked. “Ah, yes well...” she shifts in her chair, seemingly trying to conjure an answer from thin air. “Well, around a year ago I made a breakthrough in my research and attempted to... well, it’s complicated.”
rows.translation: 仆从的笑容出现裂痕，你不禁注意到她戴满戒指的手指紧握起来。这个问题似乎打乱了她的阵脚；她显然没想到你会问。“啊，是啊，嗯...”她在椅子上调整姿势，仿佛试图凭空变出一个答案。“嗯，大约一年前，我的研究取得了突破，并试图...唉，这很复杂。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant’s smile cracks, and you can’t help but notice her ringed fingers clench shut. Something about the question seems to have thrown her off, clearly taking her by surprise that you asked. “Ah, yes well...” she shifts in her chair, seemingly trying to conjure an answer from thin air. “Well, around a year ago I made a breakthrough in my research and attempted to... well, it’s complicated.”"

rows.original: You lean back in your chair, crossing your arms over your [pc.chest]. <i>“Humor me and explain it anyways.
rows.translation: 你靠回椅背，双臂交叉抱在[pc.chest]前。<i>“迁就我一下，无论如何都解释给我听。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean back in your chair, crossing your arms over your [pc.chest]. <i>“Humor me and explain it anyways."

rows.original: Just don’t use to many big words and try to lose me.
rows.translation: 只是别用太多艰深词汇，故意把我绕糊涂。
rows.raw: " Just don’t use to many big words and try to lose me."

rows.original: I’m sure I’ll be able to follow along just fine.
rows.translation: 我肯定完全能听懂。”
rows.raw: " I’m sure I’ll be able to follow along just fine."

rows.original: The Servant snorts, seemingly not liking your response. “Fine. I fashioned the necklace out of a ceremonial stone that was part of a ritual I was trying to recreate. Academically of course...” she lifts her hand to her temple, scratching just above her studded ear. “The ritual’s origins are... well, difficult to grasp. Many species throughout the galaxy, independent of each other mind you, have some version of it. I was attempting to fuse them together, focusing on the shared aspects while trimming the fat,” she taps the necklace around her throat. “This was unintended, but not an unwelcome result.”
rows.translation: 仆从嗤了一声，似乎不喜欢你的回答。“好吧。我用一块仪式用石制作了项链，那块石头属于我试图重现的仪式。当然，纯粹是学术研究...”她抬手挠了挠带耳钉耳朵上方的太阳穴。“那个仪式的起源...嗯，很难理解。银河各处许多彼此独立的种族都有某种版本。我试图把它们融合起来，专注于共同部分，同时剔除多余内容，”她轻点颈间项链。“这个结果并非本意，但也并不令人讨厌。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant snorts, seemingly not liking your response. “Fine. I fashioned the necklace out of a ceremonial stone that was part of a ritual I was trying to recreate. Academically of course...” she lifts her hand to her temple, scratching just above her studded ear. “The ritual’s origins are... well, difficult to grasp. Many species throughout the galaxy, independent of each other mind you, have some version of it. I was attempting to fuse them together, focusing on the shared aspects while trimming the fat,” she taps the necklace around her throat. “This was unintended, but not an unwelcome result.”"

rows.original: You examine the Red Stone Necklace for a moment, seeing it gleam once more. Something about her explanation doesn’t sit right with you. If it was an unintended result, then what was she trying to do? “What was the goal of the ritual then?”
rows.translation: 你观察红石项链片刻，看见它再次闪耀。她的解释让你觉得哪里不对。如果结果并非本意，那她原本想做什么？“那么仪式的目标是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou examine the Red Stone Necklace for a moment, seeing it gleam once more. Something about her explanation doesn’t sit right with you. If it was an unintended result, then what was she trying to do? “What was the goal of the ritual then?”"

rows.original: The Servant seems almost amused by the question. “Well, there were a few different possible outcomes, if the source material could be believed. One iteration of it was believed to cause fertility, while another thought it was a way to commune with the dead.”
rows.translation: 仆从似乎觉得这个问题有些好笑。“嗯，如果那些原始资料可信，可能会出现几种不同结果。其中一个版本据说能带来生育力，另一个版本则认为这是与死者交流的方式。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Servant seems almost amused by the question. “Well, there were a few different possible outcomes, if the source material could be believed. One iteration of it was believed to cause fertility, while another thought it was a way to commune with the dead.”"

rows.original: You can tell she’s being evasive, not wanting to properly share. Cutting through her smokescreen, you ask her flat out what she thought was going to happen.
rows.translation: 你看得出她在闪烁其词，不愿坦诚分享。你直接穿透烟幕，直截了当地问她原以为会发生什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can tell she’s being evasive, not wanting to properly share. Cutting through her smokescreen, you ask her flat out what she thought was going to happen."

rows.original: She hesitates, then smacks her painted lips together. “Honestly?”
rows.translation: 她犹豫了一下，随后抿了抿涂过颜色的嘴唇。“说实话？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hesitates, then smacks her painted lips together. “Honestly?”"

rows.original: “Yes. Honestly.”
rows.translation: “没错。说实话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes. Honestly.”"

rows.original: “I...” she trials off, looking down at her chest. You can tell it’s speaking to her, as she seems to be focused on it rather intently. When she speaks, her voice is softer than normal and noticeably subdued. “I didn’t think anything would happen. Not really. I just... wanted to do it. It seemed like it would have been... fun. To try and call out to the void and maybe hear a call back.” She looks up from her chest and sighs. “Imagine my surprise when it not only works, but I get a visitor as well.”
rows.translation: “我...”她欲言又止，低头看向胸口。你看得出它正在和她说话，因为她似乎把注意力全都集中在上面。再次开口时，她的声音比平常更柔和，也明显更克制。“我没觉得会发生任何事。真的没有。我只是...想试试。向虚空发出呼唤，或许能听见回应，这似乎会很...有趣。”她从胸口抬起视线，叹了口气。“想象一下我的惊讶吧，不仅成功了，还迎来一位访客。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I...” she trials off, looking down at her chest. You can tell it’s speaking to her, as she seems to be focused on it rather intently. When she speaks, her voice is softer than normal and noticeably subdued. “I didn’t think anything would happen. Not really. I just... wanted to do it. It seemed like it would have been... fun. To try and call out to the void and maybe hear a call back.” She looks up from her chest and sighs. “Imagine my surprise when it not only works, but I get a visitor as well.”"

rows.original: You can’t help but frown at the absurd explanation. Is she trying to tell you that she just did it for fun? Trying to be serious, you ask her what is fun about talking to a transdimensional being.
rows.translation: 你不禁对这个荒谬解释皱眉。她是在告诉你，自己只是为了好玩才这么做吗？你努力保持严肃，问她与一个跨维度存在交谈有什么好玩的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but frown at the absurd explanation. Is she trying to tell you that she just did it for fun? Trying to be serious, you ask her what is fun about talking to a transdimensional being."

rows.original: “An interest in the dark and macabre, maybe?” she scoffs, rolling her eyes, a hint of her bratty attitude just under the surface. “I was trying to prove something, and I guess I did. How could so many cultures spread out over so many worlds believe things so similar? That was the academic in me, but to say there wasn’t a part of me that wanted to meet something... ‘Dark and Otherworldly’? Well, sue me I’m guilty.” She leans back in her chair, a smug expression on her pale face. “So. Does that answer your question?”
rows.translation: “也许是对黑暗和死亡的兴趣？”她嗤之以鼻地翻了个白眼，顽劣态度隐约浮到表面。“我想证明某件事，而我想自己的确证明了。分散在如此多星球上的众多文化，怎么会相信如此相似的事物？这是我作为学者的那一面；但要说我心中没有一部分想遇见某种...‘黑暗而异界的东西’？好吧，告我吧，我认罪。”她靠回椅背，苍白脸上带着得意神情。“所以，这回答你的问题了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“An interest in the dark and macabre, maybe?” she scoffs, rolling her eyes, a hint of her bratty attitude just under the surface. “I was trying to prove something, and I guess I did. How could so many cultures spread out over so many worlds believe things so similar? That was the academic in me, but to say there wasn’t a part of me that wanted to meet something... ‘Dark and Otherworldly’? Well, sue me I’m guilty.” She leans back in her chair, a smug expression on her pale face. “So. Does that answer your question?”"

rows.original: It doesn’t really, but you get the feeling she doesn’t know much more. Whatever exactly happened might only be really known by whatever is inside the necklace itself, and you’re not about to speak to it directly.
rows.translation: 其实没有，但你感觉她知道的也不多。究竟发生了什么，也许只有项链里的东西真正清楚，而你并不打算直接与它交谈。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt doesn’t really, but you get the feeling she doesn’t know much more. Whatever exactly happened might only be really known by whatever is inside the necklace itself, and you’re not about to speak to it directly."

rows.original: Origins
rows.translation: 来历
rows.raw: "Origins"

rows.original: You ask The Servant why exactly she’s serving an interdimensional being.
