rows.translation: “我在军队时，曾在伙房工作过一阵子。在那里，我发现自己对准备食物的喜爱几乎不亚于当坦克兵。所以退役后，我在一家餐厅找了份工作。我本想一步步往上爬，也许有朝一日能当上站灶厨师，可惜的是，”法迪尔长叹一声，“那份工作没能持续多久。几个月后，我收到姐姐的消息，说妈妈病了。显然，那种疾病在早期阶段相当无害，但若不治疗，可能引发危及生命的健康并发症。不仅如此，由于病症极其罕见，治疗费用也高得离谱。我们意识到，即使每个人都出钱，仍然不足以支付费用；而贷款则会让全家背上沉重债务。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, when I was in the army, I worked in the mess for a while. While I was there, I found myself enjoying food preparation about as much as I enjoyed being a tanker. So after I left the service, I got a job at a restaurant. I had hoped to work my way up, maybe become a line cook one day, but unfortunately,” Fadil heaves a sigh, “That didn’t last very long. A couple of months later I got a message from my sister telling me that mom had gotten sick. Apparently, in the early stages the illness was rather harmless, but left untreated it could result in life-threatening health complications. Not only that but the treatment was inordinately expensive because the illness was so rare. We realized that even if everyone pitched in, it wouldn’t be enough to pay, and taking out a loan would have put the family deep into debt.”"

rows.original: Fadil pauses his story to drink from his glass. His ears twitch towards elsewhere in the bar, and for a moment you become aware of silverware clinking against dishes and muted conversation.
rows.translation: 法迪尔停下讲述，喝了一口杯中饮料。他的耳朵朝酒吧别处抽动；有那么一瞬间，你注意到餐具与盘子碰撞的叮当声，以及压低的交谈声。
rows.raw: "\n\nFadil pauses his story to drink from his glass. His ears twitch towards elsewhere in the bar, and for a moment you become aware of silverware clinking against dishes and muted conversation."

rows.original: “I’m sorry to hear that,” you say. “Did you find a way to help your mother?”
rows.translation: “听到这件事，我很遗憾，”你说。“你找到帮助母亲的办法了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry to hear that,” you say. “Did you find a way to help your mother?”"

rows.original: “I did. I realized that it was my turn to take care of the family. I applied to a mining company under an indentured laborer contract. I didn’t tell mom or my siblings until after I signed the indenture. They would have tried to dissuade me from it, but I couldn’t stand by and let my mother’s health decline, or allow loans to hamstring my siblings. Not when I could do something about it.”
rows.translation: “找到了。我意识到轮到自己来照顾家人了。我向一家采矿公司申请，以契约劳工的合同受雇。签下契约之前，我没有告诉妈妈或兄弟姐妹。他们肯定会试图劝阻我，可我不能袖手旁观，看着母亲的健康不断恶化，也不能让贷款束缚兄弟姐妹。只要我还能对此做些什么，就绝不能那样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I did. I realized that it was my turn to take care of the family. I applied to a mining company under an indentured laborer contract. I didn’t tell mom or my siblings until after I signed the indenture. They would have tried to dissuade me from it, but I couldn’t stand by and let my mother’s health decline, or allow loans to hamstring my siblings. Not when I could do something about it.”"

rows.original: “Anyway, I came home to find my sisters in the living room having a meeting about mom’s condition, trying to figure out what they were going to do. There were holopads and all sorts of papers, documents and just junk everywhere, so I figured they had been at it for a while.” A slight smirk begins to tug at the corner of his mouth. “My sisters were a little shell-shocked when I told them what I’d done. They’d spent a few days wringing their brains for ways to cover treatment costs, and I’d rendered it moot all at once.”
rows.translation: “总之，我回到家时，发现姐妹们正在客厅开会讨论妈妈的病情，想弄清楚该怎么办。到处都是全息板、各种纸张、文件，还有一堆杂物，所以我猜她们已经忙了很久。”他嘴角渐渐浮现一丝坏笑。“听说我的所作所为时，姐妹们有些惊呆了。她们花了几天绞尽脑汁地寻找支付治疗费的办法，而我一下子就让那些努力失去了意义。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, I came home to find my sisters in the living room having a meeting about mom’s condition, trying to figure out what they were going to do. There were holopads and all sorts of papers, documents and just junk everywhere, so I figured they had been at it for a while.” A slight smirk begins to tug at the corner of his mouth. “My sisters were a little shell-shocked when I told them what I’d done. They’d spent a few days wringing their brains for ways to cover treatment costs, and I’d rendered it moot all at once.”"

rows.original: “Now my brother, on the other hand, when I told him he just went along with it.” Fadil snorted. Fadil seems to have a rather lively family, you surmise.
rows.translation: “至于我的哥哥，则完全不同；我把这件事告诉他时，他就那么接受了。”法迪尔哼笑一声。你推测，法迪尔的家庭似乎相当热闹。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now my brother, on the other hand, when I told him he just went along with it.” Fadil snorted. Fadil seems to have a rather lively family, you surmise."

rows.original: Now that you think about it, dad brought you to various company workplaces as a wide-eyed young child. Your interest piqued by your own internal musing, you gaze thoughtfully at Fadil and ask, “So, you mentioned serving out an indenture for a mining company. Do you mind if I ask what your specific occupation was?”
rows.translation: 现在想来，小时候父亲曾带着满眼好奇的你参观过各处公司设施。内心的思绪勾起了兴趣，你若有所思地看向法迪尔并问：“所以，你提到曾为一家采矿公司履行契约。介意告诉我，你具体从事什么工作吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that you think about it, dad brought you to various company workplaces as a wide-eyed young child. Your interest piqued by your own internal musing, you gaze thoughtfully at Fadil and ask, “So, you mentioned serving out an indenture for a mining company. Do you mind if I ask what your specific occupation was?”"

rows.original: “Oh sure,” replies Fadil. “You remember, how I used to be a tanker? Well, my unit underwent some cross-training to ensure we could support our engineers during sustained operations. So, for me, getting company certification to operate heavy equipment was mostly just a matter of applying what I already knew to a different work environment. I mostly used the initial training period to get acquainted with the people I was going to be working with. After that I spent the next several years going wherever operations deployed us until I paid off my debt and fulfilled my indenture.”
rows.translation: “哦，当然可以，”法迪尔回答。“还记得我以前是坦克兵吗？为了确保持续作战期间能支援工程兵，我们部队接受过一些交叉训练。因此对我来说，要取得公司操作重型设备的认证，基本只是把已有知识应用到不同工作环境中。我主要利用初期培训阶段熟悉将要一起工作的人员。之后几年里，我一直跟着行动部署四处奔波，直到还清债务、履行完契约。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh sure,” replies Fadil. “You remember, how I used to be a tanker? Well, my unit underwent some cross-training to ensure we could support our engineers during sustained operations. So, for me, getting company certification to operate heavy equipment was mostly just a matter of applying what I already knew to a different work environment. I mostly used the initial training period to get acquainted with the people I was going to be working with. After that I spent the next several years going wherever operations deployed us until I paid off my debt and fulfilled my indenture.”"

rows.original: Well, that doesn’t sound too bad. But from what you understand, it isn’t uncommon for rarer, specialized medical treatments to cost in the hundreds of thousands of credits. How did he pay off his debt so quickly?
rows.translation: 好吧，听起来并不算太糟。不过据你了解，较罕见的专业医疗手段往往需要几十万信用点。他是怎么这么快还清债务的？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that doesn’t sound too bad. But from what you understand, it isn’t uncommon for rarer, specialized medical treatments to cost in the hundreds of thousands of credits. How did he pay off his debt so quickly?"

rows.original: “That’s a good question,” Fadil says with a nod of his head. “During my third yearly performance review, my boss made me a job offer, saying that he’d recommended me to sapient resources for a promotion and that management had opened a leadership track slot for me. I had begun to half-expect something early in the review but being offered a promotion caught me off guard. I wanted to refuse at first because I wasn’t sure I was right choice for the job, but then I thought about it and realized that the increased pay would help me pay off my mother’s medical bills faster.”
rows.translation: “问得好，”法迪尔点头说道。“在第三次年度绩效评估时，上司给了我一个工作机会，说他已向智慧生物资源部门推荐我晋升，管理层也为我开放了一个领导岗位名额。评估开始不久后，我已经隐隐预料到会发生什么，可晋升邀请仍让我措手不及。起初我想拒绝，因为不确定自己是否适合这份工作；但仔细一想，我意识到增加的薪水能帮助我更快付清母亲的医疗费。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s a good question,” Fadil says with a nod of his head. “During my third yearly performance review, my boss made me a job offer, saying that he’d recommended me to sapient resources for a promotion and that management had opened a leadership track slot for me. I had begun to half-expect something early in the review but being offered a promotion caught me off guard. I wanted to refuse at first because I wasn’t sure I was right choice for the job, but then I thought about it and realized that the increased pay would help me pay off my mother’s medical bills faster.”"

rows.original: “In any case, getting that promotion turned out to be a good thing in more ways than one,” Fadil says with a shrug. “Although, I did end up working my ass off in order to keep up with the new responsibilities. I still wore a hard hat but now I had to help direct separate teams in the field, assist with planning and briefings, coordinate between our different departments, train new personnel - it was all very hands-on work. There were a lot of times where we all pitched in to turn an empty patch of ground into a command post or a workable area. My back hurts just thinking about it. If I hadn’t gone through boot camp as a kid, I don’t know if I would have been focused enough to do as well as I did. I spent a lot of extra hours making sure I did everything right.”
rows.translation: “无论如何，那次晋升从许多方面来说都是件好事，”法迪尔耸肩说道。“不过，为了跟上新职责，我确实拼命工作。虽然仍戴着安全帽，如今却必须帮助指挥现场的不同团队、协助规划与简报、协调不同部门、培训新员工，这些全都是非常实际的工作。有很多次，我们所有人齐心协力，把一块空地改造成指挥所或可用作业区。光是想想，我的背就开始疼了。要不是年轻时参加过新兵训练，我不知道自己能否足够专注，取得当时那么好的表现。我花了许多额外时间，确保每件事都做到正确。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In any case, getting that promotion turned out to be a good thing in more ways than one,” Fadil says with a shrug. “Although, I did end up working my ass off in order to keep up with the new responsibilities. I still wore a hard hat but now I had to help direct separate teams in the field, assist with planning and briefings, coordinate between our different departments, train new personnel - it was all very hands-on work. There were a lot of times where we all pitched in to turn an empty patch of ground into a command post or a workable area. My back hurts just thinking about it. If I hadn’t gone through boot camp as a kid, I don’t know if I would have been focused enough to do as well as I did. I spent a lot of extra hours making sure I did everything right.”"

rows.original: Fadil pauses. “I won’t deny I was lucky, though. I’d like to say that the thought of seeing my mother, healthy and happy, was all that was needed to keep me motivated, but that isn’t true. There were many days where I couldn’t think of anything other than my bed. Heck, there were days where I could barely think at all. The fact of the matter is, there are many people that I owe thanks to for bringing me to where I am today.”
rows.translation: 法迪尔停顿下来。“不过，我不否认自己很幸运。我很想说，只要想到能看见母亲健康幸福的样子，就足以让我保持动力，可那并不是真的。有很多天，我脑子里除了自己的床什么都想不了。见鬼，有些日子我几乎根本无法思考。事实是，我能走到今天，需要感谢许多人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFadil pauses. “I won’t deny I was lucky, though. I’d like to say that the thought of seeing my mother, healthy and happy, was all that was needed to keep me motivated, but that isn’t true. There were many days where I couldn’t think of anything other than my bed. Heck, there were days where I could barely think at all. The fact of the matter is, there are many people that I owe thanks to for bringing me to where I am today.”"

rows.original: “Anyone specific?” you ask.
rows.translation: “有具体的人吗？”你问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyone specific?” you ask."

rows.original: Fadil breaks into a small smile. “The boss’s wife comes to mind. She took a liking to me and helped me out, mostly giving me advice or excuses to rest. In exchange, I occasionally kept her company.”
rows.translation: 法迪尔露出一丝微笑。“我会想到老板的妻子。她很喜欢我，也帮助过我，主要是给我建议或找借口让我休息。作为交换，我偶尔会陪伴她。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFadil breaks into a small smile. “The boss’s wife comes to mind. She took a liking to me and helped me out, mostly giving me advice or excuses to rest. In exchange, I occasionally kept her company.”"

rows.original: That’s quite the story. You certainly can’t deny that he’s been lucky.
rows.translation: 这真是一段相当曲折的经历。你确实无法否认，他很幸运。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s quite the story. You certainly can’t deny that he’s been lucky."

rows.original: “Yeah, and that’s why I started running my charity. A lot of people aren’t as lucky,” he says, nodding. “But I’ve rambled about myself long enough.”
rows.translation: “是啊，所以我才开始经营自己的慈善机构。很多人没那么幸运，”他点头说道。“不过，我已经絮叨自己的事情够久了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, and that’s why I started running my charity. A lot of people aren’t as lucky,” he says, nodding. “But I’ve rambled about myself long enough.”"

rows.original: Charity
rows.raw: "Charity"

rows.original: “So what’s this charity you mentioned?” You ask.
rows.translation: “那么，你提到的慈善机构是怎么回事？”你问。
rows.raw: "“So what’s this charity you mentioned?” You ask."

rows.original: “Well, when I was working as an indentured servant I learned how a lot of companies handle their servants. Companies that operate on the fringes of the known galaxy tend to not follow regulations quite to the letter. So people who end up in debt in the fringes often never get out of it, and the worst part, almost no one in the universe cares. So, when I got free, I decided to do my best to help people in that situation. We look for people in debt-slavery, buy their debt, and help them to look for a fair job.” He frowns and lets out a long sigh. “Unfortunately, while we would like to help everyone, we still have to look for people who are likely to find honest work; there is no point in freeing someone only to have them in debt a week later.”
rows.translation: “我当契约劳工时，了解到许多公司会怎样对待自己的仆工。在已知银河边缘运营的公司，往往不会一丝不苟地遵守规章。因此，在边疆陷入债务的人通常永远无法脱身，而最糟糕的是，宇宙里几乎没人关心他们。所以恢复自由以后，我决定竭尽全力帮助处于那种境地的人。我们寻找债务奴隶，买下他们的债务，并帮助他们寻找公平的工作。”他皱起眉，长叹一声。“可惜，尽管我们希望帮助每个人，仍然必须寻找那些有可能找到正当工作的人；如果释放某人一周后，他又重新负债，那就毫无意义。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, when I was working as an indentured servant I learned how a lot of companies handle their servants. Companies that operate on the fringes of the known galaxy tend to not follow regulations quite to the letter. So people who end up in debt in the fringes often never get out of it, and the worst part, almost no one in the universe cares. So, when I got free, I decided to do my best to help people in that situation. We look for people in debt-slavery, buy their debt, and help them to look for a fair job.” He frowns and lets out a long sigh. “Unfortunately, while we would like to help everyone, we still have to look for people who are likely to find honest work; there is no point in freeing someone only to have them in debt a week later.” "

rows.original: Fadil reaches for his glass, only to find it empty. “One moment,” he says, giving you an apologetic grin as he flags down a passing waitress..
rows.translation: 法迪尔伸手去拿杯子，却发现里面已经空了。“稍等一下，”他说着，歉意地朝你一笑，并招呼一名路过的女服务员..
rows.raw: "\n\nFadil reaches for his glass, only to find it empty. “One moment,” he says, giving you an apologetic grin as he flags down a passing waitress.."

rows.original: As the waitress departs to get his refill you ask, “How exactly do you do it? I mean, that sounds like quite the complex operation.”
rows.translation: 女服务员离开去为他续杯时，你问：“你们具体是怎么做的？我是说，这听起来是一套相当复杂的行动。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the waitress departs to get his refill you ask, “How exactly do you do it? I mean, that sounds like quite the complex operation.”"

rows.original: “We primarily look for slaves on the open market since it’s not uncommon for slave contracts to be put up for sale when their owner judges that selling them would be more profitable than keeping them around. To begin with one of my employees will run background checks and look for a suitable workplace for them. If they have no glaring issues and we can find a job for them we’ll try to schedule a face-to-face chat with them. And if everything works out we’ll buy their contract, and help them with getting employed before finally nullifying their contract.”
rows.translation: “我们主要在公开市场上寻找奴隶，因为奴隶合同被拿出来出售并不罕见；只要主人认为卖掉他们比留在身边更有利可图，就可能这么做。首先，我的一名员工会进行背景调查，并为他们寻找合适的工作场所。如果他们没有明显问题，而且我们能找到工作，就会设法安排一次面对面交谈。如果一切顺利，我们便买下他们的合同，帮助他们获得工作，最后再使合同失效。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We primarily look for slaves on the open market since it’s not uncommon for slave contracts to be put up for sale when their owner judges that selling them would be more profitable than keeping them around. To begin with one of my employees will run background checks and look for a suitable workplace for them. If they have no glaring issues and we can find a job for them we’ll try to schedule a face-to-face chat with them. And if everything works out we’ll buy their contract, and help them with getting employed before finally nullifying their contract.”"

rows.original: Reclining in his seat, Fadil clears his throat before continuing. “Then we have the outlier cases, people who are deep in debt but aren’t actively sold as slaves. In those cases we’ll look into possible family connections or friends, let them know what we’ve found and let our intentions be made clear. If no family connections can be found we’ll handle it as a normal case; whereas if a family contact can be made we try to reconnect these people. The trouble is, there’s usually a reason why they aren’t being sold, so the prices can get real steep. We often have to offer such a high amount that it’d be foolish to refuse.” He looks down at the table and straightens his sleeves. “Unfortunately, sometimes there’s no price on these people.”
rows.translation: 法迪尔靠在座位上，清了清嗓子才继续说道。“然后还有一些特殊情况：这些人债台高筑，却没有被当作奴隶公开出售。遇到这种情况，我们会调查他们是否还有家人或朋友，把查到的情况告知对方，同时明确说明我们的打算。如果找不到任何亲友关系，我们就按普通案件处理；如果能联系上家人，我们便会设法让他们重新团聚。麻烦在于，他们没有被拿出来卖，通常都是有原因的，所以开价可能高得离谱。我们往往不得不开出高到让人无法拒绝的金额。”他低头看着桌面，理了理袖口。“遗憾的是，有时这些人根本不是钱能买回来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nReclining in his seat, Fadil clears his throat before continuing. “Then we have the outlier cases, people who are deep in debt but aren’t actively sold as slaves. In those cases we’ll look into possible family connections or friends, let them know what we’ve found and let our intentions be made clear. If no family connections can be found we’ll handle it as a normal case; whereas if a family contact can be made we try to reconnect these people. The trouble is, there’s usually a reason why they aren’t being sold, so the prices can get real steep. We often have to offer such a high amount that it’d be foolish to refuse.” He looks down at the table and straightens his sleeves. “Unfortunately, sometimes there’s no price on these people.”"

rows.original: “That doesn’t sound cheap,” you note. “Where do you get money for that sort of thing?”
rows.translation: “听起来可不便宜，”你指出。“你们从哪里弄到钱做这种事？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That doesn’t sound cheap,” you note. “Where do you get money for that sort of thing?”"

rows.original: “Mostly private donors,” he grunts. He thanks the waitress as she hands him the drink. “Believe it or not, giant mega-corporations don’t really want to free slaves,” he says, disgust dripping from his voice. “Still, we make do. We have a couple of big monthly donors so we can run our business smoothly. Someone called NoPainNoGain is one of our biggest monthly donors, alongside CyberCackler. Aside from the anonymous monthly donors, some of the individuals who we’ve helped in the past have repaid us the amount we spent on their debt or made small donations as a ‘thank you’ for our help. But that’s enough of that, I don’t want to bore you with the details of my work.”
rows.translation: “主要靠私人捐助者，”他咕哝道。女服务员递来饮料时，他向她道了谢。“信不信由你，那些超级巨型企业可不怎么想解放奴隶，”他说，话音里满是厌恶。“不过我们总能设法维持下去。我们有几位每月大额捐款的资助者，因此业务才能顺利运转。一个叫‘NoPainNoGain’的人是我们最大的月度捐助者之一，另一位则叫‘CyberCackler’。除去匿名的月度捐助者，有些过去受过我们帮助的人也会偿还我们替他们支付的债务，或捐一小笔钱来‘感谢’我们的帮助。不过这些就说够了，我不想拿工作细节烦你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mostly private donors,” he grunts. He thanks the waitress as she hands him the drink. “Believe it or not, giant mega-corporations don’t really want to free slaves,” he says, disgust dripping from his voice. “Still, we make do. We have a couple of big monthly donors so we can run our business smoothly. Someone called NoPainNoGain is one of our biggest monthly donors, alongside CyberCackler. Aside from the anonymous monthly donors, some of the individuals who we’ve helped in the past have repaid us the amount we spent on their debt or made small donations as a ‘thank you’ for our help. But that’s enough of that, I don’t want to bore you with the details of my work.”"

rows.original: Free Time
rows.raw: "Free Time"

rows.original: Surely he’s not working around the clock? You ask Fadil what he likes to do in his free time.

rows.original: You decide to check out the bunny girl at the back of the bar. As you get closer you notice she holds a sign with the Xenogen Biotech logo emblazoned across its top. The sign proclaims the advent of a new product, “Ask about Ovilium!”, designed to assist with all situations in which eggs and milk are required. The girl herself seems a little nervous, and as you finally reach her you see part of the reason why. Her clothing consists of a denim bikini that barely conceals her D-cup chest and short shorts that offer even less coverage to her legs. Colorful easter eggs have been tattooed across her pregnant looking stomach. Tall pink bunny ears topped with rainbow, cotton-like puffballs that bob and turn to meet new noises poke out from her head of baby blue hair. In contrast to her hair and ears, her skin is as dark as baker’s chocolate. A faint sugary scent emanates from her like perfume, leaving you with a bubbly smile. When she notices you looking her over, she blushes and smiles.
rows.translation: 你决定去看看酒吧后方的兔女郎。靠近后，你发现她举着一块牌子，顶部醒目地印着异源生物科技的标志。牌子宣告着一款新产品的问世——“欢迎咨询产卵素！”——旨在协助处理一切需要卵和乳汁的情况。女孩本人看起来有些紧张；终于走到她面前时，你也看出了部分原因。她穿着一套牛仔布比基尼，几乎遮不住D罩杯的胸部，短得不能再短的短裤对双腿的遮掩甚至更少。她看似怀孕的腹部上纹着五彩缤纷的复活节彩蛋。高高的粉色兔耳从一头淡蓝色头发中伸出，耳尖缀着彩虹色、棉花般的绒球；它们会随着新声响上下晃动并转向声源。与头发和兔耳形成对比的是，她的皮肤如烘焙巧克力般深褐。淡淡的甜香像香水一样从她身上散发出来，让你不禁露出轻快笑容。她注意到你正在打量自己，脸颊一红，也微笑起来。
rows.raw: "You decide to check out the bunny girl at the back of the bar. As you get closer you notice she holds a sign with the Xenogen Biotech logo emblazoned across its top. The sign proclaims the advent of a new product, “Ask about Ovilium!”, designed to assist with all situations in which eggs and milk are required. The girl herself seems a little nervous, and as you finally reach her you see part of the reason why. Her clothing consists of a denim bikini that barely conceals her D-cup chest and short shorts that offer even less coverage to her legs. Colorful easter eggs have been tattooed across her pregnant looking stomach. Tall pink bunny ears topped with rainbow, cotton-like puffballs that bob and turn to meet new noises poke out from her head of baby blue hair. In contrast to her hair and ears, her skin is as dark as baker’s chocolate. A faint sugary scent emanates from her like perfume, leaving you with a bubbly smile. When she notices you looking her over, she blushes and smiles."

rows.translation: 你问这位窘迫的兔女郎，她的牌子写了什么，又为什么待在酒吧里。她顿时来了精神，看起来也没那么紧张了。

rows.original: “Really? You want to hear about it? Everyone else has just been rude.” she says, the relief evident in her voice. You assure her that you’d love to hear about this “Ovilium” stuff.
rows.translation: “真的吗？你想听听？其他人一直都很无礼。”她说道，话音里明显透着如释重负。你向她保证，很乐意听她介绍这种叫“Ovilium”的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really? You want to hear about it? Everyone else has just been rude.” she says, the relief evident in her voice. You assure her that you’d love to hear about this “Ovilium” stuff."

rows.original: “Awesome! Well, it’s the newest product out of Xenogen Biotech’s development labs. It’s supposed to help with lactation for pregnant women with deficient mammary glands who don’t want to use artificially made milk,” she begins, pointing to the reference to milk on the sign.
rows.translation: “太好了！嗯，这是异种基因生物科技开发实验室推出的最新产品。它是为了帮助乳腺发育不足、又不愿使用人工乳汁的孕妇泌乳而设计的，”她一边开口介绍，一边指向牌子上有关乳汁的说明。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awesome! Well, it’s the newest product out of Xenogen Biotech’s development labs. It’s supposed to help with lactation for pregnant women with deficient mammary glands who don’t want to use artificially made milk,” she begins, pointing to the reference to milk on the sign."

rows.original: You ask her if that’s the reason she was chosen for testing, seeing as she looks quite pregnant.
rows.translation: 你问她，既然她看起来身怀六甲，这是否就是她被选来参加测试的原因。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her if that’s the reason she was chosen for testing, seeing as she looks quite pregnant."

rows.original: The dark skinned girl averts her eyes and fiddles with her sign for a moment. “Well, kinda, not really. So this was made for people who were already pregnant, but they needed to test it on people who weren’t pregnant as a control group for the medical trials. I signed up because they were offering good money to be part of the trials and living on the fringe planets isn’t always the easiest. So when I get to the testing site, they give me this gummy medicine that looks more like a piece of candy than your average drug. I take it like they tell me to, and at first, nothing really happens, and the scientists are looking kinda bummed out. Then, there’s this kinda popping noise and my stomach kinda pokes out to about half the size it is now. The scientists look kinda surprised and run over with a mini X-ray screen. When they hold it over my midsection, lo and behold, I’ve got eggs,” she says, patting her belly with one hand.
rows.translation: 这位深色皮肤的女孩移开目光，摆弄了一会儿自己的牌子。“嗯，算是吧，但也不完全是。这个本来是给已经怀孕的人用的，不过医学试验需要没怀孕的人充当对照组。我报名是因为参加试验能拿到一笔不错的报酬，而且住在边缘星球，日子并不总是那么好过。等我到了测试地点，他们给了我一种软糖似的药，看起来更像糖果，一点也不像普通药品。我按他们说的吃了，起初什么也没发生，那些科学家看起来都有点沮丧。后来，传来一声像是什么东西弹开的响声，我的肚子就鼓到了现在一半左右的大小。科学家们一脸惊讶地跑过来，拿着一块迷你X光屏。他们把屏幕放在我腹部上方一照，好家伙，我肚子里居然有蛋，”她说着，用一只手拍了拍自己的肚子。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dark skinned girl averts her eyes and fiddles with her sign for a moment. “Well, kinda, not really. So this was made for people who were already pregnant, but they needed to test it on people who weren’t pregnant as a control group for the medical trials. I signed up because they were offering good money to be part of the trials and living on the fringe planets isn’t always the easiest. So when I get to the testing site, they give me this gummy medicine that looks more like a piece of candy than your average drug. I take it like they tell me to, and at first, nothing really happens, and the scientists are looking kinda bummed out. Then, there’s this kinda popping noise and my stomach kinda pokes out to about half the size it is now. The scientists look kinda surprised and run over with a mini X-ray screen. When they hold it over my midsection, lo and behold, I’ve got eggs,” she says, patting her belly with one hand."

rows.original: You chuckle, telling her that part of her problem might be people thinking she’s just pregnant in a bar. She frowns slightly and removes her hand.
rows.translation: 你轻笑一声，告诉她，她的问题或许有一部分在于酒吧里的人只会以为她怀孕了。她微微皱眉，把手从肚子上拿开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle, telling her that part of her problem might be people thinking she’s just pregnant in a bar. She frowns slightly and removes her hand."

rows.original: “Yeah I guess, but you only got half the story. The trial I was in was more than a year ago. Apparently the test drug they gave me was a little too effective, so whenever these eggs come out more replace them near immediately. The drug that’s going to markets is improved, no permanent effects. They must have realized people would make that mistake like you thought though. The company gave me a job promoting the product, and it’s okay money - enough to rent a room on the station,” she says, sounding a little more optimistic at the end.
rows.translation: “是啊，我想也是，不过你只听了一半。参加那次试验已经是一年多以前的事了。显然，他们给我的试验药效果有点太强，所以每当这些蛋排出来，新的蛋几乎立刻就会补上。即将上市的药已经改良过，不会有永久性影响。他们肯定也意识到，别人会像你说的那样误会我。不过公司给了我一份推广产品的工作，薪水还算可以——足够在空间站租个房间，”她说道，临近结尾时语气显得乐观了一些。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah I guess, but you only got half the story. The trial I was in was more than a year ago. Apparently the test drug they gave me was a little too effective, so whenever these eggs come out more replace them near immediately. The drug that’s going to markets is improved, no permanent effects. They must have realized people would make that mistake like you thought though. The company gave me a job promoting the product, and it’s okay money - enough to rent a room on the station,” she says, sounding a little more optimistic at the end."

rows.original: You mention that you heard her mentioning “layings” and ask what that entails. She blushes and sets the sign off to the side, weaving her fingers together and looking around to see if anyone else is listening.
rows.translation: 你提到自己听见她说了“产蛋”，便问那究竟是怎么回事。她红着脸把牌子放到一旁，十指交扣在一起，环顾四周，看看有没有其他人在偷听。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou mention that you heard her mentioning “layings” and ask what that entails. She blushes and sets the sign off to the side, weaving her fingers together and looking around to see if anyone else is listening."

rows.original: “Well, so I’m full of eggs, and even though they keep coming back, laying is fairly regular. Usually it’s just once every couple days, but they can be... coerced to come out sooner. If you get over the fact that they came out of a person, they taste really sweet,” she says with an embarrassed smile. Without really thinking about it, you tell her you’d be happy to assist her with laying eggs if she ever wanted help. The dusky saleswoman’s pink bunny ears turn beet red as she takes in your words, and you realize what you said.
rows.translation: “嗯，我肚子里都是蛋。虽然它们会不断补上，但产蛋的周期其实很规律。通常每隔几天才会产一次，不过也可以...诱使它们提前出来。只要别介意它们是从别人身体里出来的，其实吃起来非常甜，”她带着窘迫的微笑说道。你没怎么多想便告诉她，如果她想找人帮忙，你很乐意协助她产蛋。这位深色皮肤的女推销员听懂你的话后，粉红色兔耳顿时红得像要滴血，而你也这才意识到自己说了什么。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, so I’m full of eggs, and even though they keep coming back, laying is fairly regular. Usually it’s just once every couple days, but they can be... coerced to come out sooner. If you get over the fact that they came out of a person, they taste really sweet,” she says with an embarrassed smile. Without really thinking about it, you tell her you’d be happy to assist her with laying eggs if she ever wanted help. The dusky saleswoman’s pink bunny ears turn beet red as she takes in your words, and you realize what you said."

rows.original: “W-well, if you really wanted too, I’d be okay with it. If I just wait for it to happen, they kinda build up and get heavier. My name is Shelly by the way,” she says, brushing her hair away from her face. You aren’t sure if she’s desperate or if you made that big of an impression being the only person who came up and talked to her, but it seems she’d be willing to let you help her, and all that entails. You give her your first name in return and tell her you’ll probably be back soon.
rows.translation: “如——如果你真的愿意，我也可以。我如果只是等它们自己出来，蛋就会越积越多，也越来越沉。对了，我叫谢莉，”她一边说，一边把头发从脸旁拨开。你不知道她是走投无路了，还是因为你是唯一主动过来和她交谈的人，给她留下了如此深刻的印象；但看来她愿意让你帮忙，也接受这件事所包含的一切。你也告诉她自己的名字，并表示很快还会再来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well, if you really wanted too, I’d be okay with it. If I just wait for it to happen, they kinda build up and get heavier. My name is Shelly by the way,” she says, brushing her hair away from her face. You aren’t sure if she’s desperate or if you made that big of an impression being the only person who came up and talked to her, but it seems she’d be willing to let you help her, and all that entails. You give her your first name in return and tell her you’ll probably be back soon."
